**About United Learning League**
United Learning League (ULL) is building a future-ready network of schools that combines academic excellence, student wellbeing, innovation and holistic development. With a vision to build 30 schools over five years, ULL invites exceptional professionals to help establish its Nagarbhavi campus and create a lasting educational legacy. Founding-team members can help shape systems and culture from day one, with potential advancement into campus and network leadership as ULL grows.
  
  
**Why Join the Founding Team?**
Build a school, not just a job role. Contribute to the campus culture and operating systems from the beginning, collaborate with ambitious colleagues and be considered for expanded responsibilities as ULL grows. Career progression and rewards depend on performance and organisational requirements.

***Interested***
***Candidates***

* Walk In Interview Timings: 11 am to 3 pm
* For any coordination and date availability, Call/ WhatsApp on: +919187715719 (Ms Mamatha)

Job Description
  
  
**About The Role**
A reputed school in Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support its marketing, admissions and communication activities. The selected candidate will create engaging visual content that reflects the school's identity and communicates effectively with parents, students and the wider community.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design posters, banners, brochures, flyers, advertisements and other promotional materials.
* Create engaging social media posts, reels covers, digital creatives and campaign artwork.
* Develop admission campaign materials, school event announcements, invitations and certificates.
* Prepare presentations, newsletters, prospectuses and other school communication materials.
* Maintain consistency in colours, typography, layouts and overall visual identity.
* Coordinate with marketing, admissions, academic and management teams to understand design requirements
* Manage multiple assignments, incorporate feedback and deliver quality work within deadlines.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related field preferred.
* Previous graphic design experience preferred; candidates with a strong portfolio may be considered.
* Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Knowledge of CorelDRAW and Adobe InDesign will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of social media formats, digital creatives, typography and visual composition.
* Creative thinking, attention to detail, communication skills and ability to meet deadlines
* Willingness to work full-time from the school location.

**Preferred Skills**
Graphic Design
  
  

* Social Media Creatives
* Branding & Visual Identity
* Poster & Brochure Design
* Canva
* Photoshop
* Illustrator
* Presentation Design
* Digital Marketing Creatives

**How To Apply**
Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with a portfolio or samples of previous design work. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview and a practical design assessment.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Any Degree, Diploma

title: Senior ICT Designer Engineer
description:
**Overview**
At
**PM Group**
, our vision is to create a world where science and technology transform lives. Powered by exceptional people, digital innovation, and technical excellence, we deliver next-generation facilities that our clients rely on and society depends on.
  
  
With over
**50 years of experience**
and a team of
**4,000+ professionals**
across Europe, the UK, Asia, and the USA, we specialise in the design, construction, and commissioning of high-tech facilities for the world’s leading pharmaceutical, data centre, food, medical technology, advanced manufacturing, and energy companies.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Due to our continued success in securing large-scale and complex projects, we are now looking for an experienced
**Senior ICT Designer Engineer**
to join our growing Bangalore office.
  
  
This opportunity comes at an exciting time for our India business. We have proudly reached a milestone of
**200 talented professionals**
in Bangalore — a testament to our sustained growth, strong leadership, and the collaborative spirit that defines our multi-discipline teams.
  
  
Since establishing our presence in India in 2010, the Bangalore office has evolved into a centre of excellence, supporting major international Life Sciences projects through integrated, multi-office execution. Our success reflects not just expansion in numbers, but the strength of our culture, innovation mindset, and commitment to delivering engineering excellence.
  
  
As Anandhi Sathyamurthy, Managing Director – India, rightly says:
  
  
*“This milestone reflects the power of our teamwork and the bright future we’re building together.”*
If you are passionate about delivering complex engineering solutions and want to be part of a high-performing, globally connected team, we would love to hear from you
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Reporting to the Senior Project Management, Stakeholders, Clients and managing, coordinating and producing ICT designs.
* Reporting directly to the Department Line Manager on progress on all projects and status
* Analysing complex engineering problems and offer effective solutions.
* The development of scope documentation for FEED (Front End Engineering Design), concept and basis of design and detailed design documents is required. The ability to take the process right through all the detail design phases and the approval processes whilst communication with all stakeholders and other disciplines is paramount.
* Liaise with all disciplines and management through the project to assure all ICT standards are compliant and adhered to in design documentation and drawings, single line diagrams and the room layouts and are correctly modelled in.
* Providing support to fee and capital budget proposals as required. Support the Management team in cost estimation and tender bid evaluations, the development of bill of materials and cost estimates.
* Assembling and managing bid, approval, and construction issue of ICT packages in an efficient and lean manner.
* Attending and participating in client and PM Group meetings. Chairing ICT meetings with all the relevant stakeholders, contractors, design engineers and Client interface colleagues
* Producing up to date ICT Designs to incorporate the following systems:

+ Containment Pathways Primary & Secondary Routes, and types of containment

- Tiered Containment systems and understanding of parameters for distance segregation etc.

+ Copper & Fibre Cabling – Knowledge of all ISP & OSP solutions and latest market infrastructure available and best suited to Clients budget and requirements.
+ Racks – Open Racks/ Enclosed/ Pod Configurations
+ ICT Room Design – stick built and Modular designs.
+ Wireless (ROIP, DAS, WIFI, DECT, RF)
+ LANs – Business & Corporate VLANs, Shop Floor networks and all associated VLANs, Security Networks, BAS VLANs, AV Networks, Wireless Networks including Predictive heat map models and post site surveys.
+ Power, Cooling & Earthing
+ Fire Stopping & Suppression
+ MDF/IDF/POE design philosophies and requirements as per industry standards and Client standard requirements.
+ Participate with Revit/BIM360 modelling of modular data centres, MDFs, IDFs etc. assuring all ICT criteria are followed and provide guidance to other engineering disciplines the client requirements.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Who are we?**
Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.
  
  
At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.
  
  
This intelligence powers our entire product suite.
  
  

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.
  
  
Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.
  
  

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.

Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
  
  
Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.
  
  
At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
  
  
The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.
  
  
**Customers**
: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
  
  
**Investors**
: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.
  
  
**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.

* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!**
**About The Role**
Whatfix builds software that helps people work — guiding users through complex applications in real time, across web, mobile, and desktop. Our Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) powers how companies create, distribute, and manage in-app guidance at scale. As we go AI-native across the platform, the design problems are getting harder, more novel, and more interesting.
  
  
We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for a core area of the DAP product. This isn't a role for someone who needs a defined process to operate. It's a role for someone who can hold a clear vision for where the product is going, think through what matters next, and ship work that matters right now.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Product Design Across DAP**

* Own the end-to-end design of features across DAP's guidance creation, distribution, and management surfaces — web, mobile, and desktop.
* Lead your domain from discovery through delivery: research, ideation, prototyping, specification, and handoff.
* Define and maintain design quality within your product area — interaction models, usability standards, and consistency with the broader design system.
* Scrutinize requirements. Push back when what's being asked for isn't the right thing to build.

**AI-Native Design Work**

* Design for AI-powered features where patterns don't yet exist. That means inventing interaction models, not adapting existing ones.
* Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — building functional POCs in code, running rapid experiments, pushing early versions to understand lived experience before it's polished.
* Help define what AI-native UX means for digital adoption: for the customers building guidance, and for the end users receiving it.

**Research and Experimentation**

* Lead qualitative and quantitative research for your product area.
* Favor real-world experimentation over controlled environments. Get something working, get it in front of real users, and learn from how it actually behaves.
* Synthesize findings into clear direction and present them to cross-functional partners and leadership with confidence.

**Collaboration and Mentorship**

* Operate as a peer in planning and prioritization conversations — contributing to how problems are framed, not just how they're solved.
* Mentor the junior designer joining the team. Share knowledge, give direct feedback, raise the bar.
* Contribute to shared design standards and the evolution of design practices on the team.

**Required**
**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 4+ years of product design experience in SaaS or enterprise software. You're a Senior Designer — not a mid-level on the path to senior.
* A portfolio that demonstrates owning complex problem spaces end-to-end: research, design decisions, tradeoffs, and shipped work.
* Active use of AI tools in your design workflow — building POCs, using LLMs for synthesis, working across Figma and code. Not aspirational. Current practice.
* Strong interaction and UX design fundamentals — you know when to follow conventions and when to break them.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, on problems that don't have established answers.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience designing for enterprise SaaS platforms, particularly tools used by non-technical users or content authors.
* Familiarity with digital adoption, in-app guidance, workflow automation, or onboarding experiences.
* Experience designing agent management, AI-generated, or AI-assisted outputs.

**How You'll Show Up**

* You design to solve problems now. You hold a vision for the future, build shared understanding for what's next, and ship in the present. Work stays connected to current OKRs, not some future state that keeps moving.
* You experiment to learn. A rough functional POC pushed to real users tells you more than weeks of structured testing. You're comfortable with that tradeoff.
* You're clear and direct. You can articulate what you're designing, why, and what you're trading off. You expect the same from the people around you.
* You're a peer, not an executor. You're in the room when problems are being framed, not just when solutions need to be drawn.
* You're already working at the edge of AI. You're not waiting for the tools to mature or the patterns to be established. You're building now, learning from what you ship, and helping define what AI-native design actually means in practice.

title: Product Designer
description:
Job description:
  
  
**About Narayana Health:**
Narayana Health is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and operates a network of hospitals in India and Overseas. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, affordable healthcare services to the broader population. Narayana Health Group is Indias leading healthcare provider and one of the largest hospital groups in the country, with a network of 21 hospitals, 5 heart centres, and 19 primary care facilities. The NH group treats over 2.6 Million patients every year from over 78 countries, covering 30+ medical specialities.   Our Centers of Excellence help in treating Adult & Pediatric patients, and we have one of the largest transplant centers in India. We have a strong presence across 17 locations in India, and an overseas hospital in the Cayman Islands, USA. Two of our hospitals have international accreditation from the Joint Commission International (JCI), and 19 hospitals have domestic accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals (NABH). For more details, please refer to our website at: https://www.narayanahealth.org  
**About Medha:**
Medha is the Advanced Analytics & AI arm of Narayana Health, focused on transforming healthcare through data, intelligence, and thoughtfully designed digital products. Our mission is to simplify decision‑making across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations. Our products power large health systems, influence mission‑critical workflows, and support clinical and non‑clinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care. For more details, please refer to our website at https://www.medha-analytics.ai/  
**Why Join Medha:**

* Shape healthcare-intelligence products that influence real clinical and operational decisions.
* Join an early design team and help define its culture and ways of working.
* Get direct exposure to users clinicians, hospital administrators, and operations teams.
* Build meaningful ownership with guidance from senior designers.

**Role Overview:**

* We are looking for a Product Designer with 3 - 6 years of experience who can independently execute design work while contributing to problem-solving, systems thinking, and cross-functional collaboration.
* You will own clearly defined problem areas, translating complex clinical and financial workflows into intuitive, data-rich experiences while working closely with senior designers.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Design Execution:**

* Create user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and interactive prototypes.
* Deliver scalable solutions across web and mobile, iterating quickly on feedback.

**Problem Solving:**

* Break down complex clinical and financial workflows into clear, structured interactions.
* Ask strong why questions and apply structured thinking to reach the root of a problem.

**Design Systems & Foundations:**

* Use and actively contribute to the design system to enable consistency and reuse.
* Apply UX/UI principles and information architecture across all work.

**Accessibility & Craft:**

* Design with accessibility built in from the start.
* Maintain a high bar for typography, spacing, hierarchy, and interaction detail.

**Collaboration & Communication:**

* Partner with PMs, engineers, and domain experts throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate design decisions with clear rationale to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Research & Insights:**

* Run and support discovery interviews, workflow deep-dives, workshops, and usability testing.
* Use behavioral analytics and research to identify friction and translate findings into product improvements.

**Tools & AI:**

* Work in Figma across all stages of flows, UI, prototyping, and developer handoff.
* Use behavioral and testing tools such as Hotjar to validate designs and surface user friction.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate exploration, iteration, and synthesis.

**Education Background:**

* B.Des or M.Des (Interaction Design, Industrial Design, Communication Design, Information Design, HCD)

**Key Requirements:**

**Must-Have:**

* 3 - 6 years of product design experience.
* Strong portfolio with end-to-end work and clear problem-solving.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Solid grasp of design systems, accessibility, and UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Problem-solving mindset, structured, comfortable with ambiguity.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Enterprise, workflow-heavy, or data-rich product experience.
* Healthcare domain familiarity.
* Exposure to user research and usability testing.
* Experience with AI design tools.
* Interest and ability in graphic design and visual communication.

4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. **What your new challenge will look like**

* Analyzing and optimizing end-to-end supply chain processes, including procure-to-pay, inventory management, warehouse operations, production supply and order-to-cash.
* Designing and configuring SAP Inventory Management processes, including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, transfer postings, movement types and physical inventory.
* Configuring SAP S/4HANA Stock Room Management processes, including warehouse structures, storage bins, transfer orders, putaway and picking strategies.
* Supporting SAP EWM functional design and configuration for inbound, outbound and internal warehouse processes.
* Analyzing integration requirements between SAP MM, SD, PP, IM, Stock Room Management and EWM to ensure consistent material flows and inventory visibility.
* Supporting S/4HANA transformation projects, process harmonization and migration from classic warehouse management solutions.
* Translating business process requirements into functional specifications and supporting integration with technical development teams.
* Independently delivering assigned functional workstreams, including process design, customizing, testing, defect resolution, cutover and go-live support.
* Facilitating process workshops with international stakeholders and supporting cross-functional solution design.
* Contributing to presales activities and the continuous development of 4flow's SAP supply chain solutions.

**Why you belong at 4flow**

* You hold a degree in engineering, supply chain management, business information systems, computer science or a comparable discipline.
* You have approximately 6–9 years of relevant SAP logistics consulting experience.
* You possess strong functional knowledge of SAP Inventory Management and SAP WM / S/4HANA Stock Room Management.
* You have practical SAP EWM process knowledge and experience in EWM configuration or implementation activities.
* You understand end-to-end material flows across procurement, warehouse management, production and distribution.
* You have hands-on experience with SAP customizing and configuration in relevant logistics modules.
* You have participated in at least one full-cycle SAP implementation or S/4HANA transformation project.
* You can independently analyze business requirements, design integrated functional solutions and manage assigned project deliverables.
* You demonstrate strong analytical thinking, process orientation and communication skills.
* You enjoy working in international and agile project environments.

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA migration and warehouse management transformation.
* Knowledge of embedded and decentralized SAP EWM.
* Experience with production supply, cross-plant logistics and intercompany stock transfers.
* Exposure to manufacturing, automotive, industrial or distribution environments.
* Experience with international SAP template rollout and process standardization projects.

**What we offer**

* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model

* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

title: Hub Lead & Senior Facilitator
description:
**A new Nook is coming to Bengaluru, and it will be bigger than any before.**

Project DEFY is a non-profit based in Bangalore. We help communities set up Nooks: self-designed learning spaces where people learn on their own terms, with no fixed curriculum, exams or teachers.

The Bangalore Community Learning Hub opens in February 2027. It brings together sport, self-directed learning, hands-on labs, wellbeing, entrepreneurship and onward pathways in one place, for young people from disadvantaged backgrounds. They move between these at their own pace, and the community helps shape the space.

We're looking for a Hub Lead & Senior Facilitator to build it with us from day one. You'll spend most of your time with learners, families and the community: bringing people together, enabling collective thinking, questioning and care, and helping people turn ideas into action. You'll lead a small, growing team of fellows and lab facilitators by example.

**This is for you if**
you want to work in education but not in a conventional classroom, enable learning without teaching, and solve problems without being patronising. It isn't a job where every instruction is ready for you. The hub's success depends on your own thinking, your willingness to experiment, and your love of engaging people in dialogue.

**What you'll do**

* **Facilitation:**
  co-facilitate in the Nook, lead reflection circles and problem-solving and design sessions, and run collective narrative practice sessions (such as Tree of Life) with learners and families.
* **Community and outreach:**
  build relationships with families, youth groups, local leaders, schools and NGOs; bring young people into the hub; organise community events and showcases; represent the hub locally.
* **Learners' journeys:**
  keep an overview of each learner's path, from sport into the Nook, the labs, the business track and onward pathways, and notice when someone is ready for a next step or drifting away.
* **Wellbeing and safeguarding:**
  be the hub's safeguarding lead, connect young people to the right support, and look after the team's wellbeing.
* **Team and operations:**
  lead the local team day to day, coordinate partner-run parts of the hub, run the site, and manage small budgets within DEFY's procedures.
* **Documentation and learning:**
  collect attendance and learning data, document community stories, and bring what you see on the ground into how the programme grows.

Most of your time is spent with people, not at a desk: about 70% with learners and the community in the first year.

**Essential**

* 2–5 years of hands-on work with communities or young people
* Experience facilitating groups, ideally in non-formal or alternative learning
* Experience coordinating a small team, volunteers or a community group
* Kannada and English, plus comfort working in the languages the community speaks
* Able to be based at the hub in Bangalore, including some evenings and weekends

**Bonus**

* Experience with self-directed learning, design thinking or narrative practice
* Knowledge of child protection and safeguarding
* Living near the community, or a link to it
* Experience of community-building in disadvantaged urban communities

**What you get:**
a founding role in a new model of learning, room to experiment and grow as a leader, training in self-directed learning and collective narrative practice, regular mentoring, and a place in DEFY's global network of Nooks.

**Details:**
Full-time · Bangalore · 12 months, renewable each year · Up to ₹45,000 a month, based on experience · Start as soon as possible, ahead of the February 2027 opening

**Who we especially encourage:**
We strongly encourage applications from individuals from under-represented or marginalised communities, women, persons with disabilities and those who identify themselves as LGBTQI or other identities that continue to struggle to find mainstream acceptance. Besides ensuring opportunities for those with fewer privileges than others, we also truly believe that your experiences in experiencing challenges yourself makes you a strong candidate who may be able to relate with and understand our learning communities who themselves have experienced severe marginalisation. We have found such empathy to be the most important guide as we design and execute programs and new ideas.

title: Senior Functional Consultant – SAP TM
description:
**About 4flow**
4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end-to-end solutions.
  
  
Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next-generation, AI-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Senior Functional Consultant SAP TM, you will support our clients throughout the project lifecycle, from transportation process analysis and solution design to configuration, implementation and go-live, with a focus on transportation planning, execution and freight management.
  
  
**What your new challenge will look like**

* Analyzing existing transportation and logistics processes to identify opportunities for optimization, standardization and automation.
* Designing and configuring SAP TM processes covering transportation demand, freight unit building, transportation planning, freight orders and freight bookings.
* Supporting transportation planning and optimization, including freight consolidation, routing, carrier selection, load planning and capacity management.
* Configuring transportation execution processes, including freight tendering, shipment execution, event management and exception handling.
* Designing and implementing freight charge calculation, rate management, freight agreements and freight settlement processes.
* Maintaining and configuring relevant SAP TM master data, including locations, business partners, transportation lanes, resources and equipment.
* Supporting SAP TM integration with SAP S/4HANA, SD, MM, EWM and external logistics platforms.
* Translating transportation business requirements into functional specifications and collaborating with technical development teams.
* Independently delivering assigned functional workstreams, including customizing, integration testing, defect resolution, cutover and go-live support.
* Conducting workshops with international clients and collaborating with transportation planners, logistics operations teams and business stakeholders.
* Supporting presales activities, solution demonstrations and the further development of 4flow's transportation management solutions.

**Why you belong at 4flow**

* You hold a degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain management, business information systems or a comparable discipline.
* You have approximately 6–9 years of relevant SAP consulting experience, including strong hands-on SAP TM experience.
* You possess sound functional knowledge of transportation planning, freight execution, carrier management and freight settlement.
* You have practical experience with SAP TM customizing and configuration.
* You understand end-to-end transportation processes and the operational challenges of transportation planning and execution.
* You have participated in at least one full-cycle SAP TM implementation project.
* You have experience with SAP TM integration into relevant S/4HANA logistics processes.
* You can independently analyze business requirements, design functional solutions and deliver assigned workstreams.
* You demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities and effective stakeholder communication.
* You enjoy working in international and agile project environments.
* You communicate confidently in English and are willing to travel internationally when required. German language skills are an advantage, not a requirement.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA embedded TM.
* Knowledge of transportation cockpit, planning profiles and optimization capabilities.
* Experience with road, ocean, air or multimodal transportation.
* Exposure to carrier connectivity, EDI/API integration and third-party logistics platforms.
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, retail, logistics service provider or 3PL/4PL environments.

**What we offer**

* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being.
* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About the Team:**

You’ll work with a team that’s reimagining how India interacts with a bank - powered by some of the smartest minds and the most intuitive tech in the ecosystem.

If you love impact, autonomy, and velocity, this is your playground

**About the Role:**

As an Analyst at
**slice**
, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Growth, Credit, Product, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Own the Full Analytics Spectrum**

**Think from First Principles:**
Break problems down to their core, use data and reasoning to uncover insights that move the business and make life simpler for our customers.

* **Descriptive**
  – Build clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards.
* **Diagnostic**
  – Dig into the
  *why*
  behind trends and performance.
* **Prescriptive**
  – Turn insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions.

**Drive Impact at Scale**

* Take full ownership of complex, high-impact problems that shape key org KPIs and influence strategic direction.
* Lead end-to-end analytics projects in close partnership with Product, Business, and Strategy teams — from framing the problem to shaping solutions that drive measurable outcomes.

**Partner with Leaders Across Teams**

* Work side by side with functional leaders and business partners across Growth, Retention, Product, Strategy, Engineering, Marketing, Fraud, and Ops — asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving.
* **Tell Stories That Drive Action:**
  Turn complex data into simple, actionable stories — crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale.

**What You'll Need:**

* **Hustle + Heart:**
  You’ve got the drive to build data-driven solutions that touch millions of lives - and the curiosity to keep asking
  *“what’s next?”*
* **1-3 years**
  of experience solving complex business problems, uncovering insights, and driving key decisions that move metrics at scale.
* **AI-Native Mindset:**
  Comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude, or CoPilots to boost your speed, scale, and smarts.
* **You speak data fluently:**
  Python and Advanced SQL are your second languages, and you’re comfortable in PySpark, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it.
* **Problem-solver at your core:**
  You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces — and crafting smart, scalable solutions that stick.
* **Natural Storyteller:**
  You don’t just present numbers — you craft narratives that align stakeholders and inspire action.
* **Always learning:**
  Whether it’s a new tool, technology, or technique, you’re excited to expand your toolkit.
* **Visualization is your superpower:**
  Whether it’s dashboards or decks, you know how to turn numbers into a story people instantly get.

**Life at slice:**

Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:

* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.
* We believe in equality. Period.

At slice, we are committed to building a diverse and talented workforce. We never discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by the applicable law.

We consider all qualified job-seekers with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the applicable law. Additionally, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities in order to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Come join our crew!

**About us**

slice

A new bank for a new India

slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.

Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

title: Senior IT & Administration Coordinator (3-4 years experience)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and
 

developing deep large-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI,
 

computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction
 

industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution,
**“Kael”**
— an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with
 

real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
**“Observance”**
, uses LiDAR scanning,
 

thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built
 

intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

 

**Role Description**

We are looking for a proactive Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint and security backbone as Inkers scales. You will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end to end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. You will anticipate needs and follow vendors and renewals through to closure, while keeping the workplace infrastructure and services our teams rely on every day running smoothly.

 

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.
 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive): licensing, mail flow, retention policies and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Manage identity and access across Active Directory, Group Policy and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): user provisioning and deprovisioning, security groups, MFA and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro or equivalent) across Windows, macOS and iOS: enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles and app deployment.
* Provide IT support for hardware, software, network, email and systems; set up and configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other equipment.
* Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licences and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control and other office and site IT infrastructure.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: system setup, access management, ID card and asset handover.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for IT.
* Travel to project sites when required for 3D scanning, scanning equipment setup and on-site IT support.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software and other IT services; compare quotes and keep contracts, renewals and invoices in order.
* Own workplace infrastructure upkeep: schedule preventive maintenance and servicing of air-conditioning, water purification, pantry and beverage equipment, and biometric/attendance devices with the respective vendors.
* Negotiate, obtain and renew Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for IT and workplace equipment; maintain an AMC and warranty tracker with renewal dates.
* Plan and procure office equipment, consumables and everyday workplace essentials so that supplies never run short; review and shortlist service vendors (such as pantry and catering) periodically.
* Arrange employee ID cards and business cards as part of onboarding and role changes.
* Be proactive: keep a preventive-maintenance calendar, raise renewals and replacements ahead of time, and flag issues before they affect the team.

**Qualifications**

 

* 4+ years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, computer hardware, networking and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Experience in vendor coordination, procurement and handling AMCs and renewals for IT and workplace equipment.
* Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

**Language Requirements**

 

* Mandatory: fluency in English, Hindi and Kannada (spoken and written).
* **Added advantage:**
  any additional language (e.g. Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi).

 

**Key Qualities**

 

Ownership, proactiveness, strong follow-up, vendor coordination, discretion with confidential information, and a service mindset.
 

 

**Work Location : HSR Layout, Bangalore (On-site : Monday to Saturday)**

description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:**
IT Operations Lead

**Primary Job Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

Yes

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone to run IT for our India office in Bengaluru. Day to day, that means setting up and looking after laptops, sorting out problems as they come up, managing Microsoft 365 and Intune for the India team, and dealing with local vendors. You will be our main IT person on the ground in India, working closely with the Corporate Technology team in North America, who look after security policy and the more complex Microsoft administration.

We do not have a proper service desk in India yet, and we would like you to set one up. That includes deciding how tickets are categorised, what hours are covered, who is on rotation, and how quickly we respond. If you have done something like this before, even for a small team, we would like to hear about it.

This is a hands-on job. As the team grows there will be room to lead people, but for now you will be doing most of the work yourself, and we are looking for someone who enjoys that.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Laptops and other hardware for our India team, from ordering and setup through to repairs, returns, and keeping the asset register accurate
* Enrolling and managing devices in Intune, including compliance and app deployment
* Day-to-day Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration for India: user accounts, groups, licences, MFA, and access
* Onboarding and offboarding for India staff, so that new joiners are ready on their first day and leavers' access and devices are handled properly
* Support tickets from the India team, and first-line support for colleagues in other regions during your working hours
* The technology in our Bengaluru office: network, Wi-Fi, firewall, printers, and meeting rooms
* Local vendors, warranty claims, and IT purchasing for India
* Setting up and running our service desk, and writing the runbooks the team will rely on
* Keeping devices secure and up to date (encryption, endpoint protection, patching) in line with our security policies, and raising anything suspicious straight away

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 to 8 years in IT operations, where you have been the person responsible for IT at an office or business unit, or have looked after client companies at a managed service provider
* Solid hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and a working understanding of Microsoft Defender
* Experience managing devices with an MDM. We use Intune, but experience with Jamf or a similar tool is fine
* Comfortable using PowerShell or Microsoft Graph alongside the admin portals. For example, you could pull a list of users or check licence usage with a script
* Good at diagnosing and fixing hardware problems, with a sound grasp of networking basics such as IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN
* You have set up or improved a service desk before, even a small one, and can talk us through what you did
* Clear spoken and written English. You will be working with colleagues in North America every day, as well as junior team members in India
* You like hands-on work. There is room to lead a team as we grow, but this role starts with you doing the work yourself

**Good to Have**

* Basic Linux skills, such as moving around the file system, managing files, and reading logs
* Experience with Fortinet or similar firewalls
* Experience with Freshservice or another service desk tool
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104. Any certification on your resume should be current

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* In your first 30 days: you have picked up India support tickets, got to know how our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune environment is set up, and checked the India asset register against who actually has which device.
* By 60 days: you are handling onboarding and offboarding for India on your own, with the steps written down, and all India devices are enrolled and compliant in Intune.
* By 90 days: a first version of the India service desk is up and running, with agreed categories, coverage hours, and response times, and the most common fixes are documented.

**How We Will Measure Success**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiners' devices ready on day one, and leavers' devices returned on time
* Accuracy of the asset register
* Device compliance in Intune
* Feedback from the people you support

**Interview Process**

* A screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, which includes a few short technical questions
* A technical conversation with a member of our Corporate Technology team
* A final round in person at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. This includes a practical session in a Microsoft Entra and Azure test environment, and a conversation about hardware and device management

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.
  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**
You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.

**We Celebrate Impact**
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

**A Collaborative Culture**
You'll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.

**Perks you'll appreciate:**

**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice

* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays

* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

**Retirement and Financial Security**

* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)

* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

**Professional Growth**

* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

**Flexible Work**

* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Accommodations:**

FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

**Candidate Privacy:**

Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Equal Opportunity:**

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**

FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.

title: Sharepoint Operation Analyst
description:

26WD101813
  
  
**Position Overview**
This is a full-time position for an IT Infrastructure Specialist – SharePoint to join the Autodesk Collaboration Team in Bengaluru. The role is part of our 24x7 support operations and requires hands-on knowledge of SharePoint Online, along with an interest in developing broader Microsoft 365 collaboration skills.
  
  
The role focuses on operational support, troubleshooting, service monitoring, access management, and routine SharePoint administration. The successful candidate will work alongside experienced team members to maintain reliable collaboration services while continuing to develop technical expertise across Microsoft 365 technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide operational support and administration for SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 collaboration services.
* Troubleshoot issues related to site access, permissions, sharing, storage, synchronization, search, and user access.
* Administer SharePoint sites, permissions, groups, sharing settings, and standard service configurations.
* Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and respond to incidents and service requests within defined service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Perform routine administrative tasks and reporting using PowerShell and Microsoft 365 administration tools.
* Assist with site migrations, configuration changes, incident investigations, and service improvement activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, the Service Desk, Identity, Security, and other teams to resolve issues.
* Escalate complex or high-impact issues in accordance with established operational procedures.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of relevant Level 2 (L2) support experience with SharePoint Online or Microsoft 365 collaboration services.
* Hands-on knowledge of SharePoint Online administration, including sites, permissions, sharing, groups, and access management.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Microsoft 365 Engineer**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Engagement Type:**
1-Year Fixed-term contract
  
  
**About Us**
Dymon Asia Capital (“Dymon Asia”), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The firm’s flagship hedge fund product is the Multi-Strategy Investment Fund (MSIF), an Asia-focused multi-manager multi-strategy fund that seeks to generate absolute consistent uncorrelated returns from emerging and developed markets.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Dymon Asia operates from nine offices across the Middle East and Asia, including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dubai, Shanghai, Mumbai, and Kuala Lumpur. Our platform is built on our people. We bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experience across our multi-strategy and private markets businesses. Maintaining a collaborative culture where our people are set up to do their best work is central to how we operate.
  
  
The Microsoft 365 Engineer builds and operates the firm's Microsoft 365 estate, covering collaboration, endpoint management, identity and compliance for trading, research and corporate teams. Reporting to the Head of Engineering and IT, this hands-on role works mainly in the M365 admin center, Intune, Entra ID and Purview, partnering with the Network, Windows, Linux and Cloud architects and the Cybersecurity Architect to take designs from build to steady-state operation. We favour simple, well-governed configurations, with uptime, data integrity and change discipline as priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and support Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, including site structures, permissions and data segregation.
* Manage Entra ID, Conditional Access and PIM; run Intune compliance, configuration, app protection and Autopilot across corporate and BYOD devices.
* Tune Defender for Office 365 and implement Purview controls (labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, insider risk), with changes going through cybersecurity review.
* Operate M365 data backup and run regular restore tests against agreed recovery objectives.
* Deliver tenant-to-tenant and on-prem-to-cloud migrations, move legacy tools to M365, and govern the Microsoft Copilot rollout.
* Act as the M365 escalation point, manage licensing and cost, automate routine work, and ensure alignment with MAS TRM and NIST CSF 2.0, supporting audits and penetration tests.

**Job Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and related collaboration and endpoint technologies, including configuring and supporting Intune and M365 workloads in production and delivering Microsoft 365 migrations and modernisation projects.
* Experience working in a regulated financial services environment; hedge fund or asset management experience is highly advantageous.
* Strong knowledge of core workloads (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams including voice/telephony, and OneDrive for Business) and Intune/Microsoft Endpoint Manager (compliance policies, configuration profiles, app protection and Windows Autopilot).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, RBAC and Privileged Identity Management, Defender for Office 365, and Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery, insider risk).
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and Microsoft Graph API for administration and reporting, and Power Automate for workflow.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102) and Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) required or strongly preferred; SC-300, MS-700 or SC-401 are advantageous. Holders of the legacy Enterprise Administrator Expert credential (MS-100/MS-101/MS-500) will be evaluated on equivalent skills.
* Experience working alongside security, infrastructure and project teams to deliver technical changes, with clear communication skills to explain technical issues to end users and stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 configuration, licensing and adoption rollout, exposure to trading, research or market data infrastructure, and familiarity with Azure/Entra hybrid identity and networking concepts are a plus.

A master's degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

Compliance
  
  
Governance, Risk and Control
  
  
Analytics and reporting
  
  
IT Tools and application
  
  
Business Partnering
  
  
Digital savvy
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Management of change application
  
  
Systems and Technology
  
  
Technical Data Management
  
  
**GENERAL INFORMATION**

It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**SOC Analyst Role - JD**

* **24x7 Monitoring Systems and Networks:**
   SOC Analysts continuously monitor networks and systems for suspicious activities or anomalies that could indicate a security breach. This involves analyzing logs, alerts, and other data to identify potential threats.
* **Incident Detection:**
   Upon identifying a threat, SOC Analysts must quickly evaluate its severity. They use various tools, such as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, to correlate and analyze security data.
* **Investigation and Analysis:**
   When a potential security incident is detected, SOC Analysts are responsible for conducting thorough investigations. They analyze the incident’s details, such as the attack vector, targeted systems, and possible impact, to determine the necessary response.
* **Incident Response:**
   SOC Analysts are not just observers; they actively participate in incident response efforts. This includes containing and remediating security incidents to minimize damage and restore normal operations.
* Threat Analysis, Threat Intelligence
* Knowledge on Threat Hunting will be added advanctage

**Importance of SOC Analysts**

The significance of SOC Analysts extends beyond their daily responsibilities. They are essential for creating a security-conscious culture within organizations. By establishing protocols and best practices, SOC Analysts help prevent potential attacks. Their proactive approach is crucial in safeguarding sensitive data and maintaining the integrity of IT systems.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* **Technical Proficiency:**
   A strong understanding of networking, security protocols, and various cybersecurity tools is vital for effective monitoring and incident response.
* **Analytical Skills:**
   SOC Analysts must be able to analyze vast amounts of data to identify patterns and potential threats.
* **Problem-Solving Abilities:**
   When incidents occur, SOC Analysts need to think quickly and creatively to find solutions that mitigate risks.
* **Communication Skills:**
   Effective communication is crucial for reporting incidents and collaborating with other teams to enhance security measures.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Network Security Operations professional to join the VNO-ESOC team supporting Heritage 3 Network Operations. This role is focused on delivering reliable, secure and efficient operational support across enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, proxy platforms, load balancers, VMware environments and Cisco FMC. The successful candidate will play a key role in incident resolution, service restoration, change implementation, risk management and continuous service improvement while ensuring high availability of customer-facing security services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Incident, Problem and Service Request Management
  
  

* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across firewall, proxy, load balancer, virtualisation and security management platforms within agreed service levels
* Investigate complex service-impacting issues across Cisco, F5, Clavister, Fortinet, NetGuard Firewalls, Symantec/Broadcom Blue Coat Proxy, VMware Hypervisors and Cisco FMC
* Manage L2 and L3 operational escalations including traffic flow analysis, routing issues, NAT issues, VPN connectivity problems, proxy access failures, load balancing issues and performance degradation
* Maintain accurate incident records, root cause analysis, resolution details and closure documentation in line with ITIL practices
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, internal teams and third-party providers to ensure timely resolution of critical incidents
* Identify recurring issues and drive corrective actions to improve service stability and operational efficiency
* Support hardware replacements, vendor escalations, RMA activities and service restoration efforts
* Create and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures and implementation guides

Change and Operational Support
  
  

* Review and validate change requests for technical accuracy, risk assessment, rollback planning and customer impact
* Support platform upgrades, firmware updates, patch deployments, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation and lifecycle management activities
* Ensure operational resilience and availability of critical application and security services

Firewall Operations and Security Policy Management
  
  

* Support day-to-day firewall operations across Fortinet, Cisco, Clavister and NetGuard platforms
* Implement and validate firewall rule changes, access policies, NAT configurations, VPN configurations, routing updates and security zoning requirements
* Participate in policy optimisation, governance and operational best practices

F5 Load Balancer Operations
  
  

* Manage F5 load balancer services including virtual servers, pools, nodes, monitors, SSL profiles, iRules and traffic policies
* Troubleshoot application availability, persistence, SSL offloading, health monitoring, traffic routing and performance issues

Proxy and Web Security Operations
  
  

* Support enterprise proxy technologies including Symantec/Broadcom Proxy and Blue Coat platforms
* Resolve URL filtering issues, authentication failures, SSL inspection concerns, policy mismatches and web traffic routing problems
* Implement approved proxy policy changes, access controls, category exceptions and allow/block list updates

**Who You Are**

* 5-7 years of experience in network security operations, managed security services, telecom operations, hosting environments or enterprise infrastructure support
* Experience leading teams or managing people within operational environments
* Hands-on experience with Fortinet, Cisco, F5, Clavister and NetGuard technologies
* Strong expertise in Cisco FMC including policy management, event analysis, device administration and configuration deployment
* Practical experience with F5 Load Balancers covering virtual servers, pools, nodes, monitors, SSL profiles and traffic management
* Working knowledge of Symantec/Broadcom Proxy and Blue Coat technologies
* Understanding of VMware Hypervisors and virtualised infrastructure environments
* Strong knowledge of routing, switching, DNS, VPNs, NAT, access control, certificates, SSL, TCP/IP and high-availability architectures
* Good understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, change and request management processes
* Experience managing customer-impacting incidents and complex operational changes
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders

Desired Experience
  
  

* Experience in large-scale multi-vendor network security environments
* Exposure to SIEM integrations, security monitoring, syslog analysis and event correlation
* Exposure to automation, scripting, reporting and operational dashboarding
* Experience working within 24x7 managed services or global delivery organisations
* Familiarity with audit requirements, compliance controls, firewall governance and rule review processes
* Exposure to cloud security, SASE, Secure Web Gateway, ZTNA and hybrid infrastructure environments

**Essential Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Telecommunications or equivalent practical experience
* Strong technical knowledge of enterprise network security and infrastructure operations
* ITIL Foundation certification or demonstrated ITIL process knowledge

Desired Certifications
  
  

* Fortinet certifications including NSE, FCNSA or FCNSP
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA Security, CCNP Security or equivalent
* F5 certifications including F5 CA or F5 CTS
* Broadcom/Symantec Proxy or Blue Coat certifications
* Security certifications from Cisco, Clavister, NetGuard or equivalent vendors

Behavioural Competencies

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:

 Our mission is to accelerate innovation by making computing simple, scalable, accessible, and affordable. We provide the infrastructure and services that enable developers to build next generation cloud native applications. We currently host hundreds of thousands of virtual machines and petabytes of data for our customers globally.
   

  

**Partner with the best**
 As an SDET II in Akamai's Cloud Technology Group, design, develop, and maintain automated testing tools ensuring software quality and reliability. Collaborate with diverse teams to identify, analyze, and resolve software defects efficiently. Contribute to improving testing processes and methodologies, fostering innovation and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer in Test II, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Building frameworks to automate deployment, configuration, and testing for many components of our compute cloud offering.
* Advising in utilizing and managing automation frameworks and tools, including Pytest, Playwright, SaltStack, Github Actions, and Jenkins.
* Showcasing high\-level proficiency in Python test case development and the creation of automated scripts.
* Having experience in Linux system administration (specifically, server administration, networking, system internals, and package management).
* Mastering of testing best practices, from the analysis of design documentation to the creation of thorough, repeatable test plans.


**Do What You Love**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

* Have 2\+ years of experience in software development and Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or its equivalent.
* Have experience in both Manual and Automation Testing using Python, Java, and TestNG.
* Have experience in working with skilled teams of SDET engineers and communicating well with development teams throughout the testing process.
* Have an interest in cloud security and knowledge of secure development best practices as defined by organizations such as OWASP.
* Have a good understanding of systems programming and networking concepts. And exposure to network fundamentals (HTTP, TLS, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.)

This role requires a strong combination of Pharmacovigilance domain expertise, hands-on experience with global safety databases, techno-functional knowledge, product management capabilities and client relationship management.

The ideal candidate should have experience working with enterprise safety databases such as Oracle Argus Safety, ArisG or Veeva Vault Safety, with a strong understanding of database configurations, system architecture, XML, E2B integrations, APIs, data migration and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

**A. Product Management & Techno-Functional Solution Ownership**

* Drive the product roadmap, strategy and continuous enhancement of Safety Databse.
* Gather, analyse and translate client, business and regulatory requirements into functional and technical specifications.
* Prepare BRDs, FRS, user stories, workflow documentation and solution specifications.
* Understand safety database architecture, application workflows, configurations, database structures and system dependencies.
* Evaluate technical feasibility and collaborate with development teams to define appropriate solution approaches.
* Identify functional gaps, technical limitations and opportunities for product improvement.
* Manage product enhancement requests, prioritization, sprint planning and release delivery.
* Participate in product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs and technical feasibility discussions.
* Ensure product functionality aligns with global Pharmacovigilance processes and regulatory requirements.

**B. Pharmacovigilance Domain & Safety Database Expertise**

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of end-to-end Pharmacovigilance processes and Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) management.
* Possess hands-on functional or techno-functional experience with Oracle Argus Safety, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety or other enterprise safety databases.
* Understand safety database configuration, case workflows, business rules, user roles, access controls and reporting functionalities.
* Have a strong understanding of case intake, triage, data entry, medical review, quality control and regulatory submissions.
* Understand ICH E2B(R2) and E2B(R3) standards, XML message structures, validation and regulatory reporting workflows.
* Have knowledge of CIOMS, MedWatch, PADER, PSUR and other regulatory reporting formats.
* Understand global regulatory requirements, including FDA, EMA, MHRA and other health authorities.
* Evaluate regulatory changes and translate them into product and system enhancement requirements.

**C. Technical Architecture, Database & System Integrations**

* Understand enterprise application architecture, database design, application workflows and system integration mechanisms.
* Possess working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably Oracle, including tables, joins, relationships and data validation.
* Have a good understanding of XML, XSD, JSON and E2B message structures.
* Understand REST APIs, SOAP web services and integration between safety databases and external applications.
