title: Software Engineer II - Product Data Gateway
description:
**About The Role**
At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats.
  
  
The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Software Engineer on MPP, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth — the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. It's a genuinely hard, high-leverage problem: the layer has to serve the entire platform at high throughput and low latency without ever becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, authentication, and fine-grained access control so every team inherits strong security and reliability for free. You won't be maintaining someone else's system — you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company.
  
  
If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer.
* Drive adoption of API-gated data sources, so product teams expose their data once and every consuming surface can reuse it, instead of building one-off integrations.
* Design and implement standard labeling for data ownership, and build the validation logic that checks incoming requests against it.
* Own the reliability and stability of the components and features you build.
* Contribute to the team's architectural decisions, and write technical design documents for the areas you own.
* Participate in regular code and design reviews as well as the team-wide on-call rotation.
* Write code with testability, readability, edge cases, and errors in mind.

**Teamwork & Collaboration**

* Communicate effectively in an asynchronous manner with team members to provide updates, discuss challenges, and propose solutions.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams as they adopt the shared data layer.
* Take ownership of projects and act as a driver who adds instant adrenaline and drives positive impact when placed on projects and teams.
* Participate in team roadmap discussions.
* Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and participate in professional development activities.

**Must Have Skills**

* Software Engineer with 4+ years of industry experience and strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Growth-oriented, looking to increase impact, responsibility, and ownership over time.
* Proven ability to own complex problems and multi-component features end-to-end, with a growing ability to collaborate and influence across teams.
* Strong experience writing production code in Python and/or Golang, and working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with system design and building reliable, scalable applications with an emphasis on operational excellence.
* Detail-driven, and care about code quality, testing, and performance.
* Ability to make practical trade-offs — evaluating multiple approaches and selecting the one that best balances customer impact, system complexity, and long-term maintainability.
* Able to write technical design documents and contribute to design and architecture reviews.
* Strong understanding of service health, monitoring, fault tolerance, and incident response practices.
* Strong communication skills and proven ability to work autonomously and asynchronously with remote collaborators and stakeholders.
* Shares knowledge with teammates and helps establish team-level patterns and best practices.

Nice to Have Skills
  
  

* Experience designing or building data access layers, APIs, or platforms that other engineering teams build on top of.
* Experience treating an internal platform as a product — building for other engineering teams as your customers.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Cursor, and other GenAI productivity tools.
* Big Data platform usage is a plus.

**A note on AI in our process:**
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. In this hands-on Senior/Lead role, you’ll build the endpoint agent that detects suspicious activity and enforces security policies on enterprise devices. You’ll work with security researchers to turn behavioral signals and AI models into real-time protection.   **C, C++, or Rust**

  for services
* or tooling.

* Familiarity with cloud services, databases, and CI/CD. Experience leading technical design, mentoring engineers, and taking features from concept to production with research and product teams.

Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.
   

  

 This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.
   

  

 We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast\-moving group solving open\-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

Position Overview
  

We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise
**Privileged Access Management (PAM)**
frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* **Architecture & Core Engineering:**
  Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, .NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework.
  
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM):**
  Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations.
  
* **Delivery & Test Engineering:**
  Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing.
  
* **AI Adoption & Technical Leadership:**
  Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.
  
* **Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development:**
  Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows.
  
* **Observability & Operational Excellence:**
  Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance.
  
* **Technical Debt & Governance:**
  Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints.
  
* **Problem solving & Troubleshooting:**
  Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.
  
  

  
**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
  

  
* **Experience:**
  8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment.
  
* **Backend Stack:**
  Deep expertise in C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs.
  
* **Databases:**
  Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures.
  
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines.
  
* **Testing:**
  Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools.
  
* **Artificial Intelligence:**
  Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams.

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
Bengaluru, KA
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how we build and adopt AI tooling. Working alongside a Staff Engineer and within a wider delivery team, you will design and build agentic systems and the supporting services that put AI capabilities into everyday engineering practice.
  
  
You take ownership of meaningful components end to end, from design through to production operation. You are trusted to make sound technical decisions within an agreed direction, to raise the quality bar through the code you write and the reviews you give, and to help less experienced engineers around you grow.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Reporting to an Engineering Director and working closely with the Staff Engineer for the domain, you deliver systems that are performant, reliable and maintainable. You contribute to design discussions, translate agreed architecture into working software, and take responsibility for the quality and operability of what you ship.
  
  
You will be a significant contributor to our adoption of the AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC) and Agentic development: piloting approaches, building the tooling that supports them, and feeding back what works and what does not.
  
  
**Domain / Systems Scope**
The role sits within AI tooling, covering agent development, AI-assisted engineering workflows, and the AWS services that support them. You will build and maintain agents for a range of business use cases, integrate them with internal and third-party systems, and help harden promising prototypes into enterprise-grade services.
  
  
**Technical design, strategy and system ownership**

* Design, build and optimise services and components within the domain, with ownership of your areas end to end.
* Implement agentic solutions using Python together with frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, and integrate them through MCP and agent skills.
* Build and operate on AWS, applying good practice around security, reliability, observability and cost.
* Contribute to the rollout of AI-DLC practices and help assess which approaches suit which teams and problems.
* Take part in technical reviews, championing testing, code quality and craftsmanship.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, reuse and refactor, and raise them with the team.
* Support and mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review and example.
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC on the ground, working directly with delivery teams rather than from the sidelines.
* Act as an advocate and evangelist for AI-DLC, building understanding, confidence and momentum across the engineering organisation.
* Help teams evolve their ways of working, coaching them through the shift and adapting the process to the realities of their domain.
* Identify gaps in tooling, process and capability, and lead the work to close them.

**Sub-Domain/Code Expertise**
You will work day to day across the following, with depth in several and a willingness to build depth in the rest:
  
  

* Python as the primary language for agent and tooling development, written to production standards.
* Agent frameworks and orchestration, including LangGraph and LangChain.
* The Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent skills, building and consuming tools that other teams rely on.
* AWS as the core platform, including Amazon Bedrock and, ideally, Bedrock AgentCore.
* AI coding harnesses and the supporting practices around evaluation, guardrails and context management.
* Observability and operational readiness for the services you own.
* Infrastructure as code and automated delivery, with Terraform an advantage.

**You’ll Partner With**

* The Staff Engineer for the domain, who sets technical direction and with whom you will design and review closely.
* Your Engineering Director and delivery team, planning and shipping work together.
* Engineering teams adopting AI-DLC, building MCPs, or agents: supporting them in practice and bringing their feedback back into the tooling.
* Product and business stakeholders, shaping use cases into something buildable.
* Platform and Security teams, making sure what you ship meets the organisation's standards.

**About You**

* Strong Python skills and practical experience building agents or AI-assisted workflows, ideally with LangGraph, LangChain, MCP or agent skills.
* A solid software engineering background, with experience delivering production systems in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on AWS experience; this is essential. Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is a clear advantage.
* Exposure to AI coding harnesses and an interest in how AI changes the way software is built.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when requirements are incomplete and to ask the right questions to close the gaps.
* A self-starter who takes ownership of outcomes and moves quickly to a working deliverable.
* Clear communicator, able to work with multiple teams and explain technical decisions to varied audiences.
* Curious and current, actively following developments in a fast-moving field.
* Exposure to the AWS AI-DLC approaches preferred
* Infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform good to have

**What happens next?**
If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

title: Python Developer
description:
We are looking for a seasoned Software Engineer with 4–6 years of hands-on experience in core Python programming, Linux systems, and computer networking. In this hybrid role, you will own critical backend and network-layer software modules, write high-reliability Python code, and lead deep-dive debugging efforts to solve complex software and protocol-level issues. Experience in the telecom domain or AI/ML integration is a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and write clean, high-performance, production-grade software in Python.
* Develop network-aware and protocol-driven applications, managing high concurrency, multi-threading, and asynchronous I/O.
* Lead root-cause analysis, memory/CPU profiling, and low-level debugging across application logic, network stacks, and Linux OS internals.
* Design, optimize, and maintain core services running natively in a Linux environment.
* Partner with engineering teams to integrate AI/ML capabilities or intelligent data processing into core software components (where applicable).
* Mentor junior developers, conduct thorough code reviews, and uphold high standards for software architecture and unit/integration testing

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  4–6 years of proven industry experience in core software development and systems programming.
* **Pure Python Mastery:**
  Deep command of core Python (3.x)—including data structures, algorithms, OOP, concurrency (asyncio, threading, multiprocessing), memory management, and low-level socket programming.
* **Advanced Debugging & Profiling:**
  Strong track record of diagnosing race conditions, memory leaks, deadlocks, and packet-level anomalies using tools
* **Computer Networking Fundamentals:**
  Sound, practical knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, routing, switching, sockets, and network security protocols (TLS/SSL).
* **Linux Internals:**
  Deep fluency in Linux environments, including process/thread management, IPC, virtual memory, file systems, and CLI system diagnostics.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Strong proficiency with Git, modular software design, and debugging multi-process/distributed applications.

**Preferred Qualifications (Added Advantage)**

* **Telecom Domain Knowledge:**
  Prior experience with telecom protocols, signaling, packet core, VoIP/SIP, 4G/5G architecture, or carrier-grade network applications.
* **AI / ML Experience:**
  Hands-on experience integrating AI APIs, LLMs, or Python ML/data libraries (e.g., PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, Hugging Face) into production software.
* Working knowledge of C/C++ to read lower-level system libraries or debug Python C-extensions.

title: Customer Care Executive
description:
**ABOUT TROVE**

Joining Immediate Preferred Trove Innovations (India) Pvt. Ltd. is one of India’s fastest growing premium tile brand, headquartered in Bangalore. With a strong digital and retail presence, we receive a high volume of inbound enquiries every day through platforms like IndiaMart, Instagram, Meta Ads, and our website. We are looking for a sharp, energetic Lead Conversion Specialist who can take ownership of every enquiry that comes in and convert it into a confirmed showroom visit — and ultimately, an order.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

As a Lead Conversion Specialist at Trove, your one job is to make sure no lead goes cold. You will call, follow up, and engage every inbound enquiry from across our digital channels, understand what the client is looking for, and get them into one of our Experience Centres. You will assign leads to the right showroom, keep the tracking sheet fully updated, and own the conversion pipeline from first contact to confirmed visit. Your performance is measured by one thing: how many enquiries become orders.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Lead Calling & First Response**

* Call every inbound lead promptly — from IndiaMart, Instagram, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and the Trove website — within the target response time. Speed of first contact is everything.
* Introduce Trove confidently, understand the client’s requirement (tile type, space, budget, timeline), and qualify the lead during the first call.
* Communicate fluently in English, Hindi, and Kannada — switch seamlessly based on the client’s comfort.

**2. Follow-Up & Nurturing**

* Own structured follow-up for every lead — call, WhatsApp, or message based on client preference — until the visit is confirmed or the lead is closed.
* Never let a warm lead go cold due to lack of follow-up. Maintain a follow-up cadence and document every interaction.
* Handle client queries about products, showroom location, timings, and design support — give clear, helpful answers that build confidence in Trove.

**3. Showroom Assignment & Coordination**

* Assign each qualified lead to the most appropriate Trove Experience Centre based on the client’s location and requirement.
* Coordinate with the showroom team to ensure the client is expected, welcomed, and attended to on arrival.
* Confirm appointments with the client and the showroom — no dropped handoffs, no missed visits.

**4. Lead Tracking & Sheet Management**

* Update all lead activity in Trove's internal software and CRM — every call, follow-up, status change, and outcome must be logged in the system in real time, not just the sheet
* Update the lead tracking sheet in real time — source, contact details, follow-up status, showroom assigned, visit date, and outcome Maintain clean, accurate data with no gaps or stale entries — the sheet is the single source of truth for the lead pipeline.
* Generate a daily summary of lead status, conversions, and pending follow-ups for review by the manager.

**5. Conversion & Order Follow-Through**

* Track every lead post-visit — follow up with the showroom and the client to understand if an order was placed or if further support is needed.
* Re-engage leads that visited but did not convert — understand objections and find ways to bring them back.
* Own your conversion number: enquiry to visit, visit to order. That is your metric.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 0–2 years of experience in tele-sales, inside sales, customer service, or lead management — freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.
* Fluent in English, Hindi, and Kannada — all three are mandatory. You must be able to switch naturally based on the client.
* Confident, warm, and persuasive on the phone — able to build rapport quickly and handle objections without sounding pushy.
* Highly organised — able to manage a large pipeline of leads simultaneously without letting any slip.
* Proficient in MS Excel, CRM or Google Sheets for lead tracking and reporting.
* Self-driven and target-oriented — motivated by conversion numbers, not just call volumes.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or lead management platforms is an advantage.

**ABOUT THE INCENTIVE**

Your fixed salary is the base. On top of that, you earn a performance-linked incentive for every enquiry that converts into a confirmed order through your follow-up. The more leads you convert, the more you earn — there is no cap. High performers consistently earn significantly above their fixed salary.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

AI Risk Engineer on Chevron’s Responsible AI (RAI) team partners with business and IT development teams to help ensure that AI and machine learning systems—including third-party tools, generative AI, and AI agents—are fair, transparent, accountable, secure, and aligned with Chevron’s ethical principles. Working at the intersection of AI/ML engineering, ethics, and policy, you will build and maintain the automation, scripts, and tooling that power Chevron’s AI impact assessment process, and help operationalize Responsible AI controls within our AI governance platform (Credo AI). You will collaborate closely with our Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy teams to ensure that AI solutions, vendors, and internal use cases adhere to Chevron guidelines, policies, and emerging regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build, maintain, and enhance the automation flows, scripts, and tooling that support Chevron’s AI impact assessment and Responsible AI review processes.
* Configure and administer Chevron’s AI governance platform (Credo AI)—adding risk scenarios, controls, and review workflows that enable teams to document mitigations, provide evidence, and track AI risks across the lifecycle.
* Design and operate review and approval checkpoints, including pre-production questionnaires and periodic re-reviews of AI use cases, streamlining through automation where possible.
* Establish and run model review processes for both pre-trained/foundation models and custom-built machine learning models.
* Assist in AI Discovery and maintain an inventory of AI models, agents, and use cases across the enterprise, ensuring proper documentation and lifecycle governance.
* Conduct ethical risk assessments and impact analyses for AI use cases, including alignment with regulations such as the EU AI Act and industry frameworks such as the IOGP Responsible Use of AI principles, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Evaluate AI vendors, models, and external AI access requests for fairness, security, and policy compliance, partnering with Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy.
* Influence the development and adoption of tools and methodologies to detect and mitigate bias, drift, and unintended consequences in machine learning and generative AI systems.
* Lead training, FAQs, and awareness campaigns—leveraging Teams and Copilot—to promote ethical AI practices and communicate process changes across business units.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate Responsible AI principles into product development and deployment workflows.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, or AI/ML engineering roles.
* Proficiency in Python and experience building automation, scripts, or data pipelines that integrate with enterprise platforms and APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to reason through ethical implications of AI systems and articulate trade-offs.
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., cybersecurity, legal, privacy, policy) to embed Responsible AI principles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and enterprise compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, NIST, OECD).

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Python,Responsible AI,AI Governance

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

AI for Cybersecurity

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications in Responsible AI, Data/AI Ethics, Cybersecurity, or AI Governance.
* Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using Python and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI frameworks, tools, or applications, and with governing AI agents (e.g., agent registries, Microsoft Agents 365).
* Experience with AI governance or model-risk platforms (e.g., Credo AI) and workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate, Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of fairness, interpretability, and robustness techniques in AI.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure ML / Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, DataRobot).
* Familiarity with emerging AI regulations and industry frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, IOGP Responsible Use of AI).

* Proven ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments and make connections between disparate data sources.
* **Must-have:**Python; familiarity AI system implementation; familiarity with policies related to AI governance

  **Good-to-have:**certification in RAI, data/AI ethics, cybersecurity, or AI governance; Oil & Gas domain.

title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
description:
* **Company Overview**

Whitelane Holdings Limited operates in the entertainment and leisure industry, with business interests spanning family entertainment, adventure experiences, social gaming, and entertainment destinations. The organisation is committed to delivering engaging customer experiences while maintaining operational excellence and sustainable business practices.

Whitelane Group also operates in the F&B industry, sports facilities, and kitchen equipment trading across India and the UAE, and is expanding its base in the USA and Saudi Arabia.

* **Role Overview**

The Assistant Restaurant Manager will be responsible for the overall management of restaurant operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, customer service, hygiene, and operational efficiency. The role involves managing front-of-house and back-of-house coordination, supervising restaurant staff, controlling costs, monitoring revenue, and ensuring compliance with food safety and company standards. The individual will work closely with the kitchen team and other site departments to deliver a consistent dining experience for guests visiting the entertainment facility.

* **Job Description**
* **Key Responsibilities**

* **Restaurant Operations Management**
* Oversee daily restaurant operations, including opening and closing procedures, service readiness, table management, and shift coordination.
* Ensure smooth coordination between the service team, kitchen, cashiering, and other relevant functions.
* Monitor service flow, food availability, order processing, and turnaround times, particularly during peak hours and events.
* Ensure restaurant facilities, dining areas, counters, and service stations are clean, organised, and guest-ready.
* Implement company policies, standard operating procedures, and service standards across restaurant operations.

* **Guest Experience & Service Quality**
* Ensure guests receive prompt, courteous, and professional service throughout their dining experience.
* Handle guest complaints, feedback, and service escalations effectively.
* Monitor food presentation, order accuracy, service speed, and overall dining satisfaction.
* Coordinate with the kitchen team to resolve food quality concerns and service delays.
* Identify opportunities to improve guest satisfaction, repeat visits, and restaurant service standards.

* **Team Management & Development**
* Supervise restaurant supervisors, captains, stewards, cashiers, and other assigned employees.
* Prepare duty rosters, allocate responsibilities, monitor attendance, and ensure adequate manpower deployment.
* Train employees on service standards, menu knowledge, upselling, hygiene, and guest handling.
* Conduct team briefings and monitor employee performance, grooming, discipline, and productivity.
* Coordinate with HR on recruitment, onboarding, training, employee engagement, and performance-related matters.

* **Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with applicable food safety regulations, including relevant FSSAI requirements, and company hygiene standards.
* Monitor cleanliness and sanitation of dining areas, service stations, storage areas, and food-handling spaces under the restaurant’s responsibility.
* Ensure employees follow personal hygiene, food handling, allergen communication, and safe service practices.
* Conduct regular hygiene inspections and ensure corrective actions are taken promptly.
* Maintain relevant checklists, records, licences, and inspection documentation as applicable.

* **Revenue, Cost & Inventory Control**
* Monitor restaurant sales, average transaction value, food and beverage revenue, and performance against targets.
* Support revenue growth through suggestive selling, promotions, combo offers, and appropriate upselling.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and purchase/store teams to monitor stock availability, consumption, wastage, and replenishment.
* Control operating expenses, breakages, pilferage, and avoidable wastage without compromising quality.
* Monitor billing accuracy, discounts, voids, cash handling, and closing reports in accordance with company procedures.

* **Kitchen & Interdepartmental Coordination**
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef or kitchen in-charge to ensure menu availability, food quality, portion consistency, and timely service.
* Communicate guest feedback, sales trends, and operational requirements to the kitchen team.
* Coordinate with Gaming Operations, Events, Sales, Housekeeping, Facility Management, and Security for group bookings, parties, promotions, and special events.
* Ensure sufficient staffing, stock, seating, and service arrangements during weekends, holidays, and peak footfall periods.
* Support site-wide initiatives and ensure the restaurant contributes to the overall guest experience.

* **Equipment & Facility Management**
* Ensure restaurant furniture, service equipment, POS systems, billing counters, and other operational assets are maintained properly.
* Report equipment breakdowns, maintenance requirements, and safety concerns to the concerned teams.
* Follow up on repairs and ensure operational disruptions are minimised.
* Monitor the condition and presentation of restaurant spaces and ensure issues are addressed promptly.

* **Reporting & Continuous Improvement**
* Prepare and review daily sales reports, inventory records, manpower reports, guest feedback, and operational checklists.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including revenue, average spend, service time, wastage, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions within the approved scope of responsibility.
* Provide regular performance updates and recommendations to the General Manager – Site.

* **Required Qualifications & Experience**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Service, or a related field.
* Experience: 7–9 years of experience in restaurant or F&B operations, preferably in a high-footfall restaurant, entertainment facility, hospitality establishment, or multi-outlet environment.
* Proven experience managing restaurant teams, daily service operations, guest relations, and shift planning.
* Strong understanding of restaurant service standards, menu knowledge, POS systems, billing, and cash handling.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, inventory management, cost control, and applicable FSSAI requirements.
* Experience monitoring restaurant revenue, budgets, wastage, stock consumption, and operational expenses.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with kitchen teams and multiple site departments.
* Strong leadership, communication, customer service, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Office and restaurant reporting systems.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and peak business hours, as required by operations.

title: Inside Sales Representative (Entry-Level) / Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
**About Us**

We are a fast-growing technology and business solutions company focused on helping organizations streamline operations, adopt modern software, and stay ahead of regulatory and compliance requirements. We are looking for driven, articulate, and coachable entry-level sales professionals to join our growth engine and connect with prospective clients across India.

**Role Overview**

As an Entry-Level Inside Sales Representative, you will be the first point of contact for potential customers. Your primary responsibility is to identify prospects, initiate meaningful conversations via phone, email, and LinkedIn, qualify leads, and set up product demonstrations or discovery calls for senior sales specialists. This role offers structured mentorship and a clear career path into closing/Account Executive roles.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Outbound Prospecting:** Reach out to prospective clients through cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach to generate new business opportunities.
* **Inbound Lead Qualification:** Respond promptly to inbound inquiries, understand prospect pain points, and assess their fit for our solutions.
* **Discovery & Scheduling:** Conduct initial discovery conversations to identify decision-makers, timelines, and needs, then schedule qualified demos or consultations.
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate records of all outreach activities, call notes, and lead stages in our CRM system.

* **Tech-Savviness:** Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, LinkedIn, and modern communication tools; prior exposure to any CRM is a bonus.
* **Time Management:** Ability to organize daily outreach blocks, follow up consistently, and manage multiple leads simultaneously.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:** Fixed base salary + uncapped performance-based incentives.
* **Training & Mentorship:** Hands-on onboarding covering sales frameworks, product knowledge, objection handling, and CRM tools.
* **Career Progression:** Fast-track growth opportunities into Senior BDR, Account Executive, or Team Lead roles based on performance.
* **Work Environment:** Collaborative, high-ownership startup culture with direct access to company leadership.

Pay: From ₹15,000.00 per month

title: Growth & Demand Generation Marketer
description:
Company: Warwick Consulting

Location: Chennai, India

Experience: 4–6 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Initially Remote, transitioning to Work from Office

Target Market: United States

**About Warwick Consulting**

Warwick Consulting is a Boston-based MedTech consulting firm with 15 years of experience helping medical device manufacturers and emerging MedTech companies bring safe, compliant products to market.

Our expertise spans regulatory strategy, FDA submissions, quality management systems, R&D, verification and validation, human factors engineering, cybersecurity and compliance remediation.

We are also developing innovative technology solutions, including VERA™, our proprietary AI-powered Quality Management System (QMS) platform.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Growth & Demand Generation Marketer to lead B2B marketing campaigns, generate qualified leads and build a measurable sales pipeline for Warwick Consulting's professional services and technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in B2B demand generation, digital marketing, marketing automation, HubSpot CRM and paid advertising, with a results-driven approach to converting marketing activities into business opportunities.

This role will work closely with the sales team, marketing specialists and technical subject matter experts to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth across the US market.

**Key Responsibilities**

Develop and execute integrated B2B marketing and demand generation campaigns.

Drive qualified lead generation for Warwick Consulting's services and VERA™ AI-powered QMS platform.

Conduct audience research, market segmentation and target account identification across the US market.

Develop and manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing workflows and automated follow-up sequences.

Manage HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub for campaign execution, marketing automation, lead tracking and performance reporting.

Develop and optimize landing pages and lead generation campaigns.

Plan, execute and optimize LinkedIn advertising and other paid digital marketing campaigns.

Manage advertising budgets, audience targeting and campaign performance.

Develop and execute account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns.

Collaborate with content writers and SEO/GEO/AEO specialists to improve campaign effectiveness.

Work closely with the sales team to improve lead qualification, conversion and pipeline development.

Leverage AI tools for market research, campaign personalization, workflow optimization and performance analysis.

Support industry events and conferences through lead capture, engagement and post-event follow-up campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance and provide actionable insights to leadership.

Track marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced sales pipeline.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

4–6 years of experience in B2B growth marketing or demand generation.

Strong experience in digital marketing, lead generation and campaign management.

Hands-on experience with email marketing, lead nurturing and marketing automation.

Experience with HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub is strongly preferred.

Proven experience managing LinkedIn advertising and account-based marketing campaigns.

Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys, lead qualification and sales funnels.

Experience collaborating with sales teams to generate qualified business opportunities.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure campaign performance and marketing ROI.

Familiarity with AI-powered marketing and automation tools.

Excellent communication, organizational and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in MedTech, medical devices, healthcare, life sciences or other regulated industries.

Experience marketing SaaS products or technology platforms alongside professional consulting services.

Experience developing marketing campaigns targeting US-based businesses and decision-makers.

Experience supporting marketing initiatives for industry events and conferences.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).

Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

Qualified sales meetings generated.

Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline.

Lead-to-opportunity conversion rates.

Campaign performance and marketing ROI.

Cost per lead and cost per qualified opportunity.

Email marketing and lead nurturing performance.

Paid advertising performance.

Monthly marketing performance reporting.

**Working Arrangement**

The position will initially be remote while our Chennai office is being established. The role is expected to transition to full-time office-based work in Chennai in early 2027.

Candidates must be available for regular working-hour overlap with the US Eastern Time Zone.

**Selection Process**

Shortlisted candidates will be required to develop an outline for a 90-day demand generation campaign aimed at generating pilot inquiries for an AI-powered Quality Management System (QMS) platform targeting quality and regulatory leaders at US medical device companies.

**The assessment should cover:**

Target audience and customer segmentation.

Campaign strategy and value proposition.

Recommended marketing channels.

Lead generation and nurturing strategy.

HubSpot campaign setup and marketing automation.

Performance metrics and success measurement.

**How to Apply**

* Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated resume along with relevant campaign experience, measurable marketing achievements, current compensation, expected compensation and notice period.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Security Engineering professional to lead the deployment, architecture, integration, and optimization of enterprise security technologies across the organization.

The role is responsible for designing and implementing security solutions, developing security baselines, hardening configurations, defining detection and prevention rules, and ensuring secure integration of security platforms with the enterprise technology landscape.

The candidate should possess strong hands-on expertise in security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, PAM, Email Security, WAF, DLP, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Identity Security solutions.

The ideal candidate will drive security product lifecycle management, including architecture reviews, technical impact assessments, change evaluations, configuration management, custom use-case development, automation, and continuous improvement of security controls.

The role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, cloud, application, and operations teams to assess the security impact of technology changes, identify risks, and implement appropriate controls. Strong troubleshooting, scripting, integration, and security architecture skills are essential, along with experience in security engineering, platform customization, and enterprise-scale security deployments.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, deploy, implement and optimize enterprise security technologies.
* Develop security baselines, hardening standards and configuration guidelines.
* Define and implement detection and prevention rules across security platforms.
* Integrate security solutions with the enterprise technology landscape.
* Drive security product lifecycle management and platform optimization.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical impact assessments and change evaluations.
* Develop custom security use cases, automation and integrations.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application and operations teams to assess technology changes and implement security controls.
* Troubleshoot security platforms, integrations and enterprise security technology issues.
* Drive continuous improvement of enterprise security controls and solutions.

Required Skills

* Security Engineering
* Security Architecture
* Enterprise Security Technology Implementation
* SIEM / SOAR
* EDR / XDR
* Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Email Security
* Web Application Firewall (WAF)
* Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
* Network Security
* Cloud Security
* Identity Security
* Security Integration and Automation
* Configuration Management and Hardening
* Security Use-Case Development
* Scripting and Troubleshooting

Preferred Certifications

CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC-200, SC-300, Palo Alto PCNSE, Splunk Enterprise Security or equivalent security engineering certifications.

Experience

8–12 years for Manager and 12–15 years for Sr. Manager in Security Engineering, Security Architecture, Security Operations Engineering or Enterprise Security Technology Management.

**Required**

* Major in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or related areas
* Previous applicable co-op or intern experience.
* Experience in delivering AI-enabled process improvements and other business solutions.
* Proven teamwork, collaboration, and leadership skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate with multiple levels of the organization, including senior leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, produce excellent work results and on commitments.
* High level of analytical and problem-solving skills including attention to detail.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.

Engineering & Automation
  
  

* Develop Python-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.

* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks

**Education**

* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA

**Experience**

* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs

**Preferred Certifications**

* CEH, CISSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, Azure AI, Open AI, AWS ML, Azure ML certifications

**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**

* Building AI-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next-generation cyber transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.
  
  
**What We Offer You**

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Head– Customer Experience & Strategic Operations
description:
**Role Overview**
Sweet Karam Coffee is looking for a
**Head- Customer Experience & Strategic Operations**
to own the end-to end customer experience while building a deeper understanding of our consumers and translating their feedback into meaningful business improvements. The role combines customer service operations, consumer insights, journey mapping, and strategic execution to ensure that customer feedback drives decisions across Product, Category, Brand, Digital, Supply Chain, and Operations. The role will balance operational rigour and customer empathy with a strong analytical mindset, building a customer-centric organization that strengthens brand trust, retention, and long-term growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and strengthen customer experience operations across D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce, social media, email, WhatsApp, and other customer touchpoints.
* Establish service standards, SLAs, escalation frameworks, quality checks, and processes to ensure consistent, empathetic, and timely customer resolution.
* Build a structured Voice of Consumer (VOC) program by bringing together customer conversations, complaints, reviews, ratings, NPS/CSAT, research, and behavioural data.
* Map the end-to-end consumer journey, identify friction points, and translate customer insights into actionable improvements across Product, Category, Brand, Digital, Supply Chain, and Operations.
* Develop customer communities through panels, surveys, tasting sessions, interviews, and co-creation initiatives to incorporate consumer feedback into product, packaging, and communication decisions.
* Track CX performance through dashboards, identify recurring issues, and drive cross-functional issue resolution and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking**

* For 12+ years of experience across Customer Experience, Customer Operations, Consumer Insights, Customer Strategy, or related roles in consumer-facing businesses. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in VOC, NPS/CSAT, customer research, dashboards, and journey mapping.
* Ability to translate customer feedback and data into meaningful business recommendations and actionable improvements.
* A strong customer-first mindset, empathy, sound judgement, and the ability to balance service quality with operational efficiency. Experience in FMCG, D2C, e-commerce, retail, hospitality, or consumer-facing businesses is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers receive faster, clearer, and more empathetic responses, with improved service quality and resolution rates.
* Recurring customer issues and escalations reduce through effective root-cause analysis and systemic improvements.
* Customer insights actively influence product, packaging, communication, and business decisions. Customer feedback translates into measurable improvements across the consumer journey, strengthening trust, satisfaction, and long-term brand relationships.

About Sweet Karam Coffee Sweet Karam Coffee is a modern Indian food brand rooted in South Indian culture, warmth, and better-for-you choices. We operate across D2C, Quick Commerce, and Marketplaces, and believe brand trust is built through consistency at every touchpoint.
  
  
Website : https://sweetkaramcoffee.in/

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Design, Tender & Estimation Engineer**

**Job Overview**

The role involves preparing fire fighting system designs, technical drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), quantity estimates, project cost sheets, vendor quotations, and tender documentation.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring technical accuracy, competitive project costing, timely tender submissions, and coordination with internal teams, clients, and vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare fire fighting system layouts, shop drawings, and installation drawings.
* Develop designs for fire hydrant, sprinkler, and fire alarm systems based on project requirements.
* Ensure technical designs comply with applicable NBC standards, NFPA guidelines, and project specifications.
* Identify design discrepancies and coordinate technical clarifications.
* Prepare detailed BOQs and quantity take-offs from project drawings and specifications.
* Estimate material, labour, equipment, and installation costs for fire protection projects.
* Prepare project cost sheets, commercial proposals, and technical quotations.
* Obtain and compare vendor quotations for materials and equipment.
* Identify cost optimisation opportunities without compromising technical requirements.
* Review tender documents, project specifications, BOQs, and scope of work.
* Identify technical requirements, deviations, exclusions, and project deliverables.
* Prepare technical offers, compliance statements, and tender documentation.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for technical specifications and pricing.
* Prepare and submit tenders and quotations within specified deadlines.
* Maintain accurate records of tender submissions, revisions, and commercial offers.
* Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, and Project Execution teams.
* Resolve technical queries with clients, consultants, and vendors.
* Provide technical support during client discussions and tender negotiations.
* Ensure smooth handover of approved drawings, BOQs, cost sheets, and technical documents to the execution team.
* Independently manage multiple design, estimation, and tender assignments.
* Ensure accuracy of project estimates, technical documentation, and commercial submissions.
* Take ownership of assigned pre-order activities from enquiry receipt to tender submission and project handover.
* Escalate complex technical matters, commercial risks, and issues requiring management approval.

**Candidate Profile**

* Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant technical discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in fire fighting system design, estimation, or fire protection projects is preferred.
* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may also apply.
* Knowledge of fire hydrant, sprinkler, and fire alarm systems.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Excel is essential.
* Understanding of BOQ preparation, quantity surveying, and project cost estimation.
* Knowledge of fire fighting system layouts, technical drawings, and project specifications.
* Ability to prepare tender documentation, technical offers, and commercial quotations.
* Understanding of vendor quotation comparison and material costing.
* Knowledge of NFPA standards and NBC is desirable.
* Good numerical, analytical, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and multiple projects.
* Ability to meet project deadlines while maintaining technical and commercial accuracy.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Experience in fire protection system design and estimation.
* Knowledge of fire fighting system components and installation requirements.
* Experience preparing BOQs, project cost sheets, and tender submissions.
* Ability to coordinate with vendors, clients, and project execution teams.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in technical documentation.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and take ownership of pre-order activities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Design accuracy and timely completion of technical drawings.
* Accuracy of BOQs, quantity take-offs, and project cost estimates.
* Timely submission of complete tenders and quotations.
* Effective vendor quotation comparison and cost optimisation.
* Quality and completeness of technical and commercial documentation.
* Coordination with Sales, Procurement, and Project Execution teams.
* Independent management of pre-order activities from enquiry to project handover.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. title: Senior Network Security Engineer - OT Specialist
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Position Description:**
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for assisting with the planning, design, optimization, implementation, audit, and troubleshooting the Barry-Wehmiller (BW) network from a security perspective to improve the protection and the efficiency of the organization. It is the responsibility of the NST to help plan and implement security measures to protect the system from cyber-attacks, hacking attacks, intrusion, infiltration, exfiltration and natural disasters at the network level. This individual will help make our company’s information technology (IT) environment more secure by protecting system boundaries, keeping computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks, and securing company and personal data.
  
  
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Assist in planning, identifying, defining, engineering, and monitoring the security arrangements for the protection of the company’s network and services.
* Design secure remote access practices and implementation plans as well as make recommendations to secure BW’s footprint in BW and customer facilities; assist in designing and optimizing security in BW’s Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) initiatives
* Participate in projects to address gaps in BW’s on-premises and cloud network environments.
* Assist in developing, documenting, and maintaining standard security policy settings for firewalls and other network security devices and appliances.
* Oversee daily operations of BW’s network security systems
* Assist the Infrastructure team with designing and documenting additional network segmentation and enhancing BW’s Information Technology / Operational Technology segregation.
* Manage daily operations of intrusion detection systems as well as ensure the security of firewalls, VPNs, web protocols and other networking equipment.
* Help investigate intrusion and hacking incidents, collect incident responses, and carry out forensic investigations as directed.
* Use industry-standard analysis criteria to test the security level of the BW enterprise; test and check the BW enterprise for weaknesses in software and hardware by assisting with penetration tests, vulnerability assessments and then managing all findings to resolution.
* Assist with the implementation of regulatory systems in accordance with IT security.
* Help optimize malware and other threat detection systems and processes.
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure team regarding improving design and security capabilities, and determining network security standards and policies.
* Participate in implementation and integration projects such as conducting product research, overseeing proof of concept evaluations, coordinating with the Infrastructure team during acquisition integrations and implementations and overseeing the configuration and installation of security infrastructure devices.
* Configure and maintain systems that log and monitor security threats and alerts.

**Job Specifications:**

* Four to Five years of Hand-on experience with IT-OT Separation using Firewalls & Routers.
* Three to four years of Hand-on experience with Cisco, Palo Alto firewalls and other next-generation firewall technologies.
* Knowledge of OT networks, ICS components, and associated security risks.
* Knowledge of routing and switching capabilities.
* Strong logical ability, natural curiosity, problem solving ability, good oral and written communication skills, thorough, takes initiative, professional appearance/demeanor, dependable, flexible with schedule, loyal, organized, and courteous.
* Troubleshooting skills with networking and computer systems, can multitask, work in a fast- paced environment while providing excellent user experience.
* Ability to work independently with general supervision; applies practical knowledge to problems.
* API programming experience strongly desired.

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Intermediate level professional with working knowledge and experience in network security.
* Minimum 2-year degree in an Information Technology field. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Four (4) to five (5) years of hands-on experience working with IP networks, firewalls, switching & routing environment.
* Two (2) years identifying threats and developing appropriate protection measures in IT-OT environment.

This is a non-supervisory position.

Occasional domestic and/or global travel may be required for this position.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery, and we're building Nitro, our AI-native product layer. We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own product and infrastructure security for the company.

What you'll own

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor security role covering the full range of product security work, not just one slice of it.

Offensive security and vulnerability discovery

* Run internal penetration tests across our web app, APIs, mobile app, and cloud infrastructure, and triage findings from external pentest vendors
* Actively hunt for vulnerabilities in new features, including in AI/LLM-powered surfaces (prompt injection paths, unsafe code execution in agent tooling, unauthenticated internal endpoints)
* Have found and driven the fix for real vulnerabilities before. We need someone who thinks like an attacker, not just someone who runs a scanner and files a ticket

Cloud and infrastructure security

* Review and harden our AWS setup: WAF rules, ALB/CloudFront TLS policies and cipher suites, container isolation, IAM and secrets hygiene
* Investigate and close out Dependabot and other CI/CD security alerts across dozens of repos, and work with engineering teams to get fixes prioritized and shipped
* Build and maintain internal security tooling

Compliance and customer trust

* Help with our compliance audit cycles end to end: evidence collection, control testing, and coordinating with auditors. This typically takes up 5% of the work.
* Respond to customer security questionnaires and InfoSec review requests, working with sales and customer success to turn these around quickly and accurately
* Keep our security documentation and posture current as the product and infrastructure evolve

Cross-team coordination

* Work directly with engineering, platform, and ops teams to get security fixes prioritized and shipped, not just logged
* Report critical findings up to leadership with clear, actionable writeups (source, sink, impact, fix)

What we're looking for

* 3+ years in a hands-on security role covering penetration testing and vulnerability research, ideally across web, API, mobile, and cloud
* Real, demonstrable experience finding and helping fix serious vulnerabilities (RCE, auth bypass, injection classes), not just running automated scans
* Solid working knowledge of AWS security: WAF, ALB/CloudFront, IAM, container security on ECS or similar
* Comfort integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning) and driving remediation with engineering teams
* Experience with, or strong interest in, securing LLM/AI-powered applications: unsafe code execution, prompt injection, agent tool-call boundaries
* Strong written communication. You'll be writing up findings for engineers and explaining risk to non-technical stakeholders in the same week

Nice to have

* Experience building or maintaining internal security scanning tools
* Familiarity with Java/Spring Boot stacks (our backend) or Python (our AI/LLM stack)
* A CTF background, bug bounty track record, or security certifications (OSCP, etc.)
* Prior exposure to SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks and customer-facing security questionnaires would be a plus

Why this role

You'd be the primary security engineer for a fast-moving product company actively shipping AI agent features, with direct access to leadership and real ownership over what gets fixed and when.

· Support domain architects with targeted research, technology analysis, control-to-requirement mapping, pattern development, threat-model pre-analysis, comparative evaluation, and proof-of-concept execution.
