· Maintain operating documentation and runbooks for architecture tools, workflow automations, repositories, data models, integrations, and control mappings.

Requirements
  
  

Basic Qualifications

· Strong foundation in security architecture concepts and 2 or more of the following: cloud and platform security, network security, identity and access management, application security, data protection, threat and response, control design, and architecture decision records.

· Hands-on experience building tooling or platforms using frameworks, scripting languages, etc.

· Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows

Preferred Qualifications

· Relevant certification such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, Microsoft/AWS/Google Cloud architecture or security certification, or comparable engineering credentials.

title: Development Engineer
description: Job Summary App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time. Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.Key ResponsibilitiesSolution Design & Application Development Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant. Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs. Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments. Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt. Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards. Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects. Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.Secure Development & Technology Risk Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks. Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant. Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities. Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.API, Integration & Data Engineering Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels. Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability. Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs. Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes. Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements. Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability. Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments. Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics. Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists. Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency. Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt. Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs. Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making. Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities. Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.Skills And ExperiencePriority Skills Software Engineering Programming Principles Application Programming Interface Database Development Distributed Systems DevOps Software Testing Secure Coding Web Application Security Mobile SecurityOther Skills Platform Management Operating Systems Computer Network Database Administration Functional WritingMotivations Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity. Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions. Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.Qualifications Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes. Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions. Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance. Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement. Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes. title: Sr Engr Cslt-AI/ML Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
you will operate at the intersection of full-stack application development, modern distributed data engineering, and cutting-edge Agentic AI systems. You will lead cross-functional engineering pods, drive technical roadmaps, and guide application teams toward Verizon’s North Star architecture. You will architect end-to-end solutions that integrate responsive web applications, streaming data backbones, and multi-agent LLM workflows, while championing engineering excellence and accelerating business value.
  
  

* Architecting, designing, and leading the delivery of multi-tier, end-to-end solutions combining modern user interfaces, scalable micro-services, high-throughput data pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Designing and deploying autonomous agent frameworks, tool-calling ecosystems, ReAct loops, and multi-agent collaboration pipelines integrated with enterprise APIs, vector databases, and real-time knowledge graphs.
* Overseeing distributed streaming and batch data architectures (Kafka, Pulsar, Spark, Druid) to support real-time ingestion, feature stores, model training loops, and semantic retrieval systems.
* Driving technical excellence through hands-on code reviews, architecture governance, and performance profiling across UI rendering, micro-service latencies, and distributed query performance.
* Translating business priorities into scalable, fault-tolerant, cloud-native technical roadmaps aligned with Verizon’s enterprise architectural standards.
* Enforcing robust MLOps, LLMOps, and DevSecOps practices, driving automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, telemetry, and observability.
* Championing a culture of engineering rigor, experimentation, continuous learning, and cross-discipline collaboration within Scaled Agile (SAFe) environments, while mentoring engineers across pods.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You are excited to work in a dynamic cloud environment, driving innovation at enterprise scale. You are a self-directed technical leader with deep systems-level thinking and strong business acumen, comfortable guiding cross-functional pods and collaborating with executive, product, and data stakeholders to deliver next-generation AI-powered platforms.
  
  
**You'll Need To Have**

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant software and data engineering experience, including proven experience leading full-stack and distributed systems initiatives.
* Full Stack & Systems Architecture: Proven experience leading full-stack development using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern state management (Redux, Zustand), alongside resilient backend microservices in Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Flask), or Java/Spring Boot.
* APIs & Databases: Deep expertise building secure, low-latency RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC services, and working with distributed SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
* Data Engineering & Streaming: Hands-on experience architecting real-time streaming and batch pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, Spark, or Flink, as well as analytical/OLAP stores (Apache Druid, ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery) and distributed query optimization.
* Agentic AI & GenAI Engineering: Direct experience building autonomous agents (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex), implementing ReAct loops, plan-and-solve paradigms, dynamic tool calling, and Advanced RAG architectures (hybrid search, semantic routing, reranking, contextual chunking) backed by vector databases.
* LLMOps & Evaluation: Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks ,safety guardrails , and cost/latency caching strategies.
* Cloud, DevOps & Agile Leadership: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Helm, enterprise CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field.
* Prior experience working in telecommunications, network telemetry, or large-scale enterprise digital transformations.
* Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (PEFT) and deploying high-throughput inference workloads using LLM.
* Background in Scala or high-performance concurrent systems.
* Cloud certifications in AWS, GCP, or Azure (Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Specialty).
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge complex business objectives and deep technical execution.

**Why Verizon?**
Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice.
  
  

* We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program.
* Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers.
* You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions.
* We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements\*.
* Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research.
* You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment.

Your benefits package will vary depending on the country in which you work.
  
  

* subject to business approval

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Technical Engineering Manager

**Position Summary**
The Implementation Associate builds, tests, delivers, maintains, and supports healthcare integrations for athenahealth clients. The role manages a high-volume portfolio of new interface builds and modifications to existing interfaces; coordinates technical, functional, and quality requirements; resolves connectivity and electronic data interchange issues; and communicates project status, risks, and timelines to clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders. The Associate applies advanced knowledge of athenahealth and other healthcare products, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration to improve delivery efficiency and expand athenahealth’s interoperability network. The ideal candidate can also support people management and team coordination. This position reports to the Operations Manager in Chennai, India.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Implementation team supports client interoperability by delivering reliable interfaces and improving the workflows used to implement and maintain them. The team works closely with interface vendors, clients, and athenahealth’s US-based Onboarding Managers, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Program Managers (IPMs), Customer Support Center (CSC), Product, and Development teams.

Success requires proactive communication, careful listening, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business problems and use cases into practical technical solutions or workarounds.
  
  
The team combines a shared commitment to improving healthcare with technical expertise across integration components, including HL7, networking protocols, VPN, SSH, SFTP, and XML. Team members apply data-driven analysis and structured problem-solving to deliver effective outcomes. Knowledge of hospital or ambulatory workflows and healthcare information systems further strengthens the team’s ability to develop practical, client-focused solutions.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Build, test, deliver, maintain, and support integrations for new and existing client interfaces.
* Manage a high volume of projects and tasks with competing priorities, maintaining clear ownership, accurate documentation, and timely delivery.
* Partner with the Interface Development team to customize integrations and incorporate technical, functional, and quality-assurance requirements.
* Communicate integration status, risks, dependencies, and timelines to clients, vendors, and athenahealth stakeholders.
* Analyze and resolve issues involving connectivity, electronic data interchange, HL7 messaging, and related integration components.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Program Managers, Product, Development, Customer Support Center teams, and other partners to ensure successful ambulatory interface engineering engagements and implementations.
* Engage clients and external stakeholders to define business problems and use cases, evaluate the advantages and limitations of available approaches, and develop appropriate technical solutions or workarounds.
* Identify workflow deficiencies and operational breakdowns, then contribute to solutions that improve outcomes, efficiency, and quality.
* Maintain effective working relationships with interface vendors, clients, and geographically distributed internal teams.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives, operational projects, and process-reengineering efforts that advance organizational capabilities.
* Optimize workflows to reduce waste and improve consistency.
* Continually assess team operations and processes and recommend measurable improvements.
* Support the training, onboarding, and mentoring of new hires.
* Support the Operations Manager with responsibilities, including communicating team performance and operational risks.
* Monitor and contribute to team performance and metrics, including routine review of daily, weekly, and monthly production and quality reports.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Operations Manager to optimize and expand operational support.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Statistics, Management, or another quantitative field.
* 8+ years’ of overall experience in Technical Support, Operations, IT/ITES, healthcare, or a related field.
* Two to three years of project management experience, including technical projects with significant cross-functional interdependencies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with geographically dispersed teams in India and the United States.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical issues, resolve problems, and apply logical, analytical, and data-driven decision-making.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency and a commitment to continually developing technical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate effectively, and deliver results in an Agile and Lean-oriented environment.
* Capability in people management and team leadership, including supporting the manager with delegated supervisory responsibilities and performance updates.
* Availability to work during US business hours, from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST.
* Preferred: Healthcare domain experience, including interfaces and integration engines; knowledge of HL7 standards, patient safety, HIPAA, EMR systems, and hospital or ambulatory workflows; basic SQL knowledge; and a project management certification.

title: SecOps Engineer
description: Company ProfileOur client is a global IT services company that helps businesses with digital transformation with offices in India and the United States. It helps businesses with digital transformation, provide IT collaborations and uses technology, innovation, and enterprise to have a positive impact on the world of business.With expertise is in the fields of Data, IoT, AI, Cloud Infrastructure and SAP, it helps accelerate digital transformation through key practice areas - IT staffing on demand, innovation and growth by focusing on cost and problem solving.Job Profile: Senior Operational Security Engineer (Senior SecOps Engineer)Location: Chennai, IndiaPreferred experience: - 9.1 - 12 years The Role:The Operational Security Engineer will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity posture across Wealth Management operations, with a focus on APAC security requirements. The role involves managing infrastructure and application vulnerabilities, implementing security controls, ensuring regulatory compliance, and overseeing production security activities. The incumbent will work closely with global and regional IT security teams, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business-critical systems and data.Responsibilities:· Manage end-to-end infrastructure vulnerability assessment, prioritization, remediation, and patch management using tools such as Rapid7 Nexpose, Qualys, and Tanium.· Coordinate with IT Development and Production teams to ensure timely vulnerability remediation, asset coverage, tracking, and management reporting.· Drive application security practices, including Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Threat Modelling, SAST, DAST, and SCA.· Conduct security risk assessments and reviews to ensure adequate security controls across Wealth Management applications and infrastructure.· Oversee production security, ensuring vulnerability management effectiveness and compliance with organizational security policies.· Manage IT security compliance in alignment with regulatory requirements such as HKMA, MAS, GDPR, and FINMA, and standards including NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001.· Coordinate with APAC and global IT security teams to monitor security activities, address process gaps, and maintain security governance.· Manage technical access controls, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Data Leakage Prevention (DLP).· Monitor and investigate security incidents, DLP alerts, and cybersecurity risks, ensuring appropriate follow-up and closure.· Ensure onboarding of applications and infrastructure assets into SIEM and support ongoing security monitoring and reporting.· Manage third-party technology risk and cloud security compliance, ensuring appropriate security controls across environments.· Prepare periodic cybersecurity dashboards, risk reports, compliance updates, and management presentations.Must - Have Qualifications:· 9–12 years of experience in Information Security / Cybersecurity.· Hands-on experience in Infrastructure Vulnerability Management and Patch Management.· Hands-on knowledge of vulnerability assessment tools such as Rapid7, Qualys, or Tanium.· Strong expertise in Application Security, Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, SAST, DAST, and SCA.· Experience in IT Security Risk Management, Security Compliance, and regulatory frameworks.· Knowledge of IAM, PAM, DLP, and SIEM.· Experience with CyberArk, Varonis, Guardium, or Symantec DLP.· Knowledge of network security, Firewall, WAF, Anti-DDoS, and encryption technologies.· Technical proficiency in various Operating Systems (Linux, AIX, Windows, AS400) and Databases (Oracle, MSSQL, PostGreSQL, MongDB)· Strong understanding of cybersecurity standards such as NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001.· Experience in banking or financial services, preferably Wealth Management.Preferred Qualifications:· Knowledge of cloud security, Docker, Kubernetes, and container technologies.· Banking security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, or ISO 27001.· Working knowledge of Python and Power BI.Application MethodApply on LinkedIn or email your resume to: careers@speedmart.co.in

description: Job Description:About UsAt Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!Global Business ServicesGlobal Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.Process Overview*This Vulnerability Analyst role supports Bank of America’s Attack Surface & Vulnerability Management (ASVM) team. ASVM is a global function, with teammates in the Americas, EMEA and APAC, that is responsible for evaluation and prioritization of security vulnerabilities to enable appropriate remediation across the company. This role will join a team of vulnerability analysts leveraging technical and analytic skills to assess cyber security related risks based on an understanding of the bank’s attack surface, control environment and threat landscape. Among other things, this will involve data mining efforts to answer the following three questions: Do we have it? Are we vulnerable? Is it exploitable? In addition, this role will assist with reporting and tracking of vulnerability risks that impact the organization.Job Description*This position will be a member of the GIS Vulnerability Identification team. The Vulnerability scanning deployment & engineering specialist will be primarily responsible for end-to-end technology enablement in support of the global Vulnerability Identification program. To continuously improve vulnerability detection capabilities, the role’s remit will span across the Americas, EMEA and the Asia Pacific regions and will focus on the planning, design, testing, deployment of tactical and strategic solutions. This role requires partnership with solutions vendors and technology infrastructure partners to optimally tailor future solutions to vulnerability identification strategic objectives. The role will require cross-organization collaboration to solve key issues impactful to the enterprise.Responsibilities*Evaluate and rate vulnerabilities using available data sources, tools and leveraging new data sources as needed.Analyze environmental conditions as it relates to vulnerabilities, threat scenarios, and mitigating controls.Search systems of record and scan tool output to identify whether vulnerable products are present in our environmentManage reporting, tracking and research updates for “watch list” vulnerabilitiesIdentification of data ingestion errors or quality concerns with intelligence feed and escalation to vendor for remediationCoordination with threat intelligence teamsConfirmation of ratings with downstream stakeholdersParticipate in follow-the-sun handoff communications to ASVM teammates in other regionsRequirements* Education* -BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)Certifications If Any* - NA Experience Range* - 4+ YearsFoundational Skills*Broad knowledge of information security principlesUnderstanding of Vulnerability Management principles and Risk Assessment methodologiesWide knowledge of application and IT products, interoperability, and IT securityFamiliarity with industry standard scoring models such as CVSSFamiliarity with industry standard data models such as CPEFamiliarity with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, SANS 25, MITRE Attack, and CWEsEffective communication skillsProcess oriented with keen attention to detailExcellent analytical skills/problem solving/conceptual thinkingStrong work ethic and ability to effectively multi-task in a fast-paced support environmentHighly motivated and willing to learnDesired Skills*Experience as a Vulnerability or Threat AnalystKnowledge of vulnerability attack methods, exploit results, attack chainsExperience operationalizing MITRE Attack & TTPs in vulnerability prioritizationKnowledge of Linux and Windows Operating SystemsFamiliarity with basic program languages such as Python and JavaExperience conducting vulnerability assessments, code reviews and penetration tests against system and application technologies, services, platforms and languages to find flaws and exploits (e.g., SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting, Cross-Site Request Forgery, Clickjacking, Authentication/Authorization, Privilege Escalation, Business Logic Bypass)Knowledge of container/cloud risk managementWork Timings* - 1:30 PM - 10:30 PM (IST)Job Location* - Chennai/Hyderabad/Mumbai

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- PAM Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

**Project Role Description**
Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.

Machine Learning (ML)

**Summary**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a senior AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.
  
  
Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
  
  
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps
  
  
Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC
  
  
Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
  
  
Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production
  
  
Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
  
  
Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
  
  
Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production
  
  
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
  
  
Minimum of 7 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
  
  
Minimum of 7 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
  
  
Minimum of 5 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
  
  
Minimum of 4 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
  
  
Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
  
  
Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
  
  
Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL
  
  
Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  
  
Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
  
  
Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams
  
  
Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
  
  
MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)
  
  
As a Large Language Model Architect, a typical day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human-like text. This role requires careful planning of neural network configurations and overseeing the training process using extensive datasets. The position demands collaboration with various teams to ensure the models meet performance and scalability requirements, while continuously refining architectures to enhance natural language processing capabilities. The architect plays a key role in driving innovation and ensuring that the language models align with evolving business needs and technological advancements.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have influencing and Advisory skills.
* Engage with multiple teams and responsible for team decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams, and provide solutions to business area problems.
* Lead the development and implementation of scalable language model architectures that address complex challenges.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate language models into broader systems and workflows.
* Mentor junior team members by sharing expertise and guiding best practices in model design and deployment.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Machine Learning (ML).
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services, Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Strong understanding of neural network architectures and deep learning frameworks.
* Experience in handling large-scale datasets and optimizing model training processes.
* Familiarity with natural language processing techniques and language model evaluation metrics.
* Ability to design and implement efficient algorithms for text generation and comprehension.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have minimum 18 years of experience in Machine Learning (ML).

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity -**
Sr. AI Platform Security Engineer
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning

+ Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
+ Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
+ Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

* MLOps, Observability & Automation

+ Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
+ Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
+ Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
+ Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
+ Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
+ Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

* Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics

+ Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
+ Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
+ Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

* Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development

+ Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
+ Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
+ Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
+ Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
+ Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
+ Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
+ Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

* RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration

+ Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
+ Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
+ Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
+ Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering

* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Strong hands-on experience on agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What You'll Be Part Of**

* A growing portfolio of AI initiatives ranging from predictive analytics to generative AI applications.
* Migration of legacy to Databricks Lakehouse platform that will serve as the organization's single source of truth.
* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture that values automation, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: SEO / GEO & AEO Specialist
description:
Company: Warwick Consulting

Location: Chennai, India - Onsite

Experience: 5–6 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Initially Remote, transitioning to Work from Office

Target Market: United States

Compensation: To be discussed

**About Warwick Consulting**

Warwick Consulting is a Boston-based MedTech consulting firm with over 15 years of experience helping medical device manufacturers and emerging MedTech companies bring safe, compliant products to market.

Our expertise spans regulatory strategy, FDA submissions, quality management systems, R&D, verification and validation, human factors engineering, cybersecurity and compliance remediation.

We are also developing innovative technology solutions, including VERA™, our proprietary AI-powered Quality Management System (QMS) platform.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Specialist to lead our organic search strategy and strengthen Warwick Consulting's digital presence across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical SEO expertise, an understanding of AI-driven search behavior and experience driving organic growth and qualified leads within a B2B environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Develop and execute comprehensive SEO, GEO and AEO strategies.

Manage organic search optimization across Warwick Consulting, VERA™ and Warwick Usability Center web pages.

Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search intent mapping.

Improve brand discoverability across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered search platforms.

Optimize website content, structured data, schema markup and site architecture.

Conduct technical SEO audits and identify improvements in website performance, page speed, crawling and indexing.

Coordinate with web development partners to implement technical improvements.

Collaborate with content writers and growth marketing teams to optimize content for search visibility and lead generation.

Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, AI search visibility and conversion performance.

Develop actionable recommendations to improve organic visibility and qualified lead generation.

Prepare regular performance reports for management.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

5–6 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B environment.

Practical understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

Strong knowledge of on-page, off-page and technical SEO.

Experience with structured data, schema markup, website architecture and technical audits.

Proficiency in Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and relevant SEO tools.

Experience working with WordPress or similar content management systems.

Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in MedTech, healthcare, life sciences or other regulated industries.

Familiarity with HubSpot.

Experience supporting B2B organic lead generation.

Key Performance Indicators

Organic website traffic growth.

Improvement in priority keyword rankings.

Brand visibility across AI-powered search platforms.

Organic lead generation.

Website technical SEO performance.

Content visibility and performance.

**Working Arrangement**

The position will initially be remote for first 1 month while our Chennai office is being established. The role is expected to transition to full-time office-based work in Chennai in early January 2027.

Candidates must be available for regular working-hour overlap with the US Eastern Time Zone.

**Selection Process**

Shortlisted candidates will be required to conduct a brief audit of Warwick Consulting's website and present their top five SEO/GEO recommendations, supported by clear reasoning.

**How to Apply**

* Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated resume along with relevant experience, current compensation, expected compensation and notice period.

description:
**ABOUT NIBAV HOME LIFTS**

Nibav Home Lifts is a premium home elevator company offering innovative, safe and technologically advanced home lift solutions designed for modern residential spaces. With a strong focus on design, quality, customer experience and innovation, Nibav caters to HNI and premium homeowners while partnering with architects, builders, interior designers and other key influencers.

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for converting premium sales opportunities into successful business, building strong relationships with HNI customers and key influencers, and driving revenue growth within the assigned market.

**WHY NIBAV HOME LIFTS**

* Opportunity to lead a high-growth regional business in the premium home Lifts segment.
* Exposure to HNI customers and leading architects, builders, and interior designers.
* Performance-linked incentives and rewards.
* International incentive opportunities for top performers.
* Performance-driven career progression.

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Convert premium leads into successful sales closures.
* Drive revenue and achieve assigned sales targets.
* Develop and execute effective territory-level sales strategies.

* Ensure a premium customer experience throughout the sales journey.

* Handle negotiations and effectively manage objections.
* Drive opportunities through the complete sales cycle—from lead qualification to closure.

* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Customer-centric approach with strong commercial orientation.
* Fluent in English and the relevant regional language.
* Strong target orientation and ability to work in a performance-driven environment.
* Immediate joiners or candidates available within 15 days preferred.

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

**Technical:**

* Premium / High-Ticket Sales
* Business Development
* HNI & Key Account Management
* Negotiation & Deal Closure
* Territory & Pipeline Management

**Behavioural:**

* Customer Centricity
* Communication & Influencing
* Ownership & Accountability
* Results Orientation
* Relationship Building

●     Track and fix catalogue errors, content rejections and listing blocks the same day.

●     Run weekly listing and search-rank audits; act on every gap.

●     Flag slow-moving and near-expiry stock early with a clear action plan.

●     Own platform pricing, margins and promotions within approved limits; escalate any deviation immediately.

●     Plan and run sponsored ads, deals and festival campaigns with defined budgets and ROAS targets.

●     Review ad spend, ACoS/ROAS and conversion daily; pause, optimise or scale decisively.

●     Track competitor prices, ranks and offers weekly and respond fast.

●     Deliver monthly campaign calendars aligned with Marketing and Sales.

●     Be the single point of contact for category managers and account teams on every platform.

●     Negotiate listing support, ad support and visibility opportunities and convert them into sales.

●     Track settlements, deductions and chargebacks; raise disputes and recover dues on time.

●     Resolve every platform escalation, customer complaint and rating issue within 24 hours.

●     Close month-end payment reconciliation with Accounts without reminders.

**5. Analytics, Reporting & Growth**

●     Publish daily sales and stock dashboards and a weekly review: GMV, units, share, rank and returns.

●     Identify new SKUs, packs, bundles and platforms with growth potential and present a plan with numbers.

●     Build monthly and quarterly sales targets by platform and own the achievement.

●     Maintain accurate records and share clean data with Finance, Sales and Management.

●     Bring one new improvement idea every month and implement it.

●     Platform GMV and sales vs target

●     Listing health: 100% active, correct content

●     Fill rate and OTIF

●     ROAS and ad efficiency

●     Settlement and claim recovery on time

●     Daily and weekly reporting on time

**What You Bring**

●     2–4 years of e-commerce or quick-commerce account handling, ideally FMCG or food

●     Hands-on with seller/vendor portals, ads and catalogue tools

●     Strong Excel and data skills; analytical and fast in follow-up

●     Graduate (BBA / B.Com / MBA preferred)

title: Strategic Account Manager - Critical Care (Cochin)
description:
**Role Overview**
The Product Specialist – Critical Care will serve as the primary clinical and commercial interface for Fresenius Medical Care's Critical Care therapy portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of revenue accountability and deep clinical expertise — responsible for driving therapy adoption in ICUs, building institutional relationships, and establishing FME as the therapy partner of choice in the critical care space.
  
  
**Broader Responsibilities**
**Revenue Ownership:**
Accountable for achieving and growing revenue targets within the assigned territory. This includes identifying opportunities for therapy initiation, utilization growth, and account expansion through both new customer acquisition and deepening penetration within existing ICU accounts.
  
  
**ICU Engagement & Therapy Adoption:**
Develop a thorough understanding of ICU workflows, patient profiles, and clinical decision-making dynamics. Engage intensivists, nephrologists, and critical care nursing teams to drive adoption of CRRT/HVHDF therapies and ensure optimal therapy utilization.
  
  
**Account Planning & Coverage:**
Create and execute structured account plans for key hospitals and critical care centres. Conduct regular in-person visits, clinical presentations, and therapy reviews to identify growth opportunities and address adoption barriers proactively.
  
  
**Clinical Support & Demonstration:**
Provide hands-on clinical demonstration, in-service training, and bedside support to healthcare teams on product usage, therapy protocols, and best practices — ensuring both clinical confidence and patient outcome focus.
  
  
**Market Intelligence:**
Track and analyse competitive activity, therapy trends, and account-level data to continuously refine territory strategy and share actionable insights with the marketing and clinical teams.
  
  
**KOL Development:**
Identify, engage, and develop Key Opinion Leaders within the critical care and nephrology community to advocate for therapy upgradation, support peer education, and strengthen FME's clinical credibility in the market.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Quarterly and annual revenue targets for the Critical Care portfolio
* Therapy initiation and utilization metrics across assigned accounts
* Number of active ICU accounts under structured engagement
* Clinical training and in-service sessions conducted
* KOL engagement pipeline — identified, engaged, and activated
* Timely and accurate reporting of account activity, pipeline, and market intelligence

**Expectations**
**Cross-functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with the Sales, Technical Service, Marketing, and Clinical teams to ensure seamless pre- and post-sale support. Act as the critical care voice within the commercial team.
  
  
**Solution-oriented Mindset:**
Understand the specific clinical and operational challenges of each ICU and offer tailored therapy solutions — backed by clinical evidence, product knowledge, and a genuine understanding of patient care outcomes.
  
  
**Commercial Acumen with Clinical Credibility:**
Balance revenue orientation with the ability to engage credibly in clinical conversations. The role demands someone who can speak the language of the ICU and the boardroom with equal fluency.
  
  
**Ideal Profile**

* Graduate in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or Biomedical Engineering; paramedical background in critical care is a strong advantage
* 3–6 years of experience in medical devices, with at least 2 years in ICU-facing roles (CRRT, ventilation, hemodynamic monitoring, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth in a clinical selling environment
* Strong communication, relationship-building, and clinical presentation skills
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory

description:
**Area Sales Manager – Kerala**

**Sensorisch Formulation Labs Private Limited**

**Location:**
Kerala (field-based; Kochi / Ernakulam preferred)

**Experience: 1**
–3 years of B2B sales (B2B background is mandatory)

1

**About the job**

**About Us**

Sensorisch Formulation Labs Private Limited is a Chennai-based B2B company that develops and manufactures flavours, seasonings and food colours for food and beverage manufacturers. With an integrated R&D and manufacturing set-up, we work closely with customers to turn their briefs into products that perform. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.

**The Role**

You will build and own Sensorisch's B2B business in Kerala: open food and beverage manufacturers, convert enquiries and samples into orders, and grow long-term accounts for our flavours, seasonings and food colours. You report to the Head of Sales & Marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Territory Plan & Business Development**

●     Own the Kerala territory plan: target accounts by industry, volume and potential, with a visit calendar.

●     Identify and open food and beverage manufacturers: bakery, dairy, beverage, confectionery, snack and seasoning units.

●     Meet owners, R&D, purchase and production heads; generate qualified enquiries and trials monthly.

●     Map incumbent suppliers at each target account and plan how to displace them.

●     Open new accounts against the annual plan; no waiting for leads to come to you.

**2. Sample-to-Order Management**

●     Capture every customer brief completely: application, target profile, dosage, benchmark, cost target, volume and timeline.

●     Hand the brief to the Sales Coordinator and R&D the same day.

●     Track every sample to feedback and decision; follow up until you get a yes or a clear no.

●     Convert approved samples into commercial orders with a defined conversion plan.

●     Keep the enquiry–sample–order funnel updated in the CRM daily.

**3. Key Account Management**

●     Build an account plan for each key account with annual volume, growth actions and risks.

●     Hold regular reviews with customer R&D, purchase and production.

●     Resolve complaints and technical issues jointly with R&D and QC within agreed timelines.

●     Grow wallet share by introducing new flavours, seasonings and colours in existing accounts.

●     Protect accounts from competitor threats through early warning and action.

**4. Pricing, Collections & Credit**

●     Quote from the approved price list and margins; escalate negotiations beyond your limits with a clear recommendation.

●     Negotiate terms professionally without giving away margin.

●     Follow up payments and keep receivables within agreed credit terms.

●     Do not accept orders or release supplies beyond credit limits without approval.

●     Reconcile outstanding with Accounts monthly and close overdue accounts.

**5. Reporting, Market Intelligence & Discipline**

●     Share a weekly visit plan, daily CRM updates and a monthly territory review.

●     Report competitor activity, pricing and new-product trends in Kerala every week.

●     Represent Sensorisch professionally at customer sites and industry events.

●     Bring customer needs and market gaps back to R&D and Head of Sales & Marketing with recommendations.

●     Take full ownership of your territory numbers; own the result.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

●     Territory sales vs monthly and quarterly target

●     New customers converted from enquiry to first order

●     Sample-to-commercial-order conversion

●     Growth and retention of key accounts

●     Receivables within agreed credit terms

●     CRM, visit plans and monthly review on time

**What You Bring**

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analyst**

**Senior Analyst | Assistant Manager**

Chennai | 4 days/week WFO, flexibility as per team norms

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The EXL Payment Integrity business unit helps leading US health insurers identify errors and recover overpayments in medical claims. Unlike a typical services firm, we earn our revenue as a proportion of the savings we identify, so the impact of this role is directly visible in our P&L.

Within EXL PI, the Analytics Center of Excellence combines domain expertise, data, algorithms, and technology to identify measurable savings opportunities for leading US health plans.

We are looking for self-driven, business-minded data analysts who will partner with analytics consultants, subject matter experts, and other key stakeholders to translate problems into clear solutions through analysis, reports, and visualisations.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

You will work with large-scale healthcare data, convert complex claims information into actionable insights and help build scalable analytics solutions across multiple health plans.

* **Analyse claims data:**
  dig into claims and operational data to find the patterns that drive measurable business outcomes.
* **Report and visualise:**
  bring together data from multiple sources into accurate, decision-ready reports and interactive visualisations.
* **Turn requirements into solutions:**
  convert business requirements into practical analytical solutions, automated reporting and clear recommendations for decision-makers.
* **Optimise performance:**
  monitor query and code performance, and keep it efficient through code optimisation, appropriate indexing and sound data-handling practices.
* **Validate and share insights:**
  check findings for accuracy, communicate them clearly and work with cross-functional teams across projects.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

* **Analytical problem-solving:**
  you apply logical reasoning and basic statistical skills to real-world, large-scale data sets.
* **Communication and stakeholder management:**
  you write and speak clearly, and represent data in a way stakeholders can act on.
* **Self-management:**
  you manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively and adapt to evolving project needs.
* **Curiosity and ownership:**
  you take ownership of your work and are keen to keep learning in a high-growth environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Science or a related quantitative field.
* 2–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, decision support, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, and Microsoft Excel, including querying, analysis, report creation, and presentation of insights.
* **Good to have (domain):**
  US healthcare experience, including claims processing, the claims lifecycle and billing, fraud analytics, or payment integrity functions such as Appeals, Repricing, Prepay Audit or Postpay Audit.
* **Good to have (tools):**
  Power BI or Tableau for reporting and visualisation, and working knowledge of Microsoft Azure DevOps and Databricks.
* Your designation is based on your experience and the scope you can take on. Senior Analysts deliver analyses and reports; Assistant Managers also review and challenge analysts’ work and own workstreams end to end.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Real impact:**
  your analysis feeds directly into the savings we identify for US health plans, and you see how it is used.
* **Learn from experts:**
  you work alongside consultants, subject matter experts and leaders across a 100+ strong analytics team and build your healthcare and payment integrity expertise quickly.
* **Modern data stack at scale:**
  work with large volumes of claims data using tools such as SQL, Python, Azure Databricks and Power BI.
* **Build alongside the team:**
  four days a week in office means you sit with data scientists, domain experts and leaders, so you learn faster and your ideas move quickly from discussion to pilot.

If the above criteria match your profile, do apply or please share your updated CV with me at Shanthi@exlservice.com by sharing the required details below.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova’s Power Conversion & Storage business is at the forefront of the energy transition. We are seeking several highly skilled Data Analyst to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making across our business.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and machine learning to real-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
  
A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or pure software development when needed.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Key ResponsibilitiesAI & ML Solution Development & Integration

+ Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.
+ Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade-offs behind that choice.
+ Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.
+ Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.
+ Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.

* Technical Implementation & Architecture

+ Collaborate with domain experts to identify high-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.
+ Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.
+ Design cloud-ready and on-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data-governance standards.
+ Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.
+ Contribute to the development of robust, production-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.

* Solution Delivery, Partner & Contractor Management

+ Write clear technical specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria for work delivered by external contractors, software vendors, or internal digital teams.
+ Contribute to supplier, platform, and tool selection through structured technical evaluation, benchmarking, and proof-of-concept comparison.
+ Steer and review the work of internal & external partners: technical follow-up, design reviews, code and model reviews, quality gates, and acceptance testing; remaining the technical owner and guardian of the delivered solution.
+ Ensure solutions remain maintainable after handover through documentation, knowledge transfer, and clearly assigned ownership, so that delivered tools do not become orphaned.

* Data Strategy & Analytics

+ Lead or support the collection, processing, structuring, and analysis of large-scale operational and business data.
+ Assess data readiness ahead of any development (availability, quality, labelling needs, access rights, confidentiality) and define strategies to close the gaps.
+ Identify patterns, trends, and performance improvement opportunities using advanced analytics and AI methods.
+ Develop data-driven solutions such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality and performance prediction, forecasting, cost analysis, document and requirement analysis, and knowledge support tools.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Work closely with technical, operational, business and IT teams to ensure AI solutions meet business and industry requirements for safety, reliability, performance, and scalability.
+ Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ Help align AI initiatives with business priorities, operational goals, and constraints.
+ Support end-user adoption: training, onboarding, feedback loops and measurement of the benefits realized once the solution is live.

* Continuous Innovation

+ Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability.
+ Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities.
+ Maintain an active technology watch on the AI tooling landscape and filter it, distinguishing capability gains from hype before proposing adoption.
+ Contribute to building an innovation-oriented culture through knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

* Education

+ Bachelor/Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

* Experience

+ Several years (2 to 4) of professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a comparable technical role.
+ Experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in industrial, technical, or other complex operational environments is preferred.

* Technical Expertise

+ Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code.
+ Hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, as well as classical ML tooling (e.g. scikit-learn, gradient boosting methods).
+ Experience with time-series analysis, optimization methods, and data-driven model development.
+ Practical experience with GenAI and their surrounding stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A)
+ Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data.
+ Solid grounding in cloud services and architecture (Azure, AWS)
+ Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, data pipelines, and structured/unstructured data handling.
+ Familiarity with MLOps practices, model deployment, and integration into production environments is an advantage.

* Domain Knowledge (Secondary)

+ Sound knowledge of artificial intelligence, combined with a strong interest in emerging technologies and digital trends.
+ Understanding of industrial processes, electrification, power systems, or related technical domains, or business processes, is an advantage.
+ Awareness of the regulatory and governance context around AI (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) is a plus.
+ Experience in innovation management and/or patent-related work is a plus.

* Personal Attributes

+ Proven ability to translate complex business and technical challenges into practical, scalable AI-driven solutions.
+ Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with a high degree of self-motivation and a structured, goal-oriented working style.
+ Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
+ Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across functions and disciplines.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes
