title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Network Engineer

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced L2/L3 Network Engineer to be a critical member of our network operations team. The ideal candidate will possess deep, hands-on expertise in configuring, maintaining, and advanced troubleshooting of enterprise level network infrastructure, with a specialized focus on Juniper (routing/switching/security) and Aruba (wired and wireless) solutions. This role involves both operational support (L2/L3 incident resolution) and project-based implementation/design activities. Juniper technologies and certifications, including JNCIE-ENT (Juniper Networks Certified Internet Expert - Enterprise), JNCDS-DC (Juniper Networks Certified Design Specialist - Data Centre), WAN (Wide Area Network), and SEC (Security) certifications. The Network Engineer will be responsible for overseeing network infrastructure, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring optimal performance and security across the network.

Job Location: Chennai

Key Responsibilities:

1. Configuration & Implementation Juniper Platform Management: Expertly configure and maintain routing, switching, and security devices, including but not limited to Juniper MX, EX, and SRX series. Aruba Platform Management: Design, deploy, and support enterprise-grade wireless and wired solutions using Aruba switches, Access Points (Aps), Controllers, Aruba ClearPass, and Aruba Airwave/Central. Internetworking: Configure and manage advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and Layer 2 technologies (VLANs, STP, Link Aggregation) across multi-vendor environments. implement and manage VPNs (IPSec/SSL), network segmentation, and access controls.

2. Advanced Troubleshooting & Operations (L2/L3) Serve as the final escalation point (L3) for complex and critical network incidents performing root cause analysis (RCA) and ensuring quick resolution. Conduct in-depth performance monitoring and tuning, capacity planning, and proactive issue resolution to maximize network uptime. Utilize network diagnostic tools (Wireshark, network monitoring systems) to analyze traffic and isolate complex L2/L3 issues. Manage and execute network changes via established change management processes (ITIL).

3. Design & Documentation: Contribute to the low-level design and architecture of scalable, secure, and reliable network solutions. Create and maintain detailed network diagrams, configuration backups, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and other technical documentation. Collaborate with security and architecture teams to enforce network security policies and best practices.

Required Skills

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a Network Engineering role, operating at L2/L3 support tiers.

• Vendor Expertise: Strong, demonstrable proficiency with Juniper (Junos OS) and Aruba (Aruba OS, ClearPass) product lines.

• Technical Depth: Expert knowledge of TCP/IP, Layer 2 (STP, VLANs), and Layer 3 (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) protocols.

• Security: Experience with firewalls, IDS/IPS, and network access control (NAC) concepts (specifically Aruba ClearPass experience is highly desired).

• Certifications (Highly Preferred): JNCIS/JNCIP, ACCP/ACCP-D/ACMP, or equivalent professional-level certifications (e.g., CCNP).

• Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work in an on-call rotation as required. Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• Certifications: Mandatory: JNCS, JNCDS-DC (Or Equivalent) • Additional certifications in network engineering or security are a plus.

• Experience: 3-4 years of experience as a network engineer, with a focus on enterprise networks. data center environments, and security.

• In-depth experience with Juniper routers, switches, firewalls, and related network devices. • Hands-on experience with WAN technologies (MPLS, VPN, BGP, OSPF, etc.)

• Strong understanding of network security concepts, including IPSec, SSL VPN. and firewall configuration. Skills

• Advanced knowledge of Designing Juniper networking solutions and their configuration. • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Familiarity with network management tools, monitoring systems, and performance analysis.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Preferred Skills: • Experience and certification with other networking technologies such as Aruba, Cisco, Fortinet and Palo Alto is a plus.

• Experience and certification in Aruba and Juniper wireless networks is a plus. • Ability to lead and mentor junior network engineers.

• Experience with cloud-based networking and hybrid network models is beneficial.

title: Optical LAN Design and Integration Engineer – Nokia Aurelis
description:
**ABOUT TELENCE SOLUTIONS**

Telence Solutions is a multi-vendor network engineering, cybersecurity and AI operations partner for service providers and mission-critical industries. From RFP to design, migration and managed operations, we deliver vendor-level depth across IP/MPLS, optics, wireless, broadband, security, cloud, automation and AIOps. Our 70+ certified engineers work across pre-sales, post-sales and operational support, and our Autonomic Network Engine (ANE) unifies orchestration across domains.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for an engineer to design and integrate Nokia Aurelis Optical LAN solutions for enterprise customers. You will work remotely from Chennai, turning customer requirements into complete, correct designs and bills of materials, and supporting the integration of the solution into the customer's network.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Design Aurelis Optical LAN solutions around the MF-2 optical switch: chassis, controller card, GPON line cards, power and battery modules, fans, blank plates and cabling
* Size each design by working out PON ports, splits, optical power budgets, modem counts and uplink capacity
* Select and match uplink and PON optics to the customer's fiber plant, including SFP+ and QSFP28 adapter options and industrial-temperature optics
* Choose optical modems for each location, with the right power adapter and regional plug
* Build and check bills of materials: part numbers, quantities, compatibility, Command Center and port-based software licenses, care services, spares and surcharges
* Produce high-level and low-level designs, rack and power layouts, labelling and fiber cabling plans
* Configure and integrate the solution with Aurelis Command Center and with the customer's LAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, PoE devices and management systems
* Write installation and integration guides, and remotely support on-site installers and customer teams through commissioning, testing and handover
* Troubleshoot issues, plan software updates and advise on spares
* Document designs and train customer and partner teams

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Experience: designing and deploying GPON or passive Optical LAN networks in enterprise, hospitality, healthcare or campus environments
* GPON fundamentals: OLT, ONT, splitters, optical power budgets, SC/APC connectors and fiber testing
* Hands-on configuration of an OLT platform, preferably Nokia Lightspan or Aurelis MF-2
* Ethernet and IP: VLANs, link aggregation, redundancy, QoS, multicast, DHCP and PoE
* Telecom power: AC and DC feeds, battery backup and grounding for rack equipment
* Bills of materials: reading vendor part-code lists and price books and spotting missing or incompatible items
* Remote delivery: working independently with customers in different time zones, with clear written and spoken English
* Location: based in Chennai, India, with a reliable home office and internet connection

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* Preferred: Nokia fixed access or Optical LAN training and certification
* Valued: Cisco CCNA or an equivalent networking certification

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with Aurelis Command Center
* Experience carrying Wi-Fi, CCTV, access control and IoT over Optical LAN
* Familiarity with PON-based out-of-band management for data centers
* Provisioning automation with Python or Ansible

**PRODUCTS YOU WILL WORK WITH**

* Aurelis MF-2 Optical Switch (AC, ETSI): chassis and core assemblies, LMNT-D controller card with clock sync, LGLT-D 16-port GPON line cards, LPWR-B AC power module, LBAT-A battery module, fan module, blank plates, dust filter, and power, DC and grounding cables
* Uplink and PON optics: 10GBase-SR SFP+ (industrial temperature), QSFP28 to SFP28/SFP+ adapter, GPON B+ SFP for the OLT, and GPON B+ SFP with SC/APC
* Aurelis Optical Modems: U-490XP-P
* Aurelis software: Command Center SW Package Rel 26 and Standard SW port packs (yearly term)
* Care services, installation and integration services, spares and memory surcharges that come with each bill of materials

Telence Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

You will be able to leverage your technical knowledge to directly support customer through commissioning, maintaining, servicing of Power Conversion’s state of the art products and solutions across the globe, while you collaborate across the globe with key functional teams and enhance your strategic business acumen. The job will require frequent traveling up to 100 % to various client sites in India and globally.
  
  
Our team of dedicated experts needs reinforcement from young or experienced colleagues. So if you find electric drive technology and the associated processes interesting, can get excited about it, and are a thoroughbred technician/engineer, then we are looking for you! Great performance needs Great Engineers!.

**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities:**

The Services Specialist develops practical and innovative ways to identify and meet goals. In this role you are responsible for work which is defined in scope, utilize your understanding and experience to execute business objectives, and have the ability to effect short-term and some long-term business goals.

  
  

* Commissioning of extensive systems consisting of power controllers, frequency converters, load commutated drives, excitation systems, Electrical machines, and load machines or production plants, such as large converters for pumped storage power plants, gas turbine power plants, and much more.
* Commissioning of the Medium Voltage AC and DC Drives with associated Voltage Switchgear in business segments such as Power Plants, Metals, Marine, Oil & Gas, Material handling, etc.,
* Show-up individuality with less supervision in commissioning and service activities in Power Equipment. Should communicate clearly and follow the instructions from Site Lead or Site manager and perform the task with at most quality. Interact and assistance to the customer, user, and other GE field personnel in the operation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of assigned product lines.
* Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair, and calibration after installation
* Perform unplanned/corrective maintenance and complete all necessary technical and business documentation on time and accurate. Comply with the integrity and compliance guidelines. Record keeping of day-to-day activities in digital forms.
* Provide technical assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair, and maintenance at customer's sites
* Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment
* Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage
* Maintain strong safety mindset to assure the executed work reflects the technical requirements within GE safety standards. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with the organization’s EHS and associated policies/procedures
* Ensure customer satisfaction with maintenance solutions, according to the metrics of service, terms, performance, and quality.
* A job at this level requires good interpersonal skills. For customer facing roles, develops strong customer relationships and serves as the interface between customer and GE. Explains technical information to others.
* Assist customer with improving reliability and reducing cost of ownership
* Provide single point of contact to the customer, customer team, and all other GE stakeholders
* Assist the factory with data collection and timely reporting to facilitate fleet performance analysis, including marketing intelligence and sales opportunities for services, and support
* Assist customer with spare parts ordering & issues resolution
  

  

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Diploma/ B.E / M.E or equivalent / Electrical/Electronic engineering from accredited college / university.
* 3 – 7 years of relevant experience
* Should have process knowledge of Metal / Marine / Oil & Gas / Test Bench / Material Handling / Power Plant
* Knowledge in Power Electronics, Low Voltage Equipment (AC/ DC) & PLC
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Work experience on Power converters, Generators, switchboards, AVR, excitation systems, DC Motors, and DC/ AC drives
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Ability to work independently. Strong problem-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Proactive self-starter and change agent & ability to work under stress environment
* Cross functional, ability to work on matrix environment, and international team experience
* Effectively communicate across all organizational levels, departments, and functions
* Demonstrated technical aptitude and business acumen.

==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Mainframe CICS System Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

  

As a Mainframe CICS System Engineer, you’ll use your CICS expertise to help run, maintain and evolve the transaction processing environments that support customers’ mission-critical applications.

  

You’ll work hands-on across IBM CICS Transaction Server environments, maintaining CICS regions and CICSplex infrastructure and helping ensure services remain available, performant and resilient. Your work will range from day-to-day system programming and production support to planned maintenance, upgrades, migrations and disaster recovery activities.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* **Run CICS environments:** Install, configure, administer and maintain IBM CICS Transaction Server environments and CICS regions.

* **Manage CICSplex:** Support CICSplex and multi-region environments, including infrastructure configuration, workload management and operational health.

* **Protect availability:** Monitor transaction processing environments, investigate availability or performance issues and implement appropriate resolution.

* **Maintain systems:** Plan and support CICS maintenance, upgrades and migrations, including IBM fixes and related system changes.

* **Connect technologies:** Support CICS integration with IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM, RACF and other z/OS services

* **Improve performance:** Analyse CICS performance, workloads and capacity using relevant monitoring and diagnostic tools to identify opportunities for improvement.

* **Strengthen resilience:** Support disaster recovery exercises and readiness activities to help maintain resilient CICS environments.

* **Support modernisation:** Contribute to CICS modernisation activities such as Web Services, API enablement and Java integration where required.

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in Mainframe CICS System Programming or CICS infrastructure support.

* Strong working knowledge of IBM CICS Transaction Server, including CICS regions, system configuration, administration, monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting.

* Experience supporting production CICS environments, including incident resolution, planned changes, service requests and system maintenance.

* Hands-on experience or working knowledge of CICS installation, maintenance, upgrades and migration activities

* Experience with CICS monitoring, performance or diagnostic tools such as IBM OMEGAMON for CICS, BMC MainView, ASG TMON/CICS, CICS Performance Analyzer, Abend-AID, Xpediter/CICS, InterTest, SymDump or comparable technologies.

* Understanding of CICS integration with IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM and other mainframe application components.

* Experience supporting CICSplex, multi-region or comparable complex CICS environments.

Ability to participate in rotational on-call support, planned maintenance and disaster recovery exercises as required.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with CICS Web Services, API enablement, Java integration or other CICS modernisation technologies.

* Experience maintaining CICS using SMP/E and applying IBM PTFs, APAR fixes or related maintenance.

* Experience with CICSPlex SM and CICS Workload Management.

* Experience with CICS performance analysis, workload balancing, capacity monitoring or tuning .

Experience contributing to CICS upgrades, migrations and continuous improvement initiatives within a broader technical team.  



**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. The
**Senior Consultant**

**strong knowledge**

In this role, you will act as a key technical resource for customer deployments while driving internal delivery innovation—designing, coding, and maintaining custom automation scripts, internal tools, and AI/LLM-assisted workflows that improve consulting efficiency across the team.

Hands-On Tooling & Automation Engineering

* Delivery Automation: Continuously identify repetitive implementation tasks and build automated scripts and frameworks to optimize delivery speed and quality.

Technical Leadership & Complex Delivery
  
  

* Technical Leadership: Act as a key technical resource on F5 security, application delivery, and cloud networking solutions for enterprise customer engagements.
* End-to-End Implementation: Own technical design, configuration, integration, and validation for client projects.
* Advanced Diagnostics & Escalation: Function as an experienced technical resource for diagnosing and resolving operational issues, infrastructure bottlenecks, and delivery obstacles.
* Technical Risk Management: Analyze customer architectures to proactively identify technical risks and design robust mitigation strategies.

Practice Enablement & Knowledge Sharing
  
  

* Reusable Blueprints & Patterns: Translate field experiences into reusable code templates, standard operating procedures, and technical assets for the broader consulting organization.
* Trusted Technical Advisor: Build strong, technical credibility with customer engineering teams, security architects, and technical leadership.
* Product Feedback Loop: Channel technical learnings, bug findings, and feature gaps from client environments back to F5 Product and Engineering teams.

**Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
Qualification Requirements
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience:

+ 5-8 years of hands-on experience in Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Web Operations supporting enterprise environments.
+ Proven track record of handling complex application delivery and security infrastructure.

Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Software Development & Automation: Advanced, hands-on scripting/programming proficiency in Python and Terraform. Demonstrated history of building developer utilities, CLIs, internal tools, or infrastructure-as-code (IaC) modules.
* AI/LLM Integration: Practical, hands-on experience integrating AI/ML APIs, LLM tools, or intelligent scripts into internal workflows, diagnostic tools, or operational tasks.
* Layer 3–7 Deep Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge in at least three of the following domains:

+ Web Application Firewalls (WAF) & Bot Management
+ Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies, and API Gateways
+ Layer 3–7 DDoS Mitigation and CDN Architecture
+ Cloud Operations and Multi-Cloud Networking

* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience deploying and managing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Networking & Web Technologies: Strong foundational and deep Layer 7 expertise, including TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL, and modern web application delivery architectures.
* Troubleshooting Excellence: Exceptional root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills across customer infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Consultative Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts clearly to both enterprise customer engineering teams and internal stakeholders.

title: Senior Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
Being a Senior / Lead Engineer within the CISO organization, you will serve as a technical authority for DTCC’s Privileged Access Management (PAM) platforms. You will design, build, and operate highly available, secure PAM services across hybrid environments, ensuring privileged access is controlled, observable, and resilient.
  
  
This role plays a critical part in advancing Zero Trust principles by embedding PAM into infrastructure, cloud, and application workflows. You will lead by example—owning production outcomes, driving automation, and ensuring the platform is observable, auditable, and operationally sound.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Design and evolve PAM platform architecture with a focus on scalability, resilience (HA/DR), and security-by-design.
* Drive platform maturity: Implement sophisticated capabilities (JIT access, session recording, credential vaulting, API integrations) and standardize onboarding of new systems.
* Implement and maintain end-to-end observability for PAM platforms using monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent).
* Governance & compliance: Establish policies for privileged account lifecycle, enforce password complexity and rotation, and ensure audit readiness for SOX, PCI, and internal controls.
* Automation & integration: Embed PAM into CI/CD pipelines and workflows; develop scripts and connectors for automated provisioning and session management.
* Operational excellence: Monitor PAM performance, lead incident response for privileged access breaches, and conduct root-cause analysis and remediation.
* Stakeholder engagement: Communicate platform health, roadmap, and risk posture to senior leadership; manage vendor relationships and licensing.
* Act as a mentor for other engineers—reviewing designs, code, and operational practices.
* Disaster recovery readiness: Participate in DR exercises and ensure PAM resilience in loss-of-region scenarios

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 6+ years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Strong experience in security/platform engineering or IAM/PAM.
* Strong PAM knowledge: privileged accounts, vaulting, rotation, and session management.
* Hands-on automation with Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or Groovy.
* Experience with Jenkins, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and system integrations.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux/Unix, Active Directory, databases, and cloud.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Bravura PAM, CyberArk, or similar enterprise PAM platforms.
* Experience with advanced PAM capabilities including JIT access, ephemeral credentials, and API-based integrations.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust and modern privileged access architectures.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and PAM integration patterns.
* Experience with automation and DevOps practices, including Ansible, Jenkins, Git, and CI/CD.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Admin Assistant

Location: Kompally, Hyderabad, TG-500078

Employment Type: Full-Time/Office Based

Experience Level: Fresher’s Applicable/1-3 Years Experience Preferred

Industry: Logistics / Warehousing / Transportation

About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Accounts Admin Assistant to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will support both the Accounts and Administrative functions of our logistics company, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations. This role requires hands-on experience with Tally Prime/SAS ERP, MS Office, especially Excel/Spreadsheets, and excellent organizational skills.

You will be fully inducted and trained according to our standard operating procedures to ensure seamless integration into your responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Maintain and update accounting records using Tally Prime ERP.
* Manage Accounts Payable / Receivable, including invoice generation, payment follow-ups, and reconciliations.
* Monitor and maintain records of miscellaneous expenses / petty cash.
* Generate quotations for potential clients and follow up as required.
* Handle day-to-day administrative operations related to logistics and office management.
* Prepare and maintain Excel spreadsheets and reports for financial tracking.
* Manage incoming and outgoing calls and emails professionally, preferable languages: English, Hindi & Telugu
* Organize and maintain physical and digital filing systems.
* Support in documentation and compliance tasks as needed.
* Liaise with vendors, clients, and internal departments to ensure efficient workflow.

Requirements:

* Proficiency in Tally Prime ERP for day-to-day accounting tasks.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel (formulas, data entry, reporting).
* Familiarity with logistics operations and related paperwork is an advantage.
* Excellent communication skills—verbal and written.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Attention to detail with a proactive problem-solving attitude.

Education & Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Business Administration, or related field (preferred).
* 1–3 years of relevant work experience in accounting or administrative support, preferably in a logistics environment.
* Freshers with strong technical skills and willingness to learn may also apply.

What We Offer:

* Comprehensive training and induction on company systems and procedures.
* A supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth within the company.
* Competitive remuneration based on experience and skills.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates can send their updated CV and cover letter to ops@fwdspace.com with the subject line: Application for Accounts Admin Assistant.

**Company Description**
Forward Space Logistics (Fwd Space) is a start-up specializing in warehousing and supply chain consulting, focused on delivering seamless logistics services to a diverse client base. The company designs tailor-made logistics solutions that support efficient storage, handling, and clubbing of materials. Fwd Space also coordinates nationwide distribution to help clients execute strategy and tactics effectively across their supply chains. Team members have the opportunity to work in a growing, dynamic environment where practical logistics expertise and innovation are highly valued.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for an Administrative Assistant at Forward Space Logistics. The Administrative Assistant will manage day-to-day administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, organizing digital files, maintaining records, and preparing basic reports and documentation. The role includes handling incoming calls and emails, directing inquiries to the appropriate team members, and supporting executives with calendar coordination and travel or meeting arrangements. The Administrative Assistant will assist with clerical tasks including data entry, document formatting, and maintaining spreadsheets and logistics-related databases. This position works closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth communication, timely follow-ups, and organized processes in a fast-paced logistics environment.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills, including scheduling, recordkeeping, data entry, and document management.
* Candidates should possess professional Phone Etiquette and Communication skills, with the ability to handle inquiries, provide clear information, and communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
* Candidates should possess Executive Administrative Assistance capabilities, including calendar management, meeting coordination, and support for senior leaders.
* Candidates should be proficient with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, email, and virtual meeting platforms).
* Candidates should demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote setting.
* Relevant experience in logistics, supply chain, or a related industry is beneficial.
* A high school diploma or equivalent is required; additional education or certification in business administration or office management is an advantage.

description:
IND Staff Engineer, Reliability - GCC070
  
  
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
  
  
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
The IND Staff Engineer, Reliability plays a critical role in ensuring the continuous availability and optimal performance of Hartford Fire Insurance Company's IT infrastructure and applications, with a focus on incident prevention, rapid resolution, and system stability.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Design, develop, and implement reliability and performance improvements for critical production systems and services.
* Proactively monitor system health, identify potential issues, and develop automated solutions to prevent outages.
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortem activities for complex production incidents, ensuring timely resolution and preventing recurrence.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and other engineering teams to integrate reliability principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to provide comprehensive visibility into system performance.
* Implement and manage disaster recovery and business continuity plans to minimize downtime in the event of major incidents.
* Conduct performance testing, capacity planning, and scalability assessments to ensure systems can handle anticipated load.
* Document system architecture, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides for knowledge sharing and team efficiency.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the development of best practices within the reliability engineering team.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in reliability engineering and site reliability engineering (SRE).

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in a reliability engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), or equivalent role.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby) and experience with automation tools.
* Extensive experience with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog).
* Solid understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing).

* Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot complex technical issues in production environments.

* Experience in the financial services or insurance industry is a plus.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* Understanding of incident life cycle and strong background in incident and problem manage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues, risks, workarounds, and resolution plans to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to participate in rotational on-call support, respond to production incidents, and drive timely restoration of service while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
* Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably financial services, with a focus on secure, compliant, and reliable technology operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preffered Qualification**
Nice to Have Skills
  
  

* Experience supporting Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services platforms, with knowledge of the trade lifecycle, investment operations, and front-to-back office workflows.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term corrective actions.
* Practical experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, logs, metrics, and traces using tools such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ThousandEyes, or similar platforms.
* Ability to automate repetitive operational tasks, reduce toil, improve runbooks, and build scripts or tools using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, or similar technologies.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the service transformation teams**
Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.
  
  
**Turn architecture into shipped services**
Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered.
  
  
**Establish the base service tier**
Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.
  
  
**Protect compatibility and business continuity**
Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.
  
  
**Modernize the application foundations**
Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.
  
  
**Raise the bar for engineering quality**
Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.
  
  
**Drive AI-native ways of working**
Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
**Hire and grow strong engineers**
Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through.
  
  
**Partner across the program**
Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed.
  
  
**What This Is Not**
This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.
  
  
This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Proven engineering leadership**
Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.
  
  
**Service transformation depth**
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.
  
  
**Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency**
Enough hands-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.
  
  
**Migration safety instincts**
You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
**Quality and operational discipline**
You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.
  
  
**People development**
You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.
  
  
**Cross-functional execution**
You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
**An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**
You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
**Bonus Points**
Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.
  
  
Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.
  
  
Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).
  
  
Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
**The base service tier becomes real**
Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.
  
  
**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**
Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.
  
  
**The platform compounds**
New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.
  
  
**The team gets stronger**
Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.
  
  
**Why This Matters**
Everything ABC is building — the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform — stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted.
  
  
This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: Senior Specialist, Market Research
description:
****Job Description****
**Senior Specialist, Market Research**
**ROLE PURPOSE Lead**
high-quality primary market research while applying hands-on AI expertise to improve research speed, rigor and insight generation.
  
  
****Job Description****
Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization is redefining how we understand patients, healthcare providers and markets by leveraging digital, data, analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enable faster, more precise and impactful decisions across the product lifecycle. As part of this ambition, we are transforming our Primary Market Research (PMR) capability to become increasingly AI-enabled, insight-led and deeply integrated into strategic decision-making.
  
  
The Senior Specialist, Primary Market Research, will serve as a strategic research partner to the business, translating key business questions into fit-for-purpose research, generating actionable insights and helping teams make informed commercial decisions. The role will independently manage PMR projects and work closely with business stakeholders, PMR colleagues, analytics partners and external research agencies. This position will manage the PMR process end to end, including framing business questions, developing research plans, selecting methodologies and agency partners, overseeing execution, budgets and compliance, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  
  
The Senior Specialist will also mentor and coach junior team members, sharing research expertise, effective practices and constructive guidance to strengthen team capability. The role requires a digital-first mindset and hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools to enhance research quality, speed, synthesis and insight generation. The Senior Specialist will apply sound judgment, research rigor and responsible-AI principles when integrating AI into day-to-day PMR activities.
  
  
The position reports to the Associate Director, Primary Market Research, DHH India Hub and would be based out of Hyderabad, with international and domestic travel as required by the business.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Primary Market Research & Insight Generation**

* Partner with business stakeholders and PMR leadership to translate strategic business challenges into clear research questions, hypotheses and learning objectives.
* Develop fit-for-purpose research and analysis plans, applying appropriate qualitative, quantitative and hybrid methodologies based on business need.
* Develop requests for proposals (RFPs), evaluate and select external research partners, and effectively manage agency relationships throughout project execution.
* Independently manage primary market research projects from design through execution, analysis and communication of findings, ensuring quality, methodological rigor, timelines, budgets and compliance requirements are consistently met.
* Integrate primary research with relevant secondary research, syndicated information and analytics to develop a holistic understanding of patients, customers, competitors and market dynamics.
* Translate findings into clear, actionable and decision-ready insights, effectively communicating implications and recommendations to business stakeholders.
* Collaborate across PMR, Analytics, Forecasting and other DHH capabilities to create integrated, insight-led perspectives for commercial teams.
* Mentor and coach junior team members on research design, agency management, insight synthesis, stakeholder communication and responsible use of AI-enabled tools.

**AI Fluency & Next-Generation PMR**

* Apply hands-on experience with approved AI-enabled and generative-AI tools across relevant stages of the PMR workflow, including research design, hypothesis development, desk research, qualitative synthesis, analysis, insight generation and knowledge reuse.
* Critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs, combining human research expertise with AI-assisted analysis to ensure accuracy, methodological rigor and decision relevance.
* Support pilots and adoption of new AI-enabled PMR approaches in partnership with PMR leadership and digital, analytics and technology teams; capture learnings and share effective practices with colleagues.
* Ensure AI-enabled research activities comply with applicable privacy, compliance, research-governance and responsible-AI requirements, with appropriate human oversight and validation.

**Education**
****Required****
BA/BS in Business, Marketing, Healthcare, Life Sciences or a related discipline.
  
  
****Preferred****
Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD or another relevant postgraduate qualification.
  
  
****Required Experience And Skills****

* 8+ years of relevant professional experience in primary market research, commercial insights, analytics, marketing, strategic planning, consulting or related roles, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare industry.
* Strong knowledge of qualitative and quantitative PMR methodologies, with the ability to select fit-for-purpose approaches and translate complex business questions into robust research plans.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage end-to-end research projects, external agencies, timelines, budgets and competing priorities while maintaining methodological quality and compliance.
* Strong analytical and strategic-thinking skills, including experience synthesizing primary research, secondary research, syndicated data and analytics into clear, objective and actionable recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across functions, geographies and organizational levels in a global or multinational environment.
* Hands-on experience using AI-enabled or generative-AI tools in market research, analytics, insight generation or commercial decision support, including the ability to critically assess and validate AI-generated outputs.
* Understanding of privacy, compliance, research governance and responsible-AI requirements, with the judgment to apply appropriate human oversight and methodological rigor.
* Demonstrated curiosity and learning agility, with experience adopting new digital research methodologies, AI-assisted approaches or emerging insight-generation capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a rapidly evolving environment while also mentoring and coaching junior colleagues and contributing effectively within collaborative teams.

****Core Skills****
Primary Market Research; Qualitative and Quantitative Research; Research Design; Integrated Insights; Strategic Analysis; Insight Generation; Stakeholder Management; Agency and Supplier Management; Project and Budget Management; Pharmaceutical and Healthcare Knowledge; AI-enabled Market Research; Generative AI; Digital and Data Fluency; Responsible AI; Research Compliance; Coaching and Capability Building.

description: Summary Position Summary Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership | Center for Integrated Research | Research & Insights | Clients, Strategy & Growth The Deloitte Center for Integrated Research (CIR) is part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy & Growth function. The candidate should be comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative evidence and translating complex information into clear, differentiated business insights.CIR deliverables include research reports, articles, surveys, case studies, data-driven analyses, executive briefings, presentations, and other thought-leadership content.ResponsibilitiesAs a Specialist, you will be expected to: Conduct primary and secondary research across a broad range of business, technology, economic, workforce, and societal topics. Conduct interviews and discussions with Deloitte subject-matter experts, business leaders, academics, and external specialists, and synthesize key takeaways. Partner with senior researchers to develop strong research narratives, points of view, and recommended actions. Develop clear charts, frameworks, and data visualizations that communicate the underlying insight effectively. Apply critical thinking to evaluate evidence, challenge assumptions, identify research gaps, and test hypotheses. Use generative AI and other research tools to improve research discovery, analysis, synthesis, and writing while ensuring appropriate validation of sources and findings. Contribute to horizon scanning and sensing activities to identify emerging trends, technologies, business models, and other developments relevant to CIR’s research agenda. Work closely with U.S. and global colleagues, researchers, subject-matter experts, and other internal stakeholders to incorporate feedback and support project priorities. Support senior researchers in preparing for executive briefings, webinars, internal discussions, and client-facing conversations. Manage assigned activities and deliverables to agreed quality standards and project timelines. Experience Requisite Experience and Skills 3–6 years of experience in business research, thought leadership, strategy research, market intelligence, consulting research, academic research, or a related field. Experience contributing to research projects involving complex or emerging business issues. Experience working with U.S. or global teams and stakeholders is preferred. Research And Analytical Skills Strong primary and secondary research skills, with experience in one or more areas such as surveys, interviews, quantitative analysis, qualitative research, case-study research, or academic research. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret evidence, identify patterns, and develop data-driven insights. Ability to work across diverse topics and quickly develop a working understanding of unfamiliar subject areas. Strong synthesis skills, with the ability to connect findings across multiple sources and domains. Ability to distinguish between a research finding and a broader business insight and clearly articulate why the insight matters. Ability to work with quantitative and qualitative datasets and communicate findings through effective charts and visualizations. Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Python, R, or similar analytical tools is an advantage. Writing And Communication Skills Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to develop clear, concise, evidence-based content for senior business audiences. Strong narrative writing skills and experience contributing to research reports, articles, presentations, or similar content. Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple and structured manner. Strong collaboration skills and ability to incorporate feedback from researchers, subject-matter experts, and senior stakeholders. Generative AI and Emerging Research Tools Proficiency in using generative AI tools for research discovery, synthesis, analysis, and business writing. Understanding of the need to validate AI-generated information, sources, data, and conclusions. Experience using generative AI or other tools for horizon scanning and identification of emerging signals is preferred. Familiarity with custom GPTs, research agents, or GenAI-enabled research workflows is an added advantage. The Broader Deloitte Research & Insights Team The Deloitte Research & Insights team conducts research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to what is coming next.The team plays an integral role in strengthening Deloitte’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thought leadership published through Deloitte Insights and other Deloitte channels.Its work includes: Managing relationships with internal stakeholders and subject-matter experts. Using survey, analytics, data science, and other research capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights. Applying editorial and visualization capabilities to make complex research accessible and engaging. title: Enforcement Detection Analyst, YouTube, Trust and Safety
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in anti\-abuse operations at scale.
* Track record of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies to solve business problems.
* Ability to work with a variety of stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models and iterate to make improvements.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities with a history of going above and beyond to make operational improvements and solve tough problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**About The Job**
 Fast\-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust \& Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust \& Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun.
   

  

 YouTube’s Trust and Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust and Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 As an Enforcement Detection Analyst , you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute. The primary focus is abuse within the YouTube Partner Program.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement strategies and solutions to enforce YouTube policies at scale. Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations for effective abuse prevention and enforcement. Leverage Machine Learning and AI, as appropriate.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders and partners in Engineering, Product, Policy and Operations to drive complex anti\-abuse solutions involving and impacting various cross\-functional areas.
* Provide rapid incident response for abuse problems, operating independently. Analyze and draw conclusions on root\-causes and define and implement mitigation steps.
* Learn complex and technical concepts and systems and deliver meaningful results using them. Communicate technical results and methods clearly.
* Design and refine LLM solutions and agents to improve accuracy of identifying and classifying abusive content and behavior.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:

title: Principal Systems Analyst, Tech Lead
description:

Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

* Identify and support remediation of technical debt and operational inefficiencies.
* Collaborate with Cloud Architects, Security, Networking, and other teams to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

**NOTE: Role based in Hyderabad (Hybrid) with support for EU/US timezones required.**

**Operational & Engineering Mindset**

Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Network Engineer to plan and execute software and firmware upgrades across JPMC’s Data Center infrastructure. The role covers Cisco ACI, Cisco Spine and Border Leaf switches, Service Leaf switches, Arista devices, Terminal Devices, and Out-of-Band (OOB) / Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) platforms.

Work with application, infrastructure, operations, and vendor support teams to resolve issues and confirm service health.

Support change reviews, implementation bridges, and weekday or weekend maintenance windows.

Maintain implementation evidence, device records, change closure documentation, and delivery status reports.

Hands-on experience with production Data Center network upgrades.

Strong knowledge of Cisco Nexus platforms, NX-OS, and Cisco ACI, including APIC, spine, and leaf components.

Experience with Arista EOS and spine-leaf network environments.

Working knowledge of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, port channels, vPC/MLAG, and VXLAN/EVPN.

Ability to assess upgrade paths, release notes, hardware compatibility, and software dependencies.

Strong troubleshooting skills across Layer 2, Layer 3, and Data Center fabric connectivity.

Experience developing and executing change plans, validation procedures, and rollback steps.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

Experience with terminal servers, OOB networks, and BMC firmware upgrades.

Familiarity with Ansible, Python, or network automation tools.

Experience in banking or other highly controlled enterprise environments.

CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, relevant Arista certification, or equivalent practical expertise.

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Associate Security Platform Engineer is an entry level subject matter expert, responsible for learning how to facilitate problem resolution and mentoring for the overall team.
  
  
This role performs operational security tasks such as performance and availability monitoring, log monitoring, security incident detection and response, security event reporting, and content maintenance (tuning).
  
  
The Associate Security Platform Engineer is responsible for detecting and monitoring escalated threats and suspicious activity affecting the organization's technology domain (servers, networks, appliances and all infrastructure supporting production applications for the enterprise, as well as development environments).
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Works as part of a 24/7 team working on rotational shifts.
* Works as part of Platform and Content Engineering handling tunings, stake holder requests, escalations, reporting, trainings.
* Administers the organization's security tools to gather security logs from environment.
* Lifecycle management of the supported security tools/technologies, Break-fix, Patching, Live update.
* Adheres to SOPs and notify stake holders on log flow/log format issues.
* Documents best practices.
* Identifies opportunities to make automations which will help the incident response team.
* Performs security incident handling and response from several vectors including End Point Protection and Enterprise Detection and response tools, attack analysis, malware analysis, network forensics, computer forensics, and a broad range of skills in LAN technologies, Windows and Linux O/S’s, and general security infrastructure.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry level knowledge on implementation and monitoring of any SIEM or security tools/technologies.
* Entry level knowledge on security architecture, worked across different security technologies.
* Customer service orientated and pro-active thinking.
* Ability to problem solve and is highly driven and self-organized.
* Great attention to detail.
* Good analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or related field.
* Relevant level of Networking certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, ACCA, PCNSA, CCSA etc. preferred.
* Relevant level of Security certifications such as AZ-500, SC-200, Security+, CEH etc. will be added advantage.

**Required experience:**

* Entry level experience in Security technologies like (Firewall, IPS, IDS, Proxy etc.).
* Entry level experience in technical support to clients.
* Entry level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Entry level experience providing remote support in Security Technologies.
* Entry level experience in SOC/CSIRT Operations.
* Entry level experience in handling security incidents end to end.
* Entry level experience in Security engineering.

On-site Working
