title: Solutions Sales Specialist
description:
**Proximus Global - HELTAR AI**

**Business Analyst and Solution Sales Associate**

Job description and role definition

**Current job title**

Business Analyst and Solution Sales Associate, Heltar AI

**Reports to**

Chief Executive Officer, Heltar

**Department**

Heltar AI

**Sub-department**

Solutions and business development

**Location**

Mumbai or Delhi NCR

**Employment**

Full time, permanent

**A. Primary focus of the function**

**☒ Focus is on technical expertise and individual contribution**

*The position is focused on technical and analytical expertise and on individual contribution, rather than on people, project or process management.*

**☐Focus is on management**

**B. Mission**

This role exists to convert the Heltar platform into solutions that customers buy. It sits close to the customer, establishes how their business actually operates, builds working solution blocks on the Heltar AI platform, and converts those solutions into platform and communication channel revenue.

The role is deliberately broad at the current stage of the business. It spans business analysis, hands-on solution build, demonstration and commercial follow-through, and the candidate is expected to move between these rather than specialise in one. As the business scales, the role is expected to deepen into either the solutions or the commercial track.

**The following activities deliver the results stated against them:**

* **(a)Understand customer business processes and identify where the Heltar platform applies**
  → so that every customer conversation begins from a business problem rather than a product feature, and so that the solution proposed is one the customer recognises as their own.
* **(b) Build and demonstrate working solution blocks on the Heltar AI platform, using prompt-based configuration rather than development cycles**
  → so that customers see a credible, working solution within days, and so that solution design is not dependent on engineering capacity.
* **(c) Convert demonstrated solutions into revenue against an individual target, and identify the next solution within the same account**
  →so that platform and communication channel revenue is generated, and so that account value compounds rather than plateauing after the first deployment.

**In summary:**
Understand the customer’s business, build the solution on the platform, demonstrate it, and sell it.

**C. Key roles and responsibilities**

Indicative allocation of time on a monthly basis. The allocation will vary by account and by stage, given the breadth of the role.

**Role / responsibility**

**Description**

**% time**

**Customer discovery and business analysis**

Working directly with customer teams to map business processes, identify manual steps and workflow gaps, and determine where the Heltar platform can be applied. Documenting requirements to a level of specificity sufficient for solution design.

25%

**Solution build on the Heltar AI platform**

Using the Heltar AI platform to construct working solution blocks for customer use cases through prompt-based configuration. Iterating with customer input until the solution addresses the identified requirement.

20%

**Demonstration and customer engagement**

Preparing and delivering solution demonstrations to customer business and technical stakeholders. Handling questions on capability, integration and commercial fit.

20%

**Solution selling and revenue generation**

Converting demonstrated solutions into commercial outcomes against an individual revenue target covering both platform revenue and communication channel revenue. Responsible for commercial structure and closure within the assigned accounts.

20%

**Account expansion**

Identifying further use cases within existing accounts and establishing the case for each additional solution, so that each account generates more than a single deployment.

10%

**Feedback to product**

Communicating recurring customer requirements and platform gaps to the Heltar product team, so that a solution built once can be deployed at other customers.

5%

**Total**

**100%**

**D. Financial responsibility**

**Direct revenue responsibility**

Yes. The role carries an individual revenue target covering both platform revenue and communication channel revenue across the accounts it works on. The target is set annually and reviewed quarterly.

**Operational budget ownership**

No

**F. Job requirements and qualifications**

**Minimum education**

Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from an IIT or BITS campus, with a minimum CGPA of 6.5.

**Minimum experience**

One to two years of work experience following completion of studies. Relevant backgrounds include consulting, enterprise technology, SaaS, product management, business analysis and solution or sales engineering. Candidates whose experience to date is analytical rather than commercial will be considered, provided there is a demonstrated interest in customer-facing work.

**Location**

Mumbai or Delhi NCR. The role requires regular time at customer premises within the assigned city.

**Required competencies**

* **Hands-on use of AI.**
  Demonstrated ability to prompt an AI platform to produce working output, not only to use AI tools for drafting or research. This is a working requirement of the role rather than a preference.
* **Business analysis.**
  The ability to understand how a customer’s operations run, identify where technology applies, and document the requirement clearly.
* **Solution selling.**
  The ability to construct and present a case based on business outcomes rather than product features.
* **Communication.**
  English at full professional proficiency, written and verbal, with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.**
  The role carries limited established process at this stage of the business, and requires judgement on where to spend time.
* **Ownership of a number.**
  The role carries an individual revenue target. Candidates should be comfortable being measured on commercial outcomes rather than on activity.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to CPaaS, WhatsApp Business messaging, chatbots or conversational AI.
* Working familiarity with APIs and integrations.
* Prior customer-facing experience in any capacity.

**How the role will be assessed**

The selection process includes a practical exercise. Candidates will be given a customer business scenario and asked to identify where the platform applies, build a working solution block using the Heltar AI platform, and present the commercial case for it. Performance in this exercise carries more weight than prior title or sector.

Sales Manager – Marine | India

Company: Aflex Ships Equipment

Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

Industry: Commercial Marine Equipment & Spare Parts

About Aflex Ships Equipment

Aflex Ships Equipment is an established international supplier of marine pumps, electric motors, pump spare parts and other marine equipment, serving shipowners, ship management companies, shipyards and marine service providers worldwide.

As the exclusive distributor of DBR Pumpen, we maintain ready stock across our international locations, including Singapore, Malaysia and the UAE, supported by dedicated sales, sourcing and technical teams.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager – Marine to develop and expand our business across India.

This position is specifically intended for a sales professional who already has strong business relationships with Indian commercial shipowners, ship management companies and shipyards and can independently generate new enquiries, develop customer accounts and convert business opportunities into confirmed orders.

The primary focus will be on customer visits, relationship development, new business generation, quotation conversion and achieving sales targets.

Our internal sales, sourcing and international teams will provide backend support for quotations, technical requirements, sourcing and order processing, allowing the selected candidate to concentrate on developing the Indian marine market.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales & Business Development

* Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Indian commercial marine market.
* Regularly visit shipowners, ship management companies, shipyards and marine service companies.
* Leverage existing customer relationships to generate enquiries and secure confirmed orders.
* Develop new customer accounts and maintain long-term business relationships.
* Promote marine pumps, electric motors, pump spare parts and other marine equipment.
* Independently approach potential customers through direct visits, networking, cold calling and follow-ups.
* Follow up on quotations, negotiate commercial terms and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.
* Identify opportunities involving vessel maintenance, dry-docking, fleet requirements and repeat business.
* Develop business with Indian ship management companies managing both domestic and international fleets.
* Identify opportunities to supply vessels through our international stock locations.
* Develop a strong sales pipeline and achieve agreed monthly and annual sales and order intake targets.
* Ensure profitable business development while maintaining agreed commercial and payment terms.

Customer Relationship Management

* Maintain direct relationships with purchasing managers, technical superintendents, fleet managers and other decision-makers.
* Conduct regular customer visits across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and other major maritime locations in India.
* Understand customers' ongoing and upcoming technical and purchasing requirements.
* Identify customer purchasing patterns, vessel maintenance schedules and potential supply opportunities.
* Identify inactive customers and develop strategies to regain their business.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing trends and developments within the Indian marine market.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding customer payment performance and outstanding receivables.

Sales Coordination & Reporting

* Coordinate with internal and international teams for quotations, sourcing, technical clarifications and order processing.
* Maintain accurate customer visit reports, enquiries, quotation follow-ups and sales opportunities in CRM.
* Submit weekly updates on customer visits, new enquiries, pending quotations and potential orders.
* Monitor individual sales performance, quotation conversion and achievement against assigned targets.
* Participate in regular sales reviews and prepare monthly sales forecasts.
* Attend marine exhibitions, industry events and customer meetings as required.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Minimum 5–7 years of direct sales or business development experience in the commercial marine industry.
* Existing business relationships with Indian commercial shipowners, ship management companies and shipyards are mandatory.
* Proven experience selling marine pumps, electric motors, marine spare parts or other technical equipment used on commercial vessels.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop new customers, generate enquiries and secure confirmed orders.
* Strong understanding of the Indian commercial marine market and its purchasing and technical decision-makers.
* Experience dealing directly with purchasing managers, technical superintendents and fleet managers.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing profitable business.
* Strong communication, negotiation and customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage regular customer visits.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi. Knowledge of additional regional languages would be an advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Maritime Studies, Business or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Must be based in Mumbai or Navi Mumbai, or willing to relocate.
* Valid driving licence and ability to travel independently for customer visits.
* Willingness to travel throughout India and internationally when required.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for a customer-facing sales professional with an established network in the Indian commercial marine industry.

The successful candidate should be capable of independently approaching shipowners, ship management companies and shipyards, developing genuine business opportunities and converting enquiries into confirmed orders.

This is a field-oriented sales and business development position, not a desk-based sales coordination role.

The selected candidate will be expected to spend significant time visiting customers, building relationships, developing new accounts and achieving sales targets.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the Indian market, identify business opportunities independently and deliver measurable sales results.

Important – Please Read Before Applying

This position is strictly for candidates with proven commercial marine equipment or spare parts sales experience and established customer relationships in India.

Applicants must have:

* At least 5 years of relevant commercial marine sales experience.
* Direct business relationships with Indian commercial shipowners, ship management companies or shipyards.
* Experience independently generating customer enquiries and converting them into confirmed orders.
* A proven track record in new business development and regular customer visits.
* Experience selling technical equipment or spare parts used on commercial vessels.

This is not a shipyard engineering, procurement, operations management, marine crewing, shipping logistics or general trading position. It is a dedicated marine equipment sales and business development role.

Please apply only if your professional experience closely matches these requirements.

title: Retail Pharmacist
description:
**Job Summary**

HealthSy Pharmacy is seeking a highly professional, detail-oriented **Retail Pharmacist** to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately dispensing prescription medications, counseling patients on proper pharmaceutical usage and potential side effects, managing store inventory efficiently, and ensuring full compliance with healthcare regulations to deliver an exceptional patient-care experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prescription Handling & Dispensing:** Process prescriptions accurately, ensure safe dispensing of medicines, and guide customers on dosage and medication usage.
* **Patient Counseling:** Educate customers on medication usage, potential side effects, drug interactions, and appropriate therapeutic alternatives.
* **Customer Handling:** Provide exceptional service by greeting walk-in customers, addressing their healthcare inquiries, resolving grievances, and maintaining a welcoming store environment.
* **Stock Management:** Work closely with the SCM team to maintain appropriate stock levels and properly log all customer requests to support continuous stock availability.
* **Delivery Coordination:** Maintain delivery request records and follow up to ensure timely delivery of medicines.
* **Customer Support:** Handle inbound calls and customer queries related to medicines, prescriptions, and home delivery orders.
* **Customer Retention & Support:** Deliver complete customer care and support to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.
* **Billing & Cash Handling:** Support counter billing and cash transactions whenever required.
* **Storage & Safety:** Ensure proper storage of medicines, including temperature-sensitive products, and maintain stock security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Follow applicable pharmacy regulations, licensing requirements, and HealthSy operational policies.
* **SOP & Policy Adherence:** Comply strictly with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and company policy for sheet handling, billing software usage, and transaction processing.
* **Inventory Verification & Inward Checks:** Perform thorough inward stock inspections by checking quantities, MRP, batch numbers, and expiry dates before updating stock entries in the system.
* **Regular Stock Audits & Expiry Monitoring:** Conduct bi-weekly physical stock counts across product categories, verify fast-moving items daily, and track product expiration to segregate near-expiry items and minimize stock wastage.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* B.Pharm / D.Pharm qualification.
* Valid State Pharmacy Council registration.
* 0–6 years of pharmacy experience (freshers can apply).
* Prior experience in a retail pharmacy setting is strongly preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer-handling skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced retail pharmacy setting and oversee daily operations efficiently.
* Customer-centric mindset paired with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary aligned with industry standards.
* Opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, dynamic healthcare organization.
* Performance-linked incentives as per company policy.
* Statutory benefits including PF and ESI compliance.
* Career development pathways and continuous learning opportunities.

* Performance incentive linked to store sales, margin, and compliance targets

### **4. Account Strategy & Sales Execution**

* Develop comprehensive account plans, stakeholder maps, competitive strategies, and deal-closing plans for strategic opportunities.
* Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or equivalent frameworks.
* Maintain sales discipline through effective opportunity management, CRM hygiene, pipeline reviews, and accurate forecasting.
* Work closely with marketing, business development, solution engineering, alliances, and leadership teams to accelerate opportunity generation and deal progression.
* Engage senior leadership strategically to strengthen customer relationships and advance critical opportunities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* 10–15 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience in direct enterprise software sales within India.
* Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue quotas.
* Strong experience selling databases, data infrastructure, cloud platforms, middleware, or other mission-critical enterprise technologies.
* Established relationships with senior technology decision-makers across large Indian enterprises.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close high-value enterprise software deals.
* Strong business acumen, commercial negotiation skills, and executive communication capabilities.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT architecture, cloud adoption, digital transformation, and modern application infrastructure.

**Good-to-Have Skills & Experience**
------------------------------------

* Proven experience selling enterprise technology solutions to Banking, Financial Services, Capital Markets, or FinTech organizations.
* Established relationships within the BFSI ecosystem.
* Experience selling database technologies, NoSQL platforms, distributed systems, or real-time data platforms.
* Previous experience with enterprise technology providers such as MongoDB, Redis, Confluent, Couchbase, Databricks, Snowflake, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience displacing incumbent technologies and winning competitive enterprise transformation deals.

The ideal candidate is a results-oriented enterprise sales professional with strong hunting capabilities, deep technology sales expertise, and an established network of senior decision-makers. They should be comfortable engaging with C-suite executives, understanding complex technical environments, building strategic account relationships, and driving enterprise deals from initial prospecting through closure.

title: Identity Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Workplace Platforms and Identity Engineer (Google Workspace and Okta) | Full-Time

  
  

**Role/Job Summary:**

We are looking for a hands-on engineer to join NewVision's Digital Workplace practice as a full-time employee, working with a global software client's workplace engineering team. The role handles Level 2 and Level 3 requests for Google Workspace, Okta and Slack. It covers troubleshooting sign-in and user provisioning issues, pulling data through APIs, and turning repeat requests into runbooks and small automations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Triage and resolve service desk tickets for Google Workspace, Okta and Slack end to end, within agreed service levels
* Troubleshoot Okta Single Sign-On and user provisioning issues, such as app assignment errors, group sync failures and new SAML or SCIM app integrations
* Read application logs and trace authentication flows (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SCIM) to find root cause, then fix or escalate with evidence
* Investigate identity lifecycle failures across HR system, identity governance, Okta and Google, such as failed syncs, stale profiles and failed access requests
* Extract and reconcile data through Google Workspace, Okta and Slack APIs for access reviews, audits and bulk clean-ups
* Support onboarding, offboarding and access changes, including account recovery, session revocation and device wipe requests
* Write and update runbooks, ticket templates and knowledge articles, and automate repeat work

  

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 3+ years of hands-on Google Workspace administration (Admin console, Gmail routing, Calendar, Drive, admin roles)
* 3+ years of hands-on Okta administration (Single Sign-On with SAML and OIDC, SCIM provisioning, group rules, System Log)
* Troubleshooting authentication and provisioning flows (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SCIM) using logs
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash, and calling REST APIs to extract and report on data
* Slack administration (app approvals, roles, workspace and channel settings), with Enterprise Grid preferred
* Level 2 and Level 3 support in an IT service management tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or similar), working a queue to service levels
* Clear written English for tickets, runbooks and handover notes

  

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Atlassian Cloud administration, including Atlassian Guard and Jira and Confluence access (ramp-up support available)
* SailPoint IdentityNow or a similar identity governance tool (ramp-up support available)
* Google Vault, legal hold and retention
* macOS device management with Jamf or Intune
* Microsoft 365 or Entra ID alongside Google Workspace
* Bulk automation with webhooks, Okta Workflows or workflow tools
* Git or Bitbucket for configuration as code
* Certifications: Okta Certified Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, ITIL 4 Foundation

  

**Experience Required:** 5 to 8 years in total, including at least 3 years of hands-on Google Workspace and Okta administration

  
  

**Shift:** Overlapping shift with the Australia time zone, so the engineer is available during Australian business hours to support the client team

title: SAP authorization Engineer
description:
**1. Key Purpose of the Role**

The SAP Authorization Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing and maintaining SAP authorization and security solutions across the global SAP landscape.

The role focuses on ensuring secure user access, role management, segregation of duties (SoD), and GRC compliance while supporting SAP projects, system enhancements and operational requirements. The engineer will work closely with functional teams, architects, security teams and external partners to deliver compliant, high-quality SAP authorization solutions.

**2. Roles & Responsibilities**

1.
**SAP Authorization Design & Implementation**

* Design, develop and implement SAP authorization concepts, roles and access models based on business requirements.
* Ensure role designs follow the least-privilege principle and segregation of duties (SoD) requirements.
* Work on SAP authorization across ERP, SAP BI, SAP HANA and Central Finance (CFIN) environments.
* Ensure compliance with global IT security policies and best practices.

2.
**SAP GRC & Security**

* Work on SAP GRC Access Control, including access risk analysis, access requests and emergency access management.
* Identify, analyse and resolve SoD conflicts and access-related risks.
* Support GRC implementation, configuration and enhancements.
* Collaborate with security teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

3.
**Incident Management & Troubleshooting**

* Handle SAP authorization and GRC-related incidents and service requests.
* Investigate and resolve user access, role assignment and authorization issues.
* Support user lifecycle management, including access provisioning, modification and removal.
* Provide technical support and ensure timely incident resolution.

4.
**Project Implementation & Delivery**

* Act as the SAP Authorization and GRC subject matter expert throughout the project lifecycle.
* Translate business and technical requirements into authorization designs.
* Coordinate with architects, functional consultants, project teams and external partners.
* Support testing, UAT, cutover and go-live activities.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely, quality delivery.

5.
**Documentation & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain documentation of authorization concepts, role assignments and security configurations.
* Conduct knowledge-sharing and training sessions for internal stakeholders.
* Work with global teams across different time zones.

6.
**Process Improvement & Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to automate authorization processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement in SAP security and GRC processes.
* Stay updated on SAP security developments, tools and industry best practices.

title: Zoom Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below job opportunity is to one of our clients who is a part of a trusted global innovator of IT and business services headquartered in Tokyo. We help clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, business process services, IT modernization and managed services. This client enables us to move confidently into the digital future. This client committed to Long Term success and combine global reach with local client attention to serve them in over 50 Countries.
  
  
**Position: Zoom Platform Engineer**
**Location: Pune**
**Work Type: Hybrid**
**Job Type: Full Time**
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
Zoom Platform Engineering and Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Release Management: Monitor Zoom release channels, security advisories, feature updates, and end-of-support notices; assess impact and coordinate controlled enterprise rollout.
* Configuration and Policy Management: Maintain enterprise settings, account structures, user groups, meeting policies, security controls, and administrative standards.
* Deployment and Client Management: Coordinate packaging, deployment, update rings, and version compliance for Zoom clients across managed desktop and mobile environments.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve client, authentication, meeting, audio, video, network, and integration issues in collaboration with support and infrastructure teams.

**Microsoft Teams Platform Engineering And Lifecycle Management**

* Release and Change Assessment: Review the Microsoft 365 roadmap, Message Center notifications, service advisories, and Teams client releases; determine business, technical, security, and support impacts.
* Policy and Tenant Configuration: Design, implement, and maintain Teams policies for meetings, messaging, applications, external access, guest access, and collaboration governance.
* Testing and Validation: Coordinate technical testing and user acceptance testing for new features, client versions, policies, and integrations before production rollout.
* Service Integration: Support integrations with identity, endpoint management, compliance, security, telephony, room systems, and approved third-party applications.

Deutsche Bank Application Patching and Operational Compliance
  
  

* Patch Monitoring and Intake: Monitor Microsoft and Zoom release channels, security advisories, client updates, vulnerabilities, and end-of-support dates. Identify patches relevant to the Deutsche Bank environment and initiate the required patching activities within defined timelines.
* Impact and Risk Assessment: Assess security, compatibility, service, user, and operational impacts. Document dependencies, affected devices and user groups, known issues, prerequisites, implementation risks, and required mitigations.
* Packaging and Deployment Coordination: Work with endpoint engineering and software distribution teams to prepare, validate, and maintain deployment packages for Teams and Zoom clients across managed desktop and mobile environments.
* Testing and Release Readiness: Define test scope and acceptance criteria; coordinate technical validation, regression testing, pilot deployment, and user acceptance testing. Confirm production readiness before wider rollout.
* Change and Implementation Support: Prepare implementation, communication, validation, and rollback plans. Support change approvals, deployment scheduling, production rollout, post-implementation checks, and issue escalation.
* Patch Compliance and Remediation: Track deployment progress and version compliance, identify failed or missing installations, coordinate remediation, manage exceptions, and escalate overdue or high-risk patching gaps.
* Evidence and Reporting: Maintain patch records, test results, approvals, deployment reports, exception documentation, and implementation evidence to support Deutsche Bank controls, audits, and governance reporting.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with application owners, security, vulnerability management, endpoint engineering, change management, service desk, business stakeholders, Microsoft, and Zoom to deliver patches safely and on time.

**Technical Skills**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Enterprise Application Patching: Strong experience supporting controlled application patching in a large, regulated enterprise, including release intake, impact assessment, packaging, testing, change preparation, phased deployment, rollback planning, compliance tracking, remediation, and evidence management.
* Microsoft Teams Administration: Hands-on experience with the Teams admin center, Microsoft 365 administration, client release management, policy management, external collaboration, application governance, and service troubleshooting.
* Zoom Administration: Practical experience with the Zoom admin portal, client version management, account and group settings, security controls, reporting, and enterprise integrations.
* Endpoint and Software Distribution: Experience with Microsoft Intune or comparable enterprise packaging and software distribution tools, deployment rings, pilot groups, installation reporting, and failed-installation remediation.
* Identity and Security: Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, conditional access, role-based administration, vulnerability remediation, data protection, and collaboration security.
* Automation and Reporting: Proficiency in PowerShell and working knowledge of Microsoft Graph and supported Zoom APIs for version checks, compliance reporting, administration, and operational controls.
* Collaboration Technologies: Solid understanding of real-time communication, audio and video fundamentals, network dependencies, proxies, firewalls, quality of service, and enterprise collaboration architecture.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Ownership: Ability to manage platform services end to end, prioritize operational risks, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills to assess changes, troubleshoot complex service issues, and translate technical findings into practical actions.
* Communication and Collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and control functions.
* Change Discipline: Ability to plan, test, document, and implement changes in a controlled enterprise environment with minimal user disruption.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

description:

**Summary**
Northern Trust Technology Cybersecurity GRC function is responsible for enabling Global Cybersecurity to strong 1st Line of Defense, foster a control aware culture, deliver compliant and secure technology capabilities, protect customers and meet regulatory requirements. The Lead role is part of the Cybersecurity GRC Team, responsible for leading and supporting risk and control assessments for core cyber security domains, performing security testing, and evaluating compliance to information security policies and procedures and regulatory requirements. The role will work directly with cybersecurity, Infrastructure and business units’ teams providing guidance to implement defense-in-depth controls to protect Northern Trust and the customers. As well as working with a dynamic team and contributing to the overall cyber security of the firm.
  
  
**Major Duties**
*include but not limited to;*

* Advise and support risk and control assessments for core cyber security domains
* Lead remediation of cyber security findings from various sources
* Solves problems and timely management of open risk and control gaps
* Support the development and maintenance of cyber security standards in line with industry best practices, as well as support technical engagements around security threats & vulnerabilities and software security testing

**Knowledge /Skills/Abilities/Experience &**
***Desirable Criteria include;***

* Strong knowledge across core cybersecurity domains, including IAM, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security and Cyber GRC.
* Good understanding of regulatory requirements and frameworks, including CHIPS, CHAPS and FRB-related requirements.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and risk management frameworks, including NIST CSF, NIST RMF, CRI Profile and APQC.
* Thorough understanding of Issue Management and remediation processes, including identification, assessment, tracking, validation, and closure of control gaps.
* Experience in mapping cybersecurity controls to risks, Issues/IPTs, regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and internal policies/procedures.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity control testing and audit methodologies, including control design and operating effectiveness assessments, risk identification, and gap analysis.
* Experience working across the 2nd and/or 3rd Lines of Defense, particularly in control testing, independent validation, and audit activities.
* Knowledge and experience in conducting cybersecurity maturity assessments and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Good understanding of Cloud Security risks, controls, and governance requirements.
* Strong evidence analysis and validation skills, including the ability to assess evidence against control descriptions, Issues/IPTs, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Technical or audit experience in core cyber security fields such as vulnerability / threat management, Pen-Testing, IAM, Data Protection, IH / IR, AppSec, Network Security, System Administrator, GRC
* Understanding of Controls across Cybersecurity domains
* Knowledge of performing risk management and industry standards, NIST etc.
* Ability to proactively assess issues, identify solutions and problem solve.
* Ability to understand and interact with technology subject matter experts regarding technology topics
* Analytical, consultative and communication skills with ability to communicate control requirements to partners in terms easily understood
* Organized and time management skills, with ability to produce high-quality timely deliverables
* Flexible approach towards changing work methods, deadlines and variable workloads.
* Ability to adapt and react timely and positively in a changing and dynamic work environment.
* Expertise in Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn new tools as needed.
* Applicable industry standard certification(s) desired
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline and technical experience in the security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications and network protocols or an equivalent combination of education and work experience

**Major Duties**

* Provides consultative support, best practice guidance and support to internal/external teams to Cybersecurity , Technology and Business Units staff in risk assessments, implement.
* Identifies, evaluates, conducts, schedules and leads technical analyses functions to ensure all applicable Cybersecurity requirements are met.
* Participates in the evaluation, development, implementation, communication, monitoring and maintenance of Cybersecurity policies and procedures.
* May act as Project Leader with servant leadership approach
* May be involved in helping and training to other specialists and team members on .
* Keeping abreast on the direction of emerging industry standards.
* Provides technical analysis of requirements necessary for the protection of all information processed, stored, or transmitted by systems.
* Serves as an expert resource or ¿go to person¿ within a group.
* Conduct preliminary analysis.
* Review work of others.
* Handles more extensive, high-profile work.
* Responsible for direct interaction with different committees and/or management.

**Knowledge**
Is a technical expert with in-depth knowledge in area of expertise and strong knowledge of other areas. Requires excellent analytical ability, consultation and communication skills, strong judgment and the ability to work effectively with clients, IT management and staff, vendors and consultants.
  
  
**Experience**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline and at least four, typically six or more years of technical experience in the security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications and network protocols or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and support risk and control assessments across cybersecurity domains, including Identity and Access Management, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber GRC.
* Plan, conduct, and oversee cybersecurity control evidence collection, risk identification, evidence validation, and control gap analysis.
* Lead the identification, assessment, tracking, validation, and closure of cybersecurity issues and control gaps, ensuring timely and sustainable remediation.
* Review cybersecurity findings from control testing, risk assessments, audits, regulatory reviews, and other assurance activities, and work with control owners to develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Map cybersecurity controls to applicable risks, Issues/IPTs, regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and internal policies and procedures.
* Evaluate evidence against control descriptions, documented procedures, Issues/IPTs, risk statements, and regulatory requirements to determine whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
* Provide technical and risk-management guidance to Cybersecurity, Technology, Infrastructure, Business, and IT Management teams regarding control implementation and defense-in-depth security practices.
* Participate in the development, implementation, communication, monitoring, and maintenance of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements.
* Support technical engagements involving security threats and vulnerabilities, penetration testing, software security testing, Cloud Security, and other emerging cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct cybersecurity maturity assessments, identify capability gaps, and recommend practical improvement opportunities aligned with organizational risk appetite and industry practices.
* Serve as a cybersecurity risk and control subject matter expert and act as the primary point of contact for complex or high-profile risk and control matters.
* Lead technical analyses and risk-based reviews to ensure applicable information security and regulatory requirements are appropriately addressed.
* Review the quality and completeness of work performed by team members and provide guidance, training, and technical assistance to junior specialists.
* Lead or support cybersecurity risk and control projects, coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
* Prepare and present clear risk assessments, control testing results, remediation updates, and management-level reporting to senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Maintain awareness of emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory expectations, technologies, and industry standards, and assess their potential impact on the organization’s control environment.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity domains, including IAM, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber GRC.
* Strong understanding of technology risk management, cybersecurity controls, control testing, audit methodologies, and design and operating effectiveness assessments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity and risk management frameworks, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST Risk Management Framework, CRI Profile, and APQC
* Understanding relevant regulatory requirements, including CHIPS, CHAPS, and FRB-related requirements.
* Experience with issue management and remediation processes, including issue identification, risk assessment, action-plan development, tracking, validation, and closure.
* Experience working within the First, Second, or Third Line of Defense, particularly in cybersecurity control testing, independent validation, risk management, or audit activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technology risks and recommend practical solutions.
* Excellent consultative, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, with the ability to explain cybersecurity risks and control requirements in clear business language.
* Ability to interact effectively with technical subject matter experts, IT management, business stakeholders, vendors, consultants, senior management, and governance committees.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities, variable workloads, and multiple deadlines while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
* Strong judgment and the ability to independently manage complex, sensitive, and high-profile cybersecurity risk matters.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn and effectively use new risk-management and cybersecurity tools.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Typically six or more years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology risk management, information security, control testing, audit, or related areas.
* Technical or audit experience across multiple platforms, operating systems, applications, communication technologies, and network protocols is preferred.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cybersecurity, risk-management, or audit certifications are desirable. The source document requires applicable industry certifications but does not prescribe specific certifications.

**Leadership Expectations**
The role is expected to operate as a technical expert, reviewer, project lead, and trusted advisor. The individual should be capable of independently handling complex assignments, guiding junior team members, reviewing the work of others, engaging with management and governance committees, and influencing stakeholders to improve the organization’s cybersecurity risk and control environment.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Senior BizOps Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior BizOps Engineer
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
At Mastercard technology, we work to connect and power an inclusive, digital
  
  
economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe,
  
  
simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and
  
  
passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions,
  
  
governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency
  
  
quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our
  
  
company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their
  
  
individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences
  
  
enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation,
  
  
and delivers better business results.
  
  
Technology at Mastercard
  
  
What we create today will define tomorrow. Revolutionary technologies that
  
  
reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before.
  
  
Safer, faster, more sustainable.
  
  
And we need the best people to do it. Technologists who are energized by the
  
  
challenges of a truly global network. With the talent and vision to create the critical
  
  
systems and products that power global commerce and connect people
  
  
everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day.
  
  
Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse,
  
  
a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your
  
  
strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career
  
  
across disciplines and continents. And the opportunity to work alongside experts
  
  
and leaders at every level of the business, improving what exists, and inventing
  
  
what’s next.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Business Operations (Biz Ops) team is seeking a Business Operations Site
  
  
Reliability Engineer (SRE).
  
  
The role of Business Operations Organization is to be the production readiness
  
  
steward for Mastercard products. As a Business Operations SRE, we are
  
  
responsible for ensuring that our platform is stable and healthy. We break down
  
  
barriers to run our products by fostering developer run ownership and
  
  
empowering developers to build resilient products. We support our developers
  
  
during the application build phase in software run principals that includes
  
  
operational design, automation, capacity planning, monitoring that leads to fault-
  
  
tolerant, scalable products. We see the big picture and help create and enforce
  
  
operations standards while facilitating an agile and learning culture.
  
  
We support daily operations with a hyper focus on triage, root cause by
  
  
understanding the business impact of our products and subsequently performing
  
  
blameless post-mortems. The goal of every Business Operations team is to
  
  
engage early in the development lifecycle to be more proactive and upfront in
  
  
the development process, and to proactively manage production and change
  
  
activities to maximize customer experience and increase the overall value of
  
  
supported applications. Business Operations teams also focus on risk
  
  
management by tying all our activities together with an overarching
  
  
responsibility for compliance and risk mitigation across all our environments.
  
  
Ultimately, the role of Business Operations is to align Product and Customer
  
  
Focused priorities with Operational needs by providing continuous feedback
  
  
throughout the lifecycle.
  
  
**Site Reliability Engineering**

* Serve as the primary contact responsible for ensuring application

scalability, performance, and resilience.
  
  
O Practice sustainable incident response and blameless post-mortems
  
  
while taking a holistic approach to problem solving and optimizing
  
  
time to recover.
  
  
O Automate data-driven alerts to proactively escalate issues. Work
  
  
with development teams to establish SLOs and improve reliability.
  
  
**Role Qualifications**
The ideal candidate will have experience in many of these areas:
  
  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding

(e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent practical experience.
  
  

* Coding or scripting exposure.
* Appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with

**Automation. Be Curious About New Technology, Infrastructure, And**
practices to scale our architecture and prepare for future growth.
  
  

* Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline

management, and software design
  
  

* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication

skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
  
  

* Interest in designing, analysing, and troubleshooting large-scale

distributed systems.
  
  

* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities and

to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically
  
  
distributed project team.
  
  

* Ability to balance doing things right with fixing things quickly. Flexible and

pragmatic, while working towards improving the long-term health of the
  
  
system.
  
  

* Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure that

expected system behaviour is understood and monitoring exists to detect
  
  
anomalies.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Stay informed about Okta updates, new features, and IAM industry trends to drive innovation within the organization.

**Preferred Skills:**

* 3-5 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

title: Firmware Design Engineer
description:
**Immediate to 30 days preferred**

**Job Type**
: Full-Time

**Interview Type**
: Video or In Person

**Duration**
: Long Term

**Experience**
: 3-7 Years

**Work Preference**
: Onsite

**Work Location:**
Pune, MH

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Development and Implementation**

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work.

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions.

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required.

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression.

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project.

Integration Debugging and Verification

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers.

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features.

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour.

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging.

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work.

**Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support**

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives.

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing.

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in.

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence.

**Team Collaboration**

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work.

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence.

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work.

**Qualifications**

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C fundamentals and practical experience with microcontrollers, interrupts, timers, GPIO, ADC, serial communications, watchdogs, and non-volatile memory.

• Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded systems, modular drivers, state machines, error handling, and resource-constrained products.

• Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, existing source code, system requirements, and test procedures and convert them into working firmware.

• Hands-on experience with embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD, common laboratory tools, version control, and defect tracking.

• A disciplined approach to coding, peer review, test evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, configuration management, and documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

• Prior experience with fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated embedded product is strongly preferred.

• Participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; exposure to UL 864 or FM Approvals is an advantage.

• Experience with Renesas or similar microcontrollers, IAR or comparable toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Exposure to fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary protocols, supervised I/O, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Implementation | MCU Peripherals | Hardware Debugging | Test Discipline | Product Lifecycle | Root-Cause Analysis | Documentation | Collaboration

title: Controls Testing Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development**
**C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation**
**D. Client Engagement & Presales Support**
**E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards**
3. AUTHORITIES
  
  

* KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* System Architecture & Scope Definition
* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments.
* Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.
* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.
* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.

The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:
  
  

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.

4. QUALIFICATIONS
**4.1 Education**

* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.

**4.2 Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects.
* Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016.
* Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.

**4.3 Technical Skills Matrix**
**Skill Area**
**Proficiency Required**
**IBMS Subsystems**
Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.
  
  
**Controller Platforms**
Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.
  
  
**BOQ & Cost Estimation**
Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.
  
  
**Network & Integration Architecture**
Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).
  
  
**Technical Proposal Writing**
Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.
  
  
**Standards & Codes**
Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).
  
  
**Thermal Management**
Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.
  
  
**Software Tools**
MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.
  
  
**SCADA / HMI / DCIM**
Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.
  
  
**4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
  
  

* Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

title: Fullstack Java With React-Software Engineer II
description:

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality engineering solutions that support enterprise applications and client transformation initiatives. In this role, you will contribute across backend and front-end development, apply modern engineering practices, and help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. You will also support continuous improvement through automation, innovation, and strong execution within project timelines.

As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
  
  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing React applications using TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and integration with RESTful or GraphQL services
* Evaluating solution options, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, scalable, and maintainable design decisions
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Supporting process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . **Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Core JAVA & Backend engineering :
* 4-7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
* Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* React
* 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in React :
* Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade React applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including JSX, component lifecycle, hooks, rendering behaviour , and component composition
* Experience implementing state management and data-fetching patterns, using Context API and modern state libraries ( e.g. , Redux Toolkit/ Zustand / Recoil ) based on application complexity.
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
* Hands-on experience integrating React applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including route protection, secure token handling , and role-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing and debugging skills with unit/component testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains
