title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within.
* Implement data visualizations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users.
* Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time.
* Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path.
* Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well.
* Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating.
* Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in.
* Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency.
* Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used.
* Write tests that cover behavior, including the degraded cases.

**Required Skills**

* 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development.
* Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them.
* Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs.
* Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters.
* Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions.
* Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e.g., RSpec and frontend testing frameworks).
* Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building.
* Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Applicants**
We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  
**Onit Values**
**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Vice President - .Net fullstack Developer - Treasury Technology
description:
**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.
  
  
**Role**
Joining the Treasury Technology team. The team is globally distributed, with a presence across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, and is responsible for providing software and data solutions to enhance and support Cash Management, FX Funding, Treasury Analytics and Liquidity.
  
  
You will work closely with Treasury to develop and maintain applications, providing application support where required. You will collaborate with global business and technology teams as part of a team of skilled, all-round developers who build and support business-critical systems, and you will contribute to technical design decisions.
  
  
Some knowledge of capital markets and/or the Treasury function is useful but is not a prerequisite.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The key responsibilities of the role are to:
  
  

* Work closely with technology and business teams to gather, analyse, document and implement requirements.
* Develop and support Treasury Technology applications used for FX order processing, liquidity, forecasting and cash flow operations.
* Contribute to the modernisation of the Treasury Technology estate, including migrating applications to modern .NET and building cloud-based data and application solutions using Snowflake and AWS.
* Write performant, maintainable and well-tested code.
* Provide application support and help resolve production issues where required.
* Follow the team’s SDLC policy, using JIRA, Bitbucket (Git), Bamboo and Artifactory for delivery and CI/CD.

**Technology Stack**
**Treasury Technology Applications Are Built On The Following**

* TSB (Treasury Service Bus) – an in-house scheduling and ETL platform built on .NET
* ASP.NET Core Web API services on modern .NET (.NET 8 / .NET 10), providing the application tier
* Web front end built using Angular and TypeScript
* SQL Server back end

**Essential Skills And Experience**

* Commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8+).
* Advanced skills in C# and ASP.NET Core, including building RESTful Web APIs, dependency injection and asynchronous programming.
* Good knowledge of Angular and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Good knowledge of SQL Server, including DML, DDL and database programming.
* Knowledge and experience of ETL data processing.
* Experience of unit and integration testing (e.g. xUnit or NUnit).
* Experience of using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, code review, debugging, documentation and solution design, while maintaining appropriate engineering standards and oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a logical approach.
* A self-starter who works well collaboratively.

**Desirable Skills And Experience**

* Knowledge of capital markets and/or the Treasury function.
* Experience of Snowflake and AWS (e.g. S3, Lambda, ECS), including building and supporting cloud-based data and application solutions.
* Experience of migrating applications from .NET Framework to modern .NET.
* Experience of Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
* Previous experience in a similar role at a financial institution or financial technology organisation.
* Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in a relevant subject.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. title: AI Application Engineer
description:
**Job Title: AI Application Engineer**
Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking AI Application Modernization Engineer to join our Digital Transformation team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in legacy application modernization, AI-assisted software development, and Microsoft cloud technologies.
  
  
As AI Application Modernization Engineer, you will lead the transformation of mission-critical business applications built on VB6 front-end technologies and IBM i (AS400) platforms, including Synon, RPG, RPGLE, and CLP. You will leverage AI and Generative AI technologies to accelerate code conversion, application modernization, testing, documentation, and deployment to modern Microsoft platforms.
  
  
You will play a critical role in reducing technical debt, improving application maintainability, and accelerating JCI's digital transformation strategy through scalable, cloud-ready solutions.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**
**AI-Powered Application Modernization**

* Hands on application development to modernization of legacy applications built using VB6, Synon, RPG, RPGLE, CLP, and IBM i (AS400) technologies.
* Utilize Generative AI, GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code analysis, conversion, testing, and documentation.
* Design and execute migration strategies from legacy platforms to modern Microsoft technologies.
* Develop reusable modernization frameworks, patterns, and best practices for enterprise-scale application transformation.

**Microsoft Development & Cloud Engineering**

* Design and develop modern business applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, and .NET MAUI.
* Modernize desktop applications into cloud-enabled and cross-platform solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Design API-first architectures and service-based integrations using Azure services.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure and scalable solutions.

**AI Strategy & Engineering Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to apply AI and Generative AI to improve software engineering productivity and modernization outcomes.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and pilots demonstrating AI-driven modernization capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices for AI-assisted application development.
* Mentor development teams on modernization approaches, AI tools, and Microsoft development platforms.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 5+ years of software development experience.
* 5+ years of experience with VB6 application development and maintenance.
* Proven experience modernizing legacy applications to Microsoft technologies.
* Experience delivering large-scale application modernization or migration programs.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools and Generative AI technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise business-critical applications and complex integrations.

**Technical Expertise**
**Front-End Technologies -**
Visual Basic 6 (VB6), C#, .NET Framework, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript
  
  
**Back-End Technologies**
Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development
  
  
**AI & Modernization Technologies**
Azure OpenAI
**,**
GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, AI-assisted code conversion tools, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  
  
**Cloud & DevOps**
Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Power Platform, CI/CD Pipelines
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience converting VB6 applications to .NET MAUI, WinUI, or modern Microsoft technologies.
* Experience modernizing Synon, RPG, RPGLE, or AS400 applications.
* Experience with Azure-based application modernization programs.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction strategies.
* Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise ERP environments.
* Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.

**Ideal Candidate:**
An engineer who has successfully delivered VB6 and AS400 modernization programs and has leveraged AI technologies to accelerate application conversion to modern Microsoft platforms such as .NET, MAUI, Azure, and Power Platform.

**Job Description**
As a
**Staff Enterprise Technology Engineer (Technical Lead)**
, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable serverless solutions that support bp’s Regulatory Reporting landscape. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and resilience of critical reporting platforms that underpin bp’s global regulatory obligations.
  
  
In this role, you will provide technical leadership to a team of software engineers and support specialists, driving engineering excellence, solution quality, and guidelines across the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Product Owner, Delivery Lead, and Solution Architect, you will supply to technical strategy, architecture, and solution design while remaining actively involved in hands-on development and delivery.
  
  
You will bring deep technical expertise across the full technology stack, lead the implementation of complex solutions, mentor engineers, and support the continuous improvement of platforms and processes to ensure the successful delivery of business and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and drive the technical vision, solution design, and engineering standards for the team.
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
* Remain hands-on with software development, contributing high-quality code, reviewing pull requests, and leading the implementation of complex technical solutions.
* Make key technical decisions, provide guidance on complex engineering challenges, and act as the primary technical escalation point.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory, and operational standards.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Delivery Leads to support backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, and prioritization.
* Translate business requirements into well-structured technical deliverables and remove technical impediments to ensure predictable delivery.
* Drive the adoption of engineering standards, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and DevSecOps.
* Champion the use of AI-enabled engineering practices to improve developer productivity, software quality, delivery speed, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities, establishing standards and governance for their responsible adoption.
* Ensure delivery of high-quality software through robust engineering practices, quality controls, and continuous improvement.
* Promote platform reliability, performance, scalability, operational resilience, reuse of common components, and reduction of technical debt.
* Coach, mentor, and develop software and support engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives to maintain stable and reliable production services.
* Support Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and operational excellence across the technology landscape.
* Know the latest with advancements in cloud technologies, software engineering practices, and AI capabilities, applying them to continuously improve the platform and ways of working.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, with extensive hands-on experience across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MySQL.
* Strong experience designing and developing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and database objects.
* Proven expertise in database performance tuning, query optimization, and solving data-related issues.
* Solid experience designing, implementing, and supporting ETL processes, data pipelines, and large-scale data integration solutions.
* Professional experience developing cloud-native, serverless solutions on AWS using Python.
* Hands-on experience building and supporting integration solutions using APIs, file-based integrations, web services, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience developing and deploying applications using AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, AWS Glue, SNS, SQS, and Spark-based data processing frameworks.
* Broad knowledge of AWS cloud services across compute, database, storage, integration, and serverless technologies.
* Strong understanding of application, data, and platform security principles, ensuring data integrity, consistency, availability, and resilience.
* Experience fixing complex production issues, analyzing defects, and supporting testing throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Experience supporting deployments across development, testing, staging, and production environments using CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**
As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.
  
  

* Design, build, and ship features end to end across the backend (Java / Spring Boot services, REST APIs, data model) and the web frontend (React / AngularJS).
* Write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code that scales to large multi-location customers with complex, highly configurable setups.
* Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause.
* Keep backend and UI behavior consistent — the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree.
* Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability.
* Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.
* Investigate and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; take part in on-call and escalation support for your area.
* Work closely with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements and validate fixes with customers.
* Mentor engineers on the team and raise the technical bar through reviews and design discussions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping software products (not consulting or website/portal development).
* Strong backend experience in Java with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
* Strong frontend experience with React or AngularJS, plus JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, including cross-browser compatibility.
* Solid relational database skills with MySQL (or similar): schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations.
* Experience with performance and scalability work: profiling, memory and allocation issues, batching, caching, and asynchronous/queue-based processing.
* Experience handling the complexity of many configurations in a multi-tenant, cloud-based product.
* Experience with AWS and containerized deployments.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
  
  
**DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION**
For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co
  
  
We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co
  
  
*Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.*
**How We Determine What We Pay**
*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.*

title: Social Media Marketing Manager
description:
**About scanO:**

scanO (Trismus Healthcare Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Pune-based AI oral health screening company, built in India. Dentists use scanO air in the clinic, scanO engage to run patient follow-ups, and scanO care to keep patients connected between visits.

Over 1,255 clinics are live on scanO across 253 towns in India, and we export to 8 countries. More than 4.2 million scans have run on the system. We are profitable and growing 3x year on year, and were part of Google for Startups Accelerator India (2023) and APAC (2024).

**About the role:**

You will own scanO's paid acquisition and social presence, with one job: put scanO in front of the right dentists and turn that attention into qualified demos for our sales team.

Our buyers are clinic owners and practising dentists, not consumers. They are busy, skeptical of AI claims, and respond to proof: real clinics, real cases, real numbers. This role is for someone who can write for that audience and run campaigns that are measured on pipeline, not likes.

**You will own following:**

**Performance marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise campaigns on Meta, Google (Search, YouTube, Display) and LinkedIn aimed at dentists and clinic owners in India and our export markets.
* Own the monthly ad budget, with cost per lead and cost per qualified demo as your core numbers.
* Build and test landing pages, lead forms, audiences and retargeting with the web and design team.
* Keep tracking clean: pixels, conversion events, UTMs and CRM attribution, so every lead can be traced to its source.

**Social media**

* Run scanO's LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X handles with a monthly content calendar.
* Turn product launches, clinic success stories, webinars and events into posts, reels and carousels.
* Write in a human, credible voice that a practising dentist would respect. No generic AI hype.
* Grow and engage communities of dentists, and respond to comments and DMs or route them to sales.

**Content and creative**

* Brief designers and video editors, and shoot short-form video with the team when needed.
* Work with founders and clinical experts to turn technical product work into simple, useful content.
* Keep every creative on brand: official logo, correct product names, consistent visual language.

**Reporting and handoff**

* Share a weekly dashboard covering spend, leads, cost per lead, qualified demos and top performing creatives.
* Review lead quality with sales every week and feed what you learn back into targeting and messaging.
* Manage agencies or freelancers where we use them.

**Required skills:**

* 3 to 5 years of hands-on performance marketing and social media work, with campaigns you personally ran and can show results for.
* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
* Comfort with GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager and UTMs, and with reading the numbers without help.
* Experience generating B2B leads, where success is a sales conversation, not a sale on a website.
* Clear, crisp writing in English. Short copy that a professional audience takes seriously.
* Working skills in Canva or Figma and a basic video editor, enough to make or fix creatives yourself.
* An owner's mindset: you track your own numbers, flag what is not working and fix it before being asked.

**Good to have:**

* Experience marketing to doctors, dentists or other healthcare professionals, or selling healthtech or SaaS to clinics.
* Campaigns run outside India, for example the UK, UAE, South Africa or Southeast Asia.
* Familiarity with Zoho CRM or a similar CRM for lead tracking.
* Experience with event and webinar promotion, and with LinkedIn thought leadership for founders.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Area Sales Manager – Pune**

**Sensorisch Formulation Labs Private Limited**

**Location:**
Pune / Mumbai (field-based)

**Experience:**
0–3 years of B2B sales (B2B background is mandatory)

**Openings:**
1

**About the job**

**About Us**

**Sensorisch Formulation Labs Private Limited is a Chennai-based B2B company that develops and manufactures flavours, seasonings and food colours for food and beverage manufacturers. With an integrated R&D and manufacturing set-up, we work closely with customers to turn their briefs into products that perform. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.**

**The Role**

**You will build and own Sensorisch's B2B business in Pune, Mumbai and the Maharashtra industrial belt: open food and beverage manufacturers, convert enquiries and samples into orders, and grow long-term accounts for our flavours, seasonings and food colours. You report to the Head of Sales & Marketing.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Territory Plan & Business Development**

**●     Own the Pune / Mumbai territory plan: target accounts by industry, volume and potential, with a visit calendar.**

**●     Identify and open food and beverage manufacturers: bakery, dairy, beverage, confectionery, snack and seasoning units.**

**●     Meet owners, R&D, purchase and production heads; generate qualified enquiries and trials monthly.**

**●     Map incumbent suppliers at each target account and plan how to displace them.**

**●     Open new accounts against the annual plan; no waiting for leads to come to you.**

**2. Sample-to-Order Management**

**●     Capture every customer brief completely: application, target profile, dosage, benchmark, cost target, volume and timeline.**

**●     Hand the brief to the Sales Coordinator and R&D the same day.**

**●     Track every sample to feedback and decision; follow up until you get a yes or a clear no.**

**●     Convert approved samples into commercial orders with a defined conversion plan.**

**●     Keep the enquiry–sample–order funnel updated in the CRM daily.**

**3. Key Account Management**

**●     Build an account plan for each key account with annual volume, growth actions and risks.**

**●     Hold regular reviews with customer R&D, purchase and production.**

**●     Resolve complaints and technical issues jointly with R&D and QC within agreed timelines.**

**●     Grow wallet share by introducing new flavours, seasonings and colours in existing accounts.**

**●     Protect accounts from competitor threats through early warning and action.**

**4. Pricing, Collections & Credit**

**●     Quote from the approved price list and margins; escalate negotiations beyond your limits with a clear recommendation.**

**●     Negotiate terms professionally without giving away margin.**

**●     Follow up payments and keep receivables within agreed credit terms.**

**●     Do not accept orders or release supplies beyond credit limits without approval.**

**●     Reconcile outstanding with Accounts monthly and close overdue accounts.**

**5. Reporting, Market Intelligence & Discipline**

**●     Share a weekly visit plan, daily CRM updates and a monthly territory review.**

**●     Report competitor activity, pricing and new-product trends in Pune, Mumbai and the Maharashtra industrial belt every week.**

**●     Represent Sensorisch professionally at customer sites and industry events.**

**●     Bring customer needs and market gaps back to R&D and Head of Sales & Marketing with recommendations.**

**●     Take full ownership of your territory numbers; own the result.**

**What You Bring**

**●     B2B sales background is mandatory: selling to manufacturers, distributors or industrial customers (not retail or B2C)**

**●     0–3 years of experience; a record of opening accounts and meeting targets**

**●     Flavour, food-ingredient, seasoning or food-colour experience is an added advantage**

**●     Ability to explain technical products to customer R&D and purchase teams**

**●     Fluent in Hindi, Marathi and English; willing to travel extensively within the territory**

**●     Graduate; B.Sc (Food Tech / Chemistry) or MBA in Sales & Marketing is a plus**

**●     Immediate joiners or short notice preferred**

**Why Join Us**

**●     Be part of a growing B2B flavour and food-colour house with its own R&D and manufacturing**

**●     Direct access to leadership and quick decision-making**

**●     Clear role ownership, with real scope to learn and grow**

**●     Competitive salary as per experience**

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**
At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers' hands.
  
  
We're looking for a highly experienced full stack Senior Software Engineer who works AI-natively and can help push Cin7's engineering practices forward. This role is primarily focused on .NET development across different types of projects, including applications built with .NET Framework, .NET, and ASP.NET MVC, with frontend technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  
  
You'll operate as a senior technical advisor: designing and implementing high-quality .NET solutions, using AI tools and agents to accelerate your own development workflow, helping evaluate and build AI-powered capabilities into our product, mentoring other developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional software at a fast pace.
  
  
**This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India.**
**Applying for this role:**
Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Partner with product managers, designers, and developers to define requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.
* Maintain, design, and develop high-performance code: Maintain and develop our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software using .NET technologies, ensuring solutions meet business needs and follow best practices in software design and development.
* Contribute to full-stack development: Work across application, database, and frontend layers when needed, including implementing API-driven features, writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures and triggers, making UI updates, adjusting page layouts, working with forms, and applying styling using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Work AI-natively: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as a core part of your daily workflow — for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test writing, and code review — while maintaining full ownership and judgment over the resulting code.
* Help build AI-powered features: Contribute to designing and implementing AI/LLM-powered capabilities within Cin7's product (e.g., integrating LLM APIs, working with retrieval or agentic workflows, evaluating model outputs for reliability), partnering with product on where AI can add real customer value.
* Lead development initiatives: Take ownership of complex, ambiguous features and modules end-to-end, providing technical leadership, architectural direction, and mentoring to other developers.
* Code reviews and quality assurance: Review code (human- and AI-generated) for consistency, quality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to coding standards, providing constructive feedback to peers.
* Optimize performance and reliability: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, scalability concerns, and technical challenges to ensure optimal system performance in a cloud SaaS environment.
* Champion testing and AI-assisted quality practices: Drive strong unit and integration testing practices, including using AI tools to help generate and maintain test coverage.
* Adopt new technologies: Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging tools, frameworks, and AI-driven practices to enhance the development process and product quality.
* Mentor and coach: Foster a culture of growth, quality, and effective AI-augmented development by providing guidance and technical mentorship to other developers, including how to use AI tools responsibly and effectively.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on software development experience, with deep specialization in .NET technologies, and a track record of senior/technical leadership on production systems.
* Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) — not just occasional use, but genuine integration into daily engineering practice.
* Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants as part of everyday software development.
* Expertise in integrating LLM APIs into an existing application.
* Experience designing and implementing production-grade AI-powered functionality involving RAG, agentic workflows, and model output evaluation.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to independently tackle and resolve complex, ambiguous technical challenges across backend, frontend, database, and application layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working in teams and mentoring others.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET technologies, including deep experience with .NET Framework, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, web applications, and APIs.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns, with practical experience applying them to complex, real-world production systems.
* Extensive experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, including writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures, triggers, indexes, and troubleshooting database performance issues.
* Solid understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, request/response lifecycle, browser behavior, and client-server communication.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, including DOM manipulation, event handling, form validation, asynchronous calls, and working with API responses.
* Solid understanding of HTML and CSS, including semantic markup, page structure, layout basics, responsive behavior, and styling existing UI components.
* Ability and willingness to work with existing frontend code when needed.
* Strong understanding of unit testing and integration testing principles, including how tests are written, structured, and maintained.
* Experience with version control systems, such as Git.
* Experience working in agile development environments.

**It's a Nice To Have If You Bring**

* Experience working with LLM/AI APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI/Azure OpenAI Service) in a production SaaS context.
* Experience working on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure.
* Experience improving performance, scalability, and reliability of production systems.
* Familiarity with automated testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and shaping engineering best practices, including AI tool adoption.

**Why work at Cin7?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineer (AMS)
description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Team**
You will be part of the Service Operations – Client Life cycle Management and Client Relationship Management (CLM/CRM) Team, which is responsible for ensuring stable platform operations and the continuous improvement of our Avaloq software and products for our clients.
  
  
As a Software Engineer, you will design, develop, maintain, and support business-critical applications and services within the CLM/CRM domain. You will be responsible for enhancing existing functionalities, investigating and resolving production issues, and ensuring the reliability, performance, and maintainability of the solutions delivered to our clients.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Service Managers, Product teams, and Project Delivery teams. You will take over, maintain, and enhance solutions delivered to production, investigate and resolve technical issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of applications and services used by our clients.
  
  
**Your key tasks**

* Ensure the stable, reliable, and efficient operation of Client Life cycle Management (CLM), Client Relationship Management (CRM), and integrated third-party applications.
* Leverage strong software development and coding expertise to analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents and complex technical issues.
* Design, develop, test, and implement high-quality code fixes for application defects, ensuring system stability and performance.
* Perform root cause analysis, delivering software changes, drive permanent resolutions, and contribute to continuous application enhancements and optimization.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development life cycle to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Maintain and enhance existing applications and services to meet evolving client and business requirements.
* Participate in client workshops and support our business analysts in requirements analysis
* Support testing activities, including functional validation, defect fixing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Maintain clear technical documentation and actively promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.
* To work with agile mindset, process, and ticketing platforms (Jira)
* Take ownership and responsibility for your area of expertise

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent
* Minimum 6 years of experience
* Proven experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, or a similar role in the banking or financial services industry
* Strong programming, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Knowledge and experience in RDBMS, Oracle SQL queries, and Oracle PL/SQL
* Knowledge of Java programming languages. Unix, Python or similar can be valuable.
* Experience in software design, development, testing, and troubleshooting
* Familiarity with software development best practices, version control systems, and CI/CD concepts
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams
* Self-motivated, proactive, and organized working approach with a demonstrated passion for continuous learning
* Full professional fluency in English (written and verbal)

**It would be a real bonus if you have**

* Experience in application support, incident management, or service operations environments
* Knowledge of CLM, AML, KYC, onboarding, and related third-party solutions
* Familiarity with cloud environments and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of Avaloq or ACCP certified
* Experience with modern software engineering practices, automation, and monitoring tools

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
  
  
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

title: Senior Accounts Executive
description:
**Position Title:** Accounts Executive

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Accounts Executive with expertise in Zoho Books and advanced Excel knowledge. The ideal candidate will be responsible for various aspects of accounting, including day-to-day bookkeeping, purchase orders, sales and purchase invoices, MIS, ledger reconciliation, bank reconciliation, GST, TDS, and ensuring tax compliance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Bookkeeping:**

Perform day-to-day financial transactions, including recording and maintaining accurate accounting records.  
Manage and update financial data in Zoho Books with precision and timeliness.

**Purchase Orders:**

Generate and manage purchase orders, ensuring alignment with organizational requirements.  
Coordinate with relevant departments to streamline the procurement process.

**Invoicing:**

Handle the entry of sales and purchase invoices, maintaining a systematic and organized record.  
Ensure accuracy in invoice details and compliance with company policies.

**MIS (Management Information System):**

Develop and generate management reports to provide insights into financial performance.  
Analyze financial data to support decision-making processes.

**Ledgers Reconciliation:**

Reconcile various ledgers to ensure accuracy and resolve any discrepancies promptly.  
Maintain a systematic and up-to-date ledger reconciliation process.

**Bank Reconciliation:**

Conduct regular bank reconciliations to match internal records with bank statements.  
Investigate and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.

**GST and TDS:**

Ensure accurate and timely filing of GST and TDS returns.  
Stay updated on changes in GST and TDS regulations and implement necessary adjustments.

**Tax Compliance:**

Assist in ensuring overall tax compliance, including the timely filing of various tax returns.  
Collaborate with external tax consultants as needed.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Proven experience as an Accounts Executive with expertise in Zoho Books.
* Advanced knowledge of Excel for financial analysis and reporting.
* Familiarity with day-to-day accounting processes, purchase orders, invoicing, and reconciliation.
* Sound understanding of GST, TDS, and other tax regulations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy in work.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications would be an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in a similar role, preferably in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
* Internship or prior experience in accounting/bookkeeping will be an added advantage

If you possess the required skills, have a keen eye for detail, and are adept at managing various aspects of accounts with efficiency, we encourage you to apply. Join our team and contribute to the financial success and compliance of our organization.

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ghitorni, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Experience:

* Taxation: 1 year (Preferred)
* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Zoho Books (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

* Ability to work collaboratively in an office environment in Noida, with a proactive and learning-oriented mindset.
* Undergraduate degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred; internships or projects in HR or recruitment are an advantage.

title: Lead, Fundraising (HNI)
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?

We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in fundraising, HNIs, Philanthropists, Family Foundations/Offices, and social sector. These engagements are key focus areas at our organisation and require a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. The Lead, Resource Mobilisation, serves as a key member within the Resource Mobilisation team and will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.

**About You**

* You are accustomed to being a top performer in a high-growth environment. Achieving goals fills you with a sense of drive and satisfaction. You are self-motivated and strategic in your approach to winning new business.
* You enjoy meeting new people and developing existing relationships, so making calls, whether by phone or in person, comes easily to you.
* You are a team player and like working with different stakeholders.
* You are an experienced team leader and get the best out of your team by motivating them, building their skills, and giving them goal clarity.
* You are a people’s person and love travelling.
* You are adept at proposing concepts and have a knack for painting a picture with words, making your vision tangible, and getting others excited about what they are going to do.
* You have the maturity, confidence, and communication skills to build rapport with C-level executives and top leaders.
* You have a special talent for negotiating with partners for the win-win closure of grants/projects.
* You understand that excellent service is the key to productive long-term partnerships, and regularly provide the ongoing support, information, and guidance that your partners can rely on.
* Ideas for new collaboration opportunities pop into your head because you know them so well.
* You are willing and able to take up high-responsibility roles and oversee managing, building, and scaling relationships.
* You know how to maintain relationships with partners by providing support, information, and guidance and being able to independently research and recommend new collaboration opportunities.
* You work efficiently in need analysis by collecting, analysing, and summarising demographic information.
* You know how to write and submit proposals.
* You are proficient in organising and participating in conferences, seminars, and workshops to create awareness of the cause.

**About Us**

* We are creating access to eyeglasses for low-income people. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life.
* As a social organization, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives - to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses - a 700-year-old technology - to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low-income people who are more than beneficiaries for us. Our beneficiaries expect high-quality eye-screenings and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit with less cost.
* We run our operations on metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.

**What You’ll Do**

**Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute the HNI & Family Office fundraising strategy aligned to VisionSpring Foundation’s 3-year growth plan.
* Roll up your sleeves and travel extensively to meet partners and organise and attend events.
* Ensure capturing all the market information and reporting diligently.
* Maintain your professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

**Fundraising and Partner Development**

* Conduct research to identify and pursue new opportunities to establish partnerships and secure funds for the organisation.
* Cold-call and network to find new opportunities, including representing the organisation at conferences, seminars, and events to proactively identify high-potential partners.
* Consistently follow up with existing and new partners to deliver the highest levels of partner service and engagement.
* Expand and steward relationships across key donor segments to drive sustained funding for the organisation. Use your creativity to find new paths, and expand existing ones, to bring eye-screening and eyeglasses to our target population.
* Write, build, and submit concept notes, budgets, and proposals. Make grant estimates and align funding opportunities accordingly. Ensure our partners can scale impact most efficiently.
* Meet and surpass monthly, quarterly, and annual goals by securing, renewing, and scaling grants and partnerships.
* Ensure that all activities are duly recorded in Salesforce, and an updated database is maintained.

**Partner Engagement and Management**

* Map and manage partners across India with the help of the team. Maintain and strengthen relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders and assure that we are building lasting partnerships. May require independent management of a few key partners.
* Regularly follow up with clients for MOUs/Agreement renewals and grant disbursals.
* Monitor completion of project deliverables in collaboration with program and implementation teams. Provide partners with timely and accurate information about project progress. Proactively communicate challenges and recommend solutions.
* Help partners share their impact with internal stakeholders, including boards of directors and employees, and work with partners’ marketing and communications teams to share results externally.
* Collect positive feedback and testimonials from satisfied partners.

**What’s Required**

* Master’s degree/MBA in marketing, partnerships development, management, and/or related field.
* Min 10 years of professional experience in fundraising, partnership development, and relationship management.
* Preferably with a proven track record of raising ₹5 Cr+ from HNIs, Philanthropists, and Family Foundations/Offices) or closing large-ticket partnerships.
* Exceptional partner and team management skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi, including strong presentation, proposal writing, and negotiation skills.
* Must meet the highest standards of ethics and personal integrity.
* Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, within India.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Salary based on experience and education.
* Competitive benefits, including health insurance and generous vacation time.

**To Apply**

* We want to know more than just what you have done. We want to know who you are. What are the passions and talents that draw you to this role?
* Please submit your application, including a thoughtful cover letter and your CV/résumé, to:
  ruchika.sharma@visionspringfoundation.org
  . Please ensure there is a short description of each organisation in your CV/résumé. Include your last name and "Lead, Resource Mobilisation" in the subject line.
* Please note, only candidates to be interviewed will be contacted.
* We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Manager – Resource Mobilisation will work closely with the Senior Management Team to bridge institutional goals with funding execution. The incumbent will be responsible for diversifying funding streams across domestic corporate CSR,
**International foundations/foreign funding, High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs),**

and

**b. Proposal Development & Grant Writing**

title: Fraud Ops - Assistant Manager
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Team**
Aspire’s FinCrime team protects the platform and its customers from money laundering, fraud and other financial crime. Working closely with Compliance, KYC, Payments and Transaction Monitoring, the team builds and runs the controls that keep Aspire compliant and safe as we scale across Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, the EU and now the US. You’ll sit within the Fraud team, reporting to the Global Head of Fraud, and act as the Fraud Senior Analyst for our US business.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Fraud & AML Operations Senior Analyst to support Aspire’s US expansion. This is a hands-on ops role covering both Fraud and AML: you’ll investigate cases, file SARs, handle US-specific payment fraud processes and help shape the controls that protect our US customers. You’ll bring a working understanding of how US businesses are formed and operate, how they move money, and how criminals exploit each of those, and you’ll turn that knowledge into playbooks the wider team can run.
  
  

* Investigate Fraud and Scam cases for US customers end to end, from alert or referral through to decision, offboarding where needed, and documentation
* Draft and file SARs in line with FinCEN requirements and timelines, and maintain audit-ready case records
* Identify and act on US-relevant typologies: business email compromise and payment redirection, account takeover, ACH debit fraud and return abuse, wire fraud, money mule and funnel accounts, synthetic and shell business onboarding, check fraud, investment and romance scam proceeds, sanctions evasion and trade-based laundering
* Assess US businesses at onboarding and through their lifecycle: entity type (LLC, C-corp, S-corp, sole proprietorship), state of formation, Secretary of State records, EIN, registered agent and virtual office use, beneficial ownership and foreign-owned US entities
* Run US payment-specific processes, including ACH unauthorized returns and NACHA timelines, wire recall and beneficiary bank outreach, and OFAC screening alerts
* Handle law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a)/(b) information sharing in coordination with Compliance
* Act as day-to-day Fraud liaison with Aspire’s US partner bank(s) on cases, escalations and reporting
* Partner with Fraud Strategy, AML, Compliance and Engineering to adapt rules, onboarding checks and monitoring scenarios for US rails and customer segments
* Build and maintain US SOPs, typology guides and red-flag training for onboarding, CX and ops teams
* Track fraud losses, case volumes, alert quality and SAR metrics, and report trends to senior stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years in fraud/scam and/or AML operations, with at least 3 years handling US-market cases at a fintech, neobank, BaaS program or bank
* Practical experience across both fraud and AML investigations, including drafting and filing SARs
* Strong understanding of US fraud and AML typologies affecting business accounts and payments
* Solid working knowledge of how US businesses are registered and operate, including entity types, state filings, EINs, registered agents and beneficial ownership, and the red flags that separate real businesses from shells
* Good understanding of US money movement: ACH (including NACHA rules and return codes), domestic and international wires, and business card programs, and how fraud and liability work on each
* Familiarity with the US regulatory framework for financial crime: BSA/AML, FinCEN SAR obligations, OFAC sanctions, and how sponsor bank oversight shapes fintech programs
* Understanding of the kinds of businesses Aspire serves in the US, such as venture-backed startups, e-commerce sellers, SaaS companies, agencies, import/export businesses and foreign-founded US entities, and their typical risk profiles
* Strong grasp of AI concepts and the ability to apply AI tools (e.g., Claude, n8n) to real workflows

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a US sponsor bank or within a BaaS program, including exams or partner bank audits
* A self started with experience building or scaling a US FinCrime ops function at an early-stage or high-growth company
* Exposure to RTP/FedNow, stablecoins or crypto on/off ramps, and cross-border FX
* Hands-on use of tools such as Sardine, Alloy, Unit21, Middesk, Socure or LexisNexis
* Basic SQL or data-querying skills (e.g., Databricks)
* CAMS, CFE or equivalent certification

title: Head of Social and Content
description:
Position: Head Of Social & Content
  
  
Location: New Delhi
  
  
️ Working Days: Monday to Saturday
  
  
Experience Required: 7+ years
  
  
**Job Description - Head Of Social & Content**
Role Overview
  
  
The Head of Social & Content will own our organic social presence end-to-end. We’re not looking for a strategist — we want an operator who can take a brief, create high-performing content, and drive real growth. From idea to execution to reach, you’ll build a culturally relevant brand presence alongside the founders and team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and lead the organic social media and content strategy across platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and emerging channels.
* Build and scale content formats including:

+ Short-form videos
+ Reels
+ Long-form content
+ Community-led narratives
+ Influencer collaborations

* Translate briefs into high-quality, high-performing content — independently or through a team.

* Implement and evolve the brand’s voice, tone, and storytelling approach across all touchpoints.

* Strong understanding of social media algorithms, content trends, and platform-specific best practices.
* Experience building brands with high organic engagement and cultural relevance.
* Ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on with content creation and execution.
* Strong creative judgment supported by data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
**Company Description**
MentorsDaily is a dedicated UPSC preparation platform that supports aspirants through the academic, emotional, and strategic aspects of their journey. The organization focuses on personalized mentorship, helping learners build on their strengths and address their challenges with tailored guidance. Using data-driven performance tracking, MentorsDaily ensures that aspirants’ efforts are directed efficiently and effectively. The platform combines curated resources, expert insights, and a strong emphasis on mental well-being to create a supportive, holistic learning environment. MentorsDaily is committed to helping candidates pursue their UPSC goals with confidence, clarity, and sustained motivation.
  
**Role Description**
The Admission Counsellor is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. The person in this role will interact with prospective students and families, explaining MentorsDaily’s UPSC programs, mentorship offerings, and support services. Day-to-day responsibilities include responding to inquiries, conducting counseling sessions (in-person and via phone or online), guiding applicants through the admission process, and maintaining accurate records of leads and conversions. The Admission Counsellor will collaborate with the academic and mentorship teams to understand program details, align recommendations with applicant needs, and ensure a positive experience from first contact through enrollment. The role also involves participating in outreach activities, following up on leads, and meeting defined enrollment and service targets while upholding MentorsDaily’s learner-centric values.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Interpersonal Communication skills to build trust with aspirants and explain programs clearly.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle inquiries professionally, address concerns, and provide a supportive experience throughout the admission process.
* Candidates should possess Sales skills to manage leads, conduct persuasive yet ethical consultations, and achieve enrollment targets.
* Candidates should possess Education-related understanding, preferably with exposure to competitive exam coaching or academic counseling.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include fluency in English and Hindi, proficiency in basic computer applications/CRM tools, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline is preferred; prior experience in admissions, counseling, or educational services will be an advantage.

title: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
What if your MBA — your hard-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?
  
  
We're looking for MBA-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. You'll stress-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision-making.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step-by-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case study analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and professional-grade quality
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify and document logical flaws in AI reasoning — such as ignoring sunk costs, miscalculating WACC, or failing to account for macroeconomic variables — and provide structured, actionable feedback

**Who You Are**

* Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
* Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
* Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive-style analysis and recommendations
* Precise and methodical — you catch errors in financial formulas, data interpretation, and business logic
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
* Background in data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in data-driven tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience producing board-level or C-suite communications and deliverables

**Why Join Us**

* Work directly with industry-leading large language models at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your terms
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact project work
* Apply your business expertise to a domain that is reshaping the global economy
* Potential for ongoing work and contract renewals as new projects launch

title: Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) team helps drive profitable business growth by reducing the risk of fraud and maintaining industry lowest credit loss rates. It uses an array of tools and ever\-evolving technology to detect and combat fraud, minimize the disruption of good spending, and provide a world\-class customer experience. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation.
   

  

 A single decision can have many outcomes. And when that decision affects millions of customers, it needs to be the right one. That’s where our Credit \& Fraud Risk (CFR) Analytics \& Data Science CoE team comes in. NA
