title: VP, Tech Lead
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As the Corporate Function Technology Vice President in Global Technology, you won't just manage a team; you'll build one. You will establish and lead a new platform engineering team supporting a diverse portfolio of corporate function technologies across Human Resources, Corporate Real Estate, Global Security, Communications, Privacy, Financial Crimes, and Records Management. You will be responsible for building the team, engineering culture, operating model, and delivery practices that drive platform reliability, operational excellence, and business outcomes.
  
  
Working closely with the Business Technology Officer, business leaders, and technology partners across geographies, you will translate strategic priorities into execution, establish scalable engineering and governance practices, manage vendor and delivery partnerships, and ensure platforms meet the risk, security, and regulatory expectations of a global financial services organization. As a member of the Corporate Function Technology leadership team, you will help shape the growth of a new Global Capability Center while building trusted relationships and developing high-performing talent.
  
  
In addition to deep technical expertise and experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Build and scale a high-performing platform engineering organization within Prudential's new Innovation Hub, establishing the culture, talent strategy, delivery model, and engineering practices that will support long-term growth and success.
* Lead the delivery, reliability, security, support, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of technologies supporting Human Resources, Corporate Real Estate, Global Security, Communications, Privacy, Financial Crimes, and Records Management.
* Establish and oversee platform operations, including application lifecycle management, release management, environment management, monitoring, operational support, and service resiliency.
* Partner closely with business leaders, product owners, architects, and technology teams across the U.S. and India to translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish modern engineering practices, governance frameworks, quality standards, and risk management processes appropriate for a global, highly regulated financial services organization, including testing, incident management, production readiness, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform modernization, automation, resiliency, and operational excellence through cloud-native technologies, DevOps practices, observability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective security and access management practices while maintaining compliance with regulatory, audit, data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Build trusted relationships across business, technology, and vendor ecosystems, providing leadership across service providers, delivery partners, and distributed teams.
* Develop and mentor technology leaders and engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing, cross-training, inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Help shape the growth and success of the PFI Innovation Hub by bringing local market insights, leadership experience, and a builder's mindset to a fast-growing organization.

**The Skills And Expertise You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8-10+ years of technology leadership experience, including 4+ years leading engineering, platform, or delivery teams.
* Experience operating within a Global Capability Center, shared services, or offshore delivery model, including building, scaling, or transforming teams.
* Proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and translate complex technical concepts for business and technology audiences.
* Experience supporting enterprise corporate functions such as Human Resources, Security, Communications, Real Estate, Privacy, Compliance, or Financial Crimes.
* Deep understanding of platform engineering, including application architecture, cloud technologies, integration patterns, DevOps, SRE, and agile delivery practices.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, third-party relationships, and associated risk.
* Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance, information security, and data privacy requirements within financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with success leading across global, matrixed organizations and navigating complex organizational dynamics.
* Demonstrated change leadership, including the ability to build new capabilities, establish processes, and drive transformation in evolving environments.
* Strong business acumen, problem-solving ability, collaboration skills, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
* Lead and effectively leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts, and perspectives to the benefit of the organization.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager

Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.

 Additional info

Modern Workplace Engineering delivers and operates enterprise workplace technologies that enable secure and reliable access across managed devices. The team engineers and supports enterprise mobile services, with a strong focus on Apple iOS and iPadOS and hands-on ownership across Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and Microsoft Intune. The team partners across security, identity, network, application and service-management functions to improve platform reliability, automation and the overall mobile experience.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As an Associate in Modern Workplace Engineering, you will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering mobile-platform engineering and operational improvements from design through production support. You will help evolve enterprise mobile services by strengthening device-management capabilities, improving automation, resolving complex technical issues and supporting secure integration with identity, networking and adjacent platforms. iOS and iPadOS engineering will be the primary technical focus, with macOS and Jamf experience contributing to broader Apple-platform capabilities. The role combines engineering delivery with steady-state service ownership and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Engineer and operate enterprise mobile management services across Ivanti EPMM and Microsoft Intune, including enrollment, configuration, compliance, application management, testing, controlled releases, platform standards and technical documentation.
* Own the mobile-platform service lifecycle, delivering engineering backlog items and Level 3 troubleshooting while supporting controlled environments, incident and problem management, knowledge transfer and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Develop secure, supportable automation and reporting using PowerShell and other appropriate scripting, application programming interface (API) and source-control capabilities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and increase visibility of platform health and performance.
* Lead iOS and iPadOS engineering and contribute to broader Apple-platform capabilities, including device enrollment, managed applications, certificates, macOS and Jamf collaboration, automation and lifecycle standards.
* Partner across security, identity, network, application and service-management teams to deliver secure and resilient mobile services, manage dependencies and communicate technical risks, decisions and status to stakeholders.

Your experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in enterprise endpoint, mobility or modern workplace engineering, including hands-on enterprise mobile management and strong iOS and iPadOS engineering capabilities.
* Experience engineering enterprise device enrollment, configuration, compliance, managed applications, reporting and device lifecycle processes.
* Practical experience with scripting, automation, APIs and controlled source-management practices, including PowerShell and relevant experience with Python, shell scripting, Git or Azure DevOps.

**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. title: Program Associate
description:
**Program Manager & Program Associate**

Central Team · New Delhi · Full-time

**Experience:**

**Program Associate: 1-3**
years

Program Manager - 3- 5 years

**Base:**
New Delhi (travel to project states)

**Reports to:**
Senior Programme Managers, Atithi Foundation

**About Atithi Foundation**

Atithi Foundation is a not-for-profit organisation working to transform India's tourism sector into a key engine of economic growth. We partner with government bodies, industry leaders, knowledge institutions and community stakeholders to design evidence-based policies and strategies to create livelihoods, safeguard heritage, and strengthen India's position on the global tourism stage.

**Our vision:**
To make India a $490 billion tourism economy by 2035, with inclusive growth, preserving heritage, and showcasing the nation's culture and natural beauty to the world.

**Tourism as an Economic Engine**

Tourism generated over $200 billion for India in 2023 — 5.5% of GDP — and supports nearly 40 million jobs (8% of national employment). 54% of the tourism workforce comprises women, making it one of India's most inclusive growth sectors.

**India's Untapped Global Potential**

Despite extraordinary geography and heritage, India attracted only 10 million foreign visitors in 2023 — against China's 66 million (2019), Thailand's 40 million, and Vietnam's 18 million. Closing even half that gap is a multi-billion dollar opportunity.

**Key Challenges We Are Solving**

* **Inadequate tourism infrastructure:**
  Most high-potential destinations lack the accommodation, connectivity, and on-site facilities needed to convert visitors into multi-night stays
* **PPP gap:**
  Tourism assets remain underinvested because transaction structures, risk allocation, and bankable project formats are not yet in place at scale
* **Fragmented governance:**
  Infrastructure development, land, environment, and culture sit across multiple departments — a single coordination failure stops a project
* **Narrow brand and distribution:**
  India's top six destinations absorb the bulk of tourism spend; 90% of the country's potential goes unmonetised

**The Role**

**This is an early-career role for someone who wants to do real work on a hard problem.**

We are not looking for a particular background in a specific space. We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious, takes ownership instinctively, and is energised by the idea of working on something that matters. Someone who wants to learn fast, roll up their sleeves, and be in the room where decisions get made, not wait to be invited.

This person will work across Atithi's programmes - supporting destination strategy, government engagement, research, investor outreach, and programme management, and grow into whatever they are best at. The role is deliberately broad at the start. What it becomes depends on you.

**What You Will Actually Do**

**1. Research and Analysis That Actually Gets Used**

* Build the evidence base for Atithi's work: tourism data, destination benchmarks, international case studies, policy and regulatory landscapes across states
* Translate research into crisp, decision-ready outputs - strategy notes, briefing papers, presentation decks for government counterparts, investors, and leadership
* Own specific analytical questions end-to-end: frame the problem, gather the data, synthesise findings, present recommendations. No handing off to someone else
* Support financial analysis on destination projects: build models, run scenarios, interrogate assumptions alongside senior colleagues

**2. Government and Stakeholder Engagement Support**

* Help prepare Atithi's teams for meetings with state governments, Tourism Departments, and Development Authorities - briefs, decks, follow-up trackers
* Sit in on government meetings and take ownership of follow-through: action items, correspondence, documentation
* Coordinate with counterparts across multiple states - track commitments, flag delays, and help unblock things before they become problems
* Over time, build your own relationships with government officials at the working level, the ones who make things happen day to day

**3. Programme and Project Management**

* Keep Atithi's destination workstreams organised and moving: track milestones, maintain project dashboards, surface blockers early
* Coordinate across Atithi's internal teams and external partners to ensure work is sequenced and nothing falls through the cracks
* Build the internal infrastructure that helps the organisation scale: templates, playbooks, process documentation, meeting notes that are actually useful
* Work across 2-3 destinations simultaneously – examples, MP (Khajuraho, Orchha), Rajasthan (Jaipur, Shekhawati), Delhi monuments corridor, and manage your own time across them

**4. Investor and Partner Outreach Support**

* Help prepare materials for corporate, CSR, and investor engagement: one-pagers, information memos, destination briefs
* Support relationship development with private sector partners, philanthropic institutions, and multilateral agencies (IFC, JICA, World Bank)
* Assist in organising site visits, roundtables, and stakeholder events, end-to-end, not just logistics

**5. Strategic and Policy Contributions**

* Contribute to Atithi's thought leadership: policy notes, sector briefs, impact reports, written to a high standard and published under Atithi's name
* Track policy and regulatory developments across tourism, land, infrastructure, and heritage, and flag what matters for Atithi's work
* Represent Atithi at relevant events and forums as you build confidence and expertise

**Who We Are Looking For**

**What We Actually Care About**

* **Ownership mindset.**
  You treat a task as yours until it is done well, not until it is handed off. You follow up without being asked. You notice what needs doing and do it.
* **Intellectual horsepower.**
  You think clearly, structure your ideas, and can explain a complex issue simply. You learn fast and retain what you learn.
* **Quality of output.**
  The work you produce is clear, well-structured, and accurate. You care about getting things right, not just getting things done.
* **Drive for meaningful work.**
  You want to work on something that has real impact. The public and social sector genuinely interests you - not as a fallback, but as a deliberate choice.
* **Willingness to operate with ambiguity.**
  Atithi is a young organisation. Roles are not fully defined. Problems do not come pre-packaged. You are comfortable figuring things out.
* **Collaborative and grounded.**
  You work well with others, take feedback seriously, and bring energy to the team without needing the credit.

**What We Don't Require**

We are deliberately open on background. You do not need to have worked in tourism, infrastructure, government, or the development sector.

We have hired from consulting, engineering, economics, liberal arts, environment management, social work, public policy. What matters is not where you come from but how you think, how you work, and what you want to build.

If you are 2-3 years into your career and you are wondering whether a role like this is for you - it probably is. Apply.

**Useful But Not Required**

* Some exposure to policy, public sector, or development sector work - internships, research, fieldwork, advocacy
* Experience with data analysis, financial modelling, or quantitative research
* Strong writing - the kind that is clear, direct, and actually read
* Comfort working in multiple Indian states and engaging with government counterparts

**Why Join Atithi Foundation**

**Steep learning, fast**

You will work directly alongside senior leaders, sit in on high-stakes government meetings, and contribute to work that actually gets used. No years of waiting your turn.

**Real ownership from day one**

This is not a support role. You will own workstreams, manage deliverables, and be held accountable for outcomes, in the way that actually builds a career.

**Work that is genuinely consequential**

The destinations Atithi works on, the PPP frameworks we help design, the government decisions we inform - these have real economic impact on real communities. That is not an abstraction.

**Build for the long term**

Atithi is early. You will be one of a small central team, which means what you build here will shape the organisation. The trajectory for the right person is fast.

title: Biodiversity Consultant
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Biodiversity Consultant**
, you will support ERM’s global Capital Project Delivery (CPD) work by delivering discrete, desk-based biodiversity workstreams and producing high-quality baseline, impact-assessment, and reporting outputs across major infrastructure, renewables, transmission & distribution, hydrogen, carbon capture (CCUS), mining, and diversified energy projects. Working within the CPD Nature & Biodiversity sub-team, you will collaborate with regional ecologists, and task leads to scale ERM’s biodiversity delivery capacity. This is a desk/office-based, globally connected role; field survey work is delivered by regional teams.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Prepare desk-based biodiversity and ecological baselines —supporting preliminary interpretation of protected-area, designated-site, habitat, and species data from public and licensed databases (e.g., IBAT, IUCN, national datasets).
* Draft ecological impact assessment (EcIA/ESIA) chapters, technical appendices, and scoping reports to internationally recognized standards (e.g., IFC Performance Standard 6, Equator Principles), adaptable to region-specific regimes.
* Support desktop habitat mapping, constraints and buffer analysis, and preliminary/desktop wetland and habitat delineation using GIS, coordinating with ERM’s GIS teams where required.
* Apply the mitigation hierarchy (avoid, minimize, restore, offset) and support biodiversity metric / net-gain style calculations and no-net-loss analysis.
* Manage discrete workstreams end-to-end — coordinating CDH and regional inputs to deliver on time, on budget, and to ERM quality, technical, and Health & Safety standards.
* Act as a reliable day-to-day point of contact for regional task leads, presenting findings clearly and supporting continuous improvement of templates, methodologies, and CDH–region ways of working.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s degree in ecology, zoology, botany, wildlife science, environmental science, conservation, forestry, biological sciences, or a closely related discipline; a relevant Master’s (M.Sc./M.Tech.) is strongly preferred.
* Typically, 2–4 years of relevant experience in environmental/ecological consulting, EIA/ESIA, research, or an NGO/government body, with a track record of contributing to biodiversity baselines or impact-assessment chapters for infrastructure, energy, or development projects.
* Familiarity with environmental impact assessment processes and biodiversity/ecology assessment methods; exposure to India’s EIA regime (MoEF&CC / SEIAA) and/or international frameworks (IFC PS6, EU/UK/Irish, or other) is valued. Willingness to learn multiple regional regimes are essential.
* Strong technical report-writing skills in English — scoping reports, biodiversity chapters, and technical appendices.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms (ArcGIS Pro / QGIS) to interpret habitat mapping, constraints, and designated sites, and to produce clear figures for reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail and quality, and the ability to work efficiently within scope, budget, and time across time zones with global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* NABET–QCI accreditation or experience as an EIA functional-area expert (Ecology & Biodiversity), or equivalent recognised ecological credential.
* Exposure to biodiversity work on major infrastructure regimes (e.g., IFC PS6 / lender due diligence, NSIP/DCO, or comparable) — or a clear aptitude to build it.
* Familiarity with ecosystem services, biodiversity net gain / no-net-loss metrics, or emerging nature frameworks (TNFD, nature-positive) is a plus, though the core of this role is project-based ecological impact assessment.
* Experience in a global delivery, shared service, or hub environment, working alongside regional consultants across time zones.
* Familiarity with automation, AI-enabled tools, remote sensing, or digital habitat-survey approaches to support baseline, assessment, and reporting workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft scoping reports, biodiversity/ecology chapters, and technical appendices from desktop data sources.
* Manage discrete workstreams (scoping, planning, delivery, technical/QA review, and coordination with regional Ecology Leads, Sub-Team Leads, and Project Managers).
* Contribute to bids, proposals, thought leadership, and internal capability building — including standardising templates, method statements, and tracker tools.
* Maintain current knowledge of relevant biodiversity policy, guidance, and metrics across the regions ERM supports.
* Adhere to ERM’s Health & Safety, ethics, and quality-management systems in all project work.

title: Change Communications Manager
description:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with more than 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges. We bring together a diverse and inclusive community of experts across regions and disciplines, fostering collaboration, professional growth, and meaningful global exposure. As a people-first organisation, ERM values well-being, career development, and the power of collective expertise to drive sustainable impact for our clients — and the planet.
  
  
**ERM Global Delivery Centre (GDC)**
We Deliver. We Synergise. We Innovate.
  
  
The Global Delivery Centre (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
  
  
At the GDC, you will:
  
  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.

**Why This Role Matters?**
The Change Communications Manager (BEL3) plays a key role in helping employees understand ERM’s ongoing business transformation by delivering clear, timely, and well-structured communications. Working under the strategic direction of the Global Communications Director for Transformation, the role owns communications delivery for defined transformation priorities and translates updates into simple, actionable messages. The role holder will manage a defined portfolio of change initiatives while working as part of a wider change communications team.
  
  
**What You'll Bring:**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
* Typically 8–12 years of experience in internal, change, or transformation communications.
* Proven experience delivering internal communications across multiple countries and continents, and an understanding of cultural differences and communication complexities.
* Experience in a global, matrixed, or professional services environment is required.
* Experience supporting change programmes is essential.

**Skills & Behaviors**

* Demonstrates strategic thinking, works autonomously with high judgment, and manages complexity across geographies.
* Influences and advises leaders while proactively anticipating risks and opportunities.
* Exceptional written English and strong editing and structuring skills.
* Ability to translate complex information into clear, simple, audience-friendly messages.
* Highly organized with strong time management and attention to detail.
* Positive, proactive, and able to work independently on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Collaborative, team-oriented, and comfortable working across cultures and time zones.
* Strong verbal communication skills and comfort engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, Viva Engage, SharePoint) is essential; experience with Poppulo is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Change Enablement Support**

* Lead communication planning and delivery for assigned transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening the transformation messaging framework within assigned workstreams.
* Help ensure messaging is consistent across functions and regions.

**Communications Delivery & Content Creation**

* Deliver communications with minimal oversight.
* Draft and publish internal communications, including emails, Viva Engage posts, Poppulo newsletters, SharePoint/Minerva updates, talking points, and FAQs.
* Tailor messaging for diverse audiences across multiple countries and time zones.
* Support the creation of leader communications, including briefings, talking points, and updates during key transformation milestones.
* Translate programme information into simple, consistent messages that help employees understand what is changing and why.

**Channel Management**

* Alongside the Global Communications team, manage day-to-day activity across internal channels, including Viva Engage, Poppulo, and SharePoint/Minerva.
* Ensure day-to-day channel activity aligns with the overarching transformation narrative and communications standards.
* Monitor channel performance and act on insights with simple recommendations for improvement.

**Engagement Activities**

* Provide recommendations to enhance the effectiveness and impact of engagement moments.
* End-to-end ownership for planning and execution of global or regional town halls, virtual meetings, and other engagement events.
* Coordinate logistics, prepare materials such as slide content, talking points, and follow-up actions.

**Measurement & Reporting**

* Ownership for recommending, tracking and analyzing communication performance using Poppulo, Viva Engage, SharePoint, and other available tools.
* Produce regular insights to help improve the effectiveness of internal communications.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, streamline, and enhance employee engagement.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Support**

* Acts as a trusted advisor within defined workstreams.
* Build effective relationships with colleagues across geographies to gather updates and coordinate messaging.
* Provide practical communications guidance to leaders and subject-matter experts (e.g., how to frame messages clearly, what channels to use).
* Work with Transformation teams to understand upcoming changes and communication needs.
* Develop a solid understanding of ERM’s business, priorities, and transformation roadmap to ensure that you can advise the Communication team and senior leaders about transformation and be able to connect it to ERM’s strategy and purpose.

This role provides strategic guidance and communications delivery with autonomy in execution. While final decisions rest with senior leadership, the role holder is expected to shape recommendations, surface risks and opportunities, influence senior stakeholders, and ensure high-quality, consistent execution.
  
  
**Time period and commitment**
This is a full-time role based in India. Some flexibility is required to work with colleagues in Europe and North America.
  
  
**Location and reporting line**
Reporting to the Global Communications Director for Transformation, the successful candidate will be located in India and may be required to work outside normal office hours.

title: SOC Analyst L2
description:
**Innspark is a deep-tech, product-based OEM specializing in cybersecurity products, AI, cloud solutions, and select hardware offerings such as drones, VTS, and telemedicine systems, with a diverse and evolving portfolio. To learn more, please visit our website: https://innspark.in.**

We’re Hiring: Security Analyst (L2 – Triage & Investigation)

Location: Delhi

Shift Model: 24×7 Operations

Experience: Minimum 2-4 years

Expected Joining: Within 15–30 days

Note: Candidates from North India are preferred.

**Role Overview**

The Security Analyst (L2 – Triage & Investigation) is responsible for advanced alert triage, cross-platform correlation, structured threat hunting, and detailed incident investigations within the SOC.

This role acts as the analytical bridge between L1 monitoring and L3 threat leadership, ensuring accurate detection validation, attack narrative reconstruction, and timely remediation aligned with defined incident response requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Perform detailed triage and investigation of security events escalated by L1. Correlate alerts across SIEM, UEBA anomaly scores, NDR flow data, Deception triggers, and ASM exposure findings to identify true-positive incidents and reconstruct the full attack narrative.
2. Execute established SOAR playbooks for incident containment, enrichment, and response actions. Identify gaps in automation coverage and propose new playbook requirements to L3 leads, with documented use cases and expected efficiency gains.
3. Conduct structured threat hunting campaigns on a weekly rotation using SIEM queries, UEBA deviation analysis, NDR traffic inspection, and Deception telemetry to identify threats that bypass automated detection. Document each hunt’s hypothesis, methodology, and findings.
4. Maintain and tune detection rules, UEBA behavioural models, and NDR baseline policies within defined parameters. Track false-positive rates, alert fidelity scores, and mean time to investigate. Escalate tuning recommendations beyond defined thresholds to L3.
5. Produce detailed investigation reports for every confirmed incident, including IOCs, affected assets, timeline, impact assessment, and remediation verification, within SLA timelines defined by incident severity.
6. Actively monitor Attack Surface Management findings. Validate exposed assets, assess vulnerability context against threat intelligence, and coordinate remediation tracking with IT operations teams.

**Required Qualifications**

• B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Information Security, or Cybersecurity.

Experience Requirement

• Minimum 2-4 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment performing alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.

Technical Skill Requirements

• Working proficiency across all six SOC platforms: SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, NDR, Deception, and ASM.

• Ability to pivot between SIEM log searches, UEBA anomaly dashboards, NDR packet/flow analysis, Deception alert triage, and ASM exposure reports during a single investigation workflow.

• Strong knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMB, Kerberos), operating system internals (Windows Event Logs, Linux audit logs, Active Directory), and common attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain).

• Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, and query languages such as KQL/SPL for investigation acceleration, IOC extraction, and bulk data analysis.

title: Senior Analyst, Identity Governance & Priviliged Access Management
description:
Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group (CCLFG), one of Canada’s leading asset managers, is seeking a
**Senior Analyst,**
**Identity Governance & Privileged Access Management (IGA/PAM)**
to join our
**Center of Excellence (CoE) – Information Security**
in Gurugram.
  
  
The Information Security team is responsible for securing and governing access to critical systems and data across the organization. This role will lead key initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), user lifecycle management, access governance, and identity security modernization. If you are passionate about reducing identity-related risk, implementing scalable access controls, and driving improvements to identity security processes, this may be the right opportunity for you. The successful candidate will collaborate with teams across Canada and India and play a key role in the ongoing implementation and operation of the organization's IAM program and reporting to the
**Information Security Manager**
based in Gurugram.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Identity Governance and Administration**

* Lead the implementation, administration, operation, and continuous improvement of the Saviynt Identity Cloud platform, including application onboarding, connector integration, configuration, and platform health monitoring.
* Design, implement, and maintain role-based and attribute-based access control models (RBAC and ABAC), access governance standards, and entitlement structures.
* Develop and maintain automated Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows that provision, modify, and deprovision access based on HR, directory, and other authoritative system events.
* Transition manual User Access Review (UAR) and certification campaigns to automated, periodic, and event-driven processes.
* Coordinate access reviews, entitlement certifications, and remediation activities, ensuring findings are tracked to closure and supported by audit-ready evidence.
* Build and optimize access request workflows, approval routing, and rules-based provisioning processes to reduce manual effort, prevent access creep, and improve the user experience.
* Identify and support the remediation of excessive privileges, orphaned accounts, inappropriate entitlements, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, and other identity-related risks.
* Integrate the IGA platform with HR systems, directories, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and adjacent identity controls, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and multifactor authentication (MFA).
* Troubleshoot identity workflows, provisioning processes, connector integrations, and platform configuration issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve IAM processes through automation, workflow optimization, analytics, and responsible use of AI.

**Privileged Access Management**

* Administer, operate, and expand CyberArk/Idira Privileged Access Management capabilities, including privileged account discovery, onboarding, credential management, access workflows, and policy enforcement.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to onboard privileged accounts, applications, and technology platforms into CyberArk.
* Monitor privileged access activity and investigate access-related security events, anomalous behaviour, and policy violations.
* Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of privileged access controls aligned with least privilege, Zero Trust, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify unmanaged, shared, dormant, or high-risk privileged accounts and coordinate their remediation.
* Support the integration of CyberArk with identity governance, directory, cloud, and security-monitoring platforms.

**Governance, Reporting, and Advisory**

* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reports covering identity governance, access certifications, JML performance, privileged account coverage, policy compliance, and remediation status.
* Produce documentation and evidence to support internal audits, external audits, risk assessments, and regulatory reviews.
* Act as a subject-matter expert and provide guidance to technical and business teams on identity security, access governance, and privileged access management best practices.
* Partner with business stakeholders, application owners, technology teams, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit to implement sustainable identity controls.
* Lead identity security initiatives, drive process improvements, and contribute to the evolution of the organization’s IAM governance framework.

**What You Bring**

* Five or more years of relevant experience in Identity and Governance Administration, cybersecurity, or information security.
* Hands-on experience implementing or administering an IGA platform, preferably Saviynt Identity Cloud.
* Demonstrated experience designing and automating Joiner, Mover, and Leaver processes and managing User Access Review and certification campaigns in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of Identity Governance and Administration, Privileged Access Management, RBAC, ABAC, Segregation of Duties, least privilege, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with user provisioning and deprovisioning, entitlement management, access requests, access certifications, role engineering, and application onboarding.
* Experience administering or supporting CyberArk PAM.
* Experience integrating IGA platforms with HR systems, directories such as Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and LDAP, and cloud and SaaS applications through connectors and APIs.
* Experience with identity technologies such as Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, AWS IAM, SSO, and MFA.
* Working knowledge of REST and SOAP APIs and experience using scripting or automation tools. PowerShell experience is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to a regulated financial-services environment, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 1, and Zero Trust architectures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex identity, entitlement, workflow, and integration issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, application owners, auditors, and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, manage competing priorities, drive process improvements, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft, cloud, or identity security certifications are considered strong assets.

*Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in office and remote working days throughout the week – this role requires 3 days/week working in our Gurugram office.*

**What We Offer**
At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:
  
  

* Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
* Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
* Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com.

Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Perform risk assessment for organizations to identify prioritized list of risk/audit
* Perform controls benchmarking to leading internal controls framework to identify gaps and excess controls
* Manage multiple assignments and demonstrate strong people management & networking skills
* Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Play substantive/lead role on projects including project planning, economics, and managing quality
* Participate in proposal development efforts
* Assist in technical knowledge development and training efforts
* Demonstrate high level of understanding of internal and external client's business

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accounting/IT/Information security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CISA/CISSP

**Required Skills**

* 8+ years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Hands on experience on testing of SAP GITC controls(Change Management, Access Security, UAR) Test of design(TOD) and test of operating effectiveness (TOE)
* Have tested SAP Automated controls (3 way match, duplicate invoices, copy controls etc) across SAP ECC, S/4 HANA
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, and network components)
* Exposure to any one industry—Financial Services; Technology, Media & Telecom; Life Sciences & Health Care; Energy & Resources; Consumer & Industrial Products
* Demonstrate MS office proficiency, problem solving & analytical skills, and strong verbal & written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, manage ambiguity, and work independently or as part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Preferred Skills**

* Big Four experience preferred
* Hands-on experience/understanding of security (SAP ECC, S/4 HANA, GRC AC and PC, SAP B/W) and functioning of ERP (At least one of - SAP or Oracle EBS or JDE or Peoplesoft or Netsuite or Workday or SAP Ariba)
* Understanding of SAP Cloud will be added advantage

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. description:

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Ping Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced Ping Identity Consultant to design, implement, and support enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using the Ping Identity suite. The ideal candidate will have expertise in SSO, MFA, federation, access management, and identity governance while ensuring secure, scalable, and high-performing authentication solutions. This role involves troubleshooting complex issues, implementing security best practices, automating operational processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise IAM initiatives
  
  

* Design, deploy, and support Ping Identity solutions including PingFederate, PingAccess, PingOne SSO, PingDavinci and PingDirectory.
* Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and LDAP integrations.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex IAM issues through root cause analysis.
* Ensure high availability, performance optimization, and security compliance of IAM infrastructure.
* Develop automation scripts and deployment processes to improve operational efficiency.
* Implement change management, disaster recovery, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with application teams, infrastructure, and security teams to integrate enterprise applications.
* Create technical documentation, knowledge articles, and deployment guides while supporting continuous process improvements.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior InfoSec Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
MongoDB is looking for a Senior InfoSec Analyst to join our Computer Security Incident Response Team. You will detect, investigate, and respond to security events across our corporate and cloud environments. You'll act as a technical lead on incidents, mentor analysts, and work with Engineering, IT, Legal, and Privacy teams to reduce risk.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead investigations from triage through containment, scoping, remediation, and postmortem for security events
* Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, and cloud and SaaS audit data to distinguish true positives from false positives and reconstruct attacker or user activity timelines
* Investigate credential and secret exposure, endpoint detections, phishing, data exposure, and policy violations such as unauthorized tool or AI usage
* Automate repetitive response work using scripting and APIs, including enrichment, ticketing, and notification workflows
* Maintain runbooks, playbooks, and severity and escalation standards
* Contribute to employee-facing security guidance and awareness
* Mentor junior analysts and help raise the team's investigative and communication standards

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or a related field
* Hands-on experience leading incidents end to end, including clear stakeholder communication during and after an event
* Strong log analysis skills in a SIEM and fluency with EDR tools
* Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, or Azure), identity and access management, and SaaS security
* Solid understanding of attacker techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK
* Ability to prioritize and make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure
* Strong written communication, including incident reports and executive-ready summaries

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience integrating LLM or AI tooling into security workflows, or assessing AI-related risk
* Familiarity with incident management platforms and Jira-based workflows
* Relevant certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CISSP, or similar)
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity -**
Sr. AI Platform Security Engineer
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning

+ Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
+ Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
+ Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

* MLOps, Observability & Automation

+ Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
+ Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
+ Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
+ Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
+ Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
+ Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

* Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics

+ Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
+ Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
+ Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

* Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development

+ Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
+ Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
+ Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
+ Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
+ Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
+ Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
+ Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

* RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration

+ Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
+ Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
+ Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
+ Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering
* 2+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially Cloud security (Azure, Aws), along with strong hand-on experience on Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Strong hands-on experience on agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

Through industry-aligned academies and enterprise partnerships, we develop enterprise-ready talent across Agentic AI, ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks, Cloud and Cybersecurity.

We bridge the gap between education and employment by aligning institutional learning with real-world enterprise demand and career opportunities.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, commercially driven Business Development Manager who can identify and convert business opportunities across both VyntraPro and VyntraVerse.

This is a cross-functional business development role requiring the ability to engage with enterprises, universities, colleges, GCCs, technology companies and other organisations.

The candidate must be quick on their feet, commercially aware and capable of identifying multiple business opportunities during a single client interaction.

For example, an enterprise conversation could lead to an Agentic AI implementation opportunity, a ServiceNow engagement, a managed SOC/NOC requirement or a demand for enterprise-ready technology professionals.

Similarly, an institutional relationship could translate into academy partnerships, student enrolments, enterprise-sponsored programmes and corporate placement opportunities.

We are looking for someone who can think beyond a predefined sales pitch, understand business requirements and identify opportunities across our entire portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Enterprise Business Development**

* Identify, develop and close new business opportunities across VyntraPro's enterprise solutions portfolio.
* Drive opportunities across Agentic AI, ServiceNow, Enterprise Automation, Cybersecurity, GCCs, SOC/NOC Operations and AIDC.
* Engage CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, HR Heads, business leaders and enterprise decision-makers.
* Understand client challenges and identify relevant technology and business solutions.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to proposals, negotiations and closures.

**2. Academy & Institutional Partnerships**

* Identify and establish partnerships with universities, colleges and educational institutions.
* Drive MoUs for VyntraVerse technology academies and career accelerator programmes.
* Generate student enrolments through institutional and direct channels.
* Build relationships with academic leadership, placement officers and university management.
* Identify opportunities for corporate-sponsored training and customised enterprise academies.

**3. Corporate Hiring & Talent Partnerships**

* Build relationships with enterprises, GCCs, IT companies and system integrators to understand their upcoming technology hiring requirements.
* Generate forward-looking hiring demand at least six months before student graduation.
* Secure enterprise MoUs and documented hiring partnerships.
* Identify opportunities to connect VyntraVerse graduates with actual enterprise requirements.
* Drive placement partnerships and establish recurring corporate hiring relationships.

**4. Cross-Portfolio Opportunity Development**

* Identify opportunities across both VyntraPro and VyntraVerse during enterprise and institutional engagements.
* Recognise additional business requirements beyond the initial customer enquiry.
* Convert a single relationship into multiple revenue opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal technology, solutions and academy teams to develop relevant proposals.
* Build a strong network of enterprise and institutional relationships.

**5. Sales Pipeline & Revenue Management**

* Own individual business development targets across assigned solution areas.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular revenue forecasts.
* Track prospects, opportunities, proposals, MoUs and closures through CRM.
* Build and execute account development strategies.
* Consistently achieve assigned business development and revenue targets.

Mandatory Requirements

* 3–7 years of experience in B2B business development, enterprise sales, technology sales or institutional partnerships.
* Must have individually closed business worth a minimum of
  **₹75 Lakhs in the last 12 months**
  .
* Experience in selling at least one or more of the following:
* Enterprise IT Solutions / Consulting.
* Agentic AI / SaaS / Enterprise Automation.
* ServiceNow / Cloud / Cybersecurity.
* Managed Services / SOC / NOC.
* GCC / AIDC solutions.
* EdTech / Corporate Training / Institutional Partnerships.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling and business development.
* Ability to engage senior enterprise stakeholders and institutional leadership.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently identify opportunities, manage multiple conversations and close deals.

What We Are Looking For

* A self-starter who does not wait for predefined leads or instructions.
* Someone who can identify business opportunities during any client interaction.
* A quick thinker who understands commercial requirements and connects them with the right solutions.
* Someone comfortable selling technology solutions as well as academy and workforce transformation programmes.
* A relationship builder who can convert networks into measurable business outcomes.

**We value commercial thinking, ownership, adaptability and the ability to generate revenue across multiple business verticals.**

Application Requirements

Candidates must provide the following details:

1. Individual sales revenue achieved in the last 12 months.
2. Largest individual deal closed and average deal size.
3. Technology solutions or services personally sold.
4. Experience in institutional partnerships, MoUs or corporate hiring partnerships, if applicable.
5. Industries and customer segments previously handled.

description:
**About myHQ:**

myHQ is India's largest commercial real estate and flex workspace marketplace. Founded in 2016 by IIT Delhi graduates, we give 50,000+ enterprises- from early-stage startups to large MNCs and GCCs, access to 10,000+ workspace options across 10+ cities, covering coworking, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and managed offices. In five years we've grown 30x and closed two back to back profitable years. Backed by Anarock Group and WeWork India, we're building toward ₹1,000Cr, and hiring the team that gets us there. We believe where you work shapes what you build. Our mission is to make the right workspace accessible to every business in India, and increasingly, beyond it. With expansion already underway in Dubai and London, we're building something with a genuinely large surface area. For the people who join us, that translates to real opportunity. We've paid out over ₹10Cr in performance bonuses in the last couple of years, and we've watched team members buy homes, build wealth, and grow into roles that didn't exist when they joined. The next five years will be harder than the last five, and significantly more rewarding.

**About the Role:**

While known for our online platform, a less known fact is that myHQ is also one of India's fastest-growing office-brokerage firms. Every year, our Assisted Marketplace team helps clients lease over 50,000 seats and more than 2 million sq ft, through a team of 150+ consultants. We're hiring consultants who want to learn commercial real estate on the ground and grow fast. Strong performers here move up to leading a pod, or into Key Accounts, within a few years. Most clients come to us with a simple problem. Their team has outgrown the current office, or they need a first one, and they need it soon. As a Client Advisory consultant, you're the person who solves that. You'll take each requirement from the first call through site visits, negotiation and paperwork, until the team moves in. It's a hands-on sales role with a lot of time spent out in the market, and you'll learn commercial real estate faster here than almost anywhere else.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Pick up inbound and assigned leads, get on a call, and work out what the client actually needs: team size, budget, location and move-in date

● Shortlist options from our inventory and operator network, and build proposals a client can compare at a glance

● Consult clients on their entire workspace discovery journey from presenting the right options to visiting them with the client

● Negotiate with operators on seat price, lock-in, escalation, customisation and rent-free periods

● Close out the paperwork: term sheet, agreement, security deposit and handover

● Keep the CRM current. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen

● Hit your monthly seat and revenue targets Requirements

● Willingness to be on ground and be the real estate expert for the market

● Clear communication in English and Hindi or the local language

● You like solving problems and don't wait to be told what to do next

● You're comfortable with targets and you follow up without being chased

● Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets. If you already use AI tools at work, tell us how

● Humility, persistence and a real drive to grow

● Experience in commercial real estate, coworking, hospitality or SaaS sales helps
