title: IT&D Sr Manager, Sales Excellence Emerging Market
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
Reckitt aims to bring the best of Sales GTM practices into our Emerging Markets operations through best-in-class technology and analytics. We seek an individual with depth in the sales tech domain across general trade and modern trade sales operations and technology.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Partnering with Business across the Emerging Markets geography, global and market sales IT to identify and shape their requirements to be delivered through IT and Digital solutions
* Build scalable roadmap to accelerate the market roadmap realization through delivery management, adoption and value generation
* In doing the above, replicate and scale successful Sales IT solutions and playbooks established in India (DMS, SFA, TPM, BI) across Emerging Markets countries, adapting to local market context, all while driving synergies across market efforts
* Detailed knowledge of
* Distributor Management System (DMS) and Mobility solutions. Previous experience in News Page solution will be an added advantage
* Other Core Sales IT areas like Trade Promotion Management, Incentive Management, Whitespace identification, Route planning and Optimization
* Deep understanding of sales analytics and experience in shaping conversation around data to drive value outcomes
* Detailed understanding of IT application solution design & development, Technical Architecture frameworks for building robust IT solutions
* Previous experience in Leading and delivering sales transformation at scale
* DMS and SFA rollouts experience is a must
* Data Analytics solutions like SKU recommender, Sales Route planning, Sales Force incentive planning etc
* New Technology projects like Digital Payments, Image Analytics, Chat Bot etc
* Establish business case/ROI for IT projects and take the project through RB approval process with Finance, Sales and other Global IT stakeholders
* Capability to identify new technology led solutions to deliver business benefits. Continuously scan the external environment to identify suitable technology trends, best in class IT led solutions in FMCG, Retail industry
* This is an individual contributor role with extensive cross-country and cross-functional interfacing - working closely with in-country business leadership, regional teams and Global IT stakeholders across multiple Emerging Markets geographies

**Responsibilities/Accountabilities**

* Partner with Sales business to Identify new IT, Digital led projects and bringing in best suited technology innovations at a fast pace to drive business benefits
* Shape the architecture of the sales tech landscape and the reporting architecture to ensure we are building to last in the age of AI
* Deliver these IT and Digital led innovation projects as per times lines, budget to realize tangible business benefits
* Support to/Identify suitable vendor partners and lead vendor teams to deliver the program
* Enable and empower market sales IT partners build the right cadence and practices to drive adoption, platform stability and value generation through the programs
* Support existing applications as per ITIL framework and ensure stable resilient IT landscape
* Liaison with Global IT team to understand Global IT capabilities in Sales area and work with Global IT team, IT vendor partners to drive these projects

The experience we're looking for
  
  
**Professional Qualifications/ Experience**

* B.Tech
* MBA in IT &/Or Operations
* Qualification in Data Analytics will be an added advantage
* Deep expertise in sales technologies for general and modern trade and proven experience in deploying these in large markets successfully
* Experience in top-tier CPG organizations within their market operations would be an added advantage

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Goal Oriented: Ability to track record of delivery, sets clear priorities and meets deadlines
* Natural leader: Positive, driven, has ability to influence, sets good examples, ambitious, determined and flexible
* Result oriented: entrepreneurial and self-motivating, good planning and organizational ability
* High level of communication ability and presentation skills, energized and enthusiastic
* Analytical skills: ability to define problems, collect details data, analyses and interprets results and recommend changes and improvements
* Resilient, resourceful and able to perform under pressure

The skills for success
  
  
Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfilio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Digital Transformation, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Associate Academic Advisor (Sales), India
description:

We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia and New Zealand.
  
  
**The Role**
This is a full-time position, based in
**India**
**What are the main responsibilities for this role?**

* Own and convert a pipeline of inbound and outbound leads, from first conversation to close
* Run consultative discovery calls and academic assessments to uncover a family's goals, concerns and decision drivers
* Present and sell Crimson programs with confidence, tailoring the proposal to each student and handling objections with skill
* Negotiate and close high-value deals with families, hitting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets

* Come up with creative new ways to reach and engage families
* Build partnerships with schools, businesses, non-profits and other organizations that generate qualified leads
* Work with the Local Area and Digital Marketing teams to improve lead generation, identifying campaigns, services and distribution channels that grow leads and sales
* Represent Crimson at school talks, careers expos and Crimson seminars, turning audiences into opportunities
* Research potential organizations and markets for lead generation, and attend relevant industry events to share insight on market trends

* An excellent track record in sales, ideally high-ticket or consultative sales with long decision cycles and multiple stakeholders
* A history of meeting or beating targets, and the drive to keep doing it
* Strong storytelling and public speaking skills, and the ability to persuade and build trust with parents and students
* Confidence selling over video and phone
* Resilience, curiosity and a creative approach to prospecting and closing
* A genuine interest in education and in connecting families to the right program

**Experience That Would Be Useful In This Role**

* CRM handling and disciplined pipeline management
* Fluency in English and one or two Indian languages
* Experience in education, edtech or admissions, or an understanding of the global undergraduate application process (particularly US and UK), is a plus but not essential

**Why work for Crimson?**

* Flexible working environment, you will be empowered to structure how you work
* Option to work from our many locations/remotely around the globe (role dependant) with us!
* Limitless development and exposure- our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year.
* $1,000 training budget per year- we love to level up!
* Psychologist on staff
* Impressive fireside chats and workshops to help the team continuously level up
* Radical Candour is a feedback approach we live by

 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

 No two days are the same. You’ll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers’ toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners—playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery.

* Deliver solution designs, high\-impact proposals, and customer engagements that reinforce Check Point’s leadership.
* Represent Check Point at cybersecurity events and demos.


**Qualifications**
**Desired Background**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations; 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles.
* Strong customer\-centric mindset and commitment to excellent customer experience.
* Hands\-on attitude; willing to roll up sleeves to resolve technical blockers.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.

* Engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline.

title: Product Innovation Lead
description:
Product Innovation Lead

**Location:**
Gurugram / Faridabad

**Experience:**
5–8+ years

**Function:**
Product Innovation & R&D

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Days:**
5 days a week

**Reporting To:**
Founder / CEO

About Rasayanam

Rasayanam is a new-age nutrition and supplements brand built for people who want everyday progress without shortcuts.

We believe supplements should deliver meaningful results, be safe to use consistently, and earn trust through evidence rather than marketing claims. We focus on purposeful formulations, clinically supported ingredients and doses, transparent communication, and products designed for long-term use.

We are building for the Conscious Indian Improver - someone who wants results, asks questions, understands what they put into their body, and does not blindly trust brands.

This is also how we expect ourselves to work: high ownership, clear thinking, strong standards, and a bias toward doing what is right for the customer over what is easiest in the short term.

About the Role

At Rasayanam, we do not build products to follow trends—we build products customers can trust with their health. The Product Innovation Lead will own the end-to-end product journey, from identifying unmet customer needs to developing evidence-backed formulations ready for commercialization. Success in this role is measured not by launch volume, but by product quality, measurable customer outcomes, and the long-term trust our formulations earn.

What You’ll Own

* **End-to-End Product Innovation:**
  Identify meaningful customer health needs, manage the innovation pipeline, and lead formulation development from concept to commercial launch.
* **Scientific Research & Formulation Design:**
  Evaluate scientific literature and emerging ingredients to create safe, effective formulations with clearly defined usage protocols and evidence standards.
* **Safety, Quality & Regulatory Compliance:**
  Own testing, validation, certifications, and quality benchmarks while ensuring every product claim is scientifically defensible.
* **Customer Outcome Measurement:**
  Define expected health outcomes for every product and continuously refine formulations using real customer feedback and performance data.
* **Supplier & Manufacturing Qualification:**
  Evaluate and onboard ingredient suppliers and manufacturing partners to maintain high standards of traceability, transparency, and quality across the supply chain.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Partner closely with Marketing, CX, Operations, and Quality teams to build repeatable systems that strengthen product decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

**Must Have**

* 5–8+ years of professional experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional foods, pharmaceuticals, or related health and wellness categories.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience specifically in product development, formulation, or innovation roles.
* Strong ability to critically analyze scientific literature and translate clinical research into practical, safe product decisions.
* Direct experience managing regulatory compliance (e.g., FSSAI), certifications, quality standards, and third-party testing protocols.
* High ownership mindset with sharp analytical judgment, rigorous attention to detail, and an uncompromising commitment to long-term safety over short-term speed.

**Good to Have**

* Experience scaling D2C or consumer-first nutrition brands in the Indian market.
* Familiarity with clinical trial design or claim substantiation documentation.
* Strong existing network of vetted raw-ingredient suppliers and GMP-certified manufacturing partners.

How You’ll Work

We’re looking for people who:

* **Own outcomes, not just tasks.**
  You take responsibility from problem to resolution.
* **Move with urgency.**
  You act decisively without lowering the bar.
* **Think for yourself.**
  You bring a point of view, challenge assumptions, and use judgment.
* **Put the customer first.**
  You optimize for what is genuinely right for the customer, not what is easiest or most convenient.
* **Raise the bar.**
  You are never satisfied with “good enough” when better is possible.

Why Rasayanam

We’re building a brand that aims to make wellness more trustworthy, transparent, and genuinely useful for Indian consumers. At Rasayanam, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with a growing team, take meaningful ownership, and help build something from the ground up.

title: Business Head- Digital Metal
description:
**About MMTC‑PAMP:**

MMTC‑PAMP is Indias
**first and only LBMA-accredited Gold & Silver refinery**
, renowned globally for its quality, integrity, and technological excellence. It is a
**joint venture between PAMP SA, Switzerland, and MMTC Ltd., a Government of India Undertaking**
. Established in 2008, the company operates one of the
**worlds most advanced precious metals refining and minting facilities**
, offering 999.9 pure gold and silver products crafted with Swiss precision and Indian artistry.

**Official Website:**
https://www.mmtcpamp.com/ [mmtcpamp.com]

**Role Overview:**

MMTC-PAMP is looking for a Business Head to own the P&L for its Digital Metal D2C business, with full accountability for revenue, margin and volume growth across our web and app channels and partner-driven channels. You’ll also lead the commercial conversations with the payment and platform partners that drive the business.

The role pairs a strong grasp of consumer buying and selling journeys with the commercial judgment to grow and renegotiate partnerships that move the P&L. Contracts and negotiations support that mandate; the heart of the role is growing the business.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own the P&L for the Digital Metal business: revenue, margin, volume and growth targets across owned D2C channels (web, app) and partner-driven channels
* Understand and continuously improve D2C user journeys (acquisition, buy/sell/redemption flows, retention, conversion), working closely with Product and Tech to prioritize the changes that move the P&L
* Lead commercial conversations with payment and platform partners to grow transacting volumes, improve economics and resolve commercial issues as they arise
* Build a working understanding of payment flows and settlement mechanics, so you can negotiate from a position of strength and find opportunities to improve margin
* Review and negotiate the commercial terms of partner agreements, amendments and vendor SOWs, with Legal support, so they serve the P&L
* Track competitive positioning and market share in the digital metal category, and build the business case for new initiatives, partnerships or product bets
* Report business performance, risks and growth opportunities to leadership on a regular cadence

**What we’re looking for:**

8–12 years of experience spanning most of the areas below. We’re after breadth across more than one of them rather than deep specialization in just one.

* **P&L ownership:**
  You’ve owned revenue/margin targets for a product, business line or channel, not just managed relationships around one.
* **Fintech / payments understanding:**
  A solid grasp of how payment systems and flows work (settlement, reconciliation, commission structures, payment gateway mechanics), built from working in or closely with a fintech or payments-heavy e-commerce business.
* **Consumer / D2C product sense:**
  You’re comfortable reviewing and improving user journeys on an app or website, working hand-in-hand with Product and Design.
* **Commercial negotiation:**
  You can lead conversations with large partners independently, balancing commercial upside, risk and long-term relationship health.
* **Contracts and legal literacy:**
  You’re comfortable reading and negotiating commercial agreements and understanding liability/indemnity implications. A legal background isn’t required; you’ll work with legal counsel as needed.
* **Executive presence:**
  You can represent the business directly with senior leadership and partner-side counterparts.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with UPI or digital-wallet payment flows, or in a precious-metals/commodities D2C business
* Experience owning or reviewing vendor SOWs for tech or data-migration projects

- Highly organized, discreet and trustworthy with confidential information.
- Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, with a strong bias for action.

title: ProjectWise Administrator / BIM Information Manager
description:
**Job Title: ProjectWise Administrator / BIM Information Manager**

**You will stand up a ProjectWise environment for a live highway project and configure the document workflows that run it — folder structure, metadata, states, roles and access.**

**This is a hands-on configuration role. You decide how the information is organised and then build it, rather than writing a procedure for someone else to implement. There is no one above you on this: you own the environment.**

**The project runs entirely on the Bentley stack: MicroStation, OpenRoads Designer, ProjectWise, AssetWise and Synchro.**

**What you'll do**

* Set up the datasource, folder structure and naming to ISO 19650, including the suitability and status codes
* Define and configure the attribute set so documents carry the metadata reporting will later depend on
* Build workflows and states — who reviews, who approves, what a document must satisfy to move
* Configure users, roles and access control
* Set up a managed workspace so every modeller opens OpenRoads with the same configuration
* Ingest the project's 2D and 3D deliverables and run them through the workflow end to end
* Document the configuration so a successor can maintain it

**You must have**

* Several years administering ProjectWise, not only using it as an end user, including at least one environment you configured from scratch
* ISO 19650 in practice — container naming, suitability codes, the CDE states and what belongs in each
* Configuration of attributes, environments and workflow states
* Enough understanding of design files to know what the model team actually needs from the CDE

**Helpful, not required**

* ProjectWise managed workspaces for OpenRoads or MicroStation
* ProjectWise 365 or Deliverables Management
* AssetWise, or any experience of the handover from a project CDE into an asset system
* Autodesk Construction Cloud, so you can compare the two with a client
* Exposure to Bentley iTwin

**How we assess**

* **A scoped exercise on a sample dataset: define the folder and attribute structure for a described project, and explain the workflow states you would build and why. We are looking at the reasoning as much as the configuration.**

title: Sr Manufacturing Engineer – Sourced Hardware
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will manage and coordinate delivery projects within the Supplier Performance & Execution Sourcing Section. You will organize and coordinate multi-functional teams to execute on product delivery improvements, support the Sourcing team and suppliers to resolve technical issues, while providing expertise to the team on manufacturing processes.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!
  
  
**Site Overview**
Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing
  
  
**Role Overview**

* Manufacturing Engineering focal for assigned supplier base. Expected to own the technical performance of multiple suppliers so supplier travel will be frequent (25-50%).
* Proactively identifies delivery barriers and resolves with fulfilment, commercial and quality team members. Is recognized as a critical team member by supplier or commodity
* Acts as a Project Manager for large complex suppliers along with others
* Has manufacturing expertise across multiple related part families and processes, along with deep domain expertise.
* Guides and influences suppliers’ performance based on manufacturing expertise.
* Actively drives cost reduction efforts within assigned supply base and is proactively engaged in addressing cost issues.
* Active in supplier selection based on value. Partners with commercial owners to ensure supplier selection provides desired value
* Supports source changes as needed and develops lower performing suppliers

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Manufacturing)
* At least 10 - 15 years of experience in Manufacturing, Engineering or Production Management

**Desired Characteristics**

* Expertise in programming or mechanically supporting traditional (milling, turning, broach, weld) and/or non-traditional (EDM, 3D printing) machining methods.
* Souring, Shop Operations, or Production Control expertise
* Manufacturing Experience in Aerospace or Automotive a plus
* Humble: respectful, inclusive, good listener, learns from past
* Transparent: Candid in feedback, shares to solve problems, helps grow others
* Focused: Safety first, prioritizes work, measures success by the customer, continuously improves
* Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
* Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.
  
  
This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required from each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes
  
  

* This is a remote position

Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.

Hub Operations Management

* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.

Mid Mile Network Operations
  
  
  

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

Network Coordination & Exception Management
  
  
  

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

Workforce & Shift Leadership

* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.

* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.

title: Mathematics Curriculum Architect
description:
**EdPlatza Tuition | Remote (India) | Project-based, flexible engagement**

* We are looking for mathematical thinkers and creators, not simply content producers.
* PRIOR EDTECH OR UK CURRICULUM EXPERIENCE IS NOT ESSENTIAL.

**Are you someone who finds beauty in Mathematics, questions conventional methods of teaching it and is fascinated by how mathematical understanding develops?**

We are looking for an exceptional mathematician who wants to help build an outstanding digital Mathematics learning platform.

Our ambition is to create learning experiences that aspire to the mathematical rigour, creativity and pedagogical quality of platforms.

We are particularly interested in mathematicians, researchers, academics, problem setters and educators who have a deep intellectual interest in Mathematics and a genuine passion for making it accessible to others.

The Challenge

How should a child develop mathematical understanding from their first encounter with numbers through to advanced calculus?

What is the most effective sequence in which mathematical concepts should be introduced? Why do students struggle with certain concepts? How can abstract mathematical ideas be made intuitive without sacrificing rigour?

We want to explore these questions and translate the answers into a comprehensive digital Mathematics curriculum covering UK Year 1 to A-Level (Indian Classes 1–12 equivalent).

This is a foundational, hands-on role, combining mathematical thinking, curriculum architecture, pedagogy and original content creation.

What You Will Create

**Mathematics Curriculum Architecture**

* Deconstruct Mathematics into meaningful, interconnected mathematical skills and concepts.
* Establish prerequisite relationships and logical learning progressions.
* Determine the appropriate depth, sequence and complexity of mathematical concepts.
* Develop a coherent curriculum aligned with UK educational requirements.

**Mathematical Learning Experiences**

* Develop original explanations that make complex mathematical ideas intuitive.
* Create visual representations, mathematical models, worked examples and thought-provoking problems.
* Design questions that develop mathematical reasoning rather than mechanical repetition.
* Identify misconceptions and develop effective ways to address them.
* Create diagnostic assessments, progressive exercises and mathematically rigorous solutions.

**You will personally undertake this work. This is not a content management or team supervision position.**

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking individuals with exceptional mathematical ability, intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for Mathematics education.

You may be:

* A PhD holder, doctoral researcher or postgraduate in Mathematics or Applied Mathematics.
* A current or retired university professor, lecturer or academic researcher.
* A Mathematics Olympiad problem setter, trainer or accomplished participant.
* A Mathematics education researcher or textbook author.
* An exceptional Mathematics graduate with demonstrated mathematical and pedagogical creativity.

We particularly welcome candidates from institutions such as ISI, CMI, IISc, TIFR, IITs, IISERs, NISER, HRI and IMSc, alongside other leading Indian and international universities.

Academic pedigree is valued, but demonstrated mathematical excellence and originality are equally important.

What Makes You Different

* You enjoy exploring why a mathematical method works, not simply applying it.
* You can explain the same mathematical concept in several fundamentally different ways.
* You value elegance, precision and originality in mathematical thinking.
* You are as interested in explaining fractions to a young child as you are in exploring advanced mathematical concepts.
* You enjoy creating original mathematical problems and learning experiences.

The Engagement

* Remote, project-based engagement.
* Flexible working arrangements around academic, research or professional commitments.
* Opportunity to shape the mathematical foundations of an ambitious educational platform.
* Remuneration commensurate with expertise and agreed project scope.

We welcome applications from practising and retired academics, independent researchers and exceptional mathematicians at different stages of their careers.

How to Apply

Please share:

1. Your CV, academic background and areas of mathematical interest.
2. A short note explaining what interests you about Mathematics education and this project.
3. Where available, a link to your published work, research, mathematical problems, teaching resources or other original mathematical work.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a mathematical and pedagogical discussion, followed by a paid practical assessment for selected candidates.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
  
  
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a
**highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi.
  
  
This is a deeply technical role requiring
**expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems.**
You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions.
* Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services.
* Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances.
* Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services.
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks.
* Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations.
* Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking.
* Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ in managing global DNS, NTP and LDAP systems on Linux Operating Systems.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code with Ansible, Terraform, or Pulumi.
* Working experience implementing OpenLDAP & NTP services (preferably Microchip SyncServer systems).
* Expertise with Infoblox DDI systems (or similar enterprise DNS systems: BlueCat, Bind9, CloudFlare, GCP and AWS DNS services).
* Familiar with various Infrastructure technology stacks like Hypervisor Technologies (KVM, Vsphere,), storage protocols (SDS) (iSCSI, NFS, CEPH), L2/L3 Networking
* Strong Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) systems engineering background with advanced scripting in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test frameworks.
* Strong experience supporting mission critical 24x7 customer facing production environments.
* Demonstrated success building or maintaining multi-region or high-availability OpenStack clusters.
* Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases and background in large enterprise infrastructure environments.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiar with Cisco UCS Blade Servers (or similar server Infrastructure), Block/File Storage (Soft defined storage preferred).
* Understanding of security best practices for system patching and security compliance (e.g., CIS, NIST).
* Background in telco, edge cloud environments.

title: Global Digital Marketing Channel Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Global Digital Marketing Analytics Senior Analyst is a hands-on analytical practitioner who serves as the dedicated analytics resource across BCG's digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, content, and beyond. This person is embedded in the day-to-day rhythm of channel execution and campaign delivery, providing the analytical support, performance interpretation, and data-driven guidance that helps channel teams make smarter decisions about how they plan, optimize, and evolve their activations.
  
  
This is not a reporting role. The Senior Specialist goes beyond pulling numbers to actively interpreting what channel data means, identifying what is and is not working across the channel mix, and translating those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that channel strategists and campaign managers can act on in real time. This person is a trusted analytical partner to multiple channel teams simultaneously — organized enough to manage a broad portfolio of analytical support needs, and sharp enough to add genuine strategic value to each one.
  
  
Channel Performance Analysis & Insight
  
  

* Serve as the primary analytics partner across digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, social, and content — providing hands-on analytical support that helps each team understand and act on their performance data
* Analyze channel performance data on an ongoing basis, going beyond surface metrics to identify trends, anomalies, and patterns that reveal what is driving or limiting channel effectiveness across campaigns and activations
* Translate channel data findings into clear, actionable insight narratives that channel teams can use to make immediate optimization decisions — explaining not just what the numbers show but what they mean and what should change as a result
* Develop a working understanding of how each channel's data behaves — its quirks, its limitations, its attribution challenges, and its most meaningful performance signals — so that analytical conclusions are always grounded in an accurate picture of what the data can and cannot tell you
* Proactively surface channel performance insights to channel leads and campaign managers without waiting to be asked, identifying inflection points, underperformance signals, and optimization opportunities as they emerge

Campaign & Activation Analytics Support
  
  

* Support the analytics needs of active marketing campaigns across the channel mix — providing pre-campaign audience and benchmarking analysis, in-flight performance monitoring, and post-campaign measurement and insight synthesis
* Build and maintain campaign performance trackers and channel scorecards that give channel and campaign teams clear, current visibility into how activations are performing against goals across all relevant metrics
* Conduct cross-channel campaign analyses that connect the dots between how audiences are engaging across email, paid, web, and other digital touchpoints — identifying patterns in cross-channel behavior that inform how campaigns should be sequenced, optimized, or adjusted mid-flight
* Contribute to post-campaign retrospectives by preparing well-structured performance summaries and insight outputs that capture what worked, what did not, and what the data recommends for future activations

Channel Strategy Insight & Optimization
  
  

* Partner with channel leads and CX strategists to bring analytical perspective into channel strategy conversations to inform how channels are planned, invested in, and evolved over time
* Conduct deeper analytical investigations when channel performance raises strategic questions
* Identify recurring performance patterns across channels and campaigns that point to systemic optimization opportunities — bringing these findings forward with clear recommendations rather than simply observing them
* Support channel investment and prioritization conversations with data — preparing analytical inputs that help marketing leadership understand where channel spend and effort are generating the strongest return

Data Pulling, Validation & Reporting
  
  

* Extract, validate, and prepare channel performance data from across BCG's digital marketing technology stack — including Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, ad network platforms, CRM, and other relevant sources — ensuring accuracy and consistency before any analysis or output is produced
* Write SQL queries against the marketing master dataset in Snowflake to access audience and engagement data that supplements platform-level reporting, expanding the analytical picture available for channel insight work
* Build and maintain recurring channel reporting outputs — dashboards, scorecards, and performance summaries — that keep channel teams consistently informed without requiring manual analytical effort for every update
* Apply rigorous data validation habits to all analytical work — checking figures, interrogating unexpected results, and never presenting numbers to stakeholders without confidence in their accuracy

Enablement & Analytical Standards
  
  

* Develop and maintain channel-specific metric glossaries, reporting templates, and analytical reference guides that help channel teams interpret their own data more independently and consistently
* Contribute to the development of shared analytical standards across the marketing analytics function — ensuring that metrics, definitions, and performance benchmarks are applied consistently across channels and campaigns
* Support the onboarding of channel team members onto analytics tools and reporting outputs, helping new colleagues understand how to read and use the data available to them

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in a digital marketing analytics, channel analytics, or marketing data role, with hands-on experience analyzing performance data across at least two or more digital marketing channels — email, paid media, web, social, or equivalent
* Solid working knowledge of the digital marketing channel landscape — how each channel works, what its key performance metrics are, how attribution and measurement differ across channels, and how audience behavior connects across touchpoints
* Hands-on experience working with marketing analytics platforms including at least several of the following: Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, Google Analytics, paid media ad network reporting platforms, or equivalent
* Solid SQL skills at a querying and analysis level, with the ability to independently access and interrogate marketing datasets in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse environment
* Proficiency in Tableau or a comparable data visualization platform for building and maintaining channel performance dashboards and analytical outputs
* Strong data validation instincts and attention to detail — you check your own work, interrogate unexpected results, and take accuracy seriously before anything goes to a stakeholder
* Clear, confident communication skills with the ability to present channel performance findings and recommendations to channel leads, campaign managers, and senior marketing stakeholders in a way that is accessible, structured, and actionable
* Experience working in a fast-moving, campaign-driven marketing environment where analytical support needs shift quickly and responsiveness matters
* Familiarity with A/B testing methodology and the ability to interpret test results accurately and communicate findings clearly
* Experience working in an Agile or sprint-based environment preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role sits within BCG's Global Marketing analytics function and operates as a shared analytical resource across the digital marketing channel teams. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the channel leads, managers, and leads across email, paid media, web, events, and content — the people whose campaign and activation shapes your analytical work is designed to sharpen and inform. You will be present in their planning conversations, their optimization reviews, and their campaign retrospectives, bringing data to the table at the moments when it matters most.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will work closely with the Senior Manager and Director of Marketing Analytics, contributing channel-level analytical output that feeds into the broader audience and performance insight picture the function produces for senior marketing leadership. You will also collaborate with dashboard and data engineering colleagues when channel reporting needs require new data pipelines or expanded Snowflake access, and with CRM data operations colleagues when audience and contact data underpins channel targeting or segmentation analysis.
  
  
This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys the variety and pace of working across multiple channels simultaneously — who finds satisfaction in being the person a channel team turns to when the data raises a question they cannot answer on their own, and who takes pride in giving them an answer that actually changes what they do next.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
You’re Good At
  
  

* Getting into the data quickly and knowing what you are looking for — you have strong analytical instincts developed across enough channel experience that you notice when something looks off, when a trend is significant, and when a number needs to be investigated before it gets presented
* Working across multiple channels and analytical workstreams simultaneously without losing quality or momentum — you are organized, prioritize well, and deliver reliably across a busy and varied portfolio of analytical support needs
* Translating channel performance data into plain language that channel managers and campaign teams can act on — you don't hide behind technical terminology or data caveats, you give people the insight they need to make a decision
* Being a genuine partner to channel teams rather than a report factory — you show up to conversations with a perspective, ask clarifying questions that sharpen the analytical brief, and add value beyond the specific output that was requested
* Moving fluidly across the digital channel landscape — you are comfortable switching from an email performance analysis to a paid media attribution question to a web engagement funnel in the same day, and you bring enough channel-specific knowledge to each that your analysis is grounded and credible
* Knowing the difference between a data issue and a performance issue — you have the technical discipline to validate your data before drawing conclusions, and the intellectual honesty to say when the data is not clean enough to support the insight being requested

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Data Analyst / BI Developer who is exceptional in Tableau and even stronger in advanced SQL and data understanding. The role will own the complete analytics lifecycle—from understanding a business question and validating source data to building optimized SQL datasets and publishing reliable, decision-ready Tableau dashboards.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently with large, complex datasets, identify data-quality issues, explain the business meaning behind numbers, and convert analysis into clear, actionable insights. Strong Python development capability is required. DBMS experience and/or React knowledge will be an added advantage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Partner with business and functional teams to understand processes, KPIs, reporting requirements, decision points, and data definitions.

• Design, develop, publish, and maintain enterprise-grade Tableau dashboards, reports, and reusable data sources.

• Build efficient and reliable SQL queries for complex analysis, reconciliation, reporting, and data preparation.

• Investigate data discrepancies by tracing data from source systems through transformations to final dashboards.

• Define data grain, joins, business rules, metric logic, filters, and exception-handling rules before visualization.

• Optimize Tableau workbooks, extracts, live connections, calculations, and underlying SQL for performance and scalability.

• Develop Python-based utilities and workflows for data extraction, transformation, validation, automation, API integration, and recurring analysis.

• Perform exploratory analysis, identify trends and anomalies, and communicate findings in simple business language.

• Create documentation covering metric definitions, data lineage, dashboard logic, refresh schedules, assumptions, and known limitations.

• Apply appropriate access controls, row-level security, testing, version control, and deployment practices.

• Support users after release, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve dashboards based on usage and feedback.

• Coach stakeholders and team members on effective dashboard use and sound interpretation of data.

MANDATORY TECHNICAL SKILLS

1. Exceptional Tableau expertise

• Deep hands-on knowledge of Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud.

• Expert-level capability in calculated fields, Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, table calculations, parameters, sets, context filters, dashboard actions, data blending/relationships, and reusable data sources.

• Strong understanding of extracts versus live connections, refresh strategy, row-level security, publishing, permissions, subscriptions, and dashboard governance.

• Proven ability to create clean, intuitive, executive-ready dashboards without compromising analytical depth.

• Strong Tableau performance-tuning skills, including reducing query load, optimizing calculations, improving workbook design, and using performance diagnostics.

2. Expert-level advanced SQL

• Excellent command of complex joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, conditional aggregation, set operations, pivots/unpivots, date logic, and advanced analytical queries.

• Ability to write accurate SQL for large datasets while handling duplicates, nulls, changing master data, incomplete records, and different levels of granularity.

• Strong understanding of query execution plans, indexing, partitioning, views/materialized views, and performance optimization.

• Ability to independently reconcile results across source tables and prove the correctness of reported numbers.

• Sound knowledge of relational database concepts, normalization, dimensional modelling, fact/dimension design, and data marts.

3. Strong data and business understanding

• Ability to translate an unclear business requirement into precise questions, definitions, source mappings, and acceptance criteria.

• Strong understanding of data quality, data lineage, master data, transaction data, historical versus current-state reporting, and source-of-truth controls.

• Ability to distinguish correlation from causation, validate assumptions, identify anomalies, and explain why a metric changed—not only what changed.

4. Python development

• Strong hands-on Python skills for data processing and automation.

• Experience with pandas, NumPy, database connectivity, REST APIs, file processing, logging, exception handling, and reusable modular code.

• Ability to build and maintain ETL/ELT utilities, validation scripts, scheduled workflows, and analytical prototypes.

• Familiarity with Git, code review, testing, and maintainable development practices.

PREFERRED / ADDED ADVANTAGE

• DBMS expertise, including schema design, indexing, EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, functions, views, materialized views, and database performance tuning.

• React knowledge for building lightweight analytical applications, integrating dashboards, or creating custom data-driven user interfaces.

• Exposure to data warehouses, cloud data platforms, orchestration tools, APIs, and modern data pipelines.

• Experience working with operational, sales, finance, supply-chain, or manufacturing data will be useful.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrable experience delivering production Tableau solutions and writing complex SQL in a business environment.

• A strong portfolio or practical examples of dashboards, SQL problem-solving, performance tuning, and data reconciliation will be preferred.

  **analytical, presentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills**

Work with enterprise clients across multiple geographies and industries, gaining experience in

building solutions for global markets.

High-Energy Culture

title: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
**Lead Product Designer**

Bajaj Capital · Gurugram · Full-time, work from office · 5–7 years · Reports to Product leadership

**About Bajaj Capital**

Bajaj Capital has helped Indian families invest and protect their wealth since 1964. Today we manage ₹12,000 Cr+ in assets, with a team of 4,000+ people and branches across 100+ cities. We are now building the digital products that bring this expertise to the next generation of investors.

At Bajaj Capital, we're building the next generation of digital wealth experiences and looking for someone to lead product design across our B2C and Partner Apps.

We're looking for someone who can simplify complex financial journeys, understand customer pain points, build scalable design systems and translate business problems into intuitive digital experiences.

Experience:5–7 years, including 3+ years in fintech, preferably wealth management or investments.

Location: Gurugram | Work from Office

**What success looks like**

**By 90 days**

* A design point of view and priorities for all three apps, agreed with product and engineering.
* RTR releases shipping to your quality bar.
* Design system v1 live: tokens, core components, a shared Figma library and handoff rules that engineering uses.
* A working process: briefs, critiques, design QA before every release, and clear direction for agency and in-house work.

**By 12 months**

* One design system across all three apps, used in code.
* Measurable improvement in key journeys across the apps, tracked through funnels and events you helped define.
* Consent, disclosure and data-sharing patterns that meet regulatory standards and that users understand.
* A regular research rhythm with customers and RMs.
* A plan for the design team, and its first hires.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years in product design, including 3+ years on fintech products used at scale. Wealth investing experience is strongly preferred.
* A portfolio of shipped work showing how you framed problems, made trade-offs, and what changed after launch.
* Experience building or substantially reshaping a design system and seeing it adopted in code.
* A track record of making complex financial ideas (projections, scores, risk, costs) clear to non-experts.
* Experience with regulated journeys such as KYC, consent and disclosures, working with compliance as a partner.
* Strong mobile craft, including design for mid- and low-end Android devices.
* Comfort with data: reading funnels, defining events and running tests.
* Experience directing others' work (agencies, freelancers or designers) through clear briefs and critique.
* The judgement to work across several products with little direction, and clear communication with senior leaders.

**Nice to have**

* People management or mentoring experience.
* B2B or advisor tools: CRM, RM workspaces, dashboards.
* Financial data visualisation, accessibility (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) and multilingual design.
* UX writing, and prototyping with code or AI tools.

**Why join**

* Build the function, not just the screens. You’ll create our design system and practice, and hire the team that carries it forward.
* Real ownership. Three apps, a direct line to product leadership, and the final word on design quality.
* Startup ownership, without startup risk. The trust and reach of a six-decade financial brand, with the freedom of a new product team.
* Work that matters. Design the products that help people build wealth and reach financial freedom.
* Grow with us. A clear path to lead design as the team scales.

**How to apply**

**Share your CV and portfolio to mannu.supriya@bajajcapiatal.com**
;

NDA-safe case studies are welcome. Our process is an intro call, a portfolio review, a live design working session, a craft and systems review, and a leadership conversation.

Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**About ERM Marketing & Communications Agency (MCA)**
ERM MCA is the marketing communications agency of ERM, the world’s leading specialist sustainability consultancy. We help top companies translate complex sustainability efforts into clear, compelling stories that build brand value, inspire action and avoid greenwashing. By combining strategic market insights, creative execution and ERM’s deep technical expertise, we deliver communications that connect with stakeholders, shape conversations and accelerate sustainability outcomes. Learn more at ERM Marketing & Communications Agency.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Managing Consultant - Graphic Designer,**
you will support ERM's global consulting delivery by leading the creative development and visual execution of sustainability communications for clients worldwide. Working within ERM Marketing & Communications Agency (MCA), you will collaborate with consultants, creative specialists, and client stakeholders across regions to translate complex ESG and sustainability topics into impactful visual experiences across reports, digital platforms, campaigns, stakeholder engagement programs, websites, digital dashboards, and branding systems. This role is critical to delivering innovative communications that enhance client impact, strengthen stakeholder engagement, and support the scalability and consistency of ERM's global delivery model.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Deliver high-quality creative direction and design solutions that translate complex sustainability and ESG topics into engaging and accessible communications.

* Build trusted relationships with internal teams and clients, serving as a strategic creative advisor and confident presenter of design concepts and recommendations.
* Mentor and develop graphic designers through effective people leadership, coaching, performance management, and career development support.
* Drive innovation by incorporating emerging design trends, digital best practices, and AI-enabled approaches into creative processes and client solutions.
* Contribute to the growth of ERM MCA by supporting proposal development, business development activities, and the continuous enhancement of design standards, processes, and capabilities.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s degree or Master's degree in graphic design only
* 12-15 years of professional graphic design experience (agency experience preferred).
* Two or more years of experience managing a small team.
* Strength in people leadership, including coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing print, interactive, and branding work.
* Breadth of previous work in multi-page document and editorial layout design (annual/sustainability reports, books, brochures, magazines, etc.).
* Superior understanding of typography and page layout.
* Extreme attention to detail and proven commitment to quality control, including maintaining file hygiene.
* Strength in client communications and leading design-focused discussions.
* Ability to communicate complex information to a broad audience of internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Proficient in Mac OS, Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop), and Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Excel).
* Solid understanding of UX/UI design for digital experiences.
* Knowledge of CSS and HTML.
* Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team, and perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
* Highly creative mindset with the ability to balance innovation with client brand standards and project requirements.
* Able to work extended hours when necessary.
* Open to input, feedback, and collaboration with colleagues and fellow creatives.
* Ability to handle conflict and manage difficult conversations internally and externally.
* Integrates Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEI&B) into leadership culture.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of environmental, social, or economic aspects of sustainability.
* Consulting industry, marketing, or advertising experience providing services to large corporate clients.
* AI integration into business tasks and design processes.
* Estimating design and marketing budgets.
* Digital accessibility for websites and PDFs.
* Experience with Webflow.
* Video and animation production.
* Illustration talent.
* Photo retouching capabilities.
* Print management and professional printing file preparation.
* 3D rendering.
* Social media experience on major platforms, i.e., Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Provide art directions to graphic designers on client sustainability communications, including reports, websites, campaigns, identity systems, digital dashboards, informational graphics, video, animation, and stakeholder engagement materials.
* Consult with client teams and directly with clients on creative, engaging ways to leverage communications in the digital space.
* Build strong and trusted relationships internally and externally.
* Research and report on design trends to the design team and ERM’s Visual Communication Design technical community.

* Lead recruiting and onboarding efforts, including working with ERM recruiters, reviewing design résumés, conducting candidate interviews, and onboarding new designers.

title: Marketing Strategist
description:
Experience: 2–5 years in SaaS, cloud, or technology product marketing / brand strategy

Department: Marketing – Brand & Product Marketing

Role Overview

We are looking for a brand and product marketing strategist to build our cloud and AI SaaS brands from the ground up. Our portfolio serves two audiences: enterprise decision-makers such as CIOs, CTOs, and IT and finance leaders, and individual users and consumers. You will understand how our products work at a technical level and translate their capabilities into clear value for each audience. That value becomes the positioning, messaging, brand architecture, and go-to market (GTM) strategy behind our growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Build brand strategy for new SaaS products, including brand platform, value proposition, brand identity, and brand guidelines.

• Define the brand architecture across a B2B and B2C product portfolio: how products relate to the master brand and how one brand stays consistent across two different audiences.

• Create audience-specific positioning and messaging frameworks. For enterprises, translate technical capabilities into business outcomes like ROI, cost optimization, security, and scalability. For consumers, translate them into everyday value like ease of use, reliability, and experience.

• Define ideal customer profiles (ICP) and buyer personas for enterprise buying committees, and user personas for consumer segments.

• Conduct market research, consumer insight studies, competitive analysis, and category mapping across both enterprise and consumer SaaS markets.

• Plan go-to-market strategy and product launches for both motions: sales-led GTM for B2B, and product-led growth (PLG) and self-serve adoption for B2C. Work with product management, pre-sales, and sales.

• Create B2B sales enablement assets, including pitch decks, solution briefs, competitive battlecards, and case studies.

• Develop thought leadership and brand content, such as whitepapers, executive point-of-view articles, and LinkedIn thought leadership, that builds credibility with global enterprise clients and trust with consumers.

• Gather win/loss insights from sales and user feedback from product teams to keep positioning sharp for both audiences.

• Track brand health and strategic impact. Use brand awareness, share of voice, and pipeline influence for B2B, and brand recall, consideration, and NPS for B2C. Use the insights to shape long-term growth strategy.

Required Skills & Competencies

• Experience in product marketing, brand strategy, or positioning for a SaaS, cloud, or technology company. MBA projects and internships count.

• Understanding of both B2B (sales-led) and B2C (product-led) marketing models. Hands-on experience in at least one is required; exposure to both is preferred.

• Working knowledge of cloud computing concepts: SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud), multi-cloud, and cloud migration.

• Understanding of enterprise and consumer AI and generative AI use cases and the value they create.

• Understanding of both the enterprise buying journey and consumer decision-making behaviour.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to turn market research and consumer insight into positioning decisions.

Educational Qualification

• MBA in Marketing or a related field.

• Engineering or technical undergraduate degree (B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / B.Sc. IT) strongly preferred.

• Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Google Cloud Digital Leader, or a product marketing certification are a plus. What a Strong Profile Looks Like

title: Commercial Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
This is an early-career commercial strategy and analytics role for candidates who enjoy structured problem solving, working with data and turning analysis into a clear business recommendation. You will work in a consulting-style project environment alongside NRM Strategy, Finance, Consumer Insights and Data & Revenue Science teams, supporting projects from problem definition through executive-ready recommendations.
  
  
The role is especially suited to high-potential candidates from leading Indian business schools, consulting/analytics teams, commercial finance or consumer businesses who want broad exposure to Revenue Growth Management (RGM), strategic pricing and growth strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end NRM engagements by helping define the problem statement, build issue trees, develop hypotheses, identify the analyses required and structure workstreams.
* Analyze sales, transactions, traffic, average order value, mix, realized price, product and store performance across categories, channels, dayparts, occasions and customer/group-size segments.
* Conduct core NRM analyses including menu architecture, price ladders, Good-Better-Best tiers, A La Carte / Everyday Value / Disruptive Value performance, KVI strategy, promotional effectiveness, competitor pricing and channel economics.
* Evaluate cost of sales (COS%), contribution margin, unit economics and product profitability to identify growth opportunities that improve both consumer value and franchisee economics.
* Clean, validate, reconcile and manipulate large datasets in Excel; use pivot tables, lookups, formulas and scenario analyses to turn raw data into decision-ready outputs.
* Decode consumer research and survey results to understand value perception, willingness to pay, Key Value Items, occasions, channel preferences and pricing thresholds.
* Partner with the Data & Revenue Science team on outputs such as elasticity, market basket, tiering and optimization; translate technical results into commercial insights and a clear "so what" for the business.
* Build client-ready PowerPoint pages, charts and exhibits with answer-first headlines, clear logic and strong visual storytelling.
* Support stakeholder interviews, market working sessions and workshops; capture inputs, synthesize themes and convert discussion into actions.
* Own defined analyses or workstreams with strong attention to detail, process discipline, deadlines and output quality.

**Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM / PGP from a leading Indian business school, or a strong undergraduate/postgraduate degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, Analytics or a related field.
* Typically, 0-4 years of relevant experience; strong campus candidates and early-career hires from consulting, analytics, finance, strategy, consumer or digital businesses are encouraged to apply.
* Strong Excel capability, including pivot tables, lookups, large-dataset manipulation, data validation and scenario analysis.
* Strong PowerPoint and business writing skills with the ability to build clean, executive-ready charts and slides.
* Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving; high curiosity, analytical rigor and attention to detail.
* Clear written and spoken English and confidence engaging with stakeholders across different markets and cultures.

title: Browser Automation & Agent Engineer
description:
**About Birdeye Inc.**
Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop.
  
  
Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
Agents that log into real third-party sites (Facebook, GBP, CRMs) and take real actions on a customer’s behalf, wherever no official API exists — a backend pipeline through to the approval UI a human clicks before anything goes live.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Job-dispatch pipeline: dispatch/poll/stall-detection (by activity gaps, not elapsed time) and safe retries
* 2FA/human-in-the-loop checkpoints: live browser handoff + auto-resume, built conservatively (we’ve shipped and fixed two real bugs here: a runaway auto-resume loop, a stale session retrying a dead login)
* Credential handling: domain-locked secret injection, secrets never reach the LLM’s own context or logs
* An independent “judge” layer that verifies what an agent actually did, not what it claims — plus real cost/quality calls across models (cheapest model measured was also the most reliable; a flagship model got lost and cost 10-20x more)
* REST API design (FastAPI/async Python) usable by both the UI and another agent calling it directly
* New connectors: task instructions, judge criteria, guardrails (exact-text guarantees, draft-vs-commit gating)
* The React/TypeScript “Command Center” UI: pending-action feed, job status, 2FA-resume flows
* Debugging from actual traces/logs, not the agent’s own summary

**What You Bring**

* Strong async Python (asyncio, polling/retry, race conditions) + FastAPI
* Real React/TypeScript experience (async state, not static UI)
* Hands-on CDP/Playwright/Puppeteer — know the difference between closing a browser and disconnecting a remote debug client
* Production LLM-agent experience: task/prompt engineering + building verification layers that don’t just trust the agent
* Security mindset: understands credential custody (not just API keys), ToS risk of automating third-party logins, defaults to the safer design
* Debugs from primary sources (reads SDK source, greps logs) over guessing

****Nice to have****

* Experience automating logins at scale (Google/Facebook/Yelp-class sites)
* SOC2/compliance-adjacent secrets work
