title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Location:** Sector 126, Noida, Uttar Pradesh | (Onsite)  
**Working Days & Timings:** Monday – Friday, 10am – 6:30pm  
**Experience:** 2-5 Years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a capable and proactive **Linux Administrator** responsible for deploying, configuring, securing, and maintaining Linux servers across cloud and on-premise environments. The role involves managing critical web services and databases, ensuring infrastructure security and performance, and automating operational workflows through scripting.

This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of systems administration, cloud operations, web server management, and database administration.

**Mandatory Technical Requirements**

Candidates must have hands-on experience with:

· **Linux Systems:** Ubuntu and/or CentOS

· **Databases:** MySQL and MariaDB

· **Web Servers:** Nginx, Apache, and HAProxy

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. System & Cloud Administration**

· Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers (Ubuntu/CentOS) across development, staging, and production environments.

· **Deploy and manage Linux infrastructure on cloud platforms** such as AWS (EC2, VPC, S3), GCP (Compute Engine), and/or Azure (Virtual Machines), including provisioning, scaling, and cost optimisation.

· **Perform OS patching, package upgrades, and security hardening in accordance with organisational standards.**

· **Manage user accounts, groups, SSH key authentication, and role-based access controls, following the principle of least privilege.**

**2. Web Server & Application Services**

· Install, organise, and maintain application services, including Apache HTTP Server, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.

· Configure and manage Nginx, Apache, and HAProxy for reverse proxying, SSL termination, and load balancing across services.

· Monitor service health, analyse access/error logs, and perform root-cause analysis for outages or degraded performance.

**3. Database Administration**

· Deploy, configure, and maintain MySQL databases, including schema management, user permissions, backups, and query performance tuning.

· Implement and test database backup strategies, ensuring reliable recovery procedures are documented and validated.

· Maintain hands-on working experience with MariaDB.

**4. Scripting & Automation**

· Write and maintain Bash scripts to automate system administration tasks, scheduled jobs, log rotation, health checks, and deployment workflows.

· Contribute to internal tooling and runbook automation to reduce manual effort and improve incident response times.

**5. Network Security & Firewall Management**

· Implement and manage **IPTables/nftables** firewall rules, including NAT, port forwarding, and stateful traffic filtering.

· Define and enforce network security policies and conduct periodic audits of firewall rules and access logs.

· Collaborate with the security team on vulnerability assessments, system hardening initiatives, and compliance requirements.

**6. Monitoring & Documentation**

· Monitor system metrics, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network performance, and configure alerts to detect anomalies before they escalate.

· Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure configurations, operational runbooks, and post-incident reports.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

· Hands-on experience with Ubuntu and/or CentOS Linux, including package management (apt/yum/dnf), systemd service management, and system troubleshooting.

· Proven experience deploying and managing Linux servers on at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.

· Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining Apache HTTP Server and related web services, with the ability to read and optimise configuration files.

· Hands-on experience with MySQL, MariaDB, including installation, configuration, backup/restore, and performance tuning.

· Proficiency in Bash scripting, including loops, conditionals, functions, cron scheduling, and error handling.

· Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining Nginx, Apache, and HAProxy in production environments.

· Working knowledge of IPTables and/or nftables for firewall management and network security policies.

**General Requirements**

· 2–5 years of professional Linux system administration experience in production environments.

· Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, and TLS/SSL certificate management.

· Strong documentation habits and clear written communication skills.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their details with updated resume through this Google Form: https://forms.gle/KtNvFzNLp1FeRSK48

title: Software Engineer
description: Department: Tech - Software EngineeringLocation: Gurugram, IndiaDescriptionThe Interfaces to AuroraAurora is the global market leader in energy market analytics and software. We built that position on fundamentals models of energy markets and the intellectual rigour behind them. Investors, lenders, developers and governments use our forecasts to decide which wind farms, solar farms and batteries get built and financed, so the data has to be trusted and bankable. None of that matters unless people can get at it.Our Product Engineering team owns the interfaces to Aurora: UI, APIs, SDKs, CLIs and newer interaction models such as MCP servers, which let AI agents work with our data directly. Our job is to make Aurora's capabilities usable for customers and our own analysts, whatever the touchpoint, and everyone in the team works across those surfaces.We're looking for a Software Engineer to join one of our squads in our growing Gurugram engineering hub.What Makes It InterestingEnergy sits where physics, economics and maths meet. A power price emerges from weather, grid constraints, fuel costs, policy and the behaviour of every asset on the system, and our models simulate all of it. Our modellers build those models, but our engineers engage just as deeply with the domain. You can't design a good interface to something you don't understand, so you'll learn how markets, assets and policy fit together, and for most of the team that's a big part of the appeal. You don't need an energy background to apply: we'll support you to build that knowledge.The harder engineering problem is that there is no single energy market. Our regional teams cover markets around the world, and a market rule in Texas, a capacity mechanism in Germany and a grid in Australia all have to be handled by the same software. Designing something that respects those differences without dissolving into special cases is where much of the interesting work sits.Key ResponsibilitiesWe're organised into long-lived squads, each owning part of the product end to end, with an embedded product representative who can make backlog decisions. Squads stay stable so they build real depth in their area.We are serious about continuous delivery and push to production many times a day in small changes, backed by automated tests and CI. We already tick most of the DORA capabilities (the practices research has found predict good software delivery outcomes), and we treat that as a starting point. Our ambition is to be among the best engineering teams at building and delivering software. You'll own what you build from design through to running it in production.AI tools are expected across the whole job: requirements, design, code, tests, review and operations. Our stance is fundamentals first. AI amplifies whatever practice it sits on, so it makes good engineering faster and bad engineering faster too. What we care about is how you frame a problem, break it down and verify what comes back.Skills, Knowledge and ExpertiseRequired attributes:You will build and ship software that real people use, and be able to explain your choices, including the ones you'd now make differentlycare about tests, readable code and what happens to your work after it's mergedenjoy understanding a problem as much as solving it, and be curious about a domain you may not know yetuse AI tools in your work, and have views on where they help and where they don'twant to get noticeably better over the next couple of years, and be someone others enjoy working with along the wayOur stack is TypeScript and Node, Express, React micro-frontends, SQL (Redshift and MySQL) and MongoDB on AWS, with some Python. Experience with it helps but isn't required: some of our strongest engineers came from C# and other stacks, because good engineering transfers.What we offerSome of the benefits we include are:Accidental, term life and medical insuranceHybrid Work modelEmployee’s Provident Fund SchemeMaternity leaveA fun, informal, collaborative and international work cultureAccess to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspectsThe Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
  
  
**Aon plc (NYSE: AON)**
is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement and health solutions. Our 50,000 colleagues in 120 countries empower results for clients by using proprietary data and analytics to deliver insights that reduce volatility and improve performance.
  
  
This role is based in the Analytics Products team and is a Level 8 position on the AON Career Framework, designed for early-career talent looking to build a career in data analytics.
  
  
You will support senior team members in the delivery of analytics projects using Aon's suite of analytical tools (Tableau, Power BI etc.), supported by our data warehouse (Databricks), while developing your technical and business skills under guidance.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Associate Software Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will start your engineering career building real features on the Aon Assessment Platform — the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments at scale, used by millions of participants worldwide.
  
  
You will join one of our international engineering squads (Germany and India), working under the guidance of your Software Engineering Team Lead and senior engineers on your team. You'll be given real, well-scoped pieces of work — not busywork — and the support to grow quickly: pairing, code review, and structured feedback are part of how the team operates day to day.
  
  
This is a strong platform to learn on. Our codebase is large and touches many interconnected components, so you'll build not just coding skill but the habit of thinking carefully about how a change affects the wider system — a skill that compounds over your whole career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Feature Implementation**

* Implement well-scoped features, bug fixes, and enhancements under the guidance of your Team Lead and senior engineers.
* Write clean, tested code across the stack — C#/.NET services, SQL Server data access, and React front-ends — following established patterns and standards.
* Break down assigned tasks into clear implementation steps, asking clarifying questions early rather than guessing at ambiguous requirements.
* Fix defects identified by QA or reported in production, learning to diagnose root causes rather than just patching symptoms.

**Quality & Testing**

* Write unit and integration tests for the code you deliver, as a core part of "done" rather than an optional extra.
* Participate in code reviews — both receiving feedback and, as you grow, reviewing the work of peers.
* Follow the team's engineering standards: layered architecture, API design conventions, and our React corporate design system.
* Verify your own changes thoroughly before raising them for review, including checking for obvious edge cases.

**Learning & Growth**

* Actively build your understanding of the platform's architecture, data model, and key components — asking questions and using documentation, pairing, and code reading to ramp up.
* Seek and act on feedback from code reviews, 1:1s, and pairing sessions — treating early mistakes as part of the learning process.
* Build foundational skills in requirements analysis, technical design, and estimation by working alongside more senior engineers on real tasks.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your Team Lead, senior engineers, QA, and Business Analysts as part of daily squad activities (stand-ups, planning, reviews).
* Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and early — this is more valuable at this stage than trying to solve everything independently.
* Contribute positively to an international team culture, working comfortably with colleagues across time zones.

**AI-Augmented Engineering**

* Use AI tools in your day-to-day work — for learning, coding assistance, debugging, and documentation — under guidance from senior engineers, building good habits for using them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 0–1 year of professional software engineering experience (2025 or 2026 passout only)
* Solid foundation in programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design, gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects.
* Some exposure to C#/.NET, SQL, JavaScript, or React — through study, internships, or personal projects; we will invest in deepening this on the job.
* Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL querying.
* Strong problem-solving ability and eagerness to learn — comfortable asking questions and receiving direct feedback.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working in an international team across time zones.
* A genuine interest in using AI tools to learn and work more effectively. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* 2026 graduates
* Available to join full-time.
* Strong coding and problem-solving skills demonstrated through assessments and interviews.
* Candidates should be willing to attend the interview process in-person at the Aon Gurgaon office

title: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Senior Compiler Performance Engineer**
to own major performance areas of Falcon. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. Your job is to push its generated code further, deciding which optimizations matter, designing them and delivering measurable speedups on real workloads.

  

You will work in a distributed team of compiler experts, with direct influence on what Falcon optimizes next.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Own performance of Falcon for a set of workloads or an optimization area end to end: analysis, design, implementation, validation

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Significant experience with LLVM optimization passes or code generation; LLVM commit access is a plus

* Deep knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with JVM internals: garbage collection, deoptimization, profiling

title: Principal Architect, Frontier AI Offense & Defense Security
description:
**Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

**About the Role**

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

**What you'll do**

* Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
* Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
* Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
* Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
* Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
* Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years with hands-on depth in both offense (red teaming, adversary simulation, pentest, AppSec, vulnerability research) and defense (detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, threat research).
* Has designed and shipped a security platform, detection and response system or SOC used at enterprise or cloud scale.
* Has built production LLM agents or multi-agent systems for security with tool use, orchestration and measured results, and knows how to catch hallucinated findings.
* Has led full-kill-chain adversary simulations and investigations into sophisticated intrusions.
* Depth in SIEM/XDR/SOAR, AWS/Azure/GCP, Entra/Okta, Kubernetes, large-scale log pipelines and security graphs.
* Has designed human-in-the-loop controls, service identity and permissions, or guardrails for automated response.
* Fluent in Python plus one of Go, Rust or TypeScript.

**Nice to have**

* RL environments, reward functions, verifiers or post-training for agentic tasks.
* Built agentic SOC, autonomous pentest or exposure-management products at a security vendor or AI lab.
* Security of AI agents: prompt injection, tool and MCP abuse, agent identity (OWASP LLM / Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS).
* Public CVEs, open-source detection content, or talks and papers at Black Hat, DEF CON, USENIX Security or IEEE S&P.

Calcutta Management Association (CMA), established in 1957, is one of India’s earliest institutions dedicated to advancing management education and practice. Formed under the aegis of the Union Ministry of Education, CMA emerged from recommendations by the All India Council of Technical Education to create regional management associations in major cities. As the first institution of its kind in the country, CMA has played a pivotal role in shaping management thought and development. CMA was also a driving force behind the creation of the All India Management Association (AIMA), the national apex body for management education, giving it a strong legacy and network that benefits its members and partners.

CMA is looking for an enthusiastic, proactive and result-oriented Business Development Executive to support its corporate relations, marketing and business development initiatives. title: Technical Lead
description:
**About the role**

Ginesys Insights 2.0 is our next-generation, multi-tenant analytics and reporting platform for India's leading

retail brands. It replaces a third-party BI engine for about 500 customers. It has a governed semantic layer,

self-service workbooks, dashboards, scheduling and exports, built on Java/Spring Boot, Next.js and Google

BigQuery on GCP.

The product is moving from a fast-built foundation to a production release. We need a hands-on Technical

Lead to own delivery end to end: architecture, release readiness, quality, cross-team dependencies and the

engineering team.

**What you'll own**

**Delivery and planning**

• Own the plan from PRD to delivery: turn the PRD, the metrics catalogue (185 P0 metrics) and the UX

task list into epics, stories, sprints and owners, and keep tracking in line with what has actually

shipped.

• Run sprint planning, estimation, risk and dependency registers, and status reporting to product and

leadership.

• Plan and run the customer migration waves from the legacy BI tool, including parity sign-off.

• Close open scope decisions with Product, for example MVP AI Chat and the open decision registers.

**Architecture and technical direction**

• Own the overall architecture across the Java/Spring Boot backend-for-frontend (BFF), the

Node.js/Next.js/React frontend and PostgreSQL.

• Work with Product and Data Engineering on how business metrics are defined and served, and make

sure the engineering design supports them.

• Strengthen security: centralise authentication and authorisation, prove tenant isolation, and harden

row-level security, column-level security and masking.

• Own the API contract (OpenAPI) between frontend and backend, including versioning.

**Production readiness**

• Stand up staging and production environments on GCP with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). That

includes Cloud Run, Cloud SQL sizing and connection budgets, Secret Manager and IAM.

• Set up monitoring, metrics and tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident management and rollback runbooks.

• Set up release management: versioning, the dev-to-main release train, promotion gates and change

control for database migrations.

• Set up cost governance for cloud and query usage, including usage metering for billing.

**Quality**

• Define and enforce quality gates: coverage thresholds and static analysis; end-to-end tests

(Playwright); automated tenant-isolation tests; and metric reconciliation against control totals from

the ERP source.

• Set code-review standards and guardrails for AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) so

speed doesn't cost correctness or security.

**People and stakeholders**

• Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 engineers across backend and frontend, working with UX/design.

Reduce key-person dependency through knowledge sharing and clear ownership.

• Be the single technical point of contact for Product, the Ginesys One/G1 platform team (SSO, identity

delegation), Security, Cloud/DevOps and Data Engineering (the BigQuery Gold pipeline).

• Drive external blockers to closure: per-user BigQuery identity through Workforce Identity Federation,

scheduler delegation, and SMTP and storage connectors.

**Must have**

• 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years as Tech Lead or Engineering Lead shipping a

multi-tenant B2B SaaS product to production.

• Strong hands-on Java (17+, ideally 21) and Spring Boot 3: REST API design, JDBC/SQL with PostgreSQL,

transactions, Flyway, JUnit and Testcontainers. Able to review and write production code.

• Strong hands-on Node.js and TypeScript: server-side JavaScript, API routes and the backend-for-

frontend (BFF) pattern, npm ecosystem and build tooling.

• Strong hands-on React (hooks, component design, state management such as Zustand or Redux, data

fetching with React Query) and Next.js (App Router, server components, route handlers, SSR).

• Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), IAM, Workload Identity Federation, Secret

Manager, Artifact Registry.

• Secure multi-tenant design: SSO (OAuth2/OIDC token exchange), session management, RBAC, audit

trails, OWASP practices.

• CI/CD with GitHub Actions, containers, and canary or blue-green deployments.

• Proven delivery management: Agile/Scrum, estimation, risk management, stakeholder reporting, and

managing dependencies on other teams.

• Strong written communication. The project is heavily documented (PRDs, API contracts, blocker and

incident logs).

**Good to have**

• Google BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse: query cost control, dry runs, partitioning and

clustering, performance tuning.

• Cube.js or another semantic layer / metric store (dbt metrics, LookML).

• Analytics and BI domain: star schemas, pivots and aggregations, non-additive measures and distinct

counts, metrics spanning several fact tables, row- and column-level security on reports.

• Experience replacing or migrating a BI or reporting tool (Exago, Qlik, Power BI, Looker, Tableau,

Metabase).

• Terraform; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring; SLO-based operations.

• Retail or ERP domain knowledge: sales, inventory, stock movement, margin, GST, Indian number

formats.

• AG Grid Enterprise (server-side row model) or similar data-grid tooling.

• Experience leading teams that use AI coding assistants, and setting review policies for AI-generated

code.

**Job Overview:** The BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating, developing, and maintaining accurate 3D models for various projects, working closely with the project team to ensure that the designs and

specifications are accurately represented in the BIM system. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills in BIM software and a keen attention to detail to ensure the quality and accuracy of the models.

* **Model Documentation:** Assist in generating accurate and detailed 2D drawings, schedules, and reports derived from the BIM model.

title: QA Tester
description:
**Overall job purpose:**

To ensure the quality, reliability and performance of web applications by designing and maintaining automated test suites, and by validating that releases can withstand real-world traffic before reaching customers. The role combines traditional test automation (functional, regression, cross-browser) with performance/load engineering and the use of AI tools to accelerate test creation, maintenance and failure analysis — working closely with developers, business analysts and the project manager throughout each release cycle to support confident go/no-go decisions.

  

**Main responsibilities and Opportunities:**

Design, build and maintain UI and API automation frameworks for web applications (for example Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured or Postman/Newman) Automate regression, smoke and cross-browser suites and run them in the CI/CD pipeline on every buildKeep tests stable: reduce flaky tests, manage test data and environments, and fix broken scripts quickly.
  
  
Performance and load testingPlan and run load, stress, spike, soak and scalability tests against web pages, APIs and back-end servicesScript realistic user journeys and workload models in tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling or LocustMonitor response time, throughput, error rate, CPU, memory, database and network during tests, and find bottlenecks with developers and DevOpsCompare results against agreed targets (for example p95 response time and peak concurrent users) and report a clear pass or fail
  
  
AI-assisted testingUse AI tools and LLMs to generate test cases, test data and automation code from requirements and user stories, and review the output for correctnessApply AI for self-healing locators, test impact analysis, log and failure triage, and visual or anomaly checksTest AI features in the product, such as chatbots and recommendation or extraction flows, for accuracy, consistency and unsafe output.
  
  
Quality reporting and collaborationReview requirements and designs early, and write test plans, test cases and traceability to requirementsRaise detailed defects, track them to closure and join release go or no-go reviewsPublish test and performance dashboards and a short summary for each release.Knowledge base to define the **test strategy and test plan using AI tools** is a must

**Qualifications, work experience:**

B.E / B. Tech. / MCA / MCM
  
**3 – 5** years of Experience
  
Performance Testing 1 year experience is a must

  

**Knowledge (Language, IT skills etc)**

**Mantadatory skills:** **IAML\LLMS**
  
**Test Automation**UI: Playwright, Selenium, CypressAPI: REST Assured, Postman/NewmanCI/CD integration: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps **Performance & Load Testing**JMeter, k6, Gatling, LocustMonitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, or APM tools (New Relic, Datadog) to watch CPU/memory/DB/network during test runs **AI-Assisted TestingLLM**s/AI copilots for generating test cases and automation code (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT-based tooling)Self-healing test frameworks (e.g., Testim, mabl, or custom LLM-based locator repair)Tools for log/failure triage and anomaly detection (could be custom scripts using an LLM API, or platforms like Applitools for visual testing) **Supporting Skills**Scripting: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (most automation and AI-tooling glue code uses one of these)Version control: GitTest management/defect tracking: Jira, TestRail, ZephyrDashboards/reporting: Grafana, Power BI, or built-in CI reporting (Allure, ExtentReports) **Databases/backend basics**SQL for test data setup/validationBasic understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices architecture, since performance testing touches back-end services directly

  

**Personal Skills:**

Team work, proactive, learner, communication Skills, support team members, takes initiative

**Work Mode: Work from Office**

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are hiring an offshore Salesforce Developer / Consultant to design, build and support Service Cloud solutions for enterprise contact-centre and case-management programs. You will work hands-on across Service Cloud Voice, Chat (Messaging for In-App and Web), Omni-Channel routing and OmniStudio, partnering with onshore architects, business analysts and client stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Service Cloud Voice-**

* Configure and support Service Cloud Voice with Amazon Connect or a partner telephony provider (BYOT), including contact flows, IVR hand-off and call transfer.
* Set up the Voice softphone, call recording, real-time transcription and post-call summaries.
* Build screen pops, case and contact matching, and click-to-dial using Apex, flows and Lightning Web Components.

**Chat and Messaging-**

* Implement Enhanced Messaging channels (web, in-app, SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger) with pre-chat forms, routing and business-hours logic.
* Configure Embedded Service deployments, chatbots and Einstein Bots, with escalation to live agents.
* Customize the messaging experience through Lightning Web Components and the Messaging APIs.

**Omni-Channel and Routing-**

* Design and configure Omni-Channel queues, routing configurations, presence statuses, capacity models and skills-based routing.
* Build Omni-Channel Flow routing for cases, chats, voice and custom objects.
* Tune routing rules, service-level metrics and supervisor views with the Omni Supervisor console.

**OmniStudio-**

* Build guided service processes with OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures and DataRaptors.
* Create reusable FlexCards and OmniScripts for agent console and digital self-service experiences.
* Integrate OmniStudio assets with external systems and Data Cloud where required.

**Delivery and Collaboration-**

* Translate business requirements and user stories into technical designs, then build, unit test and document them.
* Follow DevOps practices: Git branching, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines and Salesforce DX deployments.
* Participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, UAT support and production hypercare.
* Troubleshoot defects, performance issues and integration failures across channels.
* Advise clients on Service Cloud best practices, and mentor junior team members.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 5+ years of Salesforce experience, with at least 3 years on Service Cloud implementations.
* Hands-on delivery of Service Cloud Voice (Amazon Connect or partner telephony), including contact flows and softphone configuration.
* Hands-on delivery of Chat or Enhanced Messaging, Embedded Service and Omni-Channel routing, including skills-based routing and capacity models.
* Practical OmniStudio experience: OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures and DataRaptors, on at least two projects.
* Strong Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Flow and platform event skills.
* Experience with REST and SOAP integrations, Named Credentials and external services (CTI, CRM, telephony, knowledge systems).
* Solid grasp of Service Cloud fundamentals: case management, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, email-to-case and the service console.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce security, sharing model and governor-limit-aware design.
* Experience with Git, Salesforce DX and CI/CD tooling (Copado, Gearset, GitHub Actions or similar).
* Experience working in Agile delivery with distributed onshore and offshore teams, and comfort working the 2 PM to 11 PM IST shift.

title: SAP GRC Security Analyst
description:
**About Trellix**
  
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.

***Role Overview:***

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP Security & GRC Specialist with 6 to 8 years of hands-on expertise in SAP Security design, GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) administration, and yearly audit lifecycle management. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and operational support of SAP authorization frameworks across S/4HANA, legacy ECC, and cloud landscapes. You will drive Segregation of Duties (SoD) risk management, oversee Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and serve as the primary technical interface for annual internal and external IT General Controls (ITGC) and SOX audits.

**About Role:**

* Experience in Design, build, and maintaining role-based access control (RBAC) models across SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6.0, BW/4HANA and SAP Cloud platforms.
* Build and manage single, derived, composite, and structural roles following the principle of least privilege.
* Configure and troubleshoot security components, including tile catalogs, groups, spaces, pages, and OData services.
* Review security transports, execute user provisioning workflows, and assist with annual SAP license audit reviews.
* Administer and support SAP GRC Access Control modules: Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Emergency Access Management (EAM), and Business Role Management (BRM).
* Conduct regular Segregation of Duties (SoD) and Sensitive Access risk evaluations; collaborate with business process owners to define and enforce mitigating controls.
* Oversee the Firefighter (EAM) framework, including controller assignment, log reviews, and emergency access monitoring.
* Maintain and customize the GRC rule set to align with changing organizational risk profiles and business requirements.
* Act as the lead technical contact for yearly internal and external audit cycles (SOX 404, ITGC, SOC 1/2).
* Coordinate evidence gathering, system walk-throughs, and sample extraction for external audit teams (e.g., Big 4).
* Track, remediate, and report on audit findings, internal control gaps, and authorization risks in a timely manner.
* Facilitate periodic User Access Reviews (UAR) and User Privilege Reviews (UPR) with management and business module leads.
* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), security control documentation, and risk matrix repositories.

**About You:**

* 6–8 years of dedicated experience in SAP Security administration and SAP GRC Access Control implementation/support.
* Demonstrated experience taking primary responsibility or playing a key technical role in at least 3–4 yearly audit cycles (SOX/ITGC) with proven remediation success.
* Direct experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6.0, security, and HANA DB authorization models.Deep technical command of SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, EAM, BRM).
* Solid understanding of standard SAP business cycles (Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report) and associated SoD conflict matrices.
* Strong technical writing skills for audit documentation and executive risk reporting.
* Analytical problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail during audit defense.
* Ability to partner effectively with IT Basis, Functional Teams, Internal Audit, and Business Process Owners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or equivalent relevant field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP System Security / SAP GRC.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).

***Company Benefits and Perks:***

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

***Our Commitment to You:***

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.

Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

* Monitor security alerts and events from various security tools and platforms.

* Experience with Windows/Linux/MacOS operating systems.
* Solid understanding of networking protocols, technologies, and topologies.
* Experience with major cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to threat intelligence and threat hunting methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying technical information to non-technical audiences.

* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
We are a deeply collaborative, distributed team spanning two continents. We maintain a security-first operations approach, relentlessly prioritizing automation to streamline our work and protect our core assets. Our culture balances individual autonomy with strong collective support, empowering you to take ownership of technical decisions while fostering an environment where the entire team converges to address critical customer concerns. We value shared knowledge and diverse expertise, ensuring a high-trust partnership where your contributions are backed, your solutions are welcomed, and your professional growth remains a priority.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
This role serves as a cornerstone of our security posture, placing you at the center of Cisco’s transformation into the world's leading security company. As a Senior Security Engineer, you will be responsible for the health, scalability, and security of our hybrid directory services, ensuring that the identity fabric powering our enterprise remains resilient and cutting-edge. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on large-scale, complex multi-forest environments while driving the adoption of advanced security principles, making it an ideal challenge for someone who thrives on solving intricate technical problems that have a tangible impact on global operations.
  
  

* You will lead the operational integrity, solving, and optimization of our large-scale, multi-forest, and hybrid Active Directory environments to ensure seamless access across the organization.
* You will take ownership of the maintenance and enhancement of our Entra ID (Azure AD) multi-tenant environments, facilitating complex integrations between on-premises infrastructure and cloud services.
* You will collaborate closely with multi-functional partners to design and deploy robust security guardrails that protect our directory services and privileged access points.
* You will spearhead the development and implementation of automation scripts and self-service capabilities, using modern tools and artificial intelligence to drive operational efficiency.
* You will act as a key contributor to our incident response and change management strategies, ensuring that we adhere to the highest standards of security compliance and architectural rigor.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with security guardrails: enforcing LDAPS, disabling legacy protocols, implementing modern encryption and experience with cloud security controls: Conditional Access, risk-based authentication, privileged role management.
* Proficient in scripting (PowerShell, Python, etc.) for automation.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Splunk or similar) and security monitoring and understanding of Zero Trust and identity-centric security architecture with Deep expertise with multi-forest, multi-site Active Directory operations, solving, and replication.
* Proficient in authentication, authorization, and access control concepts.
* Strong knowledge of core networking, virtualization, and cloud concepts (Azure, AWS, GCP) and experience with Entra ID (Azure AD) administration and integration

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Relevant certifications: CISSP, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator, Azure Security Engineer, etc.
* Experience supporting application migrations from on-prem to cloud-native environments and supporting large-scale, hybrid or cloud-native environments.
* Hands-on experience with attack path analysis frameworks (e.g., Bloodhound Enterprise).
* Experience with System Center (SCOM, SCCM, SCO).
* Experience with other identity and access management platforms (Okta, SailPoint, Duo).

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. description:

**Customer**

The Customer team at Deloitte Consulting empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with their customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, and transformative technologies. Our Advertising, Marketing & Commerce practice focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients' brand values, implementing the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce, and marketing experiences. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, engineers, and architects solving the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, and the workforce.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Associate Business Transformation Architect or equivalent**

As a Salesforce CPQ Specialist Senior, you will be a hands-on practitioner and trusted advisor responsible for the end-to-end design, configuration, and delivery of Salesforce CPQ solutions for enterprise clients. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate complex Quote-to-Cash requirements into scalable, high-quality CPQ implementations. This role requires deep product knowledge, strong configuration skills, and the ability to guide junior team members while delivering independently.

**Work you’ll do:**

**Hands-On CPQ Implementation**

* Configure and customize Salesforce CPQ end-to-end: products and bundles, pricing rules, discount schedules, approval workflows, quote templates, amendments, and renewals.

* Design and build product catalogs, pricing waterfalls, and usage-based pricing models aligned with client business requirements.

* Develop and maintain CPQ-specific Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to extend platform capabilities.

* Conduct data migration, sandbox management, and environment strategy activities across CPQ implementation lifecycles.

**Solution Design & Requirements**

* Engage directly with client business and IT stakeholders to gather, document, and validate CPQ and Quote-to-Cash requirements.

* Translate complex business processes (subscription models, multi-tier pricing, channel discounting, contract amendments) into scalable CPQ configurations.

* Produce solution design artifacts including data flow diagrams, configuration workbooks, integration specs, and process maps.

* Participate in and lead CPQ design workshops, sprint planning, and backlog grooming sessions.

**Integration & Technical Delivery**

* Implement and support integrations between Salesforce CPQ and downstream systems including ERP, billing platforms, and provisioning tools.

* Apply integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, event-driven) for seamless data exchange across the Lead-to-Cash ecosystem.

* Perform configuration reviews, unit testing, UAT support, and defect resolution throughout project delivery.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* Collaborate with architects, developers, and business analysts to deliver high-quality solutions on time and within scope.

* Mentor and guide junior consultants and admins on CPQ best practices, configuration standards, and platform capabilities.

* Contribute to internal CPQ accelerators, playbooks, and reusable assets to improve delivery efficiency.

* Support pre-sales efforts including solution scoping, effort estimation, and demos for prospective clients.

**Qualifications**

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 5–8 years of overall Salesforce Platform experience, with a minimum of 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ implementation experience.

* Proven experience delivering at least 2–3 full-cycle Salesforce CPQ implementations from requirements through go-live.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in:

* CPQ product catalog setup, bundles, option constraints, and configuration attributes

* Pricing methods: list price, cost plus, percent of total, block pricing, and tiered pricing

* Discount schedules, price rules, product rules, and quote calculator plugins

* Approval workflows and advanced approvals

* Quote templates (PDF generation) and custom quote line fields

* Contract amendments, renewals, and subscription management

* Hands-on experience with Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce APIs.

* Strong understanding of Salesforce data model and relationships as they apply to CPQ (Opportunity, Quote, Order, Contract objects).

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.

* Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification (required).

**Good-to-Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud (Billing, Advanced Approvals)

* Exposure to multi-cloud implementations involving Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

* Experience in SaaS, high-tech, manufacturing, or subscription-based business models.

* Familiarity with integration middleware platforms such as MuleSoft.

* Additional certifications: Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer I, Sales Cloud Consultant.

* Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Copado, Gearset, SFDX) and release management practices.

**Education**:

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location**:

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations, maintain accurate financial records, handle vendor payments, reconcile accounts and support monthly financial reporting.

The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and statutory compliance, preferably with experience in retail, food & beverage or multi-outlet operations.

Key Responsibilities1. Day-to-Day Accounting

* Record daily financial transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts and payments.
* Maintain purchase, sales, expense and journal entries.
* Ensure all accounting entries are accurately recorded in the accounting software.
* Maintain proper documentation of invoices, bills, vouchers and supporting records.
* Monitor petty cash transactions and expense claims.

2. Store Accounting & Sales Reconciliation

* Collect and verify daily sales reports from all company-owned outlets.
* Reconcile POS sales with actual collections, including cash, UPI, card and online payments.
* Identify and report discrepancies in sales, collections and settlements.
* Monitor daily cash deposits and store expenses.
* Maintain outlet-wise sales and expense records.
* Coordinate with store managers for missing bills, supporting documents and clarification of discrepancies.

3. Vendor & Payment Management

* Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and goods received records.
* Process vendor bills and maintain accounts payable records.
* Prepare vendor payment schedules and coordinate payment approvals.
* Track outstanding vendor payments and supplier balances.
* Maintain vendor master data and periodically reconcile vendor accounts.

4. Bank & Ledger Reconciliation

* Perform regular bank reconciliation.
* Reconcile customer, vendor and general ledger accounts.
* Track outstanding payments and receipts.
* Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

5. GST, TDS & Statutory Compliance

* Assist in GST data preparation and reconciliation.
* Verify purchase invoices and GST input credit details.
* Support monthly GST return preparation and filing.
* Assist in TDS calculations, deductions and return-related documentation.
* Maintain records required for statutory audits and compliance.
* Coordinate with external auditors and consultants whenever required.

6. MIS & Financial Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales and expense reports.
* Prepare outlet-wise revenue and expense statements.
* Assist in monthly closing activities.
* Track outstanding payables and receivables.
* Prepare basic MIS reports for management review.
* Highlight unusual expenses, discrepancies and financial irregularities.

7. Inventory & Purchase Coordination

* Coordinate with operations and stores for purchase and stock-related documentation.
* Verify purchase bills and stock records.
* Assist in identifying purchase and inventory discrepancies.
* Maintain proper documentation of inter-store stock transfers and related accounting entries.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* 2–4 years of experience in accounts and finance operations.
* Good knowledge of Tally Prime or other accounting software.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and bank reconciliation.
* Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.
* Good numerical, analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in retail, QSR, restaurants, food manufacturing or multi-outlet businesses.
* Experience handling daily sales reconciliation across multiple locations.
* Knowledge of POS systems and online payment settlements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.
* Daily sales reconciliation across all outlets.
* Timely vendor invoice processing and payment coordination.
* Accuracy of bank and ledger reconciliation.
* Timely preparation of monthly MIS reports.
* Timely GST and TDS data preparation.
* Proper maintenance of accounting records and supporting documents.
* Timely identification and reporting of financial discrepancies.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles.

* Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment.
* Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming.
* Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers.

* Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software.
* Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX).
* Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330).

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges.

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
About MRK and the role

MRK (MetroRide Kids) runs safe, reliable school rides for children across Hyderabad. Parents trust us with their kids every morning and afternoon, so the quality of our drivers is the quality of our service.

As Driver Recruiter, you will own high-volume hiring of gig drivers and DCOs (Driver-cum-Owners) for MRK. You will source, screen, verify and onboard drivers who are safe, punctual and good with children, and keep the pipeline full as we add schools and routes.

Key responsibilities

•     
**Sourcing:**
Run high-volume driver hiring through referrals, driver hubs, stands, transport unions, local agencies, WhatsApp/Facebook groups, job portals (Apna, WorkIndia, Naukri) and walk-in drives.

•     
**DCO acquisition:**
Identify and onboard Driver-cum-Owners with suitable vehicles; explain the earning model, attachment terms and payout cycles clearly.

•     
**Screening:**
Conduct phone and in-person screening for driving skill, route knowledge, punctuality, communication and suitability to ride with children.

•     
**Verification:**
Coordinate document checks (DL, badge, RC, insurance, permit, fitness, PUC, Aadhaar, PAN), police verification and background checks; ensure zero gaps before a driver goes live.

•     
**Driving & vehicle checks:**
Schedule driving tests and vehicle inspections with the operations team.

•     
**Onboarding:**
Run induction on child safety, conduct norms, app usage and SOPs; hand over trained drivers to ops on time for route launches.

•     
**Pipeline & reporting:**
Maintain the candidate tracker and CRM; report daily/weekly funnel numbers (leads, screened, verified, onboarded, active) and turnaround times.

•     
**Retention & re-hiring:**
Track early attrition, collect exit reasons, re-engage dropped-off drivers and build a bench for peak demand and replacements.

•     
**Vendor & community management:**
Build relationships with driver agencies, fleet owners and local networks to keep a steady supply.

Requirements

•     1–5 years of experience hiring gig drivers, DCOs or delivery partners (ride-hailing, school/staff transport, logistics, quick commerce or similar).

•     Proven track record of high-volume, fast-turnaround blue-collar hiring.

•     Strong network of drivers, fleet owners and agencies in Hyderabad.

•     Working knowledge of driver documents, commercial vehicle permits and background verification processes.

•     Fluent in Telugu and Hindi; working English.

•     Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and a CRM or applicant tracker.

•     Willing to work from the Hyderabad office and travel locally for sourcing drives.

•     Graduate in any discipline.

Good to have

•     Experience hiring for school transport, kids' mobility or other child-safety-sensitive roles.

•     Experience onboarding EV drivers or EV fleet partners.

•     Familiarity with Zoho CRM or Zoho Recruit.

•     Two-wheeler and a valid driving licence for field sourcing.

What we offer

•     Competitive salary with performance incentives on hiring targets.

•     Ownership of driver supply for a fast-growing kids' mobility business.

•     A mission that matters: getting children to school safely every day.

**How to apply:**
Send your CV to hr@metroride.com with the subject line "Driver Recruiter – MRK Hyderabad".

The ideal candidate should have extensive hands-on experience in Oracle Database Administration, Oracle RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, Microsoft SQL Server, and Always On Availability Groups.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing critical production database environments, ensuring high availability, optimizing database performance, handling major incidents, and implementing backup and disaster recovery strategies.
  
  
This role requires someone who can independently troubleshoot complex database issues, lead P1/P2 incident resolution, coordinate with global technical teams, and provide technical guidance to junior DBAs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Oracle Database Administration

Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Oracle Database 12c/19c environments.
  
  
Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC environments, including Clusterware, ASM, cluster nodes, and interconnects.
  
  
Manage Oracle Data Guard configurations, monitor synchronization, and perform switchover and failover operations.
  
  
Handle RMAN backup, restore, recovery, and point-in-time recovery activities.
  
  

* SQL Server Database Administration

Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments.
  
  
Manage SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, replica synchronization, monitoring, and failover operations.
  
  
Administer standalone SQL Server instances and Log Shipping configurations.
  
  
Troubleshoot database availability, connectivity, and performance-related issues.
  
  

* Production Support & Critical Incident Management

Independently manage and lead troubleshooting of critical P1/P2 production database incidents.
  
  
Perform impact assessments, coordinate technical resolution, and restore services within defined SLAs.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  
  
Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, on-site DBAs, and other stakeholders.
  
  

* Database Performance Tuning

Perform advanced performance tuning and optimization across Oracle and SQL Server databases.
  
  
Analyze execution plans, SQL queries, indexing, locks, blocking, deadlocks, CPU, memory, and I/O bottlenecks.
  
  
Utilize Oracle AWR, ASH, and ADDM reports, along with SQL Server DMVs, for performance diagnostics.
  
  

* High Availability & Disaster Recovery

Implement and maintain database High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions.
  
  
Plan and execute failover, failback, and disaster recovery exercises.
  
  
Monitor database backups, recovery operations, and synchronization.
  
  
Ensure compliance with defined Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) requirements.
  
  

* Database Maintenance, Migration & Upgrades

Execute production database patching, security updates, and version upgrades.
  
  
Perform database migrations, refreshes, and server migrations.
  
  
Monitor database health, tablespace utilization, transaction logs, scheduled jobs, and database growth.
  
  
Conduct pre- and post-implementation health checks and maintain rollback plans.
  
  

* ITSM, Documentation & Team Coordination

Manage incidents, problems, and change requests using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  
  
Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and RCA reports.
  
  
Coordinate production changes and maintenance activities with global technical teams.
  
  
Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to junior DBAs and L1 support teams.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
7–9 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Database Administration and Microsoft SQL Server Administration.
  
  
Strong expertise in Oracle Database 12c/19c installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Clusterware, and ASM.
  
  
Strong experience in Oracle Data Guard, RMAN backup, restore, and recovery.
  
  
Advanced Oracle performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, and SQL execution plans.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft SQL Server administration, patching, and production support.
  
  
Good working knowledge of SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and Log Shipping.
  
  
Experience with SQL Server performance tuning, indexing, DMVs, blocking, and deadlock analysis.
  
  
Proven experience handling P1/P2 production incidents, RCA, and critical issue resolution.
  
  
Strong understanding of database backup, recovery, HA/DR, RPO, and RTO concepts.
  
  
Experience with production patching, database migrations, and upgrades.
  
  
Good knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments.
  
  
Working knowledge of Shell Scripting, PowerShell, or Python.
  
  
Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  
  
Experience creating technical documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Experience supporting enterprise-level, business-critical production database environments.
  
  
Exposure to automation of database administration and maintenance activities.
  
  
Experience coordinating with global teams and on-site database administrators.
  
  
Prior experience mentoring junior DBAs and supporting L1 database teams.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
Strong technical ownership and independent troubleshooting capabilities.
  
  
Ability to lead critical production incident resolution under pressure.
  
  
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination abilities.
  
  
Ability to prioritize multiple incidents while adhering to SLAs.
  
  
Willingness to work US night shifts and participate in scheduled weekend maintenance and disaster recovery activities.

The role will require cross-organization collaboration to solve key issues impactful to the enterprise.

title: HR Recruiter
description:

**Company:** The Chocolate Room (TCR Cafe)  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Designation:** Senior HR Recruiter / HR Executive  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Reporting To:** Director

Job Purpose

To independently manage recruitment, manpower planning, onboarding, and HR coordination for corporate office, café outlets, and new store openings. The role requires strong recruitment expertise, employee coordination, and the ability to support day-to-day HR operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for café outlets, corporate office, and new store openings.
* Recruit for Store Managers, Assistant Managers, Supervisors, Baristas, Service Staff, Cashiers, Chefs, Bakery Staff, Helpers, and corporate positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, walk-ins, consultants, and recruitment networks.
* Conduct initial screening, schedule interviews, coordinate selections, and negotiate salary.
* Ensure timely offer release, follow-up, and candidate joining.
* Handle bulk hiring and recruitment drives for new outlets.

**2. Manpower Planning & Coordination**

* Maintain outlet-wise manpower requirements and vacancy trackers.
* Coordinate with Operations and Store Managers to understand hiring requirements.
* Ensure vacancies are closed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain a database of qualified candidates for future requirements.

**3. HR Operations & Employee Onboarding**

* Coordinate joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Maintain employee records and HR files.
* Coordinate induction, training, and onboarding activities.
* Assist with attendance, leave records, employee queries, and HR documentation.
* Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

**4. HR Administration**

* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, and other HR documents.
* Coordinate employee exit formalities and documentation.
* Maintain HR trackers, recruitment MIS, and employee databases.
* Assist in implementing HR policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with payroll/accounts for employee-related information and documentation.

**5. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Prepare weekly recruitment and manpower status reports.
* Track vacancies, interviews, selections, offers, and joinings.
* Monitor recruitment turnaround time and candidate dropouts.
* Provide updates to management on manpower status and recruitment challenges.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in HR preferred.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email, and recruitment portals.

Experience

* 3–5 years of experience in HR recruitment and HR operations.
* Experience in hospitality, QSR, restaurant, café, retail, or food service industries preferred.
* Experience in bulk hiring and multi-location recruitment is an advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong recruitment and sourcing capabilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Negotiation and candidate management skills.
* Good organizational and follow-up skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies and priorities.
* Proactive, responsible, and target-oriented approach.
* Basic understanding of HR policies and employee documentation.

KPIs

* Monthly recruitment target achievement.
* Vacancy closure within agreed timelines.
* Offer-to-joining conversion ratio.
* Candidate retention during the initial employment period.
* Manpower fulfillment for new outlet openings.
* Recruitment MIS accuracy and timely reporting.
* Timely completion of onboarding and HR documentation.

Working Requirements

Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.

Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.

For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.

**Job Description:**
====================

**About the role**

Russell Investments’ Global Performance & Reporting team delivers investment performance measurement, analysis and reporting across global products and client portfolios. Our reporting platforms support internal teams, existing clients and prospective clients around the world.

As a Senior Analyst based in Mumbai, you will be the product specialist for Vermilion reporting. You will partner with Performance & Reporting (P&R) and other global stakeholders to turn business needs into reliable reporting solutions. This includes integrating bespoke reports into Vermilion, building and maintaining reports and templates, configuring data connections, and testing changes and releases.

The role calls for strong Vermilion skills, sound judgment, and end-to-end ownership. You will work with business and technical teams to understand requirements, recommend practical solutions, and confirm that the final reports meet agreed requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Vermilion reporting and solution delivery**

* Build, configure and maintain reports, templates and layouts in Vermilion to meet business and client requirements.
* Lead the integration of bespoke reporting into Vermilion, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing and implementation.
* Configure and maintain data sources, connectors and reporting components needed to support report production.
* Translate business requirements into clear report specifications, identifying data, layout, calculation and presentation needs.
* Apply critical thinking to assess reporting requests, identify options and dependencies, and recommend solutions that are practical, sustainable and fit for purpose.
* Ensure final report outputs meet agreed requirements, branding standards and quality expectations.

**Testing, releases and change management**

* Develop and carry out testing for new reports, report changes, data connections and platform releases.
* Validate report outputs against business requirements, source data and expected results; investigate and resolve issues before implementation.
* Coordinate release readiness, including impact assessment, testing, issue tracking, stakeholder communication and post-release checks.
* Maintain clear records of report specifications, configurations, test evidence, changes and support procedures.
* Manage updates through to completion, keeping stakeholders informed of progress, risks and dependencies.

**Stakeholder and vendor partnership**

* Work closely with global P&R teams and stakeholders across regions to understand needs and deliver reporting solutions.
* Serve as a Vermilion subject matter expert, providing guidance on platform capabilities, reporting options and appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate with internal technology, data and business teams, as well as Vermilion and other vendors, to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.
* Explain technical considerations and report outputs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage multiple requests and priorities while maintaining agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Data, automation and continuous improvement**

* Use SQL to explore, validate and troubleshoot reporting data and data connections.
* Use VBA, Excel and other relevant tools to support report development, testing and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate report builds, testing and recurring processes.
* Recommend improvements to templates, platform use and reporting workflows to improve consistency, scalability and control.
* Develop and maintain documentation that supports ongoing ownership, knowledge sharing and reliable report maintenance.

**Experience and qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Typically, 5+ years of experience in investment reporting, reporting technology, business analysis, or a related financial services role.
* Significant hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Vermilion or a comparable reporting platform; Vermilion experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience taking reporting changes or implementations from requirements through build, testing and delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL. Experience with Python, VBA is highly desirable.
* Experience working with data connectors, relational databases or reporting integrations.
* Familiarity with investment and performance data is an advantage, including returns, exposures, benchmarks and common risk measures.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and external vendors is preferred.

**Skills and capabilities**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clarify requirements and explain solutions.
* A high level of ownership and accountability, following work through from initial request to implementation and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to investigate unexpected results and identify root causes.
* Careful and consistent approach to testing, documentation and change control.
* Ability to manage concurrent requests, adapt to changing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative approach and confidence working independently with stakeholders across regions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**What success looks like**

* Business requirements are understood, documented and translated into effective Vermilion reporting solutions.
* Reports, templates and integrations are tested thoroughly and produce outputs that meet agreed requirements.
* Changes and releases are managed with clear communication, appropriate evidence and timely follow-through.
* Stakeholders receive practical guidance and dependable support from a knowledgeable Vermilion specialist.
* Reporting processes become more consistent, maintainable and automated over time.

**Core Values**

* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong judgment and decision-making capability
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency
* Exemplifies our customer-focused, action-oriented, results-driven culture
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions
* Dedicated to the firm’s values of non-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor
