Job Description

Job Title Brand Lead

Department Marketing

Responsible to CMO

Place of Work Mumbai

Work Schedule 6 days a week

About Food Square

Home to delicious.

At Food Square, we travel across India and around the world to discover products that feel special. From

iconic regional snacks to cult international finds, we look for food that tells a story, stands up to taste

tests, and feels worth sharing.

We pick products that make sense for how people really live, eat, and shop. That’s what makes Food

Square a place for everyday essentials, snacky surprises, and delicious discoveries.

We also bring the joy of Food Square to life through catering and our in-house café. It’s a space where we

get to play with all the ingredients we love, and serve up dishes that change with the seasons and our

obsessions.

We're building this with a passionate team of buyers, chefs, designers, and food lovers. And we're always

on the lookout for people who want to help shape what the future of food retail looks like in India.

About the Role

Food Square is looking for a Brand Lead who can hold the brand to a high standard across

everything we make, say, and show up as and build the systems that keep it there as we

grow.

We work with agencies, but this isn’t a role where you hand things over and wait for a deck.

You’ll be in the work: originating ideas, directing execution, and holding the standard across

everything that goes out under the Food Square name. You’ll own brand strategy and

execution across every touchpoint: content, campaigns, social, VM, print, and in-store

experience, working closely with the larger marketing team to bring it all to life.

If you’re the kind of person who can write a campaign brief in the morning, give sharp

creative feedback at noon, and walk a store display in the evening and find all of that

genuinely energising, we’d like to meet you.

What you'll do

The following will be carried out under the supervision and guidance of your Manager:

Own and evolve the Food Square brand: its positioning, voice, and the way it shows up across every

consumer touchpoint.

Develop and maintain a brand system the whole team can work from: guidelines, tone of voice,

templates, and content frameworks that scale.

Be the internal authority on what’s on-brand and what isn’t, and communicate that clearly across

functions.

Own the annual and monthly campaign calendar across design, content, events, and VM, so every team

plans from one view instead of separate ones.

Originate the ideas behind campaigns and content, then work with the creative team to execute them

to a high standard.

Lead the in-house content operation: editorial calendar, workflows, quality standards, and output

across social, email, video, and print.

Own the creative brief from concept to delivery, not just the idea but the execution and the follow-

through.

Translate brand moments — new store launches, seasonal campaigns, product drops — into cohesive,

well-executed activations across online and offline channels.

Own campaign calendars, timelines, and budgets. Make sure things go live on time and on-brand, every

time.

Own the brand’s role in driving measurable outcomes: new customer acquisition, repeat purchase, and

retention.

Develop a working understanding of audience cohorts — what drives different customer segments to

discover, try, and come back to Food Square.

Build campaigns and content that serve the full customer journey, from awareness to trial to loyalty.

Hold one view of the overall marketing budget, and track spend against results across brand, events,

content, and design.

Report monthly on what's working across channels, drawing on social data, event outcomes, and the

performance team's numbers.

Use those results to sharpen the next brief and the next calendar.

Work closely with the creative director and team to translate brand strategy into compelling output —

providing clear briefs, sharp feedback, and consistent direction.

Establish workflows and approval processes so the team can move fast without losing quality.

Collaborate with VM, partnerships, and ops to make sure brand thinking is embedded across the

business.

What we're looking for

8 to 10 years of experience in brand, creative marketing, or content roles, with at least 2 years leading a team.

A proven track record of building and running an in-house content or creative function, not just

contributing to one.

Has conceptualised and led brand campaigns end to end: brief, idea, execution, and measurement.

Sharp on both design and copy with strong opinions and the ability to articulate them clearly.

Hands-on experience across digital and physical channels: social, email, VM, print, in-store.

Understands how marketing drives growth and can connect brand activity to acquisition, retention,

and repeat.

Strong project management instincts: knows what’s urgent, what can wait, and how to keep a team

moving without everything becoming a fire.

A collaborator who leads through influence as much as authority.

Experience in food, retail, D2C, or FMCG.

Prior work on store marketing, quick commerce, or omnichannel campaigns.

Familiarity with performance marketing and how brand and growth work together.

Why this role is exciting

You’ll be part of a small, ambitious, high-ownership team building something exciting from

the ground up. You’ll get creative freedom, real responsibility, and a front-row seat to what it

takes to build an iconic consumer brand.

* What is your Notice Period?

title: Associate Technical Implementation Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Associate Technical Implementation Engineer (Associate TIE)**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an
**Associate Technical Implementation Engineer (Associate TIE)**
to join our
**Technical Implementation team**
and support the onboarding and technical enablement of enterprise customers across multiple
**Qualys cybersecurity products**
, including
**VMDR, CSAM, Patch Management, Policy Compliance, WAS, and Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM)**
.
  
  
This is an opportunity for technically curious and customer-oriented professionals to build a career in cybersecurity implementation, technical consulting, and enterprise security solutions.
  
  
As an Associate TIE, you will work closely with experienced Technical Implementation Engineers, supporting customer onboarding activities, product deployments, configurations, troubleshooting, and technical enablement. You will receive structured training and hands-on exposure to Qualys products, enterprise IT environments, and cybersecurity use cases.
  
  
The role is designed to progressively develop your technical expertise and customer engagement capabilities, enabling you to independently manage implementation activities as you grow within the organization.
  
  
**Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in technical support,**
IT infrastructure, system administration, cybersecurity, technical operations, or other customer-facing technical roles are considered for this role.
  
  
**Fresh graduates with strong technical fundamentals,**
relevant certifications, internships, will also be considered.
  
  
**Shift Requirement: This role may require you to work in Night shifts to provide Implemenation coverage globally. Candidate must be**
**comfortable working in Night shifts.**
**Work Model: Hybrid – 3 days from office and 2 days from home. Relocation to Pune would be required for this role.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer Onboarding & Implementation Support
* Assist experienced TIEs in delivering end-to-end onboarding and implementation engagements for enterprise customers.
* Participate in customer kickoff meetings, product walkthroughs, technical discussions, and configuration workshops.
* Support the preparation and execution of customer onboarding and implementation plans.
* Understand customer IT environments, security objectives, and requirements to assist in aligning Qualys solutions with their needs
* Gradually take ownership of defined implementation activities and customer engagements under appropriate guidance.
* Technical Implementation & Troubleshooting
* Assist with the deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of Qualys agents, scanner appliances, sensors, connectors,

and APIs.
  
  

* Gain hands-on experience with Windows, Linux, networking, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Support integrations with cloud platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and OCI.
* Assist in configuring vulnerability scanning, asset discovery, patch management, and security compliance policies.
* Troubleshoot basic deployment, connectivity, scanning, and configuration-related issues, escalating complex challenges to
* senior engineers when required.
* Develop an understanding of hybrid, cloud, and containerised environments.
* Product Knowledge & Technical Enablement
* Develop functional and technical knowledge of assigned Qualys cybersecurity products.
* Participate in structured technical training, hands-on labs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and product certifications.
* Assist in conducting product demonstrations, technical walkthroughs, and customer enablement sessions.
* Develop an understanding of cybersecurity concepts, vulnerability management, configuration compliance, and security
* operations workflows.
* Maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, troubleshooting notes, and knowledge articles.
* Customer Engagement & Success
* Work alongside experienced TIEs to ensure customers have a smooth onboarding and implementation experience.
* Develop the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to customer stakeholders.
* Understand customer challenges and provide timely assistance throughout implementation engagements.
* Track assigned implementation activities, milestones, and action items to ensure timely delivery.
* Build the skills required to become a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with internal teams, including Technical Implementation, Support, Product Management, and Engineering.
* Work with senior engineers to investigate and resolve customer implementation challenges.
* Document recurring technical challenges and contribute to improving implementation processes.
* Actively participate in team knowledge-sharing initiatives and continuous learning activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience & Technical Skills
* 1–3 years of experience in technical support, IT infrastructure, system administration, cybersecurity, technical operations, or other customer-facing technical roles.
* Fresh graduates with strong technical fundamentals, relevant certifications, internships, will also be considered.
* Foundational knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, firewalls, and connectivity
* troubleshooting.
* Basic troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts, vulnerability management, and IT security fundamentals.
* Technical Aptitude & Learning Ability
* Strong willingness to learn enterprise cybersecurity
* Ability to understand technical documentation and apply concepts in practical environments.
* Interest in working with security scanning tools, endpoint agents, configuration management, and IT infrastructure.
* Ability to perform hands-on troubleshooting and systematically investigate technical issues.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash) would be an added advantage.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and interact professionally with customers.
* Comfortable participating in customer-facing technical discussions and presentations.
* Willingness to learn customer engagement, stakeholder management, and technical consulting skills.
* Collaborative approach to working with senior engineers and cross-functional teams.
* Mindset & Adaptability
* Strong ownership, accountability, and willingness to take initiative.
* Curious mindset with a passion for technology and cybersecurity.
* Analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to manage multiple assigned activities and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Open to feedback, continuous learning, and developing new technical competencies.
* Willingness and ability to work exclusively in night shifts to support global enterprise customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to cybersecurity platforms, vulnerability scanners, endpoint security, or IT management solutions.
* Basic understanding of IT asset management, patch management, and security compliance.
* Relevant certifications in networking, cloud technologies, Linux, Windows administration, or cybersecurity.
* Familiarity with Qualys or other vulnerability management platforms.
* Experience working in a technical support, service delivery, or customer-facing IT environment.

**Career Development**
The Associate TIE role is designed to build a strong technical talent pipeline for the Technical Implementation organization.
  
  
Through structured training, hands-on implementation experience, mentorship from senior engineers, and progressive customer ownership, Associates will develop the technical and consulting capabilities required to advance into a
**Technical Implementation Engineer (TIE)**
role.
  
  
The objective is to develop well-rounded cybersecurity professionals capable of independently delivering enterprise implementation engagements and driving customer success.

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
**Location : Remote (Must be flexible to travel to Pune whenever required)**

**Experience:**
7–12 Years

We are looking for a Solutions Architect who is the technical lead in our customer

conversations: designing how AiStrike fits a given environment, running evaluations and

proof-of-value engagements, and making customer teams genuinely capable at operating an

AI SOC.

You will work directly with detection engineers, threat hunters, SOC leads and CISOs. Expect

deep technical discussions on telemetry design, analytic strategy, MITRE coverage and

prioritisation logic, and expect to be the person who turns "here is our environment and

here is what we need to prioritize" into a working architecture. This is a hands-on individual

contributor role.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery: map available telemetry, retention, existing detection coverage and blind spots across a customer's estate.
* Design the analytic approach for each environment — which signals matter, what runs as a real-time detection, and what runs as a hypothesis-driven hunt.
* Own technical evaluations and POVs end to end: agree success criteria, build the environment, run the scenarios, present the results.
* Run detection coverage and telemetry-gap analysis mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and turn customer scenarios and post-incident retrospectives into concrete detection and hunt strategy.
* Configure the environment-specific context that makes analytics precise: privileged and VIP accounts, critical assets, approved regions and service principals, sanctioned tooling.
* Build SOAR and automation integrations that connect AiStrike findings to the customer's response tooling, and support onboarding across connectors, data paths, authentication and multi-tenant design.
* Run workshops and technical deep dives, and maintain the demo environments, reference architectures and scenario walkthroughs behind them.
* Bring field evidence back to Product and Engineering to shape detection content and roadmap priorities.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in security operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response or security architecture, including customer-facing or consulting experience.
* Hands-on background building and tuning detection content — you have written rules, measured how they performed, and improved them in production.
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK: technique mapping, coverage analysis and gap identification. Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS for AI and agent threats is a plus.
* Clear grasp of when a problem calls for deterministic detection logic and when it calls for baseline, rarity or behavioural analytics.
* Hands-on SOAR and security automation experience (XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines, Torq); you have built and maintained integrations and playbooks, not just operated them.
* Hands-on with several of: SIEM (Sentinel, Splunk, Chronicle/Google SecOps, Elastic), EDR/XDR, identity providers and IdP audit telemetry, CSPM/CNAPP, firewall and proxy — plus cloud security grounding in AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Comfortable reading and writing detection logic in a query language (KQL, SPL, Lucene, SQL), with Sigma or a similar portable format, and self-sufficient in Python for enrichment, scripting and API work.
* Solid networking and endpoint fundamentals across Windows and Linux.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the range to move between a hunt query and a broader risk conversation.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment with high ownership.

**Nice to have**

* Background in an MSSP or with multi-tenant, content-centric security platforms.
* Exposure to agentic AI systems, LLM-driven investigation workflows, or AI security.
* Detection-as-code experience: Git-based workflows, CI/CD, versioned and tested content.
* Certifications such as GCIA, GCTI, GCFA, CISSP or a cloud security specialty.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.

Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator® (DNO™) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.

LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.

**Job Description:**

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for all technical aspects of integrating and launching our offering, LotusFlare DNO Cloud with a customer from kickoff to go-live. You will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures. Within LotusFlare, you are the advocate for your customers to ensure the successful progression of their project and advancement improvements to LotusFlare DNO Cloud, informing the roadmap of LotusFlare DNO Cloud capabilities and functions.

In your role, you ensure project goals are met and customer expectations are fulfilled. You will utilize your solid understanding of project management fundamentals and must be comfortable communicating with senior leadership (with customers and LotusFlare) verbally and in writing. Given your understanding of technology and project goals, you will connect technology to tangible project results in order to deliver valuable business outcomes to LotusFlare DNO Cloud customers.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ experience in Project Management, Technical Program Management, or similar technical leadership role
* 3-5 years of experience with software development lifecycle from conception to delivery as a software engineer or a solution architect
* 5+ years of experience working in the telecommunications industry
* You are a digital-savvy individual who knows the latest digital technologies and trends; you enjoy experimenting and are open to integrating new digital technologies into everyday work.
* Proficient in API design, client-server interaction design, and cloud infrastructure architecture
* Telecommunication architecture experience; across IT and Core (OCS/PS/CS) domains to manage and design solutions at scale
* Experience in delivering products against a plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, and often ambiguous environment
* Experience working independently to design, plan, and execute technical projects
* Able to distill data and articulate the rationale for making difficult trade-offs
* A solid foundation in service-oriented and digital technologies to be able to understand service inter-dependencies and drive technical solutions for multi-tiered systems
* Demonstrated understanding of systems within program space to include limitations, scaling, boundary conditions, and architectural decision-making process
* Demonstrated deep knowledge of technical program management and engineering best practices
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20% of the time
* Comfort and experience with cross-organizational communication; excellent written and verbal communication skills. Written and verbal fluency in the English language is required.

**Required Skills:**

Pre-sales:

* Deliver customized pre-sales technical presentations and product demonstrations to customers
* Assist in the development of RFI/RFP responses and drive to close new opportunities
* Engage with potential customers to understand their business objectives and demonstrate the value proposition of LF DNO platform

Solution:

* Work with LotusFlare’s engineering team and externally with customer technical teams to propose and help clients build solutions that unblock deployment

Delivery:

* Drive project execution technical track; track delivery, take ownership of change management, proactively seek and resolve blockers.
* Manage UAT and production releases, and project handover to our support and operational teams.
* Act as a key interface between the customer and the LotusFlare organization including product, engineering, support and business.
* Support project management activities, ensuring issues are documented and addressed.
* Be a part of a Global Delivery Team, share experiences and develop the PM discipline: simplify processes, methods and tools with creative ideas
* Troubleshoot customer technical issues in real time
* Create documentation and develop best practices to help customers get the most out of using the system

**Benefits we have for you:**

- Competitive salary package

- Paid lunch (In the office)

- Training and workshops

- Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with

**About us:**

At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:

- Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.

- Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.

From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator™ Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.

With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.

They support the sales team in determining the optimal application of company products based on customer requirements, prepare and present product demonstrations to prospective customers, provide customer and distributor training, deliver follow-up technical support, manage pre-sales projects with critical customers, and support product testing, evaluation, and training-content creation.

****About Regal Rexnord****
Regal Rexnord Corporation (“Regal Rexnord”) is a leading manufacturer of electric motors, electrical motion controls, power generation, and mechanical power transmission products and sub-systems. The company serves customers around the world in general industrial, consumer commercial construction, food and beverage, alternative energy, and other end markets. Regal Rexnord sells its products and solutions to OEMs, through distributors, and directly to end users. Regal Rexnord is a $7.2B company with 36,000 associates globally.
  
  
****About Regal Rexnord****
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
  
  
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
  
  
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. title: Senior QA Engineer, AI Agents & Agentic Workflows
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD**
is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
*We are a virtual first company and your primary work experience will be virtual / working from your home. Occasional travel to a physical office may be required to enhance working relationships, collaboration, design, strategy and alignment.*
**Job Description**
QAD is seeking a
**Sr QA Engineer**
to own the continuous validation and quality of Champion Assist, a multi-
  
  
agent AI product with ~20 evolving agents. You will test the agents themselves: their reasoning, tool use,
  
  
orchestration and handoffs, and the quality of their responses. This goes beyond UI and API checks. You will
  
  
design evaluation frameworks and regression suites that catch failures unique to non-deterministic, LLM-
  
  
driven systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, run and maintain end-to-end business scenarios that exercise multi-step agentic workflows,

including agent routing, tool/function calls, and multi-turn conversations.
  
  

* Evaluate agent outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, consistency, tone and

completeness, using both human review and automated methods.
  
  

* Build and maintain eval datasets (golden sets, edge cases, adversarial prompts) and automated

regression suites that run as agents, prompts, models and tools change.
  
  

* Identify cross-agent, orchestration and integration issues: wrong agent selection, broken handoffs,

tool-call failures, context loss, looping or runaway behavior.
  
  

* Test for hallucination, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage and unsafe or out-of-scope responses.
* Detect regressions caused by model upgrades, prompt changes or retrieval/knowledge changes, and

quantify them with metrics.
  
  

* Triage and root-cause issues with Engineering and Product, separating prompt, model, retrieval, tool

and orchestration causes.
  
  

* Re-test fixes, validate the end-user experience, and keep evals current as the product evolves.
* Document test strategy, eval results and quality trends clearly for global stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field.
* 3-5 years of QA experience, with at least 1-2 years testing LLM-based applications, AI agents or

agentic workflows.
  
  

* Hands-on experience evaluating non-deterministic outputs: defining pass/fail criteria, rubrics, and

acceptance thresholds for AI responses.
  
  

* Experience building or maintaining AI eval or regression suites (e.g., LLM-as-judge, golden datasets,

scoring rubrics).
  
  

* Understanding of agentic concepts: tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, planning,

memory/context, RAG.
  
  

* Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Playwright, TestComplete or similar) and API testing.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

**# AI Operation Engineer**

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced AI Operation Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control

* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security
  
  

* Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.
* Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep.
* Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls.

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration

title: Engineering Manager, Validation
description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
  
  
Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
  
  
****Our Mission****
Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
  
  
Follow us on
  
  
LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram
  
  
**About The Role**
****Job Title: Engineering Manager, Validation****
****Location:****
Pune, India (in office)
  
  
****Experience:****
8 to 12 years, including 2 to 4 years managing a validation or test team
  
  
****Job Type:****
Full Time
  
  
As a Engineering Manager you will lead our Validation team in Pune, which validates every release of the Deep Connected Platform before it reaches customer vehicles: embedded firmware on telematics units and gateways, the cloud platform, and the bundled solutions we deliver to OEMs. You will own release quality from the branch cut to customer delivery. This is a player coach role for someone who wants to manage people and stay close to the technical work, with a strong firmware lean, since that is where most of our hardest problems sit.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Lead the Validation Team: Manage, coach, and grow validation engineers and squad leads, setting clear goals and providing regular feedback and career development.
* Own Release Validation: Validate every firmware release branch on our biweekly cadence and give a clear go or no go before a release ships to customers.
* Grow Test Automation: Expand automated regression on HIL benches, LabCar, and virtual vehicles, wired into CI/CD so each release cut is tested without manual steps.
* Drive V Model Validation: Build full V model traceability from customer and product requirements down to test cases and automated runs, define a clear Definition of Done for release validation, and keep validation compliant with Automotive SPICE (SYS.5 system qualification testing and SWE.6 software qualification testing).
* Lead Stress and Fault Testing: Run end to end black box validation, fault injection, negative scenarios, and multiday endurance and stress tests across virtual vehicles, HIL benches, and cloud interfaces, to catch edge case bugs before customer delivery.
* Adhere to Engineering Process Standards: Focus on and enforce compliance with industry engineering process standards, including Automotive SPICE V-model compliance (SYS.5 System Integration and Integration Testing and SWE.6 Software Qualification Testing), throughout the validation lifecycle.
* Raise Test Quality: Find gaps in test plans and run bug escape analysis so the same class of issue does not reach a customer twice.
* Support Customer Programs: Plan validation for OEM releases with Program Management and Solutions, and deliver test reports customers can trust.
* Partner Across Functions: Work closely with Firmware, Cloud, and Product teams on testability, triage, and fix verification.
* Scale with AI: Bring AI tools into test design, automation, reporting, and analysis, and help the team adopt them in daily work.

What you should know
  
  

* Professional Experience: 8 to 12 years in validation, QA, or test engineering, including 2 to 4 years directly managing a team.
* Embedded Validation: Hands on experience validating firmware on real hardware (ECUs, telematics units, or IoT devices), with working knowledge of CAN and vehicle diagnostics (UDS).
* HIL and Automation: Experience setting up and running HIL rigs or test benches, and building Python test automation integrated into CI/CD (GitLab or similar).
* People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to manage, coach, and grow engineers, including performance conversations and hiring.
* Release Ownership: Track record of owning release sign off across several products or customer programs at once without dropping quality.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable representing the team to engineers, program managers, and customers.
* On Site in Pune: Based in Pune and working from our office, close to the labs and test benches.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud and API Testing: Experience testing SaaS platforms and REST APIs, to validate end to end from vehicle to cloud.
* OTA/Update Systems: Familiarity with over the air update systems or vehicle software management platforms.
* Standards Exposure: Familiarity with automotive process and safety standards (e.g., ASPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434).
* AI in Testing: Experience using AI tools to speed up test design, automation, or analysis.

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
* Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
* Learning & Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
* Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break.
* Team Culture: Regular team events, off-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.

Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. **Job Title**
Tech Lead, Quality Assurance Engineering
  
  
**What does a successful Quality Assurance Engineering Lead do at Fiserv?**
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineering Lead to help drive quality strategy and execution for our core payment clearing platform. In this role, you will lead both automation and manual testing efforts across complex payment workflows, helping ensure platform stability, accuracy and scalability.
  
  
You will bring strong experience testing fintech platforms, payment gateways, clearing systems or transaction processing environments. Success in this role means improving test coverage, strengthening release confidence, advancing intelligent automation practices and partnering closely across product, engineering and DevOps teams to support high-quality delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead quality assurance strategy for the core payment clearing platform
* Design, execute and improve manual and automated testing approaches across complex payment processing workflows
* Validate payment clearing cycles, settlement rules, reconciliation workflows and transaction life cycle processing
* Test financial message formats including ISO 20022 and SWIFT messages across integrated systems
* Build and maintain end-to-end regression test suites to support continuous verification in CI/CD pipelines
* Implement AI-driven quality engineering capabilities, including autonomous test generation, self-healing automation and predictive defect analysis
* Create and manage synthetic, compliance-safe financial test data to support complex clearing and settlement scenarios
* Partner with Product Managers, Developers and DevOps teams to clarify requirements, identify quality risks and improve release readiness

title: SDET Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Summary of This Role
  
  
Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing.
  
  
What Part Will You Play?
  
  

* Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed.
* Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i.e., white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing.
* Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.
* Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI.
* Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing.
* Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis.
* Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients.

What Are We Looking For in This Role?
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
* Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
* Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?
  
  

* SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues.
* JOB COMPLEXITY - Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Builds productive internal/external working relationships.
* SUPERVISION - Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.
* Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc.
* Programming Languages - Java, selenium,C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc.
* Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, harness,Service Virtualization, etc.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Senior Data Scientist (7+ Years Experience)**

Location: India (Remote ) | Full-time | Department: Data Science

**About Infinite Uptime**

Infinite Uptime is an industrial AI company. Our PlantOS platform monitors critical equipment in manufacturing plants with IoT sensors and turns vibration, process and other sensor data into predictive maintenance insights that help plants avoid unplanned downtime.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with a strong machine learning foundation who turns ambiguous problems into production ML solutions with measurable results. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role: you will write and ship production code yourself. You will own outcomes end to end, from problem definition through development, deployment and ongoing maintenance, work independently, and mentor our junior data scientists. As we move our data and ML platform to Microsoft Azure, you will also help set the standards for how models are built and run there.

**What You Will Do**

* Partner with product, engineering and domain teams to identify and prioritize problems where ML can drive measurable value; define success metrics and own the outcome.
* Build and evaluate ML and deep learning models on large-scale time-series and sensor data, including anomaly detection, forecasting, classification and remaining-useful-life estimation.
* Evaluate models rigorously: imbalanced and noisy labels, false positive / false negative trade-offs, calibration and drift.
* Build, deploy and maintain production ML pipelines and data products; monitor performance, detect drift and retrain.
* Implement MLOps practices: CI/CD, model versioning and registry, automated testing and documentation.
* Improve data accessibility and quality together with data and engineering teams.
* Lead or co-lead projects and workstreams, anticipate and prevent problems, and manage multiple assignments independently.
* Mentor junior data scientists through code and model reviews, and shape repeatable standards for data science delivery.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay current with emerging methods and technologies and apply them pragmatically.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of hands-on data science / applied ML experience with a record of delivering measurable impact.
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field preferred; Bachelor's acceptable with an exceptional track record.
* Proven end-to-end ownership: several ML solutions taken from problem definition to production and long-term maintenance, which you can walk us through in depth.
* Strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, with hands-on experience training models on time-series or sensor data.
* Expert Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn; XGBoost/LightGBM) and hands-on PyTorch or TensorFlow; strong SQL.
* Strong statistics; Git, Docker and CI/CD.
* Experience deploying and running models on a major cloud platform.
* Clear communication, experience in cross-functional Agile teams and mentoring juniors, and regular overlap with US Eastern time.

**Nice to Have**

* Azure ML and Databricks experience (Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake a plus); Spark/PySpark.
* Signal processing for vibration or acoustic data (FFT, spectral features).
* Exposure to time-series foundation models (e.g. Chronos, TimesFM) or physics-informed ML.
* Deploying models at the edge.
* Experience with LLM or agent-based workflows.

**How to Apply**

Along with your CV, please share evidence of your hands-on work: a GitHub profile, code samples, publications or a short write-up of an ML project you built and deployed.

title: Program Associate
description:
**Program Manager & Program Associate**

Central Team · New Delhi · Full-time

**Experience:**

**Program Associate: 1-3**
years in Economics, public policy, or any related fields from top university.

Program Manager - 3- 5 years, with masters preferred.

**Base:**
New Delhi (travel to project states)

**Reports to:**
Senior Programme Managers, Atithi Foundation

**About Atithi Foundation**

Atithi Foundation is a not-for-profit organisation working to transform India's tourism sector into a key engine of economic growth. We partner with government bodies, industry leaders, knowledge institutions and community stakeholders to design evidence-based policies and strategies to create livelihoods, safeguard heritage, and strengthen India's position on the global tourism stage.

**Our vision:**
To make India a $490 billion tourism economy by 2035, with inclusive growth, preserving heritage, and showcasing the nation's culture and natural beauty to the world.

**Tourism as an Economic Engine**

Tourism generated over $200 billion for India in 2023 — 5.5% of GDP — and supports nearly 40 million jobs (8% of national employment). 54% of the tourism workforce comprises women, making it one of India's most inclusive growth sectors.

**India's Untapped Global Potential**

Despite extraordinary geography and heritage, India attracted only 10 million foreign visitors in 2023 — against China's 66 million (2019), Thailand's 40 million, and Vietnam's 18 million. Closing even half that gap is a multi-billion dollar opportunity.

**Key Challenges We Are Solving**

* **Inadequate tourism infrastructure:**
  Most high-potential destinations lack the accommodation, connectivity, and on-site facilities needed to convert visitors into multi-night stays
* **PPP gap:**
  Tourism assets remain underinvested because transaction structures, risk allocation, and bankable project formats are not yet in place at scale
* **Fragmented governance:**
  Infrastructure development, land, environment, and culture sit across multiple departments — a single coordination failure stops a project
* **Narrow brand and distribution:**
  India's top six destinations absorb the bulk of tourism spend; 90% of the country's potential goes unmonetised

**The Role**

**This is an early-career role for someone who wants to do real work on a hard problem.**

We are not looking for a particular background in a specific space. We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious, takes ownership instinctively, and is energised by the idea of working on something that matters. Someone who wants to learn fast, roll up their sleeves, and be in the room where decisions get made, not wait to be invited.

This person will work across Atithi's programmes - supporting destination strategy, government engagement, research, investor outreach, and programme management, and grow into whatever they are best at. The role is deliberately broad at the start. What it becomes depends on you.

**What You Will Actually Do**

**1. Research and Analysis That Actually Gets Used**

* Build the evidence base for Atithi's work: tourism data, destination benchmarks, international case studies, policy and regulatory landscapes across states
* Translate research into crisp, decision-ready outputs - strategy notes, briefing papers, presentation decks for government counterparts, investors, and leadership
* Own specific analytical questions end-to-end: frame the problem, gather the data, synthesise findings, present recommendations. No handing off to someone else
* Support financial analysis on destination projects: build models, run scenarios, interrogate assumptions alongside senior colleagues

**2. Government and Stakeholder Engagement Support**

* Help prepare Atithi's teams for meetings with state governments, Tourism Departments, and Development Authorities - briefs, decks, follow-up trackers
* Sit in on government meetings and take ownership of follow-through: action items, correspondence, documentation
* Coordinate with counterparts across multiple states - track commitments, flag delays, and help unblock things before they become problems
* Over time, build your own relationships with government officials at the working level, the ones who make things happen day to day

**3. Programme and Project Management**

* Keep Atithi's destination workstreams organised and moving: track milestones, maintain project dashboards, surface blockers early
* Coordinate across Atithi's internal teams and external partners to ensure work is sequenced and nothing falls through the cracks
* Build the internal infrastructure that helps the organisation scale: templates, playbooks, process documentation, meeting notes that are actually useful
* Work across 2-3 destinations simultaneously – examples, MP (Khajuraho, Orchha), Rajasthan (Jaipur, Shekhawati), Delhi monuments corridor, and manage your own time across them

**4. Investor and Partner Outreach Support**

* Help prepare materials for corporate, CSR, and investor engagement: one-pagers, information memos, destination briefs
* Support relationship development with private sector partners, philanthropic institutions, and multilateral agencies (IFC, JICA, World Bank)
* Assist in organising site visits, roundtables, and stakeholder events, end-to-end, not just logistics

**5. Strategic and Policy Contributions**

* Contribute to Atithi's thought leadership: policy notes, sector briefs, impact reports, written to a high standard and published under Atithi's name
* Track policy and regulatory developments across tourism, land, infrastructure, and heritage, and flag what matters for Atithi's work
* Represent Atithi at relevant events and forums as you build confidence and expertise

**Who We Are Looking For**

**What We Actually Care About**

* **Ownership mindset.**
  You treat a task as yours until it is done well, not until it is handed off. You follow up without being asked. You notice what needs doing and do it.
* **Intellectual horsepower.**
  You think clearly, structure your ideas, and can explain a complex issue simply. You learn fast and retain what you learn.
* **Quality of output.**
  The work you produce is clear, well-structured, and accurate. You care about getting things right, not just getting things done.
* **Drive for meaningful work.**
  You want to work on something that has real impact. The public and social sector genuinely interests you - not as a fallback, but as a deliberate choice.
* **Willingness to operate with ambiguity.**
  Atithi is a young organisation. Roles are not fully defined. Problems do not come pre-packaged. You are comfortable figuring things out.
* **Collaborative and grounded.**
  You work well with others, take feedback seriously, and bring energy to the team without needing the credit.

**What We Don't Require**

We are deliberately open on background. You do not need to have worked in tourism, infrastructure, government, or the development sector.

We have hired from consulting, engineering, economics, liberal arts, environment management, social work, public policy. What matters is not where you come from but how you think, how you work, and what you want to build.

If you are 2-3 years into your career and you are wondering whether a role like this is for you - it probably is. Apply.

**Useful But Not Required**

* Some exposure to policy, public sector, or development sector work - internships, research, fieldwork, advocacy
* Experience with data analysis, financial modelling, or quantitative research
* Strong writing - the kind that is clear, direct, and actually read
* Comfort working in multiple Indian states and engaging with government counterparts

**Why Join Atithi Foundation**

**Steep learning, fast**

You will work directly alongside senior leaders, sit in on high-stakes government meetings, and contribute to work that actually gets used. No years of waiting your turn.

**Real ownership from day one**

This is not a support role. You will own workstreams, manage deliverables, and be held accountable for outcomes, in the way that actually builds a career.

**Work that is genuinely consequential**

The destinations Atithi works on, the PPP frameworks we help design, the government decisions we inform - these have real economic impact on real communities. That is not an abstraction.

**Build for the long term**

Atithi is early. You will be one of a small central team, which means what you build here will shape the organisation. The trajectory for the right person is fast.

title: Manager, Data Scientist - Network Modeling & Optimization
description:
**About Gap Inc.**
Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.
  
  
But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Gap Inc. is building a proactive, data-driven sourcing capability within our Network, Planning & Costing team. We are moving from manual, vendor-quoted decisions to automated models that help us optimize our supply network and build product cost from the ground up — giving our sourcing teams a transparent, defensible foundation for every country, supplier, and cost decision.As a Data Scientist focused on network modeling, you will design and build the optimization and simulation engine that shapes how Gap Inc. sources across its T1 and T2 network. You will generate optimized country and supplier allocation frameworks, run what-if and disruption scenarios, and translate long-range and in-season simulations into executable sourcing plans that balance cost, speed, resilience, and risk. You will partner closely with Sourcing, Planning, and Commercial teams to turn deep supply-chain expertise into automated, auditable analytics. This is a hands-on build role with high visibility, directly shaping network sourcing strategy across the portfolio.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Build optimization and simulation models that generate executable network strategies — country, supplier, and style-level allocation frameworks that balance cost, lead time, capacity, risk, and resilience across the T1/T2 network.
* Develop models that produce multi-year, long-range network plans and in-season re-optimizations, incorporating constraints, supplier capabilities, macro commitments, and the latest negotiated opening costs as model inputs.
* Design what-if and scenario-modeling capabilities — simulating tariff and trade changes, geopolitical and regulatory shifts, operational disruptions, and commercial changes (style migrations, assortment or volume shifts) to quantify cost, margin, and risk impact before execution.
* Interconnect disparate, multi-source datasets — sourcing, supplier, capacity, logistics, and risk data — into a unified data model that gives end-to-end visibility of the sourcing network.
* Deliver comparative analysis of multiple network scenarios and feed simulation outputs into dashboards that enable interactive visualization, side-by-side comparison, and confidence levels based on data maturity.
* Explore and implement the application of agentic-AI and automation techniques to evaluate constraints, recommend optimized vendor and country placements, and generate automated insights and alerts for deviations or risks.
* Partner closely with Sourcing, Planning, and Commercial partners to validate logic, reconcile exceptions, and ensure every model output is explainable, auditable, and trusted by decision-makers.
* Produce clear documentation and reusable tooling so the network sourcing strategy is transparent, maintainable, and scalable across brands, categories, and seasons.

Who you are
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or Computer Science).
* 5+ years of data science or analytics experience, ideally in supply chain, network design, or logistics.
* Strong in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines.
* Experienced with optimization and simulation techniques (e.g. linear/mixed-integer programming, scenario modeling, or digital-twin approaches).
* Clear communicator who can explain complex analysis to non-technical partners.
* A collaborative, detail-oriented problem solver who cares about building trustworthy, auditable solutions.

Benefits at Gap Inc.
  
  

* One of the most competitive paid time off plans in the industry
* Comprehensive health coverage for employees, same-sex partners and their families
* Health and wellness program: free annual health check-ups, fitness center and Employee Assistance Program
* Comprehensive benefits to support the journey of parenthood
* Retirement planning assistance
* See more of the benefits we offer.

Gap Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We have received numerous awards for our long-held commitment to equality and will continue to foster a diverse and inclusive environment of belonging. * Develop like-for-like (LFL) and like-for-similar (LFS) matching logic that identifies comparable prior-season styles so opening bids reference historical cost and never drift upward year over year.
