title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description: Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.We are looking for a Staff Compiler Performance Engineer to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmapLead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collectorMake architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategyLead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul productsMentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validationRepresent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilersWhat You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilersTrack record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in productionExpert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebasesDeep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code sizeExpert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture levelNice to HaveRecognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream workDeep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similarExperience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier designWe may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: BRIM Technical Architect
description: What You'll Do:Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order-to-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.Main missions:Own the end-to-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI-CA) within the O2C flow Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level. Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event-based integration. Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds. Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade-offs and platform limitations before build starts. Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options. Tasks:Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level. Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event-driven, API-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation. Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build. Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade-safe. Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build-vs-standard trade-offs that shape future product decisions." Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements. Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing. Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA. Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward-compatible. Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads. Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture-level technical issues. Who You Are:8+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end-to-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations. Strong cross-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns. Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level. Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non-SAP systems. Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to. Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks. Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams. Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions. Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade-offs legible to non-architects. We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!Who We Are:We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.What We Offer:🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
* 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
* Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.
* React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained.
* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
* Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
* Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
* Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
* Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
* AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
* Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
* Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
* Experience in the second backend language.

**About the job:**
WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
* Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
* Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
* Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
* Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
* Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
* Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
* Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
* Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
* Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
* Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing.

**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: Technical Architect
description:

microservices, Vue 3 frontends and the Kafka-based data backbone. The expected

outcomes are a scalable, secure and cost-efficient architecture, clear engineering

standards, and teams that deliver faster with fewer production issues.

* Lead design of event-driven and CDC architecture using Kafka, Kafka Connect and
* Debezium.
* Set data strategy across MySQL and MongoDB: modelling, partitioning, replication

* Schema Registry, Avro / Protobuf, and stream processing (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB).
* Cloud cost optimisation and capacity planning.

title: Flutter Developer
description:

CargoClave is an AI-native Global Trade Management platform built to simplify, automate, and connect every stage of international trade. The company replaces fragmented tools and manual paperwork with a single intelligent platform for importers, exporters, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and fleet operators. CargoClave provides document intelligence, shipment visibility, freight and fleet management, compliance automation, and AI agents that enable autonomous workflows across the supply chain. Backed by decades of logistics expertise and modern enterprise software experience, the team focuses on building solutions that are AI-first rather than retrofitted onto legacy systems. CargoClave is headquartered in Delhi, India and builds products for global customers.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, hybrid Flutter Developer role based in Delhi, India, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Flutter Developer will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications that integrate with CargoClave’s AI-powered trade management platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean and efficient Dart code, implementing responsive UI/UX, integrating RESTful APIs and back-end services, and ensuring application performance, reliability, and security. The role involves collaborating with product managers, designers, and back-end engineers to translate requirements into scalable features, as well as participating in code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous improvement of the mobile stack. * Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

* Experience with Back-End Web Development and integration of RESTful APIs or microservices into mobile applications.
* Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their practical application in production code.
* Experience building and deploying Flutter apps for Android and iOS, including state management (e.g., Provider, Bloc, Riverpod) and modular architecture.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and collaborative development workflows.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and basic understanding of security best practices for mobile and web applications.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment, communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, and take ownership of features from concept to release.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in logistics, supply chain, or B2B SaaS products is a plus.

description:

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work-integrated degree programs embedding structured on-the-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International-collectively reinforcing its demand-driven, industry-co-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill-integrated higher education institutions.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in

**About Medhavi Group:**

Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise

**Role Overview:**

The Sr. Executive / Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment for the WISE (Work Integrated Skills Education) segment of Medhavi Skills University. The role involves hiring across academic, operations, sales, partnerships, and corporate functions while ensuring speed, quality, and cultural alignment. The incumbent will work closely with hiring managers and leadership to support rapid growth and workforce planning initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from manpower requisition to onboarding.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand workforce requirements and hiring priorities.
* Draft and refine job descriptions aligned with functional needs.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, consultants, and internal databases.
* Conduct preliminary screenings and coordinate interview processes.
* Ensure defined Turnaround Time (TAT) for position closures.

**2. Salary Negotiation & Offer Management**

* Conduct compensation benchmarking and align salary proposals with internal budgets.
* Lead salary negotiations with selected candidates to ensure cost-effectiveness and acceptance ratio optimization.
* Draft Offer Letters (OL) as per organizational policy.
* Coordinate pre-joining engagement to minimize offer dropouts.

**3. Documentation & Verification**

* Verify candidate documentation including educational qualifications, experience letters, salary proofs, ID proofs, and other statutory documents.
* Ensure compliance with university hiring policies and documentation standards.
* Coordinate background verification (if applicable) and onboarding formalities.

**4. HRMS Onboarding & Employee Record Creation**

* Create and update employee profiles in the HRMS system.
* Ensure accuracy of personal, compensation, and reporting details.
* Coordinate with Payroll and HR Operations for seamless salary processing.
* Support smooth onboarding experience including joining formalities and induction coordination.

**5. Strategic Hiring for WISE Segment**

* Support hiring for roles across WISE
* Develop talent pipelines for volume hiring and critical positions.
* Conduct competitor and industry mapping for lateral talent acquisition.

**6. Process Management**

* Provide regular recruitment dashboards and status updates to your manager.
* Manage hiring manager expectations and drive structured interview evaluations.
* Support audit and compliance requirements related to recruitment.

**Qualifications & Experience Required:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in Education, EdTech, Staffing, or Skill Development sectors.
* Experience in both bulk hiring and mid-level lateral hiring.
* Exposure to academic and field sales hiring preferred.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant qualification preferred.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies:**

**HR Operations Knowledge**

**Execution & Coordination**

**Personal Attributes**

Job Overview
  
  
  

Saburi Plywood is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to support the sales team with order processing, sales operations, documentation, and basic accounting activities. The ideal candidate should have good coordination skills, knowledge of basic accounts, and the ability to manage sales-related data efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Coordinate with the sales team, dealers, distributors, and customers regarding orders and deliveries.
* Process sales orders, prepare quotations, invoices, and other sales-related documents.
* Maintain accurate records of sales transactions, customer details, and order status.
* Coordinate with the accounts and dispatch teams to ensure timely order processing and delivery.
* Follow up on pending orders, payments, and outstanding customer balances.
* Assist in maintaining sales reports, daily MIS, and monthly sales performance data.
* Handle basic accounting activities, including sales entries, payment tracking, and reconciliation support.
* Maintain and update customer and dealer databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and timely reporting to the management.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team.

Requirements
  
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
  
  

* 1–3 years of experience in Sales Coordination, Sales Operations, or a similar role.
* Knowledge of basic accounting principles is essential.
* **Knowledge of Tally ERP / Tally Prime will be an added advantage.**
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS Office applications.
* Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain accurate records.
* Experience in the plywood, building materials, or manufacturing industry will be preferred.

Key Skills
  
  
  

* Sales Coordination & Order Management
* Basic Accounting & Financial Documentation
* Tally ERP / Tally Prime
* MS Excel & MIS Reporting
* Sales Invoicing & Documentation
* Payment Follow-up & Outstanding Tracking
* Dealer & Customer Relationship Management
* Data Entry & Record Maintenance
* Interdepartmental Coordination
* Communication & Time Management

title: Sales Executive
company: Idiosys: Empowering Global Innovation with Advanced Software Solutions
description:
**Company Description**
Idiosys is an international software engineering and AI solutions company focused on building, automating, scaling, and modernizing complex digital systems for clients worldwide. With over a decade of experience, the company helps businesses engineer scalable software products, integrate intelligent automation, and modernize legacy platforms. Idiosys is known for strong engineering practices, robust and scalable architectures, and reliable project delivery. The team works closely with global clients to address complex technology challenges and deliver measurable business value. This environment offers sales professionals the opportunity to represent advanced, high-impact technology solutions in a growing international market.
  
  
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in Kolkata. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify new business opportunities, build and manage a pipeline of prospects, and present Idiosys’ software engineering and AI solutions to potential clients. Daily responsibilities include conducting client meetings and demos, preparing proposals and commercial offers, negotiating terms, and closing deals in alignment with company targets. The role also involves collaborating with technical and delivery teams to understand solution capabilities, ensuring accurate scoping, and maintaining strong post-sale relationships to support renewals and upsell opportunities. The Sales Executive will track sales activities in CRM tools, analyze market trends, and contribute to strategic sales initiatives to expand Idiosys’ presence in key regions and sectors.
  
  
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in B2B sales, consultative selling, and account management for technology or software solutions.
* Candidates should possess skills in lead generation, pipeline management, and CRM usage to manage opportunities and forecast revenue.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills to engage decision-makers and close deals.
* Candidates should possess basic understanding of software development, AI solutions, and digital transformation concepts to discuss offerings credibly.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret client needs and align them with Idiosys’ services.
* Relevant experience in IT services or SaaS sales, particularly in international or enterprise markets, is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and meet revenue and activity targets consistently.

Jerai Fitness is a leading Indian fitness equipment manufacturer with over three decades of expertise, serving commercial gyms, hotels, corporates, real estate projects, and home fitness enthusiasts. * Travel within the assigned territory for meetings, business development activities, and client acquisition.

* Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial offers based on client requirements.
* Manage the sales pipeline, maintain lead records, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Handle existing clients, maintain customer relationships, and identify opportunities for repeat business.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and close sales deals effectively.
* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and business development objectives.

* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, delivery, installation, and after-sales support.
* Conduct market research to understand customer requirements, industry trends, competitor activities, and market opportunities.
* Maintain customer databases, sales reports, lead information, and business development records.
* Provide regular updates on sales performance, market feedback, and business opportunities to management.
* Support business expansion and strengthen Jerai Fitness's presence across the assigned territory.

Must-Have Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or any relevant field.

title: Sr. Account Executive, Expansion Sales
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD102107
  
  
**Locations**
We are investing in remote Field Sales roles across the APAC region, specific to these locations: Australia, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
  
  
**Global Expansion Sales**
The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.
  
  
Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.
  
  
Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a Sr. Account Executive in Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.
  
  
You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.
  
  
You will be expected to lead complex, high-value sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.
* Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.
* Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.
* Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.
* Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.
* Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.
* Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.
* Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.
* Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.
* Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.
* Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.
* Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.
* Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.
* Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.
* Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.
* Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.
* Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.
* Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.
* Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

**What Success Looks Like**
Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of quota-carrying B2B technology, software, SaaS or cloud sales experience, including at least 5 years leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.
* Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop substantial opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.
* Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.
* Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.
* Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.
* Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.
* Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.
* High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.
* Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.
* Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.
* Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.
* Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.
* Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

**How We Work At Autodesk**
At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.
  
  
In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.
  
  
****Learn More****
**About Autodesk**
Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.
  
  
We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.
  
  
When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!
  
  
**Belonging**
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:

title: Knitted Fabric Quality Controller
description:
**Company Description**
Venus Fabric is a specialized knitted fabric partner dedicated to delivering high-quality materials and reliable service to apparel manufacturers, clothing brands, and fashion labels. Since 2014, the company has focused on aligning customer expectations with contemporary fashion through a knowledge-based and research-backed approach. Venus Fabric offers a diverse range of fabric options suited to various garment types, supported by an innovative R&D department and strong market trend expertise. The business emphasizes outstanding quality control, collaboration with industry specialists, and custom fabric blends. Its scalable solutions and commitment to excellence make Venus Fabric a trusted resource for fashion-focused organizations.
  
**Role Description**
The Knitted Fabric Quality Controller is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This position is responsible for inspecting knitted fabrics at different stages of production to ensure they meet internal standards and customer specifications. Day-to-day activities include checking fabric for defects, measuring fabric parameters (such as GSM, shrinkage, colorfastness, and dimensional stability), documenting findings, and reporting non-conformities to production and management teams. The role involves collaborating closely with knitting, dyeing, finishing, and packing departments to resolve quality issues, support continuous improvement, and maintain consistency across batches. The Quality Controller also contributes to updating quality procedures, supporting audits, and assisting in training production staff on quality requirements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Quality Control for knitted fabrics, including defect identification, measurement, and documentation.
* Experience in Quality Assurance activities, such as implementing quality standards, monitoring compliance, and supporting process improvements.
* Knowledge of Quality Management practices, including maintaining records, supporting audits, and contributing to corrective and preventive actions.
* Ability to participate in Training related to quality guidelines and to assist in educating production staff on quality procedures.
* Exposure to Auditing processes within textile or manufacturing environments, with attention to detail and compliance.
* Practical experience in knitted fabric production or textile manufacturing, especially in inspection, dyeing, or finishing.
* Understanding of textile testing methods (e.g., GSM, shrinkage, colorfastness, pilling) and use of basic inspection tools and equipment.
* Strong observational skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to work systematically in a fast-paced production environment.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with production, R&D, and management teams.
* Diploma or degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs comprehensive test plans for a functional area, selecting strategies to address technical unknowns and scalability. Manages test environments, executes validation for critical services, and performs risk-based regression. Investigates and reports defects, participates in post-incident reviews, and tracks quality metrics. Collaborates across teams to align test activities and improve tools and processes. Develops automation scripts, executes tests in Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and applies quality gate criteria at key checkpoints.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Design and Strategy:**

* Designs comprehensive test plans that align with quality goals of the function and product vision.
* Chooses strategies based on behavior to inform architecture and tooling initiatives.
* Evaluates coverage to account for technical unknowns and scalability across systems within own functional test area.

**Test Execution:**

* Manages test environments and ensures adequate data for testing.
* Executes validation tasks for critical service areas by following test plans, identifying defects, and escalating risks to support prioritization and service quality.
* Follows documentation for failures across components, working with others to implement corrections where needed.
* Performs risk-based regression to balance speed, risk, and automation coverage across products or services.

**Defect Tracking and Management:**

* Reproduces, diagnoses, and collaborates on customer-reported issues, ensuring timely resolution.
* Investigates and escalates defects across features.
* Owns reporting on test progress/defects, working with engineering to address root causes.
* Contributes to post-incident (post-mortem) reviews by gathering relevant data, documenting observations, and assisting in the identification of root causes; supports the drafting of findings and preventative actions for leadership review.
* Leads triage for components on root cause analysis to uncover recurring quality issues and drive improvements.

**Collaboration and Communication:**

* Assists with cross-functional quality initiatives by tracking test coverage against feature delivery, surfacing test concerns, and supporting coordination with partner teams on test activities.
* Works with cross-functional development team members to align on areas for testing.
* Influences the design and prioritizes testing and tooling.
* Develops and enhances test management and automation tools to improve automation and test processes.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Follows and applies established processes to improve consistency and reduce friction in engineering workflows within a defined feature or task area.

**Automation:**

* Participates in quality improvement efforts by sharing observations and documenting test execution gaps within the team.
* Implements automation scripts by following established patterns to support test coverage within a component or feature.
* Identifies and reports automation issues by executing tests and escalating failures or gaps to senior team members.
* Executes automated tests within Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows and raise issues related to test failures or integration breaks.

**Risk Assessment:**

* Identifies quality risks early and collaborates to mitigate them.
* Applies quality gate criteria on checklist at key software development checkpoints by reviewing test results, static analysis outputs, and defect trends, soliciting approval for completion.
* Reviews test plans to ensure potential impact areas are accurately identified and addressed by Scrum teams, coordinating across functions to confirm adequate test coverage and risk mitigation.

**Test Tooling:**

* Develops and enhances test management and automation tools that increase efficiency and scalability.

**Additional Responsibilities (as needed):**
**Performance Testing:**

* Tests non-functional requirements, including single-user performance, scalability, and responsiveness under dynamic workloads.
* Engages performance to support load testing, tooling, and system tuning for high-risk or complex scenarios.
* Incorporates user experience considerations into performance assessments to ensure acceptable response times and system usability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements.
* Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.
* Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships.
* Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

**Problem Solving:**

* Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
* Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.
* Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices.
* Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills.
* Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team.
* Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: License Owner & Operator, Kolkata
description:
**Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
  
  
Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Kolkata.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
Visit
**www.strangersoccer.com**
and explore the
**"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"**
section to learn more.
  
  
If this opportunity aligns with your goals, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also recommend downloading the Stranger Soccer app to experience the platform firsthand.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Kolkata
* Recruit, train, and manage a small local team (2-3 people), supported by Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues and regular playing opportunities
* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with Stranger Soccer HQ, supported by established operations and technology teams

**What We're Looking For**

* Passion for football and strong connections within the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, sales, or customer-facing roles
* An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently
* A strong sense of ownership and ambition to grow Stranger Soccer locally
* Motivation to deliver results, with rewards tied to performance and growth

**About Stranger Soccer**
Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
  
  
Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.
  
  
Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
  
  
**Our Mission**
To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
  
  
**Our Vision**
A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
  
  
**Ready to be part of the journey?**
We'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Senior Compiler Performance Engineer**
to own major performance areas of Falcon. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. Your job is to push its generated code further, deciding which optimizations matter, designing them and delivering measurable speedups on real workloads.

  

You will work in a distributed team of compiler experts, with direct influence on what Falcon optimizes next.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Own performance of Falcon for a set of workloads or an optimization area end to end: analysis, design, implementation, validation
  
* Design and implement new optimizations and improve existing ones in the middle end and back end: inlining heuristics, loop optimizations, vectorization, escape analysis, speculation and deoptimization, GC barrier and runtime call optimization
  
* Drive code generation quality on x86\_64 and AArch64, including bringing Falcon to new hardware platforms
  
* Investigate complex performance issues reported by customers and turn findings into compiler improvements
  
* Review code, mentor engineers on the team and raise the bar for performance methodology
  
* Contribute to upstream LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 5+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills in large codebases
  
* Proven track record of delivering compiler optimizations with measurable performance impact
  
* Deep knowledge of compiler optimization theory and its practical tradeoffs: compile time, code size, correctness
  
* Strong performance analysis skills: profilers, hardware counters, reading and reasoning about generated assembly
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Significant experience with LLVM optimization passes or code generation; LLVM commit access is a plus
  
* Experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Deep knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with JVM internals: garbage collection, deoptimization, profiling
  
* PhD in Computer Science or significant research experience in compilers

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking to engage an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to design and build this shared platform capability.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining cloud platform engineering, workflow orchestration, automation and Python developer enablement. It is not a traditional infrastructure administration role and is not a pure application-development role. The successful candidate will work across Amazon Web Services, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, Kubernetes, Argo Workflows, infrastructure automation, platform security, observability and delivery pipelines.

The role will also create reusable Python libraries, workflow abstractions, examples and documentation that enable actuarial and other adopter teams to build their own governed workflows. The Platform Engineer will provide enablement, technical review and assurance rather than developing all adopter business logic.

The initial delivery model is expected to include two cross-functional Platform Engineers. Each engineer should be capable of contributing across the end-to-end platform lifecycle, reducing key-person dependency and ensuring the platform remains supportable after initial delivery.

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

• Design and implement the platform on Amazon Web Services, using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service and standard Kubernetes interfaces.

• Create cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, storage and security configuration through version-controlled Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

• Implement Argo Workflows and related platform services for multi-step, parallel, recoverable and traceable workflow execution.

• Configure workload classes, queues, priorities, quotas, compute pools, autoscaling and cost controls for analytical and batch workloads.

• Integrate approved container registries, secrets management, object storage, monitoring, logging and enterprise service-management capabilities.

• Build for high availability, controlled upgrades, disaster recovery, operational support and future portability.

Developer Enablement

• Develop supported Python libraries, software development kits and abstractions that simplify workflow creation and hide unnecessary Kubernetes complexity.

• Create representative workflow examples, templates and reference implementations for adopter teams.

• Define clear workload contracts covering inputs, outputs, parameters, resource requirements, status, failure handling and retained artefacts.

• Provide guidance and technical review to actuarial and other teams building workloads on the platform.

• Produce concise developer documentation, onboarding material and troubleshooting guidance.

Delivery Automation

• Create supported Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines for building, testing, scanning, signing and promoting container images and workflow assets.

• Implement source-controlled platform configuration and automated reconciliation using Argo CD, Flux or an approved equivalent.

• Ensure deployable artefacts are built once and the same approved version is promoted through development, test, user acceptance and production environments.

• Implement traceability across source code, container images, workflow definitions, inputs, outputs and runtime versions.

Security, Reliability & Operations

• Implement least-privilege identity, role-based access, network isolation, secure secret injection and policy enforcement before workload execution.

• Build observability using metrics, logs, traces and audit records that support operations, security monitoring and workflow-level troubleshooting.

• Develop backup, recovery, resilience and platform rebuild automation and evidence.

• Create operational runbooks, support boundaries, lifecycle procedures and production-readiness evidence.

• Work closely with Quality Assurance, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Cloud Shared Services and service-management teams.

Stakeholder & Technology Engagement

• Work with actuarial developers and subject-matter experts who will build business workflows using the platform libraries, templates and patterns.

• Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture on high-level design and contribute practical engineering detail to the low-level platform design.

• Engage Cloud Shared Services on account, network, identity, security and cloud-governance dependencies.

• Explain complex platform decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and constructively challenge weak assumptions.

Skills & Experience

Essential

• Strong hands-on Amazon Web Services experience, including production use of Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service.

• Deep practical knowledge of Kubernetes workload scheduling, networking, identity, storage, security and cluster operations.

• Infrastructure as Code experience, with Terraform strongly preferred.

• Experience implementing workflow orchestration using Argo Workflows or a closely comparable container-native workflow engine.

• Strong Python development skills and experience creating reusable libraries, frameworks, software development kits or developer tooling.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.Life as a Sprinter -Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.The mission -Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.Where you'll leave your mark?Agents whose output nobody re-checks. You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.The kind of builder we're looking for -Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it. An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one. Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules. 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed. Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt. Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal. Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing. How we care for our Sprinters?Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beachCo-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowanceWe care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skillsWe count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need toYour Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salaryWorkspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for youInclusion & Diversity -At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**#MakeYourMoment**
so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to shape and deliver the next generation of our enterprise data platform. You will lead the design and build of scalable, well-governed data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that power analytics, reporting and AI use cases across the business.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set engineering standards, guide a team of data engineers and work closely with BI developers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to turn data into a trusted, reusable asset. Python will be your primary engineering languag, and Microsoft Fabric the core platform you help us mature.

Key responsibilities

Platform and architecture

* Design, build and evolve our data platform on Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks and Real-Time Intelligence.
* Define and implement a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture with Delta Lake, covering ingestion, transformation, modelling and serving layers.
* Make sound architectural decisions on storage, compute, capacity sizing, workspace design and cost optimisation within Fabric.
* Shape the integration approach between Fabric, Power BI semantic models and source systems (ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, APIs and on-premises databases).

Engineering delivery

* Build robust, reusable and well-tested data pipelines in Python and PySpark, using Fabric Notebooks and Spark job definitions.
* Write efficient SQL (T-SQL and Spark SQL) for transformation, data modelling and performance tuning.
* Implement batch, incremental and near-real-time ingestion patterns, including change data capture where appropriate.
* Own data quality, observability and reliability, with automated checks, monitoring, alerting and clear runbooks.

Engineering standards and DevOps

* Establish coding standards, reusable frameworks and design patterns for the data engineering team.
* Drive CI/CD for data workloads using Git integration, Azure DevOps or GitHub, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
* Promote automated testing, code review, documentation and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Governance and security

* Apply data governance, lineage and cataloguing through Microsoft Purview and Fabric's built-in capabilities.
* Implement role-based access, row-level and object-level security, and sensitivity labelling in line with company policy and GDPR.
* Partner with architecture, security and compliance teams to keep the platform secure and audit-ready.

Leadership and collaboration

* Lead, mentor and coach data engineers, providing technical direction, code reviews and career development support.
* Plan and prioritise work with the product owner and stakeholders, and break down epics into deliverable increments.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay current with the Microsoft Fabric roadmap and bring forward improvements that add measurable value.

Skills and experience

Essential

* 7+ years of data engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a lead or senior technical role.
* Strong, hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Notebooks, OneLake) or closely related Azure services (Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2) with a clear path to Fabric.
* Advanced Python for data engineering, including PySpark, pandas, packaging, testing (for example pytest) and clean, maintainable code.
* Expert SQL skills and solid understanding of dimensional modelling, data vault or similar modelling approaches.
* Practical experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse architecture patterns.
* Experience implementing CI/CD and version control (Git) for data solutions.
* Good understanding of data governance, security and privacy requirements.
* Proven ability to lead technical delivery and mentor engineers.

Desirable

* Microsoft certification such as Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) or Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
* Experience with Power BI semantic models, Direct Lake mode and DAX.
* Exposure to Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstreams or KQL databases.
* Experience supporting machine learning or generative AI workloads on a data platform.
* Familiarity with ERP data (for example IFS Cloud), enterprise integration patterns and REST APIs.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Bicep, Terraform) and Azure networking basics.
* Agile delivery experience (Scrum or Kanban) in a product-oriented team.

Personal attributes

* A pragmatic problem solver who balances engineering quality with delivery pace.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical topics simply.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust, shares knowledge and raises the capability of the team.
* Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in modern data and AI technology.

**Qualifications**

Essential:

* 2-3 years’ experience in similar role
* Fluency in English (written and verbal)
* University degree in Computer Science or related subjects

Highly Beneficial

* Azure BI technology (Fabric, Synapse, Power BI, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSAS, Purview, OneLake, ADF)
* Microsoft training/certification on DP-203 or DP-500
* Generative AI
* Azure AI & Machine Learning
* Microsoft Purview
* Data Catalog
* MDM

**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*
