Infinity Learn, an edtech venture backed by Sri Chaitanya’s 40+ years of educational expertise, is looking for a dynamic and target-oriented Inside Sales Associate to join its K-12 Education Program Division.The role involves B2B sales, school engagement, relationship management, lead generation, and the execution of offline Olympiads. The candidate will be responsible for onboarding schools, building relationships with school stakeholders, driving student participation, and ensuring the successful execution of the FREE SCORE / Genius Olympiad.Although the position offers WFH flexibility, regular travel to assigned schools within an approximate 200 KM radius of the base location is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

1. B2B Sales & School Relationship Management •    Identify, approach, and onboard schools for educational programs and offline Olympiads.•    Build relationships with Principals, Vice Principals, School Owners, Coordinators, Teachers, and Administrators.•    Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and outreach to presentations, onboarding, and post-sales follow-ups.•    Conduct meetings, webinars, and program demonstrations for school authorities.•    Drive school signups and maximize student participation.•    Achieve the monthly target of 2,000+ student prelims from Grades 6–12.

2. Olympiad Execution & Field Operations

Visit assigned schools regularly and coordinate examination arrangements.•    Work with school authorities and the Online Execution Team to finalize schedules, exam timings, and participation details.•    Conduct the FREE SCORE / Genius Olympiad as per the planned schedule.•    Distribute question papers and OMR sheets to participating students.•    Guide students in correctly filling in their personal and academic details on OMR sheets.•    Supervise examinations and ensure smooth execution.•    Verify, collect, and dispatch OMR sheets to the central processing team within the prescribed timeline.•    Coordinate with internal teams until the Olympiad process is successfully completed.

3. Lead Generation & Business Development

•    Generate B2B leads through calls, meetings, school visits, and other outreach activities.•    Identify opportunities to expand school partnerships and increase student participation.•    Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective and existing school partners.•    Support admission lead generation by maximizing Olympiad participation.•    Achieve assigned sales, conversion, and onboarding targets.

4. Reporting & Documentation

•    Maintain daily records of calls, connections, meetings, webinars, and school visits.•    Track school onboarding, student registrations, and Olympiad participation.•    Maintain OMR collection and dispatch records.•    Submit daily activity reports, school feedback, and performance updates.•    Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational challenges.•    Performance Metrics (KPIs)Daily call, connection, and meeting targets.•    School visits, webinars, and school onboarding.•    Student registrations and Olympiad participation.•    Monthly target of 2,000+ student prelims.•    Expected conversion rate of 20–40%, depending on assigned targets.•    Timely Olympiad execution, accurate reporting, and effective school relationship management.

Work Schedule & Location

Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM.

Working Days: Monday to Saturday.

 Weekly Off: Sunday.Work Setup: WFH with mandatory school visits in pune region for to execute genius olympiad exam .

Travel Radius: Approximately 200 KM from the assigned base locationSchool visits may be required for training, supervision, or performance improvement, depending on business requirements.

title: SPE-Accounts Receivable
description:
**Location:**
**Coimbatore/Chennai/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata**
**Job Summary**
Serve as a specialist in accounts receivable for a global organization managing end to end receivables activities within the order to cash cycle while working in a hybrid night shift model. Contribute to accurate cash flow forecasting timely collections and high quality customer billing directly supporting the company financial health and enabling sustainable growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end to end accounts receivable activities including invoice validation posting and reconciliation to ensure accurate recording of revenue and customer balances in line with company policies and timelines.
* Coordinate timely collection efforts through structured follow ups payment reminders and issue resolution to reduce past due amounts and improve overall days sales outstanding for the organization.
* Monitor customer accounts for payment trends unapplied cash and aging analysis preparing clear reports that help stakeholders make informed decisions on credit exposure and cash flow optimization.
* Handle billing discrepancies short payments and credit memo requests by investigating root causes and collaborating with internal teams to implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
* Maintain effective communication with customers and internal partners through email and virtual meetings to clarify invoice details resolve disputes and promote a positive experience that supports long term relationships.
* Update and maintain accurate customer master data and receivable records in the finance system to support reliable reporting compliance requirements and smooth audit reviews.
* Perform regular account reconciliations between subledger and general ledger to identify mismatches correct posting errors and ensure integrity of financial statements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by proposing pragmatic enhancements to order to cash workflows receivables controls and documentation that increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support month end and quarter end closing activities by preparing receivable schedules aging reports and variance explanations that facilitate timely and accurate financial close.
* Adhere to established night shift schedules and hybrid work guidelines while maintaining responsiveness to global stakeholders and meeting agreed service levels for receivable processes.
* Apply finance and accounting principles to evaluate revenue recognition timing doubtful accounts provisions and write off decisions helping safeguard company assets and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with cross functional order management and cash application teams to ensure that orders invoices and payments are aligned minimizing exceptions and improving end customer satisfaction.
* Document standard operating procedures for key accounts receivable tasks so that knowledge is retained onboarding is streamlined and process consistency is maintained across the team.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate practical experience of at least two years in accounts receivable operations with a strong track record of managing invoices collections and reconciliations in a corporate finance environment.
* Show applied familiarity with the broader order to cash domain by working with order management or billing stakeholders and ensuring smooth handoffs that support timely revenue realization.
* Apply foundational finance and accounting knowledge such as journal entries reconciliations and aging analysis to interpret receivable data and support accurate financial reporting.
* Utilize business applications for receivable processing and reporting such as enterprise finance tools or spreadsheets to manage data efficiently and produce clear dashboards for stakeholders.
* Exhibit strong communication and negotiation abilities that enable effective interaction with customers and internal teams supporting resolution of payment delays and disputes in a professional manner.
* Display adaptability to hybrid work arrangements and night shift schedules while maintaining productivity focus and alignment with global business timelines.

**Certifications Required**
Certification in finance or accounting such as Certified Accounts Receivable Specialist or equivalent credential.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Apache Spark & DevOps)
description:
**Senior Data Engineer (Apache Spark & DevOps)**

**Start: ASAP**

**Employer: Kanda Software - Boston, USA (**
**www.kandasoft.com**
**)**

**Long term, full-time, remote job**

**Location: Remote within India; Coimbatore preferred. You’ll work Indian Standard Time (IST) hours, with occasional early-morning or late-evening calls with the client’s US Pacific Time team.**

Kanda Software is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to tune production Apache Spark workloads and automate how those changes are deployed. The client already has an internal AI tool that recommends Spark optimizations. You’ll use job metrics and execution plans to decide whether a recommendation addresses the actual bottleneck, then build the checks that let the team apply it safely or reject it before it reaches production.

This is a hands-on data platform role focused on Spark performance and production tooling, not analytics, reporting, or building AI models.

**What you’ll do**

* Diagnose slow or expensive Spark jobs by investigating partitioning, data skew, shuffle, memory usage, and executor sizing.
* Build pre-deployment checks that catch unsuitable recommendations, and define what counts as an improvement before rolling out a change.
* Automate approved changes within the client’s existing platform. Monitor the results, roll back regressions, and record what changed and who approved it.
* Work directly with the client’s Engineering Manager and join team standups. Document the tuning decisions and write runbooks so the client’s engineers can maintain the workflow after handover.

**What you’ll need**

* 7+ years in data engineering, data platform engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience running and tuning Apache Spark in production on at least one of Amazon EMR, Databricks, YARN, or Kubernetes, backed by strong distributed systems fundamentals.
* Strong programming skills in at least two of Java, Scala, and Python. Scala is especially valuable for this assignment.
* Experience orchestrating data workloads with Apache Airflow or an equivalent tool.
* Hands-on experience building or operating CI/CD, deployment, or configuration management tooling that automates production data or Spark job changes. Writing data pipelines alone isn’t enough for this role.
* Professional written and spoken English (B2 or higher).

**Preferred experience**

* Approval workflows, feature flags, canary or staged rollouts, and automated rollback.
* Production metrics, alerting, and audit logging for automated changes.
* Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
* AdTech, high-volume data processing, or cloud data platform cost optimization.

Initial client assignment: Three months, with the possibility of extension at the client’s discretion. A background check is required before assignment.

description:

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Data Engineer Interns who are interested in building a career in Data Engineering, API Ingestion Pipelines, Backend Systems, and Database Architecture.

As a Data Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to build, normalize, and harden the Python ingestion pipelines and PostgreSQL data layer that power our enterprise AI Security & Governance Discovery platform.

This role is ideal for fresh graduates who have strong fundamentals in Python and SQL, good problem-solving abilities, and a willingness to learn production data engineering practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in building and maintaining async Python data collectors (REST/OAuth APIs) that extract metadata from cloud, identity, and SaaS platforms.
* Clean, normalize, and validate unstructured JSON/API payloads into structured, multi-tenant relational schemas.
* Work with
  **PostgreSQL**
  ,
  **SQLAlchemy**
  , and
  **Alembic**
  for schema design, indexing, and database migrations.
* Implement idempotent ingestion, pagination, rate-limit handling (429 retries/backoff), and caching/state management (Valkey/Redis-compatible).
* Support data quality, field-bounds validation, and PII/secret sanitisation before database persistence.
* Write unit and integration tests (pytest) to verify end-to-end data accuracy and tenant isolation.
* Assist in documenting pipeline flows, data schemas, and operational runbooks.

**Required Technical Skills:**

Candidates should have basic knowledge or an understanding of the following:

**1. Programming & Scripting**

* Strong fundamentals in
  **Python**
  (working with functions, classes, JSON, file handling, and error handling).
* Basic familiarity with REST APIs (requests or httpx) and asynchronous concepts (asyncio).

**2. Databases & SQL**

* Solid understanding of
  **SQL**
  (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, aggregations, and basic indexing).
* Basic familiarity with relational databases (
  **PostgreSQL**
  or SQLite).

**3. Data Cleaning & ETL Fundamentals**

* Understanding of how to extract, clean, validate, and transform raw JSON/CSV data.
* Awareness of handling missing/null values, duplicates (idempotency), and basic data validation.

**4. Version Control & OS**

* Basic knowledge of
  **Git**
  and
  **GitHub**
  .
* Basic Linux command-line navigation and troubleshooting.

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory):**

* Hands-on experience with
  **SQLAlchemy**
  ,
  **Alembic**
  , or
  **Pydantic**
  through academic or personal projects.
* Familiarity with
  **FastAPI**
  ,
  **Pandas**
  , or
  **pytest**
  .
* Basic exposure to Docker, Valkey/Redis, or cloud APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub).
* GitHub repositories demonstrating personal or academic data/backend projects.

**Educational Qualification:**

* B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or related disciplines.
* B.Sc / BCA / MCA or equivalent qualifications in Computer Science or IT.
* **2025 / 2026 / 2027 graduates**
  are welcome to apply.

**What We Expect From You:**

* Strong interest in Data Engineering, Python backend development, and database systems.
* Good analytical and debugging skills.
* Willingness to verify edge cases and test end-to-end data flows rather than stopping at happy-path code.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
* Good communication and documentation skills.

**What You Will Gain:**

* Hands-on exposure to real-world, multi-tenant Python data pipelines and PostgreSQL in production.
* Practical experience building resilient API collectors, schema migrations, and automated test suites.
* Mentorship from experienced security and platform engineers.
* Exposure to enterprise AI governance, cloud security APIs, and containerized Linux deployments.
* Opportunity to convert into a full-time
  **Junior Data / Backend Engineer**
  based on performance and business requirements.

**Important Note:**

This is an entry-level internship opportunity. We do not expect candidates to be experts in all the technologies mentioned above. Candidates with strong Python/SQL fundamentals, genuine curiosity, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

**Start your journey in Data & Platform Engineering with Sennovate!**

title: Security Operations Manager (SOC/NOC) -MSSP - Shift: 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST (US business hours overlap)
description:
Closing the alert is part of the job. Fixing the reason it keeps firing is the other part.

We're hiring a Security Operations Manager in Coimbatore to lead both.

At Fountain Hills Technologies (FHT), you'd coach analysts on investigation quality and escalation packets. You'd also own the ongoing research and improvement of our security stack across EDR/XDR, SIEM, email security, DNS filtering, and firewalls.

You'd lead proof-of-concept (PoC) efforts from test plan and success criteria through rollout runbooks and training. Working with our leadership team and our L3 senior engineers, you'd turn post-incident findings into improvements that address recurring causes.

The goal is less noise, faster response, and better coverage, all measured.

You bring 10+ years in SOC/NOC or IT operations and 4+ years leading teams. Full-time, evening shift that overlaps US business hours.

The job posting has the full role details.

Apply for This Role.

Have questions about the role? Reach out to akarthik@fountainhillstech.com

**Security Operations Manager (SOC/NOC) – MSSP**

**Location:**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Full-time)

**Shift:**
4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST (US business hours overlap)

**Reports To:**
CEO (United States)

**The Mission**

**Fountain Hills Technologies is an Arizona-based MSSP expanding our 24/7 India operations. We’re seeking a seasoned, hands-on player-coach to lead our Coimbatore SOC/NOC team. You will own day-to-day delivery, ensure operational discipline and incident response maturity for our US-based clients, and drive continuous improvement of our security tooling and tech stack—so nothing is missed, forgotten, or overdue.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Operational Leadership:**
  Own queue health in Zoho Desk—ensure alerts/tickets are triaged, prioritized, and progressing with clear ownership and next steps (without manual dispatching).
* **Service Desk Ownership (Zoho Desk):**
  Own and continuously improve Zoho Desk as the operating backbone—workflows, automations, routing rules, SLAs, escalation paths, templates/macros, categories/tags, and dashboards/reporting to ensure tickets move predictably and nothing ages unnoticed.
* **Workflow Standardization:**
  Translate operational procedures into enforceable system behavior (required fields, required evidence, handoff templates, severity tagging, mandatory customer update cadence by severity).
* **Reporting & Visibility:**
  Maintain real-time visibility for leadership—backlog aging, SLA adherence, MTTA/MTTR, reopen rates, and quality metrics; run weekly service desk reviews and drive corrective actions.
* **Coverage & Execution:**
  Own 24/7 scheduling and readiness to ensure
  **minimum staffing requirements are always met**
  and coverage scales as the team grows (including backfill planning and shift readiness).
* **Incident Management:**
  Lead high-severity response end-to-end (classification, escalation, containment coordination, customer communications, PIRs).
* **SOC/NOC Program Ownership:**
  Build and enforce practical playbooks and standards for triage, investigation, evidence capture, escalation, and handoffs.
* **Team Development:**
  Coach analysts on shift readiness, investigation quality, documentation discipline, and consistent escalation packets.
* **Training & Certification Program:**
  Build and maintain role-based learning paths for analysts and engineers (partner trainings, internal enablement, and progression plans). Track completion and ensure the team stays current on required certifications.
* **Partner Enablement:**
  Coordinate and schedule partner training sessions; ensure new tool capabilities and vendor best practices are translated into runbooks and daily workflows.
* **Policy & Procedure Coaching:**
  Coach the team on company policies, security/incident handling procedures, and operational standards (documentation, evidence handling, customer comms).
* **US Business Interaction Coaching:**
  Train and reinforce U.S.-aligned customer interaction standards (tone, urgency, escalation etiquette, executive summaries, meeting discipline) that may differ from typical India norms.
* **Tooling Strategy + Modernization:**
  Own ongoing research and continuous improvement of our security stack—identify gaps, recommend improvements, and drive measurable outcomes (reduced noise, faster response, better coverage).
* **POC Leadership (Internal + Customer):**
  Lead proof-of-concept efforts from start to finish: define test plans and success criteria, coordinate testing, validate operational fit, document results, and drive production rollout readiness (runbooks, training, support model).
* **Strategic Collaboration:**
  Partner with US leadership and L3 Senior Engineers to reduce noise via tuning/automation and to turn PIR findings into permanent operational improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  **10+ years**
  in SOC/NOC or IT operations, with
  **4+ years**
  in formal leadership/management roles.
* **Security-First Technical Depth:**
  Strong, hands-on understanding of modern security operations, including alert lifecycle management, incident response fundamentals, threat triage, and operational security controls.
* **Broad Infrastructure Fundamentals:**
  Deep working knowledge of Windows/M365 and networking fundamentals (identity, endpoint, email, and connectivity troubleshooting) to confidently guide remediation and escalation decisions.
* **Tooling Competence:**
  Experience operating and improving security tooling such as
  **EDR/XDR, SIEM/logging, email security, security awareness, DNS filtering, and firewall ecosystems**
  . (CrowdStrike and Palo Alto experience strongly preferred.)
* **POC / Evaluation Capability:**
  Demonstrated ability to evaluate tools and solutions objectively—define success criteria, run structured testing, and make rollout recommendations tied to operational outcomes.
* **Training Leadership:**
  Demonstrated experience building team training plans and driving certification completion/partner enablement.
* **Service Desk Systems:**
  Experience implementing or improving service desk workflows/automation (
  **Zoho Desk preferred**
  ; ServiceNow/Jira Service Management/Freshservice/Zendesk acceptable equivalents).
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and spoken English for high-stakes customer calls, incident briefings, and daily coordination with US leadership.
* **Operational Authority:**
  Calm, decisive leadership under pressure; comfortable enforcing standards and holding teams accountable. ITIL-style service management experience is a plus.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  Primary shift is
  **4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST**
  ; occasional flexibility required for major incidents, customer escalation calls, or operational reviews.

**Tools & Platforms (partial)**

* **Security & Identity:**
  CrowdStrike (EDR/XDR), ThreatMate, FortiMail, KnowBe4, DNSFilter
* **Infrastructure & Networking:**
  Palo Alto Firewalls, Cisco Meraki (Switches/APs), Datto RMM
* **Data Protection:**
  Rubrik (On-Prem & SaaS)
* **Service Management:**
  Zoho Desk

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Operational Control:**
  Coverage runs smoothly with clean handoffs, clear ownership, and minimal backlog aging.
* **Incident Excellence:**
  Faster, more consistent response with stronger evidence capture, clearer customer communications, and higher-quality escalation packets.
* **Tech Stack Progress:**
  A repeatable POC process is in place and the security stack steadily improves (measurable noise reduction, better detection/coverage, more automation).
* **Team Readiness:**
  Role-based learning paths are implemented; certification tracking is active; partner training is completed on schedule; customer interactions reflect U.S.-aligned expectations.
* **Weekly Cadance:**
  A weekly operating cadence exists (KPIs, backlog review, PIR actions tracked to completion)

description:

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking to build a dedicated to support a leading alternative investment / private markets client. This team will play a critical role in delivering high-quality finance, fund accounting, credit operations, and client reporting services, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with established service-level agreements. The team will collectively support end-to-end Credit Finance and Client Reporting activities, ensuring seamless service delivery and stakeholder management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Credit Finance Operations**

* Perform end-to-end accounting and finance activities for private credit and alternative investment funds.

* Reconcile cash, loan positions, investment balances, and general ledger accounts.
* Prepare and validate NAV-related calculations and supporting schedules.
* Assist with audit requests and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ensure adherence to client-specific accounting policies and internal control frameworks.

**Client Reporting**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual investor/client reporting packages.
* Generate portfolio performance reports, exposure analyses, capital activity summaries, and management reports.
* Perform data validation and quality checks before report distribution.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to gather reporting inputs.
* Support ad-hoc reporting requests from clients and senior management.
* Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery against agreed SLAs.

**Data & Systems Management**

* Maintain and update transactions within Investran and Geneva.
* Reconcile information across accounting systems, portfolios, and reporting platforms.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation initiatives.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure data integrity across systems.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related disciplines.
* Professional qualifications such as CA, CPA, CFA, or MBA Finance will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 4-7 years of relevant experience in credit finance, fund accounting, and client reporting.
* Strong understanding of private credit and investment operations.
* Exposure to alternative investments, private debt, or credit funds preferred.

**What we look for:**
**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Investran.
* Hands-on experience with Geneva.
* Fund accounting and investment accounting expertise.
* Credit finance and loan administration knowledge.
* Financial statement preparation and review.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Data reconciliation and reporting experience.
* Understanding of alternative investment structures, including private credit, direct lending, and debt funds.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
**Preferred Skills**

* Experience supporting private equity, private credit, hedge funds, or alternative asset managers.
* Knowledge of capital calls, distributions, waterfall calculations, and investor reporting.
* Exposure to workflow automation and reporting tools.
* Experience working in global delivery or shared services environments.
* US Visa Holder with 5-8 years of finance experience will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong ownership mindset and accountability.
* Embrace innovation and seek opportunities to enhance processes through technology and AI-enabled solutions.
* AI Fluency: Beginner-level AI fluency is required for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using AI-powered tools to improve productivity, support decision-making, and enhance work quality while adhering to responsible AI and data security practices.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Structural Engineer Intern
description:
**Company Description**
ProDes ( https://prodes.com.au) is an Australian engineering consultancy delivering practical, high-precision structural and civil engineering solutions across New South Wales and Australia. Its Indian office works directly alongside the Australian leadership team, providing end-to-end design, analysis, and CAD documentation for residential, commercial, and light-industrial projects.

**Role Description**
We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Structural Engineer Intern to join the team for a
**3-month paid internship at our office in Pallikkara, Kakkanad**
. The intern will work on Australian projects, assisting senior Australian engineers with structural calculations, residential and commercial framing designs, footing/slab systems, civil drainage concepts, and CAD drafting. The role involves regular communication with the Australian engineering team, so strong written and spoken English proficiency is essential. Based on the intern’s performance during the 3-month internship and the company’s business requirements, a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) may be considered for a full-time opportunity with the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Structural & Civil Design:**
  Assist in preparing structural calculations and design packages for Class 1 residential dwellings, renovations, retaining walls, steel portals, and light commercial structures.
* **CAD Drafting & Documentation:**
  Produce clear, accurate, and compliant structural and civil engineering drawings using AutoCAD (and Revit where required) in accordance with ProDes drafting standards.
* **Standards Compliance:**
  Apply Australian Standards (AS/NZS 1170, AS 1684, AS 2870, AS 3600, AS 4100, AS 3700) under the mentorship of Chartered Australian Engineers (CPEng).
* **Civil Engineering Support:**
  Assist with basic site grading, stormwater drainage layouts, on-site detention (OSD) calculations, and driveway/access profiles.
* **Cross-Border Collaboration:**
  Participate in daily design reviews, mark-up sessions, and project briefings with the Sydney-based engineering team.
* **Quality Assurance:**
  Conduct thorough self-checks on calculations and drawings prior to senior review to ensure zero-error deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Civil or Structural Engineering. Final-year students and recent graduates may also apply if they meet the technical requirements.
* **Experience:**
  0–1 year of relevant design or drafting experience. Fresh graduates with strong academic fundamentals and CAD proficiency are encouraged to apply.
* **Communication (Non-Negotiable):**
  Exceptional command of the English language—both spoken and written—with the confidence to articulate technical concepts clearly during live video calls with Australian engineers.
* **Technical Software:**
  Strong proficiency in AutoCAD (2D structural/civil drafting), alongside familiarity with structural analysis software (e.g., SpaceGASS, ETABS, STAAD.Pro, or similar) and Excel-based engineering spreadsheets.
* **Mindset:**
  High attention to detail, eagerness to learn international building codes, strong ownership of tasks, and ability to work efficiently within Australian time-zone overlaps.

**What the Internship Offers**

* **Paid Internship:**
  A structured, 3-month paid internship based at the Pallikkara, Kakkanad office.
* **Direct International Exposure:**
  Work on Australian projects and gain hands-on exposure to Australian Standards and construction practices.
* **Mentorship:**
  Receive direct training and technical guidance from experienced Chartered Professional Engineers (CPEng) in Australia.
* **Practical Learning:**
  Gain experience with modern cloud-based engineering tools, standardized templates, and structured project workflows.
* **Career Opportunity:**
  An opportunity to demonstrate your capabilities for consideration for future roles, subject to business requirements and performance.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates should send their CV, academic transcripts, and a brief portfolio or sample of CAD/design work (if available) to admin@prodes.com.au with the subject line: Application: Structural Engineer Intern – [Your Name].

title: Medical Representative
description:
**Company Description**
Anderson Diagnostics & Labs is an integrated precision healthcare provider that unifies Radiology, Laboratory Medicine, and Advanced Genetics within a single diagnostic ecosystem. The organization focuses on combining imaging, pathology, molecular diagnostics, and genomics to enable faster and more personalized clinical decision-making. With capabilities spanning advanced radiology and imaging, comprehensive laboratory services, and precision genetics, the company supports multiple high-growth healthcare verticals. Anderson Diagnostics leverages cutting-edge technology, scalable genomics platforms, and strong clinician partnerships to deliver patient-centric diagnostic solutions. The team is committed to innovation, scientific excellence, and creating long-term value for clinicians, patients, partners, and stakeholders.
  
**Role Description**
The Medical Representative role at Anderson Diagnostics & Labs is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The role involves promoting the company’s diagnostic services and solutions to healthcare professionals, including physicians, clinics, and hospitals, through regular visits and presentations. The Medical Representative will build and maintain strong relationships with clinicians, understand their diagnostic requirements, and provide tailored information on radiology, laboratory, and genetics services. Daily responsibilities include planning and executing field activities, following up on leads, supporting test order generation, and ensuring high levels of customer service and satisfaction. The role also requires coordinating with internal teams for timely support, staying updated on medical and diagnostic advancements, and contributing to local marketing initiatives and business growth.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Medical Sales, including field promotion, relationship management with clinicians, and meeting sales objectives for diagnostic services.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, with the ability to present clinical information clearly, negotiate effectively, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills, including responsiveness, follow-up, and a patient- and clinician-centric approach to solving service-related issues.
* Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in Medicine or related healthcare domains to understand diagnostic tests, clinical indications, and medical terminology.
* Candidates should possess knowledge in Pharmacy or allied health sciences that supports scientific discussions and understanding of therapeutic areas and test relevance.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related field; prior experience as a Medical Representative or in healthcare sales is preferred.
* Additional beneficial skills include familiarity with diagnostic products and services, basic data reporting, territory planning, and proficiency with CRM tools and office software.
* Ability to travel within Kochi and nearby regions, strong ethical standards, and a results-oriented mindset are essential.

* Support the professional development of team members through technical training, knowledge sharing, and guidance on design practices, tools, standards, and company procedures.

**Techinal Scope**

* ICT / Data and Network Infrastructure
* Structured Cabling and Wireless Network Systems
* CCTV / Video Surveillance Systems
* Access Control and Intrusion Detection Systems
* Intercom and Video Intercom Systems
* Audio Visual (AV) Systems
* Smart Building / IoT Systems
* Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Infrastructure
* Multidisciplinary Design Coordination
* Design Drawings, Specifications, and Equipment Schedules
* Tender Documentation and Technical Submissions
* BIM Coordination, Clash Detection, and Constructability Reviews
* Application of Relevant Standards, Regulations, and Industry Guidelines

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.

* Proven experience in leading engineering teams and managing design deliverables across multiple projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM workflows, multidisciplinary coordination, and clash detection processes.
* Experience in preparing design reports, technical specifications, tender documents, and detailed engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with applicable international standards, local regulations, authority requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience working on Middle East projects is highly desirable.
* Excellent technical report-writing, communication, client management, and presentation skills.
* Strong project management, resource planning, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
* Exposure to diverse and high-profile projects.
* A collaborative and supportive working environment.
* Opportunities to lead technical teams and contribute to the growth of the business.
* Career progression within a growing consultancy organization.

description:
**PEOPLE & CULTURE MANAGER — HR & BRAND DEVELOPMENT**

**LOCATION:**
Kerala (Hybrid / Remote) |
**REPORTS TO:**
Leadership Team

Data & AI Consulting |

Full-Time |

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Stratakor is a Data and AI transformation consultancy with global delivery across India, the Philippines, Dubai, Kenya and the US. As we scale, we are looking for a
**People & Culture Manager**
to own two things that drive our growth: our people and our brand. This is a split role —
**about 60% People & Operations**
(HR operations, recruitment, employee concerns, training and performance) and
**about 40% Brand Development**
(LinkedIn presence, thought-leadership content, networking and business outreach).

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Part A — People & Operations (about 60%)**

**HR Operations & Compliance**

* Run day-to-day HR operations across locations — onboarding, employee records, leave and attendance, documentation and exits.
* Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws and statutory requirements; coordinate with local partners for other delivery locations.
* Build and maintain HR dashboards (headcount, attrition, hiring pipeline) that help leadership make decisions.

**Recruitment & Onboarding**

* Own end-to-end recruitment for consulting and delivery roles — workforce planning, job descriptions, sourcing, screening, assessments and offers.
* Design a structured onboarding experience that gets new hires productive and client-ready quickly.

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Be the first point of contact for employee concerns and grievances; resolve them fairly, discreetly and on time.
* Run feedback mechanisms (pulse surveys, check-ins, exit interviews) and act on the trends they reveal.
* Build engagement and recognition initiatives that create one culture across a distributed, multi-country team.

**Training & Performance Improvement**

* Own the performance cycle — goal setting, reviews, feedback and performance improvement plans.
* Coach managers through feedback conversations, underperformance and team dynamics.
* Identify capability gaps and run training and certification programs (e.g. Databricks, cloud, AI, client communication) with delivery leads.

**Part B — Brand Development (about 40%)**

**LinkedIn & Social Media Presence**

* Own Stratakor's LinkedIn page; grow reach and engagement through a consistent content calendar, and report on performance.
* Support leadership's personal LinkedIn presence — drafting posts, profile positioning and engagement.
* Showcase culture, team stories and career growth to strengthen Stratakor's employer brand.

**Thought Leadership & Content**

* Write and publish articles, case studies, client success stories and point-of-view pieces on data, AI and transformation.
* Work with consultants to turn project experience into credible, publishable content.
* Keep brand voice, visual identity and messaging consistent across all channels.

**Networking & Business Outreach**

* Build relationships through industry events, communities and partner ecosystems (e.g. Databricks).
* Run targeted outreach to prospective clients and partners, and generate qualified leads for leadership.
* Organise webinars, events and speaking opportunities that position Stratakor as a trusted data and AI partner.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Master's degree**
  (MBA in HR, Marketing or Communications preferred) from a recognised institute.
* **5+ years helping start-ups or growth-stage businesses build presence**
  , spanning people/HR operations and brand, marketing or communications.
* Hands-on experience in
  **recruitment, employee relations, performance management and HR operations**
  .
* **Proven track record growing a company's LinkedIn presence**
  and producing thought-leadership content, with measurable results (portfolio required).
* **Fluent, excellent English, written and verbal**
  — writes credible content for senior audiences and speaks confidently with leaders, clients and candidates.
* Networking and outreach experience that has led to partnerships, leads or new business.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Comfortable building processes from scratch in a fast-paced, multi-location environment.
* Exposure to IT services, consulting, data or AI businesses is an added advantage.

**WHY JOIN STRATAKOR**

* **Build Two Functions:**
  Shape both the people function and the brand of a growing data and AI consultancy.
* **Direct Leadership Access:**
  Work closely with leadership, with real influence over how Stratakor grows.
* **Global Exposure:**
  Work with teams and clients across India, the Philippines, Dubai, Kenya and the US.
* **Visible Impact:**
  See your work show up in hiring, retention, brand reach and new business.

title: Administrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a proactive, well-organized, and responsible
**Administrator**
to manage the day-to-day operations of a commercial building. The ideal candidate will be responsible for tenant coordination, rent collection, building maintenance, vendor management, staff supervision, financial administration, and ensuring the smooth functioning of all building facilities.
  
  
The candidate should have strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and administrative skills, with the ability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently and maintain positive relationships with tenants, vendors, service providers, and management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the commercial building.
* Coordinate with tenants regarding enquiries, complaints, maintenance requests, lease agreements, and renewals.
* Monitor and ensure timely collection of rent, maintenance charges, utility bills, and other applicable payments.
* Maintain accurate records of rental agreements, tenant details, payment receipts, outstanding dues, and lease expiry dates.
* Follow up with tenants regarding overdue payments and prepare regular collection and outstanding payment reports.
* Coordinate building maintenance activities, including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, lift, generator, and other facility-related services.
* Schedule and monitor preventive maintenance to ensure building equipment and facilities remain in good working condition.
* Supervise housekeeping, security personnel, maintenance staff, and other building support teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, and service providers for repairs, maintenance, and facility-related services.
* Obtain and compare quotations, verify vendor invoices, and coordinate service agreements and payment approvals.
* Monitor electricity, water, and other utility consumption and support cost-control initiatives.
* Ensure the cleanliness and proper maintenance of common areas, parking facilities, wash rooms, and other shared spaces.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
description:

**Job Description**
We are seeking a
**highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi.
  
  
This is a deeply technical role requiring
**expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems.**
You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions.
* Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services.
* Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances.
* Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services.
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks.
* Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations.
* Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking.
* Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ in managing global DNS, NTP and LDAP systems on Linux Operating Systems.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code with Ansible, Terraform, or Pulumi.
* Working experience implementing OpenLDAP & NTP services (preferably Microchip SyncServer systems).
* Expertise with Infoblox DDI systems (or similar enterprise DNS systems: BlueCat, Bind9, CloudFlare, GCP and AWS DNS services).
* Familiar with various Infrastructure technology stacks like Hypervisor Technologies (KVM, Vsphere,), storage protocols (SDS) (iSCSI, NFS, CEPH), L2/L3 Networking
* Strong Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) systems engineering background with advanced scripting in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test frameworks.
* Strong experience supporting mission critical 24x7 customer facing production environments.
* Demonstrated success building or maintaining multi-region or high-availability OpenStack clusters.
* Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases and background in large enterprise infrastructure environments.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiar with Cisco UCS Blade Servers (or similar server Infrastructure), Block/File Storage (Soft defined storage preferred).
* Understanding of security best practices for system patching and security compliance (e.g., CIS, NIST).
* Background in telco, edge cloud environments.

description:

InstaSupply Inc. · Remote, India · Full-time · Toronto hours · ₹1,00,000 per month

**The role**

We're looking for a senior engineer who can work across the full stack: mobile, backend, payments and security. You'll take features from idea to release and own them in production. You'll ship real work from your first week. We want someone who holds a high bar and doesn't need to be managed.

**Working hours**

This is a Canadian-hours job. You work remotely Toronto business hours, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time. That's 7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST (6:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST during Canadian summer time). You're online and reachable for the full shift. If you can't work these hours every day, don't apply.

**What you'll work on**

- React Native (Expo) apps on iOS and Android, through to App Store and Google Play release

- Supabase: Postgres, Row Level Security, phone OTP login, Realtime, Edge Functions, Storage

- Stripe Connect: payments, payouts, refunds, webhooks

- Push notifications, maps and live location

- React web dashboards

- Security and performance across the platform

**What you need (all required)**

- 4 to 7 years of full-time experience

- A live app where you built the backend yourself, with real users and real payments

- Production experience with Supabase or Postgres, including access rules

- Stripe in production

- You've published apps to both stores yourself

- Your own Mac, stable internet and power backup

- You use AI coding tools every day and read every line before you ship

**How you work**

- Online for the full Toronto shift, every working day

- Reply within 30 minutes during work hours

- Written update at the end of every shift: done, doing, stuck

- "Done" means tested and live, not "I pushed the code"

- You find problems and raise them before anyone else does

- No missed days without notice

**This job is not for you if**

- You've only built app screens and someone else did the backend and payments

- You've never shipped a live app with real users and real payments

- You can't work Toronto hours every day

- You wait to be told what to do, or leave work half done

- You ship AI-written code without reading it

- You have another job, freelance clients or a side business

- This is just a paycheque for you

**How to apply**

Send links to the live apps on the App Store and Google Play where you built the backend, plus your GitHub. Applications without these links are not reviewed.

You can email your links, or anything else you want to share, to simran@instasupply.ca.

How we hire

- 15-minute call

- 1-hour live task on a shared screen, camera on, no AI tools

- Reference call with a previous manager (required)

- Offer

About one week from start to finish. The first month is a paid trial on real work. If the work isn't finished to standard, we part ways at the end of the month.

Degree: B.Tech, B.E. or MCA in CS or IT, or equivalent experience. What you've shipped matters more than the degree.

title: Founding AI Engineer-AI Agents
description:
About the job

**The Opportunity**

A stealth AI startup in San Francisco, founded by HBS alumni, is building agents that handle complex, high-stakes paperwork for US families. They research what applies to each family, handle correspondence, and follow up over weeks. The product is running in test. You’ll be the first engineering hire, working directly with the two co-founders to take it live.

* You’re a Fit If YouAre high agency. You don’t wait for permission or perfect information. You see what needs doing and make it happen.
* Figure things out on your own. When something’s unclear, you research, decide, build, and check in with what you did, not with a list of questions.
* Are comfortable in an unstructured environment: no detailed specs, no fixed processes, no one assigning your day
* Have owned a product or major feature end to end, ideally as an early engineer at a startup
* Ship fast, with small changes daily, and know when scrappy is good enough
* Adapt easily when priorities shift mid-week. The product is early, and plans will change as users teach us things.
* Make product calls yourself and push back when you disagree, including with the founders
* Keep the team updated on what shipped, what’s blocked, and what needs a decision

* **What You’ll Build**

Features end to end, from agent logic to the screen a family uses

* Agents with tool calling, guardrails, evals and tracing
* Long-running workflows that wait days for replies and survive restarts
* Secure handling of sensitive personal data

**Must-Haves**
: 5+ years of software engineering, with strong TypeScript across the stack (Node.js + React)

* Independent production ownership: you’ve designed, deployed and run features in production yourself, including monitoring, debugging live issues and fixing what breaks, with no separate DevOps or QA team to lean on
* Built and shipped at least one LLM-powered feature or agent yourself: tool calling, structured/validated output, and handling model failures
* PostgreSQL and relational data modelling
* Background jobs, queues or workflow engines (e.g. Temporal, Inngest, Celery) that retry and survive failure
* Deploying on AWS or Azure: CI/CD, environment setup, logging and alerting
* Secure handling of sensitive data: access control, encryption, no secrets in code or logs
* Automated testing as a habit, including tests for model-driven behaviour
* Daily use of AI coding tools, with the judgement to review what they produce
* Excellent English; comfortable on camera for daily stand-ups

**Bonus: founding-engineer experience; Python, Go or Rust in production; agent frameworks (LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK); evals and observability for LLM systems; infrastructure as code (Terraform/Pulumi); document processing and OCR.**

**Details**

* Long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, dedicated to this client
* IST hours: 2:30–11:30 p.m. or 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (finalised after the first few weeks)
* Own laptop (16 GB+ RAM, disk encryption on)
* Process: Technical task, founder intro call → 90-min technical session. Quick decisions.
* Start: Immediately on finalisation

* **To Apply**

Send your CV, a link to something you’ve shipped (repo, live product or demo), and 2–3 lines on a time you solved a problem with no guidance and no one to ask: what you did, and how fast you got it live.

Requirements added by the job poster

* 5+ years of Software Development experience

description:

**Job Title: Sr. Cyber Data Scientist**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
* Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
* Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

**RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**MLOps, Observability & Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
* Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
* Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

**Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Associate Consultant - NOC Job
description:
**About The Role**
You are the first person to see an alert or a ticket, day or night. You check it, decide how serious it is, fix it using the runbook where you can, and pass it on with good notes where you cannot. You cover every technology in the estate at first-line level, so no incident waits because 'the right person' is not on shift. You also handle the client's Netskope remote-access requests and first-line connection issues.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Watch and respond**

* Watch the monitoring dashboards for servers, hypervisors, cloud instances, firewalls and WAN circuits.
* Acknowledge every alert within the response target, check it against the runbook and set the right priority.
* Spot duplicate or related alerts and group them into one incident.
* Do the daily health check at the start of the day shift and raise anything abnormal.

**Fix first-line problems**

* Restart failed Windows services and Linux daemons, clear disk space, end runaway processes and recover hung servers using the runbook.
* Power on, restart or check virtual machines in vCenter and instances in the AWS, Azure and Alibaba Cloud consoles.
* Check firewall and WAN alerts (link down, high CPU, HA state) and log carrier tickets with the internet or circuit provider, then chase them to closure.
* Route alerts for areas the iNOC does not own (storage, backup, databases, applications, security) straight to the right client team.

**Remote access (Netskope)**

* Handle remote-access requests: add or remove a user's access, or move them to the right group or policy, exactly as the approved request and the runbook say.
* Troubleshoot first-line connection issues: client installed and enabled, user signed in, correct steering and app access, tunnel up, known outages.
* Collect client logs and details and pass harder cases to L2 or the client's remote-access team.
* Watch the health of the remote-access publisher and gateway nodes and escalate alerts.

**Requests, records and handover**

* Complete standard operating-system requests from the request catalogue, for example planned reboots inside an approved window or agent restarts.
* Keep every ticket updated so the next person understands what happened, and close it only after checking the service is back.
* Write a clear handover at the end of every shift: open incidents, exceptions, planned work, pending actions.
* Open the bridge and send the first updates when a major incident starts.
* Tell the Technical Lead when a runbook is missing or wrong, so it gets fixed.

**What You Need**

* 2 to 4 years in NOC, server operations or L1/L2 infrastructure support, ideally in a 24x7 managed service.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux basics: services, processes, disk, event logs and syslog.
* Basic VMware vSphere (VM power state, console, VMware Tools) and basic use of at least one public cloud console (AWS or Azure).
* Understanding of networking basics: IP, DNS, DHCP, ping and traceroute, VPN concepts.
* Experience working tickets in an ITSM tool and following runbooks or SOPs exactly.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable on calls with teams in Europe and North America.
* Willing to work rotational 24x7 shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on Netskope, Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access or similar remote-access (ZTNA or VPN) support.
* Monitoring tools such as Grafana, LibreNMS, Zabbix, SolarWinds or Nagios.
* Exposure to Azure Local, Alibaba Cloud or firewall monitoring.
* Basic PowerShell or shell scripting.

**Certifications**
Good to have: ITIL 4 Foundation; AZ-900 or AWS Cloud Practitioner; Netskope or another vendor's remote-access certification. We will support you to earn these.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Alerts acknowledged within target on every shift.
* Most first-line incidents and remote-access requests closed at L1.5, without escalation.
* Tickets and handovers good enough that the next shift never has to ask what happened.

About the Role – Staff Engineer, Cloud Networking & Network Security
  
  
We are seeking a Staff Engineer – Cloud Networking & Network Security to design, build, and evolve cloud-native networking and security capabilities across multi-cloud environments. This role is intended for a strong hands-on networking engineer with deep experience in routing, NAT, traffic forwarding, and firewall data planes. You will work on complex, production-grade networking systems and contribute to architecture and design decisions within your domain, while partnering closely with senior engineers and architects.
  
  
You will be responsible for delivering robust networking functionality—from detailed design and implementation through production rollout, scale, and operational maturity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Networking Design & Implementation
  
  

* Design and implement networking components for cloud networking and security products, spanning both control plane and data plane.
* Contribute to architectural designs for routing, NAT, traffic steering, and firewall enforcement within defined product areas.
* Own medium-to-large technical problem areas and drive them from design through production.

Cloud Networking Platforms
  
  

* Design and work with cloud networking topologies, including:

+ VPC/VNet segmentation and routing architectures
+ Hub-and-spoke and transit networking models
+ Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity patterns

* Work hands-on with cloud-native networking constructs such as:

+ Gateways, routing tables, NAT gateways
+ Managed and custom firewall services

* Ensure implementations align with security best practices and zero-trust principles.

Routing, NAT & Traffic Engineering
  
  

* Design and implement routing-centric features, including:

+ Dynamic routing using BGP
+ Policy-based routing and traffic steering
+ Route summarization, convergence, and failure handling

* Implement and scale NAT functionality, including:

+ SNAT, DNAT, and bidirectional NAT
+ Centralized vs distributed NAT designs
+ Capacity planning, port exhaustion handling, and resiliency

* Develop a strong understanding of packet-level behavior across gateways, firewalls, and load balancers.

Firewall & Data-Plane Systems
  
  

* Contribute to the design and implementation of firewall data planes, including:

+ Policy evaluation and enforcement pipelines
+ Stateful vs stateless inspection models

* Work on performance-sensitive packet processing paths with a focus on correctness and scalability.
* Debug complex scenarios involving asymmetric routing, NAT traversal, and multi-path traffic.

Execution & Collaboration
  
  

* Deliver features from design to production with a strong focus on quality, scalability, and operability.
* Participate actively in technical design reviews, providing feedback on networking correctness and performance.
* Collaborate closely with product management, QA, and operations teams to deliver reliable, shippable solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers on networking fundamentals, packet flows, and troubleshooting techniques.

* Hands-on experience developing or operating cloud networking or network security products.
* Strong understanding of IP networking fundamentals, including:

+ TCP/IP, ARP, ICMP
+ Subnetting, CIDR planning, and IP address management

* Solid experience with routing, including:

+ BGP fundamentals (design, policy control, troubleshooting)
+ Static vs dynamic routing models
+ ECMP and failover concepts

* Strong hands-on experience with NAT, including:

+ SNAT and DNAT behavior
+ Common corner cases and failure scenarios
+ Interaction of NAT with routing and firewalls

* Experience working with firewall and network security technologies, such as:

+ Policy-based rule engines
+ Stateful and stateless firewalls
+ NGFW or cloud-native firewall services

* Proficiency in Python and/or Go (Golang) for building control-plane services, tooling, or automation.
* Good understanding of distributed systems concepts as applied to networking control planes.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI and service networking.
* Hands-on experience with one or more public cloud networking stacks (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with virtual routers, SDN controllers, or network operating systems.
* Exposure to high-performance packet processing technologies (eBPF, DPDK, XDP).
* Experience working on high-scale or latency-sensitive networking systems.
* Contributions to open-source networking or cloud infrastructure projects.
* Certifications such as AWS Advanced Networking, GCP Professional Cloud Network Engineer, CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent.

3–5 Years in NOC Operations / Service Desk / IT Infrastructure Support

24×7 Rotational Shifts

We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Monitoring / NOC Engineer responsible for proactive and reactive monitoring of IT infrastructure, identifying potential issues, performing initial troubleshooting, and coordinating with L2/L3 support teams for timely resolution.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of infrastructure monitoring tools, incident management processes, ITIL practices, and basic troubleshooting across network, server, storage, and application environments.

* Monitor critical infrastructure parameters, including CPU, memory, disk utilization, network performance, backup status, and device availability.
* Identify, analyze, and respond to infrastructure alerts, ensuring timely notifications and escalations.
* Perform initial-level troubleshooting and coordinate with L2/L3 technical teams for issue resolution.
* Manage the complete incident lifecycle, including logging, assignment, tracking, escalation, follow-up, and closure through ITSM tools.
* Handle service requests and stakeholder communications in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Support ITIL-based Event, Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Assist in availability, capacity, and performance monitoring of IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with end users and stakeholders through email and phone to understand issues and provide regular updates.
* Maintain operational reports, monitoring logs, incident records, and technical documentation.
* Ensure proper shift handover and maintain operational continuity across 24×7 shifts.
* Follow established operational procedures and escalation matrices.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Good understanding of IT infrastructure monitoring and IT operations.
* Familiarity with monitoring dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and event monitoring.
* Basic knowledge of performance monitoring and log analysis.
* Understanding of network, server, storage, and application health monitoring.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and report infrastructure alerts.
* Knowledge of ITIL-based service management practices.
* Basic understanding of incident management, problem management, and change management.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Willingness to work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.

Relevant Experience

* 1–2 years of experience in NOC Operations, Service Desk, or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Exposure to infrastructure monitoring, incident management, basic troubleshooting, and ITSM tools.
* Basic knowledge of Networking, Windows/Linux Servers, Storage, and Data Centre Operations is preferred.
* Experience working in an enterprise IT operations or managed services environment will be an added advantage.

Value-Added Skills (Preferred)

* Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Kibana.
* Exposure to cloud monitoring tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or equivalent platforms.
* Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows Server administration.
* Understanding of networking concepts, server health checks, and storage monitoring.
* Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, or PowerShell).
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or Jira Service Management.
* Exposure to automation-based alert monitoring and operational process improvements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A proactive and detail-oriented professional with strong monitoring and analytical skills, capable of identifying infrastructure issues, managing incidents, coordinating with technical teams, and ensuring operational stability while meeting defined SLAs.
