title: Risk Analyst II, Account Integrity
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.
  
  
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.
  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.
* Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.
* Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.
* Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.
* Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
* Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
* Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.

A day in the life
  
  
No Two Days Look The Same When The Automated-abuse Landscape Shifts In Real Time - Your Week Balances Hands-on Investigation, Strategy, And Close ML Partnership To Keep Anti-Automation Ahead Of Emerging Threats
  
  
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)
  
  

* Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action.
* Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
* Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.

Strategy (Building What's Next)
  
  

* Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.
* Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.

ML Partnership (Scaling the Defense)
  
  

* Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
* Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
* Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.

Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)
  
  

* Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
* Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.

**About The Team**
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.
  
  
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The Anti-Automation vertical sits at the front line of that fight, taking on bots and scripted abuse at the scale.
  
  
If you want to do work where your findings directly translate into customer trust at global scale - and where the adversary never stops evolving - this is the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data-driven role (e.g. business analyst, risk analyst, data analyst, operations analyst, or research analyst) or similar quantitative/analytical roles across any domain

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Master's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related Science field, or experience in data

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**About The Company**
If you want to build, develop, and see your impact, join Skillz and level up your Career!
  
  
Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile eSports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide, is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
At Skillz, we understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. Want to join a team made up of alums from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts and more? Learn more to see if Skillz is the right fit for your next career move!
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a
**Senior Analytics Manager**
to help shape the future of our products through data-driven decision making. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Leadership to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and influence strategic decisions. You'll play a key role in understanding user behavior, measuring product performance, and ensuring that product investments are backed by meaningful analysis.
  
  
This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about turning data into actionable insights that drive exceptional customer experiences and business growth.
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Experimentation craft. Strong fundamentals in A/B testing — hypothesis framing, metric selection, power analysis, cohort-level lift analysis, and disciplined readouts. Knows the difference between statistical and practical significance and is comfortable challenging poorly designed experiments.
* User-level behavioral insight. Reasons about individual user journeys, not just aggregate metrics. Can identify meaningful behavioral archetypes from raw activity, distinguish correlation from causation, and connect what users do to what the product offers.
* Roadmap influence and opportunity sizing. Translates analysis into prioritized recommendations. Comfortable telling a PM "this won't move the metric you care about" before the work is built. Can size the financial impact of an opportunity and stack-rank it against other bets.
* Strong technical foundation. Expert in SQL on large datasets. Comfortable with Python for analysis and modeling. Fluent in BI tools (Tableau or equivalent). Comfortable with regression, classification, and basic ML for propensity, LTV, or churn prediction.
* Agentic AI fluency. Has a real point of view on AI tooling for analytics. Can prompt and orchestrate agents effectively, design human-in-the-loop workflows, and critically evaluate agent output. Treats agent output as a junior analyst's first draft — useful but always verified.
* Communication and executive presence. Writes for executives — leads with the answer, not the method. Can compress a complex analysis into a 3-bullet recommendation. Calibrated about uncertainty. Updates publicly when wrong.
* Domain judgment. Knows when to stop analyzing. Recognizes when 80% confidence with speed beats 95% confidence with delay. Pushes back on stakeholders constructively.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of analytics experience, with at least 5 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related function with 3 years experience in managing a Analytics team/pod
* Demonstrated ownership of high-impact analyses that influenced a product roadmap or strategy decision.
* Hands-on experience designing and measuring product experiments at scale — not just reading dashboards.
* Proven background in a transactional or two-sided marketplace product (gaming, fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces). Experience with payment funnels or fraud analytics is strongly preferred.
* Strong SQL and BI background; Python or equivalent for analysis and modeling.
* Bonus: hands-on experience building or deploying agent-based or AI-augmented analytics workflows.
* Bonus: experience in skill-based gaming, sports betting, or real-money product environments.

**Location:**
Onsite - Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%

title: Product Lead, Analytics
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling recently launched Data Cloud, opening up a new opportunity to help customers understand and act on data across their business. By bringing together first-party, third-party, and customer-created data across HR, IT, finance, and external systems, Rippling can answer business questions that traditional analytics tools struggle to connect.
  
  
As Product Lead for Analytics, you will turn this extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for enterprise and mid-market customers. You will own customer-facing analytics experiences and the shared capabilities that power analytics across Rippling—from intuitive reporting for business users to sophisticated analysis for advanced users.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to define new AI-centric experiences beyond classic dashboards. You will build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, uncover insights, and proactively learn when meaningful events in their data need attention. AI will be the backbone of the features you ship—and a core part of how you build them.
  
  
Your core engineering team is based in India. You will work closely with engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and stakeholder teams across India and the USA to shape the product direction for a foundational part of Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Analytics within Rippling’s Data Cloud.
* Define and build new experiences for how customers analyze data in the AI era, extending beyond classic reports and dashboards.
* Make sophisticated analysis intuitive for admins and business users while giving advanced users the depth and flexibility they need.
* Build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, explain trends, and proactively discover meaningful events in their data.
* Partner with your India-based engineering team and engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and product stakeholders across India and the USA to deliver trusted analytics across Rippling and external data.
* Work directly with enterprise and mid-market customers to understand their needs, win adoption, and measure customer value.
* Use AI extensively to accelerate discovery, prototyping, delivery, and product iteration.

**What You’ll Need**

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex B2B products.
* Experience building analytics, BI, data platforms, or adjacent products; experience with shared platform capabilities is valuable.
* Strong customer and UX judgment, with the ability to make sophisticated analysis intuitive without sacrificing power.
* Technical fluency in data modeling, querying, metrics, and permissions, and the ability to work closely with engineering on product trade-offs.
* AI fluency: an understanding of how to build reliable AI and agentic experiences, evaluate their quality, and use AI effectively in your own work.
* Strong systems thinking, clear communication, and the ability to drive execution across teams and geographies with high ownership.
* Alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, and We go and see.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.
  
  
**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.**

**About ClickPost**

ClickPost is a post-purchase intelligence platform that helps brands simplify and scale their logistics. Its platform brings shipment tracking, carrier management, delivery exceptions and returns together, connecting 600+ carriers through a single API. Trusted by brands like Walmart, Nykaa, Mars and Adidas, ClickPost uses AI to help businesses improve delivery experiences and build stronger customer relationships.

**About the Role**

ClickPost is looking for an Account Executive to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to solutioning, negotiation and closing. This is a hands-on B2B SaaS sales role for someone who enjoys building pipeline, engaging senior stakeholders and converting business conversations into revenue.

**This role is also open to high-performing Senior SDRs and BDRs ready to move into an Account Executive position.**
If you’ve recently transitioned into an AE role, or have independently owned and closed a few deals end to end, we’d love to hear from you. You don’t need to have spent your entire career as an AE, but you should have real closing experience beyond just booking meetings.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting accounts to closing deals.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline through cold calling, email outreach and LinkedIn prospecting.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer needs and business challenges.
* Engage CXOs and other senior decision-makers across target accounts.
* Lead product conversations and present solutions aligned with customer requirements.
* Manage commercial discussions, negotiations and deal closures.
* Build strong relationships with prospects and customers, identifying opportunities for renewals and upselling.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably selling SaaS or technology products.
* **Senior SDRs / BDRs with 1–2 years of actual closing experience are encouraged to apply.**
* Experience independently taking at least a few deals from prospecting or discovery through negotiation and closure.
* Strong prospecting, discovery, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage a pipeline and work towards sales targets independently.
* Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and understanding complex business requirements.

**A note on experience:**
Meeting-booking or lead-generation experience alone will not be sufficient. We’re looking for people who have started owning revenue outcomes and are ready to take on a full-cycle sales role.

**Compensation**

**₹32–35 LPA total compensation**

* Fixed: ₹22–25 LPA
* Variable: ₹9.6–11 LPA

MSQUARE SOLAR PVT LTD is a growing solar energy company focused on delivering reliable, high-efficiency solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. The organization specializes in the design, supply, and installation of solar power systems that help customers reduce energy costs and environmental impact. With an emphasis on technical excellence and customer satisfaction, MSQUARE SOLAR PVT LTD works closely with partners and clients to provide customized solar solutions. Team members collaborate in a fast-paced environment that values innovation, safety, and continuous learning.

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Technical Sales Support Engineer based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. The role involves supporting the sales team with technical expertise on solar products and systems, preparing proposals and quotations, and responding to technical queries from customers and partners. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines on-site.
* Comfort working in the Greater Bengaluru

title: Business Development Manager – Cyber & AI Security
description:
Every company is rushing to adopt AI, and every CTO and CISO is asking how to keep it secure. We're looking for someone who can help them answer that. This is a customer-facing role for an ambitious, entrepreneurial professional who wants to learn fast, grow with a young organization, and take on new markets over time.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Valamm.AI helps startups, mid-market, and emerging enterprises adopt AI and the cloud. We do this through three services: Agentic AI & Security, Cloud Modernization & Migration, and GTM 360. VirtualizingHumans.AI is our cyber and AI security initiative. It is guided by an experienced founding team and advisors with deep business and industry experience, and we work alongside the AWS ecosystem and other technology partners. Our customers are adopting AI faster than they can secure it, and that is the gap we are here to close.

This role comes in at the start of that story. The person who joins will learn how AI and cloud security really work, build relationships with CTOs and CISOs, and see those conversations turn into customer wins that the whole company notices.

ROLE AT A GLANCE

**Role:**
Business Development Manager, Cyber & AI Security

**Focus:**
70 to 80% customer-facing, with the rest on planning and collaboration with extended teams

**Experience:**
3 to 5 years in security sales or pre-sales, with engineering and management exposure

**Profile:**
High-potential, entrepreneurial, and hungry to succeed

**Markets:**
Primarily India, with other markets based on demonstrated success

**Location:**
Bengaluru, work from office, all weekdays

OUR PORTFOLIO

Our security offering has two parts. Agentic AI & Security protects AI agents and LLM applications from risks like prompt injection, data leakage, and over-permissioned access. Cloud security looks after posture, identity, and compliance across SaaS, cloud, and DNS environments, using unified platforms from leading global security partners. Both sit alongside Valamm.AI's Cloud Modernization & Migration services.

New joiners are trained on every offering, the questions buyers tend to ask, and the competitive landscape. We also support them in earning the certifications that matter.

THE ROLE

Most of the week is spent with customers. That means understanding their AI and cloud setup, running discovery calls, demos, and proofs of concept, and carrying each opportunity from the first conversation to a signed deal. The pipeline covers startups, mid-market, and emerging enterprises in India, and other markets open up as results come in.

The role works closely with AWS and other partners, including through cloud marketplaces, and with our wider teams, so that what customers need, where they push back, and where competitors fall short all make their way back into what we build. The first 90 days are about learning the portfolio, meeting customers, and opening the first qualified opportunities.

THE PROFILE

We're looking for someone with 3 to 5 years in B2B sales, technical pre-sales, or security consulting, an engineering background, and some experience leading, whether that's a project, a small team, or a revenue target. They should be comfortable talking risk with a CISO and architecture with a CTO, and explaining both in plain business language.

Attitude matters just as much. We want someone outgoing, who builds trust easily, thinks like an owner, and doesn't wait to be told what to do. Resilience and a real hunger to succeed go a long way here. They will start by building a track record in India, and should be happy working from our Bengaluru office every weekday.

Certifications are desired, such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, Security+, AWS Security Specialty, Azure AZ-500, or Google Cloud Security Engineer.

GROWTH PATH

Growth here follows performance. Good results can lead to larger accounts, responsibility for a new market as we expand beyond India, and the opportunity to build a team as the practice grows.

THE EXPERIENCE

The real reward here is the experience: selling a cyber and AI security portfolio that customers genuinely need, learning from experienced business leaders, and building a reputation early, with the chance to take on other markets along the way.

We are a growing organization, so pay reflects where we are today, and it grows as we do, along with role and responsibility. People who join us do it for the learning and for what they can help build.

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates can send a resume, along with a short note about an AI or cloud security problem they've helped solve, to
**ganeshs@valamm.ai**
.

* The selection process is simple and practical: a conversation about the candidate's experience, a sales scenario related to the role, and a discussion with our leadership team. We will share the details when we connect.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Backend Developer with 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in developing scalable and robust backend systems. The ideal candidate will have extensive expertise in building cloud-native solutions utilizing Java, Spring Boot, AWS, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You should have a solid understanding of microservices architecture, clean design principles, and enterprise observability. A core component of this role involves ensuring high performance and availability,

meaning hands-on experience with advanced monitoring tools like Dynatrace and AWS CloudWatch is essential. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and observing the critical backend services that

power our core applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable backend services and RESTful APIs utilizing Java and Spring Boot.
* Architect and interact with dual database systems, balancing relational data in PostgreSQL with highly available, distributed NoSQL patterns in AWS DynamoDB.
* Instrument, monitor, and troubleshoot production applications using Dynatrace and AWS CloudWatch to ensure optimal performance and rapid issue resolution.
* Collaborate closely with frontend developers, DevOps engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality, end-to-end product features.
* Apply solid principles of microservices architecture to design loosely coupled, resilient, and independently deployable services within the AWS ecosystem.
* Ensure rigorous code quality through comprehensive unit testing, integration testing, and strict adherence to organizational coding standards.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and mentoring junior team members.
* Contribute to broader architectural discussions and technical decision-making processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

The following requirements are mandatory criteria for this position. Candidates must demonstrate proven experience in these areas.

1. **Java & Spring Boot:**
   3 to 5 years of hands-on, production-level experience in Java application development and the Spring Boot framework.
2. **AWS Ecosystem**
   : Broad experience operating within Amazon Web Services,understanding cloud-native design, networking, and deployment paradigms.
3. **PostgreSQ**
   L: Strong proficiency in relational database design, query optimization, and complex data modeling using Postgres.
4. **AWS DynamoDB:**
   Solid experience with NoSQL database architectures, partition key strategies, and scaling distributed data stores.
5. **Dynatrace & CloudWatch**
   : Deep expertise in application performance monitoring (APM), configuring alerts, logging analysis, and creating dashboards using Dynatrace and AWS CloudWatch.
6. API Design: Proficiency in designing and implementing efficient, secure, and standardized RESTful APIs working with JSON payloads.
7. Architecture: Solid understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven design, and cloud - native patterns.
8. Development Tools: Experience with Git version control, Maven/Gradle build tools, and integrating with CI/CD deployment pipelines.
9. Software Craftsmanship: Deep knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented programming (OOP), and clean code principles. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience utilizing additional AWS serverless and managed services such as AWS Lambda, Amazon Cognito, API Gateway, and Amazon S3.

Familiarity with containerization tools and orchestration platforms, particularly Docker and Kubernetes.

Strong understanding of secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10) and application security fundamentals within distributed systems.

title: Sharepoint Tester
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SharePoint QA Engineer with 4–6 years of experience in software testing, particularly in Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments. The candidate should have strong experience in functional, integration, regression, and UI testing of SharePoint applications and solutions.

The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding business requirements, preparing test scenarios, identifying defects, and ensuring the quality and reliability of SharePoint-based applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing of SharePoint applications.
* Test SharePoint Online.
* Validate SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, content types, workflows, permissions, and customizations.
* Test SPFx web parts, extensions, and custom SharePoint solutions.
* Validate integrations between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, Power Automate, and Microsoft Graph.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test execution reports.
* Identify, document, track, and verify defects using Azure DevOps or similar defect-tracking tools.
* Perform cross-browser, UI, usability, and compatibility testing.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and functional teams to understand requirements and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release validation.
* Ensure quality standards are maintained across development and production releases.

Required Skills

* 4–6 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing.
* Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
* Good understanding of SharePoint architecture, lists, libraries, site collections, permissions, and content management.
* Experience testing custom SharePoint solutions and SPFx components.
* Knowledge of Power Automate workflows and SharePoint integrations.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for test management and bug tracking.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and defect management processes.
* Experience in writing test cases, test scenarios, and test execution reports.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with automation testing using Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
* Basic knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API testing using Postman.
* Knowledge of Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and custom web part testing.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and release management.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Hands-on experience in testing SharePoint-based enterprise applications.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing activities.
* Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset.
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a maximum notice period of 30 days preferred.

You will combine hands-on system testing, test automation, defect investigation, and quality leadership across embedded firmware, software applications, communication interfaces, and hardware-software integration. Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improving automated build, execution, reporting, and traceability workflows. Analyzing software logs, crash information, network traffic, protocol traces, hardware signals, and test results to isolate system-level failures. Experience with API and UI testing tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent tools. Experience analyzing logs, traces, crash data, network traffic, and system behavior to investigate complex failures. Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or comparable debugging equipment. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams. Experience with defect and requirements tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent systems. title: Data Engineer, Databricks
description: Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers through EDI and APIs, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.SwiftB2B exists to change that. We are an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens. The platform does not stop at flagging a delay. It works out what the delay costs, weighs the options, and starts the fix.We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s work in supply chain and EDI technology, and on a team that has spent careers in logistics, retail, and enterprise software. We know what a late container does to a retailer’s shelf, and we know what the data underneath it looks like.That data is where you come in. The intelligence in SwiftB2B is only as good as the pipelines feeding it. We are a Databricks partner and we are building our data platform on the lakehouse. We want engineers who understand the full breadth of Databricks, from ingestion and Delta tables through Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and Mosaic AI, and who can see how all of it applies to shipment data, customer profitability, emissions reporting, and the rest of the problems logistics companies live with.What you will doYou will design, build, and run the data pipelines and models that power the visibility and decision-making in SwiftB2B. In practice that means:Ingesting and transforming data from logistics and enterprise systems (EDI feeds, TMS/WMS exports, ERPs, carrier APIs) into analytics-ready lakehouse tables on Databricks.Building and tuning ETL and ELT workflows, and modeling data for analytics, warehousing, and the AI features in the product.Owning data quality end to end: validation, lineage, monitoring, and fixing production issues when they happen.Working with product, engineering, and operations to turn messy supply-chain data into features customers use.Improving the platform as it grows, so it keeps up with more customers, more data, and more automation.What we are looking forReal experience as a data engineer, building and maintaining pipelines and integrations that have run in production.Hands-on Databricks experience: Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, medallion architectures, Unity Catalog, and job orchestration. Databricks certifications are a plus.Strong SQL and Python, and solid data modeling and warehousing skills.Experience designing, optimizing, and automating ETL/ELT processes on a cloud data platform (Azure preferred).Comfort with analytics: you can use data to answer a question, support a decision, and improve the product.A background in supply chain, logistics, or a related domain is a strong advantage. Familiarity with EDI (X12, EDIFACT) or enterprise integration is a plus.A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.You can explain complex data problems to non-engineers, work across teams, and take ownership of a solution from source system to customer-facing feature.Not sure you tick every box?Apply anyway. With 40+ years of experience in the Insurtech game, we’re not just redefining what’s achievable, we’re creating a place where amazing career moments are made possible.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for an experienced
**Staff**
**Data Engineer**
with proven experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to join our growing Data team in India. We are on an exciting journey to scale our Data and Analytics capabilities to enable better data-driven decision making across the business. In this role you will contribute towards setting the technical direction for our data platform on Google Cloud Platform — defining architecture, establishing engineering standards, optimizing data processes, and ensuring the seamless integration of data from various sources. This is an individual contributor role with organization-wide influence: you will solve our hardest data problems and raise the bar for how we solve all of them. If you are passionate about data and excited to work on cutting-edge technologies, we want to hear from you!
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, develop, operationalize robust and scalable data pipelines with automated data quality checks to support business needs and demonstrate ownership of live data pipelines and establish the patterns other engineers use to build theirs.
* Proficiency understanding and implementing data life cycles, data lineage, custom metadata, and data governance.
* Proficiency implementing BigQuery SQL procedures, functions, and similar, with actionable logging
* Optimize ETL processes and data workflows to ensure abiding by performance constraints, for efficiency and scalability.
* Together with the Principal Engineer and Architect, own the architecture of our data platform end to end — ingestion through consumption — across GCP, BigQuery , dbt , Airflow, and Python.
* Expertise in JSON, XML, text parsing using Dataflow, Python, or batch jobs.
* Define and enforce engineering standards across data teams: code review norms, testing strategy, reusable frameworks, CI/CD for data.
* Design, develop and maintain robust, and scalable data models and schemas to support analytics and reporting requirements.
* Optimize data processing performance, ensure high availability, scalability of data systems and solutions.
* Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Ensure data quality and consistency through rigorous testing and validation processes in development and production tiers.
* Create, update, and maintain technical documentation of the data processes, pipelines, and models.
* Mentor and grow engineers across teams through design review, pair programming, and structured technical feedback.
* Partner directly with Engineering, Product, and business leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into technical requirements.
* Identify systemic problems no one has asked you to fix, and build the case for addressing them.

Optimize processing performance, parallelization, partitioning, and resource utilization to ensure scalability and cost efficiency.
* Implement Workflow Orchestration and Data Architecture: Design and maintain workflow orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, and failure recovery mechanisms. Work with data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures, including data modelling to support analytics, reporting, and downstream machine learning workloads.

Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed computing concepts, including partitioning, shuffling, parallelization, and cluster management. Familiarity with Parquet and Avro data formats.

title: DEVOPS ENGINEER I
description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The pace of innovation in artificial intelligence and machine learning continues to accelerate, and the Data and Devices Business Unit is at the center of this transformation. Our customers are building intelligent systems that redefine how data is processed, analyzed, and used across compute, networking, and cloud infrastructure. At TE Connectivity, we support this evolution by delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions that enable next-generation products.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid software engineering and infrastructure foundation who is passionate about building reliable development platforms and automated deployment systems. You will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and IT teams to build and maintain the infrastructure required to develop, deploy, and operate modern software and AI solutions at scale.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain infrastructure and automation systems that support software development, machine learning workflows, and production deployments. You will help implement CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure, and ensure systems operate reliably and securely in production environments.
  
  
You will also play a key role in enabling development teams to move quickly by automating workflows, improving deployment processes, and ensuring infrastructure scalability and reliability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure and Platform Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable infrastructure to support software and machine learning applications.
* Develop and manage cloud environments and compute resources used for development, testing, and production workloads.
* Implement infrastructure as code practices to enable reproducible and automated infrastructure deployment.
* Ensure systems are designed for high availability, scalability, and operational resilience.

**CI/CD and Automation**

* Design and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines that automate build, testing, and deployment processes.
* Implement automation tools that improve development productivity and reduce manual operational tasks.
* Support version control workflows and automated testing processes across engineering teams.

**Containerization and Cloud Platforms**

* Build and manage containerized environments using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Deploy and maintain applications and services across cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Optimize infrastructure and deployment pipelines to support scalable workloads and distributed systems.

**Monitoring and Reliability**

* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems that ensure reliability of deployed services.
* Track system performance and identify potential reliability or scalability issues.
* Support incident response and root cause analysis for production system issues.

**Security and Compliance**

* Ensure infrastructure and deployment systems follow security best practices.
* Implement secure configuration management and access control policies.
* Support compliance with enterprise IT and cybersecurity standards.

**Collaboration and Enablement**

* Work closely with software engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists to support deployment of applications and machine learning models.
* Provide guidance on DevOps best practices, automation strategies, and infrastructure design.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to improve system reliability and development workflows.

**Required Skills & Competency**

* Bachelor’s with 5+ years, Master’s with 3+ years, or PhD with 0+ years of experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed system architectures.
* Experience implementing monitoring and logging systems such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.
* Clear communicator who works well in a collaborative team environment.
* Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies and continuously improve operational systems.
* Ability to travel occasionally, up to 10%, for team meetings or training as needed.

**Competencies**
Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

title: Lead Network DevOps Engineer
description:
**DevOps Engineer – Network Product Services**
**We’re excited to welcome new DevOps Engineers to our Network Product Services team!**
In this role, you’ll help shape, build, and support the platforms that power our network automation products. We work closely across engineering, architecture, SRE, operations, and security, and we’re committed to creating systems that are reliable, scalable, secure—and increasingly intelligent through agentic workflows and AI-driven automation.
  
  
You’ll make a meaningful impact by contributing to our CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and operational reliability, while also helping us advance automated incident response, intelligent triage, and self‑healing capabilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**CI/CD & Automation**
You’ll design and maintain modern CI/CD pipelines that streamline how we build, test, and deploy network automation products. You’ll work with tools like Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CloudFormation to express infrastructure as code, automate provisioning, and improve the overall deployment experience. We value engineers who continually push automation forward and reduce manual work wherever possible.
  
  
**Cloud Infrastructure & Operations**
You’ll manage and optimize cloud environments across Azure, AWS, or GCP, and support containerized workloads running on Kubernetes and Docker. You’ll enhance observability with monitoring and logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog, and you’ll partner with our security teams to maintain strong security practices across all layers of our stack.
  
  
**Network Operations & Support**
Our network automation products depend on strong infrastructure, and you’ll play a key role in supporting and improving those systems. You’ll help diagnose and resolve issues tied to networking fundamentals and infrastructure interactions, contribute to runbooks and SOPs, and take part in our on‑call rotation to support 24x7 production environments. We learn from every incident—and you’ll help us implement fixes and preventive measures.
  
  
**Teamwork & Continuous Improvement**
We believe great products come from great collaboration! You’ll work directly with software engineers, SREs, and operations teams to integrate features, improve reliability, and iterate quickly. We participate in Agile ceremonies, reflect openly, and constantly look for ways to improve how we operate. We stay curious and keep up with emerging DevOps trends, tools, and automation technologies.
  
  
**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or a similar role
* Strong background with CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
* Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker
* Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Helm
* Solid understanding of Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Programming/scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar
* Understanding of networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, load balancing)
* Ability to participate in an on‑call rotation
* Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment

**Preferred**

* Experience designing agentic workflows or AI‑driven automation
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) and prompt engineering
* Knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP)
* Understanding of RAG patterns and vector databases
* Experience with network automation tooling
* Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK stack
* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (Azure, AWS, CKA, DevOps certs)
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Understanding of compliance or regulated industries

**Who We Are**
We care deeply about building reliable, inclusive, and innovative systems. We believe in automation that empowers teams, collaboration that strengthens outcomes, and technology that adapts to the future of networking.
**We’re passionate about learning, improving, and making an impact together!**
**Equal Opportunity & Accessibility**
We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels supported and included. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, we’re happy to provide them—just let us know.
  
  
Proud to share LSEG in the India is Great Place to Work certified (Jun ’25 – Jun ’26).
  
  
Learn more about life and purpose of our company directly from India colleagues’ video: Bengaluru, India | Where We Work | LSEG
  
  
**Career Stage:**
Senior Associate
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

workloads. You will own the automation platform underneath VLSI infrastructure - the tooling, services and pipelines that turn manual infrastructure work into something that runs itself

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use recruiting data to make decisions and improve outcomes.

* Comfortable working in an environment that values ownership, speed, ambiguity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

title: GenAI Designer

**OLIVER**

is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. **The Brandtech Group**

, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our
**AI solutions**

enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

**Role:**

GenAI Designer

**Location:**

Mumbai, India

 

**About the role:**

 

This is an opportunity to join the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub, OLIVER's dedicated in-house studio embedded within the Unilever Beauty & Wellbeing programme, as a Senior GenAI Integrated Designer — delivering premium motion content, AI-powered creative production, and multi-market campaign assets for some of the world's most iconic beauty brands, including Dove, TRESemmé, Pond's, and Simple. 

 

Beauty is where craft, technology, and emotion converge. Based on-site in Mumbai and creating for markets XXX, you'll lead the origination, creative concepting, and production of social-first motion content, hero campaign films, and retail/e-commerce assets — while directing AI agents that handle art direction, retouching, and static design at scale. Your eye for beauty aesthetic, mastery of GenAI design and motion workflows, and ability to elevate AI-assisted creative output will set the quality bar for the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub and raise the capability of the team around you. 

 

We support flexible working and are open to different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the process. 

 

As Senior GenAI Integrated Designer within the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub, you sit at the intersection of craft, technology, and beauty storytelling. Drawing on a range of skillsets, you are responsible for origination, creative concepting, and producing all creative design work associated with a campaign — owning motion output for Unilever Beauty & Wellbeing and holding quality across social-first content, premium campaign films, and retail assets for Dove, TRESemmé, Pond's, Simple, and beyond, ensuring every deliverable reflects the visual language of the beauty category at its best. 

 

Beyond your own output, you direct AI agent workflows for art direction, retouching, and static design — reviewing, refining, and elevating what the tools produce against premium beauty standards. You supervise art operations and creative development at account level, mentor junior creatives, establish workflow benchmarks, and act as a creative authority within the studio: the person the team looks to when the bar needs raising and the work needs defending. 

 

 

**What you will be doing:**

 

The role is responsible for origination, creative concepting, and producing all creative design work associated with a campaign. They will own the end-to-end creative delivery of social-first content, in moving image, animation, special motion effects, long and short form videos, hero campaign films, retail/e-commerce assets, etc. A sharp beauty aesthetic sensibility and expert-level command of Gen AI motion tools — text-to-video, image-to-video, AI-assisted compositing — are essential, alongside strong proficiency in After Effects, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. 

 

Beyond individual output, this role carries clear leadership responsibility: supervising art operations and creative development at account level, mentoring junior and mid-level creatives, setting Gen AI workflow benchmarks, scoping design phases, and presenting creative decisions to brand teams and executive-level client stakeholders. The successful candidate brings a proven ability to orchestrate AI agents with rigorous quality control, design scalable AI-assisted workflows, and upskill others on prompting practices — all while keeping multi-market delivery on track without compromising on craft. 

 

* Responsible for the visual creation of collateral material across the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub's output for Unilever Beauty & Wellbeing.
* Lead origination, creative concepting, and end-to-end production of social-first motion content, animation, special motion effects, long and short-form video, hero campaign films, and retail/e-commerce assets for Dove, TRESemmé, Pond's, Simple, and other B&W brands across.
* Direct and orchestrate AI agents for art direction, retouching, and static design — establishing clear quality criteria, reviewing outputs rigorously, and knowing when human craft must take over.
* Apply a trained eye for beauty aesthetic to all motion and AI-assisted creative: skin texture, light quality, colour grading, product rendering, and brand tone held to the standard the category demands.
* Develop and own GenAI design and motion workflows for the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub — including prompting frameworks, style references, and quality benchmarks for AI-assisted content production.
* Provide creative direction and hands-on mentorship to junior and mid-level designers and motion creators within the studio.
* Supervise art operations and creative development at account level — maintaining consistent quality standards and ensuring output integrity across all workstreams.
* Collaborate with creative strategists, producers, and client teams to translate brand briefs into compelling motion narratives — from concept through to final delivery.
* Adapt and localise campaign creative ensuring cultural relevance, brand consistency, and platform optimisation.
* Act as motion craft authority within the Beauty AI Studio Creative Hub — reviewing work before client delivery and maintaining consistent output quality across the team.
* Partner with production and project management to scope design phases accurately, manage feedback cycles, asset delivery volumes, and multi-market timelines without compromising quality.
* Present creative decisions and campaign work to brand teams and executive-level client stakeholders with confidence and clarity.
* Stay ahead of emerging Gen AI tools, techniques, and beauty motion trends — sharing knowledge, running informal sessions, and elevating the team's collective capability.
* Manage project-level production budgets, including cost estimation, purchase orders, supplier sourcing, and reconciliation.

 

**What you need to be great in this role:**

 

Motion Craft and Technical Skills:

 

* Advanced motion design skills across 2D and 3D, with a portfolio that demonstrates premium beauty or personal care work — including animation, special effects, and long and short-form video — showing a clear understanding of what beauty looks like in motion.
* Expert-level proficiency in Gen AI motion tools, including text-to-video, image-to-video, AI-assisted compositing, and AI upscaling workflows.
* Strong proficiency in industry-standard motion and post-production applications (After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent).

**Client Marketing Design**

* Incorporate approved feedback and revisions.

* Support new client onboarding through review of existing brand assets.

* Create social media advertising assets.
* Adapt creative concepts for consumer audiences.
* Support seasonal and promotional B2C campaigns.

**Coaching & Professional Development Creatives**

* Design event banners and promotional graphics.
* Create course promotion visuals.
* Design speaker cards and testimonial creatives.
* Develop presentation templates.
* Create social media content for coaching programs.
* Produce email campaign graphics.
* Maintain a professional and growth-oriented visual identity.

**Design Brief Management**

* Review creative briefs before starting work.
* Understand target audience, platform and communication objective.
* Clarify incomplete requirements before design execution.
* Follow approved copy and design directions.
* Deliver first drafts within agreed timelines.
* Flag potential deadline or execution issues early.

* Implement creative feedback within agreed timelines.
* Review design output before submission.
* Check typography, alignment and visual hierarchy.
* Verify logos, colours and brand elements.
* Confirm correct image resolution and output format.
* Ensure final designs are suitable for their intended platform.
* Maintain consistency across campaign assets.

**Creative Asset Management**

* Maintain organised source files and exported assets.
* File approved designs under appropriate brand or campaign folders.
* Maintain reusable templates and brand assets.
* Keep editable working files available for future modifications.
* Archive completed campaign creatives systematically.

Join Cisco's AIC, a multifaceted group revolutionizing routing, optical and automation solutions for the next generation of connectivity.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Influence product roadmaps through customer feedback and market intelligence.
* Leverage Cisco's broader portfolio and partner ecosystem to develop comprehensive customer solutions.

* An accomplished technology sales professional with a strong track record of delivering revenue growth and winning strategic opportunities.
* Experienced in selling networking, telecommunications, optical transport, data center or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong understanding of Service Provider, Webscaler, Hyperscaler, Neo-Cloud, Public Sector and Enterprise markets.

* Able to articulate complex technology propositions in terms of customer business value, ROI and competitive differentiation.
* Experienced in working across large, matrixed organizations and leading virtual teams to deliver customer outcomes.

description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital Commerce Sales Senior Vice President is a strategic professional who closely follows the latest trends in the field and adapts them for application within the job and the business. The role is held by a small number of people in the business who provide this level of expertise. It requires excellent communication skills to guide, influence and convince clients and partners. It carries accountability for significant direct business results and for authoritative advice on business growth and strategy.

The role carries a dual mandate. As Citi India's Pan-India leader for Digital Commerce, you will build and run the eCommerce and Digital Commerce franchise end-to-end. You will drive the strategy and growth of Citi's position across Payments, Trade and Liquidity. You will also drive Sales engagement for Citi's large technology relationships, with a focus on winning new clients.

The role is technology-forward and sits at the centre of the new-age economy. It covers eCommerce platforms and marketplaces, FinTechs, payment aggregators, digital-native businesses, and global technology companies. You will be the recognized authority on Digital Commerce and a trusted advisor to senior client executives. You will partner with Citi’s clients in these highly dynamic industries to understand their complex needs and design solutions that deliver on their key objectives. You will also work across Citi's global organization to drive client consultations, win deals, bring solutions to life and shape product strategy for our diverse institutional client base.

**Responsibilities**

* Drive the Digital Commerce strategy for India, including target segments, priority payment and trade flows, products, and the growth roadmap. Execute the country sales strategy in conjunction with partners.
* Portfolio Management and Optimization: Develop deep relationships with key global and regional clients. These include technology companies, eCommerce and marketplace players, payment aggregators and FinTechs. Retain clients and grow volumes/values.
* Lead complex Digital Commerce deals end-to-end, including RFP responses and client pitches. Recommend innovative solutions across digital collections and payouts, cross-border commerce flows, instant payments, and Banking-as-a-Service.
* Position Trade and working capital solutions, such as supply chain finance, receivables finance and digital trade. Target marketplaces, eCommerce sellers, platforms, and technology supply chains.
* Identify cross-sell opportunities across Cash, Trade, Cards, and Digital Commerce products.
* Build and monetize FinTech and ecosystem to access clients' commercial flows. Enable global technology clients to route cross-border capital and operational flows into India.
* Market Development: Develop a client focus strategy for all key clients and sub-sector targets. Maintain a target list of underpenetrated names with a "Hunting License" for new business, including unsolicited bids. Review account plans and support origination through thought leadership material.
* Market Presence: Be the go-to subject matter authority and an ambassador for Citi at client forums, industry conferences, and flagship events. Maintain leading-edge expertise on the industry, regulatory and competitive environment.
* Ownership and Leadership: Act as a steward of the business and influence its strategy and market leadership as a key member of the regional and global sales team. Feed market and competitive insights into product roadmaps. Mentor junior sales talent.
* Meet all Sales Management goals tied to pipeline management (CRM), Deal Review and Implementation Project Kick-Offs. Lead client presentations. Work with Implementations/account managers to ensure deals are implemented efficiently for revenue realization and ramp-up.
* Control and Compliance: Maintain a pristine control environment (KYC, documentation, training). Work closely with Legal, Compliance, AML, Risk, Audit and Finance on higher-risk flows such as cross-border, instant payments and marketplace.
* Manage key Balance Sheet drivers, including assets and liabilities. Partner with Banking, as appropriate, on client credit risk (appetite, commitment, and returns), particularly for Trade solutions.
* Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance, expense discipline, and ethics.
* Appropriately assess risk when making business decisions, with particular consideration for the firm's reputation. Safeguard Citigroup, its clients, and assets by complying with laws, rules, regulations, and policy, and by escalating control issues with transparency. Adhere to Citi's Code of Conduct.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience
* Broad client management experience, preferably in payments, trade, eCommerce, FinTech, or technology clients
* Excellent communication and written skills
* Demonstrated organizational skills (including self-organizational skills)
* Superior client management and deal negotiation skills
* Ability to interact at all levels of global, regional, and local
* Superior interpretive and problem-solving skills
* Excellent team working and outstanding interpersonal skills
* Ability to operate in a complex matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

* Working Environment: office setting, minimal travel required.
* Effort: minimal physical effort required.

description:
**5–8 years** of relevant experience in tender management, bid management, proposal management, or IT business development.

Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field**. MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Business Development, or related areas will be an added advantage.

Job Summary

The Tender Manager will be responsible for managing the complete **tender and bid management lifecycle** for IT projects. The role involves identifying relevant tender opportunities, analyzing tender requirements, coordinating with technical, finance, legal, HR, and management teams, preparing compliant technical and commercial proposals, and ensuring timely submission of high-quality bids.

Key Responsibilities1. Tender Identification & Opportunity Management

* Identify and track relevant IT tenders, RFPs, RFQs, EOI, RFI, and government procurement opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals and other sources for new business opportunities.
* Evaluate tender opportunities based on eligibility, scope, commercial viability, technical requirements, and organizational capabilities.
* Maintain a tender opportunity tracker and bid calendar.
* Coordinate internally for **Go/No-Go** decisions.

2. Tender Document Analysis

* Review tender/RFP documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, timelines, commercial conditions, and contractual terms.
* Identify mandatory documents, compliance requirements, evaluation criteria, EMD/Bid Security, Performance Bank Guarantee, and other tender conditions.
* Prepare tender requirement checklists and compliance matrices.
* Identify risks, deviations, and clarification requirements before bid submission.

3. Proposal & Bid Management

* Lead the preparation and submission of complete technical and commercial bids.
* Coordinate with technical teams for solution design, methodology, architecture, project plans, and technical write-ups.
* Coordinate with the finance/commercial team for pricing, costing, taxes, and financial proposals.
* Coordinate with legal and management teams for contractual and statutory requirements.
* Prepare executive summaries, covering letters, declarations, undertakings, and other bid documents.
* Ensure all documents comply with tender specifications and prescribed formats.

4. Team Coordination

* Coordinate with **Business Development, Sales, Technical, Project Management, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Senior Management** teams.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish internal timelines for each tender.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely receipt of required information and documents.
* Conduct internal bid review meetings before submission.

5. Compliance & Quality Control

* Ensure 100% compliance with tender eligibility and submission requirements.
* Verify all forms, certificates, declarations, annexures, credentials, and supporting documents.
* Ensure that technical and financial proposals are complete, accurate, consistent, and error-free.
* Maintain version control and confidentiality of tender documents.
* Ensure bids are submitted within the specified deadline and through the required procurement portal/mode.

6. Commercial & Pricing Support

* Work with the finance and management teams to prepare competitive and commercially viable pricing.
* Analyze BOQ, manpower requirements, project costs, licenses, infrastructure, and other cost components.
* Support preparation of financial proposals and price schedules.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis wherever possible.
* Ensure pricing is aligned with tender requirements and organizational margins.

7. Post-Bid Activities

* Track tender opening, technical evaluation, commercial evaluation, and award status.
* Respond to clarification requests from clients/tendering authorities.
* Coordinate presentations, demonstrations, technical discussions, and negotiations where required.
* Support contract finalization and handover to the project/delivery team after successful award.
* Maintain records of submitted bids, outcomes, and lessons learned.

Key Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **IT tendering and proposal management**.
* Excellent understanding of RFP, RFI, RFQ, EOI, and government/enterprise procurement processes.
* Strong technical proposal and business writing skills.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good commercial and financial understanding.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work under strict deadlines.
* Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially **Word, Excel, and PowerPoint**.
* Experience with government e-procurement/tender portals will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT services, software development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and managed services will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of tenders successfully submitted.
* Tender submission accuracy and compliance percentage.
* Timely submission of bids.
* Bid-to-win/conversion ratio.
* Value of contracts won.
* Quality of technical and commercial proposals.
* Compliance with tender requirements.
* Timeliness of internal coordination and documentation.
* Reduction in bid errors, omissions, and disqualifications.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in handling tenders for **Government Departments, PSUs, Corporates, Banks, Educational Institutions, Healthcare Organizations, and other large enterprises** will be preferred.

Experience with **GeM, CPPP/e-Procurement portals, state government tender portals, and other online tendering platforms** will be an added advantage.

* Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs for application-to-application and front-end-to-backend communication.
* Experience with SQL and analytical data platforms such as Snowflake, StarRocks, or similar modern data warehouse or analytics technologies.
* Experience with authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or similar enterprise identity integration approaches.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience with Apache Superset, ECharts, or similar business intelligence and data visualization platforms.
* Experience developing embedded analytics or business intelligence applications for enterprise users.
* Experience working with data engineers, architects, and analytics teams in cloud or modern data platform environments.
* Experience improving performance and usability of interactive data applications.

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information.
