title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**
As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.
  
  

* Design, build, and ship features end to end across the backend (Java / Spring Boot services, REST APIs, data model) and the web frontend (React / AngularJS).
* Write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code that scales to large multi-location customers with complex, highly configurable setups.
* Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause.
* Keep backend and UI behavior consistent — the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree.
* Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability.
* Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.
* Investigate and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; take part in on-call and escalation support for your area.
* Work closely with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements and validate fixes with customers.
* Mentor engineers on the team and raise the technical bar through reviews and design discussions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping software products (not consulting or website/portal development).
* Strong backend experience in Java with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
* Strong frontend experience with React or AngularJS, plus JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, including cross-browser compatibility.
* Solid relational database skills with MySQL (or similar): schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations.
* Experience with performance and scalability work: profiling, memory and allocation issues, batching, caching, and asynchronous/queue-based processing.
* Experience handling the complexity of many configurations in a multi-tenant, cloud-based product.
* Experience with AWS and containerized deployments.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
  
  
**DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION**
For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co
  
  
We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co
  
  
*Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.*
**How We Determine What We Pay**
*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.*

title: Senior Backend / Fullstack Engineer (Python & React)
description:
**About the Role**

We’re hiring an SDE-2 (Fullstack) to help build a product that runs people’s financial lives. The engineering team is small and deliberately values quality over headcount, so the work you ship has weight and your decisions are visible.

You’ll own features end-to-end, with your center of gravity on the backend — the Python services, APIs, and AWS infrastructure — while staying hands-on across the React and React Native frontends. You’ll build systems that are scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant, working directly with product, design, and fellow engineers to turn messy financial problems into usable software.

You’ll work across the full product surface:

* Advisor Portal (Internal): A dense, data-heavy, performance-sensitive web app used by advisors to onboard clients, build financial plans, and manage client interaction.
* Client Web App: Where clients see their full financial picture, track goals, and engage with their plan. Correctness and trust are non-negotiable.
* Mobile App: A React Native app for clients on the go. You’ll help shape its architecture, shared component patterns, and release pipeline as it scales.

This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be expected to seek out context, push back when a requirement doesn’t hold up, and translate it into systems you can defend in review. You’ll report directly to the Engineering Lead.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and own APIs and backend services in Python — scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant under real financial data and load.
* Own data modeling and integrations: work with the Account Aggregator framework and other financial data rails (CAS parsing, MFCentral, broker and AMC integrations) to bring a client’s complete financial picture into the product.
* Build and operate the infrastructure your services run on — AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS/Postgres, S3, Lambdas, DynamoDB) — treating reliability, observability, and security as part of the feature.
* Ship features end-to-end, taking work through to the React / Next.js or React Native frontends when needed.
* Partner closely with product, design, and engineers, challenging requirements and design decisions when they don’t hold up.
* Keep the codebase healthy: ship in reviewable increments and review others’ code with rigor.
* Drive your own improvements — performance fixes, refactors, tooling, developer experience — without waiting to be assigned.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years in a software engineering role, with real backend depth building APIs and services in Python that run at scale.
* Strong Python and solid TypeScript; comfortable moving across the stack.
* Solid backend fundamentals: API design, data modeling, relational databases (Postgres), and clear reasoning about scalability, reliability, and failure modes.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure on AWS (ECS, RDS/Postgres, S3, Lambdas) and an understanding of how your code runs in production.
* Real frontend experience with React (and Next.js) / React Native — enough to own a feature through the UI.
* High ownership: you find the problem, understand it, propose a direction, get buy-in, and ship it.
* Clear, direct communication with engineers, designers, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Care about correctness: you think about edge cases, failure modes, and what happens to a user’s money if something breaks.
* Comfort with ambiguity: messy briefs, shifting priorities, and the occasional wrong turn.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in fintech, wealth management, banking, or other regulated, data-heavy domains.
* Familiarity with India’s financial data ecosystem — Account Aggregator, CAS / eCAS, MFCentral, depositories (CDSL / NSDL), broker and AMC APIs.
* Infrastructure and DevOps skills: ECS / Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and AWS IAM done properly.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows, and a point of view on where they help vs. hurt.
* Prior experience as one of the earliest engineers at a startup, comfortable with greenfield work.
* Exposure to data-privacy and security requirements (DPDP, encryption, PII handling).

**Why This Role**

* Real ownership: you’re building the product, not working someone else’s ticket queue.
* Direct line to decision-makers, with no politics or design-by-committee.
* Small, senior team with high trust, high autonomy, and very little process for its own sake.
* Full-stack, multi-surface scope: backend, infra, web, internal tools, and mobile.
* A high-stakes domain where there’s room to do meaningfully better work.

**What’s On Offer**

* Personal learning budget for courses, books, conferences, and tools.
* Non-linear growth: title and scope follow impact.
* Hybrid flexibility for Bangalore-based candidates.

title: Java Full Stack Lead
description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.
  
  
  
  
By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.
  
  
  
  
From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

**Job Description**

**Overview**

We are looking for a skilled and experienced
**Java Full Stack Lead**
to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in object-oriented programming, strong experience with the Spring Framework, and practical frontend experience with React JS.

This role requires a collaborative mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and an interest in developing high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance, reusable Java applications.
* Develop and maintain responsive frontend components using React JS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for relational databases such as DB2 or Oracle.
* Work with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ.
* Develop scalable solutions using microservices architecture to ensure modularity, availability, and ease of deployment in distributed systems.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs to enable backend-to-frontend integration
* Analyse requirements and propose effective technical solutions considering functional and non-functional requirements.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
* Write automated unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito.
* Write and maintain documentation of software components and code.
* Conduct and participate in peer code reviews and design discussions.
* Ensure performance, security, and availability of applications.
* Identify and address technical risks and issues; propose and implement practical solutions.
* Conduct demos and facilitate acceptance discussions with Product Owners to validate deliverables.
* Maintain a proactive attitude toward learning and adopting new tools and frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Required experience and skills**

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on delivery of backend or distributed systems; the technical lead should typically have 10+ years.

Strong Java experience (Java 17 or later preferred) and production experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, service design, testing, and troubleshooting.

Experience designing distributed systems and event-driven architectures, including Kafka or a compatible platform such as Amazon MSK.

Experience deploying or operating containerised services on Kubernetes; AWS EKS experience is strongly preferred.

Sound understanding of relational databases and SQL, data modelling, transactions, concurrency, schema evolution, and performance tuning.

Experience with at least one document database and one Redis-compatible in-memory data platform; understanding of when to use each and their consistency and failure trade-offs.

Practical knowledge of API and event versioning, idempotency, resiliency patterns, back-pressure, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.

Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code review, and production support for business-critical services.

Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design trade-offs and work effectively across teams.

**Preferred experience**

Experience in payments, fintech, commerce, banking, provider integrations, or another regulated, business-critical domain.

Familiarity with payment lifecycle concepts, provider routing, payment status handling, reconciliation, refunds or reversals, and operational exception flows.

Experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM, CloudWatch, and managed messaging or networking services.

Experience with Datadog and OpenTelemetry, including distributed tracing and service-level indicators.

Infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation; Helm and GitOps-based Kubernetes delivery.

Awareness of PCI DSS and secure handling of sensitive payment data. Direct compliance implementation experience is an advantage, not a substitute for sound engineering fundamentals.

**Technology environment**

Core engineering environment:
  
Java and Spring Boot; AWS EKS; Amazon MSK; Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB compatibility; Amazon MemoryDB for Redis; Amazon RDS; Amazon S3; AWS Secrets Manager; and Datadog. The final service choices and versions will be confirmed during solution design.

Candidates should be able to reason from workload needs and operating requirements rather than assume a particular service is right for every use case.

**Recommended stack additions and design clarifications**

API edge and protection:
  
identify whether Kong or Amazon API Gateway will own external API management, and include AWS WAF where public web APIs require managed edge protection.

Async work and recovery:
  
use MSK for domain event streams where replay and multiple consumers matter; consider SQS with dead-letter queues for isolated work queues and controlled redelivery. Define outbox/inbox and idempotency patterns across database and message boundaries.

Security and audit:
  
include AWS KMS, IAM roles for service accounts, CloudTrail, network segmentation, and a clear sensitive-data and tokenisation approach. Confirm applicable PCI DSS scope and market-specific obligations with the client security team.

Platform delivery:
  
include infrastructure as code, Helm, CI/CD or GitOps, automated security checks, environment promotion, and tested rollback procedures.

Telemetry:
  
standardise on OpenTelemetry-compatible instrumentation and consistent correlation IDs; use Datadog as the operational view, with CloudWatch retained where needed for AWS-native signals.

Database fit:
  
confirm DocumentDB API and feature compatibility against the application’s MongoDB driver and required behaviors before locking the choice. Use MemoryDB when Redis-compatible in-memory data durability is required; if the primary need is an expendable low-latency cache, evaluate ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey. Specify the RDS engine and its purpose.

Workflow orchestration:
  
keep latency-sensitive payment processing paths lean. Consider a workflow engine for long-running or human-assisted exception flows only when the state, timeout, and recovery requirements justify it.

**Additional Information**

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Software Testing Lead Engineer
description:
Overview:

The Lead Test Automation Engineer will own the test strategy and automation delivery for web and Windows desktop applications. He or she will contribute directly by writing, run, debug and maintain test suites written in C# using SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Selenium or Playwright. The lead will also set testing priorities, resolve blockers, and mentor team members so they can independently deliver reliable automation for their product areas.

Responsibilities:

* **Write and maintain automation scripts.** Take direct ownership of automating critical and complex test scenarios. Write, run, debug and maintain test suites written in C# using SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Selenium or Playwright. Develop API tests and use appropriate tools for Windows desktop automation. Debug failures and update scripts as the product evolves.
* **Lead the vendor transition.** Work with the outgoing team to understand product workflows, existing test coverage, frameworks, and known issues. Verify that the incoming team can independently run, troubleshoot, and maintain the test suites.
* **Own test strategy and planning.** Analyse business and technical requirements, identify quality risks, and develop test plans, scenarios, cases, and test data. Prioritise automation for high-risk workflows and frequently repeated regression tests.
* **Build and improve automation frameworks.** Design frameworks where needed, enhance existing ones, and establish coding standards that help engineers write readable, reusable, and reliable tests.
* **Lead sprint and release testing.** Estimate testing effort, assign clear ownership, track progress, and resolve blockers. Work with developers and product owners to communicate quality risks and provide a release-readiness recommendation.
* **Perform hands-on testing.** Execute functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests across web and Windows desktop applications. Validate critical workflows at both the UI and API levels where applicable.
* **Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines.** Configure test suites to run during builds and deployments, monitor results, and investigate failures. Identify whether each failure comes from the product, test script, test data, or environment and coordinate the fix.
* **Drive defects through closure.** Report defects with clear reproduction steps and evidence, lead triage with developers, verify fixes, and add regression coverage where appropriate.
* **Mentor engineers and build team ownership.** Review test cases and automation code, pair with engineers on challenging scripts, and give practical feedback. Coach team members to independently design, write, debug, and maintain tests for their assigned product areas.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering or any equivalent technical discipline.
* 9–12 years in software testing and QA, including manual testing and hands-on automation.
* Experience leading test delivery from planning through release and resolving blockers.
* Strong C# skills for writing, run, debug and maintain test suites written in C# using SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Selenium or Playwright.
* Hands-on experience testing APIs and Windows desktop applications.
* Experience building and improving automation frameworks using BDD tools such as Spec Flow, Reqnroll, or Cucumber.
* Ability to turn business requirements into Gherkin scenarios and implement step definitions, hooks, and reusable components.
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines, investigating failures, and fixing unreliable tests.
* Familiarity with Jira or Digital.ai Agility (VersionOne) for sprint planning and defect tracking.

title: Technical Application Developer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Application Developer to design, build, test, and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions. You will independently deliver medium-complexity features, contribute to technical design, troubleshoot production issues, and guide junior developers while working within enterprise architecture and platform standards.

The role supports Commercial and Marketing organizations across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and Field Service; authenticated customer and partner portals built on Power Pages; and integrations with Eloqua and Oracle ERP.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Dynamics 365 technical design and development

* Design and deliver medium-complexity Dynamics 365 solutions across data models, forms, views, business process flows, automation, integrations, and security.
* Build plug-ins, custom APIs, JavaScript form scripting, Dataverse Web API integrations, and selected PCF controls using maintainable patterns.
* Evaluate standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, and custom code; recommend an approach based on maintainability, performance, security, and supportability.
* Implement and review Dataverse security configurations, including business units, roles, teams, field-level security, and record sharing.
* Diagnose production issues involving plug-ins, transactions, performance, security, access, and integrations using trace logs and platform diagnostics.
* Contribute to solution management and ALM, including solution layering, managed solutions, environment strategy, automated deployments, and release-wave readiness.
* Build model-driven and canvas Power Apps and Power Automate flows with robust validation, error handling, monitoring, and operational documentation.
* Document design decisions and raise significant architectural trade-offs to senior developers, platform owners, or enterprise architects.

Power Pages and integrations

* Design, develop, and support authenticated customer and partner experiences using Power Pages, Liquid, web templates, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, forms, lists, and the Power Pages Web API.
* Implement web roles, table permissions, page permissions, and approved identity patterns; validate authorization and record-level access.
* Troubleshoot portal authentication, registration, authorization, data access, performance, and accessibility issues.
* Develop and support integrations between Dynamics 365, Eloqua, Oracle ERP, and Azure services, including monitoring and failure handling.

Delivery, mentoring, and business collaboration

* Translate approved requirements into technical designs, user stories, estimates, tasks, and acceptance criteria for assigned features or workstreams.
* Own assigned features through development, testing, release readiness, deployment, and production stabilization; keep Azure DevOps status, risks, and dependencies current.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, demos, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and release planning across time zones.
* Review code and configuration, reinforce development standards, and coach junior developers through implementation questions and defects.
* Partner with Commercial and Marketing stakeholders to understand workflows, explain options and trade-offs, validate proposed behavior, and demonstrate completed solutions.
* Prototype practical Dynamics 365 AI and Copilot Studio use cases, support showcases, and incorporate user feedback into improvements.

DYNAMICS 365 APPLICATION SCOPE

**Sales:** Accounts and contacts, account hierarchies, lead qualification, opportunities, product catalogs, price lists, quotes, orders, forecasting, seller productivity, and Oracle ERP connections.

**Customer Service:** Case management, queues, routing, service-level agreements, entitlements, knowledge management, and representative productivity.

**Field Service:** Work orders, incident types, customer assets, service agreements, scheduling, dispatch, case-to-work-order handoffs, and technician mobile experiences.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 4+ years of hands-on experience developing Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Power Platform solutions.
* Strong Dynamics 365 development skills, including C# plug-ins, custom APIs, JavaScript form scripting, Dataverse Web API integrations, and exposure to PCF controls.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and Field Service, including configuration, data models, and extensibility.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse security, solution management, ALM, source control, deployment automation, and production troubleshooting.
* Hands-on Power Pages or Power Apps portals experience, including Liquid, web templates, web roles, table permissions, and external authentication concepts.
* Strong Power Platform skills across model-driven apps, canvas apps, and Power Automate, plus working knowledge of Azure integration patterns.
* Experience delivering work in Agile teams, estimating features, reviewing code, coordinating dependencies, and supporting releases across distributed teams.
* Ability to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions and explain options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Exposure to Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 AI or Copilot capabilities, with the ability to build or contribute to working prototypes.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Microsoft certification related to Power Platform development or Dynamics 365 applications.
* Experience leading a small feature team or mentoring junior developers without formal people-management responsibility.
* Experience with Eloqua integration, Oracle ERP integration, Azure services, or automated Dynamics 365 deployments.
* Experience building Copilot Studio agents or Dynamics 365 AI prototypes that reached pilot or production use.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Within the first 90 days, learn the CRM and portal landscape, begin owning medium-complexity enhancements, and become a dependable technical partner for assigned business areas.
* Deliver features end to end, support code and design reviews, resolve production issues effectively, and improve development or release practices.

Over the first year, lead selected workstreams, mentor junior developers, and help move at least one Dynamics 365 AI or Copilot Studio use case from prototype toward adoption.

title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer (Flutter + PHP)
description:
Job Description

Zylu is building an AI-powered growth management platform for salons, spas, and beauty businesses worldwide.

We help businesses simplify operations, increase revenue, retain customers, and grow through intelligent software and AI-driven automation.

We're a product-driven SaaS company serving customers across the globe.

Our engineering philosophy is simple: **AI is a fundamental part of how we build software, not an optional productivity tool.**

We're looking for engineers who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building AI agents, intelligent workflows, and scalable applications.

Why Join Zylu?

* Build AI-powered products used by real businesses.
* Work with modern AI coding tools, LLMs, and agentic development workflows.
* Own meaningful features from design to production.
* Work directly with the founding team and influence technical decisions.
* Grow your technical expertise and take ownership of increasingly complex systems.
* Build your career in a product-driven SaaS company with opportunities for technical or engineering leadership.

**What You'll Do**

**AI-Native Engineering**

* Use AI coding agents throughout development, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Build and integrate LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and automated workflows.
* Develop agents that interact with APIs, retrieve relevant context, and execute authorized actions.
* Implement tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and workflow orchestration.
* Evaluate AI outputs and implement safeguards for reliability, security, and performance.

**Full-Stack Product Development**

* Design, build, and maintain applications using Flutter, PHP/Laravel, and MySQL.
* Develop scalable APIs, backend services, and intuitive user experiences.
* Own features end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Write secure, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Identify and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Automate repetitive development and operational tasks.
* Improve code quality, testing, CI/CD, and engineering workflows.
* Make sound technical decisions and document important trade-offs.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve customer problems.
* Take responsibility for the quality and reliability of everything you ship, including AI-generated code.

**What We're Looking For**

**Core Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience with Flutter/Dart, PHP/Laravel, and MySQL.
* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs into applications.
* Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tool calling and external APIs.
* Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and agent orchestration.
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, automated testing, and debugging.
* Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and software architecture.
* Ability to independently design, build, test, and deploy production-ready features.
* Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, and ability to learn quickly.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with MCP, RAG, or multi-agent architectures.
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimizing AI agents in production.
* Familiarity with Redis, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience building or scaling B2B SaaS applications.

**How We Work**

**AI-native by default:** We use AI throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Ownership over tasks:** We take responsibility for outcomes, not just completed tickets.

**Build, ship, improve:** We prioritize working software, feedback, and continuous improvement.

**Quality is non-negotiable:** AI-generated code must meet the same security, reliability, and maintainability standards as any other code.

**Small teams, high impact:** We value engineers who think independently, solve problems, and improve the effectiveness of the entire team.

**Career Growth**  
Strong individual contributors have opportunities to grow into senior engineering and technical architecture roles.

Engineers who demonstrate the ability and interest to develop others may also grow into technical leadership or engineering management positions.

Career progression is based on demonstrated impact, technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to raise engineering standards.

**Hiring Process**

We value demonstrated engineering ability over credentials alone.

* **Introductory Conversation:** Discuss your experience, projects, and approach to engineering.
* **Practical Technical Assessment:** Build or extend a small application involving Flutter/Laravel and an AI agent that integrates with an external API. AI coding tools are encouraged.
* **Technical Review:** Explain your architecture, agent design, testing, security considerations, and how you validated AI-generated code.
* **Final Conversation:** Discuss ownership, engineering standards, expectations, and mutual fit.

**If you're already building software with AI and agents, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to own products from idea to production, we'd like to hear from you.**

It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today's hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

title: Senior Java / Golang Engineer
description:
**Hey there!**

We are looking for curious minds to join our **Engineering** team at Procedure. We are an **applied AI and product development company** established in early 2017. Before we dive into the job description, allow us to introduce ourselves.

Our team is a mixed bag. Of the smart and the hard workers. Of the organised and slightly chaotic. Of the early risers and the burners of the midnight oil. We appreciate diversity and truly like having differing perspectives in the room.

We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools, libraries and frameworks while consistently delivering business value. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them.

**Here are some of our beliefs about work**

* **Work is only 1 part of your life** and not your entire life. We treat it as such.
* **Weekends are sacred** and not to be messed around with. So you won't be asked to work on one.
* **Side gigs are welcome**. We believe there are multiple avenues to learn and grow. So why restrict it only to work?
* **Asynchronous by-default**. Synchronous communication is expensive, so we default to writing docs and literature to enable async communication.
* **Good things come in pairs.** Errors get halved. Productivity, ideas and fun get doubled. Learning gets accelerated exponentially.
* **Learning from mistakes.** If you are not making mistakes and learning from them, you are not growing.

Apart from work, we continually invest in growing you as a professional and a human.

* **Extensive Boot Camp** - get to learn, regardless of your experience, about Data Structure and Algorithms, LLD, HLD, DevOps, frontend, backend and/or test engineering.
* **Book club** - broaden your horizons by picking up a book every month and have fun doing so
* **Brown Bag/ Tech Debt sessions** — every two weeks, someone on the team walks the rest through something they built, broke, or learned.
* **Internal Projects** - where your craft, experiment and learning precedence over deadlines. Also, try out new technologies and domains.
* **#Go\_Pros** — we push people to step forward: speak at meetups and conferences, contribute to open source, host Mumbai Meets AI (our free quarterly meetup; 5 editions, 470+ registrations so far). When you put your work out there, we amplify it.

**Growth requires mentorship**

We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. My co-founder, Braj, and I have more than a decade of experience in our respective fields. I will be mentoring you to become a better engineer and a coder. Braj will help you with domain expertise, product thinking and problem-solving. Ask us how it has helped our ex-employees in their careers when you chat with us.

**What's it like here**

We love debating over languages and frameworks and want someone who can bring their opinions to these discussions. We love reading/sharing articles, podcasts, and tech essays. If you are someone who loves tea or coffee, Marvel or DC, Peterson or Zizek, or even something eclectic, you will feel right at home. Continuous improvement is at the heart of everything we do at work & outside.

**This sounds good. But what exactly will you work on?**

Since we are a service company, you will have the advantage of working on a wide gamut of problems, technology & real world-wise. You will be involved in all stages of a product lifecycle. You'll never have to wonder why you are working on something because you'll always know it.

**What are you currently working on?**

We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. My co-founder, Braj, and I have more than a decade of experience in our respective fields. I will be mentoring you to become a better engineer and a coder. Braj will help you with domain expertise, product thinking and problem-solving. When you chat with us, ask us how it has helped our ex-employees in their careers.

Some of the sectors we are working on:

* Healthtech
* Edtech
* Insurtech
* Sportstech
* Fintech
* And much more!

Trust us, there's never a dull day at work.

**Here's what we expect from you**

* You love coding and think of it as a craft. We wouldn't have it otherwise.
* You have a strong grasp of **Java or Golang**, including core language fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, concurrency and writing efficient, maintainable code.
* You have experience building backend services and **REST APIs** using Java with Spring/Spring Boot or Golang. You understand API design, service communication and error handling.
* You have experience designing and building **scalable, distributed microservices**. You understand domain-driven design, service boundaries and the trade-offs involved in distributed systems.
* You understand database and storage fundamentals. You have experience working with **relational databases (SQL)** and familiarity with NoSQL data models, indexing, caching and query optimisation.
* You understand the importance of **performance, low latency and reliability**. You can identify bottlenecks, debug issues, benchmark applications and optimise systems for responsiveness and scalability.
* You write clean, testable code and follow good engineering practices. You have experience with unit testing, integration testing, code reviews and maintaining high code quality.
* You are comfortable working with **cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and messaging systems** such as Kafka. You understand how to deploy, monitor and maintain production applications.
* You aren't complacent about your skillset and have a hunger to learn more. You enjoy exploring new technologies, participating in architecture and design discussions, and solving challenging engineering problems.
* You are an **AI-forward engineer** who loves tinkering, experimenting and building with AI-driven and agentic development tools to improve how software is built.
* You like to share your learnings with others. You value collaboration, constructive code reviews and helping your teammates become better engineers.

**The fine print**

* **Experience**: 3-8 years
* **Location**: Bangalore (on-site)
* **Notice Period:** Immediate, serving or at max 30 days.

If you have made it this far, I think we should have a chat. Apply now!

title: O2C Senior AI Developer
description:
**The role & your impact**

We are establishing a new AI & Automation capability within Order-to-Cash to accelerate how we use AI and automation to improve customer service and operational efficiency. As an O2C Senior AI Developer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining AI-powered products that support our global Customer Service and Order Fulfilment functions.

You will join the Order-to-Cash Automation Developer team based in Bangalore and collaborate closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, IT, Salesforce Development, and the AI Center of Excellence. This is an opportunity to shape innovative AI solutions from concept through production while contributing to the future of customer service technology at Novonesis.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Design and build AI solutions end-to-end, translating customer service business requirements into scalable and practical technical solutions.
* Design and develop AI agents, prompts, instructions, grounding and retrieval approaches, and orchestration capabilities.
* Build and maintain solutions using technologies such as Python, TypeScript, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Power Automate, and related platforms.
* Take solutions from prototype through deployment into production environments.
* Define end-to-end solution architecture across AI, data, integrations, APIs, workflows, and cloud components.
* Make technology decisions that balance scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, and speed of delivery.
* Review, challenge, and improve technical designs and implementation approaches.
* Design and implement integrations between AI solutions, Salesforce, enterprise applications, APIs, and data sources.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration, application, AI, and production issues.
* Define and execute testing, evaluation, monitoring, and quality assurance approaches for AI solutions.
* Monitor solution quality, performance, and reliability and continuously improve solutions based on production results and user feedback.
* Break down complex requirements into development tasks and technical components.
* Participate in feasibility assessments, estimation activities, solution design discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Contribute to technical standards, documentation, development guidelines, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, the AI Center of Excellence, Salesforce teams, and business stakeholders.

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

* Proven hands-on experience designing, developing, and delivering AI, Generative AI, or agent-based solutions.
* Experience with agent instructions, prompting, grounding, actions, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and enterprise knowledge grounding.
* Experience evaluating, testing, debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting AI-powered solutions.
* Experience with enterprise AI and automation technologies such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Power Platform, or comparable platforms.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using Power Automate, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps, or similar technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, JSON, and Git.
* Experience working with modern software development practices and CI/CD approaches.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technology teams.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritized development activities.
* Ability to work effectively with architects, platform specialists, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Good understanding of security, permissions, identity and access management, enterprise data handling practices, responsible AI principles, and enterprise architecture concepts.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Experience as a Technical Product Owner, Solution Architect, Senior Developer, or in a similar role.
* Experience designing cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
* Understanding of services related to application hosting, serverless workflows, containers, databases, integrations, and enterprise data access.
* Adaptability and the ability to thrive in a fast-changing business and technology environment.
* Strong business mindset with a focus on creating value for users and business processes.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies, AI, automation, and enterprise platforms.
* Proactive approach to identifying opportunities, risks, bottlenecks, and improvements.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills across diverse stakeholders and functions.
* Pragmatic and quality-focused approach to solution delivery.
* Positive and constructive mindset that contributes to team engagement and success.

**What we offer you**

* An opportunity to help build and shape a new AI & Automation capability with significant business impact.
* Exposure to cutting-edge AI, automation, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Collaboration with colleagues across Supply Chain, IT, Salesforce Development, and AI disciplines.
* Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and technical development.
* A collaborative and innovative environment where ideas can be transformed into scalable business solutions.
* Meaningful work that contributes to improving customer experience and operational excellence.

**Working conditions**

* Hybrid working model with your primary workplace located in Bangalore.
* Working hours aligned with the Central European Time (CET) zone.
* Limited international travel as required by business and project needs.

**Relevant information**

Location: Bangalore, India

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Software Engineer - Siemens Teamcenter PLM, 9-13 Yrs, Bangalore
description:
Meet the Team
  
Join our diverse and inclusive Supply Chain IT team, part of one of the world’s leading Supply Chains. We deliver crucial services, tools, platforms, and data that power this top-tier operation. At Cisco, we prioritize innovation and continuous evolution, optimizing and automating business processes, employing cloud services, and developing ground breaking in-house solutions. You will be part of a dynamic, empowered, and collaborative team that values diverse perspectives and inclusive practices, passionate about building, supporting, and improving a seamless end-to-end Orchestrator system. We are committed to encouraging an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute outstanding ideas and experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
In this role, you will bridge design engineering with world-class supply chain operations to accelerate time-to-market, ensure product compliance, and drive supply chain excellence through our PLM platform. Collaborating with dedicated engineers and business partners, you will lead the end-to-end IT solution architecture for Siemens Teamcenter (Active Workspace), with expertise in Item& BOM Management, Engineering Change Management, Advanced Classification, Vendor Collaboration, and other modules. You will drive innovation by exploring AI-driven capabilities, establish standards for Teamcenter configuration, and ensure scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with long-term PLM strategy. Your leadership will guide functional teams, manage cross-track dependencies, and optimize workflows using emerging technologies such as AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect scalable BMIDE data models, dynamic LOVs, naming rules, revision/versioning rules, and Deep Copy Rules (DCR), adhering strictly to out-of-the-box design principles.
* Expore and implement emerging capabilities such as AI-driven automated part classification, geometric deduplication, and digital thread traceability from requirements to manufacturing execution.
* Partner with business leadership to challenge, rationalize, and finalize business requirements, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Establish principles for Teamcenter standardization, fit-to-standard approaches, configuration versus customization, and solution reuse.
* Evaluate sophisticated requirements to determine appropriate Teamcenter solutions, considering cross-module and cross-system impacts.
* Review and approve IT solutions, ensuring alignment across multiple project tracks and providing direction to functional leads and development teams on complex decisions.
* Identify cross-track dependencies, functional gaps, and risks, driving timely resolution to maintain project momentum.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 9-13 years of tactical experience in PLM implementations, including Siemens Teamcenter and Active Workspace
* Validated expertise designing integrations between Teamcenter and ERP systems
* Exceptional partner management skills with the ability to communicate architectural decisions to executive leadership and technical teams
* Strong understanding of AI/GenAI opportunities in PLM and enterprise applications
* Sophisticated knowledge of AI concepts and practical implementation experience, with strong security proficiency
* Solid understanding of Agile and DevSecOps practices and toolsets

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Deep supply chain proven experience, including high-tech hardware product development, NPI processes, multi-tier BOM structures, AVL/AML management, and contract manufacturing collaboration
* Experience with middleware technologies (SOA, REST, Kafka) and engineering data lakes
* Prior experience migrating legacy PLM systems (e.g., Oracle Agile PLM to Siemens Teamcenter)
* Ability to balance business needs, Teamcenter capabilities, AI/automation opportunities, customization, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Experience developing enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, and UiPath
* Siemens certifications (e.g., Teamcenter Deployment Specialist or Solution Architect)
* Experience with AI orchestration platforms and knowledge of vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or semantic search

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. title: Software Engineer III
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Bengaluru, KA

**About The Role:**

This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how we build and adopt AI tooling. Working alongside a Staff Engineer and within a wider delivery team, you will design and build agentic systems and the supporting services that put AI capabilities into everyday engineering practice.

You take ownership of meaningful components end to end, from design through to production operation. You are trusted to make sound technical decisions within an agreed direction, to raise the quality bar through the code you write and the reviews you give, and to help less experienced engineers around you grow.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

Reporting to an Engineering Director and working closely with the Staff Engineer for the domain, you deliver systems that are performant, reliable and maintainable. You contribute to design discussions, translate agreed architecture into working software, and take responsibility for the quality and operability of what you ship.

You will be a significant contributor to our adoption of the AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC) and Agentic development: piloting approaches, building the tooling that supports them, and feeding back what works and what does not.

  

**Domain / Systems Scope:**
---------------------------

The role sits within AI tooling, covering agent development, AI-assisted engineering workflows, and the AWS services that support them. You will build and maintain agents for a range of business use cases, integrate them with internal and third-party systems, and help harden promising prototypes into enterprise-grade services.

**Technical design, strategy and system ownership**

* Design, build and optimise services and components within the domain, with ownership of your areas end to end.
* Implement agentic solutions using Python together with frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, and integrate them through MCP and agent skills.
* Build and operate on AWS, applying good practice around security, reliability, observability and cost.
* Contribute to the rollout of AI-DLC practices and help assess which approaches suit which teams and problems.
* Take part in technical reviews, championing testing, code quality and craftsmanship.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, reuse and refactor, and raise them with the team.
* Support and mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review and example.
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC on the ground, working directly with delivery teams rather than from the sidelines.
* Act as an advocate and evangelist for AI-DLC, building understanding, confidence and momentum across the engineering organisation.
* Help teams evolve their ways of working, coaching them through the shift and adapting the process to the realities of their domain.
Identify gaps in tooling, process and capability, and lead the work to close them.  

  

**Sub-Domain/Code Expertise:**
------------------------------

You will work day to day across the following, with depth in several and a willingness to build depth in the rest:

* Python as the primary language for agent and tooling development, written to production standards.
* Agent frameworks and orchestration, including LangGraph and LangChain.
* The Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent skills, building and consuming tools that other teams rely on.
* AWS as the core platform, including Amazon Bedrock and, ideally, Bedrock AgentCore.
* AI coding harnesses and the supporting practices around evaluation, guardrails and context management.
* Observability and operational readiness for the services you own.
Infrastructure as code and automated delivery, with Terraform an advantage.  

  

**You’ll partner with:**

* The Staff Engineer for the domain, who sets technical direction and with whom you will design and review closely.
* Your Engineering Director and delivery team, planning and shipping work together.
* Engineering teams adopting AI-DLC, building MCPs, or agents: supporting them in practice and bringing their feedback back into the tooling.
* Product and business stakeholders, shaping use cases into something buildable.
Platform and Security teams, making sure what you ship meets the organisation's standards.  

  

**About you:**
--------------

* Strong Python skills and practical experience building agents or AI-assisted workflows, ideally with LangGraph, LangChain, MCP or agent skills.
* **A solid software engineering background, with experience delivering production systems in an enterprise environment.**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Hands-on AWS experience; this is essential. Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is a clear advantage.
* Exposure to AI coding harnesses and an interest in how AI changes the way software is built.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when requirements are incomplete and to ask the right questions to close the gaps.
* A self-starter who takes ownership of outcomes and moves quickly to a working deliverable.
* Clear communicator, able to work with multiple teams and explain technical decisions to varied audiences.
* Curious and current, actively following developments in a fast-moving field.
* Exposure to the AWS AI-DLC approaches preferred
Infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform good to have  

  

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

description:

We are seeking a technically strong and people-focused **Engineering Manager** to lead the development and lifecycle management of software for medical devices.

The role combines **technical leadership, people management, Life Cycle Engineering (LCE), cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance** . The Engineering Manager will lead a high-performing software team responsible for both new development and the long-term maintenance, security, quality, and regulatory compliance of released medical-device software.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical & Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of medical-device software using **Modern C++ (C++11/14/17 or later)** .
* Provide technical direction on software architecture, system design, interfaces, performance, and complex engineering challenges.
* Drive modular, scalable, testable, and maintainable software architecture across product generations.
* Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, static analysis, automated testing, CI/CD, and effective management of technical debt.
* Guide modernization and evolution of legacy software while maintaining product stability and backward compatibility.

**2. Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) & Product Sustenance**

* Lead **LCE and post-market software activities** for released medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive analysis and resolution of software defects, field issues, customer feedback, and CAPA-related actions.
* Manage software evolution across product variants, legacy platforms, and multiple device generations.
* Plan and execute software updates, patches, upgrades, technology refreshes, and obsolescence-related changes.
* Ensure appropriate impact analysis, risk management, verification, traceability, and documentation for software changes.
* Collaborate with Service, Quality, Regulatory, Product Management, and other stakeholders to ensure effective feedback from the field into product development.

**3. Cybersecurity & Compliance**

* Establish and drive **Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)** practices across new development and LCE.
* Ensure cybersecurity is considered throughout architecture, design, implementation, verification, release, and post-market activities.
* Drive threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, security-focused code reviews, penetration testing, remediation, and **Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)** management.
* Manage cybersecurity vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source software components.
* Ensure software engineering activities align with applicable standards and regulations, including **IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 81001-5-1** , and applicable regulatory cybersecurity requirements.
* Support audits, regulatory submissions, technical documentation, and post-market surveillance activities.

**4. People & Delivery Leadership**

* Build, develop, and lead a high-performing software engineering team.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and strengthen competencies in C++, architecture, cybersecurity, regulated development, and lifecycle ownership.
* Own resource, capacity, competency, and succession planning for the team.
* Establish clear technical ownership and accountability across new development and LCE activities.
* Plan and execute development and sustenance roadmaps, balancing feature development, quality, cybersecurity, technical debt, and lifecycle needs.
* Collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional teams including **Systems Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Service, DevOps, and Cybersecurity** .

**Education & Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **14+ years of software engineering experience** , including significant experience developing complex software systems.
* **3+ years of experience in engineering management, people leadership, or senior technical leadership roles** .
* Strong experience with **C++-based software products** .
* Experience across the complete software lifecycle, including development, release, maintenance, and product sustenance.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong technical knowledge of **Modern C++** , object-oriented design, multithreading, memory management, debugging, and system-level software development.
* Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns, refactoring, unit/integration testing, and legacy software modernization.
* Experience with **Git, Jira, Jenkins, SonarQube, static analysis, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines** .
* Ability to guide teams in investigating complex defects, integration issues, performance problems, and field-reported issues.

**Cybersecurity**

* Strong understanding of **secure software development and secure coding principles** .
* Knowledge of threat modeling, vulnerability management, penetration testing, dependency management, static analysis, and **SBOM management** .
* Understanding of security concepts such as authentication, authorization, encryption, secure communication, certificate management, and secure software updates.
* Experience incorporating cybersecurity considerations throughout the software lifecycle.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Proven ability to **lead, mentor, and develop software engineering teams** .
* Ability to combine **technical depth with people and delivery leadership** .
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.
* Experience working with global and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to balance **delivery, quality, cybersecurity, technical debt, and long-term product maintainability** .

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Medical Device & Regulatory Knowledge**

* Experience developing or maintaining software for **medical devices, safety-critical products, or regulated systems** .
* Familiarity with medical-device software development and applicable standards such as:
  + **IEC 62304** – Medical device software lifecycle processes
  + **ISO 14971** – Medical device risk management
  + **IEC 81001-5-1** – Health software cybersecurity
* Understanding of requirements management, risk analysis, traceability, verification and validation, change control, and regulated documentation.
* Experience with **post-market/LCE activities** , including field issue management, CAPA interfaces, software updates, vulnerability remediation, and product maintenance.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, submissions, or compliance activities is an advantage.
* Experience with **Class II/III medical devices** is an added advantage.

description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. The
**Principal Full Stack AI - Base Management**
is a hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, building, and shipping end-to-end, production-grade AI solutions. You will solve complex business problems using the right mix of AI paradigms—spanning Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, multimodal processing, and predictive/applied ML—wrapped in resilient, intuitive full-stack applications. Alongside direct solution delivery, you own the technical health and capability growth of our core delivery base, setting the architectural standards and production rigor that enable full-stack squads to consistently ship high-impact AI products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Full-Stack & AI Solutioning
* Complete Production Application Delivery: Architect and build full-stack AI applications end-to-end—owning responsive frontends, backend services, data pipelines, and model integration from initial design through live production scale.
* Pragmatic AI Architecture: Evaluate business problems and select the right technical approach—combining LLM reasoning, RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic workflows, fine-tuned task models, or classical predictive ML services rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all pattern.
* Data, Retrieval & Context Engineering: Design high-precision data ingestion, chunking, hybrid search (vector + keyword), reranking, and structured feature pipelines across enterprise databases and unstructured knowledge sources.
* Adaptive & Human-in-the-Loop UX: Build responsive web interfaces engineered for real-time token streaming (SSE/WebSockets), dynamic UI rendering, source citation traceability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review workflows.
* Production Hardening, Evaluation & FinOps
* Enterprise-Grade Reliability: Transition AI solutions from proof-of-concept to hardened production systems with deterministic guardrails, graceful model fallbacks, strict latency budgets, rate limiting, and PII/security compliance.
* Automated Evaluation & Quality Gates: Implement continuous evaluation harnesses that benchmark task accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, model drift, and regression safety prior to every production release.
* Inference & Cost Optimization: Instrument end-to-end tracing and implement intelligent model routing, semantic/prompt caching, and context optimization to maximize responsiveness and minimize cost per transaction.
* Base Management & Technical Governance
* Solution Architecture & Code Governance: Lead architecture reviews, define production-readiness checklists, and enforce clean code, testing, and API standards across the delivery base.
* Capability Building & Mentorship: Coach senior and mid-level full-stack specialists in end-to-end AI solutioning through hands-on pair architecture, design critiques, and internal technical workshops.
* Delivery Readiness & Hiring: Partner with technical and delivery leaders to assess skill gaps across the talent pool, structure onboarding ramp-up plans, and calibrate hiring rubrics.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading full-stack production architecture and 3+ years shipping live AI/ML and Generative AI solutions at scale.
* Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong command of asynchronous state management, real-time streaming protocols (SSE/WebSockets), and designing intuitive UX for probabilistic AI outputs.
* Backend & AI Solutioning: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO) and/or Node.js/TypeScript, with hands-on experience across LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom state machines), and serving predictive ML or multimodal models in production.
* Data & Search Systems: Production experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate), hybrid retrieval, and scalable ETL/data-ingestion pipelines.
* Cloud & Production Operations: Hands-on experience deploying containerized workloads on AWS, GCP, or Azure (Kubernetes/ECS), CI/CD automation, and AI observability/evaluation suites (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry).
* Leadership: Proven track record of owning complex technical deliverables end-to-end, resolving production bottlenecks, and elevating execution across multiple full-stack squads.

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

BE graduate with API and Microservices experience
