title: Tech Lead, Software Development Engineering
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Tech Lead, Software Development Engineering
  
  
**Senior Platform Engineer: Kubernetes & Internal Developer Platform**
**Role Introduction**
We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and help build and evolve our Kubernetes and Internal Developer Platform capabilities. You will design, develop, automate, and operate platform capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and run workloads across cloud and on-premises environments in a secure, standardized, and self-service way.
  
  
The role combines Kubernetes engineering, cloud technologies, software development, Infrastructure as Code, and automation. Depending on your strengths, there will be stronger focus on Kubernetes and platform engineering or IDP development and platform automation to provide features on top of strong Kubernetes layer. Our goal is to provide application teams with reusable platform services, APIs, automation, and golden paths that reduce operational complexity and improve developer experience.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build, develop, and maintain a modern Internal Developer Platform (IDP) providing self-service capabilities for application teams.
* Design and develop platform services, APIs, automation frameworks, and reusable components that simplify application onboarding and lifecycle management.
* Design, build, and support Kubernetes-based platform with focus on scalability, resilience, security, observability, repeatable global patterns and automation.
* Develop automation around Kubernetes cluster and workload lifecycle management, upgrades, configuration, policy enforcement, and operational processes.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Terraform, and contribute to reusable infrastructure modules and global platform patterns.
* Develop and enhance CI/CD and GitOps workflows for platform and application delivery.
* Build developer tooling, templates, golden paths, and self-service workflows that enable application teams to work independently.
* Integrate platform capabilities with cloud services, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD systems, identity and security services, observability platforms, and developer tooling.
* Partner with application teams to understand workloads and provide technical guidance on Kubernetes, cloud-native architecture, automation, and platform capabilities.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across Kubernetes, infrastructure, networking, and cloud layers.
* Apply software engineering practices to platform development, including Git-based development, code reviews, automated testing, versioning, documentation, and API design.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineering, SRE, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Product teams to deliver platform capabilities aligned with engineering and business objectives.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in Kubernetes, cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and AI-assisted engineering.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering, Software Engineering, or a comparable technical role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments.
* Good understanding of Kubernetes architecture, workloads, networking, ingress, storage, RBAC, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of at least one major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, Git, containers, and Docker/OCI-based technologies.
* Good Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, certificates/TLS, and cloud networking.
* Scripting or software development experience using Python, Go, Bash, or a similar language.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and modern software engineering practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology layers.
* Good English communication skills and ability to work effectively in a distributed international engineering organization.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or contributing to an Internal Developer Platform.
* Experience with Argo CD, Flux, Helm, or similar Kubernetes and GitOps tooling.
* Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or automation using Kubernetes APIs.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace or similar observability technologies.
* Experience with Kubernetes policy and security technologies such as Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper.
* Understanding of cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps principles.
* Experience supporting platforms used by multiple application teams in a large enterprise environment.

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Lead - Fullstack
description:
**Lead Software Engineer – Full Stack**

  
**Department:**
Engineering
  
**Role type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is building world-class software for customer onboarding, professional services, and modern service delivery teams.
  
  

We care deeply about product craft. Our engineers work closely with Product and Design to solve complex problems, build delightful user experiences, and create systems that remain fast and reliable as we scale.
  
  

If you enjoy owning a problem end-to-end — from the database and APIs all the way to the interactions a customer sees in the browser — this role is for you.
  
  
**What will you do?**

As a
**Lead Full Stack Engineer**
, you will own meaningful parts of the Rocketlane product from design through production.
  
  

You will:

* Design and build features end-to-end across our
  **React frontend and Java backend**
  .
* Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, thoughtful product experiences.
* Build polished, performant user experiences for complex SaaS workflows.
* Design clean APIs, data models, and backend services that can scale as our customers and usage grow.
* Solve challenging product problems involving real-time collaboration, rich interactive experiences, workflow automation, large datasets, and highly configurable enterprise use cases.
* Make thoughtful architectural decisions across frontend, backend, database, caching, and asynchronous processing.
* Own the performance and reliability of what you build — from browser performance through API latency and database queries.
* Debug complex issues across the entire stack rather than stopping at service boundaries.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews.
* Identify technical debt and proactively improve architecture, developer experience, observability, and engineering productivity.
* Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions.
* Take ownership of features in production and work with the team to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.
* Participate actively in engineering design discussions and influence how Rocketlane's technology evolves.

**You should apply if**
**Frontend**

You are comfortable with:

* React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
* SPA architecture and component design
* HTML and CSS
* State management and complex client-side application flows
* Browser fundamentals such as caching, storage, networking, and rendering
* Building reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture
* Frontend performance profiling and optimization
* Building responsive and high-quality product experiences

Experience with real-time applications, WebSockets, large data-heavy interfaces, rich editors, or spreadsheet-like experiences is a plus.
  
  
**Backend**

You have strong fundamentals in:

* Java and Spring or similar backend frameworks
* HTTP and REST API design
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* Data modelling and query performance
* Redis and caching
* Asynchronous processing and message brokers
* Designing scalable and resilient backend services
* Performance optimization
* Debugging and root-cause analysis
* Logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting

**Engineering fundamentals**

Beyond knowing frameworks, we expect you to understand
**why systems behave the way they do**
.
  
  

You should be comfortable discussing topics such as:

* API and system design
* Database transactions and concurrency
* Caching strategies
* Distributed systems fundamentals
* Failure handling and resiliency
* Performance and scalability
* Security and authorization
* Testing strategy
* Production observability
* Clean code and maintainable architecture

**What we're really looking for**

We're
**not looking for someone who is 50% frontend and 50% backend but shallow in both**
.
  
  

We're looking for an engineer who has strong depth in at least one part of the stack, solid engineering fundamentals across the other, and the ability to independently take a customer problem from:
  
  

**Problem → Design → Architecture → Backend → Frontend → Production**

You should be someone who asks:
  
  

“What is the right solution for the customer and the product?”
  
  

rather than:
  
  

“Is this a frontend problem or a backend problem?”
  
  
**You'll thrive here if**

* You enjoy owning problems rather than just completing tickets.
* You care about both
  **how a product works and how it feels to use**
  .
* You can move quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.
* You are comfortable working through ambiguity and breaking large problems into smaller ones.
* You enjoy collaborating directly with Product and Design.
* You are willing to dive into unfamiliar parts of the stack when the problem requires it.
* You care about performance, reliability, and maintainability — not just getting something to work.
* You enjoy mentoring other engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.
* You like learning, experimenting, and continuously improving the way software is built.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building B2B SaaS products
* Experience in a startup or high-growth product company
* AWS experience
* Docker/containerization experience
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience building real-time collaborative applications
* Experience with WebSockets
* Experience working with high-volume APIs or large datasets
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks
* Experience designing enterprise-grade integrations
* Exposure to AI-assisted product development or AI-powered product experiences

**Why Rocketlane?**
**Build challenging product experiences**

You'll work on problems that go well beyond basic CRUD applications — collaborative workflows, highly interactive interfaces, automation, data-heavy experiences, enterprise integrations, and increasingly AI-powered experiences.
  
  
**Own meaningful parts of the product**

Engineers at Rocketlane are expected to understand the problem, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from how customers use it.
  
  
**Work across boundaries**

You won't be constrained by artificial frontend/backend boundaries. If solving the problem requires changing the UI, API, data model, cache, or infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to work across all of them.
  
  
**Raise your engineering bar**

You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about building a world-class SaaS product.
  
  

And most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to look at something customers use every day and say:
  
  

**“I built that.”**

* Strong experience in designing, developing, and supporting Spring Boot Microservices deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes-based container platforms.
* Proven experience in deploying, debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting highly available production applications running on OpenShift.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, resiliency, exception handling, and application performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test, deployment, and release processes.
* Strong understanding of secure coding and engineering best practices, including secure configuration and secrets/credential management without hardcoding sensitive information.
* Strong understanding of containerization using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes, including application configuration, health checks, resource management, scaling, and deployment strategies.
* Experience in production support, root cause analysis, incident resolution, performance troubleshooting, and application monitoring/log analysis.
* Ability to perform technical design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and implementation guidance, while ensuring adherence to coding standards and engineering best practices.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Hands-on expertise with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, including query optimization, indexing, performance analysis, and troubleshooting.
* Strong hands-on experience with distributed messaging and event-streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka.
* Hands-on experience working with enterprise messaging technologies such as IBM MQ and Solace.
* Experience with Apache Camel or similar integration frameworks for message-driven and event-driven applications.
* Experience with application monitoring and log-analysis platforms such as Kibana/Elastic Stack.
* Understanding of high-availability, scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and business-continuity patterns for production-critical applications.
* Experience troubleshooting distributed applications across application, database, messaging, and infrastructure layers.
* Experience working in Agile environments, including collaboration with business, QA, infrastructure, production-support, and other technology teams.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Gitlab Duo, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar Generative AI tools for software development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation

This role will be based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

**Job Overview**

The Software Engineer is responsible for coding, testing and implementing products for our HRS Platform Team, which is increasingly focused on agentic and AI-driven engineering. This role is for engineers who have meaningfully adapted their day-to-day workflow (design, coding, testing and debugging) around AI-assisted and agentic development tools and who can bring that fluency to raise the bar for the broader team. Responsibilities include reviewing functional and technical requirements, performing research, designing solutions and developing code in a variety of programming languages for a Web + AI -based enterprise application.

 

Key responsibilities

**Engineering**

* Design, build, test and ship full-stack features in C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, SQL and a modern web front end.
* Write code that meets design specifications, follows team standards, and is easy to maintain.
* Review functional and technical requirements, research options, and propose designs. Write or contribute to design documents.
* Join design sessions and code reviews.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools in daily work, including code generation, coding agents, AI code review and test generation, to improve both speed and quality.
* Get reliable, production-quality output from agentic tools through good context engineering: agent instructions, skills, repo conventions and guardrails.
* Coach teammates on effective and responsible AI tool use, including review discipline, security and data-handling rules.

**AI in the product**

* Build and integrate LLM features into Tracker I-9, such as document extraction, RAG, agents and tool use, using Azure OpenAI and related Azure AI services.
* Add observability, evaluation and cost and latency monitoring to AI features. Make sure they meet compliance, privacy and security requirements for employee PII.

**Quality and delivery**

* Do unit, automation and peer testing so features ship fully tested.
* Ship through CI/CD on Azure DevOps, and help improve pipelines and engineering processes.
* Document your work. Give demos, training sessions and presentations when needed.
* Work with product, QA, hosting, infrastructure and DBA teams so project requirements are met.
* Recommend refactoring, process improvements, tools and new AI-driven development practices.

Required skills and experience

* 3+ years of professional software development, mostly in C# and .NET (.NET Core).
* Strong object-oriented design, design patterns and SOLID principles.
* ASP.NET Core and MVC, building RESTful Web APIs, and validation libraries such as FluentValidation.
* 3+ years of SQL and relational databases (Azure SQL / SQL Server), including query tuning, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper.
* Front-end development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework (Angular preferred). Experience with Bootstrap and jQuery is useful for legacy modules.
* Cloud development on Microsoft Azure: App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault and Managed Identity.
* CI/CD and Git on Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards).
* Unit testing and mocking with NUnit or xUnit and Moq or NSubstitute. Familiarity with test automation.
* Authentication and security protocols, including OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and secure coding practices (OWASP).
* **Hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools**
  such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar in your normal workflow. You should be able to explain specifically how they changed the way you design, code, test and debug.
* Understanding of how to manage agent instructions, skills, context and guardrails to get consistent, production-quality results from agentic tools.
* At least one shipped project where AI-assisted development clearly sped up delivery or improved quality.
* Strong logical reasoning, predictable delivery, and clear written and spoken communication.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About The Role**
In the role of Staff Software Engineer, you will report to the Platform Engineering Manager in Infrastructure.
  
  
We are considering applicants for the location(s) of Hyderabad, Telangana, India
  
  
As a Staff Software Engineer within the Infrastructure Engineering organization, you will lead the product strategy and technical execution of our Internal Developer Portal (IDP), a critical platform designed to boost developer productivity and streamline software ownership at scale. You will own the full-stack development of our IDP, from architecting scalable backend services to designing intuitive UI components that simplify complex developer workflows and operational tasks. Partnering closely with Engineering Operations and cross-functional teams, you will translate ambiguous requirements into an executable roadmap, ensuring our platform evolves to meet the future needs of Crunchyroll Engineering. Success in this role will be defined by your ability to deliver world-class developer experiences and drive adoption of self-service workflows which are secure, robust and reliable.
  
  
Core Areas of Responsibility
  
  

* Own the year-over-year technical strategy and product roadmap for the Internal Developer Portal, driving initiatives that enhance developer productivity and service ownership.
* Architect, build, and maintain full-stack features within the IDP, leveraging modern web technologies for the frontend and scalable backend systems for data aggregation and integration.
* Lead the design of developer-centric UI workflows, simplifying complex processes such as service creation, dependency mapping, and operational dashboarding.
* Implement comprehensive measurement frameworks to track usage metrics and platform health, continuously iterating based on data-driven insights.
* Collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams to drive adoption of platform standards, ensuring consistent access to tools and workflows across the organization.
* Participate in on-call rotations, owning the resolution of operational issues within your sphere of responsibility and actively reducing sources of toil.
* Coordinate effectively across time zones to align on project status, resolve dependencies, and ensure smooth hand-offs with engineering partners.

**About You**
We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
  
  

* You possess 12+ years of professional experience in high-scale production environments, with a proven track record of bridging the gap between robust software engineering and infrastructure operations.
* You are a Full Stack Expert: You are highly proficient in TypeScript (for modern frontend/portal development) and backend languages like Go or Python. You are comfortable modeling complex relationships in both relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non-relational (DynamoDB) databases to support service catalogs.
* You architect for security and scale: You possess deep expertise in infrastructure-adjacent domains, including complex authentication/authorization frameworks (OIDC, RBAC) and security protocols, and have successfully applied data sovereignty and privacy principles (e.g., GDPR) to platform architectures.
* You are a force multiplier: You don't just build; you guide. You have a history of establishing operational best practices and sharing knowledge across teams to elevate the engineering culture. You thrive in cross-functional environments, partnering with Product and Engineering Operations to ensure the platform directly supports business objectives.
* You demonstrate product-minded technical judgment: You excel at translating ambiguous business requirements into executable technical roadmaps, balancing the need for rapid iteration with long-term platform sustainability and developer experience. You make build-vs-buy and prioritization decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term platform sustainability in a fast-evolving AI landscape

Pluses
  
  

* You treat Platform as a Product: You have deep expertise in building Internal Developer Portals or platform experiences. You excel at translating complex SDLC workflows—such as CI/CD pipelines (GHA, CodeDeploy) and GitOps practices—into intuitive, self-service UI workflows that reduce developer friction.

**About The Team**
At Crunchyroll, our Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for the foundation on which our services are built. We directly influence our customer experience and the velocity of our engineers. Our team objectives are to ensure that our developers are enabled, our tools are self-service, that everything about our infrastructure is automated and consistent. Infrastructure engineering team members will engage directly with development teams on helping them become empowered and effective at delivering on our Infrastructure.
  
  
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
* Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Free premium access to Crunchyroll
* Professional Development
* Company's Paid Parental Leave
* up to 26 weeks for birthing parents
* up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Paid Time Off
* Flex Time Off
* 5 Yasumi Days
* Half-Day Fridays during the summer
* Winter Break

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
  
  

* Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

title: Temenos Triple'A Core TAP Developer/Lead
description:
**Role: Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Developer/Integration Lead**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Mode of Work: Hybrid / Remote**

**Experience Level: 5-8+ years 10 Positions/ 10+ Years 10 Positions**

**Domain: Wealth Management / Banking & Financial Services (Temenos WealthSuite)**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) consultant to design, build and support GUI customisations for wealth and portfolio management solutions. You will work with business analysts, architects and client teams to turn business requirements into well-built, tested and documented TAP configurations and customisations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**TAP GUI Customisation**

* Design, develop and customise TAP formats, screens, data validations (DV), input controls and GUI scripting to meet client requirements.
* Write and maintain TAP scripts for screen behaviour, validations, calculations and user interactions.
* Enhance existing screens and formats while keeping upgrades and release compatibility in mind.

**Business Logic and Configuration**

* Configure and tailor investment strategies and workflow designs.
* Configure and implement financial functions, such as valuation, transaction and operation history, performance and return analysis, and order entry.
* Set up constraints and rules, and configure parameters for the relevant business functions.

**Integration and Extensibility**

* Configure and troubleshoot TAP subscriptions for data exchange with upstream and downstream systems.
* Create and manage user-defined fields (UDFs) and other user-defined extensions, and handle the related data mapping.

**Delivery and Quality**

* Prepare functional and technical specification documents and design artefacts.
* Unit-test customisations, support UAT, and fix defects within agreed timelines.
* Review code and scripts against agreed standards, and help prevent regressions.
* Analyse and resolve client and project issues, including production support where required.
* Take part in estimation, sprint planning and release activities in an Agile team.

**Collaboration**

Work with business analysts, architects, testers and client stakeholders, and mentor junior consultants.

Communicate technical choices clearly and explain design trade-offs.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) / WealthSuite GUI customisation.
* Strong hands-on skills in formats, screens, DV, TAP scripting and input controls.
* Experience configuring strategies, workflow designs and financial functions.
* Experience with setup constraints, subscriptions and UDFs.
* Understanding of wealth and portfolio management concepts and common financial products.
* Strong debugging, analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Good to Have
* TAP certification (Bronze / Silver).
* Knowledge of TSL, OData, WUI / TCIB, TAP Gateway and import/export mechanisms.
* Experience with WTX maps, reporting tools (e.g. Actuate) and SQL/database skills.
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Confluence and version control (e.g. SVN).
* Basic Java, shell scripting or API knowledge.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Software Engineer – Workflow (.NET) | Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC)**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Workflow team within Deloitte Tax in India’s Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC). You will design, build, and support the workflow automation capabilities of the GES platform using .NET / C#, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven integration with Kafka, helping streamline business processes, modernize existing components, and deliver reliable, reusable platform services.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings 8 to 12 years of hands-on .NET development experience, including meaningful exposure to workflow or business process automation. You have strong engineering fundamentals, work well independently with minimal supervision, and collaborate and communicate effectively with your own team, other product teams, business users, and global delivery partners.

* Build services and components using .NET / .NET Core / C#.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
description:
Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
This position is based out of our India Development Center in
**Hyderabad.**
Who we are looking for
  
  
Join Truveta’s
**Intelligence Platform and Applications**
(IPA) team to build the next wave of healthcare AI — developing adaptive agentic systems and fine-tuned foundation models that continuously learn, reason, and accelerate real-world impact. Guided by Truveta’s mission of Saving Lives with Data, you’ll help transform how health data becomes intelligence, powering breakthroughs that enable researchers, clinicians and operational managers to make data-driven, proactive, and impactful decisions. We firmly believe that patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve to benefit from the artificial intelligence revolution that is transforming productivity, creativity, and communication. You’ll help shape the AI capabilities that make healthcare more intelligent, efficient, and equitable — driving real-world impact across research, care delivery, and patient outcomes. If you’re seeking a sense of purpose and are motivated to advance how AI supports learning, decision-making, and discovery in healthcare, you’ll find this an inspiring place to grow.
  
  
We are seeking AI Engineers who thrive at the intersection of agentic and applied AI, machine learning, and large-scale engineering. You’ll blend ML craftsmanship with platform engineering excellence to create scalable, self-improving AI agents and models that learn from vast, diverse healthcare data and deliver meaningful insights through automation and reasoning. As part of the IPA team, you’ll use your expertise in applied AI, model optimization, and agentic intelligence to create systems that think, adapt, and improve R&D, business strategy, operations and care delivery across the healthcare ecosystem. You’ll work in an ambitious, fast-paced and collaborative environment where every contribution helps make healthcare more connected, intelligent, and impactful.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Agentic AI
  
  

* Design and reason with agentic AI frameworks — experienced in building multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI, integrating reasoning, reflection, planning, tool use and memory to create intelligent, goal-driven systems. Have a deep understanding of capabilities of multi-modal models in agentic systems.
* Understand evaluation deeply — fluent in ML validation and measurement (Precision, Recall, Specificity, NPV, etc.), and experienced designing reward functions, evaluators, or grader models for reinforcement fine-tuning and continuous improvement. Good understanding of LLM as judges for qualitative and semantic evaluations.
* Fluency in embeddings and vector stores — experienced in building or integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search, or similar), and leveraging semantic search or context injection to enhance reasoning.
* Adapt and learn continuously — staying ahead of evolving AI architectures, agentic frameworks, and emerging paradigms in reasoning and retrieval. You have curiosity, humility, and a bias for iteration.

Machine Learning and LLMs
  
  

* A solid understanding of classical ML, and LLM fundamentals — knowledgeable in transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, and tokenization principles. You understand how embeddings, context windows, and model scaling laws influence quality, cost, and performance.
* Excellence in model fine-tuning — with hands-on expertise fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) or multimodal models using supervised, reinforcement, or instruction-tuning techniques (e.g., LoRA, PEFT, TRL). Skilled at optimizing model efficiency, interpretability, and inference performance.

Thought leadership
  
  
As a senior member of the development team, you must provide thought leadership to the team in the following areas:
  
  

* Collaboration across boundaries — partnering with platform, application, and product engineers to transform concepts into scalable, reliable AI solutions. You communicate clearly, share knowledge openly, and thrive in cross-functional teams.
* Solid engineering — grounded in strong software design principles, modular architecture, and code quality. You can translate experimental ideas into robust, maintainable systems that integrate seamlessly within large-scale AI platforms.
* Demonstrating ownership — capable of setting technical direction, mentoring peers, and making pragmatic design trade-offs that balance innovation, performance, and reliability.
* Acting with purpose — applying thoughtful engineering and ethical AI principles to create systems that advance healthcare intelligence responsibly and at scale.

**Key Qualifications**

* B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
* 5+ years of industry experience building and deploying scalable, production-ready ML systems in a collaborative engineering environment.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, with proficiency in Python and experience designing scalable systems in modern cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).  Experienced in modern development workflows such as code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and collaborative development tools. Experience with debugging, testing, feature flags, experimentation and version control (Git). Exposure to Python-based web services (FastAPI a plus) and containerized application development (Docker or Kubernetes).
* Proficiency with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and understanding of interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A. Deep experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) architecture, AI systems or APIs, or large-scale codebases is preferred.
* Experience working with vector databases and embeddings, integrating FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, or Azure AI Search into retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or semantic-search pipelines.
* Hands-on experience fine-tuning and optimizing large language models (LLMs) or multimodal models, using techniques such as LoRA, PEFT, and TRL.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with a pragmatic and collaborative approach to problem solving

  
  
Why Truveta?
  
  
Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional, and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.

title: Software Engineer CFD
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for motivated Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Software Engineers to join our CFD Solver Development team.
  
  
Our team develops the core thermo-fluid flow solver capabilities within Simcenter STAR-CCM+, Siemens’ flagship multiphysics simulation platform. These capabilities enable engineers across industries to model complex physical phenomena including turbomachinery, external aerodynamics, internal flows, heat transfer, combustion, and other thermo-fluid applications.
  
  
As a CFD Software Engineer, you will work at the intersection of CFD physics, numerical methods, software engineering, and high-performance computing. You will design and implement new solver capabilities, improve existing algorithms, and help ensure that our solvers are accurate, robust, computationally efficient, and scalable on modern parallel computing architectures.
  
  
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving challenging numerical and computational problems and translating advanced CFD methods into production-quality software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop core CFD solver capabilities: Design and implement numerical methods and solver components for Simcenter STAR-CCM+, contributing to the development of accurate, robust, and efficient thermo-fluid simulation capabilities.
* Solve complex numerical problems: Apply strong knowledge of CFD and numerical methods to address challenging problems involving the Navier-Stokes equations, aerodynamic and hydrodynamic flows, and complex physical phenomena.
* Develop high-performance software: Design and optimize CFD algorithms for highly parallel computing environments, with a focus on performance, scalability, memory efficiency, and heterogeneous architectures including GPUs.
* Innovate and enhance solver technology: Contribute to the conception, design, and implementation of new solver capabilities driven by product requirements, customer needs, and strategic technology initiatives.
* Improve existing capabilities: Investigate and resolve defects, refactor and modernize existing code, improve numerical robustness and performance, and maintain the quality of established solver functionality.
* Apply modern software engineering practices: Develop maintainable C++ software using appropriate object-oriented design principles, design patterns, testing practices, and coding standards.
* Collaborate and provide technical leadership: Participate in design discussions and code reviews, share technical knowledge, and collaborate with other CFD and software engineers to drive innovation and continuously improve solver technology.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD degree in Engineering, Computational Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, preferably with a strong focus on CFD, numerical methods, or high-performance scientific computing.
* 2+ years of commercial CFD software development experience, or approximately 5+ years of relevant non-commercial/research CFD software development experience.
* Strong understanding and practical experience implementing numerical methods for solving the Navier-Stokes equations and related CFD problems.
* Strong knowledge of aerodynamic and hydrodynamic CFD, with the ability to translate numerical and physical concepts into robust computational solutions.
* Strong hands-on expertise in modern C++ and object-oriented software development, with experience applying software design principles and patterns to complex applications.
* Experience developing or optimizing high-performance and highly parallel CFD algorithms, including experience with heterogeneous computing architectures such as GPUs/GPGPUs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with experience developing complex scientific software and working effectively within collaborative, multi-disciplinary engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Expertise in one or more physical domains such as thermodynamics, heat transfer, multiphase flow, or combustion.
* Experience applying CFD methods to vehicle/external aerodynamics, internal combustion engines, turbomachinery, or similar industrial applications.
* Experience with GPU programming, heterogeneous computing, or parallel programming.
* Experience with Java or other programming languages used in large-scale scientific software.
* Experience with source-control systems and modern collaborative development practices.
* Experience participating in design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and multi-team software development.
* Experience working with large-scale, client-server, or distributed scientific computing platforms.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**
**#DISWSIM**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment, automated testing, and continuous evaluation

**AI-Augmented Development**

* Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) to dramatically accelerate development workflows
* Use AI tools for code generation, refactoring, test writing, documentation, and code review
* Develop and maintain custom AI-powered developer tools, automations, and internal platforms

**Technical Documentation & Mentorship**

* Influence engineering culture by evangelizing AI-first development practices across teams
* Train and upskill team members on effective use of AI tools, LLM integration patterns, and ML best practices
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, tech talks, and communities of practice
* Partner with product, design, and data science teams to identify and deliver AI-driven opportunities
* Participate in architecture reviews and design discussions, ensuring AI solutions are production-ready from day one

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML solution development and delivery
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* AI/ML Expertise:

+ Strong understanding of large language model architectures, capabilities, and limitations
+ Proven track record building and deploying production AI systems (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, embeddings, vector search)
+ Proficiency with AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex)
+ Hands-on experience with major LLM providers and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock)
+ Solid understanding of prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies, and AI safety/guardrails

* Programming: Expert-level proficiency in Python; strong skills in at least one additional language (Java, TypeScript/Node.js, C#/.NET)
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Data: Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, ChromaDB), and data pipeline tools
* API Development: Proven track record building production APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and event-driven integrations
* AI Tools Proficiency: Advanced daily usage of AI coding assistants with demonstrated impact on productivity and code quality
* Testing: Strong testing practices for AI systems including model evaluation, integration testing, and automated quality checks
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex AI concepts to diverse audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms serving multiple product teams
* Familiarity with custom model training, fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), and RLHF techniques
* Experience with agent-based AI architectures and autonomous multi-step workflows
* Knowledge of AI security concerns (prompt injection, data leakage, model poisoning) and mitigation strategies
* Experience in regulated industries (insurance, finance, healthcare) with security and compliance requirements

title: Guidewire Senior Developer -QA - Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Guidewire Senior Developer - QA - Associate, you will engage in client support within our Technology Consulting practice, focusing on delivering quality solutions and enhancing client satisfaction. This role involves working closely with clients to understand their needs and implementing Guidewire solutions that align with their business objectives. You will be part of a dynamic team that values innovation and collaboration, providing you with the opportunity to develop your skills in a supportive environment.
  
  
As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources. You will be expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, embrace ambiguity, ask questions, and use these challenges as opportunities for growth.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the chance to work on diverse projects, enhancing your adaptability and reliability. This position offers a platform for personal growth and the development of a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Demonstrates expert abilities and extensive Application Managed Service projects and Quality Assurance Testing the Guidewire applications suite on premises and SaaS, with proven success executing and leading all aspects of complex engagements within the Guidewire product suite achieving on-time and on-budget delivery, as well as the following:
* Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLA’s, and contracting;
* Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Lead QA.
* Developing and configuring Guidewire BillingCenter and ClaimCenter applications to meet client requirements
* Integrating Guidewire systems with other software platforms to enhance functionality and streamline processes
* Participating in software development and system development tasks to support application evolution services
* Collaborating with teams to apply software development methodologies in project execution
* Utilizing intellectual curiosity to explore innovative solutions and improve system performance
* Engaging in active listening and accepting feedback to refine development processes and deliver quality outcomes
* Supporting client engagements by providing technical insights and solutions for Guidewire applications
* Applying teamwork skills to foster a collaborative environment and achieve project goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* QA experience in Guidewire applications testing both Manual and Automation
* Deep Expertise in Guidewire Policy Center and Working Knowledge on Billing Center and Claims
* Experience with both OOTB Guidewire functionality and client customizations for Policy, Billing and Claims Center for Property and Casualty Insurance companies
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2-4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

+ Ability to grasp business and technical processes analytically/strategically.
+ Work cross-functionally to assist with problem-solving and project plan activities.
+ Respond to inquiries, and requests in a timely fashion.
+ Effective written and verbal communication in a professional manner to management, business partners, associates, and external resource

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Actuarial Science, Business Administration/Management, Business Analytics, Commerce, Computer and Information Science, Computer Applications, Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering & Accounting, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Economics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Finance, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management/Research, Risk Management, Software App, Statistics

* Demonstrating proficiency in Guidewire BillingCenter and ClaimCenter
* Engaging in software development methodologies and system development
* Utilizing intellectual curiosity to drive innovative solutions
* Participating in GuideWire integration projects
* Excelling in teamwork and client support environments

title: Sr Engr Cslt-AI/ML Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
you will operate at the intersection of full-stack application development, modern distributed data engineering, and cutting-edge Agentic AI systems. You will lead cross-functional engineering pods, drive technical roadmaps, and guide application teams toward Verizon’s North Star architecture. You will architect end-to-end solutions that integrate responsive web applications, streaming data backbones, and multi-agent LLM workflows, while championing engineering excellence and accelerating business value.
  
  

* Architecting, designing, and leading the delivery of multi-tier, end-to-end solutions combining modern user interfaces, scalable micro-services, high-throughput data pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Designing and deploying autonomous agent frameworks, tool-calling ecosystems, ReAct loops, and multi-agent collaboration pipelines integrated with enterprise APIs, vector databases, and real-time knowledge graphs.
* Overseeing distributed streaming and batch data architectures (Kafka, Pulsar, Spark, Druid) to support real-time ingestion, feature stores, model training loops, and semantic retrieval systems.
* Driving technical excellence through hands-on code reviews, architecture governance, and performance profiling across UI rendering, micro-service latencies, and distributed query performance.
* Translating business priorities into scalable, fault-tolerant, cloud-native technical roadmaps aligned with Verizon’s enterprise architectural standards.
* Enforcing robust MLOps, LLMOps, and DevSecOps practices, driving automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, telemetry, and observability.
* Championing a culture of engineering rigor, experimentation, continuous learning, and cross-discipline collaboration within Scaled Agile (SAFe) environments, while mentoring engineers across pods.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You are excited to work in a dynamic cloud environment, driving innovation at enterprise scale. You are a self-directed technical leader with deep systems-level thinking and strong business acumen, comfortable guiding cross-functional pods and collaborating with executive, product, and data stakeholders to deliver next-generation AI-powered platforms.
  
  
**You'll Need To Have**

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant software and data engineering experience, including proven experience leading full-stack and distributed systems initiatives.
* Full Stack & Systems Architecture: Proven experience leading full-stack development using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern state management (Redux, Zustand), alongside resilient backend microservices in Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Flask), or Java/Spring Boot.
* APIs & Databases: Deep expertise building secure, low-latency RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC services, and working with distributed SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
* Data Engineering & Streaming: Hands-on experience architecting real-time streaming and batch pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, Spark, or Flink, as well as analytical/OLAP stores (Apache Druid, ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery) and distributed query optimization.
* Agentic AI & GenAI Engineering: Direct experience building autonomous agents (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex), implementing ReAct loops, plan-and-solve paradigms, dynamic tool calling, and Advanced RAG architectures (hybrid search, semantic routing, reranking, contextual chunking) backed by vector databases.
* LLMOps & Evaluation: Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks ,safety guardrails , and cost/latency caching strategies.
* Cloud, DevOps & Agile Leadership: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Helm, enterprise CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field.
* Prior experience working in telecommunications, network telemetry, or large-scale enterprise digital transformations.
* Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (PEFT) and deploying high-throughput inference workloads using LLM.
* Background in Scala or high-performance concurrent systems.
* Cloud certifications in AWS, GCP, or Azure (Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Specialty).
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge complex business objectives and deep technical execution.

**Why Verizon?**
Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice.
  
  

* We are a ‘pay for performance’ company and your contribution is rewarded through competitive salaries and performance-based incentives. We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad-based discretionary equity award program.
* Your benefits are market competitive and delivered by some of the best providers.
* You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions.
* We offer generous paid time off benefits to help you manage your work life balance and opportunities for flexible working arrangements\*.
* Verizon provides training and development for all levels, to help you enhance your skills and develop your career, from funding towards education assistance, award-winning training, online development tools and access to industry research.
* You will be able to take part in volunteering opportunities as part of our environmental, community and sustainability commitment.

Your benefits package will vary depending on the country in which you work.
  
  

* subject to business approval

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms, and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who will have a holistic approach about systems when driving the definition, building, deployment and operations of Solera applications in close collaboration with Dev, QA and Ops peers.
  
  
We are seeking an individual who will show ownership and can help build the appropriate bridges and processes across the various teams, leveraging experience with minimal direction, while balancing trade-off and strict processes and methodologies in a fast-paced environment. This individual will lead the creation and evolution of our CI/CD pipelines for deployment and operations of solutions across Solera’s various environments which may include on-prem or cloud systems.
  
  
Our products intersect with all the current and exciting trends in the automotive and transportation industries, and our business is growing every year. Our people and our platforms are the foundation and enabler of that growth.
  
  
We are expanding our team looking for technologists with a passion for developing highly available and distributed applications in the cloud, and a drive to deliver software products that make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.
  
  
These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  
**Our Stack**
We expect the ideal candidate to be proficient in the following technologies and tools (list not exhaustive), in particular the CI/CD and Infrastructure stacks:
  
  

* CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Helm Deploy, Spinnaker, Octopus Deploy, Jenkins, NuGet, SonarQube
* Source Control and Processes: Jira, Confluence, Git/GitHub
* Languages: Python, PowerShell, batch, bash
* Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, MSK, EC2, S3, ECR, Secrets Manager, Cognito, etc...), Terraform, Linux administration, Windows Server administration, Docker
* Backend: MS SQL Server, Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog
* Traditional internet and security protocols (HTTP, TLS, PKI)

**Our Team**
The IT team runs the entire infrastructure supporting Solera services and customers, powered by on-prem systems in our datacenter and a large public cloud footprint. The team, whose ownership and drive has no match, is composed of experts in DevOps, DataOps, Production Operations, IT, and Security. Our team is a global operation with support around the clock to ensure we fulfill the Solera Promise to our customers.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead the transition of legacy/manual deployment processes to a completely automated, DevOps ready posture
* Ownership in a very agile and fast paced environment of the CI/CD pipeline for deployment and operations of Solera AWS footprint
* Create and maintain the continuously evolving Solera DevOps CI/CD pipelines across Dev, QA and Production
* Create and maintain all cloud resources with Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Maintain stability across all environments with IaC
* Develop with cross-functional teams’ strategies towards higher organizational throughput via automation and flexible processes
* Design and create reliable continuous deployment solutions that will yield higher availability and uptime for our internal and external customers
* Manage operational cost with optimal resource utilization across on-prem and cloud services, including evolving capacity planning
* Help the team balance and plan longer term projects against the demands of a fast-changing environment
* Enforce security policies by ensuring vulnerabilities are tracked and timely addressed
* Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Solera environments
* Support Dev and QA teams along the steps of the Software Development Life Cycle by maintaining environments and tools
* Maintain and develop documentation to facilitate understanding of products, features, and tools, including training material
* Participate in rotations as necessary in a 24x7x365 organization

**Minimum Qualifications**

* B.S. or M.S. Degree in Computer Science/Computer Information Science or equivalent (M.S. highly desirable)
* 8+ years of experience driving CI/CD for systems being deployed to cloud providers (proficiency with AWS services and associated setup/operations)
* 8+ years of experience in a 24x7x365 global SaaS/PaaS operation
* 8+ years of experience with virtualization and Docker containers
* Proficiency with scripting languages (PowerShell, batch, bash, Python, or equivalent)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* You demonstrate proficiency the technologies in our stack (see above) with 8+ years of experience in a large portion of the tools and technologies we leverage, in particular the CI/CD and Infra stacks.
* You demonstrate a high sense of urgency and ownership
* You take great pride in helping teams and individuals
* You have competence in building and designing complex systems leveraging multiple technologies (legacy and new)
* You can demonstrate and ensure consistency in line with industry best practices for CI/CD, code quality, operational readiness, and security
* Strong organizational skills in a fast paced and fast changing environment
* You are driven, self-motivated to learn and ramp up fast
* You are candid and can hold your own as the DevOps representative in cross-functional teams
* Be able to perform training and knowledge transfers

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Company**

**Opella**
is a global consumer healthcare company, focused on over-the-counter
**(OTC) medicines and self-care**
products. Opella is currently the
**third-largest player globally**
in the OTC and vitamins & supplements market and operates in over
**100 countries**
. The company has a workforce of around
**11,000**
employees and a strong portfolio of more than
**100 well-known brands**
, including Allegra, Dulcolax, and Doliprane.

**About the Role**

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in building and maintaining Opella’s cloud and automation foundations. This position requires strong hands-on expertise in Azure, Terraform, and GitHub, ensuring secure, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure. You will contribute to defining governance models, ways of working, and technical implementation standards that will shape Opella’s cloud and DevOps landscape. Experience with observability or monitoring tools such as New Relic or Splunk is considered a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, governance alignment, and security across environments.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment provisioning, and state management.
* Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines through GitHub Actions, automating infrastructure deployments, testing, compliance, and platform configuration.
* Establish and uphold GitHub governance, including repository standards, branch protection, code scanning integration, and secrets management.
* Define and promote DevOps ways of working, contributing to cloud governance frameworks, automation strategies, and platform engineering standards.
* Collaborate with application, architecture, and operations teams to integrate Azure services, harmonize cloud patterns, and improve developer productivity.
* Support modernization and migration initiatives, leveraging automation and IaC for deployment, configuration, and environment lifecycle management.
* Participate in architectural and design discussions, providing expert guidance on cloud infrastructure, automation patterns, and DevOps best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance tooling, efficiency, operational reliability, and cloud maturity.

(Nice to have) Observability-related responsibilities

* Support the migration from Splunk to New Relic when required.
* Assist teams in implementing logging, metrics, APM instrumentation, or dashboards in New Relic.
* Contribute to observability governance and standardization efforts.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering roles.
* Strong practical expertise in Azure, Terraform, and GitHub/GitHub Actions.
* Experience defining or supporting cloud governance, automation standards, and infrastructure best practices.
* Exposure to observability technologies (e.g., New Relic, Splunk) is a plus.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated, and globally distributed environment.

**Required Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, take initiative, and deliver results with minimal supervision.
* Strong proactive mindset, anticipating challenges and driving solutions independently.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical concepts to diverse, non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with cross-functional and international teams.
* Ownership-driven, with a focus on continuous improvement, quality, and operational excellence.

title: Principal DevOps Engineer
description:
**Core Responsibilities**

* CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build, maintain, and update continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines (using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) to automate code testing and deployment.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision, scale, and manage cloud or hybrid environments programmatically using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
* Cloud & Server Administration: Manage virtual machines, cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking configurations (DNS, load balancers, firewalls), and user permissions.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Package and scale applications using Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift.
* Monitoring & Observability: Track system health, application performance, and logs using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Splunk to spot bottlenecks early.
* Incident Response & Troubleshooting: Debug live production issues, handle quick rollbacks, and minimize downtime or service outages.
* Security & Compliance (DevSecOps): Integrate automated vulnerability scans, security policies, and patch management into the pipeline.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work directly with developers, QA testers, and IT operations to align on release requirements and best practices.

**Key Skills Needed**

* Scripting & Coding: Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for writing automation scripts.
* Operating Systems: Strong command of Linux/Unix system administration.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

**Soft Skills:**
Problem-solving under pressure, communication, and team alignment

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
****Responsibilities****
The OUX Infra Engineer owns the infrastructure foundation that the Octave Unified Experience (OUX) platform runs on. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the Kubernetes-based infrastructure, database layer, Microsoft Fabric integration points, and the Refold MCP service that together enable Platform Studio and all OUX shell applications to function reliably at scale, across multi-tenant customer environments. This is a platform infrastructure role with a product engineering sensibility — the infrastructure you build directly determines what developers and customers can do on the platform.
  
  

* Design, deploy, and operate the Kubernetes infrastructure underpinning the OUX platform — cluster configuration, namespace strategy, resource management, autoscaling, and multi-tenancy isolation
* Own the PostgreSQL database layer for the OUX platform — schema design, provisioning, backup and recovery, performance tuning, and migration strategy for the ontology tool and Platform Studio backend services
* Build and maintain the Microsoft Fabric integration infrastructure — service principal configuration, workspace provisioning, lakehouse connectivity, and Fabric API authentication patterns for the platform's data pipeline triggers
* Deploy and operate Refold as the platform's MCP tool configuration service — maintaining the Refold API surface, its integration with the agentic framework, and the infrastructure reliability guarantees the MCP
* Designer tool depends on
* Design and implement the tenant provisioning infrastructure — automated onboarding of new customer tenants, namespace isolation, credential management, and per-tenant resource quotas
* Own infrastructure security posture: network policies, secrets management (Azure Key Vault), certificate lifecycle, and the ingress/reverse proxy layer
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Terraform, or Helm) and application deployment across environments
* Instrument the infrastructure layer with observability tooling — metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and cost-per-tenant dashboards feeding the platform's commercial reporting
* Collaborate with the OUX UI Engineer on security architecture — AuthN/AuthZ integration (Ory, Azure AD), CORS policy, and penetration testing remediation

****Education / Qualifications****

* 6 - 8 Years in platform or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on production Kubernetes experience (AKS strongly preferred)
* Strong proficiency with PostgreSQL — schema design, performance tuning, HA configuration, and operational management
* Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure services: AKS, Azure Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitor, and Azure networking
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric administration — workspace management, capacity configuration, service principal access, and API-based provisioning
* Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools (Bicep, Terraform, or Pulumi) and GitOps practices
* Experience designing and operating multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure — namespace isolation, resource quotas, and tenant lifecycle management
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes security primitives — RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, and secrets management
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable)
* Solid understanding of OAuth2/OIDC and enterprise identity integration patterns

NICE TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience with Refold or comparable MCP service infrastructure
* Familiarity with Ory (Hydra, Kratos) for identity and access management
* Background in industrial or capital project software infrastructure environments
* Experience with FinOps tooling and cost-per-tenant attribution in cloud environments
