title: Sr DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**Role**
Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain
  
  
**The Team**
The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions span DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly.
  
  
**The Impact**
You will embed security governance into the software delivery lifecycle by translating requirements into clear policies and automated controls. Your work will protect source control, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure and the software supply chain without creating unnecessary friction for engineers. You will strengthen credentials, secrets and non-human identity governance; drive security findings through to remediation; and contribute to AI-assisted development governance and developer endpoint security. Working with platform teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will support audit and compliance and make secure practices the default across S&P Global.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
Help shape how thousands of engineers build and ship software securely. You will work hands-on with enterprise security tooling and emerging areas such as AI tool governance and policy as code. You will own controls end to end, from policy design to automated enforcement, and collaborate with InfoSec, audit and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, certification support and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments.
* Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows.
* Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain.
* Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray.
* Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK.
* Contribute to governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security.
* Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and support audit and compliance activities.
* Partner with platform and engineering teams to automate security controls and drive adoption.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security governance.
* Strong experience designing and automating enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of source control security and common pipeline threats.
* Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies.
* Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows.
* Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning or cloud security tools.
* Ability to write clear security policies and standards and translate them into technical enforcement.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege.
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code, including Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK, and familiarity with configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js.
* Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails.
* Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and Cursor IDE, and developer agents/MCP integrations.
* Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems.
* Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel.
* AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD).
* Security certifications, such as CSSLP, Security+ or AWS Security.

**Technical Environment**
**Source Control & CI/CD Security:**
GitHub Enterprise security features, GitHub Actions hardening, OIDC and GitHub Apps
  
  
**Application Security:**
SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GHAS
  
  
**Cloud & Container Security:**
Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability tools
  
  
**Software Supply Chain:**
Artifactory/Xray or similar tooling, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and artifact signing
  
  
**Secrets & Identity:**
Vault or other secrets managers, Okta or similar tooling, and non-human identity governance
  
  
**Runners & Endpoints:**
Runner hardening tools and MDM
  
  
**AI Governance:**
Copilot controls, MCP and agent guardrails
  
  
**Monitoring:**
Splunk or similar security information and event management (SIEM) tooling
  
  
**Automation & Cloud Security:**
Python, Bash, Terraform and AWS security (IAM, KMS)
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technology-related field.
  
  
**What’s In It For**
**You?**
**Our Mission**
Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  
**Our People**
We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  
**Our Values**
**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**
Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits**
We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
**Our Benefits Include**

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

description:

**DevSecOps Architect – Software Supply Chain Security**
**Location:**
Hyderabad (Work from Client Location)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Contract 6months (extended)
  
  
**Company:**
New Era Technology
  
  
**Work mode**
: Hybrid
  
  
**Summary**
:
  
  
New Era Technology is seeking a hands-on DevSecOps Architect to help Commvault protect the way it builds software. The role will design and operate software supply chain security controls that keep build pipelines, dependencies, Kubernetes environments, and software artifacts trustworthy from commit through release.
  
  
**Role Overview**
:
  
  
This is a hands-on architecture role focused on software supply chain security rather than policy development. The selected contractor will work directly in GitHub and GitLab, instrument SBOM generation across products, implement security as-code and policy-as-code guardrails, secure Kubernetes-based build and deployment environments, threat model pipelines and AI-assisted development workflows, and close risks introduced by attackers, vulnerable dependencies, and AI-generated code.
  
  
**Client Environment Context: The contractor will:**

* Design and implement software supply chain security architecture across Commvault's build and release pipelines. Own SBOM generation, validation, and distribution using tools such as Syft, CycloneDX, or SPDX, and integrate SBOM output into CI/CD.
* Harden GitHub and GitLab environments through branch protection, signed commits, provenance attestation, and access controls.
* Implement artifact signing and verification using technologies such as Sigstore and Cosign, and enforce provenance checks before deployment.
* Build automated dependency and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines and drive remediation with engineering teams.
* Define and enforce policy-as-code guardrails for third-party and open-source component risk across the software development lifecycle.
* Apply security-as-code principles so pipeline, infrastructure, and Kubernetes controls are version-controlled, tested, and repeatable.
* Secure Kubernetes-based build and deployment environments, including admission control, image provenance, network policy, and workload policy enforcement.
* Run threat modeling exercises against build pipelines, release infrastructure, and AI-assisted development workflows to identify and close attack paths.
* Evaluate and secure AI-assisted coding tools and AI-generated code entering the pipeline.
* Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to align controls with SLSA, NIST SSDF, and NIST SP 800-218.
* Create runbooks, reference architectures, and durable documentation for engineering and audit audiences.
* Mentor engineering teams on secure pipeline practices and shift-left security habits.

**Required Technical Skills:**
Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in most of the following areas:
  
  

* 5-8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security, or platform engineering, with direct ownership of CI/CD security.
* Hands-on expertise with GitHub and GitLab, including Actions, pipelines, and administration of enterprise-scale instances.
* Practical experience generating and managing SBOMs using SPDX or CycloneDX at scale.
* Working knowledge of SLSA, NIST SSDF, and NIST SP 800-218.
* Experience with artifact signing and provenance tools such as Sigstore, Cosign, or in-toto.
* Hands-on Kubernetes security experience, including admission controllers, network policy, image provenance, and workload hardening.
* Practical experience with security-as-code and policy-as-code tools such as Open Policy Agent, Kyverno, or Conftest.
* Working knowledge of threat modeling methods such as STRIDE or attack trees applied to pipelines and infrastructure.
* Awareness of AI-specific supply chain risk, including AI-generated code and AI coding assistants.
* Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Familiarity with container security and registries, including Docker, OCI images, Harbor, or similar technologies.

**Required Education:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with cloud-native security tooling in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Background in a regulated or enterprise software environment.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms such as Snyk, Dependency Track, or similar tools.
* Prior contract or consulting experience delivering security architecture to a distributed engineering organization.

**Target Experience Level:**
5-8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security, or platform engineering, including direct ownership of CI/CD security.
  
  
**Qualifications and Competencies: The successful candidate should demonstrate:**

* Hands-on, implementation-oriented approach to security architecture.
* Strong analytical and threat-modeling skills across software pipelines and infrastructure.
* Ability to translate supply chain risk into automated, enforceable engineering controls.
* Excellent documentation skills for architecture decisions, runbooks, reference designs, and audit evidence.
* Strong written and verbal communication with both engineering and audit stakeholders.
* Collaborative working style across security, development, platform, compliance, and distributed delivery teams.
* Ability to mentor engineering teams on secure pipeline practices and shift-left security.
* Comfort working across US and India time zones with overlapping collaboration hours.
* Self-directed execution, attention to detail, and a focus on durable, repeatable controls.

**How to Apply:**
Please Send your updated resume to
**Sravani.Karri@neweratech.com**

title: Sr. Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Join Us as Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer!**

ORBCOMM is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure that powers our global business and customer-facing platforms. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing cloud modernization, automation, platform reliability, and operational excellence across our multi-cloud environments.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

As a member of our Information Technology & Security team, you will partner closely with application, database, security, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud-native solutions that support enterprise operations and customer experiences.

Based in Hyderabad, India, you will contribute to the evolution of ORBCOMM’s cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping drive scalability, resiliency, and innovation across the organization.

This position is based in our Hyderabad office and will be working an onsite work schedule.

**What You’ll Do**

**Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering**

* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments.
* Develop scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant infrastructure solutions.
* Support enterprise and customer-facing applications with a focus on security, performance, and reliability.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver cloud-native infrastructure and platform services.
* Lead cloud modernization initiatives and infrastructure migration projects.

**Scalability & Performance Optimization**

* Design infrastructure capable of supporting business growth and increasing workload demands.

* Drive continuous improvements in infrastructure resiliency, recoverability, and operational maturity.

* Support compliance initiatives, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other applicable frameworks.

You are an experienced cloud infrastructure professional who thrives in complex, high-growth environments. You bring deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and infrastructure engineering, along with a passion for building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that support business-critical workloads.

**If You Have**

* 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

* Proven success designing systems that support business growth, high transaction volumes, or global user bases.

* Experience administering both Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

**Preferred**

* Azure and/or AWS cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms and distributed applications.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
* Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

**The Benefits of Working Here**

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
The
**Principal Full Stack AI - Base Management**
is a hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, building, and shipping end-to-end, production-grade AI solutions. You will solve complex business problems using the right mix of AI paradigms—spanning Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, multimodal processing, and predictive/applied ML—wrapped in resilient, intuitive full-stack applications. Alongside direct solution delivery, you own the technical health and capability growth of our core delivery base, setting the architectural standards and production rigor that enable full-stack squads to consistently ship high-impact AI products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End Full-Stack & AI Solutioning
* Complete Production Application Delivery: Architect and build full-stack AI applications end-to-end—owning responsive frontends, backend services, data pipelines, and model integration from initial design through live production scale.
* Pragmatic AI Architecture: Evaluate business problems and select the right technical approach—combining LLM reasoning, RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic workflows, fine-tuned task models, or classical predictive ML services rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all pattern.
* Data, Retrieval & Context Engineering: Design high-precision data ingestion, chunking, hybrid search (vector + keyword), reranking, and structured feature pipelines across enterprise databases and unstructured knowledge sources.
* Adaptive & Human-in-the-Loop UX: Build responsive web interfaces engineered for real-time token streaming (SSE/WebSockets), dynamic UI rendering, source citation traceability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review workflows.
* Production Hardening, Evaluation & FinOps
* Enterprise-Grade Reliability: Transition AI solutions from proof-of-concept to hardened production systems with deterministic guardrails, graceful model fallbacks, strict latency budgets, rate limiting, and PII/security compliance.
* Automated Evaluation & Quality Gates: Implement continuous evaluation harnesses that benchmark task accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, model drift, and regression safety prior to every production release.
* Inference & Cost Optimization: Instrument end-to-end tracing and implement intelligent model routing, semantic/prompt caching, and context optimization to maximize responsiveness and minimize cost per transaction.
* Base Management & Technical Governance
* Solution Architecture & Code Governance: Lead architecture reviews, define production-readiness checklists, and enforce clean code, testing, and API standards across the delivery base.
* Capability Building & Mentorship: Coach senior and mid-level full-stack specialists in end-to-end AI solutioning through hands-on pair architecture, design critiques, and internal technical workshops.
* Delivery Readiness & Hiring: Partner with technical and delivery leaders to assess skill gaps across the talent pool, structure onboarding ramp-up plans, and calibrate hiring rubrics.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading full-stack production architecture and 3+ years shipping live AI/ML and Generative AI solutions at scale.
* Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong command of asynchronous state management, real-time streaming protocols (SSE/WebSockets), and designing intuitive UX for probabilistic AI outputs.
* Backend & AI Solutioning: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO) and/or Node.js/TypeScript, with hands-on experience across LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom state machines), and serving predictive ML or multimodal models in production.
* Data & Search Systems: Production experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate), hybrid retrieval, and scalable ETL/data-ingestion pipelines.
* Cloud & Production Operations: Hands-on experience deploying containerized workloads on AWS, GCP, or Azure (Kubernetes/ECS), CI/CD automation, and AI observability/evaluation suites (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry).
* Leadership: Proven track record of owning complex technical deliverables end-to-end, resolving production bottlenecks, and elevating execution across multiple full-stack squads.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Advisor Pharma Procurement
description:
**ABOUT AXENSION AI**

Axension AI is a next-generation software technology company building powerful, autonomous, and intelligent AI systems that redefine how work gets done. We design and engineer agentic AI architectures, intelligent models, and automation platforms capable of reducing manual operational workload by up to 60% or more across multiple industries.Our mission is to create AI systems that do not simply respond they reason, plan, decide, and execute. We believe the future of software lies in autonomous intelligence, and we are building the core technologies that will power that future.

At Axension AI, "Acceleration to Ascension" is not just a tagline it is our philosophy. We help organizations ascend through innovation and accelerate through intelligent automation.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a senior pharmaceutical procurement leader to join us as a Senior Advisor.We did not start by building software and then looking for a problem. We walked the floor of 70+ pharma plants, sat with procurement teams, and identified the real, daily pain firsthand and only then engineered our solution: an agentic operating system for pharma procurement, not just another "AI agent."We now want a veteran who has lived this world for decades to advise us directly sharpening the product, validating the value, and shaping the metrics that prove its impact.

A Senior Advisor — someone who has genuinely lived in pharma procurement for years — to guide our product team on each feature we build, validate whether we're solving the right problems, help us define credible impact metrics, and where useful and add their profile in our LinkedIn page to lend industry credibility.

This is an advisory role, not an operational one — roughly 2 to 3 hours a day (as per requirement)

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

As our Senior Advisor Pharma Procurement, you will:Advise on product direction so our agentic operating system maps precisely to real procurement workflows sourcing, vendor management, contracting, compliance, and day to day operations.

Validate the pain points we identified across 70+ pharma plants and help us prioritise what to solve next.

Help define and validate impact metrics for example, hours saved per procurement professional per day (early target: 1.8+ hours/day per user), procurement cycle-time reduction, and cost/efficiency gains so customer outcomes are measurable and credible.

Guide pilots and deployments with pharma customers, helping ensure the solution lands in live operations and delivers proven, demonstrable results.Help us position the product correctly to the market as an agentic operating system for pharma procurement distinct from the now-overused "AI agent" label.

Lend industry credibility and, where appropriate, open relationships across the pharmaceutical ecosystem.

**REQUIREMENT**

05–35 years of experience in pharmaceutical procurement, with significant time in senior or leadership roles.Deep, hands-on knowledge of pharma procurement end-to-end: strategic sourcing, vendor/supplier management, contract negotiation, category management, and procurement compliance.

Strong understanding of pharma manufacturing operations and the regulatory/quality environment procurement works within e.g., GxP-adjacent sourcing of raw materials, APIs, excipients, packaging, and services.

Demonstrated track record of driving measurable efficiency, cost, and cycle-time improvements.

An established network within the pharmaceutical industry.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

A strategic thinker who has also done the operational work someone who knows exactly where a procurement team's time actually goes.

Genuine curiosity about AI and automation, and a belief that intelligent systems can transform how procurement runs.

Someone who values evidence comfortable helping us build, validate, and stand behind hard metrics.

A collaborative, candid advisor who is invested in seeing the solution succeed in the real world.

**WHAT YOU'LL GAIN**

A direct hand in shaping a category-defining product in agentic AI for pharma procurement.Direct influence over a solution built from real plant-floor insight not theory.

Close association with a fast-moving, next-generation AI company and its leadership.

A meaningful advisory engagement, with recognition and hourly compensation.

The opportunity to leave a lasting fingerprint on how an entire industry modernises its procurement operations.

title: Senior Analyst/Manager – AI/Technology Development (TIS)
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Portland, Houston, and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent, along with native LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google).
* Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs in Python, exposing capabilities via REST and gRPC.
* Build LLM-driven automations (e.g., document intelligence, workflow copilots, chat-to-action systems) to augment or replace manual processes across investment, operations, and analytics.
* Integrate LLMs with structured and unstructured data sources, including databases, document stores, and third-party APIs.
* Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and iteration.
* Establish evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM systems, balancing cost, latency, and reliability.
* Ensure AI safety and responsible use, including prompt-injection mitigation and PII handling.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into production-grade AI solutions.
* Contribute to code reviews, system design discussions, and engineering best practices using GitHub-based workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 3–5 years of software engineering experience and hands-on exposure to applied AI / LLM systems in production.
* Own end-to-end frontend development for internal AI tools and copilots (React, Next.js, TypeScript), including component architecture, state management, and production deployment — not limited to prototyping.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
* Strong Python expertise with experience building scalable APIs (REST/gRPC) and production-grade backend systems.
* Hands-on experience with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and agent frameworks (LangGraph or similar), including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and building AI applications (automation, copilots).
* Experience building lightweight UIs (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and ability to prototype and iterate quickly in ambiguous environments.
* Clear communicator with a strong ownership mindset for production systems (reliability, cost, and user experience) and awareness of evaluation, observability, and AI safety best practices.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
  
  
You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

* Implement approved personalization capabilities and privacy-conscious analytics events, including GA4 event contracts, in coordination with analytics and integration teams.
* Identify and recommend improvements to development practices, AI tooling, prompt and evaluation approaches, documentation, and platform capabilities that increase quality and delivery efficiency.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of software development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital platforms in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud solutions using React, Next.js, Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, and Vercel.
* Experience implementing or extending SitecoreAI features, AI-assisted content workflows, intelligent search or discovery, personalization, or related generative AI capabilities within a digital experience platform.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript, component-based development, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns for approved AI services.
* Experience with content modeling, templates, component configuration, metadata, publishing workflows, and authoring experiences in Sitecore.
* Working knowledge of Sitecore Helix principles, headless implementation patterns, composable DXP architecture, and responsible AI development practices.
* Ability to design prompts, structured inputs, guardrails, and practical evaluation scenarios for AI-enabled features, and to assess outputs for quality, relevance, accuracy, privacy, and security.
* Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment practices.
* Experience integrating Sitecore with third-party and enterprise systems, such as analytics, identity, CRM, consent management, search, marketing platforms, or AI services.
* Ability to diagnose application, rendering, caching, API, deployment, AI integration, and content-delivery issues across environments.
* Understanding of web security, data privacy, accessibility, scalability, performance optimization, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and AI-related decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing while aligning with the Sitecore Architect’s technical direction.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Experience with additional Sitecore products, such as Content Hub, Search, CDP, Personalize, or SXA.
* Experience developing with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI APIs, or agent-based workflows in an enterprise environment.

Build the complex systems that move SimCorp's clients' data and trades. Turn continuous learning into a platform that scales with our growth. Raise the bar on development and testing so quality is designed in, not inspected in. Grow domain depth in applied finance and investment management — and turn it into products clients can't work without. Investment Operations Product Areas (Data & Post-trade Engineering Line).
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
You will be a member of a self-organized scrum team consisting of software engineers, who collaborate closely with business experts. The team is responsible for developing and supporting a set of enterprise products within the Collateral Product Area. You are expected to interact with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark, Austria, and Germany. After a comprehensive onboarding program, we expect you to:
  
  

* Design, develop, and test solutions for a new product capabilities.
* Create and implement test strategy to ensure high quality of the product.
* Closely communicate and collaborate with Teams, Product Owners, and Architects follow and ensure architecture/technical roadmap & guidelines
* .Create and analyze functional and non-functional requirements during feature refinements.
* Ensure outstanding product support and proactively minimize it.
* Initiate technical and process enhancements in the team.
* Initiate and drive improvement of automation, tools, frameworks, etc.
* Work as a full stack developer, both front-end and back-end (SOA). Initiate and drive improvement of automation, tools, frameworks, etc.
* Work as a full stack developer, both front-end and back-end (SOA)

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:
  
  

* Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps, with the ability to develop and manage CI/CD pipelines.
* Rich experience with Cloud Infrastructures.
* Extensive knowledge and experience (10+ years) in C# and Angular .
* Proficient in both manual and automated testing, with the ability to design and implement comprehensive test strategies and all level tests for software applications (E2E, API, UT).
* Understanding and adherence to XP practices (TDD, pair-programming etc.)
* Readiness to learn APL.
* M.Sc. in Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field (will be a plus).
* Curiosity and readiness to learn and improve in-house tools and frameworks
* Experience with Domain-Driven Design.
* Experience with relational databases (SQL).
* Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery
* Good English skills (upper intermediate and higher), written as well as spoken

  
  
**AI-Enabled Development**
  
  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low-value work in the team.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Principal Software Engineer - AWS
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
The Innovations team at Genesys builds AI-powered applications and agents on top of Genesys Cloud, delivering them to enterprise customers through AppFoundry. These solutions include industry-specific agents, compliance-focused capabilities, and platform integrations that help organizations orchestrate customer experiences at scale. Operating with the speed and mindset of a product studio, the team focuses on turning emerging AI capabilities into practical, production-ready solutions for real customer needs.
  
  
This role is critical to that mission. We are looking for a full-stack engineer who is excited to build AI applications that solve meaningful customer experience challenges. You will work across the stack from modern React frontends to backend services and LLM integrations, to design and deliver solutions that are scalable, usable, and enterprise ready.
  
  
**About Genesys**
Genesys powers customer experiences for organizations around the world. Genesys Cloud helps enterprises orchestrate omnichannel journeys, modernize service operations, and deliver differentiated customer and employee experiences at scale.
  
  
Genesys Innovations builds applications, accelerators, and integration-led solutions that help customers unlock more value from their Genesys platforms through AI, analytics, automation, and modern cloud engineering.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a principal-level builder to architect, build, and operate secure, scalable, cloud-native applications on AWS. The role spans React and TypeScript front ends, Node.js and Python services, APIs, event-driven integrations, data flows, and production operations.
  
  
You will also help shape AI-enabled product capabilities such as intelligent assistants, search, summarization, recommendations, workflow automation, and agentic user experiences. Success in this role requires strong engineering judgment across reliability, security, latency, cost, observability, and maintainability.
  
  
This is not a pure people-management role. We are looking for someone who enjoys moving between architecture, implementation, design reviews, technical leadership, and production problem solving.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of full stack applications and platform components across UI, backend services, integrations, data, and cloud infrastructure.
* Stay deeply hands-on in implementation, prototyping, code reviews, debugging, and design validation.
* Build secure, scalable APIs, microservices, event-driven workflows, and responsive user experiences on AWS.
* Design and deliver AI-enabled and agentic capabilities using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and action invocation, workflow orchestration, context management, evaluation, and guardrails where appropriate.
* Integrate applications with Genesys platforms and with customer enterprise systems using APIs, SDKs, middleware, data pipelines, and event streams.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, performance, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Codify reusable assets such as libraries, components, prompts, templates, accelerators, and reference patterns that improve delivery speed across engagements.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools and coding agents responsibly to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring, documentation, and root-cause analysis; validate all AI-generated output before release.
* Partner with product, consulting, delivery, and customer stakeholders to turn business goals into scalable technical solutions and implementation roadmaps.
* Troubleshoot production issues, drive root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes and telemetry improvements.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Principal engineering foundation**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building commercial applications, including experience leading technical direction for complex systems at senior, staff, or principal level.
* Strong hands-on full stack expertise with React, TypeScript or JavaScript, and Node.js, plus working proficiency in Python, Java, or a comparable backend language.
* Strong experience designing and delivering distributed systems, REST or GraphQL APIs, microservices, asynchronous services, and cloud-native architectures.
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs – tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG, evaluation. Production preferred, serious side projects count.
* Comfortable with agentic patterns: multi-step reasoning, autonomous tool use, structured planning, and the failure modes that come with giving an LLM real agency.
* Working familiarity with AWS, experience with Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Bedrock, or similar is a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, secure coding practices, release engineering, and production observability.
* Experience integrating with enterprise systems and data sources, including real-time and event-driven patterns.
* Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, architects, delivery leaders, and customer stakeholders in both technical and non-technical settings.
* Demonstrated success in customer-facing or consulting-style delivery environments where solution quality, speed, and pragmatism matter.

**Agentic AI and GenAI delivery**

* Recent hands-on experience building and shipping GenAI, LLM, or agentic applications in production enterprise environments.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt and workflow design, tool use or function calling, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrail patterns.
* Understanding of enterprise AI requirements such as observability, auditability, tenant isolation, RBAC, privacy, safety, and responsible use.
* Experience integrating model or AI services through Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms and APIs.
* Familiarity with modern AI application frameworks or protocols such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, MCP, A2A, or equivalent approaches.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or coding agents such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent tooling to improve developer productivity with disciplined human review.
* Ability to evaluate AI solutions for correctness, latency, cost, reliability, maintainability, and measurable business value.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Experience in customer service, contact center, or CX domains, especially AI oriented systems like Sierra, Decagon, or Kore.AI
* Practical experience integrating with Genesys technologies, APIs, and SDKs such as PSDK, WFM API, IceLib, ICWS, GWS, or comparable patterns.
* Experience building real-time analytics, streaming applications, or RTA-style user experiences.
* Strong consulting and stakeholder management practices, including architecture notes, design specifications, user guides, and deployment documentation.
* Experience with database performance tuning and optimization.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
  
  
**Stay Connected**
Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
  
  
Get notified about relevant opportunities.
  
  
**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**
**Employee Referral**
If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.
  
  
**About Genesys:**
Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com.

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.**

description:

* Identify potential machining risks and implement corrective actions before production.
* Optimize cycle time, tool life, material utilization and machining efficiency.

* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace quality requirements, including AS9100 practices.

* B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical / Manufacturing Engineering.
* **5 years of relevant experience in CAM Programming within the Aerospace Manufacturing industry.**
* Advanced hands-on proficiency in **Siemens NX CAM**.
* Strong experience in CNC Milling and Turning programming.
* Practical experience in **3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis machining**.
* Strong knowledge of G&M code generation and CNC post-processors.
* Good understanding of **GD&T as per ASME Y14.5**.
* Experience in toolpath simulation, collision detection and machining optimization.
* Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and 3D models.

* Aerospace component machining – Aluminium, Titanium, Inconel and other aerospace materials.
* Fanuc / Siemens / Heidenhain CNC controllers.
* Multi-axis machining and complex component programming.
* Cutting tool selection, feeds and speeds optimization.

title: Internship
description:
**About The Role**
You would work on Mangrove — real parts of it, with real consequences — in the same room as the people building it. You take something from a question to working software, and then watch somebody use it.
  
  
Mangrove is a Tauri application: Rust underneath, with a React and TypeScript front end. You would write both ends of it.
  
  
We take one intern at a time. That is deliberate: teaching somebody properly takes attention, and attention does not divide well.
  
  
Why we do this
  
  
Companies are hiring fewer junior developers, and AI is doing the work they used to learn on. We still believe a trade has to pass from one generation to the next, one person teaching another.
  
  
It is also the point of the company. Our motto is that through learning we flourish, and a company that means it should be willing to spend money on somebody who is still learning.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Take one meaningful piece of work from a question to something people use, over three to six months.
* Sit in on the decisions — what we build, what we decline to build, and why.
* Say when something we are doing makes no sense. You will often be the only one who can see it, because you are the only one who has not got used to it yet.

What we're looking for
  
  

* A habit of making things, whatever their size and however rough.
* Curiosity about why things work, not only how.
* Willingness to be taught, and willingness to argue.
* Three to six months you can spend in Mumbai, in person.

**Compensation & Benefits**
₹20,000 a month, paid monthly. What we quote is what reaches you.
  
  
Time off works the same for you as for everybody here: every paid day earns two points, ten points buys a paid day off, and you take one without telling us why. Over three months that comes to about thirteen days. If you need a day before you have earned it, take it anyway.
  
  
We would rather publish all of this than make you ask for it. You should be able to tell whether a role is worth your time before you spend any of it writing to us.
  
  
How to apply
  
  
Email us three things: a phone number, the days and times you are free for a ten minute call, and a few sentences on what you want to learn on the job.
  
  
We read applications in the order they arrive and keep calling until we have found the person, so we will write to everybody once the place is filled.

* Teamwork and collaboration
* Analytics thinking
* Time Management
* Strong Trouble shooting and problem-solving skills

* Ability to communicate ideas and collaborate with teammates.

****Configuration and Customisation****

* Design and implement workflows for asset ingestion, approval, distribution, and archival.

****API and Integration Development****

* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to configurations and integrations

****Documentation and Training****

* Create and maintain detailed documentation of configurations and customizations.
* Assist with the development of training materials for users.
* Provide support to users on configuration-related issues.

****Ongoing Support and Optimisation****

* Work closely with the DAM Lead and other team members to ensure the successful implementation of solutions.
* Participate in design workshops and provide technical input.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest features, functionalities, and best practices.

****Collaboration and Support****

* Align DAM solutions with ICP's overall technology strategy and business objectives.
* Establish and maintain DAM governance standards and best practices, including metadata standards, naming conventions, and security protocols.
* Work with IT leadership to ensure the security and compliance of DAM implementations.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a seasoned Temenos Transact Architect to join the Temenos Centre of Excellence within the GDS - Banking and Capital Markets practice. **Your Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse functional and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable, and high‑quality T24 solutions.
* Design, develop, unit test, and implement custom T24 developments using COB and Services Framework.
* Work actively with Design Studio, GitLab, SQL Developer, Temenos Unit Test Framework, JIRA, and job schedulers (AWA).
* Develop and support integrations using Temenos Integration Framework, Interaction Framework (IRIS), Outbox Event Streaming, MQ, and JBOSS.
* Support implementation of SWIFT messaging, interfacing patterns, and STP processes.
* Collaborate within an Agile / SAFe delivery environment, participating in sprint ceremonies, design discussions, and code reviews.
* Investigate and resolve production (RTB) issues, ensuring application stability and performance.
* Use monitoring and logging tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, and Tivoli for issue diagnosis and resolution.

+ Job schedulers (AWA)
+ SQL Developer
+ Temenos Unit Test Framework
+ JIRA / Confluence
+ Experience with Integration Framework, IRIS, Outbox Events, MQ, and JBOSS
+ Exposure to cloud‑based T24 development environments (preferred)
+ Sound understanding of Oracle DB concepts, SQL tuning, indexes, and Linux scripting
+ Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk

**Functional Knowledge**

* Good functional understanding of Core T24 Retail Banking modules including:

+ Customer
+ Accounts
+ Retail Banking
+ TPH modules
+ Awareness of end‑to‑end banking and payment processing flows

**Delivery Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities
* Calm and effective in handling production issues and tight timelines
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Strong focus on code quality, stability, and performance
* Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to evolving technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* TCCP certification in T24
* Experience working with EMEIA or global banking clients
* Exposure to large‑scale core banking transformation programs

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python)
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
  
  
  
  
Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python) for our Mumbai location. This role involves developing scalable, high-performing web applications for our AI-powered SaaS solutions. You will work across frontend and backend systems, building intuitive user interfaces using React and robust backend services using Python, while collaborating closely with product, design, DevOps, and engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Frontend Development: Develop and optimize responsive, user-friendly interfaces using ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.

API Development & Integration: Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs; integrate frontend applications with backend services, databases, and third-party platforms.

Database Management: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability.

Performance Optimization: Improve frontend rendering, application responsiveness, backend performance, and API reliability.

Code Integrity: Maintain and improve code quality through unit testing, integration testing, automation, documentation, and code reviews.

Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker and Kubernetes to deploy and manage containerized applications. Work with GCP, AWS, or Azure for cloud deployment and application management.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform and Helm to manage cloud infrastructure and ensure scalable, efficient deployment environments.

CI/CD Management: Contribute to continuous integration and deployment processes, including test automation, build artifact creation, and application releases.

**Qualifications**

3–6 years of software development experience, with hands-on experience in full stack development using ReactJS and Python.

**Skills**

* Strong expertise in ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

* Proficiency in Python and backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.

* Experience with REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a plus.

* Experience with frontend state management solutions such as Redux, Context API, React Query, or Zustand.

* Database management experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar SQL/NoSQL databases.

* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architecture.

* Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications using GCP, AWS, or Azure.

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills with Terraform and Helm.

* Understanding of unit testing, API testing, code reviews, and secure coding practices.

* Familiarity with Figma, responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility.

**Education**

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Debug and Test

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills And Experience**  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.

* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Platform & AI Infrastructure)
description:
**About the Role**  
In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership from initial architectural design to live production operations of AWS platform. You will be responsible for securely hosting multi-tenant AI agents, enabling them to execute long-running, stateful sessions and safely run model-generated code.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and run the cloud infrastructure for AI agent sessions: provisioning, isolation between users and organizations, scaling, and cost control.
* Build sandboxed execution environments for model-generated Python and other computational workloads, with strict limits on resources, network and file access.
* Develop the backend services and APIs that stream agent output to the browser, manage long-running and background jobs, and recover cleanly from failures in the middle of a session.
* Implement authentication, organization permissions, and secure storage of project files and application data.
* Own AWS infrastructure as code, automated deployments, observability, alerting, and incident response.
* Adapt the existing React frontend to the web: replace desktop-only integrations with web APIs, and handle file upload, download and project storage in the browser.
* Make architectural decisions and improve performance, reliability, and infrastructure cost.

**Tools & Technologies**

* AI and agents: Model APIs (including Amazon Bedrock), agent orchestration, tool execution, and sandboxed Python.
* Cloud infrastructure: AWS ECS/Fargate, ECR, CloudFront, API Gateway, IAM, VPC networking, and Docker.
* Infrastructure and delivery: Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Backend: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, and server-sent events for streaming.
* Data and authentication: PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS, S3, and Cognito.
* Frontend: React, TypeScript, and Vite.
* Testing: Playwright, Vitest, and pytest.

**Requirements**

* 4+ years building and operating production backend systems on AWS, including containers, IAM, networking, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).
* B.E.\B.Tech\B.S./ME or relevant field candidates with significant prior experience in the fields above will be considered.
* Experience running long-lived, stateful, or untrusted workloads in production: for example, agent sessions, job runners, notebooks, CI runners, or multi-tenant compute.
* A solid understanding of isolation and security for code you don’t control: containers, sandboxing, least-privilege IAM, and network controls.
* Strong backend skills in Node.js/TypeScript or Python, including streaming, asynchronous processing, and databases.
* Experience with CI/CD, observability, and taking ownership of production incidents.
* Enough comfort with React and TypeScript to work in an existing frontend codebase.

**Strongly preferred**

* Hands-on experience hosting AI agents or LLM-powered applications in production, including tool calling, streaming, and controlling model cost.
* Experience building secure execution environments, such as Firecracker, gVisor, or locked-down containers.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

description:

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Java Full Stack Developer with 5–8 years of hands-on expertise in developing scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and modern frontend technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong experience with Core Java, Spring Framework, REST APIs, frontend development using Angular or React, SQL, database design, and application integration.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Solution Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and technology teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, high-performing full-stack applications.
  
  
Day to Day Job Duties

* Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular or React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Implement application security using Spring Security, JWT, OAuth2, and role-based access controls.

* Collaborate with architects and technical teams to define application design, technical solutions, and integration approaches.
* Work with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, application builds, deployments, and production releases.

Basic Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience developing REST APIs and microservices-based applications.
* 3+ years of experience with frontend technologies such as Angular or React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* 3+ years of experience with SQL, relational databases, and database integration.
* Strong experience with Hibernate, JPA, and ORM-based development.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Spring Cloud, API Gateway, Service Discovery, and Resilience4j.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

* Knowledge of application monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK, or Grafana.
