title: Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
Locations: **Mumbai, India; Gurgaon, India**

Additional Locations: **Gurugram, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President**
-----------------------------------------------------

**Your team**
-------------

You will join the Client Intelligence engineering organization within Aladdin Data, working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and modern cloud technologies. The team builds scalable applications and platforms that enable intelligent client experiences and help drive commercial impact.

  

**Your role and impact**
------------------------

This is a backend-focused full-stack engineering role with significant hands-on technical ownership. You will design and build scalable applications and platforms, with a strong focus on Java and/or Python alongside modern frontend development using React and TypeScript/JavaScript. You will own complex engineering initiatives from architecture and implementation through production operation, while helping raise engineering standards and mentoring engineers across the team.

  

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable architectures across backend services, APIs, data platforms, and user-facing applications, making informed trade-offs across performance, scalability, availability, maintainability, user experience, and cost.
* Remain hands-on in Java and/or Python, building distributed backend services, reusable APIs, components, and platform capabilities that support multiple products and use cases.
* Provide technical direction for modern web applications using React and TypeScript/JavaScript, owning capabilities across backend services, APIs, and frontend experiences.
* Build data- and artificial intelligence-enabled applications that integrate large language models, agents, enterprise data, APIs, retrieval systems, and efficient data access patterns into intuitive user experiences.
* Establish high engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, security, observability, performance, and operational resilience.
* Mentor engineers across backend and frontend technologies and lead architecture, design, and code reviews.
* Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, artificial intelligence engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.
  

  

**Your experience**
-------------------

* Demonstrated software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications and platforms, with strong hands-on expertise in Java and/or Python.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ownership of complex production systems, including troubleshooting and performance optimization.
* Full-stack development experience with React and TypeScript/JavaScript, including component-based design, state management, API integration, performance, and frontend testing.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data-intensive application design, with experience working across modern data platforms and data-processing workflows.
* Experience designing and operating cloud-native applications with strong engineering fundamentals in object-oriented and domain-driven design, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, security, and performance engineering.
* Experience providing technical leadership through architecture, design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and communicating technical decisions and trade-offs to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with artificial intelligence-enabled applications, large language model integration, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows, reusable platform capabilities, and financial services or client-facing technology platforms is beneficial.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: eLearning Developer – Articulate Storyline 360
description:
**About FinThots**

FinThots® is a Mumbai-based BFSI-focused capability-building company. We work with regulators, leading banks, NBFCs and financial institutions through eLearning, instructor-led training and blended learning programs. Our projects address real business, credit, risk and sales challenges – not generic off-the-shelf training.

**About the Role**

Turn approved storyboards into working, tested, LMS-ready courses. The Instructional Designer decides what the learner sees and does; you own how it is built in Storyline – screens, layers, triggers, variables, assessments, results, audio sync and publishing – so the course works exactly as designed on every device and LMS. This is an eLearning developer role, and some hands-on graphic-design skill is an added advantage.

**What You’ll Work On**

· Develop Storyline 360 courses screen-by-screen from approved storyboards – layouts, layers, states, triggers, variables, animations and timeline sync with voiceover.

· Build interactivities, knowledge checks, branching scenarios, simulations, gamified/gated modules and scored assessments with result slides.

· Apply client branding kits and templates consistently; build desktop and mobile views, and free and restricted navigation versions where required.

· Publish SCORM/xAPI packages and test them on SCORM Cloud and client LMSs – tracking, completion, scoring and resume.

· Share builds on Articulate Review 360, close SME/client feedback across review rounds, and keep story files, published files, assets and versions organised.

· Work with IDs, designers and voiceover artists to flag build feasibility early; rebuild or migrate legacy courses (e.g. iSpring, flash) into Storyline when needed.

**Who We’re Looking For**

**The essentials**

· 2–4 years of hands-on eLearning development in Articulate Storyline 360; portfolio/work samples required.

· Working knowledge of Articulate Rise 360 for rapid development

· Strong command of triggers, variables, conditions, layers, states, sliders, drag-and-drop and question banks.

· Experience publishing SCORM 1.2/2004 and xAPI, and fixing LMS tracking and completion issues.

· Ability to troubleshoot course functionality and resolve publishing issues

· Ability to read a storyboard and build it

· Strong sense of layout, typography, and colour — ability to produce clean, professional course screens

· Sharp eye for alignment, timing, audio sync and on-screen text; disciplined self-QA before every review.

· Working knowledge of image, audio, video and related AI voice/image/video tools (Photoshop/Illustrator or equivalent, basic video editing, Flow, Eleven Labs, Synthesia).

**Helpful, but not essential**

· JavaScript in Storyline, Captivate/iSpring, and accessibility (WCAG) basics.

· BFSI/corporate learning experience, or gamification and software-simulation builds.

**What’s in it for You**

· Build ownership – take courses from storyboard to a tested, LMS-ready package.

· Variety of builds – scenarios, simulations, gamified modules, assessments and mobile-ready courses.

· Work on meaningful projects for regulators like RBI and NHB and India's leading banks.

· Get hands-on guidance and quick feedback in a small, supportive team.

· Grow into bigger roles as the company grows, with support along the way.

· Learn how banking works from founders with senior banking experience (SBI Group, PNB, Axis Bank) and an IIM Calcutta background.

Kalpataru Avenue, Kandivali East, Mumbai. Work from office, with occasional flexibility where appropriate.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

* For this work-from-office role, are you comfortable commuting to the office ?

* eLearning Developer : 2 years (Preferred)

title: WordPress Developer
description:
We are looking for a technically proficient, creative, and result-oriented WordPress Developer who can take complete ownership of our website development, maintenance, performance optimization, security, and continuous improvement.

Our objective is to develop a premium, fast, secure, and conversion-oriented website that attracts international customers and generates qualified business enquiries.

**We are not looking for someone who can only install themes, import templates, and use page builders. We need a developer who understands website architecture, customization, performance, security, user experience, and business requirements.**

Roles and Responsibilities

* Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress websites.
* Design premium, professional, and conversion-focused landing pages.
* Develop custom WordPress themes, templates, and functionalities wherever required.
* Customize existing themes and plugins according to business requirements.
* Develop responsive websites compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Optimize website loading speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance.
* Identify and resolve website bugs, compatibility issues, and technical errors.
* Implement website security measures and protect against common vulnerabilities.
* Manage website hosting, DNS, SSL certificates, databases, and backups.
* Create and maintain staging environments for safe development and testing.
* Integrate CRM systems, enquiry forms, marketing automation, and third-party APIs.
* Work with the SEO team to implement technical SEO improvements.
* Implement Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.
* Improve website navigation, user experience, and customer conversion journeys.
* Develop reusable website components to reduce development time.
* Ensure compatibility across different browsers and devices.
* Maintain proper documentation of website configurations, customizations, and updates.
* Research and recommend new technologies and functionalities that can improve website performance and business outcomes.

Required Technical Skills

* WordPress CMS
* HTML5 and CSS3
* JavaScript and jQuery
* PHP
* MySQL
* WordPress theme and plugin customization
* Elementor, Gutenberg, or similar page builders
* WordPress hooks, actions, and filters
* REST API integration
* Responsive website development
* Website performance optimization
* Website security and backup management
* Hosting, cPanel, DNS, and SSL management
* Git and version control
* Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse
* Basic technical SEO
* Website debugging and troubleshooting

Preferred Skills

* WooCommerce development.
* Custom WordPress plugin development.
* Advanced Custom Fields (ACF).
* CRM and marketing automation integrations.
* Figma-to-WordPress development.
* UI/UX design fundamentals.
* Cloudflare configuration and CDN management.
* Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).
* Experience using AI-powered development tools responsibly.
* Experience developing websites for international B2B, technology, engineering, or industrial businesses.

Expected Outcomes During the First 30 DaysWeek 1 – Website Audit and Technical Assessment

* Conduct a comprehensive technical audit of the existing company website.
* Review website architecture, themes, plugins, database, and hosting configuration.
* Identify unnecessary, outdated, incompatible, and potentially vulnerable plugins.
* Assess website performance across desktop and mobile devices.
* Identify responsive design issues, broken links, functional errors, and usability problems.
* Review existing website security, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Establish a baseline for website speed, Core Web Vitals, and technical performance.
* Create a staging environment to safely implement website modifications.

**Expected deliverables:** Complete technical audit report, website performance baseline, prioritized issue tracker, and development action plan.

Week 2 – Performance, Security and Bug Resolution

* Resolve or mitigate critical website errors identified during the audit.
* Optimize images, scripts, stylesheets, caching, and other website resources.
* Remove unnecessary plugins after verifying dependencies.
* Improve database performance and eliminate unnecessary database overhead.
* Resolve identified mobile responsiveness issues.
* Implement appropriate website security measures.
* Establish automated backup procedures and verify backup restoration.
* Resolve broken links, non-functional forms, and navigation issues.
* Document performance improvements through before-and-after comparisons.

**Expected deliverables:** Optimized website, security assessment, backup and recovery procedure, and documented performance improvements.

Week 3 – Website Development and Conversion Optimization

* Develop at least three premium, commercially focused landing pages.
* Improve existing service pages to better communicate company capabilities.
* Develop reusable website sections and templates for future landing pages.
* Improve website navigation and customer enquiry journeys.
* Implement or improve enquiry forms and calls to action.
* Configure conversion tracking in coordination with the marketing team.
* Ensure all newly developed pages are responsive, SEO-friendly, and performance-optimized.
* Conduct cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing.

**Expected deliverables:** Three fully functional landing pages, reusable website templates, improved enquiry mechanisms, and conversion tracking implementation.

Week 4 – Website Quality Assurance and Growth Roadmap

* Conduct a comprehensive website functionality and quality assurance review.
* Test all critical contact forms, buttons, navigation links, and integrations.
* Verify website performance improvements against the initial baseline.
* Resolve remaining high-priority development issues within the agreed scope.
* Create a standardized checklist for developing and publishing future website pages.
* Document website architecture, plugin configurations, and custom code.
* Establish a preventive website maintenance schedule.
* Prepare a 90-day website development and improvement roadmap.
* Present completed work, measurable improvements, outstanding issues, and future opportunities to management.

**Expected deliverables:** Website quality assurance report, maintenance procedures, technical documentation, first-month performance report, and 90-day development roadmap.

First 30 Days Performance Targets

The following targets will be assessed against the initial website audit and agreed development priorities:

* Target Google PageSpeed Insights performance score of 90+ on desktop and 80+ on mobile for agreed priority pages.
* Target LCP of 2.5 seconds or less.
* Target CLS of 0.1 or less.
* Target INP of 200 milliseconds or less, where sufficient real-user data is available.
* Zero unresolved critical website security vulnerabilities within the developer's control.
* Zero known broken links on newly developed pages.
* 100% functionality of critical website enquiry forms.
* 100% responsive design compliance for newly developed pages against agreed test criteria.
* Minimum three commercially focused landing pages.
* Verified website backup and restoration mechanism.
* Complete documentation of website modifications.
* No avoidable disruption to the live website during development.

Performance targets may be adjusted based on existing hosting limitations, third-party integrations, website architecture, and the initial technical assessment.

What We Do Not Want

* Developers who depend entirely on ready-made templates and page builders.
* Candidates who install unnecessary plugins for every minor functionality.
* Developers who modify live websites without proper backups and testing.
* Candidates who use pirated or nulled themes and plugins.
* Developers who compromise website performance for visual appearance.
* Candidates who copy competitor websites instead of developing original designs.
* Developers who generate AI code without reviewing, testing, and understanding it.
* Candidates who require continuous supervision for routine development activities.
* Developers who focus only on website appearance without considering business conversions.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with an international technology company.
* Ownership of website development and digital infrastructure.
* Exposure to international B2B marketing and lead generation.
* Opportunities to work with advanced development and AI-powered tools.
* Freedom to propose and implement innovative website functionalities.
* Long-term career growth based on technical capabilities and performance.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit their updated resume along with answers to the following questions:

* Share links to three WordPress websites you have independently developed or significantly customized.

* How do you ensure website modifications do not affect existing functionality or cause downtime?
* Which development, debugging, and website optimization tools can you use independently?

Candidates may be required to undergo a practical WordPress development and troubleshooting assessment as part of the selection process.

**We are looking for a developer who takes ownership of website quality, performance, security, and business growth—not someone who simply creates web pages.**

title: Software Engineer
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

##### **Responsibilities**

We are looking for a Fullstack Software Engineer (all genders) to join our new Integrations & Partner Enablement team in Noida. The team connects TeamViewer products to the enterprise systems our customers run on, such as ERP, warehouse management (WMS) and manufacturing execution (MES) systems, and gives partners the tools to build integrations on their own.

You will build connectors, SDK features, integration templates and web extensions. The work is mostly backend, with web frontend work on our extension tools. You will work in an agile team alongside engineering and product teams in Europe.

* Develop and maintain connectors, SDK features and backend services using Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Build web extensions and features with React and TypeScript.
* Implement data mapping and transformation between our products and enterprise systems such as SAP, WMS and MES.
* Help turn customer-specific integrations into standard, reusable templates and workflows.
* Write documentation and samples for partners and system integrators.
* Write automated tests across the stack and take part in code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants effectively in your daily work, while keeping ownership of quality, security and maintainability.
* Collaborate with your team and other teams on technical decisions and knowledge sharing.

##### **Requirements**

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of professional experience in fullstack development.
* Solid backend experience with Java and/or Kotlin and Spring Boot, or with Node.js and TypeScript.
* Solid experience with React and TypeScript.
* Experience building and integrating with REST APIs, including data mapping and transformation.
* Familiarity with event-driven integration and messaging is a plus.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and Docker; cloud experience (Azure or AWS) is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including critically reviewing and testing AI-generated code.
* Interest in understanding customer processes and turning them into reusable solutions.
* Experience working in agile teams.
* Good working-hours overlap with Central European Time.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).

**Nice to have**

* Background in SAP consulting or a systems integrator, or at a product company with an integration platform or SDK (e.g. iPaaS, WMS or MES vendors).
* Experience with SAP integrations (e.g. SAP EWM, SAP S/4HANA, OData, BAPI/RFC, IDoc, SAP BTP / Integration Suite).
* Experience with WMS or MES products and understanding of logistics, warehouse or manufacturing processes.
* Experience building SDKs or developer tools.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. title: Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
  
  
Your team
  
  
You will join the Client Intelligence engineering organization within Aladdin Data, working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and modern cloud technologies. The team builds scalable applications and platforms that enable intelligent client experiences and help drive commercial impact.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
This is a backend-focused full-stack engineering role with significant hands-on technical ownership. You will design and build scalable applications and platforms, with a strong focus on Java and/or Python alongside modern frontend development using React and TypeScript/JavaScript. You will own complex engineering initiatives from architecture and implementation through production operation, while helping raise engineering standards and mentoring engineers across the team.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Design scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable architectures across backend services, APIs, data platforms, and user-facing applications, making informed trade-offs across performance, scalability, availability, maintainability, user experience, and cost.
* Remain hands-on in Java and/or Python, building distributed backend services, reusable APIs, components, and platform capabilities that support multiple products and use cases.
* Provide technical direction for modern web applications using React and TypeScript/JavaScript, owning capabilities across backend services, APIs, and frontend experiences.
* Build data- and artificial intelligence-enabled applications that integrate large language models, agents, enterprise data, APIs, retrieval systems, and efficient data access patterns into intuitive user experiences.
* Establish high engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, security, observability, performance, and operational resilience.
* Mentor engineers across backend and frontend technologies and lead architecture, design, and code reviews.
* Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, artificial intelligence engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.

Your experience
  
  

* Demonstrated software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications and platforms, with strong hands-on expertise in Java and/or Python.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ownership of complex production systems, including troubleshooting and performance optimization.
* Full-stack development experience with React and TypeScript/JavaScript, including component-based design, state management, API integration, performance, and frontend testing.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data-intensive application design, with experience working across modern data platforms and data-processing workflows.
* Experience designing and operating cloud-native applications with strong engineering fundamentals in object-oriented and domain-driven design, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, security, and performance engineering.
* Experience providing technical leadership through architecture, design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and communicating technical decisions and trade-offs to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with artificial intelligence-enabled applications, large language model integration, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows, reusable platform capabilities, and financial services or client-facing technology platforms is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:

**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

Build the complex systems that move SimCorp's clients' data and trades. Turn continuous learning into a platform that scales with our growth. Raise the bar on development and testing so quality is designed in, not inspected in. Grow domain depth in applied finance and investment management — and turn it into products clients can't work without. Investment Operations Product Areas (Data & Post-trade Engineering Line).

You will be a member of a self-organized scrum team consisting of software engineers, who collaborate closely with business experts. The team is responsible for developing and supporting a set of enterprise products within the Collateral Product Area. You are expected to interact with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark, Austria, and Germany. After a comprehensive onboarding program, we expect you to:

* .Create and analyze functional and non-functional requirements during feature refinements.

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:
  
  

* Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps, with the ability to develop and manage CI/CD pipelines.
* Rich experience with Cloud Infrastructures.
* Extensive knowledge and experience (10+ years) in C# and Angular .

* Understanding and adherence to XP practices (TDD, pair-programming etc.)
* Readiness to learn APL.
* M.Sc. in Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field (will be a plus).
* Curiosity and readiness to learn and improve in-house tools and frameworks
* Experience with Domain-Driven Design.
* Experience with relational databases (SQL).
* Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery
* Good English skills (upper intermediate and higher), written as well as spoken

  
  
**AI-Enabled Development**
  
  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low-value work in the team.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Development Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Lead to drive the design, development, delivery, and governance of production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions. The role requires hands-on technical leadership in Large Language Models, RAG, Agentic RAG, multi-agent workflows, tool-calling architectures, LLMOps, Responsible AI, cloud AI services, and enterprise system integration. The candidate should be able to lead a team, define technical standards, guide solution architecture, mentor developers, and collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable AI-enabled applications.

This role is suitable for candidates with a
**minimum of 6 years and up to 10–12 years of relevant experience**
in GenAI development, AI engineering, Python/backend development, ML/NLP applications, cloud AI services, enterprise automation, or technical leadership roles.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end design and delivery of GenAI, RAG, Agentic RAG, AI assistant, chatbot, document intelligence, and automation agent solutions.
* Define agentic AI architecture patterns including tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, multi-agent orchestration, workflow routing, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Guide teams in building robust RAG pipelines covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata design, embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, and grounded response generation.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership using Python, APIs, microservices, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.
* Lead integration of LLMs with enterprise applications, knowledge repositories, databases, workflow platforms, search services, and cloud-based AI services.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt versioning, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, tool integration, evaluation datasets, and model configuration management.
* Drive LLMOps and GenAIOps practices including observability, tracing, monitoring, regression testing, latency optimization, token usage tracking, cost optimization, and production support readiness.
* Ensure Responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, access control, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, auditability, and compliance controls are embedded in solution design.
* Review solution designs, code, prompts, retrieval logic, evaluation results, deployment plans, and production issues to maintain engineering quality.
* Mentor developers, conduct technical reviews, support estimation and planning, coordinate delivery, and communicate solution progress to stakeholders.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in
  **Python**
  , APIs, microservices, backend integration, modular application design, debugging, and production-grade development practices.
* Strong experience with
  **Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, token management, structured outputs, and LLM-based application development**
  .
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing
  **RAG and Agentic RAG solutions**
  using enterprise documents, knowledge repositories, vector databases, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation.
* Strong understanding of
  **agentic AI concepts**
  including planning, reasoning loops, tool calling, function calling, memory, autonomous workflows, multi-agent systems, supervisor-agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop design.
* Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as
  **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI**
  , or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience integrating LLMs through cloud AI services and model APIs such as AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open-source model endpoints.
* Strong knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, Qdrant, or pgvector.
* Working knowledge of LLMOps, GenAIOps, model evaluation, hallucination control, guardrails, observability, prompt/version management, and cost optimization practices.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, perform design reviews, mentor engineers, estimate work, manage technical risks, and communicate with stakeholders.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Experience leading GenAI delivery teams or technical workstreams for enterprise AI use cases.
* Exposure to AgentOps, AI gateways, MCP-based tool integration, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontology-driven retrieval, or advanced reasoning patterns.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud deployment of AI-enabled applications.
* Knowledge of OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, search, automation, and enterprise workflow use cases.
* Cloud or AI certifications across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Solution Architecture are preferred.

**Experience Criteria**

* **6 to 12 years**
  of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI engineering, Python/backend development, ML/NLP application development, enterprise automation, or technical leadership roles.
* Candidates should have hands-on experience building, integrating, evaluating, or deploying GenAI, RAG, Agentic RAG, AI assistant, chatbot, document intelligence, or automation agent solutions.
* Candidates should demonstrate technical leadership through solution design, code reviews, mentoring, delivery ownership, stakeholder communication, and quality governance.

**Mandatory Qualification:**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**

* BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.

Interested candidates can reach out at preeti\_bisht@hcltech.com

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
The short version
  
  
Most cloud jobs in India are someone else's public cloud. This one is not. The prime focus is Kubernetes on hardware we own: clusters on metal, and tenant clusters those hosts provision. Git is the only path to production. You would own that platform.
  
  
You will not get an interview on Active Directory and Microsoft 365 alone, and you will not get one on a Kubernetes certificate alone. The person this is written for has already operated both, and wants Kubernetes to be the majority of the work going forward. On-prem Exchange is useful. It is not the job.
  
  
****The stack you will work with.****
Kubernetes (kubeadm, Cluster API, KubeVirt, hosted control planes, AKS)
  
  

* Flux, Kustomize, Helm
* Harbor
* Keycloak
* Active Directory, Entra ID, Entra Connect
* Microsoft 365, Exchange Online
* VMware vSphere/ESXi
* Windows Server
* Cisco UCS
* OpenTofu, Ansible, PowerShell
* Prometheus, Grafana
* AlmaLinux, Ubuntu
* Go, Python, Bash

What you would own
  
  

* Cluster lifecycle, both layers. Design, build, upgrade and operate Kubernetes across bare-metal (kubeadm), virtualised (KubeVirt with Cluster API and hosted control planes) and managed cloud (AKS). Own the control plane: etcd backup and restore, certificate rotation, upgrades, RBAC and admission. Operate Cluster API so create, upgrade and retire is a repeatable path, not an artisan one. Workload topology (disruption budgets, anti-affinity, requests and limits) and multi-tenancy that actually holds. Diagnose the hard failures and turn them into runbooks.
* GitOps as the operating model. Flux, Kustomize, Helm. Desired state lives in Git, not in someone's shell history. Infrastructure as code with OpenTofu or Terraform and Ansible. Automate toil in PowerShell, Bash, and Python or Go. Written blast-radius and a rollback path before production changes.
* Cluster networking and storage, as a platform consumer. Own service exposure on the clusters: Gateway API and HTTPRoute, ingress, kube-vip and CoreDNS. Use NetworkPolicy, StorageClasses, PVCs, snapshots and the CSI drivers the platform is given. Diagnose whether a fault is the application, the CNI, the CSI or the layer beneath, then work it with the network or storage engineer rather than owning those layers. Deep Cilium and Ceph operations sit with those roles.
* Active Directory and hybrid identity. Architect and maintain Active Directory: forest and domain design, Group Policy at scale, replication health, trusts, schema changes, and identity hygiene across multi-domain or multi-site environments. Manage hybrid identity through Entra ID and Entra Connect. Own enterprise DNS and DHCP at scale, including AD-integrated DNS, conditional forwarders, scope design, failover and reservations. Join Linux and Windows hosts into the directory where the platform requires it, and integrate Kubernetes access with the identity you already run. Windows Server lifecycle, provisioning, patching, hardening, performance tuning and decommissioning, is part of this, including Windows worker nodes on the clusters.
* Microsoft 365 and application mail. Exchange Online, hybrid mail flow, and the Microsoft 365 admin surface. Application email enablement: SMTP relay, OAuth 2.0 for mail, SPF, DKIM and DMARC. On-prem Exchange Server is useful if you have it. It is not required.
* VMware and KubeVirt virtualization. Operate the VMware estate (vSphere/ESXi, vCenter, HA, VM lifecycle) and the boundary with Kubernetes. On the Kubernetes side, KubeVirt is how VM workloads run on the clusters, on KVM. You decide which workload belongs where rather than lifting everything by default.
* Platform services. Container registry (Harbor or equivalent) and cluster identity (Keycloak or equivalent, federated with Active Directory and Entra ID), or the depth to take both on. Secrets, cert-manager, and image policy as part of how the fleet is run.
* Kubernetes-native backup and restore. Own backup and disaster recovery for stateful workloads with Velero, Kopia and etcd snapshots, and prove it by restoring, not by reading a green job status. A backup nobody has restored is not a backup.
* Observability and reliability. Prometheus and Grafana the team actually uses. On-call as a shared rotation, incident command when the platform is the fault, and a root cause analysis afterwards. Capacity planning, and DR you have tested rather than documented.
* The path from a new server to a production node. Repeatable provisioning, not a manual build: out-of-band management (IPMI, iLO, iDRAC), RAID, SAN/NAS attach, Cisco UCS, firmware, then kubeadm or Cluster API with CNI and CSI validated before the node takes workload. Linux and Windows worker nodes on the same clusters.

What the first year looks like
  
  

* Make cluster create, upgrade and retire a GitOps path that someone other than you can run.
* Establish verified high availability on production: replica counts, host anti-affinity and disruption budgets, applied and checked continuously rather than reconstructed after an outage.
* Establish provable backup and restore for the Kubernetes platform and its stateful workloads, with independently witnessed evidence. This is a stated company priority, and the platform half of it would be yours.
* Bring Active Directory, hybrid identity, Microsoft 365 and the VMware estate under the same operating standard as the Kubernetes platform: documented, monitored, and not a single point of knowledge.
* Remove the single points of knowledge, so no part of the platform depends on one person being reachable.

What we need you to have done
  
  
****Three hard requirements. Miss any one and this is not the right role.****

* Production Kubernetes you have operated, including cluster lifecycle. Not a single managed cluster you clicked in a console, and not a certificate you collected to know it. Walk us through a cluster you built or upgraded, a control-plane failure you diagnosed, and how desired state got from Git onto the nodes.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or equivalent depth you can demonstrate live. The certificate is the floor. We will still ask you to debug a real failure. CKS or CKAD is a plus. Neither substitutes for (1).
* Production Active Directory and Microsoft 365 you have operated. Multi-site or multi-domain AD, Entra Connect, Exchange Online and hybrid mail flow. Not an account you were given. On-prem Exchange is not required.

Kubernetes, the majority of the role
  
  

* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering. Production Kubernetes is a substantial part of recent work, not a lab, a side project or a certification year. We will not insist on five full years of fleet-scale Kubernetes if the depth is real and current, because this hire also has to have run Windows identity and Microsoft 365.
* Control-plane depth: etcd operations, cluster upgrades, RBAC and admission, scheduling, and failure diagnosis that is not restart-and-hope.
* GitOps in production, Flux or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm. Git is the only path to production.
* Cluster API and KubeVirt, or the equivalent: you have provisioned Kubernetes clusters as virtual machines on a management plane, not only consumed AKS or EKS. KVM underneath is expected.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking and storage as a cluster operator: Services, NetworkPolicy, Ingress or Gateway API, PVCs and StorageClasses. Deep Cilium and Ceph operations sit with the network and storage roles.
* Linux fundamentals on RHEL/AlmaLinux or Ubuntu: systemd, kernel, the storage and network stacks, performance debugging.
* Restores you have personally performed for clusters or etcd (Velero, Kopia or equivalent). Not backup jobs you monitored.
* Prometheus and Grafana in production. Thanos or Loki is a plus.
* Container registry and cluster identity (Harbor and Keycloak or equivalent), or the depth to take both on.

Windows identity and Microsoft 365, you arrive with this
  
  

* Hands-on Active Directory: multi-domain or multi-site, Group Policy at scale, replication, trusts, identity hygiene. Entra ID and Entra Connect. Enterprise DNS and DHCP, including AD-integrated DNS and DHCP failover.
* Microsoft 365 in production: Exchange Online, hybrid mail flow, and the M365 admin surface. Azure administration fundamentals.
* Application mail flow: SMTP relay, OAuth 2.0 for mail, SPF / DKIM / DMARC.
* Windows Server in production, including Windows worker nodes in Kubernetes, not console-only.
* PowerShell as a working tool, not a line on a CV. OpenTofu or Terraform, Ansible and Bash as well, plus Python or Go.

Hardware and virtualization
  
  

* Physical server work: IPMI, iLO, iDRAC, RAID, SAN/NAS attach, Cisco UCS. Automate it rather than repeat it.
* VMware vSphere/ESXi in production: hosts, vCenter, clusters, VM lifecycle, and how that estate meets Kubernetes.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear writing. An ownership mindset. Troubleshooting that proves where the fault is, across identity, mail flow, networking and storage.

Nice to have
  
  

* Cilium in production: eBPF datapath, BGP control plane, LB-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy and Hubble. The Senior Network Engineer owns this layer. It is useful here, not required.
* Ceph and CSI operations: Rook or cephadm, OSD and CRUSH, CephFS and RBD, snapshots and storage performance troubleshooting. The Senior Storage Engineer owns this layer. It is useful here, not required.
* Datacenter networking: VLANs, LACP, BGP, VXLAN, MTU and jumbo frames, enough to work fluently alongside the network team.
* Experience building and operating bare-metal Kubernetes, not managed cloud only.
* Azure experience (AKS and hybrid connectivity). AWS or GCP also useful.
* On-prem Exchange Server 2016/2019/SE: DAGs, hybrid configurations, CU/SU patching and migrations. Useful. Not required. Office 365 is the mail requirement.
* eDiscovery (standard and/or premium) and Microsoft Purview: data classification, DLP, retention and audit workflows. Useful. Not required. Microsoft 365 administration is the mail and identity requirement.
* Conditional access, Intune, and broader Entra ID security tooling.
* Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Flatcar Container Linux, OpenBao.
* Experience in a FedRAMP, SOC 2, or comparable regulated environment.
* Red Hat (RHCSA/RHCE), Ceph, Isovalent/Cilium, HashiCorp Vault, or Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305) certification.
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects.

Boundaries
  
  
Backup responsibility is split across three roles. This is the proposed division.
  
  
Owner
  
  
Owns
  
  
****Senior Cloud Engineer****
(this role)
  
  
Kubernetes-native stateful backup as part of the platform: Velero, Kopia, etcd snapshots, CSI snapshot plumbing.
  
  
****Senior Storage Engineer****
The storage and backup platform beneath it: enterprise arrays, Commvault, Ceph capacity, and restore evidence for non-database systems.
  
  
****Manager, Data Platform****
Database backup, point-in-time recovery and restore, and the evidence standard for data recoverability.
  
  
How the team works
  
  

* You would join the IT Infrastructure team and work directly with network, storage, security and the application platform teams.
* On-call is a shared rotation, not a permanent state. Major incidents escalate to the whole team, and we would rather fix the cause than staff the symptom.
* We expect ownership rather than ticket-taking. If you find something broken outside your area, we would rather you said so than routed it.
* Based in Noida. That is firm. Relocation is funded. Deep private-cloud Kubernetes people are scarcer in NCR than in Bengaluru, so we expect to hire from elsewhere rather than treat location as a filter after the fact.
* This role is a step toward platform architecture ownership as the Noida centre grows.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
  
  
**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
  
  
With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
* 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
* Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.
* React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained.
* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
* Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
* Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
* Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
* Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
* AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
* Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
* Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
* Experience in the second backend language.

**About the job:**
WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
* Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
* Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
* Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
* Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
* Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
* Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
* Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
* Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
* Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
* Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing.

**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Hiring: Claude AI & Software Development Specialist**
**Company:**
Valueline
  
  
**Location:**
Sultanpur, MG Road, New Delhi
  
  
**Experience: 1-3**
years (flexible for the right candidate)
  
  
This is a hybrid role.
  
  
**About The Role**
Valueline is looking for a tech-savvy professional with strong expertise in Claude AI and AI-powered software development to take ownership of the continued development of our in-house Operating System (OS).
  
  
Our proprietary OS has been built entirely using Claude AI and is designed to manage our internal operations and business lifecycle. We are now looking for someone who understands how to build, improve and maintain software using Claude AI, and can take our existing platform to the next level.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on software development skills with a strong understanding of Claude AI, AI-assisted coding and business process automation.
  
  
You will work closely with the business to develop new functionalities, improve existing systems, build analytical tools and enhance the overall user experience of our OS.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Claude AI & In-house OS Development
* Take ownership of the continued development and enhancement of Valueline’s existing in-house OS, built using Claude AI.
* Use Claude AI effectively for software development, debugging, feature development and system improvements.
* Build new modules and functionalities based on evolving business requirements.
* Understand the existing codebase, architecture and workflows to ensure seamless development without disrupting existing operations.
* Identify opportunities to make the OS more efficient, scalable and intelligent.
* AI-Powered Development & Automation
* Leverage Claude AI and relevant AI tools to accelerate software development and improve productivity.
* Develop AI-powered features, integrations and automation solutions within the existing OS.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks that can be automated through intelligent workflows.
* Experiment with new AI capabilities and translate them into practical business applications.
* Analytical Tools & Reporting
* Develop analytical tools, dashboards and reporting functionalities within the OS.
* Build solutions that help management track business performance, operational efficiency and key metrics.
* Improve data visibility and enable informed, data-driven decision-making.
* Bug Fixing & System Maintenance
* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve bugs and technical issues in the existing OS.

title: AI Engineer, RQA, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
AI Engineer, RQA, Associate
  
  
Your team
  
  
Join the Core Risk Engineering team within Core Risk Management, part of BlackRock's Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group, and help build production Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) systems that shape how BlackRock manages investment risk.
  
  
RQA provides independent oversight of BlackRock's fiduciary and enterprise risks globally. The Core Risk Engineering team builds and evolves the technology platforms, services, AI-enabled solutions, and data capabilities that underpin investment risk management processes.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As an Associate AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, software engineering, data, and investment risk. You will partner with RQA stakeholders and BlackRock's technology teams globally to build resilient, scalable, and modern risk technology solutions.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine the scale and complexity of a global financial institution with the challenge of building next-generation software, data platforms, and production GenAI solutions supporting investment risk management.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Contribute hands-on to the design, development, modernization, and production support of technology used across RQA.
* Apply and help shape RQA's software development practices, including Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) principles, coding standards, scalable Python, and AI-assisted development tools, to deliver reliable, on-demand risk analytics in line with firm policy.
* Develop AI-enabled tools and automated checks that analyze large volumes of data to identify unusual risk exposures for review, in partnership with risk managers.
* Build and productionize GenAI-enabled capabilities across risk and investment analysis, including information extraction, analytical assistants, and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or Google Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Design and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over risk reports, investment data, and enterprise documents so outputs are accurate, grounded, and traceable to source.
* Define, evaluate, and monitor Large Language Model (LLM) systems for quality, hallucination, latency, and cost, implementing appropriate guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and documentation aligned with BlackRock's model risk and data governance standards.
* Design, build, and maintain Python-based Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), backend services, and data pipelines that draw on enterprise and Aladdin data sources, and help modernize legacy risk workflows toward scalable architecture.

Your experience
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI development, supported by a strong software engineering background.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree, such as B.Tech, B.E., M.Tech, or M.S., in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, with proficiency in Python and Structured Query Language (SQL).
* Strong working knowledge of machine learning and LLMs, including prompt engineering, embeddings, LLM APIs, and experience designing and deploying production RAG pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, vector databases, and retrieval tuning.
* Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or Google ADK is strongly preferred.
* Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems for quality, hallucination, latency, and cost, including implementing guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Solid backend engineering experience, including Representational State Transfer (RESTful) APIs and services, testing, code review, Git, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and deployment on cloud platforms such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Amazon Web Services (AWS), using containers and enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling.
* Experience in financial services, investment risk, or another regulated environment is beneficial, together with strong ownership, adaptability, attention to detail, organizational skills, and curiosity about finance, investment, or quantitative processes.

Your learning & development
  
  
**You'll Gain**

* Ownership of production GenAI systems that support investment risk management at global scale.
* Exposure to BlackRock's culture, tools, and leadership.
* Access to learning platforms, career coaching, and peer networks.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)

**Department:**
Technology

**Reports to:**
CTO
