8+ years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India-Remote

**Company Introduction**

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021- 2025) with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4.4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities.

**Job Overview**

Genea is looking for a Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming) to lead the team building Genea Video, our cloud-native video solution built directly into the Genea security platform alongside access control and visitor management. Genea Video lets customers connect compatible RTSP cameras through the Genea Gateway (an on-site NVIDIA Jetson appliance that runs AI at the edge) or stream supported Axis cameras straight to the cloud. Customers can then watch live view and recorded playback, build camera walls, search across every camera with AI, and see the door and badge event behind every clip. You will own the engineering of this video streaming pipeline end to end, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search, and participate in the full SDLC from system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid engineering role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, building high quality, high performance software alongside a great team.

**What you would do, day-to-day?**

* Lead and grow the team building Genea Video, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search.
* Have a keen eye on code quality, with scalability, maintainability and readability in mind.
* Have a solution-oriented mindset and design high-load, low-latency video streaming systems that scale across thousands of cameras and locations.
* Estimate and delegate work across streaming, edge (Genea Gateway) and web/mobile client workstreams.
* Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team’s goals.
* Drive the design, strategy, and execution of video projects that support the Genea Video roadmap, including live view, recorded playback, camera walls, clip export and camera management.
* Lead the architecture of the video pipeline: RTSP ingest through the Genea Gateway, Axis Camera-to-Cloud streaming, transcoding, adaptive delivery, storage and retention.
* Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams working on Genea Video.
* Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for engineering and operational excellence, including stream reliability, latency, uptime and cost per camera. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessing goals and improving deliveries.
* Lead SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features, such as AI-powered search and security automations, and to fix prior mistakes.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and the Access Control and Visitor Management teams to link video to door and badge events and deliver one unified platform experience.
* Implement a data-driven approach to execution to drive transparency, and partner with DevOps and Support to keep video services reliable around the clock.

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture.
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies such as Go, Python or C++.
* Hands-on experience with video streaming technologies and protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS/DASH and RTMP, and with video codecs such as H.264 and H.265.
* Experience building or managing media pipelines for live and recorded video: ingest, transcoding, adaptive bitrate delivery, recording, storage and retention (for example, with FFmpeg or GStreamer).
* Experience with edge computing and on-device AI/computer vision. Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded platforms is a plus.
* Understanding of IP camera ecosystems (RTSP, ONVIF, Axis) and VMS/NVR concepts, and of video security use cases such as video linked to access control events.
* Experience designing for low latency, high throughput and cost-efficient storage, with observability for stream health (uptime, latency, dropped frames).
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript-based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc. Experience building browser-based video players and live view/playback interfaces is a plus.
* Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
* Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable.
* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
* Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call.
* Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed.
* Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
* Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies.
* Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels.
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious.
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.

**Competencies**

* Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

title: Quantitative Developer
description:
**Node.js + Python Developer | Ahmedabad | Full Time - 2+ Years Experience**

**About the Role**

Miracles Fintech is an NSE/BSE/MCX/SEBI-registered, technology-first proprietary trading and quantitative research firm building scalable, low-latency systematic trading systems with colocation infrastructure across Indian equity, derivatives, and commodity markets. The gap between a research idea and a live, production-grade strategy is where this role lives.

We're looking for a Quantitative Developer who understands market microstructure — order books, spreads, liquidity, price discovery, and execution dynamics — and can translate that understanding into fast, correct, well-engineered code in Python and Node.js. You'll sit between research and infrastructure: converting signals and strategies from research notebooks into production systems, building the data and execution plumbing around them, and using modern AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code) to move fast without cutting corners. This role suits engineers who think like traders and build like engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Implementation & Market Microstructure Engineering**

•
**Research-to-production:**
Translate quant research (signals, strategies, backtests) from Python research code into robust, production-ready systems in Python and Node.js.

**• Microstructure-aware engineering:**
Build order execution, order book handling, and market-data processing logic that correctly accounts for spreads, slippage, order flow, tick size, and expiry/rollover effects across NSE, BSE, and MCX.

**• Execution logic:**
Implement and refine order placement, smart order routing, and execution algorithms that minimize market impact and latency for intraday/short-term strategies.

**• Derivatives handling:**
Build systems that correctly handle futures/options data — strikes, expiries, ATM shifts, implied volatility — for both research and live trading.

**Systems & Data Engineering**

**• Real-time data pipelines:**
Build and maintain data pipelines for tick-level, OHLC, and order-book data, ensuring correctness (no look-ahead bias, no data leakage) across research and production environments.

**• Backend services:**
Design and build backend services and APIs in Node.js and Python that connect strategy logic, risk checks, and monitoring dashboards.

**• Live monitoring:**
Build tooling to compare live vs. backtested performance and flag degradation from regime change, signal decay, or execution issues.

**AI-Accelerated Development**

**• Claude Code workflows:**
Use Claude Code and structured prompting (CLAUDE.md/spec-driven development) as a core part of the development workflow — for rapid prototyping, refactoring, test generation, and documentation, while maintaining full understanding and ownership of the resulting code.

**• Engineering discipline:**
Apply the same rigor to AI-assisted code as hand-written code — reviewing, testing, and validating before anything reaches production, especially around trading and risk logic.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Market & Domain Knowledge**

• Solid understanding of market microstructure — order books, bid-ask spreads, liquidity, price discovery, slippage, and market impact.

• Familiarity with Indian markets (NSE/BSE/MCX), derivatives (futures/options), and expiry/rollover mechanics.

• Ability to read and reason about strategy logic — mean reversion, momentum, spread/ratio trading, or similar — well enough to implement it correctly.

**Core Technical Skills**

• Strong proficiency in Python (mandatory) for research-to-production work, and Node.js for backend/API development.

• Comfortable building and consuming real-time and REST/WebSocket APIs; experience with high-throughput or time-series data is a plus.

• Practical experience using Claude Code or similar AI-assisted coding tools in a real development workflow — not just casual use.

• Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and writing clean, testable, production-grade code.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

• Experience with XTS APIs integration

• Experience with time-series/high-throughput databases (QuestDB or similar) and caching layers (Redis).

• Exposure to backtesting frameworks, execution algorithms, or low-latency system design.

• Prior experience at a prop trading firm, brokerage, or exchange-connected technology team.

• Familiarity with structured, spec-driven development practices (CLAUDE.md/TASKS.md-style workflows) for working effectively with AI coding tools.

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a closely related field; a Master's degree is a plus.

**How to Apply**

Email: hradmin@miraclesfintech.com

Website: www.miraclesfintech.com

title: Strategist
description:
**About Powersmy.Biz** Powersmy.Biz is an AI-first revenue and growth company. Through our brands, including Navrev, Relay and FIKA Engage, we help businesses grow revenue by fixing the whole funnel: lead generation, paid media, SEO, chat and voice AI, call QC, outreach, reporting and re-engagement. Our clients span healthcare, education, retail and ecommerce, B2B services and hospitality, and many of them are founder-led. Some come to us directly; others come through our agency and technology partners.

**The Role**

You are the person who decides what we do for a client, and why. Account managers own the relationship; delivery teams and AI agents run the work. You own the thinking in between: the diagnosis, the growth plan, the channel mix, the experiments and the call on what to change when results move. You will hold a strategy for a portfolio of client accounts at once. For each one you set the goal, write the plan, brief the team, read the results every week and change course with evidence, not opinion. When something works more than once, you turn it into a tool or a product spec, not just a slide.

**Why this role matters:** we sell outcomes, not activity. Clients renew and expand when the numbers move, and the numbers move when the strategy is right. That strategy is yours.

**What You Will Own** **1. Pre-sale diagnosis**

* Run audits and qualification before a client signs: business-fit checks, SEO, UI-UX, ads and chatbot audits, and lead-response tests.
* Use the audit to show the prospect where they are losing revenue, grounded in real data, never inflated.
* Shape the proposal from what the audit found, not from a standard package.

**2. Diagnosis before plan**

* Read each client's business end to end: unit economics, margins, pricing, sales process, lead flow, funnel data and customer behaviour.
* Look beyond marketing: sales follow-up, CRM hygiene, operations, inventory, stores and telephony are often where revenue actually leaks.
* Test the funnel as a customer before you read the dashboard. Submit a lead, message the chatbot, call the number after hours, and time the response.
* Read call and chat QC transcripts. Dashboards tell you what happened; conversations tell you why.
* Find the real constraint on growth. Is it traffic, lead quality, speed to lead, conversion, retention or cash? Fix that first, not the channel you like best.
* Write the diagnosis in one page, with the numbers, before anything is built or spent.

**3. Growth strategy and plan per account**

* Set one clear outcome per client, with a metric, a baseline and a target date.
* Build the plan to hit it: channel mix (Meta, Google Ads, SEO, content, outreach, chat and voice AI, re-engagement), budget split, offer and funnel changes.
* State what we are not doing, and why. A good plan rules channels out as clearly as it rules them in.
* Run a pre-mortem on every plan: what could make it fail, and what we will watch for early.

**4. Briefs that execution can run without you**

* lTurn strategy into clear, specific briefs for delivery teams and our AI agents: audience, message, offer, budget, success metric and deadline.
* Contribute to our playbook library, so a strategy that works once can be reused across clients.
* Check output against the brief and send back anything that will not move the number.

**5. Productising what works**

* When a fix works for more than one client, write it up as a business or product requirements document (BRD or PRD) that our developers and AI teams can build from.
* Examples: automated audits, lead-magnet tools, reporting views, outreach and agent configurations.
* Review what gets built against the spec, and test it before it reaches a client.

**6. Experiments and optimisation**

* Run a test-and-learn rhythm on every account: one hypothesis, one change, one metric, read on a fixed date.
* Kill what does not work fast, scale what does, and record why in the account log.

**7. Reporting, insight and the next move**

* Read dashboards fluently: CAC, ROAS, CPL, conversion by stage, response time, pipeline and revenue attribution.
* Turn each week's numbers into a short story and a decision: what happened, why, and what we do next.
* Arm the account manager with the insight, the recommendation and the upsell case for founder conversations.
* Show clients only confirmed results. Keep internal process and half-finished work inside the team.

**8. Commercial thinking**

* Help scope proposals and outcome-based contracts: the metric, the baseline, the attribution window and what is realistic.
* Never sign off a target, timeline or promise that the data and the team cannot defend.

**9. Partner-sourced accounts**

* Run strategy for clients that come through our agency and technology partners, sometimes under the partner's brand.
* Keep the partner informed and confident, so they bring us the next client.

**10. Escalations on strategy**

* Own strategy questions that account managers escalate to you, and answer them within one working day with a clear recommendation.
* Know the difference between a strategy problem and an execution problem, and route each one to the right owner.

**What We Are Looking For** **Must-haves**

* 3+ years in growth strategy, performance marketing strategy, digital strategy or revenue roles, at an agency, consultancy, D2C brand or SaaS company.
* Owned the strategy and the result for several clients or business lines at once, not only executed someone else's plan.
* Hands-on depth in at least two of: paid media (Meta, Google), SEO and content, CRM and lifecycle, outbound, conversion and funnel optimisation. Working knowledge of the rest.
* Strong with numbers: comfortable in spreadsheets and dashboards, and able to build a simple funnel model or budget plan yourself.
* Can show a growth result you drove: the number before, the number after, and what you changed.
* Has built at least one working AI workflow, agent or automation for their own work, and can show it.
* Has written a spec or brief that a developer, designer or delivery team built from without needing a follow-up meeting.
* Curious about AI in marketing and revenue work, and able to explain AI-led products in plain business language.
* Excellent written and spoken English: one-page plans, sharp briefs, clear recommendations.

**How you think**

* First principles: you start from the client's business and its constraint, not from a channel or a template.
* Evidence over opinion: every recommendation comes with the data behind it and the metric that will prove it right or wrong.
* Test it yourself: you experience the client's funnel as a customer before you trust a report about it.
* Thinking in constraints: you plan inside real limits of budget, time, team capacity and client readiness, and you lay out the trade-offs.
* Understanding the why: you know the business reason behind every task, and you push back when the reason does not hold up.
* Simple and specific: you can say the strategy in three sentences and the brief in one page.

**Traits we hire for**

* Ownership: you treat each account's result as your own.
* Speed with rigour: you decide quickly, test cheaply and learn fast.
* Builder's instinct: when you solve a problem twice, you want to make sure nobody has to solve it a third time.
* Clear writer: your plans and briefs need no follow-up meeting to understand.
* Collaborative: account managers and delivery teams want you in the room.
* Honest: you call out a failing plan early, including your own.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in healthcare, education, retail or ecommerce, B2B services or hospitality.
* Experience with offline or omnichannel businesses: stores, inventory, call centres.
* Experience with international clients (Middle East, US, Australia).
* Familiarity with Zoho, HubSpot, GA4, Looker Studio or similar tools.

**Not for you** if You can only think or only execute. We need someone who decides the plan and can roll up their sleeves to prove it. It is also not for you if you defend a plan after the data has turned against it, you write long decks instead of clear decisions, or you need a template before you can start.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Movement on each account's agreed target metric against its baseline
* Client retention and expansion revenue on your accounts
* Experiments run and read on time, with decisions logged
* Every account with a current one-page diagnosis, plan and pre-mortem
* Strategy escalations answered within one working day
* Playbooks you add to the library that other strategists reuse
* Specs and tools you define that make it into production

**How You Will Work**

* Hybrid setup, with team days in office and flexibility on the rest.
* Strategy reviews across India, Gulf, Australian and US time zones, so some flexibility on timing is needed.
* Occasional travel for client workshops and pitches.

**What You Get**

* Real ownership of strategy for a portfolio of clients from day one.
* Work with founders across industries and geographies.
* Hands-on work with AI-led revenue products and execution, and a say in what we build next.
* Direct access to leadership.
* A fast-growth environment with a clear path to Senior Strategist and Head of Strategy.

**Our Hiring Process**

* CV and short note screen
* Intro call with the Business Head
* Live audit: we name a real business; within 24 hours you mystery-shop its funnel and send one page on its biggest revenue leak
* Case exercise: given a client's funnel data, write a one-page diagnosis and a 90-day growth plan
* Case review: walk us through your plan and defend it under questions
* Final conversation with leadership

**ABOUT ORGANIZATION**

***Immidart*** Technologies LLP is an *Enterprise SaaS* company offering Global Mobility solutions to organisations across the world. The firm is backed and incubated by the TTK Group, a global conglomerate in India. Immidart was founded in January 2015 and has its headquarters at Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a ***Senior Product Analyst*** to drive product implementation, functional enhancements, change requests (CRs), and related product delivery activities for our enterprise SaaS platform.

The individual will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Customer Success teams, and customers to understand business requirements, configure product capabilities, define functional requirements, and ensure successful delivery.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and functional skills, with the ability to understand business processes, identify functional gaps, recommend appropriate solutions, and independently drive assigned activities through implementation and closure under the guidance of the Business Analyst.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Product Implementation:** Drive assigned end-to-end product implementation activities, including requirement understanding, product configuration, functional validation, UAT, and go-live support.
* **Customer Interaction:** Interact with customers to understand their business processes, functional requirements, feedback, and implementation expectations.
* Requirement Gathering and Analysis: Elicit, analyze, organize, and document business requirements for product implementations, enhancements, and change requests.
* **Process Analysis and Functional Solutioning:** Analyze customer business processes and recommend appropriate functional solutions by leveraging existing product capabilities.
* **Gap Analysis:** Identify gaps between customer requirements and existing product functionalities and collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Managers to recommend suitable solutions.
* **Product Configuration:** Configure and maintain product workflows, business rules, approval hierarchies, access controls, and other configurable functionalities as per customer requirements.
* **Product Enhancements and Change Requests:** Analyze, document, and drive assigned product enhancements and change requests from requirement definition through development, testing, deployment, and closure.
* **Impact Analysis:** Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing product functionalities, workflows, business rules, configurations, and integrations.
* **Documentation:** Prepare and maintain product requirement documents, functional specifications, process flows, user stories, business rules, validations, and acceptance criteria.
* **Product Improvement:** Identify and recommend product enhancements based on customer feedback, recurring requirements, operational challenges, and opportunities for process improvement.
* **Integration Requirements:** Support the analysis and documentation of system integration requirements, including data mapping, business rules, validations, and exception-handling scenarios.
* **Project Coordination and Reporting:** Track the progress of assigned implementations, enhancements, and change requests. Communicate project status, dependencies, risks, and potential delays to relevant stakeholders.
* **Agile Delivery:** Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, sprint reviews, and other product development activities.
* **Internal Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Business Analysts, Product Managers, developers, QA, and Customer Success teams to ensure requirement clarity and successful product delivery.
* **Functional Testing and UAT:** Validate developed functionalities against agreed requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and facilitate the resolution and closure of identified issues.
* **Product Support:** Assist in analyzing escalated production issues, identifying functional or configuration-related gaps, and coordinating resolution with relevant teams.
* **Training and Communication:** Conduct product demonstrations, feature walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions for internal teams and customers where required.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in Product Analysis, Business Analysis, Product Implementation, Functional Consulting, or similar roles.
* Experience working on enterprise workflow systems such as ERP, HRMS, CRM, B2B SaaS, compliance platforms, or similar applications.
* Exposure to at least one complete product or system implementation lifecycle.
* Experience in analyzing and documenting customer requirements, product enhancements, and change requests.
* Experience in business process analysis, workflow mapping, functional solutioning, and requirement documentation.
* Exposure to product configuration, functional testing, UAT coordination, and go-live activities.
* Exposure to API-based integrations, system-to-system data flows, and data mapping.
* Understanding of project management practices and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience coordinating with customers, development teams, QA, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to independently manage assigned requirements and implementation activities through delivery and closure.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**Primary Key Skills**

* **Business Analysis Tools:** Familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io, and Balsamiq for process modeling, workflow documentation, and wireframing.
* **Requirement Management:** Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms for managing requirements, change requests, and delivery activities.
* **Product Configuration:** Ability to understand and configure enterprise application workflows, business rules, and functional settings.
* **Data Analysis:** Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, validation, and reporting. Familiarity with Power BI or similar visualization tools is desirable.
* **Database Knowledge:** Basic understanding of SQL for querying databases, validating data, and supporting functional analysis.
* **Project Management:** Understanding of project management methodologies, Agile and Scrum practices, delivery tracking, and dependency management.
* **API and Integration:** Understanding of API concepts, JSON, data mapping, and system integration processes.
* **UI/UX and Prototyping:** Familiarity with Figma, Balsamiq, or similar tools for creating basic wireframes and screen mock-ups to communicate functional requirements.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience working on B2B enterprise SaaS products.
* Exposure to HRMS or other enterprise system integrations.
* Experience working with configurable and workflow-driven applications.
* Exposure to compliance-driven or regulatory business processes.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Exposure to AI-assisted tools for requirement analysis, documentation, and prototyping.
* Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Product Management, or Agile/Scrum.

**SOFT SKILLS**

* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills for interacting with customers, internal stakeholders, and documenting requirements.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Strong analytical skills for understanding business processes, identifying functional gaps, and recommending appropriate solutions.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to investigate functional issues, evaluate solution alternatives, and recommend practical solutions.
* **Ownership and Accountability:** Ability to independently drive assigned activities, proactively follow up on dependencies, and ensure timely closure.
* **Teamwork:** Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to effectively coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders while managing expectations.
* **Attention to Detail:** Strong attention to detail in requirement documentation, product configuration, business rules, and functional validation.
* **Time Management:** Ability to prioritize and manage multiple implementations, enhancements, and change requests simultaneously.

title: Senior Analyst - Process Modelling
description:
**Job Description :**

**About us:**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.

Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

**About the Function:**

Global Business Operations keeps our business moving, connecting markets, streamlining processes and keeping everything running smoothly at scale.

With teams across Bangalore, Budapest, Bogotá, Gurugram, and Manila, GBO delivers the essential services that support our day-to-day performance, from finance to operations and beyond. It’s a truly global environment, where collaboration across time zones and cultures is part of everyday life.

**About the team:**

**About the role: The Process Modelling & SAP Signavio Specialist will be a member of the Process Modelling Centre of Excellence (CoE), responsible for supporting the organisation in establishing and maintaining high-quality, standardized and governed business process documentation.**

**The role will provide specialist capability in BPMN 2.0 and SAP Signavio, supporting process modelling, model quality assurance, governance, training, migration activities and continuous improvement.**

**As the organisation transitions from ARIS to SAP Signavio, the role will also support the successful adoption of the new process management environment and help build sustainable internal capability in process modelling and process governance.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. BPMN 2.0 Process Modelling & Quality Assurance**

**Review process models for modelling quality, consistency and compliance before publication.**

**Identify and correct modelling issues including incorrect gateway usage, event usage, sequence/message flow errors, deadlocks, livelocks and other BPMN anti-patterns.**

**Guide business users and process owners on appropriate process modelling techniques and conventions.**

**Support the development and continuous improvement of enterprise process modelling standards.**

**2. SAP Signavio Capability**

**Develop strong functional expertise in SAP Signavio Process Manager and associated process collaboration capabilities.**

**Support business users in creating, reviewing and maintaining process models within SAP Signavio.**

**Support configuration and administration activities that fall within the Process Modelling CoE's scope.**

**Support governance of process models, attributes, modelling conventions and publication requirements.**

**Work with relevant technical teams and implementation partners to investigate and resolve Signavio-related issues.**

**4. Process Governance**

**Support the Process Modelling CoE in implementing enterprise process modelling governance.**

**Ensure process models comply with agreed modelling standards, naming conventions, taxonomy and quality requirements.**

**Perform governance and quality checks before process models progress through the approval/publication lifecycle.**

**Support the definition and maintenance of modelling guidelines, governance controls and supporting documentation.**

**Help drive consistency in process modelling practices across different business functions.**

**5. Training & Capability Building**

**Deliver SAP Signavio and BPMN 2.0 training to business users, process SMEs and other stakeholders.**

**Support development and continuous improvement of training materials, exercises, assessments and reference guides.**

**Coach users on BPMN modelling principles and Signavio functionality.**

**Support assessment of users before appropriate modelling/editor access is provided.**

**Act as a point of contact for BPMN 2.0 and process modelling queries.**

**6. Stakeholder & Business Support**

**Work closely with Global Process Owners, Process SMEs, Business Analysts, technology teams and other CoEs.**

**Translate business process information into clear and standardized process models.**

**Challenge process models constructively where they do not meet agreed standards or modelling principles.**

**Provide specialist guidance to stakeholders on how business scenarios should be represented using BPMN 2.0.**

**Support workshops and working sessions relating to process modelling, governance and Signavio adoption.**

**7. Continuous Improvement**

**Identify opportunities to improve process modelling practices, governance controls and user experience.**

**Monitor recurring modelling issues and recommend preventive actions through standards, training or system controls.**

**Contribute to building reusable modelling guidance, examples and best practices.**

**Stay current with developments in BPMN, Business Process Management and SAP Signavio and apply relevant practices within the organisation.**

**Essential Skills & Experience**

**Strong understanding of business process management and process modelling.**

**Working knowledge of BPMN 2.0 or demonstrated ability to develop advanced BPMN capability.**

**Experience creating, reviewing or analysing end-to-end business processes.**

**Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.**

**Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into structured process models.**

**Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies in process documentation.**

**Experience working with business stakeholders across functions and geographies.**

**Strong communication and facilitation skills.**

**Ability and willingness to deliver training and coach business users.**

**Ability to work within defined governance frameworks while constructively challenging non-compliant practices.**

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

**Hands-on experience with SAP Signavio Process Manager.**

**Previous experience with ARIS or another enterprise process modelling platform.**

**Experience with process model migration or transformation programmes.**

**Experience in a Process Excellence, Business Process Management, Business Analysis or Process Modelling CoE environment.**

**Understanding of process hierarchy/taxonomy and enterprise process architecture.**

**Exposure to process governance, workflow approvals and process repositories.**

**BPMN, SAP Signavio, Business Analysis, Lean Six Sigma or related professional certification would be advantageous.**

**Key Competencies**

**The successful candidate should demonstrate:**

**Process thinking – ability to understand processes end-to-end rather than as isolated activities.**

**Modelling discipline – ability to apply standards consistently and accurately.**

**Analytical thinking – ability to identify logical gaps, exceptions and process weaknesses.**

**Quality orientation – strong attention to modelling and documentation quality.**

**Stakeholder management – confidence working with SMEs, process owners and cross-functional teams.**

**Consulting mindset – ability to question, challenge and recommend better approaches rather than simply document what is provided.**

**Learning agility – willingness to rapidly build deep expertise in BPMN 2.0 and SAP Signavio.**

**Knowledge sharing – willingness and ability to train, coach and support other users.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**Success in this role means that business processes are represented accurately, consistently and in accordance with BPMN 2.0 and organisational modelling standards; business users receive effective guidance and training; SAP Signavio adoption is supported through strong internal expertise; and the organisation develops a sustainable process modelling capability that is not dependent on external implementation partners.**

**The role will be expected to progressively develop into a subject-matter expert in BPMN 2.0 and SAP Signavio process modelling and contribute to strengthening the Process Modelling CoE as the organisation's specialist capability for process modelling and governance.**

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Flutter Developer (iOS & Android) | Ride-Hailing Apps

Job description :

Ahlan Rides is hiring a full-time, mid-level Flutter Developer based in India to build our rider and driver apps for an initial launch in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Both apps will support English and Arabic. You’ll work with the founder, UI/UX designer and backend engineer from the first booking flow through release on Google Play and the Apple App Store.

An early milestone will be a complete test ride on two phones. A rider requests a trip, a driver accepts it, and both see the correct trip status even if one phone briefly loses its connection. We’re looking for someone who can build that experience and explain how they tested it.

Work location :

You’ll work remotely from India for the first three months, with regular overlap during agreed Riyadh working hours. From month four, you can continue working remotely from India or, by mutual agreement, relocate to work on-site in Riyadh. Relocation is optional. If you’re interested in moving, we’ll discuss the timing, compensation and any relocation support with you in writing before you decide.

What you’ll build :

Rider app. Pickup selection, destination search, one pickup with multiple drop-offs, vehicle categories, fare estimates, booking, live driver tracking, payments, receipts and trip support. Driver app. Registration, document submission, online availability, incoming ride requests, pickup navigation, trip status and earnings. Our planned zero-commission model also requires drivers to see their subscription status, cost and renewal date. Shared features. Sign-in, notifications, trip history and English and Arabic layouts, including right-to-left navigation. Future releases may include partner car rentals, premium memberships and installment-payment options.

Your responsibilities :

Turn Figma designs into accessible Flutter screens that work across different phone sizes, including lower-cost Android devices. Integrate maps, GPS, backend APIs, real-time trip updates and payment services. Handle location permissions, background tracking and battery use appropriately during driver availability and active trips. Work with the backend engineer to prevent duplicate bookings and recover the correct trip after weak connectivity, an app restart or a delayed notification. Write maintainable Dart code and automated tests for critical journeys. Test on real Android and iOS devices, review code in Git and document release steps. Prepare test builds and store submissions, monitor crashes after release and resolve production issues. Keep source code and release credentials in company-approved systems.

Experience and skills :

Ideally 3+ years in mobile development, including 2+ years using Flutter and Dart, or equivalent experience demonstrated through shipped apps. Hands-on experience releasing a production mobile app. Be ready to explain which features you personally built and how you supported them after launch. Practical knowledge of Flutter state management, API integration, asynchronous programming, debugging and performance testing. Ride-hailing experience is a strong plus. Experience with delivery, logistics, navigation, live location or another on-demand marketplace is also valuable. Experience with Arabic right-to-left interfaces, Google Maps or Mapbox, push notifications, payment integrations or release automation is an advantage.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Senior Data Performance Engineer (Oracle, dbt, Airflow)
description:
About the role
  
  
This role focuses on making data workflows built on dbt and Apache Airflow on Oracle run fast and reliably. Workflows migrated from Informatica must produce accurate data and perform as well as or better than the process they replace.
  
  
**As a member of the performance engineering team, you will:**  

* Troubleshoot. Find the root cause of slow data workflows across the database, transformation and orchestration layers.
* Tune. Fix the bottleneck and prove the improvement with measurements, without affecting data accuracy.
* Templatize. Turn each fix into a reusable pattern, template or guideline that other developers can apply on their own.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys tracking down where time is lost and building solutions that keep the same problem from coming back.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Troubleshoot performance end to end
  

* Profile slow workflows across the full execution path: scheduler, Airflow, containers, dbt and database.
* Separate actual database processing time from framework and orchestration overhead.
* Set performance baselines and compare results against legacy Informatica runtimes.
* Identify root causes and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Tune across every layer
  

* Oracle: Tune SQL and PL/SQL using execution plans, SQL Monitor, AWR/ASH and wait-event analysis. Resolve optimizer, cardinality, memory and parallelism issues. Tune distributed queries across database links so processing happens where the data lives.
* dbt: Design efficient models and materializations. Reduce parsing, compilation and run overhead, and keep large projects fast.
* Airflow: Design efficient DAGs and tasks. Reduce scheduling and start-up delays, and make workflows reliable through sound retry, restart and failure handling.
* Find and fix data accuracy and reliability issues uncovered during tuning.

Build reusable templates and standards
  

* Turn proven fixes into reusable templates, macros, utilities and shared components.
* Design shared changes so they can be adopted gradually and rolled back safely.
* Create tuning playbooks, troubleshooting checklists and automated performance checks that catch regressions before release.
* Mentor developers and review designs so new workflows perform well from the start.

Collaborate and influence
  

* Present findings, options, trade-offs and measured results to developers, architects, DBAs and leadership.
* Work with architecture and database teams to get approval for platform-level improvements.

What you bring
  
  
Required qualifications
  

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or database engineering, with significant hands-on Oracle performance tuning.
* Production experience with dbt and an understanding of how dbt builds and runs models.
* Production experience with Apache Airflow DAG design and operations.
* Working knowledge of ETL concepts, ideally including Informatica PowerCenter.
* Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting and Python.
* A data-driven approach: measure first, isolate the problem, change one thing and prove the result.
* Experience turning one-off fixes into standards or tools used by others.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to have
  

* Hands-on Informatica PowerCenter experience, including migration to modern platforms.
* Docker and container-based execution.
* Enterprise schedulers such as Control-M.
* Large-scale dbt projects or the dbt Python API.
* Oracle RAC and parallel execution.
* Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data pipelines.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.

We are looking for a skilled and experienced **Java Full Stack Lead** to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in object-oriented programming, strong experience with the Spring Framework, and practical frontend experience with React JS.

This role requires a collaborative mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and an interest in developing high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance, reusable Java applications.
* Develop and maintain responsive frontend components using React JS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries for relational databases such as DB2 or Oracle.
* Work with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ.
* Develop scalable solutions using microservices architecture to ensure modularity, availability, and ease of deployment in distributed systems.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs to enable backend-to-frontend integration
* Analyse requirements and propose effective technical solutions considering functional and non-functional requirements.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
* Write automated unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito.
* Write and maintain documentation of software components and code.
* Conduct and participate in peer code reviews and design discussions.
* Ensure performance, security, and availability of applications.
* Identify and address technical risks and issues; propose and implement practical solutions.
* Conduct demos and facilitate acceptance discussions with Product Owners to validate deliverables.
* Maintain a proactive attitude toward learning and adopting new tools and frameworks.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required experience and skills**

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on delivery of backend or distributed systems; the technical lead should typically have 10+ years.

Strong Java experience (Java 17 or later preferred) and production experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, service design, testing, and troubleshooting.

Experience designing distributed systems and event-driven architectures, including Kafka or a compatible platform such as Amazon MSK.

Experience deploying or operating containerised services on Kubernetes; AWS EKS experience is strongly preferred.

Sound understanding of relational databases and SQL, data modelling, transactions, concurrency, schema evolution, and performance tuning.

Experience with at least one document database and one Redis-compatible in-memory data platform; understanding of when to use each and their consistency and failure trade-offs.

Practical knowledge of API and event versioning, idempotency, resiliency patterns, back-pressure, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.

Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code review, and production support for business-critical services.

Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design trade-offs and work effectively across teams.

**Preferred experience**

Experience in payments, fintech, commerce, banking, provider integrations, or another regulated, business-critical domain.

Familiarity with payment lifecycle concepts, provider routing, payment status handling, reconciliation, refunds or reversals, and operational exception flows.

Experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM, CloudWatch, and managed messaging or networking services.

Experience with Datadog and OpenTelemetry, including distributed tracing and service-level indicators.

Infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation; Helm and GitOps-based Kubernetes delivery.

Awareness of PCI DSS and secure handling of sensitive payment data. Direct compliance implementation experience is an advantage, not a substitute for sound engineering fundamentals.

**Technology environment**

Core engineering environment: Java and Spring Boot; AWS EKS; Amazon MSK; Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB compatibility; Amazon MemoryDB for Redis; Amazon RDS; Amazon S3; AWS Secrets Manager; and Datadog. The final service choices and versions will be confirmed during solution design.

Candidates should be able to reason from workload needs and operating requirements rather than assume a particular service is right for every use case.

**Recommended stack additions and design clarifications**

API edge and protection: identify whether Kong or Amazon API Gateway will own external API management, and include AWS WAF where public web APIs require managed edge protection.

Async work and recovery: use MSK for domain event streams where replay and multiple consumers matter; consider SQS with dead-letter queues for isolated work queues and controlled redelivery. Define outbox/inbox and idempotency patterns across database and message boundaries.

Security and audit: include AWS KMS, IAM roles for service accounts, CloudTrail, network segmentation, and a clear sensitive-data and tokenisation approach. Confirm applicable PCI DSS scope and market-specific obligations with the client security team.

Platform delivery: include infrastructure as code, Helm, CI/CD or GitOps, automated security checks, environment promotion, and tested rollback procedures.

Telemetry: standardise on OpenTelemetry-compatible instrumentation and consistent correlation IDs; use Datadog as the operational view, with CloudWatch retained where needed for AWS-native signals.

Database fit: confirm DocumentDB API and feature compatibility against the application’s MongoDB driver and required behaviors before locking the choice. Use MemoryDB when Redis-compatible in-memory data durability is required; if the primary need is an expendable low-latency cache, evaluate ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey. Specify the RDS engine and its purpose.

Workflow orchestration: keep latency-sensitive payment processing paths lean. Consider a workflow engine for long-running or human-assisted exception flows only when the state, timeout, and recovery requirements justify it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Quality Assurance Developer
description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  
Successful candidate will be part of the Engineering team responsible for testing of OpenText’s IX (GXS) product solutions, achieving organization’s goal of delivering high quality and on time releases.
  
  
What the role offers
  
  

* Analyze requirements, user stories and architecture to identify test scenarios, risks and edge cases.
* Write clear test plans, test cases and acceptance criteria covering functional, integration, regression and negative scenarios.
* Apply test design techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning and decision tables.

UI testing and automation
  
  

* Test web applications for functionality, usability, cross-browser behavior and responsiveness.
* Build and maintain UI automation using Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress with a Page Object Model or similar maintainable design.
* Reduce flaky tests through stable locators, proper waits and good test-data handling.

API and backend testing
  
  

* Understand how backend services, request/response flows, authentication and service-to-service calls work.
* Test REST APIs manually (Postman) and through automation (REST Assured, or Python requests/pytest), validating status codes, payloads, headers, schemas and error handling.
* Test authentication and authorisation flows such as OAuth 2.0, JWT and API keys.
* Use application logs and monitoring tools to investigate failures down to the service level.

Database testing
  
  

* Write SQL queries to validate data integrity, transformations and persistence after UI and API actions.
* Automate data validation and test-data setup/cleanup as part of test suites.

CI/CD and quality practices
  
  

* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) and keep them green and fast.
* Report test results and quality metrics such as coverage, pass rate and defect trends.
* Log, track and verify defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps and root-cause notes.
* Take part in Agile ceremonies, code reviews of test code and continuous improvement of the test framework.

What you need to succeed
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–4 years of hands-on experience testing web UI and backend applications.
* Solid understanding of how backend systems work: client-server architecture, HTTP, REST principles, JSON/XML, how the UI, services and database interact.
* Strong grasp of testing methodologies for UI and APIs: functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end and negative testing.
* Proven automation experience across all three layers:
* UI: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright
* REST APIs: REST Assured, Postman, or pytest with requests
* Database: SQL-based validation using JDBC or Python DB libraries
* Good programming skills in Java or Python (JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus), including OOP and writing clean, reusable test code.
* Experience with test frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit or pytest, and build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
* Working knowledge of SQL (joins, aggregations, subqueries) on a relational database such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle or SQL Server.
* Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines and using Git for version control.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and defect tracking in Jira.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills, and clear written and verbal communication.

One last thing
  
  

* Experience with BDD tools such as Cucumber or Behave.
* Performance testing with JMeter, Gatling or k6.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* Contract or schema testing for APIs (JSON Schema, OpenAPI/Swagger, Pact).
* Testing of messaging or integration systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, file-based or B2B data exchange).
* Basic security testing awareness, such as the OWASP Top 10.
* ISTQB Foundation or an equivalent certification.
* Attention to detail and the ability to triage and diagnose complex issues in test applications.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to learn and contribute quickly.
* Ability to handle assigned tasks independently and also a good team player.
* Possess good communication and interpersonal skills.

Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Software Testing Engineer
description:
Overview:

Test assigned features in web and Windows desktop applications through manual testing and automation. Design and execute test cases, write and maintain automated scripts, and contribute to the team’s automation frameworks. Work with the QA lead and developers to report defects, verify fixes, and support reliable software releases.

Responsibilities:

* **. Requirements and test planning**

* Analyse requirements for assigned features to identify test scenarios, edge cases, and quality risks.
* Prepare test cases and test data and contribute to test plans and strategy reviews with the QA lead.
* **Manual and API testing**

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate web and Windows desktop workflows and test the APIs that support them.
* **Automation development**

* Write, run, debug and maintain test suites written in C# using SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Selenium or Playwright.
* Build reusable test components and contribute to automation framework development and maintenance.
* **CI/CD and defect management**

* Help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor results, and investigate failures.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, track them with developers, and verify fixes.
* **Sprint and release delivery**

* Clarify expected behaviour with developers and product owners and estimate testing effort during sprint planning.
* Complete assigned sprint and release testing, communicate results, and raise quality risks early.
* **Peer support and continuous improvement**

* Review peers’ test cases and scripts, share testing practices, and help newer engineers troubleshoot issues.
* Identify repetitive manual checks and evaluate automation or AI-assisted testing to improve coverage and reduce effort.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering or any equivalent technical discipline.
* 3–5 years in software QA, including manual testing and automation.
* Experience designing test cases and preparing test data.
* Hands-on testing of web apps, Windows desktop apps, and APIs.
* Strong writing, run, debug and maintain test suites written in C# using SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Selenium or Playwright.
* Experience building or maintaining BDD frameworks using Spec Flow, Reqnroll, or Cucumber.
* Hands-on experience with step definitions, hooks, reusable components, and test configuration.
* Experience turning requirements into BDD scenarios with analysts, developers, and QA teams.
* Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines, investigating failures, and verifying fixes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and defect tracking in Jira or Digital.ai Agility (VersionOne).

title: Senior Gen AI Scientist
description:
**The team - who are we:**

We are an ambitious team with the shared passion to use data, data science, machine learning, generative AI and engineering excellence to make a difference for our customers.

We are a team, not a collection of individuals. We value our diverse backgrounds, our different personalities and strengths & weaknesses. We value trust and passionate debates. We challenge each other and hold each other accountable. We uphold a caring feedback culture to help each other grow, professionally and personally.

We are now seeking a new team member who is excited about building production-grade generative AI and agentic systems that automate and augment end-to-end workflows across container terminal planning, scheduling, execution and operations worldwide, helping terminals compound intelligence across decisions rather than solving problems one at a time.

**We Offer - This Is What You Get**

You will be part of the APM Terminals team within APMT TECH, responsible for developing and delivering generative AI and agentic solutions for container shipping terminals. As a Senior Generative AI Scientist, you will have a leading role in designing, building, maintaining, and iterating on AI products that directly impact terminal operations and commercial outcomes.

This position goes well beyond chatbots and single-shot prompting. You will design multi-agent systems that plan, reason, use tools, and act across terminal workflows: berth and yard planning, equipment scheduling, vessel operations, exception handling, and back-office processes. You will work at the intersection of large language models, retrieval and semantic layers over operational data, and classical optimization and simulation, combining them so that each layer strengthens the next.

This is an exciting time to join a growing and dynamic team that solves some of the toughest problems in terminal operations and builds the future of container shipping. We offer a unique opportunity to impact global trade via world-leading container terminals. We focus on our people and the right candidate will have broad possibilities to further develop competencies in an environment characterized by change and continuous progress.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation and delivery of agentic AI systems that automate end-to-end terminal workflows spanning planning, scheduling, execution and operations, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, and human-in-the-loop control
* Architect retrieval and grounding layers over operational and enterprise data, including semantic layers, knowledge graphs and vector search, so that LLM-driven systems answer and act on trustworthy, terminal-specific context
* Build production LLM applications with rigorous evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability and cost/latency management, taking systems from prototype through to reliable operation at terminals globally
* Integrate generative AI with existing optimization, simulation and ML assets so agents can invoke solvers and models as tools rather than replacing them
* Establish and evangelize best practices for AI-assisted engineering across the team, using modern development tools and agentic coding workflows to raise team-wide productivity
* Coach and mentor team members in LLM application design, agentic patterns, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation methods
* Work with relevant stakeholders to understand terminal operational dynamics and business processes, incorporating their needs into products to enhance value delivery
* Collaborate and communicate system design, results and insights with product teams, leadership and business stakeholders to roll out solutions to production environments
* Analyse data, measure delivered value, and continuously evaluate and improve systems to increase effectiveness and operational impact

**To do this job, we imagine you have:**

* 5+ years of industry experience in building and delivering ML or AI products, with at least 2 years of hands-on practitioner experience shipping LLM-based applications to production
* PhD or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or other field related to algorithms and data (or equivalent experience)
* Demonstrated experience building agentic systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, function calling, planning and reasoning loops, and workflow automation using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent in-house stacks
* Strong practical command of retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, semantic layers, and structured grounding of LLMs over enterprise and operational data
* Experience with LLM evaluation and reliability engineering: building eval suites, red-teaming, hallucination and drift monitoring, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization in production
* Fluency with modern AI development tools and code assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow, not an occasional aid
* Excellent record of delivery using Python and technologies like Git, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Ability to understand complex operational systems and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions
* Experience in leading technical work, coaching junior colleagues, and driving projects from concept to delivery
* Strong communication skills with ability to work independently with stakeholders while liaising and reviewing with the team

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in container terminal operations, port logistics, supply chain, or similar operational environments with complex resource allocation and scheduling dynamics
* Exposure to combinatorial or continuous optimization, discrete event simulation, or reinforcement learning, and experience wrapping such solvers as tools within agentic systems
* Experience fine-tuning or adapting open-weight models, and familiarity with model serving and inference routing across multiple providers
* Familiarity with container handling equipment, yard operations, or vessel operations

title: BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)
description:
### **BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)**

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.

We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.

### **What Matters Most to Us**

* **Numbers You Can Trust:** Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.
* **Understanding the Goal Behind a Request:** You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.
* **Business Sense:** You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.
* **Ownership:** You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Strategic Impact:** Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.
* **Stable, Overlapping Schedule:** Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.
* **Modern Data Stack & Growth:** Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).
* **Clean, Documented BI Function:** Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **BI Platform Evaluation**
* **What You Will Do:** Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.
* **Requirements & Business Partnering**
* **What You Will Do:** Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.
* **Data Connections & Pipelines**
* **What You Will Do:** Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.
* **Data Modelling & DAX**
* **What You Will Do:** Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.
* **Data Validation & Quality**
* **What You Will Do:** Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.
* **Dashboards & Reports**
* **What You Will Do:** Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.
* **Maintenance & Support**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep refreshes, connections, and access rights running; tune performance; manage versions and changes.
* **Documentation & Training**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep a data dictionary, KPI definitions, and how-to guides in our Outline knowledge base; train business users.
* **Presenting Insights**
* **What You Will Do:** Present findings and recommendations in simple English to colleagues in Germany.

### **Key Requirements**

* **Hands-On BI Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on experience in BI or data analysis, building dashboards used in production, backed by a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or similar (or equivalent experience).
* **Power BI & Data Modelling:** Strong proficiency in DAX (CALCULATE, SUMX, time intelligence, context), Power Query, and star-schema data modelling.
* **SQL & Data Warehousing:** Solid SQL skills (joins, window functions, and CTEs) on a relational data warehouse (we use MySQL).
* **Requirements Thinking & Cost Awareness:** Ability to ask "what decision will this support?" and adapt reports to how people actually work, paired with familiarity with a second BI tool (e.g., Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or Qlik) and understanding of BI licensing models (per user vs. capacity vs. open source) and maintenance costs.
* **Communication & Setup:** Clear written and spoken English, able to explain numbers to non-technical managers, plus your own laptop, a second monitor, and a stable internet connection.
* **Practical AI Usage:** Confident using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot) in your daily workflow to move faster—and critically reviewing the output rather than trusting it blindly. *(Bonus if you use AI coding assistants for SQL/DAX or LLM APIs in data automation.)*

### **✨ Nice to Have**

* **Tracking & Marketing Data:** Experience with Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, Google Ads metrics, attribution, and campaign performance.
* **Retail & E-Commerce KPIs:** Familiarity with retail or e-commerce metrics such as contribution margin, sell-through, and returns.
* **Database & Analytics Tooling:** MySQL performance and data-warehouse modelling, Python (pandas) or similar for analysis and automation, and dbt, Git, or other version control.
* **Power BI Administration & Certification:** Experience with Microsoft Fabric / Power BI Service administration and licensing, or Microsoft PL-300 certification.
* **Compliance & Languages:** Awareness of GDPR when handling customer and sales data, and basic German skills.

### **Job Details**

* **Role:** BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX
* **Work Arrangement:** Remote within India (home office with stable internet)
* **Engagement Type:** Freelance, full-time (Monday–Friday)
* **Reports To:** IT Team Lead (working closely with the technical lead for BI in Germany)
* **Equipment & Tools:** You use your own laptop with a second monitor and a stable internet connection. We provide the BI licences and tool access you need (MySQL data warehouse, Power BI, Outline).

### **Compensation & Working Terms**

* **Monthly Compensation:** INR 55,000–60,000 per month (INR 6.6–7.2 LPA), depending on experience
* **Schedule:** Full-time (Monday–Friday, 12:30–21:30 IST) providing at least 7 hours of live overlap with German business hours

### **How to Apply**

Please complete our online application form and provide:

* Your updated CV / resume.
* A brief introductory video (up to 2 minutes) :
  + A brief introduction of your background.
  + How you keep yourself organized when juggling multiple recurring tasks and follow-ups.
  + Describe a time the numbers in a report didn't match – how you found the cause and fixed it.  
      
    **Application Link:** ***https://forms.gle/APR83nG2iJiV7UxTA***  
    *(Copy and paste this link on your browser to open it)*

### **About Gusti Leder**

Our products are a symbol of conscious consumption and sustainable elegance. We are proud to offer our customers high-quality natural leather products that bring the charm and elegance of vintage leather goods closer to them. From the unmistakable smell of real leather to our diverse product range—including bags, backpacks, accessories, and stationery—Gusti Leder offers products designed to be both stylish and functional.

**What Makes Us Special?** Gusti Leder stands for more than just the beauty of natural leather products. We actively support the principles of slow fashion by investing in transparent production and creating items that are durable and timeless. Our close and trusting collaboration with local producers allows us to maintain high standards of quality and responsible sourcing.
