title: Product Owner, Agentic Platform (India)
description:
**Product Owner,** ***Agentic Platform***

Scale merchOne as an AI-first platform, for our sellers and for our own teams.

**About the** ***role***
------------------------

**merchOne is a B2B print-on-demand platform for online sellers.**

Sellers connect their shop through our Shopify app or public API, and we produce and ship their orders from sites in Europe and North America. AI is at the core of our work, and of our sellers' work.

In a nutshell - own the product work behind merchOne's AI-first platform, from seller demand to shipped feature.

**At a glance**

**Location**

**India**

Fully remote

**Reports to**

**Sven Neu**

Head of B2B Reseller

**Level**

**3 to 5 years**

Product Owner / Manager

**Employment**

**Full-time**

**Works with**

**The whole business**

dev, sales, AM, CS, marketing, ops

**The role in** ***detail***
----------------------------

What you will do, and what we need from you. Side by side.

### **What you will do**

* + **Own the backlog.**Understand what sellers need through interviews and data, and keep one ranked backlog.
* + **Specify and approve.**Write briefs, specifications and acceptance criteria for the development team, and approve what is developed.
* + **Make it AI-usable.**Make every merchOne service usable by AI assistants as well as by people.
* + **Remove manual steps.**Find every manual step between a seller's signup and a delivered order, and remove it.
* + **Automate recurring work.**Move our teams' recurring work to AI agents, so people can focus on ideas that grow our business and our partners' businesses.
* + **Measure and report.**Measure speed and manual effort in live data, and report progress regularly.

### **What you bring**

**Must have**

* + 3 to 5 years as Product Manager or Product Owner, or in process automation or operations, in e-commerce, marketplace or SaaS.
* + You answer business questions from order and funnel data yourself, and can read and check SQL, including queries written by AI.
* + You understand APIs and data models well enough to specify what an AI assistant may read and do.
* + You build roadmaps and ranked backlogs from business objectives.
* + You map processes end to end and get colleagues to change how they work.
* + You work AI-natively: you write briefs, tickets and prototypes with AI assistants and use agents in your daily work.
* + Hands-on work with AI agents or automations.
* + Fluent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* + B2B experience.
* + Knowledge of the print-on-demand ecosystem.
* + Experience with CRM, web analytics and project tools.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

After your first 90 days, you have measured the baseline, removed the first manual steps for sellers and moved first team workflows to AI agents.

**Why this** ***role***
-----------------------

**Mandate**

#### **Build the AI-first platform**

You own the product behind merchOne's AI-first platform, from seller demand to shipped feature.

**AI-first | Full ownership**

**Impact**

#### **Remove the manual work**

Find and remove every manual step between a seller's signup and a delivered order.

**Automation | Agents**

**Reach**

#### **Across the whole business**

You work with the dev team, sales, account management, customer service, marketing and operations.

**Cross-team**

**Direct line**

#### **Straight to the business**

You report to the Head of B2B Reseller, with fast decisions so your work does not wait.

**Fast decisions**

**Who we are** ***looking for***
--------------------------------

Two short lists. The second one is on purpose: it saves us both time.

### **Sounds like you?**

* + You work AI-natively, with briefs, prototypes and agents in your daily work.
* + You answer business questions from data yourself, and can read and check SQL.
* + You turn business objectives into roadmaps and ranked backlogs.
* + You understand APIs and data models well enough to direct an AI assistant.

### **Probably not a fit if**

* + You would rather someone else pulls and reads the data for you.
* + You have not yet worked hands-on with AI agents or automations.
* + You prefer running a set roadmap to building one from business goals.
* + You see AI as an occasional tool rather than part of how you work.

**What we** ***offer***
-----------------------

* + **A clear mandate**a direct reporting line to the head of the business
* + **Fast decisions**your work does not wait
* + **Attractive salary package**plus health insurance
* + **The AI tools the role needs**

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
About Team
  
  
GDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead the engineering team(s) responsible for designing, building, and operating GDF's core data platform capabilities - pipelines, processing frameworks, storage layers, and service APIs that power downstream analytics and AI workloads across Walmart.
  
  
Stay hands-on: write and review production code, prototype solutions to hard technical problems, and participate directly in design and code reviews rather than delegating all technical depth to the team.
  
  
Own the engineering roadmap, technical execution, and delivery of scalable, high-throughput data services built on languages/frameworks including Java, Python, and Spark.
  
  
Guide architecture and system design decisions across distributed data processing systems, batch and streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse storage, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
Drive the design and evolution of Big Data capabilities - data ingestion, transformation, quality, observability, and governance - at the scale Walmart's platforms require.
  
  
Partner with product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, and platform/security teams to deliver reliable, well-governed data capabilities that enable downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases.
  
  
Lead pragmatic integration of AI and GenAI capabilities into the data platform - e.g., feature pipelines for ML models, embeddings/vector search for retrieval, LLM-assisted data quality checks, and intelligent pipeline monitoring - wherever they create measurable engineering or business value.
  
  
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, performance, observability, security, and cost efficiency, appropriate for petabyte-scale enterprise data platforms.
  
  
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and ongoing operational excellence.
  
  
Champion DevOps, platform engineering, and automation best practices to improve engineering velocity, reduce toil, and support continuous delivery for a newly formed team building process and standards from scratch.
  
  
Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, observability practices, and production readiness reviews.
  
  
Define and track engineering and data quality metrics - availability, latency, pipeline SLAs, data freshness, defect rates, deployment frequency, incident trends, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Hire, mentor, and develop hands-on engineers, building a high-performing team culture grounded in craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous learning.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional relationships across engineering, product, data science, and business teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
  
  
Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/ML technologies, applying them pragmatically where they improve platform reliability, engineering productivity, or business value.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience building and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and backend services.
  
  
4+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing engineers and leading technical teams through complex delivery programs.
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Genuinely hands-on: comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code - not just directing others. Strong proficiency in Java and Python is required; working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is expected.
  
  
Strong exposure to Big Data technologies and ecosystems - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, or equivalent - including batch and streaming data processing, data pipeline design, and large-scale data transformation.
  
  
Experience with data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with enterprise data lakes/lakehouses (e.g., Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks).
  
  
Strong experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, and enterprise system integration.
  
  
Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations.
  
  
Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, alerting,
  
  
incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale data systems.
  
  
Full exposure to AI technologies in a production data platform context - hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM-based tooling, working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines). Comfortable using AI to strengthen data quality checks, pipeline monitoring, and engineering productivity, not just aware of it conceptually.
  
  
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business/technical problems into clear execution plans, especially in a newly formed team without established process.
  
  
Strong people leadership skills - hiring, coaching, mentoring, performance management - and a track record of building engineering culture from the ground up.
  
  
Strong ownership mindset, sound technical judgment, high accountability, and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 environment.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

Option 2: 7 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. 2 years’ supervisory experience.

title: Technical Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
Reporting to the Technical Director of our core product groupings, the Technical Engineering Manager is accountable for day-to-day technical leadership, delivery and people management of one or more multi-disciplinary engineering teams aligned to our 3x3 squad target operating model.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows what good engineering looks like, can raise technical standards in practice, and can build teams that deliver high-quality, resilient cloud services.
  
  
You combine strong technical credibility with a genuine passion for coaching and developing engineers, while owning the operational, financial and resourcing commitments that keep delivery on track.
  
  
You turn the Technical Director's strategy into clear engineering standards, practical ways of working practices and measurable outcomes. You are expected to lead from the front on modern, AI-enabled engineering practices, demonstrating their practical use across the software development lifecycle rather than simply mandating their adoption.
  
  
This role reports to, and works in close partnership with, the Technical Director, escalating architectural, cross-team or strategic decisions while retaining full ownership of team-level technical quality, delivery and people outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Of The Role**
****Technical excellence and forward-facing engineering****
Champion engineering excellence, coding standards, architectural alignment and software design quality across your teams.
  
  
Act as the escalation point for technical decisions before they reach the Technical Director.
  
  
Stay ahead of emerging engineering practices, tooling and industry trends, and translate these into practical improvements for your teams.
  
  
Own the technical roadmap for your area in partnership with Architecture, ensuring cloud-native, secure and scalable patterns are followed consistently.
  
  
****AI-enabled engineering****

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development, testing, code review and operational tooling within your teams, measuring and reporting on the productivity and quality gains achieved.
* Act as a practical advocate for AI-enabled ways of working, personally using AI tools in technical decision-making, delivery planning and problem-solving.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual engineering and delivery processes, feeding improvement ideas back into the wider engineering organisation.

****Delivery and operational leadership****

* Accountable for the timely delivery, quality and technical approach taken by your teams, including resource management and capacity planning against commitments.
* Own and escalate operational risks and issues in your area, ensuring appropriate mitigation and transparency to the Technical Director.
* Measure, monitor and report delivery and engineering KPIs, using data to drive continuous improvement rather than retrospective justification.
* Foster a culture of end-to-end ownership, where teams build, operate, improve and support the services they create.
* People leadership and development
* Lead, coach, mentor and line manage a multi-skilled team of engineers, building an empowered culture where individuals take pride and ownership in delivering excellence.
* Build clear development pathways for engineers and emerging technical leads, identifying and growing future talent within the team.
* Create fast feedback loops with Product and users, keeping teams connected to real customer and clinical outcomes.
* Promote continuous improvement through blameless post-incident reviews and root-cause analysis.
* Financial and commercial ownership
* Own resourcing, capacity and cost forecasts for your teams, balancing delivery commitments against budget and headcount constraints.
* Bring a strong commercial understanding of business strategy and its impact on prioritisation and technical investment decisions.
* Balance feature delivery against investment in technical debt reduction, resilience, security and platform sustainability.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Demonstrable experience leading empowered engineering teams that build, operate and improve high-quality cloud services, with a proven focus on reliability, resilience, security and timely delivery.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to software development, code review, testing or engineering productivity, with evidence of measurable impact.
* Strong technical grounding in modern, cloud-native architecture and software engineering best practices, with the judgement to identify what good looks like, challenge weak technical decisions and support teams in raising their engineering standards.
* Expert in, and evangelist for, agile software engineering methodologies and processes.
* Experience of resource management, capacity planning and budget ownership at team level.
* Exceptional judgement, decision-making, communication and leadership abilities, with a high focus on people engagement, continuous improvement and team development.
* Experience operating in environments of continual change, transformation and evolving delivery practices.
* A good knowledge of the healthcare market and product base, and a strong, astute commercial understanding of business strategy.
* Track record of coaching engineers and emerging technical leads into more senior technical or leadership roles.

****Ready to join us?****
If you're looking for a rewarding role where you can develop your career, work with great people and make a meaningful contribution, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
****Be the spark that helps healthcare move forward. Apply today.****
****Inclusion & Belonging****
At Enlivio Health, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and backgrounds make us stronger. They help us better support our colleagues, customers and the communities we serve.
  
  
We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and able to be their authentic selves. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunities employer.
  
  
We consider all qualified applicants regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.
  
  
We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and inclusive for everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or selection process, please let us know and we'll be happy to support you.
  
  
**About Enlivio Health**
Enlivio Health powers a more connected healthcare system. Across general practice, community care and pharmacy, we support over 10,000 healthcare organisations, connecting teams, information and workflows across the places where millions of people receive care every day.
  
  
Our smarter technology simplifies complexity, helps information move more effectively and supports better decisions, so healthcare professionals can spend less time navigating systems and more time focused on their patients.

**Vestas is a major company in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.**

  

**Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows Advisors**

  

The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.

As an AI Innovation Lead, you will redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and working operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for running the automation work, aligning scope, implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, test assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation.

  

**Responsibilities**

As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for:

* Coordinating the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Partnering with key business stakeholders to identify and scope work packages with clearly defined resource needs, measurable outcomes, and target problems- Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
* Defining success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
* Overseeing the development of local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
* Working directly with frontline users to embed the redesigned workflow and supporting automation into daily operations
* Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
* Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

  

**Qualifications**

This role requires someone who is highly motivated, engaged, and able to work well both on their own and alongside a diverse group of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and skills below:

* A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc.), business transformation, or similar, combining solid technical understanding and effective communication skills - At least 6 years of relevant experience in a similar role- Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
* Experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
* Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

  

**Competencies**

* Business oriented, value-focused mindset
* Effective communication skills, both spoken and written, plus the ability to navigate complex organizations and align differing stakeholder needs- Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
* Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
* You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
* Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

  

**What We Offer**

* Purpose - An opportunity to support climate action and improve the future for people to come using automation and AI
* Steep learning curve - You will be part of a highly knowledgeable AI advisory team with wide-ranging and in-depth experience. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling
* Strong relationships - We plan to cultivate an open and supportive atmosphere with a tight-knit team that can learn from one another and contribute meaningful value to Vestas
* Opportunity to shape your role - We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us
* Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options
* Commitment to building a diverse and inclusive workplace
* Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team

  

**Additional Information**

Your primary location will be in Chennai, India

Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026

Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

  

**DEIB Statement**

  

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**

  

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

  

**About Vestas**

  

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

* Participate in technical reviews, testing, deployment, and production support.

title: Engineering Software Developer (VB6 / .NET)
description:
We are seeking a Software Developer to support and modernize a business-critical thermal engineering application built in Visual Basic 6 (VB6). In the near term, this role will maintain and enhance the existing VB6 application and support the engineers who rely on it. Over the longer term, the developer will play a key role in planning and carrying out the migration of the application to a modern .NET platform, preserving the accuracy of its engineering calculations throughout. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with both VB6 and .NET (C# preferred), and a track record of building or maintaining software that performs heavy engineering or scientific calculations.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of professional software development experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience maintaining and enhancing production VB6 applications, including COM/ActiveX components, OCX controls, and ADO/DAO data access.
* 3+ years of professional experience in C# with .NET Framework and/or .NET Core
* Experience developing or maintaining software that performs heavy engineering, scientific, or numerical calculations (e.g., iterative solvers, numerical methods, property correlations, unit conversions).
* Solid understanding of floating-point precision and numerical accuracy, and experience validating calculation results against known reference cases.
* Solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software design patterns.
* Experience developing Windows desktop applications using VB6 and .NET.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including in large legacy codebases with limited documentation.
* Familiarity with source control systems such as Git or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or modernizing VB6 applications to .NET, including incremental migration strategies, COM interop, and running legacy and new components side by side.
* Familiarity with thermal and fluid engineering concepts such as heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid flow, combustion, or steam/water properties (e.g., IAPWS-IF97).
* Experience in power generation, boilers, heat exchangers, or similar industrial equipment domains.
* Exposure to Fortran or other legacy scientific code.

### **Responsibilities**

* Maintain, support, and enhance the existing VB6 thermal engineering application, including bug fixes, minor enhancements, and support for engineering users.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the application’s calculation logic, data flows, and dependencies, and document them where documentation is missing.
* Work with thermal and process engineers to understand, validate, and implement engineering calculation requirements.
* Build and maintain regression test cases with known-good results to verify calculation accuracy before and after every change.
* Assess the existing codebase and contribute to the migration strategy and roadmap for moving the application to .NET.
* Design and develop .NET (C#) components, such as calculation libraries and user interfaces, as part of a phased migration, ensuring results match the legacy application within defined tolerances.
* Debug, refactor, and optimize existing codebases.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* Participate in code reviews and team discussions.

### **Interpersonal Skills Required**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills for effective interaction with engineers and other business users.
* Customer focused; sensitive to customer satisfaction, knows customer needs and expectations, responds promptly to customer queries, and strives to exceed customer expectations.
* Quality focused; shows commitment to the accuracy and reliability of calculation results delivered to engineering users.
* Detail oriented; patient and methodical when working through complex legacy code and engineering logic.
* Problem solving skills; identifies problems; determines relevant information; uses reason to generate and evaluate alternatives and determine course of action.
* Algorithmic and structured thinking; problem decomposition, and logical what-if analysis of problems and solutions.
* Organized and self-managed with effective time management skills.

Chennai, India

### **Position Type**

Full-Time/Regular

title: Senior Developer - Flutter
description:
**Company Description**

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description**

**Roles & Responsibilities :**  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Flutter Developer who builds with AI coding agents every day. You’ll help shape modular, high performance and secure apps that patients and clinicians use with connected medical devices. AI speeds up your scaffolding, testing and documentation, so your own time goes into architecture, verification and patient safety. You use AI heavily, but you own and can explain every line that ships.

You’ll work in a collaborative, design driven, regulated (MedTech) environment alongside stakeholders, designers, architects, regulatory and QA teams. As a senior team member, you’ll take full ownership of your work from architecture to delivery and help shape our mobile platform.

 **Qualifications**

Educational qualification: B.E/B.Tech

**Experience :** **13-18 years**

**Mandatory/requires Skills :**  

* Build and maintain features in a modular, feature-first Flutter codebase (Dart 3) targeting iOS and Android.

* Implement state management and dependency injection with Riverpod (codegen), and immutable data models with Freezed.
* Implement navigation with go\_router, including shell routes, deep linking, and typed navigation.
* Develop reliable BLE communication flows with connected medical devices, including pairing, reconnection, and background handling.
* Integrate with backend services (REST and/or GraphQL, Backend-for-Frontend architecture) using Dio and/or a GraphQL client, with code generation for types and clients.
* Implement secure authentication with a managed identity provider (e.g., Auth0) using OIDC/OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, including multi-organisation access and JWT-based authorisation.
* Integrate native SDKs via platform channels where needed (e.g., real time communication or telehealth SDKs).
* Implement offline first data handling and local persistence (e.g., Drift or another SQLite-based solution) with sync to the backend.
* Ensure error handling and performance optimisation: efficient rebuilds, lazy loading, deferred components, and app size control.
* Use AI agents to automate routine work, including:

o Feature, screen and widget scaffolding, Riverpod providers, and Freezed/json\_serializable models from API specs

o Test coverage gap analysis and test generation (widget, golden, integration)

o Code review feedback and PR descriptions

o Bug and crash triage from logs and crash reports

o Accessibility checks and fixes (Semantics, text scaling, contrast)

o Localisation (ARB generation and translation workflow)

Migrate existing apps to Flutter from other cross-platform or native stacks using AI assisted conversion

**Preferred Skills :**  
  

* AI in a regulated SDLC: Using AI tools within our Quality Management System (IEC 62304 / ISO 13485). Every AI generated change is reviewed by a human, traceable to requirements, and covered by verification tests. No patient data, PHI or customer-confidential material goes into prompts or external tools

* Prompt and context engineering: Giving AI agents the right context (codebase conventions, specs, constraints) and refining prompts until they produce correct, idiomatic Dart/Flutter code, then reviewing the result to production standard.
* Claude Code (preferred): Hands on use of Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding CLI for coding, refactoring, debugging and documentation. This includes project context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md), custom commands and skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers.
* Model selection: Picking the right model for the task by weighing capability, speed and cost.
* Other AI coding tools: Working knowledge of at least one other AI assisted tool, such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Cursor or Windsurf.
* Agentic Workflows: Breaking features into well scoped tasks for AI agents, with clear context, guardrails and validation, then reviewing the output until it meets production standards
* AI-Driven Testing: Using LLMs to generate unit, widget, golden, and integration tests, mocks, and edge case scenarios
* Documentation Automation: Using AI to maintain real time documentation, API contracts, and architectural decision records (ADRs)

**Experience:**

**Must have:**

* 5+ years in mobile development, including 4+ years shipping production Flutter apps to the App Store and Google Play (signing, environments, TestFlight / Play Console tracks)
* Deep Dart 3 and Flutter knowledge: sealed classes, records, pattern matching, isolates; widget/element/render trees, rebuild optimisation, profiling with DevTools
* Riverpod (including codegen), Freezed and go\_router in production
* Designed or maintained a modular, feature-first architecture on a medium-to-large app (50+ screens) with several developers
* Strong testing discipline: unit, widget, golden and integration tests
* Daily use of AI coding agents (see AI section)
* Secure mobile coding practices (OWASP MASVS, secure storage, certificate pinning)

**Strongly preferred:**

* BLE or other device connectivity (e.g., flutter\_blue\_plus), including pairing, reconnection and background handling
* Software delivery under IEC 62304 / ISO 13485 or a similar regulated framework

**Nice to have:**

* Platform channels / FFI, with native Swift and Kotlin interop
* Offline-first data with local persistence and sync
* OIDC/OAuth 2.0 authentication flows
* Migrating apps from other stacks to Flutter
* Tooling: FVM, Melos / Dart pub workspaces, Sentry, Fastlane, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Self-driven and highly autonomous : you thrive with minimal supervision and demonstrate professionalism and accountability in all your interactions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration experience : you've worked closely with product managers, designers, quality assurance, and other engineering teams.
* AI-First Mindset : You use AI for implementation wherever it helps, and put your own effort into architecture, review, validation and business logic.
* Mentorship : you raise the bar for the team on Flutter best practices and AI augmented workflows.

title: Software Dev Engineer II
description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience Technology (AE-Tech) organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) handle contacts, compose responses, wrap up interactions, and collaborate with AI—across every contact channel worldwide.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Within AE-Tech, Our Team Owns The End-to-end Associate-facing Tools, Workflows, And AI Capabilities That Power How CSAs Interact With Customers Across Contact Channels. Our Charter Spans Five High-impact Workstreams
  
  
Email Contact Channel & Systems — End-to-end ownership of the Email contact channel, one of the highest-volume and most complex channels in Amazon Customer Service—encompassing email ingestion, routing, associate-facing workflows, response management, and channel-level performance optimization
  
  
Contact Handling & Composition Tools — The systems associates use to handle and respond to customer contacts, including Email Composer, After Contact Work (ACW), annotation systems, and order selection workflows
  
  
Wrap-up Automation & Contact Lifecycle — Intelligent automation that streamlines post-contact workflows, reduces manual documentation burden, and accelerates wrap-up to improve Average Contact Handle Time (ACHT)
  
  
GenAI-Powered Customer Service — AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, intelligent summarization, and full contact automation powered by Large Language Models and Generative AI
  
  
Native Widget Experiences — Modern, performant native widgets that replace legacy page-based experiences, delivering faster and more intuitive tooling for associates across all contact channels
  
  
We are investing deeply in transforming the associate experience through AI and automation. Our team has already automated a meaningful percentage of contacts and delivered millions in annualized cost savings, and we are just getting started. The opportunity ahead includes scaling automation across channels, building next-generation GenAI-powered tools, and creating intelligent workflows that make every associate more effective.
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role. You will own the design, implementation, and delivery of key features and services across these workstreams—writing production code, building scalable systems, and contributing to the tools and platforms that hundreds of thousands of associates use every day to serve Amazon customers worldwide.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer within AE-Tech, you will be a core builder on the team—taking ownership of features and components, delivering high-quality code, and contributing to system design decisions. You will work at the intersection of associate experience, Generative AI, and operational efficiency—collaborating with senior engineers, SDMs, Product Managers, Applied Scientists, and Business Intelligence Engineers across India and North America to deliver systems that improve associate effectiveness and customer satisfaction at global scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and deliver features across the Email contact channel and associate-facing systems — own end-to-end feature delivery for email contact handling workflows, Email Composer, ACW, Wrap-up Automation, annotation systems, and native widget experiences, from design through production deployment
* Contribute to GenAI-powered capabilities — implement AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, and intelligent summarization features by integrating LLMs, building prompt pipelines, and developing model orchestration components
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable services — write clean, well-tested, production-quality code; design APIs, data models, and service interfaces that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements across the Email channel and broader AE-Tech systems
* Deliver native widget experiences — contribute to the migration from legacy page-based tools to modern, high-performance native widgets that improve associate efficiency and reduce latency across contact channels
* Own operational excellence for your services — monitor, alarm, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues; participate in on-call rotations and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions
* Participate in and contribute to technical design — author design documents for your features, participate in team design reviews, and provide constructive feedback in code reviews to improve overall code quality
* Collaborate effectively across teams — work with AE-Tech and partner teams (Routing, Quality, Applied Science, Operations) to understand requirements, resolve dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions
* Grow and help others grow — actively seek feedback, invest in your own technical development, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:

Role purpose

The role turns repetitive monitoring, event handling, remediation and security response work into tested, documented and measurable automation, so the operation can scale without adding headcount at the same rate.

**Direct reports**

**Scope**

**Role purpose**
================

The Automation Specialist builds and runs one automation capability for both the NOC and the SOC. The role turns repetitive monitoring, event handling, remediation and security response work into tested, documented and measurable automation, so the operation can scale without adding headcount at the same rate.

The role sets the standards that all automation must follow, selects the right tool for each use case (SOAR, runbook automation, ITSM workflow or monitoring-tool logic) and makes sure NOC and SOC priorities are balanced fairly through one shared backlog.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Platform and strategy**
-------------------------

* Represent CTS Service Operations (NOC and SOC) in the enterprise SOAR platform decision led by the CISO’s office: supply CTS use cases, integration requirements (Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Imperva, Jira/ITSM, monitoring tools) and PCI DSS needs, and take part in the proof of concept.
* Plan and run the move of existing CTS automations from Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR (end of sale February 2026) to the enterprise platform selected, before the XSOAR contract ends; keep new XSOAR-specific build to the minimum in the meantime.
* Administer the CTS workspace on the enterprise platform: integrations, credentials and secrets, access control and health, keeping CTS (PCI DSS) data and workflows separate from other divisions, working with the enterprise platform owner.
* Design automation to be vendor-neutral where practical, keeping business logic portable between platforms.
* Choose the right tool for each use case: SOAR for security response and cross-tool orchestration; Ansible, Azure Automation, AWS Systems Manager, PowerShell or Python for infrastructure remediation; Jira/ITSM workflow for ticket handling; monitoring-tool logic for correlation and suppression.

**Automation standards and lifecycle**
--------------------------------------

* Define and publish the automation framework: intake, use-case scoring (volume, time saved, risk), design template, coding standards and naming.
* Hold all automation code and playbooks in Git with peer review, non-production testing, change approval before production and a documented rollback.
* Where the platform is no-code or low-code, enable NOC and SOC analysts to build their own workflows within the standard, with review and approval before production.
* Require human approval steps for any destructive or customer-impacting action (for example host isolation, account disable, service restart in production).
* Monitor automation runs, alert on failures and keep audit logs of every automated action in line with PCI DSS retention requirements.
* Use least-privilege service accounts and managed secrets for every integration.

**NOC automation**
------------------

* Work with the Monitoring and Observability Lead and monitoring engineers to reduce alert noise through enrichment, de-duplication, correlation and dependency-based suppression.
* Automate ticket creation in Jira/ITSM with context attached: configuration item, owner, contract, recent changes, related alerts and linked runbook.
* Build auto-remediation for the most frequent recurring events (for example service restarts, disk clean-up, tablespace or log growth, failovers), starting with the top 10 by volume.
* Link maintenance-mode suppression to approved changes, so planned work does not raise incidents.
* Automate routine checks such as backup job verification, certificate expiry and capacity thresholds.

**SOC automation**
------------------

* Inventory existing Splunk alert actions and triggers and bring them under the automation standard.
* Build and maintain security playbooks with SOC Tier 2 and Tier 3, starting with phishing triage, malware/EDR detections (CrowdStrike Falcon), account compromise, malicious IP blocking (Palo Alto, Imperva) and critical vulnerability ticketing (Tenable).
* Automate enrichment of security alerts (asset, owner, threat intelligence, vulnerability status) to cut investigation time.
* Capture evidence automatically for PCI DSS requirements, including daily log review (10.4.1), response to logging failures (10.7) and incident response (12.10).
* Encode the PCI DSS 12.10 incident response steps, including acquirer and payment brand notification timelines, as explicit, testable playbook steps; confirm time synchronisation (10.6) is verified at the infrastructure layer rather than assumed from the platform.

**Integration**
---------------

* Integrate monitoring and security tools with the automation platform and ITSM: Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Imperva, SolarWinds, AppDynamics, Site24x7, Azure Monitor, and AFCMS where APIs allow.
* Work with the SRE team (AWS CloudWatch) and L3 DB team (Oracle OEM) under the federated monitoring model to route their events and automate their use cases.

**Collaboration and prioritisation**
------------------------------------

* Run one shared automation backlog in Jira for NOC and SOC requests.
* Hold a monthly prioritisation meeting with the NOC Manager and SOC Manager and report against the agreed capacity split (initially about 60% NOC, 40% SOC).
* Work alongside the Monitoring and Observability Lead, who remains team lead and owns intake and allocation for monitoring work.
* Share playbooks and practices with SOAR users in other Cubic divisions through the enterprise platform owner.

**Documentation, training and reporting**
-----------------------------------------

* Document every production automation in Confluence: purpose, trigger, steps, approvals, owner, rollback and known limits, using the team’s templates.
* Train NOC and SOC analysts on running, approving and troubleshooting automations.
* Publish a monthly automation value report covering the KPIs below.

**Expectations for the first six months**
=========================================

* **By day 30:** Inventory of current automations, scripts and Splunk triggers; baseline of alert volumes, MTTA and MTTR for in-scope contracts; shared Jira backlog live.
* **By day 60:** Automation framework and standards published and approved by NOC and SOC managers.
* **By day 90:** CTS use cases and requirements submitted to the enterprise SOAR proof of concept; XSOAR migration plan agreed; first 5 automations in production.
* **By month 6:** Top 10 NOC event automations and top 5 SOC playbooks in production; all existing Splunk triggers under the standard.

**Key performance indicators**
==============================

Targets apply to contracts onboarded to the NOC/SOC and are measured against the baseline taken in the first 30 days. Targets will be reviewed annually.

**KPI**

**Target**

**Qualifications and experience**
=================================

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent experience.
* 6+ years in IT operations, infrastructure or security engineering, including 3+ years building automation in production.
* Hands-on experience with at least one SOAR platform (Tines, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel with Logic Apps, FortiSOAR, Rapid7 InsightConnect or similar), and comfortable working in both no-code builders and code.
* Strong Python; working knowledge of PowerShell or Bash.
* REST APIs, JSON and webhooks; integrating tools that do not share a native connector.
* Splunk searching (SPL), alerting and alert actions.
* At least one runbook automation tool: Ansible, Azure Automation or AWS Systems Manager.
* Git-based development, code review and testing practices.
* Jira or ITSM workflow automation.
* Working understanding of ITIL event, incident, change and problem management, and of security incident response.
* Clear written and spoken English for working with UK and US stakeholders.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Tines, Cortex XSOAR or Rapid7 certification; Splunk certification.
* Experience migrating playbooks from one SOAR platform to another.
* Microsoft Sentinel, KQL and Azure Logic Apps.
* Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, Tenable, Imperva, SolarWinds or AppDynamics APIs.
* AWS or Azure associate-level certification.
* Experience in a 24x7 NOC or SOC, or a multi-client managed service environment.
* Awareness of PCI DSS v4.0 logging and incident response requirements.
* Exposure to transport, payments or OT device environments.

**Behaviours and competencies**
===============================

* **Neutral partner:** balances NOC and SOC needs openly and transparently, using data rather than whoever is loudest.
* **Outcome focus:** automates what saves the most time or risk, and measures the result.
* **Engineering discipline:** tests, documents and controls change; never puts untested automation into production.
* **Systems thinking:** sees the full chain from alert to ticket to fix and removes manual steps across it.
* **Teacher:** helps analysts and engineers understand and trust automation.

**Key working relationships**
=============================

* **Internal:** NOC Manager, SOC Manager, Monitoring and Observability Lead and monitoring engineers, Technical Editor, NOC/SOC Tier 1 and Tier 2, SOC Tier 3, shift managers, ops engineers, MIM, problem management, change management.
* **Wider organisation:** SRE team (AWS), L3 DB, L3 apps and infrastructure teams, the CISO’s office and enterprise SOAR platform owner, information security.
* **External:** Tool vendors (SOAR platform vendor, Splunk, CrowdStrike and others).

description:
**About Us**

Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.

**Role**

Joining the Treasury Technology team. The team is globally distributed, with a presence across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, and is responsible for providing software and data solutions to enhance and support Cash Management, FX Funding, Treasury Analytics and Liquidity.

You will work closely with Treasury to develop and maintain applications, providing application support where required. You will collaborate with global business and technology teams as part of a team of skilled, all-round developers who build and support business-critical systems, and you will contribute to technical design decisions.

Some knowledge of capital markets and/or the Treasury function is useful but is not a prerequisite.

**Key Responsibilities**

The key responsibilities of the role are to:

* Work closely with technology and business teams to gather, analyse, document and implement requirements.
* Develop and support Treasury Technology applications used for FX order processing, liquidity, forecasting and cash flow operations.
* Contribute to the modernisation of the Treasury Technology estate, including migrating applications to modern .NET and building cloud-based data and application solutions using Snowflake and AWS.
* Write performant, maintainable and well-tested code.
* Provide application support and help resolve production issues where required.
* Follow the team’s SDLC policy, using JIRA, Bitbucket (Git), Bamboo and Artifactory for delivery and CI/CD.

**Technology Stack**

Treasury Technology applications are built on the following:

* TSB (Treasury Service Bus) – an in-house scheduling and ETL platform built on .NET
* ASP.NET Core Web API services on modern .NET (.NET 8 / .NET 10), providing the application tier
* Web front end built using Angular and TypeScript
* SQL Server back end

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8+).
* Advanced skills in C# and ASP.NET Core, including building RESTful Web APIs, dependency injection and asynchronous programming.
* Good knowledge of Angular and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Good knowledge of SQL Server, including DML, DDL and database programming.
* Knowledge and experience of ETL data processing.
* Experience of unit and integration testing (e.g. xUnit or NUnit).
* Experience of using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, code review, debugging, documentation and solution design, while maintaining appropriate engineering standards and oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a logical approach.
* A self-starter who works well collaboratively.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* Knowledge of capital markets and/or the Treasury function.
* Experience of Snowflake and AWS (e.g. S3, Lambda, ECS), including building and supporting cloud-based data and application solutions.
* Experience of migrating applications from .NET Framework to modern .NET.
* Experience of Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
* Previous experience in a similar role at a financial institution or financial technology organisation.
* Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in a relevant subject.

title: Technology Consultant - QA Engineer
description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 398326
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant - QA Engineer to join our team in Mumbai, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
**Title:** Technology Consultant – QA Engineer (Automation Manual Testing)
  
  
**Job Location:** Mumbai, India
  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced QA Engineer with 5–8 years of hands-on expertise in software quality assurance, test automation, and manual testing of enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in test planning, test case design, functional testing, regression testing, API testing, automation frameworks, and defect management. Candidates should have experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Java, TestNG, and API testing tools such as Postman or Rest Assured.
  
  
The role will work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and technology teams to understand business requirements, define test strategies, ensure application quality, and deliver reliable software solutions.
  
  
Day to Day Job Duties
  
  

* Analyze business and technical requirements to understand application functionality and testing scope.
* Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test data based on business requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Java.
* Develop and maintain automation frameworks using TestNG, Page Object Model (POM), and other automation design patterns.
* Perform API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, or similar tools.
* Validate REST APIs, request/response payloads, HTTP status codes, and backend data.
* Perform database testing and validate data using SQL queries.
* Execute automated and manual test suites and analyze test execution results.
* Identify, document, track, and manage defects using Jira or similar defect management tools.
* Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot defects and perform root cause analysis.
* Integrate automated test scripts into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing.
* Perform cross-browser, compatibility, and application performance testing as required.
* Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, and code review activities from a quality perspective.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployments, and post-release validation.
* Maintain test documentation, automation scripts, test execution reports, and quality metrics.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* 5–8 years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing.
* 3+ years of experience in automation testing using Selenium WebDriver and Java.
* Strong experience in manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing.
* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks using TestNG, JUnit, and Page Object Model.
* 2+ years of experience in API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, or similar tools.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira.
* Experience with Git, Maven, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and defect management processes.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Core Technical Skills
  
  

* Testing: Manual Testing, Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, End-to-End Testing
* Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, JUnit
* Automation Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, Hybrid Frameworks
* API Testing: Postman, Rest Assured, REST API Validation
* Database Testing: SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle
* Test Management: Jira, Test Case Management, Defect Tracking, Test Execution Reporting
* CI/CD: Jenkins, Continuous Testing, Automation Pipeline Integration
* Performance Testing: JMeter or similar tools
* Development Practices: SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, Defect Life Cycle

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber and Gherkin.
* Knowledge of API automation using Rest Assured and Java.
* Experience with performance testing using JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Knowledge of mobile application testing using Appium.
* Experience with cloud-based testing platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes-based testing environments.
* Experience integrating automation frameworks with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals and application vulnerability assessment.
* Experience with accessibility testing and cross-browser compatibility testing.
* Familiarity with monitoring and reporting tools such as Grafana and Kibana.
* Experience with test management tools such as Zephyr or TestRail.
* Knowledge of Python or JavaScript for test automation and scripting.
* Experience testing microservices-based applications and distributed systems.
* ISTQB certification or other relevant QA certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. title: GCP Security Architecture and Agentic AI Security
description:
**Senior Cloud Security Architect: GCP Security Architecture and Agentic AI Security**

**Role Summary**

We are hiring a hands-on Cloud Security Architect to design and harden Google Cloud platforms that run autonomous AI agents. The work is delivered as part of an engagement with Google Professional Services (PSO). You will write and review Low-Level Designs (LLDs) for platform hardening, then automate those designs with Terraform and Python.

The role covers the security of the platform and of the agents themselves: which actions an agent may take, what content passes through it, how agents authenticate to each other and to tools, and how their decisions are logged for audit. You will work with VPC Service Controls, Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), Model Armor, Security Command Center (SCC) AI Protection and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and review Low-Level Designs for GCP platform hardening, covering VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC), CMEK and network perimeter isolation.
* Configure Model Armor to filter agent input and output content, and build defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration and model manipulation.
* Design identity and access management for non-human identities (NHI), including fine-grained RBAC for agent tool authorizations and API scopes.
* Implement secure agent-to-agent (A2A) communication using mutual TLS (mTLS) and cryptographic validation.
* Harden agent tool connections over MCP and route them through Agent Gateways.
* Configure SCC AI Protection and design chain-of-thought logging frameworks so that agent decision paths can be audited for compliance and forensics.
* Write and maintain reusable Terraform modules that provision secured cloud baselines.
* Write secure Python automation scripts, test cases and custom runtime validation tools.
* Add security linting, static analysis (SAST) and pre-deployment policy checks to deployment pipelines.
* Align agent platforms with data privacy controls such as Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) and data masking, and set up human-in-the-loop (HITL) override gates.
* Remediate critical and high-risk infrastructure security findings and document the fixes in technical runbooks.
* Work with Google PSO engineers, client security teams and application developers to review designs and resolve security issues.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in cloud security or security architecture, with at least 4 years on Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing LLDs for cloud platform hardening, and production experience with VPC Service Controls and CMEK.
* Strong understanding of IAM for service accounts and other non-human identities, and of mTLS-based service-to-service authentication.
* Hands-on Terraform and Python experience.

title: AI Engineer - Tech
description:
About Arira AI

Arira AI implements AI That Saves & Makes Money inside growing businesses.

About the role

As an AI Engineer you work on site at our client companies. You sit with their teams, learn how the work is really done, then use AI tools to build and roll out solutions that make that work faster and better. You are measured by one thing: the value the business gets from AI.

What you will do

1. Work on site at client company offices as the face of the AI programme.
2. Sit with business users, understand how they work today and where time and effort are lost.
3. Ask the right questions to draw out how processes really run, including the exceptions.
4. Document workflows, requirements and decisions clearly so others can build on them.
5. Choose the right language models and AI tools for each problem.
6. Build and configure working solutions yourself, from prompts and agents to quick apps.
7. Roll solutions out, train users and help them adopt new ways of working.
8. Follow up after go-live, fix what does not work and keep improving it.
9. Show the business the value it is getting from AI in terms it cares about.
10. Feed lessons from each deployment back into how we deploy AI.

What you bring

1. 2 to 5 years of professional experience.
2. Hands-on use of different language models and AI tools.
3. A working understanding of technology and the software development cycle.
4. Experience as a business user of software, close to real operations.
5. A product mindset, in a product or project manager style of role.
6. A people person: easy to talk to, curious, and good at getting information out of users.
7. Clear, accurate documentation.
8. Able to join quickly. Shorter notice periods are preferred.

Why join

1. AI that actually gets used: your work goes live with real business teams.
2. A free hand with the best tools: full access to our AI assets and the tools the job needs.
3. Learn fast, grow faster: a structured start, then real ownership of live deployments, working closely with leadership.

Details

Full-time, permanent. On site at client company offices. Reports to Head of Implementation. Vacancy reference AIE-T-2026.

Arira AI is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from everyone.
