description:
**Job Title:**
AI Engineer
  
  
**Department:**
ISPL Data Office, CIB IT Transversal
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Global Markets
  
  
The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT work load, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The AI Engineer will design, build and deploy production-grade data and AI solutions. The role combines strong Python and data engineering fundamentals (ETL, relational databases, REST APIs) with hands-on development of AI capabilities such as LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows.
  
  
The position requires working in a virtual team and international environment and is multidisciplinary in nature. It involves coordination with other locations and divisions of BNP Paribas as necessary. The candidate should have strong engineering discipline, a problem-solving mindset and the ability to turn business requirements into reliable, secure and scalable solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop and maintain scalable Python applications and data pipelines using Pandas for data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL).
* Build and expose secure, well-documented REST APIs using FastAPI, applying data validation (e.g. Pydantic) and API best practices.
* Write efficient SQL and work with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server, including data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning.
* Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment across development, test and production environments.
* Develop Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions – LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI.
* Integrate Large Language Models through provider APIs (e.g. OpenAI / Azure OpenAI) and open-source models (e.g. Hugging Face), applying prompt engineering, structured outputs and function / tool calling.
* Build natural-language interfaces to data (e.g. Text-to-SQL agents) that allow business users to query databases in plain English.
* Automate business workflows by combining AI capabilities with APIs, scheduling / workflow tools (e.g. n8n) and messaging integrations.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data sources and tools, including vector databases and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tool integrations.
* Implement LLM observability, tracing and evaluation (e.g. Langfuse) to monitor quality, cost, latency and reliability of AI applications.
* Develop, train and evaluate Machine Learning models where appropriate, using libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and NumPy.
* Follow sound engineering practices: version control with Git, code reviews, unit / integration testing and clear technical documentation.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions / Jenkins) and support deployment of AI services on on-premise or cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure).
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and work closely with business users, data teams and other stakeholders throughout implementation and delivery.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to the design of reusable components, frameworks and best practices for data engineering and AI development within the team.
* Ensure solutions comply with the Group’s standards on data security, privacy, Responsible AI, risk and compliance.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and propose AI-driven solutions.
* Participate in knowledge sharing, mentoring and cross-training to build AI capabilities within the team.
* Stay up to date with the evolving AI / LLM ecosystem and assess new tools and techniques for adoption.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in data manipulation and analysis using Pandas.
* Solid working knowledge of SQL and relational databases – Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server.
* Experience designing and building REST APIs, preferably with FastAPI.
* Good understanding of ETL concepts, data pipelines, data quality and data integration.
* Practical experience with Docker and Git based development workflows.
* Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI), Hugging Face models, prompt engineering, LLM application frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI), RAG pipelines, vector databases and LLM observability tools (e.g. Langfuse) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with ClickHouse, front-end frameworks (React / Angular), Machine Learning libraries (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy), CI/CD and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Python development / data engineering, with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI / LLM based applications (Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI) will be preferred.
* Prior experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain is desirable.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
Must Have
  
  

+ Python
+ Pandas
+ Oracle / PostgreSQL / MS SQL Server
+ REST API
+ FastAPI
+ Docker
+ Git
+ ETL Concepts

Good to Have
  
  

+ ClickHouse
+ React / Angular
+ Agentic AI – LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain
+ LLM APIs – OpenAI / Azure OpenAI; Prompt Engineering
+ Hugging Face (open-source LLMs, embeddings)
+ Text-to-SQL / Natural-language data querying agents
+ LLM Observability – Langfuse
+ Model Context Protocol (MCP)
+ RAG Pipelines and Vector Databases
+ Machine Learning – Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, NumPy
+ Pydantic
+ Workflow Automation – n8n
+ CI/CD – GitHub Actions / Jenkins
+ Cloud Platforms – AWS / GCP / Azure

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Communication skills – oral & written
+ Analytical Ability
+ Problem Solving / Critical Thinking
+ Team Player / Ability to collaborate
+ Ability to deliver / Results driven
+ Adaptability and continuous learning

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related field)
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. title: Data Platform Consultant
description:
### **Description**

**Location:** Pune  
**Mode:** Hybrid (In India Office)  
  
**Why this role exists…**

At Snap Analytics, we don’t just build data stacks; we engineer the “invisible engines” that power global industry. In seven years, we have grown from a founding idea to nearly 200 specialists, sustaining a 200% year-on-year growth trajectory and we are still in the early chapters. We specialise in transforming the most complex data challenges into the foundations for elite advanced analytics and AI, and the people who join us now will help shape what comes next.

* Supporting high-performance engineering in elite F1 racing teams.
* Powering the digital transition for over 5.8 million energy consumers.
* Optimising supply chains that reach 94% of UK households.
* Supporting the financial futures of over one million families through the platforms we build for leading wealth management firms.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: a “no-ego” collaborative culture, a relentless focus on customer success. We’re looking for senior leaders. We hire seasoned experts who act as strategic partners, capable of navigating the boardroom and the modern cloud data estate with equal poise. You will join an award-winning team trusted by Fortune 500 and FTSE 250 organisations to steer their most critical digital transformations. If you are ready to own high-stakes programmes and mentor the next generation of data & AI talent in a rapidly expanding firm, we want to hear from you.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career defining opportunity.

### **What you'll be doing...**

You’ll lead the delivery of data solutions for our clients, working closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and implement high-quality outcomes.

**Your core responsibilities will include:**

* Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data models within Snowflake and/or Databricks
* Data transformation, modelling and testing with DBT
* Data ingestion and orchestration using tools like Matillion
* Building CI/CD pipeline using bit bucket/git hub
* Working directly with clients to understand requirements, challenge assumptions, and co‑create solutions
* Mentoring junior colleagues and contributing to internal improvements

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:**

* Leading a small team to deliver a complex data solution
* Facilitating a workshop with a client to shape project direction
* Receiving positive feedback on your leadership and strategic thinking

  

### **What you'll need to succeed...**

We’re looking for someone who brings technical expertise, consulting experience, and leadership capability.

**You might be a great fit if you have:**

* 4+ years experience working within a consultancy environment
* Deep familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience working with DBT, Matillion, SQL and Python
* A consultative mindset and ability to build consensus across stakeholders
* Experience mentoring others and driving internal improvements

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:**

* A purely technical role with minimal client interaction
* A focus on data science or machine learning rather than data engineering and analytics

  

### **Why choose Snap?**

At Snap Analytics, we don’t see India as a delivery hub we see it as a strategic driver of global Data & AI transformation.

* Your voice shapes global outcomes
* Your expertise leads, not follows
* Your impact is visible at every level from engineering to boardroom

If you’re ready to operate at the intersection of Data, AI, and leadership, this is your platform.

### **About Snap Analytics**

Snap Analytics is a specialist data and AI consultancy that designs and engineers modern cloud data platforms for large enterprises. We’re the team of “invisible engines” that turn complex, siloed data into a trusted foundation for analytics and AI. Founded in Bristol in 2019, we’re best known for our deep SAP expertise combined with modern platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran, dbt and AWS. We believe in creating a world where data makes sense for everyone and that technology alone doesn’t solve problems: it takes skilled people who understand business processes, working with a no-ego, customer-first mindset.  
  
We work with global enterprises in manufacturing, energy, retail and consumer goods, and financial services to bring their SAP and non-SAP data together into one governed, well-engineered platform so they can make faster decisions, cut cost and complexity, and put AI use cases into production. Our work includes high-performance engineering for elite Formula 1 racing teams, the digital transition for more than 5.8 million UK energy customers, supply chains that reach 94% of UK households, and wealth-management platforms supporting over one million families. Every engagement is delivered through Snap 360, our delivery framework, built on four pillars: Data, People, Processes and Technology.  
  
This is a genuinely exciting time to join; demand for SAP-to-cloud modernisation and enterprise AI is accelerating, and we’re scaling our teams across the UK, India and South Africa to meet it. Honestly, rapid growth also means some of our internal processes and team structures are still evolving, and as a consultancy your priorities will often be shaped by client timelines, so you’ll need to be comfortable with change.

title: Senior Software Engineer —BPaaS (Pune)
description:
**About the Team** We build Bloomberg Platform as a Service (BPaaS), a multi-tenant application platform built on Kubernetes. BPaaS is the default deployment path for many teams at Bloomberg and accounts for a substantial share of the firm's compute infrastructure. By bringing deployment, networking, security, and observability together with Bloomberg's internal tooling, we let engineers focus on their applications rather than the infrastructure behind them.

Our team is focused on the core systems that deploy applications and connect them to Bloomberg's infrastructure.

The team will build and evolve the software that takes application artifacts and turns them into running, reachable services on BPaaS. This includes the systems responsible for application deployment, cluster orchestration, ingress and traffic management, and the infrastructure capabilities that connect workloads to the rest of Bloomberg's environment.

The work sits directly in the critical path between an engineer submitting an application and that application running successfully in production. As BPaaS grows across more workloads, clusters, and environments, the team will focus on making this path reliable, scalable, automated, and increasingly independent of the underlying infrastructure.

This is a new team with the opportunity to establish significant technical ownership while working closely with other teams in San Francisco, New York, and London.

**What's in it for you?**

  

* Build software on Bloomberg's application deployment path.
  
* Work on Kubernetes, deployment, ingress, networking, and orchestration.
  
* Solve distributed systems problems across a large Kubernetes environment.
  
* Turn real platform challenges into reusable capabilities.

### **We'll trust you to:**

  

* Develop systems that translate application and deployment intent into running Kubernetes workloads and make those applications reliably reachable through ingress and traffic management.
  
* Develop automation and orchestration for managing BPaaS across a large fleet of Kubernetes clusters.
  
* Own projects from design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production operation.
  
* Diagnose complex production issues spanning application deployment, Kubernetes, networking, ingress, and infrastructure dependencies.
  
* Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and operational maturity of the application deployment path.
  
* Reduce dependencies on individual clusters and environments as BPaaS evolves toward increasingly cluster-agnostic platform capabilities.
  
* Partner with application teams to understand deployment and adoption challenges and turn recurring problems into platform improvements.
  
* Collaborate with BPaaS teams in San Francisco, New York, and London on architecture and capabilities that span the platform.
  
* Evaluate new technologies, challenge existing designs, and help shape the future direction of BPaaS.

### **You'll need to have:**

  

* Strong software engineering skills and experience developing production systems in an object-oriented or strongly typed programming language.
  
* Extensive hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting production systems at scale in Kubernetes environments.
  
* Experience building or operating multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
  
* An understanding of distributed systems and the challenges involved in operating reliable services at scale.
  
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application and infrastructure boundaries.
  
* The ability to work effectively across teams and turn loosely defined infrastructure problems into well-designed engineering solutions.
  
* An interest in learning unfamiliar systems and developing expertise across multiple layers of a platform.

### **We'd love to see:**

  

* 4+ years of demonstrated software engineering experience in Golang, Kubernetes and Javascript/Typescript .
  
* Experience with Kubernetes controllers, operators, or custom resources.
  
* Familiarity with Kubernetes networking, ingress, or service mesh technologies such as Istio.
  
* Experience building deployment, orchestration, or workload lifecycle systems.

description:
Arisen Guruteck Solutions LLP is looking for a passionate and technically motivated **Mobile App Developer (Flutter) Intern** with a strong understanding of cross-platform mobile application development. The candidate should have practical knowledge of Flutter and Dart, along with the ability to develop, integrate, debug, and maintain responsive mobile applications for Android and iOS.

The candidate should be willing to work on live client projects and build scalable, smooth, and user-friendly mobile applications using Flutter.

Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Mobile UI Development (Flutter & Dart)**

* Develop responsive, smooth, and user-friendly mobile interfaces using Flutter and Dart.

**3. API Integration & Backend Connectivity**

* Understand mobile UI/UX best practices and platform-specific guidelines (Material Design and Cupertino).

**5. Testing, Debugging & Deployment**

* Test application functionalities across emulators and physical devices to identify and resolve UI or logic bugs.

* Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Assist in generating release builds (APK/AAB/IPA) and understand deployment workflows for Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Follow industry coding standards and maintain proper project documentation.

**Required Skills**

* Dart programming language and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.

* Firebase fundamentals (Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Messaging).
* Git and GitHub for version control.
* Postman or similar API testing tools.
* Debugging tools (Flutter DevTools) and problem-solving techniques.

**Additional Advantage:**

* Knowledge of Clean Architecture or MVVM patterns.
* Experience integrating payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe) or Google Maps API.
* Familiarity with native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) basics and platform channels.
* Understanding of Google Play Console and App Store Connect release processes.

Preferred Qualifications

* Pursuing or completed B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience with real-world cross-platform mobile app development.
* Opportunity to work on live client projects across various industries.

* Experience working with APIs, state management, databases, and third-party SDK integrations.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / TypeScript), EdTech LMS
description:
**About us**  
PM Publishers is an established publisher of K–8 school textbooks aligned with NEP 2020. Our learning platform, PMP Online, brings our books into the classroom digitally. Schools, teachers and students use it for e-books and multimedia resources, practice assignments and self-assessments, online tests, question-paper generation, holistic progress cards and an AI tutor. QR codes printed in our textbooks link readers to videos, activities and a book-based chatbot.

**The role**  
We're looking for a senior backend developer to take technical ownership of PMP Online as a whole: the API, the React front end, and how the platform is deployed and run. The platform is live and used by schools across India. You'll be the main person responsible for it: improving its security, reliability and code quality, and building new features with the team. This role suits someone who enjoys owning a system end to end, not just closing tickets.

**What you'll do**

* Own the whole platform end to end: the Node.js / TypeScript REST API (around 300 endpoints, four roles: super admin, school admin, teacher and student), the React front end, and deployments
* Design and enforce authentication and role-based access control, with secure handling of student and school data
* Strengthen and refactor existing code: input validation, consistent error handling, pagination and API versioning
* Write automated tests (unit, integration and access-control) and set up CI for the backend
* Work with MySQL and TypeORM, AWS (S3, CloudFront signed URLs and cookies, EC2), Redis, and Nginx on Ubuntu
* Build and maintain AI features: OpenAI API, document embeddings and retrieval for the textbook chatbot
* Work closely with the React front-end developers on API contracts, and pick up front-end work when needed
* Review code, document decisions, and help less experienced developers improve

**Must have**

* 3+ years of professional backend development with Node.js and Express
* Strong TypeScript skills
* MySQL with an ORM (TypeORM preferred), including migrations, indexing and query performance
* Solid understanding of web security: OWASP Top 10, JWT and cookie-based sessions, role-based access control, OTP and password-reset flows, rate limiting
* Experience writing automated tests with Jest or similar, and working with Git and pull-request reviews
* Hands-on AWS experience, especially S3 and CloudFront
* Experience designing REST APIs that other teams depend on
* Working knowledge of React (with Material UI) and React Router, enough to own front-end changes and trace issues across the stack
* Working knowledge of AI: LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar), prompt design, embeddings and retrieval (RAG)
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor in daily work, with the judgement to review, test and secure the code they produce

**Good to have**

* Experience as a tech lead, or as the main developer responsible for a live product
* Redis and background job queues (e.g., BullMQ)
* Experience building RAG or AI-tutor features in production
* Joi or zod validation, Swagger/OpenAPI, Winston logging
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act or handling children's data
* Previous EdTech or LMS experience

title: Software Engineer
description:
### **Description**

Aurora is the global market leader in energy market analytics and software. We built that position on fundamentals models of energy markets and the intellectual rigour behind them. Investors, lenders, developers and governments use our forecasts to decide which wind farms, solar farms and batteries get built and financed, so the data has to be trusted and bankable. None of that matters unless people can get at it.

Our Product Engineering team owns the interfaces to Aurora: UI, APIs, SDKs, CLIs and newer interaction models such as MCP servers, which let AI agents work with our data directly. Our job is to make Aurora's capabilities usable for customers and our own analysts, whatever the touchpoint, and everyone in the team works across those surfaces.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join one of our squads in our growing Gurugram engineering hub.

Energy sits where physics, economics and maths meet. A power price emerges from weather, grid constraints, fuel costs, policy and the behaviour of every asset on the system, and our models simulate all of it. Our modellers build those models, but our engineers engage just as deeply with the domain. You can't design a good interface to something you don't understand, so you'll learn how markets, assets and policy fit together, and for most of the team that's a big part of the appeal. You don't need an energy background to apply: we'll support you to build that knowledge.

The harder engineering problem is that there is no single energy market. Our regional teams cover markets around the world, and a market rule in Texas, a capacity mechanism in Germany and a grid in Australia all have to be handled by the same software. Designing something that respects those differences without dissolving into special cases is where much of the interesting work sits.

### **Key Responsibilities**

We're organised into long-lived squads, each owning part of the product end to end, with an embedded product representative who can make backlog decisions. Squads stay stable so they build real depth in their area.

We are serious about continuous delivery and push to production many times a day in small changes, backed by automated tests and CI. We already tick most of the DORA capabilities (the practices research has found predict good software delivery outcomes), and we treat that as a starting point. Our ambition is to be among the best engineering teams at building and delivering software. You'll own what you build from design through to running it in production.

AI tools are expected across the whole job: requirements, design, code, tests, review and operations. Our stance is fundamentals first. AI amplifies whatever practice it sits on, so it makes good engineering faster and bad engineering faster too. What we care about is how you frame a problem, break it down and verify what comes back.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

**Required attributes:**

* You will build and ship software that real people use, and be able to explain your choices, including the ones you'd now make differently
* care about tests, readable code and what happens to your work after it's merged
* enjoy understanding a problem as much as solving it, and be curious about a domain you may not know yet
* use AI tools in your work, and have views on where they help and where they don't
* want to get noticeably better over the next couple of years, and be someone others enjoy working with along the way

Our stack is TypeScript and Node, Express, React micro-frontends, SQL (Redshift and MySQL) and MongoDB on AWS, with some Python. Experience with it helps but isn't required: some of our strongest engineers came from C# and other stacks, because good engineering transfers.

### **What we offer**

Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

### **About Aurora Energy Research**

From its academic roots, Aurora Energy Research is a thriving, rapidly growing company, currently serving over 1000 of the world’s most influential energy sector participants, including utilities, investors, and governments.  
  
While we constantly strive to reach new markets and diversify our product portfolio, we are already active across the globe in Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Europe, South Africa and North America, working with leading organisations to provide comprehensive market intelligence, bespoke analytic and advisory services, and cutting-edge software.  
  
We are a diverse team of experts with vast energy, financial, and consulting backgrounds, covering power, hydrogen, carbon, and fossil commodities. With this, we provide data-driven intelligence to fuel strategic decisions in the global energy transformation.

description:

Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Bengaluru, KA

**About The Role:**  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role that will see you driving engineering excellence across multiple systems and teams, with a particular focus on how we build, adopt and operate AI engineering tooling.

Operating within a domain or sub-domain, you turn architectural vision into elegant, scalable and reliable systems. Leading through technical mastery and influence, you will drive design, guide implementation, and mentor engineers to solve complex problems with clarity and creativity. You raise the bar on quality, make excellence repeatable, turn design principles into engineering reality, and bring architecture to life in code. Staff Engineers join the dots, anticipate challenges, and set the technical direction that makes ambition achievable.

  

**What You’ll Do**  
  
Reporting to a Director of Engineering and working closely with Engineering Managers, you ensure solutions are built for performance, resilience and long-term evolution. By combining deep technical expertise with strong design and collaboration skills, you make certain systems are built right: performant, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with business and architectural goals.

As the most senior technical individual contributor within delivery, you act as the technical anchor for your domain or sub-domain. You design, review and implement complex systems, mentor other engineers, and ensure architectural intent translates into execution reality.

**Domain / Systems Scope**  
  
The role centres on AI tooling and the AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC). You will define how teams adopt AI harnesses and agentic workflows, establish the standards and guardrails that make them safe and repeatable, and build the platform capabilities that put these tools into the hands of engineers across the organisation.

A significant part of the role is judgement. AI-DLC is not a single prescribed process, and you will be expected to assess where it fits, where it does not, and how it should be adapted to different teams and problem spaces. Because this work reaches across many teams, you will spend considerable time consulting, aligning and influencing beyond your immediate group.

**Technical design, strategy and system ownership**

* Lead the design, implementation and optimisation of multiple systems or services across a domain or sub-domain.
* Define and evolve our AI-DLC practices, selecting and tailoring approaches rather than applying a single template.
* Design, build and productionise agentic systems for a range of business use cases, from prototype through to enterprise-grade operation.
* Ensure systems meet functional and non-functional requirements, including scalability, reliability, performance, security and cost efficiency.
* Conduct deep technical reviews and champion craftsmanship, testing and code quality.
* Identify opportunities for reusability, refactoring and simplification of the technical landscape.
* Evaluate emerging technologies in a fast-moving field and advocate pragmatic, evidence-based adoption.
* Drive experimentation and continuous improvement across technical and delivery processes.
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC on the ground, working directly with delivery teams rather than from the sidelines.
* Act as an advocate and evangelist for AI-DLC, building understanding, confidence and momentum across the engineering organisation.
* Help teams evolve their ways of working, coaching them through the shift and adapting the process to the realities of their domain.
* Define and publish policies, guidelines and best practice for specific use cases, so teams have clear and practical guardrails to work within.
Identify gaps in tooling, process and capability, and lead the work to close them.  

  

**Sub-Domain/Code Expertise**
-----------------------------

**You will be expected to hold genuine depth, and to be hands-on, in the following:**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Python as the primary language for agent and tooling development, with the engineering discipline expected of production code.
* Agent frameworks and orchestration, including LangGraph and LangChain, and the design patterns that make multi-step agents reliable.

title: Technical Lead - SDET
description:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**1. About the role**
=====================

TAC powers IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services for customers around the world. It manages the full life of SIMs and eSIMs: provisioning, activation, subscription changes and termination. Customers use it to connect millions of devices and consumers.

We are changing how we build and test TAC. AI is now part of how we design, code, test and deliver. We want quality to move at the same speed.

This is a senior role. You will own quality for your area from test strategy to release sign-off. You will design how we test, not only run tests. You will use AI to test faster and better, and you will lead the team in doing the same.

You work with limited supervision, make sound technical calls, and are trusted by the Senior Engineering Manager, architects and product owners on quality decisions.

**2. Why this role exists**
===========================

* Our platform keeps growing: more GSMA specs, more customers, more devices, more cloud environments.
* Manual testing cannot keep up. We need strong automation that people trust.
* AI can cut the time spent on test design, test data, failure analysis and reporting. We need someone who can prove it and scale it.
* We need a senior voice on quality: someone who sets direction, guides others and holds the bar.
* Releases must stay safe. Every release needs clear evidence that it works, is secure and performs.

**3. Key responsibilities**
===========================

**3.1 IVVQ and test ownership**
-------------------------------

* Plan and run integration, verification, validation and qualification (IVVQ) for every TAC release.
* Design test plans, traceability matrices and a clear regression strategy.
* Review requirements and user stories early. Flag gaps, risks and unclear points before development starts.
* Define entry and exit criteria for each stage of testing.
* Prepare test reports and release sign-off evidence.
* Follow the DDPS delivery process and its quality gates. Make sure evidence is ready on time.
* Support audits, co-assessments and engineering fundamentals reviews with clear test records.

**3.2 IoT and mobile connectivity testing**
-------------------------------------------

* Test end-to-end connectivity services: SIM and eSIM activation, subscription changes, suspend and resume, and termination.
* Test IoT use cases: device onboarding, eSIM provisioning at scale, and profile switching between operators.
* Test integrations with mobile network operators (MNOs) and connectivity partners.
* Check data, SMS and roaming-related service behavior where it applies to TAC.
* Test bulk and batch operations across large device fleets.
* Check customer-facing APIs, order flows and error handling against specs and customer needs.
* Reproduce customer issues and build regression tests so they do not come back.

**3.3 eSIM and GSMA domain testing**
------------------------------------

* Test TAC against GSMA specifications: SGP.22 (consumer), and SGP.31 and SGP.32 (IoT).
* Test Remote SIM Provisioning flows end to end: profile download, enable, disable and delete.
* Test eIM operations and the roles of IPAd, IPAe, SM-DP+ and eUICC.
* Run tests with real SIM and eSIM cards, test profiles and test certificates.
* Check that test setups stay valid when external parts change, such as the GSMA test CI or certificates.
* Follow GSMA test specs (for example SGP.23 and SGP.33) as a guide for conformance coverage.

**3.4 Test automation**
-----------------------

* Build and maintain automation frameworks for API, UI, end-to-end and card-level tests.
* Keep the code clean, reusable and easy to review. Treat test code like product code.
* Make tests stable. Find and fix flaky tests quickly.
* Manage test data and test environments so tests are repeatable.
* Automate anything that is done twice.

**3.5 AI-assisted testing and delivery**
----------------------------------------

* Use AI tools to generate test cases, test data and automation code from requirements and specs.
* Use AI to analyze failures, group similar defects, find patterns and spot flaky tests.
* Use AI to draft test reports, release notes and defect summaries. Always check the facts.
* Review AI output with a critical eye. You own the final quality.
* Build small AI-assisted tools and workflows that save the team time.
* Try new AI testing ideas. Measure the gain (time saved, defects found, coverage) and share what works.
* Protect data. Know what can and cannot be shared with AI tools.
* Help the team build good prompting habits and safe AI practices.

**3.6 Quality, security and performance**
-----------------------------------------

* Use SonarQube quality gates. Track code smells, bugs and coverage, and help fix them.
* Use Fortify for static security scans. Track findings to closure and retest fixes.
* Do basic security and API security testing, including authentication and authorization checks (OAuth, Keycloak).
* Run performance, load, stress, endurance and resilience tests, including large device and order volumes.
* Do performance engineering and benchmarking: set baselines, compare releases and report trends.
* Find bottlenecks and work with developers on fixes. Retest to confirm the gain.

**3.7 Platform and delivery**
-----------------------------

* Integrate tests into CI/CD so every build gets fast feedback.
* Test on Kubernetes, using Docker images and Helm charts.
* Validate deliveries on GCP and AWS environments.
* Use Git for code, branching and code reviews.
* Test gateway, security and infrastructure components, for example Kong, APISIX and Keycloak.
* Check upgrade, rollback and deployment paths, not only features.

**3.8 Agile ways of working and teamwork**
------------------------------------------

* Take part in PI planning, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives in an Agile and SAFe setup.
* Triage defects, find root causes and work closely with developers, architects and product owners.
* Work with Product, Platform, DevOps and Blueprint teams on shared deliveries.
* Mentor junior testers. Raise the quality bar of the team.
* Update the Senior Engineering Manager on quality, risks and progress. Speak up early.

**3.9 Senior-level ownership and leadership**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the test strategy for your area of TAC. Decide what to test, how deep, and with which tools.
* Design the architecture of our automation frameworks. Set standards for structure, reuse, naming and reviews.
* Lead release sign-off for your area. Take the go or no-go quality view and explain the risks clearly.
* Define and own the AI-in-testing roadmap: pick use cases, run pilots, measure gains and scale what works.
* Set quality gates and metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, performance trends) and report them to leadership.
* Influence requirements, architecture and design reviews from a testability and risk point of view.
* Lead technical triage for customer escalations and critical defects. Drive root cause and prevention.
* Estimate effort, plan capacity and raise risks early during PI and sprint planning.
* Coach and mentor testers and engineers. Review their work, grow their skills and build a strong bench.
* Take part in interviews and hiring, and help build the team’s skills plan.
* Work across teams (Product, Platform, DevOps, Blueprint, other feature teams) and resolve quality dependencies.

**4. What we are looking for**
==============================

**4.1 Must have**
-----------------

* **Experience:** 6+ years in QA, SDET or IVVQ roles, with strong automation work and 2+ years as owner or lead of a test area or framework.
* **Framework design:** Proven record of designing and growing automation frameworks, not only using them.
* **Programming:** Strong in Java or Python. Able to write clean, maintainable test code.
* **Automation tools:** Hands-on with tools such as Selenium, REST Assured, Postman, Cypress or Playwright.
* **API testing:** Solid skills in REST, JSON, OAuth and Keycloak basics.
* **Connectivity:** Understanding of IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services (SIM lifecycle, subscriptions, MNO integration).
* **eSIM:** Good understanding of eSIM, eUICC and the Remote SIM Provisioning flow.
* **GSMA:** Working knowledge of SGP.22 and SGP.31 / SGP.32. Understanding of IPAd, IPAe and eIM roles.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar.
* **Containers:** Hands-on with Docker as the container, Kubernetes as the orchestrator and Helm as the package manager.
* **Cloud:** Familiar with GCP or AWS as a platform.
* **Source control:** Git for repository management, branching and reviews.
* **Quality and security tools:** Experience with SonarQube and Fortify, or similar tools.
* **Performance:** Experience in performance testing, performance engineering and benchmarking.
* **Process:** Agile development experience. Good test design: test plans, traceability, coverage and regression strategy.
* **Leadership:** Experience mentoring others and influencing decisions without formal authority.
* **Communication:** Clear written and spoken communication, including reporting risks to senior stakeholders and customers.

**4.2 AI skills we expect**
---------------------------

* Daily use of AI assistants for coding and testing.
* Able to write clear prompts and review AI output with care.
* Understand AI limits: wrong answers, bias and data privacy.
* Comfort building AI-assisted test tools or workflows and driving their adoption across a team.
* Curiosity to learn new AI tools and test whether they really help.

**4.3 Good to have**
--------------------

* Cellular basics: 4G/5G, LTE-M, NB-IoT, APN and roaming.
* Experience with a connectivity management platform (CMP) or an IoT platform.
* Experience with SGP.21, SGP.23 and SGP.33 test specs.
* Knowledge of SM-DP+, SM-DS and eIM servers.
* Performance tools such as JMeter, Gatling or k6.
* Jira and Xray for test management.
* Experience with AI agents or LLM-based test generation.
* Security testing: OWASP, API security.
* Experience with API gateways such as Kong or APISIX.
* Telecom or IoT product background.

**4.4 Education**
-----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecom or a related field.

**5. How this role supports our AI transformation**
===================================================

We expect AI to become part of normal testing work. This table shows how we see it.

**Area**

**What AI helps with, and what you do**

**Test design**

AI drafts test cases and edge cases from specs and requirements. You review, fix and approve them.

**Test data**

AI helps create varied and realistic data. You check it is safe, valid and free of customer data.

**Automation code**

AI helps write and refactor test scripts. You review for quality, readability and correctness.

**Failure analysis**

AI groups failures and points to likely causes. You confirm the root cause with developers.

**Reporting**

AI drafts reports and summaries. You check every fact before it is shared.

**Team enablement**

You share prompts, tips and working examples so the whole team improves.

**Roadmap and governance**

You pick the use cases, define safe-use rules, measure the gain and report it to leadership.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Staff Compiler Performance Engineer**
to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

  

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers
  

  
**What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Principal Consultant
description: Job DescriptionAs an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs. Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs. Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes. Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements. Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies. Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery. Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption. Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness. Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes. Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required. Skills - Mandatory Experience At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience. Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live. Oracle Products Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules. Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs. Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes. Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management. Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk. Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle. Functional Skills Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules. Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs. Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information. Technical Skills Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas. Stakeholder Management Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Leadership Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates. Good to Have Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations. Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective. Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities. Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications. Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates. About UsOnly Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

* Ability to work independently, self-motivated, and highly focused
* Experience in a consulting firm and global exposure is desirable

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Any SAP Ariba/MM certification a plus

**Ideally, you should also have**

* Experience on SDLC or SAP Activate methodology or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about SAP Ariba’s latest release and functionalities

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY SAP practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

title: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET / Angular / Azure)
description:
**About Ace Rooms Ltd**

Ace Rooms Ltd is a UK-based B2B travel technology company with over 16 years of experience in global hotel and transfer distribution. Our platform enables travel agents and API partners to search live inventory, book hotels and transfers, and manage payments. We are currently undergoing a full greenfield platform rebuild on Microsoft Azure, migrating from a legacy monolith to a modern, service-based architecture.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our core in-house engineering team in Kolkata and contribute to the ground-up rebuild of our hotel-distribution platform. Working across both the .NET back end and Angular front end on Microsoft Azure, you will build end-to-end features, RESTful APIs, and responsive user interfaces while collaborating closely with our backend, frontend, and QA engineers to ensure shared technical ownership across the stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

·        Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core) on the back end and Angular (TypeScript) on the front end.

·        Build, consume, and version RESTful APIs connecting our Angular single-page application (SPA) and third-party travel partner integrations.

·        Develop responsive, high-performance UI components in Angular for hotel/transfer search, live pricing, and booking workflows.

·        Implement and manage Azure SQL database schemas; write efficient, optimised T-SQL and Entity Framework Core queries.

·        Work with Redis caching, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management (APIM) to support high-speed availability searches and asynchronous booking events.

·        Implement server-side payment validation, booking lifecycle management, and idempotency controls.

·        Manage application secrets via Azure Key Vault and follow strict secure-coding standards (parameterised queries, input validation, and OWASP best practices).

·        Maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, participate in peer Pull Request (PR) code reviews across both front end and back end, and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

·        
**Back End:**
Solid commercial experience building back-end services with C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core), and Entity Framework Core.

·        
**Front End:**
Strong commercial experience building modern, responsive web applications with Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS).

·        
**Databases:**
Azure SQL / SQL Server schema design and T-SQL query optimisation.

·        
**Microsoft Azure:**
Hands-on experience with Azure App Service, Redis Cache, Service Bus, Key Vault, and APIM.

·        
**APIs & Data Exchange:**
Designing RESTful APIs and handling high-volume JSON/XML payloads for supplier and partner integrations.

·        
**CI/CD & Git:**
Experience with GitHub Actions pipelines, feature-branch workflows, and Pull Request code reviews.

·        
**Security & Quality:**
Awareness of secure coding standards, secrets management, and unit/integration testing.

·        
**Communication:**
Clear written and spoken English with the ability to collaborate directly with UK leadership and document technical decisions concisely.

**Desirable Skills**

·        Experience in travel technology (bed banks, hotel/transfer APIs, channel managers, or GDS connectivity).

·        Familiarity with .NET 8/9/10 and recent versions of Angular (v17+).

·        Familiarity with Azure AD B2C or Microsoft Entra for authentication and authorisation.

·        Understanding of high-concurrency booking platforms (caching strategies, idempotency, and ledger integrity).

**Qualifications**

·        Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent commercial experience).

·        Minimum 4–5 years of commercial full-stack software development experience with .NET and Angular.

**What We Offer**

·        
**Greenfield Platform Rebuild:**
Direct influence on architecture, UI/UX, and engineering standards from the ground up.

·        
**Stability & Direct UK Collaboration:**
Full-time, permanent role with an established, profitable UK travel-technology company (16+ years in operation).

·        
**Work Schedule:**
Monday to Friday, 12:00 Noon – 9:00 PM IST (overlapping with UK business hours).

·        
**Compensation & Benefits:**
Competitive salary negotiable based on experience, plus Provident Fund.

title: Specialist - Pilot line IQC
description:
Purpose of the Role
  
  
Own Incoming Quality Control (IQC) for raw materials and components used on the Pilot Line — active materials, binders/solvents, conductive additives, foils, separators, electrolyte, and cell hardware (casings, tabs, terminals) inspecting and releasing material against approved specifications for each chemistry (e.g., LFP, NMC, or other emerging chemistries) ahead of trial builds.
  
  
Define and update incoming inspection plans and acceptance criteria for new materials/suppliers introduced during chemistry changeovers and NPI trials, coordinating with R&D, SCM, and Production to avoid trial downtime. Manage non-conforming material disposition and CAPA, and ensure incoming quality data is captured accurately in MES/SAP for full material traceability.
  
  
Key Responsibility Areas
  
  

* Inspect and test incoming raw materials/components against approved specifications (e.g., active material particle size/purity, binder/solvent properties, foil thickness/surface, separator porosity/thickness, electrolyte composition/moisture, cell hardware dimensions) before releasing material for Pilot Line trial builds.
* Maintain and execute sampling plans (AQL-based) and calibrated test/measurement methods for each material category.
* Quarantine, disposition, and drive CAPA on non-conforming (NG) incoming material, coordinating with suppliers, R&D, and SCM for resolution.
* Maintain lot-level traceability of incoming materials in SAP/MES for full genealogy back to trial builds. NPI & Multi-Chemistry Support

Knowledge Generic
  
  

* 5–10 years of incoming/supplier quality experience in Li-ion cell, EV battery pack, or solar cell manufacturing (or a battery raw-material supplier), with hands-on ownership of material qualification, NPI, or multi-chemistry changeover work
* Deep technical knowledge of battery raw materials (active materials, binders/solvents, conductive additives, foils, separators, electrolyte, cell hardware) and how specs shift across chemistries
* Proficiency with incoming inspection equipment (particle size analyzer, viscometer, Karl Fischer, coating weight gauge, XRF, dimensional metrology) and AQL sampling
* Strong grounding in SPC and problem-solving tools (8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC, 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA) for supplier/incoming-material CAPA

Job Context
  
  

* Support qualification of new materials and suppliers for new chemistries — jointly define incoming test plans/specifications with R&D and execute first-article inspection ahead of trial use.
* Coordinate with R&D on material specification changes required for each chemistry changeover, and update incoming inspection standards accordingly.
* Document incoming-quality learnings, specification changes, and supplier qualification data for technology transfer to the Gigafactory line. Coordination & Problem Solving
* Coordinate with SCM for timely, quality-compliant material availability to support the Pilot Line trial schedule.

Job Context Specific
  
  

* Coordinate with the Pilot Line Manager, Production, and Process Engineering to contain and resolve incoming-material-related process or trial issues.
* Lead root-cause investigations and CAPA for supplier/incoming-material quality issues using 8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC Tools, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and FMEA.
* Ensure safe handling, storage, and disposal of incoming materials, with attention to chemistry-specific hazards (e.g., electrolyte, solvents, active materials).
* Ensure IQC processes and documentation meet IATF 16949 quality management system requirements and are audit ready.

Knowledge Specific
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytical Chemistry, or a related field

title: Growth Strategy Manager
description:
**About the Role**

The company is seeking a highly organized Growth Strategy person to act as the operational engine behind their U.S. sales team. It is a hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) rolededicated to accelerating the sales cycle. You will be responsible for supporting seniorsales executives by managing the opportunities in the sales funnel. Your primary focus willbe removing friction from the sales process by owning pre-sales collateral, craftingwinning proposals, managing pricing structures, and overseeing the contracting process. You will serve as the critical bridge between the Sales, Product, and Legal teams to ensuredeals are structured correctly and closed efficiently.

**Responsibilities**

* Funnel Advancement: Collaborate directly with Sales to advance opportunities from "Qualified Lead" to "Closed Won," ensuring momentum is not lost during the evaluation phase.

* Presentation Development: Create and customize compelling sales decks, demo scripts, and client-facing presentations that address specific customer pain points and technical requirements.

* Contract Management: Manage the contracting workflow, including the preparation of Master Services Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs). Liaison with internal legal/finance teams to resolve redlines and accelerate signature.
* Pre-Sales Coordination: Coordinate technical demonstrations and proof-of-concept (POC) setups between the prospect and our technical product teams.
* Sales Enablement Assets: Maintain a repository of up-to-date case studies, battle cards, and whitepapers to ensure the sales team has immediate access to relevant collateral.
* CRM & Reporting: Maintain strict hygiene in the CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), ensuring deal stages, probability, and next steps are accurately reflected for forecasting.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of experience in Growth Strategy, Sales Operations, Pre-Sales, or Business Development within the SaaS/Technology sector.
* Healthcare Domain Expertise: Prior experience working with U.S. healthcare payers, providers, or risk adjustment solutions is highly desirable.
* Documentation Mastery: Proven ability to write complex proposals, SOWs, and professional business documents.
* Global Model Experience: Demonstrable experience working in a global model, that directly support a U.S. or international market.
* Individual Contributor Mindset: Comfortable working in a standalone, high-accountability role without direct reports, focusing purely on execution and deal support.
* Exceptional Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (both written and verbal) are mandatory for C-suite and U.S. market engagement.
* Educational Background: MBA with Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.

**Required Skills**

* CRM Proficiency: Advanced skills in Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
* Presentation Tools: Advanced skills in presentation tools (Google Slides, PowerPoint) to build polished, executive-ready decks.
* Analysis: Strong Excel skills for pricing calculations and deal modeling.

**Preferred Skills**

* Sales Methodology Certification: Training or certification in SPIN Selling or The Challenger Sale is preferred.
* Familiarity with U.S. healthcare contracting standards and compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC2).
* Experience interacting with Legal and Finance teams to finalize complex enterprise software agreements.
* Deep knowledge of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, including value-based care and risk adjustment concepts.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Opportunity to shape the future of a high-growth company
* Board visibility and executive leadership exposure
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Collaborative and innovative work environment

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. You will be responsible for testing Workday applications and integrations, ensuring quality across releases, enhancements and business changes while collaborating with functional, technical and business teams.

* Execute functional, integration, regression and UAT testing.

* Support Workday R1/R2 release testing and validate system changes.

* Validate Workday integrations and support deployment verification.
Provide testing status reports, metrics and continuous improvements.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

### **Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

* **4+ years of QA testing experience (Mandatory).**
* Experience in Workday HCM and/or Workday Integrations testing.
* Understanding of Workday business processes, Security, EIB, Studio and Web Services.
* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and UAT testing.
* Experience with Jira, Zephyr or similar test management tools.
* Knowledge of SDLC processes and defect management.
Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.  

  

### **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

* Exposure to test automation tools and frameworks.
* Experience in Workday release testing (R1/R2).
* Experience working in global QA teams and stakeholder environments.
Exposure to environment validation, smoke testing and deployment verification.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
