**Job Title - VTEX Commerce Architect - Manager - ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 7-Manager**
**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai**
**Must have skills: VTEX, VTEX IO, FastStore, Store Framework, Headless Commerce, GraphQL, React/Next.js, Commerce Architecture**
**Good to have skills: Enterprise Integration, Cloud-Native Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, DevSecOps, Agile Delivery**
**Experience: 13 - 15 years of experience is required, including strong enterprise commerce architecture experience**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced VTEX Commerce Architect with 13–15 years of overall technology experience and proven expertise in architecting enterprise-scale digital commerce solutions using VTEX. The candidate will own end-to-end solution architecture across VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, headless storefronts, GraphQL APIs, integrations, security, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
  
  
The ideal candidate should combine hands-on VTEX platform knowledge with strong architectural thinking. The role requires translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, evaluating native VTEX capabilities versus custom extensions, leading architecture governance, and guiding distributed engineering teams through design and delivery.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the end-to-end architecture of enterprise digital commerce solutions built on the VTEX Commerce Platform.
* Define solution architecture covering catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, payments, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and VTEX Master Data.
* Design modern storefront solutions using VTEX Store Framework, VTEX IO, FastStore, React, Next.js, and GraphQL.
* Lead the design of headless and composable commerce architectures, including presentation, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), commerce services, CMS, search, identity, and enterprise integration layers.
* Evaluate business requirements and determine when to use native VTEX capabilities, VTEX IO applications, custom services, middleware, or third-party products.
* Define GraphQL and REST API contracts, schema design, API aggregation, versioning, caching, rate limiting, security, and error-handling standards.
* Design integrations between VTEX and ERP, PIM/MDM, OMS, WMS, CRM, payment gateways, tax services, identity providers, search platforms, and marketplaces.
* Define synchronous, asynchronous, webhook, and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate retry, idempotency, dead-letter, reconciliation, and observability mechanisms.
* Establish non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, reliability, accessibility, SEO, maintainability, security, privacy, and disaster recovery.
* Design storefront performance strategies using SSR, SSG/ISR, CDN, edge caching, browser caching, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals principles.
* Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical risk assessments, production issue reviews, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation planning.
* Create and maintain HLDs, LLDs, C4 diagrams, sequence diagrams, integration specifications, API specifications, data-flow diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records.
* Guide engineering teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architecture principles, coding standards, security controls, and operational requirements.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, client architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, and delivery leadership to align architecture with business objectives.
* Mentor technical leads, senior developers, and architects, while promoting engineering excellence and continuous learning.

title: Staff Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Field Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Field Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are very time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Field Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB's R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Forward Deployed AI Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernization projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bangalore for our hybrid working model.

### **Requirements:**

* 10+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients.
* Proficiency in Python and Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages.
* Expert level knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations.
* Deep experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases.
* Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable.
* Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems.
* Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings.
* Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus.
* And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

### **Position Expectations:**

* Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption.
* Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organization.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap.
* Personally execute well-defined, outcome-focused projects, POC, MVP and everything in between. POCs include developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations.
* Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols.
* Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams.
* Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers.
* Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month and to travel to Australia two weeks per year to collaborate with the Product development team

### **Success Measures:**

The Forward Deployed AI Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

* Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products.
* Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering.
* Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences.
* Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field.
* Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers.
* Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Hardware Engineer

Full-Time | Bengaluru, Work from Office

Qualifying Degree: B.Tech from a Tier 1 Institute | Experience: 4+ years

Note: Shortlisted candidates will complete a take-home assignment as part of the process.

**About Us**
============

At Hoomanely, we're building the first precision health platform for pets , a sensor-driven, AI-powered ecosystem that decodes the health signals dogs give off every day, the ones most people miss, and turns them into insight you can act on.

It starts with EverBowl, a clinical-grade device that reads hydration, intake, body temperature, eating behavior, and the sound of a bite , building toward a single daily wellness score. Paired with the Hoomanely app and Protect+, our insurance-rewards membership, we're helping pet parents move from guesswork to knowing. Calm. Confident. In control.

We're not building another pet gadget. None of it works without hardware that reads the same signal reliably, meal after meal, for years , on a device that has to be safe, stable, and manufacturable at scale. That's the problem this role exists to solve.

**About the Role**
==================

We're looking for a hardware engineer to design and validate the electrical and mechanical systems behind Hoomanely's connected devices, working closely with firmware and industrial design to take products from schematic to a reliable, mass-manufactured device.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Design and validate schematics and PCB layouts for sensor-driven consumer hardware, including power, battery charging, and signal integrity
* Select and integrate sensors , thermal imagers, IMUs, cameras , ensuring correct electrical interfacing with the compute module
* Design safe battery charging paths, thermal cutoff mechanisms, and power budgets that hold up under continuous real-world use
* Design clock trees and signal paths that stay stable across crystal tolerance drift and environmental variation
* Work with contract manufacturers on DFM and DFT, and support bring-up, debugging, and yield improvement during production runs
* Build and run test fixtures to validate hardware performance, reliability, and compliance requirements
* Work closely with firmware, industrial design, and ML teams to make sure the hardware supports the sensing accuracy the product depends on

**You Might Be a Fit If…**
==========================

* You have a B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, or equivalent) , mandatory
* You have 4+ years of hardware design experience
* You have strong hands-on experience with schematic design, PCB layout, and power management circuits
* You're proficient with EDA tools (Altium, KiCad, or equivalent) and lab equipment for hardware validation
* You've taken a hardware design from prototype through DFM to mass production
* Bonus: experience with thermal imaging, IMU, or camera sensor integration
* Bonus: familiarity with battery charging ICs and safety certification requirements
* Bonus: prior experience in IoT, wearables, or connected consumer hardware

**Why Join Us?**
================

* Design hardware that ends up in the hands (and homes) of real pet parents , not a reference board that never ships
* Own real pieces of a product taken from schematic to mass manufacturing
* Take ownership early, with a direct line to firmware, industrial design, and founding leadership
* Join a small, fast-moving team building a category-defining, sensor-driven product

**To Apply**
============

Share your background, along with any hardware designs you've taken from prototype to mass production. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short assignment as part of our process.

title: Analog Layout Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Seniority level: Associate Level

  

Min Experience: 3+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Hyderabad, Telangana, India  
JobType: full-time

We are seeking a skilled Analog Layout Engineer with strong expertise in custom analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit (IC) layout design. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality layouts from schematic implementation through tape-out, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, area efficiency, and compliance with process design rules.

The role involves working on a range of analog and mixed-signal circuit blocks, applying advanced layout techniques, resolving physical verification issues, and collaborating closely with analog design, verification, reliability, and foundry teams throughout the chip development lifecycle.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and implement custom analog and mixed-signal layouts from schematic to tape-out.
* Design and execute layouts for various circuit blocks, including:
  + Amplifiers and Comparators
  + Bandgap References
  + Low-Dropout Regulators (LDOs)
  + Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs)
  + Analog-to-Digital and Digital-to-Analog Converters (ADCs/DACs)
  + Power Management IC (PMIC) Blocks
  + SerDes Analog Blocks
* Implement advanced layout techniques to ensure device matching, symmetry, shielding, isolation, and parasitic optimisation.
* Apply matching-sensitive layout methodologies, including common-centroid and interdigitation techniques.
* Perform floorplanning and layout optimisation to meet performance, area, power, and reliability requirements.
* Execute and resolve physical verification checks, including:
  + Design Rule Check (DRC)
  + Layout Versus Schematic (LVS)
  + Electrical Rule Check (ERC)
  + Antenna Checks
  + Density Checks
* Support post-layout extraction (PEX) activities and assist with layout-related debugging and optimisation.
* Collaborate with analog design, circuit verification, reliability, and foundry teams to ensure design accuracy and successful implementation.
* Drive layout closure and support chip tape-out activities.
* Ensure compliance with process design rules, ESD requirements, latch-up prevention, and reliability standards.
* Contribute to the development and physical implementation of integrated circuits across architectural design, logic design, circuit design, physical design, verification, fabrication, and packaging stages.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Analog Custom Layout: Strong hands-on experience in custom analog and mixed-signal IC layout development.
* Matching-Sensitive Layouts: Expertise in precision layout techniques to minimise mismatch and improve circuit performance.
* Common-Centroid Layout Techniques: Practical experience implementing common-centroid structures for matching-critical devices.
* Interdigitation: Experience with interdigitated layout structures and device placement strategies.
* Physical Verification: Hands-on experience with DRC, LVS, ERC, antenna, and density checks.
* Layout Reliability: Understanding of guard rings, shielding, isolation, ESD protection, and latch-up prevention methodologies.

**Technology Node Experience**
------------------------------

Mandatory hands-on experience in one or more of the following semiconductor process nodes:

* 28nm
* 40nm
* 55nm
* 65nm
* 90nm
* 180nm

**EDA Tools and Technologies**
------------------------------

Must-Have:

* Cadence Virtuoso Layout XL
* Calibre DRC/LVS/ERC

Good-to-Have:

* Virtuoso ADE
* Assura
* PVS

**Good-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* Experience with Virtuoso ADE for analog design analysis and verification.
* Familiarity with Assura and PVS physical verification tools.
* Experience supporting post-layout simulation and parasitic extraction.
* Understanding of analog circuit design, physical implementation, and semiconductor fabrication processes.
* Exposure to complete IC development and tape-out workflows

title: Presales Solutions Consultant (Off Campus)
description:
Build the Future of Enterprise AI

Are you a
**top engineering graduate**
who enjoys solving problems, understanding technology, building things, and explaining how technology can create business impact?

Do you find yourself naturally exploring
**AI, GenAI, APIs, software products, and emerging technologies**
?

At
**Zycus**
, you can turn that technical curiosity into a career at the intersection of
**AI, Enterprise Technology, Consulting, and Business**
.

We are looking for exceptional Graduate Engineers to join our
**Pre-Sales / Solution Consulting**
team and work with some of the world's largest enterprises.

This is not a traditional sales role.

You will work with Sales, Product, Engineering, AI, and customers to understand complex business problems, design technology-led solutions, and demonstrate how
**AI-powered enterprise software**
can transform the way organizations work.

What You'll Do

Solve Real Business Problems With Technology

Enterprise customers come to us with complex problems—not just requests for software.

You will:

* Understand customer business processes and challenges.
* Break ambiguous problems into structured requirements.
* Translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Research industries, companies, and customer environments.
* Identify where software, automation, and AI can create measurable value.
* Work with experienced Solution Consultants to develop solution strategies.

Your job is to answer:

**"How can technology solve this customer's problem?"**

Bring AI Into Enterprise Solutions

AI is at the core of Zycus.

You will learn and work with:

* Generative AI
* LLMs
* AI Agents
* Intelligent Automation
* AI-powered workflows
* Conversational AI
* Data and analytics

You will help demonstrate how AI can automate work, generate insights, improve decision-making, and transform enterprise processes.

You will also be encouraged to experiment with AI tools to improve your own productivity and create better solutions.

**We want engineers who don't just know about AI—they use it.**

Design Technology Solutions

Working with senior Solution Consultants and Product teams, you will:

* Design solutions based on customer requirements.
* Understand system architecture and application workflows.
* Work with APIs, integrations, data, and enterprise systems.
* Configure and demonstrate product capabilities.
* Create solution prototypes and proof-of-concepts where required.
* Understand how enterprise SaaS applications integrate with customer ecosystems.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical solutions.

You will progressively develop from
**understanding the product → designing solutions → owning solution discussions.**

Create Compelling Product Demonstrations

One of the most important skills you will develop is the ability to
**show—not just tell—how technology solves a problem.**

You will:

* Build customized product demonstrations.
* Design demos around customer business scenarios.
* Present technical capabilities and business outcomes.
* Demonstrate AI-powered workflows.
* Explain complex technology to both technical and business audiences.
* Participate in customer presentations and solution workshops.

The goal isn't to demonstrate every feature.

The goal is to demonstrate:

**"Here's your problem. Here's how we solve it. Here's the value you get."**

Work With Global Enterprises

You will gain exposure to some of the world's largest organizations and work alongside experienced Sales and Solution Consulting teams across global markets.

You may participate in:

* Customer discovery sessions
* Technical workshops
* Solution presentations
* Product demonstrations
* Proof-of-concepts
* RFP/RFI responses
* Executive presentations
* Competitive analysis
* Account strategy

You will learn how enterprise technology decisions are actually made.

Work Across the Organization

You will collaborate with:

* Enterprise Sales
* Product Management
* Engineering
* AI/ML teams
* Customer Success
* Implementation
* Marketing

You will become the
**technical bridge between the customer and Zycus**
.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for
**elite Graduate Engineers**
with strong technical foundations and exceptional problem-solving ability.

Education

* B.E./B.Tech —
  **2026 graduates**
* Preferred disciplines:
* Computer Science Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Information Technology
* Artificial Intelligence
* Data Science
* Information Science
* Electronics & Communication
* Other strong engineering disciplines

We are particularly interested in candidates from
**top engineering institutions**
with strong academic and technical credentials.

What We Value

You don't need prior Pre-Sales experience.

We are looking for:

Strong Problem Solving

* Excellent analytical and structured-thinking ability.
* Ability to break complex problems into logical components.
* Strong aptitude for learning new concepts quickly.
* Comfort working with ambiguous problems.

Technical Curiosity

* Strong programming fundamentals.
* Understanding of software and technology concepts.
* Interest in SaaS, cloud, APIs, data, and enterprise technology.
* Ability to understand how different systems work together.

AI Fluency

We strongly value candidates who actively use AI.

You should be able to demonstrate how you have used tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* Claude
* Gemini
* Cursor
* GitHub Copilot
* Perplexity
* Other AI development or productivity tools

Even better if you have:

* Built an AI application.
* Built an AI Agent.
* Worked with an LLM or RAG.
* Created an AI-powered automation.
* Built a chatbot.
* Used AI to solve a real-world problem.
* Participated in an AI/technology hackathon.

Communication & Influence

Great Solution Consultants are excellent communicators.

You should be able to:

* Explain technical concepts simply.
* Present ideas confidently.
* Tell a compelling story around technology.
* Listen carefully and ask intelligent questions.
* Communicate with both engineers and business leaders.
* Influence without relying on authority.

You don't need to be a polished salesperson.

**We will teach you Pre-Sales.**

What we cannot easily teach is
**curiosity, intelligence, problem-solving ability, and the desire to understand technology deeply.**

What You'll Learn

At Zycus, you will develop a combination of skills that is difficult to acquire in a traditional engineering role.

Technology

Enterprise SaaS • APIs • Cloud • Integrations • Data • Architecture

AI

GenAI • LLMs • AI Agents • Intelligent Automation

Consulting

Discovery • Problem Definition • Solution Design • Business Analysis

Pre-Sales

Product Demonstrations • POCs • Solution Workshops • RFPs • Competitive Strategy

Business

Enterprise Buying • Digital Transformation • ROI • Value Selling

Communication

Storytelling • Executive Communication • Presentation • Influence

Where Can This Career Take You?

This role is designed to build the next generation of
**technology consultants and enterprise solution leaders**
.

As you grow, you can build a career toward:

**Solution Consultant → Senior Solution Consultant → Solution Architect → Principal Solution Architect**

or explore adjacent paths across:

**AI • Product Management • Enterprise Consulting • Sales Engineering • Customer Success • Business Value Consulting**

Why Zycus?

Zycus is an
**AI-first enterprise SaaS company**
transforming procurement for some of the world's largest organizations.

Our platform combines
**Source-to-Pay technology with Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, data, and intelligent workflows.**

You will get the opportunity to:

* Work with
  **Fortune 500 and global enterprises**
  .
* Work on real-world AI use cases.
* Learn enterprise SaaS and technology architecture.
* Work alongside Sales, Product, Engineering, and AI teams.
* Build solutions that impact large organizations.
* Develop both technical and business skills.
* Learn from experienced Solution Consultants and technology leaders.
* Build a career at the intersection of
  **AI + Technology + Business**
  .

The Profile We're Looking For

If you are someone who:

**Loves technology**

**Uses AI every day**

**Enjoys solving difficult problems**

**Can explain what you build**

**Enjoys interacting with people**

**Wants to understand how businesses work**

—you could be an exceptional Solution Consultant.

Start Your Career Where Technology Meets Business

Your engineering degree gives you the technical foundation.

At Zycus, you'll learn how to turn that foundation into
**solutions that solve real problems for the world's largest enterprises.**

**Build with AI. Solve complex problems. Work with global enterprises. Create impact.**

Join Zycus as a Graduate Solution Consultant

description:
**Company Description**
D-Metrix Fab And Piping Pvt Ltd is an industrial fabrication and piping solutions company based in Mumbai. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, quality-driven services for projects in sectors such as infrastructure, manufacturing, and process industries. Its teams collaborate closely with clients to meet project specifications, safety standards, and timelines. As the company grows, it offers opportunities for professionals to contribute to complex projects and develop their careers in a structured, process-oriented environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Tendering Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering and bidding process for fabrication and piping projects. The role includes identifying relevant tenders, analyzing tender documents and technical specifications, and coordinating with internal teams to gather necessary inputs. The Tendering Specialist prepares competitive proposals, cost estimates, and supporting documentation, ensuring compliance with client requirements and company standards. Day-to-day tasks also involve monitoring procurement portals, maintaining tender records, tracking submission deadlines, and supporting negotiations or clarifications with clients. The role works closely with sales, engineering, and finance teams to improve win rates and ensure alignment between bids and operational capabilities.

* Strong Tender Management and Procurement skills, with experience handling complete bidding cycles and vendor/client interfaces.

* Proficiency in Proposal Writing, including structured technical and commercial documents aligned with tender specifications.
* Relevant experience in fabrication, piping, construction, or industrial projects, preferably in a tendering or proposals role.
* Familiarity with government and private procurement portals and standard tendering procedures.
* Good command of MS Office and related tools for documentation, data analysis, and reporting.
* Diploma or degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
* Ability to work with deadlines, manage multiple tenders simultaneously, and maintain attention to detail.

User satisfaction

Legacy systems

Low digital adoption

Data gaps and inconsistencies

title: Database Administrator – Microsoft SQL / Kinetica
description:
**Job Title:**
Database Administrator – Microsoft SQL / Kinetica
  
  
**Department**
: RISK IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The mission of Risk Systems is to provide Senior Management of the Group, of the Operating Divisions, and of RISK with full transparency and dynamic analysis of the risks and clients managed by Corporate Investment Banking (CIB) and Investment Solutions (IS) Business Units, as per the scope detailed below.
  
  
On Market & Liquidity risks: it is Group-wide. Risk Systems comprehensively covers the CIB capital markets activities, ALM Treasury as well as the IS Business Units,
  
  
On Counterparty risks: it is Group-wide. Risk Systems cover all counterparty risks arising from derivative and repo transactions,
  
  
Depending on mandates given, Risk Systems also assumes, directly or indirectly, responsibility for the above risk categories in specific areas of the Retail Business Units.
  
  
To provide a fully integrated market and counterparty risk management system, combining flexibility with industrial reliability, operating at the heart of the bank’s risk management framework helping to protect shareholder value and the integrity of investment banking activities
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Within BNP Paribas, RISK group is responsible for calculating & providing Market and Credit Risk to traders, market, and risk analysts. We are looking for a Database Administrator responsible for the administration, optimization, and lifecycle management of multiple database instances. You will analyze all available sources of information, as well as liaising with colleagues to obtain technical & business knowledge in order to ensure quick resolution to run the business functions. The main objective is to consistently deliver high quality client services to Risk Systems users by combining industrial operational processes with sound risk knowledge. The team is responsible to ensure the correct risks are available in timely manner and to provide functional provision of the risk system to the users daily. As the bank moves toward an AI-integrated landscape, this role is designed to be forward-looking, seeking a professional who can leverage AI-enabled tools and AIOps methodologies to enhance database observability, automate complex workflows, and support the data requirements of emerging AI initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Providing technical support to users, developers, and application support teams for database topics.
* Providing support on how to improve/optimise sql queries, through better sql construction for the DDL/DML, including suggestions on DML improvements given data and query patterns
* Intervening in the event of incidents which limit the performance of databases or access to information
* Active participation in post-mortems for major and/or recurring database incidents
* Ensuring technological monitoring to maintain the suitability of performance and database specificities for meeting needs
* Maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations, ensuring adherence to strict Banking RTO/RPO targets
* Assessing and deploying innovative solutions which permit the simplification, automation, or optimisation of database costs
* Automating recurrent database administration tasks, ensuring there is adequate monitoring and reporting for performance with a view on capacity management e.g. of disk, cpu, memory
* Familiarity with AI-enabled observability tools, AIOps platforms, or the use of Generative AI to augment technical workflows (coding, troubleshooting, or automation).
* Making database implementation choices, in accordance with the specifications and in collaboration with the various project players
* Appropriate and timely communication with all stakeholders
* Ability to operate in Agile methodology and have an understanding on deliverables
* Maintain quality of deliverables to keep the key KPI and trends in check
* Provide input to the implementation plans
* Creative problem-solving ability, inquisitive mind-set, comfortable with working on ambiguous situation
* Attention to detail and high-quality standards of documentation, processes and control of environment

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Database administrator experience for IT Production environment in Investment banking domain
* Hands-on experience in Microsoft SQL or Sybase IQ or Kinetika databases
* Hands-on experience in Unix/Linux systems and Shell or Python scripting
* Have worked in production systems with critical systems following SDLC lifecycle
* Team player with strong interpersonal, oral and written communication skills
* Experience of Java would be an added advantage

**Specific Qualifications**

* Minimum 10-15 years of hands-on DBA support experience in Microsoft SQL or Sybase IQ or Kinetika database.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Microsoft SQL / Kinetica / Sybase IQ
* Unix / Python / Shell scripting
* Dynatrace (good to have)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Communication
* Analytical Ability
* Team Player

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai / Thane
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. description:

As an Agentic Commerce Analyst, you will help evolve a trusted product information foundation that makes accurate, reusable, and channel-ready content available across retailer sites, brand.com experiences, and emerging AI-assisted shopping journeys. * Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-moving transformation initiative with changing priorities and multiple dependencies.

* Experience with agentic commerce, generative artificial intelligence, large language model-assisted shopping, answer-engine optimization, or structured content for machine consumption.

* Manage the day-to-day relationship with e-commerce and quick commerce partners, such as Amazon, Flipkart, FirstCry, Swiggy Instamart, Blinkit and Zepto.
* Build and execute channel-wise business plans, sales targets and growth strategies.
* Coordinate with partner category and buying teams on listings, assortment, pricing, promotions and negotiations.
* Plan inventory with the supply chain and warehouse teams. This covers purchase orders, replenishment, stock availability and avoiding stock-outs.
* Make sure product catalogues are accurate. This includes titles, images, descriptions, A+ content and compliance details such as BIS and licensing information.
* Plan and run campaigns, deals, festive sales and platform ad activity (sponsored ads, visibility and in-app promotions). Work with marketing and agencies on this.
* Monitor sales, ad spend, margins, ratings and reviews, and share regular MIS reports and insights.
* Work with the finance team on invoicing, payment follow-up, claims, returns and reconciliation.
* Track competitor pricing, new launches and market trends, and recommend actions.
* Support on-ground and brand activations with quick commerce partners, such as co-branded promotions.
* Resolve operational issues with partners. These include order fulfilment, delivery, returns and listing problems.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline. An MBA or PG in marketing or business is preferred.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or quick commerce account management, sales or category management. Experience must be in the toy industry or FMCG.
* Working knowledge of marketplace portals and the vendor/seller dashboards of major platforms.
* Strong command of English, spoken and written, for partner communication and reporting.
* Good negotiation, coordination and relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and data analysis.
* Ability to work independently, manage several partners and meet deadlines.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing key accounts on quick commerce platforms.
* Understanding of digital advertising on marketplaces.
* Knowledge of toy safety and BIS compliance requirements.

**To apply:**
Send your CV to cs@simbatoysindia.com

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Business head consumer products
description:
**Company:**
RUDRAMRUT Health Care Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Position:**
Business Head – Consumer Products

**Experience:**
8–15 Years

**Industry:**
Nutraceuticals | Herbal Wellness | Ayurveda | Cosmetics | FMCG | D2C

**Employment:**
Full-Time | Leadership Position

About RUDRAMRUT

RUDRAMRUT Health Care Pvt. Ltd. is building a premium, science-led consumer wellness brand with ambitions to expand across India and international markets.

Our product portfolio will focus on:

* Nutraceuticals and botanical wellness supplements
* Ayurvedic and herbal OTC products
* Skincare, cosmetics and personal care
* Functional nutrition and preventive wellness

We are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who has experience developing, launching and scaling consumer product brands.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Product Strategy & Development**

* Identify high-potential products and categories.
* Lead product development from concept to commercial launch.
* Coordinate with R&D, formulation experts and third-party manufacturers.
* Manage packaging, pricing, positioning and product differentiation.
* Develop profitable product portfolios.

**2. Business Growth & P&L Ownership**

* Take responsibility for the consumer-products vertical's revenue, margins and profitability.
* Build annual business plans, budgets and category strategies.
* Develop sustainable customer acquisition and retention models.
* Scale successful products through disciplined commercial execution.

**3. D2C & E-Commerce**

* Build and scale sales through Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa and other relevant marketplaces.
* Lead performance marketing, influencer marketing and brand-building strategies.
* Monitor ROAS, CAC, conversion rates, repeat purchases and contribution margins.
* Develop a high-performing digital marketing and e-commerce team.

**4. Retail & Distribution**

* Develop pharmacy, modern trade, general trade and distributor networks.
* Identify strategic retail and institutional partnerships.
* Build an omnichannel distribution strategy.

**5. International Business Development**

* Develop market-entry strategies for the USA, UAE, Singapore and other international markets.
* Evaluate international contract manufacturing and private-label opportunities.
* Coordinate country-specific product compliance, packaging and distributor partnerships.
* Build scalable international business channels.

**6. Leadership**

* Recruit and lead product, marketing, e-commerce and sales teams.
* Manage external manufacturing, creative and marketing partners.
* Report business performance and strategic progress directly to the promoters.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience at companies such as:

**Kapiva | Mamaearth | OZiva | Wellbeing Nutrition | HealthKart | Himalaya Wellness | The Ayurveda Co. | The Derma Co.**

Candidates from comparable high-growth D2C, nutraceutical, beauty and FMCG businesses are equally welcome.

Ideal Candidate

* 8–15 years of relevant industry experience.
* Proven success launching and scaling consumer products.
* Strong understanding of D2C, marketplaces and omnichannel distribution.
* Experience managing category or business P&L.
* Knowledge of third-party manufacturing, product development and supply chain.
* Strong commercial and analytical decision-making skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business from an early stage.

**International nutraceutical market experience will be an added advantage.**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to build a premium consumer wellness brand from the ground up.
* Direct collaboration with the company's promoters.
* Leadership responsibility and decision-making authority.
* Competitive fixed compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Long-term growth opportunities based on demonstrated performance.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can send their CV along with:

1. Current and expected CTC.
2. Notice period.
3. Brands and product categories previously managed.
4. Largest annual revenue or category P&L managed.
5. Examples of products successfully launched or scaled.

**Subject: Application – Business Head, RUDRAMRUT**

Join us in building an Indian-origin global wellness brand.

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform
description:
**Job Role: Full Stack Principal Engineer, AI Platform**

**Office Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**

**About Accrete**

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Full Stack Principal Engineer**
to join our
**AI Platform team**
. The ideal candidate will have a
**PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field**
and a strong background in designing and building AI-driven systems. You will play a pivotal role in architecting, building, and scaling the platform that powers Accrete's AI products and agentic systems.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. You will work across the full technology stack while driving architectural decisions, solving complex engineering challenges, and shaping the technical direction of the AI Platform. You will collaborate closely with software engineers, ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams to turn advanced AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and production-ready systems.

**What You'll Do**

**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of core components of the AI Platform.
* Drive technical direction across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and platform services.
* Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable systems for complex AI agent workloads.
* Solve complex and ambiguous technical problems and make sound architectural decisions considering scalability, performance, reliability, cost, and time-to-market.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical risks and proactively drive solutions.
* Establish engineering best practices across system design, code quality, testing, security, observability, and maintainability.

title: AWS Administrator / Cloud Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an AWS Administrator / Cloud Engineer responsible for managing, maintaining and
  
  
optimising our AWS cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in managing
  
  
production environments, ensuring infrastructure availability, troubleshooting technical issues, implementing
  
  
security best practices and automating routine cloud operations.

Support cloud migrations and deployments while ensuring minimal downtime.
  
  
Automate routine infrastructure tasks using AWS CLI, Bash/Shell scripting and AWS Lambda.
  
  
Configure CloudWatch dashboards, alarms and notifications for proactive monitoring.
  
  
Implement AWS security best practices and manage infrastructure access controls.
  
  
Monitor cloud resource utilisation and optimise AWS infrastructure costs.

Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field.
  
  
Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS and CloudWatch).
  
  
Good understanding of Linux, networking, DNS and SSL/TLS.
  
  
Knowledge of AWS CLI, Bash scripting, monitoring and troubleshooting.

title: Vice President, Product Design
description:
**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Designer**
We're seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Product Designer, AI Hub to join our Digital Channels team. This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Make complexity clear - Take systems that are genuinely hard: multi-step workflows, cross-platform journeys, enterprise-scale data. Design experiences that make sense to the people who depend on them. Understand the problem at depth before touching anything.
* Drive concept development from day one - Bring ideas from research and outcomes to prototyped form fast. Demonstrate possibilities rather than describing them. Use AI-assisted tools to close the distance between design intent and working experience.
* Own the design of end-to-end experiences - Map journeys across users, teams, and systems. Identify where things break, where friction accumulates, and what needs to be rebuilt versus refined. Operate across the full scope of a platform experience, not just the screens in front of you.
* Contribute to a design system built for how design works now - Our design system is structured as machine-readable infrastructure, not just a component library. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Patterns encode reasoning about when and why they apply. AI agents consume it directly alongside human developers. Contributing here means adding to the grammar, not just the vocabulary, and understanding why that distinction matters.
* Communicate design as a point of view, not a deliverable - Articulate the rationale behind decisions. Help product managers and engineers understand the tradeoffs. Make design legible to people who don't speak design, without dumbing it down.
* Mentor through example. Raise the standard of work around you through critique, collaboration, and how you approach problems. Not through title.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise**

* Typically, 10 -14 years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated through portfolio and impact.
* Strong product design fundamentals: research synthesis, interaction design, systems thinking, visual craft
* Experience designing complex systems: enterprise software, multi-step workflows, data-heavy interfaces
* Demonstrated comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the problem isn't handed to you pre-formed
* The ability to communicate design rationale to mixed audiences (product, engineering, business) and hold your perspective under pressure

**Preferred**

* You already work with AI-assisted tools, not just for ideation, but for building and prototyping
* You've worked in shared codebases or repos with cross-functional teams, or you're actively moving in that direction
* You can describe a moment when AI changed how you approached a design problem, not made it faster, but made it \*different\*
* You've contributed to a design system at the pattern or systems level, not just component execution

**What Will Set You Apart**

* You work at the intersection of design and technical implementation, close to the material, not downstream from it
* You've felt the industry shift happening and leaned toward it
* Your process produces things, not documents

You have a deep excitement for and understanding of the opportunity that AI creates for design, even if you haven't fully arrived there yet, you're moving fast
  
  
**A portfolio is required, but what we most want to see may not look like a traditional design portfolio.**
The most compelling thing you can share is evidence of how you actually create products: working alongside product managers and engineers in real time, from research to something shippable, in a way that reflects how modern product teams operate. Show us a process, a repo, a prototype you built directly, a decision you influenced in the room. If you've worked in a shared codebase or repo with cross-functional partners, bring that to life. If you've used AI tools to get from insight to working experience faster, bring that to life.
  
  
Beyond that, we want to see what you'd expect: complex systems thinking, end-to-end journey work, evidence of design decisions that improved the experience and why. Figma files, PDFs, personal sites, live products: format doesn't matter. Show us the work that best reflects how you think and what you shaped.

title: Knowledge Graph Devloper / Associate Director, Service Management
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What We're Looking For**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**
If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**AWS / GCP | Python | Generative AI | Terraform | Kubernetes | SRE | LLMOps / MLOps | Observability**

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced **AI Reliability Engineer** to design, operate, monitor, and continuously improve highly reliable **AI/ML and Generative AI systems in production**.

The role focuses on ensuring the **availability, performance, scalability, observability, security, and quality** of AI applications, including **LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, ML inference systems, and AI-enabled APIs**.

The ideal candidate will combine strong **SRE/DevOps fundamentals** with hands-on experience in **AI/ML platforms, LLMOps/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, and production troubleshooting**.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and operate reliable and scalable production platforms for **AI/ML, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI workloads**.
* Define and monitor **SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, latency, throughput, and reliability metrics** for AI services.
* Establish end-to-end observability across the AI stack using **metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, ing, and distributed tracing**.
* Monitor AI-specific indicators such as **model/API latency, token consumption, inference failures, retrieval quality, model drift, hallucination/quality signals, vector search performance, and LLM service dependencies**.
* Implement production monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for **LLM and RAG applications**, covering retrieval, generation, model/API dependencies, and overall application health.
* Develop automated processes for **incident detection, response, recovery, root-cause analysis, and prevention**.
* Improve system resilience through **circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, rate limiting, caching, graceful degradation, fallback models, and disaster recovery strategies**.
* Design and maintain **CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for reliable deployment of models and AI applications.
* Automate cloud and platform infrastructure using **Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** practices.
* Deploy and manage workloads using **Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud services**.
* Optimize AI infrastructure for **performance, scalability, reliability, and cost**.
* Collaborate with **AI/ML engineers, data scientists, platform engineers, application developers, and security teams** to improve production readiness.
* Participate in **production support, incident management, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement initiatives**.
* Establish operational **runbooks, dashboards, ing standards, and production-readiness checks**.

* Experience troubleshooting **complex distributed systems and production incidents**.

### **Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Hands-on experience with **Docker and Kubernetes**.

### **Observability**

* Experience with tools such as **Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, or Google Cloud Operations**.
* Ability to implement **end-to-end monitoring, tracing, ing, and dashboards** for AI applications.

### **Engineering & Automation**

* Strong programming/scripting skills in **Python**.
* Experience building or supporting **REST APIs and FastAPI-based services**.
* Working knowledge of **Git, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI**, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of **Linux, networking, APIs, distributed architectures, and cloud-native applications**.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Vertex AI**, or similar MLOps platforms.
* Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as **Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch**.

title: Machine Learning Analyst
description:
Experience Required

3 - 5

Location

Pune

Role Type

Full Time

  

###### **Designation:** **Machine Learning Analyst**

###### **Department:** **R&D**

###### **Location:** **Pune**

###### **Work Mode****: Work from office**

###### **Working Days:** **Monday to Friday**

###### **Experience:** **3 - 5 years**

### **Job Description:**

#### **About The Role**

Our AI team builds machine-learning and AI use cases that make our products smarter. Our ML engineers build the models; we are looking for full stack developers to turn those models into real product features.

You will own the integration work end to end: the backend services and APIs that connect our products to AI models, and the user interfaces that put AI features in front of our customers. You’ll work closely with ML engineers, product managers and our core development teams, and see AI features go from prototype to production.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **ML Modelling & Data Analysis**
  + Design, build, and evaluate ML models — classification, regression, time-series forecasting, anomaly/fraud detection, churn prediction, and recommendation systems — for retail and e-commerce use cases.
  + Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data pre-processing, and feature engineering on large structured and unstructured retail datasets (orders, transactions, customers, catalog, POS data).
  + Optimize and fine-tune models through rigorous evaluation, validation, and hyperparameter tuning to meet accuracy and performance benchmarks in real-world scenarios.
  + Build and maintain models across multiple client companies, with company-specific configuration and strict data isolation between companies.
  + Measure real-world impact — such as recommendation click-through and conversion, or forecast error against actual sales — and work with product teams on A/B tests where possible.
  + Support AI rollouts to client companies, working with implementation teams on client-specific configuration, data onboarding, and model tuning.
* **Generative & Agentic AI**
  + Build Generative AI features using LLM APIs, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG),>embeddings, and prompt design.
  + Design and build Agentic AI workflows in which LLMs plan multi-step tasks and call tools or product APIs, with guardrails, human approval for sensitive actions, and systematic evaluation of agent behaviour.
  + Build evaluation for LLM features and agents — test sets and metrics for answer quality, tool-use accuracy, and safety — and run them before every release.
  + Build image-based and multimodal models, such as extracting product attributes from product image using computer vision or vision-capable LLMs.
  + Manage LLM cost and latency through model selection, caching, and prompt optimization.
* **Production & MLOps**
  + Translate models from prototype into production-ready code and expose them as versioned REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask) with clear input and output contracts.
  + Work with the Data Engineer on training and inference data needs, and with Full Stack Developers on integrating models into the SaaS product.
  + Monitor models in production for performance and data drift, and retrain them when retail patterns shift (seasons, promotions, catalog changes), using the team\'s MLOps tooling.
  + Handle customer data responsibly in training data and LLM prompts in line with our privacy standards, check models for bias, and document each model’s purpose, limitations, and training data.
  + Collaborate with fellow ML engineers, data engineering, full stack developers, business analysts, and DevOps to define requirements, use cases, and user stories.
* **Continuous Improvement**
  + Apply ML engineering best practices — model versioning, containerization, and deployment strategies.
  + Contribute to internal tools, reusable components, and libraries that make the AI team more efficient.
  + Keep up to date with advances in ML frameworks and in Generative and Agentic AI.

###### **The Job responsibilities of the candidate shall include but not limited to the Job Description & to perform any other tasks/functions as required by the Company**

#### **Experience and Skills:**

###### **Must-Have**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience building ML models, with at least one delivered to production.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, modelling, and data workflows.
* Strong hands-on experience with classical ML — supervised and unsupervised algorithms, Deep learning Models (DL), Scikit-learn, and XGBoost/LightGBM or other ensemble methods.
* Strong grounding in statistics and ML fundamentals — data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, validation strategies, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Experience with at least one ML use case delivered to production — understanding how models are served, integrated, and monitored in real applications (not just POCs or notebooks).
* Basic knowledge of MLOps — model versioning, experiment tracking (e.g., MLflow), workflow scheduling (e.g., Airflow), containerization (Docker), and CI/CD — with willingness to deepen these skills on the job.
* Core understanding of Generative and Agentic AI — RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool/function calling and AI agents, and how LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) are used to build applications.

###### **Good-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience delivering Agentic AI use cases — multi-step agents that use tools or APIs, built with frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, or with protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including evaluating and guarding agent behaviour.
* Hands-on experience building LLM applications — RAG systems, chatbots, AI assistants, or conversational AI.
* Experience with deep learning frameworks — TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch — especially for image or text models.
* Experience with computer vision or multimodal models — image classification, attribute extraction, or vision-capable LLMs.
* Experience with pricing and promotion modelling — price elasticity, uplift modelling, or optimisation.
* Experience evaluating LLM applications or agents — building test sets and measuring answer quality, tool use, and safety.
* Experience with time-series forecasting, anomaly/fraud detection, churn prediction, or recommendation systems.
* Exposure to NLP — text classification, sentiment analysis, or extracting insights from customer feedback data.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with the retail/e-commerce domain (orders, inventory, POS, pricing, promotions, customer behaviour data).
* Experience with BI/visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau) for communicating insights.
