title: Senior Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (On Contract)
description:
Join us as a **Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer** to lead the migration and integration of historical and operational data into a governed Fabric platform. The role covers migration from Google BigQuery, connection of SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA companies, and ingestion from SQL Server and other legacy or custom sources. The engineer will create reliable data products that support Power BI reporting, advanced analytics and production AI/ML use cases.

### **How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Assess Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitions, clustering, SQL logic, dependencies, volumes, retention and security; create a wave-based migration plan with reconciliation and cutover controls.
* Design the Microsoft Fabric data platform using OneLake, Lakehouse and/or Warehouse patterns. Define workspaces, domains, capacities, naming, environments, shortcuts and medallion layers aligned to governance needs.
* Integrate with the organisation’s Microsoft Azure landing zone, including subscriptions, resource groups, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, private endpoints, DNS, firewall rules and approved data egress patterns.
* Build metadata-driven ingestion and transformation frameworks using Fabric Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, Spark, SQL, Dataflows Gen2, event-driven patterns and reusable configuration tables.
* Ingest SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data using approved mechanisms such as SAP extractors, CDS-based extraction, OData, files, middleware or partner connectors. Preserve delta semantics and business keys and provide traceable reconciliation.
* Integrate SQL Server, flat files, APIs and custom databases using appropriate on-premises data gateway, virtual network data gateway, self-hosted integration runtime or secure connector patterns.
* Implement incremental loading, change data capture, watermarking, idempotency, late-arriving data, schema evolution, deletion handling, replay and backfill procedures.
* Create Delta tables and curated dimensional or data-product structures that serve Power BI through Direct Lake, semantic models or Fabric Warehouse SQL endpoints.
* Develop data quality controls for completeness, validity, uniqueness, referential integrity, timeliness and reconciliation. Quarantine exceptions and expose operational metrics.
* Engineer observability with pipeline logging, notebook telemetry, capacity metrics, alerts, retry logic, runbooks and lineage. Lead incident recovery and root-cause analysis.
* Prepare trusted feature and training datasets for AI/ML use cases; support Fabric Data Science experiments, MLflow tracking, model scoring and batch inference while maintaining separation between experimental and production workloads.
* Apply security and governance using least privilege, Entra ID groups, workspace roles, item permissions, sensitivity labels, Purview lineage, secrets management and environment segregation.
* Optimise Spark jobs, Delta layouts, partitions, file sizes, SQL queries, concurrency and Fabric capacity consumption; provide evidence-based scale and cost recommendations.
* Mentor engineers, perform design and code reviews, establish CI/CD and testing standards, and produce architecture, mapping, operations and handover documentation.

### **Your Expertise:**

* Senior hands-on role across at least three production data-platform programmes, including architecture decisions, estimation, delivery leadership and operational support.
* Strong experience with OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake, SQL endpoints, shortcuts, capacities and deployment practices.
* Practical understanding of Azure landing zones, Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, networking, gateways, private connectivity, monitoring and cost controls.
* Experience extracting and reconciling BigQuery data, translating SQL and partition logic, managing large historical loads and executing controlled cutovers.
* Experience engineering data from SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA; understanding of deltas, business keys, document relationships, master data and finance/logistics reconciliation.
* Advanced SQL plus Python and PySpark; ability to build reusable frameworks, tests, logging and performance-tuned transformations.
* Hands-on integration with SQL Server, APIs, files and custom databases; knowledge of gateways, drivers, connectivity troubleshooting and schema drift
* Dimensional modelling, medallion architecture, data products, Delta Lake, CDC, SCD handling, metadata-driven design and batch/near-real-time trade-offs.
* Experience preparing feature datasets and integrating model development or scoring pipelines. Understanding of MLflow, experiment tracking and production controls.
* Git-based source control, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, observability, incident response and clear technical documentation.
* Strong English communication and the ability to explain technical choices, risks, estimates and dependencies to architecture, SAP and business stakeholders.

**Certification**-

* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) or equivalent current Fabric data engineering credential.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), where held, or equivalent proven Azure experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor and enterprise data-governance operating models.
* Knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP BW, SAP Business Data Cloud or common SAP-to-cloud extraction patterns.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, consumer goods or multi-company SAP transformation programmes

### **Why Join Westernacher?**

* Inspiring and exciting, innovative working environment.
* Competitive remuneration package (salary, bonus, benefits).
* International company culture and minimal hierarchical structure.
* Chance to work on complex projects from different industries.
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.

**This is Westernacher:**

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of SAP partnership experience, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise, and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.

Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Lead System Power & Performance Engineer**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated **System Power & Performance Engineer** to join our **System PnP team**. This role will have a **dual focus**:

* Benchmarking, Profiling, and bottleneck analysis on AMD’s system PnP stack, with emphasis on **Linux and virtualized environments**.
* Driving **competitive benchmarking** across market segments, comparing AMD SoCs against competition.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical depth in **system performance analysis** with a passion for competitive evaluation, ensuring AMD delivers industry-leading performance and power efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Power & Performance / PnP**

* Execute and own **system performance including low level profiling and bottleneck analysis** on AMD’s SoCs, focusing on Linux (Ubuntu, Yocto), Windows, FReeRTOS and virtualized software stacks for Robotics, automotive and industrial.
* Perform **benchmark characterization**, system-level tuning, micro architecture and workload analysis across CPU, GPU, NPU, AI and memory subsystems.
* Collaborate with SoC architects, BIOS/FW teams, and software developers to identify performance gaps and recommend optimizations.
* Generate **comprehensive technical reports, dashboards, and documentation** for leadership reviews, customer engagements, and outbound collateral.
* Contribute to automation for benchmark execution, data collection, and results visualization.
* Work with cross-functional teams to debug system-level issues blocking performance goals.

**Competitive Benchmarking**

* Drive **competitive benchmarking initiatives** by running workloads on competitive platforms (Nvidia, Intel, Qualcomm, ARM-based SoCs) and building comparative landscapes across segments (client, embedded, industrial, automotive).
* Build comparative performance landscapes across segments including client, embedded, server, industrial, and automotive.
* Provide actionable insights that help influence future SoC, firmware, and platform design.

**Automation, Reporting & Documentation**

* Support development of automation for benchmark execution, data collection, and results visualization.
* Generate technical reports, dashboards, and documentation for leadership and customer engagements.
* Foster continuous improvement and innovation within validation and performance analysis environments.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **10 - 14+ years** of relevant experience in system performance engineering, profiling, bottleneck analysis, or post-silicon validation.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Linux system performance analysis**; exposure to Android and virtualized stacks is a plus.
* Expert in **Linux internals** (scheduling, memory management), **Real Time systems** (RT kernel, interrupt and jitter), QoS Tuning.
* Hands on in performance profiling tools: Perf**, valgrind, LTTng, perfetto, Trace Compass, wireshark, Nsight, Vtune, Oprofile, Flameghraphs, GPU Perf studio etc**
* Strong understanding of **x86 SoC architecture**, CPU/GPU/NPU performance, memory hierarchy, PCIe, BIOS/FW interactions, and system-level behavior.
* Experience with industry benchmarking suites such as **CyclicTest, RTLA,**
* Exposure to benchmarks like **SPEC, 3DMark, PCMark, GFXBench, MLPerf, MobileMark**, browser benchmarks, and multimedia workloads.
* Proficiency in **Python/Bash/C/C++/Perl** for automation, data processing, and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of **embedded OSes and hypervisors** (Linux, Windows Server, VMware, KVM, Xen, etc.).
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in fast-paced environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience producing clear, data-driven reports.
* Proven cross-team collaboration skills and ability to drive complex debug efforts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **virtualization technologies** (Xen, KVM, Hyper-V, container environments).

* Experience with **competitive benchmarking methodologies** and customer-facing documentation.

* Strong inclination to leverage AI tools (code assistants, log analysers) to accelerate day‑to‑day RAN development and debugging.

* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across global, cross-functional teams and translate security requirements into practical architectural solutions.
* Exposure to security certification processes, ecosystem partnerships, and engagement with industry stakeholders is preferred.
* Knowledge of software supply chain security practices, including SBOM management, reproducible builds, tamper detection, and firmware integrity mechanisms, is beneficial.

description:

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. Are you passionate about working on cutting edge new technology in a team that embodies the growth mindset? Are you hoping to join an organization which is built on a mission “To empower every person and organization on this planet to achieve more”?

We are working on the next generation Hardware/Firmware for server, silicon, and rack infrastructure of Cobalt/Maia systems with a focus on innovation in firmware technology to secure Azure infrastructure for Microsoft and their customers.

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Engineer who is passionate about system level thinking, deep debugging, and scalable validation, and who thrives in a cross-functional, fast paced environment spanning silicon, firmware, GPU, OS, and manufacturing.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Firmware Engineer in the Firmware System Engineering team, you will own platform‑level firmware integration and validation across SoC firmware, GPU, BIOS, BMC, and OS interactions. You will contribute directly to early silicon bring‑up, de‑risking of firmware releases, customer issue debug, and continuous improvement of validation strategies, tooling, and automation—building on the foundations already established by the team.

* You will be involved with all phases of product development including pre-silicon, post-silicon, and platform deployment in the datacenter.

* You will architect and/or submit requirements to define stimulus, test content, and frameworks that will be utilized to conduct testing and establish coverage.

* You will identify and address inefficiencies and gaps in architecture, testing, execution, etc.

* You will mentor, guide, and help peers and other team members.

* Ability to see system level “big picture” to validate that the integrated firmware/system software aligns to architectural goals of product.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar.

* 8+ years of working experience in large scale system design & architecture, development, testing, and release and performance tuning.

title: Engineering Manager, Platform
description:
**Location:** Bangalore, India (hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 from home) · **Reports to:** Head of Platform Engineering · **Team:** one Engineering and QA team, 3–6 direct reports

**OVERVIEW:**

APEXX is an **independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.** Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: a**cquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.** Our **routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.** We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

**We're backed by Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.** We're looking for a Engineering Manager in Bangalore to help build and run the core of that platform.

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

**Hands-on engineering**

* Write and review production code in Java and Spring Boot for a large part of your week, taking work that keeps you off the team's critical path.
* Guide design across payment flows, routing and cascading, acquirer, APM and BNPL connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation, working with your senior engineers on technical design docs.
* Set the team's engineering standards, including how we use AI coding tools safely.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own your team's delivery end to end: planning, estimation, release readiness and follow-through until work is released and stable.
* Run your team's on-call rota, lead incidents, and make sure blameless RCAs lead to changes that ship.
* Define and track SLOs and service dashboards for your team's services.
* Own your team's part of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls: code review before release, change control, patching timelines and secure-coding practice.

**People and team**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers and QA: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, honest feedback, performance reviews and career conversations.
* Hire for the team: run interview loops, calibrate interviewers and onboard new joiners.
* Build a team where ownership is easy: clear responsibilities, documented decisions and time for improvement work.

**Across the business**

* Work with Product, Business Analysis, Solutions, Support and InfoSec to turn merchant and partner needs into plans your team can commit to.
* Work with the technical teams at our acquirer and APM partners on certifications, changes and outages.
* Work closely with engineering colleagues in the UK, Portugal and India.

**ABOUT YOU:**

We hire for skills and evidence, not pedigree, and you don't need a specific degree. If you can show us most of the following, we'd like to hear from you.

* Experience leading an engineering team, including performance conversations, career growth and hiring.
* Strong, current hands-on backend engineering in **Java and Spring Boot** (or a comparable JVM stack), and you still enjoy writing and reviewing code.
* **You've run services in production:** on-call, incident command, blameless postmortems and the follow-up that prevents repeats.
* A strong grasp of **distributed-systems failure modes** (retries, idempotency, timeouts, ambiguous states) and how they apply to money movement.
* Experience with **PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS, and with CI/CD and release practices such as feature flags, canary releases and rollback.**
* Experience working inside **regulated change control,** or a willingness to learn it quickly.
* **Clear written and spoken communication,** including with non-engineers during incidents.
* You use **AI coding tools** productively, and you set sensible standards for how your team uses them.

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* **Payments experience:** card acquiring, 3DS2/SCA, network tokens, APMs and BNPL, settlement and reconciliation, or payment orchestration.
* Built or run acquirer, APM or BNPL connectors, or routing logic.
* Produced audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS.
* Managed QA engineers, or led a team split across the UK and India.
* Owned cloud cost for your team's services.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

**Competitive Compensation**: *We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.*

**Generous Time Off** :*Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.*

**Work From Anywhere:** *Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to* ***90 days per year****, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*\*

**Comprehensive Health Insurance:** *Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance to help support you and your loved ones when it matters most.*

**Personal Accident Insurance:** *Additional protection and peace of mind with personal accident insurance coverage.*

**Enhanced Family Leave:** *Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.*

**Learning & Growth:** *We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.*

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the **UK & India,** helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to **200+ acquirers**, **150+ alternative payment methods**, and **10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers**, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including **Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2**, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below:

**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/apexxglobal/

**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en

**Main Website:** https://apexx.global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

title: IT Operations Lead
description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** IT Operations Lead

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:** Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**Reporting Line:** Head of Corporate Technology

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled

**Notice Period:** 30 days or less preferred, 60 days maximum

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes

**Application Deadline:** Open until Filled

**Shift Timings:** 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone to run IT for our India office in Bengaluru. Day to day, that means setting up and looking after laptops, sorting out problems as they come up, managing Microsoft 365 and Intune for the India team, and dealing with local vendors. You will be our main IT person on the ground in India, working closely with the Corporate Technology team in North America, who look after security policy and the more complex Microsoft administration.

We do not have a proper service desk in India yet, and we would like you to set one up. That includes deciding how tickets are categorised, what hours are covered, who is on rotation, and how quickly we respond. If you have done something like this before, even for a small team, we would like to hear about it.

This is a hands-on job. As the team grows there will be room to lead people, but for now you will be doing most of the work yourself, and we are looking for someone who enjoys that.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Laptops and other hardware for our India team, from ordering and setup through to repairs, returns, and keeping the asset register accurate
* Enrolling and managing devices in Intune, including compliance and app deployment
* Day-to-day Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration for India: user accounts, groups, licences, MFA, and access
* Onboarding and offboarding for India staff, so that new joiners are ready on their first day and leavers’ access and devices are handled properly
* Support tickets from the India team, and first-line support for colleagues in other regions during your working hours
* The technology in our Bengaluru office: network, Wi-Fi, firewall, printers, and meeting rooms
* Local vendors, warranty claims, and IT purchasing for India
* Setting up and running our service desk, and writing the runbooks the team will rely on
* Keeping devices secure and up to date (encryption, endpoint protection, patching) in line with our security policies, and raising anything suspicious straight away

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 to 8 years in IT operations, where you have been the person responsible for IT at an office or business unit, or have looked after client companies at a managed service provider
* Solid hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and a working understanding of Microsoft Defender
* Experience managing devices with an MDM. We use Intune, but experience with Jamf or a similar tool is fine
* Comfortable using PowerShell or Microsoft Graph alongside the admin portals. For example, you could pull a list of users or check licence usage with a script
* Good at diagnosing and fixing hardware problems, with a sound grasp of networking basics such as IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN
* You have set up or improved a service desk before, even a small one, and can talk us through what you did
* Clear spoken and written English. You will be working with colleagues in North America every day, as well as junior team members in India
* You like hands-on work. There is room to lead a team as we grow, but this role starts with you doing the work yourself

**Good to Have**

* Basic Linux skills, such as moving around the file system, managing files, and reading logs
* Experience with Fortinet or similar firewalls
* Experience with Freshservice or another service desk tool
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104. Any certification on your resume should be current

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* In your first 30 days: you have picked up India support tickets, got to know how our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune environment is set up, and checked the India asset register against who actually has which device.
* By 60 days: you are handling onboarding and offboarding for India on your own, with the steps written down, and all India devices are enrolled and compliant in Intune.
* By 90 days: a first version of the India service desk is up and running, with agreed categories, coverage hours, and response times, and the most common fixes are documented.

**How We Will Measure Success**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiners’ devices ready on day one, and leavers’ devices returned on time
* Accuracy of the asset register
* Device compliance in Intune
* Feedback from the people you support

**Interview Process**

* A screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, which includes a few short technical questions
* A technical conversation with a member of our Corporate Technology team
* A final round in person at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. This includes a practical session in a Microsoft Entra and Azure test environment, and a conversation about hardware and device management

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**  
You’ll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**  
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**  
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.

**We Celebrate Impact**  
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

**A Collaborative Culture**  
You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.

**Perks you’ll appreciate:**

**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice
* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays
* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

**Retirement and Financial Security**

* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)
* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

**Professional Growth**

* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

**Flexible Work**

* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Accommodations:**

FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

**Candidate Privacy:**

Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Equal Opportunity:**

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**

FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.

**Learn More About Us:**

**Website:** **fulfillmentiq.com**

**LinkedIn:** **Fulfillment IQ**

**Spotify:** **eCom Logistics Podcast Spotify**

**YouTube:** **eCom Logistics Podcast YouTube**

**Job Summary:**

As a Security Software Designer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing software solutions that protect systems and networks from cyber threats. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that security is integrated into every phase of the software development lifecycle.

**Primary responsibilities:**

1. Carry security assessment Complying to Wabtec CATO requirements on Embedded Product Using Threat Model ,Threat & Risk Analysis and vulnerability analysis.

2. Bring up the Security Architecture and Design as per the Need of the project to mitigate/Remediate the threats and Get final Cybersecurity approval for Release.

title: Antenna Design Engineer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/26/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 4-6 years
* City Bangalore North
* State/Province Karnataka
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 560085

**Job Description**
-------------------

Design, simulate, develop and optimize high-performance antennas for satellite-based RF sensing applications, focusing on weak-signal acquisition, wide-area coverage, multiband operation, frontend integration and performance in complex electromagnetic environments.

Key Responsibilities

Antenna Design & Electromagnetic Engineering

* Design and develop wideband, multiband, directional and omnidirectional antennas for satellite-based RF sensing and signal acquisition.
* Optimize antenna parameters including gain, bandwidth, directivity, radiation efficiency, polarization and impedance matching.
* Perform electromagnetic modelling, 3D simulations, radiation pattern analysis and design optimization using HFSS/CST.
* Evaluate antenna architectures and configurations based on mission-specific frequency, coverage and sensitivity requirements.
* Understand and contribute to RF receiver front-end architectures, including LNAs, filters, pre-selectors and impedance-matching networks.
* Optimize antenna-to-receiver integration for low-noise signal acquisition and improved receiver sensitivity.

Satellite Integration & RF System Engineering

* Design and optimize antenna-feed networks, impedance matching and RF interfaces.
* Evaluate antenna coupling, isolation, mutual interference and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC/EMI).
* Analyze antenna placement, orientation and satellite-platform effects on radiation patterns and overall performance.
* Optimize antenna configurations considering satellite payload size, weight and power (SWaP) constraints.
* Understand propagation effects, multipath, polarization and their impact on weak-signal reception and detection.

Prototyping, Testing & Validation

* Drive antenna development from electromagnetic simulation and design through prototyping, characterization and validation.
* Perform S-parameter, VSWR, gain, efficiency, polarization and radiation pattern measurements.
* Work with VNAs and antenna measurement setups, including anechoic chamber testing.
* Correlate simulation results with measured hardware performance and implement design improvements.

### **Requirements**

What We're Looking For

* Strong fundamentals in antenna theory, electromagnetics and microwave engineering.
* Hands-on experience in antenna architecture, design, simulation and optimization.
* Experience with wideband, multiband, antenna array or multi-antenna systems.
* Ability to independently drive antenna development from conceptual design to physical validation.
* Understanding of antenna behaviour in complex electromagnetic and real-world operating environments.
* Experience in satellite, aerospace, defence, radar or RF sensing domains is highly preferred.

Core Competencies

* Antenna Design, Electromagnetic Theory & Microwave Engineering.
* HFSS / CST Studio Suite (Must-have).
* Radiation Patterns, Gain, Polarization & Impedance Matching.
* Antenna Arrays, Coupling, Isolation & EMC/EMI.
* Transmission Lines, Feed Networks & RF Integration.
* VNA and Antenna Characterization Systems.
* MATLAB / Python / ADS (Good-to-have).

Experience: 4–6 years in antenna design and electromagnetic engineering.

Preferred Background:

* Satellite, space systems, aerospace or defence electronics.
* Experience with antenna arrays, multiband systems or satellite RF payload integration.
* Exposure to antenna prototyping, fabrication and measurement.

title: Sr Mgr Package Engineering
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

The **Senior Packaging Engineer- ExM Tech Transfer CoE** as induvial contributorat Teva Global ExM and will manage site-to-site packaging technology transfers of established/development commercial pharmaceutical products and responsible for leading technical operation related engagements with external manufacturing partners (e.g., contract manufacturing organizations or CMOs).

The role is therefore responsible for ensuring that the existing registered packaging configuration, product quality, functionality, patient usability, regulatory commitments, and supply continuity are maintained while packaging operations are transferred from the Sending Unit (SU) to the Receiving Unit (RU).

The position will serve as the packaging technical lead within cross-functional technology-transfer teams and will own packaging activities from initial due diligence and gap assessment through receiving-site readiness, component and equipment qualification, engineering/validation batches, regulatory implementation, launch, stabilization, and transfer closure.

The role should operate within the pharmaceutical quality-system framework. specifically includes Technology Transfer and Commercial Manufacturing within its lifecycle scope and identifies knowledge management, quality risk management, change management, CAPA and process/product monitoring as core elements.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

**Packaging Technology Transfer Leadership:**

* + Support end-to-end packaging workstreams for commercial product transfers from Sending Site to Receiving Site.
  + Develop/review the packaging portion of the Technology Transfer Plan/Protocol, including scope, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, risks, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
  + Provide technical leadership for receiving-site packaging equipment readiness
  + Establish a structured packaging knowledge-transfer process between sending and receiving sites.
  + Review existing commercial packaging processes and establish the package/process baseline before transfer.
  + Support packaging technical due diligence and identify gaps between current and future manufacturing sites.
  + Ensure packaging transfer activities are executed using a science- and risk-based approach.
  + Participate in transfer governance meetings and provide clear status, risks, mitigation plans and escalation to project leadership.
  + Ensure technical transfer deliverables are completed and approved according to the overall project schedule.

**Process Development & Optimization:**

* Packaging Technology Transfer Support:
* + Oversee technical aspects of Packaging processes to ensure they meet product specifications, regulatory standards, and Teva requirements
  + Optimize existing Packaging processes for efficiency, robustness, and yield
  + Provide technical leadership in scale-up and transfer of new products from development to commercial Packaging.
  + - Review and transfer packaging-material specifications.
    - Confirm component drawings and dimensional tolerances.
    - Evaluate change of component supplier/manufacturing location when required.
    - Coordinate component samples and trials.
    - Assess receiving-site equipment/component compatibility.
    - Support machinability studies and packaging-line trials.
    - Define component qualification strategy.
    - Evaluate proposed changes using quality risk assessment.
    - Ensure specifications and approved artwork are appropriately controlled.
* Process Improvement:
* + Continuously review and improve processes at external manufacturing sites to meet the Teva standards for product quality and operational efficiency
  + Introduce process improvements and ensure effective implementation at external sites
  + Evaluate and implement changes to improve robustness and scalability of manufacturing processes
* Troubleshooting:
* + Provide technical troubleshooting support for issues that arise at external manufacturing facilities. Lead cross-functional teams to address /resolve issues that impact production timelines
  + Support investigations into deviations and work with CMOs to implement corrective actions

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

**Quality and Regulatory Compliance:**

* Ensure Compliance:
* + Ensure that all Packaging activities at external sites are compliant with cGMP, ICH, FDA, EMA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  + Ensure successful execution demonstrates that the Receiving Site can consistently reproduce the approved commercial packaging configuration at the required quality and performance level
* Audit and Inspection Support:
* + Lead and/or support external manufacturing site audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions, ensuring that CMOs meet all quality standards and regulatory requirements.
* Deviation and CAPA Management:
* + Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for Packaging deviations, non-conformances, and other quality issues at external sites
  + Collaborate with external partners to implement CAPAs effectively
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality to:
* + Assess the regulatory impact of the manufacturing-site transfer.
  + Identify packaging changes requiring notification or approval.
  + Ensure the transferred packaging configuration aligns with applicable marketing authorization commitments.
  + Support regulatory documentation associated with manufacturing-site changes.
  + Provide technical packaging justification for identified differences.
  + Support responses to regulatory queries related to packaging transfer.
  + Ensure implementation timing is coordinated with regulatory approvals.

**Technical implementation:**

* Support Technology Transfer:
* + Commercial artwork changes
  + Site/manufacturer information
  + Product labels
  + Cartons
  + Leaflets
  + Printed components
  + Variable data
  + Barcode requirements
  + Serialization
  + Aggregation where applicable
* Manage Material transfer projects:
* + Lead & support material transfer project (Changes in packaging material etc.) and ensure timely completion
* Scale-up Support:
* + Oversee the scaling up of packaging processes, ensuring that commercial production is consistent with development batches in terms of product quality and process performance.

**Cross-functional Collaboration:**

* Cross-departmental Coordination:
* + Work closely with internal teams such as Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Product Development to ensure seamless integration of manufacturing processes and that timelines are met.
* Project Management:
* + Manage or contribute to cross-functional project teams, ensuring that all aspects of product commercialization and manufacturing at external sites are executed efficiently and on schedule

**Reporting & Documentation:**

* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and documentation for both internal and external stakeholders.

Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for external manufacturing operations, providing updates to senior leadership

**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical/scientific discipline.
* 10+ years pharmaceutical packaging/validation/other related experience for US FDA approved sites
* Strong experience in working with external manufacturing partners (CMOs, CDMOs, etc.)
* Good oral and written communication skills, attention to detail, ability to work independently, good people skills, demonstrated organizational skills.
* Demonstrated experience in commercial pharmaceutical packaging technology transfer, site transfer, manufacturing transfer or network-transfer projects.
* Experience supporting transfers between geographically separated manufacturing sites is highly desirable.
* **The role is at Bangalore.**

**Also Good to Have**
---------------------

* Strong technical background with expertise in packaging processes, process development, and scale-up.
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting & analytical skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build relationships with external partners.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with manufacturing management systems (e.g., SAP, MES).
* Thorough familiarity with cGMPs, SOP's, relevant government regulations, and current industry standards.

**Job Type**
------------

This is fixed term position as role required till Dec.2028

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.

Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**

applicable.

evidence and review records in accordance with the project process.

software testing.

* Strong working knowledge of embedded C, pointers, structures, bit operations, memory handling, compiler

behavior and debugging of hand-written production code.

* Practical experience in unit-test isolation using stubs, drivers, mocks and test harnesses for hardware-

dependent and inter-module interfaces.

* Project experience in testing AUTOSAR Classic BSW, MCAL, complex device drivers or platform software

components.

* Experience with dynamic unit-testing tools such as TPT, VectorCAST and static-analysis tools such as

Polyspace is preferred.

* Familiarity with host-based testing, target-based testing, code instrumentation, coverage analysis and defect-

reporting workflows.

diagnostics (UDS/DCM/DEM), NVM and ECU state management is preferred.

verification evidence is preferred.

* Awareness of ISO 26262, MISRA C, CERT C and safety-related verification practices is preferred.

* Experience with Python, CAPL, shell scripting or CI/CD pipelines for test automation, data preparation and

report generation is preferred.

Attributes:

* Good analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage activities in a timely

manner.

* Team player with good interpersonal and communication skills.

* Ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines when required.

* Problem solving skills.

* Ambitious, highly self-driven and motivated.

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* automotive embedded software unit testing,: 3 years (Required)

* Embedded C, Test Isolation: 3 years (Required)

The role involves integrating data and enterprise systems, modernizing legacy processes, automating operational workflows, improving platform stability and delivering reusable engineering solutions.

* Develop and test solutions in controlled development and sandbox environments, and support deployment across relevant environments.
* Understand application architecture, system design, component integration, scalability and production-readiness considerations.
* Diagnose root causes of operational issues and implement automated, observable controls that prevent recurrence.
* Evaluate AI approaches and generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, performance and production readiness.
* Improve platform scalability, developer productivity, operational efficiency and system stability.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on **Python development** within complex production codebases.
* Practical experience in **software/application development**, including building, testing, debugging and deploying working solutions.
* Experience with **data integration**, API development and integration across databases, enterprise applications and external systems.
* Practical experience implementing **AI/ML and Generative AI solutions**.
* Demonstrated experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into applications and operational workflows.
* Ability to use **GitHub or equivalent Git-based platforms** for source-code management, collaboration and version control.
* Hands-on understanding of **CI/CD pipelines**, automated testing, build processes and deployment workflows.
* Experience working with sandbox, development, testing and production-like environments.
* Understanding of **system design and application architecture**, including APIs, integrations, data flows, modularity and scalability.
* Experience with distributed systems, concurrency, scheduling, resource management or large-scale computing.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging, performance-engineering and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
* Experience across production support, infrastructure, release management or platform engineering.
* Sound judgment when reviewing, validating and deploying AI-generated solutions.
* Strong communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering, business and senior-management stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

A pragmatic, outcome-oriented engineer who combines strong **Python, software development and platform-engineering expertise** with practical AI capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on solution builder who can independently translate requirements into working applications, leverage AI-assisted development tools effectively, integrate enterprise data and systems, understand the underlying architecture, write and manage code, and take solutions from development through testing and deployment.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate at least one meaningful AI-enabled application, automation or engineering workflow that they have personally designed and built in a production or production-like environment.

**Key skills required:**

* RAG, embeddings and vector-search technologies.
* AI agents, tool calling and workflow orchestration.
* FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
* GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI-assisted development tools.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to accelerate application development while maintaining code quality and engineering standards.
* Cloud platforms, containerization and application deployment.
* CI/CD automation and release engineering.
* Observability, operational metrics and SLA-based reporting.
* Release engineering and change-control governance.
* Global Markets, financial services or regulated-technology experience.
* Desired qualifications
* Experience in modelling or validation of Wholesale IRB capital models, IFRS9, Climate Risk Modelling experience within large banking organizations
* Strong technical skills in Python, R, SAS, SQL and knowledge of credit modelling statistics
* Deep knowledge of:
* IRB rating system architecture and approvals
* Basel III/IV capital rules for wholesale credit
* Model risk governance expectations (e.g., SR 11-7)
* Strong analytical judgment and written communication skills
* Desired qualifications : Any Graduate
* 4 to 6 years of experience

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Platform Engineer III – DocuSign, Malbek CLM and Designated Systems**

**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE**

The Platform Engineer III is a hands-on Computer Engineering professional on a DevOps team supporting Takeda’s enterprise DocuSign and Malbek Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) SaaS platforms, along with other designated systems. As a subject matter expert (SME) in system configuration, integration, operations, API, MCP, and AI training, the role delivers secure, scalable, and supportable solutions across GxP and non-GxP environments.

The Platform Engineer provides Level 3 support to resolve complex issues and incidents, builds reusable components, and develops agentic solutions that facilitate workflow. The role partners with the Platform Lead, Product Owner, business stakeholders, architects, security, integration teams, Quality, and other DD&T resources. The same engineering, documentation, testing, security, SDLC, and change-management practices apply to all changes; GxP changes carry the additional Quality, Validation, and System/Business Process Owner approvals.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Platform Configuration and Engineering**

* Configure and maintain DocuSign and Malbek CLM, including templates, workflows, routing, notifications, authentication, permissions, and reusable platform components.
* Translate prioritized requirements and user stories into secure, scalable technical solutions, assessing impact, dependencies, and architecture standards.
* Deliver enhancements, requests, defect fixes, and backlog items; provide estimates, risks, and technical impact analysis.
* Evaluate vendor roadmaps, releases, and new capabilities, and recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and unnecessary customization.

**Integration, API and MCP**

* Design, build, and support system and data integrations using REST APIs, connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft 365, identity services, and other enterprise systems).
* Support DocuSign and Malbek integrations and UI components, including Malbek for Word.

**Development and Agentic Solutions**

* Develop reusable components and automation in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, and C#/.NET.
* Build and train AI-enabled agentic solutions that facilitate and automate workflow, within platform controls.
* Promote reusable engineering standards, patterns, and self-service capabilities.

**Level 3 Support and Operations**

* Serve as Level 3 escalation point; diagnose and resolve complex incidents and problems through root cause analysis of logs, configuration, and integrations.
* Distinguish defects, configuration errors, and training gaps; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and security, and transition completed solutions into operational support.

**Testing, Release and Change Management**

* Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, and user-acceptance tests; maintain traceability and test evidence.
* Prepare technical specifications, configuration documentation, deployment and rollback procedures, and release documentation.
* Execute approved production deployments through Takeda’s change-management process and verify results post-deployment.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Deep knowledge of the DocuSign eSignature platform and Malbek CLM SaaS or comparable CLM, including configuration, workflow automation, integrations, AI-enabled features, and data migration.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, and C#/.NET, plus SQL; strong data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and system/data integrations; familiarity with MCP.
* Experience with AI tools, AI training, and building agentic or automated workflow solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for Level 3 incident and problem resolution.
* Experience with Agile, SDLC, DevOps tools and practices, CI/CD, and ITIL-based change management.
* Experience in regulated (GxP) environments is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to collaborate across teams and manage multiple priorities.

**SUCCESS IN THE ROLE**

Takeda has a strong internal engineering capability that executes, supports, and continuously improves DocuSign, Malbek CLM, and other designated systems across GxP and non-GxP processes. The Platform Engineer takes prioritized demand through a consistent lifecycle: **understand the requirement assess the impact design the solution configure/develop it document it test it obtain approvals deploy it verify it support it in production.**

The result is a secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable platform that evolves with Takeda’s business needs while meeting quality and regulatory requirements.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic Data Engineer - Senior**

  

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.

  

**Role**

**Semantic Data Engineer - Senior Experience Guide**

* Guide / 5-10 years Primary Skill Area
* Semantic Data Engineering, Knowledge Graphs, Metadata Engineering, AI-Ready Data Products & GraphRAG Enablement

  

**The opportunity**

Design, build and operationalise semantic data engineering solutions that enable Knowledge Graphs, semantic layers, enterprise search, AI-ready data products, GraphRAG and intelligent data discovery. This role is implementation-focused and bridges data engineering, semantic modelling, metadata engineering and AI-ready data platform delivery. The candidate must be able to engineer semantic models, integrate structured and unstructured data, build semantic data pipelines, support ontology and knowledge graph implementation, and operationalize governed semantic assets across modern lakehouse and enterprise data platforms.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Semantic Data Engineering & Semantic Modelling**

* Design and implement semantic data engineering solutions using semantic modelling, ontology implementation, taxonomies, SKOS concepts and governed semantic layer patterns.
* Translate business concepts and architecture guidance into implementable semantic data structures, reusable semantic mappings and operational data products.
* Build semantic models that connect business glossaries, metadata, data lineage, data quality rules and downstream analytics or AI consumption needs.
* Support semantic standards adoption by documenting implementation patterns, naming conventions, mappings and reusable engineering assets.

**Data Modelling & Analytical Data Structures**

* Apply data modelling practices including conceptual data modelling, logical data modelling, physical data modelling and dimensional modelling for semantic and analytical use cases.
* Implement entity, relationship, hierarchy, classification, metric and attribute structures that support relational, lakehouse, graph and semantic layer consumption.
* Support star schema, snowflake schema, domain model, canonical model and Power BI Semantic Model implementation where required for analytical consumption.
* Partner with data architects and semantic architects to ensure data models are reusable, governed, explainable and aligned with enterprise information architecture.

**Knowledge Graph Engineering**

* Build and maintain Knowledge Graph solutions using graph data modelling, graph relationships, entity resolution patterns, classifications and hierarchical structures.
* Implement semantic graph pipelines using RDF, OWL, SPARQL and knowledge graph platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune and GraphDB.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data into semantic ecosystems and knowledge graph foundations.
* Support GraphRAG, semantic search, enterprise search, vector search and AI-driven knowledge retrieval use cases.

**Data Integration, ETL/ELT & Lakehouse Engineering**

* Develop data integration pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, ETL/ELT patterns, APIs, enterprise data integration and metadata-driven engineering patterns.
* Build semantic data pipelines across lakehouse architecture, data platforms, semantic layers, knowledge graph platforms and AI-ready data products.
* Engineer reliable data flows for business glossaries, metadata management, lineage capture, semantic mappings, graph loading and data quality validation.
* Collaborate with platform teams to implement scalable and maintainable semantic data products across lakehouse, warehouse and graph ecosystems.

**AI-Ready Data Products, GraphRAG & LLM Grounding**

* Prepare AI-ready data products that improve LLM grounding, contextual retrieval, semantic search and explainability for AI and GenAI use cases.
* Support GraphRAG, RAG, vector search, semantic search, enterprise search and intelligent agent patterns using trusted semantic data foundations.
* Partner with AI engineering teams to ensure semantic data assets are usable for retrieval, contextual reasoning and AI-enabled data discovery.
* Contribute to agentic AI patterns where semantic metadata, knowledge graphs and governed data products support autonomous discovery or insights workflows.

The individual will be responsible for orchestrating complex migration engagements involving multiple business units, application owners, infrastructure teams, data teams, security teams, cloud providers, and other stakeholders to migrate enterprise workloads from on-premises environments to the cloud.

The role encompasses a diverse portfolio of workloads, including data platforms and workloads, transactional applications, and virtual machine (VM)-based applications. The leader will be accountable for defining migration strategies, establishing execution roadmaps, managing interdependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring successful delivery with minimal business disruption.

A key dimension of this role is to drive application modernization using AI, leveraging our internally developed AI modernization platform to transform traditional migration and modernization engagements into AI-enabled, agentic delivery models. The individual will work closely with architecture, engineering, and AI teams to operationalize AI capabilities across application discovery, assessment, modernization planning, code transformation, testing, and migration execution.

1. Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution

* Lead end-to-end migration of enterprise workloads from on-premises environments to cloud platforms, covering data workloads, transactional applications, and VM-based workloads.
* Define workload-specific migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, and retire or retain decisions, based on business objectives and technical considerations.
* Develop migration roadmaps, wave plans, dependency maps, resource plans, timelines, and execution governance.
* Drive application discovery, dependency assessment, infrastructure readiness, data migration planning, and cloud landing zone alignment.
* Ensure migration programs meet agreed objectives for cost, performance, scalability, availability, security, compliance, and business continuity.
* Anticipate and resolve migration risks, technical blockers, application dependencies, and cross-team execution challenges.
* Establish cutover, rollback, disaster recovery, and post-migration stabilization plans.

2. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Leadership

* Serve as the central leader coordinating application owners, business stakeholders, infrastructure and operations teams, database and data engineering teams, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud platform teams, and external partners.
* Drive alignment across multiple departments to establish migration priorities, ownership, dependencies, timelines, and acceptance criteria.
* Facilitate technical and business discussions to resolve competing priorities, clarify requirements, and accelerate decision-making.
* Establish a structured governance model with regular steering reviews, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, and executive reporting.
* Communicate migration progress, risks, decisions, and business impact clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build collaborative working relationships across teams and ensure accountability for deliverables throughout the migration lifecycle.

3. AI-Led Application Modernization

* Lead the technical strategy and execution of application modernization initiatives using AI-assisted and agentic approaches.
* Leverage the organization's internal AI modernization platform to accelerate application assessment, code analysis, dependency mapping, modernization recommendations, code transformation, documentation, test generation, and migration readiness.
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications by improving architecture, maintainability, scalability, resilience, performance, and cloud-native compatibility.
* Guide modernization decisions involving monolithic decomposition, API enablement, containerization, microservices, database modernization, and adoption of managed cloud services, where appropriate.
* Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to validate AI-generated recommendations and transformations against enterprise architecture standards and business requirements.
* Establish human-in-the-loop review mechanisms, automated quality gates, security controls, testing standards, and approval workflows for AI-assisted modernization.
* Define reusable modernization patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, and accelerators to improve delivery consistency and reduce manual effort.

4. Agentic Transformation of Migration Engagements

* Champion the adoption of an agentic operating model for cloud migration and application modernization engagements using the internal AI modernization platform.
* Identify opportunities to orchestrate specialized AI agents across the engagement lifecycle, including discovery, assessment, planning, dependency analysis, remediation, code modernization, testing, migration validation, and reporting.
* Translate engagement requirements and delivery challenges into platform capabilities, agent workflows, automation opportunities, and reusable use cases.
* Partner with internal AI platform and product teams to refine capabilities based on real-world project requirements and feedback from delivery teams.
* Define appropriate autonomy levels, human approval checkpoints, escalation mechanisms, and auditability for agent-driven activities.
* Establish measurable improvements in delivery speed, engineering productivity, assessment accuracy, automation coverage, and overall engagement economics.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform by capturing lessons learned, common patterns, exceptions, and reusable knowledge across migration programs.

5. Technical Governance & Solution Assurance

* Provide technical leadership across workload assessment, target-state architecture, migration design, modernization options, and production readiness.
* Review and validate solution designs, technology choices, integration patterns, security architecture, data protection, and operational requirements.
* Ensure migration and modernization approaches comply with enterprise security, regulatory, resilience, and governance requirements.
* Establish technical review checkpoints and quality standards across discovery, design, implementation, testing, migration, and post-migration operations.
* Help teams make informed trade-offs between speed, cost, technical debt reduction, business continuity, and long-term maintainability.
* Ensure AI-generated code and architecture recommendations are reviewed, tested, and approved before production adoption.

6. Program Delivery, Commercials & Business Outcomes

* Own delivery planning and execution across multiple concurrent migration and modernization workstreams.
* Track key milestones, dependencies, resource utilization, risks, delivery quality, budgets, and expected business outcomes.
* Define and monitor KPIs covering migration throughput, workload readiness, schedule adherence, defect rates, automation levels, productivity improvements, and cloud cost optimization.
* Partner with account, sales, consulting, and solutioning teams to shape migration proposals, define delivery approaches, estimate effort, and articulate value propositions.
* Identify opportunities to scale delivery through reusable assets, standardized processes, automation, and AI-enabled engineering.
* Drive post-migration optimization, operational handover, and continuous improvement to realize the intended business value.

Qualifikationen

Qualifications

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in enterprise technology leadership, cloud migration, application modernization, and large-scale digital transformation programs.
* Proven track record of leading complex, enterprise-wide cloud migration initiatives involving multiple business units, diverse application portfolios, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud architecture, landing zones, networking, security, and infrastructure services.
* Demonstrated experience in migrating data platforms, databases, transactional applications, and virtual machine (VM)-based workloads from on-premises environments to cloud platforms.
* Strong knowledge of migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, retire, and retain, with the ability to determine appropriate approaches based on business and technical requirements.
* Experience in application discovery, dependency mapping, workload assessment, migration wave planning, cutover management, rollback planning, disaster recovery, and post-migration stabilization.
* Proven expertise in enterprise application architecture, modernization patterns, cloud-native technologies, containerization, microservices, API-led architecture, and managed cloud services.
* Experience driving AI-led application modernization initiatives using generative AI, AI-assisted software engineering, and agentic AI capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled modernization platforms and tools supporting code analysis, application assessment, code transformation, automated documentation, test generation, and migration planning.
* Understanding of agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, workflow automation, human-in-the-loop controls, AI governance, and responsible AI implementation.
* Ability to translate enterprise migration and modernization requirements into reusable AI workflows, automation use cases, platform capabilities, and delivery accelerators.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud governance, resilience, observability, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated experience in program and portfolio management, including delivery governance, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Ability to define and monitor delivery KPIs, productivity metrics, automation coverage, migration throughput, quality measures, cloud cost optimization, and business value realization.
* Experience working with senior business stakeholders, enterprise architects, engineering leaders, infrastructure and operations teams, cybersecurity teams, cloud providers, and technology partners.
* Strong commercial and consulting acumen, including solutioning, effort estimation, proposal development, delivery planning, and articulation of business value.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across complex organizations.
* Ability to lead multiple concurrent migration and modernization engagements while balancing business priorities, technical complexity, delivery commitments, cost, quality, and risk.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to establish reusable frameworks, reference architectures, delivery playbooks, and standardized practices that improve engineering productivity and transformation outcomes.

AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture.
