title: Firware - AOSP
description:
About Lenskart

In 2010, we started in Delhi with a mission to make quality eyewear accessible to all. Today, we are a

publicly listed global omnichannel eyewear and tech company (NSE/BSE: LENSKART) serving 50M+

customers across India, Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and beyond — on a long-

term vision to impact a billion people. We don't just sell eyewear — we own the entire stack:

automated manufacturing, global supply chain, 3,300+ retail stores, and the hardware and software

that run all of it.

As Peyush Bansal says, “Tech is our DNA.” Beyond powering our global retail network, robotic

manufacturing, and remote optometry, we have expanded into wearable computing with B by

Lenskart — our first AI-powered smart glasses built on Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1. You'll join a high-

velocity engineering organization building the connected hardware and embedded software

foundation at global consumer scale.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on builder's role, not a coordination role. We are looking for someone who has

personally executed end-to-end embedded Android/AOSP platform bring-ups — architecture, HAL

and kernel code, power optimization, wireless connectivity, and ODM firmware integration — and

wants to do it again for Lenskart's smart eyewear platform.

You will own the foundational embedded software stack on the Qualcomm AR1 or similar platforms

— ensuring rock-solid Android bring-up, deterministic low-power duty cycling, reliable OTA updates,

and seamless RF connectivity. You will act as the technical anchor between internal teams and our

ODM partners, setting the bar for system performance, and firmware reliability

What You'll Do

Our platform will not stay on one chip. Today it is Android/AOSP on Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1;

tomorrow it could be an RTOS-class part (BES or similar) or silicon we have not picked yet. You will

own the firmware foundation in a way that survives that change: strong on the fundamentals, not

tied to a single vendor SDK.

Own the Platform Foundation, Across Silicon

* Lead system bring-up from early prototypes to production. Today that is AOSP on AR1; the same

ownership applies if the next generation runs on an RTOS or a different SoC.

* Design, implement and debug HALs, kernel drivers and BSP/RTOS drivers for glasses-specific

subsystems: camera and ISP, microphones, speakers, sensors, display, touch, LEDs and haptics.

You write production code, not just review it.

* Draw a clean line between silicon-specific code and portable platform code, so that moving to a

new SoC is a bounded porting effort rather than a rewrite.

* Be the escalation point for cross-layer issues, tracing from app and framework through HAL and

kernel to firmware to find the root cause.

Own Bluetooth & Wi-Fi Connectivity

* Take end-to-end ownership of the Bluetooth stack: Classic and BLE, audio profiles, GATT, pairing

and reconnection with the phone and companion app, and the glasses-to-phone data path.

* Take end-to-end ownership of the Wi-Fi stack: station and direct modes, throughput for media

transfer, connection stability, and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi coexistence on a tiny antenna budget.

* Debug below the framework, using HCI and driver logs, packet captures and chip firmware logs,

and work with the connectivity chip vendor on fixes.

Own Power, Battery & Thermal

* Architect the device power state machine: sleep and wake sources, suspend/resume, low-power

duty cycling and always-on paths, so that a face-worn device meets its battery and skin-

temperature limits.

* Own battery management end to end: charging, fuel gauge accuracy, brown-out and low-battery

behavior, and the charging case and accessory interfaces.

* Profile power per subsystem and per use case, and drive down regressions release over release.

Own OTA & Update Reliability

* Build, integrate and maintain the OTA update system across every image on the device:

application processor, MCU or RTOS cores, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi firmware, and on-device models.

* Make updates safe by design: secure boot and signing, rollback, power-loss and low-battery

resilience, delta updates and staged fleet rollouts, with field telemetry to catch failures early.

Own On-Device AI Deployment

* Deploy and maintain wake word detection and other edge models on the glasses, including the

always-on low-power path and the hand-off to the main processor, balancing latency, accuracy

and power.

* Understand the compute fabric of each chip (CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU, ISP, memory bandwidth) and

decide with the AI team what runs where. Work with vendor NPU/DSP toolchains and model

runtimes, including quantization and model packaging.

* Make model delivery and versioning part of the OTA pipeline, so models can be updated in the

field as safely as firmware.

Govern the ODM & Silicon-Vendor Interface

* Define and own the interface with ODM partners and silicon vendors: HAL and driver boundaries,

integration contracts, SDK/BSP drop reviews and delivery quality gates.

* Drive joint debugging with ODM firmware engineers and chip vendors, and hold both to

Lenskart's reliability bar.

* Contribute to technical evaluation of new SoCs, covering bring-up effort, SDK maturity, power

profile, connectivity and NPU capability, so that platform decisions are made with firmware in

the room.

Mentor and Lift the Team

* Raise the technical bar through direct mentorship, code and design reviews, and by modeling

first-principles debugging.

* Coach engineers on AOSP and embedded internals, driver debugging and power profiling, and

build engineering habits that outlast any single project or chip.

Who We're Looking For

Experience

* Deep, hands-on experience in embedded Android/AOSP firmware engineering in product

companies building shipping hardware.

* Has personally executed full-lifecycle Android/AOSP bring-ups from ground up — you can speak

directly to specific architectural decisions, HAL/driver trade-offs, power issues, and how you

resolved them.

* Demonstrated track record owning power management, low-power duty cycling, and wireless

connectivity (Bluetooth and Wi-Fi) in production.

* Comfortable moving between architecture discussions, C/C++ HAL and kernel driver debugging,

hardware bring-up labs, and cross-functional stakeholder conversations in the same day.

Technical Depth

* AOSP at HAL & Driver Level: Deep, hands-on mastery of AOSP architecture, Hardware Abstraction

Layers (HAL), and Linux kernel drivers.

* Platform Bring-Up: Practical experience executing Android bring-up on AR1 or comparable

wearable/mobile SoC platforms.

* Power Management: Strong command of device power state machines and low-power duty

cycling.

* Connectivity & RF: Hands-on ownership of the RF connectivity software layer, with practical

ability to absorb and debug Bluetooth and Wi-Fi stacks.

* OTA & System Software: Experience designing and maintaining OTA update agents and working

across the ODM firmware interface.

* Core Languages & Tooling: Strong C and C++ programming fundamentals, low-level kernel/

system debugging, and profiling tools.

Other Requirements

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or

equivalent practical experience.

* Clear, decisive communicator capable of defending low-level architectural decisions to technical

leadership and aligning with ODM and cross-functional stakeholders.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

You don't wait to be told where the problem is — you inspect the kernel logs, trace the HAL calls,

profile the power state transitions, and find the root cause yourself. You have already brought up

AOSP platforms and owned low-power and wireless subsystems before, and you know where

hardware-software interfaces fail in practice. When a teammate is stuck on a stubborn driver, power

leak, or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi issue, you're the person they come to, and they leave the conversation

better than they came in.

Why Join

You will own the core firmware foundation for Lenskart's AI smart eyewear — combining our global

retail and optical leadership with cutting-edge wearable hardware. This role offers end-to-end

platform ownership from bring-up and kernel/HAL architecture to power management, OTA, and

connectivity at global consumer scale.

You'll need to understand how these users think, build trust, discover products, and make purchasing decisions rather than simply applying established design patterns. You'll own design end to end, working closely with product, engineering, and business teams. We value product thinking, speed, and execution as much as design craft.

### **What you'll do**

* Own design end to end: From understanding problems and users to designing, prototyping, shipping, and iterating based on outcomes.
* Build commerce experiences: Work across product discovery, cart, checkout, repeat purchases, and other key user journeys.
* Design for Bharat: Understand users across different levels of digital familiarity, language preferences, and purchasing behaviours. Create intuitive, accessible, and trustworthy experiences.
* Think beyond screens: Understand user behaviour, business objectives, and trade-offs. Challenge assumptions and help shape what gets built.
* Work AI-first: Actively use AI for research, ideation, design exploration, rapid prototyping, and execution. Continuously improve the speed and quality of your work.
* Stay close to users: Speak with users, observe their behaviour, and translate insights into product decisions.
* Ship and learn fast: Collaborate closely with engineers, test ideas quickly, and improve experiences using feedback and product metrics.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4+ years of product design experience with strong UX, interaction design, and visual design fundamentals.
* 0 1 experience is a must: You've designed a new product, built for a new audience, or created a new use case from scratch, whether at a startup or an established company.
* AI-first mindset: You actively integrate AI into your workflow and can demonstrate how it helps you work faster, explore more, and deliver better outcomes.
* Strong user empathy: You understand, or are genuinely motivated to understand, Bharat and emerging internet users, including their behaviours, constraints, and trust barriers.
* Strong product thinking: You can navigate ambiguity, question requirements, and make design decisions grounded in user needs and business outcomes.
* High ownership: You're comfortable driving problems independently and collaborating directly with engineers through launch.
* Strong portfolio: Real, shipped work demonstrating your problem-solving process, design decisions, iterations, and impact.
* Preferred: Experience designing e-commerce or marketplace products, particularly across discovery, conversion, checkout, and repeat purchase journeys.  
    
  **Who Will Thrive Here**
You'll enjoy this role if you like building new experiences, solving problems without established playbooks, and seeing your work directly influence product and business outcomes.  
* We're a small, fast-moving team where designers are expected to think independently, stay close to users, and ship frequently.

title: Linux Device Driver Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you’ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what’s possible. Join us in helping leading Consumer Products and Retail Services (CPRS) organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.

**Your Role**

As a **Linux Kernel & BSP Development Engineer** , you will be responsible for developing Linux kernel drivers, BSPs, and platform software for embedded SoCs and custom hardware platforms. You will work closely with hardware and software teams to enable board bring-up, kernel optimization, driver integration, and system-level debugging.

In this role, you will:

* Develop and customize **Linux kernel drivers, BSPs, and platform software** .
* Perform **board bring-up** , bootloader integration, and hardware enablement.
* Work on peripheral drivers such as **SPI, I2C, UART, USB, PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, NAND, and eMMC** .
* Debug complex system issues using **JTAG, J-Link, Oscilloscope, and Logic Analyzer** .
* Support **kernel upgrades, upstreaming, driver porting, and component integration** .
* Collaborate with hardware teams on schematics, datasheets, and platform validation.

**Your Profile**

* 5-12 years of experience in **Linux Kernel Development, BSP Development, or Embedded Systems** .
* Strong expertise in **C programming** , Linux kernel internals, and device driver development.
* Hands-on experience with **Bootloaders (U-Boot), Board Bring-up, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR subsystems** .
* Strong understanding of **ARM/x86 architectures, multicore systems, memory management, IPC, DMA, IOMMU, and interrupt handling** .
* Experience with **Linux/RTOS environments, concurrent programming, and system-level debugging** .
* Familiarity with **Yocto, Buildroot, Git/GitHub** , and embedded development workflows.
* Exposure to **GPU, Multimedia, Display drivers, OpenGL/OpenCL** is an added advantage.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

**What You’ll Love About Working Here**

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence. You’ll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI.

**About Us**

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

title: Sr Architect (Servicenow ITOM)
description:
**Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect**

**Company:** Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)
  
**Location:** India (Remote / Hybrid)
  
**Function:** AI & Automation — Engineering

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **ServiceNow ITOM Expert** to join our AI and Tools Automation team. You will own the design, implementation, and evolution of our IT Operations Management capabilities on ServiceNow — spanning Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB governance, and AI-powered auto-remediation workflows. You will be a technical authority who can work independently, integrate ITOM deeply with monitoring platforms like **LogicMonitor, AppDynamics, SentryOne** , and drive intelligent, self-healing IT operations across a complex healthcare IT environment.

This is not a configuration role — we need someone who architects, engineers, and leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ITOM Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and Health Log Analytics (HLA)
* Define platform standards, integration patterns, and governance models for ITOM across the organization
* Lead technical design reviews, contribute to architectural decisions, and represent ITOM in cross-functional planning
* Independently investigate, debug, and resolve complex ITOM platform issues — from MID Server failures to CMDB reconciliation conflicts — without escalation
* Identify opportunities to consolidate, automate, and modernize legacy monitoring and event workflows

**Discovery & CMDB Governance**

* Design and maintain **ServiceNow Discovery** patterns — horizontal, vertical, and cloud discovery across on-prem, Azure, and hybrid environments
* Own **CMDB** health — deduplication, reconciliation rules, CI relationships, data certification, and lifecycle management
* Build and enforce CMDB governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
* Manage **Service Mapping** — application service discovery, dependency mapping, and business service modeling aligned to healthcare IT operations
* Design CI class structures, identification and reconciliation rules, and IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) policies

**Event Management & AIOps**

* Architect and manage the **Event Management** pipeline — connector configuration, alert ingestion, event correlation rules, and suppression logic
* Configure and tune **Health Log Analytics (HLA)** for log-based anomaly detection and noise reduction
* Build intelligent alert correlation and deduplication rules to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate MTTR
* Design event-to-incident promotion workflows with smart routing, priority assignment, and SLA alignment
* Integrate **LogicMonitor** as a primary event source — mapping LM alert payloads to ServiceNow event schema, managing thresholds, and ensuring bidirectional status synchronization

**Auto-Remediation & Intelligent Workflows**

* Design and build **auto-heal workflows** that trigger automated remediation actions in response to ITOM events — owning the architectural principle that condition-determination logic belongs in the monitoring layer (LogicMonitor), with ServiceNow executing remediation based on clean, pre-evaluated signals
* Build **Flow Designer** and **Integration Hub** workflows for automated incident response, CI status updates, and cross-platform orchestration
* Develop spoke integrations and REST/MID-based connectors for third-party tools
* Implement safety checks and precondition validations within remediation flows to prevent unintended actions in production environments
* Continuously improve auto-remediation coverage and reliability through feedback loops with the monitoring team

**MID Server & Integration Engineering**

* Own **MID Server** architecture — deployment topology, cluster configuration, upgrades, health monitoring, and failover
* Design and maintain integration architecture between ServiceNow and external platforms — LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Kubernetes, and other operational tools
* Build and maintain **REST** , **SOAP** , and **scripted integrations** using Integration Hub, Scripted REST APIs, and Import Sets
* Manage credentials, connection pooling, and secure credential storage using ServiceNow Credential Vault

**AI-Augmented Engineering**

* Actively use **AI tools** (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — for scripting, debugging, documentation, and solution design
* Leverage AI to accelerate complex problem-solving — generating Business Rules, Flow Designer logic, Scripted REST endpoints, and Groovy/JavaScript-based scripts faster and with higher quality
* Use AI to explore and prototype new ITOM automation patterns and self-healing use cases
* Stay current with ServiceNow’s native AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, NLU, and Virtual Agent — and assess their applicability to the team’s operational goals

**Azure & Cloud Integration**

* Deep understanding of **Azure platform** as it relates to ITOM — Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Log Analytics Workspaces, Event Grid, and resource tagging models
* Architect cloud discovery and service mapping for Azure-hosted workloads — VMs, AKS clusters, PaaS services, and resource groups
* Integrate Azure-native alerting and telemetry into the ServiceNow Event Management pipeline
* Understand Azure RBAC and Entra ID as they apply to MID Server service accounts, API integrations, and CMDB data sources

**GitHub & Development Practices**

* Operate confidently in **GitHub** — maintain ITOM configuration as code where possible, manage update sets through version control, and use GitHub Actions for deployment automation
* Document integration designs, flow logic, and architectural decisions clearly and maintain them in source control
* Apply software engineering discipline to ServiceNow scripting — clean code, peer review, and regression testing before deployment to production

**Platform Governance & Mentorship**

* Own the ITOM module’s platform health — upgrades, deprecation planning, performance tuning, and licensing awareness
* Define and enforce development standards for ITOM scripting, flow design, and integration work
* Mentor developers (such as Kamalesh) working on ITOM-adjacent tasks and conduct structured code and configuration reviews
* Contribute to organization-wide ITSM/ITOM alignment — ensuring CMDB, Event Management, and incident workflows operate as a cohesive system

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **10+ years** of ServiceNow experience, with **4+ years** specialized in **ITOM** — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB
* Expert-level knowledge of **MID Server** architecture, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Deep proficiency in **ServiceNow scripting** — JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST APIs, Scheduled Jobs
* Strong command of **Flow Designer** and **Integration Hub**
* Proven experience building **event-driven auto-remediation** workflows at production scale
* **Deep, hands-on Azure platform knowledge** — Monitor, Arc, Log Analytics, Event Grid, Entra ID; able to architect cloud ITOM integrations independently
* Experience integrating **LogicMonitor** or comparable monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SCOM) with ServiceNow Event Management
* **GitHub proficiency** — branching, PRs, Actions-based CI/CD, and managing ServiceNow config artifacts in source control
* Strong independent debugging skills — able to own and resolve complex, multi-system issues without escalation
* **Demonstrated fluency with AI tools** in day-to-day engineering — uses AI to solve problems, generate scripts, and prototype solutions
* Excellent communication skills — can represent ITOM architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **Health Log Analytics (HLA)** and log-based AIOps
* Familiarity with **Kubernetes / AKS** monitoring and CMDB integration for containerized workloads
* Knowledge of **ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence** and ML-based alert correlation
* Exposure to **ITSM** modules (Incident, Change, Problem) and their integration touchpoints with ITOM
* Familiarity with **LogicMonitor** platform internals — DataSources, alert payloads, Groovy scripting
* Understanding of healthcare IT environments and compliance considerations
* ServiceNow **Certified Implementation Specialist — ITOM** certification
* Experience with **Virtual Agent** or **NLU** for ITOM self-service scenarios

**Who You Are**

* An ITOM engineer who treats the platform as a **product** — not a tool to configure, but a system to architect and own
* **Deeply self-sufficient** — you debug across MID Servers, CMDB reconciliation logs, Flow Designer execution histories, and REST payloads without waiting to be unblocked
* You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster and sharper
* You hold strong architectural opinions and can defend them clearly — including knowing where logic belongs (monitoring layer vs. remediation layer)
* Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you are the ITOM domain authority
* A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across adjacent team members
* You care about data quality in the CMDB the same way a data engineer cares about pipeline reliability

title: Platform Engineer III
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**GCP Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineer - E**xperienced engineer to design, develop, deploy, and operate enterprise Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning solutions on Google Cloud. The role requires strong Python engineering skills and hands-on experience with Gemini, Gemini models, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). He/She will transform business requirements and prototypes into secure, scalable, measurable production solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Solution engineering:** Translate business requirements into AI architectures, technical designs, implementation plans, and reusable components.
* **Generative AI development:** Build Gemini-powered applications using the Google Gen AI SDK, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, grounding, and multimodal capabilities.
* **Agent development with Google ADK:** Implement agents, custom tools, agent delegation, sequential and parallel workflows, session state, memory, artifacts, and callbacks.
* **Multi-agent interoperability:** Implement A2A-based communication, agent discovery through Agent Cards, task delegation, task lifecycle handling, and secure interaction with remote agents.
* **MCP integration:** Develop and integrate MCP servers and clients to expose enterprise APIs, databases, and business tools through governed interfaces with authentication, authorization, schema validation, and error handling.
* **RAG and enterprise knowledge:** Build document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, and source attribution pipelines.
* **Enterprise integration:** Connect agents with GCP components, enterprise applications, knowledge repositories, and transactional systems through APIs, connectors, and MCP tools.
* **Reliable execution:** Implement human-in-the-loop approvals
* **Deployment and operations:** Deploy and manage applications using managed Google Cloud agent runtimes, Cloud Run, and GKE, according to workload requirements.
* **Evaluation and observability:** Establish evaluation datasets and automated checks for response quality, grounding, tool selection, execution trajectories, safety, latency, and cost. Implement tracing, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
* **Performance optimization:** Optimize model selection, context usage, caching, retrieval quality, concurrency, token consumption, and operational costs.
* **MLOps and AgentOps:** Implement version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, rollback, and ongoing quality monitoring.
* **Traditional ML:** Develop and operationalize predictive models where required, including classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation, and anomaly detection.

**Collaboration:** Work with architects, domain experts, data engineers, security teams, and delivery stakeholders; document solutions and contribute to engineering standards.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8+ years of relevant experience** in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data science, including strong production Python development.
* Demonstrated delivery experience with Generative AI or agent-based applications on Google Cloud.
* Hands-on implementation experience with Google ADK and practical exposure to A2A and MCP.
* Experience taking solutions from discovery and proof of concept through deployment and production support.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

Python Python, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, FastAPI etc. and integration testing  
Gemini: Agent Platform, Gemini APIs, Google Gen AI SDK, Google Cloud SDK  
Google ADK Agent and tool development, orchestration, delegation, workflow agents, sessions, state, memory, callbacks, and evaluation  
A2A Agent2Agent protocol concepts, Agent Cards, remote agent integration, task handling, authentication, and interoperability  
MCP Model Context Protocol concepts, server/client integration, tool schemas, secure tool execution, and access control  
Generative AI Prompt design, structured generation, function calling, grounding, context management, multimodal inputs, and hallucination mitigation  
RAG and search Document processing, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, retrieval evaluation, and citations  
Deployment Git, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and technical documentation Docker, Cloud Run, managed agent deployment, configuration management, and production troubleshooting  
Evaluation and observability Agent evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing, tool execution assessment, tracing, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring  
Security IAM, OAuth 2.0, Secret Manager, sensitive data handling, prompt injection mitigation

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* **Developer productivity:** Experience with Google Agents CLI, Gemini CLI, and Google Antigravity for agent development, debugging, evaluation, and deployment, supported by code review and automated validation.
* **Enterprise agent platforms:** Experience integrating custom agents with Gemini Enterprise and enterprise search capabilities.
* **Retrieval technologies:** Experience with RAG Engine, Vector Search, BigQuery vector search, or AlloyDB vector capabilities.
* **Advanced agent capabilities:** Long-running workflows, durable state, event-driven processing, human approval checkpoints, and real-time multimodal interaction.
* **AI security:** Model Armor, Sensitive Data Protection
* **ML and data engineering:** TensorFlow or PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, PySpark, statistical analysis, and Vertex AI Pipelines.
* **Additional frameworks:** LangGraph or LangChain, with an understanding of when to use them alongside Google ADK.
* **Certifications:** **Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer** or Professional Cloud Architect, or relevant Google Cloud Generative AI credentials.

Alongside direct solution delivery, you own the technical health and capability growth of our core delivery base, setting the architectural standards and production rigor that enable full-stack squads to consistently ship high-impact AI products.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **1. End-to-End Full-Stack & AI Solutioning**

* **Complete Production Application Delivery:** Architect and build full-stack AI applications end-to-end—owning responsive frontends, backend services, data pipelines, and model integration from initial design through live production scale.
* **Pragmatic AI Architecture:** Evaluate business problems and select the right technical approach—combining LLM reasoning, RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic workflows, fine-tuned task models, or classical predictive ML services rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all pattern.
* **Data, Retrieval & Context Engineering:** Design high-precision data ingestion, chunking, hybrid search (vector + keyword), reranking, and structured feature pipelines across enterprise databases and unstructured knowledge sources.
* **Adaptive & Human-in-the-Loop UX:** Build responsive web interfaces engineered for real-time token streaming (SSE/WebSockets), dynamic UI rendering, source citation traceability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review workflows.

* **Enterprise-Grade Reliability:** Transition AI solutions from proof-of-concept to hardened production systems with deterministic guardrails, graceful model fallbacks, strict latency budgets, rate limiting, and PII/security compliance.
* **Automated Evaluation & Quality Gates:** Implement continuous evaluation harnesses that benchmark task accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, model drift, and regression safety prior to every production release.
* **Inference & Cost Optimization:** Instrument end-to-end tracing and implement intelligent model routing, semantic/prompt caching, and context optimization to maximize responsiveness and minimize cost per transaction.

* **Solution Architecture & Code Governance:** Lead architecture reviews, define production-readiness checklists, and enforce clean code, testing, and API standards across the delivery base.
* **Capability Building & Mentorship:** Coach senior and mid-level full-stack specialists in end-to-end AI solutioning through hands-on pair architecture, design critiques, and internal technical workshops.

* **Backend & AI Solutioning:** Strong proficiency in **Python** (FastAPI, AsyncIO) and/or **Node.js/TypeScript**, with hands-on experience across LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom state machines), and serving predictive ML or multimodal models in production.

Yubi, formerly known as CredAvenue, is re-defining global debt markets by freeing the flow of finance between borrowers, lenders, and investors. We are the world's possibility platform for the discovery, investment, fulfilment, and collection of any debt solution. At Yubi, opportunities are plenty and we equip you with tools to seize it.

In March 2022, we became India's fastest fintech and most impactful startup to join the unicorn club with a Series B fundraising round of $137 million.

In 2020, we began our journey with a vision of transforming and deepening the global institutional debt market through technology. Our two-sided debt marketplace helps institutional and HNI investors find the widest network of corporate borrowers and debt products on one side and helps corporates to discover investors and access debt capital efficiently on the other side. Switching between platforms is easy, which means investors can lend, invest and trade bonds - all in one place. All of our platforms shake up the traditional debt ecosystem and offer new ways of digital finance.

* Yubi Credit Marketplace - With the largest selection of lenders on one platform, our credit marketplace helps enterprises partner with lenders of their choice for any and all capital requirements.

Backed by marquee investors like Insight Partners, B Capital Group, Dragoneer, Sequoia Capital, LightSpeed and Lightrock, we are the only-of-its-kind debt platform globally, revolutionising the segment.

At Yubi, People are at the core of the business and our most valuable assets. Yubi is constantly growing, with 1000+ like-minded individuals today, who are changing the way people perceive debt. We are a fun bunch who are highly motivated and driven to create a purposeful impact. Come, join the club to be a part of our epic growth story.

Inviting applications for the role of Technical Architect.

Architects at Yubi are responsible to lead, evangelise and drive technology. Along with designing and architecting robust and scalable software systems, they are the ambassadors of best software engineering practices. They go above and beyond their roles to take ownership in solving complex software problems which have an organization wide impact. title: Senior Software Architect
description:

IN

Job Family Engineering

Job ID 72058

**Join us in architecting high‑performance embedded software that powers and drives the next generation of wind energy.**

**If you are passionate about building robust software solutions, leading the architecture of large-scale embedded and real-time systems, and driving best-practice software development, this role is for you.**

**We are looking for a technical leader with strong stakeholder management skills and deep expertise in C++ and embedded software engineering, ready to navigate a complex and fast-paced environment.**

**Vestas Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Product Applications & Controls R&D > Turbine Control Software Module > Technical Management**

Vestas Technology & Operations (VTO) brings together R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality into one integrated organization, ensuring our products meet high standards for quality, efficiency, and time-to-market.

Within VTO, the “WTG Controls” solution is a team of skilled engineers and specialists across India, Portugal, and Denmark. We organized in SAFe/FlowAgile ARTs and develop advanced software solutions that support the turbine performance including the control system.

Our work is rooted in strong systems engineering principles, with a focus on delivering robust, high-quality software across the full product lifecycle. We take ownership end-to-end — from design to delivery — and continuously push the boundaries of what turbine software can achieve.

  

**Responsibilities**

As a Software Architect for Turbine Software, you will report to the Module Design Owner for Turbine SW and play a central role in defining and safeguarding the software architecture that powers all Vestas wind turbines. Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of high-performance, safety-critical embedded software systems primarily developed in modern C++ (C++17/20 and beyond)
* Collaborate across engineering and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment. Define and own the software architecture guidelines for the WTG Control solution with ~400 people. Translate business and technical requirements into clear architectural solutions and development guidelines
* Define and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns, and best practices for scalable, maintainable, and testable systems. Write high‑quality, performance, and testable code, and analyze complex legacy and modern codebases to implement fixes and improvements
* Ensure better support for the utilization of AI agentic frameworks for development
* Provide expert troubleshooting and operational support for products, tools, and customer‑reported issues
* Promote continuous integration and automated testing practices for embedded (e.g., unit testing frameworks and hardware-in-the-loop testing). Maintain and update comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture descriptions and interface specifications, to support software functionality and lifecycle management
* Drive continuous improvement by enhancing processes, tools, and developing utilities that support operations and maintenance

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Familiarity with software architecture principles, including modular design, layered architecture, and interface-driven and modular development
* Extensive experience in modern C++ development, with strong knowledge of recent language features (C++17/20 and beyond). Demonstrated experience in a technical leadership role within a large Agile software development organization
* Proven experience in embedded software development preferably in real-time and/or safety-critical systems. Knowledge about Docker and Linux. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
* Beneficial with knowledge from RTOS2 or other open-source real-time operating systems
* General knowledge or experience in Secure Product Development and Cyber Security is beneficial
* Ability and motivation to understand complex technical domains, system behavior, and low-level software interactions
* Experience with AI agentic frameworks

  

**Competencies**

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates the following competencies and personal attributes:

* Strong technical leadership within C++ and embedded systems domains, with the ability to guide and mentor engineers
* Proven ability to lead and collaborate with remote, multi‑location teams
* Proficient English communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem‑solving and decision‑making
* Builds trust and influence through effective leadership and stakeholder management
* Results‑oriented, open‑minded, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment

  

**What we offer**

We offer an exciting opportunity to take full lifecycle responsibility for a key area of the turbine software system. You will join a highly adaptive and empowered team where you are encouraged to make decisions, drive initiatives, and implement your own solutions.

In this role, you will build a broad network across a truly global organization, gaining extensive opportunities for cross‑disciplinary collaboration and personal development. You will be part of a result-oriented environment that maintains a high professional standard and a strong commitment to technical excellence.

Most importantly, you will work with a clear sense of purpose—understanding the value of your contributions and how your work directly supports the global effort to address climate change.

  

**Additional information**

Primary work location: Aarhus (Denmark), Porto (Portugal) or Chennai (India)

Up to 15 days of travel per year.

We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 4th Oct 2026.

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring**

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

  

**DEIB Statement**

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

  

**About Vestas**

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad or Bangalore

**Mandatory Educational Background:**
Graduation or Post Graduation with Mathematics & Statistics background.

***The role***

The Senior Data Scientist will design, build, and deploy data science solutions for nxzen's critical national infrastructure clients (primarily energy and utilities such as water, gas, and electricity, expanding in the mid-term to rail and highways sectors) in the UK, Australia, and internationally, applying predictive analytics and statistical modelling, optimisation and simulation to real operational problems, and leveraging machine learning and AI as tools where they add value.

Based in nxzen’s Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad or Bangalore, you will report to the Director of AI and Analytics and work as part of a growing Data Science team delivering production-grade analytical and predictive solutions for critical national infrastructure operators. This is a hands-on technical delivery role with a team leadership and coaching element. You will write production code, build predictive models, run simulations, and work directly with client data, while leading and mentoring small teams of data professionals alongside you.

The role spans the full data science lifecycle: from problem framing and use case discovery, through exploratory data analysis and feature engineering, to model development, validation, and production deployment. Your core discipline is predictive analytics and statistical modelling, optimisation and simulation. You will apply machine learning techniques (regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting, deep learning) and generative AI (LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows) where they are the right tool for the problem. You will work closely with data engineers, analytics leads, and domain consultants to ensure solutions are robust, explainable, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will contribute to nxzen’s IP and solution development, and support pre-sales by building proof-of-value prototypes, technical demonstrations, and contributing to proposals and commercial presentations under the direction of the Director of AI and Analytics and the Head of the Data & AI practice. Success in this role requires strong applied data science skills, comfort with messy real-world data, the ability to communicate technical results to non-technical stakeholders, and a genuine interest in energy and infrastructure as an application domain.

***Key responsibilities***

The Senior Data Scientist will design and deliver data science solutions across nxzen’s critical national infrastructure client portfolio, combining analytical depth with practical delivery focus. You will work on client engagements from discovery through to production, collaborating with onshore/offshore consultants, data engineers, and client technical teams.

You will own the end-to-end model development lifecycle, from problem structuring and data exploration through to deployment and monitoring, ensuring solutions are production-grade, explainable, and aligned to client requirements and nxzen’s delivery standards.

A key focus will be translating business problems into well-structured analytical and predictive solutions that deliver measurable value for regulated critical national infrastructure clients. You will contribute to the growth and technical maturity of nxzen’s Global Capability Centre data science function.

* Design, develop, and deploy predictive analytics and statistical models for critical national infrastructure use cases including asset risk scoring (CNAIM/NARM), predictive maintenance, leak and outage prediction, demand forecasting, failure probability modelling, and network performance optimisation, applying machine learning techniques where they improve accuracy or scalability.
* Apply rigorous statistical methods (survival analysis, Bayesian inference, regression modelling, ensemble methods) to underpin the predictive models above, working with operational data including SCADA historian, smart meter, weather, and IoT sensor streams.
* Build optimisation and simulation models to support client decision-making, including workforce scheduling, capital investment prioritisation, network capacity planning, and maintenance strategy optimisation. Techniques include linear and mixed-integer programming, Monte Carlo simulation, and agent-based modelling. Experience tailored to energy and utilities contexts is desirable but not essential.
* Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and data quality assessment on operational, asset, geospatial, SCADA, and financial datasets typical of energy and utilities environments.
* Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to computer vision problems including asset defect detection, vegetation management, and infrastructure inspection, using image classification, object detection, and segmentation models.
* Design and deploy generative AI solutions where appropriate, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and intelligent assistants for field engineers, regulatory analysts, and operations teams. Generative AI is one tool in the toolkit, not the default answer.
* Build and maintain deployment pipelines (MLOps, LLMOps) for model training, validation, production deployment, monitoring, and retraining, using platforms such as Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, or equivalent.
* Contribute to nxzen IP development (e.g., intelligent IT service management and field knowledge assistant platforms), embedding analytical and predictive capabilities where they add value.
* Support pre-sales and business development by building proof-of-value prototypes, technical demonstrations, and solution architecture inputs for client proposals and commercial presentations, working under the direction of the Director of AI and Analytics and the Head of the Data & AI practice.
* Apply responsible AI and model risk management principles to all model development, including explainability, fairness, bias detection, model documentation, and alignment with the UK AI Regulation White Paper, NCSC Guidelines, and ISO/IEC 42001.
* Lead small delivery teams of data professionals on client engagements, including work allocation, technical direction, code review, and supporting team members' career development. Comfortable combining hands-on technical delivery with team leadership responsibilities.
* Mentor more junior team members and support peer learning within the Data & AI practice, contributing to code review and technical standards development.
* Collaborate with onshore delivery leads and client data teams through regular stand-ups, sprint planning, and technical reviews, operating effectively in a distributed onshore/offshore model across geographies and time zones.
* Work with data engineers to ensure model inputs are well-governed, documented, and traceable, supporting end-to-end data lineage from source systems through to model outputs.
* Stay current with advances in data science, statistical methods, optimisation techniques, machine learning, and generative AI (e.g., conformal prediction for distribution-free uncertainty quantification with guaranteed coverage, decision-focused learning for training predictive models against downstream decision quality, and time-series foundation models for zero-shot forecasting on unseen data), evaluating new approaches for applicability to nxzen's client problems.
* Contribute to nxzen’s technical thought leadership in the data science space through internal knowledge sharing, technical blog posts, and reusable solution accelerators.

***What we’re looking for***

We are looking for a data scientist whose core strength is predictive analytics, statistical modelling, and quantitative problem-solving, with the ability to apply machine learning and AI techniques as tools where they fit. This is not a research-only role. We need someone who can take a business problem, structure it as an analytical or predictive task, select the right method, build and validate models, and deploy them with proper monitoring. We expect at least 7 years of professional experience in data science, applied quantitative analytics, or related roles, with at least 5 years in hands-on model development and deployment. A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or similar) is expected. A Master’s or PhD in a relevant field is desirable.

You will work in a distributed team with onshore/offshore consultants and client stakeholders in the UK and Australia. Strong written and spoken English is essential. You must be comfortable presenting technical findings to non-technical audiences and working across time zones. Experience in energy, utilities, or infrastructure is highly desirable but not essential.

* Strong proficiency in Python for data science and analytical development, including core libraries: pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, and at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred, TensorFlow accepted). Experience with R is a plus.
* At least 5 years applying predictive analytics and statistical modelling techniques to real business problems, including regression techniques, survival analysis, Bayesian methods, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and time-series forecasting. Able to select and justify the right method for the problem, not just the most complex one.
* Experience with optimisation, simulation, and decision modelling techniques (linear/mixed-integer programming, Monte Carlo simulation, agent-based modelling, discrete event simulation) is desirable. Application to energy and utilities problems such as capital planning, outage scheduling, or network capacity is a strong plus.
* At least 2 years leading data or analytics teams (formally or informally) on client engagements or internal projects, including work allocation, technical direction, code review, and supporting team members' development. Comfortable combining hands-on delivery with team leadership responsibilities.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying predictive and analytical models in production, including model training, validation, performance monitoring, and iterative improvement. Not just Jupyter notebooks. We expect experience with production deployment patterns.
* Strong understanding of offline and online evaluation of AI and ML models. Offline: cross-validation, holdout testing, classification and regression metrics (precision, recall, F1, AUC, RMSE, MAE), calibration, and robustness checks. Online: A/B testing, shadow deployments, champion-challenger evaluation, monitoring for data drift, concept drift, and performance degradation in production. Able to design appropriate evaluation strategies for the problem at hand.
* At least 2 years working with MLOps tooling and practices for productionising models: model versioning (MLflow, Weights & Biases), CI/CD for deployment pipelines, containerisation (Docker), and orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow, or equivalent).
* Experience with at least one major cloud ML platform: Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Databricks ML, or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with generative AI techniques as applied tools, including LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, crew.ai, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent). Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral APIs.
* Experience working with operational, asset, or geospatial data in energy, utilities, or infrastructure sectors (highly desirable, not essential). Familiarity with SCADA, historian, GIS, or IoT sensor data is a strong plus.
* Experience with computer vision (image classification, object detection, segmentation) and/or NLP (text classification, entity extraction, summarisation) in applied settings.
* Knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, Spark, data pipeline design, and data quality principles. You do not need to be a data engineer, but you must be able to work effectively with them.
* Strong written and spoken English. Comfortable presenting technical results to non-technical stakeholders, writing model documentation, contributing to proposals and commercial presentations, and participating in client-facing calls and workshops.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles, model risk management, explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME), and fairness/bias assessment. Familiarity with the UK AI Regulation White Paper or ISO/IEC 42001 is desirable.
* Genuine interest in energy, utilities, and critical national infrastructure as an application domain. Aligned to nxzen’s purpose and brand.

**Job Description: SDET – Playwright & Test Automation**

**Location:** Hyderabad, India
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Experience:** 4-6 years

**Position Overview**

  
  

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in **Playwright-based UI automation**, API testing, modern programming practices, and CI/CD integration. This individual will own quality outcomes—not merely test execution—and partner with product, engineering, architecture, and business teams to improve release confidence, speed-to-market, customer experience, and production stability.

Key Responsibilities:

**Automation Strategy and Architecture**

* Define and implement an enterprise-grade test automation strategy across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

* Architect scalable and reusable automation frameworks using **Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript**.

* Establish framework standards for modularity, maintainability, parallel execution, cross-browser testing, reporting, and failure diagnostics.

* Guide the appropriate use of unit, component, API, contract, integration, UI, and end-to-end.

* Reduce dependence on manual regression through risk-based, sustainable automation.

**Quality Engineering and Shift-Left Practices**

* Drive shift-left quality by influencing requirements, acceptance criteria, solution designs, and testability.

* Define the overall test approach, quality gates, automation coverage targets, and release-readiness criteria.

* Champion test-driven development, behavior-driven development, API-first testing, and early defect prevention.

* Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to create clear, testable acceptance criteria.

**Code Quality and Engineering Standards**

* Conduct automation design and code reviews and ensure adherence to programming, security, and maintainability standards.

* Establish reusable libraries, coding guidelines, test patterns, branching practices, and Definition of Done.

* Ensure automated tests are reliable, independent, maintainable, and resistant to flaky execution.

* Implement effective test reporting, failure analysis, defect triage, and root-cause analysis practices.

**CI/CD, Cloud and Non-Functional Quality**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast and actionable feedback.

* Enable parallel, cross-browser, environment-based, and scheduled test execution.

* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve test environment availability, test data provisioning, and pipeline reliability.

* Contribute to performance, accessibility, security, compatibility, and resiliency testing strategies.

* Implement dashboards and quality metrics that provide visibility into coverage, defects, execution stability, and release risk.

**Stakeholder and Business Outcome Ownership**

* Communicate quality status, release risks, dependencies, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Provide objective, data-driven release-readiness assessments rather than limiting accountability to test completion.

* Drive measurable improvements in release confidence, escaped defects, automation coverage, cycle time, and customer experience.

MUST HAVE Skills:

* 12–15 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, including technical leadership responsibilities.

* Deep hands-on experience designing and developing automation frameworks using **Playwright**.

* Strong programming capability in **TypeScript or JavaScript**; working knowledge of Python or Java is valuable.

* Strong experience testing modern web applications across multiple browsers and responsive interfaces.

* Expertise in API testing using tools or frameworks such as **Karate, REST Assured, Playwright API, Postman, or equivalent**.

* Experience designing maintainable automation using page/component models, reusable fixtures, data-driven approaches, and appropriate design patterns.

* Strong knowledge of test pyramid principles, shift-left testing, risk-based testing, and quality engineering practices.

* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.

* Proficiency with Git-based version control, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies.

* Experience with BDD and Gherkin, with sound judgment on where behavior-driven specifications add value.

* Strong understanding of test data management, service virtualization, mocking, environment management, and defect lifecycle.

* Ability to troubleshoot complex failures across UI, API, integration, data, and application layers.

Sales organizations are under increasing pressure to accelerate growth, improve productivity, enhance customer engagement, and scale effectively in a rapidly evolving business environment. Achieving these outcomes requires more than process improvement or technology adoption. It demands modern operating models, disciplined execution, AI-enabled innovation, and a relentless focus on value realization.

This role plays a critical part in shaping that transformation. It offers the opportunity to work directly with senior sales and business leaders, influence enterprise priorities, and lead initiatives that redefine how sales teams operate, execute, collaborate, and create commercial impact.

The successful candidate will help build the frameworks, governance mechanisms, operating rhythms, capabilities, and transformation roadmaps that position the sales organization for sustainable growth and long-term success.

1. Strategic Program Leadership

* Lead a portfolio of high-priority strategic programs aligned to sales and business objectives.

* Develop mechanisms that enhance execution discipline, accountability, operational rigor, and performance transparency across teams and geographies.
* Identify opportunities to remove process friction, improve organizational productivity, and increase seller effectiveness.
* Implement scalable operating mechanisms that strengthen commercial execution while supporting business growth objectives.

3. Sales Transformation, Enablement & Operating Model Innovation

* Define and execute transformation roadmaps spanning sales processes, capabilities, operating models, governance, and ways of working.
* Define and help evolve the future-state sales operating model, including sales planning, performance management, seller productivity, knowledge enablement, governance, and execution effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to redesign how sales teams access information, collaborate, prioritize activities, and engage customers throughout the sales lifecycle.
* Lead initiatives that improve organizational scalability, simplify seller experiences, and reduce non-selling effort.
* Develop scalable frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, and operating models that improve sales effectiveness.
* Build and institutionalize reusable sales-enablement assets, including points of view, capability narratives, executive presentations, case studies, commercial frameworks, pursuit support materials, and playbooks.
* Establish repeatable frameworks that improve the consistency of commercial execution while enabling flexibility across geographies, markets, and account teams.
* Improve the speed, quality, and consistency of sales pursuits through standardized approaches and best practices.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities, processes, operating models, and sales-enablement solutions across the organization.
* Support the creation of differentiated commercial propositions and strategic sales assets that enhance customer engagement and business development efforts.

* Drive adoption and business value realization through governance, change management, measurement frameworks, and user engagement strategies.
* Ensure digital transformation initiatives remain focused on business outcomes, user adoption, and measurable value creation.
* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across sales operations and enablement functions.

5. Governance, Executive Reporting & Value Realization

* Define key performance indicators, success measures, and value-tracking frameworks for strategic initiatives.

* Ensure strategic initiatives maintain a clear focus on business impact and value creation.
* Enable informed executive decision-making through fact-based reporting, insights, and performance analytics.

* Influence and align stakeholders across functions, geographies, and organizational boundaries.

* Demonstrated technical Lead ership across embedded systems development and product delivery.

title: Data Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
Data Engineer, Architecture – ClientIQ
  
  
Your team
  
  
The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm’s enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement.
  
  
The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
In this role, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning ClientIQ. You will define architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption.
  
  
A critical expectation is the ability to quickly learn and leverage BlackRock’s internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, leveraging and extending existing platform capabilities before building new solutions.
  
  
You will lead data engineering across structured and semi-structured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI (GenAI), and agentic experiences.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve ClientIQ’s target-state data architecture, leveraging internal dPaaS capabilities and applying a reuse-first approach across data products, models, application programming interfaces (APIs), metadata, and shared services.
* Provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery, partnering across platform, product, engineering, AI, governance, and business teams.
* Architect the ingestion, integration, and modeling of client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, interaction, behavioral, and external data into trusted and reusable data products.
* Lead engineering across batch and real-time processing, distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, and event streaming.
* Design capabilities across structured and semi-structured data that support AI-ready architectures, including document processing, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Embed data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, observability, security, resilience, and performance into data products and production engineering practices.
* Build reusable data services that power applications, analytics, AI models, agents, and downstream platforms while improving interoperability, scalability, and speed to market.

Your experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, or large-scale software engineering, including delivery of scalable enterprise data platforms and data products.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, SQL, Snowflake, and DBT, with experience across distributed processing, batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, event streaming, and data orchestration using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing.
* Experience developing production data solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, semi-structured data, and role-based data access controls.
* Experience developing transactional database solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, complex SQL, stored procedures, database programming, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Ability to rapidly learn and leverage internal platforms and dPaaS capabilities, applying strong architectural judgment to balance reuse, speed, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
* Experience with AI-ready data architectures and exposure to GenAI, machine learning, semantic technologies, document processing, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, RAG, and agentic architectures.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, observability, resilience, performance, production engineering, Microsoft Azure, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, containerized environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure automation

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

The mission of RISK Markets and Financial Institutions (“RISK MFI”) is to provide Senior Management of the Group, of the RISK Function and of Global Markets (“GM”) with full transparency and dynamic analysis with respect to the market, counterparty, valuation and liquidity risks originated and managed by CIB GM, in order to assist them in their risk decision making.
  
  
The VALUATION ADJUSTMENTS department is within RISK MFI, the team that owns all responsibilities related to Independent Price Verification(IPV), Fair Value Reserves (FVR), Methodology Corrections (MC) & Prudent Value Adjustments (PVA) across all Global market trading activities and regions.

Fulfil the mission statement of RISK MFI Valuation Adjustments by taking ownership of the definition, maintenance, documentation, reference implementation, testing and release of methodologies used for Valuation adjustments covering Independent Price Verification (IPV), Fair Value Reserves, Prudent Value Adjustments among all asset classes. title: Vice President, Specialist, Model Validation, Risk Management Group
description:
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to lead the Model Validation function with Risk Management Group. The successful candidate will be responsible for independently validating a diverse range of credit risk models used across both wholesale and retail banking businesses. This role involves assessing model design, data quality, implementation, and ongoing performance to ensure models are fit for purpose, compliant with regulatory requirements, and effectively manage financial risk.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities and Requirements:**

* Independent Model Validation: Conduct end-to-end independent validation of credit risk models, including but not limited to:
* Wholesale Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for corporate, commercial real estate, and other institutional exposures; stress testing models; counterparty credit risk models; credit rating models
* Retail Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, personal loans; application scorecards, behavioral scorecards, collections models.
* Methodology Review: Critically evaluate model development methodologies, underlying assumptions, conceptual soundness, and quantitative techniques.
* Data Quality Assessment: Assess the quality, completeness, and appropriateness of data used in model development and ongoing monitoring.
* Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems.
* Performance Monitoring: Review and challenge ongoing model performance monitoring frameworks and results, including backtesting, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis.
* Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements.
* Documentation & Reporting: Prepare comprehensive validation reports detailing findings, limitations, recommendations, and conclusions. Present findings to model owners, developers, and relevant committees.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models and validation practices comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11-7, CECL, IFRS 9, Basel Accords).
* Challenging Model Development: Proactively engage with model developers to provide constructive challenge and guidance throughout the model lifecycle.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate effectively with model development teams, risk management functions, business lines, internal audit, and regulators.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of validation processes, methodologies, and tools.

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in model validation or model development, specifically with exposure to credit risk models.
* Demonstrable experience with model review and validation pertaining to both wholesale banking and retail banking
* Understanding of technical modelling requirements throughout model life cycle covering data analytics, coding, development, deployment, monitoring and maintenance for both traditional AI and Gen AI models
* Capacity to adopt new modelling areas (e.g., climate risk & Agentic AI) and problem solving
* Understanding of model governance requirements and principles

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
Post -graduate/ Graduate degree in quantitative discipline (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Data Analytics or equivalent) is preferred
  
  
**Core Competencies**

* Deep understanding of credit risk concepts, including PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, credit ratings, credit scores, and stress testing.
* Familiarity with relevant RBI and Basel guidelines
* Understanding of financial products and business processes in both wholesale and retail banking segments.
* Analytical & Critical Thinking: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify subtle model weaknesses and propose practical solutions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
* Collaboration: Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in a regulated financial institution environment.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong proficiency in statistical modeling techniques: regression analysis, econometrics, time series analysis, machine learning algorithms (e.g., logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting).
* Expertise in programming languages for data analysis and statistical modeling: Python, R, SAS.
* Familiarity with database querying tools (SQL) is a plus.
* Experience with large datasets and data manipulation.
