title: Oracle fusion finance architect
description:
**Job Description: Oracle Cloud ERP Finance Solution Architect (Practice & Product)**

**Role Overview:**

**As a Product Architect within the Oracle Practice, you are the "Master Builder" of functional solutions in FIN Area. You will be responsible for conceptualizing end-to-end business solutions, leading short-term strategic consulting assessments, and physically configuring Proof of Concepts (POCs) in our internal sandboxes. You must be able to bridge the gap between a complex business problem and a working Oracle Cloud solution. This is not a traditional pre-sales role.**

**I. Core Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Solutioning: Conceptualize holistic business solutions within the ERP ambit. You must design how R2R, S2P, and O2C flows will operate across Finance, SCM, and Manufacturing modules.**
* **Sandbox Configuration & POCs: Own the internal sandbox. You will be responsible for configuring POCs in Oracle Cloud ERP (and EBS where required) to demonstrate specific functionalities for new opportunities or for mining existing accounts.**
* **Short-Term Consulting Gigs: Lead and deliver 4–6 week high-impact engagements, such as:**
* **Blueprinting Assessments: Defining the future-state business architecture.**
* **Cloud Migration Assessments: Evaluating legacy footprints (EBS/On-prem) and mapping the journey to Cloud.**
* **Client Presentation: Prepare "Solution Pages" and architectural decks. You must present convincingly to customers, defending your design choices and demonstrating product value.**
* **Innovation & Agents: Conceptualize and configure "New Agents" or automated features within the sandbox to showcase the latest Oracle Cloud innovations (AI/ML/Automations).**
* **Integration Solutioning: Propose functional integration designs for multi-source data environments, ensuring seamless transactions between Cloud, On-prem, and Hyperscalers.**

**II. Domain Expertise**

* **Financials Stack: Deep expertise in configuration and process design for GL, AP, AR, FA, and CM.**
* **Business Process Flows: Mastery of Record-to-Report (R2R), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Order-to-Cash (O2C).**
* **Cross-Module Awareness: Strong understanding of how Finance integrates with SCM (Purchasing, Inventory) and Manufacturing (Costing).**
* **Reporting Requirements: Ability to gather requirements and architect solutions for BI Publisher, OTBI, and Financial Reporting Studio (FRS).**

**III. Candidate Profile**

* **Experience: 10+ years in Oracle ERP, with a strong focus on Fusion Cloud Financials.**
* **Mindset: A "Product First" approach. We are looking for an architect who loves to build and configure, rather than just manage a proposal process.**
* **Autonomy: Ability to own a consulting sprint (4–6 weeks) from start to finish with minimal oversight.**
* **Communication: High-level presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex technical/functional architecture for a business audience.**

**Trade Finance operations, product development and emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI).**

* Technology Evaluation & Product Adoption: Evaluate AI, automation, blockchain and other emerging technology solutions, drive adoption across banks and monitor product performance, operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

* Working knowledge of UCP 600, ISBP, URDG 758, ISP98, RBI and FEMA regulations applicable to Trade Finance.
* Familiarity with Trade Finance platforms such as Finacle Trade, Finastra TI, Intellect or equivalent systems is added advantage.
* Understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies and their applications in Trade Finance.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Graduate degree in a relevant discipline.

**Preferred**

* Experience in developing or implementing Trade Finance products across multiple banks or financial institutions.
* Exposure to AI-driven Trade Finance solutions, including Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), Generative AI, discrepancy detection and automated compliance checks.
* Understanding of SWIFT MT7xx, ISO 20022, APIs and banking system integrations.
* Knowledge of electronic Bills of Lading, MLETR, digital trade initiatives and blockchain/Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)-based Trade Finance platforms.
* Exposure to sanctions screening, Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) controls and fraud detection.
* Experience working with banking technology vendors, fintechs or digital financial infrastructure platforms.
* MBA or relevant professional qualification preferred.

description:

The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects and transition initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business priorities. The role drives delivery excellence through effective governance, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on delivery role, requiring active involvement in project planning, execution, issue resolution, stakeholder engagement, and the achievement of key delivery milestones. The position also promotes the adoption of emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation, to enhance project outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and support organisational transformation.

Strategic Focus

Operational Management

Governance & Risk

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

Experience

* Management office in both an agile and waterfall context
* Extensive experience in project portfolio management and governance of portfolios in a complex environment with a high volume of change
* Experience working within structured project environments, applying established methodologies and best practices to achieve project outcomes
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and project management tools, with the ability to effectively utilise technology to support project delivery

* Well-developed analytical skills
* A questioning and inquisitive disposition
* Critical thinking
* Strong communication and report writing skills

title: Project Director
description:
**Company presentation**  

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023.

www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

  
**Your responsibilities**

As a Project Director, you carry overall accountability for the successful delivery of a strategically critical EPC/EPF project in the field of alkaline water electrolysis. You lead at executive level with ownership for a complex scope covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, cell assembly, logistics, construction interfaces, commissioning support and extended supervision. The role requires business judgment, solution orientation, technical credibility and the ability to lead international teams, drive decisions and secure results in a multi-company environment.

* You hold end-to-end accountability from bid and contract handover through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction interfaces, commissioning support, final acceptance and close-out.
* You establish the Project Execution Plan and governance model, including decision rights, organization, resource plan, management cadence and executive reporting.
* You integrate engineering, procurement, fabrication, quality, supply chain, logistics, project controls, commercial management and contract administration into one global, cross-functional and intercultural project team.
* You challenge bid assumptions, execution concepts, schedule logic, partner models and resource loading to secure a realistic and executable baseline.
* You own delivery performance against schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, quality, HSE and contractual commitments, intervening early when deviations threaten project outcomes.
* You govern technical, commercial, contractual, supply-chain and interface risks and ensure disciplined mitigation, contingency and recovery measures.
* You safeguard contractual entitlement through structured change control, timely notices, variation management, claims strategy, escalation and robust decision documentation.
* You act as the primary executive interface to the customer, project sponsors, steering committees, international partners, suppliers and other key stakeholders, resolving critical interfaces across organizations.
* You bring sufficient technical depth to challenge engineering-led solutions and drive timely, robust and executable decisions.
* You lead critical phases including execution ramp-up, major change, supply-chain disruption, instability and recovery through clear priorities and fact-based intervention.
* You guide Project Managers and senior discipline leads, setting high standards for safety, quality, integrity, accountability and collaboration.

  
**Your profile**  

* You have completed a degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
* You have typically 20 or more years of experience in EPC project execution, including substantial leadership of major chemical, energy, hydrogen, electrolysis, process-plant, petrochemical or comparable industrial projects.
* You have proven accountability for complex projects involving international customers, consortium and multi-company interfaces under significant contractual and stakeholder pressure. Previous experience of executing projects in a consortium with international stakeholders and partners is an vital prerequisite for this position
* You have a strong command of project economics, integrated scheduling, cost forecasting, margin and cash protection, risk management, contract strategy, change control and claims.
* You have steered projects through difficult phases such as bid-to-execution transition, execution ramp-up, major contractual change, supply-chain disruption, recovery and final acceptance.
* You combine executive presence with delivery discipline and can lead large cross-functional and intercultural organizations over different international locations in a matrix environment.
* You exhibit strong leadership skills, can demonstrate good relationship management, take full ownership and drive decision making
* You hold a recognized senior project-management certification such as PMP, IPMA Level B/A or an equivalent qualification.
* You are fluent in business English. German or another relevant international language and experience working with Asian stakeholders are advantageous.
* You are willing to travel extensively in India and internationally and to accept extended project assignments when necessary.

  
**Your benefits with us**  

* A strategically important leadership role in industrial-large-scale green hydrogen and electrolysis projects.
* High personal responsibility in an international, interdisciplinary environment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders.
* Development opportunities aligned with individual strengths, experience and career goals.
* Flexible working arrangements where compatible with project requirements, together with modern workplace infrastructure and group-wide employee programs.

title: Interior Designer
description:
**Job Title**

Interior Designer

**Department**

Design

**Location**

Mumbai

**Reporting To**

Lead - Design

**Job Summary**

The Interior Designer is responsible for developing creative and functional design solutions for commercial interior fit-out projects. The role involves space planning, concept development, material selection, preparation of design presentations, and coordination with project execution teams to ensure successful implementation of design intent. The position requires strong design sensibility, technical knowledge, and the ability to deliver innovative workplace environments that align with client requirements, project budgets, and timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop concept designs, mood boards, and design presentations for commercial interior fit-out projects.
* Prepare space planning layouts, furniture layouts, ceiling plans, flooring plans, elevations, sections, and detailed design drawings.
* Create 3D visualizations and renderings to communicate design concepts effectively.
* Select and specify materials, finishes, furniture, fixtures, and accessories in line with project requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, and project teams throughout the design process.
* Prepare design documentation and support preparation of Good for Construction (GFC) drawings.
* Work closely with MEP, QS, Procurement, and Project Execution teams to ensure design feasibility and constructability.
* Conduct site visits for measurements, design verification, and execution support.
* Review shop drawings, material submittals, and mock-ups to ensure alignment with approved designs.
* Incorporate client feedback and site requirements into design revisions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards, codes, and company design guidelines.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging materials, workplace strategies, and interior design innovations.
* Maintain project documentation, drawing revisions, and design records.
* Any other duties as assigned by management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications in design software or visualization tools will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **5+ years** of experience in Commercial Interior Fit-Out, Workplace Interiors, Corporate Office Projects, Retail, or Hospitality Interiors.
* Experience in handling design development and coordination for end-to-end interior projects.
* Exposure to large-scale corporate office fit-out projects is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Strong knowledge of SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, Lumion, or similar design and visualization software.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and PowerPoint.
* Strong understanding of space planning and workplace design principles.
* Knowledge of interior construction details, materials, finishes, furniture systems, and fit-out methodologies.
* Basic understanding of MEP coordination and construction processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Creativity and Design Thinking.
* Strong Presentation Skills.
* Communication and Client Management.
* Attention to Detail.
* Problem Solving and Decision Making.
* Time Management.
* Team Collaboration.
* Adaptability and Innovation.

**Working Relationships**

**Internal Stakeholders**

* Design Team
* Project Management Team
* MEP Team
* Quantity Surveying Team
* Procurement Team
* Factory & Production Team
* Business Development Team
* Planning Team

**External Stakeholders**

* Clients
* Architects and Design Consultants
* Vendors and Suppliers
* Contractors and Subcontractors

**Travel Requirements**

**Occasional** – Travel to project sites, client locations, vendor showrooms, and coordination meetings as required.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Design Engineer
description:
We're looking for a cracked Design Engineer

At Totem, we solve expensive leaks for enterprises with custom-built automations, digitization for legacy businesses with high-converting authoritative websites and self-driving apps, and product partners for founders.

I'm looking for someone with exceptional taste, design judgment and the technical ability to go from idea to impact

We run a tight ship and work directly with the clients and me, That means that you will be speaking to business leaders and have the autonomy to decide what gets built and how and will own outcomes, not just outputs.

Who you could be:

* a designer who became exceptionally good at engineering.

* an engineer who developed exceptional taste and product intuition.

* someone who's owned and shipped products end to end and can demonstrate the impact of their decisions.

* someone who can sit across from a CEO, understand their business, challenge their assumptions and translate that conversation into a working product.

you should be proficient in React, Next.js, TypeScript, CSS, API integrations and modern AI assisted development. what you can accomplish with your stack matters more than how many technologies you know.

(You've shipped websites that established authority for businesses and converted visitors into customers. you've taken an underperforming website, app, product or store and turned it around through design and engineering. you have the receipts to prove it.)

What you'll actually do:

* understand the business, identify what's broken and map the entire user experience, not just the UI.

* design and ship beautiful, high converting websites, web apps, products and ecommerce experiences.

* establish brand authority through design, positioning, copy and interactions without spending a month figuring out the colour palette.

* take over existing products, identify bottlenecks and turn them around.

* build frontends that don't explode in production. own performance, responsiveness, usability and quality.

* measure the impact of your work. more conversions, better activation, fewer drop offs, more revenue. whatever actually matters to the business.

good to know:

conversion psychology, brand positioning, motion design, design systems, copywriting, analytics, accessibility and a decent understanding of how businesses make money and where they lose money because of bad digital experiences

don't apply if this sounds like you:

* you don't have taste

* you have taste and think that's all it takes.

* you can't think for yourself.

* you don't want to talk to clients or enterprise leaders.

* you can't own, explain or defend your design decisions.

* you think client approval is a substitute for your own standard of quality.

* you need 2 weeks of discovery, 5 stakeholders and a 4 week branding sprint to make a business look credible.

* you don't have your own set of references, libraries, tools and a playbook that consistently drives results.

* your frontend looks considerably better in Figma than it does in production.

Now that the bots have departed :)

We don't particularly care where you've worked, how many years of experience you have or what fancy brands are on your résumé. Remuneration is equally proportionate to the results.

i care about what you've shipped, the problems you've solved and the standard you hold yourself to.

If you are a cracked fresher with less experience on paper but more in real life.

Link, artifact or vercel preview.

We encourage the use of AI to to test thoroughly and ship rapidly. We call this the open canvas assignment because anybody can draw with a coloring book.

We're a Mumbai based software lab that started off building games and interactive experiences, doing nearly 200,000 downloads and working with top three publishers of the world. Giving us the product mindset to extract the ROI from software after our pivot.

Our company has two segments Service and SaaS, we operate a tight team, so we look for people capable of wearing multiple hats.

One of our products, Velocity, makes people better at using AI without requiring them to switch platforms or learn prompt engineering. With nearly 10,000 users and being used in over 32 companies, we have saved users thousands of hours.

We work across industries, technologies and business models. the common denominator is solving problems worth solving.

our motto is simple: ruthless speed to results. sustained value beyond initial impact.

title: Architect Logistics
description:
**Role Title -**
Architect - Logistics Systems

**Location -**
Pune / Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

**About Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center is the technology hub for Williams-Sonoma, Inc., supporting global digital commerce, supply chain, enterprise platforms, and customer experiences across our portfolio of brands. The India Technology Center partners closely with global business and engineering teams to build scalable, resilient, and innovative platforms that serve millions of customers worldwide.

https://www.linkedin.com/company/williams-sonoma-inc-/life/1db504b6-8aaf-47f0-9d53-2931be7a5b8f/

**About the Team**

The Logistics Technology team builds and supports the platforms that move products across the WSI supply chain, from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. The team partners with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, product teams, delivery teams, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable solutions that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership team where architects and engineers work end to end: setting technical direction, designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how the distribution network runs every day.

**About the Role**

The Senior Architect will own the Logistics systems domain and provide broad technical leadership across Warehouse Management, Warehouse Execution, Warehouse Control, and Transportation Management platforms. The role sets architectural direction, defines and governs technical standards, and translates large programs and strategic initiatives into viable, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

The role requires a senior technical leader who can operate as a domain subject matter expert, influence product and engineering direction, partner effectively with business stakeholders and vendors such as Manhattan Associates, and mentor architects and engineering practitioners across the enterprise.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set technical direction for the Logistics systems domain and ensure project and program designs align with enterprise principles, standards, and constraints.
* Create viable solution approaches for complex programs, decompose them into logical components, and define responsibilities, integration points, and dependencies across layers and systems.
* Propose and evaluate alternative designs, clearly articulate trade-offs, and make sound architectural decisions across competing approaches.
* Assess design impact across solution components and adjacent domain systems, including implications over a three-to-five-year horizon.
* Define and own enterprise integration architecture across WMS, WES, WCS, OMS, RMS, ERP, and TMS landscapes, including integration boundaries, canonical data flows, and system-of-record ownership.
* Decide the right integration style for each interaction, including synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven, and batch patterns, and document rationale, failure modes, idempotency, and recovery expectations.
* Design and govern reusable integration patterns, templates, service contracts, and reference implementations that delivery teams can adopt without rework.
* Define and advise on enterprise API standards, including versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation policy, governance, and security.
* Lead performance engineering for high-throughput and low-latency logistics workloads, including performance test strategy, capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, and ongoing optimization.
* Apply product thinking to platform and integration decisions by prioritizing capabilities based on user outcomes, business value, consumer needs, and roadmap alignment.
* Partner with product management and business teams to understand strategic initiatives and help decompose programs into deliverable projects.
* Initiate, lead, and contribute to creation and review of organizational technical standards, design principles, and architecture governance practices.
* Provide technical direction to architects and practitioners across Logistics and adjacent domains, review solution work, and mentor teams on complex technical topics.
* Accept ambiguity in large initiatives and devise practical approaches to resolve or accommodate uncertainty while maintaining delivery momentum.

**Required Qualifications-**

**Experience**

* 14+ years of software engineering and solution architecture experience, including at least 5 years in an architect role owning a business or systems domain.
* Proven track record setting architectural direction for enterprise-scale logistics, supply chain, retail, or distribution systems.
* Experience delivering in Agile environments, including program decomposition, estimation, and delivery tracking using Jira.
* Experience operating as a recognized subject matter expert across multiple major functions within a domain.

**Functional Expertise**

* Proficient knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems, Warehouse Execution Systems, Warehouse Control Systems, and Transportation Management systems.
* Strong understanding of Distribution Center operations, slotting, labor management, fulfillment flows, and logistics execution processes.
* Hands-on experience with Manhattan WMOS and Manhattan Slotting, including third-party vendor integrations.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology direction to revenue, cost, service-level, and operational goals.
* Ability to learn adjacent skills and domains quickly where needed to make sound enterprise architecture decisions.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep technical expertise in microservices architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and scalable infrastructure design.
* Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful web services, and event-driven integration using Kafka.
* Strong relational database skills across DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle, including data modeling for high-volume transactional systems.
* Experience with Kubernetes or similar container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of secure coding standards, Git branching strategy, and code quality tools such as Sonar.
* Proficiency with observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana.
* Breadth across REST, messaging, streaming, file and batch interfaces, API gateways, and middleware, with sound judgment to select the right pattern for each use case.
* Experience defining API and event contract standards, including versioning, backward compatibility, schema evolution, and governance forums.
* Strong background in performance and load test design, throughput and latency profiling, capacity planning, and tuning of high-volume transactional systems.
* Working knowledge of zero-trust principles, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, mTLS, token and secrets management, and API security controls.

**AI and Automation Skills**

* AI-first mindset with the ability to define where AI and automation can create durable business and operational value.
* Experience using AI tools, AI agents, or automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, documentation, or knowledge retrieval.
* Ability to architect AI-agent led solutions for issue triage, exception monitoring, report generation, regression testing support, operational analytics, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Practical understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, Model Context Protocol, agent tooling patterns, and safe grounding of AI in enterprise data and systems.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, validation of AI-generated outputs, and agent behavior evaluation.
* Awareness of AI security considerations such as prompt injection, data leakage, model and tool access control, tenant isolation, and guarded tool execution.
* Awareness of emerging supply chain data and compliance requirements such as Digital Product Passports and product traceability mandates.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Demonstrated situational leadership with the ability to guide teams, drive execution, and deliver measurable business value.
* Ability to facilitate productive discussions across diverse stakeholder groups and drive alignment on architectural decisions.
* Experience mentoring architects and engineers and raising engineering standards across an organization.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain, defend, and adapt architectural decisions for both technical and business audiences.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people-first and performance-driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career, and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership environment that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce and supply chain platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

title: Advisor, Software Architecture
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Software Architecture
  
  
**What does a successful Software Architecture Advisor do at Fiserv?**
We are looking for a Software Architecture Advisor to help shape the design and modernization of high-throughput payment processing and financial clearing platforms. title: Director, Software Engineering (Technology & Architecture Principal)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Director, Software Engineering (Technology & Architecture Principal)
  
  
Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology & Architecture)
  
  
**Overview**
The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
  
  
RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
  
  
Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
  
  
Role
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture & technology leadership for multiple Real-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
  
  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design & architecture excellence
* Contributes & drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology & implementation decisions including all non-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability

The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
  
  

* Design & Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering & Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency & Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership & Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.

**All About You**
Experience & Technical Expertise
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.

Technology Breadth
  
  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands-on experience across object-oriented & functional programming languages - Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang
* Experience working across multiple technology stacks and system layers (application, messaging, data, platform).
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized environments; ability to operate effectively across heterogeneous market deployments.
* Payments or financial services experience (e.g., real time processing, regulated environments) is a strong plus.

Leadership & Ways of Working
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making high impact technical decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on long term platform health, not just short term delivery.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sr Architect (Servicenow ITOM)
description:
**Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect**
**Company:**
Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)
  
  
**Location:**
India (Remote / Hybrid)
  
  
**Function:**
AI & Automation — Engineering
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**ServiceNow ITOM Expert**
to join our AI and Tools Automation team. You will own the design, implementation, and evolution of our IT Operations Management capabilities on ServiceNow — spanning Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB governance, and AI-powered auto-remediation workflows. You will be a technical authority who can work independently, integrate ITOM deeply with monitoring platforms like
**LogicMonitor, AppDynamics, SentryOne**
, and drive intelligent, self-healing IT operations across a complex healthcare IT environment.
  
  
This is not a configuration role — we need someone who architects, engineers, and leads.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**ITOM Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and Health Log Analytics (HLA)
* Define platform standards, integration patterns, and governance models for ITOM across the organization
* Lead technical design reviews, contribute to architectural decisions, and represent ITOM in cross-functional planning
* Independently investigate, debug, and resolve complex ITOM platform issues — from MID Server failures to CMDB reconciliation conflicts — without escalation
* Identify opportunities to consolidate, automate, and modernize legacy monitoring and event workflows

**Discovery & CMDB Governance**

* Design and maintain ServiceNow Discovery patterns — horizontal, vertical, and cloud discovery across on-prem, Azure, and hybrid environments
* Own CMDB health — deduplication, reconciliation rules, CI relationships, data certification, and lifecycle management
* Build and enforce CMDB governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
* Manage Service Mapping — application service discovery, dependency mapping, and business service modeling aligned to healthcare IT operations
* Design CI class structures, identification and reconciliation rules, and IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) policies

**Event Management & AIOps**

* Architect and manage the Event Management pipeline — connector configuration, alert ingestion, event correlation rules, and suppression logic
* Configure and tune Health Log Analytics (HLA) for log-based anomaly detection and noise reduction
* Build intelligent alert correlation and deduplication rules to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate MTTR
* Design event-to-incident promotion workflows with smart routing, priority assignment, and SLA alignment
* Integrate LogicMonitor as a primary event source — mapping LM alert payloads to ServiceNow event schema, managing thresholds, and ensuring bidirectional status synchronization

**Auto-Remediation & Intelligent Workflows**

* Design and build auto-heal workflows that trigger automated remediation actions in response to ITOM events — owning the architectural principle that condition-determination logic belongs in the monitoring layer (LogicMonitor), with ServiceNow executing remediation based on clean, pre-evaluated signals
* Build Flow Designer and Integration Hub workflows for automated incident response, CI status updates, and cross-platform orchestration
* Develop spoke integrations and REST/MID-based connectors for third-party tools
* Implement safety checks and precondition validations within remediation flows to prevent unintended actions in production environments
* Continuously improve auto-remediation coverage and reliability through feedback loops with the monitoring team

**MID Server & Integration Engineering**

* Own MID Server architecture — deployment topology, cluster configuration, upgrades, health monitoring, and failover
* Design and maintain integration architecture between ServiceNow and external platforms — LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Kubernetes, and other operational tools
* Build and maintain REST, SOAP, and scripted integrations using Integration Hub, Scripted REST APIs, and Import Sets
* Manage credentials, connection pooling, and secure credential storage using ServiceNow Credential Vault

**AI-Augmented Engineering**

* Actively use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — for scripting, debugging, documentation, and solution design
* Leverage AI to accelerate complex problem-solving — generating Business Rules, Flow Designer logic, Scripted REST endpoints, and Groovy/JavaScript-based scripts faster and with higher quality
* Use AI to explore and prototype new ITOM automation patterns and self-healing use cases
* Stay current with ServiceNow’s native AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, NLU, and Virtual Agent — and assess their applicability to the team’s operational goals

**Azure & Cloud Integration**

* Deep understanding of Azure platform as it relates to ITOM — Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Log Analytics Workspaces, Event Grid, and resource tagging models
* Architect cloud discovery and service mapping for Azure-hosted workloads — VMs, AKS clusters, PaaS services, and resource groups
* Integrate Azure-native alerting and telemetry into the ServiceNow Event Management pipeline
* Understand Azure RBAC and Entra ID as they apply to MID Server service accounts, API integrations, and CMDB data sources

**GitHub & Development Practices**

* Operate confidently in GitHub — maintain ITOM configuration as code where possible, manage update sets through version control, and use GitHub Actions for deployment automation
* Document integration designs, flow logic, and architectural decisions clearly and maintain them in source control
* Apply software engineering discipline to ServiceNow scripting — clean code, peer review, and regression testing before deployment to production

**Platform Governance & Mentorship**

* Own the ITOM module’s platform health — upgrades, deprecation planning, performance tuning, and licensing awareness
* Define and enforce development standards for ITOM scripting, flow design, and integration work
* Mentor developers (such as Kamalesh) working on ITOM-adjacent tasks and conduct structured code and configuration reviews
* Contribute to organization-wide ITSM/ITOM alignment — ensuring CMDB, Event Management, and incident workflows operate as a cohesive system

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of ServiceNow experience, with 4+ years specialized in ITOM — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB
* Expert-level knowledge of MID Server architecture, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Deep proficiency in ServiceNow scripting — JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST APIs, Scheduled Jobs
* Strong command of Flow Designer and Integration Hub
* Proven experience building event-driven auto-remediation workflows at production scale
* Deep, hands-on Azure platform knowledge — Monitor, Arc, Log Analytics, Event Grid, Entra ID; able to architect cloud ITOM integrations independently
* Experience integrating LogicMonitor or comparable monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SCOM) with ServiceNow Event Management
* GitHub proficiency — branching, PRs, Actions-based CI/CD, and managing ServiceNow config artifacts in source control
* Strong independent debugging skills — able to own and resolve complex, multi-system issues without escalation
* Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in day-to-day engineering — uses AI to solve problems, generate scripts, and prototype solutions
* Excellent communication skills — can represent ITOM architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Health Log Analytics (HLA) and log-based AIOps
* Familiarity with Kubernetes / AKS monitoring and CMDB integration for containerized workloads
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence and ML-based alert correlation
* Exposure to ITSM modules (Incident, Change, Problem) and their integration touchpoints with ITOM
* Familiarity with LogicMonitor platform internals — DataSources, alert payloads, Groovy scripting
* Understanding of healthcare IT environments and compliance considerations
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist — ITOM certification
* Experience with Virtual Agent or NLU for ITOM self-service scenarios

**Who You Are**

* An ITOM engineer who treats the platform as a product — not a tool to configure, but a system to architect and own
* Deeply self-sufficient — you debug across MID Servers, CMDB reconciliation logs, Flow Designer execution histories, and REST payloads without waiting to be unblocked
* You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster and sharper
* You hold strong architectural opinions and can defend them clearly — including knowing where logic belongs (monitoring layer vs. remediation layer)
* Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you are the ITOM domain authority
* A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across adjacent team members
* You care about data quality in the CMDB the same way a data engineer cares about pipeline reliability

title: SRE+ GCP Lead II - DevOps Engineering
description:
**Role description**  

ob Description: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

**Experience:** 7+ Years  
**Role:** Senior Site Reliability Engineer  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** to own and improve the reliability of mission-critical, multi-region workloads running on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role focused on **cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, automation, observability, incident management, CI/CD modernization, security, and resilience**.

The successful candidate will lead major incidents, define and manage **Service Level Objectives (SLOs)**, modernize delivery pipelines, build comprehensive observability solutions, reduce operational toil through automation, and collaborate with engineering, product, application, and security teams to improve overall platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities

### **Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering**

* Operate and troubleshoot **multi-region Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)** workloads.
* Manage **node pools, Workload Identity, Istio, Anthos Service Mesh, ingress/egress, and Private Service Connect** across multiple environments.
* Manage cloud projects, networking, IAM, and workload configurations using **Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm**.
* Deliver infrastructure changes through **pull-request workflows and automated deployment pipelines**.
* Design secure, scalable, and reusable platform patterns for application teams.

### **CI/CD & Delivery Automation**

* Implement, extend, and troubleshoot **GitHub Actions**, reusable workflows, OIDC authentication, and **ArgoCD GitOps** deployment processes.
* Lead the modernization and migration of legacy **Jenkins pipelines** to secure CI/CD workflows.
* Implement appropriate **quality and security gates** within delivery pipelines.
* Champion engineering practices including **trunk-based development, semantic versioning, canary releases, and blue-green deployments**.

### **Observability, SLOs & Incident Management**

* Design and maintain **APM, distributed tracing, infrastructure monitoring, log monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-based monitoring**.
* Develop operational and executive dashboards using **Datadog or equivalent observability platforms**.
* Correlate telemetry and trace data across cloud logging and observability platforms.
* Act as **Incident Commander for P1/P2 production incidents**, coordinating technical investigation, rollback, traffic shifting, recovery, and stakeholder communication.
* Coordinate incident activities using platforms such as **PagerDuty and ServiceNow**.
* Lead **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Define **golden-signal SLIs and SLOs** and monitor error-budget burn rates.
* Use error budgets to support release decisions and prioritize reliability improvements.

Production Troubleshooting & Software Engineering

* Use **BigQuery** and large-scale log analytics to reconstruct transaction timelines, analyze data discrepancies, and assess business impact.
* Troubleshoot **Java and Spring Boot microservices** in production environments.
* Analyze **JVM thread dumps, garbage collection, concurrency issues, and application performance problems**.
* Partner with development teams to identify and implement code-level fixes.
* Reduce operational toil through automation using **Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Go**.
* Build automation for activities such as certificate rotation, cleanup, audit evidence collection, and operational tooling.

Security, Governance & Resilience

* Work within regulated environments governed by standards such as **PCI DSS and SOC 2**.
* Support remediation of application and infrastructure security findings using tools such as **Fortify, Nexus IQ, SonarQube, and Qualys**.
* Implement **Zero Trust and least-privilege IAM principles**.
* Support controlled change-management processes and **Production Readiness Reviews**.
* Ensure new services have appropriate **monitoring, runbooks, operational procedures, and capacity planning** before production launch.
* Design and validate **multi-region failover and disaster-recovery strategies**.
* Define and validate **Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)**.
* Participate in periodic disaster-recovery testing and resilience exercises.
* Monitor cloud utilization and optimize infrastructure for **cost, performance, capacity, and reliability**.

Technical Leadership

* Translate platform and reliability risks into clear business impact for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers and promote strong **Site Reliability Engineering practices**.
* Lead a **blameless postmortem culture** focused on learning and continuous improvement.
* Maintain high-quality technical documentation, operational runbooks, and engineering work items.
* Apply **AI-assisted engineering tools**, including AI-driven root-cause analysis and log analysis, to improve operational efficiency and incident response.

Required Skills & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline**, or equivalent practical experience.
* **7+ years of experience** in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Production Engineering.
* At least **3 years of experience supporting high-availability, production-grade systems**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Deep experience with **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Kubernetes, service mesh, Workload Identity, and private networking**.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code expertise using **Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm**.
* Production experience with **GitHub Actions and ArgoCD**.
* Experience modernizing or migrating legacy **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Strong observability experience using **Datadog or comparable platforms**, including distributed tracing and SLO implementation.
* Proven experience managing or coordinating **major production incidents and Root Cause Analysis**.
* Strong programming and scripting capabilities in **Python**, along with at least one of **Bash, PowerShell, or Go**.
* Experience working in regulated or security-sensitive environments.
* Strong understanding of **SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, reliability engineering, and production readiness**.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical risks to both engineering teams and leadership.

Preferred Skills

* **Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect**, **Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer**, or **Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)** certification.
* Production-level troubleshooting experience with **Java and Spring Boot**, including JVM-level debugging.
* Hands-on experience with **BigQuery**, including large-scale log analysis and cloud billing data.
* Experience with **FinOps and cloud cost optimization**.
* Experience designing and testing **multi-region disaster-recovery solutions**.
* Experience leading **Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migrations**.
* Experience using **AI-assisted engineering tools** for incident investigation, automation, root-cause analysis, or log analysis.
* **ITIL Foundation certification** or equivalent service-management experience.
* Additional language proficiency may be advantageous depending on business requirements.

  
**Skills**

description:

**Role:** Lead Integration Architect

**Experience:** 6+ Years

**Location:** Gurgaon and Pune

**Business Services Team Overview**

Our Business Services team is a collective of creative, strategic, forward-thinking business enablers. Together, the People & Culture, Marketing & Communications, IT, Operations, Finance and Quality & Risk Management teams make it their mission to ensure Forvis Mazars has the right tools, technology, strategies and services in place to deliver exceptional client service and future-proof our growing firm.

**Job Purpose**

The Integration Architect supports the definition and implementation of the organisation’s integration architecture, helping ensure that applications, platforms and data services connect securely, reliably and consistently across the enterprise.

Working with the IT Architecture Team Lead, senior and domain architects, and the Data and Integration Technical Product Owner, the role translates agreed technology strategy, business requirements and architecture principles into practical integration designs, reusable patterns and delivery artefacts. The Data and Integration Technical Product Owner and integration developers support the architect in shaping designs and translating them into effective delivery. Integration Support resources provide critical operational links to the Integration Architect, bringing service insight, recurring issues, supportability requirements and production feedback into architecture decisions. The Integration Architect provides hands-on architecture support for integrations delivered through the Workato integration platform as well as justified point-to-point interfaces.

The role covers API-led integration, event-driven integration, batch and file exchange, ETL and ELT, application connectivity, orchestration, data mapping, error handling, monitoring and operational support. It assesses when Workato should be used as the strategic integration platform and when a direct integration is proportionate, considering reuse, cost, risk, scalability, security, performance and supportability.

The role is expected to simplify the integration landscape, reduce unmanaged point-to-point complexity, improve reuse and observability, and help delivery teams implement dependable integrations while developing strong architecture capability across UK, India and Group IT teams.

**Key Accountabilities**

Integration strategy delivery

* Translate agreed technology and integration strategy into practical designs, standards, roadmaps and delivery activities.
* Contribute to current-state, target-state and transition architecture for the enterprise integration landscape.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate interfaces, increase reuse and migrate suitable integrations to Workato.

Integration architecture and solution design

* Produce integration architecture options and solution designs for projects, products and business change.
* Select an appropriate approach, including Workato recipes, APIs, events, managed file transfer, batch exchange or justified point-to-point connectivity.
* Evaluate options against business value, cost, risk, performance, scalability, security, supportability and delivery complexity.

Workato platform architecture

* Define and apply architecture patterns for Workato workspaces, recipes, connections, environments, reusable components and deployment.
* Use Workato capabilities effectively while avoiding unnecessary platform coupling or recipe proliferation.
* Address platform capacity, licensing, lifecycle, monitoring, access and operational support considerations.

APIs, events and data exchange

* Design APIs, events, messages, batch processes and file-based exchanges aligned to enterprise patterns.
* Define contracts, schemas, mappings, orchestration, sequencing, idempotency, retry and exception handling.

Point-to-point integration management

* Assess existing and proposed point-to-point integrations and confirm where direct connectivity is justified.
* Ensure direct integrations meet appropriate security, documentation, monitoring, resilience and support standards.
* Identify brittle, duplicated or unmanaged interfaces and propose remediation or migration routes.

Security, controls and compliance

* Embed authentication, authorisation, encryption, secrets management, data minimisation and audit requirements into designs.
* Ensure integrations comply with data classification, privacy, retention, regulatory and risk requirements.
* Document material threats, controls, exceptions and residual risks with Security and Risk teams.

Delivery enablement and assurance

* Engage early with projects, product teams and the Data and Integration Technical Product Owner to shape integration requirements, priorities and options.
* Work closely with integration developers to refine architecture into implementable designs, resolve delivery questions and maintain alignment through build and testing.
* Prepare designs for Technical Design Authority, recording decisions, exceptions, risks and technical debt.
* Support build, testing, deployment, transition, operational handover and resolution of design issues.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or strategically significant decisions appropriately.

Collaboration and capability development

* Work effectively across UK, India and Group IT teams, including collaboration across time zones.
* Maintain a close working relationship with the Data and Integration Technical Product Owner, using product priorities and roadmap context to guide architecture decisions.
* Partner with integration developers throughout design and delivery, providing patterns, guardrails, reviews and timely architecture decisions.
* Treat Integration Support resources as a critical link to the architecture function, using operational insight, incidents, recurring defects and service risks to improve designs and standards.
* Contribute integration knowledge, reusable patterns and constructive design challenge, while developing personal architecture and Workato capability.

Architecture quality and documentation

* Produce integration artefacts including diagrams, interface catalogues, API and event contracts, mappings, options papers, high-level designs, standards, patterns and decision records.
* Ensure artefacts are accurate, version-controlled, reusable and accessible.
* Improve integration reference architectures, templates and documentation quality.

  

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

**Working with technology and integration leadership**

Work with the IT Architecture Team Lead, Data and Integration Technical Product Owner, senior and domain architects, integration developers and platform teams to implement agreed integration priorities.

Translate business outcomes and non-functional requirements into integration options, patterns, contracts and solution designs.

Provide evidence on feasibility, dependencies, sequencing, cost, risk and architectural trade-offs.

Maintain traceability between requirements, decisions, interface contracts and delivered integrations.

**Business and application landscape understanding**

Understand business processes, enterprise applications, data flows, integration dependencies and operational pain points.

Clarify integration requirements and ownership with stakeholders, the Data and Integration Technical Product Owner, integration developers, Integration Support resources and vendors.

Explain integration options, risks and decisions in clear language.

**Integration landscape and roadmap contribution**

Maintain documentation of interfaces, applications, endpoints, protocols, owners, dependencies and support arrangements.

Contribute to roadmaps for Workato adoption, integration simplification, API enablement and legacy reduction.

Identify duplication, unsupported interfaces and single points of failure and propose remediation.

**Patterns, standards and reusable assets**

Apply reusable patterns for Workato recipes, APIs, events, files, batch processing, orchestration, error handling and observability.

Use consistent naming, versioning, schema, mapping, security, logging and documentation standards.

Promote reuse of approved connectors, recipes, APIs and reference designs.

**Governance and design assurance**

Prepare and present integration designs for Technical Design Authority and related forums.

Apply governance proportionately to business criticality, data sensitivity, complexity and risk.

Record decisions and exceptions clearly and follow through agreed actions.

**Continuous improvement and professional development**

Improve integration methods, interface catalogues, repositories, templates, measures and knowledge sharing.

Maintain awareness of Workato, APIs, event-driven architecture, integration security, automation and cloud integration.

Build capability through training, mentoring, communities and practical delivery experience, sharing learning across architecture, product, development and support teams.

Support colleagues with integration architecture practices and evidence-based design challenge.

* Professional, ethical and aligned to Forvis Mazars values, demonstrating integrity, judgement and accountability.

**Outcome**

Integration priorities become clear roadmaps, patterns, designs and delivery artefacts.

title: AI Data & Platform Engineer | Senior Associate
description:
**About Interpath**
Interpath is an independent financial advisory business with a broad range of specialisms, operating in an agile, independent and conflict-free setting. We offer a full spectrum of restructuring services, from business performance improvement and value creation through to stress, distress and insolvency. Our advisory practice also includes corporate finance, transaction services, valuations, debt advisory, tax, pensions, forensic accounting and e-discovery. We help clients create, defend, preserve, sustain and grow value through the cycle, working with businesses and their stakeholders across the market, from regional SMEs to large, complex multinational organisations.
  
  
**About The AI CoE**
Interpath's AI Centre of Excellence designs and builds AI solutions with practices across the firm, taking high-impact use cases from idea to production. The India team is small and hands-on: five people — an AI CoE Lead, two AI Engineers, a Data & Platform Engineer and an AI Business Partner — working as one squad with the Head of AI and practice teams across the firm.
  
  
**About The Role**
In professional-services AI, much of the work is getting the right information out of documents and systems. You will own that work (ingestion, extraction, pipelines and retrieval) and the shared platform the team deploys onto, working with central IT, who own the wider cloud environment.
  
  
**Requirements**
****Key responsibilities****

* Ingest and extract — build pipelines that bring in documents (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned files) and data from practice systems; handle OCR, parsing, tables and metadata
* Build the retrieval layer — chunking, embeddings, indexing and search, tuned for accuracy on our documents
* Protect data — enforce access permissions, confidentiality boundaries between clients and engagements, retention and audit
* Run the platform — deployment pipelines, environments, secrets, a shared model gateway, logging and monitoring
* Manage cost and performance — track model and cloud spend; use caching, model routing and capacity planning to keep it efficient
* Partner with central IT — network, identity and cloud landing-zone requirements
* Keep data trustworthy — data quality checks, lineage and documentation

****Required qualifications****

* 3+ years in data engineering, with platform or DevOps responsibilities
* Strong Python and SQL; experience building production data pipelines
* Document processing experience (PDF parsing, OCR, Azure AI Document Intelligence or similar)
* Cloud infrastructure, ideally Azure: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, monitoring
* Solid understanding of data security, access control and privacy

**Preferred (nice To Have)**

* Vector databases and RAG pipelines in production
* LLMOps: model gateways, observability tooling, cost tracking
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse; SharePoint / Graph API data access

**Tech & tools**
Python, SQL, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search / pgvector, Azure Data Factory / Fabric / Databricks, Azure Functions, Terraform / Bicep, Docker, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor / Application Insights.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like In Year One**

* Reusable ingestion and retrieval pipelines serving every live use case
* A deployable, monitored platform with clear cost reporting and agreed security controls

**Benefits**
**Benefits**
At Interpath, our people are at the heart of our business. That's why we provide employees with a competitive and comprehensive reward package, including compelling salaries, opportunities for progression, and a range of core and optional benefits.
  
  
Hybrid working policy which includes a minimum of 3 days in the office at all levels.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values shape how we work with colleagues and clients:
  
  

* Embrace different — We welcome different cultures, perspectives and mindsets
* Do the right thing — We make principled decisions, even when they are not the easiest option
* All hands on deck — We work together, drawing on individual expertise to deliver results
* Passion drives success — We challenge the status quo and focus on delivering positive outcomes for our clients

Connect with potential clients, government departments, and key decision-makers.

Prepare client presentations and business proposals.

Attend industry events, meetings, and networking sessions.

Prepare company profiles, capability presentations, and case studies.

Conduct client presentations and explain company services and solutions.

Maintain professional communication with clients and business partners.

Support marketing and business development activities.

**5. Reporting & Business Development**

Maintain records of business opportunities, tenders, and proposals.

Prepare regular reports on business pipeline, submissions, and project outcomes.

Track proposal status and conduct client follow-ups.

Support business development planning and targets.

Work with the Product Lead to identify market opportunities.

Conduct competitor and market research.

Identify potential customers for GRASP.

Support product sales, marketing, and business development activities.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1658635

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**Senior Security Consulting**

**EY Technology:**

  

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  

EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:

  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds, and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity**

  

As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and controls, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Support a technical team with a focuse on the following responsibilities:
* Define security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
* Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in the following areas:
* Identity and Access Management – Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
* Cloud Security – Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Application Security - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills
* Ability to appropriately balance firm security needs with business impact & benefit
* Ability to facilitate compromise to incrementally advance security strategy and objectives
* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
* Operational Security – Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
* Information Security Standards – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
* Product Management – working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.
* Agile & DevSecOps Methodologies – Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

  

* Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Excellent , communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings, and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
