title: Sr IT Engineer, Endpoint & Workplace
description:
**Sr IT Engineer, Endpoint & Workplace**
========================================

GURGAON, IN, 122001 GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

  

**Position Overview**

The Sr IT Engineer, Endpoint & Workplace is a senior technical leadership role responsible for the strategy, architecture, engineering, and continuous evolution of the enterprise endpoint and digital workspace environment.

  

This role serves as a subject matter expert and technical authority across endpoint management, device provisioning, virtual desktop services, mobile device management, and enterprise printing. The position will establish technical direction and engineering standards across Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), Windows 365, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Mobile Device Management (MDM), and cloud-based printing.

  

This role goes beyond day-to-day administration. You will lead solution design, influence technology strategy, establish engineering standards, drive modernization, mentor technical teams, and partner across Security, Infrastructure, and Architecture to deliver secure, scalable, and employee-focused workplace services. The successful candidate will operate within an Agile product-line model as a subject-matter expert and trusted technical advisor, translating business and technology strategy into secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable solutions.

  

This role is also required to participate in the creation and approval of new standards as part of an architectural standards board and support the global architectural function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for enterprise endpoint and workspace technologies.
* Define architecture, engineering standards, reference designs, and technology roadmaps for endpoint management, VDI, Cloud PC, mobility, and printing.
* Lead the engineering and optimization of Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and SCCM, including device configuration, application deployment, compliance, security baselines, updates, and lifecycle management.
* Drive the modernization of endpoint management from traditional infrastructure toward cloud-first, automated management and provisioning.
* Lead technical design and engineering for Windows 365 and VDI, including architecture, application delivery, image management, security, connectivity, performance, and employee experience.
* Define engineering standards and capabilities for MDM and Mobile Application Management (MAM) across corporate and personally owned devices.
* Lead the modernization of enterprise printing and cloud printing, including Microsoft Universal Print, secure printing, provisioning, and print infrastructure.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and Identity teams to integrate device compliance, access, identity, authentication, and endpoint security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to use automation, analytics, and self-service to improve the employee experience and reduce operational complexity.
* Evaluate emerging workplace technologies and provide recommendations on architecture, investment, adoption, risk, and business value.
* Lead technical design reviews, proofs of concept, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex engineering challenges.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance to operational and support teams.
  

**Level of Education and Discipline**  
  
Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field; graduate degree an asset.
  
  
**Certification and/or Licenses**
  
  
Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365, InTune, SCCM, Azure, security, or enterprise architecture are considered assets.
  
  
**Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen**

* 12+ Years of IT experience, with significant experience designing, engineering, and supporting enterprise endpoint and digital workplace technologies in a large, complex global environment, including 2+ years in a lead/architect role guiding technical teams.
* Significant experience designing, engineering, and supporting enterprise endpoint and Digital Workplace technologies in a large-scale environment focusing on End User Experience Design
* Advanced experience designing seamless digital workplace experiences with Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management
* Strong knowledge of OS deployment strategies which include Autopilot, automated device provisioning, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), MDT and hybrid/cloud endpoint management models.
* Experience designing, engineering and managing VDI and/or Windows 365 environments across global markets.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Endpoint architecture, security, application deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing or supporting enterprise printing, preferably including cloud-based print architecture.
* Experience developing technical architecture, engineering standards, roadmaps, and solution documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple infrastructure, security, architecture, and support teams.
  

Technical Skills

  

Strong knowledge designing or engineering and hands-on experience across:

* Microsoft Intune
* Windows Autopilot
* Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM)
* Windows 11
* Windows 365 Cloud PC
* VDI technologies
* Mobile Device Management (MDM)
* Mobile Application Management (MAM)
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft 365
* Endpoint security and compliance
* Application packaging, deployment and delivery
* Application lifecycle management, virtualization, and patching
  

**Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence**  
  
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business risks, options, and recommendations.
  
  
**Other Skills and HPO Competencies**

**Accountable:**

  

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical leadership, strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and influencing skills. They must be able to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences and effectively influence architecture and technology decisions across multiple teams.

  

The role requires the ability to work across organizational boundaries, challenge existing approaches constructively, build consensus, mentor technical resources, and lead complex initiatives without depending solely on formal authority. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential, along with the ability to balance employee experience, cybersecurity, operational complexity, cost, and long-term technology strategy..

  

**Deliverables:**

  

* **Solution Architecture**: Ability to translate complex business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technology designs.
* **Technical Leadership**: Ability to provide direction, establish standards, and influence technical decisions across multiple teams.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to develop roadmaps and make technology decisions aligned with business outcomes.
* **Security & Governance:** Commitment to secure-by-design principles, data protection, compliance, and responsible AI adoption.
* **Business Partnership:** Ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners.
* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**: Ability to identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and enhanced user experience.
* **Communication**: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Accountability & Execution:** Ability to take ownership of architectural outcomes and drive initiatives from design through implementation.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

**WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?**
--------------------------

As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.

Between our passion for flavor, our 130-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

title: Director - Data Engineering
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the engineering hub of Deutsche Telekom, Europe’s #1 telecom brand. We build the digital products that millions of customers across Europe use every day. AI-first by design, we don't just adopt new technology, we build with it.

You will be part of Deutsche Telekom:

#1 most valuable telecom brand in the world, and #11 across all brands (Brand Finance Global 500, 2026)

* Top 100 in the Fortune Global 500 (#72 in 2025)
* EUR 119 billion Group revenue in 2025
* 273 million+ mobile customers in 50+ countries

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

With the right team, anything is possible.

If you're someone who believes data is the most underutilised superpower in any organisation, you'll fit right in. This team turns raw signal into sharp decisions, obsesses over quality at the source, and never settles for a dashboard when a model can do more. Fast-moving, deeply curious, and consumer-obsessed. We don't just analyse the past, we build what helps shape what comes next.

**YOU ASK WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? WE SAY,**

* AI tools, on us — Every engineer ships with AI. Coding agents, token budgets and hackfests to build what's next.
* Grow faster — Free Coursera & Udemy access, certifications and internal mobility across teams.
* Time to recharge — Uncapped leaves, birthday leave, flexible hours, and sabbatical options.
* Family first — 9 months maternity on full pay, 15 days paternity, crèche support, infertility treatment and adoption leave.

* Money & everyday — Flexi benefits for car, fuel and books. Free meals and snacks on campus. Monthly phone and broad

**What exactly is the objective of this role?**

As Director Engineering, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for building and operating scalable data platform components within Deutsche Telekom’s Unified Data Platform. You will drive execution, ensure engineering excellence, and contribute to the evolution of a cloud-native, AI-ready data ecosystem serving multiple countries.

**What will be my Key Responsibilities?**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers to deliver scalable, reliable data platform capabilities
* Own end-to-end delivery of platform components (design → build → run) with clear accountability for quality, performance, and reliability
* Partner with Product Managers to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions
* Contribute to and implement target data architecture aligned with enterprise standards
* Drive best practices in data engineering, DevOps, and platform reliability
* Ensure systems are built with observability, cost efficiency, and scalability in mind
* Collaborate with domain teams and region specific (LOB) teams to enable reusable data products and standardized platform capabilities
* Identify and resolve systemic issues, focusing on long-term engineering health
* Evaluate new technologies and lead proof-of-concepts where required
* Build strong engineering culture with focus on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

**Data & Technical Expertise**

* 14+ years of overall experience with 6 to 8+ years in data engineering, data platforms, or distributed data systems
* Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially:
* BigQuery (data warehousing, performance tuning, cost optimization, partitioning/clustering)
* Dataflow (Apache Beam) for large-scale batch and streaming pipelines
* Pub/Sub for real-time ingestion and event-driven architectures
* Cloud Composer (Airflow) for orchestration and workflow management
* GCS (Cloud Storage) as part of lakehouse or staging architectures
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures including Lakehouse patterns on GCP and distributed processing systems
* Strong experience designing and operating end-to-end data pipelines (ingestion to transformation to serving) at scale
* Expertise in real-time and streaming architectures, including event design, schema evolution, and fault-tolerant processing
* Hands-on programming skills in Python, Spark (Scala), with experience in building distributed data applications
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines, including versioning, testing, and deployment automation
* Strong understanding of data modelling and optimization for analytical workloads in BigQuery
* Practical exposure to data product thinking, including:
* Data contracts and schema governance
* Discoverability and reuse across domains
* Ownership and lifecycle management
* Familiarity with MLOps and AI-enabled data platforms on GCP, including support for:
* Feature engineering pipelines
* Model training and inference workflows
* Integration with Vertex AI (preferred)
* Strong focus on platform reliability and observability, including monitoring, alerting, lineage, and data quality frameworks
* Experience managing cost-performance trade-offs in GCP (e.g., BigQuery cost controls, Dataflow optimization)
* Proven ability to work in globally distributed, federated environments, enabling standardization across multiple teams and geographies
* Awareness of evolving trends in cloud-native data platforms, data mesh, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to apply them pragmatically

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Proven ability to lead and grow high-performing engineering teams with a strong focus on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Tech Lead
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of professional software development in Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
* 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
* Language and craft. You are an expert in Python. You write idiomatic, fully typed Python, understand asyncio and the GIL in depth, and can diagnose concurrency, CPU and memory problems in production. You set our Python version strategy, dependency policy, framework choices (FastAPI or Django) and coding patterns, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.
* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
* Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with SQLAlchemy and Alembic. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and Celery or Arq, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
* Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
* Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team.
* Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
* AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
* Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
* Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
* Experience in TypeScript.

**About the job:**
WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for Python across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture of Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
* Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
* Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
* Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
* Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
* Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
* Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
* Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
* Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
* Set the hiring bar for Python engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
* Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing

**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

title: Sr DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**Role**
Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain
  
  
**The Team**
The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions span DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly.
  
  
**The Impact**
You will embed security governance into the software delivery lifecycle by translating requirements into clear policies and automated controls. Your work will protect source control, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure and the software supply chain without creating unnecessary friction for engineers. You will strengthen credentials, secrets and non-human identity governance; drive security findings through to remediation; and contribute to AI-assisted development governance and developer endpoint security. Working with platform teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will support audit and compliance and make secure practices the default across S&P Global.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
Help shape how thousands of engineers build and ship software securely. You will work hands-on with enterprise security tooling and emerging areas such as AI tool governance and policy as code. You will own controls end to end, from policy design to automated enforcement, and collaborate with InfoSec, audit and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, certification support and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments.
* Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows.
* Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain.
* Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray.
* Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK.
* Contribute to governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security.
* Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and support audit and compliance activities.
* Partner with platform and engineering teams to automate security controls and drive adoption.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security governance.
* Strong experience designing and automating enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of source control security and common pipeline threats.
* Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies.
* Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows.
* Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning or cloud security tools.
* Ability to write clear security policies and standards and translate them into technical enforcement.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege.
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code, including Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK, and familiarity with configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js.
* Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails.
* Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and Cursor IDE, and developer agents/MCP integrations.
* Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems.
* Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel.
* AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD).
* Security certifications, such as CSSLP, Security+ or AWS Security.

**Technical Environment**
**Source Control & CI/CD Security:**
GitHub Enterprise security features, GitHub Actions hardening, OIDC and GitHub Apps
  
  
**Application Security:**
SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GHAS
  
  
**Cloud & Container Security:**
Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability tools
  
  
**Software Supply Chain:**
Artifactory/Xray or similar tooling, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and artifact signing
  
  
**Secrets & Identity:**
Vault or other secrets managers, Okta or similar tooling, and non-human identity governance
  
  
**Runners & Endpoints:**
Runner hardening tools and MDM
  
  
**AI Governance:**
Copilot controls, MCP and agent guardrails
  
  
**Monitoring:**
Splunk or similar security information and event management (SIEM) tooling
  
  
**Automation & Cloud Security:**
Python, Bash, Terraform and AWS security (IAM, KMS)
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technology-related field.
  
  
**What’s In It For**
**You?**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  
**Our People**
We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

title: Sr IT Engineer, Collaboration
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview**
McCormick & Company is seeking a Sr IT Engineer, Collaboration to provide technical leadership and architectural direction for our global collaboration and workplace technology ecosystem.
  
  
The Collaboration Engineer will be responsible for shaping the architecture, engineering standards, governance, and multi-year technology direction across Microsoft 365, enterprise conferencing, digital signage, Microsoft 365 Copilot and emerging AI-powered workplace technologies
  
  
The role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to influence enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, workplace technology, communications, business stakeholders, and strategic partners. The successful candidate will operate within an Agile product-line model as a subject-matter expert and trusted technical advisor, translating business and technology strategy into secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable solutions.
  
  
This role is also required to participate in the creation and approval of new standards as part of an architectural standards board and support the global architectural function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Teams Calling, and compliance capabilities.
* Define architecture patterns, engineering standards, governance, and lifecycle management practices across collaboration platforms.
* Drive standardization, governance, service lifecycle management, and continuous improvement across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to shape and deliver the next generation of our enterprise data platform. You will lead the design and build of scalable, well-governed data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that power analytics, reporting and AI use cases across the business.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set engineering standards, guide a team of data engineers and work closely with BI developers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to turn data into a trusted, reusable asset. Python will be your primary engineering languag, and Microsoft Fabric the core platform you help us mature.

Key responsibilities

Platform and architecture

* Design, build and evolve our data platform on Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks and Real-Time Intelligence.
* Define and implement a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture with Delta Lake, covering ingestion, transformation, modelling and serving layers.
* Make sound architectural decisions on storage, compute, capacity sizing, workspace design and cost optimisation within Fabric.
* Shape the integration approach between Fabric, Power BI semantic models and source systems (ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, APIs and on-premises databases).

Engineering delivery

* Build robust, reusable and well-tested data pipelines in Python and PySpark, using Fabric Notebooks and Spark job definitions.
* Write efficient SQL (T-SQL and Spark SQL) for transformation, data modelling and performance tuning.
* Implement batch, incremental and near-real-time ingestion patterns, including change data capture where appropriate.
* Own data quality, observability and reliability, with automated checks, monitoring, alerting and clear runbooks.

Engineering standards and DevOps

* Establish coding standards, reusable frameworks and design patterns for the data engineering team.
* Drive CI/CD for data workloads using Git integration, Azure DevOps or GitHub, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
* Promote automated testing, code review, documentation and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Governance and security

* Apply data governance, lineage and cataloguing through Microsoft Purview and Fabric's built-in capabilities.
* Implement role-based access, row-level and object-level security, and sensitivity labelling in line with company policy and GDPR.
* Partner with architecture, security and compliance teams to keep the platform secure and audit-ready.

Leadership and collaboration

* Lead, mentor and coach data engineers, providing technical direction, code reviews and career development support.
* Plan and prioritise work with the product owner and stakeholders, and break down epics into deliverable increments.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay current with the Microsoft Fabric roadmap and bring forward improvements that add measurable value.

Skills and experience

Essential

* 7+ years of data engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a lead or senior technical role.
* Strong, hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Notebooks, OneLake) or closely related Azure services (Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2) with a clear path to Fabric.
* Advanced Python for data engineering, including PySpark, pandas, packaging, testing (for example pytest) and clean, maintainable code.
* Expert SQL skills and solid understanding of dimensional modelling, data vault or similar modelling approaches.
* Practical experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse architecture patterns.
* Experience implementing CI/CD and version control (Git) for data solutions.
* Good understanding of data governance, security and privacy requirements.
* Proven ability to lead technical delivery and mentor engineers.

Desirable

* Microsoft certification such as Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) or Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
* Experience with Power BI semantic models, Direct Lake mode and DAX.
* Exposure to Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstreams or KQL databases.
* Experience supporting machine learning or generative AI workloads on a data platform.
* Familiarity with ERP data (for example IFS Cloud), enterprise integration patterns and REST APIs.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Bicep, Terraform) and Azure networking basics.
* Agile delivery experience (Scrum or Kanban) in a product-oriented team.

Personal attributes

* A pragmatic problem solver who balances engineering quality with delivery pace.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical topics simply.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust, shares knowledge and raises the capability of the team.
* Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in modern data and AI technology.

  
**Qualifications**

Essential:

* 2-3 years’ experience in similar role
* Fluency in English (written and verbal)
* University degree in Computer Science or related subjects

Highly Beneficial

* Azure BI technology (Fabric, Synapse, Power BI, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSAS, Purview, OneLake, ADF)
* Microsoft training/certification on DP-203 or DP-500
* Generative AI
* Azure AI & Machine Learning
* Microsoft Purview
* Data Catalog
* MDM

  
**Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

**Who We Are**

**The Role**

**Your Role** 
 
**As a** **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) specializing in Mainframe Modernization & Cloud Transformation** **, you will lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of reliability engineering capabilities for enterprise modernization initiatives. You will translate the availability, resiliency, recovery, and operational characteristics of legacy mainframe environments into scalable, cloud-native reliability architectures that support business-critical workloads. Working closely with Mainframe SMEs, Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, Application Owners, and Modernization Teams, you will establish observability, automation, resilience, and operational excellence practices across hybrid mainframe and cloud environments. Your focus will be on ensuring migrated applications achieve defined service reliability targets through SLO/SLI frameworks, automated operations, proactive monitoring, incident management, capacity planning, and continuous resilience validation while maintaining enterprise governance, security, and production readiness standards throughout the transformation journey.** 
 
**What You Will Do**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Design and implement **site reliability engineering (SRE) practices** for modernized cloud workloads, defining and managing **SLOs, SLIs, and Error Budgets** to ensure service reliability and operational excellence.
* Architect and validate **cloud-native resiliency solutions** by translating mainframe availability and recovery requirements into **High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and Business Continuity** frameworks.
* Establish **end-to-end observability** across hybrid mainframe and cloud environments through monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, incident management, and reliability dashboards.
* Drive **performance, scalability, and resilience engineering** through capacity planning, workload optimization, chaos engineering, fault-tolerance testing, and automated recovery/self-healing capabilities.
Partner with architects, modernization teams, platform engineers, and application owners to support migration and coexistence strategies, define production readiness standards, and develop operational runbooks and support procedures.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Deep expertise in **observability and monitoring** , leveraging OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and trace correlation tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, and CloudWatch.
* Proven background in **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** , encompassing service level management (SLI/SLO/Error Budgets), incident and problem management, production operations, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Hands-on experience in **automation and DevOps** , including Python and shell scripting, CI/CD pipeline implementation, automated remediation, self-healing systems, and operational automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of **mainframe modernization reliability challenges** , including RTO/RPO translation to cloud architectures, CICS and batch SLA-to-SLO mapping, hybrid mainframe-cloud observability, capacity and performance modeling, chaos engineering, automated recovery design, and mission-critical workload reliability.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Understanding of mainframe production environments, including CICS, batch processing, scheduling, and operational controls.
* Experience in financial services, insurance, retail, healthcare, or other mission-critical enterprise systems.
* Hands-on experience implementing observability and reliability frameworks for cloud-native applications.
Experience with hybrid cloud and multi-cloud production environments.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. title: Lead SRE- VMware VCF Automation (Development Lead / SME)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Assume a critical role in defining the future of a globally recognized firm and have a direct and significant effect in a realm tailored for top achievers in site reliability.
  
  
As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you hold a leadership role in your team, demonstrate strong knowledge across multiple technical domains, and advise others on the technical and business issues facing them. Take lead and conduct resiliency design reviews, break up complex problems into digestible work for other engineers, act as a technical lead for medium to large-sized products, and provide advice and mentoring to other engineers.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Consistently models and champions site reliability culture and practices, documents and shares knowledge within your organization via internal forums and communities of practice
* Lead the design, development and delivery of the automation platform for the Global ESX Infrastructure SRE team's VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF 5.x / VCF 9) estate, covering vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN and NSX, as development lead engineer and SME
* Own the automation codebase and engineering standards across the full SDLC, including requirements, design reviews, Git branching, peer code review, automated testing, static analysis, secure coding, CI/CD, versioning, release notes and controlled promotion from lab to production
* Develop secure, high-quality, maintainable Python code (pyVmomi, vSphere Automation SDK, SDDC Manager / VCF and NSX REST APIs), and review and debug code written by others
* Build reusable frameworks, Infrastructure as Code and self-service workflows (VCF / Aria Automation and Orchestrator, Terraform, Ansible) that automate provisioning, patching through vLCM / SDDC Manager, configuration drift remediation, resource optimization, compliance, health checks and reporting
* Design safe automation based on VMware virtualization (HA/DRS, vMotion, vSAN, maintenance mode, vLCM), with pre/post validation, idempotency, automated testing, rollback and runbooks, and make sure every change follows ITIL change management with traceability and audit evidence
* Build observability and self-healing patterns into automation and platform tooling by correlating vCenter events, VCF Operations, VCF Operations for Logs and out-of-band (iLO/iDRAC) telemetry, and work with stakeholders to define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
* Serve as SME, main point of contact and escalation point during major incidents, use enterprise-authorized AI and analysis of past incidents to speed up triage and RCA, and drive problem management to closure through preventive automation
* Mentor engineers on software engineering and SDLC practices, work with SRE, platform engineering and application teams to prioritize the automation backlog, lead performance testing and evaluation of new tools, and promote reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows with appropriate guardrails
* Leads reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows across SDLC/toolchain practices (e.g., CI/CD quality checks, test/validation automation, and operational readiness), ensuring traceability/auditability, resiliency, and security controls.
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate major-incident triage, troubleshooting, and post-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Demonstrated proficiency in reliability, scalability, performance, security, enterprise system architecture, toil reduction, and other site reliability best practices
* Hold a current VMware certification such as VCP-VCF Administrator or VCP-DCV
* Demonstrate proven experience as a development lead or senior software engineer delivering production-grade infrastructure automation in large-scale, high-availability VMware environments using SDLC best practices (Git, code review, unit / integration testing, CI/CD, release management)
* Apply advanced Python development skills (object-oriented design, packaging, testing frameworks such as pytest) against REST and SOAP APIs, with working knowledge of additional languages such as PowerShell, JavaScript or Java
* Bring a solid understanding of VMware virtualization, including vSphere (ESXi, vCenter), HA/DRS, vMotion, vSAN and NSX within VCF 5.x / VCF 9, and proficiency in making service-level changes and troubleshooting in enterprise environments
* Use Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD tooling (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), containers and container orchestration, and observability practices such as white and black box monitoring, SLO alerting, telemetry collection, VCF Operations and VCF Operations for Logs

title: Knowledge Graph Devloper / Associate Director, Service Management
description:

67909

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join a distributed team of specialist and senior engineers spanning multiple locations globally. In this role, you will be a hands-on technical contributor and force multiplier — working alongside specialist engineers to raise the collective bar through knowledge sharing, unblocking, and collaborative problem-solving. You will bring deep expertise in Azure-based Kubernetes platforms and a breadth of DevOps practice to help deliver and evolve our infrastructure at scale.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

**Kubernetes & Container Platform**

Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes workloads on Redhat OpenShift and AKS in production and test environments, with consideration for future AWS expansion.  
Define cluster topology, multi-tenancy models, RBAC policies, namespace strategy, and workload placement standards.  
Implement and contribute to GitOps workflows using ArgoCD; manage the broader Kubernetes tooling ecosystem including Helm, Kustomize, ingress controllers, and service mesh.  
Maintain container image standards including base image governance, vulnerability scanning, and registry hygiene.

**CI/CD, IaC, & Cloud Platform**

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable fast, reliable delivery; introduce progressive delivery patterns where appropriate.  
Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform; contribute to shared module libraries and uphold consistent standards across environments.  
Contribute to cloud architecture decisions on Azure (VNet design, IAM, private connectivity, cost optimization) with an eye toward multi-cloud extensibility.

**Observability, Reliability, & Security**

Work within the observability stack (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) to ensure consistent coverage and actionable signal across platform components.  
Drive SLO/SLI practices, lead blameless post-mortems, and systematically reduce classes of production incidents.  
Enforce security by default including secrets management, policy enforcement (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno), network policies, and compliance posture.

**Technical Leadership & Enablement**

Act as a technical resource and mentor for engineers on your team, sharing knowledge, reviewing work, and removing blockers to keep delivery moving.  
Produce and maintain clear documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and runbooks to support team-wide understanding.  
Participate in architecture reviews and roadmap planning, ensuring platform concerns are well represented in cross-functional decisions.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* BTech/MTech/MCA
* 10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering; prior experience at a principal or staff level.
* Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise, including Redhat Openshift or AKS in production environments.
* Hands-on proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code, and ArgoCD for GitOps-based deployments.
* Strong Azure platform knowledge: networking, identity, cost management, and Azure-native services.
* Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and security practices (secrets management, policy enforcement).
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and elevate peers, communicate technical concepts clearly, and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
* Experience migrating workloads to Kubernetes or managing on-premises Kubernetes deployments.
* Familiarity with containerization strategies and best practices for legacy application modernization.
* AWS experience or multi-cloud background.
* Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, or CKS).

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**You will own client projects from the first estimate to the final release**

MTechZilla is a custom software development company with a team of 30+ in Pune. We

build web, mobile, cloud and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US

and Europe, and have delivered 40+ products.

You will run 3 to 4 client projects at a time, each with a team of 3 to 6 developers. You are

the client's main contact, you write the stories the team builds from, and you keep each

project on scope and on budget.

You will also write the technical estimate behind every quotation we send. That is why this

role needs a former developer: you design the solution and size the work yourself, with no

layer of team leads or project management office under you

**Who this role fits**

**This role fits you if:**

* You are a technical project manager, delivery lead or engineering lead at a software
* agency or startup.
* You worked as a developer before you moved into project or delivery work.
* You write user stories and estimates yourself, and you talk to clients directly

**It does not fit you if:**

* You have never worked as a software developer.
* Your project management work is mostly tracking, reporting and running ceremonies.
* You manage through team leads or a project management office.
* You are looking for a large account and a large team.

**What you will be responsible for:**

**Keep projects on scope, on time, and on budget**

* Own delivery of your projects from kickoff to release and handover.
* Act as the main delivery contact for clients across time zones.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Turn scope changes into approved, billable change orders.
* Track risks and blockers every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Run sprint demos and status reviews, and tell clients about risks before dates are
* missed.
* Coordinate with QA so every release is tested before a client sees it.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk
* and decisions needed.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the
* growth team to close

**Turn client briefs into stories developers can build from**

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without
* guesswork.
* Prioritize features by business value, effort and risk.
* Answer your clients' technical questions during the project: architecture, feasibility,
* timelines and costs.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.

**Design solutions and write estimates for new leads**

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead's technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does
* not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation: scope, assumptions, exclusions,
* team composition, milestones and timeline.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client's budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed

**Lead the developers on your projects**

* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go
* through you.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Run projects in Jira and keep requirements, architecture decisions and handover
* notes in Confluence.

**What you will grow into**

**After your first six months, you will take on more of how we work:**

* A reusable estimation model built from past projects, so quotes get faster and more
* accurate.
* Our standards for documentation, sprints, QA gates and releases.
* Hiring and interviews for the engineering team.

**Technical skills you need**

You do not need to write production code every day. You do need to design a system,

judge whether a developer's estimate is realistic, and hold a technical conversation with a

client's CTO.

* At least 3 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into project or delivery work.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: Reactand Next.js, React Native, Node.js and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps and notifications.
* Security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD and architecture diagrams

**Experience and qualifications**

Required

* 5 to 7 years of total experience, including at least 3 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* Experience owning delivery of a software project from kickoff to release.
* Experience estimating software projects, with one example of an estimate compared to actual delivery.
* Experience working directly with clients, ideally in the US or Europe.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum, release planning and QA coordination.
* Daily use of Jira or a similar tool.
* Clear written English for estimates, user stories and status reports.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience at a software services company or agency, especially on fixed-price projects.
* Experience running more than one project at the same time.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment or logistics.
* Daily use of Claude or other AI tools in your work.
* What success looks like in your first 6 months
* Quotations and estimates for new leads go out without the CEO filling in technical or timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member could pick up and work from.
* We have a first version of an estimation model built from past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Participates in vendor or subcontractor agreement negotiations when required. 15. Maintains current knowledge of relevant contractual procedures and practices

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Senior DevOps Engineer**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the OPTI (Office of Product and Technology Innovation) AI Platform team in Pune. You will keep our platforms deployable, observable, and reliable: owning deployments, environments, monitoring, and the CI/CD pipelines that ship the agentic AI platform, the Databricks data platform, and our shared services.

You are a strong individual contributor who automates first, treats infrastructure as code, and cares about how systems behave at 2 a.m., not just at release time. You will work day to day with the Pune and US AI Platform team, and the team builds, ships, monitors, and supports what it owns in production.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design and develop automation to support continuous delivery and continuous integration (CI/CD) Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for the AI platform, Databricks, and shared services, with automated testing and safe, repeatable releases
* Manage cloud infrastructure on Azure as code with Terraform and Bicep, keeping environments consistent from development to production
* Operate and support Azure Databricks: workspaces, clusters, Unity Catalog setup, access, and deployment of jobs and pipelines
* Run and improve the environments the agentic runtime, LLM gateway, and knowledge base depend on
* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting so the team sees problems before users do, and keep dashboards and alerts useful rather than noisy
* Lead troubleshooting and production support when something breaks, and drive root-cause fixes so it doesn't happen again
* Track and improve reliability across the platform
* Work with the OPTI US and Pune team so deployments and quality gates fit how they build
* And other duties as assigned.

**What to Bring:**

**Azure and Databricks**

* 5 to 8+ years of hands-on DevOps, platform, or site reliability engineering experience in a production environment
* Strong hands-on experience operating Azure: compute, networking, storage and monitoring
* Experience operating Azure Databricks, including workspace setup, cluster management, access control, and job deployment

**CI/CD and infrastructure as code**

* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions
* Hands-on infrastructure as code with Terraform and Bicep
* Experience with containers (Docker) and deploying containerized services
* Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation

**Monitoring and production support**

* Experience setting up monitoring, logging, and alerting, for example with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or Datadog
* Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, and application layers
* Experience supporting production systems, including on-call, incident response, and root-cause analysis

**Working style**

* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools like Claude
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with distributed teams across India and the US

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with Kubernetes, such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Experience deploying or operating LLM-based services, agents, or vector databases
* Azure certifications, such as AZ-104 or AZ-400
* Experience in the oil and gas or energy industry

**About You:**

You'd rather automate something once than do it by hand twice. You ask how do we roll this back? before something ships, and you keep a calm head when production is down. You work well independently and thrive in a collaborative team spread across Pune and the US.

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

**Quorum Diversity Statement:** At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.*

**Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department**
