title: Technical Approval Officer
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Business Assurance**
We help companies ensure compliance, build high-performing management systems, and meet competence needs within a wide range of industries. DNV helps companies understand Working with us, you can be involved in technically challenging and innovative projects worldwide demanding a broad variety of expertise. Our strong focus on research and innovation opens an array of opportunities, and allows you to engage in projects which develop next generation solutions. and manage their risk picture through our management system certification and training portfolios.
  
  
**About The Role**
**About the Role**
Due to continued growth, DNV Business Assurance is seeking a Senior Technical Approval Officer to join our Global Technical HUB (GTH).
  
  
The Global Technical HUB is part of Global Operations & Technical and is responsible for global accreditation governance, technical compliance, and consistent certification quality across all DNV market units worldwide.
  
  
In this role, you will be part of an international team of technical experts, working closely with market units, technical managers, sales, and operations. You will play a key role in ensuring that certification decisions fully comply with ISO/IEC 17021‑1, relevant IAF mandatory documents, scheme rules, and accreditation requirements.
  
  
You will report to the GTH Team Manager.
  
  
**As a Senior Technical Approval Officer, You Will**

* Perform technical reviews and certification decisions to verify compliance with ISO/IEC 17021‑1, applicable schemes, and DNV rules
* Review audit reports, competence assignments, proposals, and certification decisions across multiple management system standards
* Monitor and analyse certification performance and quality trends across market units
* Provide clear, pragmatic, and constructive feedback to support continuous improvement
* Actively support market units in maintaining accreditation acceptance and meeting business and quality objectives
* Proactively communicate and collaborate with global stakeholders to resolve technical issues
* Support resolution of internal and external audit findings, including accreditation body findings
* Maintain your own lead auditor qualifications through periodic auditing
* Ensure that impartiality and independence are always safeguarded
* Work in a production-oriented environment, balancing quality, consistency, and timeliness

What we offer
  
  

* Work in a global technical role with real influence on certification quality and governance
* Be part of an experienced international expert community
* Continuous professional development following DNV’s 70‑20‑10 learning philosophy
* Competitive compensation, attractive benefits, and incentive scheme
* A culture built on trust, competence, and independence

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**
You are a technical professional who combines strong accreditation knowledge with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 4 years of experience in accredited management system certification activities (e.g. technical review, accreditation management, scheme governance, quality or performance analysis)
* Strong working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17021‑1 and relevant IAF Mandatory Documents
* Knowledge of ISO/IEC 17029 is an advantage
* In-depth experience with at least three management system standards, such as:

+ ISO 9001
+ ISO 14001
+ ISO 45001

* Knowledge of sustainability-related schemes or standards (e.g. ISCC, ISO 14064, EU ETS) is a strong plus
* Certified Lead Auditor, with at least two maintained LA qualifications
* Ability to review and assess audit outcomes across single and integrated certification scopes
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action processes
* Confident user of digital tools and systems
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices

title: Specialist, Research
description:
**About this role:**
Are you intellectually curious and motivated by ideas? Do you want to create insights that are used by executive leaders worldwide? Gartner is seeking an India-based Specialist to join our Technology, Leadership and Architecture (TLA) team within the Content Lifecycle Center of Excellence. This role provides exposure to a broad range of leadership-level strategic and management topics.
  
  
The Specialist will be responsible for: (a) investigating, analyzing, and writing about critical issues facing TLA executives in leading global organizations; and (b) innovating and scaling content delivery models to accelerate content creation and help clients navigate their most pressing challenges.
  
  
This individual will develop a range of written deliverables by partnering with subject matter experts, conducting secondary analysis, and synthesizing qualitative and quantitative data to generate actionable insights for TLA executives. The role requires distilling complex concepts into clear, compelling content that enables executive decision-making.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have opportunities to develop tools and frameworks that help TLA executives address critical business challenges and drive organizational transformation.
  
  
**What will you do:**

* Identify best-practice solutions to many of today's most significant business challenges.
* Analyze and solve business problems using qualitative and quantitative methods.
* Create role-relevant insights by engaging with subject matter experts and conducting wide-ranging secondary analysis.
* Be a key member of the Content Lifecycle CoE, responsible for improving the client experience and engagement through TLA content, including (but not limited to) white papers, presentations, tools/templates, and how-to guides.
* Develop a deep understanding of the TLA executives’ workflow to create actionable and insightful content.
* Collaborate closely with peers and senior stakeholders across India, the US, the UK, and Australia as part of global content and insight initiatives.

**What you will need:**

* Master's degree (e.g., Management, Economics, Sociology, History, Philosophy, Literature, Political Science, MBA) or PhD in a relevant field such as management or social sciences.
* 0–3 years of content development and/or management consulting experience
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas effectively and collaborate with global teams.

**Who you are:**
We are looking for creative, analytically strong, articulate, and self-motivated individuals who are eager to develop deep domain expertise while building their content development and problem-solving skills. Unlike management consulting, investment banking, or law, our strategic content roles do not require a special appetite or aptitude for sales or business development. Our search for talent is centered, without exception, on the ability to dive deep into a logical, philosophical, or economic problem and emerge with rigorous, original insights.
  
  
Some of the characteristics commonly found in our most successful associates include:
  
  

* Strong appetite for diving deep into a given content terrain to develop expertise and distill key findings.
* Ability to gather, analyze, restructure, and synthesize qualitative and/or quantitative information to generate original insights.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with particular attention to precision of language and the ability to organize information logically.
* Proven ability to meet deadlines, manage multiple priorities, and perform effectively in ambiguous or uncertain environments (e.g., changing circumstances, limited information).
* A strong desire to learn continuously and improve.

**What we offer:**
In addition to an outstanding work environment with strong opportunities for growth and advancement, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive base salary
* Great on the job learning
* A great work culture

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
**SEO Content Writer**

**Company: Egrowth Partners Pvt Ltd**

**Location: Delhi, India**

**Type: Full-time (Work from Office)**

**Experience: 2 to 4 years**

**Salary: Up to 7 LPA (Based on skills & experience)**

**About us**

EGrowth Partners is the back office and growth team for print businesses in the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and Australia. We run order entry, pre-press, customer service and bookkeeping for printers, and build the websites and marketing that bring in their next job. Everyone on the team is trained in print before working on client accounts, so the role builds real industry expertise.

**About the role**

EGrowth Partners is hiring an SEO Content Writer to create content that ranks on Google, gets cited in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and brings in leads. You'll work from SEO briefs, research each topic properly, and talk to subject experts when a piece needs real expertise.

Your readers will range from first-time searchers to people who know the subject well, so clear, plain writing matters more here than clever writing.

**What you'll do**

**Writing and publishing**

•     Write blogs, long-form guides, how-tos, comparison posts, service and landing pages, and FAQs from SEO briefs

•     Adjust tone and depth for each audience, and follow the style guide you're given

•     Write titles and meta descriptions that earn the click

•     Format and publish each piece yourself, with clean headings, internal links, images, and alt text

**Content Optimization**

•     Check search intent before you start writing, and shape the piece around what the searcher actually wants

•     Plan and optimize content in Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope

•     Structure content so AI search tools can pull and cite it: direct answers near the top, question-based headings, short definitions, comparison tables, and FAQ sections

•     Build E-E-A-T into each piece with first-hand insight, expert quotes, credible sources, clear author details, and current facts

•     Work with the SEO team on internal linking, schema, and topic clusters

**Quality and expertise**

•     Interview subject matter experts and turn what they know into content a beginner can follow

•     Fact-check every claim and cite your sources

•     Turn technical topics into plain language most readers can follow on the first read, usually around a 6th to 8th grade reading level

•     Proofread and self-edit before anything goes to review

**Performance and updates**

•     Refresh older content that's losing rankings or has gone out of date

•     Check performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics, and use it to decide what to fix next

•     Track where your content shows up in AI answers and rework what isn't getting picked up

**How we use AI**

You'll use AI tools for research, outlines, and first-pass ideas. The writing, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality are yours. Anything we publish has been written and checked by a person.

**How we measure success**

We look at rankings, organic traffic, AI search visibility, leads from your content, and how few edit rounds a piece needs before it goes live.

**What you'll bring**

•     2 to 4 years of SEO content writing for websites

•     A portfolio of published work, ideally with pieces that rank or have been cited in AI answers

•     Hands-on use of at least one content optimization tool (Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope)

•     A solid grasp of search intent, on-page SEO, and E-E-A-T

•     Working knowledge of how AI search tools choose which sources to cite

•     Experience publishing in WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify

•     Strong written English (C1 or above) and sharp editing skills

•     Comfort working on your own and managing deadlines in a remote or hybrid team

**Nice to have**

•     Experience with other content optimization tools like MarketMuse, NeuronWriter, or Semrush SEO Writing Assistant

•     Experience writing for health, finance, or tech brands

•     Content that's earned backlinks or press mentions

•     Some sense of page layout and UX for content-heavy pages

•     A degree in English, journalism, communications, or marketing (a strong portfolio counts more)

**What we offer**

•     Competitive salary with annual performance reviews

•     Paid earned, casual, and sick leave, plus public holidays

•     Laptop and access to paid SEO and AI tools

**Our hiring process**

1.  A short screening call to talk through your experience and samples

2.  A test piece written to a real brief

3.  A final interview with the hiring manager

**How to apply**

* Your updated resume.
* Links to any SEO-optimized content you've worked on using tools such as Surfer SEO, Frase, Clearscope, or other content optimization tools.

EGrowth Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and judge every application on skills and work.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) — Voice AI | GurgaonCallKaro AI | Onsite, Gurgaon | Six-month internship with full-time conversionWhat Is a Forward Deployed Engineer at CallKaro AI?We build Voice AI agents that handle over 5 million calls a month across 20+ languages.Getting that technology to work in a demo is one thing. Getting it to work inside a client’s actual business — with their workflows, edge cases, systems, and customers on the other end of the line — is a completely different problem.That second problem is the one we need you for.A Forward Deployed Engineer sits inside the client’s world. You learn how their business actually runs, shape our platform around it, and stay close enough to the deployment to catch a broken call flow before the client does.The role is part consultant, part engineer, and part founder.Your work directly influences whether a client renews, expands, and trusts us with more of their business.This is not a pure software engineering role.You will spend significant time with clients, understanding business workflows, debugging production deployments, analyzing call data, and translating real-world requirements into working AI systems. You need to enjoy both building technology and solving problems with people.What You Will Do* Own client onboarding end to end, from the first discovery call to the day the agents go live.* Sit with clients to understand their processes, then translate them into AI-powered call flows that hold up in production.* Write and refine LLM prompts that shape agent personas, conversation logic, guardrails, and escalation paths — including for Hindi, Hinglish, and regional-language calls.* Debug live production issues in real time by tracing call logs, reading transcripts, identifying failure points, and getting to the root cause quickly.* Analyze call volumes, conversion rates, drop-off points, and other performance metrics, then turn those insights into actions the client can take.* Build lightweight Python scripts and automations that connect our platform with client CRMs, APIs, and other systems.* Work closely with our product and engineering teams to communicate what clients actually need and advocate for features and fixes that can meaningfully improve their outcomes.* Document what you learn from each deployment so that the next implementation starts further ahead than the last one.* Be comfortable jumping between client conversations, debugging, data analysis, prompt engineering, and building depending on what the problem requires.What We Look ForMust-Have* You know enough Python to build integrations, write scripts, work with APIs, and debug API calls.* You have a working understanding of LLMs and prompt engineering, and can write prompts that produce reliable behavior rather than just impressive demos.* You are comfortable working with call data, dashboards, logs, transcripts, and metrics, and have the instinct to draw useful conclusions from them.* You can explain a technical problem to a non-technical client clearly without losing them.* You solve problems under pressure. When something breaks an hour before a client demo, you trace it to the root cause and fix it rather than escalating and waiting.* You have an entrepreneurial mindset and treat the client’s problem as your own.* You are comfortable with ambiguity. Startup priorities move faster than documentation, and you need to be able to figure things out without always having a playbook.* You communicate proactively. If something is blocked, you raise it. If something is broken, you take ownership of it.Good to Have* You have spent time at a startup in any function and understand what building from scratch feels like.* You have been exposed to conversational AI, chatbots, IVR systems, voice AI, or CRM platforms.* You have used Postman, Zapier, Make, or similar integration and automation tools.* You are familiar with cloud telephony or the WhatsApp Business API.* You have built personal projects, shipped products, or worked on something outside coursework that demonstrates how you think and build.The EngagementThis is a six-month, full-time internship, based onsite at our Gurgaon office.There is no remote or hybrid option. You should already be in Delhi NCR or be willing to relocate to Gurgaon for the internship.Freshers are welcome to apply. Prior experience is a plus, but it is not a requirement. What you have built matters more to us than how long you have been working.Compensation* Stipend: INR 25,000/month fixed* Performance bonus: Up to INR 5,000/month, variable and not guaranteed* Full-time conversion: Strong performers may be offered a full-time role after the internship* Expected full-time compensation: ₹7–8 LPA CTCFull-time conversion is subject to a structured performance review and is not automatic.The Mindset We Hire ForWe care less about where you studied and more about how you think.We want people who:* Ask why before how.* Communicate proactively instead of going quiet when something is stuck.* Ship something iterable rather than waiting for something perfect.* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.* Are comfortable getting their hands dirty with unfamiliar systems.* Are honest enough to flag what isn’t working, even when it is uncomfortable.* Care about the business outcome, not just whether the code works.This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be close to customers, close to the product, and close to the problems that matter.This seat is a strong place to start. Many of our strongest engineers and product people began here.

description:

As a Proposal Manager, you will work closely with EU countries business development, sales, and subject matter experts to develop compelling, compliant, and strategically aligned proposals that position us competitively in the market. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bid management, excellent project management skills, and a deep understanding of proposal development processes. This role will be pivotal in ensuring our bids are delivered on time, with high quality, and in alignment with both client requirements and internal strategic goals.

**Responsibilities**

* Post-submission Analysis: Gather and analyze feedback from completed bids to identify areas for improvement. Track win/loss outcomes and integrate learnings into future proposals to enhance success rates.

**Requirements**

  in bid management, proposal management, or a similar role within a corporate, consulting, or professional services environment.

* Experience in
  **international markets**
  with strong cross-cultural communication skills. Ability to navigate global business environments.
* Proficiency in proposal management software (e.g., AutogenAI, QorusDocs, Loopio, Qvidian) and document management tools (e.g., SharePoint, MS Office Suite).
* Strong project management skills with experience using tools to manage timelines and track deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to craft clear, client-focused proposals. Ability to review and edit proposals for consistency, grammar, and compliance with company standards.
* Organized and deadline-driven with the ability to manage multiple proposals simultaneously.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills to effectively work with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to assess client needs and develop tailored proposal responses.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Must have excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
* Preferred Qualifications Professional Certification: Certification in Proposal Management (e.g., APMP or Shipley) is a plus.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience working within the technology sector, professional services, or other complex B2B industries.

**Working conditions**

Role is based in Securitas AMEA office in Gurugram, India. Hybrid working model applies (with Tuesdays and Wednesdays are mandatory office days).

**What you’ll need:**

* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree with focus on writing, editing and formatting in English.
* Minimum of 2 years of writing and editing experience for corporate documents in English.
* Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills
* Ability to independently complete simple assignments and move quickly from one assignment to the next.
* Advanced English skills to understand and execute complex instructions and ensure quality of client-ready content. Both U.S. and U.K. English.
* Preliminary experience/understanding of publishing platforms to create SEO-friendly and user-friendly content and newsletter and intranet page design.
* Advanced drafting and formatting skills in MS Office. Experience working with custom templates.
* Strong editing and clean up skills.
* Strong communication skills to ensure satisfaction of Gartner associates requesting support.
* Strong research and writing skills, with the ability to manage a project from start to finish.
* Capacity to work on multiple projects at once, and also to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Expert skill level in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

**Who you are:**

* Comfortable to partner and build a trust-based, value-added relationships with senior leaders.
* Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change.
* Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement.
* A proactive thinker who thrives on using data to tell a story with actionable insights.

**What we offer:**
In addition to an outstanding work environment with advancement potential, Gartner Sales business analyst associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive base salary
* Generous performance-based bonus
* A Flexible work environment
* A great work culture

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

title: Content Manager (Research (Machinery and Electricals)
description:
**Position Summary**
The Content Manager serves as the Machinery & Electrical Equipment subject matter expert within the Energy & Industrials pod and owns its expert research content coverage. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human-moderated one-to-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The Content Manager reviews content for research quality and relevance and works with Associates and Compliance through publication.
  
  
The role requires an investor mindset and deep knowledge of Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including its companies, value chain, financial statements, operating drivers, industry cycles and current debates. The Content Manager must also understand relevant credit, private-market and other investor perspectives well enough to assess the sub-sector broadly; ask incisive questions; challenge superficial answers; and produce content that leaves investors materially better informed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Coverage ownership and research agenda**

* Set and maintain the research agenda for Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including priority companies, themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
* Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro, sector and sub-sector developments to company-level implications.
* Translate earnings calls, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring content programs for Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Use a shared research foundation to develop several distinct conversations on the same company or topic without producing repetitive content.

**Network Member strategy and interview leadership**

* Build and maintain a map of the roles, organizations, value-chain positions and geographies needed to answer priority research questions.
* Define and validate Network Member profiles, screening criteria and briefing context that distinguish direct visibility from nominal seniority.
* Design investor-focused interview agendas and questions that go beyond public commentary and generate original insight.
* Lead human-moderated one-to-one interviews, listening actively, probing inconsistencies and redirecting the conversation toward material investor questions.

**Structured programs, quality and collaboration**

* Define the research objective, respondent criteria, question sets and cadence for channel checks and other recurring structured programs within Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Brief Associates executing those programs, review representative output and determine whether it meets substantive research and quality standards.
* Work with Associates and Compliance to resolve substantive questions and carry approved content through publication.
* Capture company briefs, Network Member knowledge, question frameworks and findings in reusable form to strengthen future coverage of Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Collaborate across the sector pod when sub-sector, asset-class, regional or thematic perspectives would materially improve the research, and contribute to team ideation, knowledge sharing and quality calibration.
* Use AI-enabled research and moderation tools to deepen preparation and improve efficiency, applying judgment to validate outputs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity or credit research, buy-side or sell-side analysis, research services, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, primary research or an expert network.
* Deep expertise in Machinery & Electrical Equipment, preferably developed through public-equity or comparable fundamental research, with sufficient familiarity across credit, private-market and other relevant investor perspectives to assess the category broadly.
* Experience producing research or insight for institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and the performance indicators relevant to Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the intellectual curiosity and discipline to maintain deep expertise within Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to translate research objectives into incisive, investor-relevant questions designed to generate differentiated insight.
* Excellent verbal communication and live-interviewing skills, including the ability to probe beyond surface-level responses and challenge senior operators in real time.
* Strong written English and research judgment, with the ability to distinguish incremental insight from general commentary.
* Ability to own Machinery & Electrical Equipment independently, collaborate effectively within the Energy & Industrials pod, and deliver high-quality work at speed in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Independent ownership of company, industry or thematic research within Machinery & Electrical Equipment that informed an investment, strategy or operating decision.
* Direct exposure to expert interviews, earnings or market-event analysis, or senior-level research discussions.
* Relevant language skills, local-market knowledge, transaction experience or technical credentials for specialist mandates.
* MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant graduate or technical qualification.

Translate stakeholder requirements into technical designs, configure prompts and agent workflows, and validate output quality, task completion, and appropriate human review before production release. Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, approved data sources, and third-party platforms. Configure connectors, retrieval workflows, and approved tool connections, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations where appropriate, while preserving source-system permissions and approved data-access boundaries. Develop and maintain APIs, scripts, and system integrations that enable reliable exchange of data and actions between AI solutions and business systems. Implement authentication, input validation, error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms; maintain version-controlled code, integration documentation, and repeatable testing and deployment procedures. Partner with business and process owners to identify and automate manual, repetitive, or information-intensive activities. Map existing workflows, determine where AI or conventional automation is appropriate, and implement approval steps and exception handling. Establish baseline measures and assess improvements in processing time, manual effort, accuracy, and user adoption. Support and continuously enhance deployed AI solutions throughout their operational lifecycle. Monitor availability, output quality, response times, usage, and operating costs; troubleshoot failures; assess the impact of model, prompt, connector, and platform changes; and implement tested improvements. Maintain support runbooks, provide user guidance, and coordinate incident resolution and operational handover with IT and service owners. Engineer solutions to meet approved security, AI governance, scalability, and operational support requirements. Work with Security and Infrastructure teams to implement least-privilege access, managed credentials, data-handling controls, audit logging, and safeguards against inappropriate data disclosure or unauthorized actions. Validate capacity, reliability, and recovery procedures; document technical dependencies and limitations; and escalate risks or exceptions for review before release. Required Skills & ExperienceIT engineering experience: Typically 7+ years of progressively responsible experience across IT infrastructure, systems engineering, cloud operations, systems integration, or automation, with demonstrated ownership of production services and delivery of maintainable technical solutions. This experience is in IT engineering, not a requirement for an equivalent number of years in AI. Programming and automation: Strong hands-on scripting and programming skills, including working proficiency in Python and practical experience with PowerShell, Bash, or a comparable language. Ability to build, debug, test, and maintain reusable automation and integration code, manage dependencies, and review and validate AI-generated code. APIs and enterprise integration: Experience integrating enterprise applications using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and structured data formats such as JSON. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, application identities, API permissions, pagination, rate limits, retries, and error handling. Infrastructure and cloud foundations: Strong understanding of operating systems, networking, DNS, TLS, identity, storage, and cloud services. Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting workloads on at least one major cloud platform, with familiarity with containers, serverless services, and repeatable environment configuration. Applied generative AI development: Demonstrable hands-on experience building an AI-enabled application, assistant, agent, or workflow using model APIs or an enterprise AI platform, beyond using a conversational AI interface. Ability to explain design choices, integration behavior, testing, and limitations; relevant experience may come from production delivery, pilots, or substantial practical projects. LLM and agent fundamentals: Working understanding of prompt and context design, structured outputs, tool/function calling, context-window limits, model selection, and the quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs of large language models (LLMs). Ability to distinguish deterministic automation from AI-driven workflows and apply bounded execution, human approval, and fallback mechanisms where appropriate. Data and knowledge retrieval: Working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, document preparation, vector or hybrid search, and grounding responses in approved sources. Ability to work with enterprise data and basic SQL, troubleshoot retrieval quality, and preserve source permissions and data-access boundaries. Testing and evaluation: Ability to develop representative test cases, acceptance criteria, and repeatable evaluations for output accuracy, tool-call correctness, task completion, and failure handling. Understand that AI outputs can vary and require evaluation beyond conventional software tests, including regression testing after model, prompt, or connector changes. Secure engineering and AI safeguards: Practical experience implementing least-privilege access, managed identities or service accounts, secrets management, and audit logging. Working awareness of AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, inappropriate disclosure, unreliable outputs, and excessive tool permissions, and the ability to implement approved controls and escalate exceptions. Production delivery and support: Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, change control, and deployment and rollback procedures. Ability to use logs, metrics, and traces to troubleshoot distributed workflows, monitor availability and response quality, manage usage and cost, and maintain operational documentation and runbooks. Business analysis and collaboration: Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, document dependencies and limitations, and explain tradeoffs to nontechnical stakeholders. Experience working across IT, Security, and business teams, supporting adoption, and measuring outcomes such as reduced manual effort, improved processing time, and solution reliability. Continuous learning and engineering judgment: Demonstrated ability to learn emerging platforms through hands-on experimentation, assess vendor capabilities critically, and select the simplest supportable approach that meets the business need. Ability to work independently within agreed architecture, governance, and delivery priorities. Preferred / Beneficial ExperienceExperience with an enterprise AI platform or agent-development framework, such as Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock, or a comparable platform; depth in one relevant ecosystem is more important than familiarity with every product. Experience developing or securing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom agent tools, AI gateways, or connectors to enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, IT service management, or collaboration platforms. Experience with infrastructure as code, workflow orchestration, message queues, vector databases, or AI observability and evaluation tooling. Experience moving an AI pilot into supported production operation, including user acceptance, operational handover, usage controls, and measurement of business benefits. Relevant cloud, automation, DevOps, security, or AI engineering certifications, or equivalent demonstrated practical experience. Advanced machine-learning research, foundation-model training, a postgraduate AI degree, and extensive experience with every emerging agent framework are not prerequisites for this applied engineering role.

title: Technical Lead - SDET
description:
Location: Noida, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  

* About the role

TAC powers IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services for customers around the world. It manages the full life of SIMs and eSIMs: provisioning, activation, subscription changes and termination. Customers use it to connect millions of devices and consumers.
  
  
We are changing how we build and test TAC. AI is now part of how we design, code, test and deliver. We want quality to move at the same speed.
  
  
This is a senior role. You will own quality for your area from test strategy to release sign-off. You will design how we test, not only run tests. You will use AI to test faster and better, and you will lead the team in doing the same.
  
  
You work with limited supervision, make sound technical calls, and are trusted by the Senior Engineering Manager, architects and product owners on quality decisions.
  
  

* Why this role exists
* Our platform keeps growing: more GSMA specs, more customers, more devices, more cloud environments.
* Manual testing cannot keep up. We need strong automation that people trust.
* AI can cut the time spent on test design, test data, failure analysis and reporting. We need someone who can prove it and scale it.
* We need a senior voice on quality: someone who sets direction, guides others and holds the bar.
* Releases must stay safe. Every release needs clear evidence that it works, is secure and performs.
* Key responsibilities

3.1 IVVQ and test ownership
  
  

* Plan and run integration, verification, validation and qualification (IVVQ) for every TAC release.
* Design test plans, traceability matrices and a clear regression strategy.
* Review requirements and user stories early. Flag gaps, risks and unclear points before development starts.
* Define entry and exit criteria for each stage of testing.
* Prepare test reports and release sign-off evidence.
* Follow the DDPS delivery process and its quality gates. Make sure evidence is ready on time.
* Support audits, co-assessments and engineering fundamentals reviews with clear test records.

3.2 IoT and mobile connectivity testing
  
  

* Test end-to-end connectivity services: SIM and eSIM activation, subscription changes, suspend and resume, and termination.
* Test IoT use cases: device onboarding, eSIM provisioning at scale, and profile switching between operators.
* Test integrations with mobile network operators (MNOs) and connectivity partners.
* Check data, SMS and roaming-related service behavior where it applies to TAC.
* Test bulk and batch operations across large device fleets.
* Check customer-facing APIs, order flows and error handling against specs and customer needs.
* Reproduce customer issues and build regression tests so they do not come back.

3.3 eSIM and GSMA domain testing
  
  

* Test TAC against GSMA specifications: SGP.22 (consumer), and SGP.31 and SGP.32 (IoT).
* Test Remote SIM Provisioning flows end to end: profile download, enable, disable and delete.
* Test eIM operations and the roles of IPAd, IPAe, SM-DP+ and eUICC.
* Run tests with real SIM and eSIM cards, test profiles and test certificates.
* Check that test setups stay valid when external parts change, such as the GSMA test CI or certificates.
* Follow GSMA test specs (for example SGP.23 and SGP.33) as a guide for conformance coverage.

3.4 Test automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automation frameworks for API, UI, end-to-end and card-level tests.
* Keep the code clean, reusable and easy to review. Treat test code like product code.
* Make tests stable. Find and fix flaky tests quickly.
* Manage test data and test environments so tests are repeatable.
* Automate anything that is done twice.

3.5 AI-assisted testing and delivery
  
  

* Use AI tools to generate test cases, test data and automation code from requirements and specs.
* Use AI to analyze failures, group similar defects, find patterns and spot flaky tests.
* Use AI to draft test reports, release notes and defect summaries. Always check the facts.
* Review AI output with a critical eye. You own the final quality.
* Build small AI-assisted tools and workflows that save the team time.
* Try new AI testing ideas. Measure the gain (time saved, defects found, coverage) and share what works.
* Protect data. Know what can and cannot be shared with AI tools.
* Help the team build good prompting habits and safe AI practices.

3.6 Quality, security and performance
  
  

* Use SonarQube quality gates. Track code smells, bugs and coverage, and help fix them.
* Use Fortify for static security scans. Track findings to closure and retest fixes.
* Do basic security and API security testing, including authentication and authorization checks (OAuth, Keycloak).
* Run performance, load, stress, endurance and resilience tests, including large device and order volumes.
* Do performance engineering and benchmarking: set baselines, compare releases and report trends.
* Find bottlenecks and work with developers on fixes. Retest to confirm the gain.

3.7 Platform and delivery
  
  

* Integrate tests into CI/CD so every build gets fast feedback.
* Test on Kubernetes, using Docker images and Helm charts.
* Validate deliveries on GCP and AWS environments.
* Use Git for code, branching and code reviews.
* Test gateway, security and infrastructure components, for example Kong, APISIX and Keycloak.
* Check upgrade, rollback and deployment paths, not only features.

3.8 Agile ways of working and teamwork
  
  

* Take part in PI planning, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives in an Agile and SAFe setup.
* Triage defects, find root causes and work closely with developers, architects and product owners.
* Work with Product, Platform, DevOps and Blueprint teams on shared deliveries.
* Mentor junior testers. Raise the quality bar of the team.
* Update the Senior Engineering Manager on quality, risks and progress. Speak up early.

3.9 Senior-level ownership and leadership
  
  

* Own the test strategy for your area of TAC. Decide what to test, how deep, and with which tools.
* Design the architecture of our automation frameworks. Set standards for structure, reuse, naming and reviews.
* Lead release sign-off for your area. Take the go or no-go quality view and explain the risks clearly.
* Define and own the AI-in-testing roadmap: pick use cases, run pilots, measure gains and scale what works.
* Set quality gates and metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, performance trends) and report them to leadership.
* Influence requirements, architecture and design reviews from a testability and risk point of view.
* Lead technical triage for customer escalations and critical defects. Drive root cause and prevention.
* Estimate effort, plan capacity and raise risks early during PI and sprint planning.
* Coach and mentor testers and engineers. Review their work, grow their skills and build a strong bench.
* Take part in interviews and hiring, and help build the team’s skills plan.
* Work across teams (Product, Platform, DevOps, Blueprint, other feature teams) and resolve quality dependencies.
* What we are looking for

4.1 Must have
  
  

* Experience: 6+ years in QA, SDET or IVVQ roles, with strong automation work and 2+ years as owner or lead of a test area or framework.
* Framework design: Proven record of designing and growing automation frameworks, not only using them.
* Programming: Strong in Java or Python. Able to write clean, maintainable test code.
* Automation tools: Hands-on with tools such as Selenium, REST Assured, Postman, Cypress or Playwright.
* API testing: Solid skills in REST, JSON, OAuth and Keycloak basics.
* Connectivity: Understanding of IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services (SIM lifecycle, subscriptions, MNO integration).
* eSIM: Good understanding of eSIM, eUICC and the Remote SIM Provisioning flow.
* GSMA: Working knowledge of SGP.22 and SGP.31 / SGP.32. Understanding of IPAd, IPAe and eIM roles.
* CI/CD: Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar.
* Containers: Hands-on with Docker as the container, Kubernetes as the orchestrator and Helm as the package manager.
* Cloud: Familiar with GCP or AWS as a platform.
* Source control: Git for repository management, branching and reviews.
* Quality and security tools: Experience with SonarQube and Fortify, or similar tools.
* Performance: Experience in performance testing, performance engineering and benchmarking.
* Process: Agile development experience. Good test design: test plans, traceability, coverage and regression strategy.
* Leadership: Experience mentoring others and influencing decisions without formal authority.
* Communication: Clear written and spoken communication, including reporting risks to senior stakeholders and customers.

4.2 AI skills we expect
  
  

* Daily use of AI assistants for coding and testing.
* Able to write clear prompts and review AI output with care.
* Understand AI limits: wrong answers, bias and data privacy.
* Comfort building AI-assisted test tools or workflows and driving their adoption across a team.
* Curiosity to learn new AI tools and test whether they really help.

4.3 Good to have
  
  

* Cellular basics: 4G/5G, LTE-M, NB-IoT, APN and roaming.
* Experience with a connectivity management platform (CMP) or an IoT platform.
* Experience with SGP.21, SGP.23 and SGP.33 test specs.
* Knowledge of SM-DP+, SM-DS and eIM servers.
* Performance tools such as JMeter, Gatling or k6.
* Jira and Xray for test management.
* Experience with AI agents or LLM-based test generation.
* Security testing: OWASP, API security.
* Experience with API gateways such as Kong or APISIX.
* Telecom or IoT product background.

4.4 Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecom or a related field.
* How this role supports our AI transformation

We expect AI to become part of normal testing work. This table shows how we see it.
  
  
**Area**
**What AI Helps With, And What You Do**
**Test design**
AI drafts test cases and edge cases from specs and requirements. You review, fix and approve them.
  
  
**Test data**
AI helps create varied and realistic data. You check it is safe, valid and free of customer data.
  
  
**Automation code**
AI helps write and refactor test scripts. You review for quality, readability and correctness.
  
  
**Failure analysis**
AI groups failures and points to likely causes. You confirm the root cause with developers.
  
  
**Reporting**
AI drafts reports and summaries. You check every fact before it is shared.
  
  
**Team enablement**
You share prompts, tips and working examples so the whole team improves.
  
  
**Roadmap and governance**
You pick the use cases, define safe-use rules, measure the gain and report it to leadership.
  
  
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Associate Sr. SDET
description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Associate Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering, test automation, and reliability across a fintech technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have strong programming expertise, hands-on experience building scalable automation frameworks, and a deep understanding of API-driven, distributed, and cloud-native systems. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure the quality, security, performance, and reliability of financial applications, payment workflows, and transaction-processing systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Develop automated test solutions using Java, Python, or other suitable programming languages.
* Build and maintain automated test suites for REST APIs, microservices, GraphQL, databases, and asynchronous workflows.
* Validate financial transaction workflows, payment processing, transaction status updates, data integrity, and error-handling scenarios.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and reliable releases.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, scalability, and reliability testing.
* Design and execute load and stress tests to evaluate system behaviour under peak transaction volumes.
* Investigate and troubleshoot complex defects across distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, and DevOps teams to define test strategies and quality standards.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, test utilities, service mocks, and test data management solutions.
* Work with containerised applications and Kubernetes-based environments to validate service reliability and deployment quality.
* Monitor test execution results, analyse failures, and provide actionable insights through test reports and quality metrics.
* Test security-sensitive workflows, access controls, data validation, and negative scenarios.
* Mentor junior SDETs and contribute to automation best practices, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Own quality engineering activities from test planning and design through execution and release validation.

**Technical Skills – Requirements**

* 6+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and quality engineering, including substantial hands-on automation development.
* Must have strong coding experience of Java/ groovy, Selenium and Database(relational) Unit Testing framework and performance testing.
* Hands on experience in building testing framework(s) BDD Cucumber/TestNG
* Must have hands on experience in Frontend automation using Selenium/appium or any other tool
* Must have hands-on experience in Web Services Automation using Java/groovy.
* Must have hands-on experience in Database testing. Well versed with writing complex SQL.
* Must have knowledge of any build tool Gradle/Maven/ANT etc.
* Must have good knowledge of CI/CD on Jenkins/ Gitlab
* Experience with Agile Methodologies, Tools (JIRA, Confluence).
* Must have hands-on knowledge in AI usage and AI tools.
* Must have exposure to design custom automation framework
* Must have exposure in Continuous Integration using Bamboo/Jenkins
* Must have exposure of Agile Methodology
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event-driven workflows.
* Good to have knowledge in performance & Security testing
* Exposure of stored procedure and PL/SQL
* Working knowledge of Unix commands
* Good to have exposure in Mobile Automation using Appium/browserstack.
* Exposure of monitoring tools such as Splunk , Dynatrace etc.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills; attention to detail, thoroughness and strong ownership of work.
* Strong expertise in API automation and REST API testing; familiarity with GraphQL is an advantage.
* Experience in performance and scalability testing, including load generation, bottleneck identification, and system behaviour analysis.
* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, debugging, troubleshooting, and code reviews.
* Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years of experience
* Experience in fintech, payments, digital banking, prepaid cards, or other financial technology platforms.
* Familiarity with payment processing workflows, transaction lifecycle management, reconciliation, and financial data validation.
* Knowledge of security testing principles, OWASP guidelines, authentication, authorisation, and secure API testing.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
* Familiarity with service virtualisation and mocking tools such as WireMock.
* Experience with Helm, service mesh technologies, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk.
* Experience with test reporting, quality metrics, and automation coverage analysis.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* A quality-focused engineer who builds robust automation solutions rather than relying solely on manual testing.
* A proactive problem-solver who identifies risks early and improves product reliability through effective test strategies.
* An engineering professional who can troubleshoot complex technical issues across services and infrastructure.
* Someone who values clean code, reusable frameworks, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

SEO is a primary revenue and customer-acquisition engine. We are looking for a seasoned **SEO Manager** to lead our organic search team and scale our presence across highly competitive fintech and affiliate categories—including coupons, cashback, credit cards, personal loans, and instant money products.

You will own end-to-end organic growth strategy across traditional Google Search and emerging AI-driven discovery ecosystems (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini), mentoring a team of SEO specialists while driving measurable revenue and conversion outcomes.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 4+ years (3+ years with an advanced degree)

**Only candidates from Tier 1 institutes are eligible to apply.**

**Mandatory Skills**: Python / TypeScript / Java, Playwright / Cypress / Selenium, API testing (RestAssured / Postman / Newman), CI/CD test gating, automation framework design

**Role Summary**

Build and own the automation framework and regression suite that decides whether a release reaches production, with real authority to stop a deployment. This is an engineering role, not manual testing with some Selenium attached: you join the design conversation and test for logical failures, not just visual ones.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Framework: API and UI automation built as a codebase with the same standards as the product.

* Regression suite: Fast enough that people run it and trustworthy enough that a red build means something.

* Release gating: Define and enforce pre-production validation and criteria for going to production.

* Contract and integration tests: Across services and across the boundary with connected organisations.

* Quality signal: Defect triage, coverage and escape metrics that leadership can act on.

* Testing blind: Design test data, fixtures and failure diagnosis that work without reading personal data payloads.

* Proving a negative: Test that an append-only, tamper-evident consent ledger cannot be quietly subverted.

* Withdrawal propagation: Verify across a distributed system, including failure paths, that a withdrawal reaches every connected organisation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 years building test automation as software, or 3 years with an advanced degree, or equivalent practical experience.

* Has designed an automation framework from scratch, not only written tests inside someone else’s.

* Strong programming in Python, TypeScript or Java.

* Playwright, Cypress or Selenium at depth, and API testing with RestAssured, Postman/Newman or equivalent.

* Tests wired into CI as a gate that can genuinely block a release.

* Test design as a discipline: risk-based coverage, boundary and negative cases, and judgement on what not to automate.

* Hands-on use of AI-assisted testing tools for authoring, maintenance or coverage analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Contract testing between services (Pact or equivalent).

* Performance and load testing with JMeter, k6 or Locust.

* Security testing fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation edge cases, injection paths.

* Mobile test automation, ideally Flutter.

* ISTQB certification.

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

title: Substation Automation Engineer
description:
As a Substation Automation Engineer, you will support the technical delivery of digital control and protection systems for complex HVDC projects. Operating across New Product Introduction (NPI), requisition (ITO/OTR), and Product Care, you will combine hands-on engineering execution—such as IEC 61850 configuration, schematic design, and system testing—with continuous learning and collaboration alongside senior technical experts to meet project cost, schedule, and quality targets.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Design, Implementation and Integration**

* Support project designs and delivery in alignment with customer specifications, internal reference solutions, and senior engineer guidance.

* Assist in the preparation of base and detailed design documents for HVDC Control and Protection systems, including communication architecture descriptions, HMI Functional Design Specifications (FDS), test specifications, I/O lists, and switchgear interlocking specifications.

* Prepare IED configurations for Bay Control Units (BCU) and Merging Units (MU) based on approved I/O lists.

* Configure IEC 61850-based systems (GOOSE, SV, MMS) utilizing vendor-specific tools and System Configuration Tools to generate Substation Configuration Description Language (SCL) files.

* Assist in preparing HMI and Communication Gateway database configurations based on I/O lists.

* Support the integration of IEDs, HMIs, and Gateways during Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

* Assist in preparing Fibre Optic Cable schedules (interconnection diagrams) based on communication architecture and panel layouts.

* Produce control panel and cabinet manufacturing documentation using standard design tools (e.g., Engineering Base):

o Panel General Assembly (GA) drawings, Cabinet Design, and Electrical Schematics.

o Interconnection Diagrams and Cable Schedules.

o Bills of Materials (BOM) and Routine Test specifications.

* Verify electrical and physical interfaces between HVDC Control and Protection cabinets and primary equipment (e.g., Circuit Breakers, Disconnectors, Earth Switches, and Instrument Transformers [CT/VT/CVT]) under the direction of senior engineers.

  

**2. Testing and Debugging**

  

* Assist with systematic root-cause analysis and debugging for electrical circuits, auxiliary power systems, control panels, and automation hardware during manufacturing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

* Troubleshoot IEC 61850 communication streams, sampled values (SV), and Layer 2/3 substation network switches using industry-standard tools (e.g., Wireshark, IED Scout) with guidance from senior staff.

* Support FAT execution, help coordinate control system integration with Balance of Plant (BoP) and SCADA/HMI platforms, and work closely with assembly and QA teams during cabinet wiring and integration.

  

**3. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration**

* Actively participate in technical training, skill development, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the department.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (project management, primary design, quality) to ensure design quality and support delivery targets.

* Review design documents under the mentorship of senior engineers, contributing fresh perspectives to continuous improvement initiatives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, or a related field.

* **4-8 years** of professional experience in IEC 61850-based substation control and protection system design, integration, testing, or commissioning.

* Foundational hands-on debugging and troubleshooting experience across hardware, wiring, measurement circuits, and IEC 61850 communication protocols (GOOSE, SV, MMS).

* Familiarity with electrical schematic design, cabinet engineering, interconnection engineering, and C&P relay logic development.

* Basic technical understanding of substation measurement circuits, hardware signal mapping, and tripping/interlocking schemes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity best practices.

* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills with a willingness to learn in a complex system engineering environment.

* Demonstrated ability to take direction, solve routine engineering problems, and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

* A detail-oriented mindset focused on producing quality designs that meet performance and reliability targets.

  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

description:

**About Simform:**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.

  

Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Role Summary:**

Simform is hiring a Senior L1 Support Engineer to support production systems across multiple client engagements. The role combines strong SRE/DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident response) with the ability to coordinate directly with clients, understand SLA commitments, and own issues end-to-end against TTR/TTO targets

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own incident response end-to-end: acknowledge, diagnose, mitigate, resolve, and document root cause (RCA).
* Write clear, structured RCA documents for major incidents - timeline, root cause, impact, and corrective actions.
* Conduct thorough shift handovers - open issues, in-progress incidents, and pending follow-ups documented and communicated so the incoming shift can pick up without delay.
* Escalate per the support/escalation matrix when an issue needs deeper architecture or product-level involvement.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks (deployments, scaling, backups, alerting) to reduce manual toil.
* Maintain runbooks, dashboards, and documentation so operational knowledge compounds across engagements.
* Participate in a 24/7 on-call/shift rotation and report SLA/TTR/TTO metrics to internal and client stakeholders Monthly

**Required Skills**

**Technical**

* Must have Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP plus) - compute, networking, IAM, storage.
* Must have Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Must have Scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep/ARM, or CloudFormation) and configuration management.
* Working knowledge of Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Datadog, or similar).
* Working knowledge of databases and data pipelines is a plus when supporting data platform engagements.

**ITSM & Alerting Tools**

* Working with any ITSM tools like Jira Service Desk, Freshdesk, or similar.
* Worked with alerting and on-call tools like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or similar.

**Communication**

* Confident, clear communicator who can run or join client calls, give status updates, and explain technical root causes to non-technical stakeholders.
* Able to coordinate across the client and internal engineering/support teams during an incident without dropping the thread.
* Strong shift-handover discipline - able to hand off and pick up open incidents cleanly across time zones with no information loss.
* Skilled at writing clear RCA documentation that a reader with no prior context can follow.
* Disciplined documentation habits - every incident, change, and escalation logged as it happens

**Support Process**

* Solid understanding of SLA (Service Level Agreement) structures - severity/priority tiers and what each commits to.
* Working knowledge of TTR (Time to Resolve) and TTO/TTA (Time to Respond/Acknowledge) and how they're measured and reported.
* Understands escalation matrices and when to escalate vs. own an issue

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 2–4 years in a Support / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering role (B.E./ B. Tech. or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience supporting production systems with defined SLAs/uptime commitments.
* Cloud certification (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is a strong plus
* Experience directly coordinating with clients or external stakeholders, not just internal teams, preferred.
* Willingness to work in rotating shifts / on call, with overlap into client time zones

**Why Join Us:**

* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.
* Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities
