title: AI Engineer 3
description:
**Job Title**
AI Engineer 3
  
  
**Business Environment**
Joining Amadeus means shaping the technology that keeps airports and airlines moving for millions of travelers every day. Our department, Airport and Airline Operations (AirOps), is the leading industry platform in airline and airport operations, delivering seamless and personalized passenger experience, an optimized airport operation, and automated disruption resolution between airlines, airports, border, and air traffic control.
  
  
Within AirOps Engineering in Bangalore (TRU-AOP-ENG), the FBR team [Flight Management, Baggage Reconciliation and Ramp operations] works closely with engineering, product and data colleagues across Amadeus sites worldwide. It delivers solutions for efficient and optimized airport and airline operations.
  
  
In FBR you will work on AI solutioning that has a visible impact on airline and airport operations.
  
  

* Meaningful work applying generative and agentic AI to real operational challenges in the travel industry.
* Modern, cloud-native technology and the chance to influence architecture and engineering practices.
* Continuous learning, with exposure to emerging AI technologies and opportunities to grow your expertise.
* A collaborative, inclusive culture that values diversity, flexibility and work-life balance.

**Summary of the Role : AI Engineer**
As an AI Engineer in FBR, you will join a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, data engineers, data scientists, product specialists and designers building the next generation of AI-powered solutions for airport and airline operations. The team develops cloud-native services with modern frontend and backend technologies, with a strong focus on production-grade AI agents and AI advisors.
  
  
You will combine deep expertise in generative and agentic AI with solid machine learning and MLOps foundations to design, develop and deploy scalable, AI-driven solutions. Working autonomously within defined processes, you will turn real business problems into reliable, secure and cost-efficient AI capabilities that operate at production scale.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities**

* Own the design, development, deployment and maintenance of GenAI-powered solutions that support analytics and aviation operations, including new AI accelerators.
* Implement and produce GenAI and agentic workflows using cloud-native technologies, primarily Microsoft Azure within a multi-cloud strategy, integrating them with existing data platforms and operational systems.
* Build and maintain scalable APIs and backend services for conversational interfaces, tool-calling agents and AI-assisted analytics features, with close attention to latency, cost and reliability.
* Design and develop scalable AI/ML solutions for real business problems, building and deploying predictive and optimization models on structured and unstructured data.
* Drive the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from data preparation, training and validation through deployment and monitoring, ensuring model performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply Responsible AI principles throughout delivery, including security, data privacy, compliance and transparent handling of model limitations.
* Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers and share best practices across the team.
* Stay current with advances in AI/ML and generative AI, and drive innovation by evaluating new techniques and tools for FBR use cases.
* Deliver within Agile/SAFe ways of working, adapting to changing customer-driven needs.

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Design and orchestrate agentic AI systems (for example with LangGraph or Agent Development Kit), including tool calling, memory and multi-step reasoning, and the supporting infrastructure from concept to deployment.
* Contribute to the design and optimization of AI context management, covering embeddings, retrieval (RAG), prompt construction and caching, so that AI experiences are fed with reliable, compliant data.
* Establish LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrails, including offline and online evaluation, completeness and safety checks, and iterative improvement driven by real usage.
* Optimize cost and latency of AI workloads through model selection, token and context budgeting, caching and efficient serving patterns.
* Build and integrate data pipelines and deploy ML/DL models (regression, classification, clustering, NLP, deep learning) with TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn into production systems.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility, and appropriate evaluation metrics and tuning.
* Ensure end-to-end observability of AI services through logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting, and troubleshoot data and model issues in production.
* Leverage Azure (and where relevant AWS or GCP) for AI/ML workloads, using serverless containers, event-driven architectures and API gateways.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Data Engineers and cross-functional product, engineering and business teams.
* Translate business problems into data-driven AI solutions with clear success criteria.
* Communicate insights, model outcomes and technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build alignment across stakeholders through data-backed approaches.

**About The Ideal Candidate**
**Must have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in AI/ML development and deployment.
* Hands-on experience shipping GenAI solutions to production: prompt design, orchestration, RAG (e.g. Azure AI Search), evaluation frameworks, monitoring and iterative improvement from real usage.
* Experience designing and orchestrating agentic AI systems (e.g. LangGraph, Agent Development Kit) from concept to deployment.
* Strong Python (preferred) or Java/Scala, with good engineering practices: testing, code reviews and documentation.
* Solid grounding in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), statistics, probability and data modeling.
* Experience with large datasets and distributed computing.
* Solid cloud experience, preferably Azure (serverless, containers, event-driven architectures, API gateways, logging and monitoring), and MLOps practices.
* Working knowledge of Responsible AI, security and data-privacy requirements for AI systems.

**Nice to have**

* Aviation, airline or airport operations domain knowledge.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool-calling patterns.
* Experience with vector databases.
* Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Azure AI certifications.
* Experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work autonomously within defined processes.
* Clear, confident communication in English, both written and verbal.
* Thrives in a multi-cultural, global organization and adapts readily to changing, customer-driven needs.
* Collaborative mindset, curiosity and a willingness to mentor and share knowledge.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.
  
  
Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
**Be aware of recruitment scams**
Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
**About The Company**
Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.
  
  
**Role Overview :**
The Lead Data Scientist in the Research & Rapid Prototyping team owns the research agenda for a problem area within our eDiscovery platform, translating ambiguous business needs into tractable research questions and driving them through to working prototypes.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical influence. You will set the direction and the standard for how we apply Large Language Models and other advanced techniques to enterprise and legal documents, and you will mentor other data scientists on the team as you do it. The role is a natural stepping stone toward people leadership: you will develop and guide others without carrying formal line management responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership: Own end-to-end delivery of research workstreams — from problem framing and scoping, through experimentation and prototyping, to handoff to engineering and product. Make and defend the technical calls that shape how a problem gets solved.
* LLM Specialisation: Set the direction for how we implement, fine-tune, and deploy local Large Language Models for eDiscovery, with a focus on their applicability and efficiency in processing and analysing legal documents such as emails and PDFs.
* Evaluation Methodology: Own the evaluation approach the team works to. Define what "good" looks like for legal-specific tasks, build the benchmarks that measure it, and ensure results are trustworthy enough to make decisions on.
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor junior and senior data scientists through experimental design reviews, code review, and pairing. Raise the bar on research rigour across the team and help others grow into more ambiguous work.
* Horizon Scanning: Evaluate emerging models, tools, and techniques, and make clear build/buy/adopt recommendations. Decide what merits investment, and what should be left alone for now.
* Rapid Prototyping: Quickly build prototypes that demonstrate how emerging technologies can be applied in practice, exercising the judgement to know when a prototype should move to production or whether to move on.
* Statistical Analysis & NLP: Apply statistical analysis and traditional NLP techniques alongside modern methods to extract insights and deepen our understanding of enterprise and legal documents.
* Stakeholder Influence: Communicate findings, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to non-technical leadership. Influence the product roadmap based on what is genuinely technically feasible.
* Multi-modal & Graph Technologies: (Nice to have) Work with multi-modal data (images, audio, etc.) and explore the integration of Knowledge Graphs and other emerging technologies to enrich our solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 5–8 years of applied data science or machine learning experience, including demonstrable depth in modern NLP.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Master's preferred.
* Modern NLP Depth: Strong background working with LLMs, statistical analysis, traditional NLP, and enterprise documents, particularly legal and enterprise documents.
* Technical Stack: Hands-on experience with locally hosted and open-weight LLMs, and a working command of tooling such as:
* Serving & inference: vLLM and a working knowledge of deployment infrastructure (Kubernetes, containerisation etc)
* Modelling: PyTorch, Huggingface transformers, PEFT/LoRA fine-tuning
* Orchestration: LangGraph or comparable agentic/workflow frameworks
* Retrieval: embedding models and vector stores (pgvector or similar)
* Traditional NLP & ML: spaCy, scikit-learn
* Experimentation & delivery: experiment tracking (dvc or similar), Docker, Git
* Track Record: Evidence of research that reached production, or published, patented, or otherwise externally recognised work.
* Mentorship: Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching other technical practitioners — not just willingness to do so.

**Workmode & Shift timings:**

* Work mode : Hybrid ( 3 days in a week at office)

**Our True North in Action**

* Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
* Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

title: Urban Data Scientist
description:
**About the Urban Intelligence Lab**

The Urban Intelligence Lab (UIL) is an independent practice within Sidara, a global group of specialist firms in the built environment. Sidara has more than 55,000 people in over 70 countries, and its firms include Dar, Perkins&Will, TYLin, Currie & Brown, Penspen and Wood.

We make design and strategy decisions through science. We use spatial data, AI and computational methods to define the key questions in a project, test the options against clear measures, and show which choices are most likely to work.

We work in cities across Africa, Asia and the Middle East, often where data is hard to access. We show in detail how a city operates, so that design teams can make better decisions. We use sources such as location data from mobile phones, business locations and street-level imagery, and where data is missing, we create it using cameras and other sensors. In other projects, we have used optimisation to decide where millions of native trees are planted and where centres and land uses are located.

Our multidisciplinary team of 15 includes data scientists, computer scientists, urban planners, architects and economists, who trained at MIT, UCL and IIT. AI agents are a core part of how we work, and we expect everyone in the team to use them well.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an Urban Data Scientist to provide the evidence for design and strategy decisions for cities, using data science, statistics, machine learning and spatial modelling.

This is a hands-on role. You will state urban problems as clear questions, combine different datasets, design experiments, build and test models, and use the results to make recommendations for cities and regions. You will also mentor data scientists and work closely with UIL’s computer scientists, AI engineers, urban planners, architects and economists.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead projects from start to finish framing the questions, acquiring data, building spatial models, and presenting results and recommendations to clients.
* Design and implement advanced spatial models of land use, urban economics, accessibility, spatial interaction, agglomeration, productivity and mobility patterns.
* Use AI agents and LLM-based workflows to speed up data preparation, modelling and reporting, and check their results rigorously.
* Combine data from many sources, such as mobility traces, points of interest, census microdata and transport networks, into consistent datasets for modelling.
* Turn the results of models into clear recommendations, dashboards and visualisations for non-technical audiences, including government ministries and clients.
* Set methodological standards for the team, including how models are validated, how workflows are made reproducible and how methods are documented.
* Mentor data scientists, carry out regular technical reviews and support their professional development. At Lead and Associate level, this includes line management.
* Build and oversee scalable data pipelines for large spatial and mobility datasets, using tools such as PySpark, Dask and DuckDB.
* Contribute to papers and white papers about UIL’s methods and results.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Master’s or PhD in Urban Science, Data Science, Urban Economics, Geoinformatics, Urban Planning or a closely related discipline.
* At least 5 years of professional experience applying data science to urban, spatial or infrastructure questions.
* Expert skills in Python, with deep knowledge of spatial data structures, coordinate reference systems and the processing of vector and raster data (for example with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL and Rasterio).
* Strong hands-on experience using AI agents and agentic workflows in day-to-day work, including coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to check and correct their output.
* A strong background in at least two of: urban econometrics or causal inference, machine learning for spatial data, transport demand modelling, or urban informatics.
* Experience working with large datasets, using tools such as PySpark, Dask, DuckDB or Polars.
* Proven ability to produce work that is ready for clients and to present it to senior, non-technical audiences.
* Experience mentoring or managing analysts in a professional setting.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience building agentic workflows or tools, for example with LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience designing and managing spatial databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS).
* Background in modelling urban systems, such as transport models, land-use transport interaction (LUTI) models or agent-based simulation.
* Experience with a major cloud platform and with tools for orchestrating workflows, such as Airflow or Prefect. We use Microsoft Azure, but experience on AWS or Google Cloud Platform is also relevant.
* A record of published work, such as journal articles, conference papers or technical reports.
* Familiarity with the working methods and data standards of multilateral institutions such as the World Bank, AfDB, UNDP and GIZ.
* Experience working on projects in developing cities, for example in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or elsewhere in the Global South.
* Interest in cities and how they work.

description:
**About the Urban Intelligence Lab**

The Urban Intelligence Lab (UIL) is an independent practice within Sidara, a global group of specialist firms in the built environment. Sidara has more than 55,000 people in over 70 countries, and its firms include Dar, Perkins&Will, TYLin, Currie & Brown, Penspen and Wood.

We make design and strategy decisions through science. We use spatial data, AI and computational methods to define the key questions in a project, test the options against clear measures, and show which choices are most likely to work.

In other projects, we have used optimisation to decide where millions of native trees are planted and where centres and land uses are located.

Our multidisciplinary team of 15 includes data scientists, computer scientists, urban planners, architects and economists, who trained at MIT, UCL and IIT. AI agents are a core part of how we work, and we expect everyone in the team to use them well.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to solve the most technically demanding problems in our projects, in areas such as optimisation, network analysis and large-scale computation on city data. The problems come from several fields and change from one project to the next, so you should enjoy working out new approaches rather than repeating a standard method.

This is a hands-on role that combines science with engineering. You will take loosely defined urban problems and state them as precise computational problems, review the literature for promising approaches, assess how well they fit, and build working implementations yourself. We are looking for someone with strong algorithmic thinking, sound technical judgement and the confidence to reason through a problem step by step.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take full responsibility for technical problems in areas such as urban mobility, optimisation, network analysis and large-scale computation, from initial exploration to a working, validated solution that can be used in design and strategy decisions.
* Define the end-to-end approach to each problem, including the choice of algorithms, data pipelines, tools and computing platforms that are needed to run it on city-scale data.
* Set meaningful KPIs and evaluation metrics for every problem and link them to the questions that the client needs answered, so that success is measured objectively from the start.
* Implement algorithms from published papers in tested, production-quality code: reproduce the reported results, adapt the method to UIL’s urban data, and compare your solution with published methods and the best current baselines.
* Write clean, efficient, well-structured Python code and understand every component in depth. Use AI agents and agentic workflows to speed up exploration, prototyping and testing, as an aid rather than a substitute for engineering judgement.
* Work closely with UIL’s data scientists, AI engineers, urban planners, architects and economists, and explain the reasoning behind technical decisions clearly: how the problem was framed, which approach was chosen, the trade-offs and the results.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics and Computing, or a closely related field.
* At least 5 years of experience in applied science, algorithm development or scientific computing, and a record of completing projects from start to finish.
* At least 3 years of experience in areas such as urban mobility, network and graph analysis, audio processing and computer vision, or large-scale optimisation.
* Strong programming skills in Python and a solid grounding in computer science: data structures, algorithm design and analysis, complexity theory, discrete mathematics, linear algebra, probability and numerical methods.
* Proficiency with Git, using platforms such as GitHub, GitLab or Azure DevOps.
* Strong hands-on experience using AI agents and agentic workflows in day-to-day work, including coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to check and correct their output.
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, including computing, storage and running large workloads. We use Microsoft Azure, but experience on AWS or Google Cloud Platform is also relevant.
* Excellent analytical reasoning and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience building agentic workflows or tools, for example with LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with optimisation libraries such as pymoo, Google OR-Tools, Pyomo and SciPy’s optimize module.
* Familiarity with frameworks for computer vision, machine learning and deep learning, such as OpenCV, scikit-image, PyTorch, TensorFlow and XGBoost.
* Experience using Docker to package applications so that they run the same way in every environment.
* Skills in data engineering, including building data pipelines on Azure with tools such as Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory, and processing large datasets with PySpark.
* Published papers, open-source contributions or results in competitive programming that show strong algorithmic skills.
* Experience working on projects in developing cities, for example in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or elsewhere in the Global South.
* Interest in cities and how they work.

title: Data Scientist, Product Analytics
description:
As a Data Scientist at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Oculus). By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to one of the richest data sets in the world, you will help define the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses around the world. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a varied set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance and others. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve product development's biggest challenges. You will influence product strategy and investment decisions with data, be focused on impact, and collaborate with other teams. By joining Meta, you will become part of a analytics community dedicated to skill development and career growth in analytics and beyond.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and ensure the products we build bring value to people, businesses, and Meta. You will help your partner teams prioritize what to build, set goals, and understand their product's ecosystem.Analytics: You will guide teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a varied toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will influence your partners using clear, data-driven insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
  
  
Data Scientist, Product Analytics Responsibilities:
  
  

* Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches
* Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses
* Identify and measure success of product efforts through goal setting, forecasting, and monitoring of key product metrics to understand trends
* Define, understand, and test opportunities and levers to improve the product, and drive roadmaps through your insights and recommendations
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, a relevant technical field, or equivalent
* 6+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R)
* 6+ years of experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches, understanding ecosystems, user behaviors & long-term product trends, and leading data-driven projects from definition to execution [including defining metrics, experiment, design, communicating actionable insights]

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Master's or Ph.D. Degree in a quantitative field

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: SENIOR, DATA SCIENTIST
description: About The RoleMerchandising Data Science builds the systems — both automated decision engines and decision support systems — that drive high-stakes merchandising decisions: how we select and curate items, manage space, plan and allocate inventory, flow inventory through the network, decide what and how much to buy, read the competitive landscape, and price. As a Staff Data Scientist, you own a single, hard problem end-to-end — not an abstract domain, but a specific question like "how do we estimate price elasticities better?", "how do we reduce forecast error for seasonal items a year out?", or "how do we incorporate all constraints at DC outbound so the planned flow can actually be executed, exceptions and all?" Depending on the problem, the answer is a system that decides automatically, or one that gives a merchant or planner the right recommendation, tradeoff, and evidence to decide well. You take the problem from a rough business question to a precise formulation to a production system, and you make sure it keeps getting better even on the days you're not in the room. You are an individual contributor with no direct reports — your leverage comes from raising the judgment and standards of the people working alongside you on that problem, not from personal output alone.What you'll doOwn one hard, well-defined problem end-to-end — e.g., "how do we estimate price elasticities better?" or "how do we reduce forecast error for seasonal items a year out?" — from rough business question to precise formulation to production system.Define what a good answer looks like: decision variables or recommendation logic, objective function, constraints, fallback behavior, and measurable success criteria.Decide whether the problem calls for a fully automated decision engine or a decision support system that augments a human decision-maker, and design accordingly.Choose and implement the right solution approach — optimization, heuristics, simulation, forecasting, causal/statistical inference, or a hybrid — and defend the choice on evidence.Build the production system, not a prototype, integrating with the merchandising, planning, and platform systems it depends on.Establish patterns, methods, and quality standards on this problem that other people working on it (Senior DS, engineers) adopt and extend.Define the metrics and run the experiments that prove the answer is actually better — this may be estimation accuracy, forecast error, executability of a plan, margin, sell-through, or trust/adoption of a recommendation, depending on the problem.Create mechanisms — documentation, reusable components, decision frameworks — so continued progress on the problem does not depend on you personally.Proactively surface the next-most-important version of the problem before being asked (e.g., once elasticity estimation improves for core items, is the next gap seasonal or new items?).Use AI-accelerated development (copilots, agents, evaluators) to speed iteration while holding a high bar for correctness and maintainability.Communicate the problem, tradeoff, recommendation, and "so what" clearly to engineering leads, merchants, and business stakeholders.What you'll bringA track record of taking a hard, specific business question — not a vague domain — and shipping a system, automated or decision-support, that measurably improved the answer.Solid depth in optimization/decision methods (mathematical programming, constraint programming, heuristics, or simulation) and applied ML/forecasting/causal inference where relevant.Experience with problems like: demand or elasticity estimation, long-horizon or seasonal forecasting, constrained planning/execution (e.g., DC outbound flow), assortment or allocation optimization, or competitive/price response modeling — in merchandising, retail, supply chain, or a comparable setting.Comfort building for two different kinds of "users" — a machine executing a decision automatically, and a human (merchant, planner, analyst) who needs the right recommendation and evidence to decide well.Demonstrated ability to make others working on the same problem better — through review, mentorship, or reusable standards — not just to produce more yourself.Sound judgment on when to pursue optimality vs. a robust heuristic, and when to automate a decision vs. support a human making it, with the ability to explain the tradeoff.A bias for iteration with accountability: you stay with a problem through adoption and validation, not just through ship.No people-management experience required — this is an individual-contributor leadership role built on influence, not authority.About Walmart Global TechImagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate on a scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.We’re back at workWalmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.BenefitsBeyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.BelongingWe aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.Equal Opportunity EmployerWalmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. description:

**Job Description:**
***Objective / Purpose:***
*Describe at the highest level the team where this job sits and how this role will contribute to the team’s delivery of critical function.*

* Serve as a Manager-level Clinical Data Scientist within Data & Quantitative Sciences, applying statistical, data science, and analytical methods to support clinical development programs.

*Primary duties and responsibilities; essential functions only.*

* Perform exploratory analyses, data visualization, and quantitative assessments using clinical trial, biomarker, external, and real-world data sources.
* Apply established statistical, machine learning, simulation, and visualization methods to support interpretation of study results and development decisions.

* Review and contribute to outputs produced by internal teams and external partners, ensuring adherence to established standards, processes, and quality expectations.
* Communicate risks related to data quality, analytical assumptions, timelines, and quantitative outputs to study leadership and functional stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts through automation, reusable code, standard methodologies, and adoption of approved technologies and workflows.

***Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):***
*Essential and desirable education and competency requirements to perform the primary responsibilities of the job.*
**Education / Experience:**

* PhD in statistics, biostatistics, data science, epidemiology, biomedical engineering, computer science, quantitative sciences, or related field; or MS with 3+ years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations should be reviewed with HR.
* Experience contributing to quantitative analyses and data science activities within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare research, or other regulated clinical development environments.
* Demonstrated ability to support clinical development decisions through quantitative analysis, data interpretation, and clear communication of evidence.
* Experience working effectively on cross-functional study teams and collaborating across functional disciplines to achieve study objectives.
* Experience working with clinical trial data and at least one additional data type such as biomarker, real-world, external, imaging, digital health, or other high-dimensional data sources.

**Highest-priority Technical Skills:**

* Working knowledge of clinical trial design, drug development, endpoints, estimands, biomarkers, data interpretation, and the role of analytics in clinical decision making.
* Solid foundation in statistics and quantitative methods, including longitudinal analysis, survival methods, causal reasoning, simulation, predictive modeling, and communication of uncertainty.
* Ability to integrate, analyze, and interpret diverse data sources, including clinical trial, biomarker, real-world, external, imaging, digital health, or high-dimensional data as appropriate to assigned studies.

* Familiarity with modern data platforms, reusable analytics workflows, automation, metadata-driven processes, and governed data standards.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Communicates quantitative findings clearly to scientific, operational, technical, and study-team audiences.
* Builds effective working relationships across study teams and functional partners.
* Balances scientific rigor, quality, and timely delivery while proactively communicating risks and issues.
* Demonstrates accountability for assigned deliverables and commitment to reproducible, traceable, high-quality work.
* Demonstrates technical credibility, sound judgment, and collaborative problem-solving skills.
* Embraces continuous learning and adoption of innovative analytical methods, automation, and AI-enabled approaches.

title: Senior Gen AI Scientist
description:
**The team - who are we:**
We are an ambitious team with the shared passion to use data, data science, machine learning, generative AI and engineering excellence to make a difference for our customers.
  
  
We are a team, not a collection of individuals. We value our diverse backgrounds, our different personalities and strengths & weaknesses. We value trust and passionate debates. We challenge each other and hold each other accountable. We uphold a caring feedback culture to help each other grow, professionally and personally.
  
  
We are now seeking a new team member who is excited about building production-grade generative AI and agentic systems that automate and augment end-to-end workflows across container terminal planning, scheduling, execution and operations worldwide, helping terminals compound intelligence across decisions rather than solving problems one at a time.
  
  
**We Offer - This Is What You Get**
You will be part of the APM Terminals team within APMT TECH, responsible for developing and delivering generative AI and agentic solutions for container shipping terminals. As a Senior Generative AI Scientist, you will have a leading role in designing, building, maintaining, and iterating on AI products that directly impact terminal operations and commercial outcomes.
  
  
This position goes well beyond chatbots and single-shot prompting. You will design multi-agent systems that plan, reason, use tools, and act across terminal workflows: berth and yard planning, equipment scheduling, vessel operations, exception handling, and back-office processes. You will work at the intersection of large language models, retrieval and semantic layers over operational data, and classical optimization and simulation, combining them so that each layer strengthens the next.
  
  
This is an exciting time to join a growing and dynamic team that solves some of the toughest problems in terminal operations and builds the future of container shipping. We offer a unique opportunity to impact global trade via world-leading container terminals. We focus on our people and the right candidate will have broad possibilities to further develop competencies in an environment characterized by change and continuous progress.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation and delivery of agentic AI systems that automate end-to-end terminal workflows spanning planning, scheduling, execution and operations, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, and human-in-the-loop control
* Architect retrieval and grounding layers over operational and enterprise data, including semantic layers, knowledge graphs and vector search, so that LLM-driven systems answer and act on trustworthy, terminal-specific context
* Build production LLM applications with rigorous evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability and cost/latency management, taking systems from prototype through to reliable operation at terminals globally
* Integrate generative AI with existing optimization, simulation and ML assets so agents can invoke solvers and models as tools rather than replacing them
* Establish and evangelize best practices for AI-assisted engineering across the team, using modern development tools and agentic coding workflows to raise team-wide productivity
* Coach and mentor team members in LLM application design, agentic patterns, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation methods
* Work with relevant stakeholders to understand terminal operational dynamics and business processes, incorporating their needs into products to enhance value delivery
* Collaborate and communicate system design, results and insights with product teams, leadership and business stakeholders to roll out solutions to production environments
* Analyse data, measure delivered value, and continuously evaluate and improve systems to increase effectiveness and operational impact

**To do this job, we imagine you have:**

* 5+ years of industry experience in building and delivering ML or AI products, with at least 2 years of hands-on practitioner experience shipping LLM-based applications to production
* PhD or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or other field related to algorithms and data (or equivalent experience)
* Demonstrated experience building agentic systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, function calling, planning and reasoning loops, and workflow automation using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent in-house stacks
* Strong practical command of retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, semantic layers, and structured grounding of LLMs over enterprise and operational data
* Experience with LLM evaluation and reliability engineering: building eval suites, red-teaming, hallucination and drift monitoring, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization in production
* Fluency with modern AI development tools and code assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow, not an occasional aid
* Excellent record of delivery using Python and technologies like Git, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Ability to understand complex operational systems and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions
* Experience in leading technical work, coaching junior colleagues, and driving projects from concept to delivery
* Strong communication skills with ability to work independently with stakeholders while liaising and reviewing with the team

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in container terminal operations, port logistics, supply chain, or similar operational environments with complex resource allocation and scheduling dynamics
* Exposure to combinatorial or continuous optimization, discrete event simulation, or reinforcement learning, and experience wrapping such solvers as tools within agentic systems
* Experience fine-tuning or adapting open-weight models, and familiarity with model serving and inference routing across multiple providers
* Familiarity with container handling equipment, yard operations, or vessel operations

Passport, Euromonitor's flagship platform, has just been rebuilt from the ground up. It is the largest technology investment in the company's history, and AI now sits at the core of the system.
  
  
Euromonitor is establishing an AI and Data Science team in India to lead this work. The remit is a framework driven, platform centric approach: the team builds the AI platform, reusable agents, skills and tooling that product teams use to engineer AI and Data Science capability into Passport and other customer offerings, including new products built on AI and agentic flows.
  
  
Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the Technical lead, this role suits a senior engineer whose centre of gravity is applied Data Science and AI (ranking, retrieval and evaluation), combined with the backend software engineering competence to ship that work as reusable, production grade services that other teams build on. Reusability is the defining measure of the role: success is components adopted across product teams, not features shipped into a single product.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Applied Data Science and AI
  
  

* Develop reusable ranking, personalisation and recommendation components, taking them from experimentation through to shared services with measurable quality baselines.
* Build and operate the evaluation harness as a shared service: golden dataset curation, LLM-as-judge pipelines, regression gates in CI, and quality metrics that consuming teams adopt.
* Advance the shared retrieval capability across structured and unstructured data: chunking and indexing strategies, hybrid search, reranking and embedding lifecycle.
* Bring statistical rigour to the platform: experiment design, judge calibration and the interpretation of quality deltas, so decisions about models and components rest on evidence.

Reusable Platform Services
  
  

* Design and build backend services and APIs for the AI platform (retrieval, ranking, evaluation and agentic components) as versioned, documented, multi-consumer services rather than product embedded code.
* Contribute to the agent framework and skills and tool registry, with clean SDK surfaces, backward compatibility and abstraction discipline suitable for consumption by multiple product teams.
* Build for production from the start: observability, cost and token telemetry, quality gates and Responsible AI controls embedded in every component.

Collaboration and Enablement
  
  

* Onboard consuming teams onto platform components through reference implementations, documentation and paved road patterns; treat adoption as a first class outcome of every piece of work.
* Work with Engineering, Architecture and Data Platform teams to keep platform services aligned with Euromonitor's cloud native architecture.
* Raise the bar on engineering practice within the team through design reviews, testing standards and mentoring as the team grows.

* Strong Python, plus working competence in at least one further backend language such as C#, Java, Go or TypeScript (C# and .NET preferred, reflecting the services you will integrate with).

description:
**Born in India, Built for the World**

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors

500,000+ hours of content processed

26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore https://www.amagi.com/social-impact.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an impact-driven Machine Learning / AI Engineer to bridge the gap between complex business challenges and scalable AI solutions. In this role, you will own the entire ML lifecycle—from problem framing and custom model training to rigorous evaluation and deployment. Rather than just implementing off-the-shelf tools, you will design intelligent systems that solve real-world problems, making key architectural decisions alongside a multidisciplinary team.

Working closely with Product Managers and stakeholders, you will act as the technical translator to ensure our AI initiatives drive core product objectives. You will tackle complex, high-impact challenges—such as building real-time video intelligence pipelines to extract semantic meaning from live broadcasts, designing predictive fan engagement models for our Fanpulse initiative, and architecting intelligent systems that automate dynamic, personalized media workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Problem Framing & Strategy:**
Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into concrete, solvable machine learning and AI formulations.

**Frontier AI Research & Experimentation:**
Continuously explore, experiment with, and benchmark the latest frontier models, emerging architectures, and AI techniques. Develop rigorous evaluations to identify where new capabilities deliver measurable improvements, and turn promising breakthroughs into practical, production-ready solutions for our business.

**Data Collection & Processing:**
Design and implement robust data pipelines. Identify, gather, clean, and preprocess the datasets required to train and evaluate high-performing models.

**Model Training & Fine-Tuning:**
Build custom ML/AI solutions from the ground up. Train, fine-tune, and optimize traditional ML algorithms, deep neural networks, and open-source foundation models to solve domain-specific problems.

**Comprehensive Evaluation:**
Establish rigorous quantitative evaluation frameworks (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, latency, etc.) and conduct qualitative evaluations to ensure model outputs drive the desired business KPIs and user experience.

**Production Deployment:**
Package, deploy, and scale machine learning models in production environments. Build robust inference APIs and establish monitoring loops for model drift and performance degradation.

**Cross-Functional Communication:**
Clearly and effectively communicate complex AI concepts, model limitations, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and leadership to drive informed product decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience:**
2-3 years of hands-on, professional experience in building, training, and deploying machine learning models into production environments.

**Strong ML Fundamentals:**
Deep understanding of underlying machine learning principles, model architectures, optimization techniques, and rigorous evaluation methodologies to build custom solutions from the ground up.

**Programming & Frameworks:**
Strong proficiency in Python and solid experience with core ML/AI libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers).

**Data Skills:**
Proficiency in SQL and data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) with a solid understanding of data engineering best practices.

**Deployment & MLOps:**
Experience deploying models via APIs (FastAPI, Flask) and familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

**Communication:**
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven track record of successfully collaborating with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline.

Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity.

Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.

Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools.   + Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
  + Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.
* **Evals and Prompt Improvement**
  + Build and run the evaluation program for agents: task-level benchmarks built from real operational cases, regression gates in CI, and online monitoring tied to business outcomes.
  + Lead systematic prompt and program improvement using automated optimization techniques (e.g., GEPA, DSPy, AutoPrompt), driven by execution traces and failure analysis.
* **Scalable AI/ML Architecture & Deployment**
  + Partner with AI Engineering to design scalable agent and model serving on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Bedrock/SageMaker), with orchestration, model gateway routing, versioned prompt/model registries, sandboxed tool execution, and rollouts gated by eval regressions.
  + Define and enforce SLOs for task success, latency, and cost per task, using distributed tracing, caching, and tiered model routing to meet them.
* **Team Management & Mentorship following Agile Practices**
  + Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML data scientists, guiding iterative experimentation and tracking progress to deliver measurable outcomes in an agile manner.
* **Drive Model Methodology Documentation**
  + Champion documentation of methodologies, results, and best practices for knowledge sharing
* **Execution Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement**
  + Align design and delivery across partner teams to maintain execution velocity, and drive clarity on prerequisites for AI/ML development.
  + Engage stakeholders in an agile manner to develop, demo, and iterate on deliverables. Work closely with Operations, Technology, and Transformation teams to solve complex problems with AI.

**Required qualifications**

* MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
* Significant proven experience building and deploying AI applications, including LLM-based agents, in large-scale production environments.
* Hands-on experience building production agents, including the harness (function calling, context and memory, planning, orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls), rigorous evals for multi-step systems, and systematic prompt optimization (GEPA, DSPy, or AutoPrompt) with measured production gains.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).

* Experience managing data science teams and couching team members

* Strong communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: SAFETY OFFICER
description:
Job Purpose

To ensure a safe working environment across project sites and office premises by implementing safety procedures, monitoring compliance, identifying potential hazards and preventing workplace accidents. The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring that all employees, contractors and site personnel follow safety standards and statutory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Site Safety Management**

* Conduct regular safety inspections at project sites and identify unsafe conditions.
* Ensure employees and contractors follow prescribed safety procedures.
* Monitor safety during installation, electrical, networking, cabling and other project-related activities.
* Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* Check work-at-height activities, scaffolding, ladders and electrical safety arrangements.

**2. Risk Assessment & Hazard Identification**

* Conduct Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and risk assessments before commencement of work.
* Identify potential workplace hazards and recommend preventive measures.
* Ensure appropriate safety permits are obtained before high-risk activities.
* Monitor corrective and preventive actions.

**3. Safety Training & Awareness**

* Conduct safety induction programmes for new employees and contractors.
* Organise toolbox talks and regular safety awareness sessions.
* Educate employees on PPE usage, fire safety, emergency response and workplace safety.
* Maintain records of all safety training sessions.

**4. Accident & Incident Management**

* Investigate workplace accidents, near misses and unsafe incidents.
* Prepare incident reports and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain accident registers and safety documentation.
* Coordinate emergency response and first-aid arrangements.

**5. Fire & Emergency Safety**

* Ensure fire extinguishers and emergency equipment are available and maintained.
* Check emergency exits, evacuation routes and safety signage.
* Conduct mock drills and emergency preparedness activities.
* Ensure first-aid kits are available at project sites.

**6. Statutory Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and occupational health and safety regulations.
* Maintain safety inspection reports, training records and incident registers.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors and project teams during safety audits.
* Ensure compliance with client-specific safety requirements.

**7. Coordination & Reporting**

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, contractors and HR.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly safety reports.
* Follow up on safety observations and ensure timely closure.
* Promote a safety-conscious culture across all project locations.

Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma / B.Tech in Safety Engineering or Industrial Safety.
* Relevant certification in Occupational Health & Safety will be an added advantage.
* 5 years of minimum experience in site safety management, preferably in infrastructure, electrical, installation or project-based operations.
* Knowledge of workplace safety standards, risk assessments and statutory compliance.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and safety documentation.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good observation and hazard identification skills.
* Ability to manage multiple project sites.
* Knowledge of PPE, fire safety and emergency management.
* Ability to conduct safety training and toolbox talks.
* Good reporting and documentation skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in workplace accidents and near misses.
* Timely completion of safety inspections.
* Compliance with PPE and safety procedures.
* Closure of safety observations within timelines.
* Completion of safety training and toolbox talks.
* Timely submission of safety reports and statutory documentation.

title: Engineer
description:
Job Description: This development team is responsible for architecture, design, development and support of Tejas OTN and DWDM family of products. Largely comprising embedded and networking software experts, the team designs and implements entire control plane, data plane and management plane of Tejas state of the art Optical Transport products, spanning across SDH/SONET, Carrier Ethernet, OTN & DWDM technologies and optical networking standards, scaling from standalone to large multi-chassis nodes, and with line speed of 1Tbps+. Our unique software architecture and development processes ensure latest technological advances reach our customers quickly through our product offerings, that consistently meet or beat system requirements in terms of standard compliance, inter-operability, security, redundancy, performance and maintenance.

  

**Responsibilities: What you work:**

As a technical expert, you will contribute in product development and delivery including planning, requirement analysis, design, implementation, validation, verification and field testing Analyze and prioritize various features for different sub-systems to get a synchronized system delivery in a phased manner Closely work with other teams and partners to carry out system integration and user acceptance testing Focus to continuously improve system performance with quality deliverables.

**Mandatory skills:**

* Hands on developing software experience in C/C++ on Linux based environment.
* Experience with multi-tasking, multi-threading, interrupt, POSIX IPC, System V IPC, Synchronization, memory management etc. in Linux Environment.
* Ability to use application software debuggers, protocol analyzers, Wireshark, GDB, Val grind, eclipse, Code-block, GIT, CVS etc.
* Hands on experience on TCP-IP and socket programming.
working knowledge of protocols like: SNMP, SDH/SONET, Circuit Emulation/OTN/1588 V2 / QinQ, LAG etc.  

**Desired skills:**

Able to plan and execute tasks independently in a fast moving and fluid environment.

  

Qualifications: Preferred Qualifications :

* Experience: 1 to 3 years’ experience from Telecommunication or Networking background.

* Education: B.Tech/BE (CSE/ECE/EEE/IS) or any other equivalent degree

* Candidate should be good at coding skills in Embedded, Linux with C & C++.

  

About Us: Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.

**Diversity and Inclusion Statement:**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

  

About the Team: Tejas Networks is driving cutting-edge research to revolutionize content delivery and wireless communication technologies. One major area of focus is the development of advanced solutions that integrate broadcast and cellular networks to enable seamless content distribution. These innovations aim to alleviate network congestion, reduce infrastructure costs, and enhance the overall user experience. A key outcome of this work is a next-generation Content Delivery Network (CDN) architecture that supports Direct-to-Mobile (D2M) delivery, developed in collaboration with leading CDN and content providers. This initiative is backed by a robust portfolio of patented technologies in broadcast and content delivery systems.

In parallel, significant efforts are being made to enhance the flexibility and efficiency of wireless network operations. Research in this domain includes the creation of a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables platform-independent expression of Radio Access Network (RAN) functions, helping reduce dependency on proprietary hardware. Additionally, advanced AI/ML techniques are being employed to automate network management, streamline operations, and optimize resource utilization—resulting in substantial cost savings and improved performance. These contributions have led to multiple patents and active participation in international standardization efforts.

title: Software Development Engineer 4
description:
**Job Title**

Software Development Engineer 4

### **About the Role**

CPS (Payment Operations & Risk Control) part of Money Movement, oversees payment operations, transaction risk controls, and merchant and acquirer whitelisting. As a Senior Software Engineer 4, you'll design, build and run the systems that keep transactions flowing safely. That includes risk rules and controls, merchant and acquirer (MID) whitelisting and blocking, and operational tools for the teams who monitor them. You'll be the technical reference for the team, mentor developers, and work with Architects, Product Management, Product Definition and Operations to deliver secure, scalable, compliant solutions.

### **Common Accountabilities**

* Has working experience and advanced, specialised technical and functional knowledge in own discipline. Understands how own area contributes to the business. Acts as a reference for less experienced colleagues and supports junior team members.
* Influences decisions related to own activity, anticipates dependencies and consequences in complex scenarios, contributes to cross-team projects, proposes process improvements, and is accountable for own and team commitments.
* Works independently within the plan set by the manager, with some guidance in the most complex situations.

### **Specific Accountabilities**

* **Analyse specifications**

* Define user requirements for developing new software solutions or upgrading existing ones.
* Turn business and operational needs for payment operations and risk control into technical solutions.
* Size development work and help slice stories into deliverable increments.

* **Design systems and code**

* Design technical solutions and carry out feasibility studies for transaction risk controls, merchant and acquirer whitelisting, and payment operations features.
* Propose workable technical solutions to Product Management and/or users for validation.
* Work with Architects on scalable, resilient, high-availability, low-latency designs, and propose system improvements.
* Develop software to Amadeus standards, with security, auditability and PCI-DSS compliance built in from the start.
* Model, design and implement databases, including reference and configuration data such as merchant and acquirer lists and risk rules.

* **Test and validate**

* Run unit, package, integration and performance tests, and keep quality in line with Amadeus guidelines (SonarQube quality gates, Black Duck compliance).
* Take part in the product validation phase and fine-tune where needed to finalise the product.
* Review code and promote clean code practices, including spotting code smells and handling memory leaks.

* **Maintain and optimise**

* Troubleshoot and investigate defects raised by customers, so the products meet their specifications and the system stays intact.
* Debug efficiently and resolve production issues quickly, including transaction issues, risk-control incidents and urgent merchant or acquirer whitelisting and blocking requests.
* Run routine performance analysis and optimise the software.

* **Collaborate**

* Work closely with Product Management, Technical Business Analysts, Quality Assurance and Global Operations to deliver high-quality code for internal and external customers that works and matches the requirements documents.
* Collaborate with team members, learn from their knowledge and different backgrounds, and bring your own strengths to the team.
* Coordinate development across teams and areas with other teams and developers.

* **Document your work**

* Create and update standardised documentation, including software documentation, operational runbooks and risk-control configuration guides, and share it with the requesting departments.

### **Technical Expertise**

**Must-have**

* Java and microservices development.
* Distributed systems, cloud-native technologies and containers (Kubernetes).
* Monitoring, alerting and observability tools for production operations.
* Strong object-oriented design and programming in C++, including advanced concepts, OOAD and design patterns.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Scalable architecture; developing complex algorithms (for example rule evaluation or rule engines); memory management and memory-leak analysis.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting and performance-optimisation skills, including in production.
* Development in Unix/Linux, with Shell scripting.
* Relational or NoSQL databases and their use.
* Writing good unit tests; experience with at least one testing framework.
* Version control and CI/CD (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins); awareness of SonarQube and Black Duck.
* Web services and API design and troubleshooting (REST and SOAP).
* Hands-on practice with Agile methods: Scrum is required.

### **Functional / Domain Knowledge**

**Strongly preferred**

* Payment operations: the transaction lifecycle (authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks) and the roles of merchants, acquirers, processors and schemes.
* Transaction risk control: fraud and risk rules, velocity checks, limits, and blocking and whitelisting.
* Merchant and acquirer onboarding, MID management and whitelisting or blocklisting processes.

**Good to have**

* Knowledge of existing Amadeus/Outpayce payment products.
* ISO 8583 messaging and 3DS.
* Knowledge of PCI-DSS and GDPR.
* SAFe,Angular,
* Exposure to the travel domain.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering (Software Development).
* 9+ years of software development experience, across the full product development lifecycle including production support.
* Can lead a team of strong developers and develop their talent.
* Delivers high-quality results in a fast-paced, changing environment with shifting priorities, and consistently meets deadlines.
* Keeps status reports up to date on projects, technical problems and risks, and other relevant details.
* Clear communication and presentation skills, and builds good relationships with stakeholders.
* Understands business and operational requirements and turns them into technical solutions; sees the big picture from the user's, operations' and the business's point of view.
* Can explain past projects in technical and functional detail, without ambiguity.
* Curious about the domain and quick to learn new technologies and apply them; a T-shaped mindset is a plus.

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

description:
