He/she will be taken through product and technology training and mentoring programs in Tejas. Starting as an individual contributor engaged in design and implementation of complex software features, a capable and committed candidate may be able to pick up the role of development owner of specific modules and grow into a team lead, guiding a group of developers, and defining product specifications and architecture to meet the requirements driven by business and technology.

  

* Responsibilities: •Extensive coding experience and proficiency in C/C++ language in Linux based embedded platforms

* Strong knowledge in multi-threading, IPC, Synchronization

* Extensive experience in one or more layer one/layer two optical transport technologies – SDH, OTN, EVC, MPLS-TP, ERPS, Pseudowire etc.

* Deep understanding of SDH/OTN/Ethernet data path - in particular frame or packet processing architecture – either in custom FPGAs or in SoC/NPU devices

* Analytical skills – experience in troubleshooting design and coding issues involving data path impairments such as traffic instability, protection switching, QoS.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Understanding of object modeling and user interfaces

* Understanding of device drivers and hardware event handling

* Experience of having worked in Scrum/Agile processes

* Proficiency in one or more scripting languages

* Interpersonal skills and great teamwork, high level of energy and dedication to become part of a winning combination.

**Detailed job description**

* Feature design, implementation, unit testing and verification support for the sub-system. Ensure quality in all deliverables and compliance with processes and practices at all stages of development life cycle

* Troubleshooting of product issues seen in lab and field, collaborate with various teams to identify specific configurations and scenarios to reproduce defects and arrive at the root cause.

* Be comfortable with usage of various tools/practices (including development or assessment of new tools/methodologies) as appropriate.

  

* Qualifications: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electronics or Electrical Engineering from reputed institutes
* 2-7 years of experience in software feature development in networking or telecommunication domain exposure to complete development life cycle

  

About Us: Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.

**Diversity and Inclusion Statement:**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

  

About the Team: Tejas Networks is driving cutting-edge research to revolutionize content delivery and wireless communication technologies. One major area of focus is the development of advanced solutions that integrate broadcast and cellular networks to enable seamless content distribution. These innovations aim to alleviate network congestion, reduce infrastructure costs, and enhance the overall user experience. A key outcome of this work is a next-generation Content Delivery Network (CDN) architecture that supports Direct-to-Mobile (D2M) delivery, developed in collaboration with leading CDN and content providers. This initiative is backed by a robust portfolio of patented technologies in broadcast and content delivery systems.

In parallel, significant efforts are being made to enhance the flexibility and efficiency of wireless network operations. Research in this domain includes the creation of a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables platform-independent expression of Radio Access Network (RAN) functions, helping reduce dependency on proprietary hardware. Additionally, advanced AI/ML techniques are being employed to automate network management, streamline operations, and optimize resource utilization—resulting in substantial cost savings and improved performance. These contributions have led to multiple patents and active participation in international standardization efforts.

title: Director, Product Development/Management
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.

Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.

As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.

Visa is seeking a seasoned Director Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.

As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.

Responsibilities:

* Customer-Centric Product: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Product Vision: Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals. Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Leadership: Set a role model of product management for the rest of product management team. Mentor new product managers, set processes. Take team forward on the set vision. Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.

title: Product Manager - Organic Social
description:
**Product Manager – Organic Social**

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target’s Product teams are at the very heart of what delights our guests, time after time. We’re accountable for delivering the business outcomes that enable our operations and delight Target guests. Here, you’ll support cross-functional teams by building and managing technology and analytic products that are easily maintained and highly reliable. Together, we tackle a backlog inclusive of all product, technology and design work.

Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work.

Social platforms are where guests increasingly discover, engage with, and are inspired by Target. In this role, you will directly influence how Target shows up organically across social platforms—including, but not limited to, TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—driving more relevant, engaging guest experiences and unlocking growth across an ever-evolving social ecosystem. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead innovation across Organic Social, a critical foundation powering brand awareness, guest engagement, and discovery. This role will own the strategy and execution of the tools and capabilities that enable Target to manage, listen to, and optimize its organic social presence at scale.

You will operate at the intersection of social platforms, content, data, and guest insights, driving improvements in social publishing, listening, engagement, and measurement to elevate the guest experience and grow Target’s presence across social channels.

What You’ll Do

* Own the product vision and roadmap for organic social capabilities, focusing on scalability, efficiency, and guest impact across all social platforms
* Build and scale capabilities that enable teams to manage Target’s organic social presence across multiple platforms, including but not limited to TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—covering tools that support content planning, publishing, scheduling, asset management, and approval workflows
* Work closely with data & analytics teams to deliver social listening capabilities to monitor guest conversations, sentiment, trends, and brand mentions
* Drive optimization of organic social experiences through performance analytics, cross-platform reporting, and test-and-learn experimentation to improve reach, engagement, and conversion
* Support community management and guest engagement capabilities, including comment and message moderation
* Partner with social platforms to integrate APIs and emerging features (e.g., shoppable content, product tagging, creator tools), ensuring Target stays ahead of platform changes
* Manage contracts and agreements associated with social platforms and related vendors, including renewals, terms, and compliance, in partnership with legal, procurement, and vendor management teams
* Embed brand safety, governance, and compliance standards into social tools and workflows
* Manage social platform authorization and access across the enterprise, including intake, review, and approval of access requests, role-based permissions, and periodic access audits to protect Target’s brand accounts
* Develop and evolve measurement and attribution capabilities to quantify the impact of organic social on guest engagement, traffic, and sales
* Partner cross-functionally with engineering, data science, social, Roundel, and external platform partners to deliver high-impact solutions
* Translate complex social platform and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve tooling, automation, and AI-enabled workflows for teams managing organic social content, listening, and engagement

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the “voice of the product” to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of product management experience
* Domain experience, preferably in social media, social commerce, or digital marketing. Familiarity with social media management, social listening, and analytics tools a plus.
* Familiarity with Agentic platforms and capabilities
* Experience with technology and ability to facilitate communication between business and technology teams
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g., user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)

title: Kirana Club : Product Manager II - Commerce
description:
### **About the role**

You will own critical retailer-commerce journeys on Kirana Club, from product discovery and decision-making to checkout and repeat purchase. Your first and most important mandate will be to improve retailer activation—moving retailers from their first to fourth delivered order. This is an ambiguous, cross-functional problem spanning product experience, assortment, pricing, trust, fulfilment and user behaviour. You will be expected to identify where the real constraint lies, determine what product should solve, and build solutions that materially improve the business outcome.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the product roadmap for retailer activation, with an immediate focus on first-order conversion and progression from the first to fourth delivered order.
* Diagnose funnel and behavioural problems through data, user research and market visits rather than starting with predetermined features.
* Build and test solutions across discovery, product comprehension, cart, checkout, assisted buying, post-order and repeat journeys.
* Work closely with Growth, Design, Engineering, Data, Supply and Fulfilment, while distinguishing product problems from pricing, assortment and operational problems.
* Define success metrics, make clear product trade-offs and measure impact on delivered orders and repeat behaviour—not only clicks or feature adoption.
* Build scalable product systems rather than relying primarily on notifications, discounts or manual interventions.

### **What we're looking for**

* 6–9 years of total experience, including at least 4–6 years in product management, preferably in consumer commerce, marketplaces, fintech, quick commerce or another transactional product.
* Has independently owned a meaningful conversion, activation, retention, monetisation or transactional-funnel metric.
* Strong first-principles problem solver who can structure an ambiguous problem before jumping to solutions.
* Comfortable combining behavioural data, qualitative research and commercial understanding.
* Has built or materially improved a zero-to-one consumer journey, not only optimised an established feature backlog.
* Strong execution in a resource-constrained environment and comfortable working directly with business and operating teams.
* AI-native in research, analysis, prototyping and day-to-day product execution.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Wego**
--------------

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We don't just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**
----------------

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, what's next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

### **Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

### **This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **You'd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Paragon platform
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Senior Product Manager - Tech on Amazon's seller support platform, you'll own the foundation that every support decision runs on: the routing engine that decides where each seller's issue goes, the case record that follows that issue across teams and systems, and the controls that govern who can change what. The platform serves more than 220 teams across support, investigation, and compliance, and today many of them route and store cases their own way. A seller can get passed between teams, retell their problem, or wait while their history sits in another tool. Your job is to fix that at the platform level. You'll define how one routing engine serves many organizations without becoming a bottleneck, and how it decides whether an issue goes to an AI agent or a person. You'll decide what a case carries when it moves between teams and which systems stay in sync. You'll design an access model that gives specialists the full picture they need, and nothing more. As AI takes on more of the work, the issues that reach people are the hardest ones, so getting the foundation right matters more, not less. Much of this hasn't been defined yet. You'll work backwards from sellers, associates, and the teams who configure routing. You'll partner with engineers, security, and product leaders, and be the main product voice for the engineering teams you sit with. Expect ambiguity, hard trade-offs between flexibility and control, and regular conversations with senior leaders about where the platform goes next.  
  
About the team  
Paragon is the core issue management platform for Selling Partner Support, serving 220+ teams across support, investigation, and compliance. We build products spanning issue intelligence, content management, AI-powered auditing, workforce development, and intelligent routing. Our vision is mostly autonomous issue resolution with selective human intervention, where associates evolve into specialists whose judgment continuously improves the AI systems they supervise.

title: AI Research Engineer (Multi-Modal Agents)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.

You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.

You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.
* Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.
* Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.
* Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.
* Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.
* Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.
* Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.
* Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.

* Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks.
* Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang).
* Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

Identify and address areas of inefficiency in code, model architectures, and system operations (including memory/compute efficiency), recommending and implementing improvements to observability, policies, and processes.

* Familiarity with secure **data access and governance** (e.g., IAM policies for S3, access patterns for training and serving) and with designing moderately complex **distributed systems** centered on ML training and serving.

Use citizen developer journey platform to find efficiencies in our processes. The candidate will design and implement sophisticated model serving systems in collaboration with architecture and engineering teams, leveraging distributed systems and the AWS cloud platform.

The methodology covers sensitivity, stress, VaR, factor modeling and pricing for investment (market), counterparty (credit), and liquidity risk. Lending Value for credit risk profiling and client grading.

**What We're Looking For:**

* A strong understanding of statistics, applied AI/ML techniques, and a practical problem-solving mindset. Experience improving model robustness, conducting advanced statistical modeling and A/B testing to assess feasibility of business goals and support data-driven decision-making.

* A quantitative, technically proficient individual who is detail-oriented, able to multi-task, and work independently.
* Excellent communication skills.

* Practical experience in financial markets in a quantitative analysis/research role within Risk Management, a Front Office role, or equivalent is a plus.
* Work experience operating within models and data life-cycle governance frameworks is a plus.
* Knowledge of asset pricing, VaR backtesting techniques, and model performance testing is a plus.
* Knowledge of credit risk modeling, testing and validation is a plus.

We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that benefits from the perspectives and talents of our diverse team. We encourage open dialogue and professional growth. Join us and be a part of a global organization that is redefining the world of asset and wealth management.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Data Scientist II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Role**
------------------

* We are the Expedia Group Advertising team - as a global leader in travel industry advertising, we connect advertisers with millions of travelers. We are seeking a Data Scientist II to join the team that builds the predictive and optimization engines powering Expedia Group’s advertising marketplace — including ad ranking, real-time bidding, and pricing models. Our team is international, with members based across the US, Europe, and India.
You will design the experiments, causal frameworks, and measurement systems that tell us what’s working as well as identifying inefficiencies in the marketplace. In this role, you turn ambiguous business questions into testable hypotheses, build robust analyses grounded in data, and use them to inform the business on marketplace performance and help drive what to do next.  

  

**What You’ll Work On**
-----------------------

* **Experimentation & Causal Inference:** Design and run rigorous experimental studies (holdouts, diff-in-diff, instrumental variables, synthetic control) to validate the impact of models and marketplace changes built by the MLS team.
* **Impact Measurement & Incrementality:** Quantify the true incremental value of advertising products — including ad ranking, auction and bidding changes, and pricing optimizations — separating genuine lift from noise, seasonality, and confounders.
* **Decision Frameworks for the Marketplace:** Build the measurement frameworks and success metrics that guide what the team builds next, balancing partner ROI, traveler experience, and marketplace health.
* **Insight Generation & Self-Service Tooling:** Build and maintain dashboards, metric definitions, and self-service tools that let product, engineering, and business stakeholders track marketplace and model performance over time.

  

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* **Own Measurement End-to-End:** Take ownership of the full lifecycle of a measurement question — from framing the hypothesis and designing the experiment, through analysis, to communicating a clear, defensible recommendation.
* **Partner Closely with MLS:** Work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning Scientists before, during, and after model builds — helping define success metrics up front, instrumenting experiments correctly, and independently validating results post-launch.
* **Diagnose Performance for Improvement Opportunities:** Dig into model and marketplace performance data to uncover where models or marketplace mechanics are underperforming or leaving value on the table, distinguishing genuine effects from statistical noise, and surface those opportunities with supporting evidence.
* **Communicate and Influence:** Translate statistical and causal findings into clear, actionable narratives for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders, and use that evidence to influence roadmap decisions.
* **Raise the Bar on Rigor:** Bring strong statistical and experimental design judgment to the team, helping ensure claims of impact across the marketplace are sound and reproducible.

  

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* MS or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics).
* 5+ years of hands-on industry experience applying statistics, causal inference, or experimentation to real-world business or product problems.
* **Experimentation & Causal Inference:** Deep expertise in experimental design (A/B testing, sequential testing, power analysis) and causal inference methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, synthetic control, uplift modeling).
* **Statistical Rigor:** Strong grounding in statistical theory and its practical application, with the judgment to know when an observed effect is real versus noise, bias, or a flawed design.
* **Technical Fluency:** Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn), working within Databricks and comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code; SQL fluency for querying large-scale datasets is essential. The team’s tooling closely mirrors the MLS stack to support close day-to-day collaboration.
* **Software Best Practices:** Comfortable with version control (Git) and building reproducible, well-documented analyses as part of a shared codebase.
* **Communication:** Skilled at distilling ambiguous business questions into measurable objectives, and at explaining complex statistical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

* Domain knowledge in online advertising or e-commerce marketplaces, including auction mechanics, real-time bidding, or pricing systems.
* Demonstrated experience advising or partnering with machine learning teams on experiment design and impact validation for production ML systems.
* Track record of leading measurement strategy or architecture across a service, multiple services, or a domain-level scope.
* Experience applying generative AI or LLM-based techniques to accelerate data science workflows (e.g., analysis, synthesis, tooling).
* Strong record of influencing cross-functional partners and shaping roadmap decisions through data-driven evidence.



Eligible roles may also include variable incentive and/or equity grants; depending on level, location, and role requirements.



**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Technology & AI Manager
  
Job Summary
  
The Technology & AI Manager serves as the strategic leader for all technology and artificial intelligence initiatives within the account. This role is responsible for developing and executing a technology roadmap that leverages AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to drive operational efficiency, enhance client value, and create a competitive advantage. You will be the primary technology advisor to both the internal account team and the client, translating complex business needs into innovative and scalable tech-enabled solutions.
  
Duties & Responsibilities
  
Technology & AI StrategyDevelop and govern the account’s long-term technology and AI strategy, ensuring alignment with the Master Service Agreement (MSA) and client business objectives.
  
Serve as the primary technology and AI advisor to the account and the client, presenting new opportunities and managing expectations.
  
Identify, pilot, and scale new AI and technology solutions (e.g., predictive maintenance, space utilization analytics, NLP for sentiment analysis) to address business challenges.
  
Establish and maintain a technology governance framework to manage the lifecycle of applications, integrations, and data platforms.

Utilize machine learning models to forecast KPI performance, identify potential risks, and recommend proactive interventions.
  
Implement AI-driven dashboards and real-time reporting that provide the account team with actionable intelligence to optimize their performance.
  
Lead performance discussions at quarterly business reviews, presenting not only results but also data-driven root cause analyses and forward-looking strategic recommendations.
  
Analyze JLL’s ‘Client Voice’ satisfaction survey data using advanced analytical techniques (e.g., sentiment analysis) to uncover deeper insights.
  
  
Advanced Analytics & Business IntelligenceLead all account business intelligence and data science activities.
  
Collaborate with stakeholders to design, deliver, and maintain sophisticated BI reports and dashboards that visualize complex data and AI-driven insights.
  
Transform raw data into actionable strategic insights using advanced analytical techniques and machine learning models.
  
Oversee the fulfillment of all contractual reporting obligations, enhancing them with automated and intelligent reporting where possible.
  
  
AI-Ready Data GovernanceEstablish and maintain a robust data pipeline and governance framework specifically designed to support AI and machine learning initiatives.
  
Continuously monitor and report on the account’s data quality and integrity, understanding its direct impact on the efficacy of predictive models.
  
Implement a comprehensive data governance plan, including data standards, processes, and audits to ensure a single source of truth for analytics.
  
Partner with Data Program Managers and engineers to design and implement strategic plans to improve data quality, structure, and accessibility for AI applications.
  
  
Performance Objectives
  
Successful deployment and adoption of new technology and AI tools across the account.
  
Demonstrable ROI from technology investments, shown through improved efficiency, cost savings, or enhanced client satisfaction.
  
Measurable improvement in predictive accuracy and the proactive resolution of operational issues.
  
Key Skills
  
Organized, strategic, and able to drive initiatives with minimal supervision.
  
Experience in technology strategy, client advisory, AI project management, and business process optimization.
  
Experience with technology governance, risk management, and compliance is highly beneficial.
  
Ideally, you’ll have experience working in a large, diverse, complex organization with geographically dispersed teams and complex technical environments.
  
Advanced skills in data analytics, business intelligence, and a strong conceptual understanding of machine learning and AI principles.
  
Experience in the commercial property or facilities management sector is desirable but not essential.

Used to working with stakeholders with different experience levels, from entry-level roles to senior leadership, and can work and communicate effectively across organizational lines.

An analytical and strategic thinker, able to simplify complex issues and solve problems creatively.
  
Able to manage competing priorities, be resilient, and resolve conflict quickly to achieve desired results.
  
Trustworthy, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer confidence in the technology, data, and analytics space.

title: Assistant Program Manager – Customer Experience & Automation (Kirana Club)
description:
**About Kirana Club**
---------------------

India has over 12 million kirana stores, and most still depend on traditional wholesale markets to source products for their shops.  
Kirana Club is changing how these retailers discover, source, and replenish inventory. With 4 million+ kiranas on the platform, we're building a commerce marketplace that connects retailers directly with brands and sellers.  
Now part of the Meesho family, we're entering our next phase of growth, with an opportunity to rethink how B2B commerce and fulfilment work at scale.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for someone who loves solving problems at their root, building scalable systems, and using technology to make things work better.  
As we scale, thousands of retailers interact with our platform every day — placing orders, tracking deliveries, raising concerns, and requesting resolutions. Our goal is to build a customer experience where things work so reliably that retailers rarely need to contact support.  
You'll own initiatives that improve the end-to-end retailer experience by identifying recurring problems, understanding why they happen, and building long-term solutions through better processes, product improvements, and automation.  
This is not a traditional customer support management role. You won't be managing support agents or day-to-day ticket queues. Instead, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Support to systematically eliminate friction and build scalable customer experience systems.

### **What you'll work on**

* Root cause analysis: Deep dive into customer complaints, support tickets, order journeys, and operational data to identify recurring issues and their underlying causes.
* Process and system design: Build scalable workflows, SOPs, escalation mechanisms, and resolution processes that prevent recurring problems and reduce manual intervention.
* Automation and AI: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support workflows, customer communication, refunds, and issue resolution using technology and AI.
* Customer experience improvements: Work with Product and Engineering to simplify customer journeys, improve self-service capabilities, and proactively resolve issues before customers need to reach out.
* End-to-end problem ownership: Take problems from identification to solution design, implementation, and impact measurement. Ensure fixes are permanent rather than temporary workarounds.
* Data-driven prioritization: Quantify the impact of different customer experience problems and prioritize initiatives that meaningfully improve customer satisfaction, retention, and operational efficiency.

Some of the problems you might work on include reducing delivery-related complaints, automating refund and claims workflows, improving NDR resolution, and designing better customer communication systems.

### **What we're looking for**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. You can break down ambiguous problems, identify patterns in data, and get to the actual root cause rather than treating symptoms.
* Systems thinking. You naturally look for ways to eliminate recurring problems through better processes, technology, and automation.
* Strong product and technology orientation. You understand how digital products and workflows operate and can work effectively with engineering teams to build solutions. You don't need to be an engineer.
* Excellent prioritization. You can distinguish high-impact problems from noise and balance quick wins with long-term improvements.
* High ownership and bias for action. You're comfortable taking an idea from problem identification to implementation without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Strong execution and stakeholder management. You can work across Product, Tech, Operations, and other teams to get things done.
* Comfort with data
* 3–6 years of experience in business operations, program management, product operations, strategy & operations, process excellence, or customer experience transformation. Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, logistics, or high-growth technology companies is a plus.

### **What success looks like**

* Fewer customer complaints and repeat contacts per order.
* Recurring problems eliminated through permanent process or product fixes.
* Higher levels of self-service and automation without compromising resolution quality.
* Faster, more reliable issue resolution with fewer manual escalations.

description:
### **About the role**

Community is at the heart of Kirana Club. Retailers come here to compare rates, discover schemes and new products, and learn from other shop owners. Your job is to give more retailers a reason to come back every day and take part. title: Domain Project Interface (DPI) - Telematics
description:
Required Experience, minimum: 5 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 10 years

  

* Skills: Infotainment, Linux, Telematics, Project management, Solution Oriented

  

* Minimum Qualification: B.Tech/B.E

  

**Domain Project Interface (DPI) – Telematics**
===============================================

**Unit and Team Overview**
--------------------------

The Infotainment Platforms unit develops, maintains and deploys the BMW infotainment platform. This Linux-based (Yocto) software platform provides common automotive functions used by multiple electronic control units (ECUs). The unit is also responsible for cross-cutting aspects of the platform, including architecture, security, stability and performance. The platform is deployed across infotainment-domain ECUs, from head units and rear-seat entertainment systems to telematics and audio ECUs.

Domain Project Interfaces (DPIs) connect the BMW Linux platform teams with the Telematics ECU project. Each Center of Competence (CoC) has end-to-end responsibility for the functionality in its domain. DPIs represent these domains to the Telematics project, helping ensure a consistent, planned and quality-assured platform delivery.

We are looking for DPIs for multiple domains:

* System Functions and Lifecycle (e.g. start-up, shutdown, power management, software updates and diagnostics)
* Health (system health and stability monitoring)
* Log and Trace
* System Infrastructure
* Board Support Package (BSP; Linux OS)

We work within the BMW infotainment platform, which includes generic solutions for multiple ECUs as well as ECU-specific implementations and configurations. Close collaboration among BMW development teams, the Telematics ECU project and external suppliers of ECU-specific components is essential.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a Domain Project Interface for Telematics, you manage the delivery of one or more platform domains to the Telematics ECU project. You coordinate software teams across several sub-organizations and are responsible for BMW software-platform deliveries and the end-to-end functionality of domain features within the ECU project. You are a core member of the software management team, with responsibility for targets, milestones, quality and schedules.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Act as the single point of contact between the domain CoC and platform teams and the Telematics ECU project.
* Translate project needs into domain requirements, features and priorities, aligning them with Product Owners, Domain Architects and Domain Integrators.
* Plan, track and steer domain deliveries, releases and milestones; support release planning with Domain Integrators.
* Manage the domain backlog and priorities with the development teams using Agile and Scrum practices and Jira.
* Identify, assess and escalate risks, dependencies and blockers early; drive mitigation and resolution.
* Monitor and prioritize domain defects and stability issues with Problem Managers, Defect Managers and testers; support root-cause analysis and escalate issues to software teams when needed.
* Ensure the quality of domain deliveries, including test coverage, integration readiness and compliance with process and security requirements.
* Coordinate cross-functional topics spanning multiple ECUs, domains and teams.
* Manage internal and external suppliers, including topics related to software development, nomination, licensing and open-source components.
* Plan resources and capacity with sub-organizations and supplier teams.
* Report regularly on status, risks and KPIs to project and software management, and prepare decisions.
* Make and communicate decisions about scope and priorities, including difficult trade-offs.
* Drive change management and continuously improve ways of working across teams.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Basic Requirements and Education**

* Business-fluent English.
* A university degree in computer science or a comparable field (B.Eng., B.Sc., M.Sc. or Ph.D.).
* At least five years of experience in program, technology or software project management.
* Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to make difficult decisions about software-development scope and priorities.

### **Required Experience and Skills**

* A proven track record of planning, organizing and delivering results through large, distributed software teams.
* Experience with software domains on Linux systems, preferably embedded devices (Yocto, BSP and system services).
* Experience with Agile practices and project-tracking tools (Scrum, Jira, Confluence and GitHub).
* Experience in defect, risk and escalation management, including support for root-cause analysis.
* Supplier-management experience and experience delivering products that include open-source components.
* Knowledge of automotive processes and standards, such as Automotive SPICE and ISO/SAE 21434, is beneficial.

**Keywords**
------------

Infotainment · Linux · Telematics · Project Management · Solution-Oriented · Hands-On

For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:

* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M&A decisions, and long-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data-led, execution-focused, and outcome-driven** — not opinion-heavy slideware.

At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media & Telecom, and Private Equity.

Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Why Globalization Excellence (GE)**

Zinnov’s Globalization Excellence (GE) practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end-to-end — from Design & Discovery to Build, Scale, and Run.

In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:

* Own complex, end-to-end client journeys
* Work across GCC advisory, managed services, and BOT / outsourcing models
* Influence leadership decisions that shape long-term talent and operating strategies
* This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.

**About the Role**

As **Project Lead**, you will own consulting engagements end-to-end and lead high-stakes workstreams across technology-led domains (TMT, Aerospace, Automotive, Manufacturing, Telecom, Semiconductors, Healthcare, and adjacent sectors). This role is designed for a hands-on consulting leader who can translate ambiguous client asks into structured problem statements, lead teams through deep research and analysis, and deliver crisp, decision-ready recommendations.

You will work closely with Engagement Managers and senior leadership on project delivery and practice development, while also contributing to business development through solutioning, proposals, and client pitches.

**What You’ll Do**

**End-to-End Project Delivery**

* Own engagement delivery from first contact to final output — scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and risk management.

* Lead multiple projects in parallel; manage dependencies, risks, and execution trade-offs to ensure predictable delivery.

* Drive “customer delight” through clear alignment, strong outputs, and high-quality client experience.

**Research & Insight Leadership**

* Guide teams on primary and secondary research approaches; ensure strong fact bases and data validation.

* Review analysis to extract trends, patterns, and insights (qualitative and quantitative) that strengthen recommendations.

* Validate strategic recommendations and ensure outputs are tight, defensible, and decision-useful.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Own client communication and expectation management — requirements clarity, cadence, updates, and delivery alignment.

* Engage effectively across CXO and senior stakeholders while also working seamlessly with working teams.

* Manage research partner / external vendor relationships where applicable.

**Business Development & Solutioning**

* Contribute to business development by participating in client calls and pitching solutions.

* Design engagement structures — resourcing plans, effort estimates, travel assumptions, and proposal/pricing inputs.

* Develop proof-of-concepts when needed and shape proposal narratives and sales collateral.

**Practice & Organizational Development**

* Partner with senior leaders to drive practice priorities — vision, capabilities, and repeatable methodologies.

* Build reusable assets: frameworks, knowledge nuggets, thought pieces, whitepapers, capability decks, and website-ready content.

* Support practice team building through hiring inputs, onboarding, and capability development.

**People Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead and motivate teams; coach on research depth, analytical rigor, and consulting-grade communication.

* Set execution standards and review discipline to ensure consistently high-quality outputs.

* Drive skill building through structured feedback and practice-specific training initiatives.

**What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (Engineering) from a top-tier university.

* MBA/PGDM preferred.

* 5–8+ years of experience in consulting / research / strategy / analysis-heavy roles with end-to-end project delivery exposure.

* Comfort working across technology-led industries and multi-stakeholder environments.

**Key Skills**

* Excellent business writing, verbal communication, and presentation/storytelling skills.

* Strong research, analytical, and numerical capability with a rigorous, structured problem-solving approach.

* Strong execution and delivery ownership — hands-on, detail-oriented, and timeline-driven.

* Strong stakeholder management across CXO and working teams.

* Process orientation with comfort using and customizing technology/tools for delivery.

* High ownership, proactive mindset, and ability to thrive in a fast-growing environment.

* International experience is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like – Globalization Excellence (GE)**

* Engagements delivered end-to-end with strong quality, predictability, and stakeholder confidence.

* Teams coached to produce sharper research, stronger insights, and consistently client-ready narratives.

* Strong client trust built through clarity, cadence, and reliable delivery under tight timelines.

* Visible BD contribution through solutioning, proposals, and repeatable sales assets.

* Practice impact through reusable frameworks, thought leadership, and capability building.

**If you enjoy owning consulting engagements end-to-end, leading teams to deliver analysis-rich and client-ready outcomes and shaping solutions that influence senior stakeholders — this role offers both impact and growth.**

**Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

description:

**Senior Consultant – Data Product Engineering**
**Experience - 6–10 Years**
**Level - Senior Consultant**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Consultant – Data Product Engineering to design, build and operationalize reusable, trusted and business-aligned data products. The role combines data engineering, data-product thinking, cloud platforms and delivery consulting. The candidate will work with Product Owners, architects, analysts and engineering teams to convert business needs into governed, discoverable and production-ready data products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build domain-oriented data products with clear consumers, contracts, ownership, service levels and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate business requirements into data-product features, source-to-target mappings, data models, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Develop scalable batch, streaming and incremental ingestion pipelines using ETL/ELT and CDC patterns.
* Implement Bronze, Silver and Gold layers using lakehouse, medallion and dimensional-modelling patterns.
* Create curated datasets, semantic models, APIs or data-sharing interfaces for analytics, reporting, AI/ML and operational use cases.
* Implement data quality rules, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, observability, security and access controls as part of the product.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, data architects, business SMEs, platform teams and downstream consumers throughout discovery and delivery.
* Perform design and code reviews, automate tests and deployments, resolve performance issues and support production releases.
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, demonstrations, documentation, technical-risk management and continuous improvement.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote reusable frameworks, engineering standards and AI-assisted development practices.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Capability - Expected Expertise**

* Data Engineering - ETL/ELT, batch and streaming ingestion, CDC, incremental processing, reconciliation and error handling
* Cloud Data Platforms - Databricks or Snowflake; Microsoft Azure preferred, with AWS or Google Cloud exposure beneficial
* Programming Python, PySpark, SQL and shell scripting
* Data Modelling - Dimensional, normalized and denormalized models; lakehouse and medallion architecture
* Data Product Practices -Data contracts, product ownership, discoverability, SLAs/SLOs, data quality, metadata, lineage and observability
* Integration -REST APIs, event-driven integration, Kafka or equivalent messaging, and secure data sharing
* DevOps -Azure DevOps or GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality and Terraform or equivalent IaC
* AI Enablement- Engineering AI-ready datasets and using GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools for development, review and testing

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* 6–10 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing or cloud data-platform delivery.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake or a comparable modern cloud data platform.
* Strong experience developing production-grade data pipelines using Python, SQL and PySpark or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with data modelling, data quality, metadata, lineage, security and performance optimization.
* Experience working in Agile teams using Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub or equivalent delivery tools.
* Strong analytical, consulting, stakeholder communication, documentation and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

* Informatica PowerCenter, IICS/IDMC, Azure Data Factory or similar enterprise integration tooling.
* Data mesh, domain-oriented ownership, data marketplaces and data-product operating models.
* Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow, Snowpark, Streams and Tasks or Dynamic Tables.
* Power BI semantic models, AI/ML feature pipelines, vector-ready datasets or Generative AI data preparation.
* Experience in utilities, financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail or another regulated industry.
* Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, AWS or data-engineering certifications.

**Success Measures**
Data-product adoption | Data quality and reconciliation success | Pipeline reliability | SLA/SLO compliance | Time to onboard new data | Processing performance and cost | Release predictability | Production defects | Reuse of frameworks and data products | Consumer satisfaction
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A technically strong consultant who combines hands-on data engineering with product thinking. The candidate should understand the consumer and business outcome, build reusable and governed data products, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and remain accountable for data quality, reliability, security and production adoption.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

description:

**Job Title: Sr. Cyber Data Scientist**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
* Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
* Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

**RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**MLOps, Observability & Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
* Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
* Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

**Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks
