title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
*At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.*
*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.*
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build and own machine learning models that power core prediction problems across the FourKites platform — including ETA/ATA forecasting and message-based status extraction. You will work end-to-end, from data pipeline to production deployment and monitoring, turning noisy real-world logistics data into models that run at scale and directly move the needle on customer outcomes. You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams, hands-on building and shipping models yourself while also guiding the technical direction of other data scientists on the team.
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* Design, build, and productionize ML models for problems like ETA/ATA prediction, using regression, classification, and time-series forecasting techniques
* Develop NLP/LLM-based extraction pipelines for message-based ETA and status updates (text extraction, entity recognition)
* Own models end-to-end: data pipeline → training → deployment → monitoring → retraining
* Work with noisy, real-world logistics and supply chain data (GPS pings, check calls, carrier data) rather than clean, pre-processed datasets
* Diagnose gaps between offline evaluation performance and live production accuracy, and drive fixes
* Build and maintain automated training/retraining pipelines using orchestration tools such as Airflow
* Set up and maintain model monitoring and observability (e.g., Grafana) to catch drift and degradation proactively
* Replace manual or rule-based processes with ML-driven automation (e.g., automating manual check calls)
* Translate model performance improvements into business impact — operational savings, efficiency gains, and deal-relevant outcomes
* Mentor and guide other data scientists/engineers on technical approach and best practices
* Make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoff decisions independently

**About the team:**
Our product and engineering teams are dedicated to providing the industry's best-in-class end-to-end supply chain visibility platform. We are committed to building a high-performing, ML-driven team that turns supply chain data into automated, proactive action — and we want you to help lead that effort.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* Strong ML fundamentals across regression, classification, and time-series forecasting
* NLP experience — text extraction, entity recognition, or LLM-based extraction
* Production ML experience — you've shipped models serving real traffic, not just built POCs or notebooks
* Strong Python and SQL skills — pandas, scikit-learn, and comfort querying large datasets (Redshift/Snowflake a plus)
* Experience with cloud and data infrastructure — AWS (S3, EC2), and orchestration tools like Airflow for training/retraining pipelines
* Experience setting up or working with model monitoring and observability tooling (Grafana or similar)
* Comfortable working with noisy, real-world data rather than clean, curated datasets
* Experience diagnosing and closing the gap between offline evaluation results and live production performance
* A track record of replacing manual/rule-based processes with ML solutions
* Ability to translate model output into business value and communicate that impact to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations teams
* Experience mentoring or guiding other data scientists or engineers
* Ability to make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoffs independently
* A track record of reducing manual intervention or turnaround time through automation
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation
* Familiarity with real-time/streaming data (Kafka)
* Exposure to LLM/GenAI applications in production

**Who we are:**
*FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit*
*www.fourkites.com*
*.*
FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.
  
  
**Benefits:**

* Medical benefits start on first day of employment
* 36 PTO days (Sick, Casual and Earned), 5 recharge days, 2 volunteer days
* Home Office set ups and Technology reimbursement
* Lifestyle & Family benefits
* Mental Wellness support and guidance
* Ongoing learning & development opportunities (Professional development program, Toast Master club, etc.)

**FourKites is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**About the Role**
As an Engineer II in AI Science, you will be a key hands-on contributor responsible for the implementation, testing, and maintenance of AI/ML solutions that power the autonomous network operations platform. This role supports the core strategy of transitioning from reactive, queue-based work to continuous, 24/7 autonomous network coverage. You will be responsible for developing and deploying production-grade AI driven Agents that operate within the five layers of autonomous agents, focusing on data processing, feature engineering, and implementation of algorithms that detect issues, aggregate impact, and generate evidence-based insights.
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement components of AI/ML solutions using Python and CI/CD practices.
* Contribute to building scalable and efficient AI Agents for large-scale data processing.
* Implement and analyse the performance of established algorithms, including those from deep learning and generative AI.
* Write complex queries using SQL/BigQuery to extract data and build features necessary to train models and derive business insights.
* Assist in designing and implementing AI/ML pipelines for model training and deployment.
* Collaborate effectively with team members to deliver high-quality, impactful autonomous solutions.

**Technical QualificationsMust Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* Two or more years of experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions.
* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in CI/CD practices.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and distributed computing.
* Understanding of AI/ML algorithms, including Agentic AI and generative AI techniques.
* Experience working with GCP, BigQuery/SQL, and Python.

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience in building scoring models and anomaly detection solutions.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Science & Measurement
description:
**Job Description**

**NIQ Activate**
is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data Science & Measurement to manage the portfolio of data-science models and measurement capabilities used across Promotion Planning, Promotion Effectiveness, Retail Media, and Personalization.

**This is a technical product-management role, not a model-development role.**
The successful candidate will partner with Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, and Engineering to maintain the model inventory, define clear requirements, identify opportunities for standardization and reuse, and manage migration from legacy or product-specific models toward shared portfolio capabilities.

The role requires sufficient technical depth to understand model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, and limitations. Data Science retains ownership of methodology selection, model development, scientific testing, and validation.

Key responsibilities

* **Model inventory and documentation:**
  Maintain an inventory of models and measurement capabilities across the four product areas, including purpose, usage, required data, inputs, outputs, ownership, versions, dependencies, limitations, and lifecycle status
* **Gap, duplication, and modernization assessment:**
  Identify missing capabilities, overlapping or inconsistent approaches, legacy models, and opportunities for competitive parity, differentiation, modernization, partnership, or retirement
* **Standardization and reuse:**
  Identify opportunities to standardize models, methodologies, interfaces, terminology, inputs, outputs, and documentation across the portfolio
* **Migration roadmap:**
  Define and manage the path from legacy or product-specific models toward standardized and reusable portfolio capabilities, including sequencing, dependencies, risks, and adoption
* **Requirements definition:**
  Partner with domain Product Managers and Commercial teams to translate customer, market, and product needs into clear data-science and measurement requirements, use cases, expected outputs, constraints, dependencies, and acceptance criteria
* **Prioritization and roadmap management:**
  Prioritize model and measurement needs based on customer value, commercial opportunity, product strategy, technical feasibility, delivery dependencies, and reuse potential
* **Industry and best-practice research:**
  Research competitor capabilities, industry approaches, methodology trends, and applicable standards, and translate the findings into practical product recommendations
* **Cross-functional coordination:**
  Connect Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, and Architecture to align decisions, delivery plans, technical dependencies, and product integration
* **Model lifecycle and product integration:**
  Coordinate capabilities from requirement through development, integration, adoption, migration, replacement, and retirement, ensuring changes are reflected in product workflows, documentation, KPI definitions, and customer-facing experiences
* **Adoption and stakeholder communication:**
  Track whether capabilities are adopted and creating expected value, and clearly communicate model purpose, assumptions, limitations, dependencies, migration plans, and product implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with data-intensive, analytical, measurement, AI/ML, or decision-support products
* **Technical product management:**
  Demonstrated ability to translate customer and business needs into clear, delivery-ready requirements for Data, Data Science, and Engineering teams
* **Model and measurement fluency:**
  Working knowledge of concepts such as baselines, forecasting, optimization, incrementality, causal inference, attribution, segmentation, propensity, recommendations, and experiment design
* **Technical understanding:**
  Ability to discuss model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, confidence, limitations, and intended use without being the hands-on model developer
* **Portfolio thinking:**
  Experience identifying duplication, reusable capabilities, standardization opportunities, common interfaces, and migration paths across multiple products
* **Research and product judgment:**
  Ability to assess industry practices and competitor capabilities and balance customer value, commercial opportunity, feasibility, reuse, effort, and time to value
* **Roadmap and cross-functional leadership:**
  Experience managing priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, and sequencing across Product, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, and customer-facing teams
* **Communication:**
  Ability to translate technical concepts into clear product, commercial, and customer language and facilitate decisions across technical and non-technical stakeholders
* **Education and domain experience:**
  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, analytical, or business discipline, or equivalent experience. Experience in retail analytics, promotion, retail media measurement, personalization, revenue growth management, or marketing measurement is preferred
* **Delivery methods:**
  Experience with agile delivery, PI planning or comparable scaled planning, Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PowerPoint

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
You build and own assigned solution streams across 1–2 concurrent projects. You implement agentic AI solutions on AWS AgentCore and LangGraph, contribute to POC delivery, and take full ownership of your components in production — including Pro Code builds and Low Code automations where the use case fits.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Agentic AI Development

+ Implement LangGraph agentic workflows on AWS AgentCore — state graphs, tool orchestration, conditional routing, error recovery.
+ Build custom RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector retrieval, accuracy evaluation.
+ Contribute to rapid POC delivery alongside the Architect and Lead.
+ Write production-grade Python with FastAPI, Pydantic, testing, and proper error handling.
+ Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate builds. Own and fix all generated code in production.

* Low Code & Automation

+ Build Low Code automations using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate when use case and bandwidth allow.
+ Understand Pro Code vs Low Code trade-offs — flag where Low Code is the better fit.
+ Stay current on Low Code platform capabilities as they expand rapidly.

* Production Ownership & Collaboration

+ Own assigned components in production — monitor, debug, optimise, iterate.
+ Debug agent failures independently: context issues, tool errors, hallucination, retrieval degradation.
+ Collaborate with the Lead on architecture translation and implementation planning.
+ Mentor Associate Developers through code reviews and pair programming.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Must Have:**

* LangGraph — State graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing — primary framework, non-negotiable.
* LangChain — Chains, memory, custom tools — solid foundational knowledge.
* AWS AgentCore — Hands-on preferred; strong LangGraph depth with ramp path acceptable.
* AWS Bedrock — Model invocation, knowledge bases, guardrails.
* Database & AI Data Access — SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query and insight patterns. Snowflake a plus.
* RAG Pipelines — End-to-end: chunking, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation.
* Vector Databases — Pinecone, ChromaDB, OpenSearch, or FAISS — hands-on with at least one.
* Python — Production-quality — type hints, async/await, FastAPI, Pydantic.
* Multi-Model — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama — understand trade-offs across providers.
* Pro Code vs Low Code — Copilot Studio and Power Automate — build when use case fits.
* AI Development Tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cline — accelerate delivery; own and fix all generated code.
* Experience — 3–5 years total; 1–2 years GenAI/LLM; 6–12 months LangGraph; 2–3 projects with working code.

**Good To Have**

* AWS AgentCore Deep — Runtime, Memory, Tools Gateway hands-on.
* MCP / A2A — Server/client implementation or protocol awareness.
* Enterprise Integration — SAP HANA, Salesforce connectors.
* Document Intelligence — OCR, layout-aware chunking.
* Evaluation Frameworks — RAGAS, Promptfoo, DeepEval.
* Certifications — AWS, GCP, or Azure AI/ML.

**What We Expect From You**

* Customer Obsession

+ Proactively understand customer goals and deliver measurable value.

* Competitive Drive

+ Set high standards, demonstrate tenacity, and ensure our solutions lead in quality.

* Challenging Mindset

+ Foster fact-based dialogue, challenge assumptions, and encourage disruptive thinking.

* Action and Learning Velocity

+ Build fast, fail fast, learn fast. Iterate rapidly and make data-driven decisions.

* Collaboration and Accountability

+ Collaborate across a global team with humility, ownership, and mutual accountability.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build production agentic AI at global scale — real systems, real impact.
* Work with AWS AgentCore, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, and AI-powered development tools.
* Operate in a high-trust team where Architect, Lead, Developer, and Associate work in sync.
* A culture of rapid learning, fast iteration, and genuine technical excellence.

This is an applied computational-patterning role, not a general-purpose enterprise AI position. The successful candidate will combine AI/ML development experience with knowledge of computational lithography, semiconductor process modeling, computational imaging, EDA, metrology, or closely related physics-based engineering applications.

The role will develop physics-aware ML models, engineering agents, and optimization methods to improve model development, recipe creation and optimization, verification, root-cause analysis, and advanced-node exploration while maintaining technical rigor and traceable validation.

  
  

**Roles and Responsibilities Include but Are Not Limited To:**
--------------------------------------------------------------

### **Machine Learning for Physical Patterning Systems**

* Develop physics-aware, surrogate, and predictive ML models for lithography, resist, OPC, metrology, process variability, and patterning risk.
* Develop methods for contour prediction, hotspot detection, layout analysis, calibration acceleration, uncertainty estimation, and ML-assisted optimization of masks, OPC recipes, models, process windows, and design-rule space.
* Translate patterning challenges into well-defined AI/ML problems, including appropriate datasets, success metrics, validation methods, and engineering acceptance criteria.

### **Agentic AI Development**

* Design and implement agentic workflows for computational patterning applications such as experiment planning, model calibration, recipe optimization and diagnostics, verification, root-cause analysis, and technical knowledge retrieval.
* Develop reusable agentic architectures integrating engineering tools and data, workflow orchestration, context management, evaluation, provenance, human review, and appropriate controls for confidential semiconductor development data.
* Apply and evaluate agentic workflows for design-rule exploration, OPC and verification model development, process optimization, layout analysis, and multi-layer patterning trade studies.

### **Patterning Integration**

* Collaborate with OPC, lithography, resist, process integration, mask, metrology, design, and software engineers to identify and develop high-value AI/ML applications.
* Validate AI/ML solutions against physical models, simulation and measured data, with appropriate consideration of uncertainty, domain of validity, failure modes, and engineering acceptance criteria.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computational Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field with 5+ years of semiconductor industry experience focusing on RET, OPC, lithography, or mask development.
* Hands-on experience developing AI/ML systems, including modern ML frameworks, data pipelines, model evaluation, optimization, or agentic workflows.
* Experience applying ML to a physical engineering or scientific domain such as computational lithography, semiconductor process modeling, metrology, EDA, computational imaging, or physics simulation.
* Strong Python programming and software development skills.

### **Preferred**

* Experience with OPC, lithography simulation, resist modeling, computational imaging, inverse lithography, mask optimization, semiconductor metrology, or semiconductor process simulation.
* Experience in one or more of the following: physics-informed ML, differentiable simulation, geometric deep learning, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, active learning, Bayesian optimization, LLM-based agents, or integration with scientific/HPC/GPU workflows.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Lead the service transformation teams**

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.

**Turn architecture into shipped services**

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered.

**Establish the base service tier**

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.

**Protect compatibility and business continuity**

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.

**Modernize the application foundations**

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

**Raise the bar for engineering quality**

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.

**Drive AI-native ways of working**

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through.

**Partner across the program**

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Proven engineering leadership**

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.

**Service transformation depth**

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

**Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency**

Enough hands-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.

**Migration safety instincts**

You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

**Quality and operational discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.

**People development**

You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.

**Cross-functional execution**

You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.

**An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**

You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**Bonus Points**

Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.

Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.

Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.

Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).

Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**The base service tier becomes real**

Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.

**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**

Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.

**The platform compounds**

New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.

**The team gets stronger**

Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.

**Why This Matters**

Everything ABC is building — the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform — stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted.

This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next.

  

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. title: Senior Content Marketer
description:
**About Plane**
===============

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

**Humans and agents**
---------------------

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

**About the role**
------------------

Plane gets evaluated in public. Our docs, our issue tracker, and comparison pages written by competitors are all evidence a buyer collects before they talk to anyone here. You will own the content that meets them there, which means the roadmap of what we publish, the standard every page is held to, and most of the drafts. This is a writing job first. You will work with product managers on what shipped rather than what was announced, with Sales on the objections that stall enterprise evaluations, and with the community team, whose forum threads are a steady supply of real questions.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the content roadmap across discovery and evaluation: what gets written, refreshed, consolidated, or killed. You defend those calls with signups, product qualified leads, and assisted conversions rather than pageviews.
* Own the comparison and migration surfaces for Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp. These pages get read mid-evaluation with a competitor's sales team in the other tab, so they have to be accurate enough to survive that reader.
* Write for two audiences without patronizing either. A self-hoster debugging a container upgrade and a VP of engineering justifying a migration budget both have to reach the end of the page.
* Turn releases into content that says what changed and who it is for, built from the pull requests and the product manager rather than from the announcement blurb.
* Build the proof that shortens an enterprise evaluation: deployment stories, customer evidence, and content on security, governance, and data residency. Much of this means asking regulated customers for permission we will sometimes not get, and writing without it when we do not.
* Work daily with product managers, design, and community, and put every technical draft in front of the engineer who built the thing before it goes live.
* Do the maintenance: auditing pages that rank for the wrong query, rewriting posts that aged badly after a release, fixing internal links across the site, and consolidating pages that compete with each other.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* **You ship final drafts** You write long form that goes live with light editing, and you can point to three pieces you would still defend a year later.
* **You have grown organic traffic that converted** Keyword strategy, internal linking, refreshes, and topical authority are things you have run end to end, with signups or pipeline at the other end of them.
* **You write about technical products without distorting them** You have covered software you did not build, checked claims against the product, and been corrected by an engineer without it becoming a problem.
* **You have written competitive content** Comparison, migration, or alternatives pages in a category where the other side had a bigger budget than you.
* **You have editorial judgment about other people's work** You can brief a writer, cut a draft in half, and explain why, because part of this job is improving writing you did not do.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You have used Plane, run it self-hosted, or written for an open project whose community will correct you in public.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment content: SSO, audit logs, data residency, air-gapped installs.
* You have built templates, docs-adjacent content, or product education that people still use.
* You have opinions about what AI search is doing to content strategy, and you have tested them.

**Why Plane?**
--------------

Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.

**The scope is real.** We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.

**The constraints make you better.** Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.

**The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production.** We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.

**Your name is on the work.** The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.

*Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Senior Manager, AI
description:
**Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet**

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

**About the Team**

Our Data & Analytics Operations team is building a Digital Workforce: AI agents, which we call digital workers, that carry out complete business processes end to end, such as researching public records, reviewing documents, verifying businesses and assembling case evidence. Digital workers run on a shared enterprise platform with people in the loop, so experts set the rules, handle exceptions and focus on the decisions that need human judgment. Digital workers are already handling production volume, and we are scaling quickly.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team that designs, builds and runs our digital workers. You will lead a team of AI engineers, set the engineering standards for how we build, test and operate AI agents, and make sure every digital worker is accurate, secure and delivering measurable business results.

You will partner closely with product, operations, data and technology leaders across the globe, and you will play a central role in growing a world-class AI engineering capability in Hyderabad.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of AI engineers and senior AI engineers, building technical leaders who own their digital workers end to end.
* Own engineering delivery of digital workers for operations use cases including business research, data quality, risk and compliance, and fraud investigation, from concept through production.
* Apply and evolve platform patterns for orchestration, agent skills, reusable tools, retrieval, reasoning and human-in-the-loop review.
* Set shared standards for agent development, prompt and context engineering, tool calling and reuse, and run an engineering community of practice across product areas.
* Design and run evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, agreement with expert reviewers, confidence thresholds and exception rates.
* Own release management, monitoring, observability, incident response and ongoing production support (LLMOps) for digital workers.
* Integrate digital workers with enterprise data pipelines and systems of record while protecting data quality, lineage and controls.
* Partner with security, legal and compliance teams to embed guardrails, auditability and responsible-AI practices.
* Assess and size new use cases, translate business needs into engineering plans and contribute to the multi-quarter roadmap.
* Report progress, risks and business outcomes such as throughput, accuracy, cycle time and cost to serve to senior leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 10+ years in software, data or AI/ML engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams with direct reports.
* 3+ years building and shipping generative AI or LLM-based applications to production.
* Strong hands-on Python and API development skills.
* Practical experience with agentic frameworks and SDKs (for example LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock), tool calling, RAG, embeddings and vector search.
* Experience designing evaluation and quality frameworks for AI systems, including human review and hallucination controls.
* Experience with GCP and/or AWS, containers, CI/CD and MLOps or LLMOps tooling.
* Ability to turn business problems into scalable technical solutions and to influence across business and engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with senior leaders.

* Prepare estimates of work and duration for change requests, enhancements and reported issues.

* Participate in client meetings, review calls and steering committee meetings as requested.

* Identify opportunities to automate monitoring, alerts and repetitive support tasks to reduce incident volume and resolution time.
* Be available for on-call, rotational shift or weekend support as per project needs.

Educational Qualification and Skills Required

* **Education:** Undergraduate or above from a reputed institution. A relevant certificate or diploma in software technologies (or ITIL Foundation) is desirable, but relevant experience will be considered.
* **Experience:** 7–10 years in technology development and support with reputed national/international service or product companies, including proven experience leading a support team.

* **Web services:** Hands-on experience with RESTful/SOAP services and JSON/XML parsing.
* **Database:** Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL, including query tuning and data analysis for issue investigation.
* **Production support:** Proven experience in L2/L3 support, incident and problem management, and SLA-driven delivery. Working knowledge of ITIL processes and ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow or similar).

We are seeking an experienced Credit Portfolio and Relationship Management professional with 12–15 years of experience across credit analysis, portfolio management, and client relationship management within Corporate / Wholesale / Commercial Banking. title: Demand Planner
description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

**Job Description**

**Designation:**
Demand Planner

**Location:**
Nerul, Navi Mumbai

**Department:**
Supply Chain Management (SCM)

**Reporting To:**
SCM Head / S&OP Lead

**Position Purpose**

The Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining accurate demand forecasts by integrating historical sales data, market intelligence, sales inputs, and business trends. The role acts as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Finance to support the S&OP process, ensure high forecast reliability, optimize inventory levels, and proactively manage slow-moving and obsolete inventories.

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Planning & Forecasting**

* Generate, maintain, and continuously improve rolling demand forecasts at SKU, product family, and regional levels.
* Analyze historical sales data, market trends, seasonality, and business intelligence to develop demand plans.
* Incorporate Sales, Marketing, Key Account, and Channel inputs into the forecasting process.
* Segment SKUs based on demand patterns and forecast ability.
* Identify demand risks, opportunities, and forecast assumptions.
* Support new product launch forecasting and phase-out planning.
* Communicate forecast updates and demand changes to Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Procurement teams.
* Monitor forecast performance and drive continuous forecast improvement initiatives.
* Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

**S&OP Process Support**

* Lead the demand review process as part of the monthly S&OP cycle.
* Facilitate consensus demand planning with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Challenge assumptions and reconcile differences between statistical forecasts and commercial inputs.
* Provide demand scenarios and sensitivity analysis to support management decision-making.

**Inventory Management**

* Establish stocking norms, safety stock levels, and inventory policies aligned with service level targets.
* Monitor inventory health across warehouses and distribution centers.
* Balance product availability with inventory optimization objectives.
* Analyze inventory trends and recommend actions to reduce excess stock while maintaining customer service levels.
* Work closely with Supply Planning and Sales teams to improve inventory turns and working capital efficiency.

**SLOB (Slow Moving & Obsolete Inventory) Management**

* Track, analyze, and report Slow Moving and Obsolete (SLOB) inventory on a periodic basis.
* Identify root causes of excess and aging inventory.
* Develop inventory reduction plans in collaboration with Sales, Product Management, and Supply Chain teams.
* Drive liquidation, reallocation, phase-out, and inventory recovery initiatives.
* Monitor effectiveness of SLOB reduction actions and report progress to management.
* Support financial provisions and inventory risk assessments related to obsolete stock.

**Performance Monitoring & Analytics**

* Track and report forecasting KPIs and inventory-related metrics.
* Conduct forecast accuracy and forecast bias analysis.
* Prepare demand planning and inventory dashboards for leadership review.
* Generate actionable insights to improve service levels, forecast effectiveness, and inventory efficiency.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Demand Planning**

* Forecast Accuracy (%)
* Forecast Bias / Forecast Fidelity
* IBP Implementation
* Demand Plan Adherence
* Traded Goods & New Product Forecast Accuracy %

**Inventory Management**

* Inventory Turns
* Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO)
* Stock Availability / Service Level
* Inventory Health Index

**SLOB Management**

* SLOB Value (% of Inventory)
* Aging Inventory Reduction
* Obsolete Inventory Write-off Reduction
* Excess Inventory Reduction

**Key Competencies**

* Demand Forecasting & Analytics
* Project Management
* Inventory Optimization
* S&OP Process Management
* Data Interpretation & Decision Making
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Acumen

**Success in this role is measured by improved forecast accuracy, optimized inventory levels, reduced SLOB inventory, enhanced service levels, and effective participation in the S&OP process.**

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, or related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning, or S&OP.
* Experience in Manufacturing, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, FMCG, or Industrial Products preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SAP/APO/IBP, Kinaxis, or equivalent planning systems.
* Knowledge of forecasting techniques, inventory management, and S&OP processes.

**Additional Information**

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Technical Approval Officer
description:
**About Us**

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About the Role**

What we offer

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. You are a technical professional who combines strong accreditation knowledge with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

title: Data Scientist II, Analytics Engine Optimization
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created Data Scientist II role within our Analytics Engine Optimization org and will be based in our India office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
As a
**Data Scientist II**
on the Analytics Engine Optimization team, you will be responsible for conducting analysis, applying statistical and mathematical techniques, and developing models to support digital marketing measurement and investment optimization across our global portfolio. The role will measure and analyze digital, investment, and sales data to evaluate marketing effectiveness, support optimization efforts, and serve as the Marketing Analytics SME. In this role you will partner across Insights & Analytics, The Agency, Digital & Technology, Sales, Finance, Operating Units (OUs), and Business Units (BUs) to leverage Data and Advanced Analytics to solve problems and implement key initiatives.
  
  
We are looking for candidates with strong Data Science, Measurement, and Marketing expertise with a passion to solve complex problems. You will work on projects with high impact and create a new generation of products, tools and capability within an Agile environment. The role will also have exposure to many functions within the company and globally to gain a unique perspective on the business from marketing effectiveness lens.
  
  
Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S. based functional partners and managers.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with marketing and business stakeholders to define analytical problems, success criteria, data requirements, and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop and implement data-driven solutions using advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to measure marketing effectiveness.
* Build, validate, and maintain causal inference pipelines and measurement strategies such as Marketing Mix Models.
* Create statistical and machine learning models to quantify the campaigns and interactions that affect consumers’ purchase behavior.
* Build statistical model-based Omni-channel marketing solutions to optimize investment and maximize impact across different channels.
* Develop attribution model solutions to optimize the delivery and timing of marketing initiatives across different channels and audiences.
* Design, recommend, and measure statistically proven A/B tests by applying best practices.
* Communicate insights, model outputs, and recommendations clearly to non-technical audience.
* Partner with third-party vendors/agencies to define measurement strategy. Ensure the necessary data will be available at the right level to enable evaluation and optimization of marketing programs.
* Construct production ready, reusable, large scale or scalable complex optimization, simulation & machine learning models that provide real time insights aligning with General Mills Data Science standards.
* Contribute to existing Data Science projects and initiatives.
* Develop forecasts and build simulation models to predict the outcome of complex and real-world scenarios.
* Responsible for monitoring and improvement of model performance metrics in terms of accuracy, optimal near optimal recommendations with feedback incorporated from business partners.
* Understand both current uses and future state of promotional planning/optimization at General Mills, capture ongoing needs, and support integration with existing systems, data sets, reports.
* Provide thought leadership and apply creative analytical solutions to ad-hoc projects.
* Possess R&D mindset by prototyping and carrying out tests.
* Influence, educate, and train the organization to adopt new processes and systems
* Vet Analytics components with 3rd-party tools, evaluating their performance and providing recommendations to help drive procurement decisions.
* Mix analytical insights with business knowledge to build solutions that work in the real world

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or related quantitative discipline
* Minimum years of relevant experience in Data Science, Modeling, and Advanced Analytics
* Expertise in problem-solving including experience/knowledge of statistical measurement, forecasting, and econometrics
* Working knowledge in statistical algorithms, predictive modeling techniques, especially Regression, Bayesian, Classification, Boosting, and Optimization models
* Strong SQL skills
* Expertise level knowledge in Python or R
* Working knowledge of relational databases and Cloud-based environment such as GCP
* Experience working data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau), and data integration platforms (e.g. Alteryx, Talend)
* Experience in Data Mining, building and working with APIs
* Familiarity with Data Clean Room technology.
* Proven knowledge and understanding of development in Agile environment
* Exceptional Communication Skills – ability to clearly and simply communicate complex results to a wide range of audiences
* Learning agility – ability to work in white space to build new analytical processes and tools
* Familiarity with syndicated data sets (Nielsen/IRI).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in a quantitative field
* Experience working within a marketing analytics agency, tech platform, or enterprise consumer brand
* Experience working in a large, matrixed organization with multiple concurrent stakeholders and priorities.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: TC-CS-CAOE-AI Data scientist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Sr. Cyber Data Scientist**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
* Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
* Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

**RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**MLOps, Observability & Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
* Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
* Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

**Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

title: Senior Analyst - Data Quality
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Analyst - Data Quality

Function: Digital Innovation & Technology

Location: Powai, Mumbai

**Overview**

This role demand strong GenAI experience, emerging mastery in **Agentic AI Systems**, and a good foundation in classical ML.

You will design and build **intelligent, tool-using agents**, **multi-agent systems**, **RAG pipelines**, and **LLM-based applications** leveraging the **LangChain , LangGraph ecosystem, LangSmith** for evaluation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **GenAI / LLM Application Development**

* Build GenAI applications using:
* + LangChain and LangGraph
* Implement RAG architectures with:
* + Retrieval, reranking, chunking, and memory strategies
  + Vector databases such as FAISS, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, and pgvector
* Design prompt-engineering strategies:
* + Instruction following
  + ReAct (Reasoning + Acting)
  + Chain-of-thought structuring
  + Self-reflection and planning loops
* Evaluation strategy:
* + Implement evaluation frameworks for classical ML and GenAI systems, covering statistical validation, reliability, and robustness.
  + Assess LLM outputs, RAG pipelines, and agent workflows for grounding quality, relevance, and retrieval accuracy, such as recall@k and precision@k.
  + Use **LangSmith** for tracing, automated evaluations, regression testing, and continuous system-level quality monitoring.
* **Agentic System Architecture**

* Build **agentic workflows**:
* + Tool-calling agents
  + Planner–executor systems
  + Multi-agent communication systems
  + Hierarchical agent architectures
  + Deep agents
* Integrate memory systems:
* + Episodic memory
  + Semantic memory
  + Vector-based long-term knowledge
* Implement evaluation frameworks for agentic systems using LangSmith.
* **Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tooling**

* Implement MCP servers for external tool connectivity.
* Build tools that allow agents to interact with:
* + APIs
  + Code-execution environments
  + Knowledge bases
  + Company applications
* **Classical ML (Foundational DS Skills)**

* Apply ML models to structured and unstructured data.
* Conduct feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Build interpretable models where required.
* **Engineering & Integration**

* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to seamlessly integrate agentic and GenAI systems into production applications.
* Implement observability, tracing, and monitoring for GenAI workflows using LangSmith to ensure reliability and system-level transparency.
* **Cloud MLOps & Quality**

* Monitor ML modelling performance, data drift, concept drift, and model quality.
* Apply hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, or Databricks, with flexibility to work on any cloud platform.
* Adhere to stringent quality assurance and documentation standards using version control and code repositories, such as Git, GitHub, and Markdown.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **5–10 years** of total experience, including **2–4+ years of hands-on GenAI delivery**.
* Strong Python skills and solid classical ML foundations, including feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, tree-based models, and regression.
* Hands-on expertise in LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, RAG patterns, vector databases, MCP tooling, agent tool integration, ReAct, Tree of Thoughts, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Experience working with LLM APIs and/or open-source LLMs, including building, evaluating, and debugging production-grade GenAI pipelines.
* Hands-on exposure to AWS, Azure, or Databricks; Git/GitOps; MLOps; observability; and model-drift monitoring.
* Experience deploying enterprise-grade GenAI solutions in real-world environments.
* Knowledge of multimodal LLM applications involving vision, speech, or code.
* Familiarity with structured LLM evaluation, including hallucination, safety, reliability, and robustness assessments.

**Education and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant GenAI, ML, cloud, Databricks, or MLOps certifications are desirable.

**Preferred Experience**

* Enterprise deployment of complex multi-agent or multimodal LLM solutions.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI, model governance, data privacy, security, and auditability.
* AI or analytics delivery experience in manufacturing, supply chain, sales, service, channel operations, or digital transformation.
