title: Analyst, Performance & Reporting
description:
**Reporting To:**
=================

Manager - Reporting

**Shift:**
==========

EMEA (1:30 pm - 10:30 pm IST) (India)

**About Russell Investments, Mumbai:**
======================================

Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is “Top 12 Ranked Consultant (2009-2024)” in P&I survey 2024 with $1,013 billion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2026) and $417.5 billion in assets under management (as of June 30, 2026) for clients in 30 countries. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.

Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.

For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.

**Job Description:**
====================

**About the role**

Russell Investments’ Global Performance & Reporting team delivers investment performance measurement, analysis and reporting across global products and client portfolios. The team supports internal stakeholders, existing clients and prospective clients by producing accurate, timely and consistent reporting and analysis.

As a Performance & Reporting Analyst based in Mumbai, you will help deliver reporting for the APAC region and provide coverage that supports EMEA business needs. You will work with colleagues across regions and functions to reconcile performance data, investigate questions, resolve reporting issues and deliver high-quality client and internal reporting. The role requires strong knowledge of investment performance and reporting, clear communication, and the ability to take ownership of work from start to finish.

Working hours: India/APAC shift, with flexibility to support EMEA working hours when required.

**Key responsibilities**

**Performance measurement and reporting**

* Prepare, review and deliver accurate and timely performance reports and analysis for clients, funds, portfolios, GIPS composites and internal stakeholders.
* Reconcile performance data across reporting systems and source files; investigate discrepancies and follow through on resolution.
* Review reports against prior periods and supporting data to identify unexpected changes, missing information or potential errors before distribution.
* Respond to performance and reporting questions from portfolio managers, client service teams and other stakeholders, escalating complex issues when appropriate.
* Support ad hoc analysis and the preparation of historical performance information for client and prospect materials.
* Apply a sound understanding of investment concepts, asset classes, performance measures, attribution and contribution analysis.

**Client and stakeholder support**

* Understand reporting requirements and help translate them into accurate, useful reporting outputs.
* Coordinate with global P&R colleagues and teams such as Investment Data, Risk, Technology, Product, Client Service, Marketing, Operations and Compliance.
* Build effective working relationships across APAC, EMEA and other regions, communicating progress, risks and dependencies clearly.
* Support reporting readiness for new client launches, portfolio onboarding and changes to existing reporting.
* Help manage reporting changes through review, testing, internal sign-off and implementation.

**Controls and continuous improvement**

* Follow established controls and procedures to support accurate, complete and timely reporting.
* Document processes, methodologies, report specifications and issue resolutions to support consistent delivery and knowledge sharing.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting quality, standardize processes and reduce manual effort or operational risk.
* Support enhancements to reporting platforms, data flows and analytical tools.

**Experience and qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in investment performance measurement, client reporting, investment operations or a related financial services role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of investment performance measurement, including return calculations and common reporting measures.
* Familiarity with performance attribution and contribution analysis, investment risk measures and benchmark data.
* Understanding of GIPS standards or experience supporting GIPS reporting is an advantage.
* Progress toward or completion of CFA, CIPM or an equivalent qualification is preferred.

**Skills and capabilities**

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate data and explain findings clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across regions.
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to manage tasks through completion and raise risks promptly.
* Good judgment and attention to detail when working with sensitive, time-critical reporting.
* Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities and meet recurring deadlines.
* A collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to work independently when needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Technical knowledge**

**Experience with one or more of the following is an advantage:**

* Investment reporting platforms such as Vermilion, Morningstar Direct, SS&C or similar systems.
* Data and market platforms such as Bloomberg or related investment data providers.
* Power BI, SQL or MySQL, Python, VBA, or other tools used for analysis and reporting automation.
* Git/GitHub or other collaborative development and version-control practices.

**What success looks like**

* Reporting is accurate, complete and delivered on time.
* Performance questions and data discrepancies are investigated and communicated clearly, with appropriate follow-through.
* Stakeholders receive responsive, dependable support across regions.
* Work is documented and completed in line with agreed procedures and controls.
* The analyst contributes to improvements in reporting consistency, efficiency and quality.

**Core Values**

* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines,
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong judgment and decision-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer-focused, action-oriented, results-driven culture.
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.
* Ability to act with discretion and maintain complete confidentiality.
* Dedicated to the firm’s values of non-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor.

 Creative ownership and the freedom to experiment with ideas.

 A fast-paced, collaborative and high-trust environment.

India COE Compliance Hub is focused to protect the reputation of the Group and effectively manage risk across all business areas by providing support to various Compliance functions. At present the department is broadly organized into divisions which embed into the areas they support to provide services for Global Compliance Training, Capital Markets Surveillance, Electronic Communication Surveillance, Transversal Risk Management (TRM), Compliance Migrations Co-Ordination, Personal Account Dealing, MIS and Projects support. The role is related to Financial Security Quality Assurance team within India COE Compliance Hub.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Assess metrics to identify and pull relevant samples for Quality Assurance reviews related to AML investigations conducted on activities in Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.
* Conduct monthly targeted AML and Sanctions Quality Assurance reviews under the direction of the Head of the Quality Assurance team in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and internal firm policy requirements in an attempt to identify, report and prevent money-laundering, terrorist financing and market abuse activity within BNPP’s operations.
* Escalate potential issues and exception items noted during the review process to the Head of FIU, QA Manager and local Latam Financial Security teams for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.

* Conduct or assist with special investigations and projects as deemed necessary by Financial Security Management.
* Assist in compliance related matters during examinations by the firm’s regulators and internal auditors.
* While primary focus of role is to conduct QA on Latam activities, responsibilities also include being cross trained on all regional QA program streams (inclusive of United States and Canada programs spanning AML and Sanctions investigations) in order to assist on spikes in volume within QA reviews and/or to provide additional coverage as needed.

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. **Purpose of the Role**
The Supply Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the O9 Supply Planning module. Reporting into the region SP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. * Work with system integration partner and perform solver execution, perform RCA analyses KPI, perform checklist against business requirements and flag issues to partner team.
* Solve Solver related problems with consideration of sustainable and standardized solution representing AMEA.
* Responsible for planning functional build & implementation/Working in testing and processes validation Document Functional requirements / participate in fit gap analyses with regional functional stream lead

**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Supply Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance

* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

* Develop working-level expertise in the o9 Supply Planning module, including Master Production Scheduling, Distribution Planning, Truck Load Build.

* Participate in co-location events, workshops, and cross-functional design sessions as required

* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment

description:

If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Sr. Data Scientist
  
  
**Senior Data Scientist - Fraud Detection & VAS Services**
As a Senior Data Scientist in our Fraud Detection & VAS (Value-Added Services) team, you will design, deploy, and monitor enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions that strengthen fraud prevention and risk intelligence across Fiserv's payment ecosystem. You will own the full ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration to production deployment and continuous improvement, working with product, engineering, and risk teams to deliver measurable business impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and develop ML models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and transaction intelligence, using advanced techniques (GNNs, ensembles, deep learning, Generative AI)
* Build feature engineering pipelines and rigorously validate models using cross-validation, unseen test sets, and business metrics
* Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines on AWS SageMaker with CI/CD, model versioning, governance, and automated retraining to handle data drift and emerging fraud tactics
* Optimize models for production (sub-100ms inference, cost efficiency, scale to millions of transactions) and deploy with monitoring, alerting, and SLA compliance
* Maintain runbooks, track model health and data drift, and communicate risks and improvements to stakeholders
* Prototype Generative AI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, and evaluate emerging technologies (LLMs, vector databases) for fraud use cases
* Partner with AI/Backend Engineers, DevOps, Product, and Risk teams; lead design reviews and mentor junior team members
* Ensure solutions meet Fiserv standards for security, explainability, and responsible AI, including bias audits, data privacy, and audit-ready compliance documentation

**What You Will Need To Have**

* 7-10+ years as a Data Scientist or ML Engineer with a proven record of deploying production ML systems
* Expert-level Python with strong software engineering practices (testing, code reviews, Git) and SQL expertise
* Deep ML knowledge: supervised/unsupervised learning, ensembles, feature engineering, model evaluation, and statistical analysis
* Hands-on production ML experience in the cloud (AWS preferred): SageMaker, S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, Lambda, IAM; monitoring, retraining, MLOps, and CI/CD
* Experience with large-scale (100M+ records) structured and unstructured data, plus data quality and governance
* Excellent communication, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership; adaptable, detail-oriented, and committed to code quality

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Graph Neural Networks, anomaly detection, real-time decisioning or streaming pipelines, and Spark/Databricks/Dask
* LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic and multi-agent systems, and LangChain or LlamaIndex
* Fraud, AML, risk, or financial crime experience; understanding of payment systems and financial regulations
* Tools: PyTorch Geometric/DGL, CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM, MLflow/W&B, Kafka, Snowflake, SHAP/LIME
* Publications, patents, open-source or Kaggle contributions; experience mentoring and leading ML initiatives

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; Master's in ML or Data Science preferred
* 7-10+ years in data science or ML engineering, including 3+ years deploying production ML and 2+ years in fraud detection, financial services, or security; regulated-industry experience
* Knowledge of payment processing, card networks, fraud tactics, and frameworks such as PCI-DSS and Gramm-Leach-Bliley

**Why join Fiserv?**

* Impact at scale: mission-critical fraud systems protecting millions of customers and billions in transactions, with work featured at investor day
* Technical excellence: AWS/SageMaker, modern ML frameworks, 100M+ transaction datasets, and problems in graph learning, anomaly detection, and real-time decisioning

title: Senior AI & Data Science Engineer
description:
**Designation : Senior AI & Data Science Engineer**

**Required Experience:**
5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership -

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows -

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

4. Applied machine learning and data science -

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps -

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment -

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI -

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

title: Associate Specialist Data Science
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Specialist – Data Science**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization brings this purpose to life by transforming how we understand patients, markets, customers, and brands, and by leveraging data, analytics, and technology to enable better, faster, value-driven decisions.
  
  
The Associate Specialist – Data Science, Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA), based in India, will support US and global teams by delivering integrated healthcare and commercial analytics across products and therapeutic areas. Contributing to insights on disease dynamics, patient journeys, market opportunities, forecasting, and launch readiness, this role offers a strong foundation in pharmaceutical commercial analytics while developing the capability to connect data findings directly to strategic commercial decisions.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Associate Specialist will work alongside experienced BSA colleagues and cross-functional teams to address commercial and strategic questions using diverse healthcare and commercial data sources. In this collaborative environment, they will contribute to analytical workstreams by translating defined business questions into structured approaches, executing fit-for-purpose analyses (utilizing foundations in problem-solving, programming, and statistics), and synthesizing results into clear insights.
  
  
With guided execution, the individual is expected to progressively connect their technical work to the broader commercial context, building a deep understanding of disease areas, markets, and brand decisions rather than approaching analysis as a standalone technical exercise. Over time, they will actively collaborate across global teams and contribute to the development, standardization, and reuse of analytical methodologies and capabilities across therapeutic areas.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To The Following**

* Commercial Strategy & Market Insights

+ Perform analytics across diverse healthcare and commercial data sources (claims, EHR, syndicated market data, brand data, SDoH, PSP, specialty pharmacy) to generate insights that inform commercial strategy.
+ Build and analyze patient cohorts to understand diagnosed and treated populations, treatment patterns, lines of therapy, switching, persistence, adherence, and treatment funnel drop-offs.
+ Analyze patient and market trends, sources of opportunity, and performance drivers across the product lifecycle, incorporating data coverage and limitations into analytical designs.
+ Contribute analytical inputs to key commercial milestones, including patient flow assumptions for forecasting, scenario analyses, launch readiness, and post-launch KPI tracking.
+ Develop a strong foundational understanding of how disease areas, markets, competitors, and key performance indicators (KPIs) relate directly to brand performance.

* Advanced Analytics & Methodology

+ Translate defined commercial questions into structured analytical problem statements, hypotheses, data requirements, and business rules in collaboration with experienced BSA colleagues.
+ Extract, transform, integrate, and analyze large datasets using SQL and Python/R.
+ Perform data preparation, cohort creation, exploratory analysis, and statistical modelling (utilizing regression, segmentation, or machine learning where appropriate).
+ Write structured, modular, and reusable code, performing quality and validation checks to support scalable analytics.
+ Develop the analytical judgment to determine the appropriate depth of analysis, recognizing when descriptive methods are sufficient and when advanced statistical approaches add incremental business value.
+ Explore emerging capabilities, including GenAI, to selectively improve analytical workflows under appropriate guidance and governance.

* Stakeholder, Project & Team Collaboration

+ Execute assigned analytical workstreams end-to-end, from data preparation through validation, interpretation, synthesis, and final delivery.
+ Develop presentations and clear visualizations that highlight key findings, progressing from simply reporting "what the data shows" to explaining "what this means for the business."
+ Triangulate findings across quantitative analyses and qualitative insight sources (such as market research, competitive intelligence, and forecasting) to build cohesive conclusions.
+ Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across US, India, and global organizations, managing assigned deliverables and proactively communicating progress, dependencies, and risks.
+ Participate actively in analytical reviews and peer discussions, contributing code, templates, and learnings to support knowledge sharing and reuse across therapeutic areas.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 1-2 years’ experience (experience requirement can be waived off for exceptional candidates)
* Working knowledge of Python/R, SQL, Databricks, Dataiku, visualization tools and Excel
* Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, including model development, validation and interpretation, with experience applying advanced analytical techniques where appropriate.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure problems and interpret data.
* Ability to work with large and complex datasets and perform appropriate data quality and validation checks.
* Understanding of data visualization and the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional team environments.
* Experience in utilizing GenAI and prompt engineering to query datasets, synthesize multi-source information, and accelerate the generation of preliminary commercial insights.
* Self-motivated with a willingness to learn new analytical methods, healthcare and commercial datasets, and therapeutic-area concepts.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks and deliverables while maintaining attention to detail and analytical quality

**Preferred Experience And Skills**

* Advanced degree in STEM
* Exposure to healthcare and commercial data sources, including patient-level, syndicated, aggregated market, brand, primary research or epidemiological data.
* Exposure to Ophthalmology therapeutic area
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-based analytical environments and scalable analytical workflows.
* Domain Knowledge in pharmaceutical business areas such as commercial, research, clinical, and forecasting
* Knowledge of advanced machine learning models, LLMs and pharmaceutical commercial analytics.
* Demonstrated interest in connecting data and analytics with commercial or strategic business questions.

* Deep understanding of Generative Audio/Speech Architecture and Algorithms
* Experience with large-scale distributed training frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, PyTorch FSDP) on cluster architectures.
* High proficiency in C++ and low-level GPU optimization tools like CUDA, cuDNN, Triton, or TensorRT.

title: Technical Lead, Delivery and Pre-Sales
description:
**You will turn client conversations into software that ships on estimate**

MTechZilla is a custom software development company with a team of 30+ in Pune. We build web, mobile, cloud and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe, and have delivered 40+ products.

You will be the technical person in the room with our clients. You join discovery calls, design the solution, write the estimate behind our quotation, turn requirements into stories developers can build from, and stay with the project until release.

You will run 5 to 6 client projects at a time, each with a team of 3 to 6 developers per project. Expect about 20% of your week on architecture and code review, and 80% on client work, requirements, estimates, and delivery.

**Who this role fits**

This role fits you if:

* You are a senior developer or tech lead at a software agency or startup.
* You already estimate work and talk to clients directly.
* You want to own a project from the first call to release, and not only the code.

It does not fit you if:

* You want to write code for most of the week.
* You manage through team leads or a project management office.
* You have not reviewed code or written an estimate yourself in the last two years.

**What you will be responsible for**

**Design solutions and write estimates for new leads**

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead's technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones and timeline.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client's budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

**Turn client briefs into stories developers can build from**

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features by business value, effort and risk.
* Answer your clients' technical questions during the project: architecture, feasibility, timelines and costs.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.

**Keep projects on scope, on time and on budget**

* Own delivery of your projects from kickoff to release and handover.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Turn scope changes into approved, billable change orders.
* Track risks and blockers every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Run sprint demos and status reviews, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Coordinate with QA so every release is tested before a client sees it.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk and decisions needed.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

**Lead the developers on your projects**

* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Run projects in Jira and keep requirements, architecture decisions, and handover notes in Confluence.

**What you will grow into**

After your first six months, you will take on more of how we work:

* A reusable estimation model built from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Our standards for documentation, sprints, QA gates, and releases.
* Hiring and interviews for the engineering team.

**Technical skills you need**

You need to design a system, judge whether a developer's estimate is realistic, and hold a technical conversation with a client's CTO.

* At least 3 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps and notifications.
* Security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD and architecture diagrams.

**Experience and qualifications**

Required

* 5 to 7 years of total experience, including at least 3 years as a hands-on software
* engineer.
* Experience estimating software projects, with one example of an estimate compared
* to actual delivery.
* Experience leading a project or a small engineering team.
* Experience working directly with clients, ideally in the US or Europe.
* Clear written English for estimates, user stories and status reports.
* Working use of Jira or a similar tool.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or
* equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience at a software services company or agency, especially on fixed-price
* projects.
* Experience running more than one project at the same time.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment or
* logistics.
* Daily use of Claude or other AI tools in your work

**What success looks like in your first 6 months**

* Quotations and estimates for new leads go out without the CEO filling in technical or
* timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the
* discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the
* exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member
* could pick up and work from.
* We have a first version of an estimation model built from past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Data Entry Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Data Entry Executive with e-commerce and AI skills to join our growing team in India. The candidate will be responsible for entering, updating, organizing, and maintaining product data, customer records, supplier details, spreadsheets, digital files, and information on the company’s e-commerce website.

The candidate will regularly upload new products, update existing listings, make website content changes, organize product categories, manage images and specifications, and ensure that all online product information is complete, accurate, and professionally presented.

The ideal candidate should be accurate, organized, consistent, and able to follow instructions carefully. They should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, organize information, prepare product content, identify errors, and complete routine administrative and e-commerce tasks more efficiently.

AI tools should be used to support the work, but all information must be manually reviewed and verified before publishing.

Key Responsibilities

**Data Entry:** Enter and update product details, prices, descriptions, specifications, customer information, supplier records, and other company data accurately.

**E-Commerce Product Uploads:** Upload new products to the company’s e-commerce website, including product names, descriptions, prices, specifications, dimensions, materials, colours, finishes, images, categories, and other required information.

**Product Listing Management:** Update and maintain existing product listings, correct inaccurate information, replace images, revise descriptions, add new specifications, and ensure all listings remain complete and up to date.

**Website Content Updates:** Make routine changes to website content, product pages, categories, collections, banners, links, downloadable documents, and other sections when required.

**Product Categories and Variations:** Organize products under the correct categories and manage product options or variations such as size, colour, finish, material, configuration, and model.

**Pricing and Availability Updates:** Update product prices, promotional information, availability, stock status, and other commercial details based on approved instructions.

**Product Image Management:** Upload, rename, resize, organize, replace, and arrange product images to ensure they are displayed clearly and correctly on the website.

**Website Quality Checking:** Review published product pages to confirm that images, descriptions, prices, specifications, variations, links, and page layouts are displaying correctly.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Maintain spreadsheets, organize information, check records for accuracy, apply formulas, remove duplicate entries, and ensure data is formatted correctly.

**AI-Assisted Data Processing:** Use AI tools to help organize large amounts of information, structure unformatted data, summarize documents, categorize records, and convert rough information into clear and usable formats.

**AI-Assisted Product Content:** Use AI tools to help prepare, rewrite, shorten, standardize, or improve product names, descriptions, specifications, and website content while maintaining factual and technical accuracy.

**Data Cleaning and Standardization:** Use spreadsheet functions and AI-assisted tools to identify missing information, formatting inconsistencies, duplicate entries, spelling errors, and incorrect data.

**Basic E-Commerce SEO Support:** Assist with preparing clear product titles, descriptions, categories, image names, page information, and search-friendly content based on company guidelines.

**File Management:** Organize digital files, folders, product images, documents, spreadsheets, and internal records in a clear and structured manner.

**Document Processing:** Extract and organize information from PDFs, quotations, supplier documents, catalogues, images, and other files using appropriate digital and AI tools.

**Administrative Support:**  
Support the office, sales, marketing, purchasing, and operations teams with basic back-office, website, and administrative tasks.

**Quality Checking:** Review all entered, uploaded, and AI-generated information carefully to identify errors, correct mistakes, and ensure records are complete and accurate.

**AI Output Verification:** Check all AI-generated content before use. Ensure that product specifications, dimensions, prices, customer details, supplier information, and technical data have not been incorrectly changed or invented.

**Data Confidentiality:** Handle customer, supplier, pricing, product, website, and company information responsibly and maintain confidentiality at all times.

Requirements & Qualifications

**Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of experience in data entry, e-commerce operations, website product uploading, back-office operations, administration, product data management, or a similar role.

**E-Commerce Experience:** Previous experience uploading and maintaining products on an e-commerce website or content management system is preferred.

**Product Data Skills:** Ability to understand and organize product names, descriptions, dimensions, specifications, materials, finishes, images, prices, categories, and variations.

**Data Entry Skills:** Good typing speed, strong accuracy, and the ability to enter and update large amounts of information consistently.

**Excel and Google Sheets:** Good working knowledge of spreadsheets, including formatting, sorting, filtering, formulas, data validation, duplicate removal, and basic data analysis.

**AI Skills:** Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar platforms to organize information, improve written content, assist with spreadsheet work, and increase productivity.

**AI Prompting:** Ability to write clear instructions and prompts to generate accurate, structured, and relevant outputs.

**English Requirement:** Excellent English reading, writing, verbal communication, and comprehension skills are required. The candidate must be able to understand product information, website instructions, internal processes, and written feedback and communicate professionally in English.

**Attention to Detail:** Must be able to check information carefully, identify errors, compare website listings against original sources, and avoid mistakes.

**Organization:** Must be able to maintain clean records, structured folders, properly named files, accurately updated spreadsheets, and organized website listings.

**Technology:** Must be comfortable learning new e-commerce platforms, content management systems, company software, AI tools, and digital workflows.

**Attitude:** Reliable, punctual, focused, responsible, willing to learn, and able to follow instructions and complete tasks within agreed timelines.

**Why Join Us?**

Stable office-based role with opportunities for professional growth.

Opportunity to gain practical experience in e-commerce website management, product uploading, data entry, and digital operations.

Opportunity to develop practical experience using AI tools in product management, website content, and business operations.

Supportive team environment where accuracy, efficiency, consistency, communication, and responsibility are recognized.

Opportunity to work with product data and e-commerce operations for a growing office furniture company.

Certcia is an AI-powered campus for learning, building and growing. Learners explore structured pathways, build real projects, and earn verifiable credentials that matter.

Certcia's pathways run from early learners to industry professionals:

- Pre-elementary (Ages 3–7): sequencing, patterns, block coding and early AI awareness  
- Elementary (Grades 3–5): block coding, computational thinking, data literacy, robotics and sensors  
- Middle School (Grades 6–8): Python programming, data cleaning and visualization, and how AI perceives and learns  
- High School (Grades 9–12): modular Python, supervised ML workflows, generative AI literacy and capstone projects  
- College & Universities: reproducible ML pipelines, data engineering, deep learning, computer vision and NLP

Schema Registry
  
  
Kafka security – ACLs, SSL/TLS, SASL, service accounts/API keys
  
  
Kafka performance and capacity troubleshooting

AWS EKS / Kubernetes

Linux administration and troubleshooting

Production incident and problem management

title: Engineer, Mechanical-2
description:
**Job Description:**
====================

**Position Summary**
====================

We are seeking a hands-on Mechanical Design Engineer with 5-8 years of experience in centrifugal pumps or comparable rotating equipment. The engineer will execute design, analysis, documentation and product-support activities across new product development, engineered-to-order projects, value engineering and sustaining engineering. The role requires strong fundamentals in pump mechanical design, engineering drawings, material selection, tolerance analysis and manufacturing processes, with the ability to own assignments from requirements through release and validation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Execute mechanical design and development of centrifugal pump components and assemblies, including casings, impellers, shafts, sleeves, bearing housings, wear rings, baseplates, couplings and sealing arrangements.
* Translate customer, product and application requirements into design inputs, concepts, calculations, drawings, bills of material and verification plans.
* Perform engineering calculations for shaft strength and deflection, bearing life, critical fits and clearances, bolted joints, pressure-containing components, component stresses and related design checks.
* Create and review 3D models, layouts, manufacturing drawings and assembly drawings using SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software; apply GD&T and tolerance-stack-up principles.
* Select materials and manufacturing processes appropriate for castings, machined parts, fabricated structures, corrosion resistance, pressure duty and service environment.
* Execute engineered-to-order modifications and application-specific designs while maintaining product integrity, interchangeability and configuration control.
* Support design reviews, DFMEA, risk assessment, verification and validation testing, prototype builds and design-release activities using Pentair's product-development process.
* Investigate shop-floor, test-lab and field issues; perform structured root-cause analysis and implement corrective design actions.
* Partner with manufacturing and suppliers to resolve casting, machining, assembly and quality concerns and improve design manufacturability and reliability.
* Drive value-engineering and product-improvement projects to reduce cost, simplify designs, improve performance and enhance product robustness.
* Prepare and maintain technical reports, design calculation files, specifications, engineering change documentation, product manuals and lessons learned.
* Collaborate effectively with global engineering teams and support technical discussions with sales, application engineering, quality, sourcing and customers.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
==========================================

* Bachler's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering stream from a recognized institution.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in mechanical design and product engineering, preferably involving centrifugal pumps, fluid-handling equipment or rotating machinery.
* Practical experience designing pump or rotating-equipment components and releasing production-ready engineering documentation.
* Strong understanding of engineering mechanics, machine design, materials, manufacturing processes, fits and tolerances, and GD&T.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD and 2D drawing creation; SolidWorks experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of design calculations, tolerance analysis, drawing review, bill-of-material structures and engineering change processes.
* Experience supporting design validation, manufacturing, assembly, testing and failure investigation.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work in a global, cross-functional environment.

**Preferred Technical Knowledge**
=================================

* Centrifugal-pump construction and operating principles, including hydraulic loads, shaft sealing, bearings, couplings, vibration, alignment and common pump failure modes.
* Applicable standards and guidance such as Hydraulic Institute / ANSI-HI, ASME, API 610, NFPA 20, UL, FM and NSF, depending on the product and application.
* Finite element analysis using ANSYS or equivalent tools for structural, modal, thermal or pressure-related assessments.
* Design for manufacture and assembly involving sand castings, investment castings, machining, sheet-metal fabrication, welding and surface treatments.
* Experience with municipal water, wastewater, fire-protection, commercial or industrial pumping applications.
* PLM/PDM and ERP systems for document control, product structures and engineering changes.
* Engineering automation or data analysis using Excel, Mathcad, MATLAB or Python; practical familiarity with AI-enabled engineering tools is an advantage.

**Core Competencies**
=====================

* Engineering ownership: Plans and executes assigned work with disciplined follow-through on quality, timing and documentation.
* Problem solving: Uses first-principles thinking, evidence and structured root-cause methods to resolve technical issues.
* Collaboration: Works constructively across functions, suppliers and global teams without relying on direct authority.
* Quality mindset: Produces accurate, reviewable and traceable engineering outputs and proactively identifies risk.
* Continuous improvement: Seeks opportunities to improve product cost, reliability, manufacturability and engineering efficiency.
* Learning agility: Builds knowledge of products, applications, standards and emerging engineering tools.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Design outputs are accurate, complete and released on schedule with minimal rework.
* Engineering decisions are supported by calculations, standards, test evidence and documented assumptions.
* Product-improvement and VAVE assignments deliver measurable cost, quality, reliability or cycle-time benefits.
* Global stakeholders receive responsive, clear and technically sound support.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Opportunity to work on a broad portfolio of centrifugal-pump products and applications.
* Collaboration with experienced engineering and manufacturing teams across global locations.
* Technical mentoring, structured development processes and opportunities to build specialist expertise.
* Competitive compensation and benefits in accordance with Pentair policies.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================

Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

title: AI Engineer, RQA, Associate
description:
Locations: **Gurgaon, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**AI Engineer, RQA, Associate**
-------------------------------

  
  

### **Your team**

Join the Core Risk Engineering team within Core Risk Management, part of BlackRock's Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group, and help build production Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) systems that shape how BlackRock manages investment risk.

RQA provides independent oversight of BlackRock's fiduciary and enterprise risks globally. The Core Risk Engineering team builds and evolves the technology platforms, services, AI-enabled solutions, and data capabilities that underpin investment risk management processes.

  
  

### **Your role and impact**

As an Associate AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, software engineering, data, and investment risk. You will partner with RQA stakeholders and BlackRock's technology teams globally to build resilient, scalable, and modern risk technology solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to combine the scale and complexity of a global financial institution with the challenge of building next-generation software, data platforms, and production GenAI solutions supporting investment risk management.

  
  

### **Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Contribute hands-on to the design, development, modernization, and production support of technology used across RQA.
* Apply and help shape RQA's software development practices, including Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) principles, coding standards, scalable Python, and AI-assisted development tools, to deliver reliable, on-demand risk analytics in line with firm policy.
* Develop AI-enabled tools and automated checks that analyze large volumes of data to identify unusual risk exposures for review, in partnership with risk managers.
* Build and productionize GenAI-enabled capabilities across risk and investment analysis, including information extraction, analytical assistants, and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or Google Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Design and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over risk reports, investment data, and enterprise documents so outputs are accurate, grounded, and traceable to source.
* Define, evaluate, and monitor Large Language Model (LLM) systems for quality, hallucination, latency, and cost, implementing appropriate guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and documentation aligned with BlackRock's model risk and data governance standards.
* Design, build, and maintain Python-based Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), backend services, and data pipelines that draw on enterprise and Aladdin data sources, and help modernize legacy risk workflows toward scalable architecture.
  

  

### **Your experience**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI development, supported by a strong software engineering background.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree, such as B.Tech, B.E., M.Tech, or M.S., in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, with proficiency in Python and Structured Query Language (SQL).
* Strong working knowledge of machine learning and LLMs, including prompt engineering, embeddings, LLM APIs, and experience designing and deploying production RAG pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, vector databases, and retrieval tuning.
* Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or Google ADK is strongly preferred.
* Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems for quality, hallucination, latency, and cost, including implementing guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Solid backend engineering experience, including Representational State Transfer (RESTful) APIs and services, testing, code review, Git, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and deployment on cloud platforms such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Amazon Web Services (AWS), using containers and enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling.
* Experience in financial services, investment risk, or another regulated environment is beneficial, together with strong ownership, adaptability, attention to detail, organizational skills, and curiosity about finance, investment, or quantitative processes.
  

  

### **Your learning & development**

You'll gain:

* Ownership of production GenAI systems that support investment risk management at global scale.
* Exposure to BlackRock's culture, tools, and leadership.
* Access to learning platforms, career coaching, and peer networks.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

##### **Responsibilities**

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Professional Services organization and help ensure the quality of our Android and web applications and customer solutions. You’ll become one of the team’s most knowledgeable people on product requirements and customer use cases, designing and executing tests and writing reusable test cases that Test Automation Engineers can turn into automated regression coverage.

Reporting to the QA Lead, you’ll work with a global team of software engineers, technical project managers, and Test Automation Engineers, and interact directly with customers. You may support projects in other regions, including the Americas, which requires flexibility in working hours to overlap with the project team and customer.

* Analyze requirements and customer use cases to develop test plans and test cases, and review requirements early to identify gaps, edge cases, and quality risks
* Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, exploratory, and regression testing of Android and web applications
* Write structured, reusable test cases that can be executed without deep project knowledge
* Write clear, detailed bug reports and track defects through resolution
* Investigate defects using logs, SQL, APIs, and command-line tools
* Partner with Test Automation Engineers to identify regression scenarios worth automating and provide the functional context needed
* Communicate test results, defects, and quality risks to customers and stakeholders, including in customer and project meetings
* Work with software engineers, technical project managers, and QA colleagues across regions, and help improve QA processes and standards

##### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in software QA or software testing
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design, defect management, and regression testing
* Experience testing Android and/or web applications
* Experience writing structured test cases and detailed bug reports
* Experience using SQL and testing APIs with tools such as Postman
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate problems independently and communicate clear findings
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including with customers, and flexibility in working hours to overlap with teams and customers in other regions, particularly AMS

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or Cypress, and basic scripting in JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
* Experience testing complex integrations or end-to-end workflows across multiple systems
* Experience with Jira, TestRail, or Azure DevOps
* Experience using AI tools to support test design, documentation, troubleshooting, or analysis
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, or performance testing

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Kyndryl is on the lookout for a Quality Assurance Software Engineer who is passionate about delivering top-notch cloud-based managed services to our clients. As a QA Software Engineer at Kyndryl, you will be at the forefront of ensuring that our software products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance.

**Your Role**  
Your role will involve using your expertise to define test strategies, test specifications, test cases, and test plans based on design documentation, functional specifications, and high-level design documents. You will work closely with other engineering squads/tribes to develop new features and products, and ensure that the implemented components are feature, integration, and system tested before being released to our customers.
  
  
You will also be responsible for automating test cases to build test suits for regression, scalability, and performance testing. You will analyze, track, and verify defects during the software development lifecycle, and contribute to designing, developing, implementing, executing, and troubleshooting automated test tools, test frameworks, and test scripts for application and API testing.

**What You Will Do**  
As a QA Software Engineer at Kyndryl, you will be the go-to person for developing, executing, and maintaining automation tests for acceptance, functional, and regression test cases for the identified areas/modules/technology. You will also be responsible for accurately documenting and communicating issues to developers to facilitate elimination of problems and to create efficient fixes.
  
  
At Kyndryl, we believe in promoting testing best practices and principles across the organization, and as a QA Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in determining these practices and principles. You will also be responsible for leading quality engineering discussions and mentoring other QA Engineers in debugging, planning, and domain expertise.
  
  
If you are a fast learner who thrives on challenges, likes to learn new solutions, and can step into the shoes of the end user to see the product from a consumer’s point of view – then we want you on our team. Apply today and become part of a dynamic and independent squad of Engineers who are dedicated to delivering quality cloud-based managed services to our clients.
  
  
**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**  
  

* 6 years of experience testing complex software products for large enterprise customers in a fast-paced agile environment
* Deep understanding of the QA processes, standards, tools and technologies
* Experience with testing and successfully delivering complex features/products for web-based enterprise applications and automating UI, CLI, and API testing
* Practical knowledge in at least one or two open-source automation tools and frameworks
* Good understanding of the entire software development life cycle
* Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills . Collaborative communication and team working skills

  
**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Familiarity with test frameworks like Selenium, Protractor etc.
* Use of scripting languages like Python, Perl, PowerShell, and Java script to create scripts rapidly that can integrate into the testing stage within a pipeline
* Use of Test-Driven Development (TDD), SDLC, and Agile software development practices

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
