title: Data Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
Data Engineer, Architecture – ClientIQ
  
  
Your team
  
  
The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm’s enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement.
  
  
The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
In this role, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning ClientIQ. You will define architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption.
  
  
A critical expectation is the ability to quickly learn and leverage BlackRock’s internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, leveraging and extending existing platform capabilities before building new solutions.
  
  
You will lead data engineering across structured and semi-structured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI (GenAI), and agentic experiences.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve ClientIQ’s target-state data architecture, leveraging internal dPaaS capabilities and applying a reuse-first approach across data products, models, application programming interfaces (APIs), metadata, and shared services.
* Provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery, partnering across platform, product, engineering, AI, governance, and business teams.
* Architect the ingestion, integration, and modeling of client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, interaction, behavioral, and external data into trusted and reusable data products.
* Lead engineering across batch and real-time processing, distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, and event streaming.
* Design capabilities across structured and semi-structured data that support AI-ready architectures, including document processing, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Embed data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, observability, security, resilience, and performance into data products and production engineering practices.
* Build reusable data services that power applications, analytics, AI models, agents, and downstream platforms while improving interoperability, scalability, and speed to market.

Your experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, or large-scale software engineering, including delivery of scalable enterprise data platforms and data products.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, SQL, Snowflake, and DBT, with experience across distributed processing, batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, event streaming, and data orchestration using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing.
* Experience developing production data solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, semi-structured data, and role-based data access controls.
* Experience developing transactional database solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, complex SQL, stored procedures, database programming, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Ability to rapidly learn and leverage internal platforms and dPaaS capabilities, applying strong architectural judgment to balance reuse, speed, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
* Experience with AI-ready data architectures and exposure to GenAI, machine learning, semantic technologies, document processing, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, RAG, and agentic architectures.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, observability, resilience, performance, production engineering, Microsoft Azure, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, containerized environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure automation

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
Sodexo is the global leader in
**sustainable food and valued experiences**
at
**every moment in life**
: learn, work, heal and play. Operating in
**53 countries**
, our
**422,000 employees**
serve
**100 million consumers**
each day.

As part of the digital & data factory, our goal is to
**contribute to the innovation within the group**
by creating
**data-driven solutions**
through AI projects to assist our restaurants and facility management activities in anticipating the demand, and therefore decrease the waste, or to improve the allocation of our staff on our sites.

**Digital & Data Factory's foundation is based on a unique mix of skills**
: strong business knowledge, data science / software/ cloud expertise, and agile methods day to day practice. This allows us to
**deliver projects with strong business and operational value**
thanks to teams composed of the best experts in their fields.

The performance of our data services is based on a
**real technical expertise**
in AI, software engineering,
**data engineering**
and
site reliability engineering. We aim at ensuring an end-to-end product vision from the delivery of a software solution to its run in our production environment.

The AI Engineering Manager owns AI engineering, data and model quality, responsible-AI controls and technical readiness across Sodexo products. The role combines technical leadership with product delivery and operational accountability.

From day one, you will define and govern the engineering practices that take AI capabilities from experimentation into safe, reliable production use.

Working with product managers, engineering managers, tech leads, data scientists, machine learning engineers, software and data engineers, SRE, QA, security, platform teams and business stakeholders, you will align teams around measurable outcomes.

You will ensure AI products perform reliably throughout their lifecycle, with clear evidence of quality, security, compliance, cost and operational readiness.

**Responsibilities:**

You will lead AI engineering across products, setting practical standards and ensuring that data, models and services are evaluated, deployed, monitored and improved responsibly.

**Define and govern AI engineering practices**

* Set and evolve standards for model development, evaluation, deployment, observability and MLOps across product teams.
* Partner with Platform Engineering, Security, QA, Data and Product to integrate shared infrastructure and validation standards while retaining accountability for AI engineering outcomes.

**Assure data quality, model evaluation and responsible AI**

* Ensure representative, fit-for-purpose data; robust evaluation against agreed product criteria; and documented limitations, risks and mitigations.
* Establish review controls for privacy, security, fairness, explainability and applicable responsible-AI requirements.
* Require evidence of technical readiness before release, including test results, monitoring, rollback and human-oversight plans where appropriate.
* Assess third-party AI capabilities and drive corrective engineering actions when quality, risk or performance falls short.

**Operate and improve AI in production**

* Govern production monitoring for model quality, hallucination rate, data quality, drift, latency, availability and inference cost.
* Set clear incident and drift-response procedures, owners and escalation paths; drive root-cause analysis and preventive action.
* Work with product and operations teams to balance user outcomes, reliability, safety and cost over the AI lifecycle.
* Use production evidence and feedback to prioritize model, data and system improvements.

**Grow capable, accountable teams**

* Coach engineers and technical leads; build skills in AI engineering, evaluation, MLOps, security and responsible AI.
* Create a culture of measurable quality, constructive challenge, learning and shared ownership across disciplines.
* Support hiring, onboarding and career development for AI and software engineering roles.

**Make and govern technical decisions**

* Approve AI technical readiness and model-evaluation evidence; chair technical reviews for disputed AI product issues.
* Stop or defer a release when model, data, security or responsible-AI concerns are not adequately addressed.

**Required Skills:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10-15 years of experience leading engineering teams delivering production AI/ML or data-intensive digital products.
* Experience across the AI lifecycle, including data pipelines, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring and incident response.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and translate business needs into reliable technical outcomes.

**Hard Skills:**

* AI/ML engineering: Strong understanding of model development, evaluation, deployment patterns and production constraints.
* MLOps and software engineering: CI/CD, versioning, reproducibility, testing, observability and reliable service design.
* Data quality: Data lineage, validation, privacy, representativeness and controls for data and model drift.
* Model quality: Evaluation design, quality thresholds, error analysis and ongoing performance measurement.
* Responsible AI and security: Risk assessment, safeguards, human oversight, privacy and secure AI system design.
* Production operations: Monitoring, incident management, rollback, latency, availability and cost optimization.
* Third-party AI: Assess vendor capabilities, limitations, controls and evidence; manage remediation with partners.
* Cloud and platform: Work effectively with shared cloud, security and MLOps platforms and their standards.
* Governance: Document decisions, readiness evidence, risks, ownership and control effectiveness.

**Leadership Capabilities:**

* Sound judgment: Make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and escalate material risks.
* Product thinking: Connect engineering choices to user needs, business value and measurable outcomes.
* Collaboration: Align multidisciplinary teams without obscuring ownership or accountability.
* Communication: Explain model behavior, limitations, risk and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* People leadership: Coach, develop and retain high-performing teams.
* Execution: Prioritize across multiple products and manage dependencies and operational readiness.
* Continuous improvement: Learn from evaluation results, incidents and user feedback.
* Accountability: Own outcomes, surface concerns early and follow through on corrective actions.
* Empathy and inclusion: Build trust and make space for responsible challenge.
* Adaptability: Keep pace with evolving AI methods, risks and applicable requirements.
* Key interfaces and boundary : Platform Engineering provides common infrastructure and MLOps capabilities; QA defines validation standards. The AI Engineering Manager owns product compliance and AI engineering outcomes, partnering with Product, Security, Data and business teams.
* Core measures :Model quality and evaluation results; hallucination or task-error rate where applicable; data quality and model drift; inference latency, availability and cost; responsible-AI control effectiveness and compliance; incident response and remediation.

title: Lead Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
At Aristocrat, we are driven by a mission to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and we are seeking a dedicated Lead Business Intelligence Analyst to join our innovative team. This role is central to our organization. You will have the chance to build the future of our Global Supply Chain using modern data solutions and analytics. If you enjoy high-impact work, have a strong history in business intelligence, and want to join an ambitious, world-class team, this role is for you!
  
  
**What You'll Do:-**

* Manage a portfolio of high-impact data-product, analytical-tool, and automation initiatives, establishing technical priorities and delivery methods across assigned work.
* Define technical standards for Power BI solutions, including semantic models, DAX, performance, security, publishing, accessibility, and user experience across GSC BI products.
* Set Snowflake, Python, Power Query, SQL, data-modeling, and documentation practices that support reliable, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
* Resolve the most difficult issues across source systems, transformations, semantic models, calculations, deployments, and user-facing tools. Review analyst work, resolve development conflicts, and provide clear technical direction.
* Partner with GSC leaders and technical teams to build requirements, sequence work, define success measures, explain tradeoffs, and recommend technical priorities.
* Direct solution development, testing, migration, deployment, documentation, training, and post-release support across major initiatives.
* Translate technical and analytical insights into suggestions that steer product strategy, delivery options, and Global Supply Chain decisions. Communicate roadmap implications, key risks, and solution results to senior leadership.
* Coordinate daily technical tasks among analysts, monitor project progress and dependencies, resolve blocking issues, and adjust assignments as priorities shift. Serve as the first contact for technical and project-delivery critical issues. Develop analysts through mentorship, build reviews, delivery feedback, and knowledge sharing.
* Define architecture and development practices for Copilot Studio, language-model solutions, AI agents, integrations, orchestration, data pipelines, testing, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle support. Ensure AI solutions meet security, accuracy, maintainability, governance, and business standards.

**What We're Looking For:-**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Intelligence, Analytics, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6+ years of experience delivering BI products, analytical tools, automation, and related supply chain solutions.
* Experience leading a portfolio of complex BI initiatives, setting technical direction, coordinating priorities, reviewing analyst work, and resolving cross-team development decisions.
* Expert Power BI skills, including semantic modeling, DAX, visualization development, performance optimization, publishing, security, governance, accessibility, and support.
* Advanced Snowflake and SQL skills, with demonstrated Python experience crafting reusable data, automation, integration, or AI solutions; Power Query experience is preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to set direction, influence decisions, explain tradeoffs, mentor analysts, and manage competing priorities.
* Experience crafting and deploying solutions with Copilot Studio, language models, AI agents, APIs, integrations, orchestration, and data pipelines. Experience with responsible AI controls, monitoring, D365, supply chain systems, migration, or application development is preferred.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

description:

**Job Title: Sr. Cyber Data Scientist**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
* Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
* Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

**RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**MLOps, Observability & Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
* Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
* Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

**Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
* Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
* Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

**RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**MLOps, Observability & Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
* Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
* Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
* Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

**Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

title: Mining Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
**About us**  
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**  
***As a Mining Subject Matter Expert (SME) with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc….
  
  
Key Roles and Responsibilities

* Mine Planning & Design
  + Develop open-pit and underground mine designs.
  + Prepare long-term, medium-term, and short-term mine plans.
  + Optimize pit shells, stope layouts, haul roads, and production schedules.
  + Evaluate mining methods (Open Pit, Room & Pillar, Sublevel Stoping, Block Caving, Longwall, etc.).
* Resource & Reserve Evaluation
  + Review geological models and resource estimates.
  + Convert mineral resources into mineable reserves.
* Production & Operations Support
  + Monitor production performance against targets.
  + Optimize drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, and ventilation systems.
  + Identify bottlenecks and implement productivity improvement initiatives.
  + Support mine dispatch and fleet management systems.
* Geotechnical & Safety Management
  + Assess slope stability for open pits.
  + Review ground control strategies for underground mines.
  + Ensure compliance with mine safety regulations.
  + Participate in HAZID, HAZOP and other risk assessments
* Studies and Estimates
  + Scoping study, Pre-Feasibility Studies (PFS), Definitive Feasibility Studies (DFS)
  + Prepare CAPEX and OPEX estimates.
  + Evaluate project economics including NPV, IRR, and payback period.
* Equipment Selection & Optimization
  + Select mining fleets like Excavators, Hydraulic Shovels, Draglines, Drill Rigs, Haul Trucks, LHDs (Load-Haul-Dump Machines)
  + Conduct equipment sizing and matching studies.
  + Optimize fleet utilization and availability.
* Mine Infrastructure development
  + Design of Waste dumps, Tailings storage facilities, Dewatering systems, Power and water supply networks, Workshops and haul roads
* Digital Mining & Technology
  + Utilize software like Deswik, Datamine, Vulcan, Surpac, MineSched, Whittle, Minemax, Hexagon MinePlan etc
* Regulatory & Environmental Compliance
  + Ensure compliance with mining legislation and environmental permits.
  + Support Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA).
  + Develop mine closure and rehabilitation plans.
  + Monitor ESG (Environmental, Social & Governance) performance.
* Technical Due Diligence
  + Review mining projects for investors, lenders, EPCM contractors, and owners.
  + Evaluate Resource quality, Mineability, Production forecasts, Capital requirements, Technical risks etc
* Typical Deliverables for Mining Engineer SME will be to produce, review and optimize the following:
  + Pit Optimization Studies
  + Mine Plan Reports
  + Reserve Statements
  + Feasibility Study Reports
  + Production Schedules
  + Equipment Selection Reports
  + Geotechnical Risk Assessments
  + Technical Due Diligence Reports
  + CAPEX/OPEX Estimates·
  + Mine Closure Plans
* In an EPCM Project Environment, key role of SME would be interfacing between the following workgroups:
  + Geology Team
  + Mine Operations Team
  + Process Engineering Team
  + Geotechnical Engineers
  + Infrastructure Engineers
  + Environmental Team
  EPC/EPCM Contractors

**About You**  
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
Mining Engineer having >20 YEARS experience having capability to provide technical leadership and specialist expertise across the mine life cycle, from exploration and feasibility studies through mine design, operations, optimization, and closure.
  
  
**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

* Seniority level (20 - 30 years) of relevant professional experience
* Certification / accreditations in the relevant domain
* Graduate Engineers with 20-30 years of Engineering exposure in a consultancy organization dealing in Mineral Processing / Metal Extraction/ Chemical Processing projects. Experience range can be flexible for deserving candidates.
* Candidates with experience in technical services department of a Mineral Processing / Metal Extraction/ Chemical Processing plant can also apply. However at least 10 years of engineering consultancy experience as described above will be required.
* Worked as Engineering Coordinator / Project Engineering Manager in projects for minimum 10 years managing a multidiscipline team.

Should be open for short travel and deputation to sites / lead offices.

title: Project Cost Controller
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a commercially aware and analytical Project Executive – Cost Control to monitor project budgets, commitments, actual expenditure and cost variations. The role will work closely with project, procurement, contracts, accounts and site teams to support cost transparency, budget discipline and timely reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Skills:**

· Strong knowledge of construction BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, estimates and budgeting.

· Experience in project cost tracking, budget-versus-actual analysis, cost forecasting and variance reporting.

· Knowledge of contractor RA bills, measurement sheets, work orders, purchase orders and material reconciliation.

· Proficiency in MS Excel; knowledge of ERP / project management software is preferred.

· Ability to read civil, architectural and MEP drawings and understand specifications and scope of work.

· Good numerical, analytical, negotiation, coordination and documentation skills.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

· Assist in preparation and maintenance of project budgets, cost plans and package-wise cost estimates.

· Review BOQs, estimates, tender quantities and rate analyses for completeness and consistency.

· Maintain project cost trackers covering approved budgets, commitments, work orders, purchase orders, bills and actual expenditure.

· Monitor budget-versus-actual costs and identify cost overruns, savings, deviations and emerging financial risks.

· Coordinate with site and quantity surveying teams to verify measurements, quantities executed and contractor bills.

· Scrutinise contractor RA bills, variation claims and extra-item statements against approved scope, rates and supporting records.

· Track material consumption, wastage, reconciliation and major cost-sensitive items in coordination with site and stores teams.

· Coordinate with procurement and contracts teams to monitor commitments, comparative statements and package-wise costs.

· Prepare cost-to-complete estimates, cash-flow inputs and periodic cost forecasts for management review.

· Identify scope changes and variations; maintain a change log and assess their potential cost impact.

· Prepare monthly cost reports, dashboards and variance explanations with supporting documentation.

· Ensure cost records, approvals and commercial documents are properly maintained and updated in the designated system / ERP.

· Highlight potential cost risks promptly and support project teams in developing cost-saving measures without compromising quality or safety.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:

**Vestas is a major player in wind technology and a driving force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of wind turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**

  

**Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Data & Performance**

  

The Data & Performance Competence Cluster within Plant Software Solutions (PSS), part of Vestas Research & Development, is responsible for developing products and services that support monitoring, reliability, data intelligence, and advanced analytics across Vestas' global renewable energy portfolio. Our portfolio includes solutions and offerings related to:

* Monitoring & Reliability Engineering
* Data Products and Data Platforms
* Flow & Load Modeling
* AI Products and Solutions
* Advanced Analytics and Performance Optimization

We are a highly skilled and diverse organization comprising Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Reliability Engineers, Condition Monitoring Specialists, and Flow & Load Modeling experts. Together, we develop high-quality software products that enable real-time monitoring and analysis of thousands of wind power plants worldwide. By leveraging one of the industry's largest renewable energy datasets, we build advanced data products, predictive models, AI-driven solutions, and digital services that improve asset performance, increase reliability, and ultimately contribute to reducing the cost of energy for our customers.

About Plant Software Solutions (PSS): Plant Software Solutions (PSS) is on an exciting journey to innovate, develop, and deliver advanced software solutions for both Vestas wind turbines and customers worldwide. The organization operates globally with engineering and business presence across Denmark, Portugal, and India.

The Opportunity: The Data & Performance Competence Cluster is seeking an experienced and visionary Engineering Manager - Data Engineering to oversee the development and execution of Vestas' R&D Data Engineering strategy. The ideal candidate will advance innovation through advanced data engineering approaches integrated with artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making across the Vestas value chain. This role combines technical leadership, people leadership, and strategic execution, ensuring the timely delivery of scalable data science products and solutions that create measurable business value for customers and stakeholders.

The position is based in Bangalore, India, and reports directly to the Director, Data & Performance Competence Cluster.

  

**Responsibilities**

We are seeking a skilled Engineering Manager - Data Engineering to handle the design, modernization, and operation of one of the largest renewable energy data platforms in the industry. This role will be responsible for managing large-scale cloud-based data ecosystems that process data from wind turbines, solar assets, SCADA systems, IoT devices, asset performance platforms, and enterprise applications.

The chosen candidate will lead a team of highly skilled data engineers while guiding a strategic migration from legacy data platforms to a modern cloud-native architecture. This leader will contribute to AI, Machine Learning, predictive maintenance, operational analytics, energy forecasting, and digital transformation initiatives across global renewable energy operations.

Responsibilities listed

**People Leadership**

* Act as the direct line manager for Data Engineers within the organization
* Lead hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, compensation reviews, and succession planning
* Build and develop a capable global Data Engineering organization of approximately 20-25 engineers
* Encourage a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence

**Data Platform Strategy & Delivery**

* Own the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise data platforms, data lakes, and data pipelines across both cloud and on-premises environments
* Define and execute the Data Engineering roadmap aligned with business and R&D priorities
* Guide modernization of enterprise data platforms and cloud-native architecture adoption on Azure
* Own the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of large-scale data platforms, data lakes, and data pipelines
* Establish engineering standards, automation, observability, DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
* Ensure platform reliability, security, scalability, governance, and cost efficiency

**AI & Analytics Enablement**

* Build AI-ready data foundations supporting analytics, machine learning, predictive maintenance, forecasting, and operational intelligence use cases
* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, and Product teams to accelerate delivery of data products and business value

**Vendor & Financial Management**

* Manage consulting partners and external vendors providing engineering capacity for short-term and long-term initiatives
* Own supplier engagement lifecycle, including Statements of Work (SOW), resource onboarding, delivery oversight, and performance management
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and HR functions throughout sourcing and contracting processes
* Manage budgets/resources related to external consulting engagements

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business, product, technology, and R&D leaders to define priorities and support value realization
* Communicate technology strategy, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to senior stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor on data platform strategy, cloud modernization, and engineering best practices

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or related discipline
* 12-15+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or Analytics Engineering
* Minimum 5 years managing capable engineering teams
* Direct experience leading large cloud data transformation programs
* Experience managing enterprise-scale data lakes and distributed data platforms
* Exposure to Renewable Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, Industrial IoT, Energy Technology, or Asset-Intensive industries

  

**Competencies**

**Technical Competencies:**

* Oversee the strategy, architecture, and migration of large-scale enterprise data platforms to Azure cloud, enabling a modern, scalable, and AI-ready data ecosystem
* Build and manage high-performance data platforms integrating IoT, SCADA, operational, and enterprise data to support renewable energy operations and business analytics
* Hire, develop, and retain highly capable Data Engineers, building a culture of technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning
* Implement modern engineering practices including DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and platform observability
* Partner with business, product, and technology leaders to deliver data solutions that improve asset performance, predictive maintenance, energy forecasting, and operational decision-making
* Own platform reliability, security, governance, scalability, and cloud cost optimization while delivering strategic transformation programs and business value

**Leadership Competencies:**

* Build, lead, and scale a capable and collaborative Data Engineering organization (20-25+ engineers), including Engineers, Leads, Architects, having presence across Globe (Denmark, Portugal & India) while creating a collaborative culture of innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence
* Develop and execute talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and capability-building strategies to attract, develop, and retain capable engineering talent
* Direct large-scale cloud migration, data modernization, and digital transformation initiatives, partnering with global business, product, and technology stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes
* Coach and mentor engineering leaders and team members, advancing career growth, leadership development, employee engagement, and quality delivery
* Establish and monitor engineering KPIs, operational metrics, delivery performance, platform reliability, and value realization while effectively managing consultants and strategic partnerships
* Guide executive leadership on technology strategy, transformation roadmaps, risks, and business impact, while serving as a trusted advisor on data and cloud strategy.
* Bring broad experience in Azure data platforms, cloud-native architectures, AI-ready data foundations, and renewable energy, industrial IoT, utility, or asset-intensive industries, combined with effective strategic thinking and execution excellence

  

**What We Offer**

We offer you the opportunity to support important work and to work in a multicultural and international Renewable company, where you have the possibility to improve your skills and develop professionally.

* Leadership responsibility for a strategic, business-critical data platform organization

title: Principal Security Engineer
description:
Develops advanced testing tools and methodologies to proactively identify and address security weaknesses. Uses expertise to recognize and escalate complex security violations, ensuring prompt response and resolution. Contributes to compliance assessments, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls and processes. Recommends best practices and independently applies data security tools and techniques, such as encryption, hashing, masking, and access management, to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.
  

We are seeking a curious, detail-oriented Security Analyst to join our new Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) in Bengaluru.

You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across our technology environment. Your core responsibility is 24x7 alert triage: separating suspicious activity from routine events, assessing impact, and taking timely, authorized action.

As operational needs and your skills evolve, you will also contribute to incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and security improvement projects.

What you’ll do

**Security monitoring, triage, and response**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, email, network, and cloud security platforms.
* Correlate logs and evidence to assess alert validity, severity, scope, and business impact.
* Follow response playbooks; perform authorized containment and remediation; escalate complex or high-impact issues.
* Maintain clear investigation records, document decisions, and provide thorough shift handoffs.
* Partner with security, IT, and business teams to resolve issues and strengthen response quality.

**Incident response and improvement**

* Support incident response through evidence collection, timeline development, scoping, containment, and recovery.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews and improvements to playbooks, procedures, and operational knowledge.
* Identify recurring alert patterns, workflow gaps, and automation opportunities.

**Detection engineering and threat intelligence**

* Help develop, test, tune, and document detection rules to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
* Review relevant threat intelligence and apply it to investigations and detection improvements.
* Support indicator validation and guided threat-hunting activities.

**Special projects**

* Contribute to projects such as onboarding security data sources, evaluating tools, improving reporting, and building lightweight automation.
* Take on additional security operations responsibilities aligned with business needs and development goals while maintaining operational coverage.

What you’ll bring

* Foundational knowledge of security operations, common attack techniques, and incident investigation.
* Familiarity with Windows, Linux, networking, authentication, and enterprise or cloud services.
* Experience with—or practical exposure to—security alerts, logs, and tools such as SIEM or EDR.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to follow procedures while knowing when to escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including strong documentation and cross-shift collaboration.
* Willingness to work scheduled shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.
* Typically 1–4 years of relevant experience in security operations, incident response, IT operations, or a related field. Strong internships, labs, projects, or equivalent practical experience are also welcome.
* A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

* Experience investigating phishing, malware, suspicious authentication, endpoint, or cloud security events.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and threat-informed investigations.
* Basic scripting or query skills in Python, PowerShell, SQL, KQL, or SPL.
* Exposure to SOAR platforms, detection development, or incident response exercises.
* Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, or security-platform certifications. Helpful, but not required.

description:
**Controllers**

Controllers are responsible for external and internal financial reporting for the firm and its subsidiaries, including the firm’s earnings release and SEC reporting, daily internal management reporting, legal entity reporting, fund accounting for the Firm’s investment funds, and the firm’s compensation accounting functions.

Across these functions, Controllers use their expertise to ensure the integrity of financial information and that the firm and its subsidiaries meet the reporting obligations of a public financial institution.

**Business Unit**

Asset and Wealth Management (AWM) Controllers is part of the broader Controller Division which is a global team responsible for ensuring the accuracy of the financial and regulatory information of the firm and for funds managed by the firm. As well as managing both internal and external financial reporting, our expertise plays a key role in the firm's business planning decisions around allocation of scarce financial resources such as capital and balance sheet. We partner with the business in providing advice on accounting, valuation, capital, liquidity, reputational risk and other regulatory considerations when executing business with our clients. Controllers is ideal for individuals who want to work and learn within our strong culture of teamwork and collaboration and who are motivated by opportunities for challenging project work.

**Our Impact**

The AWM Product Controller Team is responsible for the accounting and reporting of the firm's long term investments and managed funds, with a strong emphasis on the valuation and other accounting issues inherent in illiquid assets held across a wide variety of asset classes. This includes working with various groups, including Investment Asset Managers, Financial Reporting, Legal Entity Controllers, Accounting Policy and Technology support groups to ensure accuracy of our financial statements and other disclosures. The team produces high quality reporting and analysis of our investments and fund activities which is leveraged by many teams across the firm up to the most senior level.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Preparing the daily profit and loss account for the business, involving an assessment of the nature of revenue generated in the context of market moves and risk held as well as reconciliation between front office systems, sub-ledger and the firm's general ledger.
* Performing periodic independent valuation reviews for illiquid assets held by the firm and alternative investment funds managed by the firm. This ranges across private equity, private credit and real estate assets.
* Participate in strategic initiatives to improve process flows and analysis as well as proactively seeking opportunities to improve workflows.
* Preparing monthly accounts for posting to the firm's general ledger and producing/reviewing relevant external disclosures.
* Interact effectively and pro-actively with the business to solve accounting issues and facilitate financial information flows which form the basis of commercial decisions.
* Developing an in-depth knowledge of products and market awareness.
* Ensuring compliance with all the Firm's financial reporting requirements.
* Preparing, analyzing, reviewing and presentation of investments on the daily balance sheet.
* Understanding of the impact of Regulatory rules on the business's activity.
* Facilitating the smooth running of audits for the funds and the firm's holding entities

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Qualified CA
* Working knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS and strong accounting knowledge
* Intellectual curiosity and interest in financial markets/products, particularly less liquid alternative investments.
* Strong analytical skills and an aptitude for problem solving.
* Track record of improving processes and adding value to clients/stakeholders.
* Ability to successfully handle multiple tasks and take initiative to improve own performance.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate what is relevant and important in a clear and concise manner.

title: GMS-Senior-OT VM
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 26, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1760268

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Description: Senior OT Vulnerability Management Analyst / Consultant**

**Experience**: 5–8 Years

**Domain**: Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Cybersecurity

**Specialization**: OT Vulnerability Management

**Role Level:** Senior1,2 /Senior 3

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **OT Vulnerability Management professional** with 5–8 years of cybersecurity experience and strong exposure to industrial/OT environments.

The candidate will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end OT vulnerability management lifecycle, including **OT asset and vulnerability monitoring, vulnerability identification and validation, risk-based prioritization, threat advisory monitoring, stakeholder notification, remediation coordination, governance, and reporting.**

The role requires hands-on experience working with **OT IDS / asset visibility platforms such as Claroty and Nozomi Networks,** along with a good understanding of industrial environments including ICS, PLCs, DCS, HMIs, engineering workstations, historians, and associated network infrastructure.

The role will work closely with plant/site OT teams, infrastructure and security teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party technology vendors to manage vulnerabilities while considering the availability, safety, and operational constraints inherent to manufacturing environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **OT Vulnerability Identification & Monitoring**
  + Perform and support vulnerability assessment activities across OT environments using organization-provided OT security and vulnerability management tools.
  + Monitor vulnerabilities identified across OT assets such as **PLCs, DCS, HMIs, engineering workstations, historians, Windows/Linux servers, network devices, and other industrial systems.**
  + Review and analyze identified **CVEs, security exposures, vulnerable firmware/software versions, and security misconfigurations.**
  + Validate vulnerability findings against available asset, firmware, software, and exposure information.
  + Support identification and investigation of potential false positives and missing detections.
  + Maintain an accurate and actionable vulnerability backlog.
* **OT IDS / Vulnerability Management Tools**
  + Hands-on experience using one or more OT security platforms, preferably:
    - Claroty
    - Nozomi Networks
  + Use OT visibility/IDS platforms to review:
    - Asset inventory and classification
    - Vulnerabilities and CVEs
    - Software and firmware information
    - Network exposure and communications
    - Risk information
  + Analyze vulnerability information produced by the organization's approved tooling and convert technical findings into actionable remediation recommendations.
* **Risk-Based Vulnerability Prioritization**
  + Perform risk-based prioritization rather than relying solely on CVSS severity.
  + Assess vulnerabilities considering:
    - CVSS score and severity
    - Exploitability
    - Asset criticality
    - OT/production impact
    - Network exposure
    - Existing compensating controls
    - Threat intelligence
    - Vendor/OEM guidance
  + Identify Critical and High-risk vulnerabilities requiring expedited stakeholder attention.
  + Support definition and application of vulnerability remediation priorities and timelines.
  + Prioritize vulnerabilities in a manner appropriate to OT environments where immediate patching may not always be operationally feasible.
* **Threat & Vendor Advisory Monitoring**
  + Monitor relevant **OEM/vendor security advisories and industrial cybersecurity vulnerability notifications.**
  + Correlate newly published vulnerabilities and advisories against known OT assets and exposures.
  + Assess whether vulnerable products, firmware, software, or components are present within the environment.
  + Identify potentially impacted sites/assets and communicate relevant vulnerability alerts to stakeholders.
  + Support threat-context enrichment and prioritization of vulnerabilities where appropriate.
* **Vulnerability Alerts & Stakeholder Communication**
  + Prepare and distribute relevant vulnerability alerts to plant/site and security stakeholders.
  + Clearly communicate:
    - Affected products and assets
    - Vulnerability severity
    - Potential operational/security impact
    - Known exposure
    - Recommended actions
    - Vendor/OEM recommendations where available
  + Escalate significant OT vulnerabilities through established governance channels.

  + Provide remediation recommendations based on tool findings, OEM/vendor guidance, and OT security good practices.

    - Vendor-approved patching

    - Configuration hardening
    - Network segmentation
    - Access restrictions
    - Protocol/application allow-listing
    - Enhanced monitoring
    - Other compensating controls
  + Collaborate with OT/site teams, infrastructure teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party vendors to support vulnerability remediation.
  + Track vulnerabilities through remediation, mitigation, risk acceptance, or closure.
  + Validate closure of vulnerability findings based on available evidence.
* **Governance & Reporting**
  + Participate in regular OT vulnerability review and governance meetings with relevant stakeholders.
  + Track open vulnerabilities, remediation status, ageing, overdue actions, accepted risks, and compensating controls.
  + Prepare periodic operational and management reporting.
  + Support risk acceptance and sign-off processes for vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated within agreed timelines.
  + Support escalation of overdue or high-risk vulnerabilities.
  + Work with stakeholders to continuously improve vulnerability reporting and remediation tracking processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

The candidate should have:

* **5–8 years of overall experience in cybersecurity**, with demonstrated experience in vulnerability management and OT/ICS security.
* Practical experience working in **OT / ICS / manufacturing environments.**
* Hands-on experience with OT IDS / visibility tools such as **Claroty and/or Nozomi Networks.**
* Strong understanding of:
  + Vulnerability management lifecycle
  + CVE and CVSS
  + Risk-based vulnerability prioritization
  + Vulnerability validation and false-positive analysis
  + Threat and vendor advisory monitoring
  + Vulnerability remediation and mitigation
  + Compensating controls
  + Risk acceptance and exception management
* Understanding of common OT technologies and assets including:
  + PLC
  + DCS
  + HMI
  + SCADA
  + Engineering workstations
  + Historians
  + Industrial servers
  + Industrial network infrastructure
* Ability to coordinate effectively with plant/site OT teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, OEMs, and third-party vendors.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

  

**Preferred Knowledge**

Candidates with knowledge or working exposure to the following would be preferred:

* **IEC 62443**
* **NIST SP 800-82**
* **NIST Cybersecurity Framework**
* **MITRE ATT&CK for ICS**
* Purdue Model / industrial network segmentation

**Key Competencies**

The ideal candidate should be able to:

description:

**Role Overview**
=================

As an Information Security Engineer III , you will play a critical role in protecting Candescent's identities, data, systems, cloud-based platforms, and services by supporting identity and access management (IAM), and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls; executing vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, and cloud and platform security activities across AWS, Azure, and GCP; monitoring and responding to security threats and incidents; maintaining the compliance documentation, dashboards, reports, and operating procedures needed to support timely remediation and regulatory alignment; and participating in day-to-day certificate management activities in partnership with IT, DevOps, application owners, compliance, legal, and business teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

The Information Security Engineer III role encompasses one or more core responsibility areas: IAM, and DLP; vulnerability, cloud, and platform security; security monitoring and incident response; compliance and documentation; and day-to-day certificate management support. Each area requires practical technical expertise and collaborative engagement with cross-functional teams to maintain Candescent's security posture across multi-cloud environments.

**IAM / DLP**
-------------

* Support the administration and security of identity and access management controls in Microsoft Entra ID, including user and access lifecycle processes, role-based access control, and least-privilege principles.
* Assist with access reviews, privileged access controls, Conditional Access, multifactor authentication, and remediation of risky users, sign-ins, or excessive permissions.
* Support secure onboarding and governance of enterprise applications, single sign-on integrations, groups, and access assignments, while maintaining IAM procedures and audit evidence.
* Administer data classification, sensitivity labeling, and information protection.
* Configure and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to prevent unauthorized sharing of sensitive data.
* Monitor DLP alerts and incidents, investigating policy violations and coordinating with business units for remediation.
* Create and update retention policies and records management classifications to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with compliance and legal teams to implement information governance frameworks aligned with organizational risk tolerance.

**Vulnerability, Cloud & Application Security**
-----------------------------------------------

* Execute and manage regular vulnerability scans and cloud security posture assessments
* Analyze scan results, prioritize remediation based on risk, and track progress against SLAs
* Coordinate with IT and DevOps teams to ensure timely patching and configuration updates across multi-cloud environments
* Maintain dashboards and reports on vulnerability trends and risk posture
* Support secure configuration and hardening of AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Maintain and optimize integrations between third-party security tools.
* Assist in enforcing identity and access management policies using Azure AD.

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**
-------------------------------------------

* Monitor SIEM platforms for alerts related to unauthorized access, malware, or misconfigurations.
* Investigate and triage security incidents, following established playbooks to contain and mitigate threats.
* Respond promptly to new and emerging threats, ensuring timely remediation of risks and attacks.

**Compliance & Documentation**
------------------------------

* Ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements related to fraud prevention and security standards.
* Maintain clear documentation of security events, SOPs, and vulnerability management processes.

**Certificate Management Support**
----------------------------------

* Participate in day-to-day certificate management activities, including certificate requests, approvals, renewals, updates, revocations, recovery, and secure downloads with proper key handling.
* Support application owners and security teams with routine certificate administration, access requests, issue resolution, and documentation, escalating platform engineering, automation, upgrade, or architecture needs to the appropriate owners.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in security engineering, vulnerability management, or SecOps roles.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Hands-on experience supporting IAM controls, including user and access lifecycle processes, role-based access control, least privilege, access reviews, privileged access, Conditional Access, multifactor authentication, enterprise applications, single sign-on, groups, and access assignments.
* Hands-on experience with data classification, sensitivity labeling, information protection, retention, and records management across.
* Experience configuring and monitoring Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and investigating DLP alerts or policy violations.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning and cloud security posture management, including risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Strong understanding of AWS, Azure, and GCP security configuration, hardening, cloud and application security practices, and security-tool integrations.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms and endpoint detection tools for security monitoring, alert triage, and incident response.
* Knowledge of WAF technologies.
* Ability to maintain security documentation, dashboards, reports, SOPs, and audit evidence supporting compliance and remediation activities.
* Familiarity with day-to-day certificate lifecycle, including requests, approvals, renewals, updates, revocations, recovery, secure downloads, and routine issue resolution.

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across IT, DevOps, and business teams.
