title: Senior Product Manager - Data Science & Measurement
description:
**Job Description**

**NIQ Activate** is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data Science & Measurement to manage the portfolio of data-science models and measurement capabilities used across Promotion Planning, Promotion Effectiveness, Retail Media, and Personalization.

**This is a technical product-management role, not a model-development role.** The successful candidate will partner with Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, and Engineering to maintain the model inventory, define clear requirements, identify opportunities for standardization and reuse, and manage migration from legacy or product-specific models toward shared portfolio capabilities.

The role requires sufficient technical depth to understand model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, and limitations. Data Science retains ownership of methodology selection, model development, scientific testing, and validation.

Key responsibilities

* **Model inventory and documentation:** Maintain an inventory of models and measurement capabilities across the four product areas, including purpose, usage, required data, inputs, outputs, ownership, versions, dependencies, limitations, and lifecycle status.
* **Gap, duplication, and modernization assessment:** Identify missing capabilities, overlapping or inconsistent approaches, legacy models, and opportunities for competitive parity, differentiation, modernization, partnership, or retirement.
* **Standardization and reuse:** Identify opportunities to standardize models, methodologies, interfaces, terminology, inputs, outputs, and documentation across the portfolio.
* **Migration roadmap:** Define and manage the path from legacy or product-specific models toward standardized and reusable portfolio capabilities, including sequencing, dependencies, risks, and adoption.
* **Requirements definition:** Partner with domain Product Managers and Commercial teams to translate customer, market, and product needs into clear data-science and measurement requirements, use cases, expected outputs, constraints, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* **Prioritization and roadmap management:** Prioritize model and measurement needs based on customer value, commercial opportunity, product strategy, technical feasibility, delivery dependencies, and reuse potential.
* **Industry and best-practice research:** Research competitor capabilities, industry approaches, methodology trends, and applicable standards, and translate the findings into practical product recommendations.
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Connect Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, and Architecture to align decisions, delivery plans, technical dependencies, and product integration.
* **Model lifecycle and product integration:** Coordinate capabilities from requirement through development, integration, adoption, migration, replacement, and retirement, ensuring changes are reflected in product workflows, documentation, KPI definitions, and customer-facing experiences.
* **Adoption and stakeholder communication:** Track whether capabilities are adopted and creating expected value, and clearly communicate model purpose, assumptions, limitations, dependencies, migration plans, and product implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Experience:** 6+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with data-intensive, analytical, measurement, AI/ML, or decision-support products.
* **Technical product management:** Demonstrated ability to translate customer and business needs into clear, delivery-ready requirements for Data, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
* **Model and measurement fluency:** Working knowledge of concepts such as baselines, forecasting, optimization, incrementality, causal inference, attribution, segmentation, propensity, recommendations, and experiment design.
* **Technical understanding:** Ability to discuss model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, confidence, limitations, and intended use without being the hands-on model developer.
* **Portfolio thinking:** Experience identifying duplication, reusable capabilities, standardization opportunities, common interfaces, and migration paths across multiple products.
* **Research and product judgment:** Ability to assess industry practices and competitor capabilities and balance customer value, commercial opportunity, feasibility, reuse, effort, and time to value.
* **Roadmap and cross-functional leadership:** Experience managing priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, and sequencing across Product, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, and customer-facing teams.
* **Communication:** Ability to translate technical concepts into clear product, commercial, and customer language and facilitate decisions across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Education and domain experience:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, analytical, or business discipline, or equivalent experience. Experience in retail analytics, promotion, retail media measurement, personalization, revenue growth management, or marketing measurement is preferred.
* **Delivery methods:** Experience with agile delivery, PI planning or comparable scaled planning, Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

description:
**Supply Chain Data Analyst**

  

**Location: Mumbai, India (hybrid)**

  

**Full time, permanent**

  

Servomex, part of the Spectris global group, is an expert in **gas analysis and sensing solutions** . Our technologies support critical applications across industry, helping customers improve process efficiency, product quality, safety and environmental performance.

  

We’re excited to be recruiting for a **Supply Chain Data Analyst** to join our global **Procurement & Supply Chain function** .

  

This is a great opportunity for an analytically minded supply chain professional who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems and turning insights into practical improvements.

  

**About the opportunity**

  

Working closely with our **Global Supply Chain Centre of Excellence (CoE) Manager** , functional leaders, site teams and IT, you’ll help develop our global supply chain analytics, business intelligence, optimisation and intelligent automation capabilities.

  

You’ll bring together and analyse data from **SAP ECC and other business systems** , develop advanced **Power BI dashboards and analytical models** , and identify opportunities to improve inventory, service, productivity and working capital.

  

The role also offers the opportunity to explore how **AI, automation and predictive analytics** can be applied to real-world supply chain challenges.

  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Consolidating and analysing global supply chain data from **SAP ECC** and other business systems.
* Developing and maintaining **Power BI dashboards, reports and analytical models** across Planning, Procurement, Inventory, Customer Fulfilment and Logistics.
* Analysing supply chain KPIs, identifying trends and investigating root causes to provide clear, actionable recommendations.
* Undertaking inventory analysis, including **ABC/XYZ segmentation, stock ageing, excess and obsolete inventory, safety stock and replenishment** .
* Analysing demand variability, forecast accuracy, supplier performance, lead times, material availability and customer service.
* Developing analytical and scenario models to improve **inventory, working capital, productivity and service levels** .
* Supporting data quality, validation and governance across critical supply chain data.
* Mapping supply chain processes and identifying opportunities for **standardisation, Lean improvement and greater efficiency** .
* Exploring and developing **AI agents, intelligent automation and generative AI solutions** for practical supply chain applications.
* Working collaboratively with global supply chain teams and IT to turn insights into scalable solutions.
* Helping track improvement initiatives and measure their operational and financial impact.

**What we're looking for**

  

You’ll ideally bring:

  

* Experience in **supply chain analytics, business intelligence, data analysis or digital transformation** , ideally within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* A good understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes across areas such as **Planning, Procurement, Inventory, Customer Fulfilment and Logistics** .
* Practical experience of **SAP ECC** and working with supply chain data.
* Advanced **Microsoft Power BI** skills, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling and dashboard development.
* AI agent development using tools such as LangChain or Semantic Kernel
* Strong **SQL and Excel** skills.
* Experience bringing together, cleansing, validating and analysing data from multiple systems.
* A solid understanding of areas such as **inventory management, demand variability, replenishment, safety stock, service levels and working capital** .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into **clear business insights and recommendations** .
* Confidence working with stakeholders across different functions, sites and locations – flexibility on working within global time-zones.

Exposure to **generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, APIs or workflow automation** would also be valuable.

  

**Even better if you have experience with**

  

You don't need to have everything on this list, but experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

  

* Python and statistical modelling
* Microsoft Azure, Fabric or Databricks
* Power Automate or Copilot Studio
* RAG architectures and enterprise AI applications
* Predictive analytics and machine learning
* Supply chain planning and optimisation systems
* SAP S/4HANA
* Lean Six Sigma or structured continuous improvement
* Global supply chain transformation or process standardisation
Precision engineering, instrumentation or industrial manufacturing  

  

**Qualifications**

  

A degree in **Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Mathematics, Statistics** or a related discipline would be beneficial, although we would also welcome candidates with **equivalent relevant professional experience** .

  

Additional certifications such as **Microsoft PL-300, APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, Azure, Python, SQL or AI-related qualifications** would be advantageous rather than essential.

  

**Why Servomex?**

  

At Servomex, you'll be joining a global business where data and digital capability can make a tangible difference. This role gives you the opportunity to work across the end-to-end supply chain, collaborate internationally and help shape how we use **analytics, automation and AI to make better, faster decisions** .

  

We want you to feel confident that Servomex is the right place for you. Throughout the process, you’ll have plenty of chances to ask questions and get a real sense of who we are, what we do and what your future here could look like.

* Friendly chat with the Talent team

* 30-minute video interview with hiring manager

* 60-minute video interview - technical interview/task with hiring team

* Peer-to-peer conversation

As part of a global organisation, we offer a **competitive salary and benefits package** , benchmarked against the local market and tailored to reflect the **location, skills and experience** you bring to the role.

We welcome and support candidates who may need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process. You will have an opportunity to tell us about any adjustments you may need when you apply, and we will do our best to put these in place.

We are also committed to making reasonable adjustments for employees wherever possible, so that everyone can perform their role to the best of their ability.

description:
**Senior Data Analyst, ADS (Mumbai)**

**About Us:** Morningstar DBRS is one of the four largest credit rating agencies globally. Our ratings, research, and data provide a clear view of credit risk across markets. Since 1976, we have challenged consensus and brought much-needed diversity of opinion to credit markets worldwide. We combine deep experience with an investor-focused, agile approach to deliver timely, differentiated insights that help credit market participants identify risks and opportunities, navigate change, and move forward with confidence.

Morningstar DBRS is committed to empowering investor success, serving the market through leading-edge technology and raising the bar for the industry. Morningstar DBRS is a market leader in Canada, the U.S. and Europe in multiple asset classes.

Morningstar DBRS rates more than 4,700 issuers and 74,000 securities worldwide and is driven to bring more clarity, diversity of opinion, and responsiveness to the ratings process. Morningstar DBRS approach and size provide the agility to respond to customers’ needs, while being large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources.

Visit: https://dbrs.morningstar.com/ to learn more.

**About the Role:** Morningstar DBRS is seeking Senior Data Analysts to join the Analytical Data Support team. Ideal candidates will have strong logical reasoning, operational and administrative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks. In this role, you will support global teams by uploading and downloading documents, extracting information from reports, including financial data input, conducting background research, maintaining document retention, supporting regulatory reporting, and performing quality control checks. You will also assist with processes related to pre- and post-rating committees. With experience, you will be expected to develop a thorough understanding of Structured Finance transactions, including primary deal documents and trustee reports, as well as the basics of the credit rating process, including fundamental analysis of borrowers across areas such as Corporates, Financial Institutions, Sovereign, and Public Finance. This position is based in Navi Mumbai.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the credit rating process by tracking, reviewing, and maintaining documentation and various operational databases.
* Extract data from trustee reports using a pre-defined format and become familiar with SF-related terminology and/or assist with updating historical financial information in proprietary tools, reconciling data, and maintaining company and peer group credit metrics, etc.

* Conduct ongoing research and review company filings, presentations, and industry publications to maintain industry data.
* Assist with background research by collecting and organizing data from internal and external sources for company-specific and industry commentaries and reports authored by the global team.
* Help global teams monitor news, announcements, and other material events affecting credits.
* Assist the global team with document retention, regulatory reporting and quality control
* Create and prepare materials for both internal and external meetings that maintain company standards and values
* Own ancillary tasks including administrative and streamlining of the ratings workflow
* Interaction with global stakeholders on timely basis & understanding their requirements
* Have a mindset to bring about process efficiencies and ideate automations

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Economics, Finance or Management Studies.
* 2-4 years of relevant Financial Data experience, experience at a rating agency is a plus
* Excellent communication and co-ordination skills and should be able to manage administrative tasks efficiently
* Proficient in computer applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and related tools.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Highly motivated, self-starter who is keen to learn, has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and deliver results in a timely manner
* Good inter-personal skills and ability to participate/ contribute as a team player

**Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.**

*Hybrid model – partial work from home option where employee will from Morningstar’s Navi Mumbai offices 4 days a week (subject to change as per organizational directive).*

**About Us**  
  
Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world.  
  
Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech-forward approach, and exceptional customer service.  
  
Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings.

If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Associate Specialist Data Science
description:
Job Description
  
  
Associate Specialist – Data Science
  
  
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization brings this purpose to life by transforming how we understand patients, markets, customers, and brands, and by leveraging data, analytics, and technology to enable better, faster, value-driven decisions.
  
  
TheAssociate Specialist – Data Science, Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA), based in India, will support US and global teams by delivering integrated healthcare and commercial analytics across products and therapeutic areas. Contributing to insights on disease dynamics, patient journeys, market opportunities, forecasting, and launch readiness, this role offers a strong foundation in pharmaceutical commercial analytics while developing the capability to connect data findings directly to strategic commercial decisions.
  
  
Role Overview
  
The Associate Specialist will work alongside experienced BSA colleagues and cross-functional teams to address commercial and strategic questions using diverse healthcare and commercial data sources. In this collaborative environment, they will contribute to analytical workstreams by translating defined business questions into structured approaches, executing fit-for-purpose analyses (utilizing foundations in problem-solving, programming, and statistics), and synthesizing results into clear insights.
  
With guided execution, the individual is expected to progressively connect their technical work to the broader commercial context, building a deep understanding of disease areas, markets, and brand decisions rather than approaching analysis as a standalone technical exercise. Over time, they will actively collaborate across global teams and contribute to the development, standardization, and reuse of analytical methodologies and capabilities across therapeutic areas.
  
  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following
  
  

* Commercial Strategy Market Insights
* Perform analytics across diverse healthcare and commercial data sources (claims, EHR, syndicated market data, brand data, SDoH, PSP, specialty pharmacy) to generate insights that inform commercial strategy.
* Build and analyze patient cohorts to understand diagnosed and treated populations, treatment patterns, lines of therapy, switching, persistence, adherence, and treatment funnel drop-offs.
* Analyze patient and market trends, sources of opportunity, and performance drivers across the product lifecycle, incorporating data coverage and limitations into analytical designs.
* Contribute analytical inputs to key commercial milestones, including patient flow assumptions for forecasting, scenario analyses, launch readiness, and post-launch KPI tracking.
* Develop a strong foundational understanding of how disease areas, markets, competitors, and key performance indicators (KPIs) relate directly to brand performance.
* Advanced Analytics Methodology

•
  

* Translate defined commercial questions into structured analytical problem statements, hypotheses, data requirements, and business rules in collaboration with experienced BSA colleagues.
* Extract, transform, integrate, and analyze large datasets using SQL and Python/R.
* Perform data preparation, cohort creation, exploratory analysis, and statistical modelling (utilizing regression, segmentation, or machine learning where appropriate).
* Write structured, modular, and reusable code, performing quality and validation checks to support scalable analytics.
* Develop the analytical judgment to determine the appropriate depth of analysis, recognizing when descriptive methods are sufficient and when advanced statistical approaches add incremental business value.
* Explore emerging capabilities, including GenAI, to selectively improve analytical workflows under appropriate guidance and governance.
* Stakeholder, Project Team Collaboration
* Execute assigned analytical workstreams end-to-end, from data preparation through validation, interpretation, synthesis, and final delivery.
* Develop presentations and clear visualizations that highlight key findings, progressing from simply reportingwhat the data shows to explainingwhat this means for the business.
* Triangulate findings across quantitative analyses and qualitative insight sources (such as market research, competitive intelligence, and forecasting) to build cohesive conclusions.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across US, India, and global organizations, managing assigned deliverables and proactively communicating progress, dependencies, and risks.
* Participate actively in analytical reviews and peer discussions, contributing code, templates, and learnings to support knowledge sharing and reuse across therapeutic areas.

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 1-2 years’ experience (experience requirement can be waived off for exceptional candidates)
* Working knowledge of Python/R, SQL, Databricks, Dataiku, visualization tools and Excel
* Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, including model development, validation and interpretation, with experience applying advanced analytical techniques where appropriate.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure problems and interpret data.

**About LumosLogic**
--------------------

LumosLogic is an AI-first IT services and technology company focused on building innovative digital solutions and helping businesses adopt modern technologies.

We work across AI, Cloud, Software Development, Digital Transformation and technology-driven business solutions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive **AI-Native Sales & Business Development Executive** who is interested in sales, technology, AI and building client relationships.

In this role, you will identify potential business opportunities, connect with decision-makers, generate qualified leads and support the company's business growth.

You will work with AI-powered tools for prospect research, lead generation, personalized outreach and sales automation while gaining practical exposure to the complete B2B sales process.

* Familiarity with LinkedIn and professional networking.
* Ability to understand customer needs and communicate solutions.
* Good follow-up, coordination and time-management skills.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and a target-oriented mindset.
* Interest in AI, technology and IT services.

**Preferred Skills**

Knowledge or experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* B2B Lead Generation and Prospecting
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Cold Calling and Cold Emailing
* CRM tools such as HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce
* Google Sheets and Excel
* AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI-powered sales tools
* Sales Automation and Email Marketing
* Basic Proposal and Presentation Preparation
* IT Services or Technology Sales

*Freshers with good communication skills, relevant internships or a strong interest in sales and technology are encouraged to apply.*

**Who Can Apply?**
------------------

* Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–3 years of experience.
* Candidates from Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering or related backgrounds.
* Final-year students available to join full-time.
* Candidates interested in B2B sales, technology, AI and business development.

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Your performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and quantity of qualified leads generated.
* Prospect research and outreach activities.
* Meetings scheduled with potential clients.
* Follow-up consistency and client engagement.
* Opportunities generated and pipeline development.
* CRM management and reporting.
* Communication, initiative and ownership.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Direct interaction with clients and business decision-makers.
* Practical exposure to B2B sales and business development.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered sales tools and automation.
* Opportunity to understand IT services and technology solutions.
* Mentorship and learning opportunities.
* Professional growth in technology sales and business development.
* Opportunity to work with an AI-first technology team.

**Why Join LumosLogic?**
------------------------

At LumosLogic, you won't just learn traditional sales techniques. You will get practical experience combining **AI, Technology, Sales and Business Development**.

You will learn how to identify business opportunities, approach decision-makers, understand client requirements and build meaningful professional relationships.

If you enjoy communication, business growth and exploring new technologies, this is an opportunity to build a strong career in technology sales.

title: Zonal Head
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION- ZONAL HEAD**

The Zonal Head – Sales will be responsible for driving business growth, achieving sales targets, expanding market presence, and strengthening dealer relationships across an assigned geographical zone comprising Ernakulam, Alappuzha, Kottayam & Idukki districts

The role involves leading and managing a team of Business Development Managers (BDMs), Business Development Executives (BDEs), and other sales personnel to ensure effective market penetration, revenue generation, and achievement of organizational sales objectives.

The candidate will be accountable for the overall sales performance of the assigned zone, ensuring operational efficiency, team productivity, dealer network expansion, and sustainable business growth.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Zonal Sales Strategy & Business Development**

* Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve zonal revenue and business growth targets.
* Drive sales and market expansion across all assigned districts within the zone.
* Identify new business opportunities, potential markets, and untapped geographical areas.
* Develop strategic plans to improve market penetration, product visibility, and market share.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies, and customer preferences to identify growth opportunities.
* Ensure effective implementation of company sales policies, promotional schemes, and business initiatives.

**B. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, manage, and supervise Business Development Managers, Business Development Executives, and other sales personnel within the assigned zone.
* Set individual and team-wise sales targets and ensure accountability for achieving the same.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, sales meetings, and field visits to monitor team productivity.
* Provide guidance, coaching, and motivation to improve the overall performance of the sales team.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective measures to improve individual and team effectiveness.
* Participate in recruitment, onboarding, and development of sales personnel as required.

**C. Dealer Network Management & Market Expansion**

* Build and maintain strong business relationships with existing dealers, distributors, and key channel partners.
* Identify and onboard new dealers and channel partners to expand the company's distribution network.
* Ensure consistent business engagement and sales performance across all dealer points.
* Develop strong relationships with key accounts and strategic business partners.
* Monitor dealer performance, business potential, stock movement, and market requirements.
* Address dealer concerns and coordinate with internal teams to ensure effective business operations.

**D. Sales Operations & Revenue Management**

* Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets across the assigned zone.
* Monitor primary sales, secondary sales, sell-out performance, and product-wise sales contributions.
* Track inventory movement, stock availability, product ageing, and market demand.
* Coordinate with finance and accounts teams regarding dealer outstanding payments, credit limits, and collection efficiency.
* Ensure timely execution of sales orders and effective coordination with supply chain and operations teams.
* Monitor sales reports, business forecasts, and performance dashboards to support data-driven decisions.

**E. Business Planning & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly and quarterly zonal business plans and sales forecasts.
* Analyse district-wise, team-wise, dealer-wise, and product-wise sales performance.
* Submit periodic sales reports and performance updates to the Sales Head / Management.
* Identify deviations from planned targets and implement appropriate action plans.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and ensure continuous improvement in zonal business performance.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with marketing, finance, accounts, warehouse, logistics, and operations teams to ensure smooth business execution.
* Ensure effective communication of company initiatives, schemes, and product updates to the field sales team.
* Work closely with senior management to align zonal business activities with overall organizational objectives.

**3. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

* MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, or a related specialization is preferred.
* Additional professional certifications in sales management, business development, or leadership will be an added advantage.

**4. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* 8–10 years of overall experience in sales, business development, or channel sales.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a leadership or managerial position.
* Proven experience managing and leading a team of Business Development Managers, Business Development Executives, or equivalent sales professionals.
* Experience in handling multiple districts, territories, or geographical regions is highly preferred.
* Prior experience in B2B sales, distribution, dealer management, or consumer electronics / mobile phone / IT product distribution will be an added advantage.

**5. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills.
* Excellent sales planning, execution, and business development capabilities.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple districts and geographically distributed sales teams.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and performance reports.
* Strong understanding of dealer networks, distribution channels, and market dynamics.
* Ability to drive targets, improve team productivity, and deliver measurable business results.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities.

**7. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for a result-oriented and strategically driven sales leader with strong experience in managing multi-district sales operations. The ideal candidate should have the ability to lead a team of BDMs and BDEs, establish strong dealer networks, identify new business opportunities, and consistently achieve business targets.

The candidate must possess excellent leadership capabilities, a strong understanding of B2B distribution business, and the ability to translate organizational sales objectives into actionable zonal business plans.

**Preferred Industry Background:**

* Consumer Electronics
* Mobile Phones & Accessories
* IT Products & Technology Distribution
* FMCG Distribution
* B2B Channel Sales
* Retail and Dealer Network Management

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Fixed Monthly Salary
* Travel Allowance (TA) and Daily Allowance (DA) as per company policy
* Performance-Based Sales Incentives
* Additional earning opportunities based on target achievement
* Career Growth Opportunities

**Preferred Languages:** Malayalam and English.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Its AI-powered solution optimises fresh food supply chains for major retailers: it drastically reduces food waste while increasing their margins by hundreds of thousands of euros a year. Backed by a global leader in retail planning, the company is expanding internationally and is opening India for the very first time.
  
  
You will be its first Forward Deployed Engineer in India, the key link between the technology and the clients, from pre-sales to full-scale deployment.
  
  
**Your Missions, Should You Choose To Accept Them**

* Lead implementation projects (POCs) end to end: integrate new client data sources, optimise data flows and fine-tune the algorithms to each client's reality, to maximise conversion.
* Engineer for scale and reliability: a hands-on role where you write data engineering code and build robust, production-grade pipelines.
* Contribute across the stack: build features from backend logic to frontend interfaces, and create reusable assets (workflows, templates) to speed up future deployments.
* Bridge tech and sales: work hand in hand with the Sales team as the technical expert, and translate complex client needs into concrete solutions to close deals faster.
* Master the ROI: monitor the KPIs that matter (margin, shrinkage reduction, service rate) and prove the business value to clients in real time.
* Drive product evolution: turn field insights into new product opportunities, experiment with new AI capabilities and influence the roadmap.

**Exigences**
***What about you?***

* You are based in India and already authorised to work there (no visa sponsorship).
* You hold a Master's degree in engineering and/or business, ideally from a top-tier school; a dual engineering and business background is a real plus.
* You have at least 3 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer or Software Engineer on AI-based products; consulting or hackathon experience can make up for it.
* You have deployed ML/AI solutions in production for clients, and you have experience in product discovery, client relationship or entrepreneurship.
* You have business acumen: you understand ROI, margins and P&L, and you can explain technical value to C-level audiences (CEOs, CTOs, Supply Chain Directors).
* You code well, ideally in Python (the stack is Python, TypeScript and Dagster; strong developers from other languages are welcome), and you are comfortable with SQL, data engineering tools (dbt, Airflow) and a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* You are autonomous: you own your client projects end to end, with support from the other FDEs rather than a direct manager.
* You are fluent in English; Hindi or another Indian language is a plus.
* You have a "do-what-it-takes" attitude, fully oriented towards impact and ownership.
* A plus: experience as a Customer Engineer, Solutions Architect or Technical Product Manager, knowledge of supply chain, retail or logistics, contributions to open-source ML projects.

**Avantages**
***What else?***

* A rare opportunity: be the first Forward Deployed Engineer in India and build the activity from the ground up.
* Compensation: INR 7,100,000 to 12,200,000 fixed per year, plus a variable of up to INR 2,030,000.
* Full remote anywhere in India, with travel to client sites.
* A company with a potential IPO within one to two years.
* A job with real impact: fighting food waste while creating measurable value for retailers.

title: AI Deployment Strategist
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai

**Experience:**
4–8 years of experience.

**Function:**
Customer Delivery

**About UnifyApps**

UnifyApps is an Agentic AI Platform for the Enterprise, headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. Our mission is to empower organizations to become AI-native enterprises—enabling them to securely and confidently operationalize AI at scale.

Our horizontal platform unifies systems of record, knowledge, and activity, allowing enterprises to find data, reason with AI models, and act within business workflows. By bringing together low-code application development, workflow automation (iPaaS), data transformation (ETL/Reverse ETL), and GenAI/LLM-driven automation into a single platform, UnifyApps transforms stalled AI initiatives into production-grade, enterprise-ready solutions.

**About the Role**

As a
**Deployment Strategist**
, you will be responsible for making sure every enterprise AI deployment solves the right problem and delivers value the customer can measure.

You will work at the intersection of
**customer executives, Technical Delivery Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product**
, turning a broad AI mandate into a prioritized roadmap of use cases, each with a clear scope, a business case, and defined success metrics.

You will embed with customers to understand how their business really runs; decide what should be built, in what order, and why; and stay with each use case after go-live until it is adopted and the value shows up in the customer's numbers.

This is a hands-on, on-site role for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, think in structured terms, and take ownership of customer outcomes rather than activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead strategic discovery:**
  Run workshops with business and IT leaders to map processes, systems, data, personas, and pain points, and identify where AI will have the largest impact.
* **Prioritize the use-case portfolio:**
  Assess each opportunity on value, feasibility, and risk; recommend what to build first and what not to build.
* **Build the business case:**
  Define the baseline, target KPIs, and value-measurement approach for every use case before build begins.
* **Define deployment strategy:**
  Translate customer needs into solution scope, success criteria, integration and data requirements, and a phased rollout plan that engineering teams can execute.
* **Shape commercial scope:**
  Work with Sales and Delivery leadership on SOWs, phase plans, and effort estimates so that commitments are realistic and clearly owned.
* **Own executive alignment:**
  Act as a trusted advisor to customer sponsors; lead steering committees, executive reviews, and QBRs with clear decisions, owners, and follow-ups.
* **Partner on execution:**
  Work alongside Technical Delivery Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers through build, UAT, and go-live, resolving scope questions and trade-offs quickly.
* **Drive adoption and change:**
  Plan user onboarding, change management, and rollout so that solutions are used as intended after launch.
* **Measure and report value:**
  Track adoption, solution performance, and business KPIs in production; report realized value against the business case and drive improvements from real usage.
* **Expand the account:**
  Identify follow-on use cases, build the multi-phase roadmap with the customer, and convert successful deployments into the next engagement.
* **Feed the platform:**
  Package successful deployments into reusable patterns and success stories, and bring field insight back to Product.

**Qualifications**

* **4–8 years of experience**
  in management consulting, deployment strategy, solutions consulting, technical program management, or forward-deployed roles within SaaS, services, or technology companies.
* Proven experience taking
  **enterprise programs from problem definition through production and measurable outcomes**
  .
* Strong ability to break ambiguous business problems into
  **structured scopes, business cases, success metrics, and phased plans**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **business process mapping, value assessment, requirements definition, and enterprise software delivery**
  .
* Technical fluency with concepts such as
  **APIs, system integrations, data flows, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, and enterprise applications**
  .
* Ability to earn the trust of
  **CXO and senior business stakeholders**
  while working effectively with engineering teams.
* Commercial awareness: an understanding of how scope, effort, and value connect to an SOW and to account growth.
* Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* High ownership, bias toward action, and the ability to proactively identify and remove blockers.
* Strong interest in
  **AI agents, GenAI/LLMs, automation, and deploying AI-powered systems in real enterprise environments**
  .
* Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time on-site with customers.

**Must have's:**

* Engineering degree from a
  **top-tier institution such as IIT, NIT, NSIT, or BITS**
  .
* Background in
  **management consulting, digital transformation, or enterprise SaaS implementation**
  with direct customer-facing ownership.
* Experience building business cases and reporting realized value to executive stakeholders.
* Experience deploying
  **AI/ML, GenAI, workflow automation, integration, or data platforms**
  .

Experience working with large enterprises on large-scale transformation programs.

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About Zamp:**

At Zamp, we’re building AI agents that empower people to move at the speed of thought. Our vision is a world where AI handles the routine, so humans can focus on strategy and innovation. We are building a platform where all operational work runs autonomously. We partner with Fortune 500s, leading global banks and companies to streamline complex Finance and Operations processes.

Founded in 2022 by Amit Jain—an IIT Delhi and Stanford graduate with over 20 years of industry leadership, including roles as Managing Director at Sequoia Capital and Head of Asia Pacific at Uber—Zamp is backed by a stellar $22M seed round. Our investors include Sequoia Capital, Dara Khosrowshahi (CEO, Uber), Tony Xu (CEO, DoorDash), and other global visionaries.

**About the role:**

At Zamp, we’re looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent who want to learn what it takes to build and grow a business. This isn’t a narrow role with a fixed playbook. You’ll work alongside the leadership team, take ownership of meaningful work from day one, and see the direct impact of what you deliver.

Think of it as a front-row seat to building a mini-startup inside a startup. You’ll work closely with customers, help identify what needs to happen, and bring the right people and resources together to get it done. As you prove yourself, your scope grows with you, with clear visibility into how your work contributes to the business.

**Tracks**

Based on your strengths and interests, you’ll join one of three tracks:

**Customer Implementation:**
Help take customers from kickoff to successful delivery and ongoing value. You’ll drive day-to-day execution, track milestones, and build strong relationships with customer stakeholders. You’ll learn to balance customer outcomes, delivery quality, timelines, and commercial performance, spotting risks early and keeping teams aligned so customers see the value Zamp set out to deliver.

**GTM:**
Help find and pursue new business opportunities. You’ll research target accounts, engage with decision-makers, and learn to understand their priorities and make a compelling case for how Zamp can help. You’ll support the full sales journey, from prospecting and discovery through pitching, negotiation, and handoff, while building a sharp understanding of the market and what it takes to win.

**Delivery Excellence:**
Help the team deliver better and faster by building the in-house tools, processes, and best practices that make great execution repeatable. You’ll identify friction in how work gets done, develop practical solutions, and work closely with teams to put them into use. Your goal: help Zamp move at the speed of light without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take clear ownership of your track’s goals, priorities, and results, with accountability for delivering outcomes.
* Work directly with customers and senior leaders, building trusted relationships and prioritising customer experience and satisfaction.
* Turn ambiguous challenges into practical plans, then drive those plans through to execution.
* Collaborate across teams, bring people together around shared outcomes, and address issues before they slow progress.
* Use customer and business feedback to improve how Zamp sells, delivers, and operates.
* Communicate progress, risks, and results clearly, and make decisions with both customer impact and business performance in mind.
* Work closely with the Founder on strategic initiatives beyond your track, such as partnerships and alliances, new market entry, innovation projects, and hiring for key roles.

**Qualifications & Skill Set Required**

* 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in management, strategy, consulting, sales, operations, or a fast-paced startup environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Economics. An MBA is a plus.
* A strong owner’s mindset: you take responsibility, follow through, and care about results.
* Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.
* Confidence in communicating with senior stakeholders, including CXOs, and clear written and verbal communication that aligns people and keeps momentum.
* Comfort working in a fast-changing environment where you’ll help create the playbook rather than wait for one.

**Good to Have**

* You’re an entrepreneur at heart. You’re not only excited about startups but truly understand what it’s like to work in one.
* You love learning new things and don’t shy away from going beyond traditional growth paths.
* You adapt quickly to change and pick up new skills when the job demands it.
* You can break a problem into smaller pieces and balance the big picture with tactical execution.

**Our Culture and Benefits:**

At Zamp, we promote a culture of open communication, collaboration, and empowerment. We

value transparency, meritocracy, and a strong work ethic. Join our early team and help us build

something exceptional.

Perks:

* Competitive salaries and stock options with substantial potential upside.
* Collaborate with top talent.
* Diverse and inclusive workspace.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouses, and children.
* A culture celebrating every victory.
* Continuous learning and skill development opportunities.
* Enjoy good food, games, and a comfortable office environment

title: Applied AI Architect ( Global Customers)
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**For roles performing work in California:**
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**For roles performing work in California:**
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

* Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, ADK, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent patterns) from an operations and deployment perspective
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating agentic workloads on at least one major cloud platform:

Azure: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, AKS
  
  
AWS: Amazon Bedrock (Agents, Guardrails, AgentCore), Amazon Connect, SageMaker, CloudWatch, CodePipeline, EKS
  
  
Google Cloud: Vertex AI, Conversational Agents (Vertex AI Agent Builder), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Dialogflow CX, GECX, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Build, Cloud Operations
  
  

* Experience managing the operational side of RAG, including data ingestion pipelines, embedding refresh, vector store operations, and knowledge base versioning
* Working knowledge of security and compliance in delivery pipelines, including secrets management, least-privilege identities for agents, guardrail and policy enforcement, dependency and supply chain scanning, and audit trails
* Experience with incident management and on-call practices for AI systems, including handling model drift, degraded responses, tool failures, and provider outages, with post-incident reviews
* Experience leading architecture reviews, operating model design, and workshops for enterprise clients
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers, data scientists, security teams, and client executives, and to mentor engineering teams on AgentOps practices

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Deccan Enterprises Private Limited is a leading player in India’s power transmission sector, specializing in 765kV HVAC and 800kV HVDC solutions. title: Manager, PDS BI&T Analytics Operations
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Manager, PDS BI&T Analytics Operations**
**Summary**
This role will play a crucial role in managing a team that supports operational analytics across PDS to ensure products continue to serve most pressing PDS analytics needs, with potential opportunities to build new advanced analytics capabilities to build in state of art solutions. Manager for this cutting-edge Analytics team should have a strong interest in solving business problems, and an eagerness to work on all parts of the analytics value chain, from partnering with IT on data pipelines to scaling and deploying analytics solution (having a thorough knowledge in Business Intelligence Space) in the service of our patients around the world.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Operate with a high degree of independence and accountability—setting priorities, making critical decisions, and delivering outcomes with minimal supervision.
* Provide strategic and technical analytical solutions for the identification, development, and deployment of Data & Analytics solutions across PDS BI&T, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and enterprise initiatives as well as harmony with BMS enterprise platforms and governance (e.g., model/platform reuse, safety & privacy reviews, data access controls, usage/cost monitoring).
* Conduct analysis and interpretation of complex data sets to derive meaningful insights and recommendations based on an understanding of PDS priorities, critical issues, and value levers.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business problems, goals, and KPIs to design, establish and maintain data pipelines, models and business facing reports and dashboards.
* Identify and implement enhancement and automation of high-value analytics while ensuring they continue to function efficiently.
* Collaborate proactively with IT teams to develop and enhance data infrastructure, data pipelines, and analytical tools for efficient data collection, processing, and analysis.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate analyses to stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
* Follow technical best practices in building, maintaining, and enhancing analytics output with scalable solutions, including code version control, pipeline management, deployment, and documentation.
* Continuously monitoring emerging AI technologies and best practices, recommending new approaches to drive continuous improvement and proposing a pragmatic roadmap for scaling Data Science & AI functions.
* Provide training, guidance, and mentorship to junior analysts and team members when required.
* Work hours that provide sufficient overlap with standard east coast US working hours.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Good critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to support and articulate a data-led approach to insight development with 8+ years of experience
* Agile problem-solving ability and desire to learn new things and continuously improve
* Proficiency in Power BI, Databricks, SQL, Python
* Strong project management skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team
* Solid understanding of digital analytics tools and platforms and version control like Github
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear manner.
* Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable insights and recommendations
* Leadership skills to lead an analytics team with required people manager skills and positive attitude to develop the team

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related scientific discipline field.
* Experience working as both a technical lead and people manager
* Proven experience in a data and analytics role, including direct development experience.
* Experience working with large datasets, data visualization tools, statistical software packages and platforms
* Proficiency in Python and machine learning as well as LLM and agentic AI solutions
* Demonstrable Experience in development of integration of generative AI or large-scale automation tools—preferably in life sciences, biotech, or healthcare.
* Experience with major PDS applications (SAP, Oracle, LIMS, Infinity, MES) is a plus.
* Experience with biotech product development, manufacturing operations, supply chain, and quality control is a significant plus.
* Experience in the biopharma industry a plus.

title: Internal Audit Manager - Data Analytics
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About Global Business Services**
Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together - OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission
  
  
**About The Role**
As the Internal Audit Manager – Data Analytics, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing the effectiveness, depth, and insight of Internal Audit through the design and delivery of high‑quality analytics. You will support global audit teams by developing data‑driven insights, dashboards, and risk indicators that improve coverage, efficiency, and assurance quality.
  
  
Working in close partnership with COE Management, you will transform raw data into actionable insights, embed analytics into audits, and help develop scalable solutions aligned to the audit universe. This role requires a hands‑on analytics expert with strong business understanding, the ability to interpret complex datasets, and the skills to collaborate with auditors, data owners, and stakeholders across the business
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Support audit planning by assessing data quality, availability, and analytics opportunities.
* Identify risks, trends, anomalies, and key indicators across business processes.
* Collaborate with auditors and stakeholders to design risk-based analytics tests.
* Extract, prepare, and analyze data from ERP, finance, HR, and IT systems.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, quality, security, and documentation standards.Develop and execute analytics routines to support audit objectives and risk assessments.
* Build and maintain standardized test libraries for key audit areas (P2P, O2C, R2R, Payroll, IT Access).
* Create dashboards and visualizations using Power BI/Tableau to highlight insights and exceptions.
* Support auditors in interpreting results, identifying root causes, and evaluating control gaps.
* Develop automated testing and continuous monitoring solutions for high-risk processes.
* Maintain reusable datasets, analytics pipelines, scripts, and reporting assets.
* Translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for audit and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of evidence-based audit observations and recommendations.
* Ensure analytics deliverables meet Internal Audit quality and documentation requirements.
* Manage multiple audit engagements, priorities, and delivery timelines effectively.
* Provide training and guidance to strengthen analytics adoption and data literacy.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing, best practices, playbooks, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in Internal Audit, Data Analytics, Assurance, or similar analytical roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL and at least one programming language (Python or R).
* Experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI (preferred) or Tableau, including data modelling and KPI design.
* Familiarity with analytics for ERP and operational systems (SAP, JDE, etc.)
* Understanding of audit processes, risk assessment, and controls testing.
* Experience applying statistical methods, anomaly detection, and sampling techniques.
* Certifications such as CIA, CISA, CPA/CA, CFE, or analytics certifications (SQL, Power BI, Azure) are advantageous.
* Strong communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality outputs under tight timelines.

The skills for success
  
  

* Data Analytics & Insights
* Audit & Risk Management
* Data Extraction & Transformation
* Data Visualization & Reporting
* Data Governance & Quality Management
* Automation & Continuous Monitoring
* Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication & Data Storytelling
* Project & Delivery Management

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
  
  
We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

* Investment Support: Deliver high-quality, timely, and consistent analysis to Investment teams across all regions and products, enabling performance evaluation and optimization.

This position requires advanced computer skills, attention to detail, a positive professional attitude, and the ability to work in a team environment.
