title: Specialist - Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA)
description:
Job Description
  
  
Specialist - Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA)
  
  
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization brings this purpose to life by transforming how we understand patients, markets, customers, and brands, and by leveraging data, analytics, and technology to enable better, faster, value-driven decisions.
  
  
The Specialist – Data Science, Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA), based in India, will support US and global business teams across the commercial lifecycle by integrating healthcare, market, customer, and commercial data. Working across diverse therapeutic areas and products, they will develop insights on disease dynamics, patient journeys, market opportunities, forecasting, launch readiness, and ongoing brand performance.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Specialist will serve as an analytical thought partner to business stakeholders, translating ambiguous business priorities into structured analytical approaches and decision-ready insights. By focusing on core business questions rather than isolated datasets, the individual will integrate multiple analytical sources to answer: What is happening? Why is it happening? And what should we consider doing next?
  
  
This role requires a blend of deep therapeutic understanding, pharmaceutical domain expertise, commercial acumen, structured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and technical depth to execute methodologies ranging from descriptive to advanced predictive analytics. Operating end-to-end, the individual will collaborate across BSA domains, partner with adjacent capabilities (including forecasting, market research, and competitive intelligence), guide junior colleagues, and build scalable, reusable analytical frameworks.
  
  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  

* Commercial Strategy Market Insights
* Lead end-to-end analytics using diverse data sources (claims, EHR, syndicated market data, brand data, SDoH, PSP, specialty pharmacy) to generate insights that drive commercial strategy.
* Leverage deep knowledge of US and global commercial databases and healthcare markets to identify, structure, and utilize the appropriate data sources for respective regional and global market analyses.
* Develop patient cohorts and analyze commercial dynamics (diagnosed populations, treatment flows, lines of therapy, switching, persistence, adherence) to quantify market opportunities, unmet needs, and potential growth pools.
* Assess market evolution, competitive dynamics, and performance drivers across the product lifecycle, incorporating data limitations and business context into analytical design.
* Support commercial forecasting, scenario development, and launch strategy/excellence by generating evidence-based inputs, launch KPIs, leading indicators, and post-launch optimization tracking.
* Advanced Analytics Methodology
* Translate strategic business questions into structured analytical frameworks, choosing the appropriate methodology and depth (from descriptive analysis to advanced predictive modeling/ML) based on the business decision required.
* Extract, transform, and analyze large datasets using SQL and Python/R to address complex commercial questions.
* Triangulate quantitative findings with qualitative evidence (market research, competitive intelligence, epidemiology) to build robust, multi-dimensional conclusions.
* Develop reusable methodologies, standardized approaches, and automation (including emerging GenAI capabilities) to scale analytical speed and workflow productivity across brands.
* Stakeholder, Project Team Leadership:
* Act as a strategic and analytical thought partner to business stakeholders, influencing how business questions are framed, prioritized and proactively identifying emerging analytical opportunities.
* Distinguish between operational symptoms and underlying business drivers, translating complex findings into concise executive narratives that clarify trade-offs and recommended actions.
* Partner effectively across US, India, and global teams, therapeutic areas, and adjacent capabilities (forecasting, market research, CI) to connect insights and minimize duplication.
* Lead, mentor, and coach junior team members through technical guidance, analytical reviews, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback.
* Manage workstream objectives, timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery.

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* Bachelors degree with 5–7 years of industry experience in pharmaceutical analytics, life sciences consulting, healthcare analytics or data science
* Proficiency in Python/R, SQL, visualization tools and Excel
* Strong foundations in statistics and advanced machine learning, including model development, validation and interpretation, with experience applying advanced analytical techniques where appropriate.
* Experience working across healthcare and commercial data sources, including patient-level, syndicated, aggregated market, brand, primary research databases, and epidemiological data, from sources such as IQVIA, Komodo, Optum, Merative, Clarivate, and IHME
* Develop patient cohorts, analyze diagnosed/treated populations, treatment patterns, lines of therapy, switching, persistence, adherence, testing patterns, market dynamics, brand performances and treatment funnel drop-offs.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches.
* Experience leading analytical projects or small teams and providing technical guidance.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to summarize complex analytical findings for business and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments and manage analytical workstreams end-to-end.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Advanced degree in STEM
* Experience in therapeutic areas like Cardio-Metabolic, Specialty Pharma
* Understanding of pharmaceutical commercial functions including brand strategy, forecasting, market research, competitive intelligence, customer analytics, and performance management.
* Knowledge of advanced machine learning techniques, LLMs and pharmaceutical commercial analytics
* Experience supporting end-to-end project management

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
Business Intelligence (BI), Database Design, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Machine Learning (ML), Software Development, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Waterfall Model

title: Business Analyst I, Business assessment and reinforcement (BAR)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.  
  
BAR designs and builds the inspection systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.  
  
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  
  
We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  
  
Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  
  
Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.
* Communication skills – ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories
* Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation
* Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau
* Ability to translate ambiguous work-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks.
* Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.

Using LLMs and Agents for efficiency improvement

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* 2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Knowledge of Python, VBA, Macros, Selenium scripts
* Knowledge of SQL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Manager, Data Scientist
description:
**About Gap Inc.**
------------------

Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.

But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.

**About the role**
------------------

Gap Inc. is building a proactive, data-driven sourcing capability within our Network, Planning & Costing team. We are moving from manual, vendor-quoted decisions to automated models that help us optimize our supply network and build product cost from the ground up — giving our sourcing teams a transparent, defensible foundation for every country, supplier, and cost decision.As a Data Scientist focused on cost modeling, you will design and build the automated first-cost engine that generates opening bids directly from the components that sit in our systems — cut & make and wash negotiated through RFPs in Coupa, fabric secured through mill MOUs, yield pulled from Gerber markers, and trims managed on rate cards. You will encode should-cost logic, like-for-like matching, and margin guardrails into robust models, and partner closely with Commercial, Costing, and Raw Material & Trims (RMT) teams to turn deep costing expertise into automated, auditable analytics. This is a hands-on build role with high visibility, directly shaping cost and margin outcomes across the portfolio.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Translate** the opening-bid and should-cost logic into production-grade models and decision trees, encoding the sequential sourcing hierarchy for each cost component (CM, wash, fabric FOB, CIF, yield, trims, and profit/miscellaneous).
* **Build and maintain** data pipelines that assemble cost components from source systems —
* **Develop** like-for-like (LFL) and like-for-similar (LFS) matching logic that identifies comparable prior-season styles so opening bids reference historical cost and never drift upward year over year.
* **Design and refine** the should-cost model built from SMV, BOM consumption, and labor minutes, and design the comparison logic that selects the appropriate cost in each sourcing scenario.
* **Embed** automated guardrail checks into the costing workflow — flagging styles where cost exceeds LY, where cost misses the net-margin-goal (NMG) target, and "underwater" styles where negotiated CM falls below should-cost.
* **Conduct** exploratory data analysis on cost drivers, negotiation spreads, and portfolio trends to continuously improve the accuracy of the opening-bid strategy.
* **Partner** closely with Commercial, Costing, and RMT partners to validate logic, reconcile exceptions, and ensure every automated cost is explainable, auditable, and trusted by negotiators.
* **Produce** clear documentation, decision logic, and reusable tooling so the costing strategy is transparent, maintainable, and scalable across categories and seasons.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **Bachelor's or Master's** degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or Operations Research).
* **5+** years of data science or analytics experience, ideally in retail, apparel, sourcing, or cost/pricing analytics.
* **Strong** in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and working with messy, multi-source data.
* **Skilled at** translating business logic and domain rules into models and reproducible code.
* **Familiar** with cost or margin concepts — should-cost, BOM structures, yield, or landed cost (FOB/CIF) a plus.
* **Clear** communicator who can explain complex analysis to non-technical partners.
* **A** collaborative, detail-oriented problem solver who cares about building trustworthy, auditable solutions.

**Benefits at Gap Inc.**
------------------------

* One of the most competitive paid time off plans in the industry
* Comprehensive health coverage for employees, same-sex partners and their families
* Health and wellness program: free annual health check-ups, fitness center and Employee Assistance Program
* Comprehensive benefits to support the journey of parenthood
* Retirement planning assistance
* See more of the benefits we offer.

Gap Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We have received numerous awards for our long-held commitment to equality and will continue to foster a diverse and inclusive environment of belonging. In 2022, we were recognized by Forbes as one of the World's Best Employers and one of the Best Employers for Diversity.

title: Manager- Finance & MIS (Office of MD)
description:
Position: Manager, Finance & MIS, Office of the Managing Director

Location: Ahmedabad (MD's office), with travel to Jodhpur and Jaipur, Rajasthan, as needed

Business Covered: Thar Group

**Key responsibilities**

**Report collection and timeliness**

* Collect all daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, and quarterly reports from the CFO's office, unit finance GMs, the CEO, and business heads on their due dates.
* Maintain a reporting calendar and tracker; follow up on any report that is late or incomplete, and escalate repeated delays to the MD
* Ensure every report follows the approved templates so the MD can compare period to period.

**Review and cross-check**

* Check each report for completeness, arithmetic accuracy, and consistency with other reports (for example, cash in the MIS against the daily cash notes; receivables against the collections reports; haulage paid against rake-wise reports).
* Compare figures with budget and previous periods and identify unusual movements, unexplained variances, and items on the red-flag checklist.
* Raise queries with the report owner and record the answers before the report reaches the MD.

**Briefing the MD**

* Prepare a one-page briefing before each weekly, monthly, and quarterly review: key numbers, issues, and suggested questions.
* Explain reports, ratios and trends to the MD as required.
* Prepare short analyses on request (for example, profitability of a customer or route, a funding comparison, or the cost of a proposal).

**Meetings and follow-up**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews; record decisions and action points.
* Maintain the action tracker, follow up with owners, and report the status at the start of each meeting.
* Promoter and family finance (if assigned)
* Maintain the promoter family's personal financial records and reports (cash, investments, net worth, tax calendar), kept fully separate from company books and paid for personally.

**Outside the scope of this role**

* Approving payments, operating bank accounts, or passing accounting entries (these remain with the CFO and unit finance teams).
* Supervising or directing the unit finance GMs, who continue to report to the CFO.
* Internal audit, which remains independent.

**Qualification**

Chartered Accountant (essential). CMA or MBA (Finance) with strong MIS experience may be considered.

**Experience**

4–8 years after qualification, in MIS/FP&A in a multi-unit company, or in statutory/internal audit with a reputed firm. Exposure to logistics, real estate, or manufacturing is an advantage.

**Technical Skill**

Strong command of financial statements, cash flow, working capital and reconciliations; advanced Excel; working knowledge of Tally/SAP or similar ERP; familiarity with GST, TDS and Companies Act basics.

**Personal qualities**

* Absolute integrity and discretion: the role sees confidential group and promoter information.
* Persistent and tactful in follow-up with senior colleagues.
* Able to explain financial matters simply and in writing.
* Organized, deadline-driven, and comfortable working directly with the MD.

title: BI Analyst
description:
**Why You Belong Here**
-----------------------

At Victoria’s Secret & Co, you’ll join a world-leading specialty retail brand recognized globally for innovation and excellence in lingerie and fashion. You’ll work alongside industry leaders to set the standard for what a retail brand can achieve, placing customers at the center of everything we do to create products and experiences that bring them joy.

We believe everyone deserves a place where they truly belong. We celebrate individuality and know that your passion, experience, and unique perspective strengthen our team and business. Here, you’ll be empowered to perform, grow, and engage through unmatched opportunities to develop your skills, gain real-world experience, and learn from the best in the business.

**Description**

**BI Analyst**

**Role Overview**

The BI Analyst plays a key role in supporting Supply Chain Operations by creating or managing data sets, building tools that enable collecting, validating, and organizing data, developing reports and dashboards that lead to insights and automations that drive user efficiency. This position works closely with Supply Chain Analytics, Global Manufacturing Ops, Solution Design Management Team, VSIT, to support the creation of reporting and analytics.

The BI Analyst is responsible for transforming raw operational data into analytics and actionable insights. They develop reliable datasets and metrics, analyze datasets, to support informed production and sourcing decision-making. The role requires maintaining data quality, following established processes, identifying and resolving issues. The role will also be responsible for building lightweight applications that improve internal workflows and reduce manual effort.

**Core Responsibilities (Day-to-Day)**

* **Analytics & Reporting:** Develop supply chain reports and dashboards using tools such as SQL, Snowflake, MicroStrategy, and Sigma. Track business-defined KPIs and ensure timely, accurate reporting for production and sourcing teams.
* **Dashboard Maintenance & Monitoring:** Maintain and enhance reporting assets based on business feedback. Automate recurring reports and proactively identify anomalies or data inconsistencies.
* **Data Engineering & ETL:** Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and structure data from internal and external data sources, enabling effective analytics.
* **Data Management & Validation:** Collect, clean, and validate data from Enterprise Systems (e.g., SAP/Centric/Salesforce) and other sources.
* **Domain Expertise:** Be the go-to person for the tools and data they support, including understanding the usage, the business processes it supports
* **Enterprise Integration Support:** Assist integrating data across Enterprise Systems to ensure seamless data flow, improved visibility, and consistency across business functions.
* **Business Application Development:** Leverage low-code tools such as Sigma, Salesforce, Power Automate and Python to build lightweight applications that improve internal workflows and reduce manual effort.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with production, planning, and sourcing teams to ensure KPIs are aligned, tracked effectively.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Analytics, or related fields.
* **Experience:** 2-3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Supply Chain Analytics (internships or project experience considered).
* **Technical Skills:**

o Proficient in SQL, with experience writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and managing relational databases.

o Proficiency in **Excel** (Power Query, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas).

o Experience in **BI/visualization tools** such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or Sigma.

o Basic understanding of **Data Warehousing concepts** and tools such as Snowflake (or similar platforms like DataBricks/Hadoop).

o Exposure to **Python** (Pandas, basic scripting) for data handling (extract, transform and loading).

o Experience with **low-code/no-code tools** like Sigma, Streamlit, or Power Apps.

o Familiarity with **data cleaning and validation techniques**.

o Experience working with large raw data sets and data ETL development including the design and maintenance of data extract, transform and load processes to streamline data collection and management.

o Attention to detail with a focus on data hygiene and documentation including writing clear specs, data dictionaries and pipeline diagrams.

o Computer Science Fundamentals:

§ Understanding of programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and algorithms.

§ Ability to apply data modeling principles and relational database theory & normalization techniques.

§ Understanding of data structures and appropriate usage (arrays, lists, dictionaries, trees).

* **Analytical Skills:**

o Ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.

o Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.

o Basic understanding of KPIs and metrics, preferably in a supply chain or operations context.

o Ability to answer business problems and present findings to stakeholders leveraging appropriate visualization technique.

* **Business & Functional Understanding:**

o Knowledge of **supply chain processes** (product development, sourcing, procurement, production, inventory, logistics) is preferred.

o Understanding of ERP systems such as **SAP** or similar platforms is an advantage.

* **Soft Skills:**

o Good problem-solving and logical thinking ability.

o Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

o Ability to manage tasks independently and follow structured processes (SOP-driven environment)

o Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

* **Nice to Have / Additional Skills**

o Knowledge of **apparel/retail supply chain** or manufacturing domain.

o Internship or academic project involving **dashboard creation or data analysis**.

description:

MOBILE CORE NOC SPECIALIST

Job Description

Experience 10+ years, including substantial hands-on Ericsson Mobile Core experience

Location India – Preferred Location Noida/Chennai

Role summary

Mobile Core NOC specialist with proven hands-on especially Ericsson Core operations experience, responsible for technical transition readiness, service assurance validation and evidence-based operational acceptance across 4G EPC, 5G Core and associated voice/core platforms. Validate network knowledge, alarms, procedures, tooling, access, fault restoration and operational readiness

Key accountabilities

* Mobile Core domain readiness and technical evidence tracking for one of the leading service provider in Australia.

* Validate knowledge transfer, runbooks, alarm handling, access and troubleshooting capability through hands-on reviews.

* Support core network fault, performance, change and incident scenario testing and closure of readiness gaps.

* Provide accurate technical risk, dependency and readiness inputs to the onshore lead and governance team.

Detailed responsibilities

Mobile Core technical assurance

* Validate operating procedures and fault isolation for EPC/packet core (MME, SGW, PGW, HSS), 5G Core functions (AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM/AUSF as applicable) and IMS/VoLTE interfaces where in scope.

* Review signalling and service flows, including LTE/5G registration, attach, session establishment, mobility, handover and voice service troubleshooting.

* Analyse node alarms, counters, logs, traces and KPI degradation; verify correlation across RAN, transport, IP, signalling and core domains.

* Verify OSS/ENM and other applicable element-management, monitoring and ticketing integrations, user access, dashboards and escalation paths.

Knowledge and documentation management

* Coordinate Mobile Core knowledge-transfer plans, technical demonstrations, shadowing, reverse shadowing and competency assessments.

* Review specific MOPs, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, alarm catalogues, topology, interface maps, known errors and escalation matrices.

* Identify documentation or skills gaps and drive corrective actions with engineering and supplier SMEs.

Operational readiness and process assurance

* Maintain domain readiness matrices covering personnel, shifts, privileges, tools, licenses, procedures, vendor support and operational dependencies.

* Validate incident, major incident, change, problem, performance and capacity management processes

* Witness dry runs for high-severity core alarms, node or link failure, subscriber-impacting incidents, signalling congestion, session failures and rollback scenarios.

* Record test observations, evidence, defects, remediation ownership, retests and sign-off status.

Reporting and stabilisation

* Provide weekly domain status, open risks, critical blockers and evidence-backed recommendations

* Support cutover and early-life operations through alarm trend review, repeat-incident analysis, root-cause inputs and runbook refinement.

* Maintain traceability between readiness criteria, technical validation evidence and acceptance decisions.

Required professional experience

* 10+ years in telecom network operations, service assurance or managed-services transition, with significant hands-on Ericsson

* Mobile Core operations and troubleshooting experience.

* Practical experience with Ericsson EPC and/or 5G Core network functions, service flows, signalling interfaces, alarm analysis, KPI monitoring and fault restoration.

* Experience in multi-vendor mobile networks, NOC operations, ITSM workflows and high-severity incident coordination.

* Experience supporting remote transition, knowledge transfer, operational acceptance and Australian stakeholders is desirable.

Technical and functional competencies

* Ericsson Mobile Core: EPC, 5GC and IMS/VoLTE (as applicable); Ericsson ENM/OSS, CLI, logs, traces and performance counters.

* Protocols and interfaces: Diameter, GTP-C/U, SIP, SCTP, HTTP/2 service-based interfaces, S1/N2/N3 and relevant interworking.

* 4G/5G subscriber and data-session troubleshooting, signalling and call-flow analysis, fault and performance management.

* Incident, change, problem and knowledge management; runbook validation, operational testing and evidence control.

Leadership and behavioural competencies

* Applies independent technical judgement and challenges unsupported operational-readiness claims.

* Explains complex core-network issues clearly to engineers, operations teams and governance stakeholders.

* Works effectively across suppliers, time zones and distributed teams; prioritises critical service risks and escalates promptly.

Education and preferred certifications

* Bachelor degree in telecommunications, electronics, computer science, engineering or equivalent relevant experience.

* Ericsson Mobile Core/EPC/5GC technical training or vendor certifications strongly preferred; ITIL certification advantageous.

Performance indicators

* Mobile Core procedures, access and alarm workflows validated against agreed acceptance criteria.

* No critical technical readiness gap remains unrecorded or without an owner and mitigation.

* Dry-run findings closed with documented retest evidence; accurate and timely.

Working model and role expectations

* Availability across Australia and India time zones, including out-of-hours support for critical operational events.

* Compliance with security, privacy, safety, privileged-access and change-control requirements.

description:

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader

Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Research IT Systems is a people leader accountable for the strategy, delivery, integration, and lifecycle management of digital platforms that enable pharmaceutical research across spectrum. The role leads a team of technical professionals and partners with scientists, product leaders, architects, quality, security, data, and platform teams to translate research priorities into secure, scalable, compliant, and user-centred technology capabilities. This leader will build organizational capability, modernize the research technology landscape, and ensure that laboratory systems, scientific data, automation, and digital workflows accelerate Design-Make-Test-Analyze cycles and high-quality scientific decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
People Leadership & Organisational Capability
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a multi-disciplinary team that may include software engineers, application developers, business systems analysts, technical product owners, integration specialists, and platform leads.
* Set clear objectives, establish accountability, conduct meaningful performance and career-development conversations, and build succession and capability plans.
* Own workforce planning, role design, hiring, onboarding, retention, and the effective use of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.
* Create an inclusive, high-performing culture focused on scientific impact, engineering excellence, customer partnership, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Develop future leaders and delegate platform, product, and delivery accountabilities to appropriate team members while maintaining effective oversight.
* Define team operating mechanisms, capacity plans, communities of practice, and technical standards that enable consistent delivery across multiple products and squads.

Research Technology Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Partner with research scientists and R&D leaders to understand scientific workflows, identify high-value technology opportunities, and shape an integrated Research IT strategy and roadmap.
* Own a portfolio of research systems and capabilities, aligning priorities, investments, resources, dependencies, risks, and outcomes with business and scientific objectives.
* Represent Research IT in governance forums and communicate strategy, progress, decisions, risks, and value to senior stakeholders.
* Build trusted partnerships across Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Data and AI, Cybersecurity, Quality, Privacy, Infrastructure, and global R&D functions.
* Champion user-centred discovery, product adoption, change management, and measurable value realization across scientific communities.
* Monitor external trends in research informatics, laboratory automation, scientific computing, cloud, data, and AI and translate them into pragmatic opportunities.

Research Platforms, Architecture & Integration
  
  

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for research platforms such as ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory instrument integrations, workflow solutions, scientific data platforms, and automation capabilities.
* Define target-state architecture, product roadmaps, integration patterns, reusable services, data flows, and modernization plans in partnership with enterprise and solution architects.
* Ensure solutions are interoperable, scalable, reliable, supportable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and cloud standards.
* Guide technical design decisions across APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, workflow orchestration, data models, identity, observability, and platform engineering.
* Drive rationalization of fragmented applications and technical debt while protecting business continuity and scientific productivity.
* Enable responsible adoption of AI-assisted research and engineering capabilities, with appropriate governance for regulated and validated environments.

Product Delivery & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Lead delivery across multiple products and workstreams using Agile and product operating model principles, from discovery and business case through implementation, adoption, operations, and retirement.
* Establish portfolio governance, delivery cadences, outcome metrics, release plans, dependency management, financial controls, and transparent risk escalation.
* Ensure engineering excellence across secure SDLC, CI/CD, automated testing, validation, documentation, observability, incident management, service management, and production readiness.
* Own service reliability and lifecycle health for assigned platforms, including upgrades, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, vendor roadmaps, technical debt, and end-of-life planning.
* Manage strategic suppliers and delivery partners through clear outcomes, statements of work, service levels, quality measures, performance reviews, and commercial discipline.
* Use operational, adoption, delivery, quality, and financial metrics to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.

Quality, Risk & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure research systems comply with applicable security, privacy, data integrity, records management, intellectual property, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality and business system owners to apply risk-based computer system validation, change control, periodic review, audit-trail review, and inspection-readiness practices where required.
* Maintain clear system ownership, decision rights, controls, documentation, and traceability throughout the technology lifecycle.
* Lead or support major incident, deviation, audit, and corrective-and-preventive-action activities, ensuring root causes and systemic improvements are addressed.
* Promote responsible AI, data stewardship, and secure-by-design behaviours across the team and partner ecosystem.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is advantageous.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in technology product management, software engineering, research informatics, laboratory systems, or enterprise application delivery.
* 7+ years of formal people-leadership experience, including direct management of managers, technical leads, or multiple individual contributors in a matrixed or global environment.
* Demonstrated success building, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams and leading workforce planning, hiring, performance management, and career development.
* Proven ownership of a portfolio of complex technology products or platforms from strategy and investment planning through delivery, operations, modernization, and retirement.
* Experience partnering with scientific or R&D stakeholders and translating complex research needs into practical technology strategies, roadmaps, and solutions.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, application integration, APIs, data management, DevSecOps, observability, and modern engineering practices.
* Experience with laboratory or research systems and integrations, such as ELN, LIMS, SDMS, instrument software, workflow platforms, or scientific data environments.
* Understanding of regulated or validated systems, risk-based computer system validation, data integrity, change control, secure SDLC, and applicable GxP principles.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives, budgets, capacity, vendors, dependencies, risk, quality, and executive-level communications.
* Strong strategic thinking, business acumen, decision-making, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a record of building trusted partnerships across global, cross-functional organizations.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting pharmaceutical discovery, medicinal chemistry, synthetic development, biologics, or other research-intensive life sciences environments.
* Experience leading managers or senior technical leads and scaling a multi-layered organisation across locations.
* Knowledge of Design-Make-Test-Analyze workflows, laboratory automation, scientific computing, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, high-performance computing, or AI/ML-enabled research.
* Experience modernizing legacy research platforms and integrating laboratory systems with cloud, data, workflow, and analytics services.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, product management, Agile, architecture, service management, or project/program management.

title: Sr. Program Manager, Brand Protections
description:

Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
  
  
The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
  
  
**Role**
We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.
* Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.

The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.

* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
description:
**Aliases**

Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands-off-the-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
  
  
You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow-through.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role you will:
  
  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.

**Required Qualifications**
The experience requirement is 11+ years in total, composed of 7+ years in a hands-on individual-contributor technical role and 4+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
  
  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands-on individual-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
The following skill sets would be good to have:
  
  

* SQL or equivalent data-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

title: Localisation Program Manager (Language Launch Architect)
description:
**How to apply:**
we don't review easy-apply profiles. Apply through our form so we can see your real work: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSftspU8WwpSRHz\_-ujUMQpZGqSgaM5TKcAtBg69QW3133Om3w/viewform?usp=pp\_url&entry.1653201307=LinkedIn . It takes about 20 minutes, plus a 60 to 90 second video.

Own Kitab's 10-language initiative end to end: the strategy, the partners, the reviewers, the operations and the on-ground launches, so people across India can read and hear ancient wisdom in their own language.

**About Kitab**

Kitab brings ancient wisdom to modern problems. We turn texts like the Bhagavad Gita into short summaries, audio and guided programs that help people Know, Grow and Free themselves. English and Hindi are live. Next come Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam. Our content is machine-translated and voiced by our own AI pipeline, then checked by native-language reviewers before it goes live. This role makes sure each language launches on time and reads like it was written by a native speaker.

**The role**

On-site in Hyderabad, full-time, 1 opening, reporting to Tameesh Sud. Experience: 3 to 6 years in program management, localisation or product launches. You will lead the 10-language initiative end to end: set the strategy and launch order, bring in the partners and native-language reviewers each language needs, run the operations tracker, and take every language live on the ground with the growth team.

You will own one number: 4 new languages live to users within your first 90 days, each one reviewed before launch and reaching real people. After that, you will turn it into a repeatable launch playbook that takes all 10 languages live.

This is a founder-style role. Ten languages, real launch dates and a lot of moving parts: you'll work across engineering, content, growth and partners, make hard calls, and own the result when something slips.

**What you'll own**

* Language strategy: which languages launch in what order, who each one is for, and what a successful launch looks like in each market.
* Partners: universities for reviewers, translation and voice vendors, and local communities that help us reach people.
* Reviewers: recruit, onboard and run native-language reviewers (interns and freelancers), with clear guidelines, turnaround times and quality scores.
* Operations tracking: one tracker for all 10 languages, with dates, owners, readiness checks, blockers and a go / no-go call for each launch.
* On-ground launches: campus, community and partner activities in each language's region, run with the growth team.
* Quality: work with engineering on the translation and text-to-speech pipeline, set a quality bar per language, and check in-app text, notifications and store listings before launch.
* Reporting: a weekly one-page update on where each language stands, what's blocked and what you need.

**Your scorecard (90 days)**

* 4 languages live to users by day 90 (2 live by day 60)
* Partners signed: 2 by day 30, 5 by day 60, one for every live language by day 90
* One strong reviewer per language: 4 languages covered by day 30, 8 by day 60
* Operations tracker for all 10 languages live by day 30 and used for every go / no-go
* On-ground launch activity for every live language, with installs tracked
* 100% of launch content reviewed before launch, with a quality score

**How AI fits this role**

* Our content is translated and voiced by AI. You decide when its output is good enough to ship, and where people must step in.
* You use AI to spot-check translations at scale, flag tone and terminology issues, and send only the doubtful parts to reviewers.
* You build AI helpers for the job: glossary checks, reviewer guidelines in every language, and weekly status summaries from the tracker.
* Prompt engineering is a core skill: you write, test and save prompts that give reliable translation checks and consistent terminology, and you know when a model is confidently wrong.

**What you bring**

* 3+ years running programs or launches with many moving parts and owners, with dates you hit
* Experience with localisation, multilingual content or a multi-market launch
* You've managed reviewers, vendors or freelancers and held them to quality and time
* Fluent English and at least one Indian language beyond English
* Hands-on with AI tools in your daily work, including writing and testing your own prompts
* Clear, short written updates that leadership can read in a minute
* A founder mindset: you own every launch end to end and treat a slipped date as your problem to solve

**Nice to have:**
two or more of Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam; translation quality checks or text-to-speech work; consumer app launches with store listings in several languages; interest in philosophy, psychology or the Indian wisdom texts.

**Why join**

* Build at an early-stage company with the scope, speed and ownership most people wait years for
* Own a clear, high-impact goal with direct access to the founders
* Bring ancient wisdom to millions of people in their own language
* Build Kitab's language-launch function from the ground up

**How we select**

Form, then we shortlist, then a 20-minute call with Ganesh, a 60-minute assignment (shared only after the call), a round with Tameesh, and a final conversation with Ravi.

Rolling applications, shortlisted every Friday. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Questions or trouble submitting the form? WhatsApp +91 63012 56771 or email hr@kitab.com. We don't take applications by email.

title: Senior Project Manager - Project Controls
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Senior Project Manager - Project Controls**
Milestone is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Controls Business Analyst / Project Manager to support the financial, operational, and governance activities across a portfolio of Information Systems (IS) projects and programs. This role serves as a critical liaison between Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Technology Leadership, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure accurate financial forecasting, project reporting, budget management, and portfolio governance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project controls expertise with business analysis, financial management, and PMO support capabilities. The role requires hands-on ownership of project financials, purchase order management, forecasting, vendor tracking, status reporting, and project governance activities while helping ensure alignment between project execution and broader organizational financial objectives.
  
  
This is a tactical execution-focused position that works directly with project and program teams to maintain financial discipline, reporting accuracy, and operational excellence across a diverse technology portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Financial Management & Controls**

* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost estimates for IS initiatives.
* Build and manage quarterly and ad hoc project financial forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure spend aligns with approved budgets and forecasts.
* Track and manage Capital Expenditures (CapEx) and Operational Expenditures (OpEx).
* Maintain project balance sheets and assist with financial reconciliation activities.
* Support monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
* Create and maintain cost tracking models and financial dashboards.
* Analyze project financial performance and identify budget variances, risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare and present financial reports for project teams, leadership, and portfolio stakeholders.
* Support Long-Range Estimates (LEs) and financial planning activities.
* Prepare and maintain Total Cost Management (TCM) reports and related financial controls documentation.
* Understand and communicate how project financials impact departmental budgets and overall P&L performance.

**Procurement, Vendor & Invoice Management**

* Create, submit, and track Purchase Orders (POs) throughout the procurement lifecycle.
* Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, and vendors to ensure timely PO processing and invoice payments.
* Review Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, contract amendments, and vendor funding requests.
* Monitor vendor invoices for accuracy and alignment to contractual agreements.
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues.
* Conduct monthly vendor spend reviews and validate vendor cost reporting across multiple suppliers.
* Track committed costs versus actual expenditures and identify financial risks.
* Support vendor onboarding and purchasing processes using established company policies and procedures.

**Project Controls & Portfolio Governance**

* Establish and maintain project financial controls and governance processes.
* Monitor project performance metrics, budget adherence, resource allocations, and financial health indicators.
* Ensure project data, documentation, and reporting artifacts remain current and audit-ready.
* Maintain project repositories, PMO documentation, governance records, and portfolio data.
* Support project intake, funding approvals, and investment lifecycle management (ILM) activities.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise project management standards, processes, and controls.

**PMO & Program Support**

* Facilitate weekly and bi-weekly meetings with Project Managers, Program Managers, Portfolio Managers, and IS Leadership.
* Support program governance activities, reviews, and steering committee preparation.
* Coordinate status collection, reporting cycles, action items, decisions, and risk tracking.
* Review, maintain, and enhance project dashboards and portfolio reporting.
* Assist in the preparation and delivery of executive-level presentations and status communications.
* Manage project documentation repositories, PMO vaults, and project records.
* Support resource planning, project prioritization, and portfolio visibility initiatives.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare monthly project and portfolio dashboards highlighting budget, forecast, risks, milestones, and overall health.
* Create executive reporting packages and management presentations.
* Develop financial analyses that support strategic decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reports related to project performance, vendor performance, financial trends, and portfolio metrics.
* Analyze complex data sets and present findings in a clear, business-focused format.
* Recommend process improvements to increase reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner closely with IS Leaders, Finance teams, Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Procurement, and vendor partners.
* Build strong relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
* Facilitate discussions regarding budgets, forecasts, funding requests, prioritization, and project performance.
* Communicate project financial risks, assumptions, and recommendations to leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 12+ years of experience supporting IT/IS projects in a Financial Analyst, Project Controls Analyst, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, PMO Analyst, or Business Analyst capacity.
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial reporting, and procurement processes.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
* Strong understanding of project financial controls, budgeting, CapEx, OpEx, and cost management practices.
* Experience with vendor management, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and SOW administration.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, financial modeling, and reporting automation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, CAPM, PMI-PBA, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology portfolios or PMO organizations.
* Experience with financial planning, portfolio management, and investment governance processes.
* Knowledge of IT financial management and technology investment practices.
* Experience working within large-scale infrastructure, digital transformation, ERP, cloud, or application development programs.

**Required Tools & Technologies**

* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Microsoft 365 / O365
* SAP
* Ariba
* Annaplan
* Smartsheet
* Microsoft Teams
* Power BI (preferred)
* SharePoint
* Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) tools

**Required 5 days onsite Hyderabad covering US hours**

title: Senior Civil Engineer – Premium Residential Villas
description:
**Company Description**
Aurean Eskar Ventures LLP is a growing engineering and infrastructure venture based in Hyderabad, focused on delivering high-quality civil engineering and construction solutions. The firm works on a range of projects that require strong technical expertise, sound planning, and adherence to industry standards. Team members collaborate closely to design and execute projects that meet client requirements while maintaining safety and sustainability. The organization values professional integrity, continuous learning, and a practical, results-oriented approach to project delivery.

**Role Description**
The candidate should be capable of independently managing villa construction from structural works through interior fit-outs and final handover, while maintaining premium quality standards, timelines, and budgets.

**1. Educational qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
* Diploma in Civil Engineering may be considered only for candidates with substantial relevant experience and proven execution capabilities.
* Additional certifications in Project Management, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or Quality Control would be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD; familiarity with MS Project or Primavera P6 is preferred.

**2. Experience requirements**

Recommended experience: 5–8 years

* Minimum 5 years of overall experience in civil construction.
* At least 3 years of experience in premium residential projects, luxury villas, or high-end independent houses.
* Hands-on experience in both civil construction and interior fit-out execution.
* Experience coordinating multiple contractors, consultants, architects, MEP teams, and specialist vendors.
* Experience in project execution in Hyderabad or similar urban residential markets would be an advantage.

**3. Mandatory technical knowledge and experience**

The candidate should have practical knowledge of the following areas:

RCC and structural works: Foundations, footings, columns, beams, slabs, reinforcement, shuttering and concreting

Masonry and plastering: AAC blocks, brickwork, internal/external plastering and finishing

Waterproofing: Toilets, balconies, terraces, swimming pools, basements and retaining walls

Flooring and stone works: Italian marble, granite, engineered stone, vitrified tiles and wooden flooring

Interior fit-outs: Gypsum ceilings, partitions, carpentry, modular kitchens, wardrobes and decorative panelling

Premium finishes: Veneer, laminate, PU/duco paint, texture paint, wall cladding, glass and metal finishes

Doors and windows: Aluminium, UPVC, wooden doors, hardware, glazing and façade interfaces

External development: Landscaping coordination, compound walls, paving, driveways and outdoor features

MEP coordination: Electrical, plumbing, drainage, HVAC, firefighting, home automation and lighting

Handover

Snagging, defect rectification, testing, commissioning and final handover

**Particular emphasis should be given to premium finishing works.**
Experience in ordinary apartment construction alone may not be sufficient for luxury villa projects.

**4. Project management and commercial capabilities**

The Senior Civil Engineer should be capable of independently handling:

* Preparation and monitoring of daily, weekly and monthly work schedules.
* BOQ verification, quantity estimation and material reconciliation.
* Contractor quotation evaluation and technical comparison.
* Site measurements and contractor RA bill verification.
* Material procurement planning and wastage control.
* Labour and subcontractor deployment.
* Budget monitoring and cost-control measures.
* Drawing coordination between architects, structural consultants, interior designers and MEP consultants.
* Identification of drawing discrepancies and preparation of technical queries.
* Preparation of daily progress reports, weekly MIS and site photographs.
* Quality inspections, checklists and method statement implementation.
* Coordination of testing, commissioning, snagging and handover.

**5. Software and computer skills**

AutoCAD: Good – drawing reading, marking and basic modifications

MS Excel: Very good – BOQ, measurements, costing and progress trackers

MS Word: Good – technical reports and documentation

MS Project: Basic to good – project scheduling

Primavera P6: Added advantage

SketchUp / Revit: Added advantage for design and coordination

**6. Personal and managerial competencies**

* Ability to independently manage a villa construction site.
* Strong communication and coordination with architects, consultants, clients and contractors.
* Good decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail, particularly for premium finishes.
* Ability to identify execution defects before they become major rework issues.
* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
* Ownership, accountability and commitment to project deadlines.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, Telugu and Hindi.
