title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the service transformation teams**
Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.
  
  
**Turn architecture into shipped services**
Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered.
  
  
**Establish the base service tier**
Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.
  
  
**Protect compatibility and business continuity**
Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.
  
  
**Modernize the application foundations**
Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.
  
  
**Raise the bar for engineering quality**
Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.
  
  
**Drive AI-native ways of working**
Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.
  
  
**Hire and grow strong engineers**
Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through.
  
  
**Partner across the program**
Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed.
  
  
**What This Is Not**
This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.
  
  
This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Proven engineering leadership**
Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.
  
  
**Service transformation depth**
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.
  
  
**Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency**
Enough hands-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.
  
  
**Migration safety instincts**
You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
**Quality and operational discipline**
You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.
  
  
**People development**
You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.
  
  
**Cross-functional execution**
You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
**An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**
You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
**Bonus Points**
Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.
  
  
Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.
  
  
Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).
  
  
Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
**The base service tier becomes real**
Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.
  
  
**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**
Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.
  
  
**The platform compounds**
New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.
  
  
**The team gets stronger**
Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.
  
  
**Why This Matters**
Everything ABC is building — the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform — stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted.
  
  
This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

description:
**Role and Company Overview**
:

LEDFlex, a pioneer in linear LED luminaires, has been designing, developing, and manufacturing innovative linear LED lighting solutions for over 10 years, with a strong focus on performance, sustainability, and energy efficiency. Our products illuminate everything from commercial spaces to architectural landmarks, combining functionality with refined design.

We are seeking a Lighting Project Engineer to assist in designing, planning, and executing lighting projects across Asia/India. You will work closely with senior engineers, clients, and contractors to deliver efficient, high-quality lighting solutions that meet performance standards and client expectations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, technical challenges, and contributing to cutting-edge projects.

:

• Develop detailed lighting designs, layouts, and schematics using AutoCAD or similar software.

• Prepare and revise Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and Bills of Materials (BOM) based on project requirements and feedback.

• Handle project design preparations, including tender documents.

• Coordinate with multiple departments to ensure accurate and timely design deliverables.

• Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to LED drivers, control systems (DALI, DMX), wiring configurations, and other electrical components.

• Perform system testing, validation, and commissioning to ensure compliance with performance standards and specifications.

• Support the Product and Sales teams with Lighting Control System Design and BOQ preparation.

• Attend technical meetings with the sales team and coordinate with contractors, site supervisors, and project managers for proper project execution.

• Conduct on-site technical meetings, supervision, and testing as required.

• Oversee assembly processes and special product testing to ensure quality and functionality.

• Train installation/project teams, distributors, and engineers from distributors on the proposed systems, as needed.

• Lead project commissioning activities to ensure successful handover.

**Documentation:**

• Maintain accurate records of project documentation, including drawings, BOQs, progress reports, and technical specifications.

• Ensure all documentation is up-to-date and accessible for reference during project phases.

**Collaboration:**

• Work closely with senior engineers, clients, and contractors to ensure smooth project execution.

• Provide technical expertise and support during all project phases, from planning to installation and commissioning.

• Foster collaboration across departments to align project goals and deliverables.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience:**

• Diploma or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field.

• Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Gain exposure to all stages of product development and management.

• Work on exciting projects that make a real impact in the market.

• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.

•

•
**Annual Leave**
: As per labour laws.

• Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive team environment with room for personal and professional growth.

**Job Type**

: Madhapur, Hyderabad

Interested candidates are invited to send their resumes to

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
UWorld is a worldwide leader in online test prep for college entrance, undergraduate, graduate, and professional licensing exams throughout the United States. Since 2003, over 5 million students have trusted us to help them prepare for high-stakes examinations.

We are looking for a hands-on Desktop Support Engineer to support our internal IT environment and employees. You will look after our Windows and macOS devices, manage employee identities and access in Google Workspace, and maintain our office network and FortiGate firewalls.

You will be the go-to person for our teams' day-to-day IT issues and own company hardware, from custom-built PCs and high-end workstations down to individual components. The role also covers our biometric systems and CCTV cameras.

Key responsibilities

**Internal IT support (Windows and macOS)**

* Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows 10/11 and macOS devices, including imaging and onboarding.
* Support Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar), business applications, VPN clients and printers, and keep patches up to date.

**Identity and access management (IAM)**

* Manage user accounts, groups, organisational units and access in the Google Workspace Admin console.
* Handle password resets, MFA, SSO issues and joiner/mover/leaver processes.

**FortiGate firewall and security**

* Administer FortiGate firewall policies, NAT, web filtering and SSL/IPsec VPN.
* Monitor logs, maintain firmware and escalate security incidents.

**Routers, switches and networking**

* Configure and maintain routers, switches and Wi-Fi, including VLANs, DHCP and DNS.
* Troubleshoot LAN and internet connectivity and coordinate with ISPs.

**Day-to-day IT support**

* Resolve employees' IT tickets within internal SLAs, in person and remotely, escalating when needed.
* Maintain IT documentation and knowledge-base articles.

**Hardware**

* Build, configure and maintain custom-built PCs and high-end workstations for performance-heavy work.
* Diagnose and replace components such as CPUs, motherboards, RAM, graphics cards (GPUs), power supplies, storage and cooling.
* Plan hardware upgrades, check component compatibility, and run stress and stability tests.
* Repair desktops, laptops, Macs, printers and peripherals, and manage warranty claims with vendors.
* Maintain the IT asset inventory and spares stock for critical components.

**Biometric and CCTV systems**

* Install, configure and maintain biometric attendance and access-control devices, including user enrolment and data sync.
* Manage CCTV cameras, DVR/NVR systems and storage, including recording, retention, remote viewing and footage retrieval.
* Troubleshoot camera, device and network connectivity issues and coordinate with security vendors.

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

* 3 - 5 years of hands-on experience in desktop support or IT infrastructure support.
* Must have strong hardware skills: building and troubleshooting custom PCs and high-end workstations, and diagnosing and replacing CPUs, motherboards, RAM, GPUs, PSUs and storage.
* Strong working knowledge of both Windows (10/11, Windows Server basics) and macOS environments.
* Practical experience with IAM in the Google Workspace Admin console (users, groups, OUs, 2-Step Verification, SAML SSO); exposure to Okta or Active Directory is a plus.
* Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting FortiGate firewalls, including policies and SSL/IPsec VPN.
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, DNS and routing, with experience on routers, managed switches and Wi-Fi.
* Experience with biometric attendance/access-control systems and CCTV, DVR/NVR and IP camera management.
* Proven track record of resolving day-to-day IT issues through a ticketing system (e.g. Freshservice, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Google endpoint management and MDM tools such as Jamf for macOS.

**Soft Skills:**

* Clear communication with colleagues across all teams, both written and verbal.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with a calm, service-minded approach.
* Ability to prioritise multiple tickets and work independently.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts as per the team roster, including weekends when scheduled, and to support urgent outages or maintenance.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, Data center engineering operation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Amazon is expanding the Data Center management team in India. This position serves as the primary operational resource to support ADSIPL within its owned and operated Data Centers in India. This position will provide a central point of ownership and accountability for the overall ‘hands-on’ management of the Mechanical, Electrical (M&E) and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers in India. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Following are the primary responsibilities (but not limited to) of Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer:  
  
Operations and Maintenance:  

* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
* Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
* Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
* Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
* Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

  
Incident and Emergency Response:  
o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.  
o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.  
o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.  
o Ensure 24\*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.  
  
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* High school or equivalent diploma
* Knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)
* 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of data center engineering experience
* 3+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience
* Electrical or mechanical journeyman license
* operating engineering license such as DC II, DC III, or equivalent
* Experience in construction or project management

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.

This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

The Staff Engineer I role is a full stack engineering position that builds end-to-end product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript), ensuring the platform's user-facing capabilities are functional, reliable, and usable by consultants and clients in live engagements. Full Stack Engineers own specific feature areas within Artemis and the broader Demand Generation Suite product workstreams and are responsible for both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users. For Artemis, this includes the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client-ready output views.

This is a delivery-focused engineering role. The ability to ship complete, tested features independently — without waiting for a backend or frontend specialist to hand off — is the core contribution. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, leading troubleshooting efforts, directing code deployments, and mentoring junior engineers. 

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Feature Development

* Own and implement complete features spanning backend API logic and React frontend components for Artemis product areas. Take features from specification through to tested, deployed code across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, ensuring request/response contracts are documented, versioned, and tested. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.

Frontend and Data Visualization 

* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, with a focus on marketing analytics interfaces: channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, model configuration workflows, and executive-ready recommendation outputs.

title: AI Business Partner (Co-Creation) | Senior Associate
description:
**About Interpath**
Interpath is an independent financial advisory business with a broad range of specialisms, operating in an agile, independent and conflict-free setting. We offer a full spectrum of restructuring services, from business performance improvement and value creation through to stress, distress and insolvency. Our advisory practice also includes corporate finance, transaction services, valuations, debt advisory, tax, pensions, forensic accounting and e-discovery. We help clients create, defend, preserve, sustain and grow value through the cycle, working with businesses and their stakeholders across the market, from regional SMEs to large, complex multinational organisations.
  
  
**About The AI CoE**
Interpath's AI Centre of Excellence designs and builds AI solutions with practices across the firm, taking high-impact use cases from idea to production. The India team is small and hands-on: five people — an AI CoE Lead, two AI Engineers, a Data & Platform Engineer and an AI Business Partner — working as one squad with the Head of AI and practice teams across the firm.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will spend most of your time with the practices, not in the CoE. Your job is to understand what people actually need: how work really gets done, where the hours and frustration go, and which problems are worth solving with AI. You turn that understanding into clear use-case briefs the build team can act on, and you lead co-creation with the practices: shaping use cases with fee earners and keeping them involved through build and launch, so what we deliver is theirs as much as ours.
  
  
**Requirements**
****Key responsibilities:****
***Understanding the business***

* Build working relationships with partners, directors and fee earners across deals, restructuring and other practices
* Spend time inside teams: shadow engagements, sit in on workflows and learn where the time goes
* Map how work actually gets done, including volumes, time spent, hand-offs and workarounds, not just the official process

***Finding and shaping opportunities***

* Run discovery sessions and workshops to surface needs and pain points
* Turn needs into clear problem statements and use-case briefs: who it's for, what good looks like, what data exists and the rough value
* Help the CoE Lead prioritise with honest assessments of value, readiness and business appetite
* Keep an opportunity pipeline per practice, so the build team always knows what's coming

***Bridging to the build team***

* Be the voice of the user during build; bring business experts in to review prototypes and give feedback early and often
* Work with those experts to agree real examples and what a correct answer looks like, so engineers know what they're aiming for
* Translate the context engineers can't get themselves: terminology, regulatory constraints and the reasons behind each step

***Driving adoption***
Make launches land: user onboarding, champions in each team, and feedback flowing into the next iteration.
  
  
Go back after launch to check the tool is actually used and saving time.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years in business analysis, consulting or transformation, ideally in professional or financial services
* Proven ability to run discovery and workshops, map processes and turn needs into clear problem statements
* Credibility with senior fee earners, and the confidence to ask "why do you do it that way?"
* Working fluency in AI / GenAI: what it can and can't do, enough to judge feasibility. No coding required
* Strong written communication: concise briefs that both the business and engineers can act on

**Preferred (nice To Have)**

* A background in deals, restructuring, forensic or other advisory work
* Experience defining success measures and tracking benefits
* Change or adoption experience, e.g. champion networks and training
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**

* A live opportunity pipeline for each priority practice
* Every build starts from a clear brief with agreed examples of good output
* Launched tools are in regular use, with measured time saved

**Benefits**
**Benefits**
At Interpath, our people are at the heart of our business. That's why we provide employees with a competitive and comprehensive reward package, including compelling salaries, opportunities for progression, and a range of core and optional benefits.
  
  
Hybrid working policy which includes a minimum of 3 days in the office at all levels.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values shape how we work with colleagues and clients:
  
  

* Embrace different — We welcome different cultures, perspectives and mindsets
* Do the right thing — We make principled decisions, even when they are not the easiest option
* All hands on deck — We work together, drawing on individual expertise to deliver results
* Passion drives success — We challenge the status quo and focus on delivering positive outcomes for our clients

G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.

Myna is the AI coworker for front desk operations at multi-location healthcare and dental brands. She answers every call, identifies the patient, asks the right screening questions, negotiates a time that works, and confirms by text — so practices can book appointments, deflect routine calls, and improve access to care without adding front desk staff.
  
  
Myna runs across every location, carries brand and location context into every conversation, and works alongside Birdeye's marketing and CX coworkers — so the same platform that gets a patient to call, gets them booked.
  
  
Myna runs on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations across EHRs, PMSs, and CRMs. Myna is an AI-native company funded by Birdeye. Learn more at myna.ai.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a customer-focused Implementation Specialist to own the end-to-end deployment of Birdeye's AI and voice solutions. This role will work closely with customers, IT teams, FDEs, Product, and Engineering to configure, test, and launch solutions successfully.

* Backend tooling or custom backend logic
* Building or modifying APIs or engineering tools
* Custom engineering/SOW development

These requirements will be identified and coordinated with FDE/Engineering, while
  
  
Implementation owns the customer communication, testing, and delivery.

title: Sr IT Engineer, Collaboration
description:
**Sr IT Engineer, Collaboration**
=================================

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

  

**Position Overview**

McCormick & Company is seeking a Sr IT Engineer, Collaboration to provide technical leadership and architectural direction for our global collaboration and workplace technology ecosystem.

  

The Collaboration Engineer will be responsible for shaping the architecture, engineering standards, governance, and multi-year technology direction across Microsoft 365, enterprise conferencing, digital signage, Microsoft 365 Copilot and emerging AI-powered workplace technologies

  

The role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to influence enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, workplace technology, communications, business stakeholders, and strategic partners. The successful candidate will operate within an Agile product-line model as a subject-matter expert and trusted technical advisor, translating business and technology strategy into secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable solutions.

  

This role is also required to participate in the creation and approval of new standards as part of an architectural standards board and support the global architectural function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Teams Calling, and compliance capabilities.
* Define architecture patterns, engineering standards, governance, and lifecycle management practices across collaboration platforms.
* Drive standardization, governance, service lifecycle management, and continuous improvement across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
* Develop and maintain architecture documentation, technical standards, reference architectures, and operational guidance.
* Compose, review, and approve solution designs, technical standards, and infrastructure changes.
* Partner with security teams to implement identity, access controls, API management and data protection using Entra ID, Conditional Access, and M365 compliance frameworks.
* Incorporate Microsoft Purview and Microsoft 365 compliance capabilities, including information protection, data loss prevention, retention, eDiscovery, and auditing, as applicable to business requirements.
* Solution and standardize enterprise video conferencing ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft Teams Rooms, Crestron, Poly).
* Lead technology evaluations and hardware standards for conferencing hardware and software.
* Lead multi-year roadmaps for M365, conferencing technology, and digital signage aligned to business strategy.
* Ensure platforms meet performance, resiliency, and security requirements.
* Provide technical direction for large-scale deployments, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership across architecture, engineering, operations, security, and project teams.
* Serve as the technical point of contact across IT, Communications, Workplace Technology, and external partners.
* Evaluate and manage vendor solutions, licensing models, and service SLAs.
* Identify opportunities for automation, reduced complexity, and improved user experience across collaboration and communication technologies.
* Establish governance, security, compliance, and lifecycle practices for Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise agent solutions.
* Drive best practices, documentation, and architectural standards.
* Establish governance, security, compliance, and lifecycle management practices for M365 Copilot and agent solutions
* Mentor engineering teams and promote technical best practices, documentation, architecture standards, and knowledge sharing.
  

**Level of Education and Discipline**

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field; graduate degree an asset.  
  
  
  
**Certification and/or Licenses**

Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365, Teams, Azure, security, or enterprise architecture are considered assets.  
  
  
  
**Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen**

* 12+ years in architecture or engineering roles with deep experience in Microsoft 365 and collaboration platforms with proven experience leading complex technology designs, migrations, platform transformations, or modernization programs.
* 6+ years designing and delivering engineering solutions for large, globally distributed enterprise environments for Microsoft 365 solutions, including 2+ years in a lead/architect role guiding technical teams.
* Technical Expertise in SharePoint Online (IA, site templates, content types/metadata, search), Exchange Online (SPF, DMARK, DKIM), Teams (governance, app integration), Teams Calling, OneDrive, Viva (Connections, Engage, Learning, Goals), Entra ID (User/Device and API Management), Intune, Microsoft Graph and governance/security frameworks
* Copilot for Microsoft 365: Readiness assessments, data/permissions hygiene, governance & safety rails, rollout/adoption patterns
* Copilot Studio for extensions (actions, connectors, data grounding), and integration via Microsoft Graph
* Security & Compliance: Microsoft Purview (Sensitivity Labels, DLP, Records/Retention, eDiscovery/Advanced eDiscovery), Entra ID (group/role design, B2B), external sharing controls, tenant standardization.
Migration & Operations: Content migration planning and execution (e.g., acquisitions/mergers, from file shares/legacy ECM), provisioning frameworks, site lifecycle, monitoring/telemetry, and support models.  

**Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence**

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business risks, options, and recommendations.  
  
  
  
**Other Skills and HPO Competencies**

**Accountable:**

Develops, Builds and configures solutions and integrations in support of the product offerings and strategy. Develops patterns for easy adoption of product and service offerings.

  

**Deliverables:**

  

* **Solution Architecture**: Ability to translate complex business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technology designs.
* **Technical Leadership**: Ability to provide direction, establish standards, and influence technical decisions across multiple teams.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to develop roadmaps and make technology decisions aligned with business outcomes.
* **Security & Governance:** Commitment to secure-by-design principles, data protection, compliance, and responsible AI adoption.
* **Business Partnership:** Ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners.
* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**: Ability to identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and enhanced user experience.
* **Communication**: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Accountability & Execution**: Ability to take ownership of architectural outcomes and drive initiatives from design through implementation.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

**WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?**
--------------------------

As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.

Between our passion for flavor, our 130-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

description:

You will effectively manage demand-run for all application capabilities for Finance & Supply Chain.

This reports directly to the CIO and will bring along deep understanding of Finance & Supply Chain in the space of CPG/ Retail with strong understand of associated technologies.
  
  
**You will demonstrate strong competencies across the following:**
  
  

* Ensures alignment of the domain strategy, vision, and portfolios with business vision across 4 diverse Business units
* Engage with business and IT leaders at regional and global level to define requirements and priorities that aligns with India’s business vision.
* Develops and manages strategic business partnership relationships with CFO & COO office and facilitates effective collaboration and communications with all stakeholders.

* Leads workforce management approach, including the sourcing, training, and development of staff to build a strong pipeline of talent for future.

* 10+ years of information technology experience, ideally in development, implementation, and maintenance of Core enterprise solutions like ERP, Master Data, Financial Planning & Controlling, Purchasing, Warehousing, Transportation, Demand Planning, Order Management etc. in the domain of Finance & Supply chain preferably in Consumer Goods / Retail Industry.

* Previous experience in business process engineering especially in areas of financial operations, Demand / Supply Planning etc. or process improvement involving broad based information systems, utilizing modern tools and techniques (RPA …) to effect business change.
* Experience with core enterprise tools, such as SAP ECC/ S4, SAP SRM, Concur, SAP IBP/ O9/ Anaplan, Order Management Systems for B2C and Integration tools to build a service-oriented architecture.

* Experience in integrating complex, cross-corporate processes and information strategies, and/or designing strategic metrics and scorecards.
* Excellent business acumen and interpersonal skills; able to work across business lines at senior levels to engage, influence and effect change to achieve common goals.
* Analytical skills: outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to effectively drive business, culture and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment.
* Demonstrates an understanding of the existing systems and technologies of the organizations. Works with technology stakeholders to identify and prioritize opportunities for innovation in the existing systems and technology.
* Excellent written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to articulate new ideas and concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills with Knowledge of business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.
* Understand and speak the language of the business
* Trusted and respected as a thought leader who can influence and persuade business and IT leaders.
* Comfortable, experienced, and accomplished at working with business executives, and able to push back in a professional and diplomatic way.
* Highly collaborative and supportive of business and of its ideals and strategies.
* Highly innovative with aptitude for foresight, systems thinking and design thinking.

What’s In It For You
  
  

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal/environmental causes to make concrete difference.

**WHO WE ARE:**  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

The successful candidate will join the MAC research team contributing to the research and development of innovative index solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities:

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related quantitative discipline.
* Around 1-3 years of of relevant experience in quantitative research, financial engineering, derivatives, portfolio analytics or a related field. Strong candidates with relevant academic or internship experience will also be considered.
* Strong, demonstrated expertise in derivatives, including option pricing, and the mechanics of futures, options and other derivative instruments. Experience structuring or valuing products such as covered calls or autocallables is highly valued.
* Hands-on experience implementing portfolio construction methods (optimisation, weighting schemes, rebalancing and risk-control rules).

title: Quantum - Treasury and Risk Manager - Functional Role
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time

**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

**Quantum | Treasury and Risk Manager - Functional Role**

The FIS Enterprise Treasury Client Experience (CX) team provides product support to global clients using Quantum (FIS Treasury and Risk Manager - Quantum Edition). The team investigates functional and technical product issues, manages client communication, coordinates with internal resolver teams, and supports reliable day-to-day use of the Quantum application.

**Role purpose**
================

Analyst Senior, Product Technical Support independently owns complex Quantum client issues from initial assessment through resolution or effective hand-off. The role combines Quantum product knowledge, treasury domain understanding, structured troubleshooting, clear client communication, escalation management, and continuous improvement. This position is focused on CX product support for Quantum or client process execution.

**What you will be doing**
==========================

* Own complex Quantum incidents and service requests from initial assessment through resolution, workaround, or effective hand-off, with clear accountability and timely updates.
* Investigate functional and technical issues using application behavior, logs, SQL queries, configuration details, interfaces, job status, and other available diagnostic evidence.
* Assess business impact and priority, manage escalations, and provide clear and accurate communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide product guidance across Quantum treasury workflows, including cash and liquidity management, payments, bank reconciliation, statements, accounting, reporting, interfaces, and related controls.
* Reproduce reported issues where possible, document findings, and coordinate with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Hosting, Database, Network, and other resolver teams.
* Drive problem investigation and root cause coordination for recurring or high-impact issues, and convert findings into preventive actions, knowledge content, or support process improvements.
* Support client discussions, incident calls, product issue reviews, risk updates, and action tracking for assigned cases.
* Contribute to upgrade, release, testing, configuration, and post-change support activities when product support involvement is required.
* Maintain high-quality ticket updates, investigation notes, handovers, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Guide less experienced support representatives, share Quantum product knowledge, and support quality reviews and case prioritization.
* Work effectively across APJ, EMEA, and US stakeholder groups in a global support environment.
* Follow security, privacy, audit, and service management requirements while handling client information and production issues.

**What you bring**
==================

**Required experience and domain knowledge**
--------------------------------------------

* Relevant experience in product support, client services, treasury management, cash management, payments, banking, or financial application support.
* Hands-on experience supporting a Treasury Management System. Quantum product experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of treasury operations, including cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, bank reconciliation, statements, accounting, and daily treasury controls.
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and problem investigations in an SLA-driven support environment.
* Experience communicating directly with global clients and explaining technical or functional issues in clear business language.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing client issues, and collaborate effectively as part of a global team.
* Willingness to work flexible rotational shifts aligned with the approved support model, if needed.

**Technical and operational skills**
------------------------------------

* Must have 4-7 years of experience of IT Product Support
* Strong functional and technical troubleshooting skills for enterprise financial applications.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, with the ability to analyze data safely for support investigations.
* Ability to interpret application logs, interface status, job results, error messages, configuration details, and monitoring information.
* Understanding of application architecture, integrations, secure file transfer, system dependencies, and hosted or cloud environments.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable service management and defect-tracking tools.
* Good documentation skills for ticket updates, client communication, handovers, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Knowledge of SWIFT messaging and ISO 20022 is advantageous where relevant to supported Quantum workflows.

**Core competencies**
---------------------

* Strong client focus, service ownership, and accountability.
* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to adapt to technical and business audiences.
* Analytical problem solving, structured debugging, and disciplined root cause thinking.
* Sound judgment in complex or ambiguous situations, with effective prioritization and escalation.
* Ability to build trusted client relationships and collaborate across multiple internal teams.
* Attention to detail and a track record of producing high-quality documentation.
* Coaching mindset, knowledge sharing, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

**Qualifications and preferred experience**
===========================================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience with Quantum (FIS Treasury and Risk Manager - Quantum Edition) is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting global banks or corporate treasury clients is advantageous.
* ITIL Foundation, treasury, payments, SQL, cloud, or service management certification is advantageous.
* Experience contributing to knowledge management, automation, monitoring improvements, or support process improvement is preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**What success looks like**
===========================

* Quantum client issues progress with clear ownership, accurate assessment, effective coordination, and timely communication.
* Clients receive confident, transparent, and product-focused support with clear expectations and next steps.
* Complex and recurring issues are converted into reusable knowledge, corrective actions, or process improvements.
* Ticket quality, handovers, and documentation consistently support reliable and audit-ready service delivery.
* Team capability improves through coaching, quality review, and practical Quantum knowledge sharing.
* Cross-functional collaboration leads to faster issue progress and stronger client outcomes.

**What FIS offers you**
=======================

* An opportunity to support global treasury clients using a leading FIS treasury solution.
* Learning and career development across product support, treasury, technology, and client service.
* Exposure to global clients and cross-functional teams.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment focused on ownership, continuous improvement, and client outcomes.
* Health and family protection benefits, career mobility opportunities, learning offerings, and an adaptable home-office work model, subject to applicable company policies.

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

Metro operates in a further 10 countries with its Food Service Distribution (FSD) business and it is thus active in a total of 34 countries.
  
  
MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide Finance, HR, IT & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 12 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.
  
  
Website: https://www.metro-gsc.in
  
  
Company Size: 1100-1200
  
  
Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Type: Privately Held
  
  
Inception: 2011
  
  
**Job Description**
**About us:**
Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.
  
  
Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.
  
  
You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!
  
  
**How you will make an impact?**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Business Value & Data Analyst to ensure that the business impact of our AI initiatives is defined clearly, measured rigorously and validated credibly. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to translate AI use cases into measurable value hypotheses, establish robust baselines and expected-value scenarios, and design appropriate approaches to validate realized impact.
  
  
Using methods such as A/B testing, control-group analysis, hypothesis testing and statistical analysis, you will assess whether observed outcomes can credibly be attributed to AI solutions. You will connect adoption, operational performance and financial outcomes, providing transparent reporting on baseline, expected and realized value across the AI portfolio.
  
  
Beyond measurement and reporting, you will challenge assumptions, identify gaps between projected and actual results, and turn analytical findings into recommendations that help stakeholders make better investment and prioritization decisions. You will validate projected and realised value, assess whether observed outcomes can credibly be attributed to an AI solution, and proactively identify new opportunities within METRO. Working with the Value Management Lead and stakeholders from squads to senior leadership, you will turn analytical findings into actionable recommendations, support alignment and buy-in, and help manage risks related to ethics and data privacy so our AI and Automation platform delivers measurable results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and challenge value hypotheses for AI use cases, translating expected benefits into measurable financial and operational outcomes.

* Determine the appropriate validation approach, including A/B testing, control groups, pre/post analysis, hypothesis testing and statistical significance, based on data availability and use-case characteristics.
* Compare baseline, expected and realized outcomes and determine the extent to which measured improvements can credibly be attributed to the AI intervention.
* Partner with business owners to validate benefits and challenge assumptions, identifying double counting, unsupported claims, external influences and gaps in evidence.
* Translate operational improvements into financial and business value, such as productivity gains, cost avoidance, revenue impact, quality improvement or risk reduction.
* Maintain transparent documentation and dashboards showing baseline, expected value, realized value, adoption, methodology, assumptions and confidence/evidence level for AI use cases.
* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership, clearly distinguishing forecast value from validated/realized value.
* Continuously improve the organization's AI value-measurement framework, standards and governance.

**Qualifications**
**Must-have:**

* Strong analytical and statistical capability.
* Practical experience with experimentation, A/B testing, Hypothesis testing and control-group evaluation.
* Advanced BI and dashboard-development skills.
* Strong SQL skills and experience combining data from multiple sources.
* Ability to translate business questions into measurable KPIs and analytical designs.
* Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Structured working style with strong attention to data quality and traceability.
* Experience using AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support analytics, reporting and insight generation.
* Strong understanding of business-case development, ROI and benefits-realization concepts.
* Ability to translate operational metrics into financial and business outcomes.
* Experience establishing baseline, target and realized-value measurement frameworks.
* Strong ability to challenge assumptions constructively and distinguish correlation from causation.
* Experience working across business, finance, data and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to communicate uncertainty, limitations and statistical findings in business-friendly language.

**Preferred**
**Additional Information**

* Experience with causal inference, forecasting or value modelling.
* Knowledge of AI product performance and adoption measurement.
* Understanding of financial KPIs and business-case calculations.
* Experience automating recurring reporting and analytical workflows using APIs, Power Automate, Python, AI tools or similar technologies.

title: Operations & Working Capital Analyst
description:
**Summary**

Pelsis Group is a global manufacturer and supplier of pest control, garden care and environmental solutions.

We are looking for an
**Operations & Working Capital Analyst**
to turn complex data into clear insights that improve performance across our global Operations & Supply Chain function.

Working closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Technical and Finance, you will provide visibility of inventory, working capital, procurement spend, savings and operational performance. Your analysis will help leaders understand what is driving results, where risks are emerging and where action can deliver improvements.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys investigating data, explaining the story behind the numbers and supporting practical business decisions.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Improve working capital and inventory visibility:**
  Analyse inventory levels, movements and turns across sites, portfolios and the Group, helping teams understand performance drivers and improvement opportunities.
* **Highlight inventory risks:**
  Identify excess and obsolete stock, assess associated financial exposure and track progress against improvement actions.
* **Support planning and forecasting:**
  Work with Operations, Supply Chain and Finance on working capital budgets and forecasts, ensuring operational and financial reporting align.
* **Strengthen procurement insight:**
  Analyse direct and indirect spend across suppliers, categories, functions and sites to identify sourcing, consolidation and savings opportunities.
* **Track savings and benefits:**
  Maintain procurement savings pipelines, monitor implementation and work with Finance to support validation of realised benefits.
* **Explain operational performance:**
  Report on key measures including labour performance, overhead recovery, productivity, inventory and cost-to-serve, highlighting significant variances against budgets and forecasts.
* **Support investment and improvement decisions:**
  Provide analysis for initiatives involving capital investment, automation, sourcing changes, cost optimisation and process improvements.
* **Build better reporting:**
  Develop useful dashboards and analytical tools, improve data accuracy and consistency, and automate recurring reporting where possible.
* **Create consistent ways of working:**
  Support common KPI definitions, maintain reporting documentation and controls, and work with IT, Finance and operational teams to strengthen underlying data.
* **Support product cost visibility:**
  Work with Technical and Finance to improve understanding of R&D expenditure and relevant product costs.

**What You’ll Bring**

You are analytical, curious and proactive, with the ability to move from detailed data to a clear explanation of what it means for the business. You build effective relationships and communicate findings confidently to colleagues with different levels of financial and technical knowledge.

**Essential**

* Strong analytical experience within operations, supply chain, procurement, finance or a comparable environment.
* Advanced Excel and data-analysis skills.
* Experience working with large, complex datasets and translating findings into clear business insights.
* A strong understanding of financial and operational performance measures.
* A good understanding of inventory and working capital principles.
* The ability to analyse performance against budgets and forecasts and explain key variances and drivers.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to non-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive approach to identifying problems and improvement opportunities.
* The ability to balance recurring reporting with ad hoc analytical priorities.

**Desirable**

* Experience within manufacturing, supply chain or procurement.
* Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
* Experience analysing direct or indirect procurement spend and savings.
* Familiarity with ERP and inventory-management systems.
* A qualification in finance, supply chain, procurement or an analytical discipline.

**What We Offer**

* A role supporting performance improvement across a global Operations & Supply Chain network.
* The opportunity to influence decisions on working capital, procurement, cost and productivity.
* Exposure to a broad range of operational and commercial challenges.
* Close collaboration with colleagues across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Technical and Finance.
* Scope to improve reporting, introduce automation and see your analysis translate into practical action.

**If you enjoy turning data into insight and helping teams improve business performance, we would love to hear from you.**
