The Investment Platform team is a central team within Investment Transformation and Technology, with a global remit supporting M&G’s investment platform and the delivery of change across the organisation.
  
  
This is a Vice President - Business Analysis role combining enterprise-level BA leadership with Asset Management domain expertise.
  
  
The role will shape analysis strategy, influence business and technology roadmaps, lead complex cross-functional transformation and establish a mature, consistent and outcome-led BA capability across teams.
  
  
The role requires a leader who can operate credibly across the broader Asset Management lifecycle while bringing strong Private Markets knowledge across investment origination, due diligence, deal execution, asset onboarding, portfolio management, valuations, cash flows, investment operations, data, reporting and the associated control environment.
  
  
The role will be expected to move comfortably between strategic leadership and hands-on analysis, translating executive priorities into sustainable operating models, technology and data outcomes while developing senior BAs and strengthening the wider BA profession.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSABILITIES:**

* Deliver Stories: Ensure timely delivery of user stories and other project deliverables within agreed timelines.
* Business Case Development: Lead the creation of business cases and associated operating models for projects, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Benefits Realisation: Assist the Project/Programme Manager in identifying and defining benefits and managing their realisation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Requirements Gathering: Produce detailed requirements (including epics and user stories) through interviews, analysis, workshops, prototyping, data analysis, and workflow analysis.
* Information Evaluation: Critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Stakeholder Communication: Proactively communicate and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand information needs, functional requirements, existing capabilities, and feasibility.
* Independent Work: Act as a self-starter, working independently and with users to define concepts under the direction of the Project/Programme/Change Manager.
* Project Team Collaboration: Drive and challenge project team members on their assumptions and plans to ensure successful execution.
* Analytical Skills: Leverage strong analytical skills to interpret customer business needs and translate them into operational requirements.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrate critical problem solving skills when presenting design/solution options.
* Business As Usual: Have end to end awareness of the business outcome and how that is going to be implemented and landed successfully in BAU, thereby ensuring existing working functionalities are not impacted.
* Risk Identification: Ensure concerns to project delivery are raised through appropriate channels, and risks, if any, are highlighted on timely basis.
* Technical Vision: Collaborate with implementation teams and subject matter experts to establish the technical vision and analyse trade-offs between usability and performance needs.
* Specification Compliance: Ensure technology builds or business processes meet specifications and participate in test preparation and execution.
* External Documentation: Contribute to key external-facing documents such as Service Level Agreements and manage third-party analysis deliverables, focusing on quality and relevance.
* Operational Readiness: Work with business teams to facilitate operational readiness and ensure smooth transitions.
* Solution Validation: Ensure the overall solution meets agreed objectives and expectations set by the project and programme.
* Test Planning Alignment: Align test planning with the Test Manager and Project Manager to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Training Documentation: Lead the responsibility for handing over training documentation and conducting training sessions as needed.

**Key Stakeholder Management**
Internal: M&G Investments, Investment teams, Private Markets stakeholders, Investment Operations, Technology & Engineering, Architecture, Data, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Change and Delivery.
  
  
External: Third-party technology/data providers and other external partners where required by the change initiative.
  
  
****Knowledge And Skills - Key****

* Leadership: Demonstrable experience leading and developing experienced BA teams, setting direction, raising standards and building sustainable BA capability.
* BA Maturity: Proven experience assessing BA capability maturity and implementing practical improvements to methods, governance, quality, knowledge management and professional development.
* Asset Management: Broad end-to-end knowledge of the Asset Management industry, including investment management, portfolio processes, investment operations, risk, compliance, data and reporting.
* Strategic Analysis: Ability to connect enterprise strategy to capabilities, operating models, processes, data, technology and measurable outcomes.
* Stakeholder Influence: Executive-level communication and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and align senior stakeholders with different priorities.
* Requirements Definition: Proven ability to lead business and technical requirements definition across large, complex programmes and products.
* Business Analysis Practice: Expert knowledge of BA tools, techniques and standards across requirements, process, data, impact assessment, options analysis and benefits.
* Technology: Strong understanding of technology-enabled change. Exposure to Aladdin or comparable investment/portfolio platforms is beneficial.
* Delivery: Strong understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall delivery and practical experience working with technology teams; Jira and Confluence experience is beneficial.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, structured problem solving and ability to evaluate complex information and challenge the status quo.
* Risk and Controls: Strong risk mindset and ability to identify business, operational, data and delivery risks and support appropriate mitigation.

****Experience****

* Minimum 17+ years of total professional experience, with substantial Business Analysis and change/transformation experience in Asset Management or closely related investment management environments.
* Significant experience operating at senior leadership level, with accountability for BA quality, capability development, stakeholder influence, and complex cross-functional outcomes.
* Demonstrable Asset Management experience to lead analysis beyond a single asset class or process area.
* Experience managing, coaching and developing senior Business Analysts and creating career/capability pathways within a BA organisation.
* Proven experience improving or maturing a BA practice, including standards, governance, reusable knowledge, quality assurance and continuous improvement.
* Experience leading analysis across large-scale business and technology transformation involving multiple teams, locations, platforms, and senior stakeholders.

****Education And Qualifications****
Graduate in any discipline.
  
  
Relevant professional qualifications in Business Analysis, Asset Management, Change, Agile or related disciplines are desirable.
  
  
**M&G Behaviours relevant to all roles:**
*Tell it like it is*
: Respectfully speaking up to create better ways forward – both direct and empathetic
  
  
*Own it now*
: Putting your name on things with confidence to drive progress and results quickly
*Moving it forward Together*
: forming cross functional teams to seize the right opportunities and solve real problems
  
  
*With Care and integrity*
…
  
  

* Strategy, Transformation and Enterprise Analysis: Shape business analysis direction for complex investment-platform change; translate strategic outcomes into executable roadmaps; and lead target-state analysis, capability assessment, option evaluation, process design and operating-model definition to deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Private Markets Leadership: Provide senior BA leadership across Private Markets change, ensuring requirements and solutions reflect the distinctive lifecycle, operating model, data and control needs of private assets.
* Asset Management Domain Leadership: Apply end-to-end understanding of Asset Management, connecting Front Office investment activity with middle/back-office operations, risk, compliance, finance, data and client/regulatory reporting.
* BA Capability Maturity: Assist the Head of Business Analysis and progressively mature BA standards, methods, governance, artefacts and quality controls. Establish pragmatic maturity measures, identify capability gaps, and lead continuous improvement across the BA lifecycle.
* Leadership and Team Development: Lead, coach and mentor senior and lead BAs; establish clear expectations of what good looks like at each level of BA seniority; and use these expectations to guide development, succession, deployment, domain capability and leadership bench strength while fostering a high-performance, inclusive culture.
* BA Community and Consistency: Build reusable practices, templates, playbooks and knowledge assets and drive consistent application of fit-for-purpose BA techniques across programmes and product teams.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior Investment, Operations, Technology, Data, Risk and Change stakeholders; challenge constructively, create alignment and communicate options, dependencies, risks and decisions clearly.
* Business Case Development: Lead creation of business cases and associated operating models, ensuring alignment to strategic goals.
* Benefits Realisation: Establish and oversee benefits realisation, defining measurable outcomes and working with programme/project leaders and business stakeholders to track delivery and drive corrective action.
* Requirements and Traceability: Lead business and technical requirements definition across large, complex initiatives and maintain traceability from strategic outcomes and obligations through design, acceptance criteria, testing and benefits.
* Data and Non-functional Requirements: Ensure data lineage, data quality, controls, security, resilience, performance and auditability requirements are identified early and validated.
* Solution Design and Validation: Partner with architecture, engineering, product and subject-matter experts to evaluate solution options and ensure delivered solutions meet agreed business outcomes.
* Operational Readiness and Change: Own the analysis contribution to transition-to-BAU, operational readiness, training and adoption, protecting existing business functionality and validating outcomes post implementation.
* Risk and Governance: Maintain a strong risk mindset; identify delivery, operational, data and control risks early, escalate through appropriate governance and support effective mitigation.
* AI-enabled Business Analysis: Set direction for proportionate use of approved AI tools across the BA lifecycle while retaining accountable human review, source validation and appropriate controls for sensitive information.
* Prompt Engineering and Quality Controls: Define practical approaches for prompt design, evaluation and reuse to improve analysis productivity and quality while preserving governance and confidentiality.
* Own and lead analysis across Private Markets business capabilities, considering the full investment lifecycle from opportunity/origination and due diligence through execution, onboarding, ongoing asset/portfolio management and exit/maturity.
* Understand Private Markets operating and data needs across asset classes such as private credit, private equity, real assets and infrastructure, and be able to distinguish common enterprise capabilities from asset-class-specific requirements.
* Lead analysis of complex investment structures, transactions, cash-flow events, valuations, positions, reference/master data, documents and reporting requirements, ensuring end-to-end process and data impacts are understood.
* Partner with Investment teams and enabling functions to simplify fragmented processes, improve controls and data quality, reduce manual interventions and define scalable target-state operating models.
* Assess platform and vendor capabilities against Private Markets business needs, define gaps and options, and ensure integrations and downstream impacts across investment, operations, risk, finance and reporting are considered.
* Drive clear ownership of business rules, data definitions, process flows, controls and decision logic so that knowledge is captured as reusable organisational knowledge rather than remaining person-dependent.
* Establish a BA capability framework spanning enterprise analysis, process, requirements, data, operating-model analysis, stakeholder management, benefits and solution validation.
* Introduce proportionate assurance of critical BA deliverables, with emphasis on quality, traceability, decision transparency and outcome alignment rather than documentation volume.
* Use delivery feedback, quality indicators and stakeholder outcomes to identify systemic BA capability improvements and maintain an actionable maturity roadmap.
* Create a culture in which BAs challenge constructively, think commercially, understand the investment domain, use data to support decisions and remain accountable for end-to-end business outcomes.
* Champion effective collaboration across UK and India teams and across business, technology and change disciplines, encouraging shared ownership and knowledge transfer.

We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

description:
**Company Description**

This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.

Website: https://www.metro-gsc.in

Company Size: 1100-1200

Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India

Type: Privately Held

Inception: 2011

 **Job Description**

**About us:**

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.

Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.

You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!

**How you will make an impact?**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Business Value & Data Analyst to ensure that the business impact of our AI initiatives is defined clearly, measured rigorously and validated credibly. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to translate AI use cases into measurable value hypotheses, establish robust baselines and expected-value scenarios, and design appropriate approaches to validate realized impact.

Using methods such as A/B testing, control-group analysis, hypothesis testing and statistical analysis, you will assess whether observed outcomes can credibly be attributed to AI solutions. You will connect adoption, operational performance and financial outcomes, providing transparent reporting on baseline, expected and realized value across the AI portfolio.

Beyond measurement and reporting, you will challenge assumptions, identify gaps between projected and actual results, and turn analytical findings into recommendations that help stakeholders make better investment and prioritization decisions. You will validate projected and realised value, assess whether observed outcomes can credibly be attributed to an AI solution, and proactively identify new opportunities within METRO. Working with the Value Management Lead and stakeholders from squads to senior leadership, you will turn analytical findings into actionable recommendations, support alignment and buy-in, and help manage risks related to ethics and data privacy so our AI and Automation platform delivers measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and challenge value hypotheses for AI use cases, translating expected benefits into measurable financial and operational outcomes.
* Establish and validate baseline performance before implementation, including data sources, measurement periods, assumptions and relevant comparison groups.
* Define the expected value and measurement methodology for each AI use case, documenting assumptions, calculation logic, KPIs and success criteria.
* Determine the appropriate validation approach, including A/B testing, control groups, pre/post analysis, hypothesis testing and statistical significance, based on data availability and use-case characteristics.
* Compare baseline, expected and realized outcomes and determine the extent to which measured improvements can credibly be attributed to the AI intervention.
* Partner with business owners to validate benefits and challenge assumptions, identifying double counting, unsupported claims, external influences and gaps in evidence.
* Translate operational improvements into financial and business value, such as productivity gains, cost avoidance, revenue impact, quality improvement or risk reduction.
* Maintain transparent documentation and dashboards showing baseline, expected value, realized value, adoption, methodology, assumptions and confidence/evidence level for AI use cases.
* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership, clearly distinguishing forecast value from validated/realized value.
* Continuously improve the organization's AI value-measurement framework, standards and governance.

 **Qualifications**

**Must-have:**

* Strong analytical and statistical capability.
* Practical experience with experimentation, A/B testing, Hypothesis testing and control-group evaluation.
* Advanced BI and dashboard-development skills.
* Strong SQL skills and experience combining data from multiple sources.
* Ability to translate business questions into measurable KPIs and analytical designs.
* Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Structured working style with strong attention to data quality and traceability.
* Experience using AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support analytics, reporting and insight generation.
* Strong understanding of business-case development, ROI and benefits-realization concepts.
* Ability to translate operational metrics into financial and business outcomes.
* Experience establishing baseline, target and realized-value measurement frameworks.
* Strong ability to challenge assumptions constructively and distinguish correlation from causation.
* Experience working across business, finance, data and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to communicate uncertainty, limitations and statistical findings in business-friendly language.

  
**Additional Information**

**Preferred**

* Experience with causal inference, forecasting or value modelling.
* Knowledge of AI product performance and adoption measurement.
* Understanding of financial KPIs and business-case calculations.
* Experience automating recurring reporting and analytical workflows using APIs, Power Automate, Python, AI tools or similar technologies.

The Data Governance Analyst will be part of the Data team at Forvis Mazars and will perform an important role in enabling the firm to deliver upon its firm-wide data strategy.

It will focus on the implementation and adherence to the firm’s data governance framework to ultimately improve the quality, consistency, reliability and value of enterprise data across Forvis Mazars. Partnering with data owners, stewards and operational and analytical platform owners will be critical to the successful deployment of the processes, procedures and controls, requiring a balance of technical expertise with strong communication, relationship management and influencing skills.

A key role to enable the delivery, embedding and execution of the data governance framework for the firm, a fundamental component of our overall data strategy. This role will be new to the firm.

**Job Description:**

* Maintain and ensure adherence to data management related policies, standards and procedures through the use of controls and measures across the firm’s operational and analytical data estates.

title: Global Technical Expert, Hybrid cloud Platforms
description:
**Position Purpose**
The Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for the planning, architecture, design, implementation, operation, and optimization of hybrid and multi-cloud platform solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure. The role partners with application architects, engineering teams, security, networking, and cloud platform teams translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure solutions.
  
  
The engineer will provide technical leadership throughout the application hosting and cloud migration lifecycle while contributing to the organization's overall hybrid cloud strategy, standards, governance, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to
  
  

* Plan, design, develop and support hybrid cloud platform/infrastructure solutions across AWS and Azure, aligned with enterprise architecture, security and application requirements.
* Own cloud platform architecture, landing zones, account/subscription structures, policies and governance guardrails across AWS and Azure.
* Design and maintain integrations with enterprise services such as Entra ID, on-premises networks, Splunk, ServiceNow, security and monitoring platforms.
* Manage the lifecycle of qualified/approved cloud services, including configuration changes and risk/impact assessments for cloud-provider or application-driven changes.
* Evaluate and qualify new AWS/Azure cloud services in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security and other relevant teams.
* Support application onboarding, solution design and cloud migration, recommending the appropriate compute, storage, database, network and platform services.
* Define and govern IAM, RBAC, privileged access, least-privilege principles and cloud access guardrails across AWS and Azure.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and DevOps automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation/CodePipeline, Azure Bicep/Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* Implement and maintain cloud security governance, working with Security, Application and Vulnerability Management teams to address risks and compliance requirements.
* Design and support hybrid/cloud networking, including VPC/VNet, routing, DNS, firewalls, private connectivity, load balancing and advanced L3/L4 troubleshooting.
* Support deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting of key AWS and Azure platform services, ensuring performance, scalability, reliability and availability.
* Drive resilience and operational excellence, including high availability, backup/DR, observability, cost optimization, platform standardization and continuous improvement.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Platform Engineering and/or Platform Security, preferably in large enterprise environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Microsoft Azure, including design, implementation and support of enterprise-scale public, private and hybrid-cloud platforms.
* Strong knowledge of cloud compute, storage, databases, networking, IAM, security, monitoring and enterprise integration services.
* Experience with cloud platform architecture and governance, including landing zones, account/subscription structures, policies, guardrails and cloud service lifecycle management.
* Strong experience with cloud networking and security, including AWS VPC, Azure Virtual Network, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, IAM/RBAC, privileged access and security controls.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps automation, including Terraform, CloudFormation/Bicep, Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline and/or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, observability and security tooling, including CloudWatch, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, Splunk and vulnerability/security monitoring solutions.
* Experience supporting application onboarding, cloud migrations and modernization, including integration with enterprise IAM, network, security, monitoring and ITSM services.
* Strong understanding of high availability, resilience, backup/disaster recovery, performance, scalability and cost optimization for cloud platforms.
* Problem solving mindset and advanced troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, security and application deployment issues.
* Ability to create and maintain solution designs, architecture diagrams, technical standards, operating procedures and implementation/test documentation.
* Strong communication, collaboration and ownership, with the ability to work across Architecture, Security, Network, IAM, Application, DevOps and Operations teams and independently drive technical issues to resolution.
* Relevant AWS, Azure and/or Terraform certifications are advantageous.

**Why Sandoz?**
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
  
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion**
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve.

description:

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

**Platform Engineer P3 (3-6 years experience)**

At Anaplan, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Environment Tooling team. The team is responsible for building, owning, and operating the platform infrastructure and non-production environments that enable engineers to develop, test, and deliver services to production with speed, safety, and reliability. As a mid-senior individual contributor, you will be part of a collaborative team of five engineers reporting to the team engineering manager.

You will play a key role in delivering our environments strategy, shifting Anaplan away from shared development environments toward reproducible, automated local and ephemeral environments.

As well as this, you will take ownership of the health of our remaining shared non-production environments, maintain our Argo CD deployment architecture, oversee secrets management using Vault, and establish resilient, code-driven governance for feature flagging that delivers lasting value.

**Your Impact...**

* **Empower engineering teams:**
  Collaborate in a cross-functional team to build and operate tools, frameworks, and platforms that improve developer experience, platform scalability, and security for hundreds of engineers
* **Shape the future of environments:**
  Contribute to the design, implementation, and roll-out of our next-generation environments strategy, helping transition engineering teams to automated, code-defined local and remote ephemeral environments
* **Champion environment health:**
  Take collective ownership of our non-production environments, ensuring platform service health and acting as a trusted first port of call for engineering support and troubleshooting
* **Scale deployment & configuration infrastructure:**
  Contribute to the maintenance and architectural evolution of our Argo CD deployment pipelines, secrets management infrastructure, and feature flagging capabilities
* **Evolve existing platform tooling:**
  Help maintain, refactor, and modernize our existing Go-based tools, APIs, and Kubernetes Operators to eliminate configuration toil and support new platform capabilities by elevating standards
* **Delivering measurable outcomes:**
  Act as a proactive self-starter who takes end-to-end ownership of your work through agile practices, planning, and road mapping, while participating in the team on-call rota

**Your Skills...**

* **Kubernetes:**
  Experience with Kubernetes in a production or pre-production environment
* **CD & GitOps:**
  Strong practical understanding of continuous delivery pipelines, GitOps workflows, and continuous deployment tooling (specifically
  **Argo CD**
  )
* **Platform-as-a-Product:**
  A passion for treating platform infrastructure as a product, focusing on improving Developer Experience, reducing cognitive load for engineers, and gathering feedback to build highly usable tools
* **Infrastructure as Code:**
  Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools, ideally Terraform
* **Secrets management:**
  Experience working with HashiCorp Vault or similar secrets management technologies
* **Resilience & quality mindset:**
  A focus on building fault-tolerant systems, backed by automated testing, golden templates, and clear developer documentation
* **Strong communication:**
  A collaborative mindset with the ability to provide clear guidance, support, best practices and articulate trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences

**Bonus Points for…**

* **Software engineering:**
  Hands-on development experience in Go (or a similar language)
* **Kubernetes operators:**
  Experience writing, testing, or maintaining Kubernetes Operators and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)
* **Feature flagging:**
  Experience administering feature flagging platforms (such as LaunchDarkly)
* **Local development:**
  Experience designing local container-based development workflows
* **Observability:**
  Knowledge of observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. title: DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
DevOps Engineer / Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and managing the organization's application delivery platforms and infrastructure components. The role focuses on CI/CD pipeline management, container orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, security integration, and operational excellence. The individual will work closely with development, infrastructure, security, andcloudteams to ensure efficient, secure, and scalable application deployment and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CI/CD DevOps Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment processes.
* Manage and administer DevOps platforms, repositories, build agents, and runners.
* Automate application deployment, testing, and release processes.
* Implement DevSecOps practices within CI/CD workflows.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues.
* Optimize build and deployment performance.

**Container Kubernetes Platform Administration**

* Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized application platforms.
* Administer Kubernetes environments including:

+ Rancher
+ Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)

* Configure namespaces, ingress controllers, storage classes, RBAC, and cluster security.
* Monitor cluster health, capacity, and performance.
* Manage container image repositories and lifecycle.

**Docker Administration**

* Build, secure, and manage Docker container environments.
* Define and maintain approved base images.
* Implement container security best practices.
* Support application teams in containerization initiatives.

**Linux Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.
* Perform system hardening, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage operating system performance and availability.
* Maintain platform documentation and configuration standards.

**Middleware Platform Services**
**Administer And Support**

* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak Identity and Access Management
* Access Manager solutions
* HashiCorp Vault

**Responsibilities Include**

* Installation and configuration
* Security hardening
* High availability implementation
* Certificate management
* Backup and recovery
* Performance tuning

**Security Secrets Management**

* Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Manage secrets, certificates, tokens, and credentials using HashiCorp Vault.
* Integrate security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability remediation activities.

**Logging, Monitoring Observability**

* Implement and manage centralized logging platforms such as:

+ ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
+ Graylog

* Create dashboards, alerts, and monitoring solutions.
* Perform log analysis and troubleshooting.
* Support incident investigation and root cause analysis.

**CloudPlatform Support**

* Support deployment and operations oncloudplatforms:
* Configurecloud-native services supporting DevOps operations.
* Assist incloudinfrastructure automation and optimization.
* Support hybridcloudand container-based deployments.

**Automation Infrastructure as Code**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and platform configuration.
* Develop scripts and reusable automation components.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using approved tools.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation.

**Platform Reliability Operations**

* Ensure high availability and resilience of platform services.
* Participate in incident management and problem management activities.
* Maintain disaster recovery and backup procedures.
* Create and maintain operational runbooks and SOPs.

**Experience**

* Up to 3 years ( 2 candidates) , 3-5 years ( 1 Candidate) of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Hands-on experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience administering Kubernetes platforms in enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting containerized applications and platform services.
* Experience with Linux system administration and middleware platforms.

**Technical Skills**
**Mandatory**

* CI/CD Pipeline Design Management
* Git-based Source Control Systems
* Build Runners and Agents Administration
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Rancher
* Red Hat OpenShift (OCP)
* HAProxy
* Nexus Repository Manager
* Keycloak
* Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
* Scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar)

**Preferred**

* HashiCorp Vault
* Access Manager Solutions
* ELK Stack
* Graylog
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
* DevSecOps Toolchains

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Job DescriptionAssistant Sales Manager – Delhi NCR

**Mukunda Foods Pvt. Ltd.**

**Department:** Sales  
**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Industry:** Commercial Kitchen Automation / Foodservice Equipment  
**Reporting To:** Regional Sales Manager / Zonal Sales Manager

About Mukunda Foods

Mukunda Foods is a kitchen-tech company focused on transforming commercial kitchen operations through automation solutions. Our innovative products help foodservice businesses improve operational efficiency, consistency, productivity and scalability.

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and customer-focused Assistant Sales Manager to drive B2B sales and business development for Mukunda Foods' commercial kitchen automation solutions across Delhi NCR.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, managing key accounts, conducting product demonstrations and trials, developing channel partnerships, converting sales opportunities into orders and achieving assigned revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should have strong B2B sales experience, preferably in HoReCa, QSR, foodservice equipment, hospitality or commercial kitchen solutions, along with excellent negotiation, relationship management and business development skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Identify, develop and generate new business opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Conduct market mapping, customer visits, networking and lead generation activities.
* Build, maintain and manage a healthy sales pipeline with timely follow-ups.
* Convert enquiries, product trials and projects into confirmed orders.
* Prepare and submit quotations, BOQs, proposals and commercial offers.

**2. Key Account Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with QSRs, restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, bakeries, caterers and foodservice companies.
* Manage existing customer accounts and identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling and cross-selling.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable automation solutions.
* Coordinate customer meetings, demonstrations, trials, installations and commercial discussions.

**3. Product Demonstrations & Trials**

* Conduct product demonstrations and coordinate customer trials.
* Present the value proposition of automation solutions in terms of productivity, consistency, manpower efficiency, food quality and process standardisation.
* Collect customer feedback and coordinate internally for improvements and timely follow-ups.

**4. Distributor & Channel Management**

* Identify, appoint and develop distributors and channel partners wherever required.
* Manage distributor relationships, sales movement, stock, order pipeline and collections.
* Follow up on distributor orders and outstanding payments.
* Collaborate with channel partners to generate leads and expand territorial coverage.

**5. Project Sales & Management**

* Identify upcoming restaurant, QSR, hotel, bakery and foodservice projects.
* Build relationships with consultants, architects, franchise owners, purchase teams, operations teams and decision-makers.
* Manage the sales cycle from enquiry, product trial and commercial negotiation through PO, dispatch, installation and payment.
* Maintain accurate project-wise sales pipeline and forecasts.

**6. Market Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor products, pricing, product launches and market activities.
* Identify emerging customer requirements, industry trends and business opportunities.
* Share market insights and customer feedback with management and Product/R&D teams.
* Support product launches and territory expansion initiatives.

**7. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with Service, Operations, Finance, R&D, Production and Supply Chain teams for smooth order execution.
* Follow up on product availability, dispatches, installations, service requirements and customer concerns.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and maintain customer satisfaction.

**8. Sales Reporting & CRM**

* Maintain accurate and updated CRM records, lead information and opportunity pipeline.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly sales reports.
* Track revenue, bookings, collections, demos, trials, pipeline and conversion rates.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to the reporting manager.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly and Quarterly Revenue Achievement
* New Customer Acquisition
* New Account Addition
* Order Conversion Rate
* Product Demonstrations & Trials
* Project Conversion
* Distributor Sales & Development
* Sales Pipeline Value and Accuracy
* Collection & Outstanding Payment Management
* Customer Retention & Repeat Business
* Territory Growth

Candidate Profile

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 2–6 years of relevant experience in B2B sales and business development.
* Experience in HoReCa, QSR, foodservice equipment, commercial kitchen equipment, kitchen automation, hospitality or related industries preferred.
* Experience handling restaurant chains, institutional customers and large accounts will be an added advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong B2B sales and business development capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen and customer relationship management.
* Lead generation, prospecting and conversion skills.
* Project sales and pipeline management.
* Distributor and channel partner management.
* Product demonstration and consultative selling skills.
* Analytical, reporting and forecasting capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage a territory and achieve targets.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM and sales reporting tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a proactive, target-driven sales professional with the ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle — from prospecting and customer meetings to product demonstrations, trials, commercial negotiations, order closure and payment follow-up.

Candidates with experience in restaurant chains, QSRs, hotels, bakeries, cloud kitchens, foodservice companies or commercial kitchen equipment will be preferred.

**Travel Requirement:** Extensive travel within the assigned territory.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

* What is your current annual CTC?
* What is your expected annual CTC?

Location:

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
Job Description – Business Development Manager (BDM)

**Company:** Tata AIA Life Insurance  
**Role:** Channel Sales / Agency Development  
**Department:** Sales & Distribution

Job Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and self-driven **Business Development Manager (BDM)** to drive business growth through the recruitment, development and management of insurance advisors for Tata AIA Life Insurance.

The primary responsibility will be to build a strong network of insurance advisors, develop their product and business knowledge, provide regular training and motivation, and ensure consistent month-on-month business generation through the advisor network.

This is a leadership-oriented channel sales role that requires strong recruitment, team management, relationship-building and sales development skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Advisor Recruitment & Team Building**

* Identify, source and recruit potential insurance advisors.
* Build and expand a productive advisor network.
* Identify individuals with entrepreneurial abilities and sales potential.
* Drive regular advisor recruitment to strengthen the distribution channel.

**2. Advisor Training & Development**

* Train newly recruited advisors on Tata AIA Life Insurance products, features, benefits and offerings.
* Educate advisors about insurance concepts, sales processes and business opportunities.
* Conduct regular product training, sales training and business development sessions.
* Ensure advisors have the necessary product knowledge and confidence to approach customers.

**3. Business Generation & Sales Management**

* Drive insurance business through the recruited advisor network.
* Help advisors identify prospective customers and generate quality leads.
* Motivate and guide advisors to achieve their individual sales targets.
* Ensure consistent month-on-month business generation and achievement of assigned targets.
* Monitor advisor performance and take corrective actions to improve productivity.

**4. Leadership & Team Motivation**

* Demonstrate strong leadership by building, guiding and managing a team of advisors.
* Keep advisors motivated and engaged through regular interactions and performance reviews.
* Develop active and productive advisors into consistent business contributors.
* Provide continuous guidance, field support and assistance in closing business.
* Build a performance-driven and growth-oriented advisor network.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Experience in sales, business development, channel sales or team handling.
* Strong ability to recruit, develop and manage a team.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Leadership qualities with the ability to motivate and influence people.
* Good understanding of sales processes and business development.
* Target-oriented, proactive and passionate about achieving business goals.
* Prior experience in life insurance, financial services, BFSI or agency channel sales will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new advisors recruited.
* Number of active and productive advisors.
* Monthly business generation through the advisor network.
* Advisor activation and retention.
* Consistent achievement of monthly business targets.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be more than just a salesperson. We are looking for someone who can **recruit people, build a team, develop future leaders, train and motivate advisors, and create a consistent business-generating distribution network.**

**If you have strong leadership skills, a passion for sales and the ability to build a productive team, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

description:

Maintains accountability for verifying that the team maximizes revenue opportunities by up-selling and accurately forecasting (e.g., catering and group rooms) for all events.

OR

* Solicits/books local catering business and develops group business.

* Develops and manages catering sales revenue and operation budgets, and provides forecasting reports.

* Works with the management team to create and implement a catering sales/marketing plan addressing revenue, customers and market.

* Develops menus that drive sales.

* Assists with selling, implementation and follow-through of catering promotions.

* Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.

* Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.

* Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process.

* Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

* Work closely with the Inside Sales and CRM teams to improve overall conversion rates.

* Analyse sales-related data and identify gaps in lead conversion.
* Recommend and implement strategies to improve team productivity and achieve business targets.

**6. MIS & Performance Reporting**

* Track follow-up efficiency, pending leads and lost opportunities.
* Maintain accurate patient databases and CRM records.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Lead-to-appointment conversion ratio.
* Appointment confirmation and patient visit ratio.
* Follow-up completion and lead closure rate.
* Patient acquisition and retention.
* Patient satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* CRM data accuracy and reporting efficiency.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be confident, proactive, customer-centric and commercially driven, with the ability to balance sales performance with patient satisfaction. title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Ownership and Strategy (20%)
  + Own and drive specific cloud networking product areas within the Public Cloud portfolio, including connectivity, ingress/egress, service networking, network security, traffic management, DNS, and hybrid cloud networking
  + Partner with senior product leadership to define vision, roadmap priorities, and quarterly objectives for networking capabilities
  + Work closely with application teams to understand networking challenges, onboarding friction points, and operational pain points
  + Identify opportunities to improve automation, self-service experiences, scalability, and developer productivity
  + Translate business and technical requirements into product roadmaps and delivery plans
* Execution and Delivery (60%)
  + Manage and prioritize networking product backlogs across multiple engineering teams
  + Define detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
  + Lead delivery of cloud networking initiatives spanning Azure, AWS, and GCP environments
  + Drive improvements in cloud onboarding, network provisioning, firewall automation, service connectivity, and developer enablement workflows
  + Coordinate delivery dependencies across engineering, security, compliance, infrastructure, and operations teams
  + Monitor product health, adoption metrics, reliability measures, and customer satisfaction indicators
  + Support release planning, testing, rollout strategies, and operational readiness activities
  + Drive issue resolution and continuous improvement initiatives through customer feedback and operational insights
* Stakeholder Management and Collaboration (20%)
  + Serve as a trusted partner to engineering managers, architects, security teams, and application stakeholders
  + Facilitate alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities and objectives
  + Communicate roadmap progress, delivery updates, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes to leadership
  + Support portfolio-level planning, quarterly business reviews, and strategic initiatives
  + Champion customer-focused product development and data-driven decision making
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of product management experience with technical infrastructure, cloud platform, networking, or enterprise technology products
* 3+ years of experience working with public cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
* Experience working with cloud-native networking services such as Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Cloud DNS, Azure DNS, Application Gateway, Load Balancers, and related technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams using Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, private connectivity, VPNs, and hybrid networking
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements and customer value propositions
* Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and successfully deliver complex initiatives
* Proven solid analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to technical and business stakeholders

description:

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Cloud Backup Storage Engineer on the Adobe Storage Engineering team, you will join dedicated team supporting one of the largest SaaS businesses in the world. The team is responsible for large-scale data storage, backup infrastructure, and cloud ecosystems supporting a wide variety of workloads. Your skills and experience building and managing complex environments will help us delight our customers at every opportunity.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain data protection / backup infrastructure.
* Support Adobe's growing multi-petabyte storage services in private and public cloud locations.
* Support a 24x7 distributed enterprise environment.
* Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation responding to alerts and issues from other team members.
* Develop and optimize Key Performance Indicators for backup services and communicate regularly with management to report on operational performance.
* Identify security design gaps in new and existing architectures and collaborate with engineering teams to craft solutions that mitigate those issues.
* Follow service management processes such as change, incident and problem management.
* Provide supporting inputs to budget planning, HW life cycle planning and resource planning/allocation.
* Participate in vendor relationship for HW procurement, product road maps and emerging Storage and Data Protection technologies.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* B. E./B. Tech in Computer Science or other equivalent degree or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of professional cloud engineering experience with in Public and Hybrid cloud technologies
* Demonstrated experience with data protection and backup tools preferably Commvault, with a DevOps focus
* Experience working with high-availability, distributed systems and services in a hosting environment including hardware, OS, storage, network, and database solutions
* Experience with programming, scripting and automation tools including Python, Git, Jenkins, REST APIs, etc.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools and CMDB (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, and Splunk.
* Hands-on experience in design and automated deployment of complex infrastructure in AWS/Azure

* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Excellent problem solving/analytical skills and knowledge of analytical tools.
* Prior experience in defining and developing strategy, technology blueprint and road maps.
* Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to establish strong relationships with all levels of the organization.
* Experience in analyzing project scope and determining resources needed to meet project demands.
* Effective at short-term actions that are consistent with long-term goals.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and complete tasks in a dynamic and high-pressure environment.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely.

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. title: TC-CS-IAM-Ping -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Ping Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced Ping Identity Consultant to design, implement, and support enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using the Ping Identity suite. The ideal candidate will have expertise in SSO, MFA, federation, access management, and identity governance while ensuring secure, scalable, and high-performing authentication solutions. This role involves troubleshooting complex issues, implementing security best practices, automating operational processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise IAM initiatives
  
  

* Design, deploy, and support Ping Identity solutions including PingFederate, PingAccess, PingOne SSO, PingDavinci and PingDirectory.
* Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and LDAP integrations.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex IAM issues through root cause analysis.
* Ensure high availability, performance optimization, and security compliance of IAM infrastructure.
* Develop automation scripts and deployment processes to improve operational efficiency.
* Implement change management, disaster recovery, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with application teams, infrastructure, and security teams to integrate enterprise applications.
* Create technical documentation, knowledge articles, and deployment guides while supporting continuous process improvements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TC-CS-CAOE-AI Platform Engineers
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Sr. AI Platform Security Engineer**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity -**
Sr. AI Platform Security Engineer
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* LLM Engineering & Advanced Reasoning

+ Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
+ Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
+ Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

* MLOps, Observability & Automation

+ Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
+ Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
+ Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.
+ Hands-on experience on Docker / Kubernetes, CI/CD using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
+ Security Knowledge Graph & AI Security - Neo4j / graph databases, Knowledge Graph and Graph-RAG
+ Automate cloud infrastructure and security controls using Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.

* Data Engineering & Cyber Analytics

+ Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
+ Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
+ Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

* Agentic AI & Multi-Agent System Development

+ Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
+ Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
+ Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
+ Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.
+ Build Security Knowledge Graphs connecting assets, identities, vulnerabilities, threats, controls and security telemetry to enable contextual security analytics.
+ Develop enterprise integrations across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, APIs and security/observability platforms for automated workflows and data exchange.
+ Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.

* RAG Systems & Knowledge Integration

+ Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
+ Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
+ Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
+ Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering
* 2+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially Cloud security (Azure, Aws), along with strong hand-on experience on Terraform, Python, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Security as Code.
* 2+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Data Engineering & Data Platforms - Strong Python skills, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Databricks / Delta Lake, Airflow / orchestration frameworks, PytTorch/TensorFlow, ETL/ELT and batch/stream processing, Data quality, lineage and governance.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Strong hands-on experience on agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 2+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

title: Desktop Systems Engineer
description:
Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based Desktop Systems Engineer to join our Information Technology team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As our team has several openings at different levels and in different skill areas, the list below are samples of some of the technologies that we work with. While we desire candidates with experience in these specific technologies, we also understand that each of them have market alternatives, so the most important skillset a candidate can have is a good attitude and have a strong work ethic. Top candidates will have an aptitude to learn new technology and have a “do what it takes” attitude.
  
  

* Designing and implementing mobile device management (MDM) policies and procedures
* Configuring and deploying mobile applications using Intune
* Monitoring and managing Medpace’s end user computing applications, deployments, and devices for compliance.
* Keeping up to date with the latest end user hardware and software best practices, technologies, and methodologies specifically around Microsoft tooling and services as well as other third party tools
* Expert experience in administrating, creating, and packaging applications and operating system security patches for deployments using Microsoft Configuration Manager tools and associated Powershell scripting
* Ensure secure operations of infrastructure technologies (security updates, vulnerability management, role access management, configuration hardening)
* Expert experience in support of Windows Operating System, MacOS, and other desktop operating systems environments
* Strong background in scripting using SQL, PowerShell, VBScript, WMI Scripting, and Python
* Demonstrated aptitude around task automation and process documentation.
* Creating, and maintaining policies and training for end users and other IT teams
* Advanced OS and Microsoft management experience
* Experience working directly with hardware manufacturers and software publishers to resolve problems.
* Experience with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, Group Policy, Intune, and Autopilot technologies strongly desired.
* Working knowledge of asset management tools, processes, and procedures
* Prior experience with Conference Room technologies, Collaboration Tools, and A/V Support is a plus
* Provide off-hours support (24 x 7) as required

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or a related field;
* Proficient in enterprise desktop management;
* Solid experience in Microsoft Intune;
* Solid experience in scripting;
* Desire to learn and grow, with a solid foundation of experience;
* Aptitude to manage many different projects, applications, and priorities effectively and simultaneously;
* Ability to communicate effectively with peers, end users, as well as all levels of management; and
* Demonstration of strong communication, decision making, self management, and teamwork capabilities.

**Medpace Overview**
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
  
  
**Why Medpace?**
When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
***Purpose-Driven Work***




+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***




+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***




+ Office based environment with on-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

**Other Employee Benefits**




+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*
**What To Expect Next**
A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
