- Opportunity to build and expand a wholesale network across India.

- Work with a growing portfolio of consumer brands across multiple product categories.

- Direct ownership of B2B business development and bulk sales.

- Build long-term partnerships with established wholesale businesses.

- Opportunity to contribute to the growth of a fast-growing consumer products business.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in FMCG wholesale sales, B2B business development, or distribution are encouraged to apply.

description:

Our Professional Services team partners with customers worldwide to implement, extend, and optimize Guidewire’s industry-leading cloud platform for P&C insurers. We work at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer delivery to reduce implementation effort and time while driving measurable customer value and successful cloud adoption. You’ll join a collaborative, outcomes-focused team that blends deep insurance, cloud, and AI expertise to help customers transform how they do business.
  
  
In this role, as Guidewire Automation QA - Senior Consultant you will be involved in designing frameworks, defining test strategy, and ensuring reliable, high‑quality delivery of our applications in the cloud. You will bring strong JavaScript automation skills, CI/CD experience, and a passion for robust engineering practices to reduce manual effort and accelerate releases. You will collaborate closely with developers, DevOps, and project teams, mentoring others and using automation and AI to cut implementation effort and time in line with Professional Services’ transformation goals.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks for Guidewire applications using TestCafe (hybrid, data‑driven, modular), JavaScript, JSON-based test data, and custom HTML reporting.

* Execute and debug automation runs, distinguish application defects from script issues, and proactively fix and refactor flaky tests to keep the automation suite stable over time.
* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, DevOps, and Professional Services project teams to plan test effort, estimate automation scope, and provide clear quality and defect insights using tools such as JIRA and test reporting frameworks.
* Mentor and up-skill junior QA engineers and partner teams on automation best practices, contributing to PS’s broader AI- and automation-enabled methodology and knowledge sharing.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Required**
**What you’ll bring**

* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* 7+ years of overall QA experience with at least 3 years leading automation initiatives or acting as a senior automation engineer on complex projects.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript and experience building or extending test automation frameworks (UI and ideally API), including data-driven and modular architectures.
* Hands-on experience with at least one modern automation toolset such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium, and willingness to primarily work with TestCafe for UI test automation.
* Practical experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity, Azure DevOps) and working with Git/Bitbucket for version control and code review.
* Ability to interpret BDD/Gherkin-style requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable automated test suites.
* Experience with test reporting and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and test reporting libraries, providing clear, actionable quality metrics.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills, with experience working in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing project delivery environments, ideally in a SaaS or cloud context.
* Exposure to P&C insurance or financial services domains, or a strong interest in developing deep insurance domain expertise as part of this role.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and running automation suites in containerized or cloud-native environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Background in performance, reliability, or non-functional testing in addition to functional automation.
* Experience contributing to test strategy, effort estimation, and quality risk assessment for large-scale programs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will learn Guidewire’s product ecosystem and Professional Services delivery model, deepen your understanding of P&C insurance workflows, and take ownership of the automation framework and strategy for one or more customer implementation projects. You’ll streamline and stabilize our automated regression and end‑to‑end suites, integrate them into CI/CD, and help teams reduce manual testing effort while increasing coverage and confidence in each release. As you mature in the role, your work will directly support Professional Services’ FY26 priorities—using AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, accelerate cloud adoption, and ensure every customer is successful and referenceable—contributing to Guidewire’s broader mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business through secure, AI‑enabled cloud solutions.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

Our environment spans distributed cloud systems, multi-region deployments, APIs, orchestration layers, and hardware-backed inference services.

We are hiring a
**Cloud Quality Engineer**
to own the quality of our weekly cloud releases end to end and to build the test infrastructure that lets the team scale. This is a hands-on senior IC role for someone who treats quality as a first-class engineering problem - not a downstream gate.
  
  
You will drive every release from branch cut to sign-off, build scalable test infrastructure that grows with customer load, and push back when quality is at risk. You will operate effectively across timezones, async-first, with clear written communication.
  
  
This is a role for someone who self-drives. You will frequently work without complete product specifications, decide under ambiguity, and ask the right questions before code lands - not after.

* Quality Discipline: Choose high-value tests over volume metrics. Drive the team's standards for what "tested" means and what "ready to ship" means.
* Cross-Team Operation: Work with platform, ML, infrastructure, and product teams across timezones. Influence quality outcomes without owning every team's roadmap.

* 5+ years of experience in quality engineering, test engineering, or a closely related role, with substantial individual contributor experience on large-scale distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.
* Deep cloud platform experience, preferably AWS - networking, compute orchestration, container platforms, and multi-region production services. You can reason about what is happening at the cloud layer when something fails.
* Track record of building scalable test infrastructure - frameworks, harnesses, environments, and automation that scale with the system under test rather than fighting it.
* Strong systems debugging and reasoning. You can take an unfamiliar failure and follow it through layers of the stack to a root cause.
* Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, Go, or C++), sufficient to read production code, write production-grade tests, and contribute infrastructure code directly.
* Excellent written and async communication. You operate effectively across time zones and in environments where most decisions get made in writing.
* Self-direction under ambiguity. You frame problems, make trade-off decisions, and push back when quality is at risk - without waiting to be asked.
* Experience with Cloud infrastructure, model serving systems, or GPU accelerated workloads is a strong plus.
* Experience using AI tooling (LLMs, coding assistants, agents) to accelerate test development, triage, or analysis is a plus.

The Senior QA Engineer partners closely with architects, engineers, administrators, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to define testing strategies, validate business requirements, and ensure ServiceNow implementations meet functional, integration, security, and performance expectations.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, integrations, platform upgrades, and releases.

* Support release readiness reviews and ensure adequate test coverage for platform enhancements, integrations, and defect fixes.
* Validate platform upgrades, patches, releases, and configuration changes to ensure stability and minimize business disruption.
* Develop and maintain quality metrics, dashboards, and reports to provide visibility into testing progress, defect trends, release readiness, and overall platform quality.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies, release planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support performance, security, integration, and end-to-end testing activities as required.
* Experience testing ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, Control Tower, and other platform intelligence features, is highly desirable.
* Fluent English is mandatory, as the role requires daily collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.

* 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or testing enterprise applications.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience testing ServiceNow implementations and platform capabilities.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), including creation, maintenance, and execution of automated test suites.
* Experience testing ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HAM, SAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, or related applications.
* Experience validating integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, and external platforms.
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools for Agile delivery, defect management, source control, and release management.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and DevOps methodologies.
* Understanding of ServiceNow application development lifecycle, source control integration, update sets, and release management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* ITIL Foundation v3 or ITIL 4 certification.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Case Management & Agent Experience
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101159
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Salesforce Case Management and the broader support platform experience. This role will drive the Case Management strategy and roadmap, modernize agent workflows, and define how Salesforce integrates with upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
Strong Salesforce Service Cloud and Case Management experience is essential, along with platform product thinking, integration knowledge, and the ability to make clear prioritization and ownership decisions. The role will also help shape AI-assisted support and agent productivity capabilities, working closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and other Product teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
What You Will Own
  
  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Salesforce Case Management and the agent support platform
* Apply strong Salesforce Service Cloud expertise, especially around the case lifecycle, data model, agent workflows, ownership, transfer, escalation, and closure
* Define the end-to-end Case Management product contract, including what data Salesforce receives, stores, exposes, routes on, and reports on
* Drive the modernization of legacy case workflows and simplify fragmented or manual agent experiences
* Define reusable integration and workflow patterns across upstream and downstream systems instead of creating one-off solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Routing, Taxonomy, and business teams to define MVPs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes
* Own prioritization and product tradeoffs across platform health, agent productivity, technical debt, and future Salesforce transformation

AI and Intelligent Support
  
  

* Define where AI should assist agents and where deterministic workflows should remain in control
* Shape AI-assisted capabilities such as summarization, intent detection, sentiment signals, recommended actions, similar case suggestions, and guided troubleshooting
* Define data requirements, evaluation criteria, confidence thresholds, fallback behavior, and human-review guardrails
* Partner with Data, AI, Engineering, and Architecture teams to ensure AI capabilities are measurable, grounded, and production-ready
* Ensure AI outputs improve the actual Case Management workflow and agent experience rather than becoming isolated demos or creating additional noise

Product Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Start with the customer or business problem and challenge vague solution requests before committing engineering capacity
* Make strong prioritization decisions and clearly distinguish true platform needs from incremental enhancements
* Define clear ownership boundaries across Case Management, routing, integrations, taxonomy, and business systems
* Bring recommendations, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes to leadership rather than only presenting options

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of hands-on Product Management experience or equivalent domain experience
* Applies deep Product Management principles and strong Salesforce Service Cloud expertise to solve complex Case Management, agent workflow, and support platform problems
* Connects customer, agent, operational, technical, and business needs into a coherent product strategy and roadmap
* Uses data, customer insights, operational signals, and sound judgment to prioritize work and make decisions when information is incomplete
* Leads complex cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, Operations, and business teams without requiring day-to-day direction
* Identifies opportunities to simplify existing processes, retire unnecessary complexity, and create scalable platform capabilities instead of one-off solutions
* Acts as a trusted product partner to Engineering and Architecture while maintaining clear ownership of the problem, customer outcome, product requirements, and success measures

title: Product Manager - Organic Social
description:
**Product Manager – Organic Social**
**About Us**
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
  
  
Target’s Product teams are at the very heart of what delights our guests, time after time. We’re accountable for delivering the business outcomes that enable our operations and delight Target guests. Here, you’ll support cross-functional teams by building and managing technology and analytic products that are easily maintained and highly reliable. Together, we tackle a backlog inclusive of all product, technology and design work.
  
  
Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work.
  
  
Social platforms are where guests increasingly discover, engage with, and are inspired by Target. In this role, you will directly influence how Target shows up organically across social platforms—including, but not limited to, TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—driving more relevant, engaging guest experiences and unlocking growth across an ever-evolving social ecosystem. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead innovation across Organic Social, a critical foundation powering brand awareness, guest engagement, and discovery. This role will own the strategy and execution of the tools and capabilities that enable Target to manage, listen to, and optimize its organic social presence at scale.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of social platforms, content, data, and guest insights, driving improvements in social publishing, listening, engagement, and measurement to elevate the guest experience and grow Target’s presence across social channels.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own the product vision and roadmap for organic social capabilities, focusing on scalability, efficiency, and guest impact across all social platforms
* Build and scale capabilities that enable teams to manage Target’s organic social presence across multiple platforms, including but not limited to TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—covering tools that support content planning, publishing, scheduling, asset management, and approval workflows
* Work closely with data & analytics teams to deliver social listening capabilities to monitor guest conversations, sentiment, trends, and brand mentions
* Drive optimization of organic social experiences through performance analytics, cross-platform reporting, and test-and-learn experimentation to improve reach, engagement, and conversion
* Support community management and guest engagement capabilities, including comment and message moderation
* Partner with social platforms to integrate APIs and emerging features (e.g., shoppable content, product tagging, creator tools), ensuring Target stays ahead of platform changes
* Manage contracts and agreements associated with social platforms and related vendors, including renewals, terms, and compliance, in partnership with legal, procurement, and vendor management teams
* Embed brand safety, governance, and compliance standards into social tools and workflows
* Manage social platform authorization and access across the enterprise, including intake, review, and approval of access requests, role-based permissions, and periodic access audits to protect Target’s brand accounts
* Develop and evolve measurement and attribution capabilities to quantify the impact of organic social on guest engagement, traffic, and sales
* Partner cross-functionally with engineering, data science, social, Roundel, and external platform partners to deliver high-impact solutions
* Translate complex social platform and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve tooling, automation, and AI-enabled workflows for teams managing organic social content, listening, and engagement

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.
  
  
You will be the “voice of the product” to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
  
  
You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
  
  
**About You**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of product management experience
* Domain experience, preferably in social media, social commerce, or digital marketing. Familiarity with social media management, social listening, and analytics tools a plus.
* Familiarity with Agentic platforms and capabilities
* Experience with technology and ability to facilitate communication between business and technology teams
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g., user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)
* Ability to lead a body of work with cross-functional partners
* Strong communication skills

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Paragon platform
description:
**Description**
As a Senior Product Manager - Tech on Amazon's seller support platform, you'll own the foundation that every support decision runs on: the routing engine that decides where each seller's issue goes, the case record that follows that issue across teams and systems, and the controls that govern who can change what. The platform serves more than 220 teams across support, investigation, and compliance, and today many of them route and store cases their own way. A seller can get passed between teams, retell their problem, or wait while their history sits in another tool. Your job is to fix that at the platform level. You'll define how one routing engine serves many organizations without becoming a bottleneck, and how it decides whether an issue goes to an AI agent or a person. You'll decide what a case carries when it moves between teams and which systems stay in sync. You'll design an access model that gives specialists the full picture they need, and nothing more. As AI takes on more of the work, the issues that reach people are the hardest ones, so getting the foundation right matters more, not less. Much of this hasn't been defined yet. You'll work backwards from sellers, associates, and the teams who configure routing. You'll partner with engineers, security, and product leaders, and be the main product voice for the engineering teams you sit with. Expect ambiguity, hard trade-offs between flexibility and control, and regular conversations with senior leaders about where the platform goes next.
  
  
**About The Team**
Paragon is the core issue management platform for Selling Partner Support, serving 220+ teams across support, investigation, and compliance. We build products spanning issue intelligence, content management, AI-powered auditing, workforce development, and intelligent routing. Our vision is mostly autonomous issue resolution with selective human intervention, where associates evolve into specialists whose judgment continuously improves the AI systems they supervise.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
description:
**Role Overview**
This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.
  
  
The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Product Strategy & Ownership**
Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly
**automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management**
.
  
  

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations.
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including Offers and Orders, would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.
  
  
They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.
  
  
Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.
  
  
They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

title: Product Management Expert
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager. You should have solid technical skills and a fascination for data platforms. Your role will be to lead the development of BDC Foundation Services. This involves automated tenant onboarding and the SAP-managed Lakehouse. The Lakehouse transforms SAP data into trusted Data Products. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, design, and go-to-market teams to define product requirements, shape roadmap priorities, and deliver services every BDC customer depends on. You bring customer kindness, execution focus, and a collaborative mindset to deliver valuable outcomes for both internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**What You Ll Build**
**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and manage product requirements and use cases based on customer needs, stakeholder inputs, and technical feasibility
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver high-quality features on time and with measurable impact
* Prioritize and manage the product backlog, balancing short-term iterations with long-term strategic goals

**Data-Driven Insights**

* Use adoption data and user feedback to continuously improve onboarding, pipeline reliability, and Data Product quality.
* Monitor onboarding latency, tenant lifecycle health, and Data Product consumption to measure impact and identify opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Facilitate productive relationships across BDC, SAP LoBs, and external partners; coordinate with adjacent platform capabilities on shared contracts and interfaces.
* Ensure alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders on product objectives.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Gather feedback directly from internal users, partners, and customers to validate hypotheses and inform the roadmap.
* Participate in customer calls, demos, and workshops to showcase capabilities and understand evolving needs.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 6+ years in product management for platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or data pipelines, including ownership of a technical platform area at scale.

You should be fluent in various platforms. This includes multi-tenant SaaS architecture. It also includes event-driven or orchestration systems.
  
  
Commercial awareness: Understands how the platform's features help users adopt and use it. Recognizes how these features make the platform site out.
  
  
Technical Expertise: A solid background in data platforms is needed. This includes multi-tenant provisioning and event-driven systems. You should have knowledge of medallion/Lakehouse architecture, change data capture (CDC), and open table formats like Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake. Knowledge with object storage, Apache Spark, and data catalog/governance is highly desired.
  
  

* Customer Focus:Proven ability to translate user needs into product requirements and iterate quickly on feedback.
* Execution Skills: Strong organizational, collaboration, interpersonal, and planning skills with a bias toward action and delivery.
* Communication Skills: Proficient written and verbal communication, able to articulate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Advanced degree or MBA is a plus.

**Where you belong**
BDC is a forward-looking organization at the forefront of innovation, focused on delivering intelligent, data-driven solutions within SAP Business Data Cloud. We are committed to engineering excellence, customer impact, and building high-quality products that harness cutting-edge AI technologies. As we continue to scale and expand our portfolio of AI-powered capabilities, we are looking for a dynamic Product Manager to help shape our vision, drive execution, and inspire a high-performing product team.

title: Product Expert - SAP Ariba Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
**Bring**
**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 15+ years of experience in customer-facing product management.
* Experience building SaaS applications in the enterprise software space.
* Experience building AI-first capabilities and making data-driven product decisions.
* You should have good communication skills. You need to manage stakeholders successfully. Experience in converting technical ideas into business results is also important.
* Solid customer management skills.
* A robust ownership bias and willingness to jump into areas with great levels of ambiguity and drive clarity and progress forward.
* Solid experience in Finance, Treasury, Payments, Settlement, Accounts Payable, and/or Accounts Receivable business processes is highly desired.

**Soft Skills & Approach**

* Strategic, systems-level thinker with a bias toward action and clarity.

* Collaborative and comfortable working across distributed global teams.
* Effective communicator. Able to influence and align with internal and external stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities and complex technology stacks.

**Build**
We are seeking a Product Expert to drive SAP’s vision for intelligent, end-to-end procurement experiences. In this role, you will work with product and engineering leaders. You will focus on sourcing, contracting, buying, and fulfillment. Your goal is to define and implement a clear product and AI strategy. This strategy will link these areas. It will use shared intelligence, contextual grounding, and workflow orchestration. You will translate the latest AI advancements into scalable, production-grade features that elevate user experiences, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable business outcomes across the procurement suite. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you’ll need well-developed technical fluency in LLMs, retrieval and grounding, and platform services to bridge engineering, data, and business teams across SAP’s ecosystem.
  
  
You will help create a plan for procurement applications and AI features. These features include assistants, agents, recommendations, insights, and automation. You will also ensure that everything aligns with Joule, SAP Knowledge Graph, the SAP Business Data Cloud, and central AI services. You’ll collaborate with engineering and platform teams to manage dependencies, accelerate delivery, and ensure consistency across products. In addition, you’ll work closely with other procurement and enterprise PMs to define how intelligent agents, shared models, and orchestration frameworks integrate across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems. This role will be pivotal in guiding teams toward an AI-first procurement experience, ensuring our products remain interoperable, grounded, and future-ready.

* Shape Product and AI Strategy: Contribute and drive the procurement application and AI roadmap aligning with Joule, KG, BDC, central AI services, and support user research and customer events.

* Own the Product and AI Lifecycle: Partner with engineering and data science to design, test, and launch production-ready AI features and models.
* Define Success Metrics: Establish and track KPIs for product and AI performance, adoption, and business impact to guide continuous improvement.
* Ensure Data Quality: Collaborate with PMs to build ground-truth datasets and evaluate ML/AI feature quality using quantitative and qualitative signals.
* Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with UX, platform, and domain teams to ensure consistent, contextual AI experiences across the procurement suite.
* Drive Market Alignment: Partner with Product Marketing to articulate product and AI vision, differentiation, and customer value for go-to-market success.

We are part of the SAP Ariba Product Management organization. Our mission is to be the single front-door for end users to simplify their work and automate business workflows. As product leaders within this domain, we bridge engineering, field services, UX, and platform teams to define and deliver visionary capabilities grounded in real enterprise needs. We collaborate across functions and geographies to craft product strategy, prioritize roadmap features, manage dependencies, and drive adoption. title: Sr.Technical Product Manager - InsurTech
description:
**About Chubb**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com .
  
  
**About Chubb India**
At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow
  
  
With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.
  
  
We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Job Title: Sr.Technical Product Manager**
**Function/Department: Technology**
**Employment Type: Full-time**
**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore**
**Position Summary**
**Key Responsibilities:**
This is a product role for someone who has shipped AI-enabled products — not managed the backlog for an AI team. You know what a prompt looks like, you have opinions on model selection, you have navigated the "AI works in demo, fails in production" problem. You bring product instincts, insurance domain fluency, and enough technical depth to be taken seriously by engineers and architects. You will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery outcomes for technology products within the insurance domain.
  
  

* Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for insurance technology products — real ownership means writing the hard prioritization decisions, not just the tickets.
* Define AI product capabilities with precision: what the model does, what it cannot do, how confidence is handled, how humans stay in the loop.
* Translate complex insurance business problems into crisp, buildable product specifications.
* Define and track outcome metrics for AI features — including model performance indicators such as precision/recall thresholds and human override rates.
* Drive discovery: user research, stakeholder interviews, data analysis, and rapid hypothesis testing.
* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, architecture, design, and data science — you are a co-owner of delivery, not a requirements dispenser.
* Stay close to the regulatory and compliance landscape for AI in insurance; proactively factor it into product decisions.
* Communicate product strategy and trade-offs clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Indicative experience: 15+ years in product management or technical programme management.
* Candidates with fewer years but a strong AI product track record are encouraged to apply. Insurance domain experience is advantageous.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
  

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:
  
  

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances

title: Product Lead, Finance Accounting
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Finance Accounting team builds the accounting foundation behind Rippling’s Finance products. We help customers turn the activity happening across spend, procurement, reimbursements, and other finance workflows into accurate, auditable data in their ERP.
  
  
This is a high-leverage product area where accounting infrastructure, ERP connectivity, and AI automation meet. The team’s work spans the full lifecycle of financial data: helping customers configure accounting rules, validate transactions before they post, recover when syncs fail, and ultimately close their books with more confidence and less manual work.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead Finance Accounting at Rippling. You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance products and help define the future of accounting automation on top of Rippling’s platform.
  
  
Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.
  
  
Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. That gives us the context to automate work accountants perform manually today and to build an accounting product that can become a major platform in its own right.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Set the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Accounting, with a clear point of view on how Rippling should help finance teams translate their operational activity in Rippling into accurate accounting outcomes.
* Build the core accounting platform behind Rippling’s Finance products, including the workflows customers use to configure rules, map data, post to their ERP, and resolve issues when syncs fail.
* Design product experiences that give accountants confidence in the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of their books.
* Lead the development of AI-assisted accounting workflows that help customers validate transactions, identify exceptions, recover from failures, and reduce manual close work.
* Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences.
* Spend time with customers, implementation teams, support, accounting experts, and ERP partners to understand where accounting workflows break down and where the product can remove friction.
* Define how Rippling should support enterprise customers and their unique needs, like multi-entity setups, tax and currency needs, and high expectations for controls and reporting.

**What You Will Need**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy.
* Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure.
* A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them, or the ability to quickly develop fluency in them.
* The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems.
* Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand.
* High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.
  
  
****Nice to have****

* Experience building accounting, ERP, fintech, or financial operations products.
* Familiarity with systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience with month-end close, reconciliation, transaction coding, or financial integrations.
* Experience building AI agents or AI-powered workflow products.
* Experience building products for controllers, accountants, or enterprise finance teams.

**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.**

title: Sr Product Designer
description:
The Senior Product designer is responsible for building empathy for the Target Guest throughout the product development lifecycle for Target’s web, app and registry product teams and also working enterprise level tools supporting the internal operations through enabling effortless experiences. As a pivotal member the Target India’s UX team, this team member will support Product Designers, Product Managers and Engineering for a broad set of digital and in-store experiences.

* Support product/project teams (product owners, designers, engineering) throughout the project life cycle – recommending appropriate methodology, scoping, and coordinating the entire process, facilitating in-field research and post-research synthesis through analysis.
* Conduct and synthesize qualitative research needed by the projects – including, but not limited to: in person moderated testing, remote moderated & unmoderated testing, surveys, heuristic reviews, benchmark studies, concept testing, online & in-store intercepts, ethnographies, shop-alongs.
* Assist the broader team in keeping our ongoing research library up-to-date and comprehensive.
* Build wireframes and interactive prototypes within the desired timelines of agile sprints
* Enable test and iterate approach for product development.

Required Qualifications

* Strong Wireframing and prototyping abilities

* Experience practicing UX design research for digital product teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to cross functional partners

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable speaking to a diverse group of people and leading conversations to discover research insights.
* A strong ability to tell compelling stories from data.
* Comfortable within ambiguity with the ability to prioritize; demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects (both small and large) and adjust to changing priorities
* Strong project management skills – experience managing multiple projects at various stages in the project life cycle.
* Experience running, recruiting, moderating and analysis of online panels and thinking strategically about their application.
* Experience working as part of Agile teams

**About You**

* Four-year degree in Design, Fine Art, or similar area, or equivalent experience
* Minimum 8+ years of experience
* Experience in Lean UX Research methods, including remote moderated & unmoderated testing, online & in-context (store) intercepts.
* Demonstrated understanding of user testing methods & technologies.
* Computer design system skills including Adobe Tools, Sketch, InVision and similar
* Commercial sense, market knowledge, ability to research and apply market/trend information
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to successfully work in a team environment and to respond to business objectives with creative, innovative, and cost-effective design solutions
* Knowledge of product development processes

**\*Job Title:\* Branch Manager**

\*Experience:\* 5–8 Years

\*Qualification:\* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management or any equivalent field

\*Salary:\* Upto 6 LPA (depending on experience and Interview)

\*Department:\* Branch Sales & Operations

\*Industry:\* Banking / NBFC / Financial Services

**\*Job Description:\***

We are looking for an experienced Branch Manager to independently manage overall branch operations, business development, sales targets, portfolio quality, collections and team performance. The candidate will be responsible for driving branch profitability, ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining customer relationships and managing all aspects of branch functioning in accordance with company policies and regulatory guidelines.

**\*Key Responsibilities:\***

\* Take complete ownership of branch operations, business performance, profitability and overall P&L.

\* Drive branch revenue, achieve business targets and manage the overall product portfolio.

\* Prepare and monitor daily, weekly and monthly business plans, sales targets and performance reports.

\* Manage branch portfolio quality and monitor AUM, timely interest collections, overdue accounts and recovery performance.

\* Identify new business opportunities through local market research, customer acquisition and business development activities.

\* Oversee day-to-day branch operations, customer service, administration and operational governance.

\* Ensure proper verification of customer documents, KYC, loan applications and approval processes within delegated authority.

\* Monitor operational security, asset safety and compliance with internal procedures.

\* Lead and manage the branch team, allocate responsibilities, monitor individual performance and ensure achievement of targets.

\* Coordinate with sales, collections, customer service, HR, finance, legal and other internal departments.

\* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, statutory guidelines, internal policies and audit standards.

\* Coordinate with external stakeholders, vendors and relevant agencies for smooth branch functioning.

**\*Key Requirements:\***

\* 5–8 years of experience in Banking, NBFC or Financial Services, preferably in branch management.

\* Strong understanding of loan operations, portfolio management, collections, overdue recovery and asset quality.

\* Good leadership, communication, negotiation and decision-making skills.

title: Java Springboot Module Lead
description:
Company Description

  
  

**About Sopra Steria**
  
Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.
  
**The world is how we shape it.**

  
  

Job Description

  
  

**About the Role**

As a Senior API Developer, you will own the design and development of new APIs and services on our cloud platform. This is a **hands-on, build-focused engineering role**: you will spend your time designing, coding, and delivering new API capabilities, not working in a production-support or maintenance function. You will work closely with product managers, architects, QA, and DevOps teams, and mentor junior engineers along the way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deliver secure, high-performance RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.

* Build and expose APIs using AWS services such as Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and related integration services.

* Define API contracts and specifications, versioning approaches, and standards for consistency across teams.

* Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and API-first solutions.

* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, including unit and integration tests, and champion engineering best practices.

* Implement API security, including authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT), throttling, and rate limiting.

* Participate in design reviews and code reviews, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members.

* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments in collaboration with DevOps.

* Optimize API performance, scalability, and reliability through thoughtful design and monitoring.

* Produce clear technical documentation for internal and external API consumers.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **4 - 8 years** of professional software development experience, with a strong track record in **API development** (new builds and feature development, not primarily support or maintenance work).

* Strong hands-on expertise in **Java** (Java 8 or higher; Java 11/17 preferred).

* Deep experience with the **Spring Boot** framework, including Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Security.

* Proven experience designing and building **RESTful APIs** and microservices.

* Practical experience with **AWS API services**, particularly Amazon API Gateway, along with AWS Lambda and other core AWS services (e.g., S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, CloudWatch).

* Solid understanding of HTTP, JSON, API design principles, and API lifecycle management.

* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB).

* Experience with version control (Git) and build tools.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in an Agile environment.

* Good written and verbal communication skills.

  

**Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS/EKS).

* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.

* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CloudFormation).

* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, SQS, SNS).

* Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) and observability tools.

* AWS certification (e.g., Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate).

  

**Education**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to build new, impactful API products rather than maintain legacy systems.

* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture with room to grow into technical leadership.

  

**Total Experience Expected: 04-08 years**

  
  

Qualifications

  
  

BE graduate with API and Microservices experience

  
  

Additional Information

  
  

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

* Test free-shipping thresholds, gifting and pack options that raise order value without price cuts
* Track AOV by traffic source and product, and act on what you find

**Website roadmap and delivery**

* Own a prioritised roadmap of site improvements, ranked by expected revenue impact
* Write clear briefs for our Shopify developer and test every change before it goes live
* Evaluate and manage Shopify apps; remove ones that slow the site or no longer earn their place
* Keep tracking accurate (GA4, Meta Pixel, conversion events) with the Growth team, so every result can be trusted

**Working across the team**

* With the Growth Manager: make sure landing pages match the ads that send traffic to them
* With the Retention Manager: improve account, reorder and post-purchase experiences on site
* With the Creative Lead: brief imagery, video and copy for product pages and tests
* Share a weekly website performance report and a monthly review of tests run, results and next priorities with the Head of Growth

**How you'll be measured**

Targets for each metric are agreed with you in your first 30 days, from the current baseline.

Metric

What it tells us

Website conversion rate

Share of sessions that place an order

Average order value (AOV)

Revenue per order, with no discounts

Revenue per visitor (RPV)

Conversion rate and AOV combined

Add-to-cart rate

How well product pages persuade

Checkout completion rate

How smooth cart and checkout are

Page speed (Core Web Vitals)

Whether the site is fast enough on mobile

Tests shipped per month, and revenue from winners

Pace and impact of the optimisation programme

**Who you are**

**Must have**

* 2–5 years in D2C or e-commerce, with hands-on work on a Shopify store
* At least one change you led that moved conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor, and the numbers to show it
* Comfortable in GA4 and Shopify analytics; you build your own reports and don't wait for someone else to pull data
* Experience running A/B tests, and you know when a result is real and when it isn't
* You can write a clear brief a developer can build from without a meeting
* Strong sense of mobile UX and what makes someone trust a brand enough to buy
* Commercial thinking: you connect site changes to revenue, not just clicks

**Good to have**

* MBA (Marketing, Strategy or Operations)
* Fashion, apparel or women's wear D2C experience
* Tools such as Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, VWO, Convert, or Shopify A/B testing apps
* Basic HTML, CSS or Shopify Liquid, enough to understand what's easy and what's hard to build
* Experience with bundles, product recommendations and post-purchase upsells

**Why join**

* **Real ownership.** The website's conversion rate and AOV are yours, with your name on the results.
* **You can ship.** A dedicated Shopify developer builds what you prioritise, so ideas don't sit in a backlog.
* **A focused team.** You'll work alongside growth, retention, social and creative specialists, reporting to the Head of Growth.
* **A clear path.** This role can grow into a wider D2C product or growth leadership role as the brand scales.
* **Pay tied to impact.** A performance bonus linked to conversion rate and AOV.

title: Senior Content Marketer
description:
**About Plane**
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.
  
  
Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.
  
  
Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.
  
  
Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
  
  
****Humans and agents****
We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.
  
  
Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.
  
  
This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.
  
  
**About The Role**
Plane gets evaluated in public. Our docs, our issue tracker, and comparison pages written by competitors are all evidence a buyer collects before they talk to anyone here. You will own the content that meets them there, which means the roadmap of what we publish, the standard every page is held to, and most of the drafts. This is a writing job first. You will work with product managers on what shipped rather than what was announced, with Sales on the objections that stall enterprise evaluations, and with the community team, whose forum threads are a steady supply of real questions.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Own the content roadmap across discovery and evaluation: what gets written, refreshed, consolidated, or killed. You defend those calls with signups, product qualified leads, and assisted conversions rather than pageviews.
* Own the comparison and migration surfaces for Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp. These pages get read mid-evaluation with a competitor's sales team in the other tab, so they have to be accurate enough to survive that reader.
* Write for two audiences without patronizing either. A self-hoster debugging a container upgrade and a VP of engineering justifying a migration budget both have to reach the end of the page.
* Turn releases into content that says what changed and who it is for, built from the pull requests and the product manager rather than from the announcement blurb.
* Build the proof that shortens an enterprise evaluation: deployment stories, customer evidence, and content on security, governance, and data residency. Much of this means asking regulated customers for permission we will sometimes not get, and writing without it when we do not.
* Work daily with product managers, design, and community, and put every technical draft in front of the engineer who built the thing before it goes live.
* Do the maintenance: auditing pages that rank for the wrong query, rewriting posts that aged badly after a release, fixing internal links across the site, and consolidating pages that compete with each other.

****What you'll bring****

* You ship final drafts You write long form that goes live with light editing, and you can point to three pieces you would still defend a year later.
* You have grown organic traffic that converted Keyword strategy, internal linking, refreshes, and topical authority are things you have run end to end, with signups or pipeline at the other end of them.
* You write about technical products without distorting them You have covered software you did not build, checked claims against the product, and been corrected by an engineer without it becoming a problem.
* You have written competitive content Comparison, migration, or alternatives pages in a category where the other side had a bigger budget than you.
* You have editorial judgment about other people's work You can brief a writer, cut a draft in half, and explain why, because part of this job is improving writing you did not do.

****Nice to haves****

* You have used Plane, run it self-hosted, or written for an open project whose community will correct you in public.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment content: SSO, audit logs, data residency, air-gapped installs.
* You have built templates, docs-adjacent content, or product education that people still use.
* You have opinions about what AI search is doing to content strategy, and you have tested them.

****Why Plane?****
Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.
  
  
**The scope is real.**
We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.
  
  
**The constraints make you better.**
Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.
  
  
**The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production.**
We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.
  
  
**Your name is on the work.**
The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.
  
  
*Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Engineer
description:
* Position Summary

The ESS Specifications, Standards & Guidelines serves as the operational and technical documentation to the Engineering Technical Authority team. This role helps ensure that Engineering Specifications, Standards and Guidelines remain current, internally consistent, easier to find, and better aligned with applicable industry standards and recognized engineering practices.
  
  
The resource will work closely with ETA subject matter experts (SMEs), document owners, to coordinate document updates, support the development of new ESS documents, maintain search and access capabilities, and cascade changes through the EDL platform and established communications.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

**ESS Maintenance & Industry Alignment:**
Maintain assigned Amgen Engineering Specifications, Standards and Guidelines and coordinate periodic reviews to improve clarity, consistency, usability, and alignment with applicable industry standards and engineering practices.
  
  
**SME Document Revision Support:**
Provide hands-on support to ETA SMEs during document updates and revisions, including document control coordination, incorporation of SME comments, formatting, reference checking, revision history, review-cycle tracking, and preparation for approval.
  
  
**New ESS Development:**
Support ETA in the development of new Specifications, Standards and Guidelines by coordinating inputs, facilitating working sessions, organizing source material, and progressing drafts through the established review and approval process.
  
  
**ESS Change Cascade & Communications:**
Cascade information on new and updated ESS documents to ETA and the broader engineering community through the EDL platform and agreed communication channels. Maintain concise change summaries, effective dates, links to current documents, and communication records.
  
  
**Governance & Coordination:**
Maintain a practical ESS tracker and review calendar; monitor document status, owners, planned revisions, approvals, and publication; identify overdue or high-priority actions; and provide routine status reporting to ETA leadership.
  
  

* EDL Platform & Communication Support

The resource will maintain the operational interface for ESS updates in the EDL environment, including the established "Updated ESS Documents" SharePoint list and related communication process.
  
  

* Post or coordinate publication of approved ESS changes in accordance with ETA governance.
* Prepare short, user-focused update messages covering document title, revision, change summary, effective date, impacted audience, and link to the current version.
* Maintain a communication record so ETA can confirm that updates were cascaded to the intended engineering audience.
* Interfaces & Collaboration

Primary interfaces include ETA Technical Authorities and SMEs, Engineering discipline leads, Facilities/Utilities, project engineering teams, Quality/Validation stakeholders as applicable, document owners, and digital/knowledge-management platform support. The resource is expected to work hybrid time zones and maintain a predictable communication rhythm with global stakeholders.
  
  

* Working Hours & Global Collaboration Model

The role should be structured to provide reliable support to U.S., Europe, and Asia stakeholders. The working model may be established as Hybrid. The selected model should preserve protected time for focused document work while providing planned overlap for SME reviews, global meetings, and ESS change communications.
  
  
HYBRID
  
  
Mon-Thu: 9:30 AM-3:30 PM at site, with split remote work before/after site hours; Fri: 9:00 AM-6:00 PM ET
  
  
Per AIN reference: 3 hr with PT; 3 hr with ET; 5 hr with EU; 6 hr with Singapore
  
  
Best when on-site ETA/SME interaction is important while retaining global collaboration flexibility.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* 5 to 9 years for work experience
* Skills & Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, technical communications, information management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Experience working with engineering standards, specifications, procedures, technical documentation, or controlled document systems in a regulated or highly structured environment.
* Strong technical writing, editing, document-control, and information-organization skills.
* Ability to work effectively with subject matter experts and translate technical inputs into clear, usable document content without changing technical intent.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, document libraries, metadata/search concepts, and collaboration tools or equivalent engineering knowledge platforms is desirable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple document revisions, deadlines, reviewers, and approvals simultaneously.
* Comfort working across global time zones and adjusting meeting windows when critical SME or stakeholder participation is required.
* Working knowledge of how external codes, standards, and industry guidance influence engineering requirements; the role is expected to coordinate and research, while technical ownership remains with the designated ETA SME.
