title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About Plane**
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.
  
  
Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.
  
  
Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.
  
  
Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
  
  
****Humans and agents****
We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.
  
  
Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.
  
  
This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.
  
  
**About The Role**
Plane ships one product to three very different buyers: a team that signs up on Cloud in a minute, an organization that runs it on its own infrastructure, and one that runs it on machines with no internet connection. The same release has to be explained to all three, and the differences between what each one gets are real. You own the messaging system underneath that: what we claim for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, the proof behind each claim, and how a launch reaches the site, the docs, Sales, and the community as one story rather than three. You will work with product managers on what shipped, with Sales on the objections that decide enterprise deals, and with the community, who file an issue when a marketing page overstates the product.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Own positioning for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, and the source of truth for every claim and the proof behind it. When someone asks whether we can say something, you decide.
* Own how capability maps to edition and tier. Cloud, self-hosted commercial, and air-gapped customers get different things, and the page has to say which.
* Lead launches end to end: narrative, plan, page, announcement, email, in-product copy, and enablement, closed out with a review that names what moved and changes the next launch.
* Own the product, solution, industry, and comparison pages. These get read mid-evaluation against Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp by people who use the competitor daily.
* Run the research the positioning rests on: customer and prospect interviews, lost-deal reasons, community threads, and competitive moves, turned into language we can publish.
* Work weekly with product managers, design, Sales, and the community team, and take contested claims to the engineer who built the feature before they ship.
* Maintain the library that goes stale on its own: battlecards, edition explainers, demo scripts, and FAQs. Check claims against the docs one page at a time before every launch, because an overstated claim returns as a support ticket or a lost deal.

****What you'll bring****

* You have owned positioning that changed results. You can name the product, the claim you changed, and what moved after: adoption, conversion, or win rate.
* You ship the copy, not only the brief. Web-ready pages and launch assets that went live under your name.
* You have run launches across functions. You have held a date with product, design, Sales, and support attached to it, and you can describe one that went badly and what you changed.
* You can hold your own with technical audiences and enterprise buyers. You have written for developers and IT without distorting the product, and sat in evaluations where security and deployment decided the outcome.
* You work from evidence. Customer interviews, sales calls, and product data, used to settle positioning arguments.

****Nice to haves****

* You have marketed an open-source or open-core product, where the community reads the code and corrects the page.
* You have shipped multi-edition software where capability differs by deployment.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment narratives: SSO, audit logs, data residency, air-gapped installs.
* You have positioned a product where AI agents act on customer data, and you have opinions about what can honestly be claimed for them.

****Why Plane?****
Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.
  
  
**The scope is real.**
We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.
  
  
**The constraints make you better.**
Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.
  
  
**The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production.**
We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.
  
  
**Your name is on the work.**
The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.
  
  
*Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

**Job Overview:**

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

**Responsibilities:**

Product Discovery & Capability Support

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.

* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.

* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.

* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.

* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.

* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:

* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions

* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls

* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies

* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution & Delivery

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.

* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.

* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.

* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.

* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

**What are we looking for?**

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.

* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)

* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.

* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis

* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.

* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.

* Solid understanding of:

* Data modeling and semantic consistency

* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts

* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

**Preferences****:**

* Data platform decisions are made with **clear understanding of downstream impact and value**.

* Platform teams have strong analytical support when defining and evolving shared data capabilities.

* Data quality and semantic issues are identified early, before they impact consumers.

**Core Competencies****:**

* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.

* Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).

* Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.

* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.

The ideal candidate is technically strong and can take our hardware products from concept to mass production, aligning internal engineering teams, managing vendors and contract manufacturers, and making sure products ship on time, on budget and to quality. This role offers high ownership, direct impact on products that reach the market, and the chance to build next-generation smart glasses from the ground up.

**Who are we looking for:**

* We are looking for a Technical Project Manager with a strong technical foundation in electronics, PCB design, embedded systems, sensors and mechanical integration, who can own hardware programs end to end through the NPI lifecycle.
* The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with contract manufacturers, proven strength in procurement and vendor management, and a track record of leading cross-functional teams across hardware, firmware, software and supply chain.

**Top 3 Daily Tasks:**

* Build and track integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets and resource plans for hardware programs.
* Work closely with electrical, mechanical, optical, firmware and software engineers on design trade-offs and issue resolution.
* Manage vendors and contract manufacturers, track lead times, and drive issues to closure with clear owners and timelines.

**Minimum work experience is required:**

Minimum 8 years of total experience, including 4 years managing hardware/electronics projects.

**Top 5 Skills you should possess:**

* Strong technical foundation in electronics, PCB design, embedded systems, sensors and mechanical integration.
* Hands-on experience with the NPI process (EVT, DVT, PVT) and working with contract manufacturers.
* Proven experience in procurement, sourcing, negotiation and vendor management.
* Ability to read and review schematics, BOMs, mechanical drawings and test reports.
* Proficiency with project management tools (MS Project, Jira, Asana or similar) and excellent communication skills.

**What would you be expected to do:**

* Own end-to-end delivery of hardware programs through the NPI lifecycle: concept, EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production.
* Run phase-gate and design reviews and ensure exit criteria are met before each build stage
* Maintain risk registers and drive issues to closure with clear owners and timelines
* Coordinate prototype builds, validation, reliability and certification testing (BIS, CE, FCC, RoHS)
* Act as the single point of coordination between engineering, product, quality, supply chain and leadership
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors for components, PCBAs, optics, displays, batteries and mechanical parts
* Manage contract manufacturers (CM/ODM/EMS), including RFQs, quotations, negotiation and purchase orders
* Track lead times, long-lead and EOL parts, and plan alternate sources to de-risk supply
* Monitor vendor quality, cost and delivery, and drive BOM cost-down with finance and supply chain

**Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or a related engineering field.

**Good to have:**

* Experience with wearables, AR/VR/XR devices, smart glasses or consumer electronics
* Familiarity with optics, micro-displays, camera modules, battery and thermal design
* Experience working with suppliers in India, China, Taiwan or Southeast Asia
* PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile certification

title: Mgr MS&T
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
The
**Manager, MS&T External Manufacturing**
is a individual‑contributor leadership role within Teva Global ExM, responsible for driving all technical and manufacturing‑operations engagements with external partners, including Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). The role provides strategic and hands‑on oversight to ensure product robustness, seamless technology transfer, scale‑up, and successful commercialization of externally manufactured products.
  
  
This position leads a team of technical professionals in supporting complex root‑cause investigations, offering technical intelligence for deviations, technical complaints, OOS results, and CAPA activities. The Associate Director ensures that all external manufacturing processes consistently meet the highest standards of quality, operational excellence, and cGMP compliance, while maintaining products and processes in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in manufacturing sciences, process engineering, and process optimization, combined with strong knowledge of cGMP, global regulatory expectations, and project management principles. Success in this role requires the ability to collaborate effectively across cross‑functional teams and influence external partners to achieve reliable supply, regulatory compliance, and continuous performance improvement.
  
  
Thus, the role will provide stewardship by ensuring that both manufacturing operations at external suppliers and performance of Teva products are monitored & maintained in a validated state
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in manufacturing sciences, process optimization, and a thorough understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Project Management, simple & complex topical products products experience and will be adept at managing cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes with external partners
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
**External Manufacturing Partner Management:**

* Establish and Maintain Relationships with CMO/ CDMO manufacturing organization:

+ Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with CMO/ CDMO manufacturing organization to ensure successful product manufacturing, process development, and scale-up activities
+ Provide technical expertise and guidance to CMOs on process optimization, scale-up, and troubleshooting.
+ Support transfer of new products or processes to external manufacturing sites

* Monitor Performance:

+ Assess the performance of external manufacturing partners, identify opportunities for improvement
+ Ongoing performance tracking for external manufacturing, including quality, cost, delivery, and efficiency. Ensure the alignment of external sites with Teva expectations

* Communication and Escalation:

+ Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day technical and operational issues related to external manufacturing. Escalate concerns to senior management when necessary.

**Process Development & Optimization**

* Manufacturing Support:

+ Oversee technical aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure they meet product specifications, regulatory standards, and Teva requirements
+ Optimize existing manufacturing processes for efficiency, robustness, and yield
+ Provide technical leadership in scale-up and transfer of new products from development to commercial manufacturing.

* Process Improvement:

+ Continuously review and improve processes at external manufacturing sites to meet the Teva standards for product quality and operational efficiency
+ Introduce process improvements and ensure effective implementation at external sites
+ Evaluate and implement changes to improve robustness and scalability of manufacturing processes

* Troubleshooting:

+ Provide technical troubleshooting support for issues that arise at external manufacturing facilities. Lead cross-functional teams to address /resolve issues that impact production timelines
+ Lead investigations into deviations and work with CMOs to implement corrective actions

**Quality And Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure Compliance:

+ Ensure that all manufacturing activities at external sites are compliant with cGMP, ICH, FDA, EMA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

* Audit and Inspection Support:

+ Lead and/or support external manufacturing site audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions, ensuring that CMOs meet all quality standards and regulatory requirements.

* Deviation and CAPA Management:

+ Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for manufacturing deviations, non-conformances, and other quality issues at external sites
+ Collaborate with external partners to implement CAPAs effectively

**Technology Transfer And Scale-up**

* Manage Technology Transfer:

+ Lead the technology transfer process for new products or processes to external manufacturing sites, ensuring that the transfer is executed smoothly and within timelines

* Manage Material transfer projects:

+ Lead material transfer project s (Changes in API/ Excipient etc.) and ensure timely completion

* Scale-up Support:

+ Oversee the scaling up of manufacturing processes, ensuring that commercial production is consistent with development batches in terms of product quality and process performance.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Cross-departmental Coordination:

+ Work closely with internal teams such as Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Product Development to ensure seamless integration of manufacturing processes and that timelines are met.

* Project Management:

+ Manage or contribute to cross-functional project teams, ensuring that all aspects of product commercialization and manufacturing at external sites are executed efficiently and on schedule

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and documentation for both internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for external manufacturing operations, providing updates to senior leadership.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Master’s Degree in Pharma, Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering
* 10+ years pharmaceutical manufacturing/validation/other related experience for US FDA approved sites
* Strong experience in working with external manufacturing partners (CMOs, CDMOs, etc.)
* Good oral and written communication skills, attention to detail, ability to work independently, good people skills, demonstrated organizational skills
* Need to be experienced in simple & complex topical Products Manufacturing and Technologies in Pharma Industry
* 20 - 30% Local Or International (as applicable)

**Also Good to Have**

* Strong technical background with expertise in manufacturing processes, process development, and scale-up.
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting & analytical skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build relationships with external partners.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with manufacturing management systems (e.g., SAP, MES).
* Thorough familiarity with cGMPs, SOP's, relevant government regulations, and current industry standards

**Job Type**
This is fixed term position as role required till Dec.2028
  
  
**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.
  
  
That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.
  
  
Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.
  
  
Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.
  
  
**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: Senior Team Leader
description:
**Turner Technical Services (TTS)**

Mumbai / Bengaluru

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Department:**
Mechanical Engineering / MEP / Construction Project Management

**About the Role**

Turner Technical Services (TTS) is looking for an experienced Senior Team Leader – Mechanical to lead a team providing mechanical engineering, construction support, and project management support for US-based construction projects from our Mumbai or Bengaluru office.

The role involves technical leadership and project delivery across HVAC, ventilation, ductwork, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, mechanical piping, document control, RFIs, submittals, budgeting, procurement, commissioning, and project closeout.

The selected candidate will be responsible for team management, technical reviews, resource planning, stakeholder coordination, and ensuring timely, high-quality project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage mechanical engineers and project support teams working on US construction projects.
* Plan resources, assign responsibilities, monitor productivity, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Conduct technical reviews, team meetings, performance evaluations, and coaching sessions.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and team development.
* Act as the escalation point for technical and project delivery issues.

**Mechanical Engineering & Technical Oversight**

* Provide technical leadership across HVAC, ventilation, ductwork, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, mechanical piping, and associated systems.
* Review mechanical drawings, specifications, calculations, layouts, schematics, and schedules for accuracy, compliance, and constructability.
* Review shop drawings, technical submittals, material approvals, method statements, and installation sequences.
* Prepare and review RFIs, technical queries, value engineering proposals, and design recommendations.
* Review testing, adjusting and balancing (TAB), pressure testing, flushing, commissioning, and system turnover requirements.
* Coordinate mechanical requirements with architectural, structural, and electrical teams.
* Monitor procurement activities, long-lead equipment, and technical documentation.

**Project Delivery & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with US project teams, project managers, consultants, trade partners, vendors, and commissioning agencies.
* Participate in project meetings, design reviews, procurement discussions, and commissioning meetings.
* Track RFIs, submittals, technical issues, procurement activities, and project closeout requirements.
* Identify project risks, resolve technical issues, and ensure timely closure of assigned actions.
* Prepare technical reports, project dashboards, risk summaries, and recovery plans.

**Document Control & Contract Management**

* Manage mechanical project documentation, including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, and change documents.
* Monitor document revisions, approval workflows, submission status, and outstanding technical actions.
* Ensure compliance with project documentation standards and contractual requirements.
* Maintain accurate project records and document registers.

**Project Closeout & Commissioning**

* Lead mechanical project closeout activities across HVAC, plumbing, drainage, and fire protection systems.
* Oversee preparation and review of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, testing records, TAB reports, and commissioning documentation.
* Coordinate with project teams and commissioning agencies to ensure timely system turnover and client handover.
* Track closeout deliverables and resolve documentation gaps.

**Budgeting & Commercial Management**

* Support mechanical project budgeting, cost tracking, approval workflows, and financial documentation.
* Review trade partner proposals, BOQs/quantities, quotations, scope changes, and commercial variations.
* Support contractor payment applications, schedule-of-values reviews, and payment approval tracking.
* Monitor procurement commitments, cost variations, budget risks, and forecasting requirements.

**Quality, Safety & Risk Management**

* Identify and mitigate technical, commercial, procurement, scheduling, and construction risks.
* Ensure quality reviews of mechanical drawings, calculations, submittals, installation methods, testing, and commissioning.
* Promote safe construction practices, technical compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Master's degree in Construction Management, Project Management, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related mechanical discipline is preferred.
* Approximately 10–15 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, MEP Construction, Project Controls, Technical Design Review, Commissioning, or Project Delivery.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in team leadership, supervision, or people management.
* Experience supporting international projects, particularly US construction or engineering projects, is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience across HVAC, ventilation, ductwork, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, mechanical piping, procurement, testing, commissioning, and project closeout.
* Hands-on experience reviewing RFIs, technical submittals, shop drawings, change orders, budgets, and payment applications.
* Working knowledge of US codes and standards, including ASHRAE, SMACNA, NFPA, IMC, IPC, and applicable energy and ventilation requirements.
* Knowledge of Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Aconex, and SAP is preferred.
* Exposure to Bluebeam is an added advantage.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**Work Location & Requirements:**

* Mumbai or Bengaluru office.
* Work from Office.
* Ability to collaborate with US project teams and provide overlap with US working hours when required.

title: Project Director
description:
Your responsibilities
  
  
As a Project Director, you carry overall accountability for the successful delivery of a strategically critical EPC/EPF project in the field of alkaline water electrolysis. You lead at executive level with ownership for a complex scope covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, cell assembly, logistics, construction interfaces, commissioning support and extended supervision. The role requires business judgment, solution orientation, technical credibility and the ability to lead international teams, drive decisions and secure results in a multi-company environment.
  
  

* You hold end-to-end accountability from bid and contract handover through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction interfaces, commissioning support, final acceptance and close-out.
* You establish the Project Execution Plan and governance model, including decision rights, organization, resource plan, management cadence and executive reporting.
* You integrate engineering, procurement, fabrication, quality, supply chain, logistics, project controls, commercial management and contract administration into one global, cross-functional and intercultural project team.
* You challenge bid assumptions, execution concepts, schedule logic, partner models and resource loading to secure a realistic and executable baseline.
* You own delivery performance against schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, quality, HSE and contractual commitments, intervening early when deviations threaten project outcomes.
* You govern technical, commercial, contractual, supply-chain and interface risks and ensure disciplined mitigation, contingency and recovery measures.
* You safeguard contractual entitlement through structured change control, timely notices, variation management, claims strategy, escalation and robust decision documentation.
* You act as the primary executive interface to the customer, project sponsors, steering committees, international partners, suppliers and other key stakeholders, resolving critical interfaces across organizations.
* You bring sufficient technical depth to challenge engineering-led solutions and drive timely, robust and executable decisions.
* You lead critical phases including execution ramp-up, major change, supply-chain disruption, instability and recovery through clear priorities and fact-based intervention.
* You guide Project Managers and senior discipline leads, setting high standards for safety, quality, integrity, accountability and collaboration.

Your profile
  
  

* You have completed a degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
* You have typically 20 or more years of experience in EPC project execution, including substantial leadership of major chemical, energy, hydrogen, electrolysis, process-plant, petrochemical or comparable industrial projects.
* You have proven accountability for complex projects involving international customers, consortium and multi-company interfaces under significant contractual and stakeholder pressure. Previous experience of executing projects in a consortium with international stakeholders and partners is an vital prerequisite for this position
* You have a strong command of project economics, integrated scheduling, cost forecasting, margin and cash protection, risk management, contract strategy, change control and claims.
* You have steered projects through difficult phases such as bid-to-execution transition, execution ramp-up, major contractual change, supply-chain disruption, recovery and final acceptance.
* You combine executive presence with delivery discipline and can lead large cross-functional and intercultural organizations over different international locations in a matrix environment.
* You exhibit strong leadership skills, can demonstrate good relationship management, take full ownership and drive decision making
* You hold a recognized senior project-management certification such as PMP, IPMA Level B/A or an equivalent qualification.
* You are fluent in business English. German or another relevant international language and experience working with Asian stakeholders are advantageous.
* You are willing to travel extensively in India and internationally and to accept extended project assignments when necessary.

Your benefits
  
  

* A strategically important leadership role in industrial-large-scale green hydrogen and electrolysis projects.
* High personal responsibility in an international, interdisciplinary environment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders.
* Development opportunities aligned with individual strengths, experience and career goals.
* Flexible working arrangements where compatible with project requirements, together with modern workplace infrastructure and group-wide employee programs.

**Company**
thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023. www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

title: Senior Associate
description:
Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

**Purpose of the Position**

The Associate of Private Credit Investment Analytics will help build the development of Pantheon’s private credit data and intelligence capability, transforming investment data into structured, decision-ready insight for Portfolio Management teams. This role sits at the intersection of Investment, Data and Operations, and will focus on strengthening the firm’s ability to generate consistent, comparable, and actionable intelligence from credit portfolio data — across funds, GPs, structures, and geographies. The Associate will help architect and operate scalable analytical frameworks that standardize how private credit data is defined, sourced, governed, and translated into insight. The role will partner closely with Portfolio Management, Investment Data Operations and Data Engineering teams to embed credit analytics into Pantheon’s evolving data platforms, reducing reliance on bespoke spreadsheets and increasing transparency, comparability, and confidence This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Pantheon’s private credit data & analytics capability at a time of significant growth and platform transformation

**Key Responsibilities**

* Help build private credit investment analytics across Pantheon to help evaluate and monitor investments.
* Act as an analytics partner to Investment and Portfolio Management teams, translating complex investment needs into structured data requirements and analytical frameworks.
* Support the definition, sourcing, and validation of investment-relevant datasets, ensuring analytical outputs are complete, comparable, and decision-ready.
* Deliver differentiated actionable insights by combining internal investment operations data with GP-reported and external market data, moving beyond descriptive reporting to comparative, diagnostic, and thematic analysis. Represent the data and analytics interface with GPs and external data/technology providers, shaping data standards, templates, and requirements to improve transparency, coverage, and usability.
* Develop Investment Analytics to become a business-facing function with a product mindset, creating a roadmap that prioritises initiatives based on investment impact, adoption, and measurable decision enablement.

**Knowledge and Experience Required**

* Significant experience in private markets, with strong exposure to private credit, portfolio data, analytics or investment operations
* Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to support investment or portfolio decision making, using advanced & emerging AI toolkit to elevate the speed, rigor, and quality of insight generation
* Strong understanding of data governance, comparability challenges, and portfolio transparency
* Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels
* Proven ability to partner effectively with investment professionals and influence senior stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex information clearly and concisely
* Track record of delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines
* Curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies that enhance investment intelligence and operational effectiveness
* Experience with working 3rd party providers, data vendors & offshore teams
* Professional qualification (CFA, ACA, ACCA, IMC) or equivalent experience preferred but not essential

**Desirable Experience**

* Deep understanding of private credit structures, performance drivers, and portfolio monitoring
* Familiarity with modern data environments and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Python, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Experience systemising investment analytics within centralized data platforms.
* Exposure to automation or advanced analytical techniques to enhance portfolio monitoring

**This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.**

**Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.**

**We are not looking for someone who simply wants to come to the office, complete a few routine tasks, sit through fixed hours and go home.**

We don't believe in hiring people just to fill a chair.

We want someone who takes ownership, thinks independently, experiments with ideas, solves problems and genuinely cares about the work they produce.

We are a startup. We are still building our systems, processes, teams and brands. You will get opportunities to work directly with management, take responsibility for campaigns, experiment with marketing strategies and see the actual impact of your work.

You won't be restricted to one small department or one repetitive activity.

If you help build the business, we want to help build your career.

What we expect from you

We expect commitment, accountability and a willingness to learn.

* Take ownership of assigned work rather than waiting for someone to follow up.
* Understand the objective behind a task, not just execute instructions mechanically.
* Be proactive in identifying problems and suggesting solutions.
* Deliver work within agreed timelines.
* Be willing to experiment, learn new tools and adapt as the business grows.
* Understand that startup environments sometimes require flexibility and going beyond a narrowly defined job description.
* Treat the company's marketing budget, resources and reputation responsibly.

**We value contribution over attendance.** Being present in the office for 9–10 hours means very little if there is no meaningful output.

We are not looking for someone who watches the clock. We are looking for someone who watches the results.

A word about the startup environment

If you are specifically looking for a large corporate setup with multiple departments, rigid role boundaries, extensive administrative formalities and a highly structured leave and benefits framework, this may not be the right opportunity at this stage.

We are building our organisation, and our policies and employee benefits will evolve as we grow.

We believe in recognising people who demonstrate genuine commitment, consistency and responsibility. As the business grows, we want the people who helped build it to grow with it.

We are happy to provide greater flexibility, responsibility, learning opportunities and growth to people who demonstrate that they are invested in the journey.

**Your growth here will depend on what you bring to the table, not merely how long you have been sitting at it.**

Your Responsibilities

1. Meta Ads – Facebook & Instagram

* Set up, launch and manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Work on lead generation, Click-to-WhatsApp and retargeting campaigns.
* Configure campaign objectives, audiences, placements, budgets and instant forms.
* Monitor daily advertising performance, including spend, leads, CPL, CTR and frequency.
* Make routine campaign adjustments based on performance and management instructions.
* Test different creatives, ad copies and audience variations.
* Identify underperforming advertisements and suggest improvements.
* Maintain campaign records and execute approved advertising plans.

2. Google Ads Management

* Assist with setting up and managing Google Search campaigns.
* Conduct basic keyword research and prepare ad copies.
* Configure location targeting, negative keywords and ad extensions.
* Monitor CPC, CTR, clicks and conversion performance.
* Make routine campaign optimisations under management guidance.
* Assist with Google Business Profile updates and basic local SEO activities.

3. Social Media Content & Creative Development

* Design social media posts, stories, advertisements and WhatsApp creatives using Canva.
* Edit short-form videos and Instagram Reels using CapCut or similar applications.
* Prepare captions, headlines, hooks and basic advertising copy.
* Create content in English, with basic Hinglish and Marathi variations where required.
* Capture basic office, student, jewellery and product-related photographs/videos using a smartphone.
* Maintain and execute weekly content calendars for both brands.
* Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for social media and advertising.

4. Website Management & Basic SEO

* Perform routine content updates on existing Wix and WordPress websites.
* Update banners, pricing, service descriptions, offers, images and contact details.
* Check website forms, WhatsApp buttons and payment links periodically.
* Upload and format website content as required.
* Handle basic on-page SEO, including page titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
* Coordinate with external developers whenever technical changes are required.

5. Campaign Tracking & Reporting

* Maintain daily records of advertising expenditure and leads generated.
* Update campaign performance sheets.
* Monitor CPL, CPC, CTR and conversion rates.
* Assist in checking Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads conversion tracking.
* Share weekly performance reports with management.
* Maintain organised records of creatives, campaigns and advertising activities.

Skills & Qualifications

We are interested in what you can actually do, not just what your certificates say.

**Essential skills:**

* Basic to good working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.
* Understanding of Facebook and Instagram advertising.
* Basic working knowledge of Google Ads Search campaigns.
* Good command of Canva.
* Familiarity with CapCut or similar video editing applications.
* Practical familiarity with WordPress and/or Wix.
* Understanding of CPL, CPC, CTR, reach and other basic marketing metrics.
* Good written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Additional advantages:**

* Previous experience with Click-to-WhatsApp and lead-generation campaigns.
* Experience in education, immigration, consultancy, coaching or retail.
* Familiarity with Google Business Profile and local SEO.
* Basic knowledge of GA4, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.
* Photoshop, Premiere Pro or advanced video editing skills.

Who Should Apply?

**Freshers:** We are open to freshers who have completed practical digital marketing training and can demonstrate their skills through live campaign experience, internships, projects or a portfolio.

**Experienced candidates:** Individuals with 1–3 years of hands-on experience who can independently execute advertising campaigns and routine digital marketing activities.

We don't mind training the right person. But we expect the willingness to learn, take initiative and deliver.

Compensation & Growth

**₹12,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Compensation will depend on:

* Practical knowledge and demonstrated skills.
* Ability to independently execute campaigns.
* Quality and consistency of work.
* Experience and overall assessment during the interview.

We want to build a team, not just hire employees. People who demonstrate ownership, reliability and meaningful contribution will have opportunities to take on greater responsibilities, grow with the organisation and benefit as the businesses expand.

How to Apply

Don't just send us a resume saying you know digital marketing.

Show us what you can do.

Please share:

* Your updated resume.
* A brief description of your practical digital marketing experience.
* Sample creatives, Reels or videos you have created.
* Screenshots or examples of advertising campaigns you have managed, if available.
* Any portfolio or live projects you have worked on.

**Email:** info.migrantrix@gmail.com  
**WhatsApp:** +91 8329915513  
**Email Subject:** Application for Digital Marketing Executive – [Your Name]

**Work Location:** New Panvel East, Navi Mumbai  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, in-office.

Only candidates comfortable with working from our New Panvel office should apply.

Schedule - 10:00am to 7:00pm - Monday to Saturday

One final thing before you apply

If you are looking for a job where you can simply complete your hours, collect your salary and have no interest in what happens to the business, this probably isn't the place for you.

But if you are someone who wants to experiment, learn, take ownership, see your ideas implemented, work closely with decision-makers and be part of building two growing brands from an early stage, we would genuinely like to meet you.

**Come with skills, curiosity and commitment. Let's build something worthwhile together.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
**Reports To:**
Head of Digital Commercial Solutions
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
**Location:**
Pune

**Purpose of the role**

Digital experience is becoming increasingly important in how customers discover, engage with, and do business with SKF. As part of SKF's digital transformation journey, we are evolving the capabilities that enable customers, partners, investors, job seekers, and employees to interact with SKF in more seamless, consistent, and personalized ways.

We are looking for a Solution Owner to drive the evolution of key digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management. These capabilities are fundamental to SKF's ambition of delivering compelling, scalable, and globally consistent digital experiences across channels and markets.

As a Solution Owner, you will be responsible for translating business needs and customer insights into prioritized initiatives that create measurable value. Working closely with stakeholders across business and technology, you will ensure that SKF's digital platforms and capabilities continue to support a modern, efficient, and customer centric digital ecosystem.

In addition to continuously improving today's capabilities, you will help shape SKF's future digital landscape. This includes exploring and enabling new opportunities in AI, automation, content operations, personalization, and customer experience optimization, ensuring SKF is well positioned to adapt to rapidly changing customer expectations and technological advancements.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Shape and drive the vision, strategy, and evolution of SKF's digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management.
* Own and prioritize the SKF.com product backlog, ensuring investments are aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and SKF's digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities that strengthen SKF's brand, improve customer engagement, and create seamless end-to-end digital journeys.
* Lead the evolution of digital capabilities that enable global content creation, management, localization, and delivery at scale.
* Drive strategic transformation initiatives that modernize how SKF creates, manages, delivers, and optimizes digital experiences across markets, channels, and touchpoints.
* Explore and enable emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and data driven personalization, to improve efficiency, content effectiveness, and customer experiences.
* Define roadmaps and investment priorities that balance innovation, operational excellence, scalability, security, and long term business value.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, UX specialists, web developers, content teams, and external partners to turn strategy into impactful digital solutions.
* Champion a customer centric and data driven approach to decision making, ensuring digital experiences are informed by insights, user behavior, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure digital platforms and capabilities remain secure, resilient, adaptable, and ready to support future business growth and changing customer expectations.
* Build strong partnerships with technology vendors and implementation partners to accelerate innovation and maximize the value of SKF's digital investments.
* Promote modern product management, Agile, and DevSecOps practices that enable continuous improvement, faster delivery, and sustainable digital transformation.

****Main Requirements****

* Solid understanding of modern web and digital experience platforms including headless CMS or DXP platforms, modern frontend frameworks, analytics, technical SEO/GEO and web performance.
* Proven experience in a solution owner, product owner, digital product manager, application owner, or similar role, driving digital products and business capabilities in a complex environment.
* Experience leading digital experience platforms, global enterprise websites, content ecosystems, or customer facing digital solutions.
* Strong product management experience, including roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, value realization, and agile delivery.
* Experience working at the intersection of business and technology, translating strategic objectives into scalable digital capabilities.
* Knowledge of content management, content lifecycle management, digital asset management, translation management, digital experience delivery, or related disciplines.
* Understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data driven decision making, and emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and automation.
* Experience driving digital transformation initiatives and managing change across organizations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build alignment across business, IT, and external partners.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage audiences ranging from operational teams to senior leadership.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Product Owner
description:
**Product Owner- Information Management**
The Information Management Product Owner (“IM PO”) in BU Construction Software (“CSW”) enables CSW leadership and the wider Hilti performance management community to make informed decisions about Hilti’s software business by developing, owning, and engaging stakeholders on strategic data products. Drawing on strong technical and business knowledge, the CSW IM PO serves as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring high-quality management of BU CSW’s core steering data products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own CSW’s strategic data product landscape end-to-end, including roadmap development, intake and prioritization of feature requests and bug fixes, governance of product scope, and alignment with leadership and key stakeholders on the purpose, value, and evolution of CSW’s central data products.
* Define and structure business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders, translating needs into features, epics, user stories, and mock reports that guide technical delivery and align solutions with business objectives.
* Act as the primary business interface to IT reporting leads and back-end data product developers, ensuring agreed business priorities are translated into technical requirements and ultimately delivered via sprint execution.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain central CSW reporting solutions and data products, including core monthly management reporting outputs, ensuring they provide leadership with reliable, actionable steering visibility across products and business dimensions.
* Build, modify, and test SAP BW queries and related reporting logic, ensuring data integrity, usability, and alignment with agreed CSW definitions, standards, and documentation.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to collect feedback, explain SaaS-specific steering concepts, and promote consistent interpretation, adoption, and effective use of CSW data products.
* Provide targeted CSW data extractions, analyses, and management summaries for in-scope data products, while using recurring demand patterns to identify opportunities for scalable reporting or data product enhancements.
* Maintain clear documentation for CSW data products, covering business definitions, front-end reporting, back-end logic, and stakeholder education materials to preserve knowledge continuity and provide a consistent reference for stakeholders.
* Represent CSW in cross-functional reporting, data integration, and transformation initiatives, ensuring CSW requirements, standards, and strategic reporting capabilities are reflected in enterprise solutions.
* Drive CSW’s readiness for AI-enabled reporting by establishing and maintaining strong data quality, documentation, and governance standards that enable trusted, scalable use of CSW data products.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience operating in a reporting and analytics capacity
* 3+ years of experience in SAP Business Warehouse (required)
* Demonstrated experience in a business intelligence platform such as SAP Analytics Cloud (strongly preferred) or Power BI (preferred)
* 2+ years of data product management (required)
* People management experience (preferred)
* SaaS: Experience working in a reporting capacity in a Software-as-a-Service environment (preferred)
* General: PowerPoint & Advanced Excel (required), Jira & Confluence (preferred)
* Finance: Understanding of financial statements, financial modelling, and controlling processes (preferred)
* The ability to learn new software, reporting methodologies, and processes as needed
* Strong proficiency in English (written & verbal)

**What’s In It for You**
Your responsibilities will be great and, with them, we’ll give you the freedom and autonomy to do whatever it takes to deliver outstanding results.
  
  
We’ll offer you opportunities to move around the business – you will get global exposure, experience different job functions and tackle different markets. It’s a great way to find the right match for your ambitions and achieve the exciting career you’re after.
  
  
We have a very thorough people review process which enables your career progression as soon as you’re ready for the next challenge.
  
  
**Why Hilti**
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
  
  
**Commitment to Inclusion**
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Research Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Market Research Transformation**
**About The Role**
Our Global Primary Market Research (PMR) team is transforming into an AI-powered, scalable insights capability. As business demands grow across therapeutic areas and launches, PMR is evolving from a traditional project-based model toward one where insights are systematized, connected, reused and are continuously available to support enterprise decision-making.
  
  
The PMR Transformation Hub is a dedicated team focused on designing, building and scaling AI-enabled capabilities that transform how market research insights are generated, connected, reused and operationalized. The team partners with PMR leaders, Digital, Data Science, Compliance and external partners to deliver scalable solutions with measurable business impact.
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Senior Specialist to join the PMR Transformation Hub. The role will operate as an independent workstream leader, collaborating across a broad stakeholder ecosystem to advance PMR’s future-state operating model through AI-powered products, knowledge systems, governance frameworks and organizational enablement. The ideal candidate combines deep PMR expertise with strong AI and digital transformation acumen. This is not a traditional technology product-management role; success requires connecting market-research practice, business needs, responsible AI and organizational adoption to deliver scalable, measurable impact.
  
  
The position reports to the Director, Primary Market Research, DHH India Hub and would be based out of Pune or Hyderabad, with international and domestic travel as required by the business.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Transformation Strategy & Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to transform PMR workflows and operating models through AI, automation and knowledge management.
* Support execution of the PMR AI transformation roadmap, translating strategic priorities into actionable workstreams and deliverables.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and external innovations relevant to insight generation and develop evidence-based business cases and recommendations for PMR leadership.

**AI Capability Development**

* Lead the development and scaling of AI-enabled PMR capabilities from concept and design through validation, adoption and value realization.
* Partners with Commercial AI Capabilities, Data Science, Digital, Engineering and external vendors to design and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Define priority use cases, user requirements, success metrics and value-realization plans, and drive pilot design, testing and readiness for broader deployment.

**Knowledge Management & Insights Infrastructure**

* Support reusable insight ecosystems and knowledge repositories that improve discoverability, connectivity and reuse.
* Help define metadata standards, taxonomies, content structures and governance frameworks that transform fragmented research outputs into connected, queryable knowledge assets.

**Use Case Portfolio Management**

* Prioritize and manage high-value AI use cases, such as insight synthesis, conversational analytics, AI-generated content and stakeholder onboarding tools.
* Evaluate proposed solutions based on business impact, user need, technical feasibility, risk and scalability, and communicate value generated by pilots and scaled capabilities.

**Governance & Responsible AI**

* Support governance frameworks and adoption guardrails for AI-enabled PMR solutions.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Privacy and Legal to ensure responsible implementation and define validation standards, human-oversight requirements and quality measures for AI-generated outputs.

**Capability Building & Change Management**

* Design programs that improve practical AI fluency across PMR, including workshops, communities of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Develop playbooks, adoption frameworks and reusable learning assets that support sustained organizational change.

**Stakeholder & Executive Engagement**

* Partner with PMR leadership, Digital teams, enabling functions and external partners to align priorities and accelerate delivery.
* Develop executive communications and strategic presentations, influencing decisions through clear storytelling, structured problem-solving and evidence-based recommendations.

**Value Measurement**

* Establish and monitor KPIs for adoption, productivity, quality, cost avoidance and business impact.
* Track transformation outcomes, identify corrective actions and communicate progress to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
Education Required Bachelor's degree.
  
  
**Preferred**
Advanced degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, Data & Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline.
  
  
**Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology, healthcare consulting, commercial insights, primary market research, analytics, digital transformation or capability development.
* Strong understanding of PMR methodologies and commercial decision-making, combined with hands-on involvement in AI, generative AI or data-driven transformation initiatives.
* Proven track record leading transformation initiatives or independent workstreams and developing, scaling or operationalizing new capabilities, platforms, knowledge systems or business processes.
* Familiarity with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge management systems, metadata strategies and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating vendors, technology platforms and build-versus-buy decisions; exposure to product-management principles, agile delivery or user-centered design is desirable.
* Knowledge of change-management and organizational-adoption frameworks, with experience enabling capability building and sustained adoption.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with demonstrated collaboration across business, analytics, digital, technology, compliance and external partners.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-changing environment while managing multiple priorities, dependencies and stakeholders. Experience prototyping with approved AI tools or low-code/no-code platforms is beneficial but not required.

**Core Skills**

* AI Transformation; Responsible AI & Governance
* Primary Market Research & Insights; Knowledge Management & Metadata Strategy
* Strategic Thinking; Innovation Management; Value Measurement & Business Case Development
* Executive Communication; Storytelling; Stakeholder Management
* Change Management; Capability Building; Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Vendor & Ecosystem Management; Program and Use Case Portfolio Management

title: Product Manager – Wellness Brand
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and results-oriented Product Manager to lead product strategy, development, brand positioning, and sales growth for our Wellness Brand.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete product lifecycle, from market research and product conceptualisation to development, launch, and sales performance. The role also involves managing and driving online sales through e-commerce marketplaces and D2C channels, ensuring product growth and brand visibility across platforms.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Product Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and implement product strategies aligned with brand objectives and business goals.
* Identify market trends, consumer preferences, and emerging opportunities in the wellness industry.
* Manage the product portfolio, including product positioning, pricing, and lifecycle planning.
* Identify new product categories and opportunities for portfolio expansion.

**2. New Product Development**

* Lead the complete product development process, from concept generation to final launch.
* Coordinate with R&D, formulation, manufacturing, and quality teams for product development.
* Research ingredients, formulations, packaging, and product specifications.
* Ensure products meet quality standards, consumer expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Work on product improvements and innovations based on market feedback.

**3. Market Research & Competitor Analysis**

* Conduct regular market and competitor research within the wellness, nutrition, and healthcare sectors.
* Analyse competitor products, pricing, ingredients, USPs, packaging, and marketing strategies.
* Understand consumer buying behaviour and identify market gaps.
* Prepare market research reports and recommend actionable product strategies.

**4. Brand Management & Product Launches**

* Develop product positioning, USPs, and brand communication strategies.
* Plan and execute new product launches in coordination with marketing and sales teams.
* Work on product naming, packaging, labelling, product descriptions, and marketing briefs.
* Coordinate with creative and digital marketing teams to ensure consistent brand communication.
* Ensure products are positioned effectively across online and offline channels.

**5. E-commerce & Online Sales Management**

* Manage and drive product sales across e-commerce marketplaces and direct-to-consumer (D2C) platforms.
* Oversee product listings, catalogue management, pricing, images, descriptions, keywords, and listing optimisation.
* Manage and coordinate product presence on platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, and the brand's own website.
* Develop strategies to improve product visibility, traffic, conversion rates, and online revenue.
* Monitor marketplace sales, customer reviews, ratings, returns, and product performance.
* Coordinate with performance marketing and digital marketing teams to plan promotional campaigns and improve sales.
* Analyse sales reports, identify growth opportunities, and work towards achieving online sales targets.
* Monitor competitor pricing, marketplace trends, and category performance.

**6. Sales Growth & Business Performance**

* Develop strategies to achieve product-wise sales and revenue targets.
* Work closely with sales and distribution teams to drive product growth across relevant channels.
* Monitor sales trends, revenue, profitability, and product-wise performance.
* Identify underperforming products and implement corrective strategies.
* Prepare periodic sales and performance reports for management.
* Identify opportunities to expand market reach and improve overall product profitability.

**7. Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal teams including R&D, manufacturing, procurement, quality, marketing, sales, and e-commerce.
* Manage product development and launch timelines.
* Coordinate with external vendors, manufacturers, agencies, and marketplace partners.
* Ensure smooth execution of product-related activities across departments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Nutrition, or a related field. MBA will be an added advantage.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Product Management, preferably in wellness, nutraceuticals, healthcare, nutrition, FMCG, or personal care.
* Strong understanding of product development, brand management, and product lifecycle management.
* Practical knowledge of e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, and D2C websites.
* Experience in online sales management, marketplace operations, and product listing optimisation.
* Understanding of digital marketing, online promotions, and sales conversion strategies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and market research.
* Excellent communication, coordination, negotiation, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results within defined timelines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Prior experience with wellness, nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, nutrition, or healthcare brands.
* Knowledge of ingredients, formulations, product claims, packaging, and labelling.
* Experience in managing products across e-commerce marketplaces and online sales channels.
* Strong commercial understanding with a focus on revenue growth and profitability.
* Ability to combine product innovation, market understanding, and sales execution.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful development and timely launch of new products.
* Product-wise revenue growth and profitability.
* Achievement of online sales targets.
* Growth in e-commerce marketplace sales and D2C revenue.
* Improvement in product visibility, listing performance, and conversion rates.
* Expansion and performance of the product portfolio.
* Effective management of product development and launch timelines.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
YES MADAM

Product Manager – Growth

Own consumer product growth from acquisition to retention through product-led experiences, experimentation, and

data-driven decision making.

Team Product — YES MADAM Location Noida, Sector 63

Experience 4–8 years Working Days 5.5 days

Work Mode Work From Office Focus Consumer Mobile App + Product Growth

About YES MADAM

YES MADAM is a fast-growing consumer beauty and wellness platform focused on convenience, quality, and

exceptional customer experience.

As we scale, strong product-led growth and a seamless customer journey are critical to our next phase of growth.

The Role

As a Product Manager – Growth, you will own and optimise the complete consumer journey — from app acquisition

and onboarding to discovery, conversion, checkout, and repeat usage.

You will identify user behaviour patterns and funnel drop-offs, design better product experiences, run experiments, and

translate improvements in user experience into measurable business growth.

What You’ll Do

• Own the end-to-end consumer app user journey, from acquisition to checkout and retention.

• Identify user drop-offs and improve conversion, activation, retention, and revenue.

• Drive product-led acquisition through better app experiences, personalisation, nudges, onboarding, and

experimentation.

• Lead 0→1 product and feature development, from problem discovery to launch and scale.

• Define product hypotheses, run A/B tests and experiments, and measure impact.

• Work closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and Business teams.

• Use product analytics and user research to understand customer behaviour.

• Optimise onboarding, discovery, cart, checkout, payment, and post-purchase journeys.

• Track conversion, activation, retention, repeat purchase, revenue, and AOV.

What We’re Looking For

• 4–8 years of Product Management experience, preferably with significant Growth/Product Growth experience.

• Hands-on experience managing consumer mobile apps is mandatory.

• Strong experience in consumer journeys, funnel optimisation, and conversion improvement.

• Experience driving acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth through product.

• Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and product analytics.

• Strong understanding of app user behaviour and consumer product metrics.

• Proven 0→1 product/feature experience.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

• D2C, B2C, ecommerce, marketplace, or consumer-tech experience.

• Personalisation, recommendations, CRM/lifecycle, or loyalty experience.

• Mixpanel, GA4, Firebase, MoEngage, CleverTap, Amplitude, or similar tools.

• Transactional/commerce app experience involving checkout and payments.

• High-growth startup/product environment experience.

Why Join YES MADAM

• Own high-impact growth initiatives for a fast-growing consumer platform.

• Work on a product journey used by millions of customers across India.

• Directly influence conversion, retention, repeat purchase, revenue, and AOV.

• High ownership, visibility, and autonomy in a fast-paced product environment.

Key Hiring Preference

• Candidates with 4–8 years of Product Management + strong consumer mobile app + Product/Growth

experience will be prioritised.

• Candidates whose experience is primarily in B2B SaaS, marketing growth, performance marketing, or web-only

* products without hands-on consumer app product management experience will not be considered.
