Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?As a Technical Program Manager 3 (IC3), you will drive the execution of well-scoped engineering programs from kickoff through customer-facing release. You will work with Engineering and Product day to day, and with Technical Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, IT and HR as programs require. You will help the organization run more efficiently by using metrics, keeping commitments visible, and improving the processes your programs depend on. You will team up with a Lead Program Manager, who sets direction on larger or more ambiguous initiatives, while you own the day-to-day execution of your programs.HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE: Release Operations: Connecting Requirements to ExecutionYou bring working knowledge of how customer-facing software is built, tested and shipped, and you stay close to Engineering and Product through each release. You bring release management experience driving the planning and execution of product features developed by 20+ teams, including tracking feature complete, source code branching and bug triage, through to release quality assessments and readiness.You partner with product and engineering teams across the development lifecycle, from design and code management through branching, QA and release. You build clear execution plans, spot risks early and escalate them before they reach a release gate. You consistently work with DevOps, QA and performance teams to provide feedback on software build quality and track actions for closing gaps.You use AI-enabled and automated workflows to reduce manual program effort, and you help define where automation is trusted and where a person must review. You work with the Lead Program Manager to measure these workflows against customer-impacting outcomes.You help Product Management keep requirements clear, reviewed and ready for handoff to Engineering, and you flag gaps in requirements before work begins. Program Ownership and Navigating AmbiguityYou are the accountable owner for your assigned programs, from kickoff through release. You keep the program narrative current: what is committed, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.You build program plans, milestones and operating rhythms for well-scoped new product introduction tracks and ongoing programs, using established frameworks and adapting them as needed.You turn open-ended goals into structured plans with clear owners and measurable outcomes. You work alongside the Lead Program Manager on larger or cross-portfolio questions and act on your own for day-to-day decisions.You help define success criteria, operational metrics and execution guardrails before a program starts, in partnership with the Lead Program Manager. Data-Driven ExecutionYou track program health KPIs and maintain dashboards that give Engineering, Product and leadership an accurate view of your programs' status, and you propose improvements to the metrics you use.You use AI-assisted tracking, reporting and program management tools to surface risk, flag milestone drift and monitor compliance signals. You can build and refine these workflows, and you know when their output needs human review. CommunicationYou write and present clear, concise updates that cover risks, dependencies and the decisions you need, backed by data. You communicate effectively with engineers, product managers and program leads, and you build the confidence to present to leadership alongside the Lead Program Manager.WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING3-4 years of program or project management experience in a technical environment.Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field. A master's degree is a plus.Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle.Release management experience driving the planning and execution of product features developed by 20+ teams, including tracking feature complete, source code branching and bug triage, through to release quality assessments and readiness. Experience supporting customer-facing software or hardware products, and working with several cross-functional teams at once.Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows, improve productivity and support sound decisions.Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates:For information on personal data processing, please see our Privacy Policy.Equal Employment Opportunity Employer (EEOE)Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at 1-855-9COHESITY or recruiting@cohesity.com for assistance.In-Office ExpectationsCohesity employees who are within a reasonable commute (e.g. within a forty-five (45) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2-3 days a week of their choosing.We strongly prefer candidates who are currently located in or near the designated job location. Candidates outside the area should apply only if they are committed to relocating prior to their start date and have the legal right to work in the job location.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Job Title: Engineering Manager
  
  
Reports To: Engineering Leader
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Engineering Manager with strong experience in working with cross-functional teams of QA, product, and engineering team members. You’ll collaborate with the Engineering Leader to build, enhance, and maintain products to enable Sage’s business plans and long-term objectives using the identified architecture. This role combines team leadership with hands-on work: implementing modern APIs, building responsive user experiences, and working with relational databases to support business-critical applications.

* Experience with Azure (e.g., Blob Storage, Functions, Queue Storage, Service Bus).

* Experience with serverless technologies and infrastructure as code.

title: Sr Advanced Project Engr
description:
**Job Description**
**Honeywell Technologies**
is a diversified technology and manufacturing leader, serving customers worldwide with products and services based on control technologies for buildings and industry. A global technology leader based in USA, Honeywell Technologies shares are traded on the New York, London, and Chicago Stock Exchanges. Our quality products, integrated system solutions, and services make life safer and more secure, more comfortable and energy efficient, and more innovative and productive in every corner of our world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Sr Advanced Project Engr (Program Manager)
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for managing multidisciplinary product delivery and program execution from inception to successful Business-Case realization.
  
  
Takes a General Manager’s View To The Program Assuming Ownership Across Multiple Functions And Phases Of The NPI Process, Including But Not Restricted To
  
  
**Business Case & Concept Development:**
Drives focus on voice of customer, offering-scope and business case, influencing decisions in the initial phases.
  
  
**Detailed Planning**
: Drives the translation of business case / concept into plans with deliverables across engineering and other functions. Performs estimation, balances technical risks / dependencies, and manages costs, resources, vendors, etc. during the detailed planning phase
  
  
Playing a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, technology, processes, and tools. Coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the project team.
  
  
**Execution & Delivery**
: Uses a Line-management focus to drive the right engineering results, and achieve readiness for commercial launch, with the right metrics and tools that provide high predictability and quality to stakeholders and senior execs alike.
  
  
**Risk Management:**
On time identification of risks along with mitigation, contingency. Regular tracking and management of risks.
  
  
**Launch & Go-live:**
Oversees Marketing Communications, Demand generation, Revenue generation & tracking during and after the Launch. Works with Product Management, Business & Finance to measure outcomes against goals and Critical Targets to meet.
  
  
**Budget management**
: Able to understand the Finance reports, analysis and take appropriate actions
  
  
**Transformation**
to Agile, CI/CD, DevOps, and standardization of practices with appropriate tools / dashboards / metrics (effort, schedule, cost, revenue, defects)
  
  
**Positive Revenue impact**
to top line of the business group through New product, Product Sustenance and Enablement
  
  
**Schedule, Cost, and Effort Compliance:**
Phase gate compliance, revenue Say / Do, and continuous improvement of cycle time
  
  
**Skills**
**Business and Financial Acumen**
:
  
  
Thoroughly understands markets, finance and business needs. Can work with Engineering and Business leaders to drive Make-vs-Buy decisions to optimize the ROI and time to market.
  
  
**Technical**
Solid understanding of engineering (Software, Electrical, Mechanical) life cycle models. Exposure to Cloud, IOT, Data analytics, UI Technologies, Embedded Firmware. Control Systems domain knowledge preferable
  
  
**Vendor Management:**
Effectively builds partnering relationships with 3rd party ODMs/OEMs, Vendor evaluation, interface and management where required
  
  
**Negotiation, Stakeholder Management:**
Proficient in negotiation and influencing in a global setup; presents the problem and solution eloquently to help arrive at stakeholder consensus
  
  
**Agile**
Expert on Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum / SAFe), CI/CD, DevOps; catalyst in transforming organizational culture to bring in agility & predictability in delivery
  
  
**Influencing**
Great communicator, ability to influence teams, orienting them to be self-performing, and deliver exceptional business value
  
  
**Project Management:**
Plans and executes with project management principles / practices; drives estimation, dependencies, milestones and integration goals
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
Follows a structured problem solving approach; demonstrates agility and alacrity in execution and decisions
  
  
**AI Knowledge:**
Exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot), and application of AI in product development, program management, or business process optimization
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Experience**
Graduate in Engineering, or Masters in Math / Science / Computers, with 10-15 Yrs. of experience 4 – 8 yrs in product program management.
  
  
**Must**
Hands-on exposure to Multi-disciplinary (H/w, S/w, F/w, mechanical) programs
  
  
Experience in program execution with Agile CI / CD. Exposure to roles such as Scrum Master / Release Train Engineer / Release Train Manager preferred.
  
  
Exposure to tools such as Jira / Rally or equivalent, Microsoft Project, Configuration Management, CI, CD , Visio, and all Office Tools
  
  
Experience in managing culturally diverse and geographically distributed teams.
  
  
Proven track record of managing complex program and product deliveries creating incremental revenue impact as per the business-case
  
  
**Desired Certifications:**
PMP / IPMA / PRINCE / PMI-ACP / CSM / CSPO
  
  
**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Sr Technical Program Manager
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
F5 is seeking a dynamic and experienced
**Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM)**
to lead and deliver complex, cross-functional technical programs. The Sr. TPM will be responsible for driving programs through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), aligning Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of technical acumen, program management expertise, and the ability to influence teams without direct authority. The Sr. TPM will translate product and business priorities into executable technical plans while proactively managing dependencies, risks, schedules, and delivery outcomes.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership**

* Own and drive multiple complex technical programs from planning through delivery.
* Manage execution across SDLC phases, including requirements, design, development, testing, integration, release, and deployment.
* Develop integrated program plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, owners, and success criteria.
* Demonstrate ownership and autonomy while driving predictable, high-quality program outcomes.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with product priorities and business objectives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, Operations, Security, and other cross-functional teams.
* Bridge product vision and technical execution, translating priorities into actionable plans.
* Facilitate engineering teams in resolving cross-functional dependencies and delivery challenges.
* Build strong working relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Resolve communication gaps and facilitate timely decisions when teams or priorities are not aligned.

**Risk, Dependency, and Issue Management**

* Proactively identify and manage program risks, dependencies, constraints, and blockers.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans and ensure appropriate ownership and follow-through.
* Drive resolution of technical and cross-functional issues affecting delivery.
* Facilitate root-cause analysis when systemic or recurring issues impact program execution.
* Escalate issues with clear options, impact assessments, and recommended paths forward.

**Stakeholder Management and Communication**

* Provide clear visibility into program health, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
* Communicate effectively with engineering teams, product leaders, and senior leadership through dashboards, program reviews, reports, and presentations.
* Establish appropriate program operating rhythms and ensure stakeholders understand priorities, commitments, and delivery status.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and maintain transparency around changes in scope, schedule, resources, and risk.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Strong technical program and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage complex, cross-functional software programs.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Ability to bridge Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams and facilitate technical and business decisions.
* Strong understanding of program planning, dependency management, risk management, release management, and execution tracking.
* Ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Effective written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
* Strong organizational, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to quickly understand technical concepts and engage effectively with engineering and architecture teams.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities and changing requirements.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in technical program management, program/project management, software engineering, IT, or related technical disciplines.
* 3+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional technical programs.
* Demonstrated experience delivering software products through the complete SDLC.
* Experience coordinating geographically distributed engineering and cross-functional teams.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple engineering teams and/or products.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.

**Technical Experience**

* Strong understanding of SDLC processes, Agile methodologies, release management, and modern software development practices.
* Experience working with Jira, Confluence, CI/CD processes, and engineering delivery workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, application delivery, networking, cybersecurity, or distributed systems.
* Comfortable working with engineering and architecture teams to understand technical requirements, dependencies, trade-offs, and delivery risks.
* Ability to engage at sufficient technical depth to facilitate decisions without needing to serve as the technical architect or engineering lead.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish credibility with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Operations.
* Ability to facilitate difficult discussions, drive decisions, and establish clear ownership.
* Strong judgment with the ability to balance scope, quality, schedule, resources, and technical constraints.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing programs involving application delivery, networking, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, or SaaS products.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, containerization, or virtualization technologies.
* Experience with F5 products and technologies is a plus.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, Scrum, or equivalent program/project management certification is a plus.

title: Tech S and T-Technical Program Manager-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technical Project / Program Manager**
**Experience**
- 10-12 years
  
  
**Program Leadership**
- 5+ years
  
  
**Role Focus**
- Technical Delivery
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Technical Project / Program Manager to lead complex enterprise technology programs from planning through production rollout. The role combines strong program governance with sufficient technical depth to manage architecture, engineering, cloud, data and AI workstreams, while ensuring scope, schedule, quality, risk, dependencies and stakeholder outcomes remain controlled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end project/program planning, delivery roadmap, milestones, dependencies, RAID management, governance and executive reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across product, architecture, software engineering, data/AI, cloud/platform, DevSecOps, QA, security and operations.
* Translate business and technical objectives into executable release plans, workstreams, sprint milestones and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Lead dependency management across applications, APIs, infrastructure, environments, vendors and upstream/downstream teams.
* Drive architecture, design, security, testing, release and production-readiness checkpoints; ensure decisions and actions are closed on time.
* Monitor delivery using Azure DevOps or Jira dashboards, including scope, schedule, velocity, defects, blockers, risks and release readiness.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, technical forums, escalation management and stakeholder communications.
* Manage change control, resource/capacity planning, vendor coordination and financial tracking where applicable.
* Promote disciplined Agile/SAFe delivery, CI/CD adoption, automation, technical-debt visibility and continuous improvement.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 12+ years in technology delivery with 5+ years managing complex technical projects or multi-team programs.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications, cloud modernization, platform engineering, data/analytics or AI-enabled initiatives.
* Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, CI/CD, DevSecOps, containers and production operations.
* Hands-on program management using Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, GitHub or equivalent tools; strong command of Agile, Scrum and/or SAFe practices.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, challenge technical assumptions, identify integration dependencies and convert technical risks into actionable plans.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, vendor management, conflict resolution and escalation-management skills.

**Success Measures**
Milestone and release predictability | Schedule and scope variance | Dependency closure | RAID aging | Defect leakage | Release readiness | Production stability | Stakeholder confidence | Team throughput | Budget/resource adherence
  
  
**Education And Preferred Background**
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, cloud or technology certifications are preferred. Experience in enterprise SaaS, modernization, utilities, financial services, healthcare or other regulated environments is beneficial.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A delivery-focused technical leader who can operate confidently with architects and engineers while maintaining rigorous program governance. The candidate should be able to identify technical dependencies early, challenge unrealistic plans, drive decisions and escalations, and provide executives with a clear view of delivery health and business impact.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operations and Project Manager
description:
Qualwebs is a software company based in Bengaluru and Indore, building web, mobile, and SaaS products for clients across the US, Europe, and beyond. We are a hands-on team that builds things from scratch, moves fast, and uses AI smartly in everything we do. We care as much about how a product looks and feels as how it works.

**Read this first**

This role takes over a lot of what our leadership handles day to day. Processes are still being built, clients are in different time zones, and plans change. If you want a structured, settled environment, this is not for you. If you like bringing order to moving parts, it is.

**What you will do**

* Run projects from kickoff to delivery: scope, timelines, resources, risks, and status
* Be the main point of contact for clients after the sale, handling communication, updates, and support
* Coordinate design, engineering, and QA so commitments are met
* Review designs and builds before they reach the client, and flag what does not look or work right
* Handle client support requests and escalations quickly and calmly
* Build and improve internal processes, tools, and reporting from scratch
* Use AI tools to cut down manual work in planning, documentation, reporting, and client updates
* Report on project health, delivery, and team utilization to leadership



**What we need**

* 3+ years in operations, project management, or delivery at an IT services or software company
* Strong client communication with international clients, written and spoken
* Experience in post-sales account handling and client support
* Solid project coordination using Jira, ClickUp, Asana, or similar
* A good eye for design: you can review a screen or a deliverable and judge whether it is right
* Strong, hands-on AI skills: you use AI tools efficiently every day and follow good practices, such as clear prompts, the right tool for the task, and verifying results, rather than burning tokens on trial and error
* Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to change
* Willingness to work US hours

**Good to have**

* Experience with SaaS or enterprise software projects
* Agile or Scrum experience, or a PMP, CSM, or similar certification
* Experience setting up operations or PMO processes at a growing company

**Why Qualwebs**

* A central role working directly with leadership
* Freedom to build processes your way
* A clear path to Head of Operations or Delivery

title: Program Manager AI SDLC Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
Join us in shaping
**Nokia’s AI Software Development Lifecycle platform**
, supporting engineers across product, development, security, QA, and operations. You will collaborate across a growing engineering ecosystem, including IT, Security, Cloud Platform, business segments, and platform leaders.
  
  
As
**Manager, AI SDLC Transformation**
, you will connect strategy with execution, translating product priorities and architecture into successful delivery. You will help teams move forward by identifying and resolving blockers, risks, dependencies, and conflicting priorities.
  
  
Using delivery and flow metrics, risk and dependency insights, and Launchpad dashboards, you will bring a data-driven approach to decisions and delivery.
  
  
This is also an opportunity to put
**AI-native and agentic ways of working into practice**
, using AI not just as part of the platform, but as a practical tool for running and continuously improving the program itself.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
**Planning and schedule management**

* Own the overall plan and roadmap delivery, turning priorities from the Product Owner and architecture direction from the Chief Architect into a realistic, sequenced plan.
* Manage schedules and run the program cadence, milestones and releases; track progress and forecast delivery from data rather than status opinions.

**Dependency, risk and blocker management**

* Map and manage dependencies across the platform team and with IT, Security, Cloud Platform, segments and vendors.
* Maintain the risk and issue register, with owners, mitigation and escalation paths.

**Stakeholder management**

* Manage day-to-day relationships with stakeholders across engineering, product, security, IT and the Business Groups, whose representatives are the platform users .
* Keep expectations clear and communication timely: what is planned, what has changed and why.

**Metrics-driven management**

* Manage the program through metrics: delivery predictability, cycle time, throughput, blocker aging, dependency health and risk burn-down.
* Use the platform metrics and insights dashboards to track adoption and impact

**AI-native ways of working**

* Use AI agents and tools to run the program more effectively (e.g., planning, status reporting, dependency analysis, meeting follow-up), with human judgment on decisions.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* Engineering degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent with 12+ years of experience in program or project management for software or platform engineering, including enterprise grade programs
* Experience managing through metrics and data, with comfort in dashboards and in asking for the right data.
* Strong stakeholder management and the ability to resolve conflicts, negotiate priorities and escalate well with clear communication with engineers and executives.
* Familiarity with agentic and AI-native ways of working, ideally from using them in your own work.
* Experience with Jira (or similar) and Agile and Lean delivery practices.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with AI-enabled SDLC or developer platform programs.

We specialize in Digital Payments operating as Technology Service Provider to Regulated entities and providing Payment Platform to Industry – empowered by payment processing engine, Financial Super app, Risk Intelligence engine and digital merchant solution.

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**

PathinAI designs low-power AI silicon for “physical AI” applications in robots, drones, vehicles, and industrial machines that sense and act in the real world. The company focuses on transformer-based models running under strict power budgets and builds chips from the workload up, rather than relying on general-purpose architectures. Its flagship product, the Clean Future CF-1, is a low-power AI accelerator that supports multi-camera perception, sensor fusion, and on-device vision-language models alongside existing compute boards. Every chip is developed through the PathinAI AI Silicon Platform, which integrates workload profiling, virtual silicon simulation, architecture exploration, pre-silicon validation, and manufacturing. PathinAI collaborates with robotics, automotive, industrial AI, and semiconductor/OEM teams, and is currently partnering with edge AI product builders to shape CF-1 around real-world workloads.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Technical Content Writer role based in Noida. The Technical Content Writer will create clear, accurate, and engaging content that explains PathinAI’s AI silicon products, platform, and solutions to technical and business audiences. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching physical AI, edge computing, and hardware-accelerated AI workloads, and producing web pages, blog posts, white papers, case studies, product briefs, and technical documentation. The role involves collaborating with engineering, product, and marketing teams to translate complex concepts into accessible content, maintaining consistent messaging across channels, and optimizing content for discoverability and usability. The Technical Content Writer will also review and refine existing materials, ensuring technical accuracy, a coherent narrative, and alignment with brand voice.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills for technical and marketing materials.
* Candidates should possess Content Strategy and Research skills to plan, structure, and develop evidence-based content.
* Candidates should possess Proofreading and attention-to-detail skills to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Relevant experience in technical writing for AI, semiconductors, robotics, or edge computing is highly beneficial.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product teams and communicate complex topics in a gender-neutral, inclusive manner.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Technical Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong command of written English and familiarity with developer-focused documentation, diagrams, and content tools.

title: SEO Executive
description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities

* Conduct comprehensive technical, on-page, and off-page SEO audits.
* Identify high-commercial-intent keywords relevant to our services and international target markets.
* Develop and execute strategies to improve organic search rankings and generate qualified business enquiries.
* Perform detailed competitor research, including keyword gaps, content gaps, backlink profiles, and competitor landing pages.
* Optimize website pages, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and website structure.
* Identify and resolve website indexing, crawling, broken links, duplicate content, and technical SEO issues.
* Develop SEO-focused landing page strategies targeting specific services, industries, applications, and geographical markets.
* Work with content writers and technical teams to develop authoritative, original, and search-optimized content.
* Improve website performance, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and user experience in coordination with developers.
* Build high-quality and relevant backlinks through ethical SEO practices.
* Develop strategies to improve brand visibility across Google and AI-powered search and discovery platforms.
* Set up and monitor conversion tracking to understand which organic visitors become potential customers.
* Prepare actionable weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for organic traffic growth and lead generation.

Required Skills and Knowledge

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Keyword Planner
* Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest, or equivalent SEO tools
* Screaming Frog or equivalent website auditing tools
* Technical SEO
* On-page and off-page SEO
* International SEO
* Competitor and keyword gap analysis
* Search intent analysis
* Content optimization
* Conversion tracking
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, structured data, and website architecture
* AI-powered search optimization and content research
* Strong English communication and research skills

Experience in B2B, technology, engineering, industrial, or international service-based businesses will be preferred.

Expected Outcomes During the First 30 Days

The selected candidate will be expected to demonstrate ownership and deliver the following measurable outcomes within the first month.

Week 1: Website Audit and Performance Assessment

* Complete a comprehensive SEO audit of the company website.
* Establish baseline metrics for organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, and conversions.
* Identify technical SEO issues and classify them according to business impact and severity.
* Review Google Analytics and Google Search Console configurations.
* Identify existing website pages with the highest potential for improvement.
* Submit a prioritized SEO action plan with clear execution timelines.

**Expected deliverable:** Complete website audit report, baseline performance dashboard, and prioritized issue tracker.

Week 2: Competitor and Market Intelligence

* Conduct detailed SEO analysis of at least 10 relevant international competitors.
* Identify at least 100 relevant keyword opportunities.
* Shortlist at least 30 high-commercial-intent keywords with realistic ranking opportunities.
* Analyse keyword difficulty, search volume, search intent, geographical relevance, and conversion potential.
* Identify content and service-page gaps in comparison with competitors.
* Prepare keyword mapping for existing and proposed website pages.

**Expected deliverable:** Competitor intelligence report, keyword research database, and keyword mapping document.

Week 3: SEO Implementation

* Resolve or coordinate the resolution of high-priority technical SEO issues.
* Optimize at least 10 commercially important website pages, subject to website access and page availability.
* Improve internal linking and website navigation.
* Implement or recommend relevant structured data.
* Identify and prepare content briefs for at least five high-conversion landing pages.
* Configure or validate tracking for website enquiry forms, contact buttons, and other relevant conversion events.

**Expected deliverable:** SEO implementation report with completed activities, before-and-after comparisons, and outstanding issues.

Week 4: Growth Strategy and Performance Review

* Measure early performance changes against the initial baseline.
* Identify additional opportunities for improving organic visibility.
* Develop a database of at least 30 relevant, high-quality backlink and industry publication opportunities.
* Prepare a 90-day SEO roadmap with clear priorities and measurable targets.
* Develop a content calendar targeting commercial search intent.
* Present completed work, initial results, challenges, and the proposed growth strategy to management.

**Expected deliverable:** First-month performance report, 90-day SEO growth roadmap, and commercial content strategy.

First 30 Days Performance Evaluation

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and accuracy of SEO analysis.
* Relevance of identified keywords to our target customers.
* Number and quality of SEO improvements implemented.
* Ability to identify commercially valuable growth opportunities.

**Parameter**

**Requirement**

title: Legal Head

1. Job Purpose

Manju Groups is looking for an experienced and strategic **Legal Head** with strong expertise in Real Estate, Property Laws, Land Acquisition, Regulatory Compliance and Corporate Legal Management.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire legal function of the group, ensuring legal compliance across real estate projects and business operations, handling litigation, managing external legal consultants and leading an in-house legal team.

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the real estate industry and the ability to independently manage legal matters, provide strategic legal advice to management and lead a team of legal professionals.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Real Estate Legal Management**

* Handle all legal matters relating to real estate development, land acquisition and property transactions.
* Conduct title verification, due diligence and legal scrutiny of land documents.
* Review and validate parent documents, sale deeds, settlement deeds, EC, patta, chitta and other property records.
* Handle land acquisition documentation, Joint Development Agreements (JDA), MoUs and development agreements.
* Ensure compliance with RERA regulations, DTCP, CMDA, local planning authorities and other statutory requirements.
* Handle property registration, land conversion, approvals and other statutory documentation.
* Identify legal risks in property transactions and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

**B. Litigation & Dispute Management**

* Handle civil litigation, property disputes, land ownership disputes and contractual disputes.
* Coordinate with advocates, law firms and external legal consultants.
* Monitor court cases, legal notices, arbitration and dispute resolution proceedings.
* Represent the company's legal interests before relevant authorities through appointed advocates.
* Develop strategies to minimize legal exposure and resolve disputes effectively.

**C. Corporate Legal & Contract Management**

* Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, vendor contracts, lease agreements and service agreements.
* Handle employment-related legal matters and corporate legal documentation.
* Review agreements with customers, channel partners, contractors, consultants and business associates.
* Ensure legal protection of the group's commercial interests.
* Maintain centralized records of legal agreements, documents and statutory registrations.

**D. Legal Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with applicable central and state laws and regulations.
* Monitor changes in real estate laws, labour laws, corporate laws and statutory regulations.
* Establish internal legal review procedures and compliance monitoring systems.
* Conduct legal risk assessments for new projects and business initiatives.
* Advise management on legal implications of strategic business decisions.

**E. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage the in-house legal team.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.
* Establish timelines and turnaround standards for legal documentation and approvals.
* Review the quality and accuracy of legal work completed by team members.
* Build a proactive legal support system for Sales, Projects, Finance, HR and Management teams.
* Conduct regular legal team reviews and provide management updates.

3. Required Experience & Skills

* 12–18 years of overall legal experience, preferably with at least 8–10 years in real estate.
* Strong experience in real estate development companies, property transactions and land acquisition.
* Proven experience in handling property title verification and due diligence.
* Sound knowledge of RERA, Tamil Nadu land and property laws, DTCP and CMDA regulations.
* Experience in litigation management and coordination with external advocates.
* Strong contract drafting, negotiation and documentation skills.
* Proven experience in managing and leading a legal team.
* Ability to independently handle complex legal matters and advise senior management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and decision-making skills.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with reputed real estate developers or infrastructure companies.
* Experience handling multiple real estate projects simultaneously.
* Exposure to residential, commercial and plotted development projects.
* Strong network and coordination experience with advocates, legal consultants and government authorities.
* Ability to establish legal processes, systems and documentation controls from the ground up.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of property title verification and legal due diligence.
* Timely closure of land acquisition legal documentation.
* Compliance with RERA and other statutory requirements.
* Reduction in legal risks and preventable litigation.
* Effective management and resolution of pending legal cases.
* Turnaround time for agreements, contracts and legal opinions.
* Accuracy and maintenance of property and legal documentation.
* Team productivity, accountability and performance.
* Timely legal support to internal departments.
* Monthly legal MIS and management reporting.

6. Reporting & Team Structure

**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

**Functional Coordination:**

* Sales & Marketing
* Projects & Construction
* Land Acquisition
* Finance & Accounts
* HR & Administration
* Business Development

**Team Responsibility:** Lead and supervise the in-house legal team, legal executives, documentation executives and external legal consultants.

7. Compensation

Salary: As per industry standards and candidate experience. Negotiable for the right candidate.

8. Ideal Candidate

A hands-on legal professional who combines strong real estate legal expertise with leadership capabilities. The candidate must be capable of independently managing the group's complete legal portfolio while building, mentoring and driving a high-performing legal team.

Pay: ₹75,000.00 - ₹95,000.00 per month

* Food provided

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Zithara.ai is looking for a strategic, results-driven, and data-oriented **Head of SaaS Sales** to lead and scale our sales organization.

As we continue to expand our market presence, we are looking for an experienced sales leader who can build a predictable revenue engine, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and drive sustainable growth across the mid-market segment.

In this leadership role, you will take ownership of the overall sales function, develop scalable sales strategies, build high-performing teams, and establish structured processes that drive consistent revenue outcomes. You will also lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales engagements and mentor Account Executives to succeed in consultative B2B SaaS sales.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Sales Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and execute scalable sales strategies to accelerate customer acquisition and revenue growth within the mid-market segment.
* Build effective sales playbooks to engage multiple stakeholders, including Directors, VPs, Heads of IT, and other key decision-makers.

* Optimize sales cycles while maintaining healthy deal values and conversion rates, targeting predictable 30–90-day sales cycles.
* Collaborate with Marketing on account-based marketing (ABM), inbound opportunities, and strategic outbound initiatives to strengthen pipeline generation.

### **2. Sales Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing sales organization, including mid-market Account Executives.
* Build structured hiring, onboarding, and training processes to help new team members achieve productivity within 60 days.
* Establish clear sales targets, KPIs, accountability measures, and performance review mechanisms.
* Design effective commission structures, incentive plans, SPIFFs, and quota tiers aligned with company revenue objectives.
* Foster a performance-driven culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and consistent achievement of sales targets.

### **3. Sales Operations & Process Excellence**

* Establish and optimize CRM workflows using platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent tools.
* Monitor and improve key sales metrics, including pipeline coverage, stage-wise conversion rates, deal velocity, and average sales cycle length.
* Standardize sales processes, reporting frameworks, and playbooks to improve operational efficiency and revenue predictability.
* Deliver accurate weekly sales forecasts and pipeline reports to the executive leadership team.

### **4. Strategic Deal Management**

* Act as a strategic executive sponsor for high-value mid-market opportunities and engage with senior stakeholders throughout critical stages of the sales cycle.
* Lead complex commercial negotiations, address business objections, and drive strategic opportunities towards successful closure.
* Take ownership of revenue targets, deal conversion, and overall sales performance.
* Build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities for account expansion and long-term business growth.

**Requirements & Qualifications**
---------------------------------

* **SaaS Sales Experience:** 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with strong exposure to mid-market or mid-segment customers.
* **Leadership Experience:** At least 2+ years of experience managing and leading sales teams, preferably in a fast-growing startup or technology organization.
* **Revenue Track Record:** Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets, managing sales pipelines, and closing high-value B2B deals.
* **Deal Management:** Experience handling deal sizes ranging from ₹20 lakh to ₹80 lakh+ ARR.
* **Sales Methodologies:** Strong understanding of consultative sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Gap Selling, or SPICED.
* **CRM Expertise:** Hands-on experience with CRM and sales enablement tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent platforms.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to translate business objectives into actionable sales strategies and measurable outcomes.
* **Leadership & Communication:** Excellent communication, negotiation, team building, and stakeholder management skills.
* **Growth Mindset:** Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, take ownership, solve challenges, and build scalable sales operations.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Performance-linked **On-Target Earnings (OTE)**.
* Opportunity to lead and scale a growing SaaS sales organization.
* Direct involvement in strategic business decisions and revenue growth.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth technology company.

------------------------

At Zithara.ai, you will have the opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy, build and lead a high-performing sales team, and directly influence the company's growth journey.

If you are a results-driven SaaS sales leader who enjoys building teams, closing strategic deals, developing scalable sales processes, and driving business growth, we would love to hear from you.

description:
Job description:

**About the role**

You will own paid acquisition across Meta and Google for several clients at once, and for Absolute's own pipeline. The job is not cheap leads; it is qualified leads that sales can close, tracked end to end and improved every week.

You will plan and launch campaigns, keep tracking and lead delivery working, brief the creative team, and turn the numbers into clear decisions. You will work with designers, video editors, and the client-facing and sales teams, under the direction of the Head of Marketing.

Key responsibilities1. Paid advertising

* Plan, set up and manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage Google Ads campaigns, including Search and other campaign types where they fit.
* Own campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, bidding, placements, retargeting and optimization.
* Monitor daily spend, cost per lead, conversion rates, lead quality and return on ad spend.
* Spot underperforming campaigns early and take corrective action.
* Scale campaigns that consistently deliver, while staying within approved budgets.
* Run campaigns for multiple clients and industries at the same time.

2. Lead generation and conversion tracking

* Build and optimize lead campaigns using Meta Instant Forms, landing pages and WhatsApp.
* Make sure every lead reaches the right Google Sheet, CRM or other approved destination.
* Monitor tracking and fix issues with pixels, conversion events, GTM, GA4 and platform integrations.
* Judge campaigns on lead quality, not just lead volume or a low cost per lead.
* Work with the client-facing and sales teams to learn which leads convert, and feed that back into campaigns.

3. Reporting and analytics

* Monitor campaigns daily and keep the campaign performance tracker accurate.
* Send weekly performance updates by Saturday afternoon.
* Deliver monthly client performance reports by the agreed deadlines.
* Report spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates and ROAS where relevant.
* Explain what worked, what failed, why performance changed and what should happen next.
* Make data-backed recommendations, not just numbers.

4. Creative strategy and testing

* Write clear ad briefs for the creative team.
* Identify the right hooks, messaging, offers, formats and calls to action.
* Work with designers, video editors and content creators on performance-focused creatives.
* Test creative concepts, audiences, landing pages and offers in a structured way.
* Use results to shape the next round of creative production.
* Keep a running record of tests, learnings and winning creatives.

5. SEO and local SEO

* Carry out keyword research, on-page SEO and local SEO tasks when assigned.
* Manage Google Business Profile updates and track local rankings.
* Flag technical and on-page issues and coordinate fixes with the development team.
* Track target keywords, competitor activity and organic search performance.

6. Growing Absolute itself

* Run approved paid campaigns for Absolute Marketing Agency.
* Generate leads for the agency's own sales pipeline.
* Test offers and creatives that attract qualified business prospects.
* Hand leads over cleanly to the business development team.

7. Account management and process discipline

* Keep one central tracker of campaigns, budgets, results, account ownership and lead destinations.
* Document campaign settings, tracking setups and key optimization decisions.
* Follow access-control and data-security procedures on every client account.
* Flag campaign risks, overspend, tracking failures and lead-delivery issues immediately.
* Get approval from the Head of Marketing before any material budget change.

**Required skills and experience**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.
* Strong practical command of Meta Ads Manager.
* Proven Google Ads experience, or strong campaign results across the platforms this role needs.
* Experience running lead-generation campaigns for businesses.
* Solid grasp of conversion tracking, pixels, GA4, GTM and campaign analytics.
* Clear understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rates, ROAS and lead quality.
* Ability to read campaign data and turn it into decisions.
* Experience working with creative teams to lift ad performance.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and reporting discipline.
* Ability to juggle multiple client accounts, prioritize and hit deadlines.
* Clear written communication and a high level of ownership.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in a digital marketing agency.
* Experience across multiple industries, especially local lead-generation businesses.
* Landing page optimization, retargeting and funnel analysis.
* CRM integrations, Google Sheets lead flows and marketing automation.
* Google Business Profile and local SEO.
* A portfolio of campaigns with measurable business outcomes.

**What success looks like**

* Campaigns launch correctly and on schedule.
* No unplanned budget overspend.
* Lead destinations and tracking stay working.
* CPL and lead quality improve against agreed baselines and targets.
* Optimization decisions are driven by real data and sales feedback.
* Weekly and monthly reports go out on time.
* Winning creatives and audiences are found through structured testing.
* Absolute's own campaigns bring in qualified leads.
* Every account has documented settings, results and handover notes.

3. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

4. Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, customer collections, vendor payments, and outstanding balances.

5. Ensure proper accounting of land purchases, construction expenses, project development costs, and property sales.

6. Establish project-wise cost centres and maintain financial records for each project.

7. Review financial transactions and ensure proper supporting documentation.

**B. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

1. Manage GST compliance, including returns, reconciliations, input tax credit reviews, and applicable reverse-charge provisions.

2. Handle TDS calculations, deductions, deposits, returns, and reconciliation.

3. Coordinate the preparation and filing of income tax returns and advance tax payments.

4. Manage tax audits, statutory audits, internal audits, and other applicable assessments.

5. Review GST and TDS implications for property purchases, construction contracts, land transactions, and property sales.

6. Ensure compliance with applicable Companies Act requirements in coordination with company secretarial professionals.

7. Monitor changes in tax laws, accounting standards, and real estate regulations.

8. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and government authorities.

**C. Financial Planning & Analysis**

1. Prepare annual budgets, operating plans, and periodic financial forecasts.

2. Develop cash flow statements and working capital projections.

3. Analyse revenue, expenses, gross margins, project profitability, and return on investment.

4. Prepare monthly management reports covering actuals versus budget.

5. Identify cost-saving opportunities and financial risks.

6. Provide financial analysis to support land acquisition, project launches, pricing, and investment decisions.

7. Support management in evaluating debt funding, equity funding, and project financing options.

**D. Banking, Treasury & Audit**

1. Monitor bank balances, fund requirements, loan repayments, and interest expenses.

2. Manage banking relationships and coordinate loan documentation.

3. Prepare bank statements, reconciliations, and lender reports.

4. Coordinate internal, statutory, tax, and project-related audits.

5. Maintain proper financial documentation and audit trails.

6. Implement internal financial controls to reduce errors, fraud, and unauthorised payments.

**E. Team & Management Coordination**

1. Supervise accountants and finance executives, where applicable.

2. Establish standard operating procedures for accounting and financial approvals.

3. Coordinate with sales, procurement, construction, HR, legal, and administration teams.

4. Present periodic financial updates to the management.

5. Maintain confidentiality of financial information and company records.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Additional qualifications in finance, taxation, or project management are an advantage.

**4. Experience Required**

* Preferably 3 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
* Experience in real estate, property development, construction, or infrastructure is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax, financial reporting, and statutory audits.
* Experience in project accounting, budgeting, cash flow management.

**5. Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and applicable Indian tax laws.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime, Microsoft Excel, and accounting/ERP software.
* Experience with project-wise accounting and financial reporting.
* Knowledge of GST portals, income tax portals, and TDS compliance.
* Ability to prepare financial statements, MIS reports, budgets, and cash flow forecasts.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of monthly books of accounts and financial reports.
* Accuracy of project-wise accounting and financial statements.
* Timely filing of applicable statutory returns and payment of taxes.
* Timely bank and ledger reconciliations.

* Control of project cost overruns and identification of variances.
* Timely reconciliation of customer collections and vendor payments.
* Audit readiness and closure of audit observations.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: SAP Fieldgasss - Manager
description:

**SAP Fieldglass Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services (GDS) refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Within Consulting, EY's SAP practice helps organizations transform procurement, workforce management, finance, supply chain and contingent workforce operations through innovative SAP solutions, helping clients achieve operational excellence and digital transformation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY is seeking an experienced SAP Fieldglass Manager to join our growing SAP Consulting practice within GDS. The role offers an opportunity to lead large-scale contingent workforce and services procurement transformations powered by SAP Fieldglass.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead end-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementations, drive solution design workshops, manage global stakeholders, mentor high-performing teams, and support business growth initiatives. You will combine deep functional expertise, consulting skills, and leadership capabilities to deliver exceptional outcomes for clients across industries.

* Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans while proactively communicating project status.
* Support business development activities including proposal development, solutioning, estimations, client presentations, and RFP responses.
* Mentor consultants and senior consultants while fostering a collaborative and high-performance team culture.
* Stay current with SAP Fieldglass product innovations, workforce management trends, and emerging technologies.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong consulting mindset with ability to engage senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Proven leadership skills with experience managing distributed delivery teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication capabilities.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements in a fast-paced global environment.
* Commercial awareness with experience in project financial management.
* Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
* Ability to drive client value realization through transformational workforce strategies.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* 10-12 years of overall IT and consulting experience.
* Minimum 8 years of hands-on SAP Fieldglass implementation experience.
* Proven experience leading at least 3-5 end-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementations.
* Strong expertise in Contingent Workforce and Services Procurement modules.
* Experience in business process design, configuration, testing, data migration, and deployment activities.
* Experience managing onsite-offshore delivery models and global stakeholders.
* Knowledge of procurement, workforce management, HR, vendor management, and external workforce processes.
* Experience with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong presentation, documentation, and client-facing consulting skills.

**Ideally, You'll Also Have**

* Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), or SAP Integration Suite.
* Knowledge of Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Vendor Neutral Program (VNP) operating models.
* Exposure to AI-driven workforce analytics and procurement transformation initiatives.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for experienced consulting professionals who can combine SAP Fieldglass functional expertise with leadership and client relationship management skills. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to quality, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while helping clients achieve successful workforce transformation outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Team Leader
description:
****Job Description****
**About TaskUs:**
TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
  
  
The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
  
  
It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
  
  
**Job Description**
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
  
  
Being a
**Team Leader**
, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.
  
  
You must be adept at creating reports of your team's performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
  
  
So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
  
  
****Requirements:****
So, what are we looking for?
  
  
We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 + teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.
  
  
If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that's a plus in your favor. If you're familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.
  
  
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
TaskUs is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
****How We Partner To Protect You:****
TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
  
  
****DEI:****
In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
  
  
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
**https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
1. Build and run a weekly ad creative testing roadmap covering hooks, angles, formats, and offers, with clear hypotheses and success criteria.

2. Turn findings into ad angles and messaging the creative team can act on. Brief designers, video editors, and creators on ad concepts, scripts, hooks, and formats (UGC, static, carousel, short-form video).

3. Analyze ad performance (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CPA, ROAS, AOV) to understand what’s driving results and turn learnings into next-round iterations: new hooks, edits, formats, and angles built on winners.

4. Track ad trends, formats, and creative styles in beauty and D2C, and test the ones that fit our audience and brand. Maintain an ad creative library organized by angle, format, hook type, and performance.

5. Analyze customer reviews, surveys, ad comments, and competitor ads (via Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, etc.) to uncover pain points, objections, and language that sells.

description:
