Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for an incumbent who is competent enough to provide advisory services including Accounting support on technical and special matters including GAAP Conversion, accounting policy support, new accounting standard implementation (end to end), and Disclosure support for IFRS/USGAAP. The incumbent will work for top global clients across a wide variety of markets and industry sectors.
  
  
As part of our EY GDS Assurance Team, the individual will be responsible for working closely with FAAS Managers and Senior Managers on client engagements across Americas, EMEIA or APAC.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage quality of service delivery
* Ensure quality in delivering client service by directing daily progress of fieldwork, informing Supervisors of engagement status
* Follow through on client requests in a timely fashion, and manage expectations regarding the timing of deliverables and reports
* Explain the client's critical success factors to the engagement team.
* Working directly with the onshore engagement team on a daily basis to deliver work to onshore clients;
* Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situations
* Identify engagement and client service issues. Research and benchmark client data to industry data.
* Explain the client's critical success factors to the engagement team.
* Apply independent and objective professional judgment in applying accounting standards to meet engagement expectations, including regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situations
* Coordinating with on-shore technical accounting teams to understand their accounting issue(s) and provide research assistance on an as-needed basis on U.S. GAAP and IFRS accounting pronouncements.
* Demonstrate knowledge on special accounting matters, new accounting pronouncements, technology oriented solution driven by accounting as a functional expertise
* Customize each presentation to the acquisition’s specific attributes
* Work on a variety of corporate finance transactions in all stages, from initial client pitches to transaction closing
* Receive direction from the Manager, Senior Manager and Partner
* Maintaining a relationship approach with senior Stakeholders, interpreting feedback on key business developments/risks and understanding the Clients' marketplace in order to address their needs, while delivering 'one voice' to the client in all communications and correspondence
* Keeping abreast of pertinent industry, regulatory and business practices, driving oversight of regulatory adherence
* Initiating ongoing improvements by exploring, identifying, and implementing reporting, analysis, and process solutions
* Co-ordinating activities between small teams on projects to deliver tasks, including providing guidance and feedback to junior team members
* Undertaking practice development activities including contributing to thought leadership pieces, running industry events, delivering training, or managing team communications
* Contributing to business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients
* Contributing to the growth of the practice by providing input to EY Point of views, development of solutions, engagement tools and enablers

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good understanding of IFRS/US/UK GAAP and International auditing standards.
* Technical accounting advisory on complex topics (e.g. business combinations, consolidation, shared based payments, financial instruments including debt/equity etc.)
* Coordinating with on-shore technical accounting teams to understand their accounting issue(s) and provide research assistance on an as-needed basis on U.S. GAAP and IFRS accounting pronouncements.
* Primary responsibility for project management in connection with project role and responsibilities, ensuring relevant information flow and appropriate coordination between cross-functional team members within the finance function
* Work on a variety of accounting matters through all stages, from initial client pitches to audit closing
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation and technical writing skills
* Ability and comfort level in researching client inquires and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices and new technologies
* Flexibility and willingness to travel on short notice, as necessary
* Working experience in relation to the following services/solutions:

+ Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters
+ White paper writing skills
+ Provide comprehensive technical accounting guidance to clients, addressing complex issues and transactions. (Business Combination, consolidation, stock based compensation, revenue, leases accounting, etc)
+ Conduct research and analysis on accounting issues, documenting findings and proposing solutions.
+ Preparation of financial statements including accounting policies and governance
+ Accounting processes
+ Audit support and governance

**Professional Experience**
Typical experience may include, whilst not limited to:
  
  

* Experience of working in an advisory role.
* Manage a team of 10+ people
* Advanced skills and experience with: technical accounting matters, whitepapers on significant issues like consolidation, IFRS 15, 16, etc
* Hands-on consulting experience at a Big 4, or top tier consulting firm

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
* 6-10 years (post qualification) in Assurance including at least 3+ years of Financial Accounting and \Advisory experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Advisory \- Deals \- Financial Due Diligence \- Associate, you will provide strategic advice and business diligence services to clients involved in mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow, taking ownership and consistently delivering quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team.

* Conducting financial due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures to provide strategic advice to clients
* Analyzing financial statements and cash flows to assess quality of earnings and identify key deal issues
* Collaborating with team members to gather and interpret data from various sources for comprehensive analysis
* Applying financial forecasting and modeling techniques to support deal evaluations and recommendations
* Engaging in active listening and asking questions to clarify client needs and project requirements
* Developing commercial awareness by understanding how business operations impact financial performance
* Utilizing financial planning and review skills to contribute to client engagements and project success

 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 1 years of experience
* Current pursuit of or a Certified Public Accountant License, or Chartered Accountant, or Foreign Certified Public Accountant, or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Excelling in financial statement analysis and modeling
* Demonstrating proficiency in financial forecasting and planning
* Utilizing industry trend analysis to inform decision\-making
* Engaging in active listening and effective communication
* Applying knowledge of business performance metrics
* Adapting to fast\-paced environments and diverse teams
* Developing skills in financial due diligence and deal management

title: Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM ≥ INR 1 million through a “need-based approach,” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
* To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
* Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
* Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self-sourcing, referrals, branch walk-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
* Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
* Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products
* Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
* Mandatory - Graduate (10+2+3 years of education)
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior
* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Self-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
* In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities
* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
* Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
* Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
* Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients

description:
**About Us**
Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.

Scimplify is a specialty chemicals manufacturing and supply-chain platform. From India, it serves industrial buyers worldwide across agrochemicals, pharma intermediates, and advanced and critical materials. * Strongly data-driven, with clear writing for technical and senior audiences.

Alongside supporting wider Brand & Marketing activity, you'll help us optimise careers content for search engines and emerging AI-powered search and answer experiences, making it easier for the right talent to discover relevant jobs, content and information about working with us.
  
  
You'll become part of a global team, learning from Brand & Marketing specialists while building practical experience in SEO, AEO, digital content, analytics and employer brand across different countries and talent audiences.

Your role
  
  

* Support the delivery of global talent attraction and employer brand campaigns, with a particular focus on digital and careers-site content.
* Create, edit and optimise careers-site content using SEO and AEO principles, helping our content perform effectively across traditional and AI-powered search.
* Support keyword and search-intent research to understand what candidates are looking for and help translate this into useful, relevant content.
* Build, adapt and publish content using agreed templates, content management systems and digital tools.
* Support updates to careers websites and campaign landing pages, including page titles, headings, metadata, copy, links and other on-page content.
* Help structure content so that it is clear, accessible and easy for both people and search technologies to understand, including FAQs, question-led content and concise answers where appropriate.
* Support the ongoing review of existing careers content, identifying opportunities to improve, refresh, consolidate or remove content based on search behaviour, audience needs and performance.
* Help prepare social media and employee advocacy content for activation.

* Work across different countries and priorities, moving between projects according to business demand.
* Spot opportunities to reuse content, improve findability, simplify processes or make delivery more efficient.
* Develop broader marketing capabilities by working alongside global Brand & Marketing specialists.

**About You**
You don't need to be a recruitment marketing or SEO expert. We're looking for potential, curiosity and strong digital foundations, with a genuine interest in how people discover and engage with content online.
  
  
**You'll Ideally Have**

* Around 0 to 2 years' experience in digital marketing, SEO, content, communications, web publishing, copywriting or a related environment. This could include internships, placements, freelance work or relevant project experience.

description:

**Job Title:**
SEO & Content Associate

**About The Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, execution-focused SEO & Content Associate to help grow organic traffic and improve search visibility for a new digital telco brand in the MENA region. The successful candidate will drive SEO implementation, product high-quality content, and improve visibility across both traditional search engines and emerging GenAI platforms (like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity). S/he will own keyword research, content execution, site audits, and reporting, ensuring everything is SEO-ready, measurable, and aligned to the business’s acquisition goals.

The ideal candidate has strong written and communication skills in English, understands search behaviour across region, and knows how to tailor content to surface in GenAI results, not just search engine rankings.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Implement SEO best practices across core pages, blogs, and the Help Center - including title tags, headers, metadata, schema, and internal linking
* Conduct keyword research to support new content and optimize existing assets
* Monitor technical SEO elements like indexing, site structure, mobile responsiveness, and page speed, and work with engineering to resolve issues
* Write and optimize SEO-focused content such as landing pages, blog articles, FAQs, and product pages, aligned with key search intents
* Maintain a consistent brand tone while maximizing content discoverability and relevance
* Identify content gaps and product new content based on search trends, competitor benchmarks, and analytics
* Optimize content not only for traditional SERPs but also for retrieval and visibility in GenAI platforms (eg. ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity)
* Track and report on organic KPIs including ranking, traffic, CTR, bounce rates, and conversions
* Use GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush/Ahrefs, and Looker to surface insights and performance issues
* Conduct regular site audits and content refreshes to improve ranking and fix SEO issues
* Stay up to date with the latest search algorithm updates and GenAI platform developments, and translate them into practical executional changes
* Provide SEO input for product launches, new landing pages, and marketing campaigns
* Ensure consistency across content and acquisition channels

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 4-6 years of hands-on SEO and content experience in fast-paced digital or B2C environments
* Fluent in English, with strong written and communication skills
* Proven success in improving rankings and scaling organic traffic through content and technical SEO
* Strong familiarity with SEO tools (eg. SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog) and analytics platforms (eg. GA4, Looker)
* Experience working with CMS tools (eg. WordPress, Webflow) and cross-fucntional teams
* Prior exposure to MENA markets and understanding of GenAI platforms is a strong plus

title: Marketing Associate
description:
**About Equilibrium:**

Equilibrium is a full-stack carbon removal developer building one of the largest high-integrity carbon portfolios from the Global South, with a ~20Mt CO₂ removal pipeline. We develop bankable, high-impact projects by integrating advanced climate science, an in-house digital MRV platform, and innovative blended finance.

Our portfolio spans across nature-based and engineered removal: on nature-based, we have large-scale agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, and mangrove restoration initiatives; on engineered removal, we are building India's leading biochar platform with large-scale commercial operations. Collectively, our projects span 120,000+ hectares and will support over 150,000 smallholder farmers and coastal communities.

Our work is backed by a $3M institutional seed round from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia) and Avaana Capital, and driven by a 90+ member team with deep expertise in climate science, carbon markets, and project operations.

**About the Role**

We're looking for someone to own how EQ shows up for the farmers we work with. This is a content-first, farmer-facing role, starting with our YouTube channel (built around soil health, biochar, and practical field knowledge) and expanding to Facebook. You'll ideate, shoot, edit, and publish, track what's working, and shape the calendar around it. This isn't a caption-writing role, it's closer to running a small channel end to end.

**What you'll do**

* Ideate, plan and produce content for farmer-facing channels, starting with YouTube and expanding to Facebook
* Own video production end to end: filming (including field/site shoots), editing, and basic design as needed
* Build and manage a content calendar, planned around what farmers actually want to know
* Track channel performance and adjust the content plan based on what the data actually shows
* Work with field and project teams to source real farmer stories, on-ground footage, and technical input for explainer content
* Adapt content for regional languages rather than defaulting to English-first
* Manage day-to-day publishing and community engagement: comments, questions, audience feedback
* Coordinate with the design/brand team for visual consistency across channels
* Keep an eye on what's working for other agri/rural-facing channels and bring that back into planning

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years in social media management, video production, or content creation
* Strong hands-on video editing skills
* Comfortable with basic design work
* Willing and able to travel to field sites for shoots
* Fluency in relevant regional language in addition to English (Kannada)
* Comfortable reading platform analytics and using them to make real decisions, not just report numbers
* A self-starter who can both come up with ideas and actually execute them, without needing every detail handed over

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience creating content for a farmer, rural, or agricultural audience specifically
* Photography skills, for stills alongside video
* Experience managing a channel from a low subscriber base, you know what building from scratch actually looks like

title: Social Media & Content Lead — Multi-Brand
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, aligned with Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$42,000–C$54,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications
  
  
**Build an AI-First Content Function**
Langford Staffing is hiring a Social Media & Content Lead to build and lead organic content across a portfolio of technology and service businesses.
  
  
The portfolio includes companies in property management, leasing, real estate brokerage, home maintenance, property technology, staffing, and related services. Each brand has a different audience, business goal, and identity.
  
  
This is a hands-on, build-stage role. You’ll establish the strategy, brand standards, content systems, AI workflows, and reporting structure. You’ll also create strong content personally. As production needs grow, you’ll decide what support is required and build the team around it.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who understands how content drives discovery, trust, qualified traffic, bookings, platform adoption, and revenue—not simply views and followers.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio link.
  
  
Your portfolio should include content you personally created, examples of different brand voices, AI-assisted work, and measurable results where available.
  
  
If your background and portfolio align with the role, you’ll receive an email within 24–48 hours of applying with a link to complete a short pre-recorded interview.
  
  
Please allow one to two weeks after completing the interview for us to review all applications. Selected candidates will then be invited to a live video interview.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Build the organic content strategy across multiple brands.
* Give each brand a distinct voice, visual identity, and content direction.
* Decide how each company should use Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Create AI-assisted videos, graphics, voiceovers, written content, and platform-specific campaigns.
* Build efficient workflows for producing and repurposing content with limited original footage.
* Develop content calendars, approval processes, brand guidelines, and reporting systems.
* Improve visibility on Google and help brands become discoverable through AI platforms.
* Track which content produces qualified traffic, inquiries, bookings, listings, and platform sign-ups.
* Use AI and automation to monitor comments, messages, mentions, and reviews.
* Manage public complaints and protect each company’s online reputation.
* Decide when additional support is required and hire the right people, contractors, or agencies.
* Set expectations, review performance, and hold future team members accountable.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Five or more years of social media, organic growth, content strategy, or digital marketing experience.
* Experience managing content across multiple brands, clients, or business units.
* A portfolio showing content you personally created and measurable organic growth.
* Strong practical experience using AI for video, images, voice, research, content production, and repurposing.
* Experience with tools such as HeyGen, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, or comparable platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Experience developing brand voices, visual standards, and repeatable content systems.
* Practical knowledge of SEO, local search, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.
* Experience improving search rankings and helping brands become credible and discoverable through AI-generated recommendations.
* Experience hiring, managing, or coordinating content professionals, contractors, or agencies.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong judgment, organization, and the ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.

Agency, multi-brand, technology, property, real estate, home-services, or recurring-service experience is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Who Will Succeed**
The right person is both strategic and hands-on.
  
  
You can move from building a 90-day strategy to creating an AI-assisted video, reviewing search performance, responding to a public complaint, or deciding which capability should be added next.
  
  
You know how to prioritize when several brands need attention. You can establish structure in a growing environment and build a modern content operation without relying on a large traditional marketing department.
  
  
**Success Means**
**What Success Looks Like**

* Each brand has a clear and recognizable identity.
* Content is produced consistently without becoming repetitive or generic.
* Social reach turns into qualified traffic and business opportunities.
* Search visibility improves across Google and AI platforms.
* Comments, messages, and reputation risks are handled promptly.
* AI is used effectively without lowering quality or credibility.
* The content function becomes organized, measurable, and scalable.
* The right support is added as production requirements grow.

title: Brand Manager
description:
As a Brand Manager at Skydo, you'll open up new channels of growth and make sure our

campaigns actually work. You'll run our events and our biggest marketing campaigns, taking

each idea from a rough brief to something exporters across India see, remember, and act on.

What you will do :

* Take a theme and build a full program around it. For example, with the Export Declaration Form (EDF) coming in, you'll shape what Skydo says about it, how we help exporters understand it, and how we make sure they hear about it from us first
* Take each campaign to every channel it belongs on (social, YouTube, email, WhatsApp, the website, events, and partners) and keep the story consistent everywhere
* Set a clear goal for every campaign and report on what it delivered
* Find, test, and scale channels we aren't using yet, like creator and UGC campaigns, influencer partnerships, communities, and co-marketing with partners
* Plan and run exporter meetups, webinars, and workshops, plus our presence at industry events and trade body sessions

You’re a good fit if you have:

* 3 to 6 years of experience in marketing, brand, campaigns, events, or growth at a startup, agency, or consumer brand
* Campaigns you've shipped and are proud of, with the results to show for them
* A knack for turning complicated topics into stories people want to read, watch, and share
* Comfort with both the idea and the legwork: you can write the brief, call the vendor, chase the creator, and run the event checklist
* A habit of thinking across channels, not just one
* An analytical curiosity to understand basic metrics, track across activities
* Bonus: experience marketing to B2B, SMB, or fintech audiences, or a creator network or community you've built yourself

The mindset we’re seeking:

* Creative Courage: You bring fresh ideas to the table and aren't scared of the one that might not work.
* Customer First: Every campaign starts with one question: how is this useful to an exporter?
* Radical Accountability: Owning things fully is your default. You track what landed and what didn't, and you act on it without waiting to be asked.

description:

This person sets direction, standards, and priorities across the portfolio — driving growth, profitability, assortment, pricing, and vendor relationships — while developing the team to execute and deliver against targets.

Set direction, standards, and priorities consistently across the category portfolio.

Allocate budget, investment, and focus across categories based on opportunity and performance.

Balance and de-risk the portfolio, ensuring strong categories fund emerging ones.

Track category performance against targets and course-correct proactively.

Manage supply reliability, fill rates, and vendor performance.

Partner with supply chain and planning on forecasting, inventory health, and availability.

Minimize stockouts and overstock; manage aged and dead inventory.

Collaborate with marketing, operations, supply chain, and finance to deliver category goals.

Use data and market insight to inform decisions.

years in category management, merchandising, or buying (adjust for seniority).

Proven experience owning multiple categories and leading a team of Category Managers.

Track record of P&L ownership and category growth at portfolio scale.

Strong people-leadership, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

Comfort with data tools and category analytics.

Team leadership • Multi-category P&L management • Strategic thinking • Vendor negotiation • Data-driven decision-making • Commercial acumen

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR)
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a high-calibre
**Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) -**
who brings a strong combination of business acumen, strategic thinking, revenue ownership, and execution capabilities.
  
  
This is not a conventional strategy or operations role. We are looking for someone who has built, scaled, and driven business outcomes, someone who understands how businesses operate, how revenue is generated, how marketing drives growth, and how to manage profitability.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience across
**P&L management, business strategy, growth, digital marketing, organic marketing, and sales**
. They should have owned business metrics, driven revenue targets, managed growth initiatives, and demonstrated the ability to take businesses or business verticals from 0 to 1 or scale existing operations.
  
  
Working directly with the founders and leadership team, the EIR will identify high-impact opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and take complete ownership of strategic initiatives that drive revenue, growth, and business profitability.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Business Strategy & P&L Ownership
* Own and drive business P&L, including revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.
* Develop and execute business strategies aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Identify revenue opportunities, optimize costs, and improve overall business performance.
* Monitor key business metrics and take data-backed decisions to improve profitability.
* Translate business goals into actionable growth plans and measurable outcomes.
* Growth & Revenue Ownership
* Drive end-to-end business growth initiatives with direct accountability for revenue outcomes.
* Identify new revenue streams, business opportunities, and scalable growth models.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue.
* Work closely with sales and marketing teams to build predictable and sustainable revenue channels.
* Own growth targets and ensure execution against business objectives.
* Marketing & Customer Acquisition
* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies across paid and organic channels.
* Drive organic growth through SEO, content marketing, social media, brand positioning, and other relevant channels.
* Understand performance marketing, customer acquisition costs (CAC), ROI, lead generation, and conversion metrics.
* Identify opportunities to optimize marketing spends and improve marketing efficiency.
* Build scalable customer acquisition strategies that contribute directly to business growth.
* Sales & Business Development
* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business and revenue targets.
* Understand the complete sales funnel, from lead generation and acquisition to conversion and closure.
* Identify gaps in the sales process and implement strategies to improve sales productivity and conversion rates.
* Work closely with sales teams to drive revenue performance and improve overall business efficiency.
* Strategic Initiatives & Founder's Office
* Work directly with founders and leadership on high-priority business initiatives.
* Identify business challenges, evaluate opportunities, and independently drive solutions.
* Lead cross-functional projects across marketing, sales, product, operations, and business teams.
* Drive 0→1 initiatives, from identifying opportunities to execution and scaling.
* Build processes, systems, and business frameworks that improve organizational efficiency.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems and ensure execution with measurable business impact.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in startups, business strategy, growth, business operations, entrepreneurship, or a Founder's Office role.
* Proven experience in owning and managing P&L, with a strong understanding of revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.
* Hands-on experience in driving business growth and taking ownership of revenue targets.
* Strong understanding and execution experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, and organic marketing.
* Experience in developing and executing business and growth strategies.
* Exposure to sales, business development, lead generation, and revenue conversion.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand the bigger business picture and identify growth opportunities.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate insights into business decisions.
* Ability to independently take ownership of initiatives and drive them from strategy to execution.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or leadership teams.
* Prior experience managing a business vertical, category, business unit, or independent P&L.
* Experience scaling a startup, launching new business initiatives, or building a business from scratch.
* Experience in EdTech, Consumer Tech, D2C, SaaS, or other high-growth startup environments.
* Demonstrated success in improving revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and business growth.

**Who Would Be a Great Fit?**
**We Are Looking For Someone Who**

* Thinks like a founder and operates like a business owner.
* Understands the connection between marketing, sales, revenue, and profitability.
* Has owned business numbers and is accountable for outcomes, not just activities.
* Can build a growth strategy and has the ability to execute it independently.
* Is equally comfortable discussing P&L numbers, marketing funnels, sales performance, and business strategy.
* Can identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and turn ideas into measurable business results.
* Thrives in ambiguity and takes complete ownership without waiting for instructions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work directly with founders and leadership on mission-critical business decisions.
* Own high-impact business initiatives with direct visibility into company growth.
* Opportunity to influence business strategy, revenue, and profitability.
* Build, experiment, and scale new business opportunities.
* High ownership, autonomy, and accelerated career growth.Job Description – Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR)

title: Growth Manager
description:
Job Description: Growth Manager

**Company:**
Bambinos.live

**Location:**
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**Department:**
Growth Marketing

**Reporting to:**
Head of Growth

**Collaboration:**
Growth, Creative, Sales, Product and Data Teams

About Bambinos

Bambinos.live is an EdTech company offering live, small-group online classes for children aged 4–15. Our programs span leadership and life skills, Chess, Mathematics, English, Science, AI, and more. We serve families across India, the Middle East, and North America, supported by technology that helps parents track their child's learning progress.

Role Overview

We are looking for a results-driven
**Growth Manager**
to lead customer acquisition and drive business growth across multiple channels. This role involves building and optimizing marketing funnels, managing campaign budgets, experimenting with new acquisition channels, and improving conversion rates from lead generation to paid enrolment.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in WhatsApp and email marketing, programmatic advertising, performance marketing, and data-driven growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities

1. WhatsApp & Email Marketing

* Build and optimize WhatsApp journeys for lead nurturing, demo reminders, follow-ups, re-engagement, and conversion.
* Manage broadcast campaigns, audience segmentation, and opt-in compliance.
* Develop email lifecycle campaigns, including welcome sequences, lead nurturing, win-back, and referral campaigns.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, and conversion metrics while conducting A/B tests.

2. Paid Acquisition & Performance Marketing

* Plan, test, and scale programmatic advertising through Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) and owned-and-operated (O&O) networks.
* Explore new paid acquisition channels across publisher, OTT, and app networks.
* Manage and scale Google Ads campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen.
* Optimize campaign budgets, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and landing pages.
* Collaborate across Meta and Google Ads to improve overall acquisition performance.

3. Growth Funnels & Conversion Optimization

* Own the complete customer journey:
  **Lead Generation → Demo Booking → Demo Attendance → Paid Enrolment.**
* Identify conversion gaps and implement strategies to improve funnel performance.
* Design and experiment with new acquisition funnels, including webinars, workshops, assessments, and lead magnets.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking across advertising platforms and GA4.

4. Content & Organic Growth

* Identify opportunities to use short-form videos, parent testimonials, teacher-led content, and SEO to generate demand.
* Work with creative teams to develop high-performing marketing content.
* Use campaign insights and performance data to guide content strategy.

5. Referral, Influencer & Partnership Marketing

* Build referral and ambassador programs to drive customer acquisition.
* Develop influencer and creator partnerships within the parenting and education space.
* Establish partnerships with schools, parent communities, and complementary brands.
* Explore community-led growth opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency.

6. Analytics, Reporting & Budget Management

* Track key metrics, including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), cost per demo, demo attendance rate, conversion rate, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
* Analyse campaign performance by channel, course, and geography.
* Build dashboards and reports connecting marketing spend to revenue.
* Allocate budgets based on performance insights and growth opportunities.
* Present weekly performance updates and recommendations to leadership.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in growth marketing or performance marketing, preferably in B2C, EdTech, or subscription-based businesses.
* Hands-on experience building WhatsApp marketing journeys using platforms such as WATI, Interakt, Gupshup, or AiSensy.
* Experience managing email lifecycle campaigns using tools such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Klaviyo, or Mailchimp.
* Practical experience running and scaling Google Ads campaigns.
* Hands-on experience with DSPs or O&O advertising networks, with a focus on conversions and revenue.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels, conversion optimization, and lifecycle marketing.
* Proficiency in GA4, Google Sheets/Excel, and marketing dashboards.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret attribution data and connect marketing performance to business outcomes.
* Ability to independently manage budgets, run experiments, identify growth opportunities, and take ownership of results.
* Good understanding of how paid, owned, earned, referral, and influencer channels work together.

Good to Have

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads.
* Experience in EdTech, children's learning, or parent-focused B2C businesses.
* Experience marketing across India, the Middle East, and North America.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Metabase, or Looker.
* Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), server-side tracking, or offline conversion uploads.
* Experience building referral or affiliate programs from scratch.

Why Join Bambinos?

* Be part of a growing EdTech company serving families across multiple markets.
* Take ownership of growth strategy, experimentation, and customer acquisition.
* Work in a fast-paced environment where ideas can be tested and implemented quickly.
* Make a measurable impact on business growth and customer acquisition.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with a brief note describing one growth funnel they have managed, the improvements they implemented, and the measurable results achieved.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Job Title: Performance Marketer (Google & Meta Ads Specialist)

Location: [Bengaluru, Karnataka, INDIA]

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Mid-Senior level (3+ Years)

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a data-driven Performance Marketer with 3+ years of hands-on experience to own our paid acquisition engine end-to-end across Google Ads and Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads. You will take full ownership from campaign architecture, audience research, and creative briefing to conversion tracking, bid/budget optimization, landing page testing, and revenue reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

End-to-End Google Ads Management: Architect, launch, and scale campaigns across Search, Performance Max (PMax), Display, Shopping/Merchant Center (if applicable), and YouTube—covering keyword research, negative keyword hygiene, match-type strategy, ad extensions, Quality Score optimization, and smart bidding (tCPA / tROAS).

End-to-End Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads Management: Manage full-funnel Meta campaigns (Prospecting, Retargeting, Advantage+ Shopping/App Campaigns), audience segmentation (Lookalikes, Broad, Custom Audiences), catalog feeds, and placement/frequency optimization.

Creative Strategy & Structured Testing: Write ad copy, brief designers/video editors on high-converting static and video hooks, and run disciplined A/B tests on creatives, formats, and CTAs to combat ad fatigue and lower CPA.

Tracking, Pixels & Attribution: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot end-to-end conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager (GTM), GA4, Google Ads Enhanced Conversions, Meta Pixel, Meta Conversions API (CAPI), and strict UTM governance.

Budget Pacing & Scaling: Own monthly ad budgets, daily spend pacing, and channel mix allocation—scaling winning ad sets/campaigns profitably while protecting CAC, CPL, and ROAS targets.

Landing Page & Funnel Optimization (CRO): Analyze post-click user behavior and funnel drop-offs, partnering with web/product teams to A/B test landing pages, lead forms, and checkout flows.

Full-Funnel Reporting & Insights: Build automated performance dashboards (Looker Studio / Excel / Google Sheets) and present weekly/monthly reports linking ad spend directly to qualified pipeline, revenue, and LTV.

**Requirements & Must-Have Skills**

3+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing end-to-end performance marketing campaigns on both Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager with ownership of real budgets.

Deep working knowledge of Google Ads (Search structure, PMax asset groups, bidding algorithms, Search Term reports, and Merchant Center/YouTube where relevant).

Deep working knowledge of Meta Ads (campaign structure, Advantage+ suite, Pixel + CAPI deduplication, attribution windows, and creative testing frameworks).

Strong command of GA4, GTM, UTM tracking, and intermediate-to-advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, cohort/funnel analysis).

Sharp analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose performance dips (CPM spikes, CTR drops, CVR decay) and execute fast fixes.

Strong communication skills to collaborate smoothly with creative, product, tech, and sales/CRM teams.

**Good to Have**

Experience connecting ad platforms with CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) for offline conversion tracking (OCT) and lead-to-sale optimization.

Hands-on experience with Looker Studio or similar BI visualization tools.

Google Ads and Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate / Media Buying Professional credentials.

title: Content Marketer
description:
**About HyperVerge**

HyperVerge is a deep tech AI company providing identity verification solutions for companies in BFSI, Ed-tech, Telecom, Digital Lenders, and Marketplaces. Our homegrown AI powers large enterprises like Jio, SBI, and Bajaj Finserv, and has powered 2 billion+ AI-based automated ID checks. HyperVerge is on the path to $100M revenue and getting there requires exceptional content that unpacks complex ideas in AI and BFSI, builds trust with buyers, and drives organic and pipeline growth.

**Mission**

As Content Marketer at HyperVerge, you will build the narratives, frameworks, and content programs that drive growth, audience engagement, and sales pipeline. This is a high-ownership IC role. You will sit at the intersection of brand, PR, and email marketing. You will not just produce content, you will define what gets made, why, for whom, and how it performs.

**Outcomes for the first year**

**Within the first 3–6 months:**

* Publish a PR strategy covering target publications, executive positioning, narrative pillars, a reactive comms framework, and a quarterly pitch calendar
* Secure consistent earned coverage in tier-1 business and fintech publications through pitches, bylines, data stories, and expert commentary
* Set up and document the email infrastructure: domain strategy, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm-up, suppression lists, and deliverability monitoring
* Define the email program structure: segments, cadences, nurture flows, and a newsletter with a clear editorial point of view
* Establish a reporting rhythm for both channels: coverage, share of voice, deliverability, engagement, and pipeline attribution
* Introduce AI tooling into both workflows and demonstrate measurable efficiency gains

**Within the first year:**

* Make HyperVerge a go-to source for journalists covering identity verification, AI fraud, and digital onboarding
* Run a healthy email program at scale with deliverability, bounce, and complaint rates within industry benchmarks and measurable pipeline contribution
* Build a library of reusable PR assets: executive bios, proof-point sheets, data stories, award submissions, and a crisis comms playbook
* Establish repeatable playbooks for both channels (launch PR cycle, reactive comms, nurture templates, list hygiene cycles) that can scale with the team

**Responsibilities:**

1. Public Relations & Media Relations

Own PR strategy and execution across business, fintech, technology, and trade media, building journalist relationships and placing press releases, bylines, and expert commentary.

2. Executive Positioning & Agency Management

Shape positioning for the CEO, CTO, and senior leaders through speaking opportunities, awards, and media prep, while managing the PR agency on briefing, approvals, and performance.

3. Reactive & Crisis Communications

Monitor news for moments where HyperVerge has a credible point of view and respond quickly, while maintaining holding statements and escalation paths for issues management.

4. Email Infrastructure & Deliverability

Own the email tech stack and sending infrastructure, including domains, authentication, warm-up, sender reputation monitoring, list hygiene, compliance, and rapid diagnosis of deliverability incidents.

5. Email Program & Performance

Design and run segmentation, nurture sequences, newsletters, launch campaigns, and sales-support sequences, with A/B testing and a performance dashboard tied to leads and pipeline.

6. Content & Brand Voice

Translate complex AI, identity verification, and BFSI concepts into clear narratives for journalists and buyers, keeping all PR and email output consistent with HyperVerge's brand voice.

7. Performance Monitoring & AI Adoption

Report on both channels to leadership on a regular rhythm and actively use AI tools for media research, pitch drafting, email copy, and deliverability analysis.

8. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work with Product, Sales, BD, Growth, and Product Marketing to turn launches, proof points, and customer stories into press angles and email campaigns.

**Requirements**

Must Haves:

* An overall 2-3 years of experience, with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on PR experience (in-house or agency)
* A track record of securing earned media coverage: pitches that landed, bylines placed
* Strong writing and editing skills across press releases, bylines, pitches, and email copy
* Hands-on email marketing experience covering strategy, segmentation, copywriting, and performance tracking
* Working knowledge of email infrastructure and deliverability
* Experience operating at least one marketing automation or outreach platform
* Ability to analyse coverage and email performance data and make data-informed decisions
* Strong project management and self-organisation
* Comfort working cross-functionally
* Hands-on experience with AI tools

Good to Haves:

* Experience in BFSI, Fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology
* Experience managing a PR agency as a client or working inside one
* Familiarity with cold outbound infrastructure (multi-domain setups, inbox rotation, warm-up tooling)

title: Senior Manager - Demand Generation
description: Every era of enterprise technology has a short window when the defining companies are built and the defining careers are made. For AI in the enterprise, that window is open right now. The world's largest companies are deciding how AI agents will run their operations. Entire operating models will be redesigned around those decisions. And every one of them depends on a question most enterprises still can't answer: how does work actually happen today? Soroco was built to answer it. A deep tech company, built in Bangalore Founded by Rohan Murty, Soroco holds 600+ patents, a rare depth of IP for a software company. Our engineers and researchers have built technology that sees how work happens across people, systems, and AI agents inside the world's largest enterprises, and turns it into the work graph: a living map of how an enterprise actually runs. On the work graph, we have built two offerings: Scout turns that map into decisions. It shows leaders where effort and cost really go, recommends what to change, and tracks the value once changes land. Avali lets enterprises redesign and simulate workflows before changing anything in the real world. Some of the world's largest companies, including Bayer, PepsiCo, Unilever, BT Group, Accenture, and Cognizant, work with Soroco. We have been at the top of Everest Group's Digital Interaction Intelligence Products PEAK Matrix®, leading the category for five consecutive years. We work from Bangalore, London, and Boston. Why this role, why now Soroco has the technology, the patents and the customers. This role decides how fast the market finds out. You will own demand generation for Soroco worldwide, with the Americas and the UK as our primary markets. Every channel, every event and every account program is yours. So is the result they all serve: qualified opportunities for sales to pursue, from new enterprises and from the customers who already trust us. You choose the playbook. We judge it by the pipeline it builds. What you'll own Digital. SEO, discovery in AI answer engines, paid search, LinkedIn, email and website conversion. You decide where the money and effort go, and you show what each channel returns. Experiential events. Soroco Illuminate, our flagship event series, along with executive roundtables, city roadshows and the industry conferences where our buyers gather. You own the audience from first invitation to final follow-up. ABM. Target accounts across the Americas and the UK, mapped by function, initiative and buying group, with programs built to open each one. Hunting. New-logo pipeline from Global 2000 enterprises. You work with SDRs and AEs to turn engagement into qualified opportunities. Farming. Customer programs that grow accounts: executive briefings, advisory sessions, user communities, customer stories, and expansion campaigns that reach new business units and use cases. Partners. Joint programs with GSIs and consulting firms, with shared accounts and shared responsibility for bringing buyers in. Measurement. Funnel definitions, attribution and reporting agreed with sales, so every program is judged on the pipeline it creates. Budget and vendors. Agencies, event partners, venues and data providers. What you bring 8 to 12 years in B2B marketing, at least 5 of them in demand generation for enterprise software sold to Global 2000 companies in the US or UK Mastery of any one of the following disciplines, with results to show for each: digital demand generation, experiential events, and ABM Marketing-sourced pipeline you can quantify: targets, opportunities, pipeline value, cost per opportunity Customer programs that produced expansion pipeline Experience reaching operations, shared services, transformation or enterprise AI leaders at VP level and above First-principles thinking: you question assumptions, including your own, and reflect on what worked and why Bonus points You've built AI into your own demand engine: researching accounts, spotting buying signals, producing content or automating campaign operations. Tell us what you built and what it changed.Where and when you'll work You'll work from our Bangalore office and from home, in a hybrid model. Your hours are flexible, with regular overlap for US and UK calls and occasional travel for events. What you'll get Global ownership of demand generation, and the independence to build the engine your way Deep tech to market, with proof behind it: 600+ patents, customers like Bayer and BT Group, and five consecutive years as an Everest Group Leader A seat close to leadership while the category is being shaped SDRs, and in-house design, web and content support behind you How to apply Send your CV with one program you ran end to end: who it targeted, how you brought them in, what it cost, and the pipeline it produced. If you have wanted to own demand generation at a deep tech company while its category is being built, this is the role.

title: Performance Marketer & Funnel Builder
description: About usWe are an established Indian health and fitness coaching brand with an engaged community and social following. We are launching a premium (high-ticket) coaching programme sold through a 30-minute paid consultation call, with a limited member cap and enrolment in waves.Our VSL and ad scripts are written, our in-house video editor handles all shooting and editing, and our payment gateway is active. We now need one experienced freelancer to build the funnel, write the page and email copy, set up tracking, and run the launch and Meta ads from start to finish. When the project ends, you will hand it over so our team can run future waves.The funnelThis is a simple, fully automated funnel: no application form, no manual screening team and no manual call-backs.Meta ads + organic socials → opt-in page (name, email, phone) → VSL page (10–30 min video, programme price not shown) with a single "Book your call" button directly below the video → Razorpay payment for the consultation fee → calendar booking (30-min paid consultation, with intake questions that qualify the lead) → thank-you pageThe consultation call is paid. Only leads who complete the Razorpay payment can book a slot.Qualification happens through the booking page's intake questions, not a separate application form.Leads who opt in but don't book are nurtured by email until they book or the wave closes.Each wave has a fixed member cap. When it fills, booking closes and new leads go to the waitlist for the next wave.What you will do (in scope)1. Funnel and launch planMap the full funnel, the email tag logic (lead, junk, waitlist, paid, booked, no-show, enrolled) and the launch calendar.Plan the private beta for existing clients, a 7–10 day teaser campaign, the waitlist, and the wave schedule.2. title: Growth Hacker
description:
**Company Description**
SentLogic is an emerging technology company focused on building data-driven products and solutions that help organizations grow efficiently and intelligently. The team values experimentation, rapid iteration, and measurable impact in all initiatives. SentLogic promotes a culture of autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, encouraging team members to propose, test, and scale new ideas. The company embraces remote work and relies on modern tools and processes to support distributed, outcome-oriented teams.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for a Growth Hacker at SentLogic. The Growth Hacker will design and run experiments across acquisition, activation, retention, and referral channels to drive sustainable user and revenue growth. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying growth opportunities, developing and executing data-informed marketing strategies, analyzing web and product analytics, and optimizing funnels for conversion. The role involves close collaboration with product, marketing, and engineering teams to build and iterate on growth initiatives, landing pages, campaigns, and user journeys. The Growth Hacker will track key performance metrics, generate insights, and present clear recommendations to stakeholders.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated skills in Growth Hacking and Conversion Optimization to design, test, and scale growth experiments.
* Proficiency with Web Analytics tools to measure performance, understand user behavior, and inform decision-making.
* Experience in Marketing and Marketing Strategy to plan and execute multi-channel growth campaigns.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and hypothesis-driven testing mindset.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Comfort with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and basic statistical concepts.
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels such as SEO, paid media, email, and social media is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Data Analytics) or equivalent practical experience.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About the Role**

The HR Manager will report directly to the CEO and will be responsible for leading the HR function for Iron Asylum. This role will involve building consistent people practices, managing the employee lifecycle, and ensuring recruitment, onboarding, attendance, payroll coordination, and employee relations are handled with clear ownership, documented records, and timely follow-up.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Workforce planning and recruitment: Work with department heads to identify staffing needs, prepare role profiles and hiring plans, manage sourcing and interviews, and secure approvals for selection and offers. Track hiring progress and joining readiness.
* Onboarding and employee lifecycle: Own joining documentation, company and brand orientation, policy explanation, department training coordination, and probation reviews. Maintain the HR lifecycle tracker with milestone owners, dates, subtask status, evidence, and pending support.
* Policies and company culture: Develop and maintain policies for management approval. Explain attendance, leave, WFH, payroll, travel, reimbursement, conduct, and confidentiality requirements. Obtain employee acknowledgements and promote accountability, respectful behaviour, and collaboration.
* Attendance and payroll coordination: Own attendance and leave accuracy, approval follow-ups, and payroll input closure. Coordinate with Finance on payroll processing, employee changes, reimbursements, and queries; verify inputs and resolve discrepancies before the agreed cut-off.
* Employee relations and performance: Handle employee concerns fairly and confidentially, guide managers on documented feedback and review practices, and coordinate performance reviews, development plans, and retention actions. Escalate matters requiring management decisions.
* Training and manager support: Identify training needs with department heads, organize induction and role-specific training, and maintain completion records. Support managers in communicating responsibilities, work instructions, and performance expectations.
* Confidential records and folder governance: Finalize the HR folder structure and data migration. Maintain payroll and employee documents in restricted folders, with shortcuts in the main HR folder and approval-based access requests. Keep records current and manage access with authorized owners.
* Assets, handover, and exits: Coordinate asset issue and return with Admin/IT and relevant owners. Ensure asset-register entries and signed handover records are complete. Manage exit documentation, knowledge transfer, clearance, and final-settlement inputs with Finance.
* Compliance and management reporting: Coordinate applicable employment and payroll compliance with Finance and qualified advisers. Maintain relevant records, monitor pending actions, and submit concise HR updates, risks, escalations, and support requirements to management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of HR experience, including independent ownership of HR operations and coordination with leadership and department heads.
* Hands-on experience in recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, attendance, payroll coordination, performance reviews, and policy implementation.
* Experience in a growing consumer-brand, distribution, retail, e-commerce, or similar business is preferred.
* Working knowledge of relevant employment and payroll requirements, with the ability to coordinate specialist support when needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and practical problem-solving.
* Sound judgement, discretion, and consistent handling of confidential employee information.
* Ability to establish clear processes, maintain accurate records, and close actions on time.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and HR systems; ability to manage trackers, reports, and folder permissions.
* Ability to handle sensitive conversations, support managers, and encourage an owner-driven working culture.

**Location & Work Mode**

The role is based in Bangalore and is an onsite position.

title: Global Process Owner - Organisation Design
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Team**
People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.
  
  
We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.
  
  
Our Global Process Owners (GPOs) in our Global Process Solutions team are critical to helping us deliver this ambition; ensuring business need is translated into clear, standardised and scalable process solutions, enabling consistent ways of working and driving improved service outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
As
**GPO for Organisation Design**
, you will be responsible for partnering closely with the Organisational Effectiveness team and Tech colleagues to design, govern and continuously improve how we manage our organisational blueprint (including supervisory structures, position management, cost centre alignment, business entity management) across the globe, and ensure we have clearly governed, and robust solutions for effectively managing HR colleague access to employee data.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end global organisational blueprint process framework, driving standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across all markets.
* Define, maintain and optimise organisational change processes, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, compliant and aligned with Haleon’s operating model.
* Act as subject matter expert for supervisory organisation, position management, cost centre alignment, business entity management and HR security and access management processes, providing guidance and decision-making support to Organisational Effectiveness, People Solutions, HR teams, Digital & Technology teams and business stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Organisational Effectiveness, People Solutions, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Digital & Technology teams to drive process simplification, automation and service excellence.
* Establish and maintain global process standards, controls, policies, Knowledge contents and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring consistency while balancing local regulatory and legislative requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging process analytics, automation opportunities and industry best practices to improve employee experience, organisational blueprint integrity and operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with legislation, labour laws, local regulations, statutory obligations and Haleon policies across all relevant jurisdictions.
* Partner with the Quality & Effectiveness team to define and monitor key process performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality metrics and payroll accuracy measures, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead process governance forums and stakeholder engagement activities, ensuring alignment of process priorities, change initiatives and business requirements.
* Partner with Digital & Technology teams to help shape the organisation design and systems roadmap.
* Provide process leadership for technology enhancements, integrations and digital transformation initiatives.
* Ensure robust governance and integrity of organisational structure data across HR, payroll, finance and workforce management platforms.
* Support acquisitions, divestitures, organisational redesigns and transformation programs impacting organisational blueprint processes.
* Collaborate with vendors, consultants and implementation partners to evaluate and adopt best-in-class solutions and practices.

**About You**
**Technical and functional expertise:**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in organisation design/effectiveness, HR Operations, Shared Services, Process Ownership or related disciplines.
* Strong expertise in global organisation design operations, workforce management processes and security and access controls.
* Experience operating within complex global organisations, ideally using multiple vendors and service delivery models.
* Proven experience leading global process ownership, governance and standardisation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Workday and organisation design-related integrations, with the ability to assess process, data and system impacts.
* Experience working with global design systems such as OrgVue.
* Demonstrable experience leveraging data analytics and process insights to drive business performance improvements.
* Knowledge of automation, digital transformation and emerging technologies impacting HR Operations and Shared Services.
* Certification in process improvement methodology (e.g. Lean Six Sigma) is advantageous.

**Leadership and behavioural capabilities:**

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate competing priorities effectively.
* Curious, proactive and solutions-focused, with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Resilient and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and changing business needs.
* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for delivering results.
* Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail with a focus on compliance, governance and operational excellence.
* Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-29
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Technical Support Analyst
description:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome.

. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.
  
  
You'll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what's possible.
