* Analyze and interpret data to identify issues and trends, and offer creative, practical solutions
* Monitor, progress and resolve incidents in ServiceNow, keeping customers satisfied through proactive updates, frequent contact and escalation where necessary
* Communicate directly with customers, many of them healthcare organizations in Canada
* Learn and pick up tickets across all four functional modules of the product, rather than specializing in just one
* Build and maintain strong technical expertise on all Tecsys products and the devices and platforms they run on
* Follow incident and problem management procedures and coordinate with the Customer Care team in Canada, including occasional off-hours meetings

* Knowledge of / prior experience with any WMS (Warehouse Management System), ideally 2-3 years working on a WMS module
* 2+ years of experience in technical support, desktop support or a similar role
* Strong written and verbal English communication, including clear, professional email correspondence with clients, suppliers, business partners and colleagues
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow for incident management, request fulfillment and problem management
* Ability to learn new technology easily and explain it to others
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment, and enjoying solving problems as a team
* Flexibility to work in shifts, including weekend rosters, and for occasional off-hours meetings

**Nice to have:**

* University or technical degree related to information systems or supply chain
* Understanding of supply chain concepts in health care or complex distribution
* Knowledge of accounting or finance as it relates to ERP software (Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Ledgers, etc.)
* Working knowledge of UNIX/LINUX and Windows
* Firm grasp of SQL along with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL

**Benefits**

* Benefits (Insurance and access to learning platform) and vacation from day one
* Regular Employee Engagement initiatives
* Room to learn, stretch and take on new challenges
* Collaboration with global teams and our customers
* We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.

If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk
  
  
Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!

title: Senior Associate - Deals - Deal Analytics & Value Creation
description:
**Job Summary**
PwC's Working Capital team, part of the Deals Strategy & Value Creation practice, helps private equity and corporate clients release cash and improve liquidity by optimizing receivables, payables and inventory. We support clients across the deal lifecycle, from diligence through post-close transformation, using data-driven diagnostics built on large volumes of transaction-level client data.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Associate to drive working capital diagnostics from the Acceleration Center, working closely with US engagement teams. You will own analysis workstreams across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Inventory, turning large volumes of transaction-level client data into reconciled datasets, quantified cash opportunities and clear, client-ready insights. The role requires strong working capital and financial understanding, hands-on data skills and the ability to guide associates while delivering high-quality work at deal speed.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Senior Associate, you will drive day-to-day working capital analysis and deliverables, working with US engagement teams and guiding associates. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Own working capital analysis workstreams on diligence, value creation and operational improvement engagements, from data intake to client-ready outputs.
* Lead data requests and data validation with client and engagement teams, mapping ERP extracts and data room files to standard information request lists and assessing data completeness.
* Build and maintain Alteryx workflows to cleanse, transform and reconcile transaction-level AR, AP and inventory data, tying outputs back to client financials (trial balance, aging reports and ledgers).
* Calculate and analyze key working capital metrics such as DSO, DPO, DIO, the cash conversion cycle, and weighted average terms and days to pay or collect.
* Size cash release opportunities across levers such as customer and supplier payment terms (harmonization and extension), collections and past-due performance, payment timing and payment runs, and inventory levels, safety stock, and slow-moving and obsolete stock.
* Develop Power BI dashboards and Excel models, including scenario analysis, that present findings clearly to US engagement leaders and clients.
* Translate analysis into insights and recommendations, and prepare client-ready deliverables and presentation materials.
* Review the work of associates for accuracy, quality and consistency, and coach them on working capital concepts, analytical approaches and tools.
* Contribute to accelerators, standard workflows, methodologies and AI-enabled tools that improve the speed and quality of working capital analysis.
* Support business development activities, including proposals, pitch materials and practice enablement initiatives.

PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level also include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Use feedback and reflection to develop self-awareness and personal strengths, and address development areas.
* Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results.
* Demonstrate critical thinking and the ability to bring order to unstructured problems.
* Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance.
* Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others.
* Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.

**Preferred Fields Of Study/Experience**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Economics, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related field. An MBA or professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CMA) are a plus.
  
  
A total of 4–7 years of experience in Big 4 or management consulting, transaction services/deal advisory, analytics consulting, performance improvement, FP&A or operational finance, including hands-on experience in working capital analysis.
  
  
**Preferred Knowledge/Skills**
Working Capital
  
  

* Hands-on experience analyzing transaction-level working capital data (for example, AR open items and invoice/payment history, AP invoice and payment data with supplier terms, and inventory/SKU-level data). This should go beyond high-level KPI or peer benchmarking analysis.
* Good understanding of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Inventory (Forecast-to-Fulfill) processes and the operational drivers of working capital.
* Experience calculating working capital metrics and sizing cash release opportunities across payment terms, collections, payment practices and inventory.
* Understanding of financial statements and of working capital in a deals context (for example, normalized working capital and working capital as a value creation lever for private equity portfolio companies).
* Exposure to 13-week cash flow forecasting, scenario analysis or liquidity planning is a plus.

Client and Team Skills
  
  

* Experience working effectively with US-based engagement teams and stakeholders, and managing day-to-day deliverables.
* Ability to synthesize analysis into clear insights and present them in a concise, structured way.
* Experience guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under time-sensitive client deadlines.

Technical
  
  

* Proven track record of transforming large, raw client datasets (ERP extracts, data room files) into clean, reconciled datasets, models and dashboards at deal speed.
* Proven skills in Alteryx, Advanced Excel and Power BI (including visualization and DAX); SQL/Python is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP and financial systems (for example, SAP, Oracle) and their AR, AP and inventory data structures.
* Strong financial modeling, analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data quality.
* Experience using GenAI or building AI-based tools for analysis or process optimization is a plus.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Material Depot is looking for a highly customer-oriented, proactive and ownership-driven person to own the end-to-end customer experience, retention and relationship management.

Buying materials for a home is a high-involvement purchase. Customers interact with multiple advisors, visit our experience centres, place orders across categories and depend on us for timely deliveries and resolution of issues. We want every customer to feel that someone at Material Depot genuinely cares about their home and is looking out for their interests.

You will own the relationship beyond the point of sale. The goal is not just to resolve customer complaints, but to build trust, anticipate problems, make the experience effortless and turn customers into repeat buyers and advocates for Material Depot.

What you'll own:

1. Own the customer relationship: Take responsibility for the overall customer experience from order placement through delivery and post-purchase. Ensure customers always have clarity on what is happening and who is accountable.

2. Build lasting relationships: Proactively engage with customers, understand their requirements and create meaningful touchpoints beyond transactional interactions. Build relationships that translate into repeat purchases and referrals.

3. Resolve customer issues: Take complete ownership of complaints involving delayed deliveries, damaged material, shortages, quality concerns, wrong products and service failures. Coordinate with internal teams until the issue is actually resolved.

4. Anticipate problems: Identify potential customer dissatisfaction before it becomes a complaint. Track delayed orders, unresolved issues and service gaps, and proactively communicate with customers.

5. Drive retention and repeat business: Identify opportunities to re-engage existing customers, understand their upcoming requirements and encourage them to return to Material Depot for future purchases.

6. Build a customer feedback loop: Capture customer feedback, identify recurring problems and work with Retail, Sales, Logistics, Category and Product teams to fix root causes rather than repeatedly addressing symptoms.

7. Own customer satisfaction metrics: Track customer satisfaction, resolution times, repeat purchase rates, referrals, complaint rates and other measures of customer experience. Be accountable for improving them.

8. Improve processes: Continuously identify ways to make the customer journey simpler, more transparent and more reliable. Build processes and systems that allow us to deliver a consistently great experience as we scale.

9. Be the customer's internal champion: Represent the customer's interests within the organisation and ensure that important customer issues don't get lost between departments.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about customers, has exceptional communication and problem-solving skills, and takes personal responsibility for making things right. Someone who doesn't consider a problem closed just because they have passed it on to another team.

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
PropTiger.com, owned by Aurum PropTech, is India’s leading tech-driven real estate advisory and transaction platform focused on simplifying and enhancing the homebuying experience. The company leverages advanced PropTech solutions, automation, and data insights to deliver transparency, efficiency, and confidence at every stage of the home purchase journey. With a strong nationwide presence and a team of 300+ relationship managers, PropTiger.com has supported over 18,000 homebuyers in purchasing properties worth more than US $1.5 billion. Its platform connects buyers, developers, and financial institutions to create a seamless, informed, and rewarding property search and transaction process. Supported by Aurum PropTech’s innovation ecosystem, PropTiger.com continues to drive digital transformation in India’s real estate sector with customer-centric, future-ready solutions.

**Role Description**
The Senior Relationship Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. This role involves managing end-to-end relationships with homebuyers, from understanding requirements and recommending suitable projects to coordinating site visits and guiding clients through negotiations, documentation, and closure. The Senior Relationship Manager will collaborate closely with developers and financial institutions to ensure competitive offerings, smooth loan processing, and timely completion of transactions. Responsibilities include maintaining a high-quality sales pipeline, meeting revenue and conversion targets, providing market insights, and ensuring a superior customer experience. The role also requires accurate reporting, CRM updates, and adherence to organizational processes and compliance standards.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in client relationship management, account handling, and consultative sales in real estate or related industries.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to build trust, influence decisions, and manage multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to understand property markets, evaluate project offerings, and provide data-driven recommendations to homebuyers.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, digital platforms, and basic data analysis to track leads, monitor performance, and improve outcomes.
* Proven ability to work toward sales targets, manage pipelines, and deliver high-quality customer service in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in residential real estate advisory, banking (home loans), or financial services sales is highly beneficial.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings and site visits, and to work flexible hours based on customer requirements.

title: SAP Fieldgasss - Manager

**SAP Fieldglass Manager**

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

* Proven experience leading at least 3-5 end-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementations.

**Position Overview**
The Customer Excellence Manager (CEM) is responsible for helping strategic customers achieve measurable business and engineering outcomes through successful adoption of our simulation and engineering software solutions.
  
  
The CEM serves as the trusted advisor and primary post-sales relationship owner, developing customer success plans, driving adoption initiatives, monitoring customer health and sentiment, and ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong CAE and engineering software knowledge with customer engagement, strategic account management, stakeholder alignment, and business acumen. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, and Marketing teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while supporting retention and long-term account growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Success & Value Realization: Own customer success outcomes by driving product adoption, value realization, and achievement of customer business and engineering objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Strategic Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with technical, management, and executive stakeholders, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate for customer success.
* Customer Health & Retention: Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and sentiment to proactively identify risks, develop recovery plans, and support long-term customer retention.
* Account Planning & Growth: Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to contribute customer insights, support account planning activities, and identify opportunities for product adoption, expansion, and growth.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate activities across Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Voice of the Customer: Represent customer needs and feedback within the organization, helping influence product priorities, adoption strategies, and customer experience improvements.
* Executive Business Reviews & Governance: Lead customer governance discussions and business reviews that demonstrate value, align stakeholders, identify opportunities, and strengthen strategic relationships.
* Customer Advocacy: Develop customer champions and advocates who can participate in reference programs, industry events, case studies, and other strategic engagement initiatives.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Business Development, Application Engineering, Technical Consulting, Pre-Sales, or Account Management within engineering software, CAE, simulation, PLM, CAD, or related technology industries.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and driving long-term adoption programs.
* Experience conducting customer reviews, executive engagements, and technical discussions with multiple stakeholder levels.
* Proven history of supporting customer retention, adoption growth, and business expansion initiatives.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong customer-centric mindset.
* Strategic account planning and stakeholder management.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance customer engagement, adoption, reporting, and productivity.
* Executive communication and presentation skills.
* Customer health and sentiment management.
* Value realization and adoption planning.
* Cross-functional leadership and influence without authority.
* Analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong business and commercial acumen.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Tools & Platforms
  
  

* CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight.
* Bring AI expertise
* Customer adoption and engagement analytics tools.
* Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Customer Outcomes: Achievement of customer success plan objectives; customer adoption and utilization growth; successful onboarding and adoption milestones.
* Customer Health: Customer health score improvements; customer sentiment and relationship strength; risk identification and mitigation effectiveness.
* Retention & Growth: Customer retention rate; contribution to Net Revenue Retention (NRR); expansion opportunities identified and supported; renewal readiness and account stability.
* Customer Advocacy: Customer references and success stories generated; product feedback submitted and acted upon; participation in advocacy and community initiatives.
* Operational & Reporting: Accurate customer planning, reporting, and cross-functional execution.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
**A successful candidate will be a technically credible CAE professional who can build trusted relationships, drive customer adoption, influence cross-functional teams, manage customer sentiment, contribute to account planning, and identify business growth opportunities while ensuring customers achieve measurable engineering and business outcomes.**
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
We’re looking for someone who can walk into a boardroom with a CIO, CFO, or CHRO and be treated as a peer — not a vendor. This person owns post-sales outcomes across the full customer lifecycle — implementation, adoption, and value realization — in ServiceNow’s large enterprise accounts in India, building the trusted relationships and business fluency that connect the customer’s ambition to what ServiceNow can deliver. Success here isn’t measured by activity — it’s whether your accounts renew, expand, and see real value from the platform.
  
  
This is a foundational role with real room to grow — you’ll be building the account ownership and executive presence the next level of this career path demands.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Develop and nurture executive relationships (CIO, CFO, CHRO, business unit leaders), building the kind of trust senior stakeholders extend over time
* Own the customer’s post-sales journey end to end — implementation, adoption, and value realization — and are accountable for the KPIs that matter: technical health, renewal, satisfaction, and expansion

* Support and help coordinate co-delivery models across ServiceNow, GSIs, and SI partners so delivery feels seamless to the customer

* Contribute to implementation and readiness strategies that help shorten time-to-value

* Champion ServiceNow’s best practices and stay current on how AI and agentic capabilities are changing customer operating models
* Deliver strong, durable customer satisfaction that shows up in renewals and expansion

**Qualifications**

* Experience at large India enterprise accounts, with solid judgment navigating multiple stakeholders
* Strong command over knowledge of digital transformation — design, implementation, and management
* Emerging expertise in one industry
* IT, HR, or GBS transformation exposure
* Experience partnering with Big 4 or large SI’s in a delivery context
* 2–5 years of experience on large, multi-tracked programs, ideally including organizational change management

title: Marketing Manager (AI-First)
description:
Marketing Manager (AI-First) – JuTech
  

* **Location:**
  Remote (India) — overlapping significantly with Singapore Standard Time (SGT)
* **Compensation:**
  ₹30,000 / month
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time (or as applicable)

About JuTech

JuTech is a Singapore-based software company building and delivering
**AI callbots and chatbots**
,
**outsourced developers starting at $998/month**
, and
**custom software solutions**
.

We operate as a lean, high-leverage team. Much of our growth engine is automated—built and run using
**Claude**
,
**Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors**
, and
**Claude skills**
so a single marketer can execute the output of a small growth team with precision and speed.

The Role

You will own JuTech’s end-to-end lead generation engine: outbound prospecting, inbound content and paid acquisition, and automated sales follow-ups that convert interest into booked calls.

Rather than doing repetitive manual tasks by hand, you will design, connect, and run repeatable AI-assisted workflows using Claude, MCP connectors, and custom skills—while maintaining strong human judgment over quality, accuracy, and platform compliance.

What You Will Own1. Outbound Marketing (Proactive Prospecting)

* **LinkedIn Outreach Automation:**
  Keep active campaigns topped up with fresh, qualified leads daily.
* **High-Volume Cold Email:**
  Run outbound email campaigns supported by clean lead lists and healthy sending domains/inboxes.
* **Cold Calling Support:**
  Prepare lead lists, call scripts, and Do Not Call (DNC) checks for human callers and for JuTech’s AI voice agent once live.
* **WhatsApp & Multi-Platform Social Listening:**
  Execute WhatsApp outreach and monitor conversations across Reddit, Facebook, X, and Threads.
* **New Company Outreach:**
  Identify and reach out to newly registered companies matching JuTech’s ideal customer profile.

2. Inbound Marketing (Demand Capture & Content)

* **Monthly Social Content Plan:**
  Plan, create, and schedule roughly
  **24 posts, stories, and reels per month**
  across LinkedIn and Instagram.
* **Short-Form Video (Reels):**
  Produce reels covering AI news, product demos, and motivational/founder-led angles.
* **Paid Acquisition:**
  Launch and manage Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads promoting JuTech’s AI solutions, outsourced developers ($998/month), and custom software.
* **SEO, AEO & GEO:**
  Improve visibility and recommendations across traditional search (Google) as well as AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity).
* **Newsletter:**
  Restart and run the weekly newsletter when reactivated.

3. Sales Support & Follow-Ups

* **Warm-Lead Pipeline Management:**
  Track and work the warm-lead list in JuTech’s internal dashboard (replies showing interest, ad form submissions, and site visitors).
* **Automated Multi-Cadence Follow-Ups:**
  Run automated weekly, monthly, and quarterly follow-ups via WhatsApp and email.
* **Identified Visitor Outreach:**
  Trigger timely LinkedIn follow-ups for identified website visitors.
* **Additional Lead Channels:**
  Monitor freelance marketplace profiles and government tender alerts for relevant opportunities.

Core Requirement: Hands-On Claude, MCP & Skills

This is the centerpiece of the role—not a nice-to-have. During the interview process, you will demonstrate real work built with Claude.

* **Daily Claude Usage:**
  You use Claude (Claude.ai, Claude Code, or Cowork) daily for real operational work—not just drafting captions.
* **MCP Connectors:**
  You understand MCP connectors and have connected Claude to tools (such as email, spreadsheets, project boards, or a CRM) to read and act on real data.
* **Claude Skills:**
  You understand Claude skills and can write or adapt them so recurring workflows (such as a LinkedIn post format or cold email structure) produce consistent output every time.
* **Automation Mindset:**
  When you spot a repeated task, your first instinct is to see how Claude, an MCP connector, or a skill can automate or streamline it—and then build it.
* **Editorial & Technical Judgment:**
  You review Claude’s outputs before anything goes live and know where AI models are prone to hallucination, drift, or error.

Beyond the Brief (Ownership & Initiative)

The responsibilities above are your starting baseline. We look for someone who spots gaps and fixes them proactively—for example:

* Catching a drop in cold email reply rates, diagnosing which subject lines or lead segments caused it, and fixing them before being asked.
* Building a Claude skill that repurposes one blog post into a LinkedIn post, an Instagram carousel, a reel script, and a newsletter block.
* Connecting Claude to our project board via MCP to send a Monday digest of what moved, what is blocked, and what is due.
* Testing a new channel on a small budget (such as Reddit ads or a LinkedIn newsletter) and reporting back with clear metrics.
* Publishing a concise one-page case study after a project goes live without waiting for a request.
* Spotting a better or more cost-effective tool than an existing one, quantifying the savings, and planning the migration.
* Running a weekly check on how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity describe JuTech and taking action based on what surfaces.
* Turning a question from a sales call into an FAQ page, a social post, and an ad angle within the same week.

Requirements
  
Must-Have Qualifications

* **2+ years**
  of experience in B2B digital marketing or lead generation (ideally at a software or tech services company).
* Hands-on experience with
  **LinkedIn outreach automation**
  ,
  **cold email platforms**
  ,
  **Meta Ads**
  , and
  **LinkedIn Ads**
  .
* **SEO fundamentals:**
  Able to explain backlinks, how to earn quality backlinks, how to spot spammy links, and how on-page SEO works.
* **Social media execution:**
  Able to write, design, and schedule LinkedIn and Instagram content aligned with brand style, and choose the right format (carousel, reel, or story).
* **Multi-account safety:**
  Able to operate multiple Reddit, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp accounts safely within platform rules (isolated profiles, account warm-up, Reddit karma building, and subreddit rule compliance).
* **Platform rate limits:**
  Knowledge of daily limits for LinkedIn connection requests/messages, cold email volume per inbox and domain, WhatsApp messaging, and Reddit posting to avoid restrictions or bans.
* **Strong written English:**
  Crisp, clear, confident copywriting.
* **Design & video basics:**
  Working proficiency in
  **Canva or Figma**
  and
  **CapCut or Premiere**
  .
* **Data & reporting:**
  Comfortable working in spreadsheets, tracking core numbers, and delivering weekly reports.
* **Schedule alignment:**
  Available for most of the
  **Singapore working day (SGT)**
  .

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience with the
  **WhatsApp Business API**
  or
  **AI voice agents**
  .
* Familiarity with SEO tooling such as
  **Google Search Console**
  .
* Comfort with
  **webhooks**
  , workflow automation tools, or reading basic API documentation.
* Experience marketing to
  **Singapore**
  or other offshore markets.

First 90 Days Roadmap

* **Days 1–30:**
  Learn JuTech’s stack and internal dashboard, take ownership of the monthly content plan, and maintain target volume on LinkedIn and cold email outreach.
* **Days 31–60:**
  Launch the initial Meta and LinkedIn ad campaigns, set up automated email follow-up sequences, and ship at least one Claude skill used weekly by the team.
* **Days 61–90:**
  Bring automated weekly, monthly, and quarterly follow-ups live, publish initial SEO/AEO pages, and deliver a monthly report covering leads, cost per lead (CPL), and calls booked.

How to Apply

To apply, send all three of the following:

1. **Your CV or LinkedIn profile.**
2. **One example of something you automated or built using Claude, MCP, or a skill**
   (include a screen recording, screenshots, or a concise write-up).
3. **A short response:**
   How would you fill JuTech’s pipeline with
   **20 qualified leads per month**
   ?

**Assessment Note:**
Shortlisted candidates will complete a
**paid test task**
using Claude:
**one LinkedIn post**
,
**one cold email**
, and
**one ad concept**
for JuTech’s
**$998/month developer**
offering.

title: Social Media Content Executive
description:
**A LITTLE ABOUT THE QUAD**

The Quad is a fitness coaching company with strength training at its core, because strength is essential for all. Period.

You need strength to go about your day without aches and niggles. That compounds into living your life without worrying about how your body might react. One of our students summited Mt. Kilimanjaro simply because she wanted to! Your life really expands when you're stronger.

And no, it's not an all-boys club. Strength is especially important for women, and nearly 50% of the people training with us are women. If you've been to any gym, you'll know why that number is mind-blowing.

We've been around for 15 years. Today we're a team of 60+ incredibly smart and talented people, and we train folks aged 35 to 80, all with one aim: getting stronger.

**THE ROLE: SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT EXECUTIVE**

Social media is one of our most important marketing tools. It's where a lot of people discover us, learn about us, and decide to join. It's where we show who we are, who we're not, and the impact we're driving. You'll be part of the team that brings all of that to life.

Check out our Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thequad.in/

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

1. Ideas, scripts, and storyboards: You'll work with the Social Media Manager and bring your own ideas and research to the table.
2. Information gathering: We can't create content in a silo. We need input from the wider team, and you'll be the one driving that.
3. Shoot coordination: You'll line up people, locations, and timings so shoots run on schedule.
4. Shoots: You'll support the Social Media Manager on set: setting up, filming, and making sure we get the footage the edit needs.
5. Edit and design: I saved the best for last. You'll own the edit and design of every piece of content that goes out.

* Editing: which clips to pick, how to cut for hook rate and retention, which edit style fits, and which audio to use (what's trending and what suits the post). Basically, everything that turns the work into a finished piece.
* Design: carousels, static posts, stories, and more. You should know how to lay out a post so people stop on it, read it, and interact with it.

Steps 1 to 4 give you the context for what you're editing and why, so that when you sit down at the edit table, you already know what you're going to do. Editing and design WILL be a big part of this role.

As you grow, the role will expand to include more of what drives our social media.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

What we care about least: years of experience. What matters is that you can show skill and the drive to create impact through content. That, and a few more things :)

* Strong communication skills
* Solid writing skills
* A portfolio of short-form videos you've edited and designs you've made, whether for a brand, a client, a college project, or your own page
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Canva
* Comfort with quicker tools like Edits or InShot when you need a fast turnaround
* A good sense of pacing, hooks, sound, and on-screen text, and an eye for what makes someone stop scrolling
* Comfort framing and shooting content on a phone
* Reliability with deadlines and follow-ups, because other people's work depends on yours

**WHY THIS MATTERS**

If you've looked at our Instagram, you'll have noticed we don't post just for the sake of posting. We make content that resonates: content that educates, makes people laugh, or makes them feel empowered or simply seen. Content that ultimately pushes people to make a change in their lives. A healthy one!

If you'd like to be part of the team that makes this happen, I'd love to hear from you. Send us your CV and portfolio link, and we'll talk :)

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Brand Manager – Elite Global School**

**Location:**
Chennai (Villivakkam & Kosapur campuses)

**Experience:**
5–7 years in brand / marketing, with school experience mandatory

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, on-site

**About Us**

**Elite Global School is a growing K-12 school in Chennai, with campuses at Villivakkam and Kosapur. We focus on academic excellence, all-round development and a safe, caring learning environment. As we grow, we want a Brand Manager to build one strong, trusted Elite Global School brand across both campuses. The goal is more parents choosing us, and more parents staying with us.**

**Role Overview**

**You will own the school's brand, reputation and admissions marketing from start to finish. This means planning the annual brand and admissions calendar, running campaigns and events, managing social media and agencies, and working closely with the admissions team. Every campaign should turn into enquiries, campus visits and confirmed admissions. This role is for someone who has already marketed a school and knows how parents decide.**

**Key Responsibilities**

*1. Brand Strategy & Identity*

* Build and own the brand positioning, key messages and what makes us different for both campuses
* Create and enforce brand guidelines: logo use, colours, fonts, tone, uniform and signage standards
* Make sure every touchpoint looks and sounds like one school: campus branding, buses, stationery, website, social media, circulars and events
* Study competitor schools in the catchment area on fees, results, facilities and campaigns, and act on what you learn

*2. Admissions Marketing*

* Plan and run the annual admissions campaign, from pre-launch through peak season to closure
* Generate enquiries through digital ads, Google and Meta campaigns, local activations, hoardings, newspaper ads and referral programmes
* Work with the admissions team on lead follow-up, campus tours, open houses and counselling sessions
* Track the full funnel daily: enquiry → campus visit → application → admission
* Run community outreach through preschool and play-school tie-ups, residential associations, corporate tie-ups and local events

*3. Digital & Social Media*

* Manage the school's Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and Google Business Profile
* Plan a monthly content calendar covering academics, achievements, events, teacher stories, parent testimonials and campus life
* Keep the website updated with admissions pages, news, results and galleries, with search optimisation for local school searches
* Build and protect the online reputation: Google reviews, ratings and replies to parent feedback
* Get written parental consent before using any student's photo or video, and handle student data in line with the DPDP Act, 2023

*4. Events, PR & Parent Engagement*

* Plan and run flagship events: Annual Day, Sports Day, Science / Art Exhibitions, Graduation Day, Open House and festival celebrations
* Get media coverage for student and school achievements through local press and education publications
* Run parent engagement through newsletters, parent ambassador programmes and alumni connect
* Support student retention with communication that keeps current parents proud and engaged

*5. Agency, Vendor & Budget Management*

* Manage creative, digital, printing, photography / videography and event vendors
* Prepare and control the annual marketing budget; track spend and cost per enquiry and per admission
* Review all creatives for quality, accuracy and brand fit before release

*6. Reporting*

* **Weekly:**
  enquiries, campus visits, applications and admissions by campus and grade, plus campaign performance
* **Monthly:**
  report to the Correspondent covering funnel conversion, cost per enquiry and admission, social media growth, review rating, events held and budget vs actual
* **Admission season close:**
  full campaign review, covering what worked, what didn't, and the plan for next year

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Number of qualified enquiries and the enquiry-to-admission conversion rate
* Seat fill rate by campus and grade against target
* Cost per enquiry and cost per admission
* Student retention / re-enrolment rate
* Google rating and review count
* Social media reach, engagement and follower growth
* Event execution on time and within budget

**Requirements – Must Have**

* **Must have previously handled brand / marketing for a K-12 school, school chain or education group. This is mandatory. Candidates without school experience will not be considered.**
* **At least 3 of your 5–7 years of brand / marketing experience should be in the school sector**
* **A proven track record of running admission campaigns and showing results in enquiries and admissions**
* **A strong understanding of how parents decide and how the school admissions cycle works**
* **Hands-on experience with social media, Meta / Google ads, the website and Google Business Profile**
* **Experience running large school events and managing agencies and vendors**
* **Excellent communication in English and Tamil, both spoken and written**
* **Graduate or postgraduate in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration or a related field (MBA in Marketing preferred)**

**Preferred**

* Experience with a CBSE / ICSE / international school, or a multi-campus school group
* Familiarity with CRM or lead-management tools for admissions
* Basic design and video skills (Canva, CapCut or similar) for quick turnarounds
* Existing network with local media, preschools and community groups in North / West Chennai

**What We Offer**

* Full ownership of the brand for a growing multi-campus school
* Direct access to school leadership, so decisions happen quickly
* The chance to build the brand and admissions engine from the ground up
* Competitive salary, based on experience

**How to Apply**

**Send your CV, along with a portfolio of school campaigns you have handled (creatives, social pages, admission results), to [email ID]**
.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Brand Manager**

Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited · Chennai · On-site · Full-time · 4–7 years (FMCG / Food)

**About Us**

Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited is a Chennai-based FMCG company that makes food ingredients across three manufacturing units, with high standards of quality and food safety. We have an established presence in South India across retail stores and online platforms. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.

**The Role**

You will be the owner of our brands, accountable for how they grow, how they are seen, and how much they earn. You will define where each brand plays and how it wins: positioning, product portfolio, pricing, packaging, launches and communication across offline and online channels. You will turn consumer and market insight into plans that drive sales and market share, and measure every rupee spent. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager, Sales, R&D/NPD, Finance, Operations and our creative team and agencies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Define and maintain a clear positioning, brand promise, target consumer and personality for each brand and product range.
* Build the annual brand plan for each brand: objectives, volume and value targets, growth drivers, activities, calendar and budget.
* Maintain brand guidelines (logo, colours, tone, packaging rules) and make sure every touchpoint follows them.
* Track brand health (awareness, trial, repeat, preference) and adjust the strategy based on results.

**2. Consumer & Market Insight**

* Run consumer research: home visits, store visits, surveys, focus groups and taste tests, to understand how people buy and use our products.
* Track market size, category trends, competitor products, pricing, promotions and launches across South India.
* Use sales, distribution, e-commerce and retail data to find growth opportunities and gaps.
* Turn insights into clear actions for product, pack, price, promotion and communication.

**3. Portfolio, Pricing & Profitability**

* Own the brand portfolio: which SKUs, pack sizes and price points we sell in each channel and region.
* With Finance and Sales, recommend pricing, MRP and trade margins that protect profitability while staying competitive.
* Track brand-wise sales, contribution margin and A&P (advertising and promotion) spend against plan every month.
* Review slow-moving SKUs and recommend improvements or delisting.

**4. New Product Development & Launches**

* Identify new product, flavour, pack-size and format opportunities from consumer and market insight.
* Write the product brief with R&D/NPD: target consumer, benefit, taste profile, price point and cost target.
* Lead product and concept testing before launch.
* Plan and run the full launch: name, packaging, claims, pricing, launch kit, trade scheme, communication and launch calendar, with Sales and Operations.
* Make sure packaging, labels and claims follow FSSAI labelling rules, Legal Metrology requirements and the ASCI advertising code.
* Run post-launch reviews at 30, 60 and 90 days and act on the results.

**5. Packaging & Brand Identity**

* Brief and approve packaging design with the graphic designer and agencies so that packs stand out on shelf and online.
* Own packaging renovation and refresh projects; test new designs with consumers where needed.
* Coordinate with QA, Procurement and printers so artwork is correct, compliant and ready on time.

**6. Communication & Campaigns (Offline and Online)**

* Plan and run integrated campaigns across ATL (TV, radio, outdoor, print), BTL (sampling, activations, events, exhibitions) and digital (social media, influencers, performance ads, content).
* Brief creative, media and digital agencies; review and approve all creative work against the brand strategy.
* Build regional-language content and culturally relevant campaigns for South Indian consumers and festivals.
* Measure every campaign on reach, engagement, trial and sales impact, and report ROI.

**7. Trade & Channel Support**

* Develop trade marketing plans with Sales for general trade, modern trade, HoReCa and e-commerce / quick-commerce: visibility, POS materials, schemes, planograms and in-store activations.
* Create channel-specific packs, bundles and promotions where they make business sense.
* Visit markets regularly to check shelf presence, pricing, freshness and competitor activity.
* Support the e-commerce team with brand content, listing images, A+ content and platform campaigns.

**8. Budget & Agency Management**

* Own the A&P budget for your brands; plan spend by activity and month, and keep it within the approved budget.
* Select and manage agencies, influencers and vendors; negotiate costs and hold them to timelines and quality.
* Track spend against results and shift money to what works.

**9. Reporting & Reviews**

* **Weekly:**
  prepare a brand update for the Marketing Manager every Monday covering sales vs plan by brand, key campaigns running, launch status, and competitor moves.
* **Monthly:**
  prepare a brand performance report by the 5th working day. It covers sales and growth by brand, SKU and channel; market share and distribution where available; A&P spend vs plan and ROI; brand health and digital metrics; launch performance; and next month's actions.
* **Quarterly:**
  present a brand review to management covering performance against the annual plan, consumer and competitor insights, and recommended changes.
* Flag any major issue immediately, such as a sharp sales drop, a competitor launch, a product complaint trend or a packaging error.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Brand sales and growth vs plan (value and volume), by brand, channel and region
* Contribution margin of the brand portfolio vs plan
* Market share and distribution growth in priority markets
* New launches delivered on time and hitting first-quarter sales targets
* Brand health: awareness, trial and repeat purchase
* A&P spend within approved budget, with measurable ROI per campaign
* Digital and e-commerce brand metrics: reach, engagement, ratings and online sales growth
* Zero packaging or labelling compliance errors
* Weekly, monthly and quarterly reports delivered on time, complete and accurate

**What You Bring**

* 4–7 years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, ideally food, spices, beverages, bakery or ingredients
* A proven record of growing brands and launching new products from brief to shelf
* Strong understanding of consumer research, pricing, P&L, A&P budgets and campaign measurement
* Experience across offline (ATL, BTL, trade) and online (social, performance, e-commerce) marketing
* Experience briefing and managing creative, media and digital agencies
* Working knowledge of FSSAI labelling, Legal Metrology and ASCI advertising rules
* Strong analytical skills (Excel, sales and market data) and clear presentation skills
* Strong understanding of South Indian consumers and markets; excellent English and Tamil (Malayalam, Telugu or Kannada is a plus)
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing preferred
* Willing to travel for market visits, research and launches

**Why Join Us**

* Real ownership of brands in a fast-growing FMCG company
* Direct access to leadership and quick decision-making
* The chance to build and scale brands across South India, offline and online
* Hands-on exposure to the full journey, from consumer insight to product launch
* Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV to jobs@tigerfoodsindia.com with the subject "Application – Brand Manager – [Your Name]". You can also reach us on 9940301398. Please include your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

Tiger Food Ingredients is an equal opportunity employer.

title: B2B Content Strategist
description:
**VADIVAM®**
is a strategic brand identity studio. We design brand identities for established enterprises — founder-led, multi-generational and listed businesses.

**IMPORTANT: LinkedIn Easy Apply applications will not be reviewed. To apply, email your application to careers@vadivam.com as described under "How to Apply" below.**

**ABOUT VADIVAM®**

VADIVAM® began in 2013 as a freelance creative practice and was incorporated in 2018. Over 13 years, we've delivered 200+ brand projects, built a strong network of creative collaborators and partners, and worked across a wide range of creative disciplines.

We are now entering a deliberate new phase: repositioning VADIVAM® as a premium brand identity design agency for established enterprises, founder-led and multi-generational businesses — moving away from being seen as a general branding, logo or digital creative agency.

**THE TEAM AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT**

This phase is being built with a focused, lean team that will grow with the studio. You would work alongside identity designers, a motion designer, an editor and our business development team, directly with the founder, in-office.

• Role type: Full-time, in-office

• Working hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

• Saturdays: alternate Saturdays off; the monthly office calendar is shared in advance

• Detailed policies are shared once you join

**ROLE AT A GLANCE**

• Role: B2B Content Strategist

• Experience: 3 years in B2B content strategy, brand writing or agency content

• Location: Chennai — studio-based, near Teynampet Metro

• Salary: ₹25,000/month CTC, inclusive of statutory benefits

 Final compensation is confirmed after the task assessment and the final round of interview.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Your role is to shape what VADIVAM® says, to whom, and why — building the point of view, credibility and trust that lead founders, MDs and leadership teams of established enterprises to choose us.

**Content strategy and messaging**

• Build and maintain VADIVAM®'s messaging framework — our point of view, key themes and voice for business leaders

• Plan the editorial calendar across the website, LinkedIn, Instagram and newsletters

• Keep every touchpoint — website, profiles, decks, social — consistent with our premium positioning

**Thought leadership**

• Research and write "Blog Insights", articles and perspectives on brand identity as a strategic investment

• Shape and write the founder's LinkedIn presence — building credibility with business leaders

• Turn conversations, projects and industry shifts into clear, insightful content

**Proof and credibility**

• Write case studies that show the business thinking behind our identity work

• Develop the company profile, credentials decks and proposal content with the design team

• Use Instagram as a portfolio of our work, process and craft — not volume posting

**Content for growth**

• Plan content for priority sectors and target companies, in support of business development

• Write email newsletters for decision-makers

• Create website and landing page content that turns readers into qualified enquiries

**Measurement**

• Track engagement from target decision-makers, enquiry quality and meetings created through content

• Use what you learn to refine themes, formats and messaging

**APPLY ONLY IF YOU HAVE ALL OF THESE**

• 3 years of experience in B2B content strategy, brand writing or agency content

• Excellent written English — you can write for founders and MDs, with clarity and insight

• Published work you have written: articles, case studies, thought leadership or long-form LinkedIn content

• Experience planning content strategically — editorial calendars, themes and messaging frameworks

• Strong research skills, and an understanding of how B2B buyers make decisions

• Working knowledge of LinkedIn, website CMS, SEO basics and content analytics

**GOOD TO HAVE**

• Experience writing for a design, branding, consulting or creative agency

• Familiarity with LinkedIn and Meta ads

• Tamil, for engaging Tamil Nadu business owners

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

• Your experience is mainly running ads or performance marketing

• Your work is mainly high-volume social media posting or influencer content

• You measure success by follower counts rather than quality enquiries

• You're looking for remote or part-time work

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Monthly salary of ₹25,000 CTC, inclusive of statutory benefits

• Joining bonus of 50% of your agreed monthly salary, paid with your first month's salary

• A structured review at 3 months, probation confirmation at 6 months and a retention bonus at 12 months

• The opportunity to shape the voice and point of view of a premium identity studio

• Direct mentorship from the founder

**FOR CANDIDATES IN OUR SELECTION PROCESS**

• An honorarium for assessment tasks, paid on completion of the final selection round (not applicable to submissions substantially generated by AI)

• An interview incentive for candidates shortlisted for the final round

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email: careers@vadivam.com

Subject: B2B Content Strategist | Your Name

Include:

1. Your CV (PDF)

2. A short task (about 30 minutes):

  Look at VADIVAM®'s website, LinkedIn and Instagram.

  a) In 100 words: the one biggest gap in how we present ourselves to founders of established businesses — and how you would fix it.

3. Links to 2–3 pieces of content you have written

4. At the top of your email:

  – Years of experience, and the companies or agencies you've worked with

  – Current monthly salary

  – Expected monthly salary

  – Notice period

**Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.**

We review every application. Shortlisted candidates will hear from us within 10 days.

title: Communications Manager
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
The Communications Manager will play a key role in shaping and delivering the communications strategy for U.S. Bank’s India Global Capability Center. This individual will help build a strong, consistent narrative around the GCC’s strategy, growth, culture, capabilities and impact, while ensuring alignment with U.S. Bank’s broader enterprise communications priorities and brand standards.
  
  
This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role requiring strong writing, executive communication and stakeholder-management capabilities. The Communications Manager will partner closely with India GCC leadership, enterprise Communications, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition and other business and functional leaders to create clear, compelling communications for employees and key stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings experience working in a
**global organization or GCC environment**
and is comfortable operating in a fast-growing organization where communications will play an important role in engagement, transformation and culture building.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Communications Strategy & GCC Positioning
  
  

* Develop and execute an integrated communications strategy for the India GCC aligned with enterprise priorities.
* Build a compelling narrative around the GCC’s purpose, capabilities, growth, transformation and contribution to U.S. Bank.
* Create structured communication plans for major GCC initiatives, leadership priorities, organizational changes and milestones.
* Ensure communications across the GCC are consistent, accurate, timely and aligned with enterprise brand and communications standards.

Executive & Leadership Communications
  
  

* Serve as a trusted communications partner to India GCC leadership.
* Develop executive communications including leadership messages, talking points, presentations, town hall content, announcements, speeches and employee communications.
* Support leadership meetings, town halls, site visits and other high-visibility engagements.
* Translate complex business topics into concise, engaging messages for diverse audiences.
* Help establish a consistent leadership voice across internal communication channels.

Employee Communications & Engagement
  
  

* Develop communications that strengthen employee awareness, engagement and connection to the organization’s strategy and culture.
* Create content for employee campaigns, newsletters, intranet channels, leadership updates, events and other internal platforms.
* Partner with HR and business leaders on communications supporting culture, talent, learning, recognition, inclusion and employee engagement initiatives.
* Establish communication calendars and governance to ensure employees receive relevant information through the right channels at the right time.
* Measure communication effectiveness and use employee feedback and engagement insights to continuously improve content and channels.

Change & Transformation Communications
  
  

* Develop change-communication strategies for organizational transformation, new capabilities, operating-model changes and other significant initiatives.
* Create stakeholder-specific communication plans that build awareness, understanding and adoption.
* Partner with program, HR and business leaders to anticipate communication needs and manage sensitive organizational messages appropriately.
* Support leaders through periods of organizational growth and change with clear and transparent communications.

Employer Brand & External Communications
  
  

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, Marketing and enterprise Communications to strengthen the GCC’s employer brand in India.
* Develop stories that showcase employees, leadership, capabilities, community engagement and the impact of the India GCC.
* Support approved external communications, leadership profiles, industry events and social media content, including LinkedIn.
* Help position the GCC effectively within India’s competitive talent market while ensuring consistency with the U.S. Bank brand.

Events & Leadership Engagement
  
  

* Support communications for leadership visits, employee events, town halls, business reviews and GCC-wide programs.
* Develop agendas, scripts, talking points, presentations and supporting communication materials.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to deliver a consistent experience across leadership and employee engagements.

Communication Governance & Measurement
  
  

* Establish appropriate editorial calendars, review processes, templates and communication standards.
* Ensure communications comply with applicable brand, legal, compliance, privacy and corporate-communications requirements.
* Track communication effectiveness using appropriate metrics including employee engagement, content reach, channel performance and feedback.
* Identify opportunities to improve communication channels, processes and employee experience.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, Business or a related discipline.
* Typically 8–12+ years of progressive experience in corporate communications, internal communications, executive communications, employee engagement, change communications or a related area.
* Strong experience developing communications for senior executives and leadership teams.
* Exceptional English writing, editing, presentation and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business topics into clear, concise communications.
* Experience working with multiple senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality communications in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within a Global Capability Center (GCC), multinational organization or global financial-services environment.
* Experience supporting the communications needs of a growing or newly established GCC in India.
* Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Strong executive presence and ability to advise and influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience with organizational change, transformation and employee-engagement communications.
* Experience partnering with HR and Talent Acquisition on employer-brand and talent communications.
* Experience supporting senior leadership events and global executive visits.
* Strong understanding of India’s corporate and talent environment.
* Comfortable working across India and U.S. time zones when business requirements call for it.

Leadership Competencies
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Executive communication: Ability to communicate with clarity, judgment and credibility.
* Strategic thinking: Connect individual communications to broader business objectives and stakeholder needs.
* Storytelling: Turn complex business priorities into engaging, accessible narratives.
* Stakeholder management: Build trusted partnerships with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Judgment: Handle sensitive and confidential communications with discretion.
* Execution: Move comfortably between strategic planning and hands-on content creation.
* Collaboration: Work effectively across India and global teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Adaptability: Operate effectively in a growing and evolving GCC environment.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.
  
  
**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**
This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Performance Marketing Manager — SEM, Social & Programmatic (DSP)
description:
Performance Marketing Manager — SEM, Social & Programmatic (DSP)

**Company:**
Inspirelabs Solutions Ltd. (GrabOn)

**Location:**
Hyderabad (On-site)

**Experience:**
3–6 years

**About the Role**

We run high-intent, high-volume traffic across GrabOn's India, US, and UAE properties. We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition end-to-end — from search intent capture on Google/Bing, to paid social on Meta, to programmatic display and retargeting via DSPs. You'll be responsible for spend efficiency, incrementality, and revenue impact, not just clicks. This is a builder role for someone who treats a media budget like their own P&L.

What You'll Own

* Plan, launch, and scale
  **SEM campaigns**
  (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) across search, shopping, and Performance Max — structured for a coupon/deals business with thin margins and high keyword volume.
* Build and run
  **Meta (Facebook & Instagram) campaigns**
  — prospecting, retargeting, and dynamic product ads — with sharp audience strategy, creative testing, and full ownership of Meta Ads Manager and the Pixel/Conversions API.
* Build and manage
  **programmatic display and retargeting**
  through DSPs (DV360, The Trade Desk, or equivalent) — audience strategy, inventory, creative rotation, and frequency capping.
* Own the full funnel: keyword and audience research, bid strategy, budget pacing, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking.
* Set up and maintain
  **measurement infrastructure**
  — conversion tracking, GA4 events, GTM, Meta CAPI, and attribution — and defend every rupee/dollar of spend with data.
* Run structured
  **A/B tests**
  on creatives, bids, audiences, and landing pages; ship learnings, not just reports.
* Manage budgets across three geographies with distinct CPCs, currencies, and buyer behavior (India, US, GCC).
* Partner with SEO, content, and AI Labs to close the loop between paid and organic, and to automate reporting and optimization where possible.

**What You'll Need**

* 3–6 years running paid acquisition with real budget ownership and a track record of hitting ROAS/CPA targets at scale.
* Hands-on depth in
  **Google Ads**
  (Search, Shopping, PMax) — you can build a campaign structure from scratch and explain every bid decision.
* Proven experience running
  **Meta paid social**
  at scale — Ads Manager, audience/lookalike strategy, creative iteration, and Conversions API setup.
* Direct experience with at least one
  **DSP**
  (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, or similar) — programmatic buying, audience building, and inventory management.
* Fluency in GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking; comfortable with UTM discipline and attribution debates.
* Strong Excel/Sheets modeling — you can build a spend-to-revenue model and spot a leaking campaign before the dashboard does.
* Analytical bias: you optimize toward incrementality and contribution margin, not vanity metrics.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in affiliate, coupons/deals, e-commerce, or high-volume performance environments.
* Familiarity with feed management, dynamic remarketing, or catalog/shopping feeds.
* Comfort using AI tools to automate reporting, bid adjustments, or creative iteration.
* Exposure to US/international markets beyond India.

Our SWARAJ program helps young Indians build the inner skills the AI age asks for: self-awareness, agency, adaptability and judgment. Communities, campuses, events and social media are where most young people first meet Kitab, and these interns run them.

**The internships**

On-site in Hyderabad, 3 to 6 months. Freshers, final-year students and recent graduates are welcome. Both roles are founder-style: you'll own your numbers as if this were your own startup, and interns who do well grow fast here.

**Community Manager Intern (Community & Campus Catalyst), 1 opening, reports to Tameesh Sud**

* Run Kitab's community groups every day: welcome new members, start conversations, answer questions and keep the tone warm.
* Plan and run on-ground and online events, from campus talks and book circles to SWARAJ challenge meetups.
* Reach out to colleges, student clubs, communities and partners, and set up collaborations.
* Collect member feedback and pass the patterns to product and content.
* Help with user research logistics: recruit and schedule participants, send invites and keep notes and trackers organised.
* Your number: 500 new community members and 300 app downloads from your events and outreach in your first 3 months, with 30 user research sessions set up.

**Social Media Intern (Social Content & Trends Creator), 2 openings, reports to Ganesh Bende**

* Keep content going out on time across Kitab's channels, following the content calendar.
* Make simple reels, carousels and captions with Canva, CapCut and AI tools, polished with feedback from our designer.
* Research creators, formats, hooks and trends, and share them with the team every week.
* Track how each post does and point out what's working.
* Your number: 60 posts shipped in your first 3 months, with saves and shares per post above where we started. Strong performers get a full-time offer.

**How AI fits these roles**

* Community: plan events, write run sheets, invites and outreach with AI, then rewrite so it sounds like you; summarise group chats to see what members want.
* Social: research trends, brainstorm hooks and captions, and make posts faster with AI image and video tools plus the AI features in Canva and CapCut.
* Prompt engineering is a core skill in both: you write, test and save prompts that give good outreach, event plans, hooks, captions and visuals every time.

**What you bring**

* A fresher or final-year student, smart and well-spoken in English
* Hands-on with AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude, including writing your own prompts
* Organised and reliable: you keep schedules, trackers and notes tidy and meet deadlines
* Community: you've planned an event, run a club or built a group, even a small one, and you're comfortable reaching out to strangers and promoting Kitab
* Social: you notice good posts, creators and trends, have a sense of what looks good, and can show 3 posts, reels or designs you made
* A founder mindset: you own your numbers, work across teams and treat feedback as fuel

**Nice to have:**
Hindi or Telugu; campus ambassador programs, student clubs or college fests; basic Canva, video editing or a creator account you've grown; interest in self-growth, psychology or the wisdom texts.

**Why join**

* Real ownership, real numbers and founder-level exposure most people only get years into their careers
* Direct access to Kitab's leadership and real work going live from week 1
* Learn community building, events, content and growth inside a fast-moving startup

**How we select**

Form (with your 60 to 90 second video), then we shortlist, then a 20-minute call with Ganesh, then a conversation with Tameesh (community) or a craft round with our designer (social), then an offer. Interns have no assignment: your form answers and video do that job.

Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Questions or trouble submitting the form? WhatsApp +91 63012 56771 or email hr@kitab.com. We don't take applications by email.

We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Content Creator to develop engaging, innovative, and high-quality content across various digital platforms. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of social media trends, storytelling, content strategy, and audience engagement.

* Create short-form videos, reels, stories, and other multimedia content.

* Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, phone or similar platforms.
* Develop innovative content ideas to improve brand visibility.

* Research competitors, industry trends, and target audiences.
* Develop fresh content ideas based on market trends.
* Understand audience preferences and create relevant content.
* Contribute to campaign planning and brainstorming sessions.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Track content performance, reach, impressions, engagement, and views.
* Analyse content effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Stay updated with changing social media algorithms and platform features.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Media Studies, or a related field (preferred).
* 1–3 years of experience in content creation or digital marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong creative thinking and storytelling abilities.
* Knowledge of social media platforms and current digital trends.
* Basic video shooting and editing skills.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in creating Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Knowledge of SEO and digital marketing fundamentals.
* Basic photography and videography skills.
* Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools.
* Understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Quality and consistency of content.
* Social media reach and engagement.
* Growth in followers and audience interaction.
* Video views, shares, saves, and impressions.
* Timely execution of the content calendar.
* Contribution to brand awareness and marketing campaigns.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in content creation for digital platforms, including copywriting, storytelling, and basic graphic design.
* Ability to conceptualize and produce photo and video content, including shooting, basic editing, and organizing visual assets.
* Experience with social media management, digital branding, and developing content aligned with marketing goals.
* Good understanding of interior design or architectural products, or a strong interest and willingness to learn this domain.
* Proficiency with common content and design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar), and familiarity with social media analytics.

* Strong attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to work on-site with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in design, communications, media, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is passionate about creativity, understands digital audiences, follows emerging trends, and can transform ideas into impactful content that connects with people and builds the brand.

title: Content & Learning Strategist (Story Architect)
description:
**How to apply:**
we don't review easy-apply profiles. Apply through our form so we can see your real work: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScxNkEoHC1ZT8BXsugw\_eXeAt0pfZzC\_-1yByCfssoh3qc2lw/viewform?usp=pp\_url&entry.1653201307=LinkedIn . It takes about 20 minutes, plus a 60 to 90 second video.

Plan and write the stories, series and learning journeys that make 5,000 years of wisdom feel made for today.

**About Kitab**

Kitab brings ancient wisdom to modern problems. We draw on texts like the Bhagavad Gita and the Puranas and turn them into short summaries, audio, guided programs and challenges for everyday problems: stress, relationships, purpose and decisions. Everything we make serves three pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself. Our challenge is making timeless ideas land in a minute without slipping into generic motivation. This role owns what we say and how people learn it, in the app and outside it.

**The role**

On-site in Hyderabad, full-time, 1 opening, reporting to Tameesh Sud. Experience: 2 to 4 years in content strategy, editorial, learning content or storytelling. You will own what Kitab says and how people learn it: improve the content we already have, set the pillars, series and calendar, and write the summaries, lessons and journeys that turn timeless ideas into something people finish and share.

You will own one number: the 50 weakest existing pieces rewritten within your first 90 days, with the rewrites beating the old versions on completion and saves. After that, you will run a content engine where the numbers decide what we make next.

This is a founder-style role. You'll work across social, video, product and our experts, fix what's weak without waiting to be asked, and own the numbers that show it worked.

**What you'll own**

* Improve what's already there: audit every existing summary, lesson and journey in Kitab, rewrite the weakest first, and prove the rewrites work better on completion and saves.
* Content strategy: the pillars, series and monthly calendar, tied to who we're trying to reach and what we want them to do.
* Learning journeys: in-app summaries, lessons and multi-day challenges that take a person from first idea to daily habit.
* Story series: recurring formats for reels, carousels, newsletters and the app, so one idea becomes many pieces without losing depth.
* Accuracy and voice: every piece true to the source text and in Kitab's voice, checked with our experts where it matters.
* Briefs for the team: clear scripts and briefs for social, video and design.
* Learning from numbers: reach, saves, completion and retention decide what we make more of and what we drop.

**Your scorecard (90 days)**

* All existing content audited and scored by day 30; weakest 20 rewritten by day 60; weakest 50 rewritten by day 90
* Rewritten pieces +20% vs old versions on completion and saves
* Content pillars, series formats and monthly calendar agreed by day 30 and running by day 60
* 4 story series live across social and the app, with a winner scaled
* 50 new in-app learning pieces shipped by day 90
* Completion rate of journeys and challenges +15% vs baseline; saves and shares per post +20%
* A reusable prompt library for research, drafts and variants, shared with the team

**How AI fits this role**

AI does the heavy lifting; your judgement decides what's true and what's good.

* Research: use AI to find, summarise and compare passages and commentaries, then check every claim against the source.
* Drafting: first drafts of summaries, lessons, scripts and captions, which you rewrite until they sound like Kitab.
* Variants: turn one idea into hooks, formats and lengths for each channel, and test them.
* Learning design: AI helps you structure journeys and write quiz and reflection prompts.
* Analysis: summarise comments, feedback and performance data to decide what to make next.
* Prompt engineering is a core skill: you write, test and save prompts that give accurate, on-voice output, and you catch AI's confident mistakes before anything ships.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years in content strategy, editorial, learning content or storytelling, with reach or completion numbers
* A content series or system you built and grew, not just single posts
* Clear, warm English writing that makes a deep idea simple without making it shallow
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your writing workflow, including prompts you've written and refined
* Comfort reading content analytics and changing course because of them
* A founder mindset: you own the numbers on everything you publish and fix weak content without being asked

**Nice to have:**
familiarity with the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads, Puranas or other wisdom traditions; instructional or learning design, or edtech content; Hindi, Telugu or another Indian language; wellness, self-growth, philosophy or psychology content.

**Why join**

* Build at an early-stage company with the scope, speed and ownership most people wait years for
* Own the voice of a mission-led app, with direct access to the founders
* Make 5,000 years of wisdom useful to millions of people today
* Build Kitab's content function from the ground up and lead it as it grows

**How we select**

Form, then we shortlist, then a 20-minute call with Ganesh, a 60-minute assignment (shared only after the call), a round with Tameesh, and a final conversation with Ravi.

Rolling applications, shortlisted every Friday. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Questions or trouble submitting the form? WhatsApp +91 63012 56771 or email hr@kitab.com. We don't take applications by email.
