title: Executive Manager - Finance
description:
**Overview**
Lead the EMEA HQ P&L consolidation, working closely with the Sector FP&A team to ensure accurate and timely delivery of all Close, Forecast and Reporting requirements. Own the end-to-end HQ OU P&L, providing financial oversight, consolidation, variance analysis and insights to support effective decision-making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* EMEA HQ P&L Ownership & Consolidation: Own the end-to-end EMEA HQ P&L consolidation, ensuring accurate and timely consolidation of Corporate Functions, KCC, GCC and other HQ costs across Close, Forecast and Plan cycles.
* Close Management: Partner closely with the Control team and Finance Functional Managers (FFMs) throughout the monthly Close cycle to validate financials, resolve issues and ensure accurate and timely P&L submissions.
* Forecasting & Planning: Work closely with Sector FP&A and functional stakeholders to consolidate and finalize forecasts, ensuring latest business assumptions, risks and opportunities are appropriately reflected.
* Financial Analysis & Cause of Change: Lead Cause of Change, variance and trend analysis across the HQ P&L, identifying key business drivers and translating movements into clear insights for stakeholders.
* Risk & Opportunity Management: Partner with the CFO and Finance leadership to identify, quantify and present Risks & Opportunities, including scenario modelling and mitigation actions to manage the cost base and deliver financial commitments.
* Functional Finance Partnership: Collaborate closely with Corporate Functions and FFMs, providing guidance on the appropriate treatment of functional spend across the P&L and Balance Sheet and helping resolve accounting and planning-related issues.
* MCM & Cost Transfer Governance: Coordinate with OU and functional counterparts on MCM allocations, budget/plan transfers and other cost movements, ensuring changes, financial implications and required actions are clearly communicated and reflected correctly.
* Scenario Planning & Decision Support: Build financial scenarios to assess cost pressures, savings opportunities, potential investments and other changes, providing management with actionable options to manage the HQ cost base.
* Reporting & Submission Governance: Ensure all Corporate P&L submissions for EMEA HQ are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines, with strong governance around dependencies and stakeholder inputs.
* Data Integrity & Reconciliation: Maintain strong controls over financial data, ensuring accuracy and consistency across reporting and planning systems and proactively addressing reconciliation or mapping issues.
* TM1/Mosaic Ownership & Transformation: Partner with the EMEA Transformation and Mosaic Support teams to drive improvements across TM1/Mosaic, maintain mapping tables, and resolve issues impacting the OpEx and C&B cubes.
* Stakeholder Management & Ad Hoc Support: Act as a key point of contact for EMEA HQ financial matters, coordinating across Sector FP&A, Corporate Functions, Control, FFMs, KCC/GCC counterparts and Transformation teams, while managing ad hoc financial requests throughout the month.

**Qualifications**
Professional Experience
  
  

* 8–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance Analysis, Business Partnering, or related finance roles
* Hands-on experience supporting planning cycles including AOP, forecasts, month-end close, and performance reporting
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and supporting budget, forecast, and variance discussions

description:

DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Analyst to join our India office of DESRI, i.e., DESRI India Private Limited, based in Hyderabad, India. The candidate will be a part of Acquisitions and Finance team and will regularly interact with the U.S. and Hyderabad-based teams, as well as external parties. The candidate will be a part of an inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar, and storage projects within a dynamic environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.

Your primary responsibilities include developing and managing detailed financial models for active financing transactions (such as construction to term loans, refinancings, junior debt, development loan facilities, etc.), M&A transactions and PPA bids, and assessing key value drivers and risk factors. You will support the due diligence process, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders to review key project documents, including power purchase agreements, EPC contracts, and permitting documents. * The candidate must have strong communication skills with the ability to summarize complex analysis for decisionmakers.
* The candidate must have the ability to collaborate with teams located in different time zones and jurisdictions.
* The candidate must have innovative mindset with AI adoption capabilities

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. We have offices in India based out of Hyderabad, Gurugram, and Bengaluru.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
The Financial Operations group is an integral part of our global operations. If hired, you will support one or more of the functions mentioned below.
  
  
**Tax -**
In this role, you will be required to prepare, review, and file D. E. Shaw’s hedge investment funds’ income tax returns and issue annual tax information (Sch. K-1s) to investors. You will review tax information to be included in various regulatory filings (tax audits, state tax returns, etc.) and interact with D. E. Shaw’s various Financial Operations teams and the Tax Planning team. You will prepare, review, and issue quarterly investor tax estimate statements. You will compute funds’ taxable income calculations/allocations for various D. E. Shaw hedge funds, as well as for investors, which include analyzing book-to-tax differences and various taxable income allocation methodologies. You will be expected to periodically compute various state taxes, pay state tax authorities, and address tax notices. Additionally, you will periodically present D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds’ taxable income analysis to senior management and address queries raised by investors on their taxable income calculations.
  
  
**Control Room & Governance -**
The CRG team is responsible for implementing and enforcing policies and procedures across multiple regulatory requirements, where you will be assisting front-office trading desks by conducting thorough research on the firm’s positions and applicable regulations for each asset class across jurisdictions through the deployment of advanced data analytics and data visualization techniques like statistical analysis, predictive modelling, clustering, etc., on tools like Power BI and others. You will also perform regulatory filing obligations, requiring complex quantitative and qualitative analysis of the firm’s short position and long ownership reports across US, UK, EU, Japan, etc. jurisdictions, and assist in monitoring and implementing controls designed to ensure compliance with global regulations by deploying various data analytics and visualization techniques. Additionally, you will be conducting thorough analysis on the fundamental research data collected by the trading groups through their interactions with external industry experts/consultants around various market sectors to avoid potential trading while in possession of material non-public information. Furthermore, you will be assisting with long-term projects to maintain the firm’s high standards of compliance with new and existing regulations.
  
  
**P&L Reporting**
- You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns and fees is accurate, timely, and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile, and allocate P&L, expenses, and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating, and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.
  
  
**Management Company Accounting**
- In this role, you will be expected to file management company financial statements, month close operations, and other regulatory reports including having these global management entities audited. You will also be responsible for driving technology projects to build tools for reporting and analyses, streamlining workflows, and improving stakeholder experience. Additionally, you will be collaborating with multiple teams, internal and external stakeholders (other financial operations teams, CFO, COO, BU heads, auditors, third-party service providers, etc.).

The ideal candidate should hold -

description:

title: Associate 2
description:
**Working Capital Associate - Job Description**

About the role

The Working Capital team is part of Financial Operations and provides working capital support to client engagements from across the UK firm, structured by line of service. The services provided by the team includes both:

* transaction delivery - providing essential financial transaction delivery support to client engagement teams, including raising invoices, chasing outstanding debts and setting up job codes; and
* working capital optimisation - driving improvements in working capital performance through working with engagement teams.

As a Working Capital Associate you will have responsibility for a portfolio of billing managers and/or partners within a business unit across one of our lines of service. In your role you will provide your billing managers and/or partners with both transactional delivery and working capital optimisation support, meeting with them on a regular basis to discuss their working capital performance and understand and deliver on their transactional delivery requirements. The role reports directly to the Working Capital Team Leader.

The role would suit a finance administrator or finance project coordinator, demonstrating confidence with numbers, analysis and budgeting. The candidate must also have excellent proven organisational skills, be able to multi-task and have the ability to build strong working relationships with client facing senior stakeholders (manager through partner grade), including the confidence to challenge their working capital position.

The ideal applicant will be passionate about the role they play in improving working capital performance and provide excellent client service, taking the time to learn about our clients and the services we provide. They will demonstrate drive, a customer focused approach, flexibility and agility whilst enjoying the demands that come with working in a fast paced environment and exceeding KPIs.

The suitable candidate will also demonstrate leadership qualities to manage their own time, whilst being willing to learn new tasks and taking on new responsibilities. They will also be open to sharing ideas and best practice with colleagues and peers alike.

Core Responsibilities

* Financial administration and analysis: including creating client codes, raising invoices and credit notes, chasing debts, maintaining financial trackers, running/analysing financial reports and, in some lines of service, budget preparation.
* Proactive active capital movement: leading meeting with Partners, Directors, Senior Managers and Managers to discuss their working capital needs on their engagements, including providing insight into their financial metrics and progress against targets, whilst making recommendations to improve metrics.

Experience required and desirable skills

* A finance/accountancy based degree and/or studying towards an accounting or finance professional qualification
* Minimum 1-2 years experience of delivering high quality finance support, preferably in a professional services (or similar) environment
* Work effectively under pressure with excellent organisation skills and the ability to prioritise work, especially when there are conflicting demands.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, being able to interpret financial data and produce relevant reports.
* Pragmatic in your approach to problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and the personal motivation to perform your role to the highest standards, taking ownership of your portfolio and assigned tasks
* Always punctual, flexible and responsive in how you approach your work and ensuring deadlines are met
* Excellent Communication skills - written & verbal – with ability to interact confidently and professionally at all levels
* Strong interpersonal skills – able to build and maintain trusted relationships with clients and colleagues

title: Services Operations Analyst
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is a global enterprise SaaS product company engineering the future of enterprise growth through AI-native sales enablement. Our unified platform, the Seismic Enablement Cloud™ delivers the intelligent automation, predictive insights, and context-aware tools customer-facing teams need to win deals faster, build lasting buyer trust, and scale revenue predictably. Trusted by over 2,000 global enterprise customers and more than one million daily active users worldwide, we build high-impact software that redefines how modern businesses operate. Headquartered in the US, Seismic operates across global hubs in the USA, Canada, EMEA, and APAC. Our Hyderabad hub is a strategic co-center of Seismic’s global business model. Operating as direct partners with our international offices, our India teams drive end-to-end execution across Product & Engineering, Field Operations & Services, Finance, IT, Security and HR.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, plus 2 to 3 years in a professional services, operations, systems analyst, finance or accounting, or related role
* Working knowledge of the consulting and professional services operating model, common terminology and processes, and the key metrics that go with them
* Support project accounting for Professional Services engagements by tracking time, billing, and revenue against each project, and flagging variances to budget
* Experience with information systems such as CRM, PSA, ERP/accounting, and order management (Salesforce CRM AND Rocketlane OR Certinia PSA strongly preferred)
* Proficiency in Excel, plus experience with SQL and BI tools such as Tableau for building reports and conducting analysis
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain data to non-technical colleagues
* Exposure to a fast-paced, rapidly growing organization

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Do you enjoy finding better ways to get work done, producing timely and accurate data that people can rely on, and working closely with other teams? Join Seismic’s best-in-class Global Operations team as a Service Operations Analyst II, supporting our Professional Services business as it grows. In this role, you will work with teams across the company to improve data transparency and operational excellence, help our Professional Services platforms run smoothly, and contribute to the company’s growth.
* Support the Professional Services team in streamlining daily processes and keeping data accurate, from pre-sales through project delivery and billing
* Provide end user onboarding and support for our Professional Services Automation platform and related systems, share input on enhancement requests, and help test system changes
* Review new professional services contracts and set up projects in internal systems with accurate schedule, resource plan, invoicing, and revenue recognition information, getting guidance on non-standard or complex contracts
* Investigate and resolve questions from internal customers about contract terms, data updates, system changes, and billing adjustments, and escalate complex or unusual cases
* Build and maintain regular reports and ad hoc analysis on project health, resource utilization, and financial forecasts, and point out trends worth acting on
* Coordinate approvals and track status for partner and subcontractor engagements
* Support project accounting for Professional Services engagements by tracking time, expenses, billing, and revenue against each project, and flagging variances to budget.
* Support the month-end close for Professional Services revenue and expense by consolidating billing data and completing reconciliations, working with Seismic’s Finance team
* Contribute to Global Operations projects that improve processes, technology, and data transparency
* Document processes and keep standard operating procedures up to date
* Work primarily with managers and team leads across Professional Services, Finance, and Revenue Operations

Who You Are:
  
  

* A clear communicator who builds good working relationships with a range of stakeholders
* Proactive about spotting opportunities and willing to take on new challenges
* Happy working as part of a team while owning your individual work
* Detail-oriented, especially when working with complex customer and financial data
* Curious about new technology and how to get the most out of it
* Comfortable following defined processes and learning as new situations come up
* Able to manage your own workload and ask for help when priorities shift
* Eager to learn from more experienced colleagues

At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

title: Risk Specialist I, WW Transportation Controllership
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Transportation Controllership Audit team is an operational finance team responsible for controlling Amazon's transportation costs. We achieve this by strengthening internal and external systems, working closely with stakeholders across Operations, Procurement, Technology, Accounts Payable, and Finance, as well as external partners such as carriers. We are looking for a Risk Specialist I to join our team and help manage risk across financial and regulatory domains while driving automation and process improvements that support accurate carrier payments and financial reporting.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Act as a single-threaded owner responsible for the execution, and delivery of straightforward risk (e.g. financial, regulatory, Amazon policy and business continuity).
* Recommend, develop, and implement policies and programs that guide the organization in accurately estimating freight cost and ensure invoice accuracy.
* Identifies technology gaps and work with tech teams on solutions.
* Conducts effective communication of results and updates to stakeholders.
* Drives broader risk mitigation activities by working with other teams such as Internal Audit and Risk team.

**About The Team**
Amazon's Transportation Controllership Audit team plays a critical role in controlling transportation costs across Amazon's global network. We work at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations — partnering with Operations, Procurement, Technology groups, Accounts Payable, and Finance, as well as external carriers, to strengthen the systems and processes that drive accurate payments and financial reporting. Our team values collaboration, continuous improvement, and building scalable solutions that keep pace with Amazon's growth.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience working with global teams and diverse partners
* Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements
* 2+ years of experience in risk management areas such as internal / external invoice audit and investigation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of driving process improvements experience

* Willingness to learn, adapt to evolving regulatory requirements, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service quality.

title: Partner Operations Analyst
description:
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
We're hiring a Partner Operations Analyst for the Revenue Operations team. You'll support the Alliances team and Partner Managers, and work with Sales, Professional Services, Finance, and Marketing on partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals.
  
  
In this specialized role, you will be critical in designing, implementing, and executing business processes, workflows, and forecasting cadences that govern our partner ecosystem. You will be instrumental in monitoring compliance, driving partner performance measurement, and ensuring the operational efficiency of our channel strategy. The ideal candidate will have strong business acumen, a passion for operations and scalability, and the ability to deliver data driven improvements in a fast paced environment. A successful individual must be customer focused, business savvy, resourceful, and capable of dealing with ambiguity while operating at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner Operations Business Partnership: Act as the dedicated operational business partner to the Alliances leadership, providing strategic oversight on all matters related to the partner business lifecycle.
* Process ownership: Build and improve partner programs and processes, including registration, deal conflicts, referrals, compliance, and partner-to-sales handoffs.
* Performance management: Run QBRs and internal reviews to track partner performance.
* Forecasting and pipeline: Lead joint pipeline reviews and forecasting, with channel analysis and recommendations.
* Data and systems: Own partner data and systems, including the Salesforce Partner Portal. Set standards and work with RevOps and Systems on changes.
* Documentation: Maintain the Alliances playbook so Partner Managers and sales teams follow the same engagement and handover steps.
* Reporting: Build dashboards and ad-hoc reports on partner health, performance, and ROI.
* Cross-functional work: Work with Sales, Finance, and Marketing on partner initiatives and system needs.
* AWS Marketplace operations: Run the process for listings, private offers, and Marketplace deals from quote to invoice, working with Sales and Finance.
* AWS co-sell: Manage co-sell referrals and opportunity sharing between Salesforce and AWS Partner Central, and keep the data clean enough to report on AWS-sourced and AWS-influenced pipeline.
* Marketplace platform: Own day-to-day use of our Marketplace platform (Suger/Fours, Labra, or similar), including its connection to Salesforce.
* Marketplace reporting: Track Marketplace bookings, private offer cycle time, and AWS-sourced pipeline for Alliances leadership.

**Your Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or global equivalent experience preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a specialised Partner/Channel Operations role.
* Experience supporting a Partner, Channel, or Alliances team as a dedicated business partner or in a related operational function.
* Significant AWS co-sell experience (referrals, opportunity sharing, AWS Partner Central).
* AWS Marketplace experience (private offers, listings, or reconciliation with Finance).
* Salesforce experience, including reporting and data standards.
* Clear communicator with excellent written, verbal, and listening skills.
* Ability to build relationships effectively across global teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: you can break an unclear problem into parts, diagnose it, and explain the solution clearly.
* Good to have: SAP partner experience, such as SAP Store listings, co-sell, or PartnerEdge program work.
* Good to have: MSP, reseller, or distributor experience, such as deal registration, margin and billing models, and channel partner private offers on AWS Marketplace.
* Good to have: Salesforce Partner Portal or another PRM tool.

Tech Stack
  
  

* Salesforce (required)
* Salesforce Partner Portal (required)
* AWS Partner Central (required)
* Salesforce CPQ (good to have)
* Clari (good to have)
* Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) (good to have)
* AWS Marketplace platform: Suger/Fours, Labra, or similar (required)
* Qlik or other data visualisation tool (good to have)
* Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini (good to have)

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: Market Intelligence Senior Specialist
description:
TJX Companies
  
  
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Market Intelligence, Senior Specialist**
**Purpose**
The Market Intelligence Senior Specialist delivers market, supplier, category, and risk intelligence that enables informed sourcing and business decisions across GS&P. Through market research, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement, the role translates complex external and internal data into actionable insights, strategic recommendations, and executive-ready presentations. The position supports category strategies, supplier negotiations, planning activities, and risk management efforts while leveraging AI-enabled tools and market intelligence platforms to accelerate insight generation and drive business value.
  
  
**Major Duties/ Responsibilities**

* Conduct primary and secondary research using market intelligence subscription services, AI-powered research tools, and a range of external data sources, platforms, and internal datasets to enrich market insights.
* Continuously monitor external market conditions, including regulatory, geopolitical, economic, and industry factors impacting supply markets, leveraging AI-enabled research tools and automated monitoring capabilities where appropriate.
* Leverage intelligent agents and AI-enabled solutions to automate market monitoring, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and accelerate insight generation.
* Conduct in-depth market analysis across GS&P categories, including supplier landscapes, cost drivers, pricing trends, commodity indexes, benchmarking insights, and supply/demand dynamics to support sourcing decisions, financial planning, supplier negotiations, and value identification initiatives.
* Identify risks, early warning indicators, and value creation opportunities related to supplier stability, pricing volatility, supply constraints, and market developments, assessing business impacts and providing scenario analysis and recommendations to support proactive decision-making.
* Deliver proactive alerts, trend summaries, scenario-based insights, and recommendations by combining external market intelligence with supplier, contract, spend, and business demand data to support risk mitigation, forward planning, and decision-making.
* Develop structured category intelligence outputs (e.g., market scans, supplier profiles, and intelligence packs) to support sourcing and category strategies.
* Translate complex market and supplier data into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and written summaries aligned to business priorities.
* Develop compelling executive-level narratives and recommendations that translate complex market intelligence into clear business actions and strategic decisions.
* Partner with Category Managers and sourcing teams to support RFx events, negotiations, supplier selection, and intelligence requirements aligned to specific sourcing initiatives and business questions.
* Support stakeholder understanding of external market conditions impacting pricing, availability, supplier positioning, and sourcing strategies.
* Work closely with P&A, and GS&P stakeholders to integrate intelligence into decision-making processes.
* Contribute to planning cycles by providing market insights into budgeting, forecasting, category strategies, and broader business planning activities.
* Ensure insights support key outcomes including cost optimization, risk reduction, and value delivery.
* Ensure research methodologies are structured, repeatable, and aligned to best practices.
* Build and maintain a centralised market intelligence repository and knowledge base, including templates, frameworks, and reusable outputs to standardize intelligence delivery and ensure insights are accessible, shareable, and consistently maintained across GS&P.

**Decision Making**

* Applies independent judgement in analyzing market data and forming actionable insights.
* Recommends sourcing, supplier, and strategy decisions based on market intelligence findings.
* Prioritize intelligence activities based on business value and stakeholder needs.
* Identifies trade-offs across cost, risk, and market dynamics in support of decision-making.

**Span of Control (Direct/Indirect reports)**

* Individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibility.
* Works across multiple GS&P categories and stakeholder groups.
* Influences decision-making through insights and expertise rather than formal authority.

**Scope Of Responsibility (i.e. Financial Impact)**

* Supports GS&P value delivery through improved sourcing decisions, pricing insights, and risk mitigation.
* Impacts supplier selection, negotiation outcomes, and category strategy through actionable intelligence.
* Contributes to cost optimization, supplier performance improvement, and overall procurement effectiveness.

**Skills/Knowledge**
Technical / Functional Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical capability with experience in market analysis, supplier research, and data interpretation.
* Ability to synthesize internal spend, supplier, contract, and business data with external market intelligence to generate actionable recommendations.
* Advanced ability to transform complex qualitative and quantitative data into compelling narratives, executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and visual insights that drive decision-making.
* Strong PowerPoint and presentation development skills, with experience creating clear, visually engaging, and persuasive materials for senior leadership audiences.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled research tools, intelligent agents, and market intelligence platforms.
* Understanding of procurement, sourcing processes, and supply market dynamics.
* Experience with data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI or similar) and external market research platforms.
* Familiarity with cost drivers, pricing models, and supplier economics across categories.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex insights and influence business decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and business partnering capability, with confidence presenting recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* High level of curiosity, commercial awareness, and strategic thinking.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality output under time constraints.

**Minimum Formal Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, or related discipline preferred (or equivalent experience).

**Minimum Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in market intelligence, procurement, sourcing, supplier risk, analytics, strategy, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing complex market, supplier, and business data and translating findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Experience developing executive-ready presentations and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and working within cross-functional environments.

**Job Timings**

* 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST

title: Sales & Growth Operations Executive
description:
**Sales & Growth Operations Executive**

*(Pathway to Sales Operations Lead)*

**Company**

**BeWild Produce Pvt. Ltd.**

(BeWild is part of the Beforest ecosystem)

BeWild is a premium, sustainability-led food company working across specialty coffee, native grains, pulses, fresh produce, and curated food experiences. We operate with deep respect for land, people, and craft — and we are building systems that allow us to scale without losing integrity.

**Learn more:**
**www.Bewild.life**

**Location**

Hyderabad – Jubilee Hills

Full-time | On-site | 5 days/week

**Department**

Sales & Growth

**Experience**

0–2 years (early-career professionals)

**Compensation**

**Based on experience**

Structured performance and growth review at 9–12 months

**Role Intent**

This is
**not a sales-closing role**
.

This role exists to
**build the operational backbone of sales**
— the systems, data, and processes that allow revenue to scale sustainably.

You will work closely with founders and senior leaders, not as an observer, but as a
**builder of how sales actually work**
inside the company.

Over time, this role is expected to grow into a
**Sales Operations Lead**
position, supporting multiple revenue owners and shaping how decisions are made.

**Core Responsibilities (Today)**

**1. Sales Operations & Systems**

* Own and maintain the
  **sales CRM (Zoho)**
  across all channels
* Ensure data discipline: pipeline hygiene, stage definitions, reporting accuracy

+ Design and document sales workflows for:
+ D2C
+ B2B
+ Events
+ Partnerships

* Build dashboards and reports that make sales performance visible and actionable
    
    
  **2. Revenue Enablement**

* Support sales follow-ups, customer communication, and coordination
* Work closely with founders and Sales Lead to remove friction from the sales process
* Ensure smooth handoffs between sales, operations, and production teams

**3. D2C & Experimentation**

* Execute and analyse D2C initiatives (WhatsApp marketing, repeat purchase programs, campaigns)
* Track experiments, interpret results, and recommend improvements
* Build learnings into repeatable processes

**4. Documentation & Knowledge Building**

* Create SOPs, playbooks, and internal documentation
* Ensure learnings are captured, not lost
* Contribute to cross-functional process improvement discussions

**5. AI & Modern Tools (Non-Negotiable)**

+ Use AI tools (ChatGPT, automation tools, analytics tools) to:
+ Improve productivity
+ Analyse data

* Structure documentation and communication
* Stay curious and proactive about new tools and workflows

**How This Role Grows (12–24 months)**

As the company scales, this role is expected to:

* Evolve into
  **Sales Operations Lead**
* Support
  **multiple revenue owners**
  across channels
* Provide
  **strategic sales insights**
  to founders and leadership
* Influence forecasting, capacity planning, and channel prioritisation
* Potentially mentor or guide junior operations resources

This is a
**long-term capability role**
, not a stepping stone.

**What Success Looks Like**

By 6–9 months:

* Sales data is reliable, structured, and decision-ready
* Founders spend significantly less time on manual coordination
* Sales execution feels calmer, clearer, and more predictable

By 18–24 months:

* Sales operations run independently of individuals
* Leadership decisions are informed by strong sales insights
* You are recognised internally as the
  **owner of sales operations**

**Who This Role Is For**

* Early-career professionals who enjoy building systems
* People who take pride in behind-the-scenes impact
* Calm, grounded individuals who value depth over speed
* Strong communicators with high ownership
* Candidates excited by AI, tools, and continuous improvement

**Who Should Not Apply**

* Candidates seeking a pure sale or closing role
* Those looking for remote-first work
* Frequent job-hoppers
* People motivated primarily by titles or rapid promotion

**A Note from the Founder**

At BeWild, we are building a company with depth and integrity—one that respects land, people, and craft, and is designed to last.

We value people who take ownership of real work, who are comfortable with learning curves, and who care about
*how*
things are built, not just quick outcomes. You’ll work closely with founders and senior leaders, which means high standards, direct feedback, and a strong sense of responsibility—without ego or unnecessary pressure.

We don’t over-promise titles or rush growth for optics. We prefer steady progress, clear thinking, and long-term alignment.

If you’re looking for a place to do meaningful work, grow with intention, and build something you can stand behind, you may feel at home here. If you’re seeking rapid titles or a fully defined role from day one, this may not be the right fit—and that’s okay.

—
*Shruti Ajmera Reddy*
  
Founder, BeWild

BDx Data Centers is an AI-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.

Our platform brings together secured power access, high-density design, advanced cooling capabilities, interconnection, and local market execution to accelerate delivery from grid connection to live workload. With 1.2GVA+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.

Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.

For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com

**Role Summary**

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability**

• Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.

• Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.

• Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.

• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

**2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment**

• Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.

• Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.

• Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.

• Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

**3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance**

• Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.

• Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

**4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle**

• Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

• Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.

• Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

**5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance**

• Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.

• Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.

• Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

**6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation**

• Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.

• Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.

• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

**7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management**

• Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.

• Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.

• Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

**8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management**

• Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.

• Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

**9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership**

• Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.

• Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.

• This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

**Qualification & Experience**

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.

• Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.

• Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.

• Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.

• Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.

• Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.

• Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.

• Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.

• Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.

• Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.

• Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.

• Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.

• Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

**Preferred Certifications**

• CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.

• CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.

• ITIL certification.

• Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

**At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.**

title: Corporate Credit Analysis - Greater China Coverage - Assistant Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.
  
  
ICM Credit Risk Analysts are responsible for a portfolio of relationships across Greater China owning the Credit Risk Analysis for those relationships, and being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with CCB and Risk.
  
  
**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

+ Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos
+ Drafting of Credit Approval Memo (CAM) packages including but not limited to ensuring they are complete and accurate
+ Conducting initial financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis
+ Support relationships with key stakeholders in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions
+ Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives /projects as required

* Risk Management Experience:

+ Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
+ Ability to understand financing and product structures
+ Ability to assess financial and industry data to conduct credit assessment
+ Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with stakeholders and product organizations.

* Client Relationships / Business Partnership:

+ Ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
+ Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
+ Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments & geographies and other risk functions
+ Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

+ 6-10 years relevant experience
+ Experience in effectively engaging with various functions
+ Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
+ Ability to understand the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
+ Strong verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills
+ Demonstrated influencing and negotiating ability, resolve conflicts amongst various constituencies
+ Proficient presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies
+ Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

**Education:**

+ Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, Master’s degree preferred

title: Media Operations Manager
description:
Job Description: Media Ops – Executive

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Work Mode: On-site

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 1–2 Years

Salary: ₹3–6 LPA

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and performance-driven Media Operations Executive to plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in performance marketing, campaign analytics, budget optimization, and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Conduct A/B testing of ad creatives and landing pages to improve click-through rates (CTR) and campaign performance.

- Analyze market trends, qualitative insights, and quantitative data to recommend campaign improvements.

- Monitor website traffic, user behavior, and conversion performance.

- Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

- Conduct keyword research and analysis to improve campaign targeting and effectiveness.

- Monitor campaign budgets and optimize spending to achieve performance objectives.

- Coordinate with internal teams to understand business requirements and improve lead quality and campaign outcomes.

- Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and ensure campaigns meet established objectives.

Mandatory Requirements

- 1–2 years of hands-on experience in planning, executing, and reporting PPC campaigns for multiple clients.

- Strong understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads dashboards.

- Practical experience in keyword research and analysis.

- Knowledge of campaign budget allocation and optimization.

- Understanding of digital analytics, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement.

- Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

Required Platforms & Tools

Candidates should have hands-on experience with the following platforms:

- Google Ads: Search, Display, Mobile App, and Video campaigns.

- Google Analytics: Website traffic analysis and campaign performance measurement.

- Meta Ads Manager: Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Mobile Attribution Platforms: AppsFlyer or Branch.

- Google Tag Manager (GTM): Knowledge will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented approach to digital advertising. They should be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, interpreting performance data, optimizing budgets, and collaborating with internal teams to drive measurable results.

Compensation

Annual CTC: ₹3–6 LPA, depending on experience and skills.

title: AMC Partnerships & Ops Manager
description:
**Primary Skillset:**
AMC Empanelment, Investor Operations, Case Resolution, Follow-ups & Written Communication

**Years of Work Ex:**
2 - 5 yrs

**Minimum Qualifications:**
Bachelors in any field; MBA / MMS preferred

**Location:**
Nariman Point, Mumbai

**Timings:**
10am - 7pm; Monday to Friday

**Work Type:**
On-Site, 5 days a week

**Company Description:**

PaisaSmart is the operating brand name for Elixir Equities Pvt. Ltd. (EEPL), a financial services firm with operations in Prop Trading, Stock Broking, Portfolio Management & Mutual Fund distribution, and over 20 years in wealth management under founders who are recognised industry leaders.

Our mission is to build wealth for the next 100m Indians. PaisaSmart is how - a WhatsApp chatbot and an Android/iOS app that make investing simple for people who have never invested.

We ship fast. We work under broker, RA, PMS and MFD licences, so we ship fast without being careless with other people's money - doing both is the actual job.

Our values are humility, curiosity and passion. Socials: YT | Insta | LinkedIn. Try the product: message 8808990978 on WhatsApp.

**Application Process:**

1. Apply on our site. Screening happens immediately by our AI agent, no waiting immediate pass/fail.
2. One day of in-person interviews at our offices (you select a date & time) with the founder and team.
3. If we like you we make a decision immediately and share an offer.

**What You'll Own:**

* **AMC Empanelment:**
  This is a doing job. We are empanelled with 12 of 45 AMCs; you take us to 45 in your first three quarters, and you do it yourself - the forms, the follow-ups, the meetings.
* **AMC Relationships:**
  Most AMC distribution teams sit in Mumbai. You get each AMC's representative into our office regularly and make the visit worth their time. Along the way you find the right marketing contact at each AMC and hand it to our marketing team.
* **Customer Cases:**
  Every account or transaction problem is yours from the moment it is flagged - by the customer or by our case manager - until it is fixed and the customer has been told. You chase it yourself: mostly our back-office software vendor, the payment gateway and the KRA, sometimes an RTA, an AMC or our own engineers.
* **Root Causes, Not Tickets:**
  Every case gets a category; every category that keeps coming back goes to the product and tech team with your diagnosis of what broke. The measure of your work is how many case types stop existing.
* **The Tracker:**
  Empanelments live, open cases and how old they are, repeat rate by category. You build it and you own the targets. You work alongside the Head of Inside Sales, whose calling team hears from customers first.

**How We Work:**

* Small team, highly collaborative but individual responsibilities. Growth isn't gated on tenure. If you can do the next job, you get it.
* You work directly with the founder. No layer in between, nobody to hide behind. No office politics, no blame games, direct visibility.
* High responsibility, high level of freedom, minimal guidance. Find a problem, design a solution, fix it. You own your work end to end, including when something goes wrong at 9pm.
* If you're right you're right. No hierarchy, no "do it cause the boss said so". Best argument wins, regardless of who made it.
* Everyone is expected to do 2-3 different tasks. With AI tooling enabling us to learn and do more than ever before come in with one core skillset and learn & apply 1-2 completely new skills with us.

**Who This Is For:**

* You teach yourself things nobody assigned you.
* The problem is clear, the solution isn't, and that excites you.
* You want real responsibility and opportunity to make an impact immediately.

**Who It Isn't For:**

* You want a defined ladder and a manager who assigns your work.
* You want remote or hybrid. This is on-site, five days, and we're not flexible.
* You'd rather specialise narrowly than learn new things.

**Requirements:**

Be genuinely strong on one side of this role and show us evidence on the other - we'll teach you the rest.

* 2 - 5 years in operations, compliance or legal admin at a mutual fund distributor, broker, wealth firm or RTA.
* NISM Series V-A certified, or you clear it in your first month.
* You write clear, professional emails, and your third follow-up is as polite and as precise as your first.
* You have chased one counterparty for two weeks on something that wasn't their priority, and closed it.
* You keep your own tracker without being asked, and nothing in it is older than it should be.
* You can sit with an engineer to work out what broke, and explain it to a customer in plain language.

**Compensation:**

* 15 days paid vacation.
* Salary is competitive and varies substantially based on the skillset of an individual candidate.
* EEPL offers an ESOP program to select employees.

description:
**E-commerce Operations Manager**

**Company: Confidential | Fast-Growing D2C Brand**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Experience: 2+ Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Work Mode: On-site**

**Compensation: 12 to 15 LPA**

**About the Company**

We are hiring on behalf of a fast-growing Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand operating in the e-commerce space.

The company is focused on scaling its business through efficient supply chain management, streamlined fulfillment operations, and an exceptional customer experience. With an expanding operational infrastructure comprising in-house warehousing and third-party logistics partners, the company is looking for a driven operations professional to support its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven
**E-commerce Operations Manager**
to take end-to-end ownership of the company's back-end business operations.

The ideal candidate will oversee supply chain management, inventory planning, warehouse operations, third-party logistics (3PL), shipping, packaging, and customer support operations.

This role requires someone who can independently manage operational functions, anticipate challenges, resolve issues before they escalate, and build scalable systems without requiring constant founder involvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Supply Chain & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate with suppliers on production, quality, and delivery schedules.
* Plan inventory levels based on sales velocity and media buying projections.
* Prevent stockouts of fast-moving products and overstocking of slow-moving products.
* Manage inbound shipments, verify quantities, inspect product quality, and update inventory systems.
* Maintain accurate inventory visibility across in-house warehouses and 3PL locations.

**2. Third-Party Logistics (3PL) & Fulfillment**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all 3PL fulfillment partners.
* Manage inventory allocation and replenishment across 3PL warehouses.
* Monitor partner performance against service-level agreements (SLAs), including dispatch timelines, order accuracy, product handling, and damages.
* Conduct regular inventory reconciliation between internal systems and 3PL records.
* Resolve fulfillment delays, discrepancies, and operational exceptions promptly.
* Identify, onboard, and negotiate terms with new 3PL partners as the business expands into new regions.

**3. In-House Warehouse Operations**

* Build, manage, and lead warehouse teams, including pickers, packers, and quality control staff.
* Establish efficient warehouse systems, including bin locations, packing standards, and security protocols.
* Ensure 100% same-day dispatch for orders received within the designated cutoff time.
* Maintain inventory accuracy of 99% or above through regular cycle counts and reconciliation.
* Investigate and eliminate inventory shrinkage, theft, and operational inefficiencies.

**4. Shipping & Logistics**

* Manage relationships with shipping and logistics partners.
* Negotiate shipping rates and resolve delivery-related issues.
* Oversee returns processing and implement strategies to reduce Return to Origin (RTO) rates.
* Ensure international shipping documentation is accurate and compliant.

**5. Packaging & Creative Coordination**

* Coordinate with graphic designers on packaging designs and updates.
* Manage inventory of packaging materials, including boxes, inserts, labels, and other supplies.
* Ensure adequate packaging stock based on projected order volumes across in-house and 3PL fulfillment locations.

**6. Customer Support Oversight**

* Hire, manage, and oversee the customer support team or customer support manager.
* Ensure customer queries and complaints are resolved within established SLAs.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction standards.
* Identify recurring customer complaints and address their underlying operational causes.

**7. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with the media buying team on projected order volumes and operational capacity planning.
* Provide relevant operational data for financial reporting.
* Identify and communicate operational constraints before they impact business growth.
* Ensure alignment between marketing projections and operational readiness.

**8. Process Development, Systems & Analytics**

* Develop, implement, and document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all operational functions.
* Build operational redundancy to eliminate single points of failure.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), prepare reports, and make data-driven decisions.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Scale operational infrastructure ahead of anticipated business growth.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Minimum 2 years of experience in e-commerce operations or online retail management.**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, or a related field.
* Proficiency in e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, or equivalent platforms.
* Hands-on experience coordinating with 3PL partners and fulfillment systems.
* Experience with inventory management systems.
* Strong Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Familiarity with CRM and customer service platforms.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, multitasking abilities, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience working with D2C brands.
* Experience scaling e-commerce businesses in high-growth environments.
* Hands-on experience managing multi-location warehousing and 3PL fulfillment operations.
* Knowledge of payment processing and dispute management.
* Familiarity with Facebook Ads Manager and digital marketing operations.
* Experience managing logistics partners and optimizing shipping processes.
* Experience with process automation and workflow optimization.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Independently manage back-end operations with minimal founder involvement.
* Proactively identify and resolve operational challenges before they escalate.
* Achieve 100% same-day dispatch for eligible orders.
* Maintain inventory accuracy of 99% or above.
* Ensure consistent fulfillment performance and customer satisfaction.
* Build scalable operational systems capable of supporting
  **3,000 orders per day**
  across in-house and 3PL fulfillment channels without operations becoming a bottleneck.

**What We Offer**

* End-to-end ownership of e-commerce business operations.
* An opportunity to work closely with the founding team of a fast-growing D2C brand.
* Hands-on exposure to scaling warehouse, supply chain, and fulfillment infrastructure.
* Autonomy to build operational systems, processes, and teams.
* Opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic, high-growth business environment.

title: SD US Verification - Team Lead, Operations
description:
**Team Lead - OCE**
We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.
  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.
  
  
**About First Advantage**
First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.
  
  
Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.

* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes across operations, quality, training, and client-facing teams.

title: Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO) Facility Manager, Infraops
description:
****DESCRIPTION****
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Management and leadership of DCEO Engineering Team. Executes vision and goals for the team or department.
* Responsible for the overall operation and maintenance (both routine and emergency) of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations of Data Centers. Has primary responsibility for availability zone of Data Centers.
* Managing and developing teams of shift engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. Is active in the training and/or development of others.
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups. Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
* Participates in strategic planning projects. Helping in design, build and bring online new Data Centers. Negotiates and rolls out contracts and space.
* Assisting & managing relationships with vendors & contractors.
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance. Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes.
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management and reporting. Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met.
* Participates in recruiting efforts and performance management of the existing team. Continually raises the bar.
* Conducts financial analysis and contributes to financial decisions. Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers.
* Responsible for asset and inventory management.
* Assist in the design and build out of new facilities & multiple projects to increase current facility efficiency. Oversee the build out of Facility-specific infrastructure in existing locations.

**Basic Qualifications**

* An engineering degree or equivalent in an Electrical or Mechanical discipline.
* 06+ years of relevant engineering experience managing large scale services.
* At least 3 years building strong, successful technical teams in a similar culture.
* High degree of organization and detail-orientation.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering complex projects
* Ability to consistently deliver results despite competing priorities and distractions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a management position with 5 or more direct reports
* 3+ year prior ownership of the operation of a mission-critical team and/or product.
* Ability to consistently deliver results despite competing priorities and distractions.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
Responsible for the on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices and procedures.
  
  

* Has primary responsibility for availability zone of Data Centers (2-4 locations)
* Participates in strategic planning projects.
* Conducts financial analysis and contributes to financial decisions.
* Typically manages 5 or more direct reports.
* Negotiates and rolls out contracts and space.
* May oversee the build out of Facility-specific infrastructure in existing locations.
* Participates in recruiting efforts. Continually raises the bar.
* Is active in the training and/or development of others.
* Executes vision and goals for the team or department.
* Will conduct Project Management for multiple sites
* May participate in training of staff.
* Draws from a deep group or department level understanding to make business decisions.
* Uses business knowledge to set priorities and develop project plans.
* Has a deep understanding of best practices in their area of expertise and ensures their application.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Able to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
* Creates work plans and monitors accomplishments.
* Will contribute to the development of the project plan for the business group.
* Effectively sets priorities to meet goals on budget and on time.
* Demonstrates strong people/program management skills.
* Is resourceful, maintains effective pace and gets things done.
* May manage individuals and/or other managers in remote locations.
* Insists on the highest standards from self and others. Drives accountability for results.
* Keeps others informed of information that contributes to the performance of the team, department or company.
* Engenders trust and respect in all working relationships.
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance.
* Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency.
* Operate and manage both routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
* May assist in the design and build out of new facilities.
* May assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency.
* Responsible for asset and inventory management.
* Assist in recruiting efforts.
* Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met.

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
****BASIC QUALIFICATIONS****

* 3+ years of people management and team development experience
* 6+ years of engineering work managing large-scale services experience
* Experience in root cause analysis and troubleshooting or problem solving
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****

* 3+ years of work in data centers with an emphasis on building and equipment operation experience
* Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
* Experience in a management position with 5 or more direct reports

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
