title: Content Operations, Senior Manager Asia and MENA
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About Crunchyroll**
Crunchyroll connects anime fans around the world with the stories, characters, creators, and communities they love. Regional Localization & Operations makes Crunchyroll’s content, products, communications, and fan experiences locally relevant, accessible, operationally ready, and consistently executed across markets.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Manager, Content Operations - Asia + MENA will lead the operational readiness, delivery, and ongoing management of Crunchyroll’s content across Asia and MENA, based in Mumbai. This role will ensure that titles, episodes, metadata, artwork, subtitles, dubs, ratings, rights information, partner assets, and related content components are complete, accurate, compliant, and available on time across relevant platforms and channels.
  
  
You will work across Content, Localization & Dubbing, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Creative Services, Communications, Legal, Customer Experience, Data, Finance, and external vendors and distribution partners. The role will connect content planning with execution, ensuring that regional launches are delivered smoothly and that operational issues are identified, escalated, and resolved quickly.
  
  
This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong content operations expertise, project management discipline, attention to detail, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate across multiple markets, time zones, platforms, and launch priorities.
  
  
Role Overview - Lead Regional Content Operations
  
  

* Develop and manage content operations processes for Asia and MENA across content intake, planning, preparation, delivery, launch, and post-launch support.
* Establish clear workflows, operating standards, ownership models, timelines, dependencies, and escalation paths for regional content execution.
* Coordinate the operational lifecycle of titles and episodes across direct-to-consumer, distribution, partner, and à la carte channel experiences.
* Ensure content packages are complete, accurate, and delivered according to market, platform, partner, and launch requirements.
* Maintain visibility into content readiness, delivery status, risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and open issues across the region.

Drive Launch and Market Readiness
  
  

* Lead regional content readiness for new title launches, seasonal programming, simulcasts, catalog releases, campaigns, partner activations, and market expansions.
* Build and maintain launch checklists, readiness trackers, milestone plans, and operational dashboards.
* Coordinate with Content, Localization & Dubbing, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Communications, Customer Experience, and Legal to ensure launch requirements are met.
* Confirm that localized content dubs, and partner deliverables are ready for launch.
* Identify launch risks early and drive mitigation plans, escalation, and resolution.
* Support post-launch reviews to identify operational gaps, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

Manage local Content Assets
  
  

* Oversee the readiness, accuracy, and delivery of content assets, including video files, audio tracks, and dubs
* Establish quality-control checks for content packages and coordinate correction of missing, inaccurate, or technically non-compliant assets.
* Partner with Localization & Dubbing teams to track language coverage, dubbing delivery, subtitle readiness, and quality-control status.
* Ensure content information is consistent across internal systems, consumer experiences, partner platforms, and distribution channels.
* Maintain effective asset tracking, version control, documentation, and auditability across the content lifecycle.

Coordinate Partners and Vendors
  
  

* Manage operational relationships with localization vendors, dubbing studios, post-production providers, content aggregators, distribution partners, platforms, and other external service providers.
* Establish clear briefs, delivery specifications, service levels, schedules, quality expectations, and issue-resolution processes.
* Monitor vendor and partner performance across timeliness, completeness, quality, responsiveness, capacity, and cost.
* Coordinate onboarding, operational reviews, performance improvement plans, and continuous process enhancement for relevant partners.
* Ensure partner and vendor deliverables are aligned with Crunchyroll’s regional launch and content standards.

Support Regional and Global Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as a key operational contact between Asia and MENA regional teams, global Content Operations, Localization, Product, Engineering, and other enterprise functions.
* Translate regional market requirements and operational needs into clear inputs for global planning and platform processes.
* Coordinate handoffs, dependencies, decisions, and actions across teams operating in different markets and time zones.
* Provide clear reporting on readiness, performance, operational risks, incidents, and actions required from regional or global stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships across a matrixed organization and influence outcomes without formal authority.

Improve Operational Quality and Scale
  
  

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, templates, checklists, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale content operations across Asia and MENA.
* Analyze recurring defects, delays, incidents, and operational bottlenecks to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* Establish and track operational metrics such as readiness, on-time delivery, asset completeness, defect rates, issue aging, vendor performance, and launch quality.
* Share best practices and market learnings across regional and global teams.
* Support business continuity, incident response, and operational resilience for content delivery and availability.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in content operations, media operations, streaming operations, localization operations, post-production, distribution operations, or a related field.
* Experience managing content delivery and operational readiness across multiple markets, platforms, channels, or distribution partners.
* Strong understanding of content supply chains, including video and dubs, technical delivery requirements.
* Experience coordinating complex launches with multiple dependencies, stakeholders, vendors, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to build and improve operational processes, workflows, checklists, dashboards, and quality-control frameworks.
* Experience managing external vendors, content providers, localization partners, post-production teams, or distribution partners.
* Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Content, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Localization, Legal, Customer Experience, Data, and global teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard for content accuracy, completeness, quality, and timeliness.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and translate findings into practical improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise executive and operational updates.
* Comfort working across time zones and in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
* Willingness to travel regionally and internationally as required.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of relevant Asia or MENA languages is a significant plus.
* Knowledge and passion for anime, entertainment, streaming, and fan communities is a significant plus.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
* Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
* Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
* Health Saving Account HSA program
* Health care and dependent care FSA
* 401(k) plan, with employer match
* Employer paid commuter benefit
* Support program for new parents
* Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

**About Our Values**
We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
  
  

* Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
* Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
* Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
* Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
  
  
Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

Please beware of recent scams to online job seekers. Those applying to our job openings will only be contacted directly from @crunchyroll.com email account.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Title: Social Media Marketer & Content Creator

**Location:** Mumbai, Goreagon (In-person)  
**Organization:** Viaana Foundation  
**Compensation:** ₹30,000 - ₹55,000 per month (Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and skill set)

**About Viaana Foundation**

Viaana Foundation works to create meaningful social impact through partnerships, education initiatives, rural development programs, teacher capacity building, community engagement, and innovative grassroots interventions. We are looking for a highly creative, self-driven Social Media Marketer who can take complete ownership of our digital presence and help build a strong, engaged community around our work.

**Role Overview**

This is not a typical social media management role.

We're looking for someone who can own our social media end-to-end: from developing content ideas and storytelling angles to creating visuals, scripting videos, editing content, managing pages, and driving audience growth.

You will have significant creative freedom to experiment with formats, campaigns, and storytelling approaches that help us increase visibility, engagement, and community support. This is a role with significant growth opportunity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Content Strategy & Social Media Growth

* Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
* Identify trends, formats, and storytelling styles that capture attention and drive engagement.
* Build follower growth strategies and increase audience engagement organically.
* Create monthly content calendars aligned with organizational activities and campaigns.

**Creative Content Development**

* Conceptualize and create high-quality content that simplifies and humanizes social impact work.
* Develop compelling storylines around programs, beneficiaries, partners, volunteers, and field activities.
* Script reels, videos, interviews, and short-form content designed to maximize reach and engagement.
* Brainstorm innovative campaigns that inspire action, awareness, partnerships, and donations.

**Design & Multimedia Production**

* Design creatives, carousels, infographics, and campaign assets.
* Capture and edit photos and videos.
* Create reels, short-form videos, motion graphics, and platform-specific content. (Major requirement)
* Maintain visual consistency across all digital channels.

**Social Media Management**

* Manage day-to-day posting across all platforms.
* Write engaging captions and optimize content for platform algorithms.
* Monitor comments, messages, and audience interactions.
* Track performance metrics and continuously improve content based on insights.

**Brand Building**

* Establish a distinct and recognizable voice for Viaana Foundation.
* Create content that strengthens credibility with donors, CSR teams, foundations, volunteers, and community members.
* Support digital promotion of partnerships, events, campaigns, reports, and impact stories.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in social media marketing, content creation, digital marketing, or related fields.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating content creation, page growth, creative campaigns, or video production.
* Proficiency in tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
* Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills.
* Understanding of social media analytics and growth strategies.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of outcomes.
* Passion for social impact, education, development, or nonprofit work is a strong plus.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks like a creator, not just an executor.
* Understands how to make people stop scrolling.
* Can turn field activities into compelling stories.
* Takes initiative and brings fresh ideas regularly.
* Is comfortable experimenting and learning from data.
* Can manage multiple content formats and platforms simultaneously.

**What We Offer**

* Significant creative freedom and ownership.
* Opportunity to shape the public voice of a growing social impact organization.
* Direct exposure to meaningful grassroots work and sector partnerships.
* Flexible and collaborative work environment.
* Competitive compensation with room for growth based on performance.

**To Apply**

Please share:

* Your resume
* Portfolio (social media pages, campaigns, videos, designs, or relevant work)
* Links to social media accounts you have managed
* A brief note on a nonprofit or brand whose social media presence you admire and why

**Subject Line:** Application - Social Media Marketer - Viaana Foundation

Drop an email on haadi.n@viaanafoundation.org

title: Creative, Community & Digital Strategist – Izipizi Street | Together Hospitality
description:
**Creative, Community & Digital Strategist – Izipizi Street | Together Hospitality**

* Location: Kalyani Nagar, Pune – office-based and on-ground
* Experience: 3–5 years
* CTC: ₹6.5–8.5 LPA, based on experience
* Employment: Full-time, five days a week, mid-week offs
* Reports to: Brand Marketing Manager, Izipizi Street
* Works with: Designers, videographers, PR & Creator Partnerships Executive and restaurant teams

**About Together Hospitality**

Together Hospitality is a growing independent hospitality group behind Cobbler & Crew, Juju, Gather and Izipizi Street. Our sister brand, Elephant & Co., operates in Pune and Goa. Every brand is an original concept with its own identity and audience. We invest as much in our people as we do in our restaurants.

**About Izipizi Street**

Izipizi Street is a Southeast Asian street food market with in-house hawker kitchens, a bar and a shop. We make our noodles by hand, fold dimsum fresh daily and brew our Vietnamese lager, Izi Bia Hoi, with Great State.

Every month, the street explores a different country's food and culture through Night Markets. Izipizi is our first brand designed to expand into more neighbourhoods.

**About the Role**

You will own Izipizi's voice, online and in print, deciding what the brand says, how it says it and to whom.

This is a thinking role before it is a posting role. Your content, ideas and community initiatives should give guests reasons to visit, discover new dishes, attend Night Markets, bring friends for Bia Hoi or order in.

We want your thinking, taste and voice, not content produced on demand or dependent on AI tools. Bring bold ideas and explain why they will work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Content Strategy and Planning**

* Develop monthly content plans around country themes, Night Markets, launches, offers and collaborations.
* Define content pillars, platforms and formats, adapting them based on performance.
* Drive footfall, priority dish sales, Bia Hoi sales and delivery orders.
* Finalise plans with the Brand Marketing Manager before each month and maintain weekly posting schedules.
* Review reach, saves, shares, comments and guest feedback weekly. Identify what worked, what didn't and what needs to change.
* Reinforce Izipizi's positioning: easy to share, fairly priced and full of discovery.

**2. Writing, Ideas and IPs**

* Write captions, reel scripts, hooks, menus, table cards, signage, delivery listings and campaign copy.
* Develop and name original IPs and events, explaining their audience, brand relevance and business potential.
* Finalise IP and Night Market concepts, names and copy 30 days ahead.
* Research each country's food, markets, drinks, music and everyday culture, avoiding stereotypes.
* Understand what Izipizi's guests find funny, share and visit for.
* Develop a one-page voice guide within 60 days, ensure its use and review it quarterly.
* Verify names, prices and details with kitchen and bar teams. Follow alcohol advertising regulations.

**3. Creative Direction**

* Brief designers and videographers before every assignment, defining the idea, audience, format and hook.
* Develop visual concepts alongside copy and capture timely phone content.
* Own creative direction and briefs for every creator visit.
* Bring references from food, street culture, music, design and the internet into planning.
* Review final work and provide specific feedback until it is right.

**4. Community Management**

* Build an organic community of regulars, food lovers, students, office-goers and neighbourhood residents.
* Personally publish content and respond promptly to every DM, comment and review. Responses must be thoughtful, guest-specific and in Izipizi's voice, without templates.
* Identify, share and encourage guest-generated content.
* Work with CRM to engage regulars and win back guests.
* Speak to guests regularly and incorporate feedback into planning.
* Track competitors and leading food brands in India and abroad.
* Submit monthly community reports covering DMs, reviews, guest posts and feedback.
* Present new content and IP ideas quarterly.

**5. Daily Responsibilities**

* Attend morning stand-ups, set priorities, review previous-day performance, respond to guests, write, plan, brief teams and review creative work. Spend time at Izipizi several times weekly and attend key events.
* How Your Performance Will Be Measured
* Content and campaigns contributing to footfall, IP attendance, Bia Hoi and delivery sales.
* Distinct brand voice, genuine saves and shares, and most work approved within one round.
* Timely plans, posts, briefs and copy.
* Organic community growth, unsolicited guest content and personalised responses. No purchased engagement.
* Bold, well-reasoned ideas becoming part of the brand calendar.
* Error-free menus, listings and posts.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–5 years in content strategy, social media, copywriting or community management at an agency, media brand or in-house team.
* A deep, genuine interest in Southeast Asian food and culture is essential.
* Some experience with food, drink, hospitality or lifestyle brands.
* Proven organic community-building experience, without purchased followers, likes or comments.
* A portfolio of independently planned and written content with measurable results.
* Experience briefing designers and video teams.
* Strong English writing, ideation, naming and visual thinking skills.
* Understanding of young India's online behaviour and what makes people stop, save, share and visit.
* Ability to interpret content analytics alongside business performance.
* Creative judgement to distinguish good content from trending content and explain what is on-brand or off-brand.
* Ability to identify emerging trends, shoot phone content and manage deadlines.
* Southeast Asian travel, cooking or food knowledge, familiarity with Izipizi and opinions on its improvement, and Hindi or Marathi writing skills are advantages.
* Be curious, reliable, comfortable with guests and receptive to feedback. Bring original ideas and defend them with reasoning.

**Working Details**

You direct design, video and creator work. Specialist teams execute final designs, edits, advertising, listings, creator contracts, payments, logistics and PR.

Mostly daytime hours, with evening and weekend events, particularly Friday–Sunday. October–December is our busiest period.

* Probation: Six months, with a three-month KRA review.
* Career progression: Senior Strategist, followed by Brand Marketing Manager as the team grows.

**Employee Benefits**

* Maternity Leave: Six months of fully paid maternity leave.
* Mental Health Support: Free therapy and counselling, alongside in-house mental health sessions.
* Fair Pay: Industry-standard salaries and a commitment to pay parity.
* Growth: Internal promotions and career development opportunities.
* Training: Weekly learning and development sessions.
* Meals: Lunch is on us

**What to Do Next**

Apply with your CV, links to accounts or communities you have grown, five pieces of content you planned and wrote, and a one-page content plan for an Izipizi Night Market week, including captions and one IP name.

Complete the assignment yourself, without AI tools.

Hiring includes portfolio and assignment review, organic engagement assessment, a conversation about Southeast Asian food and culture, a live ideas exercise, a meeting with the Brand Marketing Manager and reference checks.

Work closely with the content and marketing teams to conceptualise and execute creative campaigns. Adapt designs for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and websites. title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client management**

Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients). Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard. 

Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it. 

Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction. 

Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month. Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day. 

Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
**Reporting & strategy**

 

Daily/weekly: Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week. 

Monthly: Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead. 

Quarterly: Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full clarity on the quarter's deliverables. 

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks. 

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.
**Delivery & process**

Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks. Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client. 

Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.

**Sales & growth**

Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role. 

Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge. 

Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments. 

**AI-first ways of working**

Use TIC's AI-powered account management processes to cut the time spent on repetitive work (briefing, reporting, task planning) without lowering the quality of client communication or the depth of relationships. 

Update your client CIDs every month, in a meaningful and detailed way. 

Fill in timesheets accurately.

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

A client-first, ownership mindset, with a strong focus on long-term retention and relationships. The ability to think like a marketer and understand the strategy behind a client's account, not just the task list. 

Excellent written communication, including clear, detailed briefs, meeting notes and client reports. Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to plan work a month ahead and track scope weekly across several accounts. 

Proactiveness: spotting early signs of client distress and raising flags with solutions, not just problems. An eye for quality and the discipline to follow process (PM tool, trackers, timesheets). Commercial awareness to spot upsell opportunities and follow up on payments. 

Comfort working with AI tools to make repetitive work more efficient.

title: ServiceNow - System Administrator
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**ServiceNow System Administrator**
**Experience:**
6+ Years |
**Certification:**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Role Summary**
The ServiceNow System Administrator will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, operational support, security, stability, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform. The role requires strong hands-on experience in platform administration, production troubleshooting, upgrades and patching, deployments, access management, integrations, and Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support ServiceNow Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments, ensuring platform stability and availability.
* Troubleshoot production incidents involving workflows, Business Rules, integrations, authentication, notifications, scheduled jobs, performance, and platform configuration.
* Plan and support ServiceNow releases, upgrades, patches, and hotfixes, including impact assessment, skipped-record review, regression validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
* Perform code migrations and deployments using Update Sets, Application Repository, and established release-management processes.
* Define, develop, maintain, and execute ATF test cases and suites for critical business processes, upgrades, patches, and releases.
* Monitor platform health, integrations, scheduled jobs, email processing, failed transactions, logs, and performance indicators, proactively addressing operational issues.
* Administer platform components including system properties, plugins, notifications, Flow Designer, Service Catalog, Import Sets, Transform Maps, and scheduled processes.
* Support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, SSO, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
* Work closely with Engineering Leads, Developers, Architects, Security, Infrastructure, and ServiceNow Support on complex issues, platform improvements, and operational governance.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, primarily in platform administration and production support.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) required.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale, multi-environment ServiceNow implementations.
* Demonstrated experience managing production incidents, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and deployments.
* Experience supporting key ServiceNow capabilities such as ITSM, CMDB, HAM/SAM, SecOps, HRSD, or SPM is preferred.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, SSO, MID Servers, Discovery, IntegrationHub, and privileged credential solutions such as CyberArk is desirable.
* Experience working within a highly governed or regulated enterprise environment is preferred.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI

plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person.

**Experience: 4 to 5 Years**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Client management
* Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients).
* Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague
* assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard.
* Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it.
* Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction.
* Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month.
* Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day.
* Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
* Reporting & strategy

**Daily/weekly:**
Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week.

**Monthly:**
Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the

relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead.

**Quarterly:**
Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full

clarity on the quarter's deliverables.

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks.

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.

**Delivery & process**

* Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks.
* Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client.
* Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.Sales & growth
* Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role.
* Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge.
* Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments.
* AI-first ways of working Use TIC's AI-powered account management processes to cut the time spent on repetitive work (briefing, reporting, task planning) without lowering the quality of client communication or the depth of relationships.
* Update your client CIDs every month, in a meaningful and detailed way.
* Fill in timesheets accurately.

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

* A client-first, ownership mindset, with a strong focus on long-term retention and relationships.
* The ability to think like a marketer and understand the strategy behind a client's account, not just the task list.
* Excellent written communication, including clear, detailed briefs, meeting notes and client reports.
* Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to plan work a month ahead and track scope weekly across several accounts.
* Proactiveness: spotting early signs of client distress and raising flags with solutions, not just problems.
* An eye for quality and the discipline to follow process (PM tool, trackers, timesheets).
* Commercial awareness to spot upsell opportunities and follow up on payments.
* Comfort working with AI tools to make repetitive work more efficient.

title: Client Servicing & Social Media Executive
description:

Whitedot Adverts is a dynamic and fast-growing advertising and branding agency focused on creating impactful digital experiences. We specialize in integrated marketing campaigns, creative content development, and data-driven strategies that help brands connect meaningfully with their audiences.

As part of our expansion, we’re looking for passionate, creative, and result-driven professionals to join our team.

Social Media Strategy & Execution

* Create and manage detailed content calendars for multiple clients
* Plan and execute organic and paid social media campaigns across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, Threads, etc.)
* Experiment with new formats such as Reels, Shorts, Stories, and Live sessions

Content Creation & Management

* Create and oversee engaging, high-quality content (text, image, and video)
* Coordinate with designers, copywriters, and video editors to ensure brand consistency

Community Reputation & Management

**Brand Marketing Manager – Elephant & Co. | Together Hospitality**

* Location: Pune (Kalyani Nagar and Baner), with monthly travel to Goa
* Experience: 4–6 years
* CTC: ₹9–12 LPA, based on experience
* Employment: Full-time, five days a week
* Reports to: Senior Marketing Manager (Brand & Creative Lead)
* Manages: Digital Executive (Elephant & Co.)

**About Together Hospitality**

Together Hospitality is an independent hospitality group behind Cobbler & Crew, Juju, Gather and Izipizi Street. Our sister brand, Elephant & Co., operates in Pune and Goa. Each brand is an original concept with its own audience. We believe hospitality is a team sport and invest as much in our people as we do in our restaurants.

**About Elephant & Co.**

Elephant & Co. opened in Kalyani Nagar in 2016. It is a neighbourhood bar built around regulars, where the team remembers names, drinks and stories.

Today, Elephant & Co. operates across Kalyani Nagar, Baner and Goa. Each venue has its own character while sharing the same approach to hospitality.

**About the Role**

You will be responsible for Elephant & Co.'s brand performance and business growth across all three venues. Your job is to bring in new guests, retain regulars, grow weeknight business, increase private bookings and maintain the brand's reputation.

You will lead creative direction, brand planning, events, partnerships and team delivery while working closely with Restaurant Managers, kitchen and bar teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth and Marketing**

* Own monthly marketing plans for each venue, covering sales, footfall, repeat visits, average spend and private bookings.
* Conduct weekly business reviews with each Restaurant Manager, agree on actions and follow through.
* Identify why targets are not being met and prepare recovery plans within the same week, without waiting to be asked.
* Plan advertising spend with the Performance & Listings Executive and measure results.
* Test new recurring event concepts (IPs), formats, offers and partnerships with Restaurant Managers. Expand what works.
* Build reasons for guests to visit on quieter weeknights.
* Work with the CRM team to recognise regulars and bring back guests who have stopped visiting.
* Support private party and corporate booking promotions.

**2. Brand Planning and Creative Direction**

* Own the brand calendar across all three venues, covering events, IPs, campaigns and collaborations.
* Finalise calendars and events 30 days ahead, and menu changes 45 days ahead, with kitchen, bar and service teams.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business goals and the team's ability to deliver.
* Maintain brand consistency while respecting each venue's character.
* Write briefs explaining what we are communicating, who it is for and what it needs to achieve.
* Work with the Social Media Strategy Consultant on weekly content plans and the Creative Strategist on menus, IPs and campaigns.
* Involve designers and video teams from the briefing stage.
* Review and approve creative work, giving specific feedback until it meets brand standards.

**3. Team Management and Delivery**

* Manage the Digital Executive, set priorities, review work and develop their skills.
* Maintain a daily task tracker with owners and deadlines.
* Coordinate with shared design, production, listings and PR teams.
* Ensure advertising creatives are ready at least five days before launch.
* Identify risks early and take responsibility for late, unclear or off-brand work.
* Attend morning stand-ups, review daily sales, reviews and bookings, and keep leadership informed of results and recovery actions.

**4. Restaurant Operations, Events and Goa**

* Spend time at both Pune venues and meet restaurant, kitchen and bar teams weekly.
* Brief service teams before every launch, offer and event.
* Manage events end to end, including artists, vendors, promotion, coverage and coordination.
* Attend key events and submit reports within 48 hours. Ensure guestlists and content reach the CRM and content library.
* Ensure compliance with event licences, noise regulations and alcohol advertising rules.
* Plan with Goa weekly and visit for one to two days monthly, giving all venues equal marketing attention.
* Manage menus, signage, table cards and guest experience cards.
* Ensure accurate listings across Zomato, Swiggy, District and Google.

**5. Partnerships, Community and Research**

* Manage partnerships with liquor brands, sponsors, creators and other brands. Track and deliver commitments.
* Build relationships with regulars and develop recurring events and traditions.
* Support PR on brand stories, including Elephant & Co.'s ten-year milestone.
* Speak to guests, study competitors and develop venue-specific marketing plans.
* Bring ideas from neighbourhood bars in India and abroad.

**How Your Performance Will Be Measured**

* Business growth: Meet monthly sales targets, grow repeat visits and weeknight footfall quarter on quarter, and test new revenue ideas quarterly.
* Planning: Finalise calendars 30 days ahead and deliver campaigns, events and launches on time.
* Team delivery: Meet deadlines, resolve risks early and develop your team member.
* Creative quality: Maintain brand consistency and ensure work rarely needs more than one round of changes.
* Partnerships and events: Attract new guests, retain regulars and meet partner commitments.
* Reputation: Improve Google and Zomato ratings across all venues.
* Submit monthly business and brand reports for each venue.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4–6 years in brand management or marketing, including at least two years with a bar, restaurant, hotel or F&B lifestyle brand.
* Direct team management experience, beyond agencies and freelancers.
* Experience owning business results, not just marketing activities.
* End-to-end event management and experience working with liquor brands or sponsors.
* Experience working with designers and video teams.
* Strong creative judgement, briefing, feedback and project management skills.
* Ability to interpret sales reports and understand different venue audiences.
* Knowledge of alcohol advertising, event licensing and noise regulations.
* Knowledge of Pune and Goa's bar scenes, an interest in hospitality operations and being a regular at Elephant & Co. are strong advantages.

**Working Details**

Expect some evenings and weekends, with mid-week offs. October to December is our busiest period. Probation is six months, with a performance review after three months.

Specialist teams handle creative production, advertising and listings. Restaurant Managers handle service and close private bookings.

**Employee Benefits**

* Maternity Leave: Six months of fully paid maternity leave.
* Mental Health Support: Free therapy and counselling, alongside in-house mental health sessions.
* Fair Pay: Industry-standard salaries and a commitment to pay parity.
* Growth: Internal promotions and career development opportunities.
* Training: Weekly learning and development sessions.
* Meals: Lunch is on us

**What To Do Next**

If this sounds like the right next step for your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Send your CV to hr@rareideas.in or apply directly through LinkedIn.

Our hiring process includes application review, an initial conversation, a short business case on filling a quiet weeknight, a meeting with the Senior Marketing Manager and reference checks.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 6 to 15 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.

You run the company's operating cadence, own the founder's highest-priority cross-functional projects end to end, and make sure every decision has an owner, a deadline and a follow-up. Strategic projectsDrive 2–3 priority programs at a time (for example MeitY/GeM empanelment, IndiaAI Mission, US expansion, key partnerships): plan, milestones, cross-team execution. Founder leverageManage the Founder's priorities and calendar: protect focus time, cut or delegate meetings.Draft communications on the Founder's behalf: team updates, partner emails, talking points for events.Candidate profileMust-haves6–12 years in management consulting, a startup operations or strategy role, or as a founder or early employee.Has run a process end to end across teams with no formal authority: a launch, a fundraise, a large deal or a regulatory filing.Writes clearly and fast: memos, investor updates, contract summaries.Comfortable with numbers: reads a P&L, builds a simple model, catches a deck number that doesn't tie out.Discreet with confidential matters (fundraise, legal, people).Real authority from day one This is not an assistant role. You decide: how internal meetings, agendas, the decision log, escalations, intake routing and investor logistics run, plus tools and travel within an agreed budget. You recommend, the founder decides: external meetings, commercial positions in contracts, investor priorities and cross-team process changes. The founder keeps: valuation, signing, hiring and compensation.Your first 90 days Days 1–30, run the cadence: take over the decision review and weekly catch-up, start the decision log, publish a weekly status by week 2 and take over the founder's calendar. Done when every open action has one owner and one deadline.Days 31–60, own intake and the fundraise: become first reader for contracts and notices, build the data room and investor CRM, and tie out the deck and model. Done when no deadline is missed and the founder sees only decisions. Days 61–90, drive strategic programs: take on 2–3 programs, each with a clear plan, milestones and owners. Done when each has hit its first milestone or been escalated early.What you'll bring 6–12 years in consulting or startup operations or strategy, or as a founder or early employee. Proof you've run something end to end across teams without formal authority: a launch, a fundraise, a large deal or a regulatory filing. Clear, fast writing, comfort with numbers (a P&L, a simple model, a deck that ties out) and discretion. Nice-to-havesBackground in cloud, datacenter, telecom or B2B SaaS; can follow GPU, colocation and SLA conversations without a glossary.Exposure to fundraising, M&A or banking.Experience with Indian government procurement (MeitY, GeM, tenders).MBA from a strong program (useful, not required).

description:
**ABOUT MACHINE MAKER**

Machine Maker (an initiative of Mart Infomedia Private Limited) is a B2B media platform focused on the manufacturing sector, connecting manufacturers, industry professionals, SMEs, technology providers, and other stakeholders. Through print, digital, visual storytelling, and on-ground events, Machine Maker highlights industry trends, innovations, business developments, and the people shaping Indian manufacturing.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Sales Manager – B2B Media & Business Development will drive revenue growth by acquiring new clients, expanding existing accounts, and developing integrated media partnerships across Machine Maker’s print, digital, video, social media, webinar, event and exhibition platforms. The role requires a consultative sales approach: understanding a client’s marketing and business objectives, translating them into relevant media solutions, and owning the commercial process from prospecting to closure, execution coordination, renewal and collections. The manager will also strengthen sales discipline, reporting and team performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**•**
**Revenue Strategy & Target Ownership:**
Develop and execute monthly, quarterly and annual sales plans; own assigned revenue targets, budgets, forecasts, and conversion goals across the media portfolio.

**•**
**New Business Development:**
Build a strong prospect pipeline through research, outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, industry databases, trade fairs and manufacturing events. Identify decision-makers in marketing, corporate communications, business leadership, and product divisions.

**•**
**B2B Media & Advertising Sales:**
Pitch and sell relevant solutions, including print advertising, digital display and website visibility, sponsored articles and branded content, video interviews / brand films, social media campaigns, newsletters, webinars, event partnerships, exhibition visibility and integrated packages, as applicable to the current portfolio.

**•**
**Industrial Market Coverage:**
Develop accounts across manufacturing and allied sectors such as machine tools, automation, robotics, engineering, industrial components, cutting tools, metrology, material handling, industrial software, electronics, automotive, aerospace, energy and manufacturing services.

**•**
**Consultative Selling & Proposals:**
Understand client objectives, target audiences, campaign budgets and timelines. Prepare tailored media plans, proposals, presentations, quotations, sponsorship packages and commercial recommendations that demonstrate value and expected deliverables.

**•**
**Negotiation & Deal Closure:**
Lead commercial discussions, negotiate rates and terms within approved pricing and discount policies, follow up systematically, close business and ensure written confirmation / purchase orders or insertion orders are secured.

**•**
**Account Management & Retention:**
Own relationships with assigned clients and agencies; conduct regular reviews, identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, secure renewals and build long-term strategic partnerships.

**•**
**Campaign Handover & Delivery:**
Coordinate with editorial, digital, design, video, social media, production and event teams to communicate approved scope, specifications, timelines and client expectations. Monitor delivery against commitments and escalate risks early.

**•**
**Client Servicing & Reporting:**
Ensure timely client communication, campaign updates, proof of publication / delivery and post-campaign reports where relevant. Capture feedback and resolve service issues in coordination with internal teams.

**•**
**Sales Operations & CRM:**
Maintain accurate CRM / lead tracker records, contact history, meeting notes, proposal status, deal value, probability, next action and closure dates. Keep pipeline data current and submit weekly and monthly reports.

**•**
**Market Intelligence:**
Track competitor offerings, media rates, industry events, marketing trends and client activity. Share market insights and product feedback to improve Machine Maker’s commercial offerings.

**•**
**Team Leadership & Collaboration:**
Guide and support sales executives where applicable, review activity and pipeline quality, coach on pitches and follow-ups, share best practices and foster accountability for collective targets.

**•**
**Invoicing & Collections:**
Coordinate with accounts and clients on billing milestones, payment follow-ups and outstanding receivables; support timely collections in line with company policy.

**•**
**Industry Representation:**
Represent Machine Maker professionally at exhibitions, conferences, customer visits, networking forums and industry associations; build relationships with senior stakeholders across the manufacturing ecosystem.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

**•**
Strong B2B sales, consultative selling, business development and revenue ownership capabilities.

**•**
Excellent communication, presentation, pitching, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

**•**
Ability to prospect independently, reach senior decision-makers and convert leads into paying accounts.

**•**
Understanding of media sales, advertising formats, sponsorships, branded content and integrated marketing solutions.

**•**

title: Growth & Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
JOB TITLE: Growth & Retention Marketing Specialist (B2B)

Company: NetPuppys Technologies Pvt Ltd

Location: Gurugram (JMD Megapolis, Sector 48), work from office

Experience: 1–3 years in growth, lifecycle, CRM or retention marketing, mainly with B2B companies or B2B clients

Employment Type: Full-time

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This role is focused on growth and retention, not general digital marketing. We're looking for someone who has worked on lead nurturing, CRM, email automation, funnels and customer retention, mainly in B2B. If your experience is mostly in social media posting, SEO or content writing, this role isn't the right fit.

ABOUT NETPUPPYS

NetPuppys is an AI-forward digital marketing company headquartered in Gurugram, with offices in Dubai and Frisco, USA. We drive growth for brands in real estate, education, e-commerce, pharma and travel/tech through SEO, performance marketing, social media, content and web development.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Growth & Retention Marketing Specialist to help our clients turn leads into customers and customers into repeat business. Most of your work will be for B2B clients: lead nurturing, CRM automation, email and LinkedIn programs, and customer retention and upsell campaigns. You'll also support D2C clients with lifecycle flows where needed. You'll work with our senior team and grow quickly into owning growth programs on your own.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

B2B growth and lead nurturing

* Build and run lead nurturing email sequences for long sales cycles, with content mapped to each buying stage
* Set up and manage lead scoring, lifecycle stages and MQL/SQL handoffs in the CRM with client sales teams
* Support account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns for high-value target accounts across email, LinkedIn and retargeting
* Run outbound email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns using sales engagement tools
* Plan and promote B2B content such as case studies, webinars, newsletters and whitepapers to drive pipeline

Retention and customer marketing

* Build onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell and win-back campaigns for existing customers
* Segment customers by behaviour, account value and engagement, and personalize communication for each group
* Track churn signals and flag at-risk accounts to client teams
* Run customer feedback and NPS surveys and turn the insights into campaigns

D2C lifecycle (as needed)

* Support lifecycle flows for D2C clients: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, repeat purchase and win-back
* Run email, WhatsApp and SMS campaigns for D2C brands

Funnel and conversion optimization

* Analyze funnels to find drop-offs, from first visit to lead to deal or purchase
* Run A/B tests on emails, landing pages, forms and offers, and document what you learn
* Suggest improvements to landing pages, demo-request flows and lead forms

Tracking and reporting

* Track key metrics: open and click rates, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline influenced, churn, repeat rate and LTV
* Build weekly and monthly reports in Looker Studio, the CRM or Google Sheets
* Keep CRM data clean and well organized

AI and automation

* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for email copy, segmentation ideas, research and analysis
* Build automated workflows in CRM and email platforms to cut manual work

Collaboration

* Work with performance marketing, content, design, SEO and client sales teams
* Brief writers and designers on nurture emails, newsletters and campaign creatives

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in growth, lifecycle, CRM or retention marketing
* Most of your experience should be in B2B, either at a B2B company or on B2B clients at an agency or digital marketing company
* Hands-on experience with at least one CRM or marketing automation platform: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Mailchimp or Brevo
* Experience building automated email sequences and nurture workflows
* Basic understanding of B2B funnel metrics: MQL, SQL, pipeline, conversion rates and churn
* Familiarity with LinkedIn for B2B marketing and outreach
* Good Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic data analysis)
* Strong writing skills for emails and campaign copy
* Comfort using AI tools in daily work
* Clear communication and a willingness to learn fast

GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS

* Experience with D2C brands, especially email, WhatsApp or SMS lifecycle flows
* Experience with D2C platforms like Klaviyo, MoEngage, CleverTap or WebEngage
* Experience with sales engagement tools like Apollo, Lemlist or Instantly
* WhatsApp marketing tools like Interakt, WATI or AiSensy
* Basic knowledge of GA4 and Looker Studio
* Experience with B2B SaaS, IT services, manufacturing or professional services clients
* HubSpot certifications (Inbound, Email Marketing or Marketing Software)
* Basic knowledge of email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, list hygiene)

WHAT NETPUPPYS OFFERS

* Hands-on growth and retention work across B2B and D2C clients in India, Dubai and the US
* Learning directly from senior growth specialists and leadership
* An AI-forward culture where you can try new tools and automation
* A clear growth path to owning client programs and senior growth roles
* Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives
* A collaborative team environment in Gurugram

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to [hr@etpuppys.com] with the subject line "Growth & Retention Marketing Specialist – [Your Name]". Applications without answers to the three questions below won't be considered:

1. Which CRM or automation tools have you used hands-on, and what did you build in them?
2. Share one B2B result with real numbers (for example: email conversion, MQL-to-SQL rate, meetings booked or churn reduced) and explain what you did.
3. A B2B client gets plenty of leads, but very few turn into sales meetings. What would you try first?

15–20+ Years

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced
**Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)**
to lead end-to-end business operations and drive commercial excellence across procurement, vendor and artisan management, production, inventory, quality, order fulfilment, logistics and working capital.

The role will focus on building a scalable, process-driven and commercially disciplined operating platform to support business growth across corporate gifting, retail, e-commerce, institutional and other channels while maintaining premium product quality and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Operations & Supply Chain**

* Lead end-to-end operations across procurement, production, inventory, quality, warehousing and logistics.
* Ensure timely, cost-effective and quality-compliant order fulfilment.
* Build and manage a strong network of manufacturers, artisans and vendors.
* Optimize procurement costs, quality standards and delivery timelines.
* Improve inventory turnover, working capital efficiency and stock ageing while minimizing wastage and shrinkage.
* Ensure robust quality control from sourcing to final dispatch.
* Maintain secure warehousing and stringent controls for high-value inventory.

**2. Commercial & P&L Management**

* Monitor product costs, margins, operating expenses and overall profitability.

* Support Sales and Business Development teams on pricing, costing, customization, feasibility and delivery commitments.
* Lead commercial negotiations and key customer proposals.

* Drive revenue realization, timely billing, collections and commercial closure of orders.
* Support the development of new products, channels and markets based on customer demand.

**3. Process Excellence & Systems**

* Establish and implement robust SOPs, approval mechanisms, controls and MIS.
* Drive ERP, inventory management, CRM and performance dashboard implementation.
* Ensure effective inventory reconciliation and control over silver/material wastage and shrinkage.
* Build scalable processes to support profitable business growth.

* Build, develop and lead strong operations and supply-chain teams.
* Drive high standards of customer service and timely resolution of customer issues.
* Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to ensure seamless order execution.
* Build an operational framework suited to a growing, entrepreneurial business.

* Strong understanding of EBITDA, operating profitability and gross margin management.
* Expertise in inventory turnover, ageing and slow-moving stock control.
* Experience in working capital management and procurement cost optimization.
* Strong understanding of silver/material wastage, shrinkage and inventory reconciliation.
* Vendor development, negotiation and performance management.
* Expertise in quality control and on-time order fulfilment.
* Strong commercial acumen, pricing, negotiation and key account management.
* Experience in SOP development, ERP implementation and process controls.
* Ability to build scalable operations aligned with business growth.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate from a recognized university.
* MBA/PGDM in Operations, Finance or General Management preferred.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* 15–20+ years of overall experience, preferably with at least 5 years in a senior operations leadership role.
* Relevant experience in silverware, jewellery, luxury/premium products, handicrafts, corporate gifting, manufacturing, retail or lifestyle businesses.
* Proven ability to build and scale operations rather than merely manage an established setup.
* Strong commercial orientation with a sound understanding of P&L, gross margins, working capital and inventory economics.
* Experience managing high-value inventory, preferably jewellery, precious metals, silverware or luxury goods.
* Strong vendor development, procurement and negotiation capabilities.
* Hands-on leader comfortable working in an entrepreneurial/promoter-driven environment.
* High integrity and strong control orientation, particularly when handling precious metals, raw materials and finished inventory.
* Appreciation for craftsmanship, design, product quality and premium customer experience.

title: Events Director

The role will act as a strategic regional business partner, providing direction, tactical recommendations and performance insights to improve the financial, commercial and operational performance of Events across all brands.
  
  
The position will translate regional commercial priorities into practical actions for hotel Directors of Events and event teams. It will also serve as the liaison between the region and Global Events, ensuring that global initiatives are effectively localized, regionalized and activated in line with market dynamics, customer preferences and hotel operating realities.
  
  
The role will work closely with F&B, Commercial Performance, Sales, Revenue, Distribution, Analytics, Marketing, Brand and hotel leadership to identify innovative and commercially sound opportunities that improve Events revenue, conversion, profitability, guest satisfaction and customer engagement.

title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
CHIEF GROWTH OFFICER (CGO)

An Entrepreneurial Leadership Opportunity | Quick Clean Laundry Solutions

Not another CXO job. An opportunity to build something extraordinary.

THE OPPORTUNITY

What if your next entrepreneurial journey didn’t require you to start from zero?

What if you could take everything you’ve learned building a business, bring that entrepreneurial energy to an established platform, and help build one of India’s next great businesses?

Quick Clean is looking for a Chief Growth Officer (CGO) who thinks and operates like a Founder.

We are a Series B-funded, industry-leading company transforming the way the hospitality and healthcare industries manage their laundry and linen infrastructure.

With 100+ operational sites across 38 cities, a strong presence across hospitality and healthcare, and the backing of institutional investors, we have established a differentiated business model in a large, underpenetrated market.

We have raised US$14 million in our Series B round and are entering our next phase of growth.

Our ambition is much bigger.

We are building towards becoming the world’s largest On-Premise Laundry (OPL) company, with an aspiration to create a publicly listed institution over the next four years.

And we are looking for someone who wants to own a meaningful part of this journey.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Not necessarily someone with a conventional corporate career.

We are particularly interested in:

\* A former Founder or Co-Founder who has built a business, experienced the realities of entrepreneurship and understands what it takes to scale.

\* An entrepreneur who has successfully built and exited a venture, or someone who has taken a startup from early stages to meaningful scale.

\* Someone who has built businesses, business units, new markets or revenue engines from scratch.

\* A leader who has the appetite to move beyond managing a function and take ownership of an entire growth agenda.

You may have founded a startup, scaled a venture-backed company, or built a business within a larger organisation.

What matters is not your designation. It is your ability to think like an owner, build like a founder and execute like an operator.

YOUR MANDATE: BUILD THE NEXT PHASE OF QUICK CLEAN

This is not a conventional sales leadership position.

You will be responsible for shaping and driving the company’s overall growth strategy, with the freedom and accountability to build the engines that will take Quick Clean to its next level.

1. Build the Next Growth Engine

\* Develop and execute the company’s next 3–4-year growth strategy.

\* Identify new markets, customer segments, geographies and business opportunities.

\* Build scalable and repeatable revenue-generation engines.

\* Drive aggressive market penetration across hospitality and healthcare.

\* Identify opportunities for geographical expansion, including international markets.

2. Think Beyond the Existing Business Model

\* Identify adjacent business opportunities and new revenue streams.

\* Explore innovative commercial models, strategic partnerships and distribution opportunities.

\* Challenge existing business assumptions and identify opportunities to create disproportionate value.

\* Build businesses around our existing capabilities, infrastructure, technology and customer relationships.

3. Build an Entrepreneurial Growth Organisation

\* Build and lead high-performance teams across sales, business development, strategic partnerships and growth.

\* Create a culture of ownership, speed, accountability and execution.

\* Attract exceptional talent and develop future business leaders.

\* Build an organisation that can scale without becoming bureaucratic.

4. Drive Strategic Partnerships & Inorganic Growth

\* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, acquisitions and inorganic growth opportunities.

\* Develop relationships with industry leaders, hospitality groups, healthcare chains and institutional partners.

\* Evaluate opportunities to enter new markets through strategic alliances, acquisitions or other innovative structures.

\* Work closely with the CEO and investors on strategic growth initiatives.

5. Leverage Technology & Innovation

\* Use technology, AI and automation to create differentiated growth capabilities.

\* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention and lifetime value.

\* Build scalable systems, processes and intelligence to support the next phase of growth.

6. Own the Outcomes

\* Take ownership of the company’s growth agenda, not just the sales number.

\* Translate strategic ambition into measurable business outcomes.

\* Drive revenue growth, market share, customer acquisition and profitability.

\* Work closely with the CEO, leadership team and investors to create long-term enterprise value.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Over the next 3–4 years, you will have played a defining role in:

\* Taking Quick Clean to the next scale of revenue and profitability.

\* Building a dominant position in India’s On-Premise Laundry market.

\* Establishing a scalable international growth platform.

\* Creating new business verticals and revenue streams.

\* Building a high-performance leadership team.

\* Strengthening the company’s institutional capabilities and IPO readiness.

You will not simply be measured by the size of the team you manage or the number of deals you close.

You will be measured by the enterprise value you help create.

THE PROFILE

We are deliberately keeping this unconventional.

We would love to meet someone who:

\* Has been a Founder, Co-Founder or early-stage entrepreneurial leader.

\* Has demonstrated the ability to build and scale a business.

\* Has strong commercial instincts and an exceptional understanding of business economics.

\* Can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

\* Is comfortable operating in ambiguity and making decisions with imperfect information.

\* Has the ability to attract talent, build teams and inspire people.

\* Thinks in terms of ownership, enterprise value and long-term wealth creation.

\* Has an appetite for taking calculated risks and challenging conventional thinking.

Industry experience in hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure, B2B services, technology-enabled businesses or asset-heavy service businesses would be valuable, but we are not restricting ourselves to any particular industry.

WHAT’S UP FOR GRABS?

A meaningful opportunity to participate in wealth creation.

We understand that someone who has built a business may value ownership much more than a conventional compensation package.

We want to structure this opportunity accordingly.

Our proposition:

\* Meaningful ESOP Ownership: A substantial equity participation opportunity linked to the value you create and the milestones you achieve.

\* Entrepreneurial Autonomy: The freedom to build, experiment, challenge and create.

\* A Strong Platform: Join an established, Series B-funded industry leader rather than starting from scratch.

\* A Seat at the Leadership Table: Work directly with the Founder & CEO and participate in shaping the company’s strategic direction.

\* Long-Term Wealth Creation: Participate in the journey of building a business with the ambition of an IPO in the next four years.

We are open to structuring a compensation package where a larger portion of the overall opportunity is linked to ESOPs and long-term value creation rather than maximising fixed compensation.

We are looking for someone who believes that building a ₹5,000–10,000 crore institution is potentially more exciting than negotiating the highest possible annual salary.

A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDER

I started Quick Clean in 2010 with an entrepreneurial ambition to transform an industry that had remained largely traditional and fragmented.

Over the years, we have built a differentiated business, created a strong operating platform, attracted institutional investors and established ourselves as an industry leader.

But I genuinely believe we are only getting started.

The next phase will require a different level of ambition, thinking, execution and leadership.

I am looking for someone who can challenge me, complement me, bring a fresh entrepreneurial perspective and take complete ownership of building the next chapter of Quick Clean.

Someone who doesn’t look at this as a job.

Someone who looks at this as their next venture.

If you have built something before and are looking for your next big entrepreneurial challenge, let’s talk.

Let’s build something that outlives us.

Anshul Gupta

Founder & CEO

Quick Clean Laundry Solutions

and generate qualified enquiries from homeowners planning to furnish a new home or renovate an existing one.

* Hands-on experience managing

As an End User Computing (EUC) Specialist, a typical day involves managing and supporting enterprise endpoint environments, including desktops, laptops, virtual desktops, and mobile devices. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune and SCCM).
  
  
Experience with Windows Autopilot, Hybrid Autopilot, Azure AD, ADFS, and Group Policy-based enrollment.
  
  
Strong understanding of BYOD, Corporate-Owned Devices (COD), and modern device management concepts.
  
  
Experience in endpoint configuration, device provisioning, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Knowledge of desktop virtualization and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI).
  
  
Familiarity with Microsoft Modern Workplace technologies and cloud-based endpoint management.
  
  
Understanding of endpoint security, compliance policies, vulnerability management, and patch management.
  
  
Experience troubleshooting Windows operating systems, endpoint devices, and application-related issues.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer service skills.

The candidate should have a minimum of 7 years of experience in Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management technologies.
  
  
Experience with SCCM, Windows Autopilot, Azure AD, and device compliance management is preferred.
  
  
Experience supporting enterprise-scale End User Computing environments is desirable.
  
  
Knowledge of ITIL/ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management is preferred.
  
  
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams is desirable.

Aylence is looking for a creative, visually driven, and execution-oriented **Video Editor & Creative Manager** who can take ownership of video production and creative execution for the brand.

We are looking for someone who is excellent at video editing, understands social media content, and is excited about experimenting with AI-powered video creation tools.

* Add transitions, animations, motion graphics, subtitles, sound effects, and background music.
* Ensure videos have strong hooks, engaging storytelling, and effective pacing.
* Edit product videos, promotional videos, brand videos, campaigns, and other marketing creatives.
* Maintain consistency in video quality, visual language, and brand identity.

* Suggest better camera angles, lighting, framing, backgrounds, compositions, and shooting techniques.
* Help the team capture footage that is easier to edit and delivers better final results.
* Prepare shot lists, references, and creative directions before shoots.
* Actively participate in shoots and guide the team on the visual execution of content.

4. Social Media Team Coordination

* Collaborate closely with the Social Media Team to understand content calendars and upcoming campaigns.
* Coordinate shoot schedules, editing timelines, and content delivery.
* Ensure videos are edited according to the content brief, platform requirements, and brand guidelines.
* Work with the team on creative brainstorming and new content formats.
* Take feedback positively and make revisions within agreed timelines.

5. Creative Strategy & Content Innovation

* Bring fresh creative ideas for Reels, short-form videos, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
* Research trending video formats, editing styles, transitions, and social media content trends.
* Analyze successful content from other brands and creators for inspiration.
* Suggest innovative ways to showcase Aylence's products and brand.
* Experiment with different editing styles, storytelling formats, and AI-generated creatives.
* Focus on creating content that captures attention and drives engagement.

6. Asset & Production Management

* Organize raw footage, edited videos, project files, and creative assets.
* Maintain an organized video library for easy access and future use.
* Ensure timely delivery of all assigned creative projects.
* Maintain consistency in quality across all video deliverables.

**At Aylence AI , we are looking for creative thinker who can help us shoot better, create better, experiment with AI, and build a strong visual identity for the brand.**

* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.

* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
