description:
Seeking a Sr. Sales Manager for a D2C brand in Mumbai!

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business opportunity identification and strategy

· Assess the market, customer needs, competitive landscape and product strengths to identify new business opportunities.

· Recommend and prioritize attractive customer segments, routes to market and partnership models based on revenue potential, scalability and profitability.

· Develop a business plan with market priorities, target customers, commercial assumptions, investment requirements and revenue milestones.

· Build a pipeline of prospective customers and strategic partners, with a structured approach to converting opportunities.

· Continuously evaluate market feedback and refine the business strategy.

2. New business development and partnerships

· Personally identify, approach and build relationships with prospective customers, partners and key decision-makers.

· Lead presentations, proposals, pitches and commercial negotiations through to closure.

· Develop anchor accounts and strategic partnerships that can generate meaningful and recurring business.

· Create tailored commercial propositions based on customer requirements and the brand's capabilities.

· Build a strong network of relevant industry contacts and use it to open new business opportunities.

3. Build the business from the ground up

· Translate the business strategy into an executable go-to-market plan, with clear priorities, milestones and ownership.

· Create the sales playbook, including pitch materials, pricing principles, commercial frameworks, customer onboarding and order processes.

· Establish effective working processes with Operations, Merchandising, Finance and Marketing for order management, stock availability, billing, dispatch, returns and collections.

· Set up a robust pipeline, CRM, reporting and forecasting discipline.

· Identify the resources, systems and capabilities required to support growth, and recommend investments where needed.

4. Commercial and financial ownership

· Own agreed revenue, gross margin and contribution targets for the business vertical.

· Evaluate the commercial viability and profitability of prospective customers and opportunities before committing resources.

· Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, payment terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.

· Monitor invoicing, collections, receivables, returns and credit exposure.

· Ensure that growth is sustainable, profitable and aligned with brand’s commercial objectives.

5. Team building and leadership

· Recommend an appropriate team structure and phased hiring plan based on business strategy and growth requirements.

· Recruit, train, manage and develop a high-performing business development and sales team as the vertical scales.

· Set individual and team targets, account ownership, review mechanisms and performance expectations.

· Coach team members on prospecting, presentations, negotiations, account management and commercial discipline.

· Build a culture of ownership, accountability, customer focus and execution.

6. Account management and business growth

· Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and strategic partners.

· Coordinate with internal teams to deliver a reliable customer experience.

· Resolve commercial and operational issues promptly and protect long-term relationships.

· Drive repeat business, account expansion, referrals and new opportunities within existing relationships.

· Track customer satisfaction and use feedback to improve the proposition and service model.

**Job Qualifications**

· 5–12 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, key accounts, partnerships, retail or distribution, preferably in a consumer-facing business.

· Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new business opportunities, rather than only manage an inherited customer portfolio.

· Experience building a new business line, channel, territory, customer segment or partnership network from an early stage.

· Evidence of personally winning meaningful new accounts and delivering measurable revenue growth.

· Experience managing commercial negotiations and understanding pricing, margins, payment terms, collections and profitability.

· Experience hiring or leading a team, or the demonstrated ability to build one as the business grows.

· Exposure to apparel, kids wear, lifestyle, fashion, sportswear, FMCG, toys, stationery or other consumer categories will be an advantage.

· Strong market understanding, entrepreneurial thinking, commercial judgement and problem-solving ability.

· Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

· Comfortable working with Excel, CRM tools, business reports and sales forecasts.

· Self-driven, organised and willing to travel as required.

title: Sales Manager - Food Ingredients
description:
Location: Mumbai, India
  
  
Department: Food Ingredients
  
  
Reports To: Business Head – Food Ingredients
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
Agrocorp International is seeking a commercially driven and results-oriented Business Development Manager to grow Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market presence in India. Based in Mumbai, this role will focus on driving sales and profitability, developing new business opportunities, and expanding customer relationships across the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new market opportunities, particularly for pea protein isolates and starches, while strengthening Agrocorp’s position as a leading supplier of food and health ingredients in India. This role requires a proactive, entrepreneurial individual with strong commercial acumen, a proven track record in business development, and the ability to build long-term partnerships in a competitive market.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Sales & Business Development
* Develop and execute sales strategies to expand Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market share in India.
* Achieve annual sales revenue and gross profit targets.
* Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities to build a sustainable customer pipeline.
* Explore new applications and market segments for pea protein isolates, starches and other food ingredients.
* Identify emerging market trends and customer needs to support business growth and product development.
* Customer Relationship Management
* Establish and strengthen relationships with local, regional and global customers operating in India.
* Build long-term partnerships with key accounts across the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries.
* Obtain customer forecasts, secure requests for quotations (RFQs), negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and drive business closure.
* Understand customer requirements and work closely with internal stakeholders to deliver effective solutions and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Market Intelligence & Strategic Growth
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing dynamics and industry developments.
* Gather and analyse competitor and market intelligence, providing timely insights and recommendations to Agrocorp’s suppliers.
* Identify opportunities to expand product applications, customer segments and market reach.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of business strategies to strengthen Agrocorp’s brand and competitive position in India.
* Commercial & Working Capital Management
* Monitor customer accounts receivable and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
* Manage inventory levels and stock ageing within acceptable business parameters.
* Support effective working capital management while balancing sales growth and commercial risks.
* Work closely with Customer Service and relevant internal teams to ensure the timely registration of customers, vendors and materials in Agrocorp’s ERP systems.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with the Business Head, suppliers, Customer Service and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of business activities.
* Provide timely updates on sales performance, pipeline development, market opportunities and customer requirements.
* Ensure accurate documentation, systematic follow-up and compliance with internal processes and commercial policies.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably within food ingredients distribution or related industries.
* Proven experience in the food, beverage or nutraceutical sectors, with a strong understanding of ingredient markets and customer applications.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving sales and gross profit targets and developing new business accounts.
* Experience in customer negotiations, pricing strategy, account management and commercial risk assessment.
* Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive positioning and working capital management.

Desired Knowledge, Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Entrepreneurial mindset: Proactive hunter mentality with a strong drive to identify and capture new business opportunities.
* Commercial acumen: Strong understanding of sales, profitability, pricing and commercial negotiations.
* Strategic thinking: Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate market insights into actionable business strategies.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in an evolving business environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Relationship building: Excellent interpersonal, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical ability: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and identify business opportunities.
* Execution excellence: Highly organised, systematic and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through.
* Initiative and accountability: Self-motivated, results-driven and willing to take calculated risks to achieve business objectives.
* Customer focus: Committed to understanding customer needs and delivering sustainable commercial value.
* Collaboration: Effective team player who can work across functions and engage with diverse, multicultural stakeholders.

Agrocorp International is a leading global agri-commodities company, connecting farmers, processors, and markets across key regions worldwide. With a strong presence in origination and destination markets, we specialize in sourcing, processing, and distributing high-quality agricultural products. Driven by innovation, sustainability, and a people-first culture, Agrocorp offers a dynamic environment where talent can grow, gain global exposure, and make a meaningful impact in the food supply chain.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Job Title: Area Sales Manager**

**Job Overview**

The candidate will own the assigned area end-to-end, including new customer acquisition, existing customer management, renewal tracking, overdue payment follow-up, Sales Executive performance and reporting to the Regional Sales Head.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Area Sales & Customer Acquisition**

* Own monthly customer acquisition targets for the assigned territory.
* Identify and approach prospective retail stores and business customers.
* Maintain an active pipeline of potential MOGA customers.
* Track prospect stage, contact details and expected conversion date.
* Conduct MOGA programme presentations and product demonstrations.
* Follow up on prospective customers until conversion or closure.
* Track demo-to-sign conversion rates.
* Develop corrective action plans where conversion falls below expectations.

**Customer Retention**

* Maintain minimum 85% quarter-on-quarter customer retention.
* Identify customers at risk of churn.
* Develop action plans to retain at-risk accounts.
* Maintain regular engagement with existing MOGA customers.
* Track reasons for customer exits.
* Use churn insights to improve future retention activity.

**Customer Renewals**

* Maintain a live renewal pipeline.
* Start renewal tracking at least 6 weeks before the due date.
* Maintain status for each renewal as confirmed, pending or at risk.
* Follow up regularly on upcoming renewals.
* Achieve minimum 88% renewal confirmation on or before due date.
* Escalate high-risk renewals to the Regional Sales Head with an action plan.

**Payment Collection**

* Track monthly customer dues for the assigned area.
* Ensure at least 90% of monthly dues are collected by the due date.
* Follow up on overdue accounts within 48 hours.
* Maintain current records of pending and collected payments.
* Review Accounts Receivable ageing every week.
* Escalate unresolved overdue accounts with a resolution plan.
* Ensure no account reaches 30 days overdue without RSH visibility.

**Sales Executive Management**

* Manage Sales Executives assigned to the territory.
* Prepare weekly field plans for each SE.
* Define stores, customer targets and expected outcomes for field visits.
* Conduct minimum one joint field visit per SE every week.
* Observe sales pitches and customer interactions.
* Support SEs during customer acquisition and closures.
* Provide feedback and coaching after joint visits.
* Review individual SE target achievement and conversion performance.
* Support underperforming SEs through structured coaching plans.

**Field Sales Leadership**

* Maintain strong field presence across the assigned territory.
* Accompany Sales Executives during customer visits.
* Support important product demonstrations and account conversions.
* Identify market-level barriers affecting sales performance.
* Ensure field activity is aligned with monthly acquisition targets.
* Drive consistent customer engagement across assigned localities.

**CRM & Back Office Coordination**

* Update every lead and customer interaction on the same day.
* Maintain accurate CRM records for prospects and active customers.
* Log call outcomes, renewal status and payment follow-ups.
* Maintain current renewal and collection trackers.
* Review Sales Executive field reports daily.
* Correct missing or incomplete field activity records on the same day.
* Ensure accurate area data is available to the Regional Sales Head at all times.

**Area Reporting**

* Prepare weekly area performance reports.
* Track acquisition, renewals, collections and SE performance.
* Prepare monthly actual-versus-target summaries.
* Highlight open action items with defined owners and timelines.
* Conduct structured weekly reviews with the Regional Sales Head.
* Report territory performance, pipeline health and major blockers.

**Territory Development**

* Identify new localities and business clusters within the assigned area.
* Activate at least one new locality or zone every quarter.
* Develop prospect lists for newly activated territories.
* Ensure the first customer is onboarded within 30 days of activation.
* Prepare quarterly area growth plans.
* Estimate customer acquisition opportunities and revenue potential.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Monthly new customer acquisition target
* Demo-to-sign conversion rate
* Customer retention: 85%+
* Renewal rate: 88%+
* Payment collection: 90%+ by due date
* CRM and same-day activity updates
* Weekly area reporting
* SE target achievement
* Joint field visit completion
* Territory expansion
* New locality activation

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 4–7 years of B2B field sales experience.
* Minimum 1–2 years of experience managing a small field sales team.
* Graduate in any discipline.
* Experience managing customer acquisition, renewals, churn and payment collection.
* Practical experience handling field sales territories.
* Experience managing Sales Executives or similar field-sales roles.
* Experience using CRM or customer management systems.
* Experience maintaining sales pipelines and customer records.
* Exposure to field-based product demonstrations and customer conversion.
* Experience tracking receivables and payment follow-ups.
* Ability to manage sales and operational reporting for an assigned territory.
* Marathi and Hindi proficiency required.
* Working English required for reporting and CRM updates.
* Own two-wheeler or four-wheeler with valid driving licence required.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in optical, FMCG, branded consumer goods or retail solutions.
* Experience in B2B retail customer acquisition.
* Experience managing multiple active customers across an assigned territory.
* Experience in customer renewals and retention.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Job Title: Regional Sales Head**

**Job Overview**

Looking for a Regional Sales Head to lead the MOGA business across Maharashtra, Goa and Gujarat.

The selected candidate will own regional sales performance, customer acquisition, renewals, collections, ASM productivity, market expansion and regional P&L.

The role carries direct ownership of the business across all three states, with an immediate focus on scaling Maharashtra to 750 active customers within 6 months while simultaneously building Gujarat and Goa from the ground up.

This is a hands-on field leadership role requiring strong experience in B2B sales, market development, field team management and commercial performance.

The candidate will be expected to review sales pipelines, accompany ASMs on field visits, improve conversion, monitor renewals and collections, manage underperformance and ensure the region delivers against revenue and profitability targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regional Sales Ownership**

* Own overall sales performance across Maharashtra, Goa and Gujarat.
* Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across the region.
* Ensure monthly and quarterly targets are achieved.
* Monitor customer growth, retention, renewals and collections.
* Take corrective action when regional performance falls below plan.
* Maintain direct accountability for regional commercial outcomes.

**Maharashtra Customer Growth**

* Drive Maharashtra to 750 active MOGA customers within 6 months.
* Achieve a minimum of 400 active customers by Month 3.
* Prepare recovery plans in case acquisition milestones are missed.
* Review customer acquisition activity by territory and ASM.
* Ensure sufficient weekly prospecting and conversion activity across the state.

**New Market Development – Gujarat & Goa**

* Build the Gujarat and Goa markets from zero.
* Recruit the Gujarat ASM within 60 days.
* Recruit the Goa ASM within 75 days.
* Personally participate in early-stage market visits.
* Accompany the Gujarat ASM on the first 10 visits.
* Accompany the Goa ASM on the first 8 visits.
* Develop a 6-month market acquisition and revenue plan for both states.
* Monitor new customer count, revenue and pipeline progress monthly.
* Expand into new districts and local markets.

**B2B Customer Acquisition**

* Review active customer acquisition pipelines for every ASM.
* Monitor demo-to-sign conversion ratios.
* Identify weak conversion areas and implement corrective actions.
* Support ASMs through joint visits and conversion coaching.
* Ensure targeted store acquisition activity across assigned markets.
* Drive structured prospect-to-customer conversion.

**Customer Retention & Renewals**

* Maintain minimum 85% quarter-on-quarter customer retention.
* Ensure renewal planning starts 8 weeks before each renewal cycle.
* Maintain visibility of confirmed and at-risk renewals.
* Intervene directly in high-value or at-risk accounts.
* Ensure minimum 88% of renewals are completed on or before due date.
* Review and document customer exits and churn reasons.
* Implement measures to improve future retention.

**Payment Collection & Receivables**

* Ensure minimum 90% of monthly customer dues are collected on time.
* Monitor overdue customer accounts.
* Ensure timely ASM follow-ups on overdue payments.
* Personally intervene in unresolved overdue cases.
* Escalate long-overdue accounts to the HOO.
* Review AR ageing on a structured weekly basis.

**Regional P&L Management**

* Own and review regional P&L performance.
* Review monthly actuals versus budget.
* Prepare variance commentary and next-month forecasts.
* Maintain positive regional P&L every month.
* Create recovery plans for deficit months.
* Control operating expenses within approved budgets.
* Present regional financial performance to the HOO.

**ASM Team Management**

* Lead and manage Area Sales Managers across all three states.
* Conduct weekly regional sales reviews.
* Review pipeline, revenue, renewals, collections and at-risk customers.
* Conduct regular joint field visits with ASMs.
* Provide field coaching based on actual customer interactions.
* Conduct monthly performance reviews.
* Track ASM target achievement.
* Implement performance improvement plans where required.
* Support development of ASM capability and market effectiveness.

**Regional Market Expansion**

* Identify new districts, territories and customer clusters.
* Activate at least one new district or area per state per quarter.
* Ensure initial customer acquisition in newly activated areas.
* Develop structured regional expansion plans.
* Build sustainable field coverage in new territories.
* Identify opportunities for long-term customer and revenue growth.

**Market Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor activity and market movements.
* Track product performance by territory.
* Identify top-performing and slow-moving product lines.
* Recommend corrective commercial actions.
* Prepare quarterly market intelligence reports.
* Identify new product categories and growth opportunities.
* Share regional market insights with the HOO.

**Performance Reporting**

* Submit regional sales and P&L reports within defined timelines.
* Track customer acquisition, revenue, renewals and collections.
* Maintain state-wise and ASM-wise performance visibility.
* Prepare monthly performance summaries.
* Submit quarterly regional growth plans.
* Highlight risks, performance gaps and recovery actions to management.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Maharashtra: 750 active customers within 6 months.
* Maharashtra Month 3 milestone: Minimum 400 active customers.
* Monthly regional sales target: 100% achievement.
* Customer retention: 85%+ quarter-on-quarter.
* Quarterly renewal rate: 88%+.
* Payment collection: 90%+ by due date.
* Regional P&L: Positive every month.
* ASM performance: Minimum 80% of monthly target.
* Gujarat and Goa market development as per launch timelines.
* New district / area activation across each state.
* Timely monthly and quarterly reporting.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–12 years of B2B field sales experience.
* Minimum 3 years of regional or multi-state sales leadership experience.
* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA in Sales or Marketing preferred.
* Proven experience managing Area Sales Managers or field sales teams.
* Experience building new markets and territories from zero.
* Experience in new customer acquisition and regional sales growth.
* Experience handling customer retention and renewals.
* Practical exposure to payment collection and receivables management.
* Experience managing regional P&L and sales budgets.
* Experience in sales forecasting and variance analysis.
* Experience conducting field coaching and performance reviews.
* Experience handling underperforming sales team members through structured improvement plans.
* Ability to travel extensively across Maharashtra, Goa and Gujarat.
* Own vehicle and valid driving licence required.
* Marathi, Hindi and English proficiency required.
* Gujarati language capability preferred.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in optical, FMCG, retail solutions or branded consumer goods.
* Experience managing multi-state B2B sales operations.
* Proven experience scaling customer acquisition across large territories.
* Experience opening and developing new regional markets.
* Experience managing ASM-led sales structures.
* Experience handling large customer portfolios involving acquisition, renewal and collections.
* Strong exposure to field sales operations.
* Experience managing regional profitability and commercial performance.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
The E-Commerce Manager will manage and grow Insight Cosmetics’ marketplace business across Myntra, Nykaa D, Purplle and Zepto. The role combines marketplace operations, sales and inventory monitoring, catalog and assortment management, promotional planning, commercial tracking, purchase-order coordination, and settlement follow-ups. The role will work closely with marketplace KAMs, SCM, Performance Marketing, the online team and Accounts to ensure accurate reporting, operational discipline and strong product visibility.

**Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Business & Account Management**

· Own day-to-day operations and account coordination across Myntra, Nykaa D, Purplle and Zepto.

· Maintain effective working relationships with marketplace KAMs and functional contacts across cataloging, marketing, supply chain and claims.

· Track marketplace issues, resolve operational blockers and escalate pending commercial, listing, PO or supply-chain matters to the relevant stakeholders.

· Maintain marketplace-specific trackers, workflow sheets, reference files, monthly plans and communication threads.

**2. Sales Reporting, Analysis & Business Tracking**

· Monitor sales performance and update the daily sales tracker where applicable, including daily Zepto sales and Myntra sales feeds, and weekly Purplle sales tracking.

· Prepare and update monthly sales reports, including item-code/SKU-wise and L3/category-wise contribution.

· Update the CTS Google Sheet and account workings on an excluding-GST basis, coordinating with the relevant sales and accounts stakeholders.

· Track sales against agreed plans and targets; identify gaps and share performance updates with internal stakeholders.

**3. Catalog, Listing, Assortment & Product Lifecycle**

· Manage marketplace cataloging and listing workflows, including Myntra listing templates and style-ID master updates.

· Ensure the Myntra master file is maintained with EAN, style ID, SKU name, MRP and active/inactive status, and shared monthly as required.

· Keep Nykaa D catalog information aligned with Nykaa.com and coordinate quarterly SKU additions after reviewing tail SKUs.

· Conduct quarterly SKU/NPI reviews for Zepto and maintain assortment additions and discontinuations.

· Monitor listing health, product visibility, offer display and pricing on marketplace apps/websites.

**4. Pricing, Discounts, Offers & Promotional Planning**

· Check Myntra portal discounts three times daily and flag any displayed discount that breaches the applicable approved ceiling.

· Maintain discount and price-off files, upload approved discounts in the relevant portals and align offers with marketplace POCs and calendars.

· Maintain Purplle BAU and IHB offer structures and coordinate discount alignment with the Purplle POC.

· Manage Zepto discount uploads using the approved Zepto Master and ensure the on-invoice discount and additional discount are handled within approved policy.

· Coordinate with the Brand Manager and relevant teams on annual/periodic Joint Business Plan (JBP) targets, marketing plans and claim slabs for Nykaa D.

**5. Purchase Orders, Inventory & Supply Chain**

· Track marketplace POs and ensure they are received, reviewed and actioned within the platform’s operating cadence.

· Reconcile inventory against open POs weekly for Myntra and Purplle, and follow up on shortages, pending orders and delivery issues.

· Coordinate Nykaa D weekly POs and obtain month-start stock-on-hand (SOH) and sales reports from the KAM.

· Coordinate Zepto’s twice-weekly POs and resolve supply-chain or lead-time issues with the internal supply-chain team and marketplace SCM contacts.

· Follow up on POs for newly listed Myntra SKUs within the SOP-defined 15–20-day timeline.

**6. Marketing, Visibility & Performance Advertising Coordination**

· Coordinate marketplace visibility plans and campaign requirements with marketplace marketing POCs.

· Work with the Performance Marketing/Ads team on PLA and PREP activity, as applicable; ensure budgets are management-approved.

· Close and review Zepto PLA visibility monthly and pursue FOC on-site visibility against PLA investment where applicable.

· Align monthly visibility on the Superstore by Nykaa app and coordinate relevant Purplle visibility/PREP plans and settlements.

· Maintain marketing decks, discounting files, listing guidelines, NPI files and monthly plans.

**7. Commercials, Claims, Settlements & Reconciliation**

· Verify marketing-investment and discount debit notes (DNs), claims and supporting workings before approval/sign-off, as applicable to each marketplace.

· Coordinate with MKKL’s online and Accounts-Receivable teams for discount and advertising settlement checks.

· Track Nykaa D JBP claims against pre-agreed slabs and coordinate applicable visibility, discount and claim settlements.

· Coordinate Purplle visibility, MOQ, discount and PREP settlements with the marketplace POC; flag discrepancies for resolution.

· Coordinate the applicable 1% West Bengal TOT claim with the Accounts team for Nykaa D.

· Maintain an audit-ready record of approved discounts, claims, bills, DNs, settlement status and supporting files.

**8. Cross-Functional Coordination**

· Work closely with Brand/Marketing, Performance Marketing, Supply Chain, Online Business and Accounts teams.

· Ensure discount values, advertising spends, visibility investments and commercial commitments are approved by the appropriate internal stakeholders before execution.

· Share clear updates on sales, inventory, listings, claims, pending actions and escalations.

**Systems & Tools**

· Myntra Partner Portal and Myntra app/website

· Nykaa D (FSN D) seller systems, Nykaa.com catalog and Superstore by Nykaa app

· Purplle seller systems and Purplle Workflow Google Sheet

· Zepto Brand Portal and Zepto discount upload portal

· Master files, style-ID/SKU masters, daily/weekly sales trackers, CTS Google Sheets, JBP plans, email and DN/claim records

**Candidate Profile**

· Education: Graduate in Business, Marketing, Commerce or a related discipline preferred.

· Experience: Relevant experience in e-commerce or marketplace account operations; the required years of experience can be defined based on the hiring level.

· Marketplace exposure: Experience with Myntra, Nykaa, Purplle, Zepto or similar e-commerce/quick-commerce platforms is preferred.

· Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, reporting accuracy and comfort with SKU-level sales and commercial data.

· Good understanding of cataloging, listing, pricing, promotions, purchase orders, inventory coordination and marketplace claims/settlements.

· Strong follow-up, stakeholder management, problem-solving, attention to detail and written communication skills.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
This is not a conventional sales role. We're looking for a **Regional Sales Manager** to join **SPT Labtech**, we partner with scientists to transform laboratory workflows through advanced automation solutions. Our business focuses on high-value laboratory automation platforms sold through consultative engagement with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology organisations, CROs, diagnostic laboratories, research institutes and academic institutions

Success in this role comes from creating opportunities rather than responding to existing demand. You will build trusted relationships with scientific and commercial stakeholders, educate customers on the value of automation, and manage complex capital equipment sales cycles

If you enjoy opening new markets, influencing technical decision-makers and building long-term customer partnerships, you'll thrive in this role

The position requires strong commercial acumen, excellent communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, critical thinking and a high degree of ownership

**About Us**

Based in Melbourn, near Cambridge, UK, SPT Labtech develops innovative automation solutions that transform the way scientists work

For over two decades, our scientists, engineers and business innovators have designed world-leading technologies for liquid handling, sample preparation and sample management, helping researchers accelerate discoveries that improve human health

Our success is built on close collaboration with customers, developing trusted partnerships and delivering innovative solutions to solve real-world laboratory challenges

Join our growing India team and help shape the future of life science research.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive commercial growth across the assigned territory by achieving quarterly and annual sales targets for advanced laboratory automation solutions
* Proactively identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, diagnostic, academic and research organizations
* Generate qualified opportunities through prospecting, networking, scientific engagement, conferences, seminars, referrals and strategic outreach
* Build and manage a healthy long-term sales pipeline using structured account planning, stakeholder mapping and consultative selling
* Own the complete sales cycle, from opportunity creation and technical discussions through commercial negotiations, order closure and post-installation relationship management
* Develop trusted relationships with principal investigators, laboratory heads, procurement teams, key opinion leaders and senior decision-makers
* Collaborate closely with Applications, Service and Product Management teams to develop customer-focused technical and commercial solutions
* Support and develop channel partners through joint customer visits, opportunity reviews, technical discussions, demonstrations and regional marketing initiatives
* Deliver compelling scientific and commercial presentations that clearly demonstrate the value of laboratory automation
* Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting and opportunity tracking using Salesforce CRM.
* Monitor market trends, customer research priorities, competitor activities and emerging technologies to identify new business opportunities
* Ensure timely quotation follow-up, commercial documentation, order processing and customer communication.
* Travel extensively within the assigned territory to develop customer relationships and support channel partners.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy building markets rather than simply fulfilling demand

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

* A hunter mentality with a passion for opening new accounts and developing untapped markets.
* The patience and resilience required to manage consultative capital equipment sales cycles
* Curiosity about science and technology, with the ability to engage confidently with researchers and technical stakeholders.
* Strong consultative selling skills focused on understanding customer challenges before proposing solutions.
* Self-motivation, ownership and the ability to work independently.
* A continuous learning mindset and enthusiasm for mastering new technologies and applications.
* High integrity and a long-term approach to building customer relationships and sustainable business growth

**Qualifications & Experience**

Essential

* Ideally 5+ years of successful sales experience in life science capital equipment, laboratory automation
* Experience selling into pharmaceutical, biotechnology, genomics, molecular biology or research markets.
* Master's degree or B.Tech in Biotechnology, Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop new business and consistently achieve or exceed sales targets.
* Ability to understand scientific applications and communicate technical concepts confidently to customers.

Preferred

* Experience selling automated liquid handling systems, genomics automation or sample management solutions
* Experience using Salesforce CRM or equivalent sales management platforms.

**What We Offer**

At SPT Labtech, you'll work alongside passionate scientists, engineers and commercial professionals who are committed to advancing scientific discovery

**We offer:**

* Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
* Private medical insurance
* Annual discretionary bonus.
* Opportunities for professional growth within a global life science technology company.
* A collaborative, inclusive and innovation-driven culture.

SPT Labtech is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to succeed, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or family status.

**Apply Now**

If you're excited by the challenge of building markets, partnering with scientists and helping accelerate breakthroughs in life science research, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your latest CV and join us in shaping the future of laboratory automation.

title: Channel Sales Specialist
description:
**Brief Job Description:**

The Partner Manager is responsible for sales growth through managed reseller and distributor partners to help maximize channel sales opportunities across the region.

The main contribution of this role is driving aggressive revenue growth of Mission-Critical infrastructure solutions from Vertiv’s Rack and Edge based products, including UPS, Rack/Row based Cooling, Power Distribution and IT Management portfolios.

Mission-critical infrastructure solutions include:

* Hardware – 1-phase and 3-phase uninterruptible power supplies, racks, power distribution, thermal management (air and liquid cooling) and remote IT management.
* Software – power & thermal management control, remote access & control of IT assets, user based access & visualization management, protocol interface & standards for IT / facilities management / DCIM / BMS systems.
* Services – extended warranty, commissioning and maintenance packages, as well as mechanical / electrical installation, project management, integration, assembly and ancillary services specific to critical infrastructure environments.

Customer Focus:

* Account focus will be on a diversified IT reseller & distribution segment, with focus on projects requiring infrastructure to support white space IT hardware and High Performance Computing applications, housing AI compute chipsets and servers.
* End users and technology service providers, ranging from SME space to global Blue Chip companies and government entities covering a full breadth of market verticals.
* Channel Partners, ranging from server OEMs to large IT resellers, working in tandem with our Electrical Distribution partner network.

**Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each: -**

**(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)**

* Create and manage agreed partner business (growth) plans. Setting targets for Partner Incentive Agreements and working to achieve / exceed agreed sales targets and KPI commitments.
* Identify, recruit, onboard and progress partners through the Vertiv Partner Program.
* On site cadence to develop the technical competency of each partner and support sales enablement, whilst utilizing resources including Application Engineering, Marketing and Sales Support.
* Along with other joint resources, roll out promotional activity, product launches and plan partner events, such as technology workshops and seminars.
* Monthly and Quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Perform site surveys to scope and qualify customer technical and commercial requirements.
* Selecting product mixes, developing solutions and managing quotations.
* Facilitating bid management, through Vertiv’s Quote to Order process: Provide effective qualification of opportunities, use of Vertiv’s configuration / quote tools, and work to manage customer expectations through Vertiv’s Application Engineering team to provide technically and commercially comprehensive bids.
* Extensive and professional use of CRM tools. Supporting Vertiv’s management standards ensuring high quality, accurate input to pipeline management and forecasting.
* Manage all additional account management functions such as operations, stock control and contact management.
* Support demonstrations, planning and accompanying partners / end users both domestically and internationally.
* Channel conflict management.
* Deal registration and Special Price Request (SPR) management.
* Lead and coordinate marketing plans, promotions and product launches, along with channel field marketing functions.
* Champion Vertiv tools and programs such as the Vertiv Partner Program, Partner Portal and Vertiv Solution Designer.
* Identify, develop and maintain relationships with Vertiv funded heads in the reseller network.

**Qualifications: -**

**Required/ Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in an applicable technology or business field, with demonstrated business aptitude.
* Excellent people management and relationship building skills.
* Excellent presentation and verbal / written communication skills, delivered in person and via virtual settings.
* Exceptionally strong channel development and management experience of at least 5+ years in similar or related positions with strong understanding of regional resellers and partners in the region.
* Outstanding, demonstratable track record in achieving sales targets.
* International English at advanced level.
* Significant experience managing sales, or multiple component products / programs.
* Experience in use of PowerBI reports to impart customer insight and facilitate internal reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with sales channels including IT Distribution, Electrical Distribution, Value Added Resellers, System Integrators, and Electrical & Mechanical Contractors is essential.
* Familiarity with technology verticals including IT cloud services, communication / telecom, collocation and enterprise is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with server OEM & ODM market leaders, their technologies, capabilities, go-to-market routes, and strategies is highly preferred.

**Additional / Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrating Ethics and Integrity: Increase Vertiv’s market share and achieve / exceed budget figures in line with company ethics and policy. You follow through with promises. You use ethical considerations to guide decision and actions, conforming with regulatory compliance and ITC.
* Building and Maintaining Relationships: You negotiate adeptly with individuals and groups. You are effective at managing conflict and confrontations skillfully. You know how to build and maintain working relationships with co-employees and external parties.
* You are a driven self-starter with a sense of urgency: an ability to plan, organize and manage time effectively, whilst developing / executing strategic business plans. You are analytical and enjoy problem solving.
* Contribute to teamwork and knowledge sharing inside the team and organization: maintain and update reporting systems, run scheduled and ad-hoc analysis, lead and participate in team meetings and share your experiences, share new knowledge you gather about the market, competitors and challenges you perceive we face.
* Focus on self-growth and development: keep an open mind and learn from some of the best experts in the industry, participate in Vertiv meetings and events to acquire knowledge of where the market is going, keep up to date with technical developments, participate in company trainings and apply the knowledge in your day-to-day work.
* Be innovative: bring your own ideas of improvements inside the team, look at each process and task with the goal of constantly improving it to bring more value to the customer, to you, the team, and the organization.

**Physical & Environmental Requirements: - (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)**

* None

**Time Travel Needed:**

* 70% travel expected on average, with prolonged peaks on occasion.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,800 experts working across six offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
The Learning Operations Manager is responsible for the operational services, infrastructure, and governance that enable learning products and services to run effectively within the Global Learning Framework.
  
  
Working in close partnership with CoE Talent Experience & HR Digital Product team (LMS Product Owner), the role ensures learning solutions can be deployed, administered, supported, and continuously improved through strong workflows, learning platforms, automation, reporting, and service processes.
  
  
The role owns the operational backbone required to deliver those concepts reliably, efficiently, and at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Operations service delivery**

* Own the Learning Operations service model that supports learning products and services across agreed delivery types and tracks.
* Translate product requirements, operating model decisions, and agreed RACI into clear operational workflows, support models, administrative processes, and service standards.
* Ensure effective operational handoffs between CoE Talent Experience, Learning Operations, HR Digital Product team (LMS Product Owner), vendors, and other delivery partners.
* Provide operational input on feasibility, readiness, scalability, support needs, and transition to run-state.

**Administration, workflows and operational processes**

* Lead the design and continuous improvement of operational processes for learning deployment, enrolment, scheduling, communications, reporting, issue handling, and learner support.
* Ensure operational processes are standardized, documented, sustainable, and scalable across the learning portfolio.
* Design, develop, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Learning Operations Services
* Drive clarity on roles, service boundaries, escalation paths, and service expectations within Learning Operations.
* Establish and continuously improve service delivery practices to ensure efficient, standardized, and user-centric Learning Operations services.

**Learning platform and LMS operations**

* Own the operational oversight of learning platforms and LMS-related processes required to support learning delivery.
* Partner with HR Digital Product team (LMS Product Owner) and relevant platform owners to ensure learning solutions are operationally viable, stable, and maintainable over time.
* Ensure strong platform operations across areas such as setup quality, data integrity, workflow reliability, system readiness, and operational support.
* Contribute operational expertise to platform changes, enhancements, and integrations that affect learning services.

**Self-service and scalable learning operations**

* Own the operational services that support self-service and scalable learning offerings, including high-volume and standardised delivery models.
* Ensure the operational model for self-service learning is efficient, user-friendly, and designed for scale.
* Improve intake, triage, workflow automation, and service performance for standard learning requests and repeatable offerings.
* Support frictionless access to learning through well-run administration, strong process design, and continuous operational improvement.

**Operational support for strategic learning products**

* Partner with Talent Experience product owners to ensure strategic learning products can be effectively deployed and sustained operationally.
* Provide early operational guidance during development to ensure learning solutions are realistic, supportable, and scalable in practice.
* Lead or coordinate the transition from design/build phase to stable operational delivery for new or evolving learning products.
* Ensure operational requirements are addressed before launch, including process readiness, platform readiness, reporting, support, and ownership in run-state.

**Reporting, data integrity and service insights**

* Lead the operational reporting and Power BI dashboard framework, providing actionable insights into learning delivery, service performance, platform adoption, and operational quality.
* Ensure accurate and reliable operational data to support decision-making, service improvement, and transparency.
* Monitor operational performance indicators and identify areas for simplification, automation, or quality improvement.
* Provide insights that help Talent Experience and other stakeholders understand operational realities, constraints, and improvement opportunities.

**Governance, service clarity and run-state ownership**

* Establish and maintain clarity on operational ownership, service responsibilities, and run-state support models for learning products once transitioned into operations.
* Support governance by making operational roles, processes, and decision points visible and understandable across stakeholders.
* Ensure mature and business-as-usual offerings have clear operational ownership and sustainable support arrangements.
* Strengthen transparency and accountability in how Learning Operations contributes to the broader learning ecosystem.

**Team leadership and capability building**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Learning Operations team to deliver high-quality, reliable, and scalable operational services.
* Set clear priorities, roles, and expectations across the team, ensuring strong coordination, accountability, and service focus.
* Build team capability in learning operations, systems, service delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, improvement-oriented team culture focused on operational excellence, stakeholder support, and end-user experience.
* Support resource planning, workload management, and capability development to ensure the team can meet current and future operational needs.

**Qualifications**
**Requirements**

* Should have 8+ year expereince
* Any graduate digree
* Significant experience in Learning Operations, HR Operations, or enterprise learning delivery, with strong knowledge of learning platforms, LMS operations, service delivery, and scalable operational processes.
* Proven ability to work across CoEs, HR Digital Product team (LMS Product Owner), vendors, and operational partners, with strong process thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to balance strategic intent with operational reality.
* A structured, reliable, and improvement-oriented leader who brings clarity to complexity, builds consistency at scale, and can confidently challenge approaches that are not operationally viable.

**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**

* Commitment to your development
* Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
* A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
* Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.
  
  
**Ready to join us?**
Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
  
  
Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
  
  
**Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do**
We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.

title: Fleet Superintendent
description:
**Location Country**
India
  
  
**Work Location**
Delhi
  
  
**Who are V?**
As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**
To ensure Technical policies and procedures are consistently applied across their assigned vessels.
  
  
Be the Primary Responsible & Accountable person for the assigned Vessels. Manage the Vessels to the highest Safety Standards in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and in accordance with V.Ships VMS, ensuring flawless service delivery to customers. Trust the fleet cell team to support him/her throughout all fleet operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Safety**
Safety is our first priority and the Fleet Superintendent has, in cooperation with the Fleet Manager, the authority and the accountability for taking necessary decisions that ensure constant safe operation and that everybody comes home safe and that we protect the environment.
  
  
**Customer**
Our Customers are our second priority after safety. The Fleet Superintendent is responsible for delivery of technical management service to the Customer. The Fleet Superintendent’s position is the link between the Customer and his/her ship and the responsible person for ensuring that the Customer fully benefits from the operational performance of his/her ship.
  
  
**Ownership**
Own the operation of the vessels managing them to the highest safety standards, effectively and efficiently in the provision of management services required under the Management Agreement and VMS. Plan, control and execute all activities connected with maintenance, repairs, dry-docking, conversion or modification of assigned vessels. This to be in line with Flag, Class and Statutory Requirements.
  
  
**Leadership**
Authorise selection process of Senior Officers for assigned Vessels, build and maintain a professional and effective working relationship with senior ship colleagues to influence the development of a strong safety culture. Conduct Senior Officer Performance Appraisals in accordance with VMS procedures and play an active role in their personal development
  
  
**PMS**
Responsible for PMS, to ensure that the job descriptions and maintenance intervals assigned to all machineries is as per makers manual, and that repairs history / spares consumed are correctly recorded in ShipSure for future reference and insurance claims / audits.
  
  
**Client**
Serve as the first contact point for the assigned vessels and liaise with respective Clients. Provide timely & accurate reports to Clients regarding the management, expenditure & condition of the Vessel as per the SMA and as agreed with the Clients.
  
  
**Monitor**
Monitor vessel performance trends including speed, fuel and lubricating oil consumptions, and implement timely remedial actions where these are outside agreed or expected parameters. Monitor and energy consumption on board the ships, ensuring that the vessels are operated most economically at all times.
  
  
**Report Issues**
Ensure that any issues that affect, or may affect, the safety, environmental or operational performance of assigned vessels are reported in time.
  
  
**Planning**
Plan Dry Dock, Vacation, Ships inspections and other absences with your Fleet Manager to ensure a consistent service to your Customers. Prepare ‘visitation’ plans to gain thorough knowledge of the assigned vessels and safety culture onboard.
  
  
**Quality**
In conjunction with the Shipboard team and the Marine Superintendent prepare vessels for inspection/audit by PSC, Flag, Oil Major and similar bodies. Deficiencies which can have an adverse effect on the commercial operation of the ship should be promptly reported to your line manager. Ensure all third party inspections are passed and that observations match individual KPI.
  
  
**Reporting**
To be an advocate of ShipSure and ensure it is properly utilised within the fleet cell. Support and assist colleagues where required and provide constructive feedback to aid continuous improvement of the system.
  
  
**Finance**
Work with relevant members of the Fleet Cell and Vessel to co-ordinate all information required for the preparation of the vessels’ running cost budget. Maintain strict control of all aspects of vessel expenditure. No out of Budget spending without prior consent of the Client.
  
  
**Day to Day**
Discuss with Ships’ Command the work plan, running costs, spares and stores situation and other issues of concern and report/correction on same.
  
  
**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
  
  
**Essential**

* Recognised Engineering or Naval Architecture qualification and/or relevant experience at sea.
* Good communication (oral and written) and English language skills,
* Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and interact with people at all levels.
* Good planning and organisational skills,
* An ability to develop creative and effective solutions to problems.

**Desirable**

* 2 Year’s experience as a senior shipboard officer on relevant ship type
* Previous experience as a Fleet Superintendent in a Technical Department, or previous experience in a Senior Engineering/Naval Architecture position in the Marine Industry.
* Member of IMarEST and Engineering Council registration or other equivalent recognised professional registration
* Basic financial understanding and some experience in administering budgets.

**Applications Close Date**

**About Epsilon Asia Group**

Epsilon Asia Group provides products and services that improve the reliability of power infrastructure. Its portfolio includes RTV insulator coatings, silicone insulation sleeves and tapes and advisory services. The group also provides sales and service support in India for Trench Group, including HSP, covering air core reactors, instrument transformers and bushings.

**Role Purpose**

You will own sales and business development for assigned products, accounts or territory. The role requires developing opportunities with EPC contractors and power-sector customers, leading technical and commercial discussions, and converting enquiries into profitable orders. You will coordinate customer commitments through execution and payment collection.

**Key Responsibilities Business Development and Sales**

· Own the sales pipeline for assigned accounts or territory, targeting EPC contractors, utilities, PSUs, OEMs, consultants and industrial customers.

· Prepare account plans covering upcoming projects, procurement timelines and decision-makers; generate and qualify enquiries through customer visits and targeted outreach.

· Develop new accounts and expand existing relationships to achieve agreed order-booking, revenue and margin targets.

Technical Sales and Customer Engagement

· Lead customer discussions on applications, specifications and operating requirements; coordinate with technical specialists to propose suitable solutions.

· Present product value using approved technical literature, test reports and case studies; coordinate demonstrations, trials and joint site visits.

Proposals and Tender Support

· Lead quotation and proposal coordination, including cost inputs, technical compliance, commercial terms and timely submission of supporting documents.

· Track tenders and RFQs; coordinate vendor registrations, product approvals and customer clarifications, including GeM and procurement portals where applicable.

· Negotiate within approved authority, review margins and commercial risks, and resolve scope, delivery or payment differences before order acceptance.

Customer Relationships and Order Coordination

· Own key-account relationships across procurement, engineering, project and maintenance teams; coordinate shared accounts and opportunities with the Business Head.

· Coordinate with technical, operations, procurement and logistics teams on delivery commitments and documentation; escalate issues affecting customer satisfaction or collections.

· Review account receivables with finance, follow up on payments and resolve commercial or documentation issues delaying collections.

Marketing and Market Development

· Plan targeted customer engagement through visits, seminars, exhibitions and product presentations; convert resulting leads into qualified opportunities.

· Develop sales material with technical colleagues and report competitor activity, customer feedback and opportunities for new applications.

Sales Planning and Reporting

· Maintain CRM records covering enquiry stages, expected order values, closure dates, decision-makers and agreed next actions.

· Present sales forecasts, account reviews, win/loss analysis and recovery plans where performance falls behind agreed targets.

Mandatory Qualifications and Experience

· B.E. or B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or another engineering discipline relevant to the assigned products.

· **8-10 years of relevant B2B technical sales, business development or project-sales experience.**

· Experience in EPC contracting, sales to EPC contractors, or comparable sales in the electrical/power industry is mandatory.

· Demonstrated ability to develop customer accounts, understand technical requirements, negotiate commercial terms and convert enquiries into orders.

· Strong communication skills in English and Hindi, including customer meetings and presentations, with clear written English for proposals and commercial correspondence.

· Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, and CRM or equivalent sales-tracking tools.

· Willingness to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations and site visits within the assigned territory.

Preferred Experience

· Product exposure to insulation systems, substations, high-voltage equipment, bushings, instrument transformers, reactors or related electrical solutions.

· Familiarity with utility/OEM approvals, GeM, e-procurement and project-based buying processes.

· A relevant customer network and experience handling longer sales cycles, account expansion and commercial follow-up.

Performance Measures

Performance will be assessed against agreed sales and margin targets, qualified pipeline and new-customer development, enquiry-to-order conversion, forecast accuracy, timely proposals, repeat business and contribution to collections. Numerical targets will be agreed with the reporting manager.

title: FP&A
description:
**FP&A – &Done**
At &Done, we’re redefining what high-performance haircare looks like for Indian hair. Backed by biotechnology and scientific precision, our formulations are designed specifically for Indian hair and weather—delivering results global brands weren’t built to offer.
  
  
We started in salons, earning the trust of top stylists across India, and are now scaling rapidly through our direct-to-consumer launch.
  
  
Founded by Saumya Yadav (Stanford GSB ’19, IIT Delhi ’13; ex-Urban Company, ex-Udayy) and Atit Jain (BITS Pilani ’09; 2X founder – Pluss, Bulbul; ex-VC at Elevation Capital), we’re VC-backed and building a category-defining brand from the ground up.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially minded FP&A professional to manage financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting and internal controls.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, translating financial information into actionable business insights and collaborating with cross-functional teams. This role requires a combination of strong financial fundamentals, analytical thinking and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Drive annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and financial planning processes.
* Monitor actual financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying key variances and their underlying reasons.
* Prepare monthly financial reports, MIS, and performance dashboards for management review.
* Analyze revenue, costs, margins, profitability, and cash flow to identify business trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business planning and strategic decisions.
* Financial Control & Reporting
* Oversee monthly financial closing and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Ensure proper accounting, reconciliation, and documentation of financial transactions.
* Monitor and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting processes, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of financial statements and management reports.
* Business Finance & Commercial Analysis
* Work closely with business teams across D2C, sales, marketing, and operations to evaluate financial performance.
* Analyze channel-wise revenue, contribution margins, customer acquisition costs, and operating expenses.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities and recommend measures to improve operational efficiency.
* Track key financial and business KPIs and provide actionable insights to management.
* Working Capital & Cash Flow Management
* Monitor cash flow, working capital requirements, receivables, and payables.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and track liquidity requirements.
* Monitor inventory-related financial metrics and identify potential working capital risks.
* Support financial planning for business expansion and operational requirements.
* Process Improvement & Financial Governance
* Establish and improve financial reporting systems, processes, and controls.
* Identify gaps in existing financial processes and drive improvements.
* Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Support the implementation and optimization of finance tools, systems and reporting frameworks.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 3–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
* Strong experience in FP&A, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Experience working with accounting software and ERP systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to interpret financial data and translate it into actionable business insights.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Someone who is hands-on and comfortable managing both strategic analysis and day-to-day financial responsibilities.
* A professional with strong ownership who can independently drive financial processes.
* Someone who can look beyond numbers and understand the business implications behind them.
* A proactive individual who can identify financial risks, spot opportunities and recommend practical solutions.
* Someone who can work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to support business growth.

💰 Competitive salary + High ownership and visibility in a growing organization
  
  
💇‍♀️ Perks: Collaborative and people-first work culture + Learning and growth opportunities across functions

**Job Description**
**Job Description**

Gurgaon, India

5+ Years

MBA Finance / Semi-Qualified CA / CMA or equivalent
  
  

* Role Overview

The Finance Business Partner will be part of the Corporate Finance team, reporting into the Country CFO organisation, and will be responsible for partnering with 1–2 business lines.
  
  
The role will own the financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, P&L analysis and management reporting for the assigned business lines. It will work closely with business leadership to provide financial insights, identify performance trends and support strategic decision-making.
  
  
The position will also contribute to the evolution of the FP&A function through enhanced analytics, reporting automation, digital tools and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
This is a business-facing finance role with a strong emphasis on FP&A, financial analysis and business partnering rather than transactional accounting.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Business Partnering & Financial Performance
* Act as the primary finance partner for assigned business lines, working closely with business leadership.
* Own and monitor the P&L, providing visibility into revenue, costs, margins and profitability.
* Analyse financial performance and provide actionable insights to support business decisions.
* Identify financial risks, opportunities and areas for performance improvement.
* Support business leaders with financial inputs for strategic and operational initiatives.
* Financial Planning & Forecasting
* Drive annual operating plans (AOP), budgeting, monthly forecasts and financial outlook processes.
* Manage monthly financial planning cycles, including LMF and periodic outlook updates.
* Analyse actual performance against budgets, forecasts and business targets.
* Track revenue, operating costs, headcount and other key financial drivers.
* Support rolling forecasts and continuous planning initiatives.
* Financial Analysis & Decision Support
* Conduct revenue, cost, margin and profitability analysis.
* Support deal pricing, bid evaluations and commercial business cases.
* Prepare financial models and scenario-based analysis.
* Evaluate headcount requirements, hiring plans and associated business cases.
* Identify cost optimisation and margin improvement opportunities.
* Provide financial inputs for working capital and collections monitoring.
* Management Reporting & Insights
* Own periodic management reporting and financial performance dashboards.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting packs for business leadership.
* Perform variance analysis and provide meaningful commentary on financial results.
* Leverage Power BI and other visualisation tools to improve reporting and business insights.
* Drive the transition from traditional reporting towards driver-based and predictive analysis.
* Systems, Data & Process Management
* Collaborate with the FP&A Operations Hub for standardised reporting, data preparation and system uploads.
* Review and validate financial reports and planning inputs prepared by the Operations Hub.
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency across finance systems.
* Work with platforms such as OneStream, Workday and other financial planning tools.
* Identify opportunities to standardise and streamline FP&A processes.
* Automation, AI & Digital Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate financial reporting, forecasting and analytical activities.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot to improve productivity and reporting efficiency.
* Explore AI-powered solutions for variance analysis, data validation and automated financial commentary.
* Collaborate with Data and Technology teams to develop and implement digital finance solutions.
* Contribute to building a predictive, technology-enabled and insight-driven FP&A function.
* Experience & Qualifications
* MBA in Finance, Semi-Qualified CA, CMA or equivalent finance qualification.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, Financial Planning, Management Reporting, Business Finance or Finance Business Partnering.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, P&L management and financial performance analysis.
* Experience in analysing financial data, identifying trends and translating findings into business insights.
* Advanced MS Excel skills and proficiency in financial modelling.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, financial planning tools and ERP systems such as Workday, OneStream or similar platforms.
* Exposure to automation, digital finance tools and AI-enabled solutions will be an advantage.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Key Competencies
* Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business performance and translate financial data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong ownership and accountability for assigned business lines.
* Effective stakeholder management and business partnering skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Proactive approach towards process improvement and automation.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt emerging technologies and AI-enabled solutions.
* Key Success Measures
* Accuracy and reliability of financial forecasts.
* Timely completion of budgeting, forecasting and reporting cycles.
* Quality of financial analysis and management insights.
* Effective P&L monitoring and identification of performance improvement opportunities.
* Data accuracy and consistency across reporting platforms.
* Improved reporting efficiency through automation and digital solutions.
* Business stakeholder satisfaction and effectiveness of finance partnering.
* Organisation & Stakeholder Interface
* Function: Corporate Finance
* Reporting: Country CFO organisation
* Location: Corporate Office, Gurgaon
* Business Coverage: 1–2 assigned business lines
* Key Interfaces: Business Leadership, FP&A Operations Hub, Controllership, HR, Business Support and Data & Technology teams.

The Finance Business Partner will serve as the financial partner to assigned business lines, with end-to-end ownership of planning, forecasting, P&L analysis and management reporting.
  
  
The role will progressively evolve beyond traditional FP&A reporting towards proactive business insights, predictive analytics, automation and AI-enabled financial decision support.
