**Why Join Us?**

**Exciting Problem**

The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews - which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.

**Immense Scale**

In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
**900k users daily**
to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.

**Stellar Team**

Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!

**Growth Opportunity**

We have grown remarkably in the last 3 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.

Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.

**What would you be doing?**

* **Own the monetization P&L**
  — set and deliver the growth and revenue target across your category, and be accountable for the number end to end.
* **Build the category annual plans**
  — bottom-up targets by category and brand, the assumptions behind them, and the quarterly milestones that make the annual number credible. Own the re-forecast when reality moves.
* **Build the category strategy and brand playbook**
  — decide which categories and brands to prioritize, how to price and package solutions, what the pitch is, and what the reachout motion looks like at scale. Turn what works into something repeatable, not a series of one-off wins.
* **Hunt and farm brand budgets**
  — build the pipeline from the ground up, run the outreach, negotiate deals, and grow spend from existing brands season over season. You'll be as comfortable opening a cold brand as expanding a live one.
* **Set and drive targets across teams**
  — translate the category plan into clear targets for the respective category KAMs, align them on the why, and run the review cadence that keeps everyone honest against the number.
* **Run the category on data**
  — build the metrics and dashboards that matter, use them to spot opportunities and diagnose problems, and translate analysis into decisions (not just charts).
* **Partner cross-functionally**
  — work with sales, product, creator, and marketing teams to execute your plan when you don't directly control every lever.
* **Shape how we monetize**
  — as an early owner, define the playbook for categories that others will build on.

**What are we looking for?**

* **5–7 years in category management**
  at an FMCG / CPG or beauty & personal care (BPC) brand, or on the e-commerce / quick-commerce / marketplace side.
* **A track record of owning a commercial or revenue number**
  — ideally monetization, ad revenue, or retail media (not only supply, assortment, or vendor management).
* Experience
  **planning a target bottom-up**
  and then landing it across teams you don't directly manage.
* **Strong, hands-on data and analytics ability**
  — comfortable in Excel/Sheets and BI tools, and able to manipulate data yourself rather than relying entirely on an analyst.
* **Proven experience building business partnerships and alliances**
  — sourcing, negotiating, and growing brand relationships.
* **Strategic and hands-on in equal measure**
  — you can set the plan and also do the work in a lean, fast-moving environment.
* **Strong commercial judgment and communication**
  — able to influence stakeholders and make sound trade-off calls.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with retail media or ad-monetization products on a platform/marketplace.
* Exposure to the creator, influencer, or affiliate-commerce ecosystem.
* Have built a monetization or GTM motion from scratch before.

**Why join us?**

* Full ownership of a category's monetization — not a slice of it.
* A rare role that genuinely blends strategy, hands-on data, and partnerships.
* High-growth stage with room to shape how the category is built.

**Perks and Benefits**

* We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning & Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**Overview**
At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
  
  
Do you thrive on empowering partners to drive successful customer outcomes and long-term value? Would you love to help our partners further develop their expertise around customer success?
  
  
As a Partner Success Manager, you will be a part of Microsoft’s Channel Technical Team, focused on Azure within SME&C and accountable for driving Azure consumption growth through a portfolio of key partners aligned to a geographic region. You will be continuously innovating, technically fluent, and be the evolution of joint partner sales and success strategies—while remaining deeply centered on delivering customer outcomes at scale. You will play a critical role in assessing and advancing partner Customer Success Unit (CSU) maturity, building scalable practices that enable partners to drive sustained adoption and consumption.
  
  
To be successful, you will bring a strong understanding of partner business models, customer success practices, and cross-sell/upsell motions across cloud services and routes to market, along with a solid foundation in Azure (minimum 200-level knowledge) and IaaS. You will work with a cross-functional v-team spanning partner, sales, technical, and operations stakeholders to accelerate Azure consumption. By developing and scaling partner-led customer success practices—including CSU maturity—you will empower partners to better invest in customer needs, unlock new growth opportunities, and drive digital transformation outcomes. This role is flexible in that you can work up to [50% home / This role is Microsoft onsite only].
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will build and maintain deep knowledge of partner capabilities, industry trends, and competitive landscapes, applying these insights to shape partner strategies, enhance growth, and deliver differentiated customer outcomes.
* You will align partner capabilities to specific business opportunities, activating the right partners and Microsoft sales plays to drive measurable customer outcomes across solutions and workloads.
* You will act as a trusted bridge between Microsoft sellers, partners, and customers—building confidence in partner capabilities, guiding engagement approaches, and ensuring alignment between partner offerings and customer needs.
* You will guide sellers/customers in selecting the right partners and solutions, leveraging customer insights and targeting tools to identify whitespace opportunities and match them to partner strengths.
* You will collaborate closely with partners and internal stakeholders to validate opportunities, assess feasibility, and ensure partners are positioned with the right customer references and capabilities to win and scale.
* You will engage key stakeholders across partner portfolios to identify and activate opportunities that drive Azure sales, new customer acquisition, and usage growth. You will guide partners to build and execute consumption plans, align the right customer targets and co‑sell solutions, and orchestrate internal resources to maximize efficiency and impact. You will also support partners in operationalizing opportunities, including activation strategy and system/tool entry as deals progress.
* You will collaborate with partners and internal teams to define goals across solution areas, industries, and prioritized customer segments. You will assess partner capabilities, align them to business needs, and co-develop consumption plans that accelerate outcomes. You will optimize partner marketing investments and ensure the right partners are prioritized to deliver strong return on investment (ROI) and scalable growth.
* You will select, develop, and manage partner performance through Partner Development Dimensions (PDDs), providing actionable feedback and closing performance gaps in partnership with development managers. You will drive co-selling execution, coach partners on consumption/usage planning and demand generation, and build and oversee partner sales plans to ensure consistent delivery against revenue and growth targets.
* You will identify and communicate high-impact sales and solution opportunities to partners, leveraging segment expertise to align the right partner capabilities to customer needs and ensure partners are enabled with the skills and resources required to execute and scale successfully.

**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in sales, industry channel sales, and industry sales OR equivalent experience.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field AND 9+ years experience in industry channel sales, and industry sales OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related field AND 11+ years experience in industry channel sales, and industry sales OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of partner engagement experience.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Blue Moon Marketing is expanding into India, and we're looking for a Client Success Manager to be one of our founding members of our presence here — someone who can turn good client relationships into great ones, keep accounts thriving, and help them grow.

We're a results-driven marketing agency headquartered in Sydney. We help businesses generate measurable results through lead generation, brand development, and integrated growth campaigns. Our team runs on creativity, collaboration, and a genuine obsession with client outcomes. This is a chance to help build something from the ground up, with the backing of an agency that's already proven across two cities.

**The Role**

This is a client-facing role for a commercially minded marketer who loves owning relationships and driving growth within their portfolio. You'll be the trusted point of contact for our Delhi clients — guiding them from onboarding through ongoing strategy, making sure they hit their goals, and identifying opportunities to expand the work we do together. You'll also play a part in growing the portfolio through warm referrals and inbound opportunities.

The role begins part-time (3 days per week) and transitions to full-time once you've hit agreed retention and revenue targets — so you control the timeline.

**What you'll do**

**Client Success & Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of Delhi clients.
* Build deep, trusted relationships by understanding each client's business objectives and marketing needs.
* Oversee delivery of marketing strategies alongside our internal strategists, ensuring expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Run regular check-ins, performance reviews, and strategy sessions to keep clients satisfied and surface upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Manage contract renewals and negotiate scope expansions to grow account value.
* Keep accurate, up-to-date records of client interactions, milestones, and communications in the CRM.
* Ensure smooth handovers between strategy and delivery teams for a seamless client experience.

**Growth & New Business**

* Develop and present tailored proposals that clearly articulate ROI across lead generation, brand growth, and digital strategy.
* Help grow the portfolio through referrals, networking, and warm opportunities in the Delhi market.
* Run high-quality discovery conversations to understand prospect goals and pain points.
* Collaborate with internal teams to align client expectations with realistic deliverables and timelines.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of our proposals, pitch decks, and client processes.

**What you'll bring**

**Essentials**

* 2+ years in client success, account management, or client-facing sales — ideally in marketing, media, or an agency environment.
* Solid understanding of marketing fundamentals: digital marketing, lead funnels, branding, and growth strategy.
* Exceptional communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with the confidence to influence and negotiate.
* A proven track record of building client relationships that drive long-term retention and growth.
* A self-starter who can manage their own portfolio and workload with minimal supervision.
* Access to a reliable vehicle for occasional client visits across Delhi.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a marketing or creative agency.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (Go High Level) and pipeline management.
* Ability to grow accounts while managing day-to-day delivery.
* Comfort with performance marketing metrics (CPL, ROAS, conversion rates) for informed client conversations.

**The details**

* **Type:**
  Part-Time, 3 days/week (8 hrs/day), with a structured pathway to Full-Time
* **Progression:**
  Transition to full-time on achieving agreed retention and revenue targets
* **Travel:**
  Occasional client site visits (own vehicle or reliable car access required)

**Why Join BM Marketing**

* Join an agency that's already established in Sydney and Melbourne — you get the upside of a founding Delhi based role with the stability of a proven business behind you.
* A clear, transparent pathway from part-time to a well-compensated full-time role — based on performance, not time served.
* The chance to shape how we grow in the Delhi market from day one.
* A passionate, collaborative team that genuinely celebrates wins.
* A flexible hybrid arrangement that supports your life from day one.
* Ongoing professional development, industry events, and learning opportunities.

* Exhibit structured, analytical thinking and strong problem-solving capability.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial and ambitious business leader to lead our expansion into a new market.

This is not a traditional sales leadership role. We are looking for someone who can think like a founder, act like an entrepreneur and deliver like a business owner.

You will be responsible for taking a new market from the ground up, identifying opportunities, creating the right business ecosystem, building strategic partnerships and driving the journey from 1 to 10.

* Identify untapped opportunities and develop innovative approaches to accelerate market penetration.

* Develop and execute aggressive business acquisition and expansion strategies.
* Build a strong network of strategic partners, customers and industry stakeholders.
* Lead commercial negotiations, close strategic deals and establish long-term partnerships.
* Own business targets, revenue growth and regional performance.

**Think Like an Entrepreneur**

* Operate with a founder's mindset, taking ownership beyond defined responsibilities.
* Convert market insights into actionable business opportunities.
* Be comfortable with ambiguity, experimentation and calculated risks.
* Find ways to achieve more with limited resources.
* Be hands-on in building the business rather than relying only on teams and processes.

**Build for Scale**

* Develop the initial business development team and create a strong execution structure.
* Establish scalable business processes, performance metrics and growth strategies.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful market execution.
* Build a sustainable and profitable business that can scale independently.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* 10–12 years of experience in Business Development, Market Expansion, Sales Leadership or Business Management.
* Experience in launching new markets, building business verticals or scaling early-stage businesses.
* Strong entrepreneurial instincts and a proven track record of delivering business growth.
* Excellent commercial, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Ability to identify opportunities, build partnerships and convert them into business results.
* Strong financial understanding with the ability to manage revenue, margins and profitability.
* A natural leader who can inspire teams, influence stakeholders and drive execution.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with high levels of ownership and accountability.

**The Kind of Leader We Want**

* A go-getter who makes things happen.
* A self-starter who thrives on challenges and ambiguity.
* Someone with a strong bias for action and a solution-oriented mindset.
* A relationship builder who knows how to open doors and close deals.
* Someone who can move seamlessly between strategy and execution.
* A leader who is hungry to build, scale and create something meaningful.

**Your Mission:**
Build the foundation, create the momentum and scale the business. Take the market from its first opportunity to a thriving business operation.

Adobe’s Integrated Customer Experience (ICX) organization represents a next-generation sales model - powered by advanced analytics, data science, and Ai, to enable highly personalized, insight-driven customer engagement at scale.
  
  
By leveraging Ai-driven capabilities such as personalized outreach, dynamic email campaigns and video messaging tailored to individual customer needs and behaviors, we are able to create more meaningful and contextual customer connects. These AI-powered interactions allow us to engage customers at the right moment with relevant messaging, improving both response rates and overall experience.
  
This approach enables us not only to deepen relationships within our existing install base through targeted expansion, but also to drive new user acquisition across accounts- accelerating overall growth while maintaining a high degree of personalization and customer-centricity.
  
  
**The Challenge:**  
We are looking for sales professionals who will be responsible for driving expansion within the existing install base, as well as growing the book of business by acquiring new users within these accounts . You will be responsible for selling our Creativity & Productivity product portfolio, aligning customer needs with the value of our offerings to achieve revenue targets and long-term account growth.
  
  
What you’ll do as a CSAM
  
**Master Adobe Solutions :** Develop a strong understanding of the product solution and lead customer conversations by anchoring on their key challenges, positioning the solution in a way that directly addresses their specific business problems Driving Expansion: Drive Up-sell & Cross-sell by prioritizing accounts with highest propensity to buy by clearly defining ideal customer profile and contact them via phones, emails & Video Meetings. New User Acquisition : Besides driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell within existing accounts, you will also be responsible for identifying and acquiring new users and business professionals within the organization who are not currently using Adobe products. This includes analyzing overall organizational headcount and current penetration levels to identify whitespace opportunities and drive increased adoption across the enterprise. Quota Attainment : Deliver the quarterly target as assigned by the business. Be accountable to the goals of calls, emails, social media contacts, qualified meetings, opportunities, and revenue. Customer Research : Research customers in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to identify the growth opportunity within an account. Know “who the customer is” on a real-time basis when interacting with the customer over email, the phone, or video conference. Execute Marketing Leads/ Growth Propensity indicators : Execute Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) & other call to actions based on the propensity growth indicators with a defined SLA to maximize revenue. Pipeline Management : Manage the lead & opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook. Keep leads and opportunities updated in our internal CRM. Demos : Provide a basic demo of Adobe solutions to customers. Identify opportunities where a product specialist team can be involved to increase the deal size. Set up and attend the demos with them.
  
  
What you need to succeed
  
**Education :** Graduation & Higher Secondary School is required. Sales Expertise : 3+ Years of IT or software sales experience; Inside Sales experience is a plus. Experience selling SaaS solutions preferred, with SMB segment exposure and proven ability to acquire net-new customers. Possess sound understanding of the sales cycle, inside sales model, and consultative selling approach. A basic understanding of sales techniques like BANT, objection handling, sales funnel, and pipeline management is desired. Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM. Communication & Interpersonal Skills : Exceptional ability to build trust and rapport through clear, professional communication across multiple channels (phone, email, video, etc.). Be ready to cold call and book meetings daily with the strong ability to lead a customer conversation.
  

* Execution Excellence & Activity Management: Thrive in a high-volume, metrics-driven sales environment with a strong emphasis on daily outreach. Expected to consistently deliver 60–70 outbound calls and 40–50 emails per day while effectively managing time, prioritizing tasks, and navigating multiple tools.
* Maintain Motivation in a Remote Work Environment : Demonstrate the ability to stay self-motivated, focused, and productive while working remotely, ensuring consistent performance and timely achievement of goals.
* Technology Enthusiast : A passion for technology with the ability to quickly learn and articulate the business value of Adobe solutions. Organizational Skills : Strong organization, follow-through, and documentation skills suitable for customer communication. Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize customer’s demographics, history, and insights to pitch and drive sales.

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. title: Sr Product Manager ( Lending)
description:
Airtel is building one of India’s most ambitious consumer financial services franchises under the Airtel Finance brand. Airtel already reaches hundreds of millions of customers across the country; the task now is to turn that reach into a financial relationship spanning a customer’s whole financial life across save, pay, borrow, invest and insure use cases. Airtel Finance is the consumer franchise and distribution layer that holds the customer relationship, working with Airtel Payments Bank and other licensed entities that hold the balance sheet and the regulatory obligations.

Borrow is one of the broadest parts of the Airtel Finance portfolio, and personal loans are central to it. We are building a digital personal loan experience for Airtel’s customer base, working with lending partners and Airtel’s own NBFC, Airtel Money Limited, to offer credit that is fast, transparent and fair.

As Lead for LSP Platform, you will own the lending platform that powers personal loan, gold loan, credit card, EMI cards and other such products. We want someone with real fintech lending experience who can raise build a stable, robust and scalable lending platform that can serve current and future needs of the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LSP Platform Ownership and Roadmap**

* Own the LSP platform roadmap and build a stable, scalable platform that serves multiple products (personal loan, gold loan, credit card, EMI cards) and can onboard new products and partners without rework.
* Own integration platform’s health metrics such as uptime, latency, API success rates, bureau hit rates and turnaround time, and drive fixes for the issues they surface.

**LSP Platform Capabilities**

* Drive MCP changes and BB changes end to end: write clear requirements, sequence releases and manage impact across the products that depend on them.
* Own API contract changes: version contracts, keep them backward compatible and manage the impact on every product and partner integration that depends on them.

* The chance to build lending products on Airtel’s distribution, alongside Airtel’s own NBFC.
* Close proximity to senior leadership, with real influence over the product agenda.

title: Implementation Manager - Client Onboarding & Operations
description:
**About CloudAI Workflow**

CloudAI Workflow (cloudaiworkflow.com), built by Barjatiya Software Pvt. Ltd., is an AI-native operations platform for multi-site businesses. It replaces WhatsApp threads, registers and spreadsheets with live workflows for purchase, inventory, tasks, attendance, payroll and approvals. We are an early-stage, founder-led team in Kolkata, and our first customers are manufacturers, distributors and traders.

**The role**

You will be the person who takes CloudAI Workflow from "signed up" to "running the business." You will go on-site to client businesses, sit with owners, managers and floor staff, map how work really happens today, and then configure, roll out and drive adoption of CloudAI Workflow for them. Because you come from marketing, you will also turn every successful rollout into case studies, demos and referrals that bring in the next customer.

**What you will do**

* Visit client sites (factories, warehouses, showrooms, offices) to run discovery: map current processes, documents, approvals, data sources and pain points
* Translate what you find into workflow designs, then configure them in CloudAI Workflow: forms, approval chains, task assignments, schedules and dashboards
* Migrate and clean client master data (vendors, items, customers, employees) from Excel, Tally, Google Sheets and other tools
* Train users at every level, from owners to data entry staff, in Hindi, Bengali or English as needed, and stay on until the system is used daily
* Own go-live plans, timelines and adoption metrics for each account; spot upsell and expansion opportunities
* Feed structured client feedback to the product team and help shape the roadmap
* Build marketing assets from real deployments: case studies, before/after stories, demo scripts, short videos and LinkedIn/WhatsApp content
* Support sales with product demos and pilot scoping for new prospects

**What we are looking for**

* 5 to 8 years of experience, with a background in marketing (B2B, product or growth marketing) plus hands-on experience implementing software, ERP, CRM or process changes inside businesses
* Comfort walking into an SME, earning the owner's trust and understanding how purchase, sales, inventory and accounts actually flow
* Strong process thinking: you can draw a messy real-world process on a whiteboard and simplify it
* Very good with tools: advanced Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to Tally, Zoho, ERP/CRM platforms or no-code/automation tools is a strong plus
* Curiosity about AI and automation; you have used tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your own work
* Clear communication in English and Hindi; Bengali is a plus
* Willing to travel to client sites in and around Kolkata, with occasional outstation travel
* Nice to have: experience in textile, garment, manufacturing or distribution businesses; experience at a SaaS startup

**What we offer**

* Fixed pay of ₹8,00,000 to ₹14,00,000 per year based on experience, plus a performance incentive tied to successful go-lives and client expansion
* Travel, commute and phone reimbursement for client visits
* Early-team role with direct work with the founder, real ownership and a clear path to lead the implementation and customer success function as we grow
* A front-row seat in building an AI-native product for Indian businesses

**How to apply**

Apply with your resume and a few lines on one process or system you implemented inside a business: what was broken, what you changed and what happened.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

title: DGM/GM CDMO BD & Out Licensing - International Markets
description:
**Company Description**
Cadila Pharmaceuticals Limited is one of India’s largest privately held pharmaceutical companies, headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with a global presence in over 100 countries. For more than seven decades, the company has focused on innovation and research across 45+ therapeutic areas and 12 specialties, including cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, respiratory, anti-infectives, antidiabetics, and immunology. Over 300 scientists drive Research and Development in Biotechnology, APIs, Formulations, Plant Tissue Culture, and Phytochemistry, addressing high unmet medical needs. Cadila operates USFDA-approved and globally compliant manufacturing facilities for formulations and APIs in India, as well as a key formulations plant in Ethiopia, ensuring high-quality products for international markets. The organization offers opportunities for professionals to contribute to a research-driven, growth-oriented environment with strong international operations.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad for a DGM/GM CDMO BD & Out Licensing – International Markets. The role involves leading business development for CDMO services and out-licensing opportunities in key international markets, identifying and evaluating new business prospects, and building a robust pipeline of strategic partnerships. The individual will develop and execute business plans, market entry strategies, and revenue growth initiatives for international territories, working closely with R&D, regulatory, supply chain, and manufacturing teams to align capabilities with client needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing and nurturing long-term relationships with global pharmaceutical and biotech clients, driving contract negotiations, finalizing commercial terms, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies. The role also requires monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to refine offerings, provide regular business performance reports to leadership, and support cross-functional teams in successful project execution.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong New Business Development and Sales skills, with a proven track record of generating and closing opportunities in international pharmaceutical markets.
* Candidates should possess Business Planning capabilities, including experience in forecasting, market analysis, portfolio evaluation, and strategic growth planning.
* Candidates should possess Business Relationship Management skills, with experience in managing key accounts, building long-term partnerships, and collaborating with cross-functional global teams.
* Candidates should possess Contract Negotiation skills, including the ability to structure and negotiate CDMO, licensing, and commercial agreements aligned with regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Relevant experience in CDMO business development, out-licensing, or international pharmaceutical sales, ideally at a senior management level.
* Strong understanding of global pharmaceutical regulations, IP considerations, and commercial models for CDMO and licensing engagements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with senior leadership and external partners.

title: DGM - Production Pilot line
description:
Purpose of the Role
  
  
Own end-to-end process management of the entire Pilot Line, including planning and execution of chemistry changeovers (e.g., LFP to NMC, or any other emerging chemistry) to support R&D trials and new product qualification. Organize and control Pilot Line operations across all process areas E/A/B zones to support process qualification, DOE trials, and yield/quality improvement targets across chemistries.
  
  
Key Responsibility Areas
  
  
Manpower, Line & Shop-floor Management
  
  

* Plan and manage manpower deployment across the Pilot Line including shift/line management, attendance, multi-skilling, and readiness for changeover-driven workload swings.
* Own overall shop-floor management of the Pilot Line, day-to-day activities across process areas, work allocation, housekeeping (5S), and coordination across electrode, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation & aging, and inspection stations.
* Manage non-standard procurement and consumables required for pilot builds (trial materials, spares, tooling, jigs/fixtures, chemistry-specific PPE), coordinating with Procurement/Stores to avoid trial downtime.

Knowledge Generic
  
  
Process Ownership & Chemistry Changeover Management
  
  

* Own the Pilot Line process end-to-end across all process areas, including planning, sequencing, and executing changeovers between chemistries (e.g., LFP to NMC or other future chemistries) with minimal downtime.
* Define and maintain changeover procedures, process parameters, and equipment settings/fixtures required for each chemistry, ensuring the line can be reconfigured quickly and repeatably for new trials.

Job Context
  
  
Functional
  
  

* Organize and implement Pilot Line process/changeover strategies and action plans across all process areas to attain process-validation and productivity targets across chemistries.
* Capture, analyze, and report trial data (process capability, NG rates, root-cause analysis) to support go/no-go decisions on process and equipment readiness for mass production.
* Initiate plans and processes which minimize Pilot Line costs through effective utilization of manpower, equipment, facilities, materials, energy, and trial-cell capital across changeovers.

Job Context Specific
  
  
Coordination with R&D, Commercial & Quality
  
  

* Coordinate with the R&D team to align pilot-line trial plans and changeover schedules with new chemistry/product development roadmaps, translating technical requirements into achievable pilot-line builds.
* Coordinate with the Commercial team to understand customer and sample requirements, prioritize pilot-line build sequencing accordingly, and ensure timely delivery of trial cells/samples against commitments.

Knowledge Specific
  
  
B.E in (Mechanical/Electrical /Chemical), Six Sigma Certified / 10–15+ years leading manufacturing/pilot-line operations in Li-ion cell, EV battery pack, or solar cell manufacturing, with NPI, process validation, or multi-chemistry changeover exposure. Strong process knowledge across electrode/mixing-coating, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation & aging, and vision inspection, including how process parameters shift across chemistries. Skilled in exception handling, NG/CAPA management, and problem-solving tools (8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC, 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE). Working knowledge of IATF 16949, SAP/ERP, and MES for shop-floor data and compliance. Proven cross-functional coordination with R&D, Commercial, and Quality to translate production needs into a pilot-line plan

title: Associate Manager - SCR, BAF and Packing
description:
**Responsibilities**
Execute daily and monthly production plans across Spooler, Bright Annealing Furnace (BAF), and Packing lines to achieve ≥98% schedule adherence and meet customer dispatch commitments.
  
  
Ensure 100% conformance to mechanical temper (soft/light-annealed), grain size, bright oxide-free surface finish, and internal carbon/moisture cleanliness standards with zero customer rejections.
  
  
Optimize spooler traverse pitch, tension control, and coil layer winding to prevent coil collapse, telescoping, ovality, or surface scratches during unwinding at customer HVAC/R plants.
  
  
Monitor and control protective furnace atmosphere (N2/H2 flow, dew point, oxygen ppm), heating/cooling zone temperature profiles, and specific power/fuel consumption per MT within approved budgets.
  
  
Enforce zero-defect packing standards—immediate end-capping/crimping, nitrogen purging (where specified), VCI/stretch wrapping, wooden pallet/box strapping, barcode labeling, and batch traceability.
  
  
Enforce strict shop-floor safety protocols (hydrogen/protective gas leak detection & purging interlocks, high-temperature furnace safety, spooler pinch-point guarding, crane/forklift handling, LOTO, and 5S) with Zero LTA.
  
  
Supervise and train shift engineers, furnace operators, and packing teams; coordinate with Maintenance for radiant tube/fan/seal upkeep and ensure accurate ERP production & FG handover entries.
  
  
**Qualifications**

title: Associate Manager - Rolling Mill & Spinner Block
description:
**Responsibilities**
Execute daily and monthly production plans across Rolling Mill / Double Drawing and Spinner Block lines to achieve ≥98% schedule adherence and uninterrupted feeding to Inner Groove and Annealing lines.
  
  
Ensure strict adherence to OD, wall thickness, concentricity/eccentricity, and internal/external surface finish tolerances by optimizing reduction passes, drawing speeds, and Eddy Current Testing (ECT) parameters.
  
  
Coordinate closely with Tool Room to manage roll pass life, tungsten carbide/PCD drawing dies, and floating plugs—maximizing tooling life per MT and minimizing changeover downtime.
  
  
Minimize pointing/swaging scrap, tube breakage, chatter marks, and internal residue; monitor drawing oil/emulsion concentration, filtration, and temperature to ensure clean tube drawing.
  
  
Drive line OEE improvement across capstans, bull blocks, uncoilers/recoilers, and rolling stands; coordinate with Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance for timely PM execution and rapid breakdown resolution.
  
  
Enforce strict shop-floor safety protocols (high-speed rotating capstan guarding, pinch-point safety, pointing/swaging safety, crane/coil handling, LOTO, and 5S) to achieve Zero Lost Time Accidents (LTA).
  
  
Supervise, train, and evaluate shift engineers and machine operators; drive Kaizen/TPM initiatives and ensure accurate SAP PP production, scrap, and coil traceability entries.
  
  
**Qualifications**
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical / Metallurgical / Production Engineering.
  
  
Work Experiences (Min & Max): 8 + Years
  
  
8+ years of hands-on production experience in copper tube cold rolling (pilgering/rolling mill), Double Drawing benches, and Spinner Block / bull-block drawing operations.
  
  
To manage and optimize Rolling Mill / Double Drawing and Spinner Block operations in a copper tube manufacturing facility by delivering high-precision, defect-free copper coils on schedule while maximizing OEE, metallic yield, tooling life, and shop-floor safety.
  
  
Any Other (Remarks): Hands-on expertise in copper tube pass-schedule optimization, tungsten carbide dies & floating plug balancing, inline Eddy Current Testing (ECT), and feeding Inner Groove / Bright Annealing lines is strongly preferred.

**Strategic Relationship Management**
Build and maintain strong, effective relationships with key officials.

Engage with other critical government departments such as the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF), Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB), Irrigation Department, Electricity Board, Road & Building Department, Railways, ONGC/NHAI, and other relevant agencies for smooth approvals.

Sales Manager – Multi-Branch Operations

**Industry:** Bakery / Cake Shop / Retail  
**Job Location:** Perumbavoor, Kerala  
**Work Location:** Perumbavoor, with regular travel across 7 branches  
**Salary:** Up to ₹35,000 per month  
**Experience:** Relevant B2C Sales and Team Management Experience  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Vehicle Requirement:** Own two-wheeler or four-wheeler mandatory

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic, experienced, and target-oriented Sales Manager to oversee sales operations across 7 bakery and cake shop branches.

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring branch-wise sales performance, managing and motivating employees, implementing effective sales strategies, improving customer service, and ensuring consistent business growth across all outlets.

The role involves regular travel between branches to monitor operations, guide employees, identify sales opportunities, and improve overall outlet performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and monitor sales operations across all 7 branches.

* Conduct regular visits to all outlets and monitor day-to-day operations.
* Motivate, guide, and train sales staff to improve performance.

* Ensure excellent customer service and customer satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and promotional activities.
* Train employees in product knowledge, customer handling, and sales techniques.
* Coordinate with branch managers and employees to resolve operational issues.
* Monitor product displays, store presentation, and cleanliness.
* Analyse sales reports and identify underperforming outlets.
* Implement corrective measures to improve branch performance.
* Support festive promotions, seasonal sales, and special offers.
* Submit regular sales and performance reports to management.

* Proven experience in B2C sales is mandatory.
* Previous experience in team handling, sales supervision, or sales management is required.
* Experience in retail, bakery, food, FMCG, or customer-facing industries will be an advantage.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good communication and customer-handling abilities.
* Ability to achieve sales targets and improve team performance.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly between all 7 branches.
* Must own a two-wheeler or four-wheeler.
* Energetic, responsible, self-motivated, and target-oriented.

Job Highlights

* Manage sales operations across 7 branches.
* Leadership role with responsibility for team performance.
* Regular field visits and branch management.
* Salary up to ₹35,000 per month, based on experience and suitability.

**Work Location:** Perumbavoor, Kerala, with regular travel to all 7 branches.

**Interested candidates are requested to apply with their updated resumes.**

Pay: ₹35,000.00 per month

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring plans, and role requirements.

title: Founding Recruiter(Engineering & Sales)
description:
**Founding Recruiter (Engineering & Sales): Find the People Who Will Build the Operating System for Commodity Markets**

**Location:**
In office, Bengaluru | Full-time | Reports to the Co-founder & COO

**The Mission**

The global commodities market is a multi-trillion dollar ecosystem, yet the businesses inside it still price, hedge, and reconcile across fragmented, disconnected systems. At Novaex.ai, we are building the AI-powered operating system for physical commodity buyers, traders, manufacturers, and hedgers.
**Novaex Pulse**
powers the pre-execution side: market intelligence, pricing context, and hedging decisions.
**Novaex Ledger**
owns the post-execution side: position management, reconciliation, and auditable controls.

A product like this is only as good as the people who build and sell it. We need ML engineers who can teach a model to read a market, software engineers who can ship systems that customers trust with real exposure, and enterprise sellers who can hold a serious conversation with a trader or a CFO. Almost none of these people are looking for a job. They have to be found, understood, and persuaded.

That is the job. We are hiring our first in-house recruiter: a hands-on, outbound-first hunter who will personally find and close the 10 to 25 people who define what Novaex becomes over the next year. This is not a coordination role, and it is not a role for someone who waits for applicants. You will be measured on the quality of the people you bring in, not on how many seats you fill.

**Your Mandate**

Reporting directly to the Co-founder & COO, and working daily with the CTO and the founding team as your hiring managers, you will own hiring end to end across engineering and sales. The engineering team sits with you in Bengaluru. The sales team is remote, across India and selected international markets.

Your core responsibilities will include:

* **Outbound Sourcing:**
  Own LinkedIn Recruiter as your primary instrument and go well beyond it: GitHub, Kaggle, research papers, open-source communities, conference speaker lists, competitor and adjacent-company mapping, referrals, and industry networks. Build precise talent maps for every search, write outreach that a busy, well-paid, passive candidate actually answers, and keep following up long after most recruiters stop. Most of our hires should come from people you found, not people who applied.
* **Engineering & ML Hiring:**
  Run full-cycle searches for ML/AI engineers (time-series forecasting, NLP, deep learning) and software engineers (backend, data, platform, frontend). Learn the work well enough to tell a genuine builder from a keyword match, to ask a credible first-round question, and to earn the respect of both the candidate and the hiring manager.
* **Sales Hiring, India and International:**
  Run searches for consultative enterprise sellers who carry credibility in commodities, fintech, market data, risk, or CTRM/ETRM. These are remote roles across Indian metal and commodity hubs and selected international markets, so you will source across geographies, time zones, and compensation norms, and learn enough about commodity markets to recognise who can hold their own with a trader, a procurement head, or a CFO.
* **Guarding the Hiring Bar:**
  Work with each hiring manager to define what great looks like before a search begins: the scorecard, the must-haves, the trade-offs we will and will not make. Run a structured, evidence-based process, do your own rigorous screening and referencing, and tell us plainly when a candidate is not good enough, including when a founder likes them and the role has been open too long. We would rather keep a seat empty than fill it badly, and we expect you to hold us to that.
* **Closing:**
  Own the candidate relationship from first message to first day. Understand what each person actually wants, tell the Novaex story honestly (what is built, what is not, what the risk and upside are), manage offers, counter-offers, and notice periods, and keep people warm through joining. No overselling: a hire who joins on a false picture is a hire we lose.
* **Campus & Intern Programs:**
  Own our university pipeline, including the one-year AI/ML internship program: campus relationships, selection, intern experience, and pre-placement offer (PPO) conversions. Treat it as a long-term source of engineers we have trained ourselves.
* **Employer Brand:**
  Make Novaex known to the people we want to hire. Shape how we show up on LinkedIn, in job descriptions, on our careers presence, and in every candidate interaction. Work with the founders and the team to turn real work into content that the right engineers and sellers notice. Every candidate, hired or not, should leave with a better opinion of us.
* **Building the Hiring System:**
  Set up the foundations a first recruiter leaves behind: a clean applicant tracking system, pipeline data the founders can trust, interview loops that are consistent and fast, interviewer training, and a talent pool we own for future roles. Keep it light. We need a system that helps us hire well, not a process for its own sake.

**What You Bring**

We are seeking a hunter with judgment: someone with the persistence of a search-firm recruiter and the ownership of an in-house one. The ideal profile includes:

**Must-Have Capabilities**

* **4 to 7 Years of Full-Cycle Recruiting, Agency and In-House:**
  You learned to hunt in a search or staffing firm, then moved in-house (ideally at a startup or growth-stage company) and learned to own outcomes rather than placements. You have sold a company that candidates had not heard of.
* **Outbound Sourcing Craft:**
  This is the one thing we will not compromise on. You are an expert LinkedIn Recruiter user (Boolean, filters, projects, InMail strategy) and you can show us the searches, messages, and response rates behind hires you sourced cold. You find people other recruiters miss.
* **An Uncompromising Bar:**
  You have a track record of hires who stayed and performed, and you can describe times you pushed back on a hiring manager, slowed a process down, or walked away from a candidate everyone else wanted. You care more about being right than about closing the requisition.
* **Curiosity About the Work Itself:**
  You have hired engineers and you want to understand what they actually do. You are willing to learn what separates a strong ML engineer from an average one, how our products work, and how commodity markets and hedging function, so that you can assess candidates credibly rather than pattern-match on CVs.
* **Range Across Engineering and Sales:**
  Strong technical recruiting experience, plus real exposure to hiring sales or other go-to-market roles, or clear evidence that you pick up a new function quickly.
* **Persuasion Without Overselling:**
  You write and speak clearly, you listen well, and you can move a passive candidate from "not looking" to "tell me more" while staying honest about an early-stage company.
* **Startup Ownership:**
  You are comfortable being a team of one: sourcing, scheduling, referencing, and reporting yourself, with no coordinator behind you. You are organised, data-literate, and reliable on follow-through.
* **In Office, Bengaluru:**
  You want to sit with the team you are building.

**Strong Advantages**

* **AI/ML Hiring Depth:**
  A record of closing ML, data science, or deep-learning engineers in a competitive market.
* **Fintech, Trading, or Data-Product Exposure:**
  Experience hiring for fintech, capital markets, commodities, analytics, or enterprise SaaS companies.
* **International Hiring:**
  Experience sourcing and closing candidates outside India, particularly in commercial roles.
* **Campus Experience:**
  Having run university hiring or an internship-to-full-time program.
* **Employer-Brand Instincts:**
  You have written content, built a careers page, or grown a company's presence in a talent market from close to zero.
* **First-Recruiter Experience:**
  You have been the first or an early talent hire before and built the function from scratch.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* **Quality of hire:**
  First and foremost. The people you bring in are still here, performing strongly, and raising the standard of the team around them, as judged by their managers at 6 and 12 months.
* **Retention:**
  New-hire retention through the first year, and low early attrition or offer drop-off.
* **Sourced share:**
  The proportion of hires that come from your own outbound work rather than inbound applications or agencies.
* **Delivery against the hiring plan:**
  10 to 25 hires across engineering and sales in your first 12 months, with predictable pipelines for each open role. Speed matters, but never at the cost of the bar.
* **Candidate experience and brand:**
  How candidates, including the ones we reject, describe their experience with Novaex, and the growth of our visibility among the talent we want.
* **Campus pipeline:**
  The strength of the internship cohort and the rate at which strong interns convert to full-time.

**The Opportunity**

This is a rare seat. As our founding recruiter, you will have a direct hand in every important hire the company makes in its next phase, working alongside the founders rather than through layers. The team you assemble will build and sell products used for decisions involving real commodity exposure and serious money, and you will be able to point to that team and say you found them.

Compensation reflects what we value. It combines competitive fixed pay with bonuses tied to the quality and retention of the people you hire (not to the volume of offers made), along with ESOPs, so that you share in the company you help build.

The right person is persistent without being pushy, persuasive without bending the truth, and confident enough to tell a founder "no, not this one." If you would rather find one exceptional person than fill three seats, you won't just recruit for Novaex. You'll decide who Novaex is.

**How to Apply**

Apply through the LinkedIn job post. In your application, tell us about one hire you sourced cold that you are proud of: how you found them, what you said, and where they are now.

title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.
  
  
This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Delivery ownership**

* Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.
* Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.
* Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.
* Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

**Stakeholder management**

* Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.
* Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.
* Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

**People leadership**

* Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.
* Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.
* Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

**Process and data**

* Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.
* Experience working with European clients and across time zones.
* Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.
* Experience managing recruitment vendors.
* Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

What we offer
  
  

* A visible leadership role in a growing India delivery centre serving international clients.
* Ownership of client accounts and a team, with the scope to shape how delivery runs.
* Quarterly performance incentive linked to hiring outcomes.
* A central sourcing team, shared dashboards and a well-defined recruitment process to support you.

alongside key

**Recruitment & Onboarding specialist**
to join our India operations in
**Marathahalli, Bengaluru**
.

In this role, you will take complete ownership of recruitment across both technical and non-technical hiring, drive post-offer candidate engagement to maximize offer-to-join conversion, and manage end-to-end onboarding for all new joiners. We are looking for an independent self-starter who brings industry best practices to the table, takes initiative without needing constant supervision, and leverages a strong local talent network in
**Bengaluru & Mumbai**
.

**1. Recruitment Coordination & Talent Sourcing (Technical & Non-Technical)**

title: Talent Acquisition Consultant
description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards—the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.\

**What is the role about?**

**Talent Acquisition Consultant · Bengaluru · 6-month contract**

Bright is hiring a Talent Acquisition Consultant on a six-month contract to run hiring across functions. You will own live roles end-to-end: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and closing - and work directly with hiring managers rather than through a layer of coordination.

These are hard roles to fill. On the Engineering side, we hire backend and mobile engineers, SDETs, engineering leadership, data scientists, and analysts, and the bar is high. Most of the pipeline will come from your own sourcing rather than inbound applications, so this suits someone comfortable building a funnel from scratch and running a process with pace and rigour.

You will be part of the Human Potential team and work closely with Talent Acquisition, hiring managers, and the leadership team.

**What will you do?**

* Own live tech roles: Run a portfolio of open engineering and data roles end to end, from intake through to offer acceptance.
* Sourcing: Build pipelines through proactive outreach on LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and talent communities; most hires will come from candidates you find, not from inbound applications.
* Screening: Assess profiles against the role requirements, run first-round conversations, and shortlist with a clear rationale the hiring manager can act on.
* Hiring manager partnership: Run intake meetings to agree on the profile and the bar, calibrate against early candidates, and keep managers moving on feedback and decisions.
* Process and scheduling: Manage interview scheduling and panel coordination, and keep the process moving so strong candidates do not go cold.
* Candidate experience: Keep candidates informed at every stage, give prompt and honest feedback, and represent Bright well with people you do not end up hiring.
* Offers and closing: Support offer discussions, manage negotiation and expectation-setting, and stay engaged with candidates through the notice period to joining.
* ATS hygiene: Keep Kula up to date-accurate stages, dispositions, and notes-so the pipeline view and reporting are reliable.
* Market intelligence: Share what you learn on compensation, competing offers, and candidate availability, so we can adjust the approach where it is not working.
* Reporting: Provide a weekly view of pipeline health, conversion, and blockers for the hiring review.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 4-6 years in talent acquisition, with the majority spent on technical hiring.
* Hiring depth: A track record of closing roles across Tech and NonTech, at product companies or high-growth startups.
* Sourcing ability: Strong hands-on sourcing skills; able to build a pipeline through direct outreach rather than relying on inbound applications or agency support.
* Technical literacy: Able to hold a credible conversation with an engineer about their stack and their work, and to screen on substance rather than keywords.
* Tools: Experience with an ATS (preferably Kula), LinkedIn Recruiter, and sourcing and outreach tooling; comfortable using AI tools in the workflow.
* Stakeholder management: Confident working directly with senior engineering stakeholders, pushing back on an unrealistic brief, and holding managers to the process.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru and available to work from the office.
* Availability: Able to start at short notice and commit to the full six-month term.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Treats the role as theirs to close, not as a set of profiles to forward.
* Pace: Works with urgency; understands that in this market a slow process loses the candidate.
* Judgment: Screens on quality rather than volume, and would rather send three strong profiles than fifteen average ones.
* Resilience: Stays effective through rejections, dropped offers, and roles that take longer than expected.
* Communication: Clear and prompt with candidates and hiring managers, and honest when something is not working.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Candidates whose experience is primarily non-technical hiring—sales, operations, or corporate functions.
* Profiles limited to coordination and scheduling, without ownership of sourcing and closing.
* Those who have worked only with inbound applicant flow, without hands-on sourcing.
* Candidates seeking a permanent role only, or unable to commit to a six-month contract.
* Those looking for a fully remote arrangement.

**Engagement details:**

* Type: Fixed-term contract engagement.
* Duration: Six months, with the possibility of extension or conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business need.
* Location: Bengaluru [in-office].
* Start date: Immediate joiners preferred.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own your roles end to end, from intake through to the candidate joining.
* Direct access: You work straight with hiring managers and the leadership team, with no layers in between.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Visible work: Six months closing hard engineering and data roles at a profitable, fast-scaling fintech.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Job Description – Talent Acquisition Manager

**Business Unit:**
upGrad Group

**Function:**
Human Resources – Central Talent Acquisition

**Location:**
Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai

**Experience:**
5–10 years

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Manager to be part of the Central Talent Acquisition function at upGrad, supporting hiring requirements across multiple business entities, central functions and geographies.

The role offers exposure to a diverse range of recruitment mandates, including leadership hiring across business and corporate functions, critical and strategic hiring requirements across various group entities in India, and international hiring, with a primary focus on Southeast Asia, followed by the Middle East.

While the hiring portfolio will predominantly comprise non-technology roles, the individual will also be expected to support technology hiring requirements as they arise.

The ideal candidate will bring exceptional stakeholder management skills, strong hands-on sourcing capabilities, international recruitment experience and an analytical approach to talent acquisition. We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, keen to understand different businesses and functions, and enthusiastic about leveraging data, AI and emerging technologies to enhance recruitment effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Strategic Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business leaders, functional heads, hiring managers and HR stakeholders across the upGrad Group.
* Develop a deep understanding of different business models, organisational structures, functional requirements and competencies required for success across roles.
* Translate business requirements into effective talent acquisition and sourcing strategies.
* Advise business stakeholders on talent availability, market dynamics, compensation trends and hiring decisions.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, anticipate recruitment challenges and drive effective solutions.

2. Talent Sourcing, Leadership Hiring & Recruitment Delivery

* Drive end-to-end recruitment across central functions, business functions and various entities within the upGrad Group.
* Independently execute leadership, critical, strategic and specialist hiring mandates across domestic and international markets.
* Demonstrate strong hands-on sourcing capabilities through direct search, professional networks, talent mapping, referrals and alternative sourcing channels.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for leadership, niche and recurring hiring requirements.
* Develop a strong understanding of target organisations, talent pools, functional competencies and transferable skills across industries.
* Ensure high-quality candidate assessments through a thorough understanding of business context and role requirements.
* Balance speed, quality and cost-effectiveness across recruitment mandates.

3. International Talent Acquisition

* Drive recruitment across international markets, with a primary focus on Southeast Asia and additional focus on the Middle East.
* Develop a strong understanding of regional talent markets, compensation benchmarks, recruitment practices and cultural nuances.
* Build and maintain relevant talent networks and sourcing channels across international geographies.
* Partner with regional business leaders and HR stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes aligned with local business requirements.
* Identify and develop relationships with relevant recruitment partners to strengthen access to international talent pools.

4. Recruitment Analytics & Talent Intelligence

* Leverage recruitment data to identify trends, bottlenecks and opportunities to improve hiring outcomes.
* Track and analyse key recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, conversion ratios, offer acceptance rates and recruitment costs.
* Develop actionable talent intelligence through market mapping, compensation insights, competitor analysis and candidate data.
* Use data-backed insights to influence stakeholder decisions and improve recruitment strategies.
* Maintain high standards of data accuracy, reporting and recruitment documentation.

5. AI, Technology & Continuous Improvement

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies across the talent acquisition lifecycle.
* Actively contribute to the experimentation, evaluation and implementation of AI-led recruitment interventions.
* Explore innovative approaches to sourcing, candidate screening, talent intelligence, recruitment analytics and process automation.
* Continuously evaluate existing recruitment practices and identify opportunities to improve productivity, consistency and hiring quality.
* Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn, experiment with and adopt new tools, technologies and recruitment methodologies.

6. Candidate Experience, Employer Branding & Vendor Management

* Represent upGrad professionally and effectively across interactions with prospective candidates, recruitment partners and external stakeholders.
* Articulate the organisation's businesses, culture, growth journey and career opportunities in a compelling and credible manner.
* Build strong relationships with prospective candidates, including senior professionals and business leaders.
* Ensure a positive, transparent and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Build productive relationships with external recruitment partners and establish clear expectations around quality, timelines and professional conduct.
* Strengthen upGrad's reputation as an employer across domestic and international talent markets.

7. Team Management & Capability Building

* Take on responsibilities for managing, mentoring and developing members of the Talent Acquisition team as required.
* Build sourcing, stakeholder management and recruitment delivery capabilities within the team.
* Establish clear expectations around ownership, accountability, communication and quality of delivery.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, experimentation and data-driven decision-making.
* Remain actively involved in sourcing and recruitment delivery alongside people management responsibilities.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 5–10 years of relevant Talent Acquisition experience, with demonstrated expertise in hands-on sourcing, stakeholder management and end-to-end recruitment, including exposure to leadership, critical and specialist hiring across business and corporate functions.
* Experience managing diverse recruitment mandates across multiple businesses, functions or geographies.
* Demonstrated experience in international recruitment, preferably across Southeast Asia and/or the Middle East. Candidates with experience in other international markets, including the US and UK, are also encouraged to apply.
* Exceptional hands-on sourcing capabilities, with the ability to independently identify, engage and assess talent for complex and niche requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions and establish credibility with senior business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical capabilities and comfort with recruitment data, spreadsheets, reporting and talent market intelligence.
* Genuine interest in AI, emerging technologies and their application within talent acquisition.
* High degree of intellectual curiosity, adaptability and willingness to develop an understanding of unfamiliar businesses, functions, industries and talent markets.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively represent the organisation to candidates and external recruitment partners.
* Experience in managing or mentoring recruiters, or demonstrated readiness to take on people management responsibilities.
* Strong ownership, commercial acumen, problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
* Exposure to technology hiring would be an advantage.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification preferred.

**Success in This Role**

* Strong, trusted partnerships with business leaders and HR stakeholders across the upGrad Group.
* Consistent delivery of high-quality talent for leadership, critical and strategic positions across businesses, functions and geographies.
* Strong direct sourcing capabilities and reduced dependence on external recruitment partners.
* Improved recruitment effectiveness through data-driven insights, talent intelligence and AI-led interventions.
* Positive candidate experience and a strong employer brand across domestic and international talent markets.
* Improved recruitment productivity, hiring quality and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Development of a capable, accountable and continuously evolving Talent Acquisition team.

**Equal Opportunity**

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
