title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
****Location****
Remote, preferably in or near Bangalore
  
  
****Reports to****
Director of Human Resources, with dotted line to Operations
  
  
****Scope****
Recruiting
  
  
****Employment type****
Full-time, permanent
  
  
****Why this role exists****
Anovia places skilled technical and professional people on client work. As our Talent Acquisition Manager, you will own how fast and how reliably we fill those seats with people who are real, qualified, and able to start. You will build and run a team that treats time-to-fill as a revenue measure, not an HR measure.
  
  
This is a player-coach role. You will lead the team and also stay hands-on in sourcing, screening, and closing, especially on the hardest and most urgent seats.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
****Fill roles fast, with quality****

* Own end-to-end recruiting, from requisition through offer acceptance and joining.
* Run daily demand reviews with delivery leaders and turn open client demand into a prioritized plan the team can act on that day.
* Keep a working view of open seats, aging, and expected revenue impact, and escalate any seat approaching a client commitment date.
* Build and maintain skill-based talent pipelines across core technical skill sets and experience levels, so candidates are ready before the demand arrives.
* Recruit hands-on for priority and hard-to-fill roles alongside the team.

****Lead and build the team****

* Lead, coach, and set targets for the talent acquisition team, and assign work by skill set and priority.
* Hire, onboard, and train recruiters, setting a clear standard for sourcing, screening, and candidate communication.
* Review team output every week and fix bottlenecks.

****Protect hiring integrity****

* Run a screening process built for a market where AI-written resumes, proxy interviews, and candidate substitution are real risks.
* Own the assessment approach for technical skills and business English, including proctoring and identity verification, and keep results consistent across recruiters.
* Work with HR on background checks, pre-joining verification, and managing drop-off between offer and joining.

****Run the systems and the data****

* Run day-to-day use of our applicant tracking system and sourcing tools, driving data quality and adoption.
* Lead the team's adoption of the AI features in our applicant tracking system and other AI-based recruiting tools. Set clear standards for how the team uses them, show the results, and make AI-assisted work the normal way the team operates.
* Track recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, quality of hire, and offer-to-joining ratio, and prepare weekly updates for leadership on the measures below, with recommended changes based on what the data shows.
* Evaluate and manage sourcing channels, job boards, and external search partners, with cost-per-hire in mind.
* Stay current on hiring trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor activity, and use what you learn to refine recruiting strategy.

****Partner with the business****

* Work with Operations leadership as the functional counterpart for demand. Operations sets which seats matter most, and you turn that into a daily recruiting plan.
* Give Operations an honest, early forecast of what is fillable, how fast, and at what cost, and flag seats at risk of missing a client commitment date.
* Act as the recruiting counterpart to delivery leaders and to HR and recruiting colleagues, and share tools, process, and learning across teams.
* Support growth planning, including large-volume programs that arrive on short timelines.

**How The Two Reporting Lines Work**
The Director of Human Resources owns hiring standards, assessment and fraud controls, team structure, performance management, and compensation. Operations sets demand priorities and hiring pace. If speed and verification ever pull in different directions, verification standards hold, and the issue is escalated to both leaders.
  
  
**How Success Is Measured**

* Time-to-fill by role family, and revenue-days lost to open seats
* Submission-to-interview and interview-to-offer ratios
* Offer acceptance and offer-to-joining rates (no-shows and early drop-off)
* Quality of hire, including client acceptance and 90-day retention
* Share of the pipeline built before demand appears
* Cost-per-hire and recruiter productivity
* Team adoption of the AI features in our applicant tracking system and other AI-based recruiting tools
* Rate of fraud and verification failures caught before offer

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of recruiting experience in India, including at least 3 years leading a recruiting team.
* Direct experience in IT or telecom staff augmentation, contract staffing, or a high-volume recruiting

agency, where recruiting drives billable revenue.
  
  

* A record of filling technical roles quickly and at volume across multiple skill sets.
* Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system and with outbound sourcing and candidate

relationship tools.
  
  

* Fluency with AI-based recruiting tools, such as AI sourcing, AI screening, or AI features in an applicant

tracking system, and a record of leading a team to adopt new tools and change how it works.
  
  

* A practical understanding of candidate fraud and verification, and how to design against it.
* Comfort with metrics and with explaining trade-offs to senior business leaders.
* Ability to work well with two leaders, one for people and process and one for business priorities.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Willingness to work some hours that overlap with North American time zones.

**Helpful, Not Required**

* Familiarity with assessment and proctoring tools.
* A history of scaling a team through a large new program.
* Experience recruiting outside of India.
* A recruiting or HR certification.
* Working knowledge of Breezy ATS, Naukri, GreytHR, Microsoft Office, and Claude.

**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive health insurance policy
* Employee wellness program with a focus on mental health
* Robust reward and recognition programs and company incentives
* Attractive leave policy: holiday, maternity, paternity, birthday, and bereavement leave, plus paid

personal time off
  
  

* Ample growth and learning opportunities
* Focus on work/life balance
* Immigration program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees

title: Bangalore, HR Manager
description:
**I. ABOUT PIZZA 4P’S INDIA**

Born in Vietnam with the mission “Delivering Wow, Sharing Happiness”, Pizza 4P’s has grown into one of Asia’s most loved restaurant brands — famous for house-made cheese, artisanal pizza, and heartfelt Omotenashi hospitality. Now, its most exciting chapter yet begins in India.

Pizza 4P’s India is a startup with the soul of a craft kitchen and the ambition of a movement. We are opening our first 2nd stores this year — and over the next 5 years, we will grow to 50 stores across the country, bringing our Earth-to-People philosophy, fresh house-made cheese, and the magic of our handcrafted pizza ovens to one of the world’s most vibrant food cultures. Joining us now means building something from the ground up: shaping the culture, growing the team, and creating dining experiences India has never seen before. Every hire, every store opening, and every “wow” moment will carry your fingerprints.

**II. ROLE PURPOSE**

The HR Manager leads the full
**Human Resources agenda**
for Pizza 4P’s India. With 2 stores launching this year and a roadmap to scale to 50 stores within 5 years, this role builds the people foundation for rapid expansion — ensuring talent readiness, workforce effectiveness, and full legal compliance from market entry through scale-up. As the company is still at the startup stage, this is a hands-on role: the HR Manager personally executes alongside setting strategy — from screening candidates and running payroll to onboarding the very first store teams — until the function scales.

**Reporting to:**
Country Manager – India

**Functional reporting line to**
: Global People & Culture Division

**Scope:**
Corporate office, all store locations, and the cheese factory across India (currently 2 stores in Bangalore, expanding to 50 nationwide)

**III. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**HR Management & Workforce Effectiveness**

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business priorities and growth plans
* Lead onboarding, training, engagement, and retention initiatives
* Oversee performance management and appraisal systems
* Manage employee relations, disciplinary cases, and investigations
* Ensure payroll accuracy, timeliness, and full compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, gratuity, state Shops & Establishments Acts, POSH) and company policies
* Align Compensation & Benefits practices with local market standards
* Maintain HR records and prepare required HR reports
* Lead the development and maintenance of local HR policies (accommodation, travel, leave, disciplinary) in line with Indian labor laws
* Oversee the partner accommodation program, including policy, eligibility, and cost management
* Manage the end-to-end offboarding process, including exit interviews, settlements, and documentation
* Oversee attendance and leave administration, probation reviews, and monthly promotion and increment processes
* Monitor changes in labor regulations (e.g., minimum wage revisions) and proactively update company practices
* Support expatriate partners with relocation, documentation, and administrative setup
* Maintain accurate and reliable HR data across systems and drive digitalization of HR operations

**Talent Management**

* Lead end-to-end talent acquisition, including workforce planning, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management for both corporate and store positions
* Build a repeatable new-store hiring playbook (staffing model, hiring timelines, and training handover per store) to support the expansion from 2 to 50 stores within 5 years
* Develop internal promotion pathways and a Store Manager / Pizzaiolo leadership pipeline so each new store can be led by home-grown talent
* Identify high-potential employees and create individual development plans (training, coaching, cross-store exposure) to accelerate their readiness for bigger roles
* Maintain succession plans for key roles (Store Manager, Head Chef / Pizzaiolo, corporate leads) so every planned store opening has identified successors in advance
* Build proactive talent pipelines (hospitality institutes, culinary schools, referral programs) and establish Pizza 4P’s employer brand in the Indian F&B market
* Manage recruitment channels, agencies, and job portals; track and improve hiring metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and quality of hire
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and ensure a positive, consistent candidate experience aligned with Omotenashi values
* Maintain continuous hiring for existing stores to ensure full staffing alongside new-store expansion

**Communication & Coordination**

* Act as the key contact point for employees, vendors, partners, and stakeholders
* Coordinate closely with Global People & Culture Team to ensure alignment
* Support cross-functional collaboration across HR, Operations, and other departments

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Support company events, meetings, and internal activities
* Handle ad-hoc tasks and projects assigned by the Country Manager
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency

**Culture & Engagement**

* Localize and roll out 4P's culture programs and values activation initiatives across India
* Develop and run partner recognition programs aligned with 4P's values
* Drive engagement improvement through action plans based on partner survey insights
* Plan and deliver company events and internal culture activities

**IV. SUCCESS METRICS & KPIs**

* 100% compliance with local labor laws and internal policies
* Accurate and timely payroll with zero critical errors
* New stores fully staffed and trained on schedule for each opening
* Recruitment KPIs met: time-to-fill, offer acceptance rate, cost-per-hire, and 90-day new-hire retention
* Strong employee engagement and retention outcome
* Positive feedback from Country Manager and regional stakeholders

**V. CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Strategic HR & People Management
* Hands-On Execution & Startup Agility
* Operational Excellence & Organization
* Empathy & Relationship Building
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
* Communication & Stakeholder Management
* Cultural Fit with Omotenashi, Kaizen, Authenticity, Compassion

**VI. TOOLS, ENVIRONMENT & WORKING CONDITIONS**

**Systems & Tools:**
MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and relevant HR systems

**Work Setting:**
Corporate office with regular interaction with operations

**Travel:**
As required for business and operational needs

**VII. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & BENEFITS**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Proven experience as an HR Manager, HR Business Partner, or similar role
* Background in retail, F&B, or restaurant operations preferred; experience scaling teams through rapid multi-site expansion is a strong advantage
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, performance management, and employee relations
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor regulations (PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops & Establishments Acts, POSH) and HR best practices; multi-state compliance experience a plus
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves working style — comfortable personally executing day-to-day HR tasks without a support team, as expected in a startup environment

title: Human Resource Business Partner- Bengaluru
description:
**About Infinity Learn**

Infinity Learn is a fast-growing EdTech company focused on competitive exam preparation (JEE, NEET, and Foundation). As the organisation scales its consumer sales, lead generation, and academic delivery teams, the HR function plays a critical role in keeping the workforce engaged, stable, and aligned with business growth plans.

**Role Summary**

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) will act as the primary HR touchpoint for assigned business functions, with a core mandate to control attrition, drive employee engagement, and act as a strategic bridge between business leaders and the Talent Acquisition team. The role requires close partnership with function heads to anticipate hiring needs, translate business plans into workforce requirements, and use data-driven insights — including Root Cause (RCA) and Retention Analysis of attrition trends — to strengthen people outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Attrition Control & Retention:**
  Own attrition metrics for assigned functions (Consumer Sales, Lead Generation, Freelance Teachers) and drive month-on-month improvement against targets. Conduct structured exit interviews and stay interviews; identify patterns and early attrition risk signals. Run Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on attrition data — by tenure, manager, location, and function — and convert findings into actionable retention plans. Partner with function leaders on manager-effectiveness and team-health interventions where attrition risk is manager-driven. Track and report attrition dashboards (voluntary vs involuntary, early attrition, regretted exits) to leadership on a monthly cadence.
* **Employee Engagement:**
  Design and execute a monthly/quarterly engagement calendar (recognition programs, team connects, skip-level sessions, R&R initiatives). Drive employee pulse surveys / eNPS, analyse results, and own follow-through action plans with respective leaders. Strengthen onboarding and early-tenure engagement (first 90 days) to reduce early attrition. Champion culture-building initiatives that reinforce Infinity Learn's values across floor and remote teams.
* **Business Partnering & Workforce Planning:**
  Maintain a regular connect cadence with function leaders (Sales, Lead Gen, Academics) to stay ahead of business plans and upcoming headcount
* needs. Translate business growth plans and attrition-driven backfills into clear, timely hiring requisitions. Share consolidated hiring requirement inputs (volume, role mix, location, urgency) with the TA Team to support sourcing and pipeline planning. Act as the single point of coordination between business leaders and TA on requisition prioritisation, offer approvals, and hiring timelines. Provide TA with context on role-specific attrition trends to help refine sourcing and screening criteria.
* **HR Operations & Reporting:**
  Maintain accurate headcount, attrition, and engagement MIS/dashboards for leadership review (MRM/business reviews). Ensure timely resolution of employee grievances and escalations in partnership with the HR/ER team. Support performance review cycles, warning/PIP processes, and policy implementation within assigned functions.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs) KRA**

**Attrition Control**

Monthly attrition % vs target; early attrition rate

**Engagement**

eNPS / engagement score; participation in engagement activities

**Hiring Input Accuracy**

Timeliness & accuracy of requisition inputs shared with TA

**Business Partnering**

Leader satisfaction score; cadence of leader connects

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education & Experience:**
  MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent, with 3–6 years of experience as an HRBP.
* **Track Record:**
  Proven track record of managing attrition and engagement in a high-growth, high-volume hiring setup.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working directly with sales/business leaders and TA teams.
* **Data Orientation:**
  Comfortable building and reading attrition/engagement dashboards in Excel/PowerBI.
* **Interpersonal Skills:**
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence without direct authority.

**What We Offer**

* **Scale:**
  Opportunity to build HR practices at scale in a fast-growing EdTech organization.
* **Exposure:**
  Direct exposure to leadership and cross-functional business partnering.
* **Culture:**
  A collaborative, outcomes-driven work culture.

title: Head (Senior Manager) - Industrial Relations
description:
**About The Team**
You will join the Security & Investigations team within Fulfilment & Experience (F&E) at Meesho. F&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India's cost-efficient, reliable and scalable e-commerce network, serving 100M+ monthly active users. From enabling Valmo's distributed logistics network to building scalable fulfilment and experience platforms, F&E operates at the intersection of technology, operations and network innovation.
  
  
Within F&E, the Security & Investigations team safeguards the integrity and resilience of this network. The team investigates shipment loss, pilferage, fraud and misconduct, oversees physical security across operating sites, and coordinates with law enforcement and other stakeholders where required. Working closely with Operations, HR, Legal and logistics partners, the team helps keep the network secure, compliant and resilient.
  
  
**About The Role**
Valmo's operating network is powered by a large and diverse workforce spanning sort centres, hubs and last-mile operations. A significant portion of this workforce is engaged through logistics partners and other workforce arrangements, creating a complex industrial-relations environment across multiple locations and states.
  
  
As Head – Industrial Relations, you will own the Industrial Relations (IR) charter for the operating network, within the Security & Investigations function, and work closely with HR, Legal, Operations and partner leadership. Your mandate will be to build a stable, compliant and scalable workforce-relations framework that prevents avoidable disputes, enables fair and timely resolution of workforce issues, and provides strong governance when matters escalate.
  
  
The role combines strategic IR leadership with significant field engagement. You will build early-warning mechanisms, manage worker and union relationships, oversee dispute and disciplinary processes, strengthen partner workforce compliance, engage with labour authorities, and create playbooks and governance mechanisms that can scale with the network.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own IR strategy and governance.**
Build and continuously evolve a national IR framework covering workforce relations, grievance management, dispute prevention, statutory compliance, worker/union engagement, escalation and resolution.
  
  
**Build workforce intelligence and early-warning mechanisms.**
Track workforce sentiment, grievances, absenteeism, wage-related concerns, shift and working-condition issues, emerging worker representation or union activity, and other indicators of potential disruption across the network.
  
  
**Prevent and manage industrial disputes.**
Develop structured approaches to prevent disputes and lead the response to strikes, work stoppages, protests, gheraos and other workforce disruptions. Engage with worker representatives and union leaders and coordinate with Operations, HR, Legal, partners, local administration, labour authorities and law enforcement, as appropriate.
  
  
**Bring IR rigour to investigations.**
Partner with Security & Investigations, HR and Legal on cases involving employees or partner workers, including theft, fraud, misconduct and policy violations. Ensure due process, appropriate documentation and legally sound decision-making.
  
  
**Govern disciplinary processes.**
Oversee show-cause notices, domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions, ensuring that processes are fair, consistent, timely and legally defensible under applicable law, standing orders and organisational policy.
  
  
**Drive partner workforce compliance.**
Establish and monitor governance over logistics partners covering contract labour requirements, wage and benefits compliance, statutory registrations, working hours, worker documentation, grievance mechanisms and other applicable labour requirements. Drive timely corrective action and escalation where gaps are identified.
  
  
**Own government and authority engagement.**
Build effective working relationships with labour departments, labour commissioners, conciliation officers and other relevant government authorities. Represent the organisation in inspections, conciliation proceedings and hearings, in partnership with Legal, and coordinate with Security on matters requiring law-enforcement engagement.
  
  
**Build effective grievance and escalation channels.**
Design and strengthen mechanisms such as worker helplines, site-level committees, grievance forums and escalation paths so that workforce concerns are surfaced and resolved before they become formal disputes.
  
  
**Create scalable IR playbooks and capability.**
Develop SOPs, policies, escalation matrices and response playbooks for dispute management, investigation-linked disciplinary action, partner workforce issues and authority engagement. Train site leaders, partner supervisors, HR teams and security personnel on relevant IR practices and labour-law basics.
  
  
**Build IR analytics and leadership reporting.**
Establish dashboards and regular reviews covering incidents, disputes, grievances, compliance health, partner risks, resolution timelines, repeat issues and emerging trends. Translate these into clear insights and actions for senior leadership.
  
  
**Strengthen cross-functional governance.**
Establish clear interfaces between IR, HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and partner leadership, including decision rights, escalation threshold
  
  
**What You Will Need**

* 8–15 years of experience in industrial relations, employee relations, labour relations or labour-law compliance, preferably in large, distributed workforce environments.
* Experience in logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, infrastructure or other large blue-collar and/or contract-workforce environments is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including the Labour Codes and associated rules/notifications, contract labour requirements, industrial disputes, standing orders and relevant state-specific requirements.
* Practical experience applying labour law and IR principles on the ground across multiple sites and, ideally, multiple states.
* Proven experience handling industrial disputes, worker grievances, union/worker representative engagement, negotiations, strikes or work stoppages.
* Experience conducting or overseeing domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings, with a strong understanding of how employee investigations intersect with employment law and due process.
* Experience managing contract labour or partner workforce compliance, including audits, statutory requirements, wage-related compliance and remediation.
* Strong ability to engage with labour authorities, conciliation officers and other government stakeholders, preferably with experience representing an organisation in formal proceedings.
* Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm, credible and objective in high-pressure situations.
* Ability to work effectively across HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and external partners, with sound judgement on ownership, escalation and confidentiality.
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in one or more regional languages is an advantage, particularly for workforce-heavy operating regions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including the ability to use workforce and incident data to identify patterns, risks and preventive actions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across operating locations and respond to sensitive on-ground situations at short notice.
* High integrity, discretion and maturity, with the ability to handle confidential matters and decisions that can materially affect employees and workers.
* A degree in law, HR, labour welfare, social work or a related discipline (LLB, MSW, MBA-HR or equivalent) is preferred.

**Role Characteristics**

* National scope with significant field engagement across the operating network.
* High level of cross-functional and external stakeholder interaction.
* Combination of strategic programme ownership, operational problem-solving and on-ground dispute management.
* Requires sound judgement, neutrality, confidentiality and the ability to balance business continuity with fair and compliant workforce practices.

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Available Location: Bengaluru, India**
**What You Would Do Here:**
Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Champion key employee lifecycle process: Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.
* Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries: Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.
* Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration: Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.
* Ensure data integrity and governance: Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence: Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.
* Support strategic HR initiatives and projects: Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.

**Skills/experience**

* 5+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.
* Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.
* Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.
* Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
* Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
  
  
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
  
  
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

    Partner closely with Enterprise IT Architects, Information Security, HR Operations, and Talent Leadership to align Workday roadmaps with corporate infrastructure and data governance standards.

    Translate high-level HR and Talent acquisition strategies into scalable technical roadmaps, managing project lifecycles, dependencies, and executive expectations.

    .

    Design and enforce role-based security architecture, data privacy standards, and SOX/payroll audit controls across the Workday tenant.
  **System Optimization & Innovation**

  - **Advanced Reporting & Analytics:**
    Design advanced calculated fields and custom reports (
    **Advanced, Matrix, and Composite**
    ) to deliver actionable workforce insights for Talent, Recruiting, and executive leadership.
  - **Complex Data Transformation:**
    Engineer intricate
    **XSLT and XML transformations**
    to standardize data payloads, reduce integration latency, and eliminate manual file manipulation across third-party vendor feeds.
  - **Workflow Re-Engineering:**
    Audit and streamline legacy business processes across Recruiting and Performance cycles to reduce administrative bottlenecks and improve end-user experience.
  + **AI Enablement**
  - **Intelligent Process Automation:**
    Leverage
    **Workday Orchestration**
    and emerging Workday AI/ML capabilities to automate repetitive HR transactions, multi-step approvals, and cross-system data syncs.
  - **AI-Driven Talent & Recruiting:**
    Enable intelligent talent matching, skills-based frameworks, and automated candidate routing within Workday Recruiting and Performance modules to accelerate hiring and internal mobility.
  - **Predictive Workforce Insights:**
    Structure clean, governed tenant data models and calculated fields to feed downstream AI analytics and workforce planning tools
  **Change Management**

  - **Release Management Leadership:**
    Direct technical and functional impact assessments, unit testing, regression testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for
    **Workday semi-annual feature releases**
    and internal upgrades.
  - **Seamless Feature Adoption:**
    Partner with HR Operations and change leads to evaluate newly released Workday functionality, guiding stakeholders through feature adoption, training, and post-deployment hypercare.
  - **Risk Mitigation & Cutover Governance:**
    Establish rigorous deployment checklists, rollback plans, and tenant migration protocols to ensure zero-downtime production releases.
  **Mentorship & Inclusive Leadership**

  - **Highest-Tier Escalation Point:**
    Act as the primary technical and functional escalation lead to troubleshoot and resolve critical production defects across integrations, security, and business processes.
  - **Analyst Coaching & Upskilling:**
    Mentor mid-level and junior techno-functional analysts through code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and hands-on training in Workday Studio, XSLT, and functional configuration.
  - **Inclusive & Collaborative Culture:**
    Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive engineering environment that encourages knowledge sharing, cross-training across HCM modules, and diverse problem-solving perspectives.

**What you’ll bring to the role**

* **Experience:**
  **8+ years**
  of related experience in a professional role with a Bachelor's degree (or
  **6+ years**
  with a Master's degree), including
  **5–7+ years**
  of deep, hands-on expertise configuring, architecting, and supporting
  **Workday Core HCM, Talent, and Recruiting**
  .
* **Workday Skills:**
  Strong proficiency with Workday functional configuration (
  **Core HCM, Talent Management, Performance, and Recruiting**
  ), complex business processes (BPs), Calculated Fields, custom reporting (
  **Advanced, Matrix, and Composite**
  ), executive dashboards, enterprise integrations (
  **Workday Studio, Orchestration, EIB, Core Connectors, DT, XSLT/XML**
  ), and navigating the core Workday ecosystem.
* **Technical Breadth:**
  Proven capability to simultaneously manage, architect, and support
  **3 or more Workday modules, enterprise systems, or cross-functional HR process areas**
  .
* **Analytical Problem Solving:**
  Ability to diagnose and resolve complex techno-functional issues spanning multiple applications and integrations, exercising sound judgment in choosing methods and techniques for scalable, compliant solutions.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to translate complex Workday architecture and technical concepts into business-friendly language. Strong capability to facilitate discovery workshops, lead UAT sessions, and present strategic roadmaps to diverse technical and HR audiences.
* **Project Management:**
  Track record of driving significant business results through strategic thinking, iterative process improvement, and managing end-to-end delivery of complex HR technology and semi-annual release projects.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  Prior experience operating at a Principal or Level 4 Senior Techno-Functional capacity within a large, multi-country internal enterprise IT organization.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
**About Prodigal**
------------------

Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.

These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?

Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.

Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.

Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.

We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

  

### **The Role**

As a Senior Technical Recruiter at Prodigal, you will own hiring end to end across both tech and non-tech roles, from understanding what a team needs to getting the right person to say yes. You'll partner closely with hiring managers across Engineering, Product, implementation, and strategy to build the team that builds Prodigal.

You'll have real ownership over how we find, assess and close talent. This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing startup, where every hire shapes the company, and where you'll have the room to sharpen how we recruit, not just run the process.

### **What You'll Own**

**End-to-End Recruitment**

* Own the full recruitment cycle for tech and non-tech roles, from intake to joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, write JDs, and align on what great looks like.
* Manage multiple open roles at once while keeping quality and speed in balance.

**Sourcing & Screening**

* Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, and direct outreach.
* Screen candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit.
* Build talent pipelines/prospect pools for critical and recurring roles, so we are never starting from zero.
* Build genuine, long term relationships with the candidates, staying in touch with strong talent even when there is no immediate role.

**Interviews, Offers & Negotiation**

* Coordinate interview loops, gather timely feedback, and keep the process moving.
* Lead offers conversations and compensation negotiations, and close candidates with confidence.
* Deliver a candidate experience that people talk about afterward, whether or not they join us.

**Pipeline Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date pipeline data in the ATS and trackers.
* Track and share hiring metrics such as funnel conversion, and source effectiveness.
* Spot gaps in how we hire today and pitch practical fixes, including smarter use of AI tools in recruiting.

### **Who You Are**

* 5+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment across tech and non-tech roles.
* Must have: proven experience hiring for tech roles, especially in a startup environment.
* Strong sourcing and screening skills, with hands-on experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and ATS tools.
* Technical proficiency, an understanding of tech stacks and roles that lets you hold informed conversations with engineers.
* Confident negotiator who can manage offers, compensation discussions, and closures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, you will be the first impression of Prodigal for every candidate.
* Organized and data-driven, able to manage multiple pipelines without anything slipping through the cracks.

  

### **Top Tier Benefits**

Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, gym membership, unlimited learning & development, flexible work schedule and a world-class team to learn and grow with!

From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

To learn more about us - please visit the following:

Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story

What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis

Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

title: Sr. Manager, HR

As a Senior Manager, HR Business Partner at Infor India, you will partner closely with business leaders to deliver strategic people solutions that support organizational objectives. This role requires strong business acumen, relationship-building skills, and the ability to balance strategic initiatives with hands-on HR execution. You will serve as a trusted advisor to leaders, driving workforce strategies, supporting leadership development, and ensuring effective HR program implementation across assigned business units. **Strong experience in strategic HR business partnering, hands-on Employee Relations (ER), and culture-building initiatives is mandatory for this role.**

  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

**1. Strategic HR Partnership**

* Align HR strategies with business objectives for assigned business units.
* Serve as a trusted HR advisor to senior business leaders on people-related matters.
* Support organizational effectiveness through workforce planning, talent management, and culture-building initiatives.
* Contribute insights to shape business unit strategy by leveraging people trends and organizational needs.

**2. HRBP Execution and Collaboration**

* Partner with global HR teams including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, PBM / Learning & Development, HRSS, and COEs to deliver integrated HR solutions.
* Implement HR initiatives consistently across business units, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities.
* Communicate proactively with the HR Leadership Team to support cross-functional HR initiatives.

**3. Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Support and execute initiatives to strengthen engagement and reinforce Infor’s culture.
* Analyze engagement survey insights with leaders and create targeted action plans.
* Promote diversity and inclusion initiatives within business units.

**4. Leadership and Employee Development**

* Support business leaders in identifying leadership development needs and implementing relevant development plans.
* Facilitate organizational development efforts to address the root causes of HR issues.
* Contribute to companywide programs (e.g., talent management, succession planning, workforce planning, organizational design and change).

* Conduct workforce planning and talent reviews with business leaders to support future workforce readiness.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and L&D to address skill gaps and develop talent pipelines.

* Manage change initiatives including communications and alignment activities during organizational transitions.

**7. Data-Driven Insights**

**Strategic & Operational Skills**

* Strong ability to align people strategies with business goals.
* Ability to navigate organizational complexity and influence leaders effectively.

**Employee Relations (ER)**

* Strong hands-on experience in managing complex employee relations matters.
* Proven ability to handle employee grievances, disciplinary issues, and workplace conflicts.

**Culture Building**

* Proven experience in driving culture-building and employee engagement initiatives.
* Strong ability to partner with business leaders to build a positive and high-performance work culture.
* Experience turning employee feedback and engagement insights into meaningful improvements.

**Leadership & Relationship Skills**

* Proven ability to influence, consult, and coach senior leaders.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (oral, written, presentation).

**Analytical & Technical Skills**

* Strong command of people analytics with the ability to interpret data and provide meaningful insights.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms and HR technologies; ability to work with tech teams to support HR solutions.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong change management capability and adaptability.
* Experience working with cross-functional and cross-regional teams.

description:

title: Staff Analyst - Workday Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

  

Okta is seeking a **Staff Analyst – People Technologies (Workday)** to join our Business Solutions Team. In this critical role, you will partner closely with the People Technology leadership and play a key role in our Workday transformation efforts. As part of a cross-functional team, you will collaborate with stakeholders across People, Payroll, IT, Finance, and international offices to optimize and scale our HR systems and processes.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about solving complex business challenges, driving innovation through automation, and delivering a best-in-class user experience.

  

**What you'll be doing :-**

* **Strategic Leadership & Delivery**
  + - **End-to-End Solution Delivery:** Spearhead complex Workday initiatives from functional requirements gathering and business process design through technical architecture, testing, and production deployment across HCM, Recruiting, and Performance.
    - **Enterprise IT & HR Alignment:** Partner closely with Enterprise IT Architects, Information Security, HR Operations, and Talent Leadership to align Workday roadmaps with corporate infrastructure and data governance standards.
    - **Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management:** Translate high-level HR and Talent acquisition strategies into scalable technical roadmaps, managing project lifecycles, dependencies, and executive expectations.  
  **Subject Matter Expertise**
  + - **Enterprise Integration Architecture:** Architect, build, and maintain high-volume inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with internal systems and external vendors using **Workday Studio, Orchestration, EIB, Core Connectors, and Document Transformation (DT)**.
    - **Core Functional & BP Ownership:** Serve as the primary functional owner for complex business processes (BPs), condition rules, and eligibility rules across **Core HCM, Recruiting, and Performance**.
    - **Security & Audit Governance:** Design and enforce role-based security architecture, data privacy standards, and SOX/payroll audit controls across the Workday tenant.  
  **System Optimization & Innovation**
  + - **Advanced Reporting & Analytics:** Design advanced calculated fields and custom reports (**Advanced, Matrix, and Composite**) to deliver actionable workforce insights for Talent, Recruiting, and executive leadership.
    - **Complex Data Transformation:** Engineer intricate **XSLT and XML transformations** to standardize data payloads, reduce integration latency, and eliminate manual file manipulation across third-party vendor feeds.
    - **Workflow Re-Engineering:** Audit and streamline legacy business processes across Recruiting and Performance cycles to reduce administrative bottlenecks and improve end-user experience.  
  + **AI Enablement**
  + - **Intelligent Process Automation:** Leverage **Workday Orchestration** and emerging Workday AI/ML capabilities to automate repetitive HR transactions, multi-step approvals, and cross-system data syncs.
    - **AI-Driven Talent & Recruiting:** Enable intelligent talent matching, skills-based frameworks, and automated candidate routing within Workday Recruiting and Performance modules to accelerate hiring and internal mobility.
    - **Predictive Workforce Insights:** Structure clean, governed tenant data models and calculated fields to feed downstream AI analytics and workforce planning tools  
  **Change Management**
  + - **Release Management Leadership:** Direct technical and functional impact assessments, unit testing, regression testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for **Workday semi-annual feature releases** and internal upgrades.
    - **Seamless Feature Adoption:** Partner with HR Operations and change leads to evaluate newly released Workday functionality, guiding stakeholders through feature adoption, training, and post-deployment hypercare.
    - **Risk Mitigation & Cutover Governance:** Establish rigorous deployment checklists, rollback plans, and tenant migration protocols to ensure zero-downtime production releases.  
  **Mentorship & Inclusive Leadership**
  + - **Highest-Tier Escalation Point:** Act as the primary technical and functional escalation lead to troubleshoot and resolve critical production defects across integrations, security, and business processes.
    - **Analyst Coaching & Upskilling:** Mentor mid-level and junior techno-functional analysts through code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and hands-on training in Workday Studio, XSLT, and functional configuration.
    - **Inclusive & Collaborative Culture:** Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive engineering environment that encourages knowledge sharing, cross-training across HCM modules, and diverse problem-solving perspectives.

**What you'll bring to the role**

* **Experience:** **8+ years** of related experience in a professional role with a Bachelor's degree (or **6+ years** with a Master's degree), including **5–7+ years** of deep, hands-on expertise configuring, architecting, and supporting **Workday Core HCM, Talent, and Recruiting**.
* **Workday Skills:** Strong proficiency with Workday functional configuration (**Core HCM, Talent Management, Performance, and Recruiting**), complex business processes (BPs), Calculated Fields, custom reporting (**Advanced, Matrix, and Composite**), executive dashboards, enterprise integrations (**Workday Studio, Orchestration, EIB, Core Connectors, DT, XSLT/XML**), and navigating the core Workday ecosystem.
* **Technical Breadth:** Proven capability to simultaneously manage, architect, and support **3 or more Workday modules, enterprise systems, or cross-functional HR process areas**.
* **Analytical Problem Solving:** Ability to diagnose and resolve complex techno-functional issues spanning multiple applications and integrations, exercising sound judgment in choosing methods and techniques for scalable, compliant solutions.
* **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to translate complex Workday architecture and technical concepts into business-friendly language. Strong capability to facilitate discovery workshops, lead UAT sessions, and present strategic roadmaps to diverse technical and HR audiences.
* **Project Management:** Track record of driving significant business results through strategic thinking, iterative process improvement, and managing end-to-end delivery of complex HR technology and semi-annual release projects.

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

* **Workday Certifications:** Workday Pro certifications in Integrations, Core HCM, or Recruiting or Talent (or active/prior Workday Partner certifications).
* **Cloud & Middleware Ecosystem:** Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms and enterprise integration middleware (such as MuleSoft, Boomi, AWS, or Azure) within a global corporate IT landscape.
* **Global Enterprise Delivery:** Prior experience operating at a Principal or Level 4 Senior Techno-Functional capacity within a large, multi-country internal enterprise IT organization.

**The Okta Experience**

* Supporting Your Well-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

title: Director, Employee Relations, APAC
description:
**The opportunity**
===================

This is an opportunity to shape how Employee Relations is delivered across one of the world’s most diverse and dynamic regions.

As the senior Employee Relations leader for APAC, you will set and lead the regional ER strategy, translating Alcon’s global Employee Relations vision into locally relevant and compliant practices across diverse markets, cultures, regulatory environments, and workforce models.

You will be a trusted advisor to senior HR and business leaders on Alcon’s most complex workforce matters, including employee and labor relations, workplace investigations, organizational transformation, conduct, compliance, and emerging workforce risk.

Just as importantly, you will help build the next generation of Employee Relations at Alcon, strengthening regional capabilities, using data and technology to identify risk earlier, and creating a more consistent and scalable approach to ER while preserving the local expertise required across APAC.

**What you’ll lead**
====================

**Shape the APAC Employee Relations strategy**
----------------------------------------------

* Define and execute the APAC Employee Relations strategy in alignment with Alcon’s global GER strategy, operating model, service portfolio, and business priorities.
* Serve as a senior regional advisor and thought partner to HR and business leadership on complex employee relations, labor relations, workplace conduct, compliance, and workforce risk.
* Represent APAC within Global Employee Relations leadership, ensuring regional perspectives influence global strategy, policy, governance, service design, and transformation.
* Anticipate workforce and employee relations implications arising from business strategy, organizational change, and evolving employment environments.
* Translate emerging regional risks and trends into actionable insights and recommendations for senior leaders.

**Lead regional ER service delivery and governance**
====================================================

* Provide regional leadership for ER services encompassing consultation, complaint and case management, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, dismissals, conflict resolution, employee representation, organizational change, HR policy, and employment-related compliance.
* Translate global ER principles and standards into locally relevant practices across APAC's varied legal, regulatory, cultural, and employee-representation environments.
* Establish clear service expectations, escalation pathways, controls, documentation standards, and quality practices.
* Build effective partnerships and clarify decision rights across Global Employee Relations, country HR, HR Business Partners, Employment Legal, Integrity & Compliance, Global Security, HR Operations, and other Centers of Excellence.
* Champion continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to simplify, scale, and strengthen ER services and the stakeholder experience.

**Navigate complex employee and labor relations**
=================================================

* Advise on the region's most complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee and labor relations matters.
* Build credible relationships with regional and country leadership and promote constructive employee and social dialogue.
* Partner with country HR and Legal on union, employee-representative, consultation, and collective labor requirements.
* Provide strategic ER leadership for restructurings, reductions in force, integrations, organizational transformations, and other significant workforce changes, including complex cross-border initiatives.
* Balance enterprise consistency with the legal, cultural, and operating realities of individual APAC markets.

**Lead complex workplace investigations and complaint management**
==================================================================

* Provide regional governance and executive oversight of significant employee complaints and workplace investigations.
* Lead or oversee high-risk, highly sensitive, executive-level, or cross-border investigations.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for matters involving discrimination, harassment, retaliation, workplace conduct, misconduct, and other significant employee concerns.
* Ensure investigations and remediation are fair, objective, timely, culturally informed, appropriately documented, and aligned with both global standards and local requirements.
* Strengthen investigation quality and capability across the regional ER and HR community.

**Influence policy, compliance and workforce risk**
===================================================

* Partner with Legal, Compliance, HR and other stakeholders to identify and proactively address emerging employment and workforce risks across APAC.
* Provide the regional ER perspective on HR policy implementation, localization, interpretation, and evolution.
* Support employment-related controls, compliance programs, regulatory reviews, audits, and remediation.
* Promote high standards of confidentiality, data privacy, documentation, records management, and defensible decision-making.

**Turn ER data into business insight**
======================================

* Establish a regional approach to ER analytics, insights, and proactive risk identification.
* Use case, investigation, workforce, compliance, and stakeholder data to identify emerging trends, systemic concerns, risk concentrations, and opportunities for prevention.
* Develop meaningful measures of service quality, timeliness, risk, stakeholder experience, and organizational impact.
* Translate patterns and data into clear, actionable insights for senior HR and business leaders.
* Explore responsible uses of AI and emerging technology to enhance ER insights, case management, knowledge management, and operational effectiveness while maintaining appropriate human judgment and oversight.

**Build capability for the future**
===================================

* Build a strong and connected APAC Employee Relations community, developing ER professionals, HR teams, investigators, and ER champions across the region.
* Strengthen capability through coaching, practical tools, playbooks, training, communities of practice, and knowledge sharing.
* Create scalable ways to share expertise, identify emerging issues, and escalate material risks across countries.
* Champion practical AI literacy and responsible adoption of emerging technologies within ER.
* Foster a culture that combines global consistency with strong local judgment, recognizing that effective Employee Relations across APAC cannot be delivered through a one-size-fits-all approach.

**What will make you stand out**
================================

We are looking for a seasoned Employee Relations leader who is equally comfortable advising senior executives, navigating a sensitive workplace matter, influencing across a matrix, and building the systems and capabilities required for the future.

You are likely to bring:

* Significant Employee Relations, Employment Law, Industrial Relations, HR, or closely related experience, including substantial experience operating across multiple APAC markets.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior HR and business leaders on complex, sensitive, and high-risk workforce matters.
* Deep experience in employee and labor relations, workplace investigations, organizational change, disciplinary matters, dismissals, and workforce-risk mitigation.
* Experience navigating different legal, cultural, regulatory, union, works council, or employee-representation environments across the region.
* A strong track record supporting complex cross-border restructurings, integrations, consultations, or workforce transformations.
* Experience designing or transforming regional ER services, governance, operating models, processes, or capabilities.
* Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to use ER data and workforce insights to influence decisions and identify risk proactively.
* Experience leading ER professionals, investigators, country resources, or distributed regional networks through direct and/or matrixed relationships.
* Strong executive presence and a reputation for sound judgment, discretion, independence, objectivity, and courage when handling sensitive matters.
* Fluency in English and the ability to operate effectively across APAC and global time zones.

**Additional experience that would be valuable**
================================================

* An advanced degree or professional qualification in Human Resources, Employment Law, Industrial Relations, Business, or a related discipline.
* Experience within a multinational, matrixed, and highly regulated industry such as medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, manufacturing, or technology.
* Experience supporting unionized or employee-represented manufacturing environments.
* Deep employment or labor-relations expertise within several significant APAC markets.
* Experience implementing or improving ER case-management systems, service catalogs, knowledge-management practices, analytics, controls, and service measures.
* Experience applying AI-enabled HR, analytics, case-management, or knowledge-management tools to improve ER services and insights.
* Proficiency in one or more APAC languages in addition to English.
* Ability to travel regionally as business needs require.
