title: Principal Engineer- Backend
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

**Principal Engineer- Backend**

**The Opportunity**

We have an outstanding career opportunity for Backend- Principal Engineer at Bangalore location. As a Backend Principal Engineer on the Clumio team, you serve as a technical leader in the control and management plane of the cloud-native data protection platform. Reporting to the Engineering Director, this role combines hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, shaping systems that are foundational to customer data protection and recovery.

**About the Team**

The Clumio Backend team designs, builds, and operates core backend systems that support Clumio's cloud-native data protection platform. For many customers, data protection is not a "nice-to-have" capability, but a foundational requirement driven by compliance, audit, and security mandates. In these environments, recovery performance, cost efficiency, strong governance, and reliable operation at scale are critical differentiators. The team builds and operates key backend components of the platform's control and management plane, playing an integral role in how customers securely interact with, configure, and manage their data protection environments.

Built on a cloud-native architecture, the Backend team develops shared services and well-defined interfaces that abstract complexity from underlying systems and enable consistent, reliable, and scalable interactions across the platform. This work supports the continued evolution of the platform, enabling new capabilities, data sources, and workflows to be added efficiently and safely. Beyond core data protection workflows, the Backend team helps enable essential SaaS capabilities across the platform, including lifecycle management, observability, usage and cost insights, and intelligent analytics that support effective operation and informed customer decision-making.

Working closely with product, frontend, infrastructure, quality engineering, and customer-facing teams, the Backend team focuses on building highly reliable, scalable, and operable distributed systems that form a critical part of Clumio's enterprise-grade cloud data protection platform.

**What you’ll do…**

* You own and drive cross-cutting technical initiatives that span multiple services and define core platform capabilities across shared services such as control planes, policy management, and operational services.
* This includes designing and evolving platform abstractions, making architectural decisions that balance correctness, cost, scalability, and operational simplicity, and leading the execution of complex projects from design through production rollout.
* You are responsible for setting technical direction and ensuring that architectural decisions are realized in high-quality production systems.
* You remain deeply hands-on, spending significant time writing and reviewing code, solving complex technical problems, and participating in production operations.
* You work closely with Senior Engineers, Product, and Customer Success teams to guide designs, incorporate operational and customer feedback, and establish technical patterns that allow the platform to scale and evolve across multiple cloud environments.

**Who you are…**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant ownership of complex, production backend or platform systems from design through operation.
* Experience in at least one modern programming language such as Go (Preferred), Python, Java, or Rust.
* Experience leading ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives, driving solutions from problem definition to production delivery.
* Strong ability to translate business, customer, and operational requirements into clear technical designs, APIs, and system architectures.
* Experience in designing, building, and evolving distributed, cloud-native systems, with emphasis on correctness, scalability, operability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Ownership of non-trivial production systems, including diagnosing real-world issues, improving reliability, and iterating based on operational feedback.
* Experience making high-impact architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and clearly communicating them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly collaborative and self-driven, with a strong sense of shared ownership, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, fostering open communication and alignment across time zones.
* Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred.

**You’ll love working here because:**

* Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Annual health check-ups, Car lease Program, and Tuition Reimbursement
* An inclusive company culture, an opportunity to join our Community Guilds
* Personal accident cover and Term life cover

Ready to #makeyourmark at Commvault? Apply now!

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. title: Talent Acquisition Assoc Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT**
At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.
  
  
At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.
  
  
Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**The Opportunity**
As a Professional Recruiter focused on professional hiring, you will play a key role in attracting, assessing, and hiring top talent for PepsiCo. You will collaborate with hiring managers, HR business partners, and stakeholders to develop and execute strategic hiring plans while ensuring a seamless and engaging candidate experience.
  
  
This role requires a blend of strategic talent sourcing, stakeholder management, employer branding, data-driven decision-making, and process excellence to support our talent acquisition goals.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As Talent Acquisition Analyst your responsibilities would consist of ...
  
  
Recruitment Consulting, Advisory & Partnership
  
  

* Partner with hiring managers to conduct recruitment strategy meetings, analyze hiring needs, define job requirements, and craft customized recruitment plans.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights on talent availability, salary benchmarks, and industry hiring trends.
* Act as a trusted talent advisor, guiding hiring managers on interviewing best practices, inclusive hiring strategies, candidate experience standards, and the effective use of assessment tools.
* Align recruitment efforts with workforce planning, strategic TA initiatives, and business priorities.
* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with hiring managers, HR, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates and proactive communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring alignment and transparency.

Candidate Sourcing, Attraction, and Engagement
  
  

* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify and attract both active and passive talent using job boards, social media, employee referrals, and networking.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles to reduce time-to-find and time-to-accept.
* Leverage PepsiCo’s employer branding and recruitment marketing to enhance talent attraction, including writing compelling job descriptions, optimizing job postings, and engaging candidates through our established EVP messaging.
* Deliver a consistent, high-touch candidate experience, ensuring timely communication and engagement at every stage of the hiring process

End-to-End Recruitment Process Management & Execution
  
  

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from job requisition creation to offer acceptance, ensuring efficiency, quality, and a seamless and positive candidate experience while adhering to all established process standards.
* Conduct structured interviews and behavioral assessments applying the company's established interviewing framework and standards to evaluate candidate qualifications, skills, and culture add.
* Facilitate hiring manager debrief sessions and provide structured feedback to support data-driven hiring decisions.
* Manage the offer process, including extending offers and negotiating compensation packages in partnership with HR, Total Rewards, and Hiring Manager.

Data-Driven Recruitment, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Track and analyze key recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-find, time-to-accept, candidate experience scores) to continuously improve hiring outcomes.
* Utilize external labor market data and talent analytics to refine sourcing strategies and hiring decisions.
* Ensure adherence to global hiring policies, DEI standards, and local employment laws.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, recruitment technology advancements, and innovative hiring trends.
* Effectively utilize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and other recruitment technologies to manage the recruitment process.

Process Adherence and Data Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM platforms.
* Follow established recruitment process standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and data integrity.

Global Talent Acquisition Initiatives Contribution and Team Support
  
  

* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in process, technology, or data, actively participating in SME networks and providing support to the assigned team.
* Team Support and Development: Provide backup support for team leaders and act as a coach/buddy for new hires to facilitate onboarding and development.
* Global Project Participation: Contribute as a Talent Acquisition Delivery SME on assigned global projects.

Specialized Responsibilities Based on Recruiter Type
  
  

* Focus on hiring for corporate/professional roles in Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, R&D, and other business functions.
* Source specialized talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional associations, networking events, and industry-specific job boards.
* Manage longer-cycle, strategic hiring with structured interview processes and leadership engagement.
* Provide data-driven insights and talent intelligence to support workforce planning.
* Work closely with senior leaders and HRBPs to align hiring strategies with business goals.

**Qualifications**
**Who Are We Looking For?**

* 1+ Years of Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to offer management within a corporate or agency environment
* Education: Bachelor's degree.
* Solid understanding of talent assessment methodologies and interviewing techniques (e.g., behavioral, competency-based).
* Proven experience with recruitment marketing principles and various channels (e.g., social media platforms, and job boards).

Technology:
  
  

* Demonstrated experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruiting technologies.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Talent Intelligence & Compliance: Knowledge of talent intelligence tools, competitor analysis, employment law, regulations, and compliance related to recruitment.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze recruitment data and metrics to inform hiring strategies and drive data-driven decisions.
* Organizational & Time Management Skills: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders at all levels.
* Problem-solving & Decision-Making: Ability to analyze situations, identify potential solutions, and make sound judgments.
* Adaptability & Flexibility: Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Results Orientation: Driven to achieve recruitment targets and contribute to team success.
* Language Proficiency: Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Global Experience: Experience working in a multinational or global organization.
* Experience coaching and mentoring junior recruiters.
* Solid understanding of project management principles.
* Experience recruiting within a Global Shared Services environment.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.
  
  
**What can you expect from us:**

* Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
* Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.
* Development programs according to Leadership skills.
* Specialized training according to the role.
* Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
* We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP SuccessFactors RCM/RMK Implementation consultant working with enterprise customers in transforming their hiring operations. Consultant is responsible for successful delivery of HCM technology and Process deliverables. This includes implementation, integration with other SF Modules and End-to-End testing of the configuration with the client during iterations.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SAP SF Recruiting & Recruiting Marketing technology, superior consulting skills, and the ability to translate vision into operational excellence as well as assist clients in implementation planning, fit analysis, testing, rollout, and post-implementation support of the Module
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, aligning their talent acquisition strategy with SAP SuccessFactors RCM capabilities, industry best practices, and long-term business goals.
* Provide thought leadership on modern recruiting practices, digital adoption, hiring team empowerment, and the Intelligent Enterprise.
* Application specific solution consulting (for a specific application: creation of business blueprint, Implementation based on a blueprint, creation of test cases, test scheduling and execution, key user training, go live support, and post go live support)
* At least two E2E SF RCM and RMK implementation and support experiences.
* SuccessFactors recruiting management, Job profile builder, Requisition through position management, should have worked on Recruitment XML Templates like Job Requisition, Candidate Profile, Application & Offer.
* Should have knowledge on recruiting scenarios, integrations and client requirements etc
* Integration with other modules. Ready to perform the client facing role.
* Should have SF EC, Position Management, RMK and ONB modules integration knowledge would be an added advantages
* Should have good communication skills.
* Basic knowledge SmartRecruiters will be added Advantage.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Work Experience in SAP SF : 3-8 years & above
* Certification is must in SAP SuccessFactors Recruitment Management, Recruitment Marketing and by SAP.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Good Analysis and troubleshooting skills
* Experience leading cross-functional implementation projects, preferably in a consulting environment.
* SAP Joule for SuccessFactors.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Leanwatts designs and develops efficient EV chargers for electric vehicles through continuous research and development. The company focuses on optimal power conversion, offering reliable, smart, and cost-effective charging solutions. Its product range spans from 300W to 3kW chargers suitable for two-, three-, and four-wheeler EV applications. Leanwatts delivers competitively priced, high-efficiency chargers and takes pride in products that are designed and made in India. Applicants will join a growing organization contributing to sustainable mobility and advanced power electronics.
  
**Role Description**
The Human Resources Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. The Human Resources Manager will manage HR policies and procedures, ensure compliance with labor laws, and maintain accurate employee records. Day-to-day tasks include partnering with leadership on workforce planning, facilitating training and development initiatives, handling employee relations, and supporting compensation and benefits administration. The role also involves fostering an inclusive, collaborative work environment aligned with Leanwatts’ mission and values.
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience in core HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Skills in HR policy development, compliance with labor and statutory regulations, and HR documentation and reporting.
* Ability to design and implement training, development, and engagement programs that support organizational growth.
* Competence in compensation and benefits administration, attendance management, and HR analytics or metrics.
* Strong interpersonal, conflict-resolution, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels.
* Proficiency with HRIS or related HR tools and standard productivity software.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, or technology sectors.

title: Senior Executive - HR Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

*1. Onboarding & Induction*

* Coordinate pre-joining formalities: offer/appointment letter issuance, document collection and joining schedules.
* Conduct joining formalities and the induction programme covering company overview, policies, safety norms, code of conduct and systems access.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Accounts and department heads for laptops, ID cards, email IDs, access and seating before Day 1.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines, and collect new-joiner feedback at 30/60/90 days.
* Maintain the joiner checklist and ensure complete, verified personnel files (including BGV coordination with the HR Manager).

*2. Attendance & Leave Management*

* Consolidate and validate daily/monthly attendance from biometric or HRMS systems.
* Track leaves, late marks, on-duty entries and regularisations, and resolve discrepancies with department heads.
* Share the finalised attendance and leave data with the payroll team by the cut-off date.

*3. Payroll Support*

* Prepare monthly payroll inputs: joiners, exits, attendance, leave encashment, incentives, reimbursements and deductions.
* Check payroll sheets/reports for accuracy before release and raise variances with the HR Manager.
* Support statutory compliance inputs (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and coordinate with Accounts/Finance and auditors as required.
* Handle employee payroll queries and payslip-related requests.

*4. TA/DA Processing*

* Receive, verify and process employee travel claims (TA) and daily allowance (DA) against company policy and approvals.
* Check supporting documents, rate eligibility and grade entitlements, and flag policy deviations.
* Coordinate claim settlement with Accounts and maintain the monthly TA/DA tracker and reports.

*5. General HR Operations*

* Maintain the employee master data, HRIS records and HR MIS (headcount, attrition, joiners/exits, attendance summaries).
* Support the exit process: resignation acceptance, clearance, full & final inputs and issue of relieving/experience letters.
* Issue HR letters and certificates (confirmation, salary/employment verification, transfers, etc.).
* Assist with employee engagement activities, statutory displays/registers and audits.
* Support the HR Manager on policy updates, performance appraisal cycles and ad-hoc HR projects.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in HR or a graduate degree with a specialisation in HR.
* 4–7 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in a manufacturing, steel, power or other industrial setup.
* Hands-on experience in onboarding, attendance management, payroll processing and reimbursement/TA-DA handling.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Working knowledge of payroll and labour compliance (PF, ESI, PT, Factories Act basics, Payment of Wages, etc.).
* Proficient in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and any HRMS/payroll software.
* Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and deadline discipline.
* Good communication and coordination skills across levels, from plant floor to senior management.
* Ability to conduct engaging induction sessions and handle multiple tasks at once.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Onboarding completion and document accuracy (zero Day-1 gaps)
* Attendance and payroll input turnaround, with error rate
* TA/DA claim turnaround time and policy adherence
* New-joiner feedback and probation-completion tracking
* Timeliness and accuracy of HR MIS reports

**Job Title: Behavioral Trainer, Assistant Manager**

**Experience:**
8 to 12 Years

**Job Location: Hyderabad**

**Job Summary:**

The Behavioral Trainer, Asst Manager is responsible for developing and implementing training programs aimed at improving employees’ behavioral and interpersonal skills. This role involves assessing training needs, creating curricula, and delivering training sessions while ensuring alignment with the organization’s culture and goals. The position also requires the manager to evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and suggest continuous improvements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Training Design & Development:**

* Develop comprehensive training programs focusing on behavioral development, including topics like communication skills, leadership, conflict resolution, emotional intelligence, team dynamics, stress management, and workplace ethics.
* Design engaging training materials and methodologies (e.g., workshops, e-learning, role-playing exercises).
* Tailor training programs to meet the needs of different employee groups, including managers, team leaders, and tech consultants.

1. **Training Delivery:**

* Conduct classroom training, virtual workshops, and one-on-one coaching sessions (Need based).
* Use a variety of teaching techniques (Psychometrics, role plays, Run polls, activities, case studies, role simulation) to engage employees and ensure knowledge retention.
* Provide feedback and support to individuals during training to improve their behavioral skills.

1. **Employee Development:**

* Conduct behavioral assessments and surveys to identify areas for improvement across teams.
* Track individual and team progress, providing ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Assist employees with setting personal development goals and support their growth.

1. **Program Evaluation & Reporting:**

* Assess the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, surveys, and performance metrics.
* Create and maintain records of training sessions and individual progress with the help of Ops team.
* Provide regular reports to PD Lead on the outcomes and success of training initiatives.

1. **Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:**

* Collaborate with HR, senior leadership, and department heads to identify behavioral training needs and align programs with company goals.
* Work closely with other training managers to ensure consistency and coherence in training delivery across the organization.

1. **Continuous Improvement:**

* Stay current on industry trends, best practices, and new training methodologies.
* Recommend improvements to existing programs to ensure they remain relevant and effective.
* Implement feedback loops and make necessary adjustments to training content.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum 8 to 12 years of experience in training, coaching, or organizational development roles, with at least 2 years in a Lead role.
* **Skills:**
* Strong understanding of behavioral science and organizational behavior.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to assess and diagnose training needs.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Familiarity with various training tools and technologies (e.g., learning management systems).
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities.

**Key Attributes:**

* Empathetic and approachable with strong emotional intelligence.
* Ability to build trust and rapport with employees at all levels.
* Proactive and results-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion and professionalism.

**Work Environment:**

* The Behavioral Trainer, Asst Manager typically works in an office environment, and may travel for on-site training or coaching sessions.
* The role may require flexible hours based on training schedules and organizational needs.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Customer Success Business Partner [T500-31133]
description:
**About Guidant Global:**

Guidant Global delivers dynamic, tailored workforce solutions that empower businesses to thrive in ever-evolving markets. Through our MSP, RPO, Direct Sourcing, Services Procurement and Consulting services, we help organizations find, engage, and manage the best permanent and contingent talent across the globe.

Part of Impellam Group, we champion A Better Way, a people-first approach that integrates deep industry expertise with advanced technology. Our technology turns workforce complexity into clarity, with real-time insights that support smarter talent decisions at scale.

With over 1.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.

**About Guidant Global India:**

At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability centre, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.

We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.

Join us, and you'll be part of a people-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.

**Role Focus:**

* Keeping recruitment processes moving from requisition approval through to offer and handover
* Providing day-to-day process support to onshore Talent Advisors
* Maintaining accurate and timely activity within the applicant tracking system
* Coordinating administrative tasks, actions and follow-ups across live vacancies
* Liaising with hiring managers, internal / referral candidates and relevant KPMG teams
* Supporting a consistent candidate and hiring manager experience
* Operating in line with agreed processes, service standards and data requirements
* Flagging ageing risk early and capturing the reasons for delays, withdrawals and declined offers

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Recruitment Process Management:**

* Manage and track recruitment activity across assigned requisitions, ensuring agreed actions are progressed and completed on time.
* Work alongside Talent Advisors to coordinate the recruitment process and maintain momentum across each stage.
* Monitor outstanding actions, interviews, feedback and candidate progression, following up with the relevant parties where required.
* Identify delays, incomplete actions or process risks and escalate them promptly to the Talent Advisor or Recruitment Operations Team Lead. Flag requisitions approaching 50 and 75 days, record the cause of delay (for example hiring manager feedback, scheduling or candidate availability) and agree the next action with the Talent Advisor.
* Support requisition set-up, vacancy posting, workflow progression and requisition closure in line with agreed processes.
* Log reasons for candidate withdrawals and declined offers promptly using the agreed reason codes, so that Governance can analyze them.

**ATS and Administration:**

* Maintain accurate, complete and up-to-date candidate and vacancy records within the applicant tracking system.
* Progress candidates through the appropriate workflow stages and ensure supporting information is recorded correctly.
* Complete recruitment administration including document management, status updates, interview records, feedback follow-up and offer-stage coordination.
* Apply consistent process and data standards across all assigned activity.
* Where assigned by the Recruitment Operations Team Lead, pull standard management information reports from the ATS to the specification and definitions agreed with the Governance, Performance & Reporting Manager.
* Handle candidate and recruitment information securely and in line with applicable data privacy requirements.

**Stakeholder and Candidate Liaison:**

* Act as an operational point of contact for recruitment process queries from hiring managers and other stakeholders.
* Liaise with hiring managers to obtain availability, feedback, approvals and other information needed to progress recruitment activity.
* Communicate with internal candidates and employee referral candidates, providing clear updates and coordinating next steps.
* Leave expectation-setting, negotiation and other critical candidate conversations, including offer discussions and declines, to the Talent Advisor, and provide the information they need.
* Liaise with KPMG’s interview scheduling team, which manages interview scheduling, to resolve escalations and keep all parties informed.
* Ensure communications are timely, professional and aligned with the agreed candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Team Collaboration and Service Quality:**

* Build an effective working partnership with onshore Talent Advisors, agreeing ownership and next steps for live recruitment activity.
* Take daily and weekly priorities from onshore Talent Advisors through agreed huddles, and work with the Recruitment Operations Team Lead to manage workload and balance activity across the team.
* Maintain a dotted-line relationship with the Client Engagement Manager to support alignment with client expectations and ways of working.
* Follow standard operating procedures, raise recurring issues with their cause, and contribute practical ideas that simplify or improve the recruitment process.
* Provide flexible support across the account as hiring volumes and priorities change.

**Experience & Capabilities:**

* Experience in recruitment coordination, recruitment operations or delivery within an RPO, in-house or agency environment.
* Practical experience using an applicant tracking system and managing recruitment administration.
* Strong organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and actions at the same time.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence liaising with hiring managers, candidates and colleagues across different locations and teams.
* High attention to detail and a disciplined approach to process and data accuracy.
* A proactive approach to follow-up, problem-solving and escalation.
* Experience supporting UK recruitment or professional services hiring would be advantageous.

**Key Behaviours:**

* Accountable: takes ownership of actions and follows them through to completion.
* Collaborative: works as one team with Talent Advisors and operational colleagues.
* Responsive: acts quickly and keeps stakeholders informed.
* Process-focused: applies agreed ways of working consistently and accurately.
* Candidate-minded: considers the candidate experience in every interaction.
* Adaptable: responds positively to changing volumes, priorities and requirements.
* Improvement-minded: raises recurring issues and helps fix them.

**Success Measures:**

* Recruitment stages and actions progressed within agreed service timescales.
* Requisitions approaching 50 and 75 days flagged early, with the cause of delay recorded.
* Withdrawal and declined-offer reasons logged completely and promptly.
* Accurate and up-to-date applicant tracking system records.
* Timely interview coordination, feedback follow-up and candidate communication.
* Effective support for Talent Advisors and positive feedback from key stakeholders.
* Consistent adherence to recruitment processes, controls and data requirements.
* Agreed ways of working, including huddles with Talent Advisors, applied consistently.
* Contribution to a smooth candidate and hiring manager experience

Techdome is a profitable, fast-growing product venture studio founded in 2020 and headquartered in Indore, with teams in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Dubai and the US. We build AI-first products across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech and Enterprise Automation.

Our flagship HRTech product, **JustInterview.ai (JIA)**, is an end-to-end AI hiring platform covering every stage from sourcing to signed offer: AI resume screening, AI video interviews, coding and Vibe Coding assessments, interview scheduling and offer management. More than 2,000 companies use JIA to hire faster and smarter.

**About the Role**
------------------

You'll handle both in-house hiring for Techdome and external hiring for our clients, using JIA every day. You'll own the complete recruitment cycle – from writing the job description to the candidate's joining day – and show what AI-powered hiring looks like in practice.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Handle in-house hiring for Techdome's teams and external hiring for client requirements
* Understand hiring needs from internal managers and clients, and create clear, accurate job descriptions (including AI-generated JDs on JIA)
* Post jobs on JIA, Keka, LinkedIn, Naukri and other relevant platforms
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and social media using Boolean search
* Use JIA for AI resume screening, AI interviews, coding/MCQ/Vibe Coding assessments and interview scheduling
* Review JIA's AI evaluation reports and shortlist the right candidates for the next rounds
* Coordinate technical and HR interviews with internal panels and client teams, and make sure feedback comes in on time
* Handle salary discussions, negotiation, offer rollout and documentation
* Stay in touch with selected candidates until joining to prevent dropouts
* Track the recruitment funnel (Sourced Screened AI Interviewed Assessed Interviewed Offered Joined) and improve conversion at each stage
* Keep candidate data updated in JIA and Keka, and share weekly hiring reports with internal teams and clients
* Share product feedback from real hiring use with the JIA product team

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Must Have**

* 0–1.5 years of experience in IT recruitment (internship experience counts)
* Strong exposure to the end-to-end recruitment cycle, from JD creation to joining (mandatory)
* Good command of recruitment funnel management and hiring metrics (mandatory)
* Good understanding of IT roles and technologies such as Java, Python, React, Node.js, Cloud, QA and Data
* Strong sourcing skills on LinkedIn and Naukri
* Comfort with AI hiring tools and quick to adopt new technology
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi
* Good negotiation, coordination and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage multiple internal and client requirements at the same time
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR is a plus

### **Good to Have**

* Experience in in-house (corporate) recruitment
* Hands-on experience with Keka
* Experience with AI interview or assessment platforms
* Internship experience in IT recruitment
* Ability to join immediately

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **Positions closed on time:** internal and client roles filled within agreed timelines
* **A healthy funnel:** conversion improves at every stage, from sourced to joined
* **Zero surprises on joining day:** offer dropouts stay low because you stay close to candidates
* **Better product:** your real-world feedback makes JIA smarter for 2,000+ companies

**Why Join Techdome × JIA?**
----------------------------

* **Hire with AI, every day:** recruit using JustInterview.ai – and help shape it
* **Double exposure early in your career:** both in-house and client hiring
* **Future-proof skills:** AI-powered recruitment is one of the fastest-growing areas in HR
* **Close to leadership:** direct exposure to founders, product and tech leaders
* **Grow fast:** an ownership culture and a clear growth path in Talent Acquisition

--------------

IT Recruiter, Technical Recruiter, Talent Acquisition, End-to-End Recruitment, IT Recruitment Fresher, Sourcing, Boolean Search, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Keka, AI Hiring, AI Interviews, Recruitment Funnel, Hiring Metrics, Offer Negotiation, Interview Coordination, Candidate Management, In-house Recruitment, Client Hiring, HR Recruiter

title: Procurement and Inbound Logistics Manager
description:
**Role and Company Overview:**

LEDFlex, a pioneer in linear LED luminaires, has been designing, developing, and manufacturing innovative linear LED lighting solutions for over 10 years, with a strong focus on performance, sustainability, and energy efficiency. Our products illuminate everything from commercial spaces to architectural landmarks, combining functionality with refined design.

We are seeking for Procurement and Inbound Logistics Manager lead and develop the procurement and inbound logistics teams in India, taking accountability for daily delivery, workload planning, team performance and continuous improvement. The role supports the company’s global warehouse network by coordinating purchasing activity with supplier readiness and inbound shipments through to warehouse delivery.

The immediate priority is to establish clear local leadership, define responsibilities and strengthen the teams’ technical capabilities. Through coaching, training and consistent processes, the Manager will enable employees to handle routine work independently.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership and Development**

• Own daily delivery across both India teams. Translate business priorities into daily and weekly work plans, allocate tasks and monitor completion against agreed deadlines.

• Act as Procurement Manager single accountable contact for India’s procurement and inbound logistics progress, risks and escalations. Resolve operational issues within delegated authority and present decisions requiring his input with clear recommendations.

• Document the handover of daily team management from Dubai, including the Dubai coordinators’ retained responsibilities, approval limits and escalation routes, to prevent overlapping ownership.

• Set individual objectives and performance expectations, hold regular team and individual reviews, and address missed deadlines, accuracy issues and recurring performance concerns.

• Assess workloads, capacity and technical skills across both teams. Rebalance suitable work and establish trained cover for key activities.

• Create practical training and upskilling plans covering procurement, shipment planning, customs documentation and system accuracy. Coach employees to make routine decisions within agreed procedures and take ownership of outcomes.

• Develop potential team leaders and review future skills needs as products, brands and regional warehouses are introduced. Confirm readiness before additional responsibilities are transferred to India.

**Technical Responsibilities:**

**Procurement Coordination**

• Oversee purchase order preparation and processing against approved requirements, prices and company approval procedures. Ensure quantities, product references and delivery requirements are complete and accurate.

• Ensure the team obtains supplier order confirmations and maintains accurate purchase order quantities, prices, production updates and agreed delivery dates in company systems.

• Review outstanding purchase orders, supplier commitments and goods readiness. Investigate overdue orders, agree recovery actions and escalate risks affecting warehouse requirements.

• Coordinate the procurement handover to inbound logistics so shipment plans use confirmed production completion dates, quantities and collection details.

• Work with suppliers and internal teams to resolve purchase order discrepancies, shortages and documentation issues within agreed authority. Analyse recurring supplier problems and follow corrective actions through to completion.

**Inbound Shipment Planning and Delivery**

• Manage inbound shipments from suppliers and production facilities into the UK, Dubai, India and future warehouse locations within the scope assigned to the team.

• Plan collections using appropriate air, sea, road or courier services. Compare freight quotations, service reliability and transit times, and recommend suitable options within agreed approval limits.

• Confirm goods readiness, collection and departure dates, expected arrival dates, carton or pallet quantities, dimensions and weights before booking transport.

• Maintain visibility of goods in transit and proactively manage missed collections, departure changes and delays. Assess their operational impact and communicate revised plans promptly.

• Ensure warehouse teams receive accurate advance delivery information, packing lists, expected quantities and arrival updates so they can plan receipt of goods.

• Coordinate final warehouse delivery, obtain delivery confirmation and work with warehouse teams and providers to resolve missing cartons, damage, short deliveries and other discrepancies.

**Import Documentation and Customs Coordination**

• Ensure commercial invoices, packing lists and supporting supplier documents are complete, accurate and consistent before collection. Follow up missing or incorrect documents and recurring supplier errors.

• Coordinate import documentation with suppliers, freight forwarders and customs brokers, including HS or commodity codes, country of origin, import declarations, certificates, preference declarations and licences where applicable. Ensure shipment arrangements reflect the agreed Incoterms.

• Provide brokers with complete shipment information, obtain specialist confirmation where classification or import requirements are unclear, and actively manage customs holds through to release.

• Review freight, duty, tax and brokerage charges against quotations and supporting records. Investigate unexpected or incorrect charges and escalate unresolved discrepancies.

**Systems Reporting and Improvement**

• Ensure purchase order and shipment records are updated accurately and promptly in the company ERP system and agreed trackers, with a clear owner, next action and due date for outstanding issues.

• Maintain one global inbound shipment tracker covering purchase order, supplier, origin, destination warehouse, transport mode, AWB or bill of lading and tracking references, ETA, customs status, delivery date, freight cost, duties and taxes, delays and actions.

• Provide Procurement Manager with consolidated reports on outstanding purchase orders, shipments, overdue work, supplier risks, capacity and decisions requiring his input.

• Maintain documented procedures, handover checklists and escalation routes. Standardise working practices across activities supported by India and verify that employees apply them consistently.

• Monitor logistics providers for collection reliability, transit time, clearance performance, communication and final delivery. Lead corrective action to reduce documentation errors, missed collections, avoidable delays and unnecessary freight costs.

**Key Skills Required:**

• 8–10 years of relevant experience across procurement and international inbound logistics, with a proven record of managing teams and delivering global operations.

• Practical experience of purchase order control, supplier follow-up, production readiness, shipment planning and delivery into multiple countries or warehouse locations.

• Strong working knowledge of commercial invoices, packing lists, import and customs documentation, Incoterms, HS codes and customs-clearance processes, including effective coordination with specialist advisers.

• Experience managing suppliers, freight forwarders, couriers and customs brokers across air, sea, road and courier movements.

• Proven ability to establish clear accountability, manage performance, develop technical skills, cross-train staff and build teams capable of working independently.

• Experience using ERP systems, Excel and operational trackers to maintain accurate records, analyse overdue work and report performance. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is desirable.

• Sound operational judgement, clear communication and the ability to resolve problems, balance competing priorities and plan the capabilities required for future growth.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience:**

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Procurement, Logistics, Business Administration or a related Field.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience in procurement, purchasing and international inbound logistics, preferably within manufacturing, engineering, electronics or LED lighting industries.

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience managing procurement and logistics teams, with proven capabilities in team leadership, performance management, employee development and process improvement.

• Strong practical knowledge of international shipping, import/export documentation, customs clearance, HS codes, Incoterms, supplier management and coordination with freight forwarders and customs brokers across multiple countries.

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, advanced Excel, procurement reporting and shipment tracking, with exposure to global supply chain operations across India, UK and UAE preferred.

**What You’ll Get Working with LEDFlex:**

• Will have a Competitive Salary (depending on experience, negotiable).

title: Assistant Manager / Manager- Leadership Hiring
description:
**Role Description | Key Deliverables**
The incumbent will be responsible for proactively identifying, mapping, profiling, and engaging senior and leadership talent across functions (e.g. Finance, Operations, Manufacturing, Marketing, HR, Technology, etc.). The role is to build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and company-wide leadership talent maps, support early stage candidate engagement, and provide data‐/market‐based insights that feed into leadership hiring, succession planning, and strategic workforce planning. Focus on depth of research and quality of information captured is vital.
  
  
**In Particular, The Individual Will Be Accountable For**
**Research and fulfillment**

* Work closely with the Lead – Leadership Hiring to develop a structured plan for every search which must include a search strategy including target companies / talent pool availability.
* Conduct comprehensive market and talent mapping, leveraging multiple sources such as professional networks, databases, social platforms, and internal repositories
* Conduct detailed market research to identify leadership talent pools across functions and geographies.
* Build and maintain talent maps and org charts indicating potential candidates, competitor benchmarking, leadership movement, compensation trends, etc.
* Ensure fulfilment of maximum number of searches through internal research in a target time. Speed and candidate relevance are of paramount importance.
* Evangelize / drive special focus on Diversity for open searches
* Capturing organizational charts, key professionals in the company, business models, references and other market intelligence through discussions with candidates
* Always strive to maintain a backup of at least 2 candidates at any given point of time

**Pre-research Focus Areas**

* Ensure that all relevant information (Must-Haves, Good-to-Haves, Budget etc) is obtained and documented in a Control Sheet for all roles at the onset of the search.
* Ensure that every search starts with a well-drafted Opportunity Dossier which has a buy in of all business stakeholders.
* Build and maintain a forward-looking pipeline of potential talent for critical leadership positions across group companies.
* Conduct competitive intelligence and market trend analysis to identify new and emerging talent pools

**Candidate Assessment**

* Preliminary assessments / conversations must include fitment with the JD and compensation budget.
* Undertake candidate assessments and propose a relevant pool for further evaluation.
* Ensuring that each candidate reached out to is provided with a top-of-the-line candidate experience
* Close loop with all engaged candidates through a formal note

**Database Management**

* Ensuring the research data is cleaned up, updated with latest comments and maintained in trackers.
* Evaluate and finalize alternate platforms for presenting Leadership Hiring data to Management
* Regularly capture reference inputs from different sources.

The position will be based in Mumbai and report to the DGM – Leadership Hiring and will be part of the Group HR Team of RPG Group.
  
  
**Desired Candidate Profile**
**The Successful Candidate Should Have The Following Attributes**

* Preferably master’s in human resources / MBA in HR
* 5-8 years of work experience in research and referencing, with exposure to EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) and other Industrial sectors is preferred
* Proven experience in sourcing and engaging active/passive candidates at senior/executive levels.
* Strong analytical mindset; able to synthesize data from multiple sources (public data, LinkedIn, industry databases) into actionable insights.
* Experience of navigating through LinkedIn, Naukri and other such platforms.
* High level of caliber and scalability, with focus on research quality and quick turnaround
* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Strong research and database management skills while managing key internal and external stakeholders
* Proactive, high energy, and strong work ethics
* High degree of discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information
* Adaptable and comfortable operating with some ambiguity / evolving priorities
* Curious about industry trends, competitor moves, leadership innovation
* Executive search firm experience with a focus on leadership hiring is desirable

description:

The
**Talent Enablement Coordinator**
will serve as a key connection point between Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and Engineering, helping accelerate technical hiring and enabling newly hired talent to transition successfully into productive engineering roles.
  
  
In this role, you will coordinate hiring activities, engineering onboarding, technical learning, ramp-up tracking, and reporting. You will work closely with Engineering Hiring Managers, Technical Leads, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition to identify bottlenecks, improve processes, and create an effective experience from candidate hiring through new-hire enablement.
  
  
Our Team
  
  
You will be part of the John Zink engineering organization, collaborating closely with Engineering Leadership, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Engineering Managers, and Technical Leads.
  
  
Our team values ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and creating long-term value by helping technical talent develop and contribute effectively.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Serve as a central liaison between Engineering, Talent Acquisition, and HR to drive effective coordination across technical hiring and talent enablement.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Talent Acquisition to identify and address bottlenecks across résumé reviews, technical assessments, interviews, and feedback.

* Coordinate engineering onboarding and technical enablement activities, including learning paths, mentoring or buddy programs, technical knowledge sessions, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day milestones.
* Partner with Technical Leads to help newly hired employees build the knowledge and capabilities required to contribute successfully.
* Track onboarding and ramp-up measures, including time-to-first-commit and talent maturity, to provide visibility into new-hire integration and development.
* Maintain accurate hiring and onboarding information across the Applicant Tracking System, internal databases, and dashboards.
* Prepare and communicate hiring-funnel, onboarding-status, and talent-enablement insights to Engineering Leadership.
* Proactively identify hiring delays and onboarding risks and collaborate with Engineering and HR stakeholders to facilitate timely support.
* Gather feedback from new hires and engineering stakeholders to continuously improve hiring coordination, onboarding, and the engineering enablement experience.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Professional university degree.
* 2 or more years of professional experience within an engineering, technology, talent enablement, talent acquisition, HR coordination, project coordination, or similar business environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple activities, stakeholders, priorities, or projects simultaneously.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and maintaining accurate operational data, trackers, or reporting.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.

What Will Put You Ahead
  
  

* Experience supporting technical or engineering hiring and onboarding processes.
* Familiarity with engineering terminology and technical talent profiles.
* Experience managing multiple open requisitions and concurrent onboarding activities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience coordinating structured 30-, 60-, and 90-day onboarding or development plans.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems, onboarding platforms, learning platforms, dashboards, or reporting tools.
* Experience preparing and presenting hiring, onboarding, or workforce metrics to business or engineering leadership.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with experience collaborating across Engineering, Talent Acquisition, HR, and global teams.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with the ability to identify process gaps and implement practical solutions.

description:
Hinduja Group –Manager HR (Job Description)

Group Vice President – HR

What is the purpose of the role?

To support the design, evolution and institutionalization of Group-wide Performance and Rewards philosophies, frameworks and governance mechanisms across Hinduja Group companies.

Working closely with the CoE Lead, Group Leadership and Company Rewards and HR teams, the role will help strengthen the linkage between business strategy, organizational performance, leadership accountability and rewards, while enabling appropriate consistency and governance across the Group.

The role will also contribute to the digital and analytics agenda for HR, identifying and driving opportunities to leverage data, technology, AI and advanced analytics to improve insights, decision-making, process effectiveness and employee experience across Performance, Rewards and the broader HR domain.

Key Responsibilities

Performance

* Design frameworks for translating Group and business strategy into organization-level KRAs/KPIs, with clear linkages between business outcomes and individual accountability.
* Develop the architecture for Organisation KRAs, Leadership KRAs and their cascading across levels, functions and businesses.
* Establish principles and standards for KRA/KPI design, including quality, measurability, outcome orientation, weightages and alignment.
* Support the evolution of performance management frameworks to strengthen differentiation, accountability and alignment between individual, leadership and organizational performance.

Rewards

* Support the design and evolution of the Group-wide Total Rewards philosophy, establishing common principles around competitiveness, internal equity, differentiation, affordability and pay-for-performance.
* Develop Group rewards guidelines and guardrails that provide consistency across Group companies while recognizing differences in industry, geography, workforce and business maturity.
* Partner on the design, evaluation and implementation of Long-Term Incentive Plans (LTIP), including ESOP/equity-linked plans, long-term cash incentive plans, and other retention and value-creation linked reward mechanisms.
* Undertake benchmarking and analysis to support compensation philosophy, reward positioning and leadership decision-making.
* Build stronger linkages between organization performance, individual performance and reward outcomes.
* Work closely with Company Rewards leads to understand business requirements, share Group perspectives and enable appropriate adoption of Group philosophies and frameworks.

Governance

* Develop the Group governance framework for Performance and Rewards, clearly defining decision rights, approval authorities, review forums, escalation mechanisms and the respective roles of Group and operating companies.
* Establish standards and guardrails for performance ratings, increments, variable pay, leadership compensation and long-term incentive decisions.
* Monitor adherence to Group philosophies and highlight areas of deviation, inconsistency or risk.
* Maintain appropriate documentation, policies and governance standards to ensure transparency and consistency of key Performance & Rewards decisions.

Analytics

* Develop a Group-wide Performance & Rewards analytics framework enabling leadership to assess outcomes, trends and areas requiring intervention across businesses.
* Build dashboards and insights covering areas such as Organisation and Leadership KRA achievement, compensation positioning and internal parity, pay-for-performance correlations, LTIP/ESOP coverage and effectiveness, and reward cost and affordability, amongst others.
* Use internal and external data to generate actionable insights and strengthen evidence-based Performance & Rewards decisions.

Digital & AI

* Support the identification and development of opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, AI and automation across the broader HR domain, beyond Performance & Rewards.
* Work with Group HR, Company HR teams and relevant technology partners to identify priority HR use cases where technology and AI can improve employee experience, productivity, decision-making and process effectiveness.
* Support the evaluation, prioritization and implementation of digital HR initiatives, including opportunities around GenAI, workflow automation, people analytics and self-service.
* Track emerging HR technology and AI developments and assess their relevance and applicability across Group companies.
* Help establish appropriate principles and guardrails for the responsible use of AI and data in HR, particularly around data quality, privacy, access and human oversight.

Skills & Competencies:

* MBA in HR
* Progressive HR professional with 5+ years of experience working in Performance & Rewards domain
* Analytical orientation and ability to interpret complex data
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with senior HR and business leaders
* Strong communication skills & high attention to detail
