title: NR-2026-0279 - US HR Operations Specialist/Associate Manager (India-based)
description:
**About Media.net**

Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.

Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net's US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.

**Role Snapshot:**

* **Location:**
  Mumbai (Andheri East), India; on-site or hybrid.
* **Shift:**
  US overlap, roughly 6 PM–3 AM IST, with flexibility for US payroll and onboarding peaks.
* **Experience:**
  4–7 years in Global HR Operations, with at least 2 years supporting US employees.
* **Works With:**
  US employees and managers, third-party payroll/PEO vendor, US benefits and 401(k) providers, India HR and Finance.

**About the role:**

This person is the single operational point of contact for our US employees, run from India. They own the US employee lifecycle end to end — onboarding, benefits and 401(k) changes, offboarding — and keep the third-party payroll vendor and our employees in sync.

The role executes and coordinates; it does not set US policy or give legal or tax advice. Compliance judgment sits with the payroll vendor and US counsel, and this person knows when to escalate to them.

This role will closely work with the CxOs and other POCs from the New York Office on day to day basis

**Key responsibilities:**

**US onboarding**

* Run new-hire onboarding for US employees: offer-to-day-one checklist, document collection, and system setup with the payroll vendor.
* Coordinate Form I-9 completion and E-Verify (where used) within federal timelines, plus W-4 and state tax forms.
* Enrol new hires in benefits and 401(k) within plan eligibility windows; run a first-week orientation on pay, benefits and policies.

**401(k) and benefits administration**

* Process 401(k) enrolments, contribution changes, and employer-match updates with the plan provider and payroll vendor.
* Reconcile payroll deductions against 401(k) remittances each pay cycle and flag mismatches before they become late deposits.
* Support open enrolment, qualifying life events, and annual plan communications.

**Offboarding**

* Run exits end to end: final pay on time per state rules, PTO payout, asset and access recovery, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate COBRA notices, 401(k) separation options, and benefit terminations with the vendor.

**HR policy**

* Maintain the US employee handbook and policies, keeping them aligned with federal and applicable state requirements.
* Track US law and benefit changes flagged by the vendor or counsel, and drive the resulting policy updates.
* Field policy questions and apply policy consistently.

**Payroll vendor liaison**

* Act as the primary contact for the third-party payroll/PEO vendor: submit inputs (new hires, changes, exits, bonuses) ahead of each cutoff.
* Review payroll registers before approval and resolve errors with the vendor.
* Track vendor SLAs and escalate recurring issues.

**Employee queries and coordination**

* Resolve US employee queries on pay, tax forms, benefits, 401(k) and leave, with a ticket or log for every query.
* Translate vendor responses into clear answers for employees, and employee issues into clear asks for the vendor.
* Keep employee records and HRIS data accurate and audit-ready.

**Must-have qualifications:**

* Graduate; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 4–7 years in HR operations, including at least 2 years directly supporting US employees (in-house, GCC, or a US-payroll/PEO outsourcing firm).
* Hands-on knowledge of US onboarding and exit mechanics: I-9, W-4, state new-hire reporting, final-pay rules, COBRA.
* Working knowledge of 401(k) administration: enrolment, deferral changes, employer match, and payroll-to-provider reconciliation.
* Experience managing a payroll or PEO vendor (e.g. ADP, Gusto, Rippling, Justworks, TriNet, Paychex) and reviewing payroll registers.
* Strong written English for employee-facing communication; comfortable on calls with US staff.
* Willing to work a sustained US-overlap shift.
* High discretion with confidential pay and personal data.

**Good-to-have:**

* SHRM-CP or HRCI (PHR/aPHR) certification.
* Exposure to multi-state US employment (e.g. California, New York) and state-specific leave rules.
* Experience with an HRIS such as Workday, BambooHR or Darwinbox, plus a ticketing tool for query tracking.
* Has written or updated an employee handbook.
* Advanced Excel for payroll and 401(k) reconciliations.

**Success in the First 6 Months:**

* **Payroll Timeliness:**
  Submit 100% of payroll inputs before the vendor cutoff for every pay cycle.
* **Payroll Accuracy:**
  Maintain zero repeat errors attributable to our inputs.
* **401(k) Reconciliation:**
  Reconcile deductions against remittances during every pay cycle, with all mismatches resolved within the same cycle.
* **I-9 Compliance:**
  Complete I-9 documentation for 100% of new hires within the federally mandated deadlines.
* **Final Pay Compliance:**
  Ensure 100% of employee exits receive final pay in accordance with applicable state laws.
* **Employee Query Management:**
  Acknowledge employee queries within 1 business day and resolve them within 5 business days.
* **US Employee Handbook:**
  Review and update the US employee handbook by the end of Month 6.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an energetic and proactive HR Intern to join our talent acquisition team. In this role, you will focus on top-of-funnel sourcing and candidate engagement aligned with specific profile targets. Unlike traditional desk-bound internships, you will have the freedom to source from anywhere, whether online or out in the field, including attending industry meetups, networking events and community gatherings to build strong talent pipelines.

**Job Requirements**

* Education & Background: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or possessing equivalent practical networking/outreach experience).
* Communication & Networking: Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the confidence to strike up conversations both online and in person.
* Target-Driven Mindset: Ability to work toward clear profile targets and sourcing milestones with self-discipline and ownership.
* Adaptability & Mobility: Comfortable working flexibly across locations, including traveling locally to attend meetups, events, and talent communities.
* Tech & Tool Familiarity: Basic comfort using sourcing channels, social platforms, spreadsheets, or recruiting trackers (prior experience with recruitment tools is a plus, not mandatory).

**Job Responsibilities**

* Targeted Sourcing: Identify and map passive and active candidates matching defined role personas, skill sets, and profile targets.
* Multi-Channel & Field Outreach: Source from anywhere using digital channels alongside real-world outreach such as attending tech/industry meetups, workshops and local events to spot and connect with promising talent.
* Candidate Engagement: Initiate warm, personalized outreach, follow up consistently, and nurture relationships so candidates stay excited about opportunities with our team.
* Pipeline Tracking: Maintain accurate records of sourced profiles, outreach touchpoints, event leads, and candidate interest levels.
* Market & Talent Insights: Attend in-person and share observations from your outreach and meetup interactions, such as candidate motivations, skill trends and effective engagement angles to help refine sourcing strategies.

title: Sr HCM Functional Consultant - Workday Success Plans
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Workday Success Plans Team are all about our customers and their post Go-Live journey - we create programs to help them drive business value from their Workday applications. The team is responsible for delivering a variety of programs and services to our customers ranging from feature demonstrations to full feature deployments.
  
  
At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and do good in the communities where we live and work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how-to questions, solve and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
  
  
Our team of experts have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment. So if you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and partnership to the Workday Success Plans team!
  
  
Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:
  
  

* Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts
* Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks
* Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements
* Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
* Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars)
* Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator)
* Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews)
* Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap
* Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics
* Helping drive the generation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption

In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:
  
  

* Office Hours to conduct appointment-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
* Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed result calling out opportunities for optimization
* Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
* Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
* Ability to travel up to 10%

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of IT implementation experience
* demonstrated ability with HR and/or Finance systems, including but not limited to Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP, Oracle, and/or JD Edwards
* 10+ years of software consulting experience

**Other Qualifications:**

* Workday Certification in HCM and at least one of the following is ideal: Talent, Recruiting, Absence, Payroll
* Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
* Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
* Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and results simultaneously
* Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Functional Consultant, you will translate business requirements into integrated solutions in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization, helping clients connect recruitment, development, and employee experience processes. Working with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders, you will apply strong Core HR knowledge to validate worker, assignment, organizational, and security dependencies. The role requires at least eight years of relevant HCM experience and participation in at least two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables. You will collaborate with technical teams on formulas, migration, integrations, reporting, and extensions; maintain clear solution documentation; and guide stakeholders through design decisions and delivery issues. You will also support quarterly update and Redwood impact assessments, mentor consultants, and serve as a functional team lead when required.
  
  
You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, recruitment, learning, and talent stakeholders to define practical functional solutions and explain design options and trade-offs.
* Design and configure Oracle Recruiting processes, where included in the selected modules, covering recruiting structures, requisitions, career sites, candidate applications and communications, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Configure Oracle Learning catalogs, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and completion tracking, where included in the selected modules, to support learner and administrator processes.
* Configure Goal Management, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, Talent Review, and Profile Management, where Oracle Talent Management is included in the selected modules, to meet agreed talent requirements.
* Configure Oracle ME capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk, where Oracle ME is included in the selected modules, according to the agreed scope, validating Core HR and security dependencies.
* Define functional requirements for Fast Formulas, data migration, integrations, reports, and extensions, working with technical teams to validate delivery.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials to support consistent implementation and adoption.
* Conduct functional testing, support system integration and user acceptance testing, resolve defects, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish solution readiness.
* Support data validation, cutover, go-live, and stabilization; assess quarterly update and Redwood impacts and support regression testing to maintain configured processes.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, issues, and design decisions to clients and project leadership; plan activities, mentor consultants, and lead the functional team when required.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* At least 8 years of relevant HCM domain and functional consulting experience.
* Participation in a minimum of two full end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations, with clear ownership of functional deliverables.
* Proven client-facing experience across requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and go-live.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on implementation and configuration expertise in a minimum of two of the following modules: Oracle Recruiting, Oracle Learning, Oracle Talent Management, and Oracle ME. The module-specific capabilities below apply to the selected modules.
* Oracle Recruiting: Recruiting structures, requisitions, candidate experience, selection processes, offers, and hiring handoffs.
* Oracle Learning: Learning content structures, courses, offerings, specializations, assignments, and learner and administrator processes.
* Oracle Talent Management: Goals, performance, career development, succession planning, talent reviews, and profile management.
* Oracle ME: Employee experience capabilities across Journeys, HCM Communicate, Grow, Touchpoints, Connections, Celebrate, and HR Help Desk.
* Strong foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion Core HR and the hire-to-retire lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Understanding of business processes, data flows, effective dating, approvals, and dependencies across the selected modules.
* Ability to independently resolve complex functional issues and explain solution options and trade-offs.
* Understanding of HCM security, including roles, data access, and appropriate handling of employee and candidate information.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Talent Management or Recruiting-related Fast Formulas.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

**Leadership**

* Ability to plan activities, mentor team members, monitor progress, and provide timely project updates.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with global or multi-country Oracle Fusion HCM implementations.
* Experience with HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, or BI Publisher from a functional requirements and validation perspective.
* Experience with Redwood adoption and relevant AI-enabled HCM capabilities.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting presales demonstrations, solution assessments, proposals, or estimates.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Sr. Associate- HR Operations
description:
**About The Role**
At HUFT, we believe that a good employee experience starts with getting the basics right. From onboarding to exit, every interaction and process contributes to how our people experience the organisation.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Associate – HR Operations who can take ownership of core HR processes, ensure smooth day-to-day execution and bring structure to the way we manage our people operations. The role will work across employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, HR data, employee engagement and performance processes, while also driving SOP implementation and continuous process improvement.
  
  
What You Will Be Responsible For
  
  

* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Manage employee documentation and processes across the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding to exit.
* Ensure timely preparation and issuance of offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, amendments and other employee-related documents.
* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure all documentation is complete and up to date.
* Coordinate onboarding formalities, employee movements, exits and full and final documentation.
* Ensure employee data and records are consistently maintained across HRMS and internal trackers.
* HR Data Management & MIS
* Maintain and regularly update employee data across HRMS and internal trackers.
* Track key people metrics including headcount, attrition, onboarding, exits, employee movements, bonuses and other HR data points.
* Prepare and publish periodic HR reports and dashboards for weekly, monthly and bi-monthly reviews.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and timely reporting.
* Analyse people data to identify trends, discrepancies and areas that need attention.
* Payroll & Attendance Management
* Manage monthly attendance and leave data consolidation and validation.
* Coordinate with business teams and the payroll team to ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs.
* Track employee additions, exits, salary revisions, incentives, bonuses and other payroll-related changes.
* Coordinate attendance regularisation and resolve payroll-related discrepancies.
* Ensure payroll inputs are shared within defined timelines and are thoroughly validated before processing.
* Employee Queries & Grievance Management
* Act as a point of contact for employees on queries related to HR policies, leave, attendance, payroll and documentation.
* Address employee concerns and grievances with sensitivity, confidentiality and a solution-oriented approach.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and closure.
* Ensure recurring employee concerns are identified and addressed through appropriate process improvements.
* Performance Management
* Coordinate the end-to-end performance appraisal process, including communication, timelines, data collation and follow-ups.
* Work with managers and business teams to ensure timely completion of appraisal cycles.
* Maintain performance records and coordinate documentation of appraisal outcomes, salary revisions and related changes.
* SOP Development & Process Implementation
* Work closely with HR and business teams to ensure processes are understood and followed across functions and locations.
* Identify gaps in existing processes, simplify workflows and drive improvements in operational efficiency.
* Establish process checks and timelines to ensure adherence to defined HR practices.
* Regularly review and update SOPs as the organisation evolves and its operational needs change.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4–6 years of experience in HR Operations / HR Generalist roles, preferably in a fast-paced retail, D2C or consumer-facing organisation.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and core HR processes.
* Hands-on experience in payroll coordination, attendance management and HR data management.
* Experience in managing performance appraisal cycles and employee queries.

title: Manager – P&C Operations
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Manager – P&C Operations will oversee payroll governance, employment-related statutory compliance, HR data integrity and operational controls. The role is accountable for accurate and timely payroll processing, regulatory adherence, audit readiness and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The role will partner with the P&C Operations Lead, Finance, Legal and other stakeholders to maintain efficient, well-controlled and compliant operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Payroll Management
  
  

* Own the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle, ensuring timely completion and effective coordination across internal teams and service providers.
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of salaries and other payroll components.
* Validate payroll inputs, reconciliations and exceptions—including employee lifecycle changes, attendance, leave, overtime, unpaid absence and variable payments—before payroll closure.
* Ensure appropriate maker-checker controls throughout the payroll process.
* Coordinate timely Full & Final settlements for separated employees.
* Review payroll reports and ensure payroll records and supporting documentation are maintained appropriately.

Statutory & Labour Compliance
  
  

* Ensure payroll and P&C operations (like working hours, overtime, leave, holidays and other employment conditions etc.) comply with applicable employment laws, statutory requirements and filing obligations.
* Monitor regulatory developments, assess their impact on payroll, policies and processes, and coordinate required changes with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure the maintenance of appropriate statutory registers and records.
* Support establishment-related registrations, renewals and compliance requirements, as applicable.

Governance, Controls & Audit
  
  

* Establish and maintain strong internal controls across payroll and compliance processes.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify compliance gaps.
* Maintain payroll and compliance SOPs, checklists and process documentation.
* Serve as the P&C point of contact for internal, external and statutory audits, coordinating responses and timely closure of observations.
* Maintain an audit-ready repository of payroll and compliance documentation.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention and strengthen process controls.

HR Systems, Data and Analytics
  
  

* Maintain accurate employee and payroll data across HRIS with appropriate confidentiality and access controls, attendance and payroll systems; review payroll-impacting configurations; and monitor payroll accuracy, exceptions and trends to support timely corrective action.
* Provide concise governance reporting on data quality, system exceptions and key payroll-impacting trends.
* Drive automation and process improvements across HR systems and data processes to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders on payroll and compliance matters.
* Manage relationships with payroll vendors, consultants and statutory service providers.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on payroll-related policies and processes.
* Escalate significant compliance risks, control failures or recurring process issues.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian payroll operations, statutory compliance, employee lifecycle processes, and related controls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail when handling sensitive employee and payroll information.
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management capabilities.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into operational processes.
* Strong Excel and HRIS/payroll system capabilities. Prior Workday experience is preferred.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and consistently meet critical monthly deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant HR and payroll experience, including substantial responsibility for payroll, statutory compliance, HR systems, and employee lifecycle operations.
* Experience independently managing end-to-end payroll processes is preferred.
* Prior experience handling statutory, internal, and external audits is desirable.
* Experience working with HRIS/payroll platforms and payroll service providers is preferred.

title: HR Business Partner (HRBP) & Talent Specialist
description:
**Job Description: HR Business Partner (HRBP) & Talent Specialist**

**Department:** Human Resources

**Reports To:** Head of HR / Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a versatile and dynamic **HR Business Partner (HRBP)** to drive our talent lifecycle. In this role, your time will be strategically divided between **Talent Acquisition (40%)** and **Talent Management & HRBP operations (60%)**. You will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, aligning HR strategies with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will manage the end-to-end recruitment funnel for critical roles while simultaneously championing our **Performance Management System (PMS)**, designing vibrant **employee engagement programs**, and overseeing day-to-day **HR Operations**.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Talent Management & HRBP Functions (60%)**

**Performance Management System (PMS)**

* the annual and mid-year performance appraisal cycles.
* **Train managers and employees** on setting SMART goals and conducting effective evaluation conversations.
* **Manage Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs)** for underperforming employees to support their growth.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* **Conceptualize and implement** employee engagement calendars to foster a positive, high-performing culture.
* **Conduct regular stay/exit interviews** and pulse surveys to analyze organizational health and retention trends.
* **Design reward and recognition (R&R)** programs that align with company values and motivate teams.

**HR Business Partnering (HRBP)**

* **Partner with department heads** to understand business goals and provide strategic HR guidance.
* **Resolve complex employee relations issues** through objective investigations and fair conflict resolution.
* **Identify skill gaps** and work with leadership to recommend learning and development (L&D) interventions.

**HR Operations**

**Oversee seamless onboarding** and orientation frameworks for new hires to ensure a strong first impression.

* **Manage employee offboarding, including exit clearances, documentation, final settlements, HRIS record updates, and compliance with applicable labour laws.**

**Talent Acquisition (40%)**

**Full-Cycle Recruitment**

* **Own the end-to-end hiring process** for assigned technical, non-technical, and leadership mandates.
* **Partner with hiring managers** to scope roles, write compelling job profiles, and align on ideal candidate personas.
* **Source passive talent** using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and employee referral channels.

**Employer Branding & Candidate Experience**

* **Ensure an elite candidate experience** at every touchpoint of the recruitment funnel.
* **Promote the company's employer brand** across digital platforms, careers pages, and industry events.
* **Track key recruitment metrics** including Time-to-Hire, Cost-per-Hire, and Quality-of-Hire to optimize processes.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master’s degree or MBA in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* **Experience:** **3 to 6 years** of experience in an HR role, with proven exposure to both full-lifecycle recruiting and core HRBP functions.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* **Tech-Savviness:** Proficient in Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, HRIS/ATS platforms, job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other digital recruitment tools used for candidate sourcing, tracking, reporting, and recruitment coordination**.**

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Category Management - Health Insurance
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a driven, analytical, and relationship-focused
**Manager**
to own end-to-end account management for our key Health Insurance partners. In this role, you will act as the strategic bridge between our organization and partner insurers. You will be responsible for line-of-business (LOB) growth, product/plan integrations, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) delivery, day-to-day operations, and partner account profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account & Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned health insurance partners.
* Build and nurture strong relationships with insurer teams across underwriting, product, operations, technology, and claims.
* Conduct regular performance reviews (Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews) with insurer leadership to track targets and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* AOP Strategy & Business Growth
* Own the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for the assigned health insurance accounts, driving revenue targets and product mix strategies.
* Analyze sales trends, conversion funnels, and customer personas to identify new growth opportunities within health insurance.
* Work with cross-functional teams (Growth, Marketing, Operations) to run targeted campaigns and drive premium volumes.
* Product Integration & Plan Management
* Drive end-to-end onboarding and integration of new health insurance products and plan variants onto the platform.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure seamless API integrations, user journeys, policy issue workflows, and UI/UX flows.
* Regularly audit live insurance products for feature accuracy, pricing precision, and regulatory/underwriting updates.
* Account Profitability & Portfolio Management
* Monitor and manage unit economics, commission structures, loss ratios, and partner margins to ensure account profitability.
* Analyze portfolio performance across parameters like persistency, renewal rates, claim settlement rates, and ticket sizes.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payouts, and exclusive product offerings with insurance partners alongside senior management.
* Operational Excellence & Support
* Oversee day-to-day operational workflows, including policy issuance, endorsements, cancellation requests, and claim escalations.
* Streamline operations between partner underwriters and internal operations to minimize drop-offs and improve turn-around times (TAT).
* Ensure strict adherence to IRDAI (or local regulatory authority) guidelines, compliance standards, and internal risk policies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue & Volume: Achievement of Monthly/Quarterly/Annual AOP targets for assigned insurer accounts.
* Account Profitability: Margins, commission compliance, and portfolio loss ratio targets.
* Product Efficiency: On-time product integration, zero feature/pricing discrepancies, and optimized conversion funnels.
* Operational SLA: Turn-around time (TAT) for policy issuance, endorsement resolution, and claim escalations.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Commerce, or related fields (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in insurance operations, account management, or category management in an Insurtech, Broker, Web Aggregator, or Health Insurance company.
* Domain Expertise: Thorough practical knowledge of Health Insurance operations, medical underwriting processes, MER workflows, endorsement rules, and claims processing (Cashless & Reimbursement).
* Technical & Data Skills: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, or reporting tools (Tableau/PowerBI) to track daily issuance metrics, funnel drops, and operational dashboards.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Strong execution ability, detail-oriented mindset, and effective negotiation skills when liaising with insurer operations desks.

This role will identify process improvement opportunities, eliminate waste and variability, establish performance measures, and deliver cross-functional projects that strengthen end-to-end operational outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate is a strategic, data-driven operations leader with strong project management discipline. **Performance Management & Analytics**

* Define, track, and improve operational KPIs related to productivity, cycle time, quality, cost, service levels, compliance, and capacity.
* Build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into performance, improvement opportunities, and project outcomes.
* Use data and business insights to diagnose performance issues, make recommendations, and quantify the value delivered through improvement initiatives.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with stakeholders and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Partner with Private Brands, LGS, PDMs, Category Managers, and other cross-functional teams to improve end-to-end business processes.
* Influence stakeholders at multiple levels through clear communication, structured problem-solving, and a strong focus on business outcomes.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to build capability in operational excellence, project execution, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning.

* Graduate (in any discipline)

****Required****

* 5+ years of leadership experience
* Experience in retail, merchandising, Private Brands, product development, packaging, print production, creative operations, or studio management.
* Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, or other relevant process-improvement/project-management certification.

title: Senior Manager -Publications Delivery Lead - Scientific Publications(GBS BBU)
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Publications Delivery Lead - Scientific Publications(GBS BBU)
  
  
Career Level: E
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build and lead a world-class publications capability that elevates scientific communication and accelerates impact for patients and clinicians? Do you thrive on creating structure, scaling teams, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-moving, global environment?
  
  
As the Publications Delivery Lead, you will establish and run a multi-tier Publications Delivery team encompassing content authors, visual designers, and iEnvision specialists. You will blend people leadership with operational excellence to deliver end-to-end publications that are on time, scientifically accurate, and aligned with global standards and policy. Your work will connect directly to how our evidence is delivered to the scientific community and informs better decisions. It will also involve crafting how we operate at scale across therapy areas and publication types.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Team Build-Out and Leadership: Establish and scale a high-performing publications delivery organization; define roles, levels, and career pathways that attract and retain top talent.
* Mentoring and Capability Development: Provide structured mentorship and feedback to publication writers, graphic artists, and iEnvision experts; improve scientific rigor, storytelling, and visual communication.
* Performance and Workforce Planning: Set clear goals, run regular check-ins, manage performance, and recognize excellence; forecast demand, plan capacity, and lead recruitment, onboarding, and succession to match portfolio needs.
* Delivery Excellence: Oversee end-to-end planning, drafting, review cycles, approvals, and finalization of publications to meet timelines and quality standards; drive first-time-right delivery and reduce cycle times.
* Ways of Working and SOPs: Design and implement SOPs, RACI matrices, workflows, and operating models across therapy areas and publication types to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify bottlenecks and lead Lean/Kaizen initiatives; standardize guidelines across teams to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Metrics and Quality Management: Define and track SLAs, important metrics, and objectives and key results, including timely delivery, first-time-right quality, cycle-time, rework rates, and collaborator happiness; implement robust QA/QC processes, editorial standards, and audit readiness; ensure compliance with GPP or equivalent experience and internal policies.
* Risk and Issue Management: Proactively identify risks, maintain RAID logs, and drive timely mitigations and resolution of critical issues to protect delivery and quality.
* Collaborator Partnerships and Governance: Build positive relationships with BBU publication teams and external partners; run structured demand intake, triage, resourcing, and scheduling; lead stand-ups, iteration reviews, routine oversight meetings, and QBRs; publish dashboards and present performance to leadership.
* Serve as the trusted advisor for publication-related queries. Provide high-impact review and mentorship to Expert and Senior Publication Writers. Resolve conflicting author comments and changing collaborator needs through clear facilitation and alignment.
* Standards and Compliance: Align with GPP, ICMJE, CONSORT/PRISMA where applicable, and medical-legal-regulatory requirements; advocate appropriate use of EQUATOR Network guidelines.
* Tools, Technology, and Documentation: Champion publication management platforms, digital archives, citation tools, cooperative software, and workflow trackers; build and maintain templates, checklists, SOPs, and training materials; explore AI opportunities to improve efficiency; develop automated dashboards and run monthly business reviews that deliver actionable insights.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or related field.
* Experience: 08-12 years in the field of medical writing and publications, including 3+ years in people management and operations leadership.
* Proven track record: Setting up new teams/functions in GCCs or service agencies, implementing SOPs, critical metrics, and delivery governance.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of GPP, ICMJE, CONSORT/PRISMA, ethical authorship, data standards, and journal/congress processes.
* Operational excellence: Demonstrated ability to run large-scale delivery with metrics, QA, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborator management: Experience collaborating with global cross-functional groups and outside agencies; strong communication and influence skills.
* Global experience: Working across time zones and cultures; experience in global capability centres or offshore/nearshore models.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* PhD/MD/PharmD/MSc.
* ISMPP CMPP Certification.
* Hands-on experience with publication management tools, content repositories, reference managers, collaboration suites, iEnvision, and solutions for overseeing workflow progress.
* Experience creating and maintaining templates, checklists, SOPs, and training materials for scalable operations.
* Familiarity with Lean, Kaizen, and standardization methods in publication operations.
* Awareness of AI potential in medical publications and identification of efficiency/savings opportunities.
* Experience building automated dashboards and leading monthly business reviews to inform decision-making.
* Background in scientific visualization or publication graphics programs.
* Exposure to agile governance forums such as sprint reviews, monthly governance calls, and QBRs.

**Why AstraZeneca**
Join a company where your leadership will tangibly shape how our science is shared with the world. You will work with diverse experts who bring bold ideas to life by getting the right people in the same room to spark progress, combining autonomy with strong support and feedback. We move quickly and thoughtfully, embracing intelligent risks and digital innovation to improve how evidence is created and communicated. You will benefit from a collaborative, globally connected network that values curiosity and kindness alongside ambition, with in-person collaboration several days a week to build momentum while respecting flexibility. Your impact will reach beyond operations—accelerating the delivery of trusted science that ultimately serves patients.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Lead the build of a scalable publications engine with real-world impact—submit your application and shape how our evidence reaches clinicians and patients worldwide.

title: AGM-Design
description:
**AGM – Designs (Operations)**

Decorpot is a Series B-funded, vertically integrated home interiors and modular furniture company with 38+ Experience Centres across 25+ Indian cities. We are hiring an AGM – Designs to run the operations backbone of a large, distributed, highthroughput design function — team management, client experience, data discipline, productivity, and attrition control.

This is an operations leadership role, not a creative role. Candidates from a pure design / architecture background are not the fit — we are specifically looking for a strong operations leader who can run a large team at scale

* Reports to - Associate Director – Design
* Team size-50–100+ (direct + matrix) across multiple cities and Experience Centres
* Travel -Regular travel to Experience Centres across operating cities (mandatory)
* Type -Full-time, on-roll

**What You'll Own**

• Run the design function like an operations shop — SLAs, throughput, capacity, quality, and cost per project — measurable, visible, and reviewed weekly.

• Own end-to-end management of a 50–100+ member distributed workforce spread across cities and Experience Centres — hiring, onboarding, allocation, workload balancing, performance.

• Own the client experience — proactive project tracking, communication cadence, escalation handling, and closure. Seniormost escalation point for the function on any customer issue.

• Own the productivity dashboard — designer productivity, project timelines, revisions, drop-offs, revenue per designer, EClevel scorecards. Turn a large volume of operating data into weekly decisions.

• Own attrition — build the levers (career growth, incentives, recognition, workload sanity, manager quality) that pull the number down and hold it there.

• Own team motivation and culture — daily rhythm, city visits, town halls, recognition, and a healthy, high-performance environment.

• Partner with Sales, Operations, Factory, and Finance to drive project-level margin, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction.

• Enforce process discipline — briefs, sign-offs, approvals, revisions, and the paper trail that keeps large projects from going off the rails.

**What We're Looking For**

• 10–15 years of operations leadership experience, with at least 4–5 years running a team of 50–100+ people.

• Not from a design or architecture background. We want a career operator — someone who has scaled and stabilised large teams and delivered on tough operating metrics.

• Strong preference for candidates from: large retail chains, BPO / customer operations, ed-tech delivery, telecom / DTH field ops, banking / insurance sales ops, consumer services (Urban Company / equivalent), consulting delivery, hospitality, aviation ground ops, or high-volume services businesses. Interiors ops backgrounds (Livspace / HomeLane / Sleek) welcome, but only in a pure operations mandate.

• Track record of managing a distributed workforce across multiple cities — with the travel and field discipline that comes with it.

• Data-fluent — comfortable running weekly reviews off dashboards, cutting operating data, building trackers, and driving decisions from numbers.

• Sharp client communication skills — verbal, written, and on-call. Poised under pressure; strong at de-escalating angry customers and rebuilding trust.

• Proven track record of attrition management in high-churn environments; demonstrated ability to build engaged, motivated teams.

• Process discipline, ownership, low ego, high pace. Go-getter who runs at problems, not away from them. • MBA preferred; strong operators without an MBA will be considered on the strength of their track record. • Open to any gender; willing to travel is mandatory.

title: Manager, Mortgage Funding
description:
**About The Team**
The Funding team ensures loans are funded accurately, securely, and on time after closing. The team validates executed closing documentation, coordinates with settlement agents and warehouse banks, initiates and approves wire activity under established controls, and supports a seamless closing experience for borrowers.
  
  
As Manager, Mortgage Funding, you will lead a team of Funding Coordinators responsible for the final funding stage of the mortgage process. You will own funding pipeline performance, quality, wire-control execution, and team development while partnering across Closing, Post-Closing, and external settlement and warehouse partners to minimize funding delays and risk.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead, coach, and develop Funding Coordinators; set clear expectations for accuracy, urgency, compliance, and customer and partner service.
* Own daily funding operations, including queue prioritization, workload distribution, capacity planning, approval coverage, escalations, and funding cut-off management.
* Oversee the review of executed closing packages and Encompass data to confirm documents, terms, conditions, and disbursement information are complete and accurate before funding.
* Ensure wires are initiated, reviewed, approved, and released in accordance with established authorization controls, security procedures, and settlement instructions.
* Manage critical funding exceptions, including missing or defective closing documents, disbursement discrepancies, settlement-agent questions, wire holds, and warehouse-bank issues.
* Partner with Closing, Loan Officers, Processors, Underwriting, Post-Closing, settlement agents, and warehouse banks to resolve blockers and enable on-time funding.

* Monitor production, funding turn time, cut-off adherence, quality, rework, wire exceptions, and escalation trends; use data to improve team performance.
* Own team onboarding, SOPs, job aids, quality calibration, training, and policy/process change communication.
* Drive operational improvements that reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve funding accuracy and borrower outcomes.
* Ensure strict adherence to ZHL policies, privacy and information-security controls, applicable mortgage requirements, and fraud-prevention practices.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5+ years of U.S. residential mortgage experience in funding, closing, post-closing, warehouse lending, or a related operations function, including 2+ years of people leadership or team-lead experience.
* Strong knowledge of mortgage funding workflows, executed closing documents, settlement disbursement, wire controls, and warehouse-bank interactions.
* Experience with Encompass or a comparable loan origination system; familiarity with MERS and settlement or wire platforms preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive operations through quality, productivity, turnaround-time, and control metrics.
* Proven judgment in managing financial and operational risk, escalating issues, and maintaining strong control discipline.
* Excellent coaching, communication, stakeholder-management, analytical, and continuous-improvement skills.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

description:

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Senior Project Manager – AI Delivery** 
 , you will own large\-scale, complex AI implementation programs for enterprise customers. You will be the driving force behind flawless execution of LLM\-powered chatbots, voicebots, and conversational AI solutions—turning ambitious CX transformations into measurable business impact.
   

  

**What will you do in this role?**
* Take complete ownership of end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact AI and SaaS implementation programs—from kickoff to go\-live and beyond.
* Lead enterprise deployments of LLM\-based chatbots, voicebots, and conversational AI solutions.
* Act as the primary customer\-facing leader, driving strategic discussions, managing expectations, and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Translate business requirements into structured delivery roadmaps in collaboration with product, engineering, QA, and AI teams.
* Mentor and guide project managers and delivery teams to ensure execution excellence.
* Run Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily scrums, and retrospectives.
* Track execution across tools like Jira, Asana, MS Project, or similar platforms.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks, escalating critical issues when required.
* Drive Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews (WBRs/MBRs) with senior stakeholders and CXOs.
* Ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery while driving adoption and long\-term success of AI implementations.


**What does success look like?**
* Enterprise AI programs delivered on time, within scope, and at high quality.
* Strong, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* Measurable business outcomes driven by scalable AI and automation.
* A high\-performing delivery team culture built on ownership and accountability.


**What would make you a good fit?**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management.
* Minimum 3\+ years in a senior or team\-handling role.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise\-scale, customer\-facing SaaS or AI implementations.
* Strong exposure to AI/LLM\-based solutions such as chatbots, voicebots, or automation platforms.
* Experience working in fast\-paced SaaS or AI\-first organizations.
* Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders and leading business reviews.


**Most Critical Skills For This Role**
* Strong stakeholder communication and executive presence.
* Expertise in scope management, planning, tracking, and delivery governance.
* Hands\-on understanding of LLM tools and AI platforms used in live projects.
* Risk identification and structured problem\-solving under pressure.
* Ability to scale and mentor high\-performing project teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple enterprise programs simultaneously.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* Have delivered AI\-led CX, CRM, or automation\-focused enterprise platforms.
* Are comfortable running strategic reviews with CXOs and leadership teams.
* Bring exposure to pre\-sales, solution design, or product collaboration in AI environments.


**Location \& Work Model**
 This is a Bangalore\-based role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person collaboration fuels innovation and agility.
   

  

**Why should you be interested?**
* Ownership of mission\-critical enterprise CX transformation programs.
* Direct exposure to global customers and complex AI\-driven implementations.
* Leadership visibility and the opportunity to shape delivery excellence at scale.
* A fast\-growing SaaS environment where your impact is tangible and valued.


 If you’re excited to lead enterprise AI programs and drive real\-world impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Associate Director, GCC Strategy & Operations
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Management

**General Summary:**

**Role Overview**

Qualcomm is seeking an experienced business and technology leader to lead GCC Strategy & Operations within Office of the GCC Leader. Reporting to the Vice President and GCC Leader, this individual will translate enterprise and Global IT priorities into an integrated GCC operating plan and establish the management system required to execute it.

The role owns the GCC-wide strategy-to-execution rhythm across portfolio governance, finance, workforce, capability planning, operating-model transformation, AI-enabled productivity and executive business reviews. The individual will create transparency, frame critical decisions and drive accountability across a complex global matrix.

The position is designed for an enterprise-minded leader with the judgment, executive presence and execution discipline to translate strategy into measurable outcomes.

**Key outcomes**

* Translate enterprise and Global IT priorities into a focused GCC portfolio with clear owners, milestones, investments, risks and measurable value.

* Create an integrated view of GCC performance across delivery, finance, workforce, productivity, talent, risk and stakeholder outcomes.

* Partner across teams to accelerate the GCC’s transition toward an AI-first operating model by embedding AI, automation and process redesign into core workflows and tracking measurable productivity, quality and experience outcomes.
* Improve the quality and speed of executive decisions by surfacing trade-offs, dependencies and issues early.

* Build scalable operating practices that support GCC growth, capability ownership and enterprise value creation.

* Build high-performing GRC and service-resilience capabilities that deliver against global functional priorities.
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Portfolio Execution**

* Partner with the GCC Leader and Global IT Leadership Team to translate enterprise and IT priorities into the GCC strategy, annual operating plan and multi-year roadmap.
* Lead integrated planning across capabilities, workforce, locations, sourcing, technology, investments and organizational dependencies.
* Develop robust business cases for new capabilities, functions and service offerings, including costs, benefits, risks, talent requirements and implementation scenarios.
* Maintain a portfolio-level view of strategic initiatives, interdependencies, risks, decisions and value realization.
* Drive selected cross-functional initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness, productivity and business value.
  

**GCC management system and executive governance**

* Own and continuously improve the GCC operating rhythm, including monthly business reviews, quarterly strategy reviews, investment governance and annual planning.
* Own the GCC executive scorecard and ensure consistent definitions, reliable data, clear commentary and actionable insights.
* Convert leadership decisions into named owners, milestones, closure criteria and disciplined follow-through.
* Prepare executive narratives, presentations, decision papers and leadership updates for senior stakeholders.
* Surface delivery, financial, workforce, talent and risk issues requiring leadership intervention, with clear options and recommendations.
* Coordinate priorities across GCC and Global IT leadership without displacing the accountability of functional leaders.
  

**Financial, workforce and business operations**

* Own the integrated GCC budget, forecast, headcount, capacity, sourcing and location-planning processes in partnership with Finance, HR, Procurement and functional leaders.

* Drive financial discipline and transparency through integrated views of investment, operating expense, unit cost, utilization, productivity and value realization.

* Develop scenario models for growth, insourcing, managed services, capability transitions and organizational changes.

* Benchmark costs, operating practices and service performance against relevant GCC, GBS and enterprise technology peers.

* Identify opportunities to improve resource deployment, vendor value, demand management and operating efficiency.
  

**Operating-model transformation and AI-enabled productivity**

* Lead initiatives that simplify governance, standardize processes, eliminate low-value work and improve service quality and employee experience.
* Build and govern a pipeline of AI, automation and process-redesign opportunities across GCC operations.
* Prioritize use cases based on strategic value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, adoption requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Track realized benefits, including capacity released, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, risk reduction and stakeholder experience.
* Support the evolution of the GCC from delivery capacity toward enterprise capability ownership and measurable business value.
  

**Global collaboration and stakeholder leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across IT, business, HR, Finance, Procurement and corporate functions.

* Influence decisions and align stakeholders across global teams, functions and reporting lines without relying solely on direct authority.

* Partner with global business-operations leaders to create consistent governance while accommodating legitimate functional differences.

* Recommend improvements to policies, standards, operating practices and governance frameworks.

* Represent the GCC in relevant enterprise forums and external partner engagements.
  

**GRC and service-resilience operations**

* Partner with global functional owners to agree service expectations, capacity plans, operating metrics, talent requirements and escalation paths for the GCC-based teams.

* Provide people leadership and operational oversight for designated GCC-based teams supporting IT GRC, IT audit readiness, controls governance, business continuity, disaster recovery and service resilience.

* Escalate aged risks, control gaps and missed commitments with clear recovery actions and accountable owners.

* Build domain capability, engagement, succession depth and leadership coverage across the assigned teams.
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* 12-15 years of experience in enterprise technology, GCC/GBS, strategy and operations, transformation, business management, governance or related discipline.

* At least 3–5 years leading an enterprise strategy, transformation, portfolio-governance or business-operations function, with direct accountability for executive governance, financial or workforce planning, and measurable business outcomes.

* Demonstrated ownership of budgets, workforce plans, investment portfolios or enterprise-wide planning processes.
* Proven ability to convert executive priorities into governed programs, measurable outcomes and sustained operating practices.
* Experience leading teams directly and influencing Vice President-level or equivalent stakeholders in a global matrix.
* Strong financial acumen, analytical judgment, executive communication and decision-framing skills.

* Sound grasp of IT controls, audit and compliance, service management, business continuity and operational resilience.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a Global Capability Centre, Global Business Services organization, shared-services environment or global enterprise technology organization.
* Prior experience in Chief of Staff, strategy, business operations, transformation, governance or portfolio-leadership role.
* Experience leading or supporting IT GRC, internal audit, controls, business continuity, disaster recovery or operational-resilience programs.
* Working knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST, SOX controls, business continuity and operational-resilience principles; relevant certifications are beneficial but not required.
* Experience in sourcing strategy, vendor governance, partner management and service-cost optimization.
* Practical experience governing AI-enabled productivity, automation, workforce transformation or operating-model modernization initiatives.

* Experience operating across multiple geographies and time zones, ideally including India and the Americas.

* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of IT-related work experience with a Bachelor's degree.

OR
  
10+ years of IT-related work experience without a Bachelor’s degree.
  
  

* 5+ years of supervisory or leadership experience.

title: Director, Master Data Management – Operations
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE Lead enterprise Master Data Management delivery and operations under the guidance of the Corporate Chief Data Officer (CDO). Support CDO-led strategy with expertise and recommendations, and translate approved priorities into trusted, resilient, product-led data services. Partner across business and technology to deliver agreed standards, controls and transformation, with accountability for service performance, data quality and global team capability. Escalate strategic decisions and material trade-offs to the CDO.**

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**
=============================================

**Strategy support, delivery leadership and product-led MDM**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Developing enterprise MDM strategy and the target operating model by providing domain expertise, operational insight and recommendations across Customer, Product and emerging master-data domains; deliver the approved roadmap.

* Translate CDO-led strategy and agreed enterprise priorities into sequenced delivery plans, resource proposals and clear operational accountabilities; seek approval for investment choices and material changes in direction.

* Deliver the agreed shift from fragmented practices to data-as-a-product and a scalable enterprise utility, balancing transformation pace with service stability and control under the CDO’s guidance.

**Governance, risk and control**
--------------------------------

* Implement CDO-approved data ownership, stewardship, policies, standards and controls across the MDM lifecycle; work with partners to embed agreed requirements into products, operations, programmes and governance forums.

* Manage MDM data risks, incidents, policy conformance and assigned audit or regulatory actions within delegated authority; escalate material matters to the CDO and relevant control owners, and deliver evidenced remediation and sustainable closure.

* Maintain operational resilience through tested continuity, recovery, service-dependency and control arrangements, supported by transparent executive reporting.

**Operational excellence and customer outcomes**
------------------------------------------------

* **Lead the global MDM operations leadership team to deliver resilient Customer, Product and related enterprise master-data services, in line with the direction and priorities agreed with the CDO.**

* Agree MDM service, quality, cost, risk, capacity and customer-outcome measures with the CDO and relevant partners; manage performance against approved targets and recommend improvements to run costs and service value.

* Standardise, simplify and automate end-to-end processes to improve first-time-right accuracy, cycle time, scalability and customer experience; lead incident and problem management to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence.

**Data quality and stewardship**
--------------------------------

* Implement the CDO-led enterprise data-quality approach within MDM, including prevention, monitoring, issue management and remediation, using agreed outcome-based thresholds and dashboards.

* Support business stewardship and accountability, promote adoption and reuse of authoritative data, and act as the MDM operational escalation point, referring material data risks and cross-enterprise decisions to the CDO and relevant owners.

**Transformation, technology and digital enablement**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Support the CDO’s executive sponsorship of MDM platforms, domain onboarding, integrations, migrations, acquisitions and end-of-life transitions; provide subject-matter expertise and lead assigned operational delivery.

* Define MDM operational requirements and recommend acceptance criteria within agreed product and technology governance; manage service introduction, release readiness, support models, documentation and knowledge transfer.

* **Use approved technology, automation and advanced analytics to address high-value MDM challenges, improving data quality, controls, decision support and productivity while maintaining security, governance and clear human accountability.**

  

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities (continued)**
=========================================================

**Enterprise partnership and commercial leadership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Work with Operations, Product, Content, Digital Rights Management, Technology, Engineering, Architecture, Finance, Risk, Data Governance and transformation leaders to coordinate delivery of agreed MDM outcomes; escalate unresolved dependencies and material trade-offs to the CDO.

* Provide recommendations and operational evidence to inform the CDO’s enterprise strategy, policy, operating-model and investment decisions; report clearly on MDM performance, value, risk and delivery.

* Manage approved MDM resources, suppliers, budgets and capacity within delegated authority; recommend investment and cost improvements, and deliver agreed transitions of scope, process and people with appropriate approvals.

**People and capability leadership**
------------------------------------

* Lead through MDM team leaders by translating CDO-led direction into clear delivery outcomes, decision rights and accountability; build leadership depth through coaching, performance management and specialist development.

* Hold leaders accountable for building inclusive, high-performing teams grounded in trust, partnership, excellence and change, where colleagues speak up, learn from evidence and improve the system.

  

**Leadership Expectations – Raise the Bar**
===========================================

**Behaviour**

**Director expectation**

**Influence & impact**

Builds stakeholder alignment for agreed MDM priorities, supports the CDO with evidence and recommendations, and delivers measurable service and customer outcomes.

**Strategic intelligence**

Understands CDO-led strategy, customer needs, product direction and risk; translates these into practical MDM delivery plans and recommendations for prioritisation.

**Speak up**

Surfaces material risks, weak assumptions and difficult trade-offs early to the CDO and relevant leaders; builds a speak-up culture within the MDM team.

**Learning agility**

Uses incidents, audits, migrations and external practice to improve MDM delivery, recommend adjustments to the CDO and prevent repeated failure.

**Technology & data mindset**

Enables responsible use of trusted evidence, approved technology, automation and analytics to improve prevention, decision quality, productivity and scale.

**Collaborative, product-led customer focus**

Organises work around shared products and end-to-end outcomes, clarifies ownership and keeps customer impact visible in decisions.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* **Extensive leadership experience in enterprise master data management, data governance and data or product operations, leading multiple teams across locations and translating senior data-leadership direction into effective delivery.**

* Strong knowledge of data strategy, quality, governance, controls, operating models and enabling technology, with experience supporting strategy development and implementing approved direction through service operations, resilience, incident/problem management and release readiness.

* Proven delivery of complex platform, integration, migration and transformation initiatives with measurable adoption, customer, control or business-value outcomes.

* Strong commercial, operational and risk judgement in managing approved resources, suppliers, budgets and competing priorities; clear executive communication, stakeholder influencing and sound judgement on when to seek CDO guidance or approval.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

* Resilient services: achievement of availability, reliability, capacity, incident recovery and change-success targets, with fewer repeat failures.

* Trusted data: improvement against agreed critical data-quality, ownership and governance targets within MDM, with fewer recurring defects and overdue issues.

* Adoption and value: delivery of CDO-approved MDM roadmap milestones, increased reuse of authoritative data and agreed value outcomes from programmes, migrations and domain onboarding.

* Efficiency and control: reduced manual intervention, reconciliations and duplicate work; improved control-testing, policy conformance and closure of audit or risk actions.
