title: Facility Manager
description:
* **Company Overview**

Whitelane Holdings Limited operates in the entertainment and leisure industry, with business interests spanning family entertainment, adventure experiences, social gaming, and entertainment destinations. The organisation is committed to delivering engaging customer experiences while maintaining operational excellence and sustainable business practices.

Whitelane Group also operates in the F&B industry, sports facilities, and kitchen equipment trading across India and the UAE, and is expanding its base in the USA and Saudi Arabia.

* **Role Overview**

The Facility Manager – Games will be responsible for the maintenance, safety, functionality, and operational readiness of gaming facilities, including indoor games, arcade machines, outdoor attractions, go-karting, and golf facilities. The role involves overseeing preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, vendor coordination, safety compliance, and technical teams to ensure smooth operations, minimal downtime, and a safe guest experience.

* **Job Description**

* **Key Responsibilities**

* **Facility & Equipment Management**
* Oversee the upkeep and operational readiness of gaming facilities, equipment, machinery, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure regular inspections, preventive maintenance, timely repairs, and servicing of arcade machines, outdoor attractions, go-karting equipment, and golf facilities.
* Monitor equipment performance, identify recurring faults, and minimise operational downtime.
* Ensure faulty or unsafe equipment is isolated and returned to service only after appropriate inspection and clearance.

* **Safety & Compliance**
* Ensure gaming facilities comply with applicable safety standards, statutory requirements, and internal operating procedures.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and risk assessments, ensuring emergency systems, signage, access routes, and safety equipment remain functional.
* Coordinate incident investigations and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain inspection records, maintenance reports, and relevant compliance documentation.

* **Maintenance & Vendor Management**
* Prepare preventive maintenance schedules and coordinate repairs without unnecessarily disrupting daily operations.
* Manage external vendors, service providers, equipment suppliers, and annual maintenance contracts (AMCs).
* Monitor service quality, repair timelines, spare parts availability, warranties, and contractor compliance.
* Coordinate equipment upgrades, replacements, and facility improvement projects.

* **Team & Cost Management**
* Supervise maintenance personnel, allocate responsibilities, and monitor timely completion of maintenance activities.
* Coordinate with gaming operations, engineering, housekeeping, security, and other departments to ensure facility readiness.
* Assist in preparing maintenance budgets and controlling expenditure on repairs, servicing, spare parts, and utilities.
* Maintain asset inventories and records of equipment condition, service history, and maintenance costs.

* **Operational Readiness & Reporting**
* Ensure gaming areas and equipment are ready before daily operations and maintained throughout operating hours.
* Address facility-related issues affecting guest safety, comfort, and experience.
* Maintain maintenance schedules, breakdown logs, inspection checklists, and equipment availability reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, maintenance processes, safety, and operational efficiency.

* **Required Qualifications & Experience**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Facility Management, or a related technical field.
* Experience: 4–7 years in facility management, engineering, or technical maintenance, preferably in gaming, amusement parks, entertainment centres, hospitality, or leisure facilities.
* Knowledge of preventive maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, mechanical and electrical systems, and general infrastructure maintenance.
* Familiarity with arcade machines, amusement equipment, go-karting systems, or golf facilities will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of workplace safety, fire safety, risk assessment, and applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience in vendor management, maintenance budgeting, asset management, and team supervision.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, and maintenance tracking or facility management systems.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required by gaming operations.

Pay: From ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting opportunity for you to enhance your career by joining Consumer & Community Banking - Data & Analytics team.

As an Analytics Solutions Manager within Consumer & Community Banking, Marketing, Credit & Customer Experiences , Credit Decisioning Business unit, you will be responsible to operate business-critical controls execution, strengthen operational controls and improve the effectiveness of a complex operating environment by streaming and transforming the way we operate. The role requires leading the implementation and ongoing oversight of Pricing business processes, including pricing-related changes, so that decisions turn into controlled, measurable outcomes for customers and the business. This is a hands-on business leadership position with accountability for delivery, issue resolution, performance oversight and continuous improvement. The role requires working across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, and Risk and Control partners to anticipate execution challenges and address the underlying causes of exceptions. It also requires embedding sustainable solutions rather than relying on recurring manual intervention.

The role also requires helping to modernize the control environment by finding opportunities for preventive controls, automation, advanced analytics and responsible AI-enabled workflows. Success requires strong business judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and a disciplined focus on operational resilience and measurable value.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Business execution and operational leadership:** Lead end-to-end execution of business initiatives and operational processes, including pricing-related changes, from requirements and readiness through implementation, validation and stabilization.
* Set implementation readiness and post-change validation standards. Ensure dependencies, open exceptions and handoffs are resolved by accountable owners before and after launch.
* Oversee operational performance, identify emerging issues early, and drive timely decisions and corrective actions across functions.
* Partner with Product, Strategy, Technology and Operations to turn business decisions into durable control process and system changes.

* **Control management, monitoring and governance :**Strengthen first-line risk and control practices by identifying process vulnerabilities, control gaps and emerging operational risks. Lead and manage a team of control analysts to monitor controls, resolve open exceptions, assess control design and operating effectiveness and reduce business residual risk.
* Oversee , SLAs, KPI/KRI and exception-monitoring frameworks with defined thresholds, separating expected activity from material deviations that require investigation or escalation.
* Lead root-cause assessment and remediation of significant or recurring exceptions, with clear ownership, milestones and evidence of sustainable closure.

* **Control modernization and intelligent operations:** Partner with Product and Technology to move appropriate manual or detective checks into preventive, system-enabled controls while keeping independent oversight in place.
* Act as business owner for technology-enabled control improvements: define requirements, success measures, validation criteria and human-review checkpoints.

* **Stakeholder and team leadership:** Run governance and operating rhythms that speed up resolution, make trade-offs transparent and keep ownership in place after implementation.
* Lead and develop team members and workstream contributors through clear accountability, coaching and performance expectations.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**

* 9+ years of relevant experience in financial services business operations, business execution, implementation, operational controls or transformation.
* Proven ownership of complex operational processes or business implementations, including readiness, change execution, post-implementation monitoring and issue resolution.
* Strong understanding of first-line risk and controls, including operational risk identification, KPI/KRI monitoring, exception management, root-cause analysis and remediation.
* Ability to interpret operational data, identify meaningful patterns, prioritize risks, and give senior stakeholders concise recommendations.
* Practical understanding of how automation, analytics and AI can strengthen controls, and of the risks they introduce.
* Track record of collaborating across Product, Technology, Operations and Strategy partners without direct reporting authority.
* Experience leading teams, workstreams or cross-functional delivery groups with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Sound judgment, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across global teams.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**

* Experience in Consumer & Community Banking, Cards, Pricing Execution related processes or other high-volume consumer financial services operations.
* Experience modernizing first-line controls through process redesign, preventive controls, continuous monitoring or controls built into the product.
* Experience sponsoring or delivering analytics, intelligent automation, Generative AI or agentic AI use cases in a controlled enterprise environment, with measured benefits.
* Working familiarity with data and workflow tools such as SAS,SQL, Python, Tableau or Alteryx, to shape requirements and challenge proposed solutions with hands on experience.
* Exposure to change governance, operational resilience, benefits tracking and cross-border operating models.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Job Description – Human Resources Executive**

**Company:**

Interiors by DeX

**Location:**

Chennai

**Experience:**

5–7 Years

**Reporting To:**

Founder / HR Manager

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a proactive, confident, and people-oriented
**Human Resources Executive**

who can manage end-to-end HR functions while actively contributing to team development, employee engagement, retention, and organisational growth.

The ideal candidate should be highly communicative, approachable, energetic, and capable of building strong employee relationships while maintaining discipline and accountability across the organisation.

This role goes beyond routine HR administration and requires someone who is passionate about people management, talent acquisition, employee experience, performance management, and building a positive workplace culture.

The individual will be responsible for attracting the right talent, engaging and retaining employees, strengthening HR processes, and creating a work environment that supports both employee growth and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for various functions, including Design, Sales, Project Management, Site Operations, and Support.
* Understand job requirements and identify candidates who align with the company's culture, values, and business expectations.
* Drive candidate sourcing through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, consultants, and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct initial screening, candidate assessments, and behavioural interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and ensure timely recruitment closures.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor hiring progress, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment metrics.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.

**2. Employee Engagement, Retention & Culture Building**

* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, monthly celebrations, team interactions, and recognition initiatives.
* Develop and implement employee retention strategies to reduce avoidable employee turnover and improve employee satisfaction.
* Build a positive and inclusive work environment where employees feel heard, valued, and motivated.
* Conduct regular one-on-one discussions with employees to understand their concerns, expectations, motivation, and career aspirations.
* Identify early signs of employee dissatisfaction, disengagement, or potential attrition and take proactive steps to address them.
* Conduct periodic employee feedback sessions and analyse reasons for employee turnover.
* Act as a point of contact for employee concerns, queries, and workplace challenges.
* Support conflict resolution and maintain healthy employee relationships.
* Promote company values, workplace ethics, discipline, and professional behaviour.
* Drive effective onboarding and ensure a positive employee experience during the initial 90 days.
* Work closely with department heads and management to improve employee satisfaction, team stability, and long-term employee commitment.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Coordinate and implement employee performance tracking through KRAs, KPIs, and performance scorecards.
* Monitor monthly performance across different departments in coordination with reporting managers.
* Facilitate periodic performance reviews, feedback discussions, and appraisal processes.
* Track employee targets, achievements, and areas requiring improvement.
* Identify training and development requirements and coordinate learning initiatives.
* Support performance improvement plans and maintain proper performance documentation.
* Coordinate with management on performance-linked incentives, employee growth, and career development.
* Encourage a performance-driven culture by ensuring clarity of expectations, regular feedback, and accountability.

**4. HR Operations & Administration**

* Manage employee documentation, attendance, leave records, and HR databases.
* Ensure adherence to HR policies, procedures, and the employee handbook.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, salary revisions, incentives, and monthly HR reports.
* Support statutory compliance and ensure employee records are maintained accurately.
* Handle employee onboarding, confirmation, probation reviews, and exit formalities.
* Conduct exit discussions, analyse attrition trends, and identify opportunities for improving employee retention.
* Ensure proper knowledge transfer, handover, and clearance processes during employee exits.
* Regularly review HR processes and suggest improvements for operational efficiency.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy while handling employee information and sensitive HR matters.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident, energetic, approachable, and people-oriented personality.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across all levels.
* Good decision-making, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to maintain a balance between employee satisfaction and organisational discipline.
* Strong organisational, coordination, and multitasking skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to work with HR data, trackers, reports, and employee metrics.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Strong understanding of recruitment, employee engagement, retention, and performance management.
* Proactive approach towards identifying workplace challenges and implementing HR process improvements.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of HR responsibilities.

**Preferred Background**

* 5–7 years of experience in Human Resources.
* Candidates from Interior Design, Real Estate, Architecture, Construction, Agency, or Startup environments will be preferred.
* Hands-on experience in recruitment, employee engagement, employee retention, performance management, and HR operations.
* Experience working in a fast-paced and growing organisation will be an added advantage.
* Practical exposure to developing HR processes, implementing policies, and improving employee experience.

title: Recruitment Manager / General Manager - Overseas Recruitment
description:
**Company Description**
Keerthi Overseas Recruitment Consultants specializes in sourcing white-collar and blue-collar talent for Gulf-based organizations across a wide range of industries, including construction, hospitality, oil & gas, engineering, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, logistics, security, facilities management, FMCG, and shipping. With over 30 years of business experience, the firm offers an edge in understanding and fulfilling diverse manpower requirements. Keerthi Overseas focuses on customized recruitment solutions, providing streamlined access to pre-screened candidates so clients can concentrate on core business growth. The company is known for its proven track record of successful placements, tailored support, and an efficient, quality-driven hiring process. Its mission is to help Gulf businesses reach new heights through strategic talent acquisition.
  
**Role Description**
The Recruitment Manager / General Manager – Overseas Recruitment will oversee end-to-end recruitment operations for client organizations in Gulf countries, working on-site in Chennai in a contract capacity. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding client manpower needs, developing recruitment plans, and managing sourcing activities through various channels such as job portals, social media, referrals, and agency networks. The role will involve screening and shortlisting candidates, coordinating interviews, handling documentation for overseas placements, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and client-specific requirements. The manager will build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, negotiate terms where required, monitor recruitment performance metrics, and provide regular updates and reports. The position also includes leading and mentoring internal recruitment staff, improving processes, and supporting business development activities related to overseas manpower projects.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong recruitment and talent acquisition capabilities, including candidate sourcing, screening, and selection for overseas roles.
* Client relationship management and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to understand and translate manpower needs into actionable recruitment plans.
* Experience in managing teams, mentoring staff, and overseeing daily operations in a recruitment or HR environment.
* Knowledge of Gulf labour markets, industry requirements (e.g., construction, oil & gas, hospitality), and relevant overseas recruitment processes and documentation.
* Solid organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple requisitions and deadlines.
* Proficiency in using recruitment tools, job portals, and basic office software; familiarity with applicant tracking systems is an advantage.
* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced qualifications or certifications in HR or recruitment are a plus.
* Previous experience in overseas recruitment, especially for Gulf nations, and demonstrated success in high-volume or multi-industry hiring.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment, and uphold ethical, non-discriminatory hiring practices.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
**Company:**
iNextLabs

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Work Location:**
Chennai / Coimbatore

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About iNextLabs**

iNextLabs is a Generative AI-focused technology company committed to making AI accessible and transformative for businesses of all sizes. We develop innovative AI-powered solutions, including Virtual AI Assistants, intelligent chatbots, advanced analytics, data visualization tools and process automation solutions.

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Customer Support Specialist to join our team and ensure an excellent customer experience across our AI-powered products and solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Support Specialist will be responsible for handling customer queries, resolving product-related issues, providing technical assistance, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate should have experience supporting SaaS or IT products, strong communication skills and the ability to understand technical issues and coordinate with internal development and product teams for timely resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking assistance with iNextLabs products and solutions.
* Handle customer queries and issues through email, chat, phone calls and other support channels.
* Provide first-level technical support, troubleshoot product-related issues and guide customers with appropriate solutions.
* Understand customer requirements and assist customers with product features, functionalities and usage.
* Support customers in using AI-powered applications, chatbots and SaaS-based solutions.
* Identify, analyse and document customer-reported issues and coordinate with the technical and development teams for resolution.
* Track customer issues through ticketing systems and ensure timely follow-ups and closure within defined SLAs.
* Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions, recurring issues, resolutions and FAQs.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and share feedback with product and engineering teams for continuous improvement.
* Assist with product onboarding, user training and customer demonstrations whenever required.
* Proactively follow up with customers to ensure issue resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall support experience.

* Perform initial investigation and troubleshooting of application issues, including login failures, functional errors, integration failures and unexpected system behaviour.
* Monitor and manage support tickets based on priority, severity and defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Handle production incidents, coordinate with relevant technical teams and ensure timely communication with affected customers.
* Analyse application logs, error messages and API responses to identify potential causes of reported issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the respective L2/L3 engineering teams with sufficient technical details, screenshots, logs and reproduction steps.
* Track escalated issues until resolution and ensure appropriate communication and closure with customers.

**Customer Support Operations**

 

* Ensure timely acknowledgement, regular status updates and resolution of customer-reported issues.
* Prepare and maintain support documentation (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, FAQs and knowledge base articles.
* Maintain support metrics and periodic reports covering ticket volume, response time, resolution time, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction.
* Identify recurring incidents and proactively recommend corrective and preventive actions to minimise repeat issues.
* Proper ticket categorisation, prioritisation and escalation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, Product Support or Customer Success roles.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong customer-handling, problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Basic understanding of web applications, software products, APIs and cloud-based platforms.
* Experience working with CRM platforms and ticketing tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk or similar systems.
* Ability to understand technical issues and communicate them effectively to development teams.
* Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer queries simultaneously.
* Strong ownership, patience and a customer-first approach.

* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes and JSON.
* Ability to troubleshoot web application issues using browser developer tools.
* Basic understanding of application logs, database concepts and software integrations.
* Familiarity with incident management, ticket prioritisation and SLA-based support processes.
* Experience working with enterprise customers in a SaaS or cloud-based environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience supporting AI-powered applications, chatbots or Generative AI products.
* Basic understanding of AI concepts, LLMs, NLP, Voice AI and chatbot workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
* Experience handling international B2B customers.
* Exposure to product onboarding, customer training and client relationship management.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer-centric mindset
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
* Adaptability and willingness to learn emerging technologies

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with innovative Generative AI and SaaS products.
* Exposure to emerging AI technologies and enterprise solutions.
* Collaborative and learning-oriented work environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and skill development..

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards to enable technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With decades of expertise in printed circuit board (PCB) technology, leading manufacturers worldwide rely on our solutions to deliver next-generation designs with precision and efficiency. Driving innovation in advanced PCB applications ICS and Large Panel Level Packaging, our
**Application Team**
plays a critical role in bridging technology and customer experience. This team ensures that our products not only meet technical specifications but also deliver exceptional value to customers across diverse industries, including automotive, consumer electronics, telecommunications, and high-performance computing.
  
  
Our mission is to enable seamless integration solutions into customer workflows, ensuring reliability, scalability, and superior performance. Operating globally, the Application Team partners closely with engineering, product development, and customer-facing teams to deliver best-in-class support and technical expertise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer Engagement & Technical Support Serve as the primary technical interface for customers, providing guidance on PCB application best practices and ensuring successful implementation.
* Product Demonstration & Validation Showcase product capabilities and performance at customer sites and internal facilities, demonstrating technical advantages over competing solutions.
* Feedback Integration Capture and analyze customer feedback to influence product development and continuous improvement across all levels of the organization.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with engineering, marketing, and software teams to align product features with customer requirements and emerging market trends.
* Application Development Leadership Lead initiatives to develop new use cases, optimize workflows, and enhance customer experience through innovative application strategies.
* Project Tracking & Reporting Monitor critical projects in real time, providing timely updates and actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Next-Generation Solutions Contribute to the development and characterization of advanced PCB technologies and ICS, ensuring readiness for future market demands.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: HR Specialist
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 100 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.

**What will you do?**

We’re seeking a proactive HR Specialist for our Chennai office to act as a trusted HR business advisor, managing employee interactions, performance reviews, and on-the-ground people issues during a rotational 3pm-11pm shift. You’ll coach managers, drive local HR initiatives, and build strong relationships with employees and leadership to support Rocketlane’s global growth.

* Manage day-to-day employee relations, including conflict resolution, career coaching, and policy guidance to foster engagement.
* Lead performance review cycles, coaching managers on feedback, goal-setting, and development plans.
* Handle ground-level issues like attendance, compliance, and team dynamics with empathy and efficiency.
* Execute on-the-ground HR initiatives such as team events, recognition programs, and engagement activities tailored to Chennai teams.
* Partner closely with managers and leaders to provide proactive advice, workforce insights, and alignment with business goals.
* Build trust as a confidential advisor, earning credibility across all levels during rotational shifts supporting global operations.

**You should apply if**

* Fantastic communication skills with the ability to build strong rapport across employees, managers, and leaders.
* Excellent proficiency in G Suite and MS Excel for data analysis, reporting, and process optimization.
* Proven ability to think critically and improve HR processes for greater efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with tools like KekaHR, Deel, and similar HRIS platforms.
* 3-5 years of HR generalist or business partnering experience in SaaS/tech environments.
* Comfort in rotational shifts (3pm-11pm IST, including weekends) and cross-timezone collaboration.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related field; SHRM-CP or PHR certification preferred.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

**Job Summary**
---------------

* The Vice President, Private Banking Operations GCC, will report directly to the Head, Private Banking Operations & Centre of Excellence and act as a key senior leader supporting delivery of the Private Banking Operations agenda.

• The role will partner with the Head to define the Private Banking Operations transformation strategy and agenda, and translate strategic priorities into disciplined execution across operations, risk and controls, transformation, digitalisation, governance and organisational capability. The incumbent will connect strategy, execution and control outcomes, provide clear management insight, and independently drive agreed priorities to completion while preserving accountability with the Head of the function.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy and Execution**  
• Partner with the Head to define the Private Banking Operations transformation strategy, target operating model and strategic priorities, aligned to WRB and Private Banking objectives, and translate these into an integrated execution roadmap with clear milestones, dependencies, accountabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
• Own consolidated tracking and execution of strategic priorities, escalating material risks, delays and decisions requiring senior intervention.
  
• Identify opportunities to simplify the operating model, strengthen controls, improve scalability and enhance client outcomes.
  
• Provide structured analysis, options and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making.
  
• Act as a senior leadership extension of the Head across agreed operational, governance and transformation priorities.

**Business and Service Delivery**  
• Support delivery of strong operational outcomes across payments, deposits, loans, credit administration and documentation, accounting, reconciliations and associated Private Banking Operations activities.
  
• Drive performance against agreed service standards, including turnaround time, accuracy, referrals, productivity, capacity and operational resilience.
  
• Establish clear visibility of service trends, exceptions, recurring issues, client-impacting themes and emerging operational risks.
  
• Coordinate resolution of cross-process issues involving Operations, Business, Product, Technology and control functions.
  
• Lead root-cause analysis of material service or operational issues and ensure sustainable corrective action.
  
• Promote an end-to-end client and transaction lifecycle perspective and reduce process-silo decision-making.

**Transformation and Digitalisation**  
**• Shape and maintain the Operations transformation agenda by defining priority initiatives, business cases, investment and resource requirements, sequencing and expected benefits for agreement with the Head; lead execution of sponsored initiatives, including process re-engineering, workflow redesign and operating model improvement.**  
**• Identify and deliver opportunities for straight-through processing, automation, digitisation, simplification and control-by-design.**  
**• Ensure transformation initiatives address process, people, technology, data, risk and control impacts end-to-end.**  
**• Establish disciplined implementation governance covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, readiness, adoption and benefits realisation.**  
**• Ensure changes are operationally sustainable, supported by appropriate procedures, training, controls and post-implementation review.**  
**• Act as the operational bridge between business objectives and technology/change delivery.**

**Risk, Control and Governance**  
**• Drive a strong risk and control culture across the assigned Private Banking Operations portfolio.**  
**• Maintain consolidated oversight of material operational risks, control weaknesses, incidents, audit actions, review findings and remediation priorities.**  
**• Ensure issues are addressed through sustainable corrective action, with clear ownership, target dates, evidence and closure discipline.**  
**• Identify recurring themes and structural weaknesses and recommend preventive and detective control improvements.**  
**• Facilitate governance forums and ensure decisions, actions, owners and dependencies are accurately recorded and tracked.**  
**• Provide concise, forward-looking management information highlighting areas requiring intervention or escalation.**  
**• Ensure adherence to applicable Group policies, procedures, risk management standards, regulatory expectations and business continuity requirements.**

**Stakeholder Management**  
**• Build effective relationships with Country and Group Private Banking Operations, Business and COO teams, Product, Technology, Operational Risk, Compliance, Finance, HR, Legal, Training and other support functions.**  
**• Influence senior stakeholders to resolve competing priorities, remove delivery obstacles and achieve sustainable outcomes.**  
**• Represent the function in agreed governance and transformation forums and provide clear updates on delivery, risk and decisions.**

**Success Outcomes**  
**• Consistent and resilient service delivery with transparent management of performance, capacity, quality and client-impacting issues.**  
**• Timely execution of strategic and transformation priorities with measurable and sustained benefits.**  
**• Stronger risk and control outcomes, disciplined remediation and reduced recurrence of operational issues.**  
**• High-quality management information that enables early intervention and effective senior decision-making.**  
**• A stronger leadership pipeline, improved organisational capability and clear succession across critical roles.**  
**• Demonstrable leadership leverage for the Head through independent ownership and reliable follow-through.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Private Banking Products and Operations**  
**• Service Delivery and Operational Management**  
**• Risk Management, Governance and Control**  
**• Transformation and Change Management**  
**• Management Information and Executive Decision Support**  
**• Process Re-engineering, STP and Digitalisation**  
**• Accounting and Reconciliation Knowledge**  
**• Strategy and Operating Model**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Client Development**  
**• Continuous Improvement**  
**• Stakeholder Engagement**  
**• Talent Development**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Energised by interacting with internal stakeholders every day and creating positive experiences that build confidence in the Bank.**

**• Motivated by helping clients navigate their banking needs through clear communication, responsive service and practical support.**  
**• Enjoys building trust through consistent, professional interactions and being a reliable point of contact for clients.**  
**• Takes pride in representing the best of WRB by connecting clients to the right services, solutions and expertise across the Bank.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Essential Experience and Capabilities**  
**• Significant experience in Private Banking, Wealth Management or complex banking operations, with strong understanding of banking products and processes that are offered to Private Banking Clients.**  
**• Demonstrated senior leadership experience spanning operations, risk and controls, governance and transformation.**  
**• Strong understanding of payments, lending and credit, deposits, operational accounting and reconciliations, with an end-to-end client and transaction lifecycle perspective.**  
**• Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional transformation and operational improvement.**  
**• Strong risk judgement and experience operating within a highly controlled and regulated banking environment.**  
**• Ability to convert complex operational information into clear management insights, options and decisions.**  
**• Executive-level stakeholder management, communication, influencing and facilitation skills.**  
**• Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development and succession-planning capability.**  
**• Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, prioritise across competing demands and drive outcomes with limited supervision.**

**Preferred Experience**  
**• Temenos T24 or comparable core-banking platform experience.**  
**• Experience delivering straight-through processing, automation, workflow or digital transformation.**  
**• Experience working across multiple markets, booking centres or global delivery locations.**  
**• Agile/change delivery experience and understanding of solution and system design.**

**Qualifications**

title: Sr. Manager - Employee Program Management
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Employee Program Management will design, implement, and oversee employee programs tailored to JLL's Integrated Facilities Management workforce — a large, distributed population that includes site-based technicians, engineers, facility coordinators, and client-dedicated account teams. This role ensures that engagement, recognition, safety culture, onboarding, and retention programs are consistently delivered across multi-site, multi-client environments, while remaining adaptable to the operational realities of frontline and field-based work.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesLead the design, rollout, and governance of employee programs specific to IFM's workforce, including onboarding for site-based roles, frontline recognition, safety and wellbeing initiatives, and retention programs for high-turnover-risk positions.
  
Partner with Account Directors, Facility Managers, EHS, and client HR stakeholders to ensure programs reflect the operational cadence of 24/7 facility environments and client-specific requirements.
  
Manage a portfolio of programs across a geographically dispersed, multi-site employee base, balancing standardization with the flexibility needed for diverse client accounts and site profiles.
  
Develop and track program KPIs — including engagement scores, retention/turnover rates, time-to-fill for frontline roles, and safety participation metrics — and report findings to IFM leadership.
  
Collaborate with Talent Development to support career pathing and upskilling programs for technicians, engineers, and facility coordinators (e.g., trade certifications, cross-training, succession pipelines for site leadership roles).
  
Build scalable communication strategies suited to a largely non-desk-based workforce (e.g., toolbox talks, site postings, mobile-first channels) to drive program awareness and adoption.
  
Manage relationships with vendors supporting IFM-specific programs (e.g., training providers, recognition platforms, wellbeing vendors).
  
Ensure program design accounts for union environments, varying shift patterns, and client contractual requirements where applicable.
  
Prepare executive-level reporting on program performance and ROI for IFM leadership and, where relevant, client business reviews.
  
Drive change management for new program rollouts across account teams, working closely with Account Directors to ensure consistent on-site execution.
  
Required QualificationsBachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  
7+ years of progressive experience in HR program management or employee experience, ideally within facilities management, real estate services, logistics, manufacturing, or another frontline/field-based industry.
  
Demonstrated experience managing programs across a geographically distributed or multi-site workforce.
  
Strong analytical skills, with experience using workforce metrics (turnover, engagement, safety) to inform program design.
  
Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience working with both internal leadership and client-facing account teams.
  
Familiarity with HR and operations systems used in IFM contexts (e.g., Workday, CMMS/IWMS platforms, ServiceNow) a plus.
  
Project management certification (PMP, PROSCI, or equivalent) a plus.
  
Preferred SkillsExperience supporting a blue-collar, trade, or technical workforce (HVAC, electrical, mechanical, janitorial/custodial, security).
  
Familiarity with EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) program integration into broader employee experience initiatives.
  
Experience operating within client-facing, contract-based service delivery models where programs must flex to client requirements.
  
Change management expertise (ADKAR, Kotter's model, or similar).
  
Union relations experience or familiarity with collective bargaining environments.
  
Core CompetenciesOperational pragmatism — ability to design programs that work for frontline, shift-based teams, not just office staff
  
Cross-functional collaboration across HR, Operations, EHS, and client stakeholders
  
Data-driven decision making with attention to workforce-specific metrics
  
Adaptability across diverse client accounts and site conditions
  
Strong written and verbal communication, adaptable to both leadership and frontline audiences
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Senior Manager - Human Resource
description:
**Sr. Manager – Human Resources**
=================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Sr. Manager of Human Resources will lead the organization’s HR function and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of human resource management, including talent acquisition, performance management, learning & development, employee engagement, compensation & benefits, compliance and culture.

The Sr. HR Manager acts as a strategic partner to the leadership team and a trusted advisor to employees.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **A. Strategic Leadership – Lead and Execute**

* Develop and execute the HR strategy aligned with the company’s business goals and growth plans.
* Serve as a member of the leadership team, contributing to organizational planning and decision-making.
* Drive organizational change, culture building, and leadership development initiatives.

### **B. Performance Management – Lead and Execute**

* Design and implement performance appraisal systems aligned with business outcomes.
* Ensure consistent goal setting, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms across levels.
* Partner with leaders to identify high performers and create talent pipelines.

### **C. HR Operations & Analytics – Lead and Execute**

* Optimize HR processes through technology and automation.
* Use HR analytics to guide strategic decisions (attrition, hiring trends, productivity, etc.).
* Manage HR budgets effectively and ensure cost efficiency.

### **D. Compensation & Benefits – Lead and Execute**

* Develop competitive compensation structures aligned with market benchmarks.
* Ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
* Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to plan HR budgets, salary projections, and cost analyses.

### **E. Compliance & Policy Management – Lead and Execute**

* Ensure adherence to labour laws and HR-related statutory requirements.
* Establish a robust governance framework for consistent policy implementation across business units and locations.
* Oversee statutory audits, inspections, and filings related to labour, social security, and employment law compliance.

### **F. Employee Engagement & Culture – Lead and Execute**

* Develop and drive a holistic employee engagement strategy that fosters motivation, belonging, and high performance across the organization.
* Partner with business and functional leaders to promote a positive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace environment.
* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives such as recognition programs, wellness activities, communication forums, and cultural events.

### **G. Learning & Development – Supervisory**

* Partner with business leaders to identify skill gaps and create structured learning roadmaps for employees across all levels.
* Develop leadership development programs to strengthen managerial capability, succession planning, and future leadership pipelines.
* Establish a continuous learning culture through e-learning platforms, mentorship programs, and self-paced learning initiatives.
* Collaborate with external training partners, institutes, and consultants to deliver high-quality learning interventions.
* Maintain L&D budgets and ensure cost-effective program design and delivery.

### **H. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning – Supervisory**

* Provide strategic oversight into the Talent Acquisition function and guide the TA Manager, who will independently lead day-to-day hiring operations.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth plans and future workforce needs.
* Strengthen the organization’s employer brand through targeted campaigns, employee advocacy, and engagement with professional networks and academic institutions.

**3. Skills & Competencies**
----------------------------

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Expertise in HR analytics, HRMS tools – KEKA, and modern HR practices.
* High emotional intelligence and integrity.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* Master’s degree in human resources (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
* Strong understanding of labour laws, HR systems, and organizational development principles.
* 15–18 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.

**About Integrative Systems**
-----------------------------

Guided by the promise **“Futureproof Your Business,”** Integrative Systems is a trusted global technology partner with over 25 years of experience delivering end-to-end IT and non-IT business solutions.

A six-time Inc. 5000 honouree and Great Place to Work certified, we operate as an extension of our clients' teams across five core service pillars.

* **Business Software Applications** across IBM i/AS400, Microsoft (.NET, Power BI), and enterprise ERP platforms.
* **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** consulting, custom application development, and automated workflow solutions.
* **Infrastructure & Cyber Security** providing 24/7 L1–L3 application support, hardware management, and threat defence.
* **ITES & Back-Office Services** covering full accounting/finance lifecycle management and non-IT customer care.
* **Graphic Design** offering 2D media production, 3D visualization, animation, and AR/VR solutions.

Through this unified structure, we help enterprises modernize legacy systems, enhance operational resilience, and achieve sustainable digital growth.

We are committed to providing you a work culture where your contributions are recognized, your inputs are heard, and your personal and professional growth is prioritized.

title: Operations Director
description:
**Job Description: Director of Operations (Catering & Events)**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented **Director of Operations** to lead and oversee all operational aspects of our catering and events business. This role requires a hands-on leader with exceptional attention to detail who can bring structure, discipline, and operational excellence to a fast-paced boutique catering environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring seamless event execution, efficient production management, team leadership, cost control, and continuous process improvement.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Proactive and self-driven
* Resourceful and adaptable
* Solution-oriented mindset
* Strong attention to detail
* Hands-on leader who takes ownership
* Anticipates challenges and resolves issues effectively
* Able to bring structure and discipline to a dynamic operational environment

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Event Operations & Execution**

* Oversee end-to-end planning and execution of all events.
* Coordinate with Directors, Client Servicing, Operations, Stores, Kitchen, Design, and Finance teams to ensure flawless event delivery.
* Develop operational plans, event checklists, timelines, and deployment schedules.
* Ensure timely venue setup and smooth service execution.
* Conduct site visits to assess logistics, kitchen facilities, equipment, and manpower needs.
* Ensure all events meet company quality and presentation standards.

**2. Kitchen & Production Management**

* Coordinate with the Head Chef and kitchen teams on production schedules and food preparation requirements.
* Ensure accurate communication of menus, quantities, dietary restrictions, and special requirements.
* Monitor food quality, consistency, portion control, packaging, and presentation.
* Oversee food dispatch and transportation processes.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene, sanitation, and food safety standards.

**3. Team & Manpower Management**

* Lead and supervise kitchen staff, service teams, floor managers, supervisors, drivers, and temporary event personnel.
* Create staffing rosters and deployment plans based on event requirements.
* Train teams on service excellence, grooming standards, discipline, and customer interactions.
* Foster accountability, communication, and collaboration across departments.
* Develop and maintain a reliable pool of trained freelance and temporary event staff.

**4. Logistics & Equipment Management**

* Manage transportation, loading, unloading, and movement of service ware and event materials.
* Maintain accurate inventory records for crockery, cutlery, linen, kitchen equipment, and operational supplies.
* Ensure all equipment is maintained, cleaned, stored, and tracked appropriately.
* Plan logistics efficiently to prevent delays, shortages, and last-minute disruptions.

**5. Cost Control & Budget Management**

* Monitor event-wise operational budgets and costs.
* Track food, manpower, transportation, and event-related expenses.
* Minimize wastage and improve operational efficiency.
* Review event profitability in collaboration with the Cost Controller.
* Identify opportunities to optimize resources and improve margins.

**6. Quality Control & Client Experience**

* Maintain exceptional standards of food quality, service, hygiene, and presentation.
* Ensure client expectations and agreed deliverables are consistently achieved.
* Address and resolve operational challenges promptly during events.
* Gather post-event feedback and implement continuous improvements.
* Uphold and strengthen the brand's premium positioning through operational excellence and attention to detail.

**7. Systems & Process Development**

* Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for daily operations and events.
* Create event checklists, inventory management systems, and reporting formats.
* Improve communication and coordination between Client Servicing, Kitchen, and Operations teams.
* Monitor operational performance and drive continuous process improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 8-12+ years of experience in catering, hospitality, food service, event operations, or a similar leadership role.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Sound understanding of food production, event logistics, inventory management, and budgeting.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

**Success Measures**

* Seamless event execution and client satisfaction.
* Consistent food quality and service standards.
* Effective cost management and profitability improvement.
* High-performing and well-trained operational teams.
* Efficient systems, processes, and inventory controls.
* Continuous operational improvement and brand excellence.

Pay: ₹922,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

title: Operations - Executive Director - CTB
description:
**Company Profile**

  

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

  

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

  
  

**Department Profile**

  

Since 2007 Morgan Stanley has been expanding its own fully owned premier investment banking and sales & trading platform in India, providing a full range of investment banking, sales & trading, equity, fixed income, commodities and derivative products, as well as research services. Building on this existing platform in India, we are looking to invest in establishing a Derivative Operations division that will continue to recognize and match the global need of our clients.

  
  

**Background on the Team**

  

The Equity Confirmation Operations team is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and finalizing trade confirmations for equity products such as equity derivatives, options, swaps and structured equity transactions. The team ensures that all trade details agreed upon between Morgan Stanley and the counterparty(s) are accurately documented and compliant with internal policies, market regulations and legal standards.

  

As an Executive Director leading Transformation Projects within Morgan Stanley’s Equity Confirmation function, the role is centered on driving strategic, operational, and technological change across the firm’s global equity post-trade infrastructure. This position focuses on modernizing the equity trade confirmations workflow enabling robust control framework, timely dispatch of confirmations to counterparties and increasing process efficiency.

  

The functional ops teams’ responsibilities include:

* Drafting and issuing trade confirmations based on executed deals
* Verifying trade terms with traders, sales teams and operations
* Coordinating with counterparties to resolve discrepancies or disputes
* Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry documentation standards (e.g., ISDA for equity derivatives)
* Maintaining accurate records and supporting post-trade lifecycle events
  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

**Scope and Purpose of the Role:**

  

This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving strategic change initiatives across the Equity Confirms Ops Group under the Derivations Operations umbrella. The ED will spearhead the design, implementation, and management of transformation programmes that align with Morgan Stanley’s global business objectives, ensuring continuous improvement, operational excellence, and robust risk management.

  

Specific Tasks:

* Develop and implement a transformation strategy to streamline workflows, optimize operations, and enhance service delivery within Equity Confirmations Operations.
* Lead cross-functional teams to identify, design, and deliver key projects focused on automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders—including business unit heads, technology, legal, and compliance—to align transformation initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Oversee large-scale projects from initiation to completion, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and measurable results.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by mentoring team members, promoting best practices, and encouraging innovation.
* Championing user led Business Intelligence tools within the wider team
* Monitor and report on transformation progress using data-driven analytics to measure impact and inform future strategy.
* Manage change activities to address both process and people aspects, minimizing disruption and maximizing engagement across the division.
* Build strong relationships with internal clients (Traders, Trade Support, Legal, Drafting Teams) to understand stakeholder priorities, protect confidentiality, and address ad-hoc requests promptly.
* Demonstrate knowledge of Equities products (Swaps, OTC options) and their lifecycle.
* Apply SDLC and Agile principles in daily change management.
* Lead requirements and user story creation, as well as project testing.
* Partner with IT to design, develop, and implement technology platforms that address business needs.
* Continuously identify and deliver value through enhanced business capabilities, efficiency, scalability, and improved operational risk management and controls.
* Manage time-sensitive regulatory changes effectively.
  

  

**Skills/Qualifications required (essential)**

  

Required

* Proven experience in transformation and project management within financial services, ideally in equity operations or post-trade processing.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results under tight deadlines.
* Ability to think strategically and provide insight into how to improve existing business and technology processes
* Minimum of 15+ years Investment Banking Operations or equivalent relevant industry experience with exposure to financial products
* Strong understanding of equity derivatives, OTC confirmations, and associated risk and control frameworks.
* Strong Communication (Writing and Verbal) Skills. Effective interaction with others across departments and regions
* Proven track record of delivering complex change programmes in a global, matrixed environment.
* Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cultural change and inspire high-performing teams.
  

  

**Required Competencies**

  

* Expert in ISDA Definitions, ensuring operational accuracy and compliance.
* Provides strategic leadership and delivers innovative solutions.
* Resolves complex issues and drives performance through advanced analytics.
* Builds collaborative, high-performing teams.
* Identifies and mitigates operational risks to support growth.
* Balances strong controls with exceptional client service.
* Manages multiple projects and meets tight deadlines.
* Streamlines workflows for greater efficiency.
* Resolves recurring issues through root cause analysis.
* Communicates effectively with stakeholders.
* Re-engineers processes for efficiency and competitive advantage.
* Promotes a culture of risk management and continuous improvement.
* Motivates teams to excel under pressure.
* Builds strong partnerships across functions.
* Delivers operational excellence through disciplined process management.
* Leads global projects to successful execution.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Product Director** in the Product & Design team to shape and deliver AI-led intelligent operations products across the complete product development lifecycle. This individual will own product strategy and execution—from ideation, discovery, and definition through build, launch, commercialization, and continuous improvement—with primary emphasis on creating a strong pipeline of validated, high-value opportunities.

You will combine market insight, customer discovery, commercial thinking, and delivery leadership to translate unmet needs into differentiated products. Working across Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Research, and Architecture, you will align stakeholders, guide execution, and ensure products deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* **Product Strategy & Innovation:** Define product vision, strategic themes, value proposition, and differentiated positioning for AI-led intelligent operations products. Translate market, customer, business, and technology signals into a prioritized portfolio of opportunities.
* **Ideation, Discovery & Definition:** Lead structured ideation and customer-led discovery to identify high-value problems, validate demand, test assumptions, and shape clear product concepts, business requirements, and success measures.

* **Commercialization & Go-to-Market:** Build product business cases and commercial models, inform pricing and packaging, and partner with Sales and Marketing on go-to-market strategy, launch readiness, client adoption, and growth.
* **Stakeholder & Customer Leadership:** Engage customers and senior stakeholders to gather demand signals, align diverse perspectives, communicate product choices, and secure commitment across the lifecycle.
* **Performance & Lifecycle Management:** Define and track product, adoption, commercial, and customer-outcome metrics. Use evidence and feedback to optimize products, refine the roadmap, and recommend scaling, repositioning, or retirement decisions.

**About you – Skills & Experience:**

* Have 10+ years of end-to-end product management experience, including product strategy, discovery, delivery, launch, and lifecycle management.

* Strong facilitation, convergence, and stakeholder alignment skills.

* Skilled in strategizing and leading ideation workshops to uncover business opportunities, align cross-functional teams, and shape innovative digital initiatives.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML, generative and agentic AI, cloud platforms, and responsible AI considerations in product strategy and delivery.

* Excellent communication and influencing skills. Ability to align diverse viewpoints around common goals.

* MBA, MS in Technology, or other advanced degree preferred.

title: Senior Financial Advisor
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst – AIFA (Project Finance & Investments)**
At ENGIE, we are accelerating the energy transition across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Our team powers this ambition through smart financial decisions that bring renewable energy projects to life. We need sharp analytical minds to help us evaluate, structure, and finance the projects that will shape tomorrow's energy landscape.
  
  
As a Financial Analyst within our AIFA team, you will play a key role in assessing greenfield and M&A opportunities. Your financial models and analyses will directly influence investment decisions and help secure the funding that turns ambitious plans into operational assets.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain financial models for project valuations in line with ENGIE's investment guidelines and modelling standards.
* Conduct financial analyses, review third-party models, and perform model audits to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Support the structuring and execution of project financing plans, including bank selection and funding source evaluation.
* Prepare accounting and tax impact assessments within financial models, collaborating with internal experts and external advisors.
* Analyze risk allocation, bankability considerations, and tax optimization strategies for new transactions.
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of internal AIFA methodologies and analytical tools.
* Collaborate with senior team members on cross-regional transactions spanning India, the Middle East, and Africa.

**What You Bring**

* A degree in Finance, Economics, or Engineering, or a professional qualification such as CFA, CIMA, ACA, or ACCA.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally within project finance, financial advisory, or investment analysis.
* Proven financial modelling expertise with advanced Excel skills, including the ability to write basic Macros.
* Solid understanding of financial valuation methodologies, accounting principles, and tax structuring.
* Familiarity with energy markets and risk allocation frameworks; exposure to renewables in India, the Middle East, or Africa is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and manage multiple priorities under pressure.
* Excellent communication skills in English; French is an advantage.

**Location**
Pune or Mumbai, India. This is an on-site role. Travel to the Middle East and Africa region is expected based on project requirements.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A competitive salary package aligned with your experience and qualifications.
* Clear career progression within a global energy leader operating across multiple continents.
* Diverse and stimulating missions spanning greenfield developments, acquisitions, and project financings across emerging markets.
* A collaborative and friendly work environment where knowledge sharing is encouraged.
* Exposure to complex, high-impact transactions that directly contribute to the global energy transition.
* Flexibility and support to maintain a healthy work-life balance alongside demanding project timelines.

At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
