title: Associate Director- Revenue Management
description:
Associate Director – Revenue Management

**Location:**
Pune, India

**Experience:**
5+ years

**Reports to:**
Senior Director – Supply

**Team Size:**
Approximately 10 members, including Revenue Managers

***About the Role***

Amber earns a commission from property partners for every student booking made through our platform. Turning a booking into collected revenue involves validating the booking, confirming attribution and move-in, reconciling with the partner, and managing invoicing and collections across the UK, US, Australia, Canada and other markets.

Today, much of this process relies on individual knowledge, manual follow-ups and spreadsheets. We are looking for someone to take end-to-end ownership of the function and transform it into a process-driven, technology-enabled operation that can support business growth without a proportionate increase in headcount.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead the team while personally driving critical process improvements and systems transformation. It is neither a pure people-management role nor a technical development role.

***What You'll Own***

1. Revenue Operations

* Ensure accurate and timely reconciliation, invoicing and collections.
* Monitor cancellation and dispute rates, process cycle times and revenue leakage.
* Establish processes, controls and KPIs to identify and prevent revenue leakage early.
* Ensure seamless partner portfolio handovers without revenue loss.
* Track performance through data and forecast invoicing, collections and cancellations for leadership.

2. Systems & Process Transformation

* Own the business-side systems and automation roadmap for the function.
* Define process flows, business rules, data requirements and exception handling for Product, Data and Technology teams.
* Drive implementation and adoption, ensuring new processes and systems are effectively used by the team.

3. Partners & Stakeholder Management

* Resolve disputes related to attribution, commissions and payments with international property partners.
* Collaborate with Sales and Key Account Management teams to address issues at the source rather than managing recurring problems downstream.

4. Team Leadership

* Lead, manage and develop the team, with full accountability for outcomes.
* Delegate day-to-day execution while maintaining sufficient involvement to continuously challenge and improve existing processes.
* Build a culture of ownership, process discipline and continuous improvement.

***What You'll Bring***

*Must-Have Requirements*

* 5+ years of experience in business operations, finance operations, ERP implementation, process transformation or a related field.
* Experience leading teams and driving execution through others, ideally including managers.
* Proven track record of redesigning processes or systems end-to-end, from conceptualisation through implementation and adoption.
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to break complex workflows into clear processes, rules and exceptions.
* Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to independently extract and analyse data. Programming experience is not required.
* Confident stakeholder management skills, including engagement with senior finance and operations stakeholders at partner organisations.
* High ownership, accountability and a strong bias for execution.

Nice-to-Have Requirements

* Experience with ERP systems or workflow automation tools such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Zoho or similar.
* Experience in order-to-cash, accounts receivable, reconciliation or collections.
* Experience in commission- or attribution-based businesses such as marketplaces, aggregators, travel, affiliate networks or study-abroad platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their application in business operations.

**Note:**
Prior experience in student accommodation is not required.

Who Will Enjoy This Role?

You'll enjoy this role if you prefer fixing the system rather than solving the same problem every month. You should be equally comfortable leading a team, analysing data, challenging existing processes and taking an idea from concept through to successful implementation.

title: FP&A Systems & Transformation Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
  
  
**Who You Are**
Zinnia is looking for a forward-thinking FP&A Systems & Transformation Leader to drive the evolution of our financial planning, forecasting, and reporting capabilities. This role will own and lead the development of NetSuite Planning and Budgeting (NSPB) while driving automation, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) across the FP&A function.The successful candidate will go beyond managing a planning system. They will play a critical role in transforming FP&A from a largely manual, Excel-driven process into an integrated, automated, predictive, and insight-driven finance organization. The objective is to build a scalable FP&A technology ecosystem that reduces manual effort, improves forecast accuracy, accelerates decision-making, and enables finance professionals to focus on strategic business partnering.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* NSPB Platform Ownership & Optimization

+ Own the end-to-end NSPB platform, including system architecture, configuration, enhancements, and ongoing optimization.
+ Lead the design and implementation of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting solutions.
+ Develop scalable financial models covering revenue, operating expenses, headcount, profitability, and cash flow.
+ Strengthen integrations between NSPB, NetSuite ERP, and other enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
+ Establish strong data governance, system controls, and standardized planning processes.
+ Drive user adoption through training, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  
  

* FP&A Automation & Process Transformation

+ Identify and eliminate manual, repetitive activities across budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting.
+ Automate data extraction, reconciliation, variance analysis, and management reporting.
+ Reduce reliance on Excel-based processes by creating standardized and automated planning workflows.
+ Develop automated dashboards and reporting solutions that provide real-time visibility into financial performance.
+ Partner with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities.
+ Establish measurable improvements in reporting turnaround time, process efficiency, and data accuracy.

  
  

* AI & Advanced Analytics – Building the Future of FP&A

+ Develop and execute a roadmap for incorporating AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics into FP&A processes.
+ Explore and implement AI-driven forecasting models to improve revenue, expense, and profitability predictions.
+ Introduce intelligent variance analysis to automatically identify performance drivers, anomalies, and emerging financial risks.
+ Evaluate generative AI solutions that can automate financial commentary, management reporting, and business performance narratives.
+ Explore natural-language financial analytics, enabling business leaders to ask questions and receive actionable insights.
+ Develop predictive and scenario-based planning capabilities to support faster, data-driven business decisions.
+ Partner with technology teams to evaluate AI tools, ensuring appropriate data security, governance, and human oversight.
+ Continuously evaluate emerging finance technologies and identify opportunities to enhance FP&A capabilities.

  
  

* Financial Reporting & Business Intelligence

+ Build automated financial reporting solutions for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
+ Integrate financial and operational data to provide a comprehensive view of business performance.
+ Develop interactive dashboards for revenue, EBITDA, expenses, workforce planning, and key operational metrics.
+ Enable self-service reporting and analytics to reduce dependency on manual FP&A reporting.
+ Improve the speed, accuracy, and consistency of monthly and quarterly management reporting.

  
  

* Strategic Leadership & Transformation Roadmap

+ Define and execute a multiyear FP&A technology and transformation roadmap aligned with Zinnia's business priorities.
+ Act as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and business leadership to translate financial requirements into scalable technology solutions.
+ Drive change management and adoption of new planning tools, automation capabilities, and AI-enabled workflows.
+ Establish KPIs to measure the impact of technology investments on FP&A productivity, efficiency, and decision-making.
+ Build a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technology-enabled financial planning.

**What You’ll Need**

* 15+ years of experience in FP&A systems, financial transformation, enterprise performance management, or related functions.
* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite Planning and Budgeting (NSPB) / Oracle EPM Planning.
* Proven experience implementing, optimizing, and managing enterprise financial planning systems.
* Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and management reporting.
* Demonstrated experience automating finance processes and integrating financial systems.
* Experience working with ERP platforms, data integrations, and business intelligence tools.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Ability to independently lead transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability

title: Analyst - Audit & Finance
description:
**Role: Analyst - Audit & Finance**

**Role Tagline**

Building the foundation of rigorous, standards-driven audit execution as a 'forward-deployed executor', where every test is thorough, every working paper is defensible, and every finding earns the trust of the people who read it.

**Role Description**

You're not here to tick boxes and move on. You're here to operate as a skeptical, detail-obsessed contributor who anchors Searce's audit function with rigor, independence of thought, and reliability. This role sits at the intersection of audit execution, risk identification, and management insight, and it demands someone who takes genuine ownership of their work. You'll work closely with senior audit leadership to plan and perform audit procedures, document evidence and conclusions, coordinate with specialists, and turn what you find into findings that help management act.

You bring audit experience, a firm grasp of auditing standards, and a restless curiosity for the evidence that doesn't fit the story. A CA qualification is a strong advantage, but what matters most is your depth of audit knowledge, your professional skepticism, and your drive to grow into a well-rounded audit professional. If you believe in challenging first, concluding second, and you treat every assumption, sample, and misstatement as a chance to add value, this role is built for you.

**Responsibilities**

**(A) Audit Execution & Documentation**

* Execute comprehensive audit procedures in adherence to relevant standards.
* Develop specific audit plans, review evidence for completeness and accuracy, and perform analytical reviews.
* Document your work meticulously and exercise professional skepticism at every step.
* Challenge assumptions while considering alternatives and disconfirming evidence.
* Identify and document audit misstatements, assessing their impact against materiality thresholds.

**(B) Planning, Coordination & Delivery**

* Proactively engage in planning, including preparation of client listings, resource allocation, and oversight of the entire audit process.
* Coordinate with specialists and assess how their findings affect the audit.
* Ensure tasks are completed to a high standard within agreed-upon timelines and budgets.

**(C) Insight, Risk & Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to the identification and documentation of risks, issues, and conclusions, escalating as necessary.
* Deliver insightful findings to management, clearly and constructively.
* Participate in debriefing sessions to identify lessons learned and improve future quality and planning.

**Functional Skills**

* **Audit Executor:**
  Plans and performs procedures with methodical precision, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.
* **Skeptic-in-Chief:**
  Questions assumptions, explores alternatives, and actively seeks out disconfirming evidence before forming a conclusion.
* **Risk Spotter:**
  Identifies misstatements, risks, and issues early, assesses them against materiality, and escalates with context.
* **Insight Communicator:**
  Translates audit findings into clear, business-relevant language for management, in writing and in conversation.
* **Delivery-Conscious Operator:**
  Keeps work on time and on budget, and contributes to cleaner, faster audit processes through lessons learned.

**Skills**

Audit Execution · Audit Planning · Professional Skepticism · Analytical Review · Materiality Assessment · Risk Identification · Audit Documentation · Stakeholder Communication · Attention to Detail

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Data-Fluent Executor:**
  Comfortable working with financial data, ERP extracts, and spreadsheets to test, reconcile, and validate information accurately.
* **Analytics-Enabled:**
  Uses analytical reviews and data-driven techniques to spot anomalies and sharpen audit focus.
* **Documentation Disciplinarian:**
  Maintains clean, structured working papers, review-ready at all times.

**Experience**

* **Education (Is Education overrated? Yes. We believe so. But there is no way to locate you otherwise.):**
  At least a Master's degree in commerce from an accredited university; a Master's in finance, accounting, or a related field is preferred. A higher qualification such as CA, CA Inter, CMA, CPA, or an MBA/PGDBA in Finance is an added advantage.
* **Audit Foundation:**
  1-5 years of proven work experience in a similar role.
* **Standards Track Record:**
  Demonstrated experience executing comprehensive audit procedures in compliance with relevant standards.
* **Documentation & Skepticism:**
  Meticulous in documenting audit processes and exercising professional skepticism.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written skills to convey audit findings effectively.
* **Leadership Readiness:**
  Ability to lead and manage a team of audit professionals.

**Bonus Points**

* **Ownership Instinct:**
  Takes full accountability for assigned work, follows through without reminders, flags blockers early, and delivers on commitments.
* **Curiosity-Driven:**
  Doesn't stop at the first explanation. Digs deeper, tests alternatives, and proactively highlights risks and opportunities.
* **Growth Mindset:**
  Actively upskills, learns from every debrief, and contributes ideas that make the team's audits sharper and smoother.
* You default to challenge, not assume; document, not defer; grow through doing, and you treat every audit as an opportunity to build judgment that compounds over time.

title: Fraud & Dispute Analyst - BA3
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a Fraud & Dispute Analyst - BA3 at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules & regulations, and codes of conduct. With competitive benefits and opportunities for career advancement, Barclays is a great place to grow your career in the banking industry.
  
  
**Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include**

* A fraud analyst must possess strong analytical skills to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data that may indicate fraudulent activity.
* Attention to detail is crucial for a fraud analyst to spot discrepancies and inconsistencies in financial records or transactions.
* Effective communication skills are essential for a fraud analyst to collaborate with other team members, report findings to management, and communicate with external stakeholders.
* Fraud analysts must be able to think critically and creatively to solve complex problems and identify solutions to prevent and detect fraud.
* A strong understanding of fraud detection techniques, tools, and technologies is essential for a fraud analyst to effectively identify and prevent fraudulent activity.
* Fraud analysts must have a good understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance standards related to fraud prevention and detection.
* Proficiency in using data, software, and systems is important for a fraud analyst to effectively analyze and interpret data to detect fraudulent activity.
* Strong Communication skills.
* Demonstrates expertise in advanced Microsoft Excel functions, including data analysis, pivot tables, and complex formulas.
* Proficiency in creating visually compelling and effective presentations using advanced PowerPoint features.
* Strong ability to analyze, organize, and sort large data sets with attention to detail and accuracy..
* Skilled at interpreting data trends and patterns, and making actionable recommendations for process improvements.
* Capacity to communicate insights clearly and collaborate with team members to implement suggested changes.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To monitor customer accounts for suspicious/fraudulent activities and take appropriate action when required.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Execution of customer query support, including credit card inquires, account management and case resolution related to suspected fraud.
* Collaboration with various internal stakeholders across function projects and law enforcement agencies in cases of potential fraud.
* Development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies and procedures, including the use of fraud detection tools and technologies.
* Support teams within the business operations function as needed, including risk management, compliance, and customer care.
* Identification and implementation of trends and developments to regulatory requirements and internal policies related to fraud prevention and detection activities.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of customer care fraud prevention operations, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Monitoring financial transactions for potential fraudulent and suspicious activities and conduct investigations and report fraud incidents.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and support
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

A hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. Product Cost Controlling depth — costing variants and estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and order settlement. Replacing a spreadsheet costing process — codifying multi-tier allocation and derivation rules into a governed system layer, and running a formal six-month parallel run to sign-off. Margin analysis and finance-facing communication — account-based CO-PA design, plus the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.Role OverviewActual cost today is produced entirely in Excel: SAP supplies only a raw variance extract, while product-number conversion, three-tier variance allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption rules, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging live in spreadsheets maintained by a few individuals. The month-end process is long, the audit trail thin, and the logic carries real key-person risk. The target is SAP Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode — periodic unit price calculated and rolled up multi-level through the BOM for management reporting, while inventory and COGS remain at standard cost. Delivery includes a six-month parallel run before Excel is retired.Key Responsibilities Lead Controlling validation workshops with the manufacturing controller and finance leadership; confirm the requirements and produce signed-off functional design. Configure Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode: ML activation per plant, currency and valuation setup, single- and multi-level price determination, and deliberate exclusion of post-closing so there is no financial-statement impact. Design the periodic unit price and multi-level roll-up so raw-material and semi-finished variances propagate through the full BOM to finished goods, with the actual cost component split carried through to allocation and reporting. Retain and validate the standard-costing foundation (price control S, annual CK40N, costing variants and sheets) and design cost object controlling: order costing, WIP, variance calculation and settlement. Map the nine cost-variance GL accounts onto standard variance categories and ML cost components; design the business-specific allocation logic — direct-by-item, pooled ratio distribution by plant and business area, business-area-only vendor discount allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging. Take and document the architecture decision — reposting custom allocation into Material Ledger versus combining it with the ML periodic unit price in the reporting layer — before custom development begins; drive upstream posting-quality remediation as the primary lever. Design margin analysis characteristics, derivation and the link from actual cost component split to item- and customer-level actual gross margin; plan and run the six-month parallel run to management-usefulness sign-off while maintaining SOX / J-SOX control integrity.Preferred Required■ BATCH MANAGEMENT & TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — PREFERRED, NOT REQUIREDBatch Management and traceability experience is preferred but not required for this role — the actual-costing scope is item-level rather than batch-level. Candidates who understand the following will integrate more effectively with the manufacturing and inventory workstreams: How batch-managed inventory and batch valuation interact with Material Ledger — including split and batch-specific valuation, and why this program's collection-only design does not require them. FIFO lot-based gross-profit reporting (deferred to a later phase here) and the batch-level data it would depend on. How scrap and yield reported at lot and batch level in execution flow into production-order variance and therefore into actual cost, so costing and shop-floor reporting design stay consistent.Required Qualifications 8+ years SAP Controlling consulting with 5+ full-lifecycle implementations and hands-on Product Cost Controlling configuration responsibility; at least 2 on S/4HANA (1909 or later). Demonstrable hands-on SAP Material Ledger implementation experience — activation, actual costing run, single- and multi-level price determination, periodic unit price, actual cost component split and CKM3N/CKMVFM analysis. This is a hard requirement. Deep Product Cost Planning and Cost Object Controlling expertise: costing variants, cost estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and settlement. Profitability analysis experience — margin analysis (account-based CO-PA) on S/4HANA, characteristic derivation, and product/customer-level margin reporting. Actual costing in report-only / collection-only mode, or the clear ability to explain the design implications of not running post-closing. Proven replacement of a spreadsheet-based finance process with a system process, including running a formal parallel run and securing sign-off. Strong CO–FI–MM–PP integration knowledge, SOX / J-SOX control experience, and the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including Japanese management-accounting conventions and J-SOX practice. Delivering costing allocation logic in a governed BW / SAP BTP reporting layer rather than bespoke ABAP. SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud for margin and cost reporting. Group Reporting, Universal Parallel Accounting or multi-valuation actual costing. Electronics or high-mix discrete manufacturing cost structures, including mold/tooling and engineer-to-order costing; ML performance tuning and month-end runtime benchmarking at scale. SAP certification in S/4HANA Management Accounting (Controlling).ENGAGEMENT DETAILSFull-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. description:
Join us as a Legal EA Team Leader at Barclays, where you will lead and manage a team of Executive Assistants, ensuring the effective delivery of administrative support services through strong people leadership, resource management, governance, operational oversight and continuous improvement. The role is accountable for maintaining service standards, optimising team capacity, driving consistency of delivery, managing risk and controls, and fostering a high-performing and engaged team environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Line management of Executive Assistants.
* Resource management of the EA team to ensure both suitable EA coverage to the Directors aligned to them and an appropriate and balanced workload between team members.
* Provide oversight and subject matter expertise on the management of on-boarding new joiners and off-boarding leavers (permanent and third party). Staying up to date on process changes, training EAs and other stakeholders, and helping to resolve and escalate issues.
* Working closely with the EAs in their direct line, and the other EA Pod Leads / Team Leaders in Legal, to ensure a seamless experience for stakeholders, supported by establishing an appropriate buddy system for each EA to cover absences and busy periods as part of the UK and India Legal EA hub.
* Supporting the creation, development and embedding of an administrative service model for the function.
* Drive continuous improvement across administrative processes and ways of working by identifying opportunities to simplify, automate and standardise activity, and by creating practical tools, guidance and resources that support colleagues in delivering consistent, high-quality outcomes.

To be successful as a Legal EA Team Leader, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Basic / Essential Qualifications And Skills**

* Graduates degreed in any discipline.
* Flexibility to work UK shift hours.
* Experience managing teams within a fast-paced corporate, professional services or financial services environment, including coaching, development, and performance management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including management of escalations and sensitive situations.
* Experience of resource planning, workload management, and service delivery oversight.
* Experience implementing service improvements, operational excellence initiatives, or automation solutions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

**Desirable Skillsets / Good To Have**

* Previous experience leading Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or administrative or operational teams.
* Familiarity with Workday, Concur, Coupa and other enterprise support platforms.
* Experience working within a hub, shared service or centralised model supporting a global business or function.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as, the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. You will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role will be based out of Pune, Maharashtra.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To provide operating and administrative support to senior leaders, simultaneously shaping and executing long-term strategic change, whilst helping to navigate complex challenges in the performance of their roles
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Implementation of Target Operating Model, business development, and financial and non-financial resource allocation, providing strategic insight and thought leadership.
* Strategic support to and oversight of demand pipeline and the book of work, including assistance in the development and execution of strategic initiatives, projects, research, and analysis to support decision-making.
* Support to and guidance for operational efficiency and colleague/customer/client experience within the organisation, including the identification of areas for improvement, streamlining of processes, and implementation of best practices to enhance productivity, effectiveness and experience.
* Management of of people plan, talent development and succession planning including the identification of high-potential employees, provision of mentorship and guidance, and support to leadership development and diversity initiatives.
* Communication with internal and external stakeholders, management of communication channels and ensuring effective coordination across different departments and teams.
* Participation in compliance activities such as SMR and other regulatory registrations/certifications, as well as support for crisis management and risk mitigation, including the development of contingency plans, coordination of responses to emergencies, and business continuity.
* Management of all organisational/team requirements relating to technology, real estate, people and communications in conjunction with relevant partners across the firm.
* Enablement of oversight of risk management and compliance with internal and external requirements, including internal Governance on critical control activities in partnership with the CCO team, such as Records Inventory and RCSAs.
* Cost control and workforce management of the Business/Function, including involvement in financial analysis and planning, forecasting, and monitoring of financial performance against targets.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. * If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

title: Lawyer
description:
**We're Hiring: Associate (Litigation, Family Law & Corporate)

Solace Ace Law Chambers (SALC) | Pune | Full Time, On-Site

About Us

Solace Ace Law Chambers is a litigation-led law firm with a growing corporate advisory practice. We represent clients before the Family Courts, District and Sessions Courts, JMFC Courts and tribunals across Pune, Maharashtra and the Bombay High Court, and we advise businesses, start-ups and individuals on their commercial and corporate matters. Our work rests on thorough research, careful drafting and practical advice. Associates here handle real matters from the first week. They work directly with senior counsel and build the courtroom and advisory skills a long legal career needs.

The Role

The Associate will work full time from our Pune office, supporting both our litigation and corporate practices.

Litigation and Court Work

• Attending and assisting at the Family Court, District Court, Sessions Court, JMFC Courts and tribunals in Pune, and handling mentions, adjournments and filings independently over time

• Drafting petitions, applications, replies, written statements, affidavits, written arguments and legal notices

• Family law matters: mutual consent and contested divorce, maintenance , PWDVA proceedings, child custody and guardianship, and matrimonial criminal complaints

• Criminal matters: bail and anticipatory bail, quashing petitions, S.138 NI Act cheque dishonour cases, and police complaints and FIR-related work

• Civil and recovery matters: suits, injunctions, caveats, execution and summary suits

• Building case briefs, compiling documents, keeping matter files and tracking court dates and limitation deadlines

Corporate and Advisory Work

• Drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, MOUs, employment agreements, leave and license agreements, development agreements and loan agreements

• Property title searches, due diligence and registration-related work

• Employment and labour advisory, including exit settlements, notices and compliance

• Start-up and business advisory, trademark and registration support, and regulatory research

Client and Team Work

• Joining client consultations, recording facts and preparing chronologies and case notes

• Researching statutes and case law (BNS, BNSS, BSA, HMA, CPC, NI Act, Contract Act and allied laws) and preparing internal memos

• Coordinating with senior counsel on strategy, timelines and hearing preparation

What We're Looking For

• LL.B. from a recognised institution; enrolment with the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa (or eligibility to enrol) preferred

• 0 to 3 years of experience in litigation or corporate practice; strong internship experience with litigating advocates or law firms will be considered

• Working knowledge of court procedure in Pune's District, Family and JMFC Courts

• Strong drafting skills in English; working knowledge of Marathi is a strong advantage for district court work

• Sound research skills, with the ability to find, read and apply current case law

• Willingness to be in court regularly and to manage several matters against tight deadlines

• Discretion with confidential client information, professional conduct and good interpersonal skills

• Comfort with legal research platforms, e-filing and basic office technology

Why SALC

• Direct exposure to family, criminal, civil and corporate matters from day one

• Close mentorship from senior counsel with over 13 years of practice

• Courtroom experience across Pune's District and Family Courts, plus advisory work for businesses

• A collaborative office focused on learning and long-term growth

Send your CV, a short cover note and one writing sample (a petition, notice or contract you drafted) to:**

**/ WhatsApp: +91 9881676147**

Reddy & Reddy Law Firm, based in Pune, is recognised as one of Maharashtra's leading law firms, serving a diverse Indian and international client base. The firm offers comprehensive legal services across civil, commercial, and criminal litigation,
family matters,matrimonial disputes,
arbitration and mediation, corporate law, and compliance, banking and finance, credit management, and real estate. Its team of experienced advocates and legal advisers takes a business-oriented, client-focused approach, providing tailored legal solutions and striving for legal excellence. Lawyers at the firm frequently act as experts on Indian law in both transactional and litigation matters, handling complex issues across multiple industrial and corporate sectors. The firm is distinguished by a personal approach to client service, strict professional and ethical standards, and high-quality legal advice and representation.

**Role Description**

We're hiring a
**Senior Associate**
for our
**Litigation Department**
in
**Pune (Full-Time | On-Site)**
. The Senior Legal Associate will work on-site in Pune City in a full-time capacity, supporting a broad range of litigation and transactional matters. Responsibilities include drafting, reviewing, and finalizing legal documents and contracts, conducting detailed legal research, and preparing case strategies and opinions. The role involves managing case files, coordinating with clients, opposing counsel, and internal teams, and representing clients before courts, tribunals, and other authorities as required. The Senior Legal Associate will mentor junior associates, ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and contribute to strengthening practice groups in areas such as civil and commercial litigation, corporate law, and arbitration. The position requires proactive participation in client meetings, risk assessment, and solution-oriented advisory work aligned with the firm's standards of excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse the brief and develop a sound litigation strategy
* Draft pleadings, applications and other court documents with precision
* Appear and argue effectively before courts and tribunals
* Coordinate closely with counsel and clients
* Take independent ownership of matters through all stages of proceedings

**Ideal Candidate**

* Sound legal judgment and strong analytical ability
* Strong drafting skills with attention to precision
* Confident courtroom advocacy
* Meticulous attention to detail
* A practical, result-oriented approach to dispute resolution
* Prior experience in teamwork and team leadership will be highly valued

We particularly value sound legal judgment, strong drafting, courtroom confidence, attention to detail and a practical approach to dispute resolution.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Law, with in-depth knowledge of relevant statutes, case law, and legal procedures.
* Proficiency in Legal Document Preparation, including drafting pleadings, contracts, opinions, and compliance documentation.
* Excellent Analytical Skills to interpret complex legal issues, assess risks, and develop sound legal strategies.
* Effective Communication skills, both written and verbal, to interact with clients, courts, and internal teams and present arguments clearly.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve Legal Issues across litigation, corporate, and advisory matters.
* Bachelor's degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognized institution; LL.M. or specialized certifications in relevant practice areas are an advantage.
* Active enrollment with the Bar Council of India and eligibility to appear before courts in Maharashtra.
* Several years of post-qualification experience in a law firm or corporate legal department, preferably handling complex civil and commercial matters.
* Strong client management skills, high professional ethics, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Comfort with legal research tools and basic proficiency in office productivity software.

title: Legal AI Researcher
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Legal AI Researcher is responsible for executing legal workflows in AI development with a strong focus on trust, safety, compliance, and risk validation. As a member of the product design process, the Legal AI Researcher helps shape how Onit’s AI products are built, recommending product design based on legal knowledge and research, and providing independent validation before release. Working under the guidance of Senior and Principal Legal Engineers, this role supports the ethical development of AI, ensures legal risk is documented and mitigated, and contributes to internal compliance, audits, and workflow execution. The position also encourages professional development and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Design Participation: Take part in the product design process from early concept through release, representing legal and trust considerations in design discussions and decisions.
* Legal Workflow Execution: Organise baselines, define research methodologies, and support structured execution of legal AI workflows.
* Compliance & Reporting Support: Assist in audits, prepare privacy statements, model factsheets, and maintain audit logs.
* AI Risk & Validation Tasks: Conduct ethical, legal, and operational risk assessments while maintaining AI risk registry and validating outputs for compliance.
* Trust & Safety Integration: Monitor ongoing legal and risk developments, initiate steps to maintain compliance, and feed findings into trust frameworks.
* Prompt Engineering Support: Contribute to prompt development and iterative improvements in legal AI services.
* Jurisdictional Research: Research and summarise AI regulations relevant to product deployment regions.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with AI engineering team to deliver legally valid and trustworthy AI solutions.
* Learning & Development: Learn from senior team members and work towards higher-impact roles.
* Independent Validation: Perform independent validation of AI features and outputs against legal, company standards and risk requirements before release, documenting findings, exceptions, and remediation, and escalating unresolved issues.

**Required Skills**

* Legal degree or equivalent legal/LegalOps experience.
* Background in legal matter or spend management.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organisational skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, including the ability to explain legal requirements clearly to product and engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt in Legal Tech environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of AI compliance and legal risk principles.
* Experience in prompt engineering or legal validation of AI.
* Exposure to legal audits, AI fairness, privacy, or regulatory frameworks.
* Prior client presentations or compliance documentation experience.
* Exposure to product design or product development processes, or to translating legal requirements into product features.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Applicants**
We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  
**Onit Values**
**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

title: Specialist- HR Operations
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.

**Job Title: Specialist – Regional HR**

**Pune**

**Role Purpose**

The Regional HR Operations Manager is responsible for managing and executing end-to-end HR operational processes across the assigned region. This role ensures seamless HR service delivery, statutory compliance, policy implementation, and employee lifecycle management while partnering with business leaders to support organizational goals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

* Manage end-to-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits across the region.
* Ensure accurate and timely execution of HR transactions in HRMS.
* Oversee documentation, employee records, and data integrity.

Employee Engagement & Frontline Interaction

* Act as the primary HR touchpoint for employees, ensuring high responsiveness.
* Conduct regular floor walks and employee listening sessions.
* Capture employee feedback, identify trends, and share insights with HR leadership.
* Collaborate with managers to proactively resolve employee concerns.

HR Analytics, Dashboards & Reporting

* Own and track key HR metrics such as attrition, attendance, manpower analytics, performance cycle progress, and workforce productivity metrics.
* Develop and maintain dashboards to support strategic business decisions.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly HR reports with high accuracy and actionable insights.

Payroll & Benefits Administration

* Coordinate regional payroll inputs and ensure payroll accuracy in collaboration with payroll vendors and finance teams.
* Manage employee benefits including PF, ESIC, gratuity, insurance, and leave administration.
* Resolve payroll and benefits-related employee queries within defined timelines.

Statutory Compliance & Audits

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws including CLRA, Shops & Establishment Act, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, and other statutory requirements.
* Manage inspections, audits, statutory filings, and compliance documentation for the region.

Policy Implementation & Employee Relations

* Implement HR policies, SOPs, and processes consistently across locations.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, and domestic inquiries where required.
* Promote a positive employee experience and healthy workplace culture.

Regional HR Support & Business Partnering

* Act as the primary HR partner for regional business leaders and employees.
* Support manpower planning, attrition analysis, and workforce reporting.
* Provide HR operational insights and recommendations to leadership teams.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

* Manage HR vendors including payroll, background verification, staffing partners, and compliance consultants.
* Coordinate with corporate HR, finance, legal, and administration teams to ensure smooth operations.

Process Improvement & Digitization

* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of HR processes.
* Support HR system enhancements, digital initiatives, and organizational transformation projects.

**Knowledge, Experience & Skills:**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources.
* 5–7 years of experience in HR Operations, preferably in a multi-location or regional role.
* Experience managing large employee populations.
* Hands-on experience in HR operations, payroll management, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Strong understanding of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* High attention to detail and strong process orientation.
* Demonstrated problem-solving and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and HR reporting tools.
* Experience with HRMS platforms and HR analytics dashboards preferred.

What do we offer?  
An open culture with a creative and challenging opportunity to satisfy your intellectual needs  
Flexible working hours  
Smart working: a hybrid remote/office working environment  
Work-life balance  
An excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment to work in  
  
About Accelya  
Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering over 200 airlines with an open, modular software platform. Owned by Vista Equity Partners, we bring together 2,000+ employees across 10 global offices. We are proud partners of AWS and pioneers in NDC expertise. Find out more at www.accelya.com

What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

**JOB OVERVIEW**  
  
As a Senior HR Shared Services Specialist, you will drive operational excellence by owning the end-to-end delivery of HR services globally. You will serve as a subject matter expert and a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, ensuring that our HR operations are not only efficient and compliant but also scalable for future growth. Your role is pivotal in transforming the employee experience through process optimization, data-driven insights, and high-touch stakeholder management.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* **Benefits enrolment**: Assist new hires with benefits enrolment processes, providing guidance on available options and answering questions related to healthcare and company offered medical insurance.
* **HR Process Management**: Own and optimize the HR lifecycle processes post-onboarding. This includes governing the workflows for data management, offboarding, and lifecycle changes to ensure they are seamless, automated where possible, and globally consistent.
* **Data Accuracy and Integrity**: stablish and maintain rigorous data entry standards and audit protocols within the HRIS. You are responsible for the "source of truth," ensuring that all employee data is compliant with global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and internal audit requirements.
* **Compliance**: Proactively monitor and interpret changes in local labor laws and regulations across all operating regions. You will lead the implementation of necessary process changes to ensure the organization remains fully compliant and minimizes legal risk.
* **Employee Support:** Serve as the primary escalation point for sensitive or high-complexity employee inquiries. You will manage the most difficult cases with a high degree of empathy and professionalism, while also analysing inquiry trends to improve self-service resources.
* **Collaboration**: Drive alignment between HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Talent Integration, Finance, and IT. You will lead regular syncs with these departments to ensure that HR operations support broader business objectives and that data flows between systems (e.g., from HRIS to IT) are flawless.
* **Process Improvement**: Act as a change agent by continuously identifying and implementing improvements to HR workflows. You will leverage data and feedback to reduce cycle times, eliminate manual work, and enhance the overall employee experience through automation or Lean methodologies.
* **Documentation & Reporting**: Develop and maintain a comprehensive library of HR standard operating procedures (SOPs). You will also deliver sophisticated reports and dashboards that provide leadership with actionable insights into workforce trends and operational KPIs.
* **Stakeholder Management**: Manage expectations and relationships with senior leadership and HRDDs. You will act as a trusted advisor on HR operational matters, ensuring that stakeholders are informed of process changes, compliance risks, and request progress.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Good Communication skills (Verbal/Written)

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.

title: Manager – P&C Operations
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Manager – P&C Operations will oversee payroll governance, employment-related statutory compliance, HR data integrity and operational controls. The role is accountable for accurate and timely payroll processing, regulatory adherence, audit readiness and continuous process improvement.

The role will partner with the P&C Operations Lead, Finance, Legal and other stakeholders to maintain efficient, well-controlled and compliant operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Payroll Management

* Own the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle, ensuring timely completion and effective coordination across internal teams and service providers.
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of salaries and other payroll components.
* Validate payroll inputs, reconciliations and exceptions—including employee lifecycle changes, attendance, leave, overtime, unpaid absence and variable payments—before payroll closure.
* Ensure appropriate maker-checker controls throughout the payroll process.
* Coordinate timely Full & Final settlements for separated employees.
Review payroll reports and ensure payroll records and supporting documentation are maintained appropriately.  

Statutory & Labour Compliance

* Ensure payroll and P&C operations (like working hours, overtime, leave, holidays and other employment conditions etc.) comply with applicable employment laws, statutory requirements and filing obligations.
* Monitor regulatory developments, assess their impact on payroll, policies and processes, and coordinate required changes with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure the maintenance of appropriate statutory registers and records.
Support establishment-related registrations, renewals and compliance requirements, as applicable.  

Governance, Controls & Audit

* Establish and maintain strong internal controls across payroll and compliance processes.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify compliance gaps.
* Maintain payroll and compliance SOPs, checklists and process documentation.
* Serve as the P&C point of contact for internal, external and statutory audits, coordinating responses and timely closure of observations.
* Maintain an audit-ready repository of payroll and compliance documentation.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention and strengthen process controls.  

HR Systems, Data and Analytics

* Maintain accurate employee and payroll data across HRIS with appropriate confidentiality and access controls, attendance and payroll systems; review payroll-impacting configurations; and monitor payroll accuracy, exceptions and trends to support timely corrective action.
* Provide concise governance reporting on data quality, system exceptions and key payroll-impacting trends.
Drive automation and process improvements across HR systems and data processes to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.  

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

* Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders on payroll and compliance matters.
* Manage relationships with payroll vendors, consultants and statutory service providers.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on payroll-related policies and processes.
Escalate significant compliance risks, control failures or recurring process issues.  

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian payroll operations, statutory compliance, employee lifecycle processes, and related controls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail when handling sensitive employee and payroll information.
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management capabilities.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into operational processes.
* Strong Excel and HRIS/payroll system capabilities. Prior Workday experience is preferred.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and consistently meet critical monthly deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant HR and payroll experience, including substantial responsibility for payroll, statutory compliance, HR systems, and employee lifecycle operations.
* Experience independently managing end-to-end payroll processes is preferred.
* Prior experience handling statutory, internal, and external audits is desirable.
* Experience working with HRIS/payroll platforms and payroll service providers is preferred.

title: Customer Support Team Lead - eSIM (India, Remote)
description:
**JOIN EXPATRIO**
Expatrio is an ambitious Berlin-based start-up in Fintech and Edtech, dedicated to making the journey to and life in Germany as easy as possible for international students. As we prepare to launch our new eSIM offering, we are looking for a
  
  
**Customer Support Team Lead - eSIM (India, Remote)**
to help build and lead a dedicated, chat-based customer support team. This hands-on role combines direct AI-assisted live chat support, technical troubleshooting and guidance of a small remote team. It is an exciting next step for an experienced telecommunications support professional with leadership potential.
  
  
**YOUR ROLE**
Provide hands-on, chat-only support for eSIM installation, activation, mobile data, roaming, device compatibility and connectivity troubleshooting.
  
  
Handle multiple simultaneous live chats with clear, empathetic and accurate written English.
  
  
Own complex technical cases and escalations through resolution and customer follow-up.
  
  
Help establish and lead a small remote support team through daily guidance, coaching and quality feedback.
  
  
Develop telecom support workflows for activation, provisioning, incidents and escalation to network partners.
  
  
Use Salesforce to manage chats, cases, documentation, escalations and performance.
  
  
Use AI-assisted support tools to improve speed and quality while verifying technical accuracy of suggested answers.
  
  
Use Slack for proactive remote coordination, team updates and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Work with internal teams and external telecommunications partners to resolve recurring service issues.
  
  
Create troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, training resources and standard operating procedures.
  
  
Monitor chat response time, resolution, quality and customer satisfaction, and continuously improve workflows.
  
  
**YOUR PROFILE**
Solid hands-on customer support experience in telecommunications, ideally with an MNO, MVNO or SIM/eSIM provider in a remote set up.
  
  
Proven live chat support expertise, including managing concurrent conversations without sacrificing quality.
  
  
Strong practical troubleshooting knowledge of SIM/eSIM activation, provisioning, roaming, network connectivity and device compatibility.
  
  
Familiarity with telecom incident management, technical escalation and service activation processes.
  
  
Highly tech-savvy, quick to learn new systems and comfortable using AI-assisted support tools responsibly.
  
  
Experience with CRM and chat platforms; Salesforce Service Cloud is strongly preferred.
  
  
Comfortable using Slack and other digital tools to collaborate with distributed teams.
  
  
Experience resolving complex customer issues independently, with strong ownership and judgment.
  
  
Leadership potential and enjoyment of coaching colleagues; previous formal management experience is a plus, not required.
  
  
Self-motivated, organized and proactive in a fully remote, fast-paced start-up environment.
  
  
Excellent written and spoken English (C1 level or equivalent), especially clear and empathetic chat writing; additional languages are a plus.
  
  
**WHY EXPATRIO?**

* International, diverse, and intrinsically motivated team
* Autonomous and progressive work environment with low hierarchies and fast decision-making
* Flexible working hours
* Most importantly: The chance to solve an actual problem

Expatrio aims is to be the best solution for international students in Germany. With a digital platform approach (an all-in-one app) at the interface of Fintech, Govtech, and Edtech, we are accompanying tens of thousands of students on their entire journey from study preparation and visa application to arriving and living in Germany. **Does the position sound interesting to you? Then we would be very happy to receive your application.**
Your Expatrio team!

**About The Role**

* Ensure positive perception of the problem management process
* Continuously improve our capability on problem management provided to our customer
* Perform the management of both reactive root-cause analysis (RCA) and proactive trend analysis
* Communicate and coordinate with concerned parties through the Problem Management process
* Prevent re-occurrence of Incidents and minimize the impact of incidents that cannot be prevented
* Explore and enhance the Known-error database

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage reactive and proactive Problem Management activities in line with the ITIL framework.
* Lead root-cause analysis and problem investigations across technical, operational and supplier teams.
* Analyse incident data and recurring trends to identify root causes and opportunities for prevention.
* Coordinate Subject Matter Experts and stakeholders to prioritise problems, assign actions and drive timely resolution.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to completion, ensuring clear ownership and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate problem, task, RCA, workaround and Known Error records within the ITSM platform.
* Support the development, implementation and validation of permanent solutions and mitigation plans.
* Minimise incident recurrence and business impact through proactive trend analysis and continual improvement.
* Monitor problem ageing, service levels, dependencies, risks and implementation progress, escalating where required.
* Produce performance reports, trend insights and management presentations demonstrating process effectiveness and service outcomes.
* Collaborate with customers, internal teams and third-party suppliers to resolve cross-functional dependencies.
* Maintain and improve Problem Management policies, standards, procedures and governance controls.
* Quality-assure Problem Management outputs before publication to protect BT and customer interests.
* Provide structured recommendations, challenge decisions not supported by evidence and raise material risks.
* Promote a positive customer experience and strengthen confidence in the Problem Management process.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree with relevant experience in Problem Management or IT Service Management.
* ITIL V3/V4 Foundation certification; ITIL Intermediate or Expert certification preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business English, with strong customer communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams independently, including in high-pressure or challenging situations.
* Strong customer focus, professional judgement and commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience.
* Excellent presentation skills, including the ability to create executive-level slide decks and communicate complex information to varied audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation capabilities.
* Collaborative team player with a proactive approach to learning, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and confident working in a Windows environment.
* Desirable Skills
* Good understanding of IT infrastructure and networking technologies, including LAN, WAN, Wireless and IPT; voice-product knowledge is advantageous.
* Practical experience with Problem Management and root-cause analysis techniques, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone and Kepner-Tregoe.
* Ability to analyse operational data, identify trends and determine root causes using relevant statistical techniques.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, BMC, CA or HP.
* Ability to interpret customer requirements and apply procedures across standard and non-standard operational scenarios.
* Experience in producing and presenting service-performance insights, including trends, root causes, mitigation actions and service-level outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, operational processes, industry practices and continual improvement principles.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision, provide guidance to colleagues and share technical or process expertise.
* Proactive and adaptable approach, with strong priority management, professionalism and stakeholder networking skills.
* CCNA certification/knowledge is advantageous but not essential.
* Familiarity with AI tools and their effective use in regular work activities is desirable.

Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
  
  
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
  
  
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
  
  
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
