title: Production Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
The Monitoring Engineer is a hands‑on technical role responsible for the day‑to‑day administration, configuration, and maintenance of enterprise monitoring platforms, with a primary focus on New Relic.
  
  
The role supports the delivery of effective monitoring and observability across FNZ platforms by implementing agreed monitoring standards, maintaining tooling health, and ensuring monitoring configurations remain current and reliable.
  
  
This position works closely with Monitoring Architects, Senior Analysts, Production Support, and Engineering teams. Monitoring requirements, strategy, and design direction are driven by Architects and senior operational stakeholders; the Monitoring Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and supporting those requirements effectively.
  
  
The Monitoring Engineer plays a key role in ensuring monitoring tooling enables timely issue detection, efficient incident investigation, and improved platform reliability.
  
  
**Team Responsibilities**
The current climate has no tolerance for slow performance, broken functionality or downtime with a need for constant and clear visibility into the end-to-end performance of our production applications.
  
  
Application Monitoring – developing new and innovative solutions to our monitoring requirements.
  
  
Stakeholder Communication – ensuring all monitoring solutions are embedded into production BAU and handed over to our operational support teams.
  
  
Project management – Manage our monitoring solutions from design, build, test, implementation and handover. Our team follows a Devops model so we will maintain our tooling and build for any upgrades, defects or improvements after go live.
  
  
Service Level Management – support the Service Managers in delivering FNZ services within KPIs, SLAs and contractual obligations.
  
  
**Specific Role Responsibilities**
Administer and maintain New Relic monitoring components under guidance from Architects and Senior Analysts, including agent configuration, alert policies, dashboards, and integrations.
  
  
Ensure New Relic agents are installed, configured correctly, and upgraded in accordance with agreed schedules and standards.
  
  
Implement monitoring for new services, applications, or infrastructure following provided requirements and design guidance.
  
  
Assist in managing requests for new monitoring deployments or changes, ensuring they are implemented accurately and consistently.
  
  
Support the maintenance of alerting rules and thresholds to ensure they are meaningful, reliable, and aligned with operational needs.
  
  
Create and maintain dashboards and visualisations to support Production Support and Engineering teams.
  
  
Maintain accurate documentation, including setup guides, configuration details, and operational runbooks.
  
  
Support vendor support cases and escalations, including collecting evidence and implementing recommended fixes.
  
  
Assist in tooling health checks and reviews to ensure monitoring platforms remain operational and effective.
  
  
Where applicable, support monitoring configuration using Infrastructure‑as‑Code approaches (e.g. Terraform) under guidance.
  
  
**Leadership & Development**
Work collaboratively with Architects, Senior Analysts, and Engineers to understand monitoring requirements and implement solutions.
  
  
Develop and maintain technical knowledge of New Relic and associated monitoring capabilities.
  
  
Share monitoring knowledge and best practices with Production Support and Engineering teams.
  
  
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to improve monitoring quality and operational effectiveness.
  
  
Contribute to audit, risk, and operational assurance activities where required.
  
  
**Experience Required**
**What we are looking for:**
Minimum 5 years of experience in Monitoring, Production Support, Platform Operations, or similar technical roles.
  
  
Hands‑on experience working with New Relic or similar monitoring/observability tools.
  
  
Experience maintaining monitoring agents, integrations, dashboards, and alert configurations.
  
  
Understanding of basic observability concepts including metrics, logs, alerts, and service health.
  
  
Good technical troubleshooting skills and a methodical problem‑solving approach.
  
  
Strong attention to detail when implementing and maintaining tooling configurations.
  
  
Ability to follow architectural guidance and implement agreed standards consistently.
  
  
Clear written and verbal communication skills for documentation and team collaboration.
  
  
**Experience Preferred**
**Beneficial but not essential:**
Exposure to managing monitoring configuration at scale, including use of Terraform or similar tools.
  
  
Understanding of OTEL standards.
  
  
Experience working with operational tooling such as ServiceNow, PagerDuty, or Splunk.
  
  
Experience supporting monitoring in cloud, virtualised, or distributed environments.
  
  
Basic familiarity with application technologies such as .NET, APIs, SQL Server, or microservices.
  
  
Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments with formal change processes.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: General Manager – Land & Regulatory Affairs
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**General Manager – Land & Regulatory Affairs**

**Industry:**
Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Data Centres & Infrastructure

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Qualification:**
LLB / LLM (Preferred)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Salary Range:**
8-9 LPA CTC (based on last drawn)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad / Motera, Gujarat

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced professional to manage end-to-end land acquisition, legal due diligence, government liaisoning, statutory approvals and regulatory compliance for real estate, renewable energy, data centre, industrial and infrastructure projects. The role requires independent coordination with government authorities to ensure timely approvals and smooth project execution.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Land Acquisition & Legal Due Diligence**

·   Oversee end-to-end land identification, acquisition, purchase, leasing, title verification, due diligence, revenue records (7/12, 8A, Ferfar, property cards, NA orders), land conversion, mutation, zoning, tenure, demarcation, regulatory compliance and legal risk assessment with appropriate mitigation.

**B. Government Liaisoning & Statutory Approvals**

* Manage government liaisoning with revenue, municipal, development, utility and regulatory authorities (Collector, DILR, AUDA, AMC, GIDC, GEDA, GUVNL, DISCOMs, GETCO, GPCB, Fire and Environment Departments) for statutory approvals NOCs, licenses, building permissions, applications, inspections, representations and timely clearances.

**C. Regulatory & Project Compliance**

·      Manage end-to-end regulatory compliance, land-use, power connectivity, transmission, environmental, fire safety and utility approvals across real estate, renewable energy, solar, data center, industrial park and infrastructure projects, ensuring timely renewals, approval conditions and project-wise documentation.

**D. Legal Documentation & Dispute Management**

* Draft and review land-related agreements, title reports, legal opinions, affidavits, undertakings, notices and official representations, while managing land and revenue disputes in coordination with advocates and legal consultants.

**E. Team Coordination & Management Reporting**

·      Coordinate with management, internal departments, architects, surveyors, town planners and external consultants to ensure smooth project execution, timely approvals, resolution of bottlenecks and periodic progress reporting to management.

**F. Governance & Ethical Practices**

* Ensure transparent and legally compliant government dealings, maintain accurate records of official transactions and statutory payments through authorized channels, and safeguard confidential company and project information.

**3. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in Gujarat Land Revenue Laws, land records, acquisition, registration, NA permissions, zoning, land conversion, mutation, title verification, legal drafting, government liaisoning, statutory approvals and regulatory compliance, with practical knowledge of renewable energy, solar, data centres, real estate and infrastructure regulations, government portals, project management, approval tracking, negotiation and stakeholder coordination.

**4. Qualification & Experience**

* LLB/LLM from a recognized university with 5–8 years of relevant experience in land acquisition, legal affairs, revenue matters and government liaisoning; experience in real estate, renewable energy, solar, data centres or infrastructure projects preferred, with Bar Council enrolment as an added advantage and willingness to travel to project sites and government offices.

**5. Language Requirements**

* Excellent Gujarati and English verbal and written communication (mandatory), with Hindi as an added advantage, and the ability to independently coordinate with government officials, consultants and internal stakeholders.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of land acquisition and statutory approvals.
* Accuracy of legal documentation and government submissions.
* Effective follow-up and closure of pending applications.
* Compliance with approval conditions and statutory timelines.
* Early identification and resolution of legal and regulatory risks.
* Effective project coordination and management reporting.

**7. Preferred Candidate Profile**

A results-driven professional with extensive expertise in Gujarat Land Revenue Laws, land acquisition, government liaisoning and statutory compliance, capable of independently managing end-to-end land, legal and regulatory affairs while ensuring timely approvals and seamless execution of large-scale projects.

title: Specialty Sales Manager, Benign GYN
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign Gynecology across South & West India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
  
  
This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization
* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign Gynecology, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.
* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including benign hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, ovarian cystectomy, and other relevant procedures within the specialty.
* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.
* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.
* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.
* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.
* Convert High-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs
* Identify and prioritize high-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign Gynecology that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.
* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision-makers.
* Partner with Capital Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.
* Support the complete program-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care-team readiness, initial case-series support, patient pathway development, and post-launch growth planning.
* Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence
* Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.
* Create development plans for high-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, mentor sites, training centers, and peer-learning platforms.
* Coordinate appropriate case observation, on-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer-to-peer education in accordance with approved processes.
* Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.
* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.
* Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value
* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.
* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account-specific value discussions.
* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.
* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision-making and program expansion.
* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.
* Elevate Specialty Sales Competency
* Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign Gynecology anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.
* Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign Gynecology specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.
* Identify area-level capability gaps and coordinate competency-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.
* Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account-planning guidance, and best-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.
* Model high-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.
* Lead Cross-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence
* Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.
* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.
* Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.
* Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market-development experience.
* Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.
* Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.
* Proven ability to influence peers and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.
* Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.
* Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.
* Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in minimally invasive surgery, robotic-assisted surgery, benign gynecology, hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, or surgical capital equipment.
* Experience developing surgeon champions, KOLs, case observation sites, training programs, or centers of excellence.
* Experience building a new clinical market, converting established surgical practices, or launching a hospital program.
* Previous people-management experience or demonstrated readiness for broader leadership responsibility.
* Experience working with large hospital groups, academic institutions, or complex accounts in India.

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

description: The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have offices in India based out of Hyderabad, Gurugram, and Bengaluru.WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:The Financial Operations group is an integral part of our global operations. If hired, you will support one or more of the functions mentioned below.Tax - In this role, you will be required to prepare, review, and file D. E. Shaw’s hedge investment funds’ income tax returns and issue annual tax information (Sch. K-1s) to investors. You will review tax information to be included in various regulatory filings (tax audits, state tax returns, etc.) and interact with D. E. Shaw’s various Financial Operations teams and the Tax Planning team. You will prepare, review, and issue quarterly investor tax estimate statements. You will compute funds’ taxable income calculations/allocations for various D. E. Shaw hedge funds, as well as for investors, which include analyzing book-to-tax differences and various taxable income allocation methodologies. You will be expected to periodically compute various state taxes, pay state tax authorities, and address tax notices. Additionally, you will periodically present D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds’ taxable income analysis to senior management and address queries raised by investors on their taxable income calculations.Control Room & Governance - The CRG team is responsible for implementing and enforcing policies and procedures across multiple regulatory requirements, where you will be assisting front-office trading desks by conducting thorough research on the firm’s positions and applicable regulations for each asset class across jurisdictions through the deployment of advanced data analytics and data visualization techniques like statistical analysis, predictive modelling, clustering, etc., on tools like Power BI and others. You will also perform regulatory filing obligations, requiring complex quantitative and qualitative analysis of the firm’s short position and long ownership reports across US, UK, EU, Japan, etc. jurisdictions, and assist in monitoring and implementing controls designed to ensure compliance with global regulations by deploying various data analytics and visualization techniques. Additionally, you will be conducting thorough analysis on the fundamental research data collected by the trading groups through their interactions with external industry experts/consultants around various market sectors to avoid potential trading while in possession of material non-public information. Furthermore, you will be assisting with long-term projects to maintain the firm’s high standards of compliance with new and existing regulations.P&L Reporting - You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns and fees is accurate, timely, and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile, and allocate P&L, expenses, and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating, and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.Management Company Accounting - In this role, you will be expected to file management company financial statements, month close operations, and other regulatory reports including having these global management entities audited. You will also be responsible for driving technology projects to build tools for reporting and analyses, streamlining workflows, and improving stakeholder experience. Additionally, you will be collaborating with multiple teams, internal and external stakeholders (other financial operations teams, CFO, COO, BU heads, auditors, third-party service providers, etc.).WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:The ideal candidate should hold -Basic qualifications:A CA (Chartered Accountancy) degree with 0 to 2 years of work experience in the financial services industry or a large audit firmInterested candidates can apply through our website:https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/AnlSnrAnlFinOpsNov2026We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. title: Sr. Associate - Finance
description:
**About GoNanny**

Finding a reliable, trustworthy, and skilled nanny is one of the highest-anxiety problems for working parents in urban India. At GoNanny, we are solving this by productizing and professionalizing the largely unorganized blue-collar nanny ecosystem. We are a Consumer Tech startup which provides a structured, tech-enabled platform connecting parents with vetted, highly trained caregivers through clear, subscription-based models. We are bringing trust, transparency, and operational excellence to childcare.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, high-ownership Senior Associate – Finance to lead our day-to-day accounting, taxation, working capital management, and financial planning. In this role, you will be the custodian of our general ledger, ensure zero-defect statutory compliance (GST/TDS), streamline customer receivables and nanny/vendor payables, and work closely with leadership on budgets, MIS reporting, and financial modeling.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Core Accounting & Books Management

* Own day-to-day bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations in compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).
* Manage month-end and year-end book closures, ensuring accurate revenue recognition across subscription tiers (3-month, 6-month, and annual plans).
* Coordinate with external statutory auditors, secretarial auditors, and tax consultants for timely audits and ROC filings.

2. Accounts Receivable (AR) & Accounts Payable (AP)

* Receivables: Reconcile customer inflows across multiple channels (payment gateways like Razorpay, UPI, net banking, corporate B2B billings), track booking tokens, and resolve failed or disputed transactions.
* Payables: Manage end-to-end vendor payments, caregiver insurance/benefit disbursements, operational overheads, and office expenses.
* Oversee caregiver incentive structures, dynamic backup pay-outs, and ensure timely reconciliation of all operational disbursements.
* Monitor working capital cycles and flag any liquidity or cash burn discrepancies to the leadership team.

3. Statutory Compliance, GST Filing & Reconciliation

* Prepare and file monthly/quarterly statutory returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and annual GSTR-9/9C.
* Conduct regular GSTR-2B reconciliations to maximize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization and prevent tax leakages.
* Manage TDS compliance (deductions, challan payments, quarterly filings of Form 26Q/24Q, and issuance of Form 16/16A).
* Stay updated on evolving PF/ESI statutory wage ceilings, labor welfare fund requirements, and municipal regulations.

4. Budgeting, Financial Modeling & MIS

* Maintain and update GoNanny’s rolling financial models, tracking unit economics (CAC, LTV, CM1, CM2, and EBITDA).
* Build monthly Revenue MIS reports, departmental budget vs. actual (BvA) variance analyses, and cash-flow runway models.
* Provide analytical support during board meetings, monthly reviews, and upcoming institutional fundraising rounds.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Commerce/Finance (B.Com/BBA Finance); Semi-qualified CA (CA Inter) or CMA is strongly preferred.
* Experience: 3–5 years of proven experience handling core accounting, GST, and payables/receivables, preferably in a fast-paced startup, tech marketplace, or D2C/e-commerce environment.
* Taxation Mastery: Thorough practical knowledge of Indian GST laws, Input Tax Credit mechanics, and withholding taxes (TDS).
* Tools Proficiency: Advanced working knowledge of accounting platforms (Zoho Books, Tally Prime, or QuickBooks) and payment gateway merchant dashboards (Razorpay, Cashfree).
* Spreadsheet Modeling: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (financial modeling, nested formulas, pivot tables, data visualization).

title: Cost Accountant
description:
**About Us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Overview of the role**

Reporting to the Accounting Manager (India), the Cost Accountant will be a hands-on individual contributor responsible for executing core product costing, inventory accounting, and variance analysis activities in support of the Olde Thompson manufacturing business. This role sits within the offshore finance team and works in close coordination with the India-based Accounting Manager and US finance leadership. The Cost Accountant will be responsible for maintaining standard cost data in SAP, performing monthly costing runs, supporting inventory reconciliations, and producing costing MIS reports. The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of experience in a manufacturing or FMCG environment, holds a CMA qualification is comfortable working in a structured, deadline-driven, multi-entity setting with US-based stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Costing & Standard Costing**

* Maintain standard cost data in SAP (CK11N / CK40N), including cost estimates, cost roll-ups, and annual standard cost updates
* Execute standard costing runs for new and existing products in coordination with the Accounting Manager
* Review and validate Bills of Materials (BOM) in SAP, cross-verifying components,
* BOM changes and assess their impact on product costs
* Prepare product cost sheets and support techno-commercial costing for new product launches

**Variance Analysis**

* Perform monthly variance analysis comparing actual production costs against standard costs, covering material, labour, and overhead variances
* Investigate root causes of significant variances and prepare clear variance reports for review by the Accounting Manager
* Calculate raw material cost (RMC) percentages for mass production lines and identify lines where actual RMC exceeds standard benchmarks
* Prepare mix, price, and yield variance reports for raw materials against standard master batch specifications
* Support overhead variance analysis on a monthly basis

**Inventory Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly inventory validation including review of shop floor stock, stock in transit, pending GRNs, pending STOs, and WIP orders; post correcting entries as needed
* Reconcile system inventory against actual physical counts at month-end; record and investigate any gaps
* Support monthly and annual physical inventory counts and cycle counting processes
* Identify and report on slow-moving, obsolete, or scrap inventory; prepare scrap value tracking reports and compare against standard scrap cost sheets
* Maintain raw material margin summaries, categorizing domestic and export products by sales value

**Material Ledger & Month-End Close**

* Execute Material Ledger (ML) runs in SAP to support actual costing and price difference settlement
* Perform COPA entries for product profitability and margin analysis
* Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process by completing assigned costing tasks within group deadlines
* Prepare and maintain profitability analysis reports for key product lines as directed by the Accounting Manager

**MIS Reporting**

* Prepare monthly costing MIS reports covering inventory validation, product costing, NRV workings, profit elimination.
* Compile monthly raw material margin and profitability summaries for management review
* Support preparation of cost reports to assist the Accounting Manager and US Finance Manager in decision-making

**Audit & Compliance Support**

* Assist with internal and statutory audit queries by providing costing data, reconciliations, and documentation in a timely manner
* Support GST compliance activities as required, including input tax credit reconciliations and filing support
* Ensure all costing records and documentation are audit-ready and maintained to a high standard

**Ad-hoc Support**

* Support annual budgeting and standard cost planning for manufacturing and operational expenses
* Assist with process improvement initiatives, including automation and standardization of costing workflows
* Provide ad hoc support to the Accounting Manager and US finance team as required

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance (B.Com or M.Com) required
* CMA (Cost & Management Accountant) qualification from ICAI strongly preferred.
* 4-6 years of hands-on experience in product costing, standard costing, or management accounting, preferably in a manufacturing, FMCG, or food & beverage environment
* Practical experience with SAP CO module, including CK11N, CK40N, Material Ledger, and COPA; SAP experience is strongly preferred
* Solid working knowledge of BOM structures, standard vs. actual costing, and inventory valuation principles
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis
* Familiarity with IFRS accounting standards; knowledge of US GAAP is an advantage
* Working knowledge of Indian indirect tax (GST) and TDS compliance
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to identify and investigate variances
* Good written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable participating in calls with US-based stakeholders
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, month-end driven environment

**Work Environment & Additional Details**

* Location: India (city TBD / remote-eligible)
* Reporting Line: Accounting Manager, India
* Working Hours: Some overlap with US Central Time required for periodic calls and reporting deadlines

title: Finance Costing COE Data & Transformation Lead
description:
**Description -**
HP is launching a
**Costing Transformation Program**
to simplify, standardize and modernize costing across the company. The program will establish a consistent enterprise framework and governance, enabling
**faster insights, greater pricing agility and better business decisions**
.
  
  
Our ambition is to create a
**unified, globally harmonized Fully Burdened Cost ecosystem**
that connects costing with pricing, supply chain and financial processes. The future-state model will provide greater end-to-end visibility, agility and control, while maintaining the financial integrity and compliance required to support HP’s future growth.
  
  
At the center of the transformation, HP is establishing a Finance-led
**Costing Center of Excellence (CoE)**
responsible for enterprise costing standards, methodologies, process design, governance and business alignment. The CoE will partner closely with Personal Systems, Print, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Digital, Pricing and other business and functional teams.
  
  
We are looking for individuals with a
**strong costing and/or Supply Chain cost-accounting background**
who are excited about the opportunity to
**challenge the status quo and shape how costing should work at HP in the future**
. This is not a lift-and-shift of today’s processes into new technology. CoE team members will help simplify existing complexity, challenge legacy practices, harmonize processes and methodologies, and translate deep costing expertise into scalable solutions.
  
  
**As an early member of the Costing CoE, you will not simply join an established organization. You will help build it, shape its operating model and influence one of HP’s key Finance transformations from the ground up.**
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Strong product-costing and cost-accounting background, with a solid understanding of how product costs are developed, maintained, analyzed and used in business decisions.
* Experience with standard cost, material cost, bill-of-material cost structures, cost rollups, burden and overhead rates, allocation methodologies, purchase-price impacts, manufacturing costs and cost variances.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end costing dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Management, Engineering, Pricing and Digital.
* Ability to assess current-state processes, identify unnecessary complexity and design simplified, standardized future-state solutions.
* Hands-on problem-solving capability, including the ability to independently analyze data and processes, develop recommendations, document future-state requirements and drive implementation.
* Experience working across functions and geographies, with strong communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to challenge established practices constructively and distinguish genuine business-model requirements from legacy process preferences.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work with large, complex product and costing data sets.
* Experience supporting process transformation, ERP implementation, systems modernization or enterprise operating-model change.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, data traceability, reconciliation and auditability.

**Preferred Profile**

* Deep Personal Systems costing experience is strongly preferred, including knowledge of PS product structures, SKU and AV complexity, bills of material, commodity cost movements, product lifecycle events and hardware-costing processes.
* Supply Chain cost-accounting experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience connecting operational cost drivers with financial costing and accounting outcomes.

* Familiarity with HP costing processes, tools, data structures and current organizational handoffs.

title: Assistant Director - Assistant Director - Strategic Finance & Business Insights
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Advanced Strategic Insights**
**The opportunity**
As part of the Advanced Strategic Insights team, you will convert complex financial, operational and market information into clear, decision-relevant insights for GDS leadership. The role will support enterprise-wide priorities by identifying performance trends, developing hypotheses, evaluating strategic choices and translating analysis into concise executive narratives. Success requires strong financial acumen, advanced analytical capability and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through evidence-based insights.
  
  
**The role**
This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibility. The Assistant Director will independently lead the development of advanced strategic insights across business performance, growth, operating model, workforce and transformation priorities.
  
  
The individual will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to frame ambiguous questions, integrate multiple data sources and deliver recommendations that inform strategic and commercial decisions. The role requires leadership through subject-matter expertise, influence and ownership of complex deliverables rather than through formal team management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead high-impact strategic insight engagements across growth, financial performance, market expansion, operating model, workforce, location strategy, alliances and transformation priorities.
* Frame business questions, develop hypotheses and structure analytical approaches that move beyond descriptive reporting to explain drivers, implications and potential actions.
* Analyse financial and operational performance, including revenue, cost, margin, productivity, utilization, investment, capacity and other relevant business metrics.
* Build robust financial models, scenario analyses, sensitivity assessments and business cases to evaluate strategic choices and quantify financial impact.
* Synthesise large and complex datasets into clear trends, insights, risks, opportunities and leadership-level recommendations.
* Develop executive-ready PowerPoint presentations with a compelling storyline, message-led headlines and clear articulation of the so what.
* Create and maintain advanced Excel-based analytical models, trackers and decision-support tools with strong data integrity and quality controls.
* Conduct external research, benchmarking and competitive intelligence, triangulating evidence and clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and hypotheses.
* Partner with Finance, Strategy, Operations, Talent and Service Line stakeholders to validate analysis, align interpretations and shape decision options.
* Present insights to senior leaders, respond to challenge constructively and refine analysis based on leadership priorities.
* Establish repeatable insight frameworks, templates and analytical standards that improve the quality, consistency and speed of decision support.
* Provide subject-matter guidance and constructive review to colleagues where required, without formal line-management accountability.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong financial acumen and the ability to interpret financial statements, management information and business performance metrics.
* Advanced Excel capability, including financial modelling, scenario analysis, complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation and management of large datasets.
* Advanced PowerPoint skills, with demonstrated ability to translate analysis into concise, visually clear and executive-ready narratives.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect data points, identify root causes and surface decision-relevant implications.
* Strong business writing, communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgement and take end-to-end ownership of complex insight deliverables.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, prioritise competing asks and manage multiple insight requirements in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity and a strong commitment to data accuracy and evidence-based conclusions.
* Effective stakeholder management, collaboration and influencing skills across functions and geographies.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in finance, strategy, business planning, commercial finance, management reporting, corporate development, transaction advisory or a related analytical role.
* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree such as CA, CMA, CFA or MBA (Finance), or a comparable qualification supported by relevant experience.
* Substantial hands-on experience in financial analysis, financial modelling, business case development and performance diagnostics.
* Proven experience using Excel and PowerPoint to deliver analysis and recommendations for senior leadership.

**Job Description:**
The Manager, Financial Operations provides financial operations support for evidence generation studies, including budget tracking, purchase order and invoice coordination, reconciliation support, variance monitoring, payment follow-up, and audit-ready documentation. **About the Role:**
The Manager, Financial Operations maintains the day-to-day financial operations required to support the Global Medical Evidence Generation portfolio. Working across Study Operations, Global Evidence Generation, Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and study owners, the role coordinates purchase order and invoice workflows, maintains reliable financial records, monitors open items, and escalates exceptions to the appropriate owner. The role contributes to consistent, scalable, and compliant ways of working while preserving appropriate human review and decision authority.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**

* Escalate budget variances, scope changes, invoice mismatches, payment delays, approval exceptions, and documentation gaps to the appropriate owner.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, Study Operations, and Global Evidence Generation to resolve routing, documentation, and payment issues.
* Support process improvements that reduce cycle-time delays, rework, and documentation inconsistencies.
* Use approved digital, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities, where appropriate, to support financial tracking, exception identification, and reporting while maintaining validation, traceability, data privacy, and human oversight.

* Ability to maintain accurate trackers, dashboards, documentation packages, and audit-ready financial records.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to coordinate across Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and global study owners.

The role also extends to the review & oversight of SPV financial statements and reporting, ensuring accuracy, compliance with accounting standards and alignment with the fund’s overall financial & regulatory requirements.

* Oversee the end-to-end capital call and distribution process ensuring timely execution and accuracy of calculations.

title: Manager, CCR Stress Testing
description:
**Job Summary**

* The successful candidate for this position will play a key role in executing the stress test models in relation to Central & Others (excluding treasury) in the Bank’s stress test exercises. He/She will be responsible for maintenance, execution & enhancement of a suite of Central & Others excluding Treasury models – Opex, Tax, Other Banking, OR RWA, Leverage, Bank Levy, et al.
* This will include Bank-of-England (BOE), Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) – Group and Countries, Resolution Planning, Recovery Planning for the Group.
* In addition, he/she should be able to provide valuable inputs to help identify opportunities to improve on stress testing current processes and own quantitative changes and change requests.
* Responsible for the stress testing data sourcing and preparations, methodological calculations including the use of existing infrastructure and technology, producing quantitative charts and packs and other related requirements.
* Deliver a high quality Structured Template Data (STDF) Templates, as per the requirements set out by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) in the Bank of England (BoE) stress test.

title: Legal Strategy and Compliance Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description :**

**About the Function:**

Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.

Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.

It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.

You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only guides in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.

**About the role**

Support the development and operation of a high-performing Legal function, providing the structure, insight and delivery capability needed to help the global Legal function operate simply, efficiently and consistently.

The role will work across the Legal and Compliance Operations agenda, helping translate functional priorities and transformation ambitions into practical and sustainable improvements in how Legal work is prioritised, accessed, handled and delivered.

Working across Legal and with enterprise partners, the role will support initiatives spanning operating model and governance, transformation delivery, service and process improvement, resource optimisation, data and performance, technology and AI enablement, and knowledge and capability.

The role is intentionally broad and will flex across priorities as the Legal and Compliance Operations agenda develops. It will suit someone who is comfortable working in a consulting-style environment: structuring ambiguous problems, developing solutions, mobilising stakeholders and translating ideas into measurable and sustainable operational change.

Key Accountabilities

1. Support the Legal and Compliance Operations operating model and embedding of the transformation agenda: Help develop and operate the frameworks, governance and management subject areas that enable Legal and Compliance Operations to support the wider Legal function effectively. Support the prioritisation and delivery of transformation initiatives, bringing structure to complex problems, coordinating stakeholders and dependencies, and helping translate strategic priorities into executable plans and sustainable change.

2. Drive service delivery and process completion: Identify and deliver opportunities to improve how Legal services are accessed, handled and delivered. Apply structured problem-solving and process-improvement approaches to simplify and standardise processes, remove inefficiency and improve the experience of teams and their internal clients. Support the development of scalable service models, including intake and triage, workflows, self-service, shared services and alternative delivery approaches.

3. Enable technology, automation and AI-led improvement: Identify and support opportunities to use technology, automation and AI to improve Legal and Compliance Operations services, processes and ways of working. Work with Legal teams, Business Integrity and D&T and other partners to understand business needs, develop use cases and requirements, evaluate potential solutions and support implementation, adoption and value realisation. Support the effective management and development of Legal and Compliance technology solutions and vendors, ensuring they remain aligned to functional needs, transformation priorities and the wider technology landscape.

4. Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible project and delivery support across the breadth of the Legal and Compliance Operations agenda, including Business Integrity, responding to evolving functional priorities and areas where additional capability is required. This could include initiatives relating to service delivery and intake, external resource management, knowledge management, technology and AI, data and analytics, financial and resource effectiveness, governance, the Business Integrity Spirit of Integrity Framework, , shared services, supplier management, compliance programme operations and other Legal and Compliance Operations capabilities. Lead or support projects from problem definition and analysis through to solution design, implementation and embedding, working across Legal and with relevant functional and enterprise partners, such as Business Integrity.

5. Develop performance, insight and monitoring capabilities: Support the development of data, management information, KPIs and supervising approaches that provide greater visibility of Legal and Business Integrity demand, activity, critical metrics, performance and operational effectiveness.

Key Competencies

1. Structured Problem Solving, Transformation and Delivery:Brings structure to complex and ambiguous problems, using strong analytical and problem-solving skills to move from diagnosis and insight through to practical solutions and implementation. Able to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, manage multiple workstreams and dependencies, and maintain momentum through to measurable and sustainable outcomes.

2. Process, Technology and Continuous Improvement:Strong continuous-improvement mentality, with the ability to understand how services and processes operate and find opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and improve them. Comfortable working with data, technology, automation and AI as enablers of transformation, and able to bridge efficiently between business needs, users and technical specialists.

3. Customer Engagement, Influence and Change:Builds strong relationships and works optimally across functions, subject areas and levels of seniority in a complex global environment. Able to influence without direct authority, challenge constructively, facilitate and communicate complex issues clearly, and bring diverse stakeholders together to design, deliver and embed new ways of working.

**Experience/skills required:**

Experience in consulting, professional services, transformation, legal operations, compliance operations or a comparable operational role; Big Four or equivalent experience would be particularly relevant.

Shown experience delivering transformation, process improvement or technology-enabled change from problem definition through to implementation.

Strong analytical, project delivery and stakeholder-management skills, with experience working across multiple teams and priorities.

Experience within Legal, Business Integrity, Compliance, or another professional-services environment would be advantageous but is not crucial.

**Working with Us**

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

Regular

Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

title: Operation Lead - South Zone
description:
**Designation:** Operations Lead – South Zone  
**Location:** Bangalore (S.R. Nagar)  
**Experience:** 5–8 years in Logistics Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Lead to oversee and manage logistics operations across the South Zone. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring seamless branch operations, shipment movement, service efficiency, cost optimization, vendor management, and adherence to company SOPs.

The ideal candidate should have strong operational knowledge of air and surface logistics, multi-branch management, and regional network operations.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Zonal Operations Management**

* Oversee day-to-day logistics operations across all branches within the South Zone.
* Ensure smooth pickup, dispatch, transit, and delivery operations.
* Monitor air and surface shipment movements and ensure timely connectivity.
* Coordinate with branch teams, hubs, and other zones for seamless operations.

**2. Service Performance & Compliance**

* Monitor operational KPIs, TAT, SLA compliance, and delivery performance.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and operational policies.
* Monitor pending shipments, PODs, delivery exceptions, and operational escalations.

**3. Vendor & Network Management**

* Manage and coordinate with transporters, co-loaders, delivery partners, and other operational vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, service quality, and operational costs.
* Identify alternative vendors and connectivity options to improve service efficiency.
* Ensure adequate vehicle and manpower availability as per operational requirements.

**4. Cost Control & Process Improvement**

* Monitor branch-level operational expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Optimize route planning, shipment consolidation, and network utilization.
* Identify and minimize revenue leakage and unnecessary operational expenses.
* Drive process improvements to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.

**5. Team Management**

* Lead, guide, and monitor branch operations teams across the South Zone.
* Ensure proper manpower planning and resource utilization.
* Conduct regular operational reviews and branch visits.
* Provide training and guidance to improve team performance and accountability.

**6. Customer & Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with CRM, Sales, Accounts, and other internal departments.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer escalations and operational issues.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for senior management.
* Maintain proactive communication regarding operational challenges and service performance.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Logistics or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in logistics and express cargo operations.
* Strong working knowledge of air and surface logistics.
* Experience in handling multi-branch or regional operations.
* Sound knowledge of the South Zone logistics network and geographical connectivity.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and cost-control skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, and logistics management software.
* Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel across South Zone branches as required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time pickup and delivery performance.
* TAT and SLA compliance.
* Operational cost optimization.
* Pending shipment and POD clearance.
* Vendor performance and network efficiency.
* Branch productivity and SOP compliance.
* Customer escalation resolution.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Program Manager – Fulfilment & Experience (Strategic Initiatives) ( Kirana Club)
description:
**About Kirana Club**
---------------------

India has over 12 million kirana stores, and most still depend on traditional wholesale markets to source products for their shops.  
  
Kirana Club is changing how these retailers discover, source, and replenish inventory. With 4 million+ kiranas on the platform, we're building a commerce marketplace that connects retailers directly with brands and sellers.  
  
Now part of the Meesho family, we're entering our next phase of growth, with an opportunity to rethink how B2B commerce and fulfilment work at scale.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, is exceptionally comfortable with numbers, and can turn ideas into real-world outcomes.  
  
You'll work on some of the most important medium-term initiatives in our fulfilment and supply chain business — projects that can fundamentally improve our cost structure, delivery experience, and ability to serve retailers across India.  
  
This is a high-ownership individual contributor role, not a traditional operations management position.

### **What you'll work on**

* 3PL allocation and optimization: Rethink how orders get allocated across logistics partners to improve delivery success, speed, and cost per delivered order.
* New fulfilment models: Experiment with initiatives like retailer self-pickup, alternative delivery networks, and new ways of reducing logistics costs.
* Supply chain economics: Analyze shipping costs, RTOs, delivery performance, and operational data to identify opportunities for meaningful improvements.
* 0-to-1 experiments: Take new ideas from hypothesis to pilot, evaluate results, and build a plan for scaling what works.
* Cross-functional execution: Work closely with Product, Tech, Analytics, Operations, and external partners to translate solutions into live implementations.

The problems will evolve as the business scales. You'll be expected to adapt, learn quickly, and take ownership of new challenges.

### **What we're looking for**

* Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You should be able to break down problems, work with data, and make sound decisions.
* Structured, first-principles problem solving, especially when information is incomplete.
* Excellent prioritization: knowing what matters, what can wait, and how to get to an answer quickly.
* High ownership and bias for action. You don't just recommend solutions; you make them happen.
* Ability to independently drive projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where problems are not always clearly defined.
* Experience in business strategy, analytics, program management, or strategic operations. Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or logistics is a plus.

### **Why this role**

You'll get to work on problems where a single successful initiative can materially change the economics of the business.  
  
This is an opportunity to build new fulfilment models, solve problems at scale, and work closely with the leadership team on initiatives that directly shape Kirana Club's growth.

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

The TPM Analyst will work with Market team to understand sales growth and profit objectives (Volume, Net Revenue, Profit – both for PepsiCo and the Customer), and building effective relationships with the and maintain planning models in Trade Promotion Management (TPM) sales system. In addition, the role will be completing regular CDA and trade spend reconciliation reviews. Finally, the role will have responsibility for ensuring the forecast is accurate and reflects the latest customer planning.

Responsibilities:

* Building and maintaining TPM planning models
* Ensuring that aligned events that require on-ticket pricing changes and/or off-ticket adjustments are entered into all applicable systems in a timely manner (TPM)
* Manage expectations through verbal and written interactions with internal teams
* Ensure delivery of accurate and timely data in accordance with agreed service level agreements (SLA)
* Work across multiple functions to aid in collecting insights for action-oriented cause of change analysis
* Ability to focus against speed of execution and quality of service delivery rather than achievement of SLAs
* Recognize opportunities and take action to improve delivery of work
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology (Automation)

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/marketing or Finance, Master’s degree is a plus
* Prior Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) company experience required
* Analytical Skills: Ability to understand and translate delivery performance, identify opportunity & risks, and adjust develop and implement detailed accurate forecasts for demand/supply team
* Communication: Strong communication skills and collaboration skills
* Time Management/Organization: Solid capability to manage and prioritize schedule
* Support Systems Literacy: Computer literacy, Excel, Power Point, Word, ERT, Business Objects & SAP/ERP, willingness and ability to learn/quickly adapt to other internal support PepsiCo software systems
* Communication Skills: Communication across all formats (meetings, presentation, conference, planning session, weekly calls, direct communication with field, etc.)
* Strong Change Management Skills: Follow Up, Follow Through, Accountability, Sense of Urgency and superior customer service
* Ability to provide new ways of approaching situations and developing new efficient solutions
* Independent & motivated individual; ability to receive direction and convert into an action plan with coaching and feedback
* Develops strong relationships/partnership for overall success of the team & customer

title: Senior Software Engineer/AWS
description:
**Job Details**
---------------

Location:

Hyderabad, Telangāna, IN

Category:

Information Technology

Employment Type:

Full time
