R2627946-333

IND Senior Software Engineer - GCC024

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

AWS - Cloud Engineer

Tier – 8B

2-6 Years

*Customer Experience Platform Engineering*

  

Role Summary

We are seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate, and support cloud-native customer experience capabilities within an Amazon Connect-powered contact center ecosystem. This role uses AWS services, APIs, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code to extend Amazon Connect and deliver seamless experiences across voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent workflows, analytics, and enterprise systems. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AWS engineering expertise with experience in contact center technologies, customer journey design, and the operational needs of a large-scale customer experience platform. We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset and expect engineers to use AI-assisted practices responsibly to improve speed, quality, and innovation.

Technical Skills Framework

Primary skills are the tools and capabilities used by the team to perform the role. Each definition describes the core skill and its application within the Amazon Connect contact center ecosystem. Comparable skillsets represent adjacent experience that may transfer and accelerate onboarding, but are not technically aligned to the team’s current way of working.

Primary Skills

Skill

Definition

Comparable skillset

Lambda

Build scalable serverless applications, APIs, routing extensions, workflow services, and event-driven integrations that enhance Amazon Connect and support customer and agent experiences.

Azure Functions; Google Cloud Functions

TypeScript

Develop maintainable, strongly typed services and integrations that support customer journeys, contact center workflows, and enterprise connectivity.

Python; JavaScript

AWS Services

Engineer cloud-native capabilities using S3, DynamoDB, KMS, EventBridge, IAM, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and related services to support interaction processing, notifications, orchestration, analytics, and secure integration with Amazon Connect.

Comparable Azure or Google Cloud services

CDK

Implement Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK to automate consistent, secure deployment and management of Amazon Connect supporting services and customer experience capabilities.

CloudFormation; Terraform

API Gateway

Design, secure, and manage REST and HTTP APIs that connect Amazon Connect, agent experiences, enterprise systems, and third-party contact center technologies.

APIGEE; APIC

Secondary Skills

Skill

Definition

Comparable skillset

Flows

Understand Amazon Connect contact flow design, customer journeys, routing strategies, integration points, and troubleshooting so cloud services work effectively within end-to-end contact center experiences.

Genesys Architect; NICE Studio; Five9 Studio; Cisco CVP

Connect Desktop

Understand Amazon Connect agent desktop configuration, routing profiles, agent workflows, and operational processes so cloud-native capabilities integrate seamlessly into the agent experience.

Genesys Cloud administration; NICE CXone administration; Five9 administration

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Platform Engineering

* Design and develop cloud-native capabilities that extend Amazon Connect functionality and improve customer and agent experiences.

* Build services that enable customer self-service, routing enhancements, agent productivity, interaction processing, workflow orchestration, notifications, authentication, analytics, and experience optimization.

* Partner with Connect Engineers, Product Owners, architects, and business stakeholders to implement end-to-end customer journeys using Amazon Connect and supporting AWS services.

* Translate contact center and customer experience needs into scalable, reusable, and supportable technical capabilities.

Contact Center Ecosystem Integration

* Develop APIs, event-driven services, and integration patterns that connect Amazon Connect with enterprise systems and third-party contact center technologies.

* Build integrations supporting voice, chat, email, messaging, customer authentication, outbound communications, workforce processes, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities.

* Integrate contact center workflows with customer, policy, claims, knowledge, workforce, communication, reporting, and other enterprise platforms.

* Contribute to migration and modernization initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform scalability.

Cloud-Native Application Development

* Design, develop, test, and support serverless applications, APIs, microservices, and reusable platform services using Lambda, TypeScript, and related AWS technologies.

* Use event-driven and asynchronous patterns to process contact events, coordinate workflows, and decouple Amazon Connect from downstream systems.

* Design for resilience, scalability, performance, recoverability, security, and cost efficiency across the customer interaction lifecycle.

Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps

* Implement Amazon Connect supporting infrastructure and AWS services using CDK and repeatable deployment patterns.

* Build and maintain CI/CD automation, testing, quality gates, security scanning, and environment promotion processes.

* Apply least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and enterprise cloud governance standards.

API and Integration Engineering

* Design, secure, version, document, and operate APIs used by contact flows, agent applications, customer channels, and enterprise systems.

* Apply authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, observability, and governance standards.

* Evaluate integration alternatives and document architectural decisions and tradeoffs based on customer experience, operational, and technical requirements.

Platform Operations and Optimization

* Monitor production services and end-to-end contact center integrations, respond to incidents, and restore customer and agent capabilities.

* Use telemetry to identify customer journey failures, integration issues, performance constraints, and improvement opportunities.

* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements that increase reliability, recoverability, and operational supportability.

* Optimize cloud consumption while protecting customer experience, platform performance, and service resilience.

AI-First Engineering

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance.

* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to routing, self-service, agent support, analytics, and engineering productivity.

Agile Delivery and Product Ownership

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Connect Engineers, architects, analysts, and Agile team members to refine requirements and user stories.

* Participate in planning, stand-ups, refinement, retrospectives, and demonstrations.

* Deliver working, production-ready customer experience capabilities aligned with sprint and program commitments.

* Use customer feedback, operational insights, and platform telemetry to continuously improve solutions.

Quality, Security, and Operational Excellence

* Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, contract, and regression tests appropriate to contact center services and integrations.

* Participate in code and design reviews and follow established engineering standards.

* Apply secure coding, privacy, data protection, cloud security, and enterprise compliance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Demonstrate end-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement.

Required Experience

* Hands-on experience building cloud-native applications, integrations, or platform services using AWS.

* Experience with contact center technologies or customer experience platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Five9, Cisco, or comparable platforms.

* Experience integrating contact center channels, routing, agent workflows, customer self-service, or interaction data with enterprise applications and services.

* Experience with Lambda, TypeScript or a comparable development language, API design, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code.

* Experience supporting production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and root cause analysis.

Professional Skills

* Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills

* Ability to understand customer journeys and translate contact center needs into cloud-native solutions

* Clear communication and effective collaboration across product, operations, architecture, Connect engineering, and enterprise technology teams

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment

* End-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience integrating AWS services with Amazon Connect

* Experience building capabilities for voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent desktop, workforce, or conversation analytics use cases

* Experience with contact center migration or large-scale customer experience platform transformation

* Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous integration patterns

* Experience with Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CloudWatch, Splunk, or comparable delivery and observability platforms

* AWS Developer, Solutions Architect, or relevant Amazon Connect certification

Success Profile

* Delivers cloud-native capabilities that measurably improve customer and agent experiences.

* Builds scalable, secure, and resilient integrations that extend Amazon Connect.

* Demonstrates understanding of customer journeys, contact center operations, and the consequences of service failures.

* Creates reusable AWS services and patterns that accelerate delivery across the Customer Experience Platform.

* Balances customer experience, delivery speed, operational reliability, security, cost, and long-term architectural integrity.

* Uses AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and innovation.

* Creates momentum by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions, and partnering across Connect, cloud, product, and operations teams.

title: Curated Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description - Curated Experience (Executive)
  
Role Summary
  
The Curated Experience Executive shall work closely in co-ordination with the Curated Experience Sr. Executive ensuring visibility and presence on a day-to-day requirement & ensure organization associates and visitors are welcomed, valued, and taken care of at every stage while they are in the office.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Guest Experience
  
The Executive is the first face a colleague sees and the last impression a guest carries with them. This means expressing warmth and professionalism at reception or entry, greeting people with care, and creating an atmosphere where every individual feels that their presence matters. Beyond the greeting, the Executive takes ownership of the physical readiness of the workplace by conducting regular and thorough checks of meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, pantries, and common areas to ensure everything is clean, stocked, and ready for use before it is needed. Responding to ad-hoc colleague requests is done promptly and with a helpful spirit, and feedback collected during daily interactions is documented accurately and shared with the Sr. Executive to drive meaningful resolutions.
  
  
Operational Support
  
The Executive plays an active role in keeping daily operations flowing smoothly. Service requests are logged, tracked, and followed through to full resolution, with timely status updates provided to colleagues along the way. Daily site inspections are conducted with a watchful eye, identifying maintenance issues, supply gaps, or safety concerns before they escalate. Routine matters are channeled to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive, while safety or security concerns are escalated directly and immediately to the Facility Manager / Security Team. Trackers, logs, and basic operational reports are maintained with accuracy and consistency.
  
  
Conference & Event Support
  
Executive ensures every room is set up to the highest standard viz., equipment tested, AV confirmed, refreshments in place (where requested), and the space reset promptly after every meeting concludes. For workplace events, training sessions, and engagement activities, the Executive provides dedicated on-ground support, working alongside the Sr. Executive to deliver a seamless experience for every attendee.
  
  
Colleague Engagement & Onboarding
  
Executive shall play a central role in making new hires feel genuinely at home from day one. Leading the site orientation tours, introducing colleagues to amenities, explaining workplace policies, and setting a warm and welcoming tone are all core to this responsibility. All colleague enquiries, whether received in person, via email or through chat are acknowledged and responded to within one business day. Executive also takes an active approach to learning by shadowing the Curated Experience Sr. Executive across site functions, building both capability and confidence within the Workplace Services environment.
  
  
Feedback & Continuous Improvement
  
Executive shall gather real-time experience feedback from colleagues and stakeholders during daily interactions, tours, and events, and document it accurately using designated trackers. This feedback need to be shared promptly with the Sr. Executive for review and closure, and the Executive follows up on minor items to confirm resolution. Beyond reactive feedback, Executive proactively reviews the service patterns, whether supply shortages, AV readiness issues, or space concerns contributing meaningfully to a culture of continuous improvement that elevates the experience for everyone.
  
  
Transport & Commute Support
  
Executive serves as a trusted first point of contact for routine transport and commute queries, helping colleagues (especially new hires) navigate shuttle schedules, parking allocations, and booking protocols with confidence and ease. Complex issues, complaints, or service disruptions are escalated promptly to the Sr. Executive or the Transport team, ensuring no colleague is left without a resolution.
  
  
Additional Workplace Responsibilities
  
Executive supports visitor badging, temporary access requests, and compliance with site security protocols, ensuring access is managed seamlessly and in accordance with established guidelines. Workplace policies including clean desk standards, appropriate use of shared spaces, and visitor management are reinforced in a friendly, hospitality first manner that reflects the values of the Curated Experience team. Contractors and vendors on site are supported with basic orientation and access to amenities, ensuring their presence is well-integrated and non-disruptive. Throughout all of this, Executive remains observant and proactive, flagging risks, hazards, or service concerns to the Sr. Executive or Facility Manager without delay.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Education & Experience:**  
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is preferred with Two to three years of experience in hospitality, customer service, front desk management, facilities coordination, or a closely related field. Candidates who bring a passion for people are strongly encouraged to apply, even if their background spans multiple industries.
  
  
**Skills & Competencies:**  
The ideal candidate is warm, approachable, and genuinely service-oriented, someone who takes pride in the details and finds satisfaction in making others feel cared for. Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and composure to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment are essential. Cultural sensitivity, patience under pressure, and the ability to de-escalate situations with grace are highly valued. A collaborative spirit, a strong willingness to learn and grow, and proficiency in the Microsoft Office including Teams, Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  
  
Working Hours
  
Flexibility to support early morning or late evening / night activities is required based on site needs, including shift-based working arrangements where applicable.

**We're looking for someone who**

* Has 5-7 years of experience in FMCG Sales, RTM/GTM, Customer Development Excellence, Sales Strategy or Distribution Development

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

title: Senior Manager – End-to-End Gifting Operations & Fulfilment
description:
**Company:**
TOFAA India

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience:**
7–12 years

**Department:**
Operations

About TOFAA

TOFAA is a corporate gifting consultancy and management company that curates, customises, and delivers gifting experiences for leading companies across India.

We manage corporate, festive, luxury, employee, and PR gifting projects, working with a diverse network of vendors, manufacturers, artisans, and logistics partners.

Unlike conventional businesses that operate with a fixed product catalogue, our gifting orders are highly dynamic. Every client may have a completely different combination of products, customisation, packaging, vendors, and delivery requirements.

We are looking for a seasoned operations leader who can manage this complexity and build a highly disciplined, reliable, and scalable fulfilment operation.

The Role

We are looking for a
**Senior Operations Manager who can take complete ownership of TOFAA's gifting orders from order handover to final delivery.**

This is a high-responsibility role where every order matters. Our clients include senior business leaders, corporate decision-makers, and high-value individual recipients. A delay, incorrect product, missing item, wrong customisation, or packaging error can significantly impact the client experience and our reputation.

The person in this role must be experienced in managing fast-paced, high-pressure operations involving multiple products, vendors, teams, dependencies, and strict deadlines.

You will be responsible for ensuring that every order is planned correctly, executed systematically, quality-checked thoroughly, and delivered as committed.

**The expectation is not just to manage operations, but to build an operation where errors are prevented through strong processes, controls, accountability, and execution discipline.**

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Order Ownership

* Take ownership of all gifting orders handed over by the Sales team.
* Manage the complete order lifecycle, from approved handover to procurement, production, packaging, quality control, dispatch, and delivery.
* Ensure every order has a clear execution plan, timeline, owner, and delivery commitment.
* Track all orders simultaneously without losing visibility of individual requirements.
* Ensure that no order progresses with incomplete specifications, unclear responsibilities, or unresolved critical dependencies.
* Maintain complete accountability for order status, execution quality, and timely delivery.

2. High-Pressure Operations Management

* Manage multiple gifting orders running simultaneously with different products, vendors, quantities, customisations, and deadlines.
* Build an operations rhythm that supports rapid execution without compromising quality.
* Prioritise orders based on delivery commitments, client importance, operational dependencies, and risk.
* Identify bottlenecks early and take corrective action before they affect delivery.
* Handle last-minute changes, vendor failures, production delays, and urgent client requirements.
* Make quick, practical decisions under pressure while maintaining commercial and quality discipline.

3. Procurement & Vendor Coordination

* Work closely with the sourcing and procurement team to ensure timely availability of every required gifting element.
* Manage procurement planning for both standard and highly customised products.
* Ensure vendor commitments are realistic and aligned with order deadlines.
* Monitor vendor performance, quality, production progress, and delivery reliability.
* Develop alternative sourcing and contingency plans for critical products.
* Ensure procurement requests, purchase orders, costs, and vendor commitments are properly tracked.

4. Production, Packaging & Assembly

* Coordinate product customisation, printing, engraving, branding, packaging, and assembly.
* Ensure every product is manufactured or customised according to the approved specifications.
* Manage dependencies between design approval, procurement, production, and packaging.
* Ensure packaging materials and assembly requirements are planned in advance.
* Maintain clear work instructions for each gifting order.
* Ensure that the final assembled gift matches the approved concept and client requirements.

5. Quality Control & Error Prevention

This is one of the most critical responsibilities of the role.

* Establish quality checkpoints at procurement, production, assembly, packaging, and dispatch.
* Ensure product quantity, specifications, branding, personalisation, and packaging are verified.
* Implement order-wise checklists and verification systems.
* Ensure critical requirements are independently checked before dispatch.
* Establish traceability for every order, product, and delivery.
* Identify recurring errors and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Build a culture where mistakes are reported immediately, investigated, and prevented from recurring.

**A gifting order should never depend on one individual's memory or assumption. Every critical requirement must have a documented verification process.**

6. Logistics & Delivery Management

* Coordinate dispatch planning, transportation, courier partners, and last-mile delivery.
* Ensure delivery commitments are realistic and monitored.
* Manage bulk deliveries, individual recipient deliveries, and multi-location shipments.
* Track shipment movement and proactively manage delays.
* Ensure proof of delivery and closure records are maintained.
* Handle urgent or high-priority deliveries with appropriate escalation and contingency planning.

7. Team Leadership & Accountability

* Lead and manage the operations team, including operations executives and fulfilment coordinators.
* Allocate responsibilities based on order complexity, workload, and deadlines.
* Establish clear ownership for every order and operational task.
* Conduct daily order reviews and regular execution meetings.
* Monitor team performance, productivity, accuracy, and accountability.
* Train team members to follow standard operating procedures and quality controls.
* Build a team that can execute independently without constant supervision from the business owner.

8. Systems, Process & Operational Excellence

* Use TOFAA's Order Management System (OMS) as the central source of truth for order execution.
* Ensure order status, procurement requests, production progress, risks, and delivery updates are recorded systematically.
* Work with the ERP and procurement teams to maintain accurate purchase and vendor records.
* Establish standard operating procedures for order handover, execution, QC, dispatch, and closure.
* Build dashboards and reports to monitor order health, pending tasks, delays, and operational risks.
* Continuously improve processes to reduce errors, improve turnaround time, and increase operational efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The role will be evaluated on:

* On-time order delivery and fulfilment.
* Order accuracy and quality of execution.
* Number of preventable errors, rework, and replacements.
* Vendor reliability and procurement turnaround time.
* Adherence to approved order budgets.
* Order visibility and timely escalation of risks.
* Team productivity and execution discipline.
* Client satisfaction and successful order closure.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in demanding, fast-moving operational environments such as:

* Quick commerce: Zepto, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart.
* Food delivery and fulfilment: Zomato, Swiggy.
* Large-scale retail and supply chain: DMart, Reliance Retail, BigBasket.
* E-commerce fulfilment and logistics.
* Event operations, premium hospitality, or high-complexity fulfilment businesses.

Experience with these companies is not mandatory. We value the operational capabilities developed in similar environments.

Required Experience & Skills

* 7–12 years of experience in operations, fulfilment, supply chain, or multi-product execution.
* At least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Proven experience managing high-pressure operations with strict timelines.
* Experience handling multiple products, vendors, teams, and operational dependencies.
* Strong understanding of inventory, procurement, quality control, logistics, and fulfilment.
* Excellent planning, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong ownership mentality and attention to detail.
* Ability to build processes, manage people, and execute through systems.

What We Are Looking For in a Leader

We need someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Remains calm and decisive under pressure.
* Understands that operational excellence is built through systems, not individual heroics.
* Can manage complexity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Is comfortable handling unpredictable product requirements and changing client briefs.
* Can identify risks before they become problems.
* Is equally comfortable reviewing a strategic operations dashboard and solving a critical execution issue on the ground.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Vikas Hitech Nursery is a consumer goods company based in Sangli, India, specializing in nursery and horticulture products for regional and national markets. The company focuses on providing high-quality plants and related goods to customers, including individual buyers, retailers, and institutional clients. Operations are centered around efficient cultivation, maintenance, and distribution processes to ensure consistent product quality. Team members work in a hands-on environment that values reliability, care for plants, and customer satisfaction.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune. The Production Manager oversees day-to-day nursery operations, including planning and managing plant cultivation, scheduling and supervising staff, and monitoring production targets. Responsibilities include coordinating inventory levels, ensuring timely dispatch of orders, and maintaining quality standards for plants and related products. The role also involves implementing safe work practices, optimizing resource use (soil, fertilizers, water, and equipment), and keeping production records up to date. The Production Manager collaborates with management to improve processes, control costs, and support customer requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong production planning and scheduling abilities, with experience managing daily operations in a nursery, horticulture, agriculture, or related production environment.
* Candidates should possess skills in team supervision, staff coordination, and workload allocation, with the ability to train and guide on-site personnel.
* Candidates should possess competencies in quality control and process improvement, including monitoring plant health, maintaining standards, and implementing best practices.
* Candidates should possess basic inventory management and record-keeping skills, including tracking stock levels, inputs, and outputs accurately.
* Candidates should possess practical knowledge of horticulture or agriculture, including plant care, soil and fertilizer use, irrigation practices, and pest and disease management.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate with suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Agribusiness, or a related field are beneficial; prior experience in nursery or farm management is an advantage.
* Candidates should be able to work on-site in Pune Division and be comfortable with hands-on, outdoor work in varying weather conditions.

description:

Likewise, you will implement building procedures and performance measures—and ease the path for compliance with these. * If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. **SAP Fieldglass Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services (GDS) refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Within Consulting, EY's SAP practice helps organizations transform procurement, workforce management, finance, supply chain and contingent workforce operations through innovative SAP solutions, helping clients achieve operational excellence and digital transformation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY is seeking an experienced SAP Fieldglass Manager to join our growing SAP Consulting practice within GDS. The role offers an opportunity to lead large-scale contingent workforce and services procurement transformations powered by SAP Fieldglass.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead end-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementations, drive solution design workshops, manage global stakeholders, mentor high-performing teams, and support business growth initiatives. You will combine deep functional expertise, consulting skills, and leadership capabilities to deliver exceptional outcomes for clients across industries.
  
  
You will work closely with global EY teams, SAP ecosystem partners, and client leadership to define future-state workforce management strategies and deliver transformative business solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and contribute to RFP, RFI and RFQ responses for SAP Fieldglass opportunities.
* Collaborate with global pursuit teams, solution architects and SAP practice leaders to develop winning proposals.
* Lead SAP Fieldglass implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements across global clients.

* Design and implement SAP Fieldglass solutions covering:

+ Contingent Workforce Management
+ Services Procurement
+ Statement of Work (SOW) Management
+ Worker Profile Management
+ Assignment Management
+ Vendor Management

* Facilitate client workshops to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable Fieldglass solutions.

* Lead solution architecture discussions and integration design for SAP Fieldglass with SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, Ariba, ERP platforms, VMS ecosystems, and third-party applications.
* Manage project financials, budgets, utilization, resource planning, and engagement profitability.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, program sponsors, and executive leadership.
* Review functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, and deployment plans to ensure quality delivery.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans while proactively communicating project status.
* Support business development activities including proposal development, solutioning, estimations, client presentations, and RFP responses.
* Mentor consultants and senior consultants while fostering a collaborative and high-performance team culture.
* Stay current with SAP Fieldglass product innovations, workforce management trends, and emerging technologies.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong consulting mindset with ability to engage senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Proven leadership skills with experience managing distributed delivery teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication capabilities.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements in a fast-paced global environment.
* Commercial awareness with experience in project financial management.
* Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
* Ability to drive client value realization through transformational workforce strategies.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* 10-12 years of overall IT and consulting experience.
* Minimum 8 years of hands-on SAP Fieldglass implementation experience.
* Proven experience leading at least 3-5 end-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementations.
* Strong expertise in Contingent Workforce and Services Procurement modules.
* Experience in business process design, configuration, testing, data migration, and deployment activities.
* Experience managing onsite-offshore delivery models and global stakeholders.
* Knowledge of procurement, workforce management, HR, vendor management, and external workforce processes.
* Experience with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong presentation, documentation, and client-facing consulting skills.

**Ideally, You'll Also Have**

* SAP Fieldglass Certifications.
* Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), or SAP Integration Suite.
* Knowledge of Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Vendor Neutral Program (VNP) operating models.
* Exposure to AI-driven workforce analytics and procurement transformation initiatives.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for experienced consulting professionals who can combine SAP Fieldglass functional expertise with leadership and client relationship management skills. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to quality, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while helping clients achieve successful workforce transformation outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Customer Support Asia Pacific
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

We are looking for a **Customer Support Manager** to join our team in Noida, India.

The Customer Support Manager Asia Pacific has responsibility for delivering a world-class Customer Support experience across both the OneSpan Cybersecurity and Digital Agreements businesses in APAC, while contributing to global follow-the-sun support delivery.

The role is accountable for regional people leadership, operational performance, major incident and escalation management, and service delivery for selected customers. The Customer Support Manager India ensures that service levels, customer satisfaction and support quality objectives are achieved, while driving continuous improvement and alignment with global operational standards, procedures and best practices. This is a growth-oriented leadership role intended to build the experience, business breadth and strategic capabilities required to progress toward a senior regional Customer Support leadership position in the medium term.

**World-class customer support**

We are fully committed to our customers' success. Our knowledgeable and highly responsive services and support team's mission is to ensure timely implementation and problem resolution in the most courteous manner.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the India-based Level 1 and Level 2 Customer Support teams supporting Cybersecurity and Digital Agreements, with accountability for assigned customer outcomes across India and the wider Asia-Pacific region, and for global incidents assigned to the India team through the follow-the-sun operating model.

* Lead, coach and develop team members through regular feedback, performance discussions, succession planning and individual development plans covering technical, product, customer and leadership skills.

* Monitor and distribute workload equitably across support resources, balancing regional demand, global follow-the-sun coverage, priority, skills and customer commitments.

* Responsible for workforce planning, staff scheduling, capacity management, recruitment, onboarding and retention.

* Drive actions to improve customer satisfaction, customer effort, quality, responsiveness and overall support experience.

* Responsible for the effective implementation and execution of the Customer Support and Incident Management processes across both business lines.

* Accountable for the quality of process execution and compliance with applicable procedures, data models, policies, controls and supporting technologies.

* Monitor operational performance and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), identify risks and ensure agreed objectives and service levels are achieved.

* Produce and analyze operational reporting for KPIs, ticket management, service performance, major incidents and improvement initiatives.

* Act as the first stage of vertical escalation and as a senior escalation point for customers, partners and internal stakeholders in the region.

* Participate in daily support operations as needed and provide management oversight during periods of elevated demand, major incidents or reduced leadership coverage.

* Coordinate regional operational activities for global incidents and ensure effective handover and continuity through the follow-the-sun model.

* Plan, coordinate, monitor and report on all activities required for effective incident management, including incident command, stakeholder updates, service restoration, closure and follow-up actions.

* Ensure service levels are respected, with particular focus on ageing, high-priority, escalated and customer-sensitive cases.

* Identify trends and recurring patterns, initiate ticket reviews and drive problem prevention and corrective actions.

* Drive the creation, review, reuse and retirement of internal and customer-facing knowledge content, using incident trends, case deflection opportunities and engineer feedback to improve support effectiveness and self-service.

* Ensure quality control for the Customer Support process and establish continuous improvement cycles covering people, performance, activities, roles, procedures and technology.

* Track service and process improvements, assign ownership, remove blockers and report progress to regional and global leadership.

* Provide service-delivery governance for assigned strategic, SaaS, premium-support or customer-sensitive accounts, based on priorities agreed with regional and global Customer Support leadership. Service-delivery governance includes:

o **Onboard assigned customers** to Customer Support services, ensuring that support models, contacts, entitlements, escalation paths and service expectations are clearly established.

o **Lead recurring service reviews for assigned customers**, covering support delivery, applicable SaaS service performance, trends, risks, escalations, actions and improvement plans.

o **Monitor services delivered to assigned customers** across Cybersecurity and Digital Agreements and coordinate agreed improvements with internal stakeholders.

* Protect customer systems, confidential information and OneSpan data by ensuring secure support practices and compliance with applicable security and privacy requirements.

* Collaborate transparently with Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, Professional Services, Sales and other regional support leaders.

* Build readiness for broader regional leadership by progressively taking ownership of cross-functional initiatives, management reporting, talent development and regional operating decisions.

* Position could include shift work and/or on-call duties.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in Customer Support, Technical Support or Service Delivery, including 3+ years in a formal people-leadership role, ideally supporting SaaS, cloud services, cybersecurity and/or digital agreement solutions

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or equivalent practical experience

* Demonstrated experience leading technical support teams and managing customer escalations, major incidents and operational performance

* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, both written and spoken

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management and talent development capabilities

* Well-organized, analytical and attentive to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-pressure environment

* Working knowledge of IT service management, incident management, service delivery and continuous improvement practices

* ITIL Foundation certification

* Fluent English

**Nice-to-haves**

* ServiceNow CSM experience

* Experience supporting both cybersecurity and digital transaction or digital agreement platforms

* Experience with public SaaS or cloud services and customer-facing service governance

* Experience leading major incidents and customer service reviews

* International experience in a global, matrixed and follow-the-sun support organization

* Experience developing team leads, emerging leaders or managers, or coordinating multiple support functions.

* Commercial awareness, including support entitlements, premium support commitments and customer retention considerations

* Languages in addition to English

* Operating Systems (Linux, macOS, Windows)

* Scripting and web technologies (XML, HTML, JSON, CSS, XSLT)

* Databases (Oracle, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server)

* Application Servers (WebSphere, Apache, WebLogic, JBoss)

description:
**Studio Manager – Aliens Tattoo**

**The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo is India's leading premium tattoo brand, with 16+ premium studios and 160+ professionals. We are building a globally admired tattoo and lifestyle brand, and we're looking for a **business-oriented Studio Manager** who can take complete ownership of studio performance.

As a Studio Manager, you will lead the studio like your own business, driving revenue, delivering exceptional customer experiences, building high-performing teams, and maintaining premium operational standards.

**The Mandate**

Your responsibility is to ensure your studio operates as a profitable, customer-centric, and high-performing business. You will own its overall performance, ensuring:

* Consistent achievement of revenue and profitability targets.
* Exceptional customer experience across the entire tattoo journey.
* Strong team performance, accountability, and employee development.
* Operational excellence, hygiene, safety, and compliance.
* Efficient inventory management and cost control.
* Continuous improvement in processes and business performance.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Business & Revenue Growth:** Drive sales, achieve revenue targets, improve conversion rates, increase Average Bill Value (ABV), and ensure effective lead follow-ups through CRM.
* **Customer Experience:** Oversee the complete customer journey, resolve complaints, maintain strong customer relationships, and drive repeat business and referrals.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead and motivate tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, and customer experience teams through daily briefings, coaching, feedback, and performance reviews.
* **Studio Operations:** Ensure smooth day-to-day operations, studio readiness, housekeeping, hygiene, safety, and adherence to company SOPs.
* **Inventory & Cost Management:** Monitor stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, wastage, and operational expenses.
* **Compliance & Quality:** Maintain statutory compliance, biomedical waste management, safety standards, and operational audit requirements.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Work closely with Cluster Managers, Design Teams, Artist Team Leaders, and support functions to ensure seamless studio operations.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Track MIS reports, business KPIs, customer feedback, and operational metrics to identify gaps and improve performance.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong experience in retail, hospitality, premium service, or customer-centric business operations.
* Proven experience in sales, revenue generation, and team management.
* Strong understanding of business operations, inventory, and cost management.
* Excellent customer handling, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage teams, drive accountability, and achieve business targets.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in MIS, CRM, and performance tracking.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and execution.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Business:** Revenue and profitability targets consistently achieved.
* **Sales:** Improved conversion, ABV, repeat business, and zero lead leakage.
* **Customer:** Excellent customer satisfaction, positive reviews, and increased referrals.
* **Operations:** High audit scores, flawless hygiene and compliance, and minimal inventory wastage.
* **People:** High team engagement, low attrition, and strong internal talent development.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Better processes, stronger execution, and consistent business growth.

title: General Manager
description:
Lead Our Growth. Build Our Future.

Matrixstore is looking for an exceptional business leader to join our senior leadership team.

Are you a strategic thinker, a strong people leader and a result-oriented professional who can take a growing business to its next level?

We are looking for an experienced General Manager who can lead our overall business operations, build a high-performance team and drive sustainable and profitable growth.

**ABOUT MATRIXSTORE**

Established in 2011, Matrixstore is an importer, distributor and multi-channel business with a growing presence in cleaning equipment, electrical appliances, power tools and related product categories.

With our flagship iBELL brand, expanding product portfolio, strong distribution network and growing e-commerce presence, we are entering an exciting phase of business expansion.

**OUR JOURNEY OF GROWTH**

**From a Strong Foundation to an Ambitious Future**

Our journey reflects the power of progress, the strength of our ambition, and our commitment to achieving greater milestones.

**A Strong Foundation**Building on the success of our previous financial year.

**A New Milestone**Expanding our business and reaching new heights in the current financial year.

**A Vision Beyond Limits**Transforming our ambitions into reality and establishing Matrix as a leading name in the industry by 2030.

**THE ROLE – GENERAL MANAGER**

The General Manager will take overall responsibility for business execution, organizational performance, operational excellence and profitable growth.

Working closely with the Managing Director, the GM will convert the company’s vision and strategic priorities into actionable plans, lead departmental heads and ensure measurable business results.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

\* Drive overall business growth and execute strategic business plans.

\* Ensure sustainable growth with strong profitability.

**2. Sales & Business Development**

\* Improve after-sales service standards and customer support.

\* Monitor operational quality and customer feedback.

\* Drive continuous improvement across the organization.

\* Strong knowledge of sales, business operations and business development.

\* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, communication and decision-making skills.

\* Strong ownership mentality with the ability to build systems, empower people and deliver results.

\* Be part of an ambitious and fast-growing organization.

\* Work closely with the Managing Director and leadership team.

\* Take ownership of business growth and organizational development.

\* Lead a growing team and build professional management systems.

\* Play a significant role in shaping the company’s future.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Technical Support**

**Experience: 3–6 Years**

**Qualification: Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical & Electronics**

**Location: Bengaluru**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Technical Support professional with 3–6 years of experience in electrical/electronic troubleshooting, preferably in the EV charging industry. The candidate will be responsible for diagnosing EV charger faults, providing remote technical support, and identifying the root causes of recurring technical issues to ensure reliable charger operations and minimize downtime.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. EV Charger Fault Diagnosis**

● Diagnose and identify faults in AC and DC EV chargers.

● Troubleshoot charger errors, charging failures, power-related issues, and component

malfunctions.

● Interpret charger error codes, fault indicators, and technical logs to identify potential

issues.

● Understand electrical and electronic components such as PCBs, MCBs, MCCBs, RCCBs, relays, and contactors.

● Analyse charger symptoms and determine whether the issue is hardware-related,

software-related, or connectivity-related.

**2. Remote Troubleshooting**

● Provide technical support to customers and field technicians through calls, video

sessions, and remote diagnostic tools.

● Guide technicians through systematic troubleshooting procedures to identify and

resolve charger faults.

● Investigate charger connectivity issues, communication failures, and unsuccessful

charging sessions.

● Coordinate with Engineering and Product teams to resolve complex technical issues.

● Document troubleshooting steps, actions taken, and final resolutions.

**3. Root-Cause Analysis**

● Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring charger faults and technical failures.

● Identify patterns in charger error logs, service reports, and recurring customer

complaints.

● Recommend corrective and preventive actions to reduce repeat failures and charger

downtime.

● Collaborate with Engineering teams to investigate persistent hardware, firmware, and

communication issues.

● Maintain a knowledge base of common charger faults, troubleshooting procedures,

and resolutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

● Strong knowledge of electrical and electronic fault diagnosis.

● Understanding of AC/DC EV chargers and their basic operating principles.

● Practical knowledge of PCB, MCB, MCCB, RCCB, relays, contactors, and control

title: Deskside Support Technician I
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose**
The Digital Operations Technician is responsible for delivering hands on support for users and workplace technology in Hyderabad. The role provides frontline support for end user devices, office based technology, onboarding activities, conference rooms, and local smart hands requirements, helping ensure stable and responsive support.
  
  
The role supports a remote and operationally important location, requiring strong independence, responsiveness, and coordination with Digital Operations as well as Infrastructure & Operations teams.
  
  
The position serves as the primary local IT support presence and works closely with global IT teams to resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, maintain device readiness, and support day to day business operations. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical troubleshooting, sound judgement and a customer focused approach.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Deskside Support Technician I with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
**End User Support**

* Provide in person support for desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, printers and mobile devices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users.
* Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities.
* Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes.

**Workplace Technology & Site Support**

* Support conference room and collaboration technology, including basic meeting room troubleshooting and readiness checks.
* Assist with workstation setup, hot desk support, office moves, and shared workspace readiness.
* Provide local smart hands assistance for infrastructure, network, telecom or vendor led onsite activities as required.
* Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation.

**Device Lifecycle & Logistics**

* Support deployment, provisioning, refresh, rebuild, recovery, and replacement of endpoint devices.
* Assist with asset handling activities including receipt, setup, collection, return, and local coordination of hardware movements.
* Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards.
* Maintain awareness of local inventory, device readiness, and support requirements for site.

**Operational Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Perform first line diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of onsite IT issues, escalating where needed.
* Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness.
* Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third party providers to help maintain stable service delivery.
* Contribute to consistent support practices, documentation, and service quality across the local environment.

**Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Demonstrate commitment to health, safety and compliance requirements applicable to the office or site environment.
* Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
* Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

**Physical Demand/Work Environment**
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.
  
  
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.
  
  
**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
* Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
* Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
* Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.
* Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
* Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
* Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
* Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
* Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: IT Support Engineer L3
description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

**Job Overview**

Be the person people across the company trust when something breaks. As an IT Support Engineer, you are the first point of contact for our internal customers, keeping employees productive across Windows 11, macOS, Microsoft 365, and the identity systems behind them. This is a hands-on role on a collaborative team, with real room to grow into identity, endpoint management, automation, and AI-enabled support.

 

We are also building AI into how IT works, from faster ticket resolution to smarter self-service. We want someone who is curious about AI and eager to experiment with it, and who will help shape how we use it.

 

**Location:**

Hybrid, Hyderabad office 2-3 days per week
 
  
**Shift:**

12:30 PM - 9:30 PM IST
 
  
**Level:**

Engineer III (5+ years)

**What

You’ll

Do**

 

* Resolve incoming tickets for hardware, software, Teams, M365, email, and account issues, owning each one through to resolution

* Triage new cases, set priority, and route or escalate with clear documentation

* Meet or exceed team SLA targets for response and resolution time, and keep ticket status current at all times

* Troubleshoot Windows 11 and macOS issues across devices, applications, networking, and peripherals

* Manage user accounts, group memberships, access requests, and password and MFA resets in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID

* Support SSO-integrated applications and diagnose authentication and access issues

* Prepare, image, and deploy Windows and Mac laptops for new hires

* Retrieve and process equipment from departing employees

**Improve and innovate**

 

* Write and maintain knowledge base articles that increase self-service and reduce repeat tickets

* Analyze ticket trends and report recurring issues and root causes to IT leadership and partner teams

* Identify and implement process improvements
* Explore and apply AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI assistants) to speed up troubleshooting, documentation, and user support, and share what works with the team

**Requirements & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or 5+ years of equivalent hands-on experience

* Independent handling of escalated, multi-step issues

* Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting Windows 11 and macOS in an enterprise environment

* Working experience administering Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (user lifecycle, groups, MFA, conditional access basics)

* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) and SSO technologies

* Experience working in a ticketing system against defined SLAs

* Fluent English, spoken and written, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users

* Ability to work onsite in Hyderabad 2-3 days per week and during the 12:30 PM - 9:30 PM IST shift

**Preferred**

 

* PowerShell or other scripting experience to automate repetitive tasks

* Microsoft certifications (e.g., MD-102, SC-300, AZ-104) or CompTIA/ITIL certifications

* Experience writing knowledge base content or building self-service resources

* Experience using AI to improve IT workflows, such as drafting KB articles, summarizing tickets, or scripting with AI assistance

**Why

You’ll

Want This Job**

 

* **Grow your skills:**

  Work across a broad stack, from endpoint and identity to M365 and automation, with a clear path from Engineer III and beyond

* **Work on AI for real:**

  Help decide how AI is used in IT support, not just read about it

* **Hybrid flexibility:**

  A balance of in-office collaboration and remote work

* **Make visible impact:**

  Your work directly affects how productive hundreds of colleagues are every day

* **Learn continuously:**

  A team that values curiosity, shares knowledge, and supports your development

To learn more, visit: everify.com***
