Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
  
  
**Senior Customer Support Engineer I**
**Electronic Arts (EA) Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)**
We are a global team of creators, storytellers, technologists, experience originators, innovators and so much more. We believe amazing games and experiences start with teams as diverse as the players and communities we serve. At Electronic Arts, the only limit is your imagination.
  
  
The Information Technology group (EAIT) works as a global team to empower EA's employees and business operations to be creative, collaborative, and productive. As a digital entertainment company, EA's enterprise technology needs are diverse and span across game development, workforce collaboration, marketing, publishing, player experience, security, and corporate activities. Our mission is to bring creative technology services to each of these areas, working across the company to "ensure better play”.
  
  
*The Customer Support Engineer will report to the Game Developer Experience Associate Manager, Customer Support.*
**Responsibilities**
Promote the value proposition in presentations and demos with prospects and customers.
  
  
Manage customer relationships, engaging them in value-added activities.
  
  
Experience using a CRM software system.
  
  

* You will work directly with the Game Developer teams and help them solve technical challenges
* Help us to resolve issues involving project implementation, code error diagnosis, debugging, validation, and root cause analysis for the products/platforms assigned
* You will build internal relationships with our development and product management teams to help us communicate the priorities of our customers
* You will Improve product quality by injecting fresh ideas and bringing innovations to existing products or platforms, building automation
* You will help develop additional software components for tasks associated with the projects/platforms, designing and debugging software applications.
* You will participate in projects that improve overall product and documentation quality
* Participate in product/platform testing and updates
* Achieve knowledge transfer through the delivery of training, knowledge sessions, mentoring
* Help increase the team efficiency by sharing knowledge, providing feedback about best practices, writing tools/utilities using AI stack.
* Develop your technology skills and become a versatile IT professional
* Participate in schedule rotations and working shifts

**Qualifications**

* 5 + years of experience working with customers
* Empathy for the customer experience
* Balance varying levels of priority and urgency
* Understand complex technical issues and manage to express them in simple and concise language
* Familiarity with database concepts (e.g. SQL Server, MongoDB)
* Experience around the following technology concepts - virtualization, operating systems and server administration (Linux, Windows), cloud infrastructure and services(AWS, Azure), networking (IP, routing, firewall, ACL's), coding/scripting (Python, Bash, Powershell), application and API endpoints, monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Kibana)
* Qualification in Computer Engineering or relevant experience needed.

**About Electronic Arts**
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
  
  
We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
  
  
Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Sr Customer Service Specialist
description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
The Sr Customer Service Specialist is the Syniverse customer point of contact for first level support for all products and services. . This role will also serve as a Point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the Customer Service group and will work closely with our customers to ensure issues and inquires are responded to and resolved within the established company guidelines.
  
  
**Some Of What You'll Do**
**Scope of the Role:**
**Direct Reports:**
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist operations management in analyzing customer’s issues and questions, including inoperability or inaccessibility of a system, module or function and take appropriate action to resolve the problem in a timely manner to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Support Customers and Managers by adhering to departmental policies and procedures.
* Assist in managing day-to-day activities specific towards the obtainment of Customer Service objectives by acting as SME for customer facing issues and escalations.
* Act as a liaison between the Customer Service Group and other functional departments in support of daily operations.
* Real Time management of daily service levels and call routing for supported products.
* Responsible for production, distribution, and analysis of standard and ad-hoc reports for various infrastructure applications (i.e. Analyzer).
* May be called upon to assist in oversight of other Level 1 personnel in conjunction with existing management.
* Function as a liaison and escalation point for all customer issues.
* Keep abreast of all customer affecting and internal affecting outages and ensuremanagement is aware of all issues that may impact supported customers.
* Participate in the development and rollout of new initiatives and customers.

**Experience, Education And Certification**

* Bachelors degree in communication or business or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years customer service experience.

**Additional Requirements**

* PC experience in a Windows operating environment with strong typing ability.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills.
* Ability to proactively anticipate customer needs and make recommendations to meet those needs.
* Coaching skills highly preferred.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with discretion.
* Ability to be on-call for after-hours support and work in an environment covering 24 x 7 x 365.

**Why You Should Join Us**
Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture.
  
  
At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world.
  
  
**Know someone at Syniverse?**
Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position.
  
  
Pay Transparency
  
  
In accordance with applicable pay transparency requirements, Syniverse will provide information regarding the salary range or compensation for this position during the recruitment process and prior to any compensation discussions.

title: Multi Skilled Network Engineers
description:
Position Description
  
  
Requirement
  
  
Provide two dedicated full time Level 3 Multi Skilled Network Engineers to support Client's network and security environment through BAU operations, incident resolution, service requests, problem management, and small approved changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 support for incidents, problems, requests, and operational activities.
* Implement and validate approved small changes.
* Perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and recovery activities.
* Maintain documentation, CMDB records, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Support patching, upgrades, backups, and maintenance activities.
* Participate in CAB, operational reviews, and governance meetings.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Routing & Switching: Cisco Catalyst, IOS/XE, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, HA
* Data Centre: Cisco Nexus, NX OS, vPC
* WAN & Internet: MPLS, DIA, SD WAN
* Cloud Managed: Cisco Meraki
* Wireless: Enterprise Wi Fi troubleshooting and administration
* Access Control: Cisco ISE, authentication and certificates
* Security: FortiGate, FortiManager, Palo Alto, Check Point
* Application Delivery: F5 BIG IP
* SSE/SASE: Zscaler ZIA/ZPA
* VPN: IPsec, SSL VPN, site to site connectivity
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure networking
* Core Services: DNS, DHCP, IPAM, PKI
* Automation: Python, Ansible, APIs
* ITSM: ServiceNow

Resource Requirements
  
  

* Minimum 5 years enterprise Level 3 networking experience.
* Proven experience in multi vendor environments.
* Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Engineers must be dedicated to Client and not shared across accounts.
* Cross skilled coverage with no single point of failure.

Service Coverage
  
  

* Support during agreed UK business hours.
* Planned out of hours and major incident support when required.
* Full knowledge transfer and continuity plans for onboarding and replacements.
* All work must follow Client security, access, and change management processes.

Change Control
  
  

* All changes require approved change records.
* Peer reviewed implementation, validation, and rollback plans.
* Execution only within approved maintenance windows.
* Failed changes must be rolled back and escalated appropriately.

Out of Scope
  
  

* Major transformation projects and large scale migrations.
* Network architecture ownership and strategic design.
* Continuous monitoring and alert management (owned by RCDC).
* Security policy ownership, risk acceptance, and audit sign off.

Performance Measures
  
  

* Incident response and resolution quality.
* Backlog management.
* Change success rate.
* Problem/RCA contribution.
* Documentation quality and CMDB accuracy.
* Operational improvement and automation recommendations.

Reporting
  
  

* Monthly KPI reporting (weekly during mobilisation or elevated risk periods).
* Include ticket volumes, backlog, change performance, documentation updates, risks, escalations, and improvement actions.
* Reports reviewed through operational and service governance meetings.

Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Advanced Technical Support Engineer -
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Advanced Technical Support Engineer -****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Advanced Product Support Engineer | Pune or Hyderabad | APJ, EMEA & AMER Shift**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone believes human potential grows exponentially when AI works in service of people. Global Customer Support is where that promise is kept — one customer, one case, one conversation at a time.
  
  
At Cornerstone, we're passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their people. Our customers rely on our technology to develop talent, build skills, and drive business success. Delivering exceptional customer experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our Global Customer Support team plays a critical role in bringing that commitment to life. We are relentlessly customer-obsessed, focused not only on resolving issues but also on building trust, driving engagement, and ensuring customers realize the full value of their Cornerstone solutions. We believe every customer interaction is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference, strengthen relationships, and help our customers succeed.
  
  
We're looking for individuals who share our passion for delivering exceptional service, embrace innovation and AI-powered technology, and take pride in making every customer interaction count.
  
  
**The Role**
As an Advanced Product Support Specialist (Level 3), you will serve as a technical authority within Cornerstone's Global Customer Support organization, providing deep product expertise to resolve our most complex technical challenges and improve the overall effectiveness of our support teams.
  
  
Working in a collaborative, AI-enabled support environment, you will leverage advanced troubleshooting capabilities, AI-powered insights, and strong partnerships with Engineering and Product teams to identify root causes, resolve critical issues, and proactively address emerging customer challenges. Rather than managing a traditional case queue, you will focus on the most complex, high-risk, and aging cases where your expertise can make the greatest impact.
  
  
You will also play a critical role in developing technical capabilities across the team, strengthening product knowledge, and ensuring our customers receive exceptional support that builds confidence, drives engagement, and maximizes the value of their Cornerstone solutions.
  
  
**In This Role You Will...**
Serve as the technical authority for your assigned product area, proactively identifying and taking ownership of the most complex, high-risk, and aging support cases to drive timely and effective resolution.
  
  
Lead advanced technical investigations, performing in-depth root-cause analysis to identify underlying product defects, configuration challenges, and integration issues.
  
  
Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to validate defects, ensure accurate reproduction steps, and support prioritization and resolution through established defect management processes, including OneList.
  
  
Leverage AI-powered tools, customer sentiment insights, and support analytics to identify recurring issues, improve troubleshooting effectiveness, and proactively address opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
  
  
Own technical knowledge development for your product area, identifying knowledge base gaps, contributing to certification content, and leading technical deep-dive sessions to strengthen team capabilities.
  
  
Mentor and coach Level 2 support specialists, using case quality insights and Level AI performance data to identify development opportunities and improve technical problem-solving across the team.
  
  
Provide technical expertise on critical customer escalations, partnering with escalation management teams, including DEEP, to validate solutions and ensure accurate, effective resolution.
  
  
Partner directly with the Pod Director to identify technical risks, improve support processes, and strengthen overall pod performance, including case aging, backlog health, defect quality, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**You've Got What It Takes If You...**
Have 5+ years of experience in advanced technical support, SaaS product support, or a similar technical role, with deep expertise in complex enterprise software environments.
  
  
Possess advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with demonstrated experience resolving complex product, integration, configuration, and data-related challenges.
  
  
Are recognized as a trusted technical expert who can confidently diagnose complex issues, validate solutions, and guide others through challenging technical situations.
  
  
Have experience collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to investigate defects, document technical findings, and drive effective issue resolution.
  
  
Are comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools, support analytics, and customer sentiment data to identify trends, improve technical support quality, and drive operational improvements.
  
  
Demonstrate strong mentoring, communication, and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to develop technical capabilities across a team and influence others without direct authority.
  
  
Are proactive, collaborative, and customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of accountability and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
  
  
Are committed to completing required Expert-tier certification within your first 90 days, maintaining deep expertise in your primary product area, and expanding your knowledge across related Cornerstone solutions.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
The TAM manages an assigned client base—both engaged and prospective—by acting as a technical and consultative resource and coordinating with other departments within CADeploy to address client needs. The TAM ensures the highest level of client satisfaction by identifying specific requirements, translating them into clear communication, and following through on commitments. The purpose of this role is to maintain healthy client relationships and strong project performance through continuous pulse monitoring, including checks on service‑delivery performance, recognition of special requirements, and early identification of potential risks. The objective is to build and maintain a strong working affiliation that supports long‑term account continuity while guiding technical and managerial execution for efficiency and effectiveness. This role is essential to CADeploy’s growth plan and serves as a foundation for strengthening its brand recognition for quality performance.

• Collaborate with the PMO and delivery teams to direct troubleshooting efforts on escalated issues.

• Review and approve client invoices prior to billing.

If inclined towards this position, please reach out with updated cv to tahyd@cadeploy.com

Thanks and Regards,

TA Hyd.

title: Technical Support Engineering App Services Dev
description:
****Overview****
MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.
  
  
Within MCAPS - Core, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.
  
  
In the Customer Service & Support (CSS) team we are looking for people with a passion for delivering customer success. As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will own, troubleshoot, and solve complex customer technical issues. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, hone your problem-solving, collaboration and research skills, and deepen your technical proficiency.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
Support Engineers (SE) serve as frontline technical resources for Microsoft customers and partners via phone, email or web. They deliver unique value by collaboratively and reactively solving customer problems, providing proactive support advice, contributing to product quality and enhancements and creating self-help assets to broadly reach more customers. You will be part of a team responsible for providing an outstanding technical support experience to our business customers. From problem identification to full resolution, you will own and manage the customer experience over the phone and Web. When needed, you will collaborate with others to engage subject matter experts, Engineering (Product Groups) or Management. Your day-to-day job will be about providing both technical expertise (either on your own or by involving your colleagues) and about being an excellent communicator and a service-oriented professional. You will be given the opportunity to become a subject matter expert in one or more areas and receive guidance and mentorship from your colleagues.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Responsible for the customer support experience with Microsoft
* Own, troubleshooting and solve customer technical issues, using collaboration, troubleshooting best practices and transparency within and across teams (e.g. swarming)
* Identify cases that require escalation (either technically or strategically)
* Create and maintain incident management requests to product group or engineering group
* Contribute to case deflection initiatives, automation and other digital self-help assets to improve customer and engineer experience
* Provide ramp activities, knowledge sharing, technical coaching and mentoring
* Drive technical collaboration and engagement outside of CSS (Product Engineering teams, Services, Support, Regions)
* Lead or participate in building communities with peer delivery roles; may be workload or specialty specific
* Improve existing and develop new troubleshooting workflows and troubleshooting guides (TSG)
* Technical interviews for new hires
* Interface with Accounts team to maintain good customer relations
* Readiness content - identify need for and/or create content
* Required Skillset:

+ Foundational experience in customer support or software development in at least three of the following: Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Web Apps on Windows or Linux, Docker-based deployments, or IIS-based hosting.
+ Hands-on troubleshooting experience on Windows or Linux web applications, including deployment, startup, and availability issues.
+ Proficiency in application development and debugging with at least one of the following: .NET Core, ASP.NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, or Ruby. Familiarity with CMS platforms like WordPress, Joomla, or Drupal is a plus.
+ Basic understanding of web standards and front-end technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
+ Solid grasp of core programming concepts like call stacks, threading, exceptions, memory usage, and performance bottlenecks.
+ Proven ability to analyze logs, telemetry, and diagnostic tools to identify root causes of issues and resolve them effectively.
+ Familiar with networking fundamentals, HTTP/S protocols, DNS resolution, and basic firewall concepts.
+ Exposure to tools like Fiddler, Wireshark, or Network Monitor for HTTP and network traffic inspection.
+ Demonstrated eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow technical depth in the cloud ecosystem.
+ It is desirable to have AZ 900/AI 900 certification.

****Qualifications****
**Required Qualifications:**

* Three years of prior product/technical support customer facing experience.
* Two years of proven experience working with Azure App Services customers.
* Good technical proficiency and skills in troubleshooting Azure App Services issues.

description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

About SailPoint

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. About the Role

As a Service Desk Specialist (L1), you will deliver extraordinary customer support by responding to questions and issues concerning SailPoint products for corporate enterprise customers across the globe. You will act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries, processing and managing support tickets, documenting case details, and dispatching complex issues to Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in a timely manner. This role operates in a fast-paced, metric-driven environment focused on customer satisfaction, high-quality case resolution, and operational efficiency across global time zones.

About the Team

Our Global Customer Support & Service Desk team is dedicated to providing world-class assistance and driving customer loyalty. We collaborate closely with technical support engineers, product specialists, and engineering teams to ensure that customer challenges are addressed with speed and precision. We foster a supportive, knowledge-sharing culture where continuous learning and operational excellence are celebrated.

30 Days:

* Complete onboarding and foundational training on SailPoint products, case management tools, and support workflows.

* Learn standard case recording procedures, account documentation protocols, and service level agreements (SLAs).

60 Days:

* Successfully dispatch complex cases to SMEs while meeting initial response and quality targets.

90 Days:

* Manage a full case volume within targeted SLAs across assigned shift rotations.
* Achieve consistent customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores and operational quality benchmarks.
* Actively contribute to knowledge base articles and internal troubleshooting documentation.

6 Months:

* Identify trends in incoming tickets and recommend workflow or procedural enhancements to streamline service delivery.
* Handle multi-region customer inquiries across North America, Europe, and APAC time zones with high autonomy.
* Assist in mentoring newer team members and participating in team quality reviews.

1 Year:

* Consistently exceed performance metrics in case resolution, customer satisfaction, and escalation accuracy.
* Partner with cross-functional support and engineering leads on service improvement initiatives.
* Serve as a SME on Tier 1 processes, ticket lifecycle management, and customer relationship building.

Requirements

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 1 to 2 years of professional experience in customer service, service desk, or customer support operations.
* Very strong written and verbal English communication skills with experience supporting global enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, metric-driven environment with strong multitasking and navigation skills in Windows operating environments.
* Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Willingness and ability to work on rotational shifts covering North America, Europe, and Asia time zones.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of basic technical troubleshooting methodologies.
* Prior experience working directly with US, UK, and Australian enterprise customers.

**Role Description**
The MES Application Support & Maintenance role is a full-time position based in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad Area with a hybrid work model, allowing some work from home. The role involves providing day-to-day support for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including monitoring applications, resolving incidents, and handling service requests from internal and external stakeholders. Typical responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating fixes or enhancements with development and infrastructure teams. The role also includes maintaining documentation, updating knowledge bases, supporting deployments and upgrades, and assisting with system performance optimization. The person in this position collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, adheres to service-level agreements, and ensures stable, reliable MES operations in a manufacturing environment.

Application Support & Maintenance

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Seniority:**
Senior

Location: Gujarat

**Work Model:**
Frequent factory visits and on-site support as required.

Job Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior Application S&M Engineers / ECS Application Managers to manage and support ECS (Manufacturing Execution System) applications across manufacturing facilities.

The selected candidates will act as the primary point of contact (SPOC) between factory operations and IT teams, ensuring the smooth functioning, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ECS applications.

The role involves managing application support activities, resolving maintenance tickets, coordinating with L2/L3 support teams, handling incidents and service requests, and supporting manufacturing operations through effective application management.

Candidates should have experience in enterprise application support within a manufacturing environment, along with knowledge of MES/ECS, SAP production processes, ITIL practices, and technical troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary SPOC between factory operations and IT teams.
* Build strong working relationships with factory leadership, production, operations, and quality teams.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into application enhancement requests.
* Conduct regular reviews with key users to ensure application capabilities align with business objectives.
* Provide user training, knowledge transfer, and updates on new system functionalities.
* Promote application adoption and standard global functionalities.

2. Application Support & Service Management

* Manage the complete lifecycle of incidents, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA compliance.
* Monitor application availability, performance, user access, routing, and system configurations.
* Perform application troubleshooting, log analysis, debugging, and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 support teams, infrastructure, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Maintain technical documentation and application records in ServiceNow (SNOW) and CMDB.
* Support application upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, and disaster recovery activities.
* Drive continuous service improvement and implement application enhancements.

3. Manufacturing & On-Site Support

* Support and optimize MES/ECS application configurations in alignment with manufacturing processes.
* Work closely with production teams to understand operational challenges and resolve application-related issues.
* Support application implementation, testing, deployment, and configuration changes.
* Provide on-site support during major projects, upgrades, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and Hypercare activities.
* Support manufacturing digitalization initiatives, including quality and labour management processes.
* Ensure minimal disruption to factory operations through effective application maintenance and support.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

title: Quantum - Treasury and Risk Manager - Functional Role
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Quantum | Treasury and Risk Manager - Functional Role**
The FIS Enterprise Treasury Client Experience (CX) team provides product support to global clients using Quantum (FIS Treasury and Risk Manager - Quantum Edition). The team investigates functional and technical product issues, manages client communication, coordinates with internal resolver teams, and supports reliable day-to-day use of the Quantum application.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
Analyst Senior, Product Technical Support independently owns complex Quantum client issues from initial assessment through resolution or effective hand-off. The role combines Quantum product knowledge, treasury domain understanding, structured troubleshooting, clear client communication, escalation management, and continuous improvement. This position is focused on CX product support for Quantum or client process execution.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own complex Quantum incidents and service requests from initial assessment through resolution, workaround, or effective hand-off, with clear accountability and timely updates
* Investigate functional and technical issues using application behavior, logs, SQL queries, configuration details, interfaces, job status, and other available diagnostic evidence
* Assess business impact and priority, manage escalations, and provide clear and accurate communication to clients and internal stakeholders
* Provide product guidance across Quantum treasury workflows, including cash and liquidity management, payments, bank reconciliation, statements, accounting, reporting, interfaces, and related controls
* Reproduce reported issues where possible, document findings, and coordinate with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Hosting, Database, Network, and other resolver teams
* Drive problem investigation and root cause coordination for recurring or high-impact issues, and convert findings into preventive actions, knowledge content, or support process improvements
* Support client discussions, incident calls, product issue reviews, risk updates, and action tracking for assigned cases
* Contribute to upgrade, release, testing, configuration, and post-change support activities when product support involvement is required
* Maintain high-quality ticket updates, investigation notes, handovers, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge articles
* Guide less experienced support representatives, share Quantum product knowledge, and support quality reviews and case prioritization
* Work effectively across APJ, EMEA, and US stakeholder groups in a global support environment
* Follow security, privacy, audit, and service management requirements while handling client information and production issues

What you bring
  
  
**Required Experience And Domain Knowledge**

* Relevant experience in product support, client services, treasury management, cash management, payments, banking, or financial application support
* Hands-on experience supporting a Treasury Management System. Quantum product experience is strongly preferred
* Working knowledge of treasury operations, including cash and liquidity management, payments, settlements, bank reconciliation, statements, accounting, and daily treasury controls
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and problem investigations in an SLA-driven support environment
* Experience communicating directly with global clients and explaining technical or functional issues in clear business language
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing client issues, and collaborate effectively as part of a global team
* Willingness to work flexible rotational shifts aligned with the approved support model, if needed

Technical and operational skills
  
  

* Must have 4-7 years of experience of IT Product Support
* Strong functional and technical troubleshooting skills for enterprise financial applications
* Good working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, with the ability to analyze data safely for support investigations
* Ability to interpret application logs, interface status, job results, error messages, configuration details, and monitoring information
* Understanding of application architecture, integrations, secure file transfer, system dependencies, and hosted or cloud environments
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable service management and defect-tracking tools
* Good documentation skills for ticket updates, client communication, handovers, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles
* Knowledge of SWIFT messaging and ISO 20022 is advantageous where relevant to supported Quantum workflows

Core competencies
  
  

* Strong client focus, service ownership, and accountability
* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to adapt to technical and business audiences
* Analytical problem solving, structured debugging, and disciplined root cause thinking
* Sound judgment in complex or ambiguous situations, with effective prioritization and escalation
* Ability to build trusted client relationships and collaborate across multiple internal teams
* Attention to detail and a track record of producing high-quality documentation
* Coaching mindset, knowledge sharing, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement

**Qualifications And Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* Experience with Quantum (FIS Treasury and Risk Manager - Quantum Edition) is strongly preferred
* Experience supporting global banks or corporate treasury clients is advantageous
* ITIL Foundation, treasury, payments, SQL, cloud, or service management certification is advantageous
* Experience contributing to knowledge management, automation, monitoring improvements, or support process improvement is preferred
* Fluent written and spoken English

What success looks like
  
  

* Quantum client issues progress with clear ownership, accurate assessment, effective coordination, and timely communication
* Clients receive confident, transparent, and product-focused support with clear expectations and next steps
* Complex and recurring issues are converted into reusable knowledge, corrective actions, or process improvements
* Ticket quality, handovers, and documentation consistently support reliable and audit-ready service delivery
* Team capability improves through coaching, quality review, and practical Quantum knowledge sharing
* Cross-functional collaboration leads to faster issue progress and stronger client outcomes

What FIS offers you
  
  

* An opportunity to support global treasury clients using a leading FIS treasury solution
* Learning and career development across product support, treasury, technology, and client service
* Exposure to global clients and cross-functional teams
* A collaborative and inclusive environment focused on ownership, continuous improvement, and client outcomes
* Health and family protection benefits, career mobility opportunities, learning offerings, and an adaptable home-office work model, subject to applicable company policies

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Sr Systems Engineer
description:
**Senior Systems Engineer**
We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, scalability, and reliability of our internal healthcare application platform. This role owns Kubernetes platform standards, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, operational excellence, and cost optimization. The role also mentors engineers and partners with development and leadership teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, own, and evolve the Kubernetes platform architecture for healthcare applications, including cluster strategy, upgrades, and multi-environment standards.
* Define and enforce standardized deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps (e.g., Argo CD or Flux).
* Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines with built-in security scanning, quality gates, and release governance.
* Lead IaC strategy with reusable Terraform modules, configuration management, and policy-as-code.
* Establish observability standards, SLOs/SLIs, and alerting. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
* Drive platform security and compliance (HIPAA, audit readiness, secrets management, RBAC, network policies, image hardening).
* Own cloud cost governance (FinOps): rightsizing, autoscaling, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, with measurable savings.
* Plan and test disaster recovery, backup, and high availability.
* Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and author technical documentation and runbooks.
* Partner with development, security, and leadership teams on the platform roadmap and technical decisions.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years in Systems Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production.
* Expert-level Kubernetes administration (AKS, EKS, or OpenShift), Docker, Kustomize and Helm.
* Proven experience designing CI/CD at scale with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins.
* Advanced Terraform skills (module design, state management) plus Ansible or similar tools.
* Strong scripting and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Deep Azure experience (networking, identity, security, cost management); multi-cloud is a plus.
* Hands-on observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK.
* Track record of leading production incidents and delivering reliability improvements.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2).
* GitOps, service mesh (Istio or Linkerd), and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno).
* FinOps practices and cloud cost tooling (Kubecost, Azure Cost Management).
* Relevant certifications: CKA/CKS, Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* A standardized, self-service Kubernetes platform adopted across application teams.
* Defined SLOs met consistently, with reduced incident frequency and faster recovery (MTTR).
* Majority of infrastructure and deployments fully automated through IaC and GitOps.
* Audit-ready platform security and compliance posture.
* Documented, measurable infrastructure cost savings.
* Stronger team capability through mentoring, standards, and documentation.

description:
**Responsibilities**

* Maintains plant critical spares inventory, in coordination with section heads, to meet the exigencies.

* Ensures electrical maintenance activities are performed in a safe, professional manner and in accordance with the industry standards, original equipment manufacturer’s recommendations and in line to approved standard operating procedures.
* Proffer solutions to solve electrical system related issues faced at Assets and ensure optimization of equipment reliability.
* Coordinate and monitor implementation of reliability centred maintenance (RCM) in conjunction with relevant section heads at Hydro and PSP Assets.
* Ensures compliance with industry standards, regulations, safety protocols, and safe system to work (SSOW) procedures.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends, innovations, and best practices in electrical engineering, to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure that all electrical aspects of the operations are managed effectively and efficiently.

**Qualifications**

* B.E/B. Tech/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* 15+ years of experience in O&M in large scale hydropower plants.
* Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro and PSS Plants.
* Maintenance experience of large-scale hydro and/or pump storage power plants is preferred
* Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works.
* Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.
* Advanced certifications in maintenance management or other power generation technologies or energy manager and auditor certification are preferred

Facility Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Facility Manager
  
Work Dynamics
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Leading on-site operations
  
Are you a pro at giving on-site support? Working with a team, you’ll oversee the day-to-day client activities for the assigned property or facility. You’ll also implement building procedures and performance measures—and ensure that they are maintained at all times. Likewise, you’ll boost on-site operations by promoting best practices and creating better processes. This job will also entail the question “How do I ensure the safety of my colleagues?” You will do this by promoting adherence to health and safety standards.
  
  
Winning our clients’ trust
  
As the facilities manager, you’ll be working frequently with clients, so you’ll need to build strong relationships with them. Likewise, you’ll need to be proactive and engaging; and make sure that the clients’ expectations are met each and every time. You will also be the go-to person for any facilities-related concerns.
  
  
Keeping an eye on budget and contracts
  
Do you have a solid background in finance management? As the person in charge, you will take care of the site’s financial operations. Also part of your job is to coordinate with vendors and suppliers, and make sure that they deliver quality work practices according to the contract, and at the right cost.
  
  
Promoting teamwork across the board
  
At JLL, we strongly believe that teamwork is the secret behind every successful company. Do you share our thoughts? If so, then you are what we’re looking for. In this role, you will support our people’s growth and development through effective training and coaching sessions. Likewise, you’ll promote a culture that upholds the ‘I am JLL’ core behaviours and fosters teamwork, cooperation and performance excellence. Also part of your job is to ensure that the team is constantly motivated, and that trust and work ethics prevail among members.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  
Competent and goal-driven
  
Do you have three to five years’ experience of managing a property? If so, you will be a perfect fit for the role. Likewise, an experience in managing commercial contracts and budgets may just help you land this job. You’ll also need to be a goal-oriented individual who’s an ace in health and safety requirements, vendor management and property technical systems management
  
  
Organised and analytical
  
We’re looking for a self-motivated and quick-thinking facilities manager who can solve problems using quantitative methods and holistic approaches. Likewise, we’re on the lookout for well-organised leaders who plan tasks in advance and constantly stay ahead of deadlines.
  
Engaging and professional
  
A passion for excellence is what makes a great facilities manager. We’ll need someone who can do more than the bare minimum to meet our clients’ expectations. In this role, you’ll also be working with different kinds of people, so you’ll need to be an expert in handling them professionally. Likewise, you’ll need to effectively manage, train and inspire the team to always do better. You’ll also need to take the time to listen to your people to create better work impact.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Manager, Program Management, Content Programs
description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced program management professional to lead an operations team and program management initiatives for the Kindle Content Programs org. This individual should be able to work in a fast-paced environment where they can affect the customer experience and add value to the business at the same time.
  
  
The Manager III, Program Management, will lead a multi-site operations team across two distinct workstreams, owning both ongoing operational delivery and a portfolio of strategic programs. For the operations workstream, this individual owns day-to-day operations, capacity planning with workforce management, partnership with technology and automation teams on process automation, handling of volume spikes and operational exceptions, process improvement, and staff management, including oversight of specialized technical services delivery in collaboration with global counterparts. In parallel, the role leads strategic programs spanning selection growth, publishing guidelines, and change management for that. This person must partner with multiple product teams and centrally manage relationships with third-party service providers. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail and the ability to set goals, develop strategy, and drive end-to-end execution and optimization
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Thinks strategically, makes data-driven decisions, and drives end-to-end execution to deliver results
  
  
Leads a team of operations managers, program managers, and associated ops within a business-strategy context, building operational strategies that remove roadblocks, handle exceptions, and improve efficiencies
  
  
Establishes process requirements, drives prioritization, and manages implementation across multiple teams
  
  
Is resourceful, analytical, and team-oriented, with strong communication and business skills and the ability to build stakeholder relationships that drive scalable, effective solutions
  
  
Thrives in a fast-paced environment owning business operations metrics, with a proven track record of end-to-end ownership and delivering results in dynamic situations
  
  
Handles ambiguity comfortably, decides swiftly, and is passionate about finding root causes and trends independently
  
  
Operates and influences without authority in a cross-functional environment, advocating for customers and identifying experience-improvement opportunities using data, defect information, and verbatims
  
  
Builds structured governance models that drive people, process, and improvement to optimize customer experience end-to-end
  
  
Drives program objectives: shapes strategies, defines project plans, manages implementation, and develops processes, documentation, and communications for rollout and ongoing support
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will lead the team with a focus on continuous improvement. You will apply strong people and project management skills, conducting in-depth analyses, thinking big, and identifying game-changing opportunities. You will be expected to deliver scalable, flexible solutions built on technology such as AI, while maintaining strong focus on people, customers, and business partners. You will work with internal and external stakeholders to identify, define, and specify solutions that meet our customers' needs. You will demonstrate execution in a dynamic operational environment and lead at both strategic and tactical levels by diving deep into metrics.
  
  
**About The Team**
Content Programs runs selection, quality, and content integrity across the Books org, spanning print and digital formats worldwide. Defects, selection gaps, and inconsistent content experiences erode customer trust and cost the business at scale, yet much of this work still depends on manual, human-intensive processes. The org runs programs to detect and prevent defects across print-on-demand and digital books, improve digital book selection across regions, and support key customer-facing feature launches through its Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) program. It also leads the digital comic business for Books (Comixology).
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

* **RCA & Escalation Management:** Identify operational issues, conduct root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* **Capacity Management:** Ensure available manpower is aligned with actual and projected business volumes across all projects.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify operational gaps, improve workflows and implement automation wherever possible.
* **Cost Management:** Monitor manpower utilisation and operational costs to maintain project efficiency.

* 3–6 years of experience in operations management, preferably in healthcare, e-commerce, BPO or service operations.

title: Director, Facilities Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Technical Services Manager
  
Integrated Facilities Management
  
Educational Qualification - BTech - Electrical
  
  
– Leading Global Technology company
  
  
Our client’s mission "to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful" has helped it become one of the few companies in the world worth more than one trillion US dollars.
  
  
The Asia Pacific region is an important part of our client’s success: occupying 65 offices across 13 countries. JLL helps our client achieve its ambitions by delivering the services and supporting the spaces that enables their business to thrive.
  
  
Kick start your career by working a team managing some of the world's most inspiring office spaces. With nearly 10 million square feet of office space across Asia, there is plenty of room to grow! The JLL account team has developed a unique culture, drawing and adapting from JLL and our client’s way of working and thinking.
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Leading Technical Services
  
You will be responsible for delivering superior technical services overseeing all operations of all building systems, ensuring they run efficiently, safely and cost-effectively. In an exciting and dynamic environment you’ll achieve excellence in managing critical operations and programs onsite with our client. You’ll ensure the highest standards are delivered and best practices implemented consistently. You’ll partner with vendors providing your expertise in managing the client environment and technical services, with a focus on continuous improvement and risk management.
  
  
This role will manage a team of technical services team members.
  
Responsible for providing outstanding client service, you’ll lead, monitor and mentor to effectively control technical services activity. This role will also support local and regional initiatives by driving consistent improvements in implementation and service delivery.
  
  
Act as a coach and mentor
  
You’ll play a key role in actively encouraging an environment that supports teamwork, cooperation, performance excellence and personal success. You’ll play the role of coach, motivating and developing team members through regular assessments of service delivery and always seeking to improve where possible.
  
  
Prioritizing the facilities needs—always
  
Experienced in technical services, you’ll be on top of all the mechanical, electrical, plumbing and civil works needed while managing facilities. Likewise, you’ll play an essential role in reducing workplace risks by maintaining visibility of maintenance, routine inspections and scheduled down times. You’ll stay in close contact with teams for all facility related issues, ensuring total compliance with all legal and technical services standards. You’ll be hands-on in your approach and while able to periodically review logs, checklists and maintenance schedules, you’ll also spearhead and implement cost saving and energy programs, improving efficiency and minimising environmental impact will see you succeed in this role.
  
  
Putting critical plans and reports in place
  
Planning is a big part of your mandate. In this role, you’ll take charge of planning and managing technical services budgets and contracts. Your expertise will be essential in planning and developing recommendations and effective inventory and planning management. You’ll be performing regular audits with a focus on cost savings, risk management and energy management. You’ll strive to keep any down time to a minimum by setting up best practices that promote seamless service delivery to our client. Your analytical skills will also come in handy, as the role requires you to record and report data accurately.
  
  
Winning our clients trust
  
As Technical Services Manager, you’ll be working with our client and will build strong relationships through your proactivity and engagement. You’ll make sure that the client expectations are met each and every time, being the go-to person for any technical services related queries.
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
**Sound like you? To apply you’ll need to be:**  
Experienced in Technical Services
  
For this role, you’ll need a minimum of engineering or technical services delivery in a facilities management environment. Furthermore, a strong knowledge of occupational safety requirements and improvement initiatives may help you land the job. A degree or a professional qualification in Engineering / Technical Services would be an advantage.
  
  
Well rounded skills
  
As Technical Services Manager, you will undeniably have very strong technical skills, for this role we’re looking for the full package, so you’ll need to demonstrate your expertise in interacting with a wide range of stakeholders and team members. Impeccable people skills will be a must have for this role as you’ll enjoy working within a diverse and inclusive team. You’ll take the time to listen to people in order to apply your expertise and create maximum positive impact.
  
  
An eye for detail
  
Do you have an eye for detail? Attention to detail combined with high level analytical skills are vital for success in this role, you’ll analyse qualitative and quantitative information and translate this into strategic deliverables.
  
  
Great organisational skills
  
We operate in a fast paced, high volume environment and you’ll need to keep up to speed. To do so you’ll have great time management and organisational skills, be good at meeting deadlines and be able to adapt to changing requirements.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
Apply today!
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Production Manager
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Production Manager - Greenfield)

As the Production Manager - Greenfield, you will play a pivotal role in establishing and leading manufacturing operations for Siemens Energy’s new Large Power Transformer factory. You will be responsible for developing world-class production processes, building operational capabilities, and ensuring safe, high-quality, and cost-effective manufacturing in line with project ramp-up objectives and business growth plans.

In this leadership role, you will oversee the readiness, commissioning, and operationalization of key production areas including Core Coil Assembly, Active Part Assembly, and Final Assembly. Working closely with engineering, quality, maintenance, EHS, project management, and technology transfer teams, you will ensure seamless factory setup while implementing best-in-class manufacturing practices to drive productivity, safety, quality, and operational excellence.

We are looking for an experienced manufacturing leader with strong expertise in large power transformer production, greenfield factory setup, and team development, who can successfully establish production operations and support Siemens Energy’s growth ambitions in India.

How You'll Make an Impact

* Lead the planning, establishment, and commissioning of production facilities for Core Coil Assembly, Active Part Assembly, and Final Assembly within a greenfield large power transformer manufacturing plant.

* Define manufacturing process requirements, production layouts, equipment specifications, tooling requirements, and operational workflows to support efficient and scalable production operations.

* Manage installation, commissioning, and operational readiness of assembly equipment, fixtures, handling systems, and supporting infrastructure.

* Coordinate closely with project, engineering, quality, maintenance, EHS, procurement, and technology transfer teams to ensure successful factory readiness and production ramp-up.

* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, inspection plans, process controls, and operational standards to support consistent manufacturing excellence.

* Lead production planning and resource allocation activities by effectively managing manpower, materials, tools, equipment, and third-party support services to achieve business objectives.

* Drive operational excellence through effective production management, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost targets.

* Establish competency frameworks and capability development programs for technicians, supervisors, and production teams to build a highly skilled and future-ready workforce.

* Develop manpower planning and shift deployment strategies to ensure optimum utilization of resources and uninterrupted production operations.

* Embed a strong health, safety, and environmental culture by promoting safe work practices, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives across all manufacturing activities.

* Ensure adherence to manufacturing specifications, engineering requirements, inspection plans, customer expectations, and quality management processes.

* Implement best practices for heavy lifting operations, crane handling, material movement, work-at-height activities, electrical equipment operation, and overall shopfloor safety.

* Establish and sustain 5S, visual management, lean manufacturing, Kaizen, and standard work methodologies to improve operational efficiency and workplace organization.

* Develop takt times, standard cycle times, work-in-progress (WIP) controls, and inter-process production targets to support balanced and efficient manufacturing flow.

* Identify production bottlenecks and implement line balancing, pull-based scheduling, and Drum-Buffer-Rope methodologies to optimize throughput and achieve delivery commitments.

* Drive productivity enhancement initiatives, cost optimization programs, and continuous improvement projects across manufacturing operations.

* Identify automation opportunities and leverage digital manufacturing tools and production-monitoring systems to enhance operational effectiveness and business performance.

* Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance teams to ensure process compliance, inspection readiness, and effective management of quality hold points.

* Partner with Maintenance and Utilities teams to maximize equipment reliability, uptime, and overall plant performance.

* Coordinate with Testing, Tanking, Logistics, and Project Management teams to ensure end-to-end production readiness and successful customer deliveries.
